papers.title: Tetris3D: 3D Scene Generation With Objects That Fit Together
papers.abstract_en: We propose Tetris3D, a generative framework for single-image 3D scene reconstruction that recovers objects which are physically and geometrically coherent as a scene. Existing methods often generate objects independently or couple them implicitly, providing limited guidance for ensuring fine-grained spatial compatibility between neighboring objects that interact with one another. To address this, we explicitly condition the generation of each object on the geometry of surrounding objects and their physical relationships, guiding its shape and pose to remain geometrically and physically plausible within the scene. Moreover, we introduce ComOb, a physics simulation-based dataset of 1.2M scenes featuring physical interactions across diverse object categories, with per-object meshes and pairwise physical relation annotations. Comprehensive experiments on synthetic and realworld scenes show that Tetris3D recovers coherent object shapes and poses even when interacting regions are occluded, and achieves state-of-the-art performance in both generation quality and physical stability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Tetris3D 把单图 3D 场景重建中每个物体的生成显式条件在周围物体几何与物理关系上，使形状与位姿在交互区域被遮挡时仍保持几何与物理一致。作者还构建了含 120 万场景的物理仿真数据集 ComOb，带逐物体 mesh 与成对物理关系标注；在合成与真实场景实验中达到生成质量与物理稳定性的 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 现有单图 3D 场景生成多独立生成各物体或仅隐式耦合，缺少对相邻交互物体之间细粒度空间兼容性的显式约束，导致物体间穿插或摆放不稳。
Method: 生成每个物体时显式以周围物体几何及其物理关系为条件，引导其形状与位姿在场景内保持合理；配套提出物理仿真数据集 ComOb，含 1.2M 场景、跨多样物体类别、逐物体 mesh 与成对物理关系标注。
Result: 在合成与真实场景上的综合实验显示，即使交互区域被遮挡，Tetris3D 仍能恢复连贯的物体形状与位姿，并在生成质量与物理稳定性两方面取得 state-of-the-art 表现；数据集规模为 1.2M 场景。
Conclusion: 把相邻物体的几何与物理关系作为显式生成条件，是让单图重建的多物体场景在遮挡下仍保持物理一致的有效路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Never Look Back: Understanding Persistence in 3D Object Memory from Egocentric Videos
papers.abstract_en: As we move through the world and carry out everyday tasks, we encounter objects that may become relevant only later. We are capable of recalling where we left something or what was inside a container, even without knowing we would need it later. Here, we study how an embodied assistant can build a similar memory from egocentric videos, by observing a person's day-to-day activities. We present Ledger, a persistent 3D object memory that combines object locations, their histories, and contextual descriptions. It associates observations across the recording and retains objects after they leave the view, including those the person never touches. It clusters each object's observations by resting locations and records a move only after repeated evidence, reducing the effect of localization noise. Short descriptions preserve details such as an object's contents or supporting surface. It saves these records to later answer spatial questions without having to access the original images or video. Our memory raises HD-EPIC accuracy from 29.7% to 42.6%, UCS-Bench accuracy from 33.8% to 38.5% and localizes Ego4D objects with a 0.99 m median error on returned predictions. Our analyses identify complementary roles for temporal persistence, contextual descriptions, and retrieval. Our study on 100 stitched streams of multiple scenes each further exposes failures in both retrieval and construction. Per-scene construction partially recovers the performance lost across scene changes compared to that of single scene streams.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Ledger 是面向具身助手的持久 3D 物体记忆：从第一人称视频中跨帧关联物体、按停留位置聚类并在重复证据后才记录移动，物体离开视野后仍保留，且用简短描述记录内容与支撑面，之后无需回看原图即可回答空间问题。在 HD-EPIC 上把准确率从 29.7% 提到 42.6%，UCS-Bench 从 33.8% 提到 38.5%，返回预测的 Ego4D 物体定位中位误差 0.99 m；100 条拼接多场景流的分析暴露检索与构建两侧的失败，逐场景构建可部分挽回跨场景切换损失的性能。
Motivation: 人在日常活动中会遇到事后才用得上的物体，具身助手需要在不回看原始图像或视频的前提下记住物体位置、历史与内容；而跨场景切换和定位噪声会让简单记忆失效。
Method: Ledger 结合物体位置、历史与上下文描述：跨录制关联观测，物体离开视野后仍保留（包括人从未触碰的物体）；按停留位置 (resting locations) 聚类每个物体的观测，只有重复证据才记为一次移动以抑制定位噪声；用简短描述保存内容与支撑面等细节，记录落盘供后续空间问答检索。
Result: HD-EPIC 准确率 29.7% → 42.6%，UCS-Bench 准确率 33.8% → 38.5%，返回预测上 Ego4D 物体定位中位误差 0.99 m；分析给出时间持久性、上下文描述与检索的互补作用；在 100 条多场景拼接流上，逐场景构建相比单场景流部分挽回跨场景切换造成的性能损失。
Conclusion: 持久 3D 物体记忆加重复证据驱动的移动判定能显著抬高第一人称空间问答准确率，但跨场景切换仍是检索与构建共同的失效点，逐场景构建只能部分恢复。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Decoupling Exploration from Optimization in RLVR
papers.abstract_en: Modern language models undergo reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) on top of already-trained checkpoints. A key promise of RLVR is the discovery of new reasoning strategies. In principle, a model can sample novel ideas absent from its prior training data. In practice, however, augmenting RLVR with strong novelty incentives has seen limited success and can degrade model quality. Because verifiable rewards supervise only a narrow slice of the model's knowledge and behavior, such degradations are difficult to recover from. Instead, we decouple exploration from optimization in a framework we call Exploration-Distillation (ExpDis). We train one or more explorer policies with a novelty bonus in the reward, filter their trajectories for correctness and quality, and distill them into a separate student policy. The student policy is then trained without a novelty bonus. We repeat the above procedure for several rounds, alternating between exploration and optimization. This decoupling allows us to aggressively scale exploration without degrading the student policy. Across seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks and two model families, ExpDis outperforms DAPO at the same wall-clock budget. Moreover, we observe improved pass@$k$ scaling, indicating that ExpDis produces models that generate more diverse correct solutions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Exploration-Distillation (ExpDis)：把带 novelty bonus 的探索与策略优化拆开，用探索策略采样并按正确性与质量过滤轨迹，蒸馏进不带 novelty bonus 的学生策略，多轮交替。在七个数学推理 benchmark、两个模型家族上，同等 wall-clock 预算下超过 DAPO，pass@k 曲线更好，说明产出的正确解更多样。
Motivation: RLVR 的一个核心承诺是发现训练数据中没有的新推理策略，但直接在奖励里加 novelty incentive 收效有限且会拉低模型质量；可验证奖励只监督模型知识与行为的一小片，退化难以恢复。
Method: ExpDis 框架：训练一个或多个 explorer policy，奖励中含 novelty bonus；对其轨迹按正确性与质量过滤，蒸馏进独立的 student policy，学生训练时不加 novelty bonus；上述探索—优化过程重复多轮交替。
Result: 在七个数学推理 benchmark、两个模型家族上，ExpDis 在相同 wall-clock 预算下优于 DAPO；pass@k scaling 得到改善，表明模型能生成更多样的正确解。
Conclusion: 把探索与优化解耦后可以激进地放大探索强度而不损害学生策略，novelty 激励应放在被蒸馏的探索者身上而非最终优化目标里。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Long-WAM: Scaling the Context of World-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Real-time robot control demands enough visual history to infer motion and task progress, but processing that history can delay action. We present Long-WAM, a model-system framework for scaling the context of causal world-action models under real-time control constraints. Our central finding is that access to history is not the same as using it: longer histories pay off far more when the video foundation is pretrained autoregressively (AR). We first learn causal prediction from robot and egocentric videos without action labels, then preserve this history-to-future structure during world-action adaptation. On RoboCasa GR-1, increasing context from 0.0 to 19.2 seconds raises success from 63.3% to 78.7%, whereas a bidirectionally pretrained initialization shows no net gain; robot-domain AR pretraining further raises peak success on GR-1 and LIBERO-Long. Long-WAM also achieves the best results among compared methods on LIBERO-Long, RoboTwin 2.0, and DOMINO. Streaming observation encoding, asynchronous execution, and hardware-specific acceleration enable deployment on RTX 5090, DGX Spark, and Jetson AGX Thor without dropping future prediction; on RTX 5090, each action chunk, including future-video latent prediction, takes 107.4 ms. Real-time deployment on Unitree G1 and YAM supports dynamic and long-horizon manipulation, including 95% success on dynamic cup stacking, where Pi0.5 and Fast-WAM succeed in none of 20 trials. As a memory-informed executor, Long-WAM also complements higher-level planning in composite tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Long-WAM 在实时机器人控制下扩展因果 world-action model 的视觉历史上下文，核心发现是「有历史」不等于「用历史」：只有当视频基座以自回归 (AR) 方式预训练时，更长历史才兑现收益。RoboCasa GR-1 上上下文从 0.0 秒增至 19.2 秒，成功率由 63.3% 升到 78.7%，而双向预训练的初始化没有净增益。
Motivation: 实时机器人控制需要足够视觉历史来推断运动与任务进度，但处理历史会拖慢动作输出；同时不清楚长上下文在何种预训练方式下才真正起作用。
Method: 先在机器人视频与第一视角 (egocentric) 视频上无动作标签地学习因果预测，再在 world-action 适配阶段保留 history-to-future 结构；配合流式观测编码、异步执行与硬件特定加速，使未来视频 latent 预测与动作块一起完成。
Result: RoboCasa GR-1 上下文 0.0→19.2 秒使成功率 63.3%→78.7%，双向预训练初始化无净增益；机器人域 AR 预训练进一步抬高 GR-1 与 LIBERO-Long 的峰值成功率；在 LIBERO-Long、RoboTwin 2.0、DOMINO 上取得对比方法中最佳结果；RTX 5090 上每个动作块（含未来视频 latent 预测）耗时 107.4 ms，可部署于 RTX 5090、DGX Spark、Jetson AGX Thor；Unitree G1 与 YAM 实机上动态叠杯成功率 95%，而 Pi0.5 与 Fast-WAM 在 20 次试验中全部失败。
Conclusion: 长历史的价值取决于 AR 预训练基座，双向初始化会浪费上下文；把 AR 因果结构保留到 world-action 适配并配合流式编码，可在不丢弃未来预测的前提下满足实时控制。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Decentralized SGD under Heavy-Tailed Noise: Optimal Convergence Rates and the Role of Gradient Clipping
papers.abstract_en: Heavy-tailed noise has been widely observed in modern machine learning, motivating the use of methods like gradient clipping and normalization. While these methods are well understood in centralized settings, much less is known in decentralized ones, where applying a nonlinearity to local gradients affects both optimization and consensus. Recent works on decentralized non-convex optimization have studied both clipping and normalization under heavy-tailed noise, with clipping yielding suboptimal rates and normalization needing local momentum or mini-batches to converge. This raises the question: can a baseline decentralized method using a nonlinearity achieve optimal convergence rates under heavy-tailed noise? We answer affirmatively with clipped decentralized SGD ($\mathtt{DSGD}$). For smooth non-convex costs under bounded $p$-th moment noise, $p \in (1,2]$, we show that clipped $\mathtt{DSGD}$ achieves order-optimal rates both with high probability and in expectation. Moreover, we establish a linear speed-up in the number of agents, which, to our knowledge, has not been shown for decentralized methods with clipping. The key technical ingredient is a sharp analysis of the consensus gap that exploits the structure of clipping, relegating network effects to higher-order terms. Our results highlight an important distinction between clipping and normalization in decentralized settings: while normalized $\mathtt{DSGD}$ can fail to converge, clipping retains magnitude information, enabling $\mathtt{DSGD}$ to be convergent and order-optimal. Numerical experiments validate our theory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在重尾噪声（有界 p 阶矩，p∈(1,2]）下，带梯度裁剪的去中心化 SGD 对光滑非凸目标可同时达到高概率与期望意义下的 order-optimal 收敛率，并在智能体数量上呈线性加速。关键在于裁剪保留梯度幅值信息，而归一化 DSGD 可能不收敛。
Motivation: 去中心化非凸优化中，对局部梯度施加非线性会同时影响优化与一致性；已有裁剪方案收敛率次优，归一化则需局部动量或小批量才能收敛，尚不清楚基线去中心化方法能否在重尾噪声下取得最优率。
Method: 提出 clipped DSGD：对各智能体局部梯度做裁剪后按去中心化方式聚合；核心分析是对 consensus gap 的精细刻画，利用裁剪结构把网络效应压入高阶项，从而在有界 p 阶矩噪声（p∈(1,2]）与光滑非凸代价下推导收敛率。
Result: clipped DSGD 在高概率与期望两种意义下均达到 order-optimal 收敛率，并建立对智能体数量的线性加速（作者称此前未在带裁剪的去中心化方法中展示）；对比之下 normalized DSGD 可能不收敛。数值实验验证了理论。
Conclusion: 裁剪与归一化在去中心化场景存在本质差别：裁剪保留幅值信息因而可收敛且 order-optimal，归一化则可能失败；重尾噪声下去中心化 SGD 用裁剪即可取最优率并随智能体数线性加速。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出 clipped DSGD：对各智能体局部梯度做裁剪后按去中心化方式聚合；核心分析是对 consensus gap 的精细刻画，利用裁剪结构把网络效应压入高阶项，从而在有界 p 阶矩噪声（p∈(1,2]）与光滑非凸代价下推导收敛率。
summary_sections.result: clipped DSGD 在高概率与期望两种意义下均达到 order-optimal 收敛率，并建立对智能体数量的线性加速（作者称此前未在带裁剪的去中心化方法中展示）；对比之下 normalized DSGD 可能不收敛。数值实验验证了理论。
summary_sections.conclusion: 裁剪与归一化在去中心化场景存在本质差别：裁剪保留幅值信息因而可收敛且 order-optimal，归一化则可能失败；重尾噪声下去中心化 SGD 用裁剪即可取最优率并随智能体数线性加速。

papers.title: Rephrase Before You Act: Characterizing and Mitigating Language Sensitivity in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) are strikingly sensitive to instruction phrasing and do not inherit the language robustness of the vision-language models they are built on. A one-word edit can move success by tens of points: $π_{0.5}$ turns on a LIBERO stove 100% of the time for "switch on the stove" and 2% for "switch on the hot plate", and a $π_0$ checkpoint finetuned with rephrase augmentation still shows swings of up to 61 points. We characterize this sensitivity with statistically tested single-edit swings and an oracle phrase search, which shows that phrasing alone nearly closes the 21-point gap between in-distribution and out-of-distribution tasks. We then reduce it without modifying the policy. Because the sensitivity is systematic, it can be expressed as explicit rules: we score many phrasings of a few training tasks, have a large language model distill the evidence into ten to twenty rephrasing rules, and at deployment rewrite each incoming instruction once under these rules. The rules improve the frozen $π_0$ by 16 to 27% relative on twelve held-out tasks across adversarial, VLM-generated, and human-generated phrasings, with gains concentrated on out-of-distribution tasks. The pipeline replicates on $π_{0.5}$ and LIBERO, lifting in-finetune success from 93.6% to 97.8%. The method requires no retraining and no per-step verification, and applies zero-shot to unseen tasks and instructions. Project website: https://sttawm.github.io/rephrase-before-you-act
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLA 模型对指令措辞极度敏感：LIBERO 上 π0.5 说 "switch on the stove" 成功率 100%，说 "switch on the hot plate" 只有 2%，一词之差可摆动数十个百分点。作者把这种敏感性刻画为可显式规则化的系统偏差，用 LLM 从多措辞打分证据中蒸馏出 10–20 条改写规则，部署时对每条指令做一次改写，不改策略、不重训。冻结 π0 在 12 个留出任务上相对提升 16–27%，增益集中在分布外任务。
Motivation: VLA 继承了底层 VLM 的规模却没继承其语言鲁棒性，一词编辑即可让成功率摆动数十个百分点，且经改写增强微调的检查点仍有最高 61 点的摆动，导致同一机器人任务在不同措辞下表现不可靠。
Method: 先用统计检验的单编辑摆动 (single-edit swings) 与 oracle 短语搜索刻画敏感性；再对少量训练任务的多种措辞打分，让 LLM 把证据蒸馏成 10–20 条改写规则，部署时按规则对每条输入指令做一次改写，策略保持冻结。
Result: π0.5 在 LIBERO 上 "switch on the stove" 成功率 100%、"switch on the hot plate" 2%；改写增强微调的 π0 检查点仍有最高 61 点摆动；oracle 短语搜索显示仅靠措辞就几乎抹平分布内与分布外任务间 21 点的差距。规则使冻结 π0 在 12 个留出任务（对抗性、VLM 生成、人工生成措辞）上相对提升 16–27%，增益集中在分布外任务；在 π0.5 与 LIBERO 上复现，把 in-finetune 成功率从 93.6% 提到 97.8%。
Conclusion: VLA 的措辞敏感性是系统性的、可写成显式规则，因此在部署时改写一次指令即可缓解，无需重训、无需逐步验证，并可零样本迁移到未见任务与指令。

papers.title: GRACE: Generation-aware latent compression for efficient video generation
papers.abstract_en: Highly compressed video autoencoders offer an effective way to accelerate video diffusion models, as the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) operates on far fewer tokens. However, such autoencoders are challenging to train, since a higher compression ratio degrades reconstruction quality and recovering it requires more channels, which is known to slow the convergence of the DiT. The compressed latent also differs from the one the DiT was trained on, so the pretrained DiT must be either retrained from scratch or adapted at considerable cost. Compressing the autoencoder the DiT was trained with appears to preserve compatibility, yet optimizing it for reconstruction alone still shifts the latent away from the distribution the DiT has learned. To address this, we propose Generation-Aware Latent Compression for Efficient Video Generation (GRACE), a two-stage framework that compresses a pretrained video autoencoder while keeping it compatible with the pretrained DiT. Specifically, we keep a frozen base latent from the pretrained encoder and learn a residual latent for the information lost under stronger compression, while aligning the compressed latent with the pretrained latent in the feature space of the frozen DiT so that the autoencoder is optimized for generation. We then adapt the DiT with lightweight fine-tuning and asymmetric denoising, where the base is denoised ahead of the residual. GRACE reduces the token count of Wan2.1-I2V-14B by 8x and its latency by 11.1x at 480x832x81, while matching the generation quality of the pretrained pipeline before compression on VBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GRACE 在不重训 DiT 的前提下把预训练视频自编码器压得更狠：冻结原编码器得到 base latent，用残差 latent 补回强压缩丢掉的信息，并在冻结 DiT 的特征空间里对齐压缩 latent 与原 latent，再用轻量微调加非对称去噪（先去噪 base 再去噪 residual）适配 DiT。结果是 Wan2.1-I2V-14B 在 480x832x81 上 token 数降为 1/8、延迟降为 1/11.1，VBench 生成质量与压缩前的预训练管线持平。
Motivation: 高压缩比自编码器难训：重建质量下降要靠更多通道补，而通道变多又拖慢 DiT 收敛；换新压缩自编码器则 latent 分布偏离，预训练 DiT 只能重训或高成本适配，即使只优化重建也会让 latent 漂移。
Method: 两阶段框架：先冻结预训练编码器保留 base latent，学习一个承载强压缩损失信息的 residual latent，并在冻结 DiT 的特征空间中把压缩 latent 与预训练 latent 对齐，使自编码器按生成目标而非纯重建优化；随后对 DiT 做轻量微调与非对称去噪，residual 在 base 之后去噪。
Result: 在 Wan2.1-I2V-14B、480x832x81 设置下，token 数减少 8 倍、延迟降低 11.1 倍，VBench 上的生成质量与压缩前的预训练管线相当。
Conclusion: 压缩自编码器时把 latent 对齐放进冻结 DiT 的特征空间并用残差承载损失信息，可以在保留预训练 DiT 兼容性的同时拿到数量级的 token 与延迟收益。

papers.title: Distilling Graph Geometry: Knowledge Gap from GNNs to MLPs
papers.abstract_en: GNN-to-MLP distillation aims to retain the predictive accuracy of a message-passing teacher while deploying a graph-free MLP at inference. Existing methods mainly transfer node-wise predictions or use confidence-based reweighting, but they do not specify where the student should preserve the teacher's graph-induced geometry. We show that this omission leads to two spectral failure modes in the student's representation space. On sparse graphs, the student suffers from spectral underfit, missing high-energy teacher directions concentrated near boundary regions. On dense graphs, it suffers from spectral overfit, retaining spurious directions that the teacher has collapsed through aggregation. Motivated by an energy-weighted teacher-student alignment objective, we propose Graph Geometry-aware MLP (G^2MLP), a training-time distillation framework guided by Ollivier-Ricci curvature. Curvature identifies where the two spectral errors concentrate and is used to allocate supervision between prediction-level and representation-level alignment. The deployed model remains a standard MLP and requires no graph access at inference. Across node-classification benchmarks, G^2MLP consistently improves over graph-free distillation baselines, reduces the teacher-student rank gap in both regimes, and transfers without architectural changes to Graph Transformer teachers and link prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GNN-to-MLP 蒸馏只搬节点预测或按置信度加权，学生在表示空间出现两种谱失效：稀疏图上谱欠拟合（丢掉集中在边界区域的高能教师方向），稠密图上谱过拟合（保留教师聚合已塌缩的伪方向）。提出 G²MLP，用 Ollivier-Ricci 曲率定位两类谱误差的集中位置，据此在预测级与表示级对齐之间分配监督；部署仍是标准 MLP，推理不需图。
Motivation: 现有 GNN-to-MLP 蒸馏不指明学生应在何处保持教师的图诱导几何，导致学生表示空间在稀疏图上欠拟合高能方向、在稠密图上保留伪方向，推理时又要丢掉图结构。
Method: 以能量加权的教师-学生对齐目标 (energy-weighted teacher-student alignment) 为核心，提出训练期蒸馏框架 G²MLP：用 Ollivier-Ricci 曲率定位两类谱误差集中处，再据此在预测级对齐与表示级对齐之间分配监督；推理时只用标准 MLP，无需图访问。
Result: 在节点分类基准上，G²MLP 相对 graph-free 蒸馏基线一致提升，并在稀疏与稠密两种体制下都缩小教师-学生的秩差距 (rank gap)；无需架构改动即可迁移到 Graph Transformer 教师与链接预测任务。
Conclusion: 把教师的图诱导几何（谱能量分布）显式对齐、并用曲率决定监督分配，可以在保持无图推理的前提下保住 GNN 教师的预测精度，且该做法跨教师架构与任务通用。

papers.title: Why Forget-Only Unlearning Needs Memorization
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning asks for a deletion algorithm whose output is close to retraining from scratch without the selected forget examples. In this work, we study forget-only unlearning, where the deletion algorithm receives only the trained model and the examples to forget, with no retained data or extra training information. We ask whether forget-only unlearning is always possible. We first show that this depends on the learning method: different datasets can produce the same trained model but require very different outputs after the same examples are removed. Using this observation, we derive lower bounds on how accurately unlearning can match retraining and instantiate them for several standard learning algorithms. We then ask what must be true when forget-only unlearning succeeds. To this end, we derive lower bounds on what an algorithm must memorize about the training data to handle arbitrary deletion requests. For simple threshold learners, the required information can be as large as the entire dataset, even though ordinary training keeps only one boundary point. Overall, our results show that information discarded during ordinary learning may be needed later for deletion, so models designed for forget-only unlearning may need to retain more information than standard training does.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文证明 forget-only unlearning（只给模型和待删样本、不给保留数据）能否复现重训练结果取决于学习算法本身：不同数据集可产生同一训练模型，却在删除同一样本后要求截然不同的输出。由此导出遗忘精度下界，并证明算法为处理任意删除请求必须记住的训练信息量下界——对简单 threshold learner，该信息量可大到整个数据集，而普通训练只保留一个边界点。
Motivation: 遗忘算法的标准要求是输出接近「去掉遗忘样本后从头重训练」，但 forget-only 设定下没有保留数据与训练信息，其可行性本身未被界定；若不可行，删除保证就是空的。
Method: 先构造「不同数据集产生同一训练模型、删除同一样本后要求不同输出」的实例，据此推导 unlearning 匹配 retraining 的精度下界，并对若干标准学习算法具体化；再推导算法为应对任意删除请求必须关于训练数据记忆的信息量下界，并在 threshold learner 上实例化。
Result: 得到两类下界：unlearning 逼近 retraining 的精度下界，以及必须记忆的训练信息量下界；对简单 threshold learner，所需信息量可与整个数据集一样大，而普通训练只保留一个边界点。
Conclusion: 普通学习中丢弃的信息在删除时可能被需要，因此面向 forget-only unlearning 的模型设计可能必须比标准训练保留更多信息。

papers.title: RoboJEPA: Scaling Robotic Latent World Models
papers.abstract_en: Latent world models have shown a remarkable ability to predict future states and to plan in the real world. In practice, however, we lack a principled way to estimate how their capabilities scale with model size, data, and compute, an open problem that slows progress in the field. In this work we present RoboJEPA, a world model based on the Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) and trained on a large-scale dataset spanning 12 robotic embodiments. We show that RoboJEPA's imagination error, the error of its latent rollouts, follows a second-order power law in compute, allowing us to predict model quality well beyond the scale at which the law is fit. We further show that downstream robotic planning performance improves predictably with compute, and that imagination error is strongly correlated with it, making it a reliable proxy for real-robot evaluation. Finally, we demonstrate that latent world models can be deployed zero-shot as robotic agents, planning toward a single goal image to solve tasks requiring long-horizon planning on real hardware. We release all model checkpoints together with our training and robot deployment code. To our knowledge, this is the first work to establish scaling laws for multi-embodiment robotic world models trained on real robot data, and RoboJEPA, at 8B parameters, is the largest JEPA predictor model trained to date.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: SciExam for ENSO: Can AI Agents Build Climate Models?
papers.abstract_en: Language-model agents are increasingly asked to carry out open-ended scientific research, yet their results are usually graded against a known answer, a rubric, or a language-model reviewer, none of which can tell whether a new scientific model is valid. The AI Science Exam for El Nino-Southern Oscillation (SciExam for ENSO) is a benchmark in which agents build low-order stochastic models of ENSO, the dominant mode of interannual climate variability, from real observations. Within a six-hour budget, agents process the observations, write their own diagnostics, which are then frozen, and develop a model using only these diagnostics as feedback. Hidden graders then test whether the model reproduces ENSO's statistics, recovers unobserved variables, and forecasts held-out years, and score a published model in the same way. Across twelve agent systems, six produce models that score higher than the published model, mainly through better reconstruction and forecasting. The simplified forms of the stronger models are each compatible with one of the two competing explanations of ENSO's warm-cold asymmetry, an open debate that the task never mentions. Controlled runs of the top system under varied information suggest that its scores do not come from recalling the dated observational record and that the information it receives shapes how it builds its model. SciExam for ENSO can thus evaluate agent research where no answer is known, and the results suggest that agents can already build competitive models whose structures bear on questions that scientists still debate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SciExam for ENSO 基准：让 AI agent 在六小时预算内从真实观测构建 ENSO 低阶随机模型，诊断程序先冻结、只以诊断输出为反馈，再由隐藏评分器检验统计量复现、未观测变量恢复和留出年份预报，并用同一套标准评一篇已发表模型。十二个 agent 系统中有六个产出的模型得分超过该已发表模型，优势主要来自重建与预报；更强模型的简化形式各自兼容 ENSO 冷暖不对称两种竞争解释之一，而任务本身从未提及这场争论。
Motivation: 现有 agent 科研评测依赖已知答案、评分细则或 LLM 评审，无法判断一个新提出的科学模型本身是否有效；需要在没有标准答案的场景下检验 agent 独立建模的能力。
Method: 以真实观测为输入，agent 在六小时内自行编写诊断程序（随后冻结），仅用这些诊断作为反馈迭代开发 ENSO 低阶随机模型；隐藏评分器从统计量复现、未观测变量恢复、留出年份预报三方面打分，并对一篇已发表模型施加同样评分；另对最优系统做不同信息条件下的受控运行。
Result: 十二个 agent 系统中六个的模型得分高于已发表模型，提升主要来自重建与预报；更强模型的简化形式分别兼容 ENSO 冷暖不对称的两种竞争解释；对最优系统的受控运行表明其得分并非来自背记观测记录，且所获信息会改变其建模方式。
Conclusion: agent 已能在无标准答案的科研任务中构建具有竞争力的 ENSO 模型，其模型结构还触及科学家仍在争论的问题；SciExam 类基准可用于评测这类开放式 agent 科研。

papers.title: Video-Conditioned Generative Joint 2D-3D Hand Motion Recovery
papers.abstract_en: Recovering faithful 3D hand motion from video remains challenging due to frequent occlusions and incomplete visual observations, which make frame-wise pose estimates unreliable and temporally inconsistent. To address this problem, we propose JoHan, a unified generative framework that recovers hand motion directly from video sequences without relying on intermediate per-frame pose predictions. Trained from scratch, our model jointly generates aligned 2D and 3D local hand pose sequences by learning their temporal dynamics and cross-representation correspondence. The generated 2D trajectories exploit direct spatial and temporal cues from the 2D images to guide the following generative 3D motion reconstruction, while the learned motion prior promotes temporal consistency. Their learned 2D-3D correspondence further enables recovery of the hand's global position and orientation relative to the camera. Extensive experiments on challenging benchmarks demonstrate significantly improved accuracy and speed in local hand-pose and camera-space reconstruction. Notably, our method captures much better hand-motion dynamics, producing significantly smoother motion than previous methods while maintaining high per-frame pose accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 JoHan：一个从视频序列直接联合生成 2D 与 3D 局部手部姿态序列的统一生成框架，绕开逐帧中间姿态预测。生成的 2D 轨迹用图像中的时空线索引导后续 3D 生成式重建，学到的运动先验保证时间一致性，2D-3D 对应再恢复相机下的全局位置与朝向；实验显示局部手姿与相机空间重建的精度和速度均显著提升，运动明显更平滑且逐帧精度保持高。
Motivation: 视频中频繁遮挡与不完整观测使逐帧姿态估计不可靠且时间上不一致，难以恢复忠实的 3D 手部运动。
Method: JoHan 从零训练，不经逐帧中间姿态，直接从视频序列联合生成对齐的 2D 与 3D 局部手姿序列：学习两者的时间动态与跨表示对应；2D 轨迹提供图像时空线索引导生成式 3D 运动重建，运动先验约束时间一致性，学到的 2D-3D 对应进一步给出手相对相机的全局位置与朝向。
Result: 在多个有挑战性的 benchmark 上，局部手姿与相机空间重建的精度和速度均显著优于先前方法；手部运动动态捕捉更好，运动显著更平滑，同时保持高的逐帧姿态精度。
Conclusion: 绕开逐帧姿态、直接联合生成 2D-3D 手姿序列，可以在遮挡条件下同时拿到时间一致性、平滑运动与逐帧精度。

papers.title: RECAST: Learning to Compute the Right Context through Adaptive Evidence Routing
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly applied to tasks grounded in long, heterogeneous information sources. Conventional Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) relies on fixed similarity-based retrieval, while agentic variants adapt queries and tool use but remain largely retrieval-centric. However, in many tasks, the evidence required for a solution is not explicitly present in any single source item. Instead, it must be derived through filtering, aggregation, or computation across multiple source items. In this work, we introduce RECAST (Routing Evidence through Computation, Access, and Synthesized Tools), a learned framework that formulates evidence construction as a sequential decision process over heterogeneous retrieval and computation operations, allowing evidence to be actively derived rather than merely retrieved. A lightweight RouterLM iteratively selects and formulates primitive operations or specifies customized operations for a frozen CompilerLM to translate into executable code. Once it judges the evidence sufficient, RouterLM passes the accepted evidence to a frozen AnswerLM to produce the final solution. We train RouterLM with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by group relative policy optimization (GRPO). Across six heterogeneous benchmark families, RECAST achieves a mean success rate of 75.6%, outperforming the strongest large-model baseline by 15.9%. Moreover, training enables the Qwen3.5-9B RouterLM to outperform a training-free Gemini 3.5 Flash RouterLM by 5.0%. On three held-out benchmarks, RECAST improves over the strongest baseline by 15.0% on average, demonstrating strong zero-shot generalization across tasks and heterogeneous source representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RECAST 把 RAG 的证据获取改写成在异构检索与计算算子上的序贯决策：轻量 RouterLM 迭代选择或定制算子，交给冻结的 CompilerLM 生成可执行代码，判定证据充分后再由冻结的 AnswerLM 作答。在六个异构 benchmark 家族上平均成功率 75.6%，比最强大模型基线高 15.9%；训练后的 Qwen3.5-9B RouterLM 比免训练的 Gemini 3.5 Flash RouterLM 高 5.0%。
Motivation: 常规 RAG 依赖固定相似度检索，agentic 变体虽能改写查询与工具使用但仍以检索为中心；而很多任务的证据不存在于任何单一来源条目中，需要跨多条目过滤、聚合或计算才能得到。
Method: RouterLM 以序贯决策方式在异构检索与计算原语中迭代选择、表述或指定定制算子，由冻结的 CompilerLM 翻译成可执行代码；RouterLM 判定证据充分后把证据交给冻结的 AnswerLM 产出答案。RouterLM 用监督微调 (SFT) 加 GRPO 训练。
Result: 在六个异构 benchmark 家族上平均成功率 75.6%，比最强的大模型基线高 15.9%；训练后的 Qwen3.5-9B RouterLM 比免训练的 Gemini 3.5 Flash RouterLM 高 5.0%；在三个 held-out benchmark 上平均比最强基线高 15.0%。
Conclusion: 把证据构造当作可学习的序贯决策而非固定检索，能让小模型 RouterLM 超过免训练的更大模型，并在未见任务与异构来源表示上保持零样本泛化。

papers.title: Validity Without Ground Truth: What Stated-Preference Economics Offers the Evaluation of Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Many of the questions now put to large language models have no correct answer to score against: what a policy is worth, which option a user should choose, how to weigh competing values. Stated-preference economics has faced this problem for decades. It judges survey responses without knowing the true value, through a framework of validity and related concepts: content, construct, and criterion validity, reliability, incentive compatibility, and consequentiality. We argue that this framework is a general method for evaluating language models, and we set out what each concept means for LLM evaluation. We demonstrate the approach using a published water-quality stated preference economic valuation survey (Vossler et al. 2023) administered to six models. In this economic application, the validity tests take the form of predictions from economic theory: demand should slope down, and willingness to pay should respond to the scope of the good and to income. The tests separate the models sharply. Two older models fail the most basic test at a household income level of \$75,000, and the two newest pass every test of theoretical validity we can score, but diverge on convergent validity. Passing validity tests shows that a model's answers are coherent, not that they are correct.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把陈述偏好经济学 (stated-preference economics) 的效度框架移植为 LLM 评测方法：用内容、构念、准则效度、信度、激励相容与结果性等概念，在无真值可对的情况下判断模型回答是否自洽。在 Vossler et al. 2023 的水质支付意愿问卷上测六个模型，效度检验表现为经济理论预测（需求向下倾斜、支付意愿随标的范围与家庭收入变化），两个较旧模型在家庭收入 75,000 美元处连最基本检验都失败，两个最新模型通过全部可打分的理论效度检验但在收敛效度上分歧。
Motivation: LLM 常被问及政策价值、选项取舍这类没有标准答案可对分的问题，传统准确率评测失效；陈述偏好经济学数十年来正是在不知真实价值的情况下评判问卷回答。
Method: 以已发表的水质陈述偏好估值问卷 (Vossler et al. 2023) 作为评测载体，对六个 LLM 施测，把效度检验具体化为经济理论预测：需求应向下倾斜、支付意愿应对商品范围与收入作出响应，并按内容、构念、准则效度与收敛效度分别打分。
Result: 两个较旧模型在家庭收入 75,000 美元处未通过最基本的需求向下倾斜检验；两个最新模型通过全部可打分的理论效度检验，但在收敛效度 (convergent validity) 上相互分歧。
Conclusion: 通过效度检验只说明模型回答内部自洽，并不等于回答正确；效度框架可作为无真值场景下 LLM 评测的一般方法。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.tldr: 把陈述偏好经济学 (stated-preference economics) 的效度框架移植为 LLM 评测方法：用内容、构念、准则效度、信度、激励相容与结果性等概念，在无真值可对的情况下判断模型回答是否自洽。在 Vossler et al. 2023 的水质支付意愿问卷上测六个模型，效度检验表现为经济理论预测（需求向下倾斜、支付意愿随标的范围与家庭收入变化），两个较旧模型在家庭收入 75,000 美元处连最基本检验都失败，两个最新模型通过全部可打分的理论效度检验但在收敛效度上分歧。

summary_sections.method: 以已发表的水质陈述偏好估值问卷 (Vossler et al. 2023) 作为评测载体，对六个 LLM 施测，把效度检验具体化为经济理论预测：需求应向下倾斜、支付意愿应对商品范围与收入作出响应，并按内容、构念、准则效度与收敛效度分别打分。
summary_sections.result: 两个较旧模型在家庭收入 75,000 美元处未通过最基本的需求向下倾斜检验；两个最新模型通过全部可打分的理论效度检验，但在收敛效度 (convergent validity) 上相互分歧。

papers.title: Oracle-Efficient and Parameter-Free Agnostic Smoothed Online Learning
papers.abstract_en: Online learning is an attractive framework in many domains because it permits well-defined learning even when data are dependent or chosen adversarially. This generality, however, comes at a steep price, introducing significant statistical and computational barriers. Recently, smoothed online learning has emerged as a promising framework that interpolates between the fully adversarial and fully stochastic settings by assuming that the conditional law of each covariate has density at most $1/σ$ with respect to some fixed base measure $μ$, and it is known to match the statistical and computational guarantees of classical learning while still allowing for much of the flexibility of online learning. However, existing oracle-efficient algorithms require either (i) sampling access to the base measure $μ$ or (ii) labels that are perfectly predicted by a fixed hypothesis. Both assumptions limit the applicability of these algorithms, in contrast to statistical learning, where empirical risk minimization (ERM) learns efficiently in the agnostic setting without any knowledge of the data distribution. We show that neither assumption is necessary, giving the first oracle-efficient algorithm that achieves sublinear regret in the agnostic setting without knowledge of $μ$. Our algorithm, based on Gaussian Follow-The-Perturbed-Leader, is parameter-free: it requires no knowledge of $μ$, the smoothing parameter $σ$, or the horizon $T$, and it achieves regret $\widetilde O(d\sqrt{T/σ})$ for binary classes of VC dimension $d$ with a single call to an ERM oracle per round, which is optimal up to a $\sqrt{d}$ factor. En route to establishing the regret bound, we introduce several new techniques that may be of independent interest.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 smoothed online learning 中给出首个 agnostic、oracle-efficient 且 parameter-free 的算法：基于 Gaussian Follow-The-Perturbed-Leger，每轮只调用一次 ERM oracle，无需知道基测度 μ、平滑参数 σ 或时域 T。对 VC 维 d 的二分类假设类达到 regret Õ(d√(T/σ))，在 √d 因子内最优。
Motivation: 现有 oracle-efficient smoothed online learning 算法要么需要对基测度 μ 的采样访问，要么要求标签被固定假设完美预测，无法像统计学习中的 ERM 那样在 agnostic 设定下高效学习。
Method: 算法基于 Gaussian Follow-The-Perturbed-Leader，每轮仅调用一次 ERM oracle；不依赖 μ 的采样、σ 或 T 的先验知识，并在推导 regret 界的过程中引入若干新技术。
Result: 对 VC 维 d 的二分类类，regret 为 Õ(d√(T/σ))，在 √d 因子内最优；每轮一次 ERM oracle 调用，且无需 μ、σ、T 的知识。
Conclusion: 对 smoothed online learning，采样访问 μ 与标签可被固定假设完美预测这两项假设都不是必要的，agnostic 设定下可实现 sublinear regret。

papers.title: EmbodiedRSI: Active Continual Robot Learning Through Hypothesis-Guided Co-Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Robot foundation models provide strong visuomotor control, yet their performance can degrade when object positions or task instructions change. Further improvements often require post-training on substantial robot data, which can be costly to collect through methods such as teleoperation. Agentic harnesses can adapt around the model, but current self-evolving harnesses use robot trials inefficiently when deciding which code and skill changes to pursue. We introduce EmbodiedRSI, a self-evolving agentic harness that autonomously decides where to explore next and turns the resulting physical interaction into improved code and skills. EmbodiedRSI realizes this through a Fast-Slow Dual-System Architecture, in which competing code and skill hypotheses are maintained in a Hypothesis Graph. Value-of-Information Experiment Selection chooses physical experiments that can distinguish these hypotheses. Their outcomes guide Code-Skill Co-Evolution. The Slow System builds Hierarchical Memory, and Reward-Grounded Memory Learning selects effective memory according to their value for later Fast-System improvement. On RoboCasa365, EmbodiedRSI reaches 77.0% overall success and 71.3% on Composite-Unseen, compared with 40.1% for the best baseline. EmbodiedRSI also reaches 86.8% overall success on LIBERO-Pro. Beyond benchmark performance, EmbodiedRSI transfers zero-shot to real-world robot, achieving 71.3% overall success across multiple challenging tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EmbodiedRSI 是一个自演化机器人 agentic harness：用 Fast-Slow 双系统架构维护竞争性的代码与技能假设（Hypothesis Graph），以 Value-of-Information 准则挑选能区分假设的物理实验，实验结果驱动 Code-Skill Co-Evolution。在 RoboCasa365 上总体成功率 77.0%、Composite-Unseen 71.3%（最佳基线 40.1%），LIBERO-Pro 上 86.8%，并零样本迁移到真实机器人取得 71.3% 总体成功率。
Motivation: 机器人基础模型在物体位置或指令变化时性能下降，而靠遥操作收集大量数据做后训练成本高；现有自演化 harness 在决定改哪段代码、哪个技能时对机器人试次利用低效。
Method: Fast-Slow 双系统架构：Slow System 维护 Hypothesis Graph 中相互竞争的代码与技能假设，Value-of-Information Experiment Selection 挑选能区分这些假设的物理实验，实验结果驱动 Code-Skill Co-Evolution；Slow System 另建 Hierarchical Memory，Reward-Grounded Memory Learning 按记忆对后续 Fast-System 改进的价值筛选有效记忆。
Result: RoboCasa365 上总体成功率 77.0%，Composite-Unseen 子集 71.3%，对比最佳基线 40.1%；LIBERO-Pro 上总体成功率 86.8%；零样本迁移到真实机器人，在多个高难任务上取得 71.3% 总体成功率。
Conclusion: 把机器人试次花在能区分假设的实验上、并让代码与技能协同演化，可以在不依赖大规模遥操作后训练的前提下同时提升仿真基准与真实机器人成功率。

papers.title: QuadTok: Quadtree Visual Tokenizer for Autoregressive Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: We introduce QuadTok, a novel framework for visual tokenization and autoregressive image generation. Compared to traditional approaches using 2D grids or 1D token sequences, we propose a hierarchical quadtree structure, bridging the gap between 2D spatial binding and 1D sequence-level flexibility. The QuadTok tokenizer dynamically allocates representational capacity to visually intricate areas while leaving homogeneous regions at a coarse resolution. Compared with a fixed 256-token grid, our ImageNet-trained tokenizer saves approximately 10% of tokens on ImageNet and 9% when transferred zero-shot to the COCO dataset, while maintaining comparable reconstruction fidelity. Furthermore, the natural causality introduced by the tree structure seamlessly enables autoregressive image generation. Conditioned on a quadtree topology supplied before generation, our 947M GPT-style generative model achieves a 2.08 gFID on the ImageNet $256 \times 256$ benchmark. Additionally, leveraging the strong spatial correlation preserved by the quadtree structure, the QuadTok generator enables zero-shot spatially controlled image generation capabilities. Code: https://github.com/myc634/QuadTok.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QuadTok 用层次化四叉树 (quadtree) 视觉 tokenizer 把表示容量动态分配给纹理复杂区域、均质区域留粗分辨率，兼顾 2D 空间绑定与 1D 序列灵活性。相对固定 256-token 网格，ImageNet 训练的 tokenizer 在 ImageNet 上省约 10% token、零样本迁移到 COCO 省 9%，重建保真度相当；树结构的自然因果性直接支撑自回归生成，947M GPT 式模型在给定四叉树拓扑条件下于 ImageNet 256×256 达 2.08 gFID。
Motivation: 传统视觉 tokenizer 用 2D 网格或 1D token 序列，二者在空间绑定与序列灵活性之间不可兼得，且对均质区域浪费 token。
Method: 提出 QuadTok：层次化四叉树 tokenizer 按视觉复杂度动态分配表示容量，均质区域粗分辨率；树结构引入自然因果性供自回归生成使用，生成时以预先给定的四叉树拓扑为条件，配合 947M GPT 式模型，并利用树保留的空间相关性做零样本空间可控生成。
Result: 相对固定 256-token 网格，ImageNet 训练的 tokenizer 在 ImageNet 上节省约 10% token、零样本迁移到 COCO 节省 9%，重建保真度相当；947M GPT 式生成模型在 ImageNet 256×256 上取得 2.08 gFID（条件为生成前给定四叉树拓扑）。
Conclusion: 四叉树 token 化能在保持重建质量的同时压缩 token 数，并因其因果结构直接支撑自回归图像生成与零样本空间可控生成。

papers.title: Evolutionary Architecture Search for Chlorophyll-$a$ Prediction in Lakes using Sentinel-2
papers.abstract_en: Small tabular datasets with expert-designed spectral features are the norm in operational Earth observation, and the networks applied to them are typically hand-designed. We revisit one such published model -- a Sentinel-2 algal bloom classifier -- and ask what architecture search adds, holding the task, the features and the lake-level train/test split of the original study fixed. Searching an extended multilayer-perceptron space with regularized evolution, and selecting on inner-cross-validation AUC only, we find networks that improve held-out AUC from 0.790 to 0.820 and accuracy from 0.733 to 0.748 while using 409 trainable parameters, 26 times fewer than the strongest hand-designed reference. The search converges on a consistent recipe -- a single narrow layer, RMS normalisation, $\tanh$ activation, step-decayed RMSprop and weight averaging -- that a practitioner would be unlikely to reach by default. At 1.6\,kB the resulting model is small enough to serve as an onboard screening trigger, which is the setting that motivates the work. Code: https://github.com/VU-AIML/automl4eo-bloom-nas.
papers.comment: Accepted at AutoML4EO 2026 (non-archival AutoML conference workshop). 4 pages + references. https://automl4eo.org/accepted-papers/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Sentinel-2 湖泊藻华分类这一小型表格任务上，用正则化进化 (regularized evolution) 搜索扩展 MLP 架构空间，固定原研究的任务、光谱特征与湖泊级划分，仅以内部交叉验证 AUC 选型。留出 AUC 从 0.790 提到 0.820、准确率从 0.733 提到 0.748，同时只用 409 个参数，比最强手工设计参考少 26 倍，模型 1.6 kB 足以作星上筛查触发器。
Motivation: 业务化 Earth observation 中常见的是专家手工设计光谱特征的小型表格数据，配套网络也靠人工设计；作者要检验架构搜索在固定任务与特征后还能带来多少增益。
Method: 重访已发表的 Sentinel-2 藻华分类器，固定任务、特征与湖泊级 train/test 划分；在扩展的多层感知机 (MLP) 空间上做正则化进化搜索，只用内部交叉验证 AUC 作为选择准则。
Result: 留出 AUC 0.790 → 0.820，准确率 0.733 → 0.748；模型 409 个可训练参数，比最强手工设计参考少 26 倍，体积 1.6 kB。搜索收敛到一致配方：单个窄层、RMS normalisation、tanh 激活、step-decayed RMSprop 与 weight averaging。
Conclusion: 在固定任务与特征的前提下，架构搜索能以极小参数量超过手工设计的藻华分类器，产出的 1.6 kB 模型适合作为星上筛查触发器。

papers.title: Insights from Autoresearch for Solar Panel Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates AutoResearch, a protocol in which a coding language model edits a training program under a one-hour GPU budget and retains a change only if validation IoU improves. The protocol is applied to photovoltaic panel segmentation on a frozen real-image split, with DeepLabV3--ResNet-50 held fixed. Three campaigns of 24 experiments, using Gemma~4 12B, Qwen3-8B all improve their one-hour baselines, but retained modifications do not transfer across hardware. The Qwen3-8B configuration, trained on real images only, reaches a test IoU of 0.836 versus 0.833 for the reference GAN-augmented schedule. Research repository https://github.com/VU-AIML/automl4eo-autoresearch-segmentation.
papers.comment: Accepted at AutoML4EO 2026 (non-archival AutoML conference workshop). 4 pages + references. https://automl4eo.org/accepted-papers/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AutoResearch 协议让编码语言模型在一小时 GPU 预算内自动改写训练程序，仅当验证 IoU 提升才保留改动，用于光伏板分割（DeepLabV3-ResNet-50 固定）。三轮各 24 次实验（Gemma 4 12B、Qwen3-8B）都超过各自一小时基线，但保留的改动无法跨硬件迁移；Qwen3-8B 仅用真实图像训练达到测试 IoU 0.836，略高于参考 GAN 增广方案的 0.833。
Motivation: 分割模型的训练配方调优耗时耗人力，且在固定预算内难以系统搜索；论文检验让语言模型自动改代码、按验证指标筛选的闭环能否在受限算力下改进真实图像分割。
Method: AutoResearch 协议：编码语言模型在 1 小时 GPU 预算下编辑训练程序，只有验证 IoU 提升的改动被保留；在冻结的真实图像划分上做光伏板分割，DeepLabV3-ResNet-50 结构保持固定，分别用 Gemma 4 12B 与 Qwen3-8B 运行三轮各 24 次实验。
Result: 三轮 24 次实验均改进各自的一小时基线；保留的改动不能跨硬件迁移；Qwen3-8B 配置仅用真实图像训练，测试 IoU 0.836，对比参考 GAN 增广方案 0.833。
Conclusion: 自动改写训练代码的闭环在单小时预算内能小幅超过人工参考配方，但结论绑定具体硬件，跨平台复用需重新搜索。

papers.title: Best Arm Identification for Bandits with Shifting Means
papers.abstract_en: We study the best arm identification problem in a stochastic environment with a novel form of adversarial perturbations, which we coin Shifting Means. While classically the mean rewards of the $K$ arms are stable in time, in Shifting Means only the gaps $\boldsymbolΔ$ between mean rewards are stable, while their common shift may be determined adversarially in each round. The objective of the learner is to identify the best arm with high probability while minimizing sample complexity (the fixed confidence setting). Handling shifts requires new tools: we show that algorithms employing a Generalized Likelihood Ratio Test (GLRT) stopping rule, including the popular Track-and-Stop, fail under time-varying shifts. Instead, we propose Importance Weights for Shifting Means ($\mathsf{ISM}$). Assuming means bounded by $U$ and $σ^2$-sub-Gaussian rewards, we show $\mathsf{ISM}$ to be $δ$-correct and to enjoy a sample complexity bound of order $K (σ^2 + U^2) Δ_{\min}^{-2} \ln \frac{1}δ$. We also present a matching (up to constant factors) worst-case lower bound and evaluate our results empirically.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在均值整体可被对手逐轮平移、但臂间 gap Δ 保持不变的 Shifting Means bandit 中，GLRT 类停止规则（含 Track-and-Stop）会失效，作者提出 Importance Weights for Shifting Means (ISM) 以在固定置信设定下正确识别最优臂。在均值有界 U、奖励 σ²- sub-Gaussian 的假设下，ISM 是 δ-correct 的，样本复杂度为 K(σ²+U²)Δ_min⁻² ln(1/δ)，并给出匹配（差常数因子）的最坏情形下界。
Motivation: 经典 best arm identification 假设各臂均值随时间稳定；Shifting Means 中只有臂间 gap 稳定，公共平移可被对手逐轮决定，现有 GLRT 停止规则在此时变平移下失效。
Method: 提出 Importance Weights for Shifting Means (ISM)：用重要性权重处理逐轮公共平移，同时保持 gap 估计；在均值以 U 为界、奖励 σ²- sub-Gaussian 的条件下证明 δ-correct，并给出匹配（差常数因子）的最坏情形下界，另做实证评估。
Result: ISM 的样本复杂度为 K(σ²+U²)Δ_min⁻² ln(1/δ)（固定置信、δ-correct），并有匹配至常数因子的最坏情形下界；GLRT 停止规则（含 Track-and-Stop）在时变平移下失效；摘要另称做了实证评估但未给具体数值。
Conclusion: 在 Shifting Means 这一新型对抗扰动下，GLRT 类停止规则不可用，而基于重要性权重的 ISM 可达 δ-correct 且样本复杂度与下界匹配（差常数因子）。

papers.title: Two-Level Softmax Sampling Done Right: Correcting Bias from Size Imbalance and Dispersion
papers.abstract_en: Sampling from a softmax distribution is a fundamental operation in machine learning, but its linear complexity in the number of items makes exact sampling impractical at scale. Two-level softmax (2LS) sampling is a popular alternative enabling sublinear-time sampling. Assuming items are partitioned into clusters, 2LS first samples a cluster and then an item within it. In this paper, we show that, despite its advantages, 2LS introduces systematic and undesirable sampling biases, which arise from misweighting clusters by ignoring both cluster size imbalance and intra-cluster similarity dispersion. We propose two sampling methods, Size-Corrected 2LS (S-2LS) and Size- and Dispersion-Corrected 2LS (SD-2LS), which correct these biases and provide provably better softmax approximations with negligible to non-existent computational overhead. In-depth experiments on five large-scale datasets validate the improved sampling properties of our methods. We recommend their consistent use in place of standard 2LS in future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 两层 softmax (2LS) 采样因忽略簇大小不均衡与簇内相似度离散度而产生系统性偏差，提出 S-2LS 与 SD-2LS 两项校正，给出可证明更优的 softmax 近似且计算开销可忽略，并建议后续工作以之替代标准 2LS。
Motivation: softmax 精确采样随条目数线性复杂度，在大规模下不可行；常用的 2LS 虽是次线性替代，却因错误加权簇而引入系统性采样偏差。
Method: 在簇划分的两层采样框架下，先按簇采样再在簇内采样；S-2LS 校正簇大小不均衡，SD-2LS 在此基础上再校正簇内相似度离散度，两者均给出可证明更好的 softmax 近似，计算开销可忽略或不存在。
Result: 在五个大规模数据集上进行深入实验，验证了所提方法采样性质的改进；摘要未给出具体数值对比。
Conclusion: 2LS 的偏差来自同时忽略簇大小与簇内离散度，两项校正能以可忽略开销给出更优近似，作者建议未来工作一致地用 S-2LS/SD-2LS 替代标准 2LS。

papers.title: Agentic RSR: Real-to-Sim-to-Real through Scene Reconstruction and Execution-Grounded Robot Policies
papers.abstract_en: A simulation of a real robot workspace must preserve task-relevant interactions, while policies developed in it must operate on observations available to the real robot. Yet scene reconstruction and policy development are often treated separately. We present Agentic Real-to-Sim-to-Real (Agentic RSR), a framework that links scene reconstruction, policy development, and real-robot execution through the same manipulation task. Given a workspace video, a task description, and a known robot model, an agent recovers metric scale, iteratively refines the scene using visual feedback, and checks task-relevant interactions in MuJoCo. A coding agent then develops an executable policy, progressing from privileged object poses to visual observations and randomized simulation. The policy can interleave multiple observations and actions within one invocation, while the agent uses execution feedback to continue, retry, or revise its approach. A shared task-level interface carries the policy and accumulated experience to the real robot, where fresh observations and safety checks guide execution. Across 18 reconstructed scenes involving two robots, the mean four-view Depth MAE against reference depth estimates is 0.1057 m, the mean Lab $ΔE_{76}$ is 11.04, and the mean grayscale SSIM is 0.6990. In real-robot experiments, the aggregate task success rate reaches 80% of the simulation task success rate, indicating substantial retention of simulated performance on hardware. Code and reconstructed scene data will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Agentic RSR 把场景重建、策略开发与真机执行用同一个操作任务串成 real-to-sim-to-real 闭环：由 agent 从工作空间视频恢复度量尺度并在 MuJoCo 中用视觉反馈迭代精修场景，再由 coding agent 从特权物体位姿逐步过渡到视觉观测与随机化仿真生成可执行策略。18 个重建场景（两台机器人）上四视角 Depth MAE 均值 0.1057 m、Lab ΔE76 均值 11.04、灰度 SSIM 均值 0.6990；真机任务成功率达到仿真成功率的 80%。
Motivation: 场景重建与策略开发通常被分开处理，重建结果未必保留任务相关交互，仿真中训练的策略也未必只用真机可得的观测，导致 sim-to-real 迁移时性能大量流失。
Method: 输入为工作空间视频、任务描述与已知机器人模型：agent 恢复度量尺度，用视觉反馈迭代精修场景并在 MuJoCo 中检查任务相关交互；coding agent 从特权物体位姿逐步过渡到视觉观测与随机化仿真生成策略，单次调用内可交错多次观测与动作，并依据执行反馈继续、重试或修订；共享的任务级接口把策略与累积经验带到真机，由新观测与安全检查引导执行。
Result: 在 18 个重建场景、两台机器人上，四视角 Depth MAE 对参考深度估计的均值为 0.1057 m，Lab ΔE76 均值 11.04，灰度 SSIM 均值 0.6990；真机实验中聚合任务成功率达到仿真任务成功率的 80%。
Conclusion: 把重建、策略与执行绑在同一个任务上并让执行反馈回流，可使仿真中获得的机器人操作性能在硬件上大部分保留；代码与重建场景数据将公开。

papers.title: Before They Can Solve: Predicting Post-Training Coding-Agent Performance from Base Models
papers.abstract_en: How can we predict which base checkpoint is worth an expensive round of agentic post-training? End-to-end pass@$K$ tests whether successful behavior already appears in a base model's distribution, but it is a poor fit for agentic coding: many base checkpoints cannot reliably produce the well-formed tool invocation required to complete a task end-to-end. Single-shot or short-horizon tasks avoid these tool-calling failures by collapsing a multi-step interaction into a fixed prompt and a single patch, but they sidestep the core capability we care about: maintaining coherent state over many tool-using steps as the repository evolves. To bridge this gap, we treat successful post-trained agent trajectories as a lookahead signal of base-model potential. Replaying each trajectory and rerunning tests after every code-changing step identifies the decisive step: the first step whose cumulative patch flips the repository from failing to passing, certifying that the recorded action solves the task given the prior context. Motivated by a coverage principle for agentic traces, we build three screens at this step that do not require a base checkpoint to drive the harness from a cold start: (i) Decisive-Action BPB (bits per byte) measures the probability mass on the certified action, (ii) Patch MCQ tests the checkpoint's choice between that action and alternatives rejected by the same verifier, and (iii) prefix-conditioned pass@$K$ evaluates support for functionally-correct generations and credits any continuation that the tests accept. Across ten pairs of public base and post-trained models, all three screens rank the cohort in close agreement with post-trained SWE-bench Verified pass@$1$. As our methods need only a benchmark's successful trajectories and its verifier, they can be applied to turn future agentic coding benchmarks into base-model evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出在昂贵的 agentic post-training 之前，用已训练成功轨迹中的“决定性步骤”给 base checkpoint 打分的三块筛选器：Decisive-Action BPB、Patch MCQ、prefix-conditioned pass@$K$。在十对公开 base/post-trained 模型上，三种筛选的排序都与 post-trained SWE-bench Verified pass@$1$ 高度一致。
Motivation: 端到端 pass@$K$ 不适合 agentic coding：很多 base checkpoint 连格式正确的工具调用都写不出来，跑不完多步任务；单步或短程评测又绕开了“在仓库演化中维持多步状态”这一核心能力，因此缺少能在 post-training 前判断哪个 base checkpoint 值得投入的指标。
Method: 把 post-training 成功轨迹当作 base 模型潜力的前瞻信号：逐步重放轨迹、每步改码后重跑测试，定位把仓库由失败翻转为通过的决定性步骤；在该步构造三个不要求冷启动驱动 harness 的筛选器——Decisive-Action BPB（度量落在该认证动作上的概率质量）、Patch MCQ（在该动作与同一 verifier 拒绝的备选之间做选择）、prefix-conditioned pass@$K$（以已接受前缀评估功能正确生成的支持度）。
Result: 在十对公开 base 与 post-trained 模型上，三种筛选器给出的 cohort 排序都与 post-trained SWE-bench Verified pass@$1$ 高度一致。
Conclusion: 只要一个 benchmark 提供成功轨迹和 verifier，就能把未来的 agentic coding benchmark 直接变成 base 模型评测，从而在投入 post-training 前筛掉不值得训练的 checkpoint。

papers.title: Label-free cell counting and viability prediction with brightfield imaging and deep learning
papers.abstract_en: Cell viability assessment is a core requirement in cell culture systems, with critical applications in biopharmaceutical manufacturing and drug development. Conventionally, it is measured by adding membrane-impermeable dyes to a sample (a process called staining), which allows compromised cell membranes to be distinguished from intact ones. However, staining has several limitations: (a) chemical agents can perturb normal cellular processes of the cells being measured, (b) it is often ambiguous to assign viability to individual cells whose membrane integrity is only partially compromised. (c) photobleaching can undermine measurement accuracy over time when using fluorescent stains, and (d) staining cannot be performed in situ or in real time. Here, we show that (1) stained cells captured under brightfield imaging contain sufficient information to distinguish live and dead cells, and (2) cells captured under unstained brightfield imaging exhibit similar image features to their stained counterparts, enabling models trained on stained cells to generalize to unstained ones. We then report the development and validation of ViabiLens, an AI-assisted software for label-free cell viability analysis. The ViabiLens combines a cell detection model for localizing individual cells with a convolutional neural network (CNN) classifier for live/dead prediction, paired with an interactive UMAP-based viewer for visualizing and exploring individual cells across the sample. Evaluated on Chinese Hamster Ovary (CHO) cells spanning a wide range of viability conditions, ViabiLens achieves a mean absolute error of 2.68\% on unstained samples against fluorescence-based reference measurements. We also release a benchmark dataset for label-free cell viability analysis to facilitate future research, available at https://amirrezavazifeh.github.io/ViabiLens-Project-Page/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ViabiLens 用明场成像加深度学习做无标记细胞活率分析：先检测单个细胞，再用 CNN 判活/死，并配 UMAP 交互查看器。关键发现是未染色明场图像与染色图像特征相似，因此在染色细胞上训练的模型可直接泛化到未染色样本，在 CHO 细胞上对荧光参考的 MAE 为 2.68%。
Motivation: 染色法测活率会扰动细胞、对膜完整性部分受损的单细胞判定模糊、荧光染料光漂白影响长期精度，且无法原位实时测量。
Method: ViabiLens 由细胞检测模型（定位单个细胞）+ 卷积神经网络 (CNN) 分类器（活/死预测）+ 基于 UMAP 的交互式查看器组成；模型在染色明场图像上训练，利用染色与未染色图像的相似特征迁移到未染色样本。
Result: 在覆盖大范围活率条件的 Chinese Hamster Ovary (CHO) 细胞上，ViabiLens 对未染色样本相对荧光参考测量的平均绝对误差 (MAE) 为 2.68%；同时发布一个无标记细胞活率分析基准数据集。

papers.title: A Society of Researchers: Designing Institutions for Populations of Autonomous Research Agents
papers.abstract_en: Deployments of research agents are moving to populations of thousands that share one pool of compute, while most current systems organize one project at a time or leave the population unorganized. We argue that such a population will acquire an organization whether or not its designers provide one, so designers should provide it explicitly, and that the multi-agent systems community holds the tools to do so. We propose a society of agents, a population of persistent agents under explicit institutions, and develop it for science as a society of researchers built on six principles. Principal investigators compete for compute through requests for proposals, independent review, and grants; a human governor, the mayor, allocates resources and assigns no tasks. In a running society of ten thousand researchers, asked only to improve the pretraining of language models, one lab reported a way to reach the same quality with about 30% less compute, a result the labs that tested it do not yet agree on. We close with six open problems for the agents community.
papers.comment: 4 pages. Short version of A Society of Researchers: Institutional Design for Populations of Autonomous Scientific Agents, doi:10.5281/zenodo.22922325
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文主张：上千个共享算力的自主研究 agent 群体无论设计者是否给出组织形式都会自发形成组织，因此应显式设计制度。提出 society of researchers：持久 agent 在明确制度下运行，PI 通过 RFP、独立评审与 grant 竞争算力，human mayor 只分配资源不派任务。在一万 agent 的运行实例中，仅被要求改进语言模型预训练，一个 lab 报告了同等质量省约 30% 算力的方法，但参与测试的 lab 尚未达成一致。
Motivation: 研究 agent 的部署正走向共享单一算力池的上千规模，而现有系统要么一次只组织一个项目，要么干脆不组织群体；作者认为组织会自发出现，不如显式给出。
Method: 提出 society of agents（持久 agent + 显式制度），并针对科学场景展开为六原则的 society of researchers：PI 用 requests for proposals、independent review、grants 竞争算力，human governor（mayor）负责资源分配且不指派任务；文末给出 agent 社区的六个开放问题。
Result: 在一个含一万个 researcher 的运行 society 中，agent 仅被要求改进语言模型预训练，某 lab 报告了以约 30% 更少算力达到同等质量的方案，而测试过该方案的 lab 目前尚不认可这一结果。
Conclusion: 大规模研究 agent 群体应由显式制度而非默认组织来治理，算力竞争可由 RFP 加独立评审的 grant 机制承载；该结果本身在参与 lab 间仍有分歧。

papers.title: How assigned AI use before class shapes active student engagement in class
papers.abstract_en: AI learning tools are rapidly entering classrooms, but evidence about whether they help students learn is mixed and rests mostly on test scores. Comparatively less research addresses whether the use of AI changes students' live learning behaviors in class. Here, we report the results of a preregistered field experiment with 759 MBA students enrolled in ten sections of a course, in which each student was randomly assigned two of ten class sessions to prepare for with a purpose-built voice-based AI discussion partner. After two uses of the AI discussion partner, students made about 31% more voluntary contributions in each later class session. Students who used the AI discussion partner more also reported greater comfort speaking up and greater perceived learning, but not greater focus or motivation. These findings suggest that repeated practice with a voice-based AI partner can meaningfully increase students' engagement in class discussion, enhancing a critical intermediate learning outcome.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 一项针对 759 名 MBA 学生、10 个班次的预注册随机田野实验显示，课前用语音 AI 讨论伙伴完成两次准备后，学生在后续课堂上的自愿发言次数增加约 31%。使用越多的学生报告发言更自在、感知学习更高，但专注度与动机没有提升。
Motivation: AI 学习工具进入课堂的证据多停留在考试分数，较少研究 AI 使用是否改变学生在课堂上的实时学习行为。
Method: 预注册随机田野实验：10 个课程班次的 759 名 MBA 学生每人被随机指派 10 节课中的 2 节，课前用专门构建的语音 AI 讨论伙伴 (voice-based AI discussion partner) 做准备，随后比较其后续课堂自愿发言与自我报告。
Result: 两次使用 AI 讨论伙伴后，学生在之后每节课的自愿发言增加约 31%；使用更多的学生报告发言更自在、感知学习更高，但专注度与动机未提高。
Conclusion: 反复与语音 AI 伙伴练习可以实质提升课堂讨论参与这一中间学习结果，但不必然带来专注或动机的同步提升。

papers.title: FoldBack: Self-Correcting Masked Generative Policy for Long-Horizon Garment Folding
papers.abstract_en: We present FoldBack, a self-correcting masked generative policy for long-horizon garment folding. Existing long-trajectory policies may continue after a missed or slipped grasp even when the garment has not reached the intended configuration. We structure FoldBack's recovery mechanisms around three inference-time decisions: when to refine and verify, how to roll back, and where and how to retry. FoldBack aligns refinement and grasp verification with pick-and-place events, returns the robot to a retryable pre-grasp configuration while preserving successful grasps, and selectively regenerates the failed segment and selected future actions while avoiding previous failed grasp locations. To our knowledge, FoldBack is the first editable full-trajectory policy to unify these decisions, enabling failed interactions to be detected, undone, and repaired before execution continues, without recovery demonstrations or base-policy retraining. Across 33 real garments from six categories, FoldBack achieves 75.2% final folding success and 0.837 final-mask IoU, versus 45.7% and 0.689 for the strongest prior baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FoldBack 是面向长时程衣物折叠的自纠错掩码生成策略：把精修与抓取验证对齐到 pick-and-place 事件，失败时回滚到可重试的 pre-grasp 位形并保留已成功抓取，再选择性重生成失败片段与部分后续动作，同时避开此前失败的抓取位置。在 33 件真实衣物（六个类别）上最终折叠成功率 75.2%、final-mask IoU 0.837，对比最强基线的 45.7% 与 0.689。
Motivation: 现有长轨迹策略在抓空或打滑后仍继续执行，即使衣物并未到达预期构型；恢复通常需要恢复示范或重训基线策略。
Method: FoldBack 在推理时统一三个决策：何时精修与验证、如何回滚、在哪里以及如何重试。它把精修与抓取验证绑定到 pick-and-place 事件，回滚到可重试的 pre-grasp 配置同时保留成功抓取，并选择性重生成失败片段与选定的后续动作，重试时避开先前失败的抓取位置；全程无需恢复示范，也不重训基线策略。
Result: 在 33 件真实衣物、六个类别上，FoldBack 最终折叠成功率 75.2%、final-mask IoU 0.837；最强先前基线分别为 45.7% 与 0.689。
Conclusion: 据作者所知，FoldBack 是首个在单一可编辑全轨迹策略中统一精修验证、回滚与重试决策的系统，使失败交互在执行继续前被检测、撤销并修复，且无需恢复示范或基线重训。

papers.title: Composing What Each Teacher Learned: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation through Teacher-Relative Shifts
papers.abstract_en: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) is used in two settings. In common-domain composition, several teachers score each student rollout from one prompt domain and their signals form a single target; in routed-domain distillation, prompts from different domains are assigned to the corresponding specialist. Both settings usually transfer each teacher's endpoint policy, which mixes what post-training changed with preferences inherited from the teacher's base. We introduce $Δ$-MOPD, which transfers each teacher's teacher-minus-base logit shift re-anchored at the student's frozen initialization, and compare it with endpoint supervision in both settings while holding teacher selection fixed. We first expose the mechanism that impedes endpoint transfer: inherited base pull can exceed the post-training shift. Removing it reduces the teacher-term norm ratio and target--student KL. Across our experiments, the results suggest that shift targets are particularly useful when teacher signals are combined at a state. With three composed teachers, $Δ$-MOPD exceeds endpoint composition by $4.11$ Math and $1.95$ five-benchmark points; with two, it matches endpoint accuracy. Under phased routing, it achieves higher mean performance in both phase orders and reduces the observed order gap from $10.50$ to $6.42$ points. Under interleaved routing, where each update involves one teacher, the two targets perform comparably. The phased results provide supporting evidence that the benefit may extend to signals accumulated across training phases. Target construction is thus an independent design axis in MOPD, complementary to teacher selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Δ-MOPD 把多教师在线策略蒸馏 (multi-teacher on-policy distillation) 的目标从教师端点策略换成“教师减基座”的 logit 位移，并重新锚定在学生冻结初始化上，从而剥离教师基座继承偏好。三教师组合下比端点组合高 4.11 Math、1.95 个五基准点；分阶段路由下两种顺序均更优，顺序差距从 10.50 缩到 6.42 点。
Motivation: 端点策略混合了后训练改动与从教师基座继承的偏好，继承的基座拉力可能超过后训练位移，阻碍端点信号向学生迁移。
Method: Δ-MOPD 转移每个教师的 teacher-minus-base logit shift，重新锚定在学生的冻结初始化上；在 common-domain composition（多教师对同一 rollout 打分合成单一目标）与 routed-domain distillation 两种设定下与端点监督对比，固定教师选择；并分析去除基座拉力后 teacher-term norm ratio 与 target–student KL 的变化。
Result: 去除继承基座拉力后 teacher-term norm ratio 与 target–student KL 下降。三教师组合时 Δ-MOPD 比端点组合高 4.11 Math、1.95 个五基准点；两教师时与端点精度持平。分阶段路由下两种顺序均取得更高平均性能，顺序差距从 10.50 降到 6.42 点；交错路由（每次更新只用一个教师）下两种目标表现相当。
Conclusion: 目标构造是 MOPD 中独立于教师选择的设计轴：当教师信号在同一状态上被组合时，位移目标尤其有用，其收益可能延伸到跨训练阶段累积的信号。

papers.title: NeuralBES: A Differentiable, Control-Aware Emulator for Scalable Building Energy Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Demand-side flexibility i.e. forecasting, shifting, and curtailing residential energy loads, depends on thermal models trusted across millions of heterogeneous buildings. Existing tools force a hard tradeoff: high-fidelity physics simulators such as EnergyPlus are accurate but sequential and require per-building calibration, while purely data-driven sequence models scale but abandon the physical structure that makes their predictions trustworthy. We introduce NeuralBES (Building Energy Simulation), a differentiable emulator that resolves this tradeoff by parameterizing a resistance--capacitance (RC) based thermal model with a shared neural encoder: static building metadata such as floor area, vintage, and HVAC type is mapped to physically bounded capacitances, conductances, and equipment coefficients, which become the coefficients of a scalar linear recurrence solved via a log-space parallel scan, and a predictor--corrector loop closes the thermostat--temperature nonlinearity while preserving full-horizon gradient flow. Trained on the ResStock dataset across three climate zones, NeuralBES handles heterogeneous building archetypes, vintages, and climate zones within a single trained encoder, while black-box baselines produce statistically plausible but physically inconsistent trajectories. On the annual full-year rollout, NeuralBES is the only data-conditioned model that is simultaneously physics-valid and accurate to within 4 MAPE points of the strongest raw-error baseline, while operating at roughly an order of magnitude fewer parameters than the transformer and recurrent baselines; among physics-valid baselines at parameter parity it more than halves the MAPE of the grey-box RC alternative.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NeuralBES 用共享神经编码器把建筑元数据映射为物理有界的 RC 热模型系数，经 log-space 并行扫描求解标量线性递推，再用 predictor-corrector 闭合温控器非线性，得到可微且全时域梯度可流的建筑能耗仿真器。在 ResStock 三个气候区全年滚动中，它是唯一同时物理有效、且与最强原始误差基线相差不超过 4 个 MAPE 点的数据条件模型，参数量比 transformer 与循环基线少约一个数量级。
Motivation: 需求侧灵活性需要跨数百万异构建筑可信的热模型，但 EnergyPlus 等高保真物理仿真需逐栋标定且串行，纯数据驱动序列模型可扩展却丢掉使预测可信的物理结构。
Method: 共享神经编码器把楼层面积、建成年代、HVAC 类型等静态元数据映射为物理有界的电容、电导与设备系数，作为标量线性递推的系数并用 log-space 并行扫描求解；predictor-corrector 迭代闭合温控器-温度非线性，同时保持全时域梯度流。

papers.title: MORCA: Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Cache Reuse in Video Diffusion Acceleration
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) achieve remarkable performance in video synthesis, but their iterative denoising process suffers from high inference latency. To address this, caching has emerged as an effective acceleration strategy by capitalizing on inter-step redundancy during denoising. Existing dynamic caching methods typically estimate the error that cache reuse would introduce at each denoising step (step error) to guide cache decisions, whereas our concern is how much quality loss cache reuse would cause in the final generated video (terminal error). We show that step error does not directly correspond to terminal error and that latent information helps capture their relationship, thereby informing cache decisions. Moreover, existing threshold-based methods cannot provide precise speedup control, making it difficult to meet practical requirements for user-specified acceleration targets. To address these limitations, we introduce MORCA, a cache scheduling framework trained through offline-to-online reinforcement learning to make latent-aware reuse/recompute decisions under user-specified acceleration targets. Extensive experiments on different video generation models across multiple target acceleration ratios demonstrate that MORCA achieves better generation fidelity than state-of-the-art caching methods under comparable computational budgets. Code is available at https://github.com/x10ngyx/MORCA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MORCA 用离线到在线强化学习做视频扩散 (DiT) 的缓存调度：以 latent 信息判断缓存复用对最终生成视频的 terminal error（而非单步 step error），并直接服从用户指定的加速比目标。在多个视频生成模型与多个目标加速比下，同等算力预算的生成保真度优于现有 SOTA 缓存方法。
Motivation: 现有动态缓存按单步误差决定是否复用，但单步误差与最终视频质量损失并不对应；基于阈值的方案又无法精确控制加速比，难以满足用户指定的加速目标。
Method: 提出缓存调度框架 MORCA，通过 offline-to-online 强化学习训练，在用户指定的加速比约束下做 latent-aware 的复用/重算决策；用 latent 信息刻画 step error 与 terminal error 的关系来指导缓存决策。
Result: 在不同视频生成模型、多个目标加速比的实验中，MORCA 在可比算力预算下比 SOTA 缓存方法取得更好的生成保真度；代码已开源。
Conclusion: 以 terminal error 和 latent 信息为决策依据、把加速比作为显式约束的强化学习调度，比阈值式 step-error 缓存更能同时保证画质与速度可控。

papers.title: PHRBench: A Behavioral Evaluation of Post-Hallucination Reasoning in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Hallucinated information can propagate through multi-stage LLM systems and become part of the context for subsequent reasoning. Existing studies of post-hallucination reasoning (PHR) mainly characterize changes in final outcomes and aggregate reasoning dynamics, leaving how models resolve hallucinated premises at the response level insufficiently understood. In this work, we introduce PHRBench, a controlled benchmark for behaviorally structured PHR across four domains and 18 large language models. PHRBench characterizes each reasoning trajectory independently of final-answer correctness through Hallucination Compliance, Hallucination Avoidance, and Heuristic Correction, and defines an insightful trajectory as successful correction that ultimately reaches the correct answer. Across 4820 controlled instances, we find that successful recovery remains relatively rare and is associated with more frequent belief updates along the reasoning trajectory. We further find that properties of the hallucinated prompt contain substantial predictive signal for successful recovery, with a lightweight predictor achieving an AUROC of 0.847. These findings provide a behavioral view of post-hallucination reasoning, characterizing how LLMs resolve erroneous context and when successful recovery is likely to occur.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PHRBench 是一个受控基准，用 Hallucination Compliance、Hallucination Avoidance、Heuristic Correction 三类行为刻画 LLM 在幻觉前提下的逐响应推理轨迹，覆盖 4 个领域、18 个模型、4820 个受控实例。成功恢复仍然少见，但与推理轨迹上更频繁的信念更新相关；仅用幻觉提示的属性训练的轻量预测器即可达到 AUROC 0.847。
Motivation: 现有 post-hallucination reasoning (PHR) 研究多停留在最终答案变化与聚合层面的推理动态，无法说明模型在单条响应上如何处理已被写进上下文的幻觉前提，也难以判定恢复何时会发生。
Method: 构建受控基准 PHRBench，跨 4 个领域与 18 个 LLM 生成 4820 个受控实例；每条推理轨迹独立于最终答案正确性标注为 Hallucination Compliance、Hallucination Avoidance 或 Heuristic Correction，并把「成功纠正且最终答对」定义为 insightful trajectory；另训练一个轻量预测器，仅用幻觉提示的属性预测成功恢复。
Result: 在 4820 个受控实例上，成功恢复相对少见，且与推理轨迹中更频繁的信念更新相关；基于幻觉提示属性的轻量预测器预测成功恢复达到 AUROC 0.847。
Conclusion: LLM 对错误上下文的处理可按响应级行为分类，成功恢复的发生时机可由幻觉提示本身的属性相当程度地预测，而不必只看最终答案对错。

papers.title: MemoCare: An Interactive Multimodal Mobile System for Automated Cognitive Screening
papers.abstract_en: MemoCare is an interactive mobile system for automated multimodal cognitive screening. A React Native application combines spoken responses, temporal and spatial orientation, touchscreen actions, and visuoconstruction in complete English and Vietnamese workflows. Speech is transcribed by Google Speech-to-Text and scored locally with deterministic task-specific natural language processing rules; GPS coordinates are resolved by the MemoCare spatial module before answer matching; touch tasks are scored from interaction events; and the drawing task uses a three-model convolutional neural network consensus with separate visual interpretation. Software tests pass 151/151 predefined cases across speech/language, spatial-answer, and touch-interaction scoring, while spatial regression passes 48/48 four-country coordinate-resolution cases. For the drawing module, validation-selected ShuffleNetV2 x1.5 achieved 91.33% mean balanced accuracy and 78.87% exact three-criterion accuracy on a locked 71-image test set. Four clinician co-authors additionally inspected the end-to-end workflow, yielding a pooled median rating of 4/5 across eight criteria, with item-level medians ranging from 3 to 4.5. At MMM, attendees can directly try a shortened multimodal screening workflow and inspect automatic item-level and total scoring.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Demo paper submitted to the MMM 2027 Demo Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MemoCare 是一个 React Native 多模态认知筛查移动系统，把语音转写、时空定向、触屏任务与视构绘画分别用确定性 NLP 规则、GPS 空间模块、交互事件打分和三模型 CNN 共识自动评分。软件测试 151/151 通过、坐标解析 48/48 通过，锁定测试集上 ShuffleNetV2 x1.5 平衡准确率 91.33%、三准则完全准确率 78.87%，临床共同作者对端到端流程给出 4/5 的合并中位评分。
Motivation: 认知筛查依赖量表施测与人工评分，流程跨语言、跨模态时耗时且评分不一致；需要一个可在手机上自动完成施测与逐项打分的系统。
Method: React Native 应用覆盖英语与越南语完整流程：Google Speech-to-Text 转写后用任务特定的确定性 NLP 规则本地打分，MemoCare 空间模块解析 GPS 坐标再做答案匹配，触屏任务由交互事件打分，绘画任务用三模型 CNN 共识加独立视觉解读；绘画模块经验证集挑选出 ShuffleNetV2 x1.5，测试集锁定为 71 张图像。
Result: 软件测试 151/151 预定义用例通过（覆盖语音/语言、空间答案、触屏交互打分），空间回归 48/48 通过（四国坐标解析用例）；绘画模块在锁定的 71 图像测试集上 ShuffleNetV2 x1.5 平均平衡准确率 91.33%、三准则完全准确率 78.87%；四位临床共同作者对端到端流程的合并中位评分为 4/5（八个条目，条目中位数 3 至 4.5）。
Conclusion: 自动逐项与总分打分可以在手机上端到端跑通并通过预定义测试与临床流程审查，绘画判读仍是三准则完全准确率明显低于平衡准确率的短板。

papers.title: A Good Self-Teacher Meets the Student Where They Are: Joint On-Policy Learning and Teaching
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning (RL) from outcome rewards suffers from sparse supervision, particularly on difficult, long-horizon tasks where successful trajectories are rare and costly to generate. On-Policy Distillation (OPD) offers an attractive alternative by providing dense token-level supervision from a stronger teacher along the student's own generations. Self-distillation methods further remove the need for a separate teacher model by conditioning the same policy on privileged information to serve as its own teacher. However, privileged conditioning alone does not guarantee that the resulting distillation update improves the student. Indeed, privileged information can lead the teacher to solve tasks through shortcuts unavailable to the student, producing supervision poorly matched to the student's current behavior. Consequently, even a higher-performing teacher can provide guidance that degrades student performance. To address this, we analyze how the choice of privileged teacher affects the student's update. We derive a necessary and sufficient condition for the teacher's local distillation update to be a positive multiple of the student's reward gradient. Our analysis suggests that the teacher should not only perform well on the task, but also provide guidance suited to the student's current capabilities. This characterization motivates a practical teacher-training surrogate that combines outcome rewards with token-level Kullback-Leibler (KL) regularization toward the student. Based on this result, we propose Joint On-Policy Learning and Teaching (JOLT), which jointly trains a single policy in two roles: a privileged teacher using a KL-regularized objective, and an unprivileged student using dense on-policy distillation. Across mathematical reasoning, coding, tool use, and terminal use, JOLT improves training efficiency and performance, with further gains from student rewards.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JOLT 让同一策略同时扮演带特权信息的教师与无特权的学生，推导出教师局部蒸馏更新为学生奖励梯度正倍数的充要条件，并据此用结果奖励加对学生 KL 正则的代理目标训练教师。在数学推理、编码、工具使用与终端使用任务上提升训练效率与性能，加入学生奖励后还有额外增益。
Motivation: 结果奖励在长时程任务上监督稀疏、成功轨迹难得；特权自蒸馏中教师可能走学生拿不到的捷径，即使教师更强也可能让学生的更新变差。
Method: 推导教师局部蒸馏更新与学生奖励梯度同向的充要条件，据此提出教师训练代理目标（结果奖励 + 对学生 token 级 KL 正则），并提出 JOLT：单一策略以特权教师（KL 正则目标）与无特权学生（稠密 on-policy 蒸馏）两种角色联合训练。
Result: 在数学推理、编码、工具使用、终端使用四类任务上，JOLT 提升训练效率与性能，加入学生奖励后获得进一步增益。
Conclusion: 教师不仅要任务表现好，其指导还须匹配学生当前能力，否则更强的教师也会损害学生；按此条件联合训练教与学可同时提高效率与最终性能。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: RunningTab: Direct Workspace Interaction with Environment-Side Tabs
papers.abstract_en: Much knowledge work produces new deliverables from files a workspace already holds, and LLM agents are beginning to take such work over. Through direct corpus interaction, an agent can search and read any of those files from a terminal with no indexing, and producing a deliverable from many of them in this way is what we call direct workspace interaction (DWI). Reaching the files, however, is only half the task: nothing keeps track of what the task asks for, what has been read, and what was listed but never opened, all of which slip through the context window without leaving a trace, so an agent may extract a figure and still deliver a report without it. To address this, we present RunningTab, a framework that equips direct workspace interaction with an environment-side tab: a per-task record of what the task still owes, kept by the environment alongside the agent. Specifically, the agent adds its requirements, while the environment records every file read as an excerpt with its provenance and every listed but unopened file as a candidate; the agent can then see each requirement beside its best-matching excerpts and top unopened candidates, resolve it against matching content or set it aside with a reason, and, should it try to finish with requirements still open, receive them in a finish check. We validate RunningTab on three benchmarks with three LLMs, where it consistently outperforms plain DWI and baselines that keep the record in the model, while its tab usually holds the values a deliverable needs once seen.

papers.title: Seq-Flow: Efficient Probabilistic Forecasting with Self-Rollout Error Control
papers.abstract_en: Many scientific forecasting tasks require updating a distribution over future trajectories as new observations arrive. Conventional diffusion and flow models generate each forecast from Gaussian noise, often at the cost of many sampling steps. Warm-start methods reuse earlier predictions to reduce this cost, but their models are not trained to perform the forecast update itself, which can compromise quality under few-step sampling. In this work, we introduce Seq-Flow, a conditional flow model whose ODE transports samples from the previous forecast distribution to the updated one. Because successive forecasts often differ only modestly, this transport starts from an informative distribution and can produce accurate updates with few flow evaluations. Recursive reuse also creates a challenge: errors in one forecast become errors in the initial states of subsequent flows. We address this with self-rollout training, in which a moving average copy of the model generates forecasts that initialize later training updates. Unlike self-forcing methods, which reuse generated outputs as conditioning context, Seq-Flow reuses them as the source of the next flow. Experiments On particle-accelerator beam spill forecasting show Seq-Flow reduces CRPS by 65% under a few-NFE sampling budget, while remaining competitive with strong baselines on fluid-dynamics forecasting tasks. Although trained on self-rollouts of at most four updates, Seq-Flow remains accurate over more than 400 consecutive updates. Our code is available at https://github.com/Graph-COM/Seq-Flow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Seq-Flow 是条件流模型，其 ODE 直接把上一次预报分布输运到更新后的分布，配合 self-rollout 训练（用模型的滑动平均副本生成后续训练更新的初始预报）控制递归复用带来的误差累积。在粒子加速器束流 spill 预报上，few-NFE 采样预算下 CRPS 降低 65%，且在超过 400 次连续更新后仍保持准确。
Motivation: 扩散与流模型每次从高斯噪声生成预报，采样步数多；warm-start 复用旧预测降本，但模型并未针对“预报更新”本身训练，少步采样下质量受损，且递归复用会把上一步误差带入后续流的初始状态。
Method: 条件流模型的 ODE 将样本从前一次预报分布输运到更新后分布，起始分布信息量足，因此少次流评估即可得到更新；用 self-rollout 训练抑制误差累积，即由模型的滑动平均副本生成用于初始化后续训练更新的预报，与把生成输出当条件上下文的 self-forcing 相区别。
Result: 粒子加速器束流 spill 预报上，few-NFE 采样预算下 CRPS 降低 65%；在流体动力学预报任务上与强基线相当；训练只用至多 4 次更新的 self-rollout，却在超过 400 次连续更新后仍保持准确。
Conclusion: 把“预报更新”本身作为流的输运目标并用 self-rollout 训练，可以在极少函数求值下做出高质量概率更新，且递归复用的误差累积在数百步尺度上仍受控。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: ECHO: Embodied Camera Observations of Human Object Carrying
papers.abstract_en: Embodied and assistive agents must do more than recognize objects: they must reason about where an object belongs given the layout of an environment and the habits of the people who live in it. Progress on this problem has been limited, in part because no dedicated benchmark or dataset exists to define and evaluate it. Existing RGB-D scan datasets reconstruct static rooms without human activity, while human-object-interaction datasets capture motion without a navigable, fully reconstructed scene or a ground-truth notion of an object's natural destination. We introduce contextual object placement as a benchmark task: predicting an object's destination during an observed object-carrying episode. To support this task, we present Embodied Camera observations of Human Object carrying (ECHO), a large-scale synthetic dataset that pairs dense RGB-D scans of indoor scenes with recordings of an embodied human carrying everyday objects to context-appropriate destinations. ECHO is the first publicly available dataset to combine reconstructed scenes, human activity, natural language, and contextual-placement annotations. It comprises 3,805 human-annotated episodes across 159 floors of 115 HM3D scenes, involving 198 distinct objects. Each floor includes a complete RGB-D scan with human-annotated room labels and a surface list. Each episode provides synchronized RGB-D encounter clips; 6-DoF camera, human, and object trajectories; start and destination surfaces; an action caption; and a human-written context: a single sentence describing the inhabitant's routine that implies the destination without naming it. We evaluate contextual object placement using input-masked probes and an end-to-end baseline. Results show that no single input modality is sufficient, highlighting the need to jointly reason over scene structure, human activity, and contextual knowledge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ECHO 提出新任务 contextual object placement：在观察到的搬运过程中预测物体的最终摆放位置，并发布配套合成数据集。数据集含 3,805 个人工标注 episode、115 个 HM3D 场景的 159 层完整 RGB-D 扫描与 198 类物体；用输入掩码探针 (input-masked probes) 和端到端基线评测，结论是任何单一输入模态都不足以完成预测，必须联合推理场景结构、人类活动与上下文知识。
Motivation: 具身与辅助智能体需要依据环境布局和居住者习惯判断物体该放哪，但此前没有专门的基准或数据集来定义和评测该问题：RGB-D 扫描数据集只有静态房间、无人类活动，人-物交互数据集有动作却没有可导航的完整重建场景和物体自然去向的 ground truth。
Method: 定义 contextual object placement 基准任务，构建合成数据集 ECHO：把室内场景的稠密 RGB-D 扫描与具身人类搬运日常物体到合乎上下文目的地的记录配对，每个 episode 提供同步 RGB-D 片段、6-DoF 相机/人/物轨迹、起止表面、动作描述 caption，以及一句暗示目的地的居住者习惯上下文；评测用输入掩码探针与一个端到端基线。
Result: ECHO 包含 3,805 个人工标注 episode、115 个 HM3D 场景的 159 层、198 个不同物体，每层带人工房间标签与表面列表；评测显示没有任何单一输入模态足以完成 contextual object placement。
Conclusion: 物体摆放预测必须同时利用场景结构、人类活动与上下文知识，缺一不可；ECHO 是首个同时结合重建场景、人类活动、自然语言与上下文摆放标注的公开数据集。
Relevance: 4
