papers.title: Q-Learning with Scalar Adjoint Matching
papers.abstract_en: Flow policies capture rich and diverse action distributions, and fine-tuning them with off-policy RL to improve beyond the demonstrations has drawn growing interest. However, fine-tuning a flow policy against a learned value function is not trivial, because the policy generates its action over many flow steps. Adjoint matching offers a principled way to update the flow model itself by propagating value information from the final action back to each flow step, but it requires a vector--Jacobian product through the policy at every step, a cost that grows with the number of flow steps and the policy size. We observe that the batch-averaged velocity Jacobian of pretrained flow policies concentrates on its diagonal. Motivated by this finding, we derive a closed-form scalar adjoint that scales the value gradient at the final action by the flow time, eliminating the per-step vector--Jacobian products. We further find that controlling the critic's value at policy-generated actions is particularly important under the scalar adjoint. Based on these findings, we propose Q-learning with Scalar Adjoint Matching (SQAM), which combines the scalar adjoint with a value penalty at those actions. SQAM's gains concentrate on the four hardest OGBench domains, where its success rate exceeds that of the strongest baseline in each domain by 18 to 35 percentage points. To test whether SQAM extends to large pretrained policies, we also fine-tune a vision-language-action policy on a real bimanual robot. SQAM improves over supervised fine-tuning on all three tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SQAM 用预训练 flow policy 的批量平均速度场 Jacobian 近似对角这一观察，推出闭式 scalar adjoint：把末端动作处的价值梯度按 flow 时间缩放，从而免去 adjoint matching 每步的 vector-Jacobian product，并在 critic 中对策略生成动作加价值惩罚。在 OGBench 四个最难域上，成功率比各域最强基线高 18 到 35 个百分点；真实双臂机器人三项任务上也全部优于监督微调。
Motivation: 用离线 RL 微调 flow policy 时，adjoint matching 需要在每个 flow step 对策略做 vector-Jacobian product，开销随步数与策略规模增长，使针对学习到的价值函数的微调难以落地。
Method: SQAM 结合两部分：由速度场 Jacobian 对角集中推出的闭式 scalar adjoint（末端价值梯度乘以 flow time），以及在策略生成动作上对 critic 施加价值惩罚；先在 OGBench 域上微调，再把同一方法用于微调一个 vision-language-action 策略。
Result: 在 OGBench 四个最难域上，SQAM 成功率超过各域最强基线 18 到 35 个百分点；在真实双臂机器人上微调大型预训练 VLA 策略，三项任务全部优于 supervised fine-tuning。
Conclusion: scalar adjoint 加动作处价值惩罚足以替代逐步 vector-Jacobian product，让 flow policy 的离线 RL 微调在大规模策略与真实机器人上都可行且更有效。

papers.title: Detecting Adversarial Images through Response Profiles of Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial perturbations can alter the predictions of frozen vision-language models (VLMs) while leaving their confidence and image--text similarity patterns seemingly plausible. We investigate whether we can identify adversarial inputs based on the broader way an image interacts with a collection of general semantic prompts. Our detector summarizes these responses using category-level statistics, relationships among prompts, deviations from clean reference distributions, and stability under weak image transformations, producing a compact response profile that is classified by a lightweight model while the VLM remains fixed. We evaluate the approach on multiple public image datasets, several CLIP-style visual backbones, and a range of gradient-based, optimization-based, automated, and spatial attacks. The detector achieves strong discrimination in attack-specific settings and retains substantial performance when evaluated on attacks not seen during training. Under a controlled detector-specific protocol, the response-profile representation outperforms the evaluated embedding-geometry baselines. Additional analyses show that the feature groups provide complementary information and that the method remains effective under variations in the prompt configuration. We also examine inference cost and performance against detector-aware adaptive attacks. Overall, the results indicate that response patterns across semantic prompts provide a useful complementary signal for adversarial image detection in frozen VLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在冻结的 vision-language model 上，用一组通用语义提示的响应剖面 (response profile) 检测对抗图像：汇总类别级统计、提示间关系、相对干净参考分布的偏离以及弱图像变换下的稳定性，再由轻量分类器判别，VLM 本身不更新。在多个公开图像数据集、多种 CLIP 式视觉骨干与梯度/优化/自动化/空间类攻击上，该表示在攻击特定设置下判别力强，对训练中未见的攻击仍保持可观性能，并在受控协议下超过所评估的 embedding-geometry 基线。
Motivation: 对抗扰动能改变冻结 VLM 的预测，却让置信度与图像-文本相似度模式看起来仍然合理，仅靠这些表面信号难以识别对抗输入。
Method: 对每张图施加一组通用语义提示，把 VLM 的响应压缩成响应剖面：包含类别级统计、提示之间的关系、相对干净参考分布的偏离，以及弱图像变换下的稳定性；再用一个轻量模型对该剖面分类，VLM 保持冻结。
Result: 在多个公开图像数据集、若干 CLIP 式视觉骨干以及梯度类、优化类、自动化与空间类攻击上评测：攻击特定设置下判别力强，对训练时未见的攻击保留可观性能；在受控的 detector-specific 协议下，响应剖面表示优于所评估的 embedding-geometry 基线；各特征组提供互补信息，且性能在提示配置变化下保持有效；另考察了推理开销与 detector-aware 自适应攻击下的表现。
Conclusion: 跨语义提示的响应模式为冻结 VLM 的对抗图像检测提供了有用的互补信号，可与几何类特征并用而非替代。

papers.title: Conditional Flow Matching for Generation of 3D Multi-variable Instantaneous Urban Microclimate Fields
papers.abstract_en: Rapid and accurate prediction of urban wind and temperature fields is important for urban microclimate design and climate adaptation. Large-eddy simulation (LES) effectively resolves these instantaneous fields, but its application is limited in iterative design of urban microclimate applications due to high computational cost. Existing regressive data-driven models offers quick outputs, but they produce only deterministic point predictions that inherently fail to represent turbulent stochasticity. This paper adopts a novel generative framework of Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) that uses building geometry and mean flow as guidance to generate plausible three-dimensional instantaneous velocity and temperature fields for urban microclimate in seconds. To overcome the GPU memory bottleneck of pixel space 3D generation, the model operates in parallel on overlapping pixel space through a shared-noise initialization that preserves high spatial continuity of flow structure across the entire domain. Against reference LES data, the CFM surrogate can rapidly and accurately restore the first-order statistics with Normalized Root Mean Square Error (NRMSE) of 2.99% for wind and 1.77% for temperature, second-order turbulence metrics with NRMSE of 7.17% for wind and 8.84% for temperature, turbulent kinetic energy with NRMSE of 7%, probability density function and vertical profiles in representative locations. Wind engineering application of local gust prediction demonstrate that the speed and accuracy of CFM, supporting the use of generative AI for making turbulence-aware resilient urban design and climate adaptation more computationally feasible.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) 以建筑几何与平均流为条件，秒级生成城市微气候三维瞬时风速与温度场，绕开 LES 的高算力成本并保留湍流随机性。相对参考 LES，一阶统计 NRMSE 风 2.99%、温度 1.77%，二阶湍流指标 NRMSE 风 7.17%、温度 8.84%，湍动能 NRMSE 7%，并能支撑局部阵风预测。
Motivation: LES 能解析城市瞬时风温场但算力开销大，难以支撑微气候的迭代设计；现有回归式数据驱动模型只给确定性点预测，无法表达湍流的随机性。
Method: 采用 Conditional Flow Matching 生成模型，以建筑几何与平均流为条件生成三维瞬时速度与温度场；为突破像素空间 3D 生成的 GPU 显存瓶颈，用共享噪声初始化 (shared-noise initialization) 让模型在重叠像素空间上并行处理，同时保持全域流动结构的空间连续性。
Result: 相对参考 LES：一阶统计 NRMSE 风 2.99%、温度 1.77%；二阶湍流指标 NRMSE 风 7.17%、温度 8.84%；湍动能 NRMSE 7%；概率密度函数与代表位置的垂直廓线也得到还原。风工程应用上，局部阵风预测展示了该 CFM 代理的速度与精度。
Conclusion: 生成式 AI 可以秒级给出湍流感知识别的城市风温场，使抗灾韧性城市设计与气候适应的计算可行性显著提高。

papers.title: SGF+: Decoupling Gradient Flows for Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive video generation requires denoising the current frames while writing their key-value representations as context for future predictions. However, these two roles typically share parameters, and we find that their gradients exhibit distinct patterns and systematic negative alignment, hindering the joint optimization of visual quality and temporal consistency. We introduce Self Gradient Forcing Plus (SGF+), which assigns separate parameters to context writing and denoising while preserving their interaction through causal attention. Both roles are jointly optimized using the original generation objective without auxiliary losses, with context writing supervised through its contribution to future predictions. This simple change improves visual quality and long-horizon consistency over the evaluated baselines in both framewise and chunkwise generation, without additional video training data or a longer training horizon. Trained on only 5s rollouts, SGF+ supports continuous generation for up to 24 hours without long-video fine-tuning. These results highlight role-specific parameterization as an effective design principle for high-quality autoregressive video generation and native long-horizon extrapolation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 自回归视频生成中，去噪当前帧与写入未来上下文的 key-value 共享参数导致梯度系统性负对齐，SGF+ 把两个角色拆成独立参数、仅用因果注意力保持交互，并用原始生成目标联合优化（无辅助损失）。在 framewise 与 chunkwise 两种生成方式上，视觉质量与长时一致性均优于所评估基线；仅用 5s rollout 训练即可连续生成最长 24 小时而无需长视频微调。
Motivation: 自回归视频生成里，去噪与上下文写入两个角色共用参数，梯度呈现不同模式且系统性负对齐，使视觉质量与时序一致性难以联合优化。
Method: 提出 Self Gradient Forcing Plus (SGF+)：为上下文写入与去噪分配独立参数，通过因果注意力保留两者交互；两个角色用原始生成目标联合优化，不加辅助损失，上下文写入由其对未来预测的贡献来监督。
Result: 在所评估基线上，framewise 与 chunkwise 生成的视觉质量和长时一致性均提升，且不需额外视频训练数据或更长训练视野；仅用 5s rollout 训练，SGF+ 支持最长 24 小时连续生成，无需长视频微调。
Conclusion: 角色专属参数化 (role-specific parameterization) 是高质量自回归视频生成与原生长时外推的有效设计原则。

papers.title: Derivative Gaussian Processes on a Two-Direction Budget
papers.abstract_en: Gradient observations promise more accurate Gaussian process (GP) surrogates, but the cost of incorporating them has long stood in the way of realizing that promise. We propose a derivative GP with a budget of just two directions per observed gradient. One direction focuses on each gradient's direct contribution to target prediction, while the other aggregates its indirect contributions through correlations with the conditioning function values. Within a Vecchia approximation, where each prediction conditions on $m$ nearby inputs in $d$ dimensions, this construction represents their $md$ gradient coordinates using at most $2m$ directional derivatives, giving $\mathcal{O}(m^3)$ dense factorization cost per prediction target. For general conditioning sets, we bound the posterior approximation error relative to using full gradients and characterize when the error is small or the approximation is exact. In simulations, our method matches the accuracy of a leading exact gradient-reduction method at equal conditioning set size. Because its cost grows much more slowly with that size, it can use conditioning sets well beyond the memory limit of the exact method, reaching lower prediction error with a small fraction of the time and memory. Notably, our method can exploit gradient observations while requiring less computation time or memory than function-only GP baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出两方向预算的导数高斯过程 (derivative GP)：每条观测梯度只保留两个方向导数，一个承接其对目标预测的直接贡献，另一个聚合经由与条件函数值相关的间接贡献。在 Vecchia 近似下，m 个近邻、d 维输入的 md 个梯度坐标被压缩到至多 2m 个方向导数，每预测目标的稠密分解代价为 O(m³)，且相对全梯度的后验近似误差有界。
Motivation: 梯度观测量本可提升 GP 代理精度，但把完整梯度并入条件集的代价长期阻碍这一承诺：Vecchia 条件集一大，梯度坐标数 md 就把内存和分解成本推到极限。
Method: 在 Vecchia 近似（每个预测以 d 维输入空间中 m 个近邻为条件）内构造两方向预算的导数 GP，用至多 2m 个方向导数表示 md 个梯度坐标，每预测目标代价 O(m³) 稠密分解；对一般条件集给出相对全梯度的后验近似误差上界，并刻画误差何时小或近似何时精确。
Result: 在模拟中，同等条件集大小下精度与领先的精确梯度降维方法 (exact gradient-reduction method) 相当；由于代价随条件集大小增长慢得多，可使用远超该精确方法内存上限的条件集，以更小的时间与内存份额达到更低预测误差；甚至在计算时间或内存上少于只用函数值的 GP 基线。
Conclusion: 梯度观测的收益不必以全梯度的内存与时间为代价：两方向预算在 Vecchia 框架下把梯度信息压到线性于 m 的方向数，代价增长慢，因而能在精确方法放不下的条件集规模上继续利用梯度并降低预测误差。

papers.title: GraphRectify: Graph-Based Transfer of Adversarial Example Detectors Across Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial example detectors are often tied to the classifier backbone they were trained on, limiting reuse when the protected model is replaced or upgraded. Directly transferring such detectors across backbones is challenging because different networks generally produce incompatible internal representations. We propose GraphRectify, a graph-based framework for transferring adversarial image detectors across classifier backbones. GraphRectify learns a structured representation of intermediate classifier features and adapts representations from a new backbone to the detector learned on the original model, enabling detector reuse. We evaluate GraphRectify across multiple datasets, backbone architectures, and adversarial attacks, including detector-aware adaptive attacks that jointly target the classifier and detector. Across the complete evaluation matrix, GraphRectify achieves higher aggregate ROC-AUC than training a detector from scratch on the new backbone and the evaluated transfer ablations. The gains are particularly strong for transfers between different backbone families and when sufficient data are available. In contrast, training from scratch remains competitive in the most data-limited settings. These results show that adversarial detection knowledge can transfer effectively across heterogeneous classifier architectures rather than being relearned whenever the protected backbone changes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GraphRectify 用图结构对齐不同分类骨干的中间特征，把在原骨干上训练的对抗样本检测器迁移到新骨干，避免每次换模型都重训检测器。在多数据集、多骨干、多攻击（含同时针对分类器与检测器的 detector-aware 自适应攻击）的完整评测矩阵上，其聚合 ROC-AUC 高于在新骨干上从零训练的检测器与所评测的迁移消融，跨骨干家族且数据充足时增益最大；数据最受限的设置下从零训练仍有竞争力。
Motivation: 对抗样本检测器与其训练所用的分类骨干绑定，受保护模型更换或升级时无法复用；不同网络的内部表征互不兼容，直接跨骨干迁移检测器行不通。
Method: GraphRectify 学习分类器中间特征的结构化图表示，并把新骨干的表征适配到在原模型上学到的检测器上，从而复用检测器；评测覆盖多个数据集、骨干架构与对抗攻击，包括联合攻击分类器与检测器的 detector-aware 自适应攻击，并与新骨干上从零训练及迁移消融对比。
Result: 在完整评测矩阵上，GraphRectify 的聚合 ROC-AUC 高于在新骨干从零训练检测器以及全部所评测的迁移消融；增益在跨不同骨干家族的迁移和数据充足时最强，而在数据最受限的设置下从零训练仍具竞争力。
Conclusion: 对抗检测知识可以在异构分类架构之间有效迁移，无需在受保护骨干每次更换时重新学习；但数据量不足时从零训练仍是合理选择。

papers.title: Which Rollout Taught It That? BehaviorTrace and the Limits of Training-Data Attribution in Online RL
papers.abstract_en: When reinforcement learning teaches a language model a new behavior, can we find the training rollouts that taught it? And when an attribution method says it can, how do we know the answer is real? We study both questions on online RL fine-tuning with GRPO, using a planted behavior with a known cause. We release BehaviorTrace, an open evaluation harness that combines full-gradient sketching, the planted-behavior setup, and controls for gradient magnitude, fluency, headroom, and variation across seeds and generation draws. Across three seeds on Qwen2.5-1.5B, much of the apparent attribution signal comes from confounds. A control that ranks training steps by gradient size alone, with no behavior target, reaches 4.2 to 4.5 times chance and matches or beats the best targeted estimator on two of three seeds. At saturated checkpoints, model fluency predicts the behavior label at least as well as every gradient method we compared it with. Once fluency is controlled, the per-rollout results change from seed to seed and from one generation draw to the next, so a single run cannot settle the question. One signal does hold on all three seeds. The gradient of the trigger tokens aligns with a target built where the behavior actually occurs. We turn these findings into a checklist for evaluating attribution in RL. We test existing estimators, including GAS (renormalized TracInCP) and a TRAK-style estimator, and do not propose a new one.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/AmitoVrito/BehaviorTrace
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BehaviorTrace 是一个在线 RL 微调（GRPO）训练数据归因的开源评测框架，用植入行为加已知成因的设定检验归因方法是否真的找对了 rollout。结果是大部分表面归因信号来自混淆：仅按梯度大小排序的无目标对照就达到随机的 4.2–4.5 倍，并在 3 个 seed 中的 2 个上追平或超过最好的定向估计器；唯一在三个 seed 上都成立的信号是 trigger token 的梯度与行为真实发生处构造的目标对齐。
Motivation: 在线 RL 教会语言模型新行为后，归因方法声称能指出是哪些训练 rollout 起的作用，但这类答案是否真实缺少可检验的评测手段，梯度大小、流畅度、headroom 等混淆因素可能冒充归因信号。
Method: BehaviorTrace 结合 full-gradient sketching、植入行为（planted behavior with a known cause）设定，以及针对梯度大小、流畅度、headroom、跨 seed 与生成抽样变化的对照；在 Qwen2.5-1.5B 上跑三个 seed 的 GRPO 在线微调，测试已有估计器 GAS（renormalized TracInCP）与 TRAK-style estimator，不提出新方法。
Result: 仅按梯度大小排序、不带行为目标的对照达到随机的 4.2–4.5 倍，并在三个 seed 中的两个上追平或超过最好的定向估计器；在饱和 checkpoint 处，模型流畅度预测行为标签的效果至少不差于所比较的全部梯度方法；控制流畅度后 per-rollout 结果随 seed 与生成抽样而变；trigger token 梯度与行为真实发生处构造的目标对齐这一信号在三个 seed 上均成立。

papers.title: Steerspeech: Activation Steering For Emotion Control In Generated Speech
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained text-to-speech (TTS) models can generate expressive speech, but reliable inference-time emotion control remains challenging: prompts and reference audio offer coarse, inconsistent control, whereas specialized conditioning and model adaptation require costly training. We present SteerSpeech, a lightweight activation-steering framework that controls emotion by injecting steering vectors into hidden activations. For each target emotion we train a lightweight low-rank transform, using a multi-expert objective that encourages monotonic emotion control while preserving speaker identity and linguistic content, constraining steering drift, and keeping the TTS backbone frozen. To optimize through discrete speech tokens, we introduce a two-pass generation-and-replay pipeline using a straight-through estimator to backpropagate expert supervision through sampled tokens. At inference, a target-emotion steering direction is optimized with its respective transform and injected into the base TTS model. Objective and subjective evaluations with Qwen3-TTS across seen, unseen, and accented speakers show stronger continuous emotion control with limited speaker and content degradation. SteerSpeech achieves 1.08x-7.12x baseline target-emotion scores and for a representative emotion subjectively, it receives 78.1%-96.8% intensity preference and 1.43x-1.46x speaker-identity preservation at high steering strengths.
papers.comment: Under review at IEEE ICASSP 2027. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SteerSpeech 在冻结 TTS 主干的前提下，用低秩激活转向向量 (activation steering) 实现推理时连续情感控制：为每种目标情感训练一个轻量低秩变换，经两步生成-回放管线把专家监督穿过离散语音 token 反传。在 Qwen3-TTS 上，目标情感得分达基线的 1.08x–7.12x，代表性情感的主观强度偏好 78.1%–96.8%，高转向强度下说话人身份保持为基线的 1.43x–1.46x。
Motivation: 预训练 TTS 的情感控制靠 prompt 或参考音频只能粗粒度、不一致地调节，而专门条件化或模型适配需要昂贵训练，缺少推理时可靠且连续的情感旋钮。
Method: 对每种目标情感训练一个轻量低秩变换，用 multi-expert 目标鼓励情感单调可控、同时保持说话人身份与语言内容，并约束转向漂移，TTS 主干全程冻结；为穿过离散 speech token 优化，采用两步生成-回放 (two-pass generation-and-replay) 管线，用 straight-through estimator 把专家监督反传过采样 token；推理时优化目标情感转向方向并注入基座模型。
Result: 在 Qwen3-TTS 上，覆盖 seen、unseen 与带口音 (accented) 说话人：SteerSpeech 取得基线 1.08x–7.12x 的目标情感得分；对一个代表性情感，主观上获得 78.1%–96.8% 的强度偏好；高转向强度下说话人身份保持为基线的 1.43x–1.46x，说话人与内容退化有限。
Conclusion: 冻结主干的低秩激活转向足以在推理时提供更强的连续情感控制，同时把说话人身份与内容损失控制在有限范围，无需对 TTS 做训练式适配。

papers.title: Training Parallel Speculative Draft Models by Directly Minimizing Expected Decoding Rounds
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by using a low-cost draft model to propose tokens that the full-size target model verifies in parallel. Parallel and semi-autoregressive (semi- AR) drafters improve drafting efficiency by proposing an entire block in a single forward pass, but training them raises a new difficulty: the draft distribution for a given position depends on where the decoding round starts, and where rounds start depends on how many tokens earlier rounds accepted. Existing training objectives typically rely on block-local surrogates that ignore this cross-round coupling, and therefore do not directly optimize the global decoding efficiency. In this work, we develop a theoretical framework for training and evaluating these drafters by representing speculative decoding as a Markov reward process. This formulation yields the Expected Decoding Rounds (EDR) objective, which weights local rejection costs by state occupancies and exactly equals the expected number of decoding rounds. Unlike prior surrogate objectives, EDR introduces no auxiliary hyperparameters. We then derive an exact temporal-difference gradient that supports unbiased stochastic optimization from target-model rollouts. The same framework also yields an exact offline evaluator for round counts, enabling paired drafter comparisons on shared target rollouts without running speculative decoding. Finetuning two state-of-the- art drafters, DSpark and DFly, with EDR consistently improves mean accepted length and outperforms existing training objectives across nine benchmarks spanning math reasoning, code generation, and chat.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把投机解码 (speculative decoding) 建模为 Markov 奖励过程，提出直接最小化期望解码轮数 (Expected Decoding Rounds, EDR) 的训练目标：按状态占用度加权局部拒绝代价，其值恰等于期望解码轮数，且不引入额外超参数。由此导出精确 TD 梯度，可用目标模型 rollout 做无偏随机优化；用 EDR 微调 DSpark 与 DFly 两个 SOTA drafter，在覆盖数学推理、代码生成与对话的九个 benchmark 上一致提高平均接受长度并胜过既有训练目标。
Motivation: 并行与半自回归 drafter 在一次前向里提出整块 token，但某位置的草稿分布取决于本轮从哪里开始，而轮起点又取决于前几轮接受了多少 token；现有训练目标用忽略跨轮耦合的 block-local 代理，无法直接优化全局解码效率。
Method: 将投机解码表示为 Markov 奖励过程，导出 EDR 目标（局部拒绝代价按状态占用度加权，精确等于期望解码轮数，无辅助超参数）；进一步推导精确 temporal-difference 梯度，支持基于目标模型 rollout 的无偏随机优化；同一框架给出轮数的精确离线评估器，可在共享目标 rollout 上做配对 drafter 比较而不实际运行投机解码。
Result: 用 EDR 微调 DSpark 与 DFly 两个 state-of-the-art drafter，在九个 benchmark（涵盖数学推理、代码生成、对话）上一致提高 mean accepted length，并优于既有训练目标；EDR 目标值精确等于期望解码轮数，且不引入额外超参数。
Conclusion: 把训练目标直接对齐到期望解码轮数这一全局量，比 block-local 代理更有效：跨轮耦合应通过状态占用度进入梯度，而非被近似忽略。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: RobotWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Robot Use Across Diverse Tasks and Embodiments
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose agents increasingly write code, use tools, and complete complex digital tasks, raising the question of how far these capabilities carry into the physical world. To investigate this, we introduce RobotWorld, a challenging simulation testbed for robot use: turning instructions and observations into physical task execution through robot interfaces. Its 84 tasks span manipulation, mobile manipulation, locomotion, driving, and aerial control, with explicit interaction budgets and executable success checks. By analysing task outcomes alongside execution traces, we identify both the capabilities that transfer and the gaps that prevent reliable completion. Furthermore, we find that current agents can construct sophisticated perception and control workflows, including image segmentation, camera calibration, spatial estimation, and dynamics-based computation. These capabilities, however, do not consistently compose into successful behaviour: agents lose task-relevant object states despite reaching commanded poses, fail to correct ineffective actions, recover too late, or mistake unfinished tasks for completion. This uneven transfer also differs across models: Astra succeeds more often on spatial and constrained-contact goals, whereas Opus 5.5 succeeds more often on continuous-balance and timed-interaction goals. By linking these outcomes to execution behaviour, RobotWorld provides both a rigorous proving ground and an empirical account of the remaining capability gaps, thereby establishing concrete targets for training and designing more reliable physical-world agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RobotWorld 是一个机器人使用的仿真测试基准，含 84 个跨操作、移动操作、运动、驾驶与空中控制的任务，带显式交互预算与可执行成功判定。分析执行轨迹后发现：当前 agent 能搭出图像分割、相机标定、空间估计与动力学计算等感知控制流程，但这些能力无法稳定组合成成功行为——会丢失任务相关物体状态、不纠正无效动作、恢复过晚或把未完成误判为完成；模型间差异明显，Astra 在空间与受限接触目标上更常成功，Opus 5.5 在连续平衡与计时交互目标上更常成功。
Motivation: 通用 agent 在代码与数字任务上已很强，但这些能力能否迁移到物理世界缺少严格、可执行判定的评测；需要一个跨多种机器人本体的基准来定位迁移断点。
Method: 构建仿真测试床 RobotWorld，把指令与观测经机器人接口转为物理任务执行；84 个任务覆盖 manipulation、mobile manipulation、locomotion、driving、aerial control，每个任务设显式交互预算与可执行成功检查，并将任务结果与执行轨迹 (execution traces) 联合分析。
Result: 84 个任务、5 类机器人技能域；agent 能构建图像分割、相机标定、空间估计、基于动力学的计算等复杂感知控制工作流，但常在到达指令位姿后丢失任务相关物体状态、不纠正无效动作、恢复过晚或误判任务完成；Astra 在空间与受限接触目标上成功率更高，Opus 5.5 在连续平衡与计时交互目标上成功率更高。
Conclusion: 能力迁移是不均衡的：单个感知控制模块可用，但组合成可靠物理行为仍断裂，这些具体断点即为训练与设计更可靠物理世界 agent 的明确目标。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Rubix: Global Correspondence-Free Point Set Alignment through Assignment Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Procrustes-Wasserstein alignment jointly estimates a matching and rotation without supplied correspondences, but alternating minimization can stop at suboptimal solutions. Rubix solves the equally weighted planar problem globally under squared Euclidean loss. Each matching $σ$ of two centered $n$-point sets defines a complex correlation $z_σ=\sum_i\bar x_i y_{σ(i)}$. Their convex hull is the permutation polygon: supporting vertices give optimal matchings at fixed rotations, and the farthest vertex gives the global alignment. We prove the sharp bound of $n(n-1)$ vertices for $n\ge2$, answering Rote's rotation-assignment open problem. In exact arithmetic, assignment queries recover the polygon in $\mathcal O(n^5)$ operations. Assignment-based bounds extend the approach to three-dimensional rotations and partial matching at a supplied translation through branch-and-bound. On timed MPEG-7 shape pairs, Rubix attains every numerical reference value in 12 ms on average, 50 times faster than a rotation grid at the same accuracy. Its distances improve gravity-aligned matching of real 3D scans, shape retrieval and noisy crystal classification over alternating minimization.
papers.comment: 67 pages, 20 figures. Includes full proofs and experimental appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Rubix 把无对应点集的 Procrustes-Wasserstein 平面配准问题全局求解：每个匹配对应复相关 z_σ，其凸包构成 permutation polygon，最远顶点即全局最优对齐，并证明 n≥2 时顶点数上界为紧的 n(n−1)，回答了 Rote 的 rotation-assignment 公开问题。在 MPEG-7 形状对上平均 12 ms 达到全部数值参考值，比同精度的旋转网格快 50 倍。
Motivation: Procrustes-Wasserstein 联合估计匹配与旋转时，交替最小化会停在次优解，缺少无对应点集配准的全局最优保证与高效算法。
Method: 对中心化 n 点集，把每个匹配 σ 映射为复相关 z_σ=Σ_i x̄_i y_{σ(i)}，其凸包即 permutation polygon：固定旋转下支撑顶点给出最优匹配，最远顶点给出全局对齐；精确算术下用 assignment query 以 O(n^5) 次运算恢复该多边形，再以 assignment-based 界结合 branch-and-bound 推广到三维旋转与给定平移下的 partial matching。
Result: 证明 permutation polygon 顶点数紧上界为 n(n−1)（n≥2）；精确算术下恢复多边形需 O(n^5) 次运算；在计时的 MPEG-7 形状对上平均 12 ms 达到全部数值参考值，比同精度的旋转网格快 50 倍；其距离在真实 3D 扫描的 gravity-aligned matching、形状检索与含噪晶体分类上优于交替最小化。
Conclusion: 把配准化为 assignment geometry 下的凸包顶点搜索，可在平面问题上给出全局最优解并把配准加速到毫秒级，且该框架可经 branch-and-bound 扩展到三维旋转与部分匹配。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: SOTA: Stock Options Trading Agents Guided by Option-Implied Return Distributions
papers.abstract_en: As option markets grow and AI advances, agentic systems for option trading are gaining increasing attention. Language-model-based agents can reason over contextual information such as news, but option trading presents a particularly challenging decision problem: a single stock can have thousands of contracts, and the agent must decide both which contracts to trade and how to combine them. Existing approaches often sidestep this complexity by restricting the policy to a fixed strategy structure, such as a straddle, limiting their ability to switch strategies as market conditions change. We present SOTA (Stock Options Trading Agents), an agentic trading framework for structured option-strategy selection. SOTA abstracts the large option universe into strategy-level decisions while deterministic resolvers handle portfolio implementation. We develop SOTA by post-training Qwen3.8-27B with supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning. SOTA is evaluated on options on nine large-cap U.S. equities and SPY against rule-based and machine-learning strategy selectors in the same trading environment. Over a six-month out-of-sample period, SOTA earns an 18.3% total return with a Sharpe ratio of 1.60 and a maximum drawdown of 8.96%. We also document an asymmetric role of news: news improves frontier-teacher trajectories, but retaining news during reinforcement learning reduces out-of-sample return from 18.3% to -2.7%.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Agenthon Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SOTA 把数千只期权合约抽象成策略级决策，用确定性 resolver 落地组合，靠 SFT+RL 后训练 Qwen3.8-27B 选择期权策略。在九只美股大盘股与 SPY 的六个月样本外交易中总收益 18.3%、Sharpe 1.60、最大回撤 8.96%；但 RL 阶段保留新闻会把样本外收益从 18.3% 打到 -2.7%。
Motivation: 单只股票就有数千个期权合约，agent 要同时决定交易哪些合约与如何组合；现有方法把策略结构固定成 straddle 之类，无法随行情切换策略。
Method: SOTA 框架把庞大的期权空间抽象为策略级决策，由确定性 resolver 负责组合实现；对 Qwen3.8-27B 先做监督微调 (SFT) 再做强化学习，并与规则型、机器学习型策略选择器在同一交易环境中对比。
Result: 在九只美国大盘股与 SPY 的期权上、六个月样本外：总收益 18.3%，Sharpe 1.60，最大回撤 8.96%。新闻的作用不对称——新闻改善 frontier-teacher 轨迹，但在 RL 中保留新闻使样本外收益从 18.3% 降到 -2.7%。
Conclusion: 策略级抽象加确定性执行能让 LLM agent 在期权交易中取得正的样本外风险调整收益；新闻信号应留在教师轨迹阶段，RL 阶段保留新闻反而摧毁样本外收益。

papers.title: Reasoning-Token Spikes Under Prompted Untruthful Responding in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Monitoring the chain-of-thought of reasoning artificial intelligence (AI) models remains a key approach to detecting deception and other forms of misbehavior in such models. However, semantic chain-of-thought monitoring depends on reasoning traces being legible and sufficiently faithful to the underlying computations that produced the model's behavior, not to mention accessible. Moreover, there is increasing evidence that chain-of-thought outputs may soon become illegible or unfaithful, if they even remain accessible. Based on cognitive load theory, we investigate a lower-bandwidth signal -- the number of reasoning tokens generated -- which does not require access to the content of the reasoning trace. Three reasoning-capable large language models answered 210 multiple-choice questions -- across analytic, descriptive, and normative reasoning types as well as moral and non-moral domains -- under system prompts instructing them to respond truthfully, falsely, or without regard for truth. Across all three models, truth-directed responding elicited fewer reasoning tokens than both lie-directed and truth-indifferent responding. These findings show that explicitly prompted untruthful response policies can produce robust group-level differences in test-time reasoning-token use. While not yet establishing reasoning-token count as a detector of spontaneous deception or general misalignment, our results are a proof of concept that it can serve as a simple, content-independent candidate signal for differentiating untruthful from truthful model behavior when raw reasoning traces are unavailable or unreliable. Future work should test instance-level detection rates, out-of-distribution generalization, learned deceptive policies, hidden objectives, and robustness under adversarial pressure.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 9 figures, 3 tables. Code: https://github.com/Wakaranaino/token-spike-project ; Data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21895296
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在三个 reasoning-capable LLM 上，用系统提示强制模型说真话、说谎或不关心真假，说真话时生成的 reasoning token 显著少于说谎与不关心真假两种策略。这说明被明确提示的不诚实响应策略会在组水平上稳定抬高测试时推理 token 用量，可作为不依赖推理文本内容的欺骗候选信号。
Motivation: 语义 chain-of-thought 监控依赖推理轨迹可读且忠实，而这类轨迹正变得不可读、不可信甚至不可访问，需要不读内容的低带宽替代信号。
Method: 基于认知负荷理论 (cognitive load theory)，只统计 reasoning token 数量而不读轨迹内容；三个具备推理能力的 LLM 各回答 210 道多选题，覆盖分析、描述、规范三类推理以及道德与非道德领域，用系统提示分别诱导 truthful、false、不关心真假三种响应策略。
Result: 跨全部三个模型，truth-directed 响应产生的 reasoning token 少于 lie-directed 与 truth-indifferent 两种响应；实验规模为 3 个模型 × 210 道多选题，覆盖三类推理与两类领域。
Conclusion: 被明确提示的不诚实策略能在组水平上稳定改变推理 token 用量，可作为原始推理轨迹不可用或不可靠时的简单、内容无关候选信号；作者明确指出这尚不是对自发欺骗或一般性失准的检测器，后续需检验实例级检测率、分布外泛化、学习得到的欺骗策略、隐藏目标与对抗压力下的稳健性。

papers.title: Self-correction Optimization for Interleaved Multimodal Generation
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made significant progress in visual understanding and generation. However, generating interleaved image--text content remains challenging, as it requires tightly integrated multimodal understanding and generation capabilities. Although existing MLLMs provide promising solutions, most rely on additional training with augmented data, which is computationally expensive and remains limited in preserving visual subjects, temporal consistency, and physical plausibility. In this work, we propose self-correction optimization (SCO), an effective training-free method for consistent interleaved generation. SCO treats the classifier-free guidance update as a reference and performs minimal self-correction under two complementary constraints, including new-event and state-preserving constraints. Specifically, the new-event constraint promotes temporal consistency across image--text sequences, while the state-preserving constraint maintains the coherence of visual subjects throughout subsequent generation steps. Experiments on challenging interleaved multimodal generation benchmarks demonstrate significant improvements in temporal coherence and visual-subject preservation. Furthermore, SCO can be extended to video generation and improves the modeling of physically grounded processes, including robot manipulation and long-horizon handcrafting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出免训练的 self-correction optimization (SCO)，把 classifier-free guidance 更新当作参考，在 new-event 与 state-preserving 两个互补约束下做最小自校正，用于一致的图文交错生成。在交错多模态生成基准上显著提升时间连贯性与视觉主体保持，并可扩展到视频生成，改善机器人操作与长程手工制作等物理过程建模。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 交错图文生成多依赖增广数据的额外训练，计算昂贵，且在视觉主体保持、时间一致性与物理合理性上仍然受限。
Method: SCO 为免训练方法：以 classifier-free guidance 更新为参考执行最小自校正，受两个互补约束驱动——new-event 约束促进图文序列的时间一致性，state-preserving 约束在后续生成步中维持视觉主体的连贯；可扩展至视频生成。
Result: 在具有挑战性的交错多模态生成基准上，时间连贯性与视觉主体保持均显著改善；扩展到视频生成后，对机器人操作与长程手工艺等物理过程的建模有所提升。
Conclusion: 免训练的约束化自校正即可在不引入额外训练的情况下改善交错生成的一致性，并能迁移到视频与物理过程建模。

papers.title: Cross-Domain Pretraining for Steady-State Neural CFD Surrogates
papers.abstract_en: Neural surrogates for computational fluid dynamics (CFD) have the potential to greatly enhance engineering innovation through accelerating simulation. However, the primary limitation for neural surrogates is the lack of generalization to geometries and applications beyond the training set, which is significant given the diversity of engineering scenarios. Currently, this is addressed by generating a new dataset for a specific application; however, this requires running costly numerical solvers. In this work, we take a step toward addressing this by studying neural surrogates trained across different geometries, boundary conditions, and fidelities. We find that cross-domain pretraining improves zero- and few-shot performance on held-out datasets relative to both training from scratch and transferring from domain-specific experts. In particular, finetuning a pretrained, cross-domain model can achieve 2-3x lower errors at the same sample size and use 8x fewer samples to achieve the same error, compared to training from scratch. This benefit is architecture agnostic and improves with model size and pretraining dataset diversity. Furthermore, we study how and why cross-domain pretraining works in CFD surrogates, and find that simply pooling steady-state datasets is both sufficient and effective. Given the high cost of generating CFD data, leveraging existing datasets through cross-domain pretraining will likely be a valuable strategy as future surrogates expand to tackle new problems and use cases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 跨域预训练（cross-domain pretraining）让稳态神经 CFD 代理在未见过的几何、边界条件与精度上获得零样本/少样本泛化：微调预训练模型在同等样本量下误差低 2–3 倍，或用 8 倍更少样本达到同等误差。作者发现简单合并（pooling）稳态数据集即已充分有效，且收益随模型规模与预训练数据多样性提升。
Motivation: 神经 CFD 代理的主要瓶颈是对训练集之外的几何与应用场景缺乏泛化，而当前做法需为每个应用重新运行昂贵的数值求解器生成数据集。
Method: 在不同几何、边界条件与精度的稳态 CFD 数据集上做跨域预训练，再对 held-out 数据集做零样本与少样本微调，与从零训练及从领域专家模型迁移对比；并分析为何跨域预训练有效。
Result: 微调跨域预训练模型相比从零训练，在同等样本量下误差低 2–3 倍，或用 8 倍更少样本达到相同误差；收益为架构无关，且随模型规模和预训练数据多样性增大；简单合并稳态数据集即充分有效。
Conclusion: 鉴于 CFD 数据生成成本高昂，跨域预训练是未来代理扩展到新问题的有价值策略；其有效性源于稳态数据集的直接合并而非复杂课程设计。

papers.title: Gaussian Density Splatting Network
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a novel crowd counting approach, the Gaussian Density Splatting Network (GDSNet). Unlike methods that rely on conventional, grid-based density maps and are sensitive to spatial resolution, GDSNet represents a crowd as a superposition of continuous 2D Gaussian primitives. Our approach is built upon two key contributions. First, we introduce a control-point-based fitting mechanism to structure the prediction of the Gaussian parameters. We design a method to allocate a set of control points that define local regions, from which features are pooled to regress each primitive's parameters. Second, we adapt a differentiable Gaussian Splatting framework to the counting task by parameterizing each primitive with geometric parameters and a scalar density mass. This formulation allows the network to be trained end-to-end via spatial matching of differentiably rendered density maps, naturally providing both local density supervision and global count optimization. Extensive evaluations on four standard benchmarks show GDSNet consistently outperforms the state of the art.
papers.comment: This is the preprint version of the paper and supplemental material to appear in NeurIPS, 2026. Please cite the final published version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GDSNet 把人群表示为连续 2D Gaussian 原语的叠加，用控制点划分局部区域并池化特征来回归每个原语的几何参数与标量密度质量，再通过可微 Gaussian Splatting 渲染密度图做空间匹配训练，同时获得局部密度监督与全局计数优化。在四个标准人群计数基准上一致超越现有最好方法。
Motivation: 常规网格密度图依赖空间分辨率，对分辨率敏感，难以精确表示连续分布的人群密度。
Method: 控制点分配机制定义局部区域、从区域池化特征以回归 Gaussian 原语参数；将可微 Gaussian Splatting 框架改造到计数任务，每个原语参数化为几何参数加标量密度质量，通过可微渲染密度图的空间匹配端到端训练。
Result: 在四个标准人群计数基准上的评测中，GDSNet 一致优于 state of the art；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 用连续 Gaussian 原语叠加替代网格密度图，配合可微渲染的空间匹配，可以在人群计数上同时拿到局部密度监督与全局计数优化并超过现有方法。

summary_sections.motivation: 常规网格密度图依赖空间分辨率，对分辨率敏感，难以精确表示连续分布的人群密度。
summary_sections.method: 控制点分配机制定义局部区域、从区域池化特征以回归 Gaussian 原语参数；将可微 Gaussian Splatting 框架改造到计数任务，每个原语参数化为几何参数加标量密度质量，通过可微渲染密度图的空间匹配端到端训练。
summary_sections.result: 在四个标准人群计数基准上的评测中，GDSNet 一致优于 state of the art；摘要未给出具体数值。
summary_sections.conclusion: 用连续 Gaussian 原语叠加替代网格密度图，配合可微渲染的空间匹配，可以在人群计数上同时拿到局部密度监督与全局计数优化并超过现有方法。

papers.title: Executing Causal Structure Learning with Linear-Attention Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Transformers can execute algorithms on data given in their input. We ask whether they can do the same for causal discovery. We study a standard continuous method that repeatedly updates a candidate causal graph while enforcing acyclicity. We explicitly construct a fixed-weight transformer whose forward pass exactly reproduces one update of this method, so repeated blocks reproduce its optimization trajectory. The transformer carries the current graph and the algorithm's multiplier between updates. We show that retaining the multiplier is essential for exact execution, since different multiplier values can lead to different next updates. We also give conditions under which, within a fixed stage, the number of updates needed to reach a target accuracy can be computed in advance and rounding errors stay bounded as depth grows. Experiments show that the constructed block agrees with a reference update to floating-point precision, while arithmetic replay on synthetic data and seven published benchmark network topologies inherits the reference solver's successes and failures. This separates accurate algorithm execution from accurate causal recovery. In contrast, the ordinary attention models tested under our training budgets do not reliably execute the update or transfer to larger graphs. Whether gradient training can learn an executor in the architecture class of the construction remains open.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 构造固定权重的 linear-attention Transformer，使一次前向传播精确复现连续因果发现方法（带无环约束的图更新）的单步迭代，重复块即复现其优化轨迹；关键在于把算法的 multiplier 与当前图一起携带，否则不同 multiplier 会导致不同的下一步更新。实验中该块与参考更新在浮点精度上一致，但在合成数据与七个已发表基准网络拓扑上，算术重放继承了参考求解器的成败，说明精确执行算法不等于精确恢复因果结构。
Motivation: Transformer 能在输入上执行算法，但因果发现这类带约束的迭代优化能否被架构精确执行尚不清楚；同时需要区分“执行准确”与“因果恢复准确”这两个常被混为一谈的问题。
Method: 针对标准连续因果发现方法（反复更新候选因果图并强制无环），显式构造固定权重 Transformer，其一次前向传播精确复现一次更新；块内状态携带当前图与算法的 multiplier。给出在固定 stage 内可预先计算达到目标精度所需更新次数、且舍入误差随深度增长保持有界的条件，并与普通 attention 模型在相同训练预算下对比。
Result: 构造的块与参考更新在浮点精度上一致；在合成数据与七个已发表基准网络拓扑上，算术重放继承参考求解器的成功与失败；普通 attention 模型在所测训练预算下不能可靠执行该更新，也不能迁移到更大图。
Conclusion: 精确执行因果发现的迭代更新可以由固定权重的 linear-attention 架构实现，且 multiplier 是精确执行的必要状态；但执行准确与因果恢复准确是两回事，梯度训练能否学出该执行器仍属开放问题。

papers.title: Kernel Autoresearch for Open-Ended Model Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Kernels encode the inductive bias of a wide range of machine learning models, yet automated kernel design faces a fundamental dilemma. A fixed grammar of base kernels and operators guarantees validity but limits the search to structures expressible by those building blocks. Conversely, unrestricted programs remove this limitation but no longer guarantee validity. In our stress tests, 22-58% of LLM-generated kernels that pass numerical checks on random inputs fail when evaluated at different scales or dimensions. We propose Kernel Autoresearch (Kernaut), which treats kernel design as open-ended model discovery. Coding agents write kernels as programs, while construction contracts ensure that every accepted kernel is valid. A quality-diversity archive retains high-performing kernels with distinct behaviors, and novelty screening steers agents toward functionally new candidates. Our experiments demonstrate that the discovered kernels encode reusable inductive biases that generalize to unseen tasks. On held-out black-box optimization families, a discovered kernel outperforms a meta-learned deep kernel trained on the same episodes. Furthermore, kernels discovered from ten enzyme-kinetic rate laws achieve lower error than tuned ARD and deep kernel baselines on five unseen mechanisms. The discovered kernels are also interpretable programs that human researchers can refine: a human-refined version of one further reduces the held-out predictive error by 5.7% and optimization regret by 7.8%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Kernaut 把核函数设计当作开放式模型发现：编码 agent 用程序写核，construction contracts 保证每个被接受的核都合法，quality-diversity archive 保留高性能且行为各异的核，novelty screening 引导搜索走向功能上新的候选。压力测试中 22–58% 通过随机输入数值检查的 LLM 生成核在换尺度或维度后失效；发现的核在留出的黑盒优化族上超过同 episode 训练的 meta-learned deep kernel，在十个酶动力学速率律上学到的核于五个未见机制上误差低于调优的 ARD 与 deep kernel 基线。
Motivation: 固定基核与算子语法保证合法性却把搜索限制在可表达结构内，无约束程序搜索放开结构却失去合法性保证；LLM 生成核在随机输入上过检、换尺度或维度即失效的比例高达 22–58%。
Method: Kernel Autoresearch (Kernaut) 由编码 agent 以程序形式写核，construction contracts 对每个被接受的核做合法性约束，quality-diversity archive 保留高性能且行为不同的核，novelty screening 把 agent 引向功能新颖的候选；实验在黑盒优化族与酶动力学速率律两个来源上做发现与留出评测。
Result: 压力测试中 22–58% 通过随机输入数值检查的 LLM 生成核在不同尺度或维度下失败；在留出的黑盒优化族上，发现的核优于在同一 episode 上训练的 meta-learned deep kernel；由十个酶动力学速率律发现的核在五个未见机制上误差低于调优的 ARD 与 deep kernel 基线；一个人类改进版本把留出预测误差再降 5.7%、优化 regret 再降 7.8%。
Conclusion: 核可以作为可读可改的程序被开放式发现，其归纳偏置能跨到未见任务；contracts 加 quality-diversity 搜索能在放开结构的同时保住合法性，且人类研究者还能在其上继续改进。

papers.title: Safe Meta-Policy Design with Risk Control
papers.abstract_en: Models can be retrained as new data arrive, but deploying every new version risks replacing a good policy with a worse one. We study how to plan policy updates (i.e., meta-policy) before future candidates are trained, balancing the benefits of improvement against the risk of performance regression. Our offline meta-policy maximizes expected cumulative value subject to a budget on the expected number of updates that perform worse than the policies they replace. We estimate the value and risk of possible switches from historical learning trajectories, represent an update schedule as a path in a directed acyclic graph, and select a schedule using dynamic programming. A leading-order analysis identifies the signal-to-noise ratio of policy improvement as a key driver of update frequency, waiting times, and risk allocation: clearer improvements support earlier, more frequent updates, while noisier improvements call for longer waits or greater risk expenditure. Their asymptotic rates also reveal a diminishing marginal cost of achieving greater safety over time. Experiments on synthetic and clinical trial data illustrate the performance--risk tradeoff and compare our method with alternative baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在模型可反复重训的场景下，把「何时换策略」当作 meta-policy 提前规划：以期望累计价值为目标，约束「新策略劣于被替换者」的期望次数预算，用历史学习轨迹估计切换的价值与风险，把更新计划表示成 DAG 上的路径并用动态规划求解。领先阶分析给出策略改进的信噪比 (SNR) 决定更新频率、等待时长与风险分配：改进越清晰越早越频繁更新，噪声大则需更长等待或更多风险支出，且随时间推移提高安全性的边际成本递减。
Motivation: 新数据到来就重训并部署每个新版本，可能把好策略换成更差的策略；需要在候选模型尚未训练前就规划更新计划，在改进收益与性能回退风险之间权衡。
Method: 离线 meta-policy 最大化期望累计价值，同时约束期望的劣化切换次数；从历史学习轨迹估计各次切换的价值与风险，把更新计划表示为有向无环图 (DAG) 上的路径，用动态规划选出计划；并做领先阶 (leading-order) 分析，把策略改进的信噪比作为更新频率、等待时间与风险分配的驱动量。
Result: 领先阶分析给出：更清晰的改进支持更早、更频繁的更新，噪声更大的改进要求更长等待或更多风险支出；渐近速率显示随时间提高安全性的边际成本递减。在合成数据与临床试验 (clinical trial) 数据上说明性能—风险权衡，并与替代基线作比较。
Conclusion: 更新时机可以作为带风险预算的离线规划问题提前求解，而策略改进的信噪比是决定更新频率与风险分配的关键量。

papers.title: MOTIP2: Spatial Priors for End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end multi-object trackers have narrowed the gap with classical tracking-by-detection on association-difficult benchmarks. Yet they still make spatially implausible errors no classical tracker would, such as assigning one identity to objects on opposite sides of the frame. A model could learn to avoid them, but tracking annotations are scarce, so we encode spatial priors explicitly instead, while keeping inference fully end-to-end with no post-hoc association. We propose three spatial priors, at the data, loss, and representation stages. Spatial ID Switches bias trajectory permutations toward spatially overlapping objects, reducing the mismatch between training and inference confusions. Spatial ID Loss scales each identity's penalty by its box distance, so a distant switch costs more than a nearby one. Spatial Anchor gives each track token its frame position, an explicit spatial cue for attention. We instantiate the three priors in MOTIP2, a tracker adapted from MOTIP and built on the real-time DEIM detection transformer. Trained without extra data, its main model, MOTIP2-L, sets a new state of the art: 73.4 HOTA on DanceTrack, 76.0 on SportsMOT, and 71.1 IDF1 on PersonPath22. MOTIP2 is a family of models spanning the speed-accuracy trade-off: a lighter model, MOTIP2-S, matches the original MOTIP at over 3x the speed, and MOTIP2-X reaches 74.8 HOTA on DanceTrack.
papers.comment: Accepted at BMVC 2026. 27 pages (14 pages main paper, appendix and references), 6 figures, 10 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 端到端多目标跟踪器会犯经典跟踪器不会的空间荒谬错误（把同一身份分给画面两侧的物体），MOTIP2 在数据、损失、表示三个阶段显式注入空间先验：Spatial ID Switch 把轨迹置换偏向空间重叠的目标，Spatial ID Loss 按框距离加权身份惩罚，Spatial Anchor 给每个 track token 注入帧位置。不加额外数据训练，MOTIP2-L 在 DanceTrack 达到 73.4 HOTA、SportsMOT 76.0、PersonPath22 71.1 IDF1，MOTIP2-X 在 DanceTrack 达 74.8 HOTA。
Motivation: 端到端跟踪器虽已逼近 tracking-by-detection，但在关联困难的基准上仍产生空间上不可能的错误；跟踪标注稀缺，靠数据学出这种约束不现实，需要显式编码空间先验且保持推理端到端、无后处理关联。
Method: 在 MOTIP（基于实时 DEIM 检测 transformer）上实例化三个先验：数据阶段的 Spatial ID Switch 使训练期混淆偏向空间重叠目标以对齐训练与推理的混淆分布；损失阶段的 Spatial ID Loss 按框距离缩放每个身份的惩罚；表示阶段的 Spatial Anchor 为每个 track token 提供帧位置作注意力的空间线索。
Result: 不使用额外数据训练，MOTIP2-L 取得 DanceTrack 73.4 HOTA、SportsMOT 76.0 HOTA、PersonPath22 71.1 IDF1 的新最优；MOTIP2-X 在 DanceTrack 达 74.8 HOTA；轻量 MOTIP2-S 以超过 3 倍速度匹配原版 MOTIP 的精度。
Conclusion: 显式空间先验可在保持端到端推理的同时消除空间荒谬的身份切换，并让模型族覆盖速度-精度权衡；标注稀缺时先验比靠数据学习更有效。

papers.title: Explicit Geometric Chain-of-Thought for Vision-Language-Action in Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action~(VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for autonomous driving. However, existing VLA models still suffer from a fundamental mismatch: driving actions require precise 3D geometric cues, while visual-language understanding and reasoning are largely conducted in a 2D semantic space. In this paper, we propose GeoCoTDrive, an explicit geometric chain-of-thought framework that grounds geometry in a planning-oriented manner. GeoCoTDrive follows a think with 2D first, drive with dedicated 3D priors paradigm. It first grounds 2D regions corresponding to decision-critical cues, and then retrieves localized 3D priors by sampling features from a geometric foundation model within the grounded regions. These localized geometric features are interleaved into the autoregressive context to support the trajectory generation. To supervise this process, we introduce planning-relevant grounding, a new region-level grounding task that focuses on local spatial cues directly affecting ego planning decisions, and construct the PlanningGrounding dataset to endow VLAs with planning-oriented grounding capability. Experiments across multiple end-to-end autonomous driving benchmarks show that GeoCoTDrive consistently improves safety-critical planning performance, demonstrating the effectiveness of the explicit geometric chain-of-thought process for VLA-based planning.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 9 figures. The code is available at https://github.com/TabGuigui/GeoCoTDrive

papers.title: RoboQuest: Generalist Physical Agents that Search, Inspect and Test
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models have made them capable generalist physical agents for a range of manipulation tasks. However, successful operation in an unfamiliar environment may require an agent to seek task-relevant information through interaction when it is absent from the observations: it may need to determine where a relevant object is, inspect an unobserved property, or discover the effect of an unfamiliar tool. We thus introduce RoboQuest, a benchmark for goal-directed embodied exploration, where agents must actively acquire task-relevant information through physical interaction, use the resulting evidence to adapt subsequent actions, and autonomously decide when to commit to task completion. RoboQuest comprises ten mobile manipulation tasks centered on three forms of uncertainty: search, manipulation-based inspection, and interactive testing. We evaluate five frontier multimodal agents through a common visuomotor interface, as well as a $π_{0.5}$ policy fine-tuned on the full-episode demonstrations we release. The best agent succeeds in only 23\% of the episodes, and the fine-tuned policy almost never succeeds. Isolated tests of the execution skills the tasks are built from, with the hidden information supplied, show that the agents can carry out most of the required actions, and our failure analysis attributes only a minority of the failures to execution. Our failure analysis further finds that the agents often stop exploring too early as they make decisions before observing the required evidence for task completion. We also find that agents rarely prevent or repair the disturbances caused by their exploration. Moreover, learning by trial and error remains difficult for most models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RoboQuest 是一个目标导向具身探索基准，含 10 项移动操作任务，围绕搜索、操作式检查、交互式测试三类不确定性，要求智能体通过物理交互主动获取信息并自行判断何时提交任务。五个前沿多模态智能体经统一视觉-运动接口评测，最佳者仅 23% 回合成功，微调 π0.5 策略几乎从不成功；失败主因是过早停止探索、在观察到必要证据前就做决策。
Motivation: 多模态基础模型已能做通用物理操作，但陌生环境中任务相关信息可能不在观测里，需要通过交互去寻找、检查未观测属性或试出陌生工具的效果，现有基准未考察这种主动取证能力。
Method: 提出 RoboQuest 基准，含 10 项移动操作任务，分搜索、基于操作的检查、交互式测试三类不确定性；用统一视觉-运动接口评测五个前沿多模态智能体，并微调 π0.5 策略于发布的全回放演示，另做隔离执行技能测试（直接给出隐藏信息）与失败归因分析。
Result: 最佳智能体仅在 23% 回合成功，微调后的 π0.5 策略几乎从不成功；给出隐藏信息的隔离执行测试显示智能体能完成大部分所需动作，失败分析中仅少数失败归因于执行。失败分析还发现智能体常过早停止探索、很少预防或修复自身探索造成的扰动，且多数模型难以通过试错学习。
Conclusion: 当前通用具身智能体的瓶颈不在执行动作，而在主动探索与证据驱动的决策时机：它们在看到完成任务所需证据之前就下判断，且试错学习仍然困难。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: OrBIT: Structure-Guided Embedding Compression
papers.abstract_en: Embedding tables are among the largest components of modern language models. Most compression methods fix a coding geometry such as coordinate blocks, low-rank subspaces, or unrestricted codebooks, and optimize within it. We instead ask whether the coding geometry can itself be discovered. We introduce \emph{OrBIT}, a structure-guided embedding compression framework that learns reusable local geometry from orbit dynamics and uses it to constrain a small set of shared codewords. The global reconstruction residual then decides where the fixed coding budget is spent, while redundant overlapping charts let local errors compensate one another after gluing. Our theory shows how tight-chart geometry controls distortion, how the global residual directs sequential allocation, and how data-geometry-guided refinement improves the codec. The resulting orbit machinery is compiled away, leaving a compact decoder in which the learned structure governs what is stored, where capacity is allocated, and how local information is assembled globally. Across four LLM embedding tables, OrBIT achieves $37.9\times$ compression on GPT-2 and over $23\times$ on each 7B table relative to 16-bit storage, while delivering competitive rate-distortion performance against established quantization and low-rank baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OrBIT 不再固定编码几何，而是从轨道动力学 (orbit dynamics) 学出可复用的局部几何来约束一组共享码字，由全局重建残差决定固定码本预算花在哪里，重叠 chart 粘合后让局部误差互相补偿。在 GPT-2 上相对 16-bit 存储达到 37.9× 压缩，三个 7B 模型的 embedding table 各超过 23×，率失真与既有量化和低秩基线相当。
Motivation: LLM 的 embedding table 是模型中最大的组件之一，主流压缩方法都先固定编码几何（坐标分块、低秩子空间或无约束码本）再在其中优化，几何本身没有被当作可学习对象。
Method: OrBIT 是结构引导的 embedding 压缩框架：从 orbit dynamics 学习可复用的局部几何并用它约束少量共享码字；全局重建残差驱动编码预算的顺序分配；冗余重叠 chart 使粘合后的局部误差互相补偿；理论部分给出 tight-chart 几何如何控制失真、全局残差如何指导顺序分配、数据几何引导的 refinement 如何改进 codec；最终 orbit 机制被编译掉，只留下紧凑解码器。
Result: 在四个 LLM embedding table 上，相对 16-bit 存储 GPT-2 达到 37.9× 压缩，每个 7B 表超过 23×；率失真表现相对既有量化与低秩基线具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 编码几何本身可以被发现并学习，学到的结构决定存什么、容量分配到哪里、局部信息如何全局组装，同时把机制编译掉只留紧凑解码器。

papers.title: Boosting and the Expressive Power of Simple Weak Learners via the $γ$-VC Dimension
papers.abstract_en: Boosting converts weak hypotheses with a small edge over random guessing into highly accurate predictors, but the expressive power of the resulting classifier can depend strongly on the structure of the base class. We study this phenomenon through the $γ$-VC dimension introduced by Alon et al. (STOC 2021). Our first result shows that this parameter characterizes the sample complexity for weak-to-strong learning up to a constant factor scaling in $γ$. We then sharpen the general relationship between the classic VC dimension and the $γ$-VC dimension. Finally, we also give improved upper and lower bounds on the $γ$-VC dimension for the fundamental concept classes of decision stumps and axis-parallel rectangles in $\mathbb{R}^d$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 以 γ-VC dimension 为工具刻画弱到强学习 (weak-to-strong learning) 的表达力：首个结果证明该参数在相差 γ 的常数因子内刻画 boosting 的样本复杂度，其次改进了经典 VC 维与 γ-VC 维的一般关系，并为 decision stumps 与 R^d 中 axis-parallel rectangles 给出更紧的上下界。
Motivation: Boosting 得到的分类器表达力强烈依赖基类结构，而 γ-VC dimension（Alon et al., STOC 2021）能否真正刻画弱到强学习的样本复杂度此前只有部分结论。
Method: 围绕 γ-VC dimension 做三步理论分析：刻画弱到强学习的样本复杂度、收紧 VC 维与 γ-VC 维的普适关系、对 decision stumps 和 R^d 中 axis-parallel rectangles 这两类基本概念类推导 γ-VC 维的上下界。
Result: γ-VC dimension 在 γ 的常数因子尺度内刻画弱到强学习的样本复杂度；给出 VC 维与 γ-VC 维之间更紧的一般关系；为 decision stumps 与 R^d 中 axis-parallel rectangles 给出改进的 γ-VC 维上下界。
Conclusion: γ-VC dimension 是衡量 boosting 后分类器表达力的正确参数，可用于判定哪些简单弱学习器经 boosting 能达到强学习。

papers.title: ResidualQuant: KV Cache Quantization for Looped Transformers with 2-Bit Residuals
papers.abstract_en: Looped Transformers improve parameter efficiency by repeatedly applying shared Transformer blocks over multiple recurrent loops, increasing computational depth without increasing the parameter count. However, KV cache memory still scales with the number of loops, becoming a key memory bottleneck that limits batch size and inference throughput. KV cache quantization can alleviate this bottleneck, but existing methods often suffer substantial accuracy degradation at aggressive low-precision regimes. We observe that looped Transformers offer a unique opportunity: KV states across loops are highly similar. Based on this observation, we propose ResidualQuant, which uses the final-loop KV states as a reference and represents the remaining loops with low-precision residuals. Our method further combines least-square scaling and rotations applied to the residuals, as well as loop-wise mixed precision, to enable accurate quantization down to INT2 while retaining efficient reconstruction. Across multiple looped Transformer models and mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks, ResidualQuant consistently improves the accuracy-memory tradeoff over state-of-the-art rotation-based KV quantization. In particular, our method retains accuracy close to BF16 under mixed-precision settings while reducing theoretical KV storage by 80.7%, achieving up to 13.0% higher accuracy than the rotation-based baseline at the same memory budget. On an RTX 5090, the reduced KV memory traffic improves fixed-batch decode throughput by up to 2.73x, while the smaller memory footprint enables up to 2x larger batches, improving peak throughput by up to 4.15x.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ResidualQuant 针对循环 Transformer (looped Transformer) 的 KV cache 随循环数增长的显存瓶颈，用最后一轮 KV 状态作参考、其余轮次只存低精度残差，并配合最小二乘缩放、残差旋转与按轮混合精度，把量化压到 INT2 仍保持接近 BF16 的精度。理论 KV 存储减少 80.7%，同等显存预算下比基于旋转的 KV 量化基线最高高 13.0% 准确率；RTX 5090 上固定 batch 解码吞吐最高 2.73x，更大 batch 使峰值吞吐最高 4.15x。
Motivation: 循环 Transformer 靠共享块重复应用提升参数效率，但 KV cache 仍随循环数线性增长，成为限制 batch size 与推理吞吐的显存瓶颈；现有 KV 量化方法在激进低精度下精度损失严重。
Method: 以最后一轮 KV 状态为参考，其余轮次用低精度残差表示；残差上叠加最小二乘 (least-square) 缩放与旋转，并做按轮混合精度 (loop-wise mixed precision)，支持到 INT2 的高效重建。
Result: 在多个循环 Transformer 模型与数学推理、代码生成基准上，混合精度设置下精度接近 BF16，理论 KV 存储降低 80.7%；同等显存预算下比旋转基 KV 量化基线最高提升 13.0% 准确率。RTX 5090 上固定 batch 解码吞吐最高 2.73x，更小显存占用支持最高 2x 更大 batch，峰值吞吐最高 4.15x。
Conclusion: 循环 Transformer 各轮 KV 高度相似这一结构特性，使残差参考式量化能在 INT2 级别同时改善精度-显存权衡与实际解码吞吐，优于旋转类 KV 量化。

papers.title: Continual Learning without Continual Training
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning requires models to adapt to new domains and new classes while retaining prior knowledge. Many existing methods rely on continued optimization, using regularization, replay, or parameter expansion to prevent new updates from overwriting previously learned knowledge. Instead, we propose replacing continual training with continual inference: a PFN-based model that is meta-trained, and then frozen, adapting to new classes only by extending an in-context evidence set. Our model, Latent Concept PFN, performs in-context Bayesian inference over a latent concept space that captures semantic structure shared across domains and classes. As each new domain or class arrives, exemplars are added to the memory; adaptation reflects updated posterior beliefs over latent concepts rather than gradient updates. No parameters are changed, reducing forgetting. The same method handles both domain and class incremental continual learning without task identity. Concept annotations are only used during meta-training, acting as a soft anchor on the latent space rather than a fixed bottleneck. Unlike fixed-vocabulary concept methods, the model also handles noisy, ambiguous, or incomplete annotations by combining concept labels with raw input evidence to discover distinctions beyond the predefined concept set. Experiments on class and domain incremental learning datasets demonstrate competitive continual learning performance while learning interpretable latent concepts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Latent Concept PFN：把持续训练换成持续推理，PFN 模型元训练后冻结，新域或新类到来时只往 in-context 证据集里加样本，通过潜在概念空间上的贝叶斯后验更新完成适应，参数完全不改从而减少遗忘。同一方法在无任务标识下同时处理类增量与域增量，概念标注仅作元训练期的软锚定，并能结合原始输入证据处理噪声、含糊或不完整的标注。
Motivation: 现有持续学习依赖正则化、回放或参数扩展的持续优化，新梯度更新会覆盖旧知识导致遗忘，且常需要任务标识。
Method: PFN (prior-factored network) 架构做元训练后冻结；在潜在概念空间上做 in-context 贝叶斯推断，新域/新类到达时把 exemplar 加入记忆并更新潜在概念的后验信念，不做梯度更新。概念标注仅在元训练期作为潜在空间的软锚，推理期把概念标签与原始输入证据结合以发现预定义概念集之外的区分。
Result: 在类增量与域增量持续学习数据集上的实验展示了具竞争力的持续学习性能，同时学到可解释的潜在概念；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 持续适应可以不靠参数更新实现：冻结模型加扩展证据集即可同时覆盖类增量与域增量并降低遗忘，代价是把适应压力移到元训练阶段。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: TaoD2C-Bench: Benchmarking MLLMs for Industrial UI Code Generation Beyond Visual Fidelity
papers.abstract_en: A key challenge for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is moving beyond visual recognition to constraint-aware cross-modal reasoning. This involves combining visual cues with information from other modalities to understand elements' relationships under domain-specific rules. This challenge is acutely evident in industrial design-to-code (D2C), which converts user interface (UI) designs into code and requires MLLMs to connect design images with disorganized layer metadata, infer component and layout implementation requirements, and realize them in code under target-library constraints. However, these capabilities remain insufficiently evaluated in realistic industrial settings. To fill this gap, we present TaoD2C-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs' ability to generate UI code that satisfies implementation requirements in industrial applications. The TaoD2C dataset consists of 2,861 production designs from 17 commercial platforms with 97,652 expert annotations across four categories: Component, Group, Alignment, and Position. These annotations distinguish required constraints from permitted implementation choices. TaoD2C-Bench defines three tasks: end-to-end UI code generation, requirement inference, and requirement realization. Evaluating eight MLLMs reveals substantial gaps in generating UI code that satisfies implementation requirements, alongside distinct performance profiles in inference and realization. We further show that MLLMs' visual reconstruction ability does not necessarily imply an ability to generate code that meets these requirements. We release TaoD2C to support research on industrial UI code generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出工业设计转代码 (D2C) 基准 TaoD2C-Bench，用 2,861 个来自 17 个商业平台的生产设计与 97,652 条专家标注，区分“必须满足的约束”与“允许的实现自由度”，并拆成端到端 UI 代码生成、需求推理、需求实现三个任务。评测八个 MLLM 显示其在满足实现要求的代码生成上存在明显缺口，且视觉重建能力好并不等于能生成符合要求的代码。
Motivation: MLLM 已能做视觉识别，但在领域规则约束下的跨模态推理（把设计图与杂乱图层元数据、目标组件库约束对齐）缺少贴近真实工业场景的评测。
Method: 构建 TaoD2C 数据集（2,861 个生产设计、17 个商业平台、97,652 条专家标注，分 Component、Group、Alignment、Position 四类，标注区分必需约束与允许实现），据此定义三个任务：端到端 UI 代码生成、需求推理、需求实现，并在八个 MLLM 上评测。
Result: 八个 MLLM 在生成满足实现要求的 UI 代码上存在明显差距，且在需求推理与需求实现两个维度上呈现不同的性能画像；视觉重建能力并不必然对应生成符合要求代码的能力。
Conclusion: 工业 D2C 需要的是约束感知的跨模态推理，视觉重建强弱不能作为代码生成合规性的代理指标；作者公开 TaoD2C 以支持该方向研究。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: PalmSpace: Towards a Versatile On-Palm Interaction Space through Unified Touch Modeling
papers.abstract_en: As smart glasses and lightweight MR devices become increasingly practical, input remains a key challenge. The bare palm is an always-available, tactile, and proprioceptively accessible surface, but it has neither an explicit coordinate system nor embedded touch sensing. Prior on-palm systems typically expose isolated touch events, discrete regions, continuous trajectories, or task-specific gestures, limiting the palm's ability to support precise selection and gesture manipulation through a common input representation. We present PalmSpace, a wrist-worn infrared system that exposes mode-aware, body-referenced absolute input on the bare palm without per-user sensing calibration. At the interaction level, PalmSpace jointly represents contact occurrence, interaction mode, and palm-referenced absolute location; at the model level, it learns these coupled outputs through a shared real-time representation. In leave-one-participant-out evaluation with 17 participants, PalmSpace achieved 6.7 mm mean localization error, 98.9% contact detection accuracy, and 96.7% F1 for four-class interaction-state recognition. User studies further demonstrated absolute pointing and dragging, eyes-free digit input, and representative multi-finger controls including scrolling and pinch-based map manipulation. These results show that a morphologically variable bare palm can function as a transferable, mode-aware interaction surface.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PalmSpace 用腕戴红外传感在裸掌上提供免逐人标定的、以身体为参照的绝对输入，把接触有无、交互模式与掌面绝对位置放进一个共享实时表征联合学习。在 17 人留一被试评估中，定位平均误差 6.7 mm，接触检测准确率 98.9%，四类交互状态识别 F1 为 96.7%。
Motivation: 智能眼镜与轻量 MR 设备的输入仍是难题：裸掌随手可得却没有坐标系与触觉传感，既有掌上系统只给孤立事件、离散区域、连续轨迹或任务特定手势，无法用统一表征同时支撑精确选择与手势操作。
Method: 腕戴红外系统采集掌面信息，无需逐人传感标定；模型层面用共享的实时表征联合学习接触发生、交互模式（四类交互状态）与掌面参照的绝对位置这三个耦合输出，评估采用留一被试 (leave-one-participant-out) 协议。
Result: 17 名参与者的留一被试评估中，定位平均误差 6.7 mm，接触检测准确率 98.9%，四类交互状态识别 F1 96.7%；用户研究演示了绝对指点与拖拽、免视觉数字输入，以及滚动、捏合地图操作等多指控制。
Conclusion: 形态多变的裸掌可以作为一个可迁移、模式感知的交互表面，用统一表征同时承载接触、模式与绝对位置，支撑选择与手势操作。

papers.title: Input-Blind Controls Produce Substantial Oracle Headroom for Layer Programs in Multiple-Choice Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive computation aims to improve language-model inference by tailoring execution to each input. For layer programs, oracle evaluations use known answers to estimate the potential gain from this flexibility, before a practical selector is available. However, a gain from selection does not by itself explain why the chosen programs help. This study examines this distinction using 32 layer-skipping and repetition programs on two models and 4,413 multiple-choice items. The analysis compares their gains over a fixed action selected without the evaluation prompt with those of input-blind perturbations at the same sites, re-evaluating selections on another prompt. With shared option order, the controls give 10.2-11.8 and 15.6-19.4 percentage points of headroom on Qwen3-4B-Base and Llama-3.1-8B, exceeding the real programs' 9.0 and 10.1 in all three random-direction draws per model. They match answer-change rate only, and the ordering depends on the menu: in post hoc comparisons, real programs lead on Llama's repeat-only menu in every draw. A smaller KL-calibrated comparison, including an input-dependent control, favours real programs in point estimate, with inconclusive corrected tests. Fixed letter offsets produce headroom of similar scale. Rotating options sharply reduces both families' headroom, while leaving positive real-minus-control differences of 1.4-2.3 and 3.7-4.5 points; their magnitudes and statistical support depend on further adjustments and the reference. A supplementary generated-answer test finds that search-selected programs keep a 26.0-point advantage over programs selected for other problems after rewording, without a placebo comparison. These results show that substantial headroom can persist across prompts with shared option order without establishing a benefit specific to the selected layer computation; neither ordering against these controls identifies that benefit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多选题评测中，32 个跳层/重复 layer program 的 oracle 增益有相当部分可由与输入无关的对照复现：共享选项顺序时，input-blind 扰动在 Qwen3-4B-Base 与 Llama-3.1-8B 上给出 10.2–11.8 与 15.6–19.4 个百分点的 headroom，超过真实 program 的 9.0 与 10.1。轮换选项后两族 headroom 都大幅下降，但真实减对照仍为正的 1.4–2.3 与 3.7–4.5 点。作者结论是：跨 prompt 存在的 headroom 不能证明所选 layer 计算本身带来收益，与这类对照的排序也无法识别该收益。
Motivation: layer program 的 oracle 评测用已知答案估计自适应计算的潜在收益，但收益本身不解释为何被选中的 program 有帮助；需要区分真实计算收益与仅由选项顺序、答案改变率驱动的表面 headroom。
Method: 在两个模型上用 32 个 layer-skipping 与 repetition program、4,413 道多选题，比较不看评测 prompt 选出的固定动作的增益与同位置 input-blind 扰动的增益，并在另一 prompt 上重评选择；另做共享选项顺序、轮换选项、固定字母偏移、KL 校准（含 input-dependent 对照）以及生成答案改写测试。
Result: 共享选项顺序下对照给出 Qwen3-4B-Base 10.2–11.8、Llama-3.1-8B 15.6–19.4 个百分点 headroom，超过真实 program 的 9.0 与 10.1，且每模型三次随机方向抽样均如此；对照只匹配 answer-change rate，Llama 的 repeat-only 菜单上真实 program 每次抽样都领先。轮换选项使两族 headroom 都锐减，真实减对照仍为 1.4–2.3 与 3.7–4.5 点；固定字母偏移产生同量级 headroom。补充生成答案测试中，search-selected program 改写后仍保持对其他问题所选 program 的 26.0 点优势（无 placebo 对照）。
Conclusion: 共享选项顺序下大量 headroom 可跨 prompt 存在，却不能确立所选 layer 计算的特异收益；无论相对这些对照的排序方向如何，都无法识别该收益。

papers.title: Temporally Interpretable Differentiable Decision Trees
papers.abstract_en: Interpretability offers a solution to safe autonomy by providing transparency into an agent's underlying decision-making model. Within sequential-decision making tasks, differentiable decision trees (DDTs) are one approach to such interpretability, maintaining automatic-differentiable policies while providing humans with a discrete tree-based visualization. Nonetheless, current implementations of DDTs are not well-suited for sequential-decision making domains, as there exists an inherent mismatch between a tree's single-timestep behavior and a human's multi-timestep planning. Our work thus introduces time as a new dimension of interpretability, coined as temporal interpretability, and demonstrates how temporal abstractions via action chunking improve it. We achieve this by first introducing two novel policy gradient algorithms that incorporate action chunking. Additionally, to maintain parameter-efficient trees, we develop an information-theoretic tree restructuring algorithm that modifies the tree during training. Across four simulation environments, we find that warm-starting action chunked DDTs from a distilled action chunked policy is the most effective way to obtain temporally interpretable trees: they match neural network policies in three of the four domains while using up to 80$\%$ fewer parameters. Our code is available at https://github.com/ei5uke/temp-interp.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出时间可解释性 (temporal interpretability) 概念，用动作分块 (action chunking) 弥合决策树单步行为与人类多步规划的错位，并给出两个带动作分块的策略梯度算法与训练中执行的信息论树重构算法。在四个仿真环境中，从蒸馏后的动作分块策略热启动得到的 DDT 效果最好：三个域上追平神经网络策略，参数量最多减少 80%。
Motivation: 序贯决策中的可微决策树 (DDT) 虽然可微且可视化，但树的单步行为与人类的多步规划存在固有错位，现有 DDT 实现不适合序贯决策域。
Method: 引入动作分块的两个新策略梯度算法；开发信息论树重构算法在训练过程中修改树以保持参数高效；并从蒸馏的动作分块策略热启动 DDT。
Result: 在四个仿真环境中，热启动动作分块 DDT 在四个域中的三个上匹配神经网络策略，同时参数量最多减少 80%。
Conclusion: 时间可解释性要靠动作分块这类时间抽象来提升，而蒸馏热启动是获得既追平神经网络又参数高效的可解释树的最有效路径。

papers.title: Koopman Observers for Diffusion Acceleration: Correcting Feature Forecasts with Shallow Measurements
papers.abstract_en: Feature caching accelerates diffusion sampling by replacing expensive network evaluations with predictions from previously computed activations. However, forecasts based only on past features cannot directly incorporate changes in the current denoising state. We investigate whether inexpensive, freshly computed features can serve as observations for correcting these predictions. We introduce an observation-corrected Koopman framework for accelerating frozen diffusion models. Using calibration trajectories, we identify finite-dimensional, time-dependent Koopman approximations that jointly describe the increments of shallow and deep network features. During accelerated sampling, these operators predict the evolution of expensive deep features, while innovations in the observed shallow features correct the predicted state. Periodic full evaluations refresh the observer, and all generative-model parameters remain unchanged. This formulation enables controlled comparisons of temporal prediction and observation correction. Across three 10,000-image runs per dataset, our method reduces paired Inception-feature MSE by $19.9\%$ on CIFAR-10 and $11.9\%$ on a ten-class ImageNet subset relative to channelwise affine prediction under the same four-partial-step schedule. Matched ablations attribute additional reductions of $4.54\%$ and $4.67\%$ to observation correction. The observer achieves $1.89\times$ and $1.85\times$ measured speedups over DDIM-50, supporting improved reference-sampler fidelity without retraining the denoiser.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在冻结的 diffusion 模型上，用浅层特征作为观测去校正 Koopman 预测的深层特征缓存，可在不重训去噪器的前提下加速采样。相对 channelwise affine 预测，CIFAR-10 与十类 ImageNet 子集的配对 Inception 特征 MSE 分别下降 19.9% 与 11.9%，其中观测校正单独贡献 4.54% 与 4.67%，相对 DDIM-50 加速 1.89× 与 1.85×。
Motivation: Feature caching 用历史激活预测替代昂贵网络前向来加速 diffusion 采样，但只依赖过去特征的预测无法纳入当前去噪状态的变化，缓存误差随之累积。
Method: 提出观测校正的 Koopman 框架加速冻结 diffusion 模型：用 calibration trajectories 辨识有限维、时变的 Koopman 近似，联合描述浅层与深层网络特征的增量；采样时由算子预测深层特征演化，浅层特征的新息 (innovation) 校正预测状态，周期性全前向刷新 observer，生成模型参数全程不变。
Result: 每个数据集三次 10,000 图像运行、同一 four-partial-step 调度下，配对 Inception 特征 MSE 相对 channelwise affine 预测在 CIFAR-10 降低 19.9%、在十类 ImageNet 子集降低 11.9%；匹配消融显示观测校正额外贡献 4.54% 与 4.67% 的下降；相对 DDIM-50 实测加速 1.89× 与 1.85×。
Conclusion: 浅层特征的新息足以作为廉价观测来校正 Koopman 特征预测，在不重训去噪器的情况下同时改善加速采样对参考采样器的保真度并保持加速比。

papers.title: Pathwise Information Certificates for Decentralized Adaptive Sensing
papers.abstract_en: We study decentralized adaptive sensing, where multiple agents choose measurements from evolving local beliefs while exchanging information over a communication graph. We ask whether the measurements actually selected by an adaptive policy have collected enough evidence to distinguish the true target from every plausible alternative. We develop a pathwise certificate based on the Rényi--Chernoff information accumulated along the realized sensing trajectory. It yields nonasymptotic MAP-error bounds and an anytime, network-wide stopping rule for arbitrary history-dependent sensing policies, while separating accumulated statistical information from a bounded network-mixing transient. Linear growth of the information against the least-resolved competitor implies exponential decay of MAP and squared-localization error. A classical pairwise KL converse, specialized to the adaptive decentralized transcript, shows that insufficient information on any pair prevents a positive uniform error exponent, confirming the hardest competitor as a fundamental bottleneck. Across policies, graph topologies, sensor profiles, and seeds, the worst-competitor score correlates more strongly with localization speed than an average-pair proxy in both 1D ($r=0.89$ versus $0.40$) and structured 2D sensing ($r=0.77$ versus $0.48$). Our results provide a practical way to certify and diagnose adaptive multi-agent sensing systems using the evidence they actually collect.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多智能体分散自适应感知中，提出基于实现轨迹上累积 Rényi–Chernoff 信息的路径级证书 (pathwise certificate)，对任意依赖历史的感知策略给出非渐近 MAP 误差界与全网 anytime 停止规则，并把统计信息与有界网络混合瞬态分离。信息对最弱分辨竞争者的线性增长蕴含 MAP 与平方定位误差的指数衰减；最弱竞争者分数与定位速度的相关性在 1D 为 r=0.89（平均成对代理仅 0.40），结构化 2D 为 0.77（对 0.48）。
Motivation: 自适应策略实际选到的测量是否已积累足够证据、能否把真目标与每个可行备选区分开，缺少可计算的判定；分散场景下网络混合瞬态还会与统计信息混在一起，难以诊断定位快慢。
Method: 沿实现的感知轨迹累积 Rényi–Chernoff 信息构造路径级证书，导出非渐近 MAP 误差界与 anytime 全网停止规则，适用于任意依赖历史的感知策略，并将累积统计信息与有界网络混合瞬态解耦；再把经典成对 KL converse 特化到分散自适应 transcript 上给出信息不足时的 converse。
Result: 最弱分辨竞争者信息线性增长则 MAP 与平方定位误差指数衰减；KL converse 表明任一成对信息不足即排除正的一致误差指数，最难竞争者是根本瓶颈。在不同策略、图拓扑、传感器配置与随机种子下，最弱竞争者分数与定位速度的相关性在 1D 为 r=0.89（平均成对代理 0.40），结构化 2D 感知为 r=0.77（对 0.48）。
Conclusion: 用系统实际收集的证据即可认证并诊断自适应多智能体感知系统，且定位速度应由最难竞争者而非平均成对信息来刻画。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: ORDERS: An Empirical Study of Norm-Rank Aggregation for Personalized Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Personalized federated learning combines shared representations with client-specific predictors, but the contribution of a server weighting rule can be obscured by local training and evaluation choices. We study ORDERS, a configuration that combines a shared backbone, a private residual adapter and classifier, geometric weights assigned by descending update norm, feature alignment, and private-parameter perturbations. The server computes a weighted sum of updates obtained from the same broadcast model; it does not obtain an additional optimization effect from sequential addition. A fully specified evaluation comprises 80 final runs: eight configurations, two datasets, and five training seeds on one fixed partition per dataset. On two-class-per-client CIFAR-10, ORDERS achieves $80.51 \pm 0.79\%$ native mean client accuracy, compared with $79.02 \pm 1.42\%$ for FedPer-R1 and $80.27 \pm 0.73\%$ for the matched uniform-weight control. After common local fine-tuning, the difference from FedPer-R1 narrows to 0.32 percentage points. On Sent140, ORDERS reaches $74.71 \pm 0.49\%$, only 0.69 points above a post hoc client training-majority diagnostic. Ablations provide limited, endpoint-dependent evidence for norm ranking and alignment, and no clear benefit from perturbations. Parameter-payload savings are 5.47% and 0.78%, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ORDERS 把共享 backbone、私有残差 adapter 与分类器、按更新范数降序的几何权重、特征对齐和私有参数扰动组合成一种个性化联邦学习配置。在每客户端两类的 CIFAR-10 上原生平均客户端准确率 80.51±0.79%，与均匀权重对照 80.27±0.73% 基本持平，对 FedPer-R1 的 79.02±1.42% 优势在统一本地微调后缩到 0.32 个百分点；范数排序与对齐的消融证据有限且依赖端点，扰动无明确收益。
Motivation: 个性化联邦学习中服务器加权规则的作用常被本地训练与评测选择掩盖，难以判断加权本身是否带来增益。
Method: ORDERS 配置：共享 backbone + 私有残差 adapter 与分类器，服务器按更新范数降序赋几何权重，配合特征对齐与私有参数扰动；服务器对同一广播模型的更新做加权求和，不引入顺序相加的额外优化效应。评测为 80 次最终运行：8 种配置 × 2 个数据集 × 5 个训练种子，每个数据集一个固定划分。
Result: CIFAR-10（每客户端两类）：ORDERS 原生平均客户端准确率 80.51±0.79%，FedPer-R1 为 79.02±1.42%，匹配的均匀权重对照为 80.27±0.73%；统一本地微调后与 FedPer-R1 差距缩至 0.32 个百分点。Sent140：74.71±0.49%，仅比事后客户端训练多数类诊断高 0.69 个百分点。消融对范数排序与特征对齐只给出有限且依赖端点的证据，扰动无明确收益；参数载荷节省分别为 5.47% 与 0.78%。
Conclusion: 在该评测设置下，范数排序加权规则的可测贡献很小，主要差异来自本地训练与评测选择；作者的对照设计意在把加权规则本身的作用与这些选择分离。

papers.title: MultiFly: A Real-World Multimodal Aerial Dataset with Annotation-Efficient Label Transfer and Cross-Modal Semantic Consistency
papers.abstract_en: We introduce MultiFly, a real-world, low-altitude UAV dataset for semantic perception across RGB, thermal, LiDAR, and radar modalities. MultiFly provides 17,272 synchronized samples from four suburban scenes with frame-wise annotations for 15 semantic classes, together with calibration and GNSS-RTK/IMU measurements. To avoid costly and inconsistent modality-specific annotation, we propagate labels from only 115 manually annotated RGB images through shared geometric representations to all four modalities. This approach generates semantic labels for 17,157 additional RGB images, 17,272 thermal images, 840M LiDAR points, and 3.4M radar points. Transferred annotations achieve 89.93% average agreement with held-out manual annotations, and 90.94% average semantic consistency across all six modality pairs. We further establish semantic segmentation benchmarks for all four modalities, revealing distinct architectural behavior for dense LiDAR and sparse radar data. Taken together, MultiFly provides a scalable foundation for multimodal aerial perception and, to the best of our knowledge, the first public real-world low-altitude aerial benchmark that combines consistent frame-wise semantic annotations for RGB, thermal, LiDAR, and radar. Data at https://github.com/markus-42/multifly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MultiFly 是低空 UAV 多模态语义感知数据集，含 RGB、热成像、LiDAR、雷达四模态 17,272 个同步样本、15 类逐帧标注；只人工标注 115 张 RGB 图，经共享几何表示把标签传播到全部四模态，额外生成 17,157 张 RGB、17,272 张热图、8.4 亿 LiDAR 点与 340 万雷达点标注。迁移标注与留出人工标注平均一致率 89.93%，六对模态间语义一致性 90.94%。
Motivation: 逐模态分别标注多模态数据成本高且各模态标签不一致，制约低空无人机多模态感知基准的规模与可比性。
Method: 以 115 张人工标注 RGB 图为源，通过共享几何表示把语义标签跨模态传播到 RGB、热成像、LiDAR、雷达；数据含四个郊区场景、标定与 GNSS-RTK/IMU，并为四模态建立语义分割基准。
Result: 17,272 个同步样本、15 类逐帧标注；标签传播覆盖 17,157 张 RGB、17,272 张热图、840M LiDAR 点、3.4M 雷达点；与留出人工标注平均一致率 89.93%，六对模态平均语义一致性 90.94%；基准显示稠密 LiDAR 与稀疏雷达数据上架构行为不同。
Conclusion: 用少量 RGB 人工标注经几何共享表示跨模态迁移，可规模化产出四模态一致的逐帧语义标签，MultiFly 成为首个公开的真实低空四模态一致逐帧语义基准。
