summary_sections.method: 以 115 张人工标注 RGB 图为源，通过共享几何表示把语义标签跨模态传播到 RGB、热成像、LiDAR、雷达；数据含四个郊区场景、标定与 GNSS-RTK/IMU，并为四模态建立语义分割基准。
summary_sections.result: 17,272 个同步样本、15 类逐帧标注；标签传播覆盖 17,157 张 RGB、17,272 张热图、840M LiDAR 点、3.4M 雷达点；与留出人工标注平均一致率 89.93%，六对模态平均语义一致性 90.94%；基准显示稠密 LiDAR 与稀疏雷达数据上架构行为不同。
summary_sections.conclusion: 用少量 RGB 人工标注经几何共享表示跨模态迁移，可规模化产出四模态一致的逐帧语义标签，MultiFly 成为首个公开的真实低空四模态一致逐帧语义基准。

papers.title: Open-MMUnlearning: Unifying Methods and Evaluation for MLLM Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: As multimodal large language models (MLLMs) become more capable and widely deployed, concerns about privacy and safety have become increasingly pressing. Machine unlearning offers one approach to addressing these concerns by removing designated information from trained models while preserving unrelated capabilities. However, fragmented implementations and evaluation protocols, incomplete robustness testing, and limited understanding of metric reliability make progress in MLLM unlearning difficult to assess systematically. We introduce Open-MMUnlearning, an open-source, extensible framework that integrates target-model preparation, multimodal data processing, unlearning, and evaluation through shared interfaces and structured configurations. The framework supports five benchmarks spanning privacy, safety, and copyright, eight MLLMs from four model families, and twelve unlearning methods. Its evaluation suite jointly assesses forgetting effectiveness, retained utility, and robustness to model interventions, adversarial inputs, and membership inference attacks. Using a common evaluation protocol, we compare ten representative unlearning methods. In this comparison, GD and MIP-Editor tie for the highest overall score: GD achieves the highest Forget Quality, while MIP-Editor preserves more Model Utility. We further introduce a metric meta-evaluation protocol that tests faithfulness using models with controlled exposure to target knowledge and robustness under quantization and relearning. Among the thirteen evaluated metrics, BLEU achieves the highest aggregate reliability score. KS-Test attains the highest faithfulness AUC but performs less well on robustness. Together, the framework and these findings support reproducible comparison of MLLM unlearning methods and systematic assessment of evaluation reliability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出开源可扩展框架 Open-MMUnlearning，把目标模型准备、多模态数据处理、遗忘 (unlearning) 与评测统一到共享接口下，覆盖隐私、安全、版权五类基准、八个 MLLM 与十二种遗忘方法。在统一协议下比较十种代表性方法，GD 与 MIP-Editor 总分并列最高：GD 的 Forget Quality 最高，MIP-Editor 保留的 Model Utility 更多；十三个指标中 BLEU 的综合可靠性最高，KS-Test 的 faithfulness AUC 最高但鲁棒性较差。
Motivation: MLLM 遗忘研究的实现与评测协议碎片化、鲁棒性测试不全、指标可靠性认识不足，导致进展难以系统评估。
Method: 以共享接口和结构化配置集成目标模型准备、多模态数据处理、遗忘流程与评测；评测套件同时考察遗忘效果、保留效用，以及对模型干预、对抗输入和成员推断攻击 (membership inference attack) 的鲁棒性；另提出用受控接触目标知识的模型、并加入量化与再学习条件的指标元评估协议。
Result: 框架支持五类基准（隐私、安全、版权）、来自四个模型家族的八个 MLLM 和十二种遗忘方法；统一协议下比较十种方法，GD 与 MIP-Editor 总分并列最高，GD 的 Forget Quality 最高、MIP-Editor 的 Model Utility 保留更多；十三个评测指标中 BLEU 综合可靠性分数最高，KS-Test faithfulness AUC 最高但鲁棒性较弱。
Conclusion: 统一评测协议加指标元评估，才能让 MLLM 遗忘方法的比较可复现、并识别哪些指标真正可信。

papers.title: MIRA: A Musical Intent Refinement Agent for Aligning Text-to-Music Generation with User Intent
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-music systems produce increasingly convincing audio, yet evaluation reveals little about whether the result matches user intent. A global text-audio relevance score can overlook the implicit intent in underspecified prompts and mask failures in specific requirements, such as instrumentation, structure, rhythm, or mood progression. To bridge this gap, we formulate text-to-music intent alignment as satisfying a per-request rubric of independently verifiable items covering both a request's explicit requirements and its implied musical intent. Scoring items individually makes evaluation diagnostic by intent source and musical dimension, rather than a single opaque score. We instantiate this as MuRA-Bench, a benchmark of real-world platform requests curated by music experts. We further propose MIRA (Musical Intent Refinement Agent), a test-time agent that first grounds a request's intent into rubrics, then searches over prompt revisions for a black-box generator under a bounded budget, iteratively generating music, verifying it against the rubrics, and using this feedback to guide a trajectory-aware tree search. Experiments across open-source and commercial backends show that MIRA improves intent alignment, enabling an open-source generator to achieve performance comparable to representative commercial systems (e.g. Suno and Mureka). Project page: https://mirareview.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MIRA 把文本到音乐的意图对齐拆成可独立核验的 rubric 条目，测试时先将请求意图落成 rubric，再在受限预算内对 prompt 做树搜索式修订，迭代生成、按 rubric 校验并用反馈引导轨迹感知搜索。在开源与商业后端上实验显示意图对齐提升，使开源生成器达到与 Suno、Mureka 等代表性商业系统相当的表现。
Motivation: 全局文本-音频相关性分数会忽略欠定 prompt 中的隐含意图，也会掩盖配器、结构、节奏、情绪推进等具体要求上的失败，评测无法按意图来源和音乐维度定位问题。
Method: 将意图对齐形式化为满足一份逐条可独立核验的 rubric（覆盖显式要求与隐含音乐意图），构建音乐专家标注的真实平台请求基准 MuRA-Bench；MIRA 为测试时 agent，先把请求意图落成 rubric，再在有界预算下对黑盒生成器搜索 prompt 修订，迭代生成音乐、按 rubric 校验并以反馈驱动 trajectory-aware tree search。
Result: 在开源与商业后端上的实验中 MIRA 提升意图对齐表现，使开源生成器达到与代表性商业系统（如 Suno 和 Mureka）相当的性能。
Conclusion: 把意图拆成可独立核验的 rubric 并在测试时做有预算的 prompt 树搜索，可以在黑盒文本到音乐生成上对齐用户意图，让开源生成器逼近商业系统水平。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Handover Problem: Governing Autonomy Transitions in Human-AI Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: Human-machine systems rarely operate at a fixed level of AI autonomy. As operators and AI systems collaborate over time, control must shift: the AI can take on more responsibility when collaboration is stable, maintain its current role when evidence is ambiguous, or return control to the human when conditions deteriorate. Existing work on adaptive automation, supervisory control, trust in automation, and deskilling explains parts of this problem, but provides no auditable, multi-signal criterion for governing when autonomy should change across multi-cycle workflows. We formalise this challenge as the Handover Problem: deciding, at each operational cycle, whether to escalate, maintain, or revert AI autonomy while keeping the process reversible, recoverable, and auditable. We introduce the Handover Readiness Score (HRS), a transparent composite measure that integrates four signal dimensions: operator readiness, human-AI trust, learning stability, and operational performance. It is combined with a hysteresis-based transition policy that requires sustained positive evidence before increasing autonomy but reverts promptly when conditions worsen. Across software engineering and manufacturing domains, the HRS and hard safety guards address complementary failure regimes: guards enforce immediate corrective action when a single indicator breaches a critical threshold, while the HRS detects the slow, multi-signal erosion of operator readiness that no individual guard can observe. The framework establishes autonomy handover as a governance problem requiring explicit, composite, and auditable criteria. This provides a conceptual and formal foundation that adaptive automation research has not previously provided.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, 8 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Human-Machine Systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把人机协作中的自主权切换形式化为 Handover Problem：用透明的 Handover Readiness Score (HRS) 综合操作员就绪度、人机信任、学习稳定性、运行性能四个信号，再配滞回 (hysteresis) 切换策略——升级需持续正证据、条件恶化则立即回退。HRS 与硬安全护栏互补：护栏管单指标越阈的即时纠正，HRS 抓单指标看不到的多信号缓慢侵蚀。
Motivation: 自适应自动化、监督控制、信任与技能退化研究各解释了问题的一部分，但缺少可审计的多信号判据来决定多轮工作流中自主权何时升降。
Method: 提出 HRS 复合指标，整合操作员就绪度、人机信任、学习稳定性、运行性能四个信号维度；与滞回切换策略结合，升级要求持续正证据、恶化时快速回退，并叠加硬安全护栏；框架覆盖软件工程与制造两类领域。
Result: 给出 HRS 与硬安全护栏的互补分工：护栏在单一指标突破临界阈值时强制立即纠正，HRS 检测任何单个护栏都观察不到的操作员就绪度缓慢多信号侵蚀；论文为 10 页、5 图、8 表。
Conclusion: 自主权交接应被当作治理问题，用显式、复合、可审计的判据来决定 escalate/maintain/revert，这是自适应自动化研究此前未提供的概念与形式基础。

papers.title: Measurement-Efficient Differentiable Quantum Architecture Search for Combinatorial Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Differentiable quantum architecture search (DQAS) is a promising framework for the automated design of quantum circuits, particularly for variational quantum optimization algorithms. However, its practical deployment on quantum hardware is limited by the large number of circuit measurements required during optimization, making hardware execution costly. In this work, we show that for a broad class of combinatorial optimization problems and commonly used rotational gate parameterizations, the measurement cost of DQAS can be significantly reduced without changing the optimization objective. We derive the proposed measurement reduction scheme theoretically and validate it experimentally on 3-SAT and MaxCut benchmark problems. Our approach reduces the requested gradient measurement cost by about 39 to 41% while introducing only negligible classical post-processing overhead, lowering the practical cost of executing DQAS on quantum hardware.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Quantum Artificial Intelligence (QAI). Code and data: https://github.com/Newida/ME-DQAS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对可微分量子架构搜索 (DQAS) 在量子硬件上梯度测量开销过大的问题，作者对一类组合优化问题与常用旋转门参数化推导出测量缩减方案，可在不改变优化目标的前提下减少所需梯度测量。在 3-SAT 与 MaxCut 基准上实验验证，梯度测量成本降低约 39% 到 41%，经典后处理开销可忽略。
Motivation: DQAS 自动设计变分量子线路时，优化过程需要大量线路测量，使量子硬件上的实际执行成本过高，限制了其部署。
Method: 针对一类组合优化问题与常用旋转门参数化，理论上推导测量缩减方案，不改变原优化目标；在 3-SAT 与 MaxCut 基准问题上做实验验证，经典后处理开销保持可忽略。
Result: 在 3-SAT 与 MaxCut 基准上，所需梯度测量成本降低约 39% 到 41%，经典后处理开销仅为可忽略级别。
Conclusion: 对这类问题与旋转门参数化，DQAS 的测量开销可以在不改动优化目标的前提下大幅削减，从而降低量子硬件执行成本。

papers.title: AutoAdapt: Automatic Domain Discovery Enables Low-Cost Extensibility
papers.abstract_en: Instruction-tuned models are deployed into environments where domains are heterogeneous and evolve, yet adding new domains or data typically requires costly retraining. We present AutoAdapt, a modular framework that incorporates new domains and data via targeted single-adapter training without modifying other adapters. The framework automatically discovers latent domains, uses them to train per-domain Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapters independently in parallel and performs parameter-free routing. Across 14 domain-specific benchmarks and GPT-4o pairwise judgements, AutoAdapt achieves parity with a LoRA adapter trained on all domains without requiring full-model retraining. We also find evidence of specialisation effect convergence across independent discovery methods. Overall, training each adapter on its own domain prevents domain interference by construction, thus enabling modular, taxonomy-free domain specialisation without aggregate performance loss or full model retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AutoAdapt 用自动潜域发现 (latent domain discovery) 把异构数据拆成各自域，独立并行训练单域 LoRA adapter，再做无参数路由，从而在新增域时只训一个 adapter 而不动其他 adapter。在 14 个 domain-specific benchmark 上配合 GPT-4o 成对评判，其表现与在全部域上训练的单一 LoRA adapter 持平，且无需全模型重训。
Motivation: 指令微调模型部署到异构且持续演化的域中，新增域或数据通常要付出高昂的重训成本，且多域混训会带来域间干扰。
Method: 模块化框架三步：自动发现潜域；按发现的域独立并行训练各自的 Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapter；推理时做 parameter-free routing。评估用 14 个 domain-specific benchmark 与 GPT-4o pairwise judgements，对照组是在所有域上训练的单一 LoRA adapter。
Result: 在 14 个 domain-specific benchmark 上，AutoAdapt 与全域训练的单一 LoRA adapter 达到 parity，且不需要全模型重训；不同独立域发现方法之间观察到 specialisation effect 收敛的证据。
Conclusion: 按域各训各的 adapter 可以从构造上避免域间干扰，实现无统一 taxonomy、无聚合性能损失的模块化域特化与低成本扩展。
Relevance: 14

summary_sections.result: 在 14 个 domain-specific benchmark 上，AutoAdapt 与全域训练的单一 LoRA adapter 达到 parity，且不需要全模型重训；不同独立域发现方法之间观察到 specialisation effect 收敛的证据。
summary_sections.conclusion: 按域各训各的 adapter 可以从构造上避免域间干扰，实现无统一 taxonomy、无聚合性能损失的模块化域特化与低成本扩展。

papers.title: Dataset Pruning from First Principles: A Label-Free Linear Programming Approach
papers.abstract_en: Dataset pruning reduces a large training set to a representative subset while preserving model performance. Existing geometry-based methods typically assume that nearby points in embedding space share similar properties. Rather than imposing this assumption, we derive geometric selection criteria by reformulating unbiased subset selection as a variance minimization problem. Unbiasedness ensures that unweighted subset averages recover full-dataset averages in expectation, including losses and gradients at fixed model parameters. Specifically, we characterize a family of unbiased subset selection algorithms as a high-dimensional polytope. In this context, minimizing the expected sampling variance is a linear objective. Differences in sampling variance, averaged over rigid motions, admit closed-form pairwise expressions. Because the polytope has high dimension, directly applying standard linear programming is impractical. We instead use these expressions to construct an efficient vertex walk that optimizes an approximation of the variance objective while preserving unbiasedness, yielding a method that requires neither labels nor model training during selection. Across CIFAR-10, MNIST, and CelebA benchmarks, our method matches or exceeds uniform sampling in mean test accuracy at every evaluated budget and outperforms competing geometric methods in several settings, particularly at small selection budgets. Beyond dataset pruning, the same framework reduces stochastic-gradient variance by increasing diversity within mini-batches while keeping the batch size unchanged.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把无偏子集选择重构为高维多面体上的方差最小化线性目标，用闭式成对方差表达式构造保持无偏性的顶点搜索 (vertex walk)，选择阶段既不需要标签也不需要训练模型。在 CIFAR-10、MNIST、CelebA 上，各预算下平均测试精度均匹配或超过均匀采样，并在小选择预算下优于几何类剪枝方法；同一框架还可通过提高 mini-batch 内多样性在不改 batch size 的前提下降随机梯度方差。
Motivation: 现有几何类数据剪枝方法依赖嵌入空间中邻近点性质相似这一假设，且高维多面体上直接跑标准线性规划不可行。
Method: 将无偏子集选择刻画为一个高维多面体，使期望采样方差最小化成为线性目标；对刚性运动取平均后方差差异有闭式成对表达式，据此构造高效顶点搜索来优化方差目标的近似并保持无偏性，选择过程无需标签与模型训练。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10、MNIST、CelebA 三个基准上，每个评估预算下的平均测试精度都匹配或超过均匀采样，并在若干设置中优于竞争性几何方法，小选择预算下优势尤其明显；同一框架在 batch size 不变时通过增加 mini-batch 多样性降低随机梯度方差。
Conclusion: 无偏性加方差最小化足以替代嵌入邻近假设来选子集，且该框架可从数据剪枝直接迁移到随机梯度方差削减。

papers.title: SLDR: Defending Against Malicious Fine-tuning via Selective Layers Recovery and Dynamic Routing
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning-as-a-service enables users to adapt aligned large language models (LLMs) to specialized tasks, but malicious fine-tuning can erode refusal behavior while preserving task performance on legitimate inputs. We revisit recent layer-wise safety diagnostics and find that safety sensitivity is signed: scaling different layers can strengthen refusal, weaken it, or have little effect. Motivated by this observation, we propose SLDR, a post-fine-tuning defense based on Selective Layers Recovery and Dynamic Routing. SLDR trains a LoRA recovery adapter only on the layers with the maximum and minimum sensitivity scores in the signed spectrum, and uses representation-based dynamic routing inference to activate the adapter only for malicious queries. Across four model architectures, five downstream tasks, and four harmful benchmarks, SLDR substantially reduces harmful outputs while preserving downstream utility. On Llama3.1/SST2, SLDR reduces the average harmful score from 11.54 to 0.08 while maintaining downstream accuracy, and the harmful score remains near zero under poisoning ratios up to 0.9. The code is available at https://github.com/Stardust457/SLDR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SLDR 是针对 fine-tuning-as-a-service 的微调后防御：先按有符号的层敏感度谱找出敏感度最高与最低的层，只在这些层训练 LoRA recovery adapter，再用基于表征的动态路由在推理时仅对恶意查询激活该 adapter。在 Llama3.1/SST2 上平均 harmful score 从 11.54 降到 0.08，且投毒比例升到 0.9 时仍接近零，下游准确率保持。
Motivation: 微调即服务场景下，恶意微调可以在保留正常输入任务性能的同时侵蚀模型的拒绝行为，原有对齐防护失效，而近期逐层安全诊断只给出无符号的敏感度，无法区分哪些层放大或削弱拒绝。
Method: 先复用逐层安全诊断得到有符号的层敏感度谱，取敏感度最大与最小的两组层，仅在这些层上训练 LoRA recovery adapter；推理阶段用基于表征的动态路由 (representation-based dynamic routing) 判断查询是否恶意，只对恶意查询激活 adapter。
Result: 在四种模型架构、五个下游任务、四个有害基准上，SLDR 显著减少有害输出并保留下游效用；Llama3.1/SST2 上平均 harmful score 由 11.54 降至 0.08，下游准确率维持不变，投毒比例 (poisoning ratio) 高达 0.9 时 harmful score 仍接近零。
Conclusion: 安全敏感度是有符号的，按符号两端选层做选择性恢复加按查询动态路由，可以在不牺牲任务性能的前提下抵御恶意微调，且对高投毒比例稳健。

papers.title: Real-Time Joint Audio-Video Generation by Parallel Adapter Composition
papers.abstract_en: Deploying a joint audio-video diffusion transformer for real-time, interactive generation normally requires two essential modifications: block-autoregressive attention, so frames can be emitted before the whole clip is finished, and few-step sampling, so each block is cheap. Conventionally, the streaming video literature obtains both capabilities from a chained pipeline. It first distills a bidirectional teacher into a causal student, then into a few-step one, or proceeds in reverse order. Each stage of such a chain fine-tunes the weights the previous one produced, so a later objective can undo an earlier capability. Following the idea of model merging, we show that on a packed audio-video backbone the two capabilities can be acquired in parallel. A causal adapter is trained against the frozen backbone, and an off-the-shelf few-step adapter provides the few-step capability. As the two edit different functional axes, we predict, and then verify, that their weight-update directions are near-orthogonal, without any explicit orthogonality constraint during training. Orthogonal updates should combine without interfering, so parallel composition is a direct sum. The two adapters are simply added at inference, with no joint training, yielding few-step, streaming audio-video whose image quality tracks the bidirectional teacher. Compared to the chained baselines, the composed model matches or beats them on most metrics, making parallel composition a practical approach. The resulting streaming system generates joint audio-video in real time, $\approx$26 fps at $480\times832$ without quantization, and sustains 30 s of continuous generation with stable image quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在打包的音视频 diffusion transformer 上，因果 adapter 与现成的少步 adapter 各自编辑不同功能轴，权重更新方向近正交，推理时直接相加即可同时得到流式与少步能力，无需联合训练。组合模型在多数指标上追平或超过链式蒸馏基线，实时生成约 26 fps（480×832、无量化），可连续生成 30 秒且画质稳定。
Motivation: 流式视频文献靠链式蒸馏先得因果再得少步（或反之），每级微调上一级权重，后一目标会破坏前一能力，两条能力难以兼得。
Method: 在打包音视频 backbone 上冻结主干，只训练一个因果 adapter；少步能力直接用现成 few-step adapter。两者编辑不同功能轴，训练中不加任何显式正交约束，推理时把两个 adapter 权重相加组合，不做联合训练。
Result: 验证两 adapter 的权重更新方向近正交；组合模型在多数指标上追平或超过链式基线，画质追踪双向 teacher；实时约 26 fps 于 480×832 且不量化，可持续 30 秒生成并保持画质稳定。
Conclusion: 并行组合（direct sum）可替代链式蒸馏，作为获得流式加少步音视频生成的实用路径，前提是两条更新方向确实近正交。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Position Forcing: Self-Conditioning 3D Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent single-stage 3D generative models commonly adopt VecSet representations, encoding 3D shapes as unordered sets of latent tokens. However, compared with two-stage methods that provide explicit positional guidance, these models must implicitly infer token positions throughout denoising, limiting their generation quality. We observe that, despite the absence of explicit positional conditioning, VecSet tokens retain recoverable spatial correspondences. Building on this observation, we propose Position Forcing, a position-based self-conditioning framework. During denoising, Position Forcing recovers token positions from the current clean latent estimate, quantizes them at progressively finer resolutions according to the denoising stage, and feeds the resulting positional encodings back into the diffusion Transformer. This progressively refined positional feedback provides spatial guidance at a granularity appropriate to each denoising stage, guiding shape generation along a coarse-to-fine trajectory and substantially improving generation quality without a separate position generation stage. Experiments demonstrate that Position Forcing achieves strong performance among single-stage 3D generative methods and outperforms several competitive multi-stage approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Position Forcing 把 VecSet 无序 latent token 中可恢复的空间对应关系显式化：去噪时从当前干净 latent 估计中恢复 token 位置，按去噪阶段逐级细化量化分辨率，再把位置编码反馈给 diffusion Transformer，实现粗到细的自条件引导。在单阶段 3D 生成方法中取得强性能，并超过若干有竞争力的多阶段方法，无需单独的位置生成阶段。
Motivation: 单阶段 VecSet 表示把 3D 形状编码为无序 latent token，缺少两阶段方法的显式位置引导，去噪全程只能隐式推断 token 位置，限制生成质量。
Method: Position Forcing 是基于位置的自条件框架：从当前 clean latent 估计恢复 token 位置，按去噪阶段以渐细分辨率量化，将位置编码回喂给 diffusion Transformer，形成 coarse-to-fine 轨迹，省去独立的位置生成阶段。
Result: 实验显示该方法在单阶段 3D 生成方法中性能突出，并优于若干有竞争力的多阶段方法；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: VecSet token 的隐式空间对应可被显式回收为逐阶段细化的位置反馈，从而在不引入第二阶段的前提下提升单阶段 3D 扩散生成质量。

papers.title: Data Reuse in Non-Stationary Learning
papers.abstract_en: We consider online learning in non-stationary environments, where the goal is to track an unknown parameter that switches abruptly between a finite set of recurring values. Recurrence opens the possibility of judiciously reusing past observations to improve algorithm performance. However, the changing nature of the underlying signal and lack of information on these dynamics may limit the ability to "safely" reuse data. In this paper we quantify some of the fundamental tradeoffs in this class of problems, and show that they bear a certain resemblance to the classical bias-variance dilemma. Specifically, we propose a class of anytime algorithms, dubbed Exposure-Capped Reuse (ECR), that combine online change detection, compatibility testing, and "contamination" control. We characterize the regime in which ECR's regret scales with the number of distinct values rather than the number of changes, and derive a novel information-theoretic lower bound that establishes the near-minimax optimality of ECR. This provides rigorous quantification of the statistical "value" of data reuse.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在参数于有限个可复现取值间突变的非平稳在线学习中，提出 Exposure-Capped Reuse (ECR)：结合在线变点检测、历史数据兼容性检验与污染控制来决定何时复用旧观测。其 regret 在特定机制下随不同取值个数而非变点个数缩放，并由新的信息论下界证明近极小极大最优。
Motivation: 非平稳信号反复回到少数取值时，复用历史观测本可提升表现，但信号变化且动态未知，使数据复用缺乏安全准则，需要量化这一基本权衡。
Method: 提出 anytime 算法族 Exposure-Capped Reused (ECR)，把在线 change detection、compatibility testing 与 contamination control 组合起来决定复用哪些历史观测；并推导信息论下界刻画该类问题的权衡，类比偏差-方差困境。
Result: 刻画出 ECR 的 regret 随不同取值个数（而非变点个数）缩放的机制；导出新的信息论下界，确立 ECR 的近极小极大 (near-minimax) 最优性，从而定量给出数据复用的统计价值。
Conclusion: 在参数取值可复现的非平稳环境中，受控的数据复用能把 regret 的主导项从变点数降到取值数，且该做法在极小极大意义下接近最优。

papers.title: When to Unpair: Regulating Pairing Dependence in Medical Visual In-Context Learning
papers.abstract_en: Visual in-context learning (ICL), well suited to label-scarce medical imaging, uses support image-label pairs to demonstrate input-output mappings, while the labels collectively indicate the requested task. We diagnose dependence on individual pairings with a test-time derangement that reassigns every support label to another support image while preserving the query, support images, and label multiset. The resulting pairing gap, defined as shuffled-minus-matched performance, shows that all four released models depend on the pairing, to widely varying degrees. Further analysis of a paired-trained model reveals support-associated spurious regions and lesion-size biases even with real, unaltered supports, alongside sensitivity to mis-registered support labels. To regulate this dependence, we introduce a late unpairing curriculum (LUC), which starts with matched training and then applies random unpairing, replacing each support label with that of another support in the same episode. LUC nearly closes the pairing gap on two backbones while maintaining or improving matched-support performance across all evaluated task types, with gains extending to held-out tasks and cross-dataset episodes. It also mitigates these failure modes. On BraTS whole-tumor segmentation, matched-support DSC rises from 0.733 to 0.857 while the gap shrinks from -0.184 to -0.008. In a released model, brief fine-tuning with random unpairing reduces the gap. A reversed curriculum that places the same number of unpairing epochs at the start of training leaves a large gap. This shows that pairing dependence is shaped by the order of training and not only by the amount of unpaired training.

TL;DR: 医学视觉上下文学习 (visual in-context learning) 中，支持集图像-标签配对本身携带了模型依赖的捷径：用测试时 derangement 打乱标签（保持查询、支持图像与标签多重集不变）得到的 pairing gap 显示四个已发布模型都依赖配对且程度差异很大。提出 late unpairing curriculum (LUC)——先按配对训练、后期再随机解配——在两个 backbone 上几乎抹平该 gap 且不损失匹配支持性能；BraTS 全肿瘤分割匹配 DSC 从 0.733 升到 0.857，gap 从 -0.184 缩到 -0.008。同样数量的解配轮次放在训练开头则 gap 依旧很大，说明配对依赖由训练顺序而非解配总量决定。
Motivation: 医学影像标注稀缺，视觉 ICL 靠支持图像-标签对演示任务，但模型可能学到支持集关联的伪区域与病灶尺寸偏置等捷径，而非真正的输入-输出映射，导致换到 held-out 任务或跨数据集 episode 时失效。
Method: 先用测试时 derangement 诊断：把每个支持标签重指给另一支持图像，查询、支持图像与标签多重集不变，定义 pairing gap = 打乱后性能减匹配性能。再提出 late unpairing curriculum (LUC)：episode 内以另一支持的标签替换每个支持标签，先匹配训练后随机解配；并对比把等量解配轮次放在训练开头的反向 curriculum，以及对已发布模型做短暂随机解配微调。
Result: 四个已发布模型均表现出配对依赖且程度差异很大；配对训练的模型在真实未改动支持下也出现支持关联伪区域、病灶尺寸偏置与对错配支持标签的敏感性。LUC 在两个 backbone 上几乎消除 pairing gap，并在全部评估任务类型上维持或提升匹配支持性能，增益延伸到 held-out 任务与跨数据集 episode，同时缓解上述失效模式。BraTS 全肿瘤分割匹配支持 DSC 0.733 → 0.857，gap -0.184 → -0.008。对已发布模型短暂随机解配微调可缩小 gap；反向 curriculum（等量解配轮次置于训练开头）仍留下较大 gap。
Conclusion: 配对依赖由训练阶段的顺序塑造，而不只取决于解配训练的总量，因此解配应放在训练后期而非开头。

papers.title: How Private is Private? A Comparative Study for Face De-Identification
papers.abstract_en: Face de-identification (FDeID) has emerged as a critical privacy-preserving technology, yet its evaluation remains fundamentally fragmented. Existing protocols rely on inconsistent metrics, heterogeneous datasets, and partial annotation coverage, so methods targeting different utility dimensions, such as landmark versus expression preservation, are reported on different benchmarks under different metrics, rendering cross-method comparison infeasible. We revisit FDeID evaluation from both the data and metric perspectives. On the data side, we introduce UtilFace, a curated, demographically balanced benchmark with high identity diversity, assembled from four large-scale face datasets through identity-aware cleaning, resolution enhancement, and stratified filtering. On the metric side, we propose HiFD, a Hierarchical Face De-identification metric that unifies identity suppression, multi-level utility preservation, and image quality under a single consistency-based paradigm: every component is computed from pretrained estimators' outputs on the original face and its de-identified counterpart, directly quantifying how much identity is suppressed and how much downstream-perceivable utility survives. HiFD organizes facial signals into a three-level utility hierarchy spanning macro cues (L1), micro cues (L2), and imperceptible cues (L3), and aggregates the five resulting components into a single interpretable score via weighted harmonic mean, with configurable application-specific profiles. Using this unified protocol, we conduct a comprehensive comparative study spanning adversarial, GAN-based, and diffusion-based methods, surfacing trade-offs and failure modes that remain invisible under existing protocols. We release the benchmark and evaluation toolkit to foster systematic and reproducible research in privacy-preserving human face analysis.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Project Page: https://cv-ac.github.io/hifd/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 人脸去标识 (FDeID) 评测因指标不一致、数据集异构、标注覆盖不全而无法跨方法比较。本文提出统一基准 UtilFace 与分层指标 HiFD，把身份抑制、多层效用保持和图像质量放进同一一致性范式，用加权调和平均聚合成单一分数，并据此对对抗式、GAN、扩散三类方法做对比研究。
Motivation: 现有 FDeID 协议指标不统一、数据集异构、标注覆盖片面，针对不同效用维度的方法只能在不同基准和指标下报告，跨方法比较不可行。
Method: 数据侧提出 UtilFace：从四个大规模人脸数据集经身份感知清洗、分辨率增强与分层过滤构建人口均衡、身份多样的基准。指标侧提出 HiFD，把面部信号分为宏观 (L1)、微观 (L2)、不可感知 (L3) 三级效用层次，五个分量均由预训练估计器在原图与去标识图上的输出计算，再以加权调和平均聚合成可解释的单一分数，并支持按应用场景配置 profile。
Result: 在统一协议下完成覆盖对抗式、GAN-based 与 diffusion-based 方法的对比研究，显现出既有协议下不可见的权衡与失败模式；发布基准与评测工具包。
Conclusion: FDeID 需要数据与指标统一的评测协议才能做跨方法比较，HiFD 的三级效用层次加加权调和平均可作为该协议的单一分数。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Average-Reward Reinforcement Learning for Multichain MDPs: A Hierarchical Decomposition Approach
papers.abstract_en: We study learning optimal policies in average-reward multichain Markov decision processes (MDPs), where the optimal gain may depend on the initial state and recurrence structures vary across policies, creating challenges for reinforcement learning (RL) methods. We propose an asynchronous value-iteration-based RL algorithm that requires no model knowledge beyond the MDP's transition graph and leverages Bather's decomposition to hierarchically partition the state space into communicating subsystems and transient states. This decomposition induces a recasting of the global decision problem into structured subproblems, which our algorithm exploits. We show that the algorithm converges to the optimal gain and produces gain-optimal policies after finite time. Building on this base algorithm, we develop two further algorithms: one approximately solves the multichain average optimality equations to obtain near gain-optimal policies, and another targets near bias-optimality by approximating the optimal bias function and solving an induced average-reward multichain MDP using the base algorithm. We provide almost-sure convergence guarantees for all three algorithms and empirically compare their tradeoffs, showing that the latter two also consistently improve transient performance relative to the base algorithm. To our knowledge, these are the first essentially model-free average-reward RL algorithms for general multichain MDPs without reductions to discounted problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对平均奖励多链 (multichain) MDP 中最优增益依赖初始状态、且策略间常返结构变化的问题，提出基于异步值迭代、只依赖转移图的分层分解算法：用 Bather's decomposition 把状态空间切成通信子系统与瞬态，再把全局决策重写为结构化子问题。基础算法在有限时间内收敛到最优增益并给出 gain-optimal 策略，另两个变体分别近似求解平均最优性方程与近似最优 bias 函数，三者均有 almost-sure 收敛保证，后两者还一致改善瞬态性能。
Motivation: 多链平均奖励 MDP 中最优增益随初始状态而变、常返结构又随策略改变，通用 RL 方法难以处理；现有平均奖励算法往往要归约到折扣问题，缺少面向一般多链 MDP 的基本无模型算法。
Method: 提出异步值迭代 RL 算法，除 MDP 转移图外不需要任何模型知识，借助 Bather's decomposition 将状态空间分层划分为通信子系统与瞬态，从而把全局问题重写为结构化子问题；在此基础上再构造两个算法，一个近似求解 multichain 平均最优性方程得到近 gain-optimal 策略，另一个近似最优 bias 函数并把诱导出的平均奖励多链 MDP 交回基础算法求解。
Result: 基础算法在有限时间内收敛到最优增益并产生 gain-optimal 策略；三个算法都给出 almost-sure 收敛保证，实验比较中后两个算法相对基础算法一致改善瞬态性能。
Conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首批面向一般 multichain MDP、不归约到折扣问题的基本无模型平均奖励 RL 算法；分层分解既保证收敛，也带来更好的瞬态表现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Performance at What Cost? A Sustainability-Aware Performance Index for Cell and Nucleus Instance Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained models for cell and nuclear instance segmentation differ substantially in architecture, pretraining data and objectives, parameter count, inference strategy, adaptation requirements, postprocessing pipeline, and computational demand. Large pretrained and foundation models are increasingly adopted because of their strong zero-shot capabilities, but their use also imposes greater energy consumption, memory requirements, computational demands, adaptation costs, and operational carbon emissions. Whether these additional demands are justified by meaningful gains in segmentation performance remains unclear. We address this question by introducing the Sustainability-Aware Performance Index (SAPI), a configurable metric that combines segmentation performance, energy consumption, and model size. We benchmark 19 pretrained and foundation models across six CellBinDB datasets under zero-shot inference and evaluate 16 fine-tunable models using few-shot adaptation with both frozen encoder and full-model fine-tuning. We estimate energy consumption for GPU, CPU, and RAM using software-based monitoring tools. Our results show that larger and more computationally demanding models do not consistently achieve proportionate improvements in segmentation quality. While few-shot adaptation benefits several models, the gains and resource costs vary considerably across architectures, datasets, and adaptation strategies, causing SAPI-based rankings to differ from rankings based on performance alone. This study provides a practical framework for comparing segmentation models more comprehensively and supports more computationally accessible and environmentally responsible model selection in biomedical image analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可持续性感知性能指数 SAPI，把分割性能、能耗与模型规模合成一个可配置指标，并在 CellBinDB 六个数据集上重排预训练细胞/细胞核实例分割模型。结果显示更大、算力更重的模型并不总带来成比例的分割质量提升，SAPI 排名与仅按性能的排名不一致。
Motivation: 预训练与基础模型零样本能力强，但带来更高能耗、显存、算力与碳排放；这些额外开销是否换来了有意义的分割性能增益并不清楚，缺少把性能与资源成本放在一起比较的指标。
Method: 提出可配置指标 SAPI，联合分割性能、能耗与模型规模；对 19 个预训练/基础模型做零样本推理，对 16 个可微调模型做 few-shot 适配（含冻结编码器与全模型微调两种策略），并用软件监控工具估计 GPU、CPU、RAM 能耗。
Result: 在 CellBinDB 六个数据集上，更大、计算需求更高的模型未稳定带来成比例的分割质量提升；few-shot 适配对若干模型有收益，但收益与资源开销随架构、数据集和适配策略差异明显，SAPI 排名与仅按性能的排名不同。
Conclusion: 模型选择应把性能与能耗、规模一起纳入比较，SAPI 提供了这样一个可配置框架，用于支撑算力可及且更环保的生物医学图像模型选型。

papers.title: HAN-Mamba: Hierarchical Selective State Space Networks for Multi-Scale Financial Volatility Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Short-horizon realized volatility forecasting requires the integration of market information that evolves at incompatible temporal resolutions, from second-level order book dynamics to weekly regime drift. Our conference work introduced HAN-T, a hierarchical architecture in which scale-specific Transformer encoders process short, mid, and long-horizon streams and a learned attention fuser weighs their contributions. This article replaces the quadratic attention encoders with selective state space (Mamba) encoders while retaining attention only in the fuser, where the input is a three-token set rather than a long sequence. The resulting hybrid, HAN-Mamba, summarizes each stream through a recurrent state whose input-dependent gating matches two structural properties of volatility: persistent but decaying memory and abrupt regime shifts. On the Optiver Realized Volatility Prediction benchmark under time-aware five-fold cross-validation, HAN-Mamba improves mean RMSPE over HAN-T (0.1942 vs. 0.1965) with 33% fewer parameters. Its linear-time encoders further allow the high-frequency context to be extended from 60 to 240 buckets, reducing error to 0.1927 where the attention variant saturates, and support constant-time streaming updates at inference. Ablations attribute the gains to the encoder swap, confirm that the hierarchical prior transfers across sequence-model families, and show that the permutation-invariant attention fuser remains the correct mechanism for cross-scale integration.
papers.comment: 16 pages. Accepted for publication in Springer Lecture Notes in Artificial Intelligence (ICAART 2026 Revised Selected Papers). Extended version of the ICAART 2026 paper (DOI: 10.5220/0014264900004052)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HAN-Mamba 用选择性状态空间 (Mamba) 编码器替换层级架构 HAN-T 中的二次复杂度 Transformer 编码器，仅在融合器保留注意力。在 Optiver Realized Volatility Prediction 上按时间感知五折交叉验证，平均 RMSPE 从 0.1965 降到 0.1942，参数少 33%；高频上下文可从 60 扩到 240 buckets，误差进一步降到 0.1927。
Motivation: 短期已实现波动率预测需要同时整合秒级订单簿动态到周级 regime 漂移等不兼容时间分辨率的信息，而二次复杂度注意力编码器限制了高频上下文长度并难以流式更新。
Method: 层级结构：短、中、长三个时间尺度流各由 Mamba 选择性状态空间编码器处理，输入依赖门控刻画持久衰减记忆与突变 regime；融合器用置换不变注意力对三 token 集合加权，训练采用时间感知五折交叉验证。

papers.title: From Digital Human Interactions to Physics-Based Humanoid Skills: Physics-Grounded Post-Training of Interaction Generators
papers.abstract_en: Recent methods have made promising progress in generating interactions between two humanoids, largely relying on physics-based tracking policies to convert digital reference motions into executable trajectories. However, limited tracking capabilities restrict the range of reference motions that can be successfully executed, reducing data utilization. Moreover, even successful tracking does not guarantee physically plausible responses or faithful realization of the intended interactions. In this paper, we introduce DIGHT, a co-adaptive framework that couples a Digital human Interaction Generator with a Humanoid Tracking policy. Our DIGHT first executes multiple text-conditioned interaction candidates in simulation using a fixed tracker. It then constructs physics-grounded preferences from the resulting rollouts, covering both general executability and interaction fidelity. Rather than collapsing these signals into a single scalar reward for candidate ranking, we align the pretrained generator using physics-decoupled diffusion direct preference optimization (DPO), preserving criterion-specific supervision without differentiating through the simulator. To improve executability, preference pairs are derived from tracking error, friction, and floating. Additionally, to improve interaction fidelity, we propose to incorporate force feedback from simulator as a measure of contact fidelity and construct preferences over contact occurrence, location, duration, and force magnitude. The aligned generator then supplies reference motions for fine-tuning the tracker, improving compatibility between generation and physical execution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach not only improves the physical plausibility of generated motions but also enables more reliable and faithful humanoid interactions in simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DIGHT：把文本条件的双人交互生成器与人形跟踪策略 (humanoid tracking policy) 联合自适应训练，用仿真 rollout 构造物理偏好对，并以物理解耦的 diffusion DPO 对齐生成器，再用对齐后的生成器微调跟踪器。摘要称该方法在仿真中同时提升生成动作的物理合理性与交互的可靠、忠实执行。
Motivation: 现有双人交互生成依赖物理跟踪策略把数字参考动作转成可执行轨迹，但跟踪能力受限使可用参考动作范围变窄、数据利用率低；即便跟踪成功，也不保证响应物理合理或忠实实现预期交互。
Method: DIGHT 先用固定 tracker 在仿真中执行多个文本条件交互候选，从 rollout 构造覆盖可执行性与交互保真度的物理偏好；不把信号压成单一标量奖励，而是用物理解耦的 diffusion DPO 分准则对齐预训练生成器，且不对仿真器求导。可执行性偏好来自跟踪误差、摩擦与浮空；保真度偏好引入仿真器力反馈，覆盖接触是否发生、位置、时长与力大小。对齐后的生成器再为 tracker 微调提供参考动作。
Result: 摘要给出的是定性结论：该方法在仿真中提升生成动作的物理合理性，并实现更可靠、更忠实的双人交互；未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 生成与物理执行应通过分准则的偏好对齐和双向微调协同改进，而不是把可执行性与保真度合并成单一奖励。

papers.title: Estimating Uncoded Crash Factors with Tabular Foundation and System One Models: Kumo Tabular and Jev
papers.abstract_en: Road safety programs count the coded fields of police crash records, while the officer's narrative, which often records factors the fields omit, is rarely read. A safety office thus cannot tell how much its counts miss or where to review. This study develops and evaluates a system that joins both views of the 5,601,890 Texas crashes from 2017 to 2025 into population estimates with stated validity. An in-context tabular foundation model, Kumo Tabular, reads the coded record of every crash, a calibrated System One model, Jev, reads the narratives of two probability samples, and human judgments recalibrate its probabilities. A multiwave predict-then-debias estimator joins the three tiers, and a second human tier drawn with recorded probabilities checks the estimates by design. For hydroplaning, medical episodes, fatigue, animals, and phone use, the narrative documents more injury crashes than the coded field, 15,074 against 7,340 for phone use, and the human check agrees with all fifteen estimates within its margin. A re-read list ranked by Kumo Tabular finds confirmed discordance 7 to 58 times as often as random reading. At the planning cost of human coding, one further round of human judgments would cut the root mean square relative half-width from 22.0 to 16.2 percent, against 21.2 for reading every narrative. Two calibrated readers of different views, joined by a sampling design, give a safety office counts, a discordance map, a validated re-read list, and a reading budget, with Kumo Tabular reading the table at 15 times the speed of TabPFN 3.5.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把警察车祸记录的编码字段与叙述文本合并成带有效性的总体估计：Kumo Tabular 读全部 5,601,890 条 2017–2025 德州车祸的编码记录，校准过的 System One 模型 Jev 读两个概率样本的叙述，人工判断重新校准其概率，再由 multiwave predict-then-debias 估计器合并三层。叙述记录的伤害车祸多于编码字段（手机使用 15,074 对 7,340），按 Kumo Tabular 排序的重读清单命中确认不一致的效率是随机阅读的 7–58 倍。
Motivation: 道路安全项目只统计警方记录的编码字段，而警员叙述中记录的因素常被字段遗漏，安全办公室无法知道计数漏了多少、该去哪里复核。
Method: 三层系统：in-context 表格基础模型 Kumo Tabular 读取每条车祸的编码记录；校准的 System One 模型 Jev 读取两个概率样本的叙述，人工判断重新校准其概率；multiwave predict-then-debias 估计器合并三层，另抽第二层人工（按记录概率抽取）按设计检验估计。
Result: 对积水打滑、医疗发作、疲劳、动物、手机使用五类因素，叙述记录的伤害车祸均多于编码字段，手机使用为 15,074 对 7,340；人工检验在设计允许的误差范围内与全部 15 项估计一致。按 Kumo Tabular 排序的重读清单找到确认不一致的频率是随机阅读的 7 至 58 倍。再加一轮人工判断（成本相当于人工编码）把均方根相对半宽从 22.0% 降到 16.2%，而读完全部叙述为 21.2%；Kumo Tabular 读表速度为 TabPFN 3.5 的 15 倍。
Conclusion: 两个校准过的、视角不同的读取器加抽样设计，能让安全办公室得到计数、不一致地图、经验证的重读清单和阅读预算；再加一轮人工判断即可在人工编码成本下超过通读全部叙述的精度。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: LLM-Assisted Generation of Transparent, Open-Source Multiphysics Models of Electrochemical Devices
papers.abstract_en: Multiphysics continuum models are powerful tools for studying electrochemical devices, enabling in silico reactor design and resolution of local pH, potential, and concentration fields that govern device performance but are difficult to measure experimentally. However, constructing such models requires substantial numerical expertise or reliance on proprietary software. Here, we show that frontier large language model agents can remove this implementation burden while keeping the underlying physics under researcher control. Using one-dimensional electrochemical CO2 reduction to CO in a porous gas diffusion electrode as a test case, we develop a machine-readable, human-specified modeling harness containing governing equations, parameters, numerical methods, logical build stages, and human-verifiable checkpoints. From this specification, the agent reproducibly constructs complete multiphysics models in open-source Julia. Independently built models, including fully autonomous agent-built models, agree with an equivalent COMSOL implementation to within 0.7% of the peak CO partial current density, and with one another to within 0.04%. Systematically planted errors demonstrate the importance of explicit specifications for reproducibility and reveal the agent's capabilities and limitations in debugging model physics. This framework establishes a more transparent approach to multiphysics modeling in which physical descriptions and governing equations, rather than specialized code, become the primary inputs for computational model development.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 6 figures, Supplementary Information and implementation guide provided as ancillary files
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用人类可读的机器规范（方程、参数、数值方法、构建阶段与可校验检查点）驱动前沿 LLM agent，可复现地生成开源 Julia 多物理场模型，物理仍由研究者掌控。在一维多孔气体扩散电极 CO2 还原制 CO 测试例上，独立构建（含全自动 agent 构建）的模型与等价 COMSOL 实现的峰值 CO 分压电流密度偏差在 0.7% 以内，模型彼此偏差 0.04% 以内。
Motivation: 构建连续介质多物理场模型需要大量数值专家经验或依赖专有软件，实现负担把电化学装置的 in silico 设计挡在研究者之外。
Method: 先写人类指定、机器可读的建模 harness：控制方程、参数、数值方法、逻辑构建阶段与人可验证检查点；agent 据此在开源 Julia 中复现构建完整多物理场模型，并用系统植入的错误检验显式规范对可复现性的作用与 agent 调试模型物理的能力边界。
Result: 测试例为一维多孔气体扩散电极上电化学 CO2 还原为 CO；独立构建模型（含全自动 agent 构建）与等价 COMSOL 实现的峰值 CO 分压电流密度 (peak CO partial current density) 偏差在 0.7% 以内，各模型彼此偏差在 0.04% 以内；系统植入错误显示显式规范对可复现性重要。
Conclusion: 物理描述与控制方程而非专用代码可以成为计算模型开发的主要输入，多物理场建模由此更透明；agent 调试模型物理的能力与局限由植入错误实验显出。

papers.title: Thinking in Depth: Retrospective Inference for Tabular Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are pretrained across diverse tabular tasks and make predictions on a new table at inference time using its labeled examples as context. Most recent TFMs perform such in-context prediction with stacked Transformer layers, repeatedly transforming how examples are represented and compared. By tracing individual queries through several strong TFMs, we find that predictive refinement is highly uneven across depth and is often concentrated in later layers. This uneven refinement motivates us to reconsider how intermediate representations are constructed and reused throughout the network. We introduce Retro, a tabular foundation model based on retrospective inference, where later stages can explicitly revisit and recombine intermediate information produced earlier in the network. Retro organizes this process around two complementary operations: which intermediate information to revisit, and how the resulting contextual update should be shaped for each query. Attention Residuals address the former by adaptively reweighting contributions from different depths, while query-conditioned Gated Attention addresses the latter by modulating the attention output element-wise across representation dimensions. Our analysis shows that Retro shifts predictive refinement earlier and more broadly across depth, with different stages revising different subsets of queries in a pattern suggestive of multi-view refinement. Across TabArena, TALENT, and RelArena, Retro ranks among the top three and lies on the Pareto frontier. These results indicate that directly reusing intermediate representations provides a practical way to better exploit depth in TFMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Retro 通过回溯推断让表格基础模型 (TFM) 的后层显式重访并重组前层中间表示，把预测精修从集中在深层前移到更早、更广的深度范围。在 TabArena、TALENT、RelArena 上排名进入前三并位于 Pareto 前沿。
Motivation: 追踪多个强 TFM 发现预测精修在深度上高度不均、常集中在后层，堆叠 Transformer 层反复变换表示的方式浪费了中间信息。
Method: Retro 围绕两个互补操作组织回溯推断：Attention Residuals 自适应重加权不同深度的中间信息贡献，query-conditioned Gated Attention 按查询对注意力输出做逐元素的表示维度调制。
Result: 分析显示 Retro 把预测精修前移并扩展到更广深度，不同阶段修订不同查询子集，呈 multi-view refinement 模式；在 TabArena、TALENT、RelArena 三个基准上排名前三并处于 Pareto 前沿。
Conclusion: 直接复用中间表示是更好利用 TFM 深度的实用途径，精修不均的问题可由回溯式重访与重组解决。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: PoreML: A Data-Driven Framework for Learning Multiphase Flow in Porous Media
papers.abstract_en: Multiphase flow in porous microstructures is central to CO$_2$ storage, fuel-cell operation, and flip-chip packaging. Predicting these flows remains challenging because wettability and complex pore geometry govern the nonlinear evolution of fluid interfaces. Machine learning holds substantial promise for advancing the field, but progress is constrained by scarce time-resolved 3D datasets and a lack of a unified workflow for training and evaluating models. To fill this critical gap, we introduce PoreML, an open-source framework unifying data generation, model training, and evaluation grounded in pore-scale physics. The framework comprises three core components. (a) A modern GPU-native lattice Boltzmann solver, validated against analytical solutions and published experiments, enables reproducible data generation. (b) A 3.3 TB dataset contains 560 simulation runs and 158,546 stored time steps across four application-driven scenarios. These trajectories span synthetic structures and geometries derived from micro-CT scans of real materials, covering diverse wetting conditions and viscosity ratios. (c) A unified learning framework evaluates one-step prediction and autoregressive rollouts. Its domain-specific evaluation protocols assess predictive accuracy and physical consistency. We evaluate five models of diverse architecture under these protocols. Two complementary challenges assess transfer to larger domains and from synthetic to micro-CT-derived structures. PoreML provides a shared foundation for machine-learning research on multiphase flow in porous media, with the aim of empowering the community to develop reliable predictive models and advance the field.

TL;DR: PoreML 把多孔介质多相流的数据生成、模型训练与评估统一成一个开源框架：GPU 原生 lattice Boltzmann 求解器生成 3.3 TB、560 次模拟、158,546 个时间步的数据集，覆盖四个应用场景与合成/micro-CT 两类几何。用单步预测与自回归 rollout 两套协议评估五种架构模型，并以向更大域迁移、从合成结构迁移到 micro-CT 结构两项挑战检验泛化。
Motivation: 润湿性与复杂孔隙几何决定界面非线性演化，预测困难；领域进展受制于稀缺的时间分辨 3D 数据集，以及缺少统一的训练与评估工作流。

papers.title: Fault-tolerant foundation models
papers.abstract_en: Emerging computer hardware often trades reliability for energy efficiency; here we show that large-language models (LLMs) can be trained to tolerate this unreliability, and that rather than degrading, their error resilience actually increases as they grow. Modified neural scaling laws inferred from 40,000 GPU-hours of training runs on simulated faulty digital hardware quantify this trend and suggest that models learn to compute within "good" error-correcting codes, whose relative overhead remains finite no matter how large the model gets. This finding leads us to conjecture that appropriately trained LLMs may be formally fault-tolerant; if true, running AI inference on low energy, faulty hardware may be a path to substantial energy savings over the status quo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在模拟故障数字硬件上训练 LLM，发现模型规模越大、对硬件错误的容忍度反而越高而非下降；由 40,000 GPU-hours 训练得到修正的神经 scaling law，表明模型学会在“好”的纠错码内计算，其相对开销不随模型增大而发散。作者据此猜想：适当训练的 LLM 可能具备形式化的容错性，从而可在低能耗但易出错的硬件上推理以大幅节能。
Motivation: 新兴硬件以可靠性换能效，错误率上升会损害推理质量；若模型能自我容忍硬件故障，就能在低功耗易错芯片上运行而不损失精度，从而绕开当前推理的高能耗现状。
Method: 在模拟的 faulty digital hardware 上进行 LLM 训练实验，累计 40,000 GPU-hours，从训练曲线拟合修正的神经 scaling laws 来刻画错误容忍度随规模的变化，并据此提出模型在纠错码内计算的机制解释与形式容错猜想。
Result: 错误容忍度随模型规模增大而上升而非下降；修正 scaling law 指示“好”纠错码的相对开销在模型任意大时保持有限；结论为猜想性质（conjecture），摘要未给出具体 benchmark 数值。
Conclusion: 若猜想成立，训练得当的 LLM 可能是形式上容错的，使低能耗易错硬件上的 AI 推理成为相对现状大幅节能的可行路径。

papers.title: RSIGym: A Flexible Environment for Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.abstract_en: Recursive self-improvement requires carrying accepted changes into later improvement cycles, while studying agent-proposed changes also requires substantial research infrastructure. Existing settings often leave agents to rebuild routine infrastructure or restrict exploration to individual components. We introduce RSIGym, an agent-native research environment based on Everything as a Service (EaaS). RSIGym exposes training, inference, rollout, evaluation, and sandbox execution through reusable services, with shared budget and permission controls supporting Data, Harness, and Joint improvement tracks. This design enables agents to investigate individual interventions and jointly optimize data, training settings, and execution harnesses within the same environment. We define RSI-Index as the mean fraction of the remaining performance gap closed across five benchmarks covering software engineering, terminal interaction, mathematics, scientific reasoning, and skill-based tasks. Comparing six frontier research models in independent Joint runs, Opus 5 achieves the highest RSI-Index of 0.4809 under a $500 platform-service budget per benchmark run. Its selected systems improve all five benchmarks, raising SWE-bench Verified from 17.67% to 50.33% and AIME from 31.67% to 97.78%. Additional experiments examine DSH-harness refinement, budget variation, and restricted network access, while recorded trajectories reveal how agents diagnose failures and select candidates. We open-source the full RSIGym codebase and results to support reproducibility and further research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RSIGym 把训练、推理、rollout、评测与沙箱执行封装成可复用服务 (EaaS)，配共享预算与权限控制，让 agent 在同一环境里跑 Data、Harness、Joint 三条递归自我改进 (RSI) 轨道。以五个基准上剩余性能差距的平均关闭比例定义 RSI-Index，六个前沿研究模型独立 Joint 运行中 Opus 5 最高，达 0.4809（每基准运行 $500 平台服务预算），并把 SWE-bench Verified 从 17.67% 提到 50.33%、AIME 从 31.67% 提到 97.78%。
Motivation: 递归自我改进要求把被接受的改动带入后续周期，但研究 agent 自提改动需要大量基础设施；现有设置要么让 agent 重复搭建常规设施，要么把探索限制在单个组件。
Method: 提出 agent 原生研究环境 RSIGym，基于 Everything as a Service (EaaS)，把 training、inference、rollout、evaluation、sandbox execution 暴露为可复用服务，共享预算与权限控制支撑 Data、Harness、Joint 三种改进轨道；定义 RSI-Index 为五个基准（软件工程、终端交互、数学、科学推理、技能类任务）上剩余性能差距关闭比例的均值，并记录 agent 诊断失败与选择候选的轨迹。
Result: 六个前沿研究模型在独立 Joint 运行中，Opus 5 取得最高 RSI-Index 0.4809，条件为每基准运行 $500 平台服务预算；其选中系统在全部五个基准上提升，SWE-bench Verified 17.67% → 50.33%，AIME 31.67% → 97.78%。另有针对 DSH-harness refinement、预算变化与受限网络访问的实验。
Conclusion: 把研究基础设施做成带预算与权限约束的共享服务，agent 就能在同一环境内联合优化数据、训练设置与执行 harness，并把改进累积到后续周期；完整代码与结果开源以支持复现。

papers.title: One-Shot Adaptive Segmentation For Scientific Images
papers.abstract_en: Scientific image segmentation methods rely on extensive annotation and task-specific training, limiting adaptation across imaging modalities and experimental conditions. We present a training-free, one-shot framework that specializes vision foundation models using a single annotated reference image. The framework combines DINOv3 representations with background-adaptive feature orthogonalization to suppress artifact-related feature directions, after which cosine similarity localizes candidate regions for SAM segmentation. We evaluate the framework on red-blood-cell microscopy, structured-illumination pool boiling, and chest radiography. Relative to the strongest baseline, the proposed method improves mean IoU by 5.91% and 78.62% on the microscopy and pool-boiling datasets, respectively, while achieving comparable performance on chest radiographs. These results demonstrate that one-shot reference conditioning can adapt general-purpose vision models to specialized scientific segmentation tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出训练自由的单样本科学图像分割框架：用一张标注参考图特化视觉基础模型，DINOv3 特征经背景自适应特征正交化抑制伪影方向后，用余弦相似度定位候选区域再交给 SAM 分割。相对最强基线，显微镜红细胞与结构光照池沸腾数据集上 mean IoU 分别提升 5.91% 与 78.62%，胸片上性能相当。
Motivation: 科学图像分割依赖大量标注与任务特定训练，跨成像模态和实验条件难以迁移。
Method: 以单张标注参考图做 one-shot 条件化：DINOv3 表征 + 背景自适应特征正交化 (background-adaptive feature orthogonalization) 去除伪影相关特征方向，余弦相似度定位候选区域后送入 SAM 分割，全程无需训练。
Result: 在红细胞显微镜、结构光照池沸腾、胸片三个数据集上评测：相对最强基线 mean IoU 在显微镜提升 5.91%、在池沸腾提升 78.62%，胸片上性能相当。
Conclusion: 单样本参考条件化足以把通用视觉模型特化到专业科学分割任务，跨模态无需重训。

papers.title: How Do Transformers Learn to Represent Symmetries?
papers.abstract_en: Training Transformer-based architectures with finite data augmentation has become an increasingly popular approach in geometric machine learning. Despite its empirical success, the interplay between the Transformer architecture, invariance to different symmetries, and augmentation budgets remains underexplored. In this paper, we study the ability of a vanilla Transformer to learn various symmetries through finite data augmentation for point cloud datasets. We identify an ordering of increasing learnability across the following symmetry groups: (i) non-angle-preserving symmetries, (ii) angle-preserving symmetries, and (iii) base angle-preserving subgroups, such as translation, rotation, and scale. For the base angle-preserving groups, we further investigate the Transformer's extrapolation behavior and conduct a structural analysis of the trained models, allowing us to identify interpretable mechanisms that induce invariance. Finally, we extend our analysis to equivariant functions and show that the detected mechanisms for approximate invariance can also provide a key building block for learned equivariance. Our project page is available at https://transformers-learn-symmetries.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在点云数据集上用有限数据增强训练 vanilla Transformer，发现对称群存在可学习性排序：非保角对称最难，保角对称次之，平移、旋转、尺度等保角基子群最易学。对基保角群进一步做外推测试与训练后模型的结构分析，识别出产生近似不变性的可解释机制；这些机制同样构成学到等变性 (equivariance) 的关键构件。
Motivation: 几何机器学习中用有限数据增强训练 Transformer 已很流行，但 Transformer 架构本身、对不同对称性的不变性、以及增强预算三者如何相互作用仍不清楚。
Method: 在点云数据集上训练 vanilla Transformer，仅靠有限数据增强（无显式对称约束）学习对称群；对基保角群做外推行为测试并进行训练后模型的结构分析，再把分析扩展到等变函数。
Result: 给出对称群可学习性由低到高的排序：(i) 非保角对称、(ii) 保角对称、(iii) 平移/旋转/尺度等保角基子群；结构分析识别出诱导不变性的可解释机制，并证明这些近似不变性机制可作为学习等变性的关键构件。
Conclusion: 有限数据增强足以让 vanilla Transformer 学到对称不变性，且不同对称群存在明确的可学习性层级；学到的近似不变性机制可复用为等变性的构件。

papers.title: SemanticFold: Latent Sequence Compression SeparatesLanguage Modeling, Decodability, and Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: We study whether latent sequence compression of prompt prefixes preserves the capabilities that large language models rely on during inference. We introduce SemanticFold, a compression scheme that folds prefix hidden states at learned boundaries, and evaluate it across five model scales: Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-8B, SmolLM2-1.7B, Pythia-1.4B, and Pythia-6.9B. We use a fixed-target protocol: a frozen prefix is executed natively or compressed, and both arms teacher-force identical continuation tokens. This design rules out target-selection explanations for likelihood changes. We examine five endpoint families: fixed-target negative log-likelihood, finite-label reasoning accuracy, linear probe accessibility, open-ended generation, and systems-level memory and latency. We find that compression moves these endpoints non-monotonically and that they do not share a single compression threshold. On Qwen3-1.7B at compression ratio R=1.7, compressed-minus-native mean NLL decreases by 0.135 under paired bootstrap with 10000 draws. On SmolLM2 at R=1.2, the mean change is 0.013 higher than native. On both Pythia checkpoints, NLL is effectively unchanged. An NLL decomposition separating sequence shortening from the learned residual transform shows that the favorable Qwen likelihood is attributable primarily to residual adaptation rather than to shortening alone. MLP-only, which applies the transform without shortening, achieves 0.082 lower NLL than Full SemanticFold. Linear probe accuracy and macro AUC change by less than 0.03 in absolute value across conditions, with confidence intervals crossing zero. We conclude that preservation under latent compression has no single scalar certificate: language-model fit, decodability, and reasoning behavior answer different questions and can move in different directions under the same compression operation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SemanticFold 在学习到的边界处折叠前缀隐状态做潜表示压缩，并用固定目标协议（冻结前缀原生执行或压缩执行，两臂 teacher-force 相同续写 token）排除目标选择对似然变化的解释。五个模型规模上各端点非单调变化且不共享单一压缩阈值：Qwen3-1.7B 在 R=1.7 时压缩减原生平均 NLL 下降 0.135，SmolLM2 在 R=1.2 时反而高 0.013，Pythia 两个 checkpoint 基本不变。
Motivation: 前缀潜压缩是否保住 LLM 推理所依赖的能力缺少可判定的判据：似然、可解码性与推理行为可能各自回答不同问题，需要在同一压缩操作下分离检验。
Method: SemanticFold 在学习到的边界折叠前缀隐状态；固定目标协议让冻结前缀分别原生执行与压缩执行，两臂 teacher-force 相同续写 token。评估五个模型规模（Qwen3-1.7B、Qwen3-8B、SmolLM2-1.7B、Pythia-1.4B、Pythia-6.9B），考察五类端点：固定目标 NLL、有限标签推理准确率、线性探针可及性、开放式生成、系统级内存与延迟；并做把序列缩短与学习残差变换分开的 NLL 分解，以及只做变换不缩短的 MLP-only 消融。
Result: Qwen3-1.7B 在 R=1.7 时压缩减原生平均 NLL 为 -0.135（paired bootstrap，10000 次抽样）；SmolLM2 在 R=1.2 时为 +0.013；Pythia 两个 checkpoint 的 NLL 基本不变。NLL 分解显示 Qwen 的似然优势主要来自残差适配而非单纯缩短：MLP-only（只变换不缩短）比完整 SemanticFold 低 0.082 NLL。线性探针准确率与 macro AUC 在各条件下绝对变化小于 0.03，置信区间跨零。

papers.title: On the Necessity of Attention-FFN Split in Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: The standard Transformer architecture relies on a rigid pattern that alternates Attention and Feed-Forward Network (FFN) layers. Despite its widespread adoption, the inductive bias imposed by this strict separation has not been systematically examined. In this work, we investigate the necessity of the Attention-FFN dichotomy in Vision Transformers (ViTs). To facilitate this analysis, we introduce the AttenFeed module, a unified component that integrates the functional properties of both Attention and FFN. Based on this module, we devise the unified Vision Transformer (uViT), which replaces the conventional alternating Attention-FFN structure with a sequence of AttenFeed modules. We then use uViT as a control group that relaxes the Attention-FFN dichotomy of the standard ViT and systematically compare the two models across multiple datasets and model scales. Our experiments reveal that the Attention-FFN dichotomy can hinder performance at smaller model scales due to the rigid parameter allocation of ViTs. The AttenFeed module and uViT serve as new analytical tools for understanding the Attention-FFN structure and offer theoretical insights into the heuristically designed architecture of conventional ViTs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出统一模块 AttenFeed，把 Attention 与 FFN 的功能合为一体，并据此构建 uViT，用它作为放松 Attention-FFN 二分结构的对照组。跨多个数据集与模型规模的对比显示，严格的 Attention-FFN 交替在小模型规模上会因参数分配僵化而损害性能。
Motivation: 标准 Transformer 固定交替 Attention 与 FFN 层，这一强加的归纳偏置从未被系统检验；在小模型规模上僵化的参数分配可能限制 ViT 表现。
Method: 引入 AttenFeed 模块，统一 Attention 与 FFN 的功能属性；基于该模块构建 uViT，用一串 AttenFeed 替代交替结构，并把 uViT 作为放松二分结构的对照组，与标准 ViT 在多个数据集和模型规模上系统比较。
Result: 实验揭示 Attention-FFN 二分结构在较小模型规模上会因 ViT 的僵化参数分配而妨碍性能；比较覆盖多个数据集与多个模型规模。
Conclusion: Attention-FFN 的严格分离并非必要，小规模下它反而成为瓶颈；AttenFeed 与 uViT 可作为分析该结构的工具，并为启发式设计的 ViT 架构提供理论洞见。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Continual Graph Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: In Continual Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (CMARL), agents learn cooperative policies across sequences of tasks, aiming to adapt effectively to new tasks while preserving the ability to solve previously encountered ones. In many applications, tasks differ in their underlying structure, which can represent, for example, distinct operational conditions or target configurations (e.g., different network topologies in power grids or arrangements in formation control). Existing CMARL methods lack dedicated mechanisms to leverage this structural information when learning new tasks, failing to promote transfer and mitigate forgetting. To fill this gap, we propose Continual Graph Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (CGMARL), a novel framework for CMARL problems in which task sequences are mapped into a series of attributed graphs, each modeling a task-specific structure. In CGMARL, each graph determines the environment dynamics (next states and/or rewards) and the number of agents for the corresponding task. Then, we present Graph-based Formation (GRAFO), the first CGMARL benchmark, and show how forgetting arises in this setting. Finally, to address this limitation, we propose Frozen Graph Encoder (FROG), a method that relies on a frozen graph backbone to preserve past structural information in graph-based CMARL policies. Experiments on GRAFO show that pairing FROG with existing CL methods substantially improves performance on multiple CGMARL scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CGMARL 框架，把持续多智能体强化学习的任务序列映射为带属性的图序列，每张图决定该任务的动力学（下一状态与/或奖励）和智能体数量；并给出首个基准 GRAFO 与冻结图编码器 FROG。FROG 用冻结的 graph backbone 保留历史结构信息，与现有持续学习方法结合后在多个 CGMARL 场景上显著提升性能。
Motivation: 现有持续多智能体强化学习 (CMARL) 方法没有利用任务间的结构差异（如电网拓扑、队形构型），无法促进迁移并抑制遗忘。
Method: CGMARL 将任务序列表示为带属性图序列，每张图刻画任务特定结构并决定该任务的环境动力学与智能体数量；提出首个 CGMARL 基准 GRAFO (Graph-based Formation)，并提出 FROG (Frozen Graph Encoder)，用冻结的图骨干网络在基于图的 CMARL 策略中保留历史结构信息。
Result: 在 GRAFO 基准上展示了遗忘现象；将 FROG 与现有持续学习 (CL) 方法结合，在多个 CGMARL 场景上显著提升性能。
Conclusion: 利用任务结构图并冻结图编码器，是缓解图结构持续多智能体强化学习中遗忘、促进跨任务迁移的有效途径。

papers.title: Revisiting Explainable AI through Model-Independent Concept Dictionaries
papers.abstract_en: Modern applications of AI rely on increasingly complex models. Explainable AI (XAI) has emerged as a set of techniques aimed at improving model transparency. However, existing XAI methods typically assume input features to be inherently interpretable, or they rely on intermediate internal abstractions that are difficult to characterize and highly architecture-specific, hindering consistent use across models. To address these limitations, we propose DictXAI, a method that defines concepts directly in the input domain via a dictionary---a large, potentially overcomplete set of predefined elements, each carrying an interpretable meaning. Technically, DictXAI first computes a sparse code of the input and then attributes the model's prediction to the associated dictionary elements. We demonstrate the actionable nature of DictXAI explanations, showing that they can attribute AI malfunctions (e.g., Clever Hans effects) directly to identifiable artifact patterns in the data, while fostering human-AI alignment on intricate biomedical signals. We further demonstrate our method's ability to operate across a wide variety of dictionaries, including learned image bases, analytically defined waveforms for electrocardiography, and experimentally acquired dictionary elements. Overall, our results show that DictXAI provides more interpretable, actionable, and architecture-agnostic insights than classical XAI or existing concept-based approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DictXAI：在输入域上用一个可能过完备的预定义字典做稀疏编码，再把模型预测归因到字典元素，从而绕开依赖内部抽象、且强绑架构的现有 XAI。它能把 AI 失效（如 Clever Hans 效应）直接归因到数据中可辨识的伪影模式，并在学习得到的图像基、心电图解析波形与实验采集字典元素上都可用。
Motivation: 现有 XAI 要么假设输入特征天然可解释，要么依赖难以刻画且高度架构特定的中间抽象，导致跨模型使用不一致。
Method: DictXAI 先对输入计算稀疏编码 (sparse code)，再把预测归因到对应的字典元素；字典定义在输入域，可为学习得到的图像基、心电图 (ECG) 的解析定义波形，或实验采集的字典元素。
Result: 展示 DictXAI 解释的可操作性：可把 AI 失效（如 Clever Hans 效应）直接归因到数据中可辨识的伪影模式，并在复杂生物医学信号上促进人机对齐；在多类字典上均可运行。
Conclusion: 作者主张 DictXAI 比经典 XAI 与已有基于概念的方法更可解释、更可操作、且与架构无关。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Shared Gaussianization: What Gaussian Regularizers Certify About Contrastive Learning, and What They Miss
papers.abstract_en: What can a distribution-matching regularizer such as SIGReg in LeJEPA certify about contrastive learning? We study shared Gaussianization (SG), a characteristic-function Gaussianity test on the average of two normalized views, scaled by an independent $χ_d$ radius. Because disagreeing views shorten the average, one test detects both misalignment and non-uniformity. SG vanishes exactly at the aligned, uniform minimizers of population InfoNCE, and under equal marginals it bounds the InfoNCE excess by $4\cdot 3^{3/4}β$ times the square root of the SG loss, plus a term linear in the loss. The square-root rate and this dimension-free constant are sharp, and no squared mean-embedding distance on view pairs achieves a faster rate. With an explicit alignment term, a rotation-invariant uniformity test gives a linear bound if and only if its spectrum dominates that of InfoNCE's kernel $e^{βu^\top v}$; SG's own test does, Gaussian kernels $e^{-γ\|u-v\|^2}$ qualify exactly when $γ\ge β/2$, and moment matching never does. Away from the optimum, the objectives differ. Along an isotropic nuisance channel, pure SG lowers its loss by adding per-view nuisance whenever the shared code is non-uniform. An alignment weight above the channel's gain makes the nuisance-free solution a strict local minimizer; for LeJEPA, the same rule gives a critical SIGReg weight that decreases with the batch size. At finite batch size, an off-diagonal U-statistic removes a plug-in bias toward misalignment. In controlled latent-variable models, pure SG retains per-view style, an alignment weight above the measured gain removes it, and for LeJEPA at three batch sizes the measured gain separates the encoders that retain style from those that do not. InfoNCE training also reaches a lower SG$_{0.2}$ loss than SG$_{0.2}$ training from scratch, which points to an optimization gap.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Ruoyu Zhao and Yuting Chen contributed equally; Tong Che is the project lead
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 SIGReg 这类分布匹配正则项对对比学习究竟能认证什么：提出 shared Gaussianization (SG)，对两个归一化视图的均值做特征函数高斯性检验并用独立 χ_d 半径缩放，一个检验同时捕捉错位与非均匀。理论上 SG 在总体 InfoNCE 的对齐且均匀极小点处为零，并把 InfoNCE 超额损失以 4·3^{3/4}β 乘 SG 损失平方根加线性项界定，该平方根速率与无量纲常数是紧的；但在最优点之外目标分歧：各向同性干扰信道下纯 SG 会通过加入逐视图干扰来降损，干扰权重超过信道增益才使无干扰解成为严格局部极小。
Motivation: 分布匹配正则项（如 LeJEPA 中的 SIGReg）被当作对比学习的诊断信号，但它到底能认证 InfoNCE 的哪些性质、在偏离最优点时又会漏掉什么，此前缺少精确的刻画。
Method: 定义 shared Gaussianization：对两个归一化视图取均值后做特征函数高斯性检验，用独立 χ_d 半径缩放，使同一检验同时检测错位与非均匀；推导其对 InfoNCE 超额损失的平方根界，并给出旋转不变均匀性检验与 InfoNCE 核 e^{βu^⊤v} 谱占优的线性界充要条件；再沿各向同性干扰信道分析最优点之外的行为，用非对角 U-statistic 消除有限批量下的插值偏置，并在受控隐变量模型上做验证。
Result: SG 在对齐且均匀的总体 InfoNCE 极小点处为零，InfoNCE 超额被 4·3^{3/4}β·√(SG loss) 加线性项界定，平方根速率与该常数为紧，且视图对上的平方均值嵌入距离无法给出更快速率；线性界当且仅当检验谱占优 InfoNCE 核时成立，SG 的检验满足，高斯核 e^{-γ‖u-v‖²} 恰在 γ≥β/2 时合格，矩匹配永远不合格。各向同性干扰信道下，对齐权重超过信道增益才使无干扰解成为严格局部极小，LeJEPA 的临界 SIGReg 权重随批量增大而下降；受控隐变量模型中纯 SG 保留逐视图 style、超过实测增益的对齐权重去除它，三种批量下实测增益能区分保留与不保留 style 的编码器；从头做 SG_{0.2} 训练的损失高于 InfoNCE 训练后达到的 SG_{0.2} 损失。
Conclusion: SG 能在最优点处认证对齐与均匀并给出紧的 InfoNCE 超额界，但偏离最优点时它与 InfoNCE 目标分歧，会奖励逐视图干扰；对齐权重须超过信道增益才能抑制这一偏差，而 InfoNCE 训练达到更低 SG 损失说明存在优化缺口。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究 SIGReg 这类分布匹配正则项对对比学习究竟能认证什么：提出 shared Gaussianization (SG)，对两个归一化视图的均值做特征函数高斯性检验并用独立 χ_d 半径缩放，一个检验同时捕捉错位与非均匀。理论上 SG 在总体 InfoNCE 的对齐且均匀极小点处为零，并把 InfoNCE 超额损失以 4·3^{3/4}β 乘 SG 损失平方根加线性项界定，该平方根速率与无量纲常数是紧的；但在最优点之外目标分歧：各向同性干扰信道下纯 SG 会通过加入逐视图干扰来降损，干扰权重超过信道增益才使无干扰解成为严格局部极小。
summary_sections.motivation: 分布匹配正则项（如 LeJEPA 中的 SIGReg）被当作对比学习的诊断信号，但它到底能认证 InfoNCE 的哪些性质、在偏离最优点时又会漏掉什么，此前缺少精确的刻画。
summary_sections.method: 定义 shared Gaussianization：对两个归一化视图取均值后做特征函数高斯性检验，用独立 χ_d 半径缩放，使同一检验同时检测错位与非均匀；推导其对 InfoNCE 超额损失的平方根界，并给出旋转不变均匀性检验与 InfoNCE 核 e^{βu^⊤v} 谱占优的线性界充要条件；再沿各向同性干扰信道分析最优点之外的行为，用非对角 U-statistic 消除有限批量下的插值偏置，并在受控隐变量模型上做验证。
summary_sections.result: SG 在对齐且均匀的总体 InfoNCE 极小点处为零，InfoNCE 超额被 4·3^{3/4}β·√(SG loss) 加线性项界定，平方根速率与该常数为紧，且视图对上的平方均值嵌入距离无法给出更快速率；线性界当且仅当检验谱占优 InfoNCE 核时成立，SG 的检验满足，高斯核 e^{-γ‖u-v‖²} 恰在 γ≥β/2 时合格，矩匹配永远不合格。各向同性干扰信道下，对齐权重超过信道增益才使无干扰解成为严格局部极小，LeJEPA 的临界 SIGReg 权重随批量增大而下降；受控隐变量模型中纯 SG 保留逐视图 style、超过实测增益的对齐权重去除它，三种批量下实测增益能区分保留与不保留 style 的编码器；从头做 SG_{0.2} 训练的损失高于 InfoNCE 训练后达到的 SG_{0.2} 损失。
summary_sections.conclusion: SG 能在最优点处认证对齐与均匀并给出紧的 InfoNCE 超额界，但偏离最优点时它与 InfoNCE 目标分歧，会奖励逐视图干扰；对齐权重须超过信道增益才能抑制这一偏差，而 InfoNCE 训练达到更低 SG 损失说明存在优化缺口。

papers.title: Physics-Aligned Electronic Ground-State Learning Improves Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) excel at in-distribution tasks, accelerating drug and material development, yet they struggle to generalize out-of-distribution. We propose to push the cost-accuracy Pareto frontier by designing observable-agnostic electronic ground-state descriptor models (GSMs) with computational costs situated between MLIPs and Kohn-Sham density functional theory (KS-DFT). We align the learning objectives and architectures of GSMs with the governing equations of KS-DFT by enforcing physical constraints and removing optimization pressure on unphysical or irrelevant degrees of freedom. In our size-extrapolation experiments from QM9 to QM40, our combined contributions OrthoNormal-Loss (ON-Loss) and Grassmann Restricted Occupied-Orbital Training (GROOT) reach a 79.1% energy and 83.4% force mean absolute error (MAE) reduction over previous state-of-the-art density GSMs. For Hamiltonian GSMs, ON-Loss and Residual Optimal-gauge Conditioning-aware KS-Eq. Training (ROCKET) together reduce the energy and force MAEs of the strongest baseline by 99.8% and 95.9%, respectively. Using a self-consistency rejection criterion, we filter out extrapolation errors on QMugs, rejecting fewer than 0.4% of predictions while reaching an energy MAE of 0.07 mHa. Finally, we demonstrate the efficiency of label-free self-consistency fine-tuning, and transfer GSMs to reactive chemistry in Transition1x, reaching energy errors below chemical accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把电子基态描述模型 (GSM) 的学习目标与架构对齐到 KS-DFT 控制方程，通过物理约束与去除对非物理自由度的优化压力，把成本压在 MLIP 与 KS-DFT 之间。在 QM9→QM40 尺寸外推上，ON-Loss+GROOT 使密度 GSM 的能量/力 MAE 相对先前 SOTA 分别下降 79.1% 和 83.4%，Hamiltonian GSM 上 ON-Loss+ROCKET 相对最强基线下降 99.8% 和 95.9%。
Motivation: 机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 在分布内表现出色，但分布外泛化差，尤其在尺寸外推场景；需要在 MLIP 与 KS-DFT 之间找到成本-精度更优的电子结构描述模型。
Method: 提出 observable-agnostic 的电子基态描述模型 (GSM)，把学习目标与架构对齐 KS-DFT：密度 GSM 用 OrthoNormal-Loss (ON-Loss) 与 Grassmann Restricted Occupied-Orbital Training (GROOT)，Hamiltonian GSM 用 ON-Loss 与 Residual Optimal-gauge Conditioning-aware KS-Eq. Training (ROCKET)；另用自洽性拒绝准则 (self-consistency rejection criterion) 过滤外推误差，并做无标签自洽微调。
Result: QM9→QM40 尺寸外推：密度 GSM 上 ON-Loss+GROOT 相对先前 SOTA 密度 GSM 达到能量 MAE 降低 79.1%、力 MAE 降低 83.4%；Hamiltonian GSM 上 ON-Loss+ROCKET 相对最强基线能量与力 MAE 分别降低 99.8% 和 95.9%。在 QMugs 上自洽性拒绝准则拒绝不到 0.4% 的预测即可把能量 MAE 压到 0.07 mHa；GSM 迁移到 Transition1x 反应化学，能量误差低于化学精度 (chemical accuracy)。
Conclusion: 把学习目标对齐 KS-DFT 方程并剔除对非物理自由度的优化压力，能显著改善 GSM 的尺寸外推与反应化学泛化，且自洽性准则可用极低拒绝率筛掉外推错误。

papers.title: Energy-Efficient Gait Adaptation via Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Quadrupedal Locomotion Across Diverse Terrains
papers.abstract_en: While energy efficiency is a critical objective for legged-robot locomotion control, achieving low energy consumption while maintaining robust performance across different velocity ranges and terrain conditions remains a key challenge. This is particularly true for end-to-end RL policies, where gait generation, motion execution, and energy optimization are tightly coupled, leading to high sensitivity to reward design. In this work, we propose a hierarchical reinforcement learning (HRL) framework that separates a high-frequency policy for stable and robust joint-level motion execution from low-frequency gait adaptation that explicitly minimizes the cost of transport (CoT). The three-stage Isaac-based training procedure enables zero-shot sim-to-real transfer with improved tracking accuracy, robustness, and energy efficiency. The learned hierarchy exhibits automatic speed-dependent gait adaptation, transitioning from pacing at low speeds to trotting at higher speeds. We validate the proposed approach in simulation against representative single-policy and hierarchical locomotion baselines, demonstrating reduced CoT over a broad range of commanded velocities, while maintaining robust locomotion across flat, uneven rough, and inclined terrains. We further demonstrate its practical feasibility through zero-shot deployment on a physical Unitree AlienGo quadruped.
papers.comment: 9 pages. Submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027. Ammar Issa, Anubhav Singh, and Anton Tsaritsin contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出分层强化学习 (HRL) 四足运动控制框架：高频策略负责关节级稳定执行，低频策略显式最小化运输成本 (CoT)，通过三阶段 Isaac 训练实现零样本 sim-to-real 迁移。学习到的分层结构自动产生速度相关步态切换，低速 pacing、高速 trotting；在仿真中对单策略与分层运动基线均降低宽速度范围内的 CoT，并在平地、粗糙不平与倾斜地形上保持鲁棒运动，最终零样本部署到实体 Unitree AlienGo。
Motivation: 端到端 RL 中步态生成、动作执行与能耗优化耦合紧密，对奖励设计高度敏感，难以在不同速度范围与地形条件下同时做到低能耗与鲁棒性能。
Method: 分层 RL：高频策略执行关节级稳定鲁棒运动，低频策略做步态自适应并显式最小化 CoT；采用三阶段 Isaac 仿真训练流程以支持零样本 sim-to-real 迁移。
Result: 仿真中对比代表性单策略与分层运动基线，在宽指令速度范围内降低 CoT，同时在平地、粗糙不平与倾斜地形保持鲁棒运动；步态自动从低速 pacing 过渡到高速 trotting；零样本部署到实体 Unitree AlienGo 四足机器人。
Conclusion: 把步态自适应与能耗优化从关节级执行中解耦成低频上层，可以在不牺牲鲁棒性的前提下降低 CoT，并直接迁移到实体硬件。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: TouchScale: 500 Hours of Human Vision and Touch for Visual-Tactile Learning
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale egocentric human interaction data is becoming an important source of physical supervision for embodied learning, yet video alone leaves the contact and pressure that characterize physical interaction unrecorded. Recent visual-tactile datasets provide this missing supervision, but their synchronized tactile data remain far smaller in volume than human video. Moreover, the largest resources often merge recordings from different sensors or annotation procedures, which makes the effect of data scale difficult to isolate. We therefore introduce TouchScale, a 500-hour dataset of contact-rich human interaction recorded with a single unified wearable setup. Its approximately 2K predefined task descriptions span everyday activities and structured manipulation, and each recording temporally aligns egocentric RGB-D video with wrist RGB video and dense full-hand bimanual tactile measurements. Compared with prior tactile data, training on the full TouchScale raises zero-shot contact IoU on data from an unseen tactile sensor from 0.134 to 0.383. Pretraining a visual encoder on TouchScale also yields the highest action recognition accuracy on three benchmarks among the compared visual-tactile datasets. Used for visual-tactile mid-training of a robot policy, TouchScale improves the average real-world success rate across four contact-rich manipulation tasks from 22.5% to 57.5%. With the sensor and collection protocol held fixed, both zero-shot tactile prediction and robot success show an overall upward trend as more TouchScale data is used. These results suggest that human visual-tactile data collected at scale with consistent sensing benefits both perception and robot manipulation. We will publicly release TouchScale, including all synchronized visual-tactile recordings and reconstructed object models, to support future research on scalable visual-tactile learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TouchScale 是用单一可穿戴装置采集的 500 小时第一人称视觉-触觉数据集，约 2K 条任务描述，逐时对齐 egocentric RGB-D、腕部 RGB 与全手双手触觉。用其全部数据训练后，对未见触觉传感器的 zero-shot contact IoU 从 0.134 升到 0.383，机器人策略 mid-training 后四项接触密集任务的真实世界平均成功率从 22.5% 升到 57.5%。
Motivation: 视频 alone 记录不了物理交互中的接触与压力，而现有视觉-触觉数据集的触觉规模远小于人类视频，且常混用不同传感器与标注流程，难以分离数据规模本身的作用。
Method: 用统一的单一可穿戴装置同步采集 egocentric RGB-D 视频、腕部 RGB 视频与稠密全手双手触觉，覆盖日常活动与结构化操作的约 2K 预定义任务描述；触觉数据用于 zero-shot 触觉预测，视觉编码器在 TouchScale 上预训练，再对机器人策略做 visual-tactile mid-training，同时保持传感器与采集协议固定以隔离数据规模效应。
Result: 与先前触觉数据相比，用完整 TouchScale 训练使未见触觉传感器上的 zero-shot contact IoU 从 0.134 提升到 0.383；在 TouchScale 上预训练的视觉编码器在三个 benchmark 上取得所比较视觉-触觉数据集中的最高动作识别准确率；用于机器人策略 mid-training 后，四项接触密集操作任务的真实世界平均成功率从 22.5% 提升到 57.5%；在传感器与采集协议固定时，zero-shot 触觉预测与机器人成功率随数据量增加整体上升。
Conclusion: 在一致传感条件下规模化采集的人类视觉-触觉数据同时惠及感知与机器人操作，且数据量本身与性能呈正向关系；作者将公开全部同步视觉-触觉记录与重建物体模型。

papers.title: $Δ$Representation: Geometry Supervised Representation Learning of Phenotypes via Counterfactual Reasoning for Medical VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) have shown increasing potential for radiological image interpretation. Medical VLMs encode radiological images into visual representations that capture both anatomical and phenotypic information for diagnosis. Existing approaches improve pathological phenotype representations through semantic-guided representation alignment. However, pathological phenotypes arise as lesion-specific visual changes superimposed on underlying normal anatomy. Such semantic alignment approaches fail to model the phenotype-specific increment relative to the corresponding normal anatomical representation. To address this gap, we propose \textbf{$Δ$Representation}, a visual phenotype representation learning framework based on counterfactual reasoning for medical VLMs. It comprises \textbf{BaseAnatomy}, a geometry-supervised representation learning module, and \textbf{$Δ$Phenotype}, a counterfactual incremental representation learning module. BaseAnatomy provides fine-grained geometric supervision through spatial relationships across and within anatomical structures. $Δ$Phenotype computes the representation increment between lesion representations and their corresponding normal anatomical representations, and supervises increments associated with the same phenotype to cluster in the representation space. Experiments on \textit{ReXGroundingCT} and \textit{LIDC-IDRI} demonstrate that $Δ$Representation effectively structures pathological phenotype representations and improves lesion grounding and phenotype characterization accuracy in medical VLMs. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/deltarep-CF6D.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ΔRepresentation：用 BaseAnatomy 的几何监督先学正常解剖表征，再用 ΔPhenotype 以反事实推理计算病灶表征相对对应正常解剖的增量，并让同一表型的增量在表征空间聚类。在 ReXGroundingCT 与 LIDC-IDRI 上，该框架结构化了病理表型表征，并提升医学 VLM 的病灶 grounding 与表型刻画准确率。
Motivation: 现有语义引导的表征对齐无法刻画病理表型作为叠加在正常解剖之上的病灶特异增量，因而学不到表型相对正常解剖的差异。
Method: 框架含两个模块：BaseAnatomy 通过解剖结构之间与内部的空间关系提供细粒度几何监督；ΔPhenotype 计算病灶表征与其对应正常解剖表征的增量，并监督同一表型的增量在表征空间聚类，整体用于医学 VLM 的视觉表型表征学习。
Result: 在 ReXGroundingCT 和 LIDC-IDRI 上的实验表明，ΔRepresentation 有效结构化病理表型表征，并提升医学 VLM 的病灶 grounding 与表型刻画准确率。
Conclusion: 把病理表型建模为相对正常解剖的反事实增量并加以监督，比单纯语义对齐更能组织表型表征并改善下游定位与刻画。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: AI Safety Considerations for Agents With Limited Time to Act
papers.abstract_en: In the wake of the increasingly public discussion about AI alignment, recent work has tried to propose specific AI architectures that behave safely. However, the proposed arguments that seemingly demonstrate proved alignment mostly neglect the environment the agent needs to act in. We discuss theoretical bounds for agent-agnostic safety guarantees in environments that can only be partially observed and within which an action is required within limited time. We introduce two realistic scenarios, one with an infinite state space and one with signal mixture. In these scenarios, we prove that even a perfect agent cannot guarantee safe behaviour. It will be argued that for any proof of AI safety or alignment, the environment and associated safe actions need to be specifically considered together with the agent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文论证：在部分可观测且必须在有限时间内行动的环境中，即使 agent 本身完美也无法保证安全行为，因此任何 AI 安全/对齐证明都必须把环境与安全动作和 agent 一起纳入，而不能只对架构本身给出保证。
Motivation: 现有声称已证明对齐的 AI 架构工作基本忽略了 agent 所处的行动环境，导致所谓安全保证在真实约束下站不住脚。
Method: 给出 agent 无关安全保证的理论上下界分析，构造两个场景：一个具有无限状态空间，另一个具有信号混合 (signal mixture)，并在其中证明完美 agent 也无法保证安全。
Result: 在无限状态空间与信号混合两个场景中证明：即使 agent 完美，也无法保证安全行为；据此论证任何安全/对齐证明必须把环境与对应安全动作同 agent 一并考虑。
Conclusion: 安全保证本质上是 agent 与环境的联合性质，脱离具体环境和安全动作定义的架构级对齐证明不成立。
Relevance: 0
