papers.title: Temporal Visuo-Tactile Learning for Dexterous Grasp Stability
papers.abstract_en: Humans can grasp everyday objects with almost perfect success rates using fingertip tactile feedback, yet much of the robotic grasping literature emphasizes vision-based grasp selection with parallel grippers. In this work, we systematically investigate how high-resolution, dynamic tactile sensing contributes to grasp stability prediction and model-guided grasping in dexterous robotic hands. To this end, we collected a dataset of 10,000 grasp trials across 200 objects using a multi-fingered robotic hand equipped with four Digit 360 tactile sensors, recording external vision, proprioception, and tactile streams throughout each grasp. With this dataset, we trained end-to-end temporal multimodal models to predict post-lift stability from pre-lift grasp observations and compared sensing modalities and encoding backbones. Experimental results and controlled input ablations show that incorporating touch, and particularly high-resolution, dynamic touch, improves grasp stability prediction. Finally, we deployed the learned predictor as an online stability gate on the real robot, where visuo-tactile model-guided regrasping improved the success rate among executed lifts by 10.5 percentage points over a non-tactile gate. These results show how rich fingertip sensing and expressive temporal models that capture the dynamics of touch can support learned grasping with multi-fingered hands without explicit contact or force modeling, providing a scalable data-driven path from tactile experience toward stable dexterous manipulation. The dataset is publicly available at https://lasr-lab.github.io/dexterous-grasp-stability/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 10,000 次抓取、200 个物体、四个 Digit 360 触觉传感器的数据训练端到端时序多模态模型，从提升前观测预测多指手抓取的提升后稳定性。加入触觉、尤其是高分辨率动态触觉，可提升稳定性预测；把预测器作为机器人上的在线稳定性门控，视觉-触觉引导的再抓取使实际提升的成功率比无触觉门控高 10.5 个百分点。
Motivation: 机器人抓取研究多集中于视觉与平行夹爪，而人手依靠指尖触觉反馈即可近乎完美地抓取日常物体；多指手的抓取稳定性预测缺少高分辨率动态触觉数据与端到端时序模型的系统研究。
Method: 采集 10,000 次抓取试验、200 个物体的数据集，多指机械手上装四个 Digit 360 触觉传感器，同步记录外部视觉、本体感觉与触觉流；训练端到端时序多模态模型，从提升前抓取观测预测提升后稳定性，比较不同传感模态与编码 backbone，并做受控输入消融；最后把预测器部署为真机上的在线稳定性门控。
Result: 实验与受控输入消融显示，加入触觉、特别是高分辨率动态触觉，改善抓取稳定性预测；真机部署中，视觉-触觉模型引导的再抓取使已执行提升的成功率比无触觉门控提高 10.5 个百分点。
Conclusion: 丰富的指尖传感加能捕捉触觉动态的时序模型，可以在不做显式接触或力学建模的情况下支撑多指手的学习式抓取，给出一条从触觉经验到稳定灵巧操作的可扩展数据驱动路径。

papers.title: Neural Sampling with Reweighted Normalizing Flows via the Wasserstein--Fisher--Rao JKO Scheme
papers.abstract_en: We propose a neural algorithm for sampling from distributions specified by unnormalized Boltzmann densities. Our approach is based on the Jordan--Kinderlehrer--Otto scheme for the Kullback--Leibler divergence in the Wasserstein--Fisher--Rao geometry (WFR JKO scheme). Our contributions are twofold. First, we prove that, for any fixed step size, the exact WFR JKO iterates converge exponentially fast to the target as the number of iterations tends to infinity. Notably, this result requires no structural assumptions on the target, such as log-concavity or a logarithmic Sobolev inequality. Second, we develop a neural implementation of the WFR JKO scheme that parametrizes its transport and reaction components using reweighted normalizing flows. Numerical experiments on challenging multimodal targets demonstrate the promising performance of the proposed method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于 Wasserstein--Fisher--Rao 几何 JKO 格式 (WFR JKO scheme) 的神经采样算法，从非归一化 Boltzmann 密度指定的分布中采样：用 reweighted normalizing flows 参数化传输与反应两个分量。理论上证明对任意固定步长，精确 WFR JKO 迭代以指数速度收敛到目标，且不需 log-concavity 或对数 Sobolev 不等式等结构假设；在困难的多模态目标上数值实验显示有希望的表现。
Motivation: 从非归一化 Boltzmann 密度采样时，多模态目标常需对目标分布加结构性假设才能保证收敛，而这类假设在实际目标上往往不成立。
Method: 以 KL 散度在 WFR 几何下的 Jordan--Kinderlehrer--Otto (JKO) 格式为骨架构造神经算法：传输 (transport) 与反应 (reaction) 分量分别用 reweighted normalizing flows 参数化，得到可训练的神经实现。
Result: 证明对任意固定步长，精确 WFR JKO 迭代随迭代次数增加以指数速度收敛到目标，且该结果不依赖 log-concavity 或对数 Sobolev 不等式等结构假设；在具有挑战性的多模态目标上，数值实验展示了该方法有希望的性能。
Conclusion: WFR 几何下的 JKO 格式配 reweighted normalizing flows 可以在无结构假设下对非归一化 Boltzmann 密度做指数收敛的神经采样，并能处理多模态目标。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: PatchBench: Measuring Collateral Damage in Activation Patching
papers.abstract_en: An LLM safety patch can pass a benchmark while still being a poor repair. This risk is especially acute for jailbreak repairs, where the goal is to correct a specific unsafe behaviour without changing unrelated behaviours. A patch may block exact evaluation prompts yet fail on close harmful variants, or suppress harmful behaviour by over-refusing benign prompts that share its wording or structure. Existing protocols primarily test whether models can be broken, while aggregate metrics (attack success, refusal rates, global capability) cannot distinguish selective repairs from broader local suppression. To address this gap, we introduce PatchBench, a benchmark of empirically observed model-specific jailbreak failures inducing actionable harmful answers. Starting from 27,870 prompts from 37 public datasets, we curate 15,314 English prompts and query 8 open-source instruction-tuned models. Combining WildGuard filtering, pairwise Elo ranking, and manual verification, we retain a curated bank of 400 high-confidence jailbreak failures. We further introduce PatchBench-Local, an evaluation protocol testing whether a patch is behaviourally precise. For each harmful source prompt, PatchBench-Local generates three families of local neighbours: harmful variants preserving malicious intent, benign prompts with matched structure, and benign prompts reusing key harmful terms. It evaluates harmful-neighbour correction and benign-neighbour preservation, distinguishing selective repair from broader local suppression. Evaluating four activation steering methods with PatchBench-Local and MMLU shows that global capability can remain nearly unchanged while local benign regressions are severe, confirming aggregate metrics miss important collateral damage. PatchBench-Local provides a more precise basis for developing and comparing jailbreak repair methods.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (Datasets and Benchmarks Track)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PatchBench 是面向 LLM 越狱修复 (jailbreak repair) 的基准：从 37 个公开数据集的 27,870 条提示中筛出 15,314 条英文提示、查询 8 个开源指令微调模型，最终保留 400 条高置信越狱失败样本；配套的 PatchBench-Local 为每条有害源提示生成三类局部邻居（保留恶意意图的有害变体、结构匹配的良性提示、复用关键有害词的良性提示），同时检验有害邻居纠正与良性邻居保持。用它评测四种 activation steering 方法并配合 MMLU，发现全局能力几乎不变而局部良性回归严重，说明聚合指标会漏掉这类附带损伤。
Motivation: 现有越狱修复评测只看模型能否被攻破，聚合指标（攻击成功率、拒绝率、全局能力）无法区分选择性修复与更大范围的局部抑制：补丁可能挡住原评测提示却在近似有害变体上失效，或靠过度拒绝措辞相近的良性提示来压制有害行为。
Method: 先构建经验性越狱失败库：从 37 个公开数据集的 27,870 条提示出发，筛出 15,314 条英文提示，查询 8 个开源指令微调模型，结合 WildGuard 过滤、pairwise Elo 排序与人工核验，保留 400 条高置信失败样本。再提出 PatchBench-Local 协议，对每条有害源提示生成三类局部邻居（有害变体、结构匹配良性提示、复用关键有害词的良性提示），分别评估有害邻居纠正与良性邻居保持。
Result: 对四种 activation steering 方法用 PatchBench-Local 与 MMLU 评测：全局能力 (MMLU) 几乎不变，但局部良性回归 (local benign regressions) 严重，证实聚合指标漏掉附带损伤。基准规模为 27,870 原始提示、15,314 英文提示、8 个模型、400 条高置信越狱失败、每源提示 3 类局部邻居。
Conclusion: 全局能力与拒绝率这类聚合指标不足以判定越狱补丁是否真正修复，修复质量必须在局部邻居层面同时看有害纠正与良性保持；PatchBench-Local 被作者作为比较和开发 jailbreak repair 方法的更精确依据。

papers.title: Sparse Planning in Visual World Models via Cost Gradients
papers.abstract_en: Token-based world models enable fine-grained latent planning, but repeatedly processing large spatial token grids makes action search expensive. We introduce COSTGRAD, a training-free, goal-conditioned selector that ranks spatial tokens by the gradient norm of the planning cost with respect to each input token. By deriving importance from the downstream control objective, COSTGRAD targets tokens that matter for planning rather than merely for prediction. On AdaLN-conditioned predictors at $50\%$ sparsity, COSTGRAD matches or exceeds full-token planning on three of four continuous-control benchmarks, while giving a measured $2.6\times$ wall-clock speedup per environment planning step. Combining token sparsity with reduced CEM search increases this to a $\sim 5\times$ total speedup while still exceeding the full-token baseline. We also identify an architecture-dependent failure mode: in a matched AdaLN-vs-concat comparison, concat maintains comparable full-token performance but pure COSTGRAD loses its advantage over random selection. This difference tracks action-pathway drift: gradient-selected removal produces less drift than random removal on AdaLN, but more on concat. These results highlight selector-architecture compatibility as a design axis for sparse world-model planning. Project page and demos: https://ycxuyingchen.github.io/costgrad/
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 20 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables. Project page and demos: https://ycxuyingchen.github.io/costgrad/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: COSTGRAD 是一种免训练、目标条件化的 token 选择器，按规划代价对每个输入 token 的梯度范数排序，只保留对控制目标重要的空间 token。在 AdaLN 条件化预测器上以 50% 稀疏度运行时，它在四个连续控制基准中的三个上追平或超过全 token 规划，单步规划实测加速 2.6×；叠加减少 CEM 搜索后总加速约 5× 且仍超过全 token 基线。
Motivation: 基于 token 的世界模型做隐空间规划时，反复处理大型空间 token 网格使动作搜索代价高昂；按预测重要性筛 token 未必对齐下游控制目标。
Method: COSTGRAD 以规划代价对输入 token 的梯度范数给空间 token 打分并稀疏化，免训练且目标条件化；在 AdaLN 条件化预测器上做 50% 稀疏，并与 CEM 搜索预算联合调节，另做 AdaLN 与 concat 架构的配对对照。

papers.title: A Closed-Loop Non-Asymptotic Convergence Analysis of PPO with Learned Critics and Clipping
papers.abstract_en: Despite its widespread use, Proximal Policy Optimization with clipping (PPO-Clip) remains difficult to tune, and the interactions among critic learning, clipping, and rollout reuse remain incompletely understood. We develop a \emph{non-asymptotic} analysis of PPO-Clip as a \emph{closed-loop actor--critic} system. It captures actor--critic coupling, nonsmooth probability-ratio clipping, finite-batch reuse, and predictable early stopping under explicit coverage and critic regularity assumptions, using raw GAE and Monte Carlo critic targets. Our synchronous and asynchronous guarantees jointly characterize policy stationarity and the tracking accuracy of the learned critic, with explicit dependence on algorithmic parameters. A sufficient coupling condition gives optimization, critic tracking, clipping, and finite-batch errors a common amplification bound. The asynchronous result also requires a delay-dependent critic stepsize restriction; violating these conditions does not establish divergence. For finite layered MDPs with tabular critics, a uniform bound on the actual clipped-gradient class replaces complete-trajectory counting. A verified growing-horizon family has polynomial sample complexity, and a two-time-scale schedule gives $O(T^{-2/5})$ stationarity and critic-tracking bounds with explicit fresh-rollout accounting. These results together advance our understanding about PPO and provide theoretical guidance in tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把带裁剪的 PPO-Clip 当作闭环 actor–critic 系统做非渐近收敛分析，同时刻画策略平稳性与 critic 跟踪精度，并给出优化、critic 跟踪、裁剪与有限批复用误差的统一放大界。在有限分层 MDP 与表格 critic 下，验证过的增长视野族具有多项式样本复杂度，双时间尺度调度给出 O(T^{-2/5}) 的平稳性与 critic 跟踪界。
Motivation: PPO-Clip 难调，critic 学习、裁剪与 rollout 复用三者的相互作用缺乏理论刻画，调参缺少可依据的收敛保证。
Method: 在显式覆盖与 critic 正则性假设下，用 raw GAE 与 Monte Carlo critic 目标，把 PPO-Clip 建模为闭环 actor–critic 系统，纳入 actor–critic 耦合、非光滑概率比裁剪、有限批复用与可预测早停；分别给出同步与异步保证，异步版本另需依赖延迟的 critic 步长限制；对有限分层 MDP 表格 critic，用实际裁剪梯度类的一致界替代整轨迹计数。
Result: 同步与异步结果共同给出策略平稳性与 critic 跟踪精度的显式界，依赖算法参数；充分耦合条件使优化、critic 跟踪、裁剪与有限批误差共享一个放大界；验证过的增长视野族样本复杂度为多项式，双时间尺度调度给出 O(T^{-2/5}) 的平稳性与 critic 跟踪界，并显式核算 fresh rollout。违反耦合或步长条件并不意味着发散。
Conclusion: PPO-Clip 的收敛可由一组显式耦合与步长条件保证，误差项可统一放大，双时间尺度调度给出 O(T^{-2/5}) 速率，这些结果为调参提供理论依据。

papers.title: Video Prediction Policy 2: Predict Better, Act Better
papers.abstract_en: World action models (WAMs) have emerged as an important class of generalist robot policies, aiming to transfer video prediction priors to action learning. However, we find that existing WAMs frequently produce incorrect motion predictions in open-ended environment, leading to erroneous actions. We attribute this limitation to two factors: (1) base video models are not optimized for manipulation, and (2) naively incorporating action components into video models can substantially degrade their generalization capabilities. We introduce Video Prediction Policy 2 (VPP2), a WAM that enables strong zero-shot generalization in both video prediction and action generation. First, we curate a large-scale, diverse dataset of manipulation videos to continue pretraining the base video foundation model. We annotate video clips with detailed captions and perform \textit{event-level} video pretraining to promote generalization across open-ended manipulation tasks. Second, we post-train and distill the video model into a single-step visual planner with fixed prediction horizon. Finally, we introduce action module via a mixture-of-transformers (MoT) architecture to learn implicit inverse dynamics model. Experiments demonstrate three key results: (1) VPP2-14B outperforms Cosmos3-64B by 11.0\% points in video prediction instruction-following success rate on open-ended tasks; (2) VPP2 surpasses the strongest baseline by 18.5\% points in success rate on real-world zero-shot ALOHA manipulation tasks; and (3) following benchmark-specific post-training, VPP2 achieves the highest success rates among evaluated methods on the challenging LIBERO-Pro, LIBERO-OOD, and RoboDojo benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VPP2 是一个世界动作模型 (world action model)：先用大规模多样化操作视频做事件级 (event-level) 继续预训练，再蒸馏成固定预测时域的单步视觉规划器，最后用 mixture-of-transformers (MoT) 接入隐式逆动力学动作模块。在开放指令任务上 VPP2-14B 的视频预测指令跟随成功率比 Cosmos3-64B 高 11.0 个百分点，真实零样本 ALOHA 操作成功率比最强基线高 18.5 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有世界动作模型在开放环境中常给出错误运动预测并导致错误动作：基础视频模型并非为操作任务优化，而把动作分量直接塞进视频模型会明显损害其泛化能力。
Method: 构建大规模多样化操作视频数据集继续预训练基础视频模型，为片段标注详细 caption 并做事件级视频预训练；随后把视频模型后训练并蒸馏为固定预测时域的单步视觉规划器；最后以 mixture-of-transformers (MoT) 架构引入动作模块，学习隐式逆动力学模型。
Result: VPP2-14B 在开放任务的视频预测指令跟随成功率上比 Cosmos3-64B 高 11.0 个百分点；在真实世界零样本 ALOHA 操作任务成功率上比最强基线高 18.5 个百分点；经 benchmark 特定后训练后，在 LIBERO-Pro、LIBERO-OOD、RoboDojo 上取得所评估方法中的最高成功率。
Conclusion: 把视频预测先验拆成事件级预训练、单步蒸馏规划器与 MoT 动作模块三段处理，可以在开放指令和真实零样本操作上同时保住视频泛化与动作质量。

papers.title: LoomSC: Scalable Deep Subspace Clustering with Projector Factorization and Exact Spectral Reduction
papers.abstract_en: Dense self-expression matrices and full-affinity spectral clustering limit the scalability of subspace clustering. We introduce the Latent Orthogonal Optimization Model for Subspace Clustering (LoomSC), a framework that addresses both bottlenecks through projector factorization and exact spectral reduction. Motivated by the spectral structure of least-squares regression, LoomSC jointly learns latent features and a projector self-representation through two thin factors. Alternating Procrustes and least-squares updates preserve the sample factor's orthogonality while keeping the coefficient matrix implicit. We construct a nonnegative quadratic affinity that preserves the projector's support. An exact feature map then reduces its normalized spectral problem to an eigenproblem whose dimension depends only on the factor width. Neither the full affinity nor the sample Laplacian needs to be formed. Our analysis quantifies the projector approximation and identifies conditions for subspace preservation and within-subspace connectivity. For fixed dimensions and iteration budgets, the complete pipeline has linear time and memory complexity in the number of samples. Across five image-clustering benchmarks, LoomSC ranks first or second in all 15 dataset-metric comparisons against 9 state-of-the-art baselines. Its mean accuracy exceeds the highest baseline mean by 6.66 percentage points. Synthetic experiments scale to 500,000 samples while maintaining at least 99.8% accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LoomSC 用两个 thin factor 联合学习潜特征与 projector 自表达，把稠密自表达矩阵和全亲和谱聚类两个瓶颈分别用 projector 分解与精确谱归约解决，归约后的特征映射使谱问题维度只依赖因子宽度，无需构造完整亲和矩阵或样本 Laplacian。在五个图像聚类基准的 15 组数据集-指标对比中对 9 个 SOTA 基线全部排名第一或第二，平均准确率高出最强基线均值 6.66 个百分点，合成实验扩到 50 万样本仍保持至少 99.8% 准确率。
Motivation: 子空间聚类依赖稠密自表达矩阵与全亲和谱聚类，两者都随样本数平方增长，成为可扩展性的主要瓶颈。
Method: 受最小二乘回归谱结构启发，LoomSC 用两个 thin factor 联合学习潜特征与 projector 自表示；交替使用 Procrustes 与最小二乘更新，保持样本因子正交并让系数矩阵保持隐式；构造保持 projector 支撑的非负二次亲和，再用精确特征映射把归一化谱问题化为维度只依赖因子宽度的特征值问题。分析给出 projector 近似误差的量化以及子空间保持与子空间内连通的条件；固定维度与迭代预算下整条流水线对样本数呈线性时间与内存复杂度。
Result: 在五个图像聚类基准上，LoomSC 在全部 15 个数据集-指标对比中排名第一或第二，对手为 9 个 SOTA 基线；其平均准确率超过最高基线均值 6.66 个百分点。合成实验扩展到 500,000 样本时仍保持至少 99.8% 准确率。
Conclusion: 把自表达与谱聚类都压到因子宽度决定的低维问题上，可以在保持子空间保持与连通条件的同时让子空间聚类线性扩展到 50 万样本量级。

papers.title: Stale, Misattributed, or Late: Where Personal Memory Fails Before Generation
papers.abstract_en: Personal memory for language agents is usually judged by whether the final an- swer is correct. That score hides errors that arise before generation: the memory block may contain an obsolete value, a fact about the wrong person, or no use- ful fact before the serving deadline. We measure these failures directly. Using Personal Fact Memory (PFM) as a reference layer, we find that temporal validity is primarily a property of memory construction in our setting. On a controlled revision benchmark, serving only the active value of each correctly keyed slot eliminates observed stale exposure; without update resolution, 70.3% of prompts expose a superseded value. Once retrievers share the same active store and par- ticipant information, participant-aware BM25 is equivalent to the reference ranker within a prespecified 0.02 margin. The harder problem is assigning revisions to the right slot. Missed merges leave stale values active, whereas false merges silently remove current values; four LLM key assigners achieve higher key re- call than a rule extractor yet produce lower clean-retrieval rates, and open-domain merge recall on LongMemEval never exceeds 0.062. Misattribution survives va- lidity filtering: an entity posterior reduces same-name exposure on controlled data but cannot distinguish identically named speakers in LoCoMo. Two frozen lan- guage models reproduce prompt errors in generated text. Retrieval latency varies across rankers, but prompt prefill dominates turn-level latency on our hardware. These results argue for evaluating agent memory before generation, separating stored-state validity, identity resolution, abstention, and serving latency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文指出语言 agent 的个人记忆错误发生在生成之前，按存储态有效性、身份消解、弃权与服务延迟四类拆开测量：不做更新归并时 70.3% 的 prompt 会暴露已被取代的旧值，而 LongMemEval 上开放域归并召回率不超过 0.062。作者主张在生成前评估记忆，而不是只看最终答案正确率。
Motivation: 个人记忆通常只按最终答案是否正确打分，这掩盖了生成前就已产生的错误：记忆块里存着过期值、张冠李戴的事实，或在服务截止前没有可用事实。
Method: 以 Personal Fact Memory (PFM) 作参考层，直接测量 stale、misattributed、late 三类失败；在受控修订基准上只服务每个正确 key 槽位的 active 值，并比较规则抽取器与四个 LLM key assigner；用 LongMemEval 与 LoCoMo 检验归并与同名实体消解，另测各 ranker 的检索延迟与 prompt prefill 占比。
Result: 无更新归并时 70.3% 的 prompt 暴露被取代值，只服务正确 key 槽位的 active 值即消除观测到的 stale 暴露；共享同一 active store 与参与者信息后，participant-aware BM25 在预设 0.02 margin 内与参考 ranker 等价；四个 LLM key assigner 的 key recall 高于规则抽取器但 clean-retrieval 更低，LongMemEval 开放域归并召回率不超过 0.062；实体后验能在受控数据上减少同名暴露，却无法区分 LoCoMo 中同名说话人；两个冻结语言模型复现了 prompt 中的错误。
Conclusion: 记忆的时效性主要由记忆构建阶段决定，而非检索或生成阶段；评估应把存储态有效性、身份消解、弃权与服务延迟分开，且 prompt prefill 在该硬件上主导轮次延迟。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.tldr: 论文指出语言 agent 的个人记忆错误发生在生成之前，按存储态有效性、身份消解、弃权与服务延迟四类拆开测量：不做更新归并时 70.3% 的 prompt 会暴露已被取代的旧值，而 LongMemEval 上开放域归并召回率不超过 0.062。作者主张在生成前评估记忆，而不是只看最终答案正确率。
summary_sections.motivation: 个人记忆通常只按最终答案是否正确打分，这掩盖了生成前就已产生的错误：记忆块里存着过期值、张冠李戴的事实，或在服务截止前没有可用事实。
summary_sections.method: 以 Personal Fact Memory (PFM) 作参考层，直接测量 stale、misattributed、late 三类失败；在受控修订基准上只服务每个正确 key 槽位的 active 值，并比较规则抽取器与四个 LLM key assigner；用 LongMemEval 与 LoCoMo 检验归并与同名实体消解，另测各 ranker 的检索延迟与 prompt prefill 占比。
summary_sections.result: 无更新归并时 70.3% 的 prompt 暴露被取代值，只服务正确 key 槽位的 active 值即消除观测到的 stale 暴露；共享同一 active store 与参与者信息后，participant-aware BM25 在预设 0.02 margin 内与参考 ranker 等价；四个 LLM key assigner 的 key recall 高于规则抽取器但 clean-retrieval 更低，LongMemEval 开放域归并召回率不超过 0.062；实体后验能在受控数据上减少同名暴露，却无法区分 LoCoMo 中同名说话人；两个冻结语言模型复现了 prompt 中的错误。
summary_sections.conclusion: 记忆的时效性主要由记忆构建阶段决定，而非检索或生成阶段；评估应把存储态有效性、身份消解、弃权与服务延迟分开，且 prompt prefill 在该硬件上主导轮次延迟。

papers.title: Using Small Language Models to Reverse-Engineer Machine Learning Pipelines Structures
papers.abstract_en: Context: Once defined a taxonomy of stages structuring Machine Learning (ML) pipelines (e.g. Data Preprocessing, Modeling...), extracting these stages from source code is key for better understanding ML practices. However, the diversity caused by the constant evolution of ML (e.g., algorithms, datasets) makes this task challenging. Existing approaches either rely on non-scalable manual labeling or on classifiers that do not properly support domain's diversity. These limitations call for more reliable solutions. Objective: We evaluate whether Small Language Models (SLMs) can leverage their code understanding and classification abilities to address these limitations, and enhance our understanding of practices in ML. Method: We conduct a confirmatory study based on two relevant reference works representing current limitations in the state-of-the-art. We first compare several SLMs using Cochran's Q test, then evaluate the best-performing model against reference studies via two McNemar's tests. An additional Cochran's Q test examines how taxonomy definition variations affect the SLM performance. Finally, goodness-of-fit tests compare ML practice insights from SLM classification with those from prior studies. Results: First, we found that the taxonomy wording significantly impacts classification performance. Second, the best performing SLM yielded good results, yet, without outperforming other classifiers. Third, the three classification methods led to significantly different insights, with varying effect sizes, when exploring practices of data scientists. Conclusions: Limitations of existing classification methods bias our understanding of ML practices. While current SLMs show promising results without prior fine-tuning, they still exhibit common limitations, in addition to inference high costs challenging their applicability in large-scale studies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用小型语言模型 (SLM) 从源码中反向抽取 ML pipeline 阶段（如 Data Preprocessing、Modeling），以替代不可扩展的人工标注和不支持领域多样性的分类器。Cochran's Q 与 McNemar's 检验显示 taxonomy 措辞显著影响分类性能，最佳 SLM 结果尚可但未超越其他分类器，且三种分类方法导出的数据科学家实践结论存在显著差异。
Motivation: ML pipeline 阶段抽取依赖人工标注（不可扩展）或不支持领域多样性的分类器，且不同分类方法本身会偏置我们对 ML 实践的认识。
Method: 确认性研究，选两篇代表现有局限的参考工作；先用 Cochran's Q 检验比较多个 SLM，再用两个 McNemar's 检验把最佳模型与参考研究对比，另用 Cochran's Q 检验考察 taxonomy 定义变化的影响，最后用拟合优度检验比较 SLM 与既往研究的实践洞察。
Result: taxonomy 措辞显著影响分类性能；最佳 SLM 表现良好但未超越其他分类器；三种分类方法在探索数据科学家实践时给出显著不同的结论，效应量不一。
Conclusion: 现有分类方法的局限会偏置对 ML 实践的理解；当前 SLM 免微调即有可用表现，但仍有常见局限且推理成本高，难以支撑大规模研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PairAudit: Guiding Human Review with Graph Tokens under Distribution Shift
papers.abstract_en: Intrusion detectors can confidently misclassify attacks that were not seen during training. Human review can correct these errors, but only a limited number of cases can be checked. Uncertainty-based review may overlook confident errors, while anomaly scores alone do not show whether changing the review plan will correct more errors. We introduce PairAudit to find overlooked errors and improve review under a fixed budget. Its graph tokens capture prediction patterns across connected nodes. Rather than building another predictor through feature aggregation, PairAudit uses unusual relational patterns to uncover potential errors in existing predictions. Human feedback then helps decide whether these findings justify changing review priorities. Experiments across security tasks show that PairAudit corrects more errors on average than uncertainty-based review, including more errors on unseen attacks. These gains account for all review costs and do not require retraining the detector.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PairAudit 用图 token (graph tokens) 刻画入侵检测器在关联节点上的预测模式，靠非常规的 relational pattern 找出被自信误分类的未见攻击，再用人工反馈决定是否调整审查优先级。在固定审查预算下，安全任务实验中它平均纠正的错误多于基于不确定性的审查，包括更多未见攻击错误，且收益已计入全部审查成本、无需重训检测器。
Motivation: 入侵检测器会对训练中未见的攻击给出高置信误判，人工审查只能覆盖少量样本；基于不确定性的审查会漏掉这些自信错误，而单看异常分数又无法判断改变审查计划能否真的纠正更多错误。
Method: PairAudit 不做特征聚合再训练一个新预测器，而是用 graph tokens 捕获关联节点间的预测模式，以异常的 relational pattern 在既有预测中定位潜在错误；随后用人工反馈判断这些发现是否值得调整审查优先级，在固定预算下分配审查。
Result: 在多个安全任务上，PairAudit 平均纠正的错误多于基于不确定性的审查，其中包含更多未见攻击 (unseen attacks) 导致的错误；这些收益已计入全部审查成本，且不需要重训检测器。
Conclusion: 在固定人工审查预算下，利用预测之间的关系模式而非不确定性分数来挑选待审样本，能纠正更多错误，包括对未见攻击的自信误分类。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: QuSema: Detecting Silent Bugs in Quantum Libraries via Quantum-knowledge-enhanced Agents
papers.abstract_en: Quantum libraries are now critical infrastructure for quantum algorithm development, yet their correctness remains difficult to test. Existing testing techniques mainly rely on failure-based or comparison-based oracles, exposing bugs only when executions fail, violate runtime checks, or disagree with another implementation. Their applicability is limited when suitable execution-based oracles are unavailable, leaving some silent bugs undetected. Such missed bugs can produce incorrect results that propagate into experimental conclusions, simulation studies, and algorithmic designs. Here we present QuSema, an autonomous testing agent for finding silent bugs in quantum libraries. QuSema uses constraints from quantum semantics and documentation as a source-level semantic oracle to assess whether implementation logic can produce invalid outputs from valid inputs. It operates through an agentic loop that repeatedly inspects library API documentation and source code, reasons about the intended behavior of quantum operations, identifies potential semantic deviations, and validates them by generating executable tests through library APIs. Guided by quantum-domain reasoning, QuSema turns high-level behavioral mismatches into concrete, user-triggerable bug reports, enabling it to uncover non-crash defects. We implement QuSema for Qiskit and PennyLane. On a benchmark of 20 historical silent bugs, QuSema achieves higher mean bug relocation counts than Claude Code and Codex, with the DeepSeek configuration costing less than Claude Code. QuSema also discovers 40 previously unknown bugs confirmed by the developers, including 30 silent bugs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QuSema 是面向量子库静默缺陷 (silent bug) 的自主测试 agent，用量子语义与文档约束充当源码级语义 oracle，判断实现逻辑是否会把合法输入算成非法输出。在 20 个历史静默 bug 基准上，其平均 bug relocation 数高于 Claude Code 与 Codex，DeepSeek 配置成本低于 Claude Code，并新发现 40 个经开发者确认的 bug（其中 30 个为静默 bug）。
Motivation: 现有量子库测试依赖失败型或对比型 oracle，只有执行崩溃、运行时检查失败或与另一实现不一致时才暴露缺陷；缺少可执行 oracle 时，静默 bug 会把错误结果带进实验结论与算法设计。
Method: QuSema 以量子语义和 API 文档约束作为源码级语义 oracle，运行一个 agentic loop：反复查阅库 API 文档与源码，推理量子操作的预期行为，定位语义偏差，再通过库 API 生成可执行测试来验证，把高层行为不匹配转成用户可触发的 bug 报告。实现覆盖 Qiskit 与 PennyLane。
Result: 在 20 个历史 silent bug 的基准上，QuSema 的平均 bug relocation 数高于 Claude Code 和 Codex，DeepSeek 配置的花费低于 Claude Code；另发现 40 个此前未知、经开发者确认的 bug，其中 30 个是 silent bug。
Conclusion: 把量子领域知识写进语义 oracle 并交给 agent 循环执行，可以在没有执行型 oracle 的情况下找出会产出错误结果的非崩溃缺陷。

papers.title: OOM-RL II: Reality Is an Oracle, Not a Debugger Provenance-Constrained Diagnosis in Continually Evolving Agent-Engineered Systems
papers.abstract_en: Reality may establish that an outcome occurred without identifying which evolving procedure produced it or why. This distinction matters in production ML systems whose code, configuration, and artifacts change while external feedback accumulates. We examine it in a human-directed, agent-engineered quantitative trading system, using oracle to mean an external source of realized outcomes rather than a complete correctness specification. Across one year, the account gained and outperformed a broad market index, while annual alpha was not statistically distinguishable from zero under the main retrospective specification. Retrospectively selected subperiods include adverse relative performance and conditional candidate-level weakness under declared approximate references. Engineering records document changes during the episode, and complete recommendation-to-runtime binding is unavailable. The archive does not establish a common frozen instance or a unique cause. The case motivates an outcome--diagnosis gap: outcome evidence, evaluated-object identity, and causal explanation support distinct claims. We distinguish frozen instances, pre-specified adaptive procedures, and ad-hoc development; organize archive-relative claim identifiability and an evidence hierarchy; and propose a prospective production-binding protocol. An illustrative compatible-history example shows how factual binding can resolve a recommendation's referent without supplying its counterfactual effect. The protocol is proposed rather than prospectively validated. External feedback constrains outcome claims, while provenance and additional identification structure determine the resolution of diagnosis.
papers.comment: 38 pages, 14 figures, 9 tables. Supplementary Dataset S1: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23215521. Follow-up to arXiv:2604.11477
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 outcome–diagnosis gap：外部反馈只能确认结果发生，无法指认是哪一版演化中的流程导致它。以一年期人工主导、agent 构建的量化交易系统为案例，账户跑赢宽基指数但年化 alpha 在主回溯设定下与零无统计区分；作者据此区分冻结实例、预设自适应流程与临时开发，给出档案相对的主张可识别性分级与前瞻生产绑定协议。
Motivation: 生产 ML 系统的代码、配置与产物持续变化而外部反馈不断累积，结果证据、被评估对象的身份、因果解释三者支撑的是不同主张，混用会把结果陈述误当诊断。
Method: 在量化交易案例中组织档案相对的主张可识别性与证据层级，区分冻结实例、预设自适应流程和 ad-hoc 开发；提出前瞻生产绑定协议 (prospective production-binding protocol)，并用一个兼容历史示例说明事实绑定如何解析推荐的指称对象。
Result: 一年期账户获利并跑赢宽基指数，但主回溯设定下年化 alpha 与零无统计区分；回溯选出的子区间含相对表现不利与在声明的近似参考下候选层面的条件性弱势。档案记录了期间的工程变更，但缺少完整的推荐到运行时绑定，也未建立共同冻结实例或唯一成因。
Conclusion: 外部反馈约束结果主张，而诊断的分辨率由 provenance 与额外识别结构决定；该协议是提出的，尚未做前瞻验证。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: On the Cyclic Assumption of the Cow-Path Search Algorithm
papers.abstract_en: In the cow-path problem, a cow must find a goal lying at an unknown distance on one of $w$ paths connected only at the origin, and performance is measured by competitive ratio. Kao, Reif and Tate designed an efficient randomized algorithm in which the cow visits the paths in a fixed cyclic order. They proved the algorithm is optimal for $w=2$, and subsequently Kao, Ma, Sipser and Yin proved its optimality for all $w$, with a claim that no algorithm does better than the best cyclic one. This note provides a detailed proof of that claim.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是对 cow-path 搜索算法最优性声明的补全证明：Kao–Reif–Tate 的随机算法按固定循环顺序访问 w 条路径，先前已证 w=2 及所有 w 下最优，本文给出「不存在算法优于最佳循环算法」这一声明的详细证明。
Motivation: Kao、Ma、Sipser、Yin 此前证明了循环顺序随机算法对所有 w 最优，但附带的「无算法能胜过最佳循环算法」声明缺少完整论证，本文补上该证明。
Method: 针对 cow-path 问题（目标位于原点相连的 w 条路径之一、距离未知、以 competitive ratio 度量），对 Kao–Reif–Tate 随机循环访问算法给出「不存在算法优于最佳循环算法」这一上界的详细证明。
Result: 证明了在 cow-path 问题的 competitive ratio 准则下，没有任何算法能优于最佳的循环顺序算法；该结论覆盖所有路径数 w，此前已知 w=2 与全部 w 下循环算法本身最优。
Conclusion: 循环顺序的随机搜索在 cow-path 问题上已达到 competitive ratio 的全局最优，后续改进只能来自改变问题设定而非搜索顺序。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Logarithmic Regret via Passive Change Detection in Piecewise-Stationary Self-Tuning Regulation
papers.abstract_en: We study minimum-variance control of an unknown autoregressive system with exogenous inputs and coefficients that change at unknown times. Under bounded independent disturbances, fixed detection gaps, stability and feasibility conditions, and sufficient time between changes, we prove \(O((C+1)\log((T+1)/δ))\) regret with probability at least \(1-δ\), where \(T\) is the horizon and \(C\) the number of changes. Unlike switching bandits, where unselected arms can change unobserved, admissible plant changes provide information during exploitation: the correct feasible controller leaves only the disturbance in the output, whereas a detectable change raises output energy under the old controller. PIECE-CD explores initially and after alarms, then uses gated recursive least squares for control. Its energy test compares windowed output power with a threshold above the noise floor; the extension to unstable controller mismatches also monitors the reference controller's input proposal. We control false alarms across the horizon and prove logarithmic detection delay. Inputs are clipped to prescribed bounds. Logarithmic regret also holds under an explicit condition ensuring that clipping becomes inactive after a finite burn-in. Under the stated feasibility conditions, the extended detector covers destabilizing changes with detectable excess energy over a fixed window.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对系数在未知时刻跳变的未知 ARX 系统，PIECE-CD 用能量检测触发重探索、以门控 RLS 做最小方差控制，在有界独立扰动、固定检测间隔与足够长的平稳段下证明 O((C+1)log((T+1)/δ)) 的高概率 regret。与切换 bandit 不同，被控对象的变化本身在利用阶段就携带信息：正确控制器下输出只剩扰动，而可检测的变化会抬高旧控制器下的输出能量。
Motivation: 切换 bandit 中未被选中的臂可无观测地变化，而控制回路里被控对象的变化会立刻反映在输出上；如何把这一性质用于分段平稳自调节控制并给出对数级 regret 保证，是论文要补的缺口。
Method: PIECE-CD 在初始阶段与报警后做探索，其余时间用门控递归最小二乘 (gated RLS) 控制；能量检测器把窗口输出功率与高于噪声底的阈值比较，扩展版还监视参考控制器的输入提议以覆盖不稳定失配；对全时域控制虚警率并证明对数检测延迟，输入被裁剪到给定界。
Result: 在有界独立扰动、固定检测间隔、稳定与可行条件及变化间足够时间下，以至少 1-δ 的概率证明 regret 为 O((C+1)log((T+1)/δ))，T 为时域、C 为变化次数；在显式条件下裁剪经有限 burn-in 后失效，对数 regret 仍成立；在可行条件下扩展检测器覆盖固定窗口内具有可检测过剩能量的失稳变化。
Conclusion: 被控对象的变化在利用阶段自带信息，配合能量检测与门控 RLS 即可在分段平稳自调节控制中把 regret 压到对数级，前提是变化间隔、可行性与裁剪失效条件满足。

papers.title: Stationary Bias and Extrapolation in Nonlinear Two-Timescale Stochastic Approximation
papers.abstract_en: Constant-step stochastic approximation generally has a nonzero stationary mean error that persists under time averaging. This paper studies that error for nonlinear two-timescale recursions driven by an exogenous finite-state Markov chain. Under stated smoothness assumptions and conditions on the stationary distribution, we derive a first-order bias expansion whose error bound remains uniform as the slow step size becomes much smaller than the fast step size. Fast-manifold coordinates keep the associated covariance equation regular in this limit. For fast step $η$ and slow step $\varepsilon$, the expansion reveals a mixed contribution $\varepsilon^2/η$ alongside terms linear in each step size. This dependence matters for bias reduction: along power-law step-size paths, the bias exponents need not be integers, so Richardson--Romberg extrapolation requires weights matched to the path. An exactly solvable nonlinear Markov example verifies the coefficients. We verify localization for temporal-difference learning and compare finite-run extrapolation at equal update budgets. For finite runs, we bound the initialization error of tail averages on both timescales under an additional coupling assumption. In the special case of additive independent noise, signed third-moment cancellation yields a sharper remainder.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究由有限状态外生 Markov 链驱动的非线性两时间尺度随机逼近 (two-timescale stochastic approximation) 在常数步长下的平稳偏差，推导出在慢步长远小于快步长时仍一致的一阶偏差展开。展开中出现混合项 ε²/η 与各步长的线性项，因此沿幂律步长路径偏差指数可能非整数，Richardson–Romberg 外推的权重必须与路径匹配。
Motivation: 常数步长随机逼近的平稳均值误差在时间平均下仍然存在，而两时间尺度设定中该偏差随快慢步长的耦合方式尚不清楚，直接影响偏差消减策略是否有效。
Method: 在光滑性假设与平稳分布条件下推导一阶偏差展开，用快流形坐标 (fast-manifold coordinates) 保证协方差方程在 ε≪η 极限下正则；用可精确求解的非线性 Markov 例子验证系数，并对 temporal-difference learning 验证局部化 (localization)，在等更新预算下比较有限运行的外推。
Result: 偏差展开揭示混合项 ε²/η 与各步长线性项；沿幂律步长路径偏差指数可为非整数，Richardson–Romberg 外推需按路径匹配权重。在附加耦合假设下给出两时间尺度尾部平均初始化误差的界；在加性独立噪声特例中，三阶矩的符号相消给出更紧的余项。
Conclusion: 两时间尺度随机逼近的偏差结构由 ε²/η 混合项主导其外推设计，偏差消减不能沿用整数指数的标准 Richardson–Romberg 权重，而须按所选步长路径重新匹配。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: MorphCL: Morphological Contrastive Learning for Inertial-based Human Activity Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Despite the ubiquity of sensors in wearable and mobile devices and the abundance of human movement data they generate, translating unlabeled recordings into foundational motion models remains an open challenge. Self-supervised learning (SSL) has alleviated the need for costly annotations, yet existing approaches leave the global structure of large-scale motion data largely untapped, relying on randomly sampled batches and local comparisons that become particularly problematic for in-the-wild inertial data dominated by stationary, low-variance behaviors. Here we introduce Morphological Contrastive Learning (MorphCL), a self-supervised pretraining framework that uses structure-aware grouping to inject explicit modeling of global structure into inertial-based SSL approaches. Building on two well-established pillars of motion analysis, the discovery of motion primitives, or motifs, and domain-specific feature descriptors, we show that MorphCL substantially improves linear probing and finetuning results of learned encoders by up to 15 percentage points in F1-score. In a comparison with existing foundation models, we demonstrate that MorphCL-pretrained encoders match or surpass them models in linear probing performance while trained on $4600\times$ less data. Qualitative analysis of the resulting embedding spaces further reveals morphologically meaningful cluster structure, with improved separation of kinematically similar activity classes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MorphCL 用结构感知分组把运动基元 (motifs) 与领域特征描述子注入惯性传感器自监督预训练，显式建模大规模运动数据的全局结构。在野外惯性数据以静止、低方差动作为主的条件下，线性探测与微调 F1 最多提升 15 个百分点，且用少 4600 倍的数据即可匹配或超过现有基础模型的线性探测性能。
Motivation: 现有惯性 SSL 依赖随机采样批次与局部对比，几乎未利用大规模运动数据的全局结构；在野外数据被静止、低方差动作主导时这一缺陷尤其严重。
Method: 提出 Morphological Contrastive Learning (MorphCL)：以结构感知分组显式注入全局结构建模，结合运动基元 (motion primitives/motifs) 发现与领域专用特征描述子做自监督预训练，随后用线性探测与微调评估编码器。
Result: 线性探测与微调 F1 最多提升 15 个百分点；与现有基础模型相比，线性探测性能匹配或超越，而训练数据少 4600 倍；嵌入空间呈现形态上有意义的簇结构，运动学相近的活动类别分离度更好。
Conclusion: 把全局结构与运动基元显式建模进惯性 SSL，能在极少数据下达到基础模型级别的表征质量，并得到运动学上可解释的嵌入空间。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: TestGRAD: Evolving Test Suites via Failure Pattern Momentum for SWE-Agent Ensemble
papers.abstract_en: SWE-agent ensembles improve issue resolution by combining candidate patches from different agents with complementary strengths. The central problem is therefore test-based selection: generate tests, execute candidate patches, and identify the best patch. We formulate this process as test-space optimization: evolving an executable repository test suite until it distinguishes competing patches. Existing test-generation methods are limited optimizers. They usually lack an explicit loss for ensemble selection, optimize through incomplete directions that mostly create new tests or delete old ones, and perform one-off generation without feedback from repeated failures. Inspired by gradient descent with momentum, we introduce TestGRAD, a framework for automatic test optimization. TestGRAD centers on three concepts. Differential loss gives the optimizer an explicit execution-defined target: useful tests should separate candidate patches by behavior. Full CRUD gradients expand the update direction from merely creating or deleting tests to reading existing test infrastructure, creating new tests, updating stale assertions, and deleting only obsolete tests. Failure Pattern Momentum mines frequent failure sequences from memory, allowing the optimizer to avoid repeated non-discriminative directions while compressing the failure-history context. On SWE-bench Verified, TestGRAD achieves 84.2% Pass@1 with a 4-agent ensemble, outperforming the strongest baseline (80.6%) by an absolute improvement of 3.6 percentage points, while compressing failure-history context by over $100\times$.
papers.comment: 12 pages, including 3 pages of supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TestGRAD 把 SWE-agent 集成的补丁选择形式化为测试空间优化：用执行定义的 differential loss、Full CRUD 梯度（读/建/改/删测试）和 Failure Pattern Momentum 挖掘失败序列，迭代演化可执行仓库测试以区分候选补丁。在 SWE-bench Verified 上 4-agent 集成取得 84.2% Pass@1，超最强基线 80.6% 共 3.6 个百分点，同时失败历史上下文压缩超过 100 倍。
Motivation: SWE-agent 集成靠合并互补补丁提升 issue 解决率，但核心瓶颈是基于测试的选择：现有测试生成方法缺少面向集成选择的显式损失，更新方向只增删测试，且一次性生成、不利用反复失败的反馈。
Method: TestGRAD 含三个组件：differential loss 以执行结果为优化目标，要求测试按行为区分候选补丁；Full CRUD gradients 把更新方向扩展为读取既有测试设施、新建测试、更新过期断言、仅删除废弃测试；Failure Pattern Momentum 从记忆中挖掘频繁失败序列，避开重复的无区分力方向并压缩失败历史上下文。
Result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 上，4-agent 集成 Pass@1 达 84.2%，对比最强基线 80.6% 绝对提升 3.6 个百分点，同时失败历史上下文压缩超过 100 倍。
Conclusion: 把测试生成当作带显式区分损失与失败记忆动量的优化问题，能在 SWE-bench Verified 上同时提高集成补丁选择的 Pass@1 并大幅压缩失败历史上下文。

papers.title: When Scientific Cognition Is No Longer Scarce
papers.abstract_en: AI could change which parts of science impede progress. Consider a world in which machine systems are better, faster, and cheaper than people at most scientific work that can be done through a computer. Our question is what would limit science in that world. Literature synthesis, hypothesis generation, software development, simulation, and analysis could become abundant, while experiments, observations, well-supported conclusions, and accountable institutional au- thority remain scarce. Science would then be constrained by a different set of resources. In this paper, we call this change the scarcity inversion and consider four parts of it: selection, physical access, validation, and organizational choice. This change is arriving first in mathematics and coding/software/algorithm design, where the whole scientific loop can run inside computation. For national laboratories, the change could be striking. Their distinctive role is to turn abundant machine reasoning into trustworthy results by combining controlled experiments, protected data, expert judgment, and accountable authority. The practical question is how facilities, verification, provenance, resource allocation, and scientific governance should change when reasoning is plentiful and trustworthy evidence is scarce.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出“稀缺性反转”(scarcity inversion)：当机器在可纯计算完成的科学工作上优于、快于且便宜于人，文献综述、假设生成、软件与仿真变得充裕，而实验、观测、可靠结论与可问责的机构权威仍然稀缺，科学的瓶颈随之从推理转向证据。作者把这一反转拆成选择、物理接入、验证与组织决策四部分，并指出它最先出现在数学与代码/软件/算法设计这类全环路可内化于计算的领域。
Motivation: 若机器推理变得充裕而可信证据稀缺，国家实验室与科研体系的约束条件会整体改变，但现有讨论缺少对“什么会限制科学”的结构性刻画。
Method: 提出概念框架“scarcity inversion”，围绕 selection、physical access、validation、organizational choice 四个组成部分展开分析，并以数学与 coding/software/algorithm design 作为首个落地领域、以国家实验室为应用场景讨论 facilities、verification、provenance、resource allocation 与 scientific governance 应如何调整。
Result: 全文为 14 页、1 图的概念性论文；给出的判断是文献综述、假设生成、软件开发、仿真与分析将变得充裕，而实验、观测、有充分支撑的结论与可问责的机构权威保持稀缺，且这一反转最先到达数学与代码/软件/算法设计。
Conclusion: 科学的限制性资源将从推理能力转为可信证据与可问责权威，国家实验室的独特价值在于把充裕的机器推理转化为可信结果，需相应重设设施、验证、溯源、资源分配与科研治理。

papers.title: ProtocolMatch: Protocol-Dependent Model Selection for Scientific Dynamics Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Scientific dynamics forecasting is often framed as an architecture choice, although deployment is also determined by observed history, rollout feedback, compute budget, physical objective, and test distribution. We formulate protocol-dependent model selection and introduce ProtocolMatch, a compute-matched, validation-selected, and failure-preserving evaluation framework. On driven quantum-spin dynamics, we compare recurrent, patched-attention, causal-attention, and low-rank linear predictors across three independently generated datasets. The causal-attention--recurrence ordering reverses as the training set grows within a fixed two-spin task, while a linear predictor has the lowest mean error in the six-spin local-observable comparison. Restricting observed history worsens every refreshed-history view but improves every closed-loop view in the four-spin study. A latest-state MLP has lower error than persistence on every dataset under state refresh across all five cells, yet its closed-loop rank varies by system and includes finite explosive errors. Physical penalties improve targeted consistency without reliably improving prediction error, and in-distribution intervals lose most coverage after a driving-frequency shift. Thus scientific model selection should return a predictor with its protocol and report accuracy, physical validity, and shifted-distribution reliability separately.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ProtocolMatch 把科学动力学预报的模型选择从「架构之争」改写为协议之争：在计算量对齐、验证集选型、保留失败样本的评测框架下，同一模型的排名会随观测历史、闭环滚动、训练集规模和分布漂移而反转。结论是选型必须连同协议一起返回，并把精度、物理一致性、漂移可靠性分开报告。
Motivation: 科学动力学预报的部署结果同时受观测历史、rollout 反馈、算力预算、物理目标和测试分布影响，但实践中常被简化为架构选择，导致排名不可迁移、失败被平均掩盖。
Method: 提出 ProtocolMatch：计算量对齐 (compute-matched)、验证集选型 (validation-selected)、保留失败 (failure-preserving) 的评测框架；在受驱动量子自旋动力学上比较 recurrent、patched-attention、causal-attention 与 low-rank linear 预测器，覆盖三个独立生成的数据集，以及二自旋、四自旋、六自旋设定下的历史受限与刷新历史、闭环与开环视图，并加入物理惩罚项与分布漂移（driving-frequency shift）检验。
Result: 固定二自旋任务中 causal-attention 对 recurrence 的排序随训练集增大而反转；六自旋局域观测量比较中 low-rank linear 预测器平均误差最低；四自旋研究里限制观测历史使每个刷新历史视图变差、却使每个闭环视图变好；latest-state MLP 在全部五个 cell 的状态刷新下每个数据集误差都低于 persistence，但闭环排名随系统变化且含有限的爆炸性误差；物理惩罚改善目标一致性却不稳定降低预测误差；driving-frequency shift 后，in-distribution 区间丢失大部分覆盖率。
Conclusion: 科学模型选择应返回预测器及其协议，并把精度、物理有效性、漂移后可靠性分开报告，而不是给出脱离协议的单一架构排名。

papers.title: Geometry-Supervised Visual Representation Learning for Multi-Phenotype Lesion Interpretation in Medical VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) have shown increasing potential for clinical image interpretation. However, these models still struggle to interpret multi-phenotype lesions whose diagnosis requires the joint assessment of multiple pathological phenotypes. Existing vision-language alignment methods produce visual representations that fail to preserve anatomical hierarchies and relationships among phenotypic subclasses. This stems from their reliance on semantic supervision, which lacks geometric constraints to preserve these relationships in the visual embedding space. Moreover, the sparsity of lesion-related anatomical and phenotypic representations makes it difficult for medical VLMs to capture important diagnostic evidence. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{PureVision}, a geometry-supervised visual representation learning framework for multi-phenotype lesion interpretation in medical VLMs. It combines a geometry-supervised representation learning module, \textbf{PureEyes}, and an anatomy-guided evidence aggregation module, \textbf{PureNeurons}. PureEyes provides geometric supervision through ideal spatial distributions that encode anatomical hierarchies and phenotypic subclass relationships. PureNeurons projects visual representations into the learned latent space, using their positions to selectively aggregate lesion-specific anatomical and phenotypic evidence. Experiments on \textit{LIDC-IDRI}, \textit{CBIS-DDSM}, and \textit{3DReasonKnee} demonstrate that PureVision improves lesion grounding and phenotype characterization in visual question answering and radiology report generation. Code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/purevision-06C2.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 PureVision，用几何监督的视觉表征学习模块 PureEyes 以理想空间分布编码解剖层级与表型子类关系，再由 PureNeurons 在学到的潜空间中按位置选择性聚合病灶特异的解剖与表型证据。在 LIDC-IDRI、CBIS-DDSM、3DReasonKnee 上改善多表型病灶的 VQA 病灶定位与放射报告生成。
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言对齐只靠语义监督、缺少几何约束，视觉嵌入无法保留解剖层级与表型子类关系；病灶相关解剖与表型表征稀疏，医学 VQA 难以捕捉关键诊断证据。
Method: PureVision 由两部分组成：PureEyes 通过编码解剖层级与表型子类关系的理想空间分布提供几何监督；PureNeurons 把视觉表征投影到该潜空间，依据其位置选择性聚合病灶特异的解剖与表型证据，用于 VQA 与放射报告生成。
Result: 在 LIDC-IDRI、CBIS-DDSM、3DReasonKnee 三个数据集上，PureVision 改善了视觉问答中的病灶定位 (lesion grounding) 与表型刻画，以及放射报告生成。
Conclusion: 给视觉表征加几何约束并按潜空间位置聚合证据，能提升医学 VLM 对需联合多病理表型判读的病灶的解释能力。

papers.title: Beyond LLM-GA: Secure Fluid Antenna Systems with ReEvo-Designed Memetic Algorithm
papers.abstract_en: Fluid antenna systems (FASs) offer significant spatial flexibility, yet securing them against eavesdropping is critical for practical FAS deployment in military, satellite, and internet-of-things networks. Although large language model (LLM)-assisted genetic algorithms (LLM-GAs) can address this secure FAS port selection problem, whether further algorithmic improvement is possible warrants deeper investigation. To this end, we propose a memetic algorithm based on reflective evolution (ReEvo). Unlike the state-of-the-art LLM-GAs, which design only crossover or mutation operators with an LLM, our algorithm leverages an LLM to evolve dedicated crossover, mutation, and local-search operators offline. These operators are then embedded into a memetic search framework, thereby obviating any online LLM queries during execution. Simulation results at equal generation counts demonstrate that our proposed algorithm achieves a higher secure sum-rate than the conventional GA and the state-of-the-art LLM-GAs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对流体天线系统 (FAS) 端口选择的安全问题，提出基于反思式进化 (ReEvo) 的 memetic 算法：用 LLM 离线进化专用的交叉、变异与局部搜索算子，再嵌入 memetic 搜索框架，执行期不再需要在线 LLM 查询。在等代数仿真下，其安全和速率 (secure sum-rate) 高于传统 GA 与现有 LLM-GA。
Motivation: FAS 端口选择需对抗窃听，现有 LLM 辅助遗传算法 (LLM-GA) 只让 LLM 设计交叉或变异算子之一，且执行中仍需在线调用 LLM，算法是否还能进一步改进并不清楚。
Method: ReEvo 用 LLM 离线演化出专用 crossover、mutation 与 local-search 三类算子，将这些算子嵌入 memetic 搜索框架执行，从而在运行时免除在线 LLM 查询；对比对象为传统 GA 与 LLM-GA。
Result: 在等代数 (equal generation counts) 的仿真设置下，ReEvo 得到的 secure sum-rate 高于 conventional GA 与 state-of-the-art LLM-GAs。
Conclusion: 把 LLM 算子设计移到离线阶段并补齐局部搜索，可在不增加在线 LLM 开销的前提下提升 FAS 安全端口选择的解质量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: LLM Persuasion Is in the Eye of the Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have already been shown to match or exceed human experts in persuasion. While their persuasive capabilities hold promise for beneficial uses such as education and health communication, they can also be used to manipulate and misinform, making their evaluation a growing priority for developers and regulators. That evaluation, however, remains fragmented: studies differ in what they treat as persuasion, and broad claims often rest on narrow, situation-specific assessments. Automated methods, often modelled on human studies, offer a way to compare such assessments directly, as they can be run on the same models at scale and can include high-risk forms of persuasion that would be difficult or unethical to test on people. In this study, we adapt nine published automated methods to a shared setup, run them on the same fifteen LLMs, and ask whether their rankings agree and why. We find that the methods agree only weakly (mean Spearman $ρ= 0.25$). Our analyses point to two contributing factors. Models that refuse some tasks but not others, directly or indirectly, lower agreement by about a quarter, and these refusals fall mostly on manipulation tasks. General capability also plays a part: most rational persuasion (non-manipulative) methods track it, whereas most manipulation methods do not. Together, these findings suggest that agreement depends more on the task a method sets than on how it scores persuasion, although this pattern is only indicative given the eight methods available for analysis. More broadly, our results suggest that persuasion scores combine a model's ability to persuade with its willingness to do so. A single score is therefore informative about its own setting, but says little about a model's persuasiveness across tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把九种已发表的 LLM 自动说服力评估方法统一到同一设置下跑同一批十五个模型，方法间排名仅弱一致（平均 Spearman ρ=0.25）。拒绝部分任务的模型会把一致性拉低约四分之一，且拒绝集中在操纵类任务；说服力分数混合了模型「能不能」与「愿不愿」说服，单一分数只在其自身设置内有意义。
Motivation: LLM 说服力评估研究碎片化：各研究对「说服」的定义不同，宽泛结论往往建立在狭窄、情境特定的测评上，缺乏可直接比较的统一评估。
Method: 将九种已发表的自动说服评估方法适配到共享设置，在同一批十五个 LLM 上运行，比较各方法给出的模型排名是否一致并分析不一致的来源；其中八种方法进入成因分析。
Result: 九种方法的模型排名仅弱一致，平均 Spearman ρ=0.25；部分拒绝任务（直接或间接）的模型使一致性降低约四分之一，且这些拒绝多落在操纵类任务上；多数理性说服（非操纵）方法与通用能力相关，而多数操纵类方法与之无关。
Conclusion: 说服力评估的一致性更多取决于方法设定的任务而非其打分方式，说服力分数同时包含说服能力与说服意愿，单一分数跨任务外推性很弱；该模式仅具指示性，因为可用于分析的方法只有八种。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Prompts to Trees: Effective LLM-Guided Tree Generation for Few-Shot Tabular Classification
papers.abstract_en: While Large Language Models (LLMs) possess rich world knowledge and impressive generalization capabilities, their direct application to tabular data classification is hindered by high inference costs and limited interpretability. In contrast, decision trees are fast and transparent but often underperform in low-data regimes. In this work, we propose a novel framework that bridges these paradigms by distilling LLM knowledge into interpretable decision trees under a few-shot learning setting. Instead of directly prompting the LLM to generate full trees, which is often unstable and inefficient, we develop a three-stage paradigm that prompts the LLM to generate rules and organize the rules into a tree. Experiments on multiple real-world tabular datasets demonstrate that our method achieves superior accuracy and interpretability with significantly lower prompting overhead compared to existing baselines.

papers.title: Why Software Engineering Is Indispensable in the Age of Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: Can AI make Software Engineering (SE) -- the discipline -- obsolete? And can it make software engineers -- the professionals -- redundant? This paper argues that the rise of capable AI coding agents makes SE and software engineers essential, not obsolete: the missing foundation without which AI-assisted development produces misleadingly plausible, unverifiable, and ultimately untrustworthy software. Three structural properties of large language models (probabilistic generation, agnosticism, and semantic statelessness) create a structural vacuum that no amount of training can eliminate. Filling it requires four knowledge levers: methodological knowledge, domain knowledge, design choices, and process choices. All four must be reified as persistent artifacts, and each requires the software engineer as methodologist, mediator, and custodian.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in Communications of the ACM. 5 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文论断：AI 编码代理的兴起不会淘汰软件工程学科与工程师，反而使其不可或缺——LLM 的三个结构性属性（概率生成、领域不可知、语义无状态）造成任何训练都无法消除的结构性真空，只有把方法论、领域、设计与流程四类知识固化为持久工件才能填补，而软件工程师正是这些工件的方法论者、中介与守护者。
Motivation: AI 编码代理能力提升引发 SE 学科与软件工程师是否会被淘汰的疑问；若缺少软件工程基础，AI 辅助开发产出的是貌似合理、不可验证、最终不可信的软件。
Method: 论证式立场文章：先指出 LLM 的三个结构性属性（probabilistic generation、agnosticism、semantic statelessness）构成训练无法消除的结构性真空，再提出四个知识杠杆（methodological knowledge、domain knowledge、design choices、process choices），要求全部以持久工件形式固化。
Result: 全文为概念论证，无实验数字；核心命题是三个 LLM 结构性属性造成结构性真空，四类知识杠杆必须被固化为持久工件，且每一项都需要软件工程师承担方法论者、中介与守护者角色。
Conclusion: AI 编码代理越强，软件工程与软件工程师越关键：可信的 AI 辅助开发以被固化的软件工程知识为前提，而非其替代品。

papers.title: Masked Feature Encoding for Large-Scale Whole Slide Image Representation
papers.abstract_en: Whole slide image (WSI) analysis in computational pathology follows a multiple instance learning (MIL) pipeline where patch embeddings are extracted independently and aggregated for slide-level prediction, but within-slide variance from staining, scanner, and local texture can overwhelm the discriminative signal. We propose Masked Feature Encoding for Multiple Instance Learning (MFE-MIL), a feature-space masking framework that trains a lightweight MLP adapter jointly with a window-based masked reconstruction branch and a MIL classification head. The two objectives are complementary. Classification guides the adapter to suppress within-slide patch variance, while window-based masked reconstruction provides an auxiliary regularizer for the adapted features without using patch coordinates, coordinate graphs, or segmentation preprocessing. The raster patch-extraction order is used only as a weak implicit prior. At inference, the decoder is removed, leaving only the adapter and MIL head. Across CAMELYON16/17, PANDA, and TCGA-BRCA with four diverse encoders, MFE-MIL improves ACC/F1 for nearly all tested aggregator-encoder settings and AUC in most, outperforms coordinate-based spatial methods (CAMIL), and achieves higher AUC than 2DMamba on three of four datasets (UNI). On five TCGA survival cohorts it improves the average concordance index for every aggregator tested, its most consistent gain. Code is available at https://github.com/AtlasAnalyticsLab/MFE-MIL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MFE-MIL 在特征空间做掩码编码：用轻量 MLP adapter 同时训练窗口式掩码重建分支与 MIL 分类头，分类目标压低片内染色/扫描仪/纹理方差，重建分支作辅助正则，推理时只留 adapter 与 MIL 头。在 CAMELYON16/17、PANDA、TCGA-BRCA 上配合四种 encoder，几乎所有 aggregator-encoder 组合的 ACC/F1 提升、多数 AUC 提升，且优于坐标基方法 CAMIL。
Motivation: WSI 的 MIL 流程中 patch embedding 独立提取，片内染色、扫描仪与局部纹理带来的方差会淹没判别信号；现有空间方法又依赖 patch 坐标图或分割预处理。
Method: MFE-MIL：特征空间掩码框架，联合训练轻量 MLP adapter、基于窗口的掩码重建分支与 MIL 分类头；不使用 patch 坐标、坐标图或分割预处理，仅把 raster 提取顺序当作弱隐式先验；推理时移除 decoder。
Result: 在 CAMELYON16/17、PANDA、TCGA-BRCA 四个数据集、四种 encoder 上，几乎所有 aggregator-encoder 设置的 ACC/F1 提升，多数 AUC 提升；AUC 优于坐标基空间方法 CAMIL，并在四个数据集中的三个上高于 2DMamba（UNI encoder）。在五个 TCGA 生存队列上，对每个被测 aggregator 都提升平均 concordance index，这是其最一致的增益。
Conclusion: 不依赖坐标的特征空间掩码重建可作为 MIL 的通用正则，同时改善分类与生存预后预测，其中生存 C-index 的提升最稳定。

papers.title: Evaluating Sequence Assembly Strategies for Differentially Private Synthetic Time-Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Differentially private time-series generators commonly produce fixed-length synthetic windows, whereas downstream forecasting models often require long continuous training sequences. How these windows are assembled after generation can therefore alter the effective synthetic data presented to a forecaster, even when the trained generator remains unchanged. We study this post-generation sequence assembly process by systematically varying overlap rates and window-weighting schemes and evaluating the resulting sequences in terms of boundary continuity, statistical and temporal fidelity, and Train-on-Synthetic-Test-on-Real (TSTR) forecasting utility. Across four types of public datasets (ETTh1, ETTm1, Weather, and Appliances) and five forecasting models, the results reveal a clear forecaster-dependent assembly principle: downstream TSTR utility is jointly shaped by the forecaster, overlap rate, and window-weighting scheme, leading to distinct assembly preferences across forecasting models. Increased overlap generally improves boundary continuity, but improvements in continuity or individual fidelity diagnostics do not consistently reduce forecasting error, indicating that these diagnostics alone are insufficient for selecting assembly configurations. Complete five-forecaster assembly grids, together with matched Train-on-Real-Test-on-Real (TRTR) references, further characterize these regularities and quantify assembly-dependent utility relative to real-data training. We then validate the identified principles through additional analyses of robustness and generator variability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在差分隐私 (DP) 合成时间序列的生成后阶段，重叠率与窗口加权方案会改变送入预报器的等效训练序列，进而改变 TSTR 效用。在 ETTh1、ETTm1、Weather、Appliances 四类数据集与五个预报模型上，最优装配方式依预报器而异：提高重叠率通常改善边界连续性，但连续性或单项保真度指标的改善并不一致地降低预报误差。
Motivation: DP 时间序列生成器只产出定长合成窗口，而下游预报模型需要长连续训练序列；生成器不变时，窗口如何拼接本身就会改变呈现给预报器的数据，且现有连续性/保真度诊断不足以选出最优装配配置。
Method: 系统改变重叠率 (overlap rate) 与窗口加权方案 (window-weighting)，在生成后装配序列，并从边界连续性、统计与时序保真度、TSTR 预报效用三类指标评估；覆盖四个公开数据集 (ETTh1、ETTm1、Weather、Appliances) 与五个预报模型，给出完整的五预报器装配网格及配对的 TRTR 参照，并补充鲁棒性与生成器变异性分析。
Result: 下游 TSTR 效用由预报器、重叠率与窗口加权方案共同决定，不同预报模型呈现不同的装配偏好；提高重叠率一般改善边界连续性，但连续性或单项保真度的改善并不一致地降低预报误差；完整五预报器装配网格与匹配 TRTR 参照量化了装配相关效用相对真实数据训练的差距。
Conclusion: 装配配置的选择必须依下游预报器而定，且不能只靠连续性或保真度诊断来定，需结合 TSTR 效用与 TRTR 参照判断。

papers.title: Finite-Sample Approximation of Hessian-Guided Perturbed Wasserstein Gradient Flows
papers.abstract_en: Wasserstein gradient flow extends gradient descent to probability measures. Its Hessian-guided perturbed variant (PWGF) adds Gaussian perturbations to escape saddle points in nonconvex problems. We investigate when its approximation by finitely many interacting particles remains accurate over growing time horizons. Our analysis retains the curvature accumulated along the population-driven reference path: negative curvature can amplify approximation errors, while subsequent positive curvature can damp their influence. This captures favorable scenarios in which temporary instability is compatible with accurate tracking over growing horizons. Under regularity assumptions and a prescribed common perturbation schedule, we prove particle and objective-value tracking bounds on a high-probability event for reference paths satisfying explicit conditions on accumulated curvature. To handle state-dependent Gaussian jumps, we construct a population-first coupling that preserves the reference particles' conditional independence and reduces jump errors to covariance comparison. We verify the conditions in a variance-plus-cosine model, where curvature recovery yields a growing-horizon tracking guarantee. We also establish local attraction, transverse descent, and positive second variation in two regions of a regularized matrix-factorization model, motivating a positive-negative-positive curvature pattern.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究 Hessian 引导的扰动 Wasserstein 梯度流 (PWGF) 用有限个相互作用粒子近似时，误差能否在增长的时间 horizon 上保持可控。核心发现是：沿总体参考路径累积的曲率决定精度——负曲率会放大近似误差，随后的正曲率又能压制它，因此暂时不稳定与长期精确跟踪可以共存。
Motivation: Wasserstein 梯度流把梯度下降推广到概率测度上，PWGF 通过加入高斯扰动逃离非凸问题的鞍点；但有限粒子近似在时间 horizon 增长时是否仍准确，此前缺少基于累积曲率的判定条件。
Method: 在正则性假设与给定的公共扰动调度下，对满足累积曲率显式条件的参考路径证明粒子与目标值的高概率跟踪界；针对状态相关的高斯跳跃，构造 population-first coupling 保持参考粒子的条件独立性，把跳跃误差归结为协方差比较。
Result: 在 variance-plus-cosine 模型中验证曲率条件成立，得到增长 horizon 下的跟踪保证；在正则化矩阵分解模型的两个区域中建立局部吸引、横向下降与正二阶变分，支持正-负-正曲率模式的构造。
Conclusion: 有限粒子对 PWGF 的近似精度由参考路径累积曲率的符号结构决定：短暂的负曲率不稳定之后若出现正曲率，跟踪误差仍可在增长的时间 horizon 上被压制。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: RoBART: Bayesian Additive Regression Trees with Tree-Specific Rotations
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian additive regression trees (BART) can require many splits to approximate boundaries misaligned with the predictor axes. RoBART assigns each tree a rotation shared by all internal nodes, retaining axis-aligned splits in rotated coordinates and constant leaves. We jointly propose a Givens rotation sequence and cutpoints on the resulting grid by Metropolis-Hastings and establish reversibility with respect to the conditional posterior with leaf means integrated out. For additive functions with component-specific rotations and anisotropic Hölder smoothness, we prove posterior contraction in empirical $L_2$ distance and for the noise standard deviation. Under the stated prior, design, and grid conditions, with fixed numbers of predictors, trees, and components and no more components than trees, the rate is a sum of componentwise rates determined by smoothness and the number of rotated coordinates used. We also establish a posterior contraction lower bound showing that there exist functions for which RoBART adapts to the intrinsic dimension but axis-aligned BART does not.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RoBART 给 BART 的每棵树配一个全节点共享的旋转，在旋转坐标里仍做轴对齐分裂，用 Metropolis-Hastings 联合提议 Givens 旋转序列与网格切点，并证明叶均值积分掉后的条件后验可逆。对带分量各向异性 Hölder 光滑的可加函数证明经验 L2 与噪声标准差的后验收缩率，且给出下界：存在函数使 RoBART 自适应于内在维度而轴对齐 BART 不能。
Motivation: BART 用轴对齐分裂去逼近与坐标轴不平行的边界时需要大量分裂，代价高且对预测轴的取向敏感。
Method: 每棵树分配一个由所有内部节点共享的旋转，分裂在旋转坐标中保持轴对齐、叶为常数；用 Metropolis-Hastings 在旋转诱导的网格上联合提议 Givens 旋转序列与切点，并证明关于叶均值积分后的条件后验的可逆性。理论部分针对分量各向异性 Hölder 光滑的可加函数，在固定预测变量数、树数、分量数且分量数不超过树数的条件下推导收缩率。
Result: 在给定先验、设计与网格条件下，经验 L2 距离与噪声标准差的后验收缩率为各分量率之和，各分量率由光滑度与所用旋转坐标个数决定；并证明存在一类函数使 RoBART 自适应于内在维度而轴对齐 BART 不行（下界结果）。
Conclusion: 给每棵树加共享旋转能让 BART 以分量级收缩率逼近轴对齐表示低效的边界，并在内在维度上取得轴对齐 BART 达不到的自适应性。

papers.title: Edge Accuracy Is Not Enough: Why Dynamics-Learned Structure Fails to Transfer to Inverse Problems
papers.abstract_en: A natural strategy for inverse problems with scarce labelled data is to transfer relational structure learned from abundant forward-simulation data. We show this strategy fails systematically, even when it satisfies the standard theoretical justification for why structure should help. We prove that approximate structure provides estimation-error benefits whenever the edge error satisfies $Δ< n^2 - kn$, reducing sample complexity from $O(n^2)$ to $O(kn+Δ)$. Structure learned via Neural Relational Inference (NRI) from dynamics prediction satisfies this condition, yet on a source-localisation task across 180 CFD-simulated hydrogen-leak scenarios and 180 acoustic scenarios, it degrades performance by 116% and 201% relative to a flexible, task-optimised attention baseline, while a physics-based prior (Green's function) degrades by only 69-72%. Four independent lines of evidence show this is not a tuning failure: NRI improves only 0.5% when given 18x more training data (versus 16.6% for the task-optimised baseline, $p<0.001$); performance is insensitive to the NRI edge threshold across a wide range; the dynamics-learned graph overlaps the task-optimal graph on only 6% of edges; and two further dynamics-derived structure estimators (correlation- and mutual-information-based) show no measurable benefit over a structure-free baseline, with the correlation-based estimator performing markedly worse. We formalise this gap as a statement about approximation error that the edge-accuracy condition cannot control, and we provide a lightweight transferability test (Jaccard similarity against a partially-observed target-task graph) that separates successful from failed transfer in all four domain/structure pairs we evaluate, using under an hour of computation and 15-20% of target-domain data; we present this as a heuristic calibrated on few cases, not a validated general threshold.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 从动力学预测学到的关系结构迁移到逆问题会系统性失效：即使满足边误差 Δ < n² − kn 的样本复杂度条件（O(n²) 降到 O(kn+Δ)），NRI 结构在源定位任务上仍比任务优化 attention 基线差 116% 和 201%。作者提出基于 Jaccard 相似度的轻量可迁移性检验，在全部四组域/结构配对上区分成功与失败迁移。
Motivation: 标签稀缺时自然策略是从丰富的前向仿真数据迁移关系结构，但该策略即使满足理论正当性条件也系统性失败，需要解释边精度条件为何控制不了近似误差。
Method: 证明近似结构在 Δ < n² − kn 时带来估计误差收益（样本复杂度 O(n²) → O(kn+Δ)）；用 Neural Relational Inference (NRI) 从动力学预测学结构，在 180 个 CFD 氢气泄漏场景与 180 个声学场景的源定位任务上对比任务优化 attention 基线与 Green's function 物理先验；另用相关性与互信息两种结构估计器做四条独立证据线，并提出对部分观测目标图计算 Jaccard 相似度的可迁移性检验。
Result: NRI 结构相对 attention 基线性能下降 116%（CFD 氢泄漏）与 201%（声学），Green's function 先验仅下降 69–72%；NRI 增加 18 倍训练数据只提升 0.5%，任务优化基线提升 16.6%（p<0.001）；动力学学到的图与任务最优图仅 6% 边重叠；相关性与互信息估计器相对无结构基线无可测收益，相关性估计器明显更差；Jaccard 检验在全部四组域/结构配对上区分成功与失败迁移，耗时不到 1 小时、用 15–20% 目标域数据。
Conclusion: 边精度条件无法控制近似误差，动力学学到的结构不保证迁移到逆问题；Jaccard 检验是作者自述为在少量案例上校准的启发式，而非已验证的通用阈值。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: OrthoGen: A Generative Orthogonal Learner for Time-Varying Treatments
papers.abstract_en: Estimating conditional distributional potential outcomes (CDPOs) over time is important in medicine (e.g., to estimate patient-specific risks under different treatment sequences). However, this task is challenging because of time-varying confounding, yet existing adjustment strategies for this task are limited. In this paper, we aim to learn CDPOs under time-varying treatments using flexible generative models. Our contributions are two-fold. (1) We introduce a tailored adjustment strategy for our setting, namely, generative recursive g-computation. Our adjustment strategy recursively propagates full conditional outcome distributions rather than conditional means, modeling the variables of interest directly rather than full trajectories. Building on our adjustment strategy, we formulate simple generative learners for CDPO estimation. However, these learners can be sensitive to nuisance estimation errors, which motivates an orthogonal learner. (2) We thus introduce OrthoGen, a Neyman-orthogonal and doubly robust generative learner. Importantly, we show that OrthoGen further achieves rate double robustness and quasi-oracle efficiency under suitable conditions. Our learners are flexible and can be instantiated with different generative backbones (e.g., normalizing flows and diffusion models). Across experiments with synthetic, semi-synthetic and real-world datasets, we find that OrthoGen is highly effective. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to propose a generative orthogonal learner for estimating CDPOs under time-varying treatments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 OrthoGen：针对时变处理下条件分布潜在结果 (CDPO) 估计的 Neyman 正交、双重稳健生成式学习器，递归传播完整条件结果分布而非条件均值。理论上在适当条件下达到 rate double robustness 与 quasi-oracle efficiency，可用 normalizing flows 或 diffusion models 作骨干；在合成、半合成与真实数据实验中被报告为高度有效。
Motivation: 时变处理下估计 CDPO 受 time-varying confounding 制约，现有调整策略有限，且朴素生成学习器对 nuisance 估计误差敏感。
Method: 先提出 generative recursive g-computation：递归传播完整条件结果分布、直接建模目标变量而非整条轨迹，据此构造简单生成式 CDPO 学习器；再叠加 Neyman 正交化与双重稳健结构得到 OrthoGen，骨干可换用 normalizing flows 或 diffusion models。
Result: 理论上在适当条件下达到 rate double robustness 与 quasi-oracle efficiency；在合成、半合成与真实世界数据集的实验中，作者发现 OrthoGen highly effective。
Conclusion: 生成式正交学习器可作为时变处理下 CDPO 估计的首个此类方法，正交化正是为缓解 nuisance 误差敏感性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CARES: A Controlled Synthetic Benchmark of Speaker Reactions to Sound
papers.abstract_en: Automatic audio scene description turns a recording into a text account of a situation. One difficulty is deciding which elements of the audio should be kept, since a description cannot include them all. Annotators disagree about this, making a ground truth hard to obtain. In this work, we first define the ground truth, then generate the data. We focus on audio events and define sound salience with a simple rule: a sound is salient when a speaker audibly reacts to it. For scale and variety, a controlled set of scenarios fixes the ground truth, and a language model writes the dialogues. The resulting corpus, CARES, contains 10,000 two-speaker scenes. We then benchmark six audio-language models on three tasks: identifying the scene, tagging the sounds present, and classifying reactions. We show that these models hear the sounds but miss how the speakers react to them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CARES 用「说话人对声音有可听反应即该声音显著」这一规则先定义 ground truth，再由语言模型写对白、生成 10,000 个双人对话场景的受控合成语料，用于自动音频场景描述 (automatic audio scene description)。在场景识别、声音标注、反应分类三项任务上对六个 audio-language model 基准测试，结果显示这些模型能听到声音，却漏掉说话人对声音的反应。
Motivation: 自动音频场景描述要决定哪些声音该写进文本，标注者之间对取舍不一致，导致 ground truth 难以获得。
Method: 先以「说话人对某声音有可听反应则该声音显著 (sound salience)」的规则固定 ground truth，再用受控场景集合加语言模型生成对白，构造 CARES 语料；随后在场景识别、声音标注 (tagging)、反应分类三项任务上评测六个 audio-language model。
Result: CARES 含 10,000 个双人对话场景；六个 audio-language model 在三项任务上的表现显示它们能识别声音，但无法捕捉说话人对这些声音的反应。
Conclusion: 把显著性定义为说话人的可听反应，可以先固定 ground truth 再合成数据；现有 audio-language model 在声音识别与反应理解之间存在明显落差。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Computations of the slice genus and the unknotting number of links via machine learning
papers.abstract_en: Links are disjoint unions of circles smoothly embedded in $S^3$. We use reinforcement learning and Bayesian optimisation to obtain new upper bounds on several link invariants that are not known to be algorithmically computable: the slice genus and the unknotting number for links, and the strong slice genus for algebraically split links. We also compute lower bounds using known invariants. Combining the upper and lower bounds, we obtain new exact values in many cases. Our unknotting agents can reproduce the non-additivity of the unknotting number for several counterexamples due to Brittenham and Hermiller, in some cases finding new unknotting trajectories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用强化学习与贝叶斯优化搜索纽结/链环不变量的上界，配合已知不变量给出的下界夹逼，在许多情形下得到 slice genus、unknotting number 以及代数分裂链环的 strong slice genus 的新精确值；其 unknotting 智能体还复现了 Brittenham 与 Hermiller 反例中 unknotting number 的非可加性，并在部分情形找到新的 unknotting 轨迹。
Motivation: slice genus 与 unknotting number 等链环不变量不 known to be algorithmically computable，缺少通用算法，精确值长期依赖手工构造与不等式夹逼。
Method: 以强化学习 (reinforcement learning) 智能体搜索上界构造，配合贝叶斯优化 (Bayesian optimisation) 调参；下界由已知不变量计算，上下界合并给出精确值；unknotting 智能体输出具体 unknotting 轨迹。
Result: 在多个链环上得到新的上界与若干新精确值；unknotting 智能体复现了 Brittenham 与 Hermiller 给出的多个 unknotting number 非可加性反例，并在部分反例中找到新的 unknotting 轨迹。
Conclusion: 对不可算法计算的拓扑不变量，RL 加贝叶斯优化的搜索式上下界夹逼能产出新的精确值，且智能体可重建已知反例的非可加性结构。

papers.title: Three-dimensional Lagrangian ecosystems: carbon dynamics and potential for artificial fertilization
papers.abstract_en: Transient supplies of nutrients to the surface ocean, both natural and artificial, stimulate blooms of phytoplankton and the formation of organic matter, driving air-sea gradients and uptake of CO$_2$. However, quantifying the associated carbon budget remains challenging, as it requires tracking the coupled biophysical evolution of water masses while they are transported, stretched and diluted. Here, we present an idealized three-dimensional model that describes biomass production and carbon dynamics within a Lagrangian patch in the ocean. The framework reproduces observed biogeochemical patterns from an artificial fertilization experiment and provides integrated metrics for the local carbon budget. Utilizing large ensembles of simulations, we examine the sensitivity of patch-scale primary production and carbon uptake to biochemical and physical factors. Our results show that patch dilution can enhance the ecosystem response, and how carbon uptake is sensitive to initial injected area, horizontal divergence and vertical diffusivity. In the context of renewed interest in ocean fertilization strategies for climate mitigation, our approach can thus provide quantitative tools to assess their efficacy and potential.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个三维拉格朗日斑块模型，追踪受营养盐补给的水团在输送、拉伸与稀释过程中的生物量生产与碳吸收。大集合模拟显示斑块稀释反而增强生态系统响应，碳吸收对初始注入面积、水平散度与垂直扩散系数敏感；该框架可复现人工施肥实验观测到的生物地球化学格局并给出局地碳收支积分指标。
Motivation: 自然或人工营养盐补给会引发浮游植物水华并驱动海气梯度与 CO2 吸收，但量化碳收支需要同时追踪被输送、拉伸、稀释的水团的生物物理耦合演化，这一直难以做到。
Method: 构建理想化三维模型，描述海洋拉格朗日斑块内的生物量生产与碳动力学；用大集合模拟考察斑块尺度初级生产与碳吸收对生化和物理因子的敏感性，并以人工施肥实验的观测生物地球化学格局检验框架。
Result: 框架复现了人工施肥实验观测到的生物地球化学格局，并给出局地碳收支的积分指标；集合模拟表明斑块稀释可增强生态系统响应，碳吸收对初始注入面积、水平散度和垂直扩散敏感。
Conclusion: 拉格朗日斑块框架可作为评估海洋施肥策略效能与潜力的定量工具，其核心判断是稀释过程本身会放大生态系统响应。

papers.title: How to train your model organism
papers.abstract_en: Model organisms of alignment-relevant behaviors (e.g., backdoors, sycophancy, spurious correlations) have emerged as a key tool for evaluating whitebox interpretability techniques. We argue that the prevailing practice of training model organisms to a single objective of installing the target behavior is insufficient and propose validating model organisms with respect to three objectives with associated metrics: target-behavior installation, general-capability preservation (i.e., parametric knowledge, chat quality), and output naturalness (i.e., CoT and activations). We re-visit two publicly released organism suites using this validation framework and show that (1) chat quality and CoT naturalness degrade substantially across training recipes, and (2) validation metrics predict how well interpretability methods recover the installed behavior, e.g., a logit lens readout covaries with an organism's general capabilities. We introduce a multi-objective training approach based on model merging to train more realistic model organisms. Finally, on a new suite of model organisms targeting demographic biases in clinical reasoning, we compare training recipes and find that DPO training stays closer to the base model than supervised finetuning, and the proposed model optimization approach better preserves capabilities and naturalness. Auditing this suite with an investigator agent, we again observe validation metrics tracking bias recovery. In sum, training methods shape the interpretability conclusions an organism supports, and we argue that one should consider multiple objectives to draw generalizable conclusions about interpretability methods using (realistic) model organisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对齐研究用的「模型生物」(model organism) 惯例只按单一目标训练（装入后门、谄媚、虚假相关等目标行为），本文主张改用三目标验证框架：目标行为装入度、通用能力保持（参数化知识、chat 质量）、输出自然度（CoT 与激活）。重访两个公开 organism 套件后发现 chat 质量与 CoT 自然度在各训练配方下普遍明显退化，且验证指标能预测白盒可解释性方法能否恢复被装入的行为（如 logit lens 读出与通用能力共变）。
Motivation: 白盒可解释性技术依赖 model organism 作为受控测试对象，但现行做法只保证目标行为被装入，不保证 organism 仍像真实模型，导致可解释性结论可能只反映训练配方而非方法本身。
Method: 提出三目标验证框架（行为装入度、通用能力保持、输出自然度），用它重访两个公开发布的 organism 套件；再提出基于 model merging 的多目标训练方法，并在一个针对临床推理中人口统计学偏见的新 organism 套件上比较训练配方（DPO vs 监督微调），最后用 investigator agent 审计该套件。
Result: 发现 (1) chat 质量与 CoT 自然度在各训练配方下普遍明显退化；(2) 验证指标可预测可解释性方法恢复被装入行为的程度，logit lens 读出与 organism 的通用能力共变。新偏见套件上，DPO 比监督微调更贴近基座模型，所提多目标优化在能力与自然度保持上更好；审计时验证指标同样跟踪偏见恢复。
Conclusion: 训练方法会塑造 organism 支撑的可解释性结论，因此评估可解释性方法时必须同时优化多个目标，才能得到可推广的结论。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GAGR-Lab: Evaluating Joint Spatial-Geometric and Analytic Function Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Joint spatial-geometric and analytic function reasoning requires translating a perceived spatial configuration into a symbolic function whose executed curve satisfies geometric constraints. We present GAGR-Lab, a framework for measuring this capability through Cartesian game scenes, explicit function semantics, and authoritative Rust trajectory execution. It distinguishes spatial perception, metric grounding, geometric relations, function interpretation, function construction, and constrained synthesis. We specify four configurable scene-difficulty presets and a prospective 24-cell diagnostic design, while reporting only the subset actually evaluated. A bounded pilot of one hosted model (Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct) using two API credentials as execution replicas yields 72 balanced games with 432 attempts, 429 valid provider responses, and no target hits; exploratory ordinary-function prompt variants also fail to hit, while the structured localization interface yields no scoreable outputs. A privileged analytic search control independently succeeds on 600 directional cases from 300 generated scenes, with exact repeatability and 1,200 successful vertical-reflection or translation checks. The framework separates serving reliability, symbolic compliance, and geometric success, and preserves exact model-visible inputs and realized paths. A staged protocol outlines diagnostic calibration, held-out replication, multi-model comparison, and paired robustness tests. The contribution is an operational research framework with an executed pilot and a clearly identified prospective study plan; the full difficulty matrix and comparative model results remain untested.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GAGR-Lab 是一个评测「空间-几何构型 → 符号函数 → 执行曲线满足几何约束」能力的框架，用 Cartesian 游戏场景、显式函数语义与 Rust 权威轨迹执行，把空间感知、度量锚定、几何关系、函数解释、函数构造与约束综合分开度量。试点中 Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct 在 72 局、432 次尝试（429 次有效响应）下零命中，而特权解析搜索控制在 300 个生成场景的 600 个方向案例上全部成功且可精确复现。
Motivation: 把感知到的空间配置翻译成满足几何约束的符号函数这一能力缺少可操作的分项诊断手段，无法区分失败发生在感知、度量锚定还是函数构造环节。
Method: 框架由 Cartesian 游戏场景、显式函数语义与权威 Rust 轨迹执行构成，区分六个能力维度；预设四种场景难度与 24-cell 诊断设计，只报告实际评测的子集；试点用两个 API 凭据作为执行副本跑 Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct，并保留模型可见输入与实际执行路径，另设特权解析搜索控制。
Result: 试点 72 局平衡游戏、432 次尝试、429 次有效提供方响应，目标命中为 0；探索性普通函数 prompt 变体同样零命中，结构化定位接口无可评分输出。特权解析搜索控制在 300 个生成场景的 600 个方向案例上独立成功，精确可复现，并完成 1200 次垂直反射或平移校验。
Conclusion: 该贡献是一个带已执行试点与明确前瞻研究计划的操作性研究框架，完整难度矩阵与多模型对比结果尚未测试；框架把服务可靠性、符号合规与几何成功三者分离开来度量。
Relevance: 0
