papers.title: Robust Decentralized Fairness Auditing
papers.abstract_en: Emerging legislation requires large language models (LLMs) to be audited for compliance with regulatory standards, particularly fairness. Such black-box audits typically assume a single auditor with access to a large, representative set of queries. In practice, it can be difficult for an auditor to obtain such a query set, but multiple auditors can together cover the relevant demographic groups by auditing the LLM collaboratively with their individual query sets. However, relying on multiple auditors raises a fundamental trust problem, as they may act on behalf of the LLM provider to portray a misleading appearance of fairness, i.e., fairwashing. We propose Auditopus, a novel approach for robust decentralized fairness auditing. In Auditopus, auditing proceeds in rounds without a central server. In each round, every auditor issues a fixed number of queries to the LLM, and sends only cumulative statistics vectors of its query results to other auditors instead of sensitive queries in clear. The fairness of the audited LLM is then estimated by aggregating all the vectors. We show theoretically and empirically that even a single adversarial auditor in the network can steer this estimate by fabricating the vectors it sends, making an unfair LLM appear fair. To address this threat, Auditopus has each honest auditor locally down-weight any auditor whose cumulative statistics vectors are statistically inconsistent with previous ones. We implement Auditopus and compare it to robust aggregation baselines on two datasets with two pre-trained LLMs. Against an attacker that optimizes the vectors it sends to make the LLM appear fair, Auditopus reduces audit error by up to 78% on average relative to no defense and at least 62% relative to the robust aggregation baselines. Even when 49% of the auditors are adversarial, Auditopus never lets a very unfair or moderately unfair LLM pass as fair.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Auditopus 把 LLM 公平性审计改成无中心服务器的多审计方协作：每轮各方只交换累计统计向量而非原始查询，并在本地对与历史不一致的向量降权。面对会伪造向量的对抗审计方，其审计误差相对无防御平均降低最多 78%，相对鲁棒聚合基线至少降低 62%；即使 49% 审计方为对抗方，也很不公平或中等不公平的 LLM 不会被判为公平。
Motivation: 监管要求对 LLM 做公平性黑盒审计，但单个审计方难以拿到覆盖各人口群体的代表性查询集；多方协作又引入信任问题，任一审计方可能替 LLM 提供方伪造结果，制造 fairwashing 假象。
Method: Auditopus 以轮次制、无中心服务器运行：每轮每个审计方对 LLM 发固定数量查询，只把查询结果的累计统计向量发给其他审计方，再聚合全部向量估计公平性；对与自身历史统计不一致的向量在本地降权，以抵御伪造。实现后与鲁棒聚合基线在两个数据集、两个预训练 LLM 上对比。
Result: 在攻击者专门优化所发向量以让 LLM 显得公平的设定下，Auditopus 相对无防御平均降低审计误差最多 78%，相对鲁棒聚合基线至少降低 62%；即使 49% 的审计方是对抗方，也从未让很不公平或中等不公平的 LLM 通过为公平。理论上与实证均显示单个对抗审计方即可通过伪造向量操纵估计。
Conclusion: 仅靠聚合各审计方的统计向量不足以防 fairwashing，必须让每个诚实审计方按统计一致性本地降权异常参与者；该机制在近半数参与方为敌手时仍能守住判定。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: VolCo: Volumetric Contact for High-Fidelity Human Grasp Generation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate contact modeling is fundamental to understanding hand-object interaction, yet existing contact representations are typically restricted to object surfaces and rely on hand-crafted rules to recover contact details, leading to severe penetrations and implausible results. To better exploit the rich detail in motion-capture data, we introduce Volumetric Contact (VolCo), a representation that expands surface points to a set of 3D volumetric grids. VolCo encodes 3D contact that allows precise hand part recovery, and is organized in an inherent hierarchy: local contact details within each volume and global hand geometry across all volumes. Our framework, VolCoDiff, employs two modules to capture local and global features following this hierarchy. For local contact details, we use a 3D variational autoencoder to model the possible hand configurations conditioned on the local object signed distance field (SDF). For global hand geometry, we design a prior-guided diffusion model that learns the distribution of compressed latent features aggregated from the volumetric grids. We evaluate our method on two benchmark datasets and demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in penetration and stability, indicating the capability to generate tight grasps with much less severe penetrations. Our code is available at https://github.com/chzh9311/volco.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VolCo 把只在物体表面定义的接触表示扩展为一组 3D 体素网格 (volumetric grids)，并按层级编码局部接触细节与全局手部几何；VolCoDiff 用条件 3D VAE 建局部手型、用先验引导扩散建全局潜特征，在两个基准数据集上取得 SOTA 的穿透与稳定性表现，生成更贴合且穿透显著减轻的抓取。
Motivation: 现有接触表示局限于物体表面并依赖手工规则恢复接触细节，导致严重穿透与不合理结果，难以充分利用动捕数据中的丰富细节。
Method: VolCo 将表面点扩展为 3D 体素网格集合，层级化组织局部接触与全局手几何；VolCoDiff 含两模块——局部用 3D 变分自编码器 (3D VAE) 在局部物体 SDF 条件下建模手部构型，全局用先验引导扩散模型学习由各体素网格聚合的压缩潜特征分布。
Result: 在两个 benchmark 数据集上达到 state-of-the-art 的穿透 (penetration) 与稳定性 (stability) 表现，生成更紧密的抓取且穿透严重程度大幅降低。
Conclusion: 把接触从表面提升为带层级的体积分量表示，配合局部条件生成与全局先验扩散，能同时改善生成抓取的贴合度与物理合理性。

papers.title: HuLiGen: Human LiDAR Generation from Parametric Body Models
papers.abstract_en: LiDAR point clouds of humans are extremely expensive to collect and annotate, thus represent a scarce resource that hinders the development of human analysis using this modality. To alleviate this scarcity, prior work relies on simulated human LiDAR, but such samples do not fully reflect the geometry and sensing characteristics of real observations. In contrast, we introduce HuLiGen, a generative model that generates human LiDAR point clouds from a parametric body model, using a point transformer trained with a flow-matching objective. We show that our generated point clouds are closer to the real capture distribution. Using HuLiGen to generate synthetic data, we propose a synthetic-only pretraining scheme for LiDAR-based HPE that achieves state-of-the-art performance, with even larger gains in low-annotation and low-data regimes, where MPJPE is reduced by up to 50%. Code, models and generated samples are available at https://github.com/valeoai/HuLiGen.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HuLiGen 用 point transformer 加 flow-matching 目标，从参数化人体模型 (parametric body model) 生成人体 LiDAR 点云，生成分布比既有仿真样本更接近真实采集分布。用其合成数据做 LiDAR 人体姿态估计 (HPE) 的纯合成预训练达到 state-of-the-art，低标注、低数据 regime 下 MPJPE 最多降低 50%。
Motivation: 真实人体 LiDAR 点云采集与标注成本极高、数据稀缺，而既有仿真样本在几何与传感特性上不能真实反映真实观测，制约了该模态的人体分析。
Method: 提出生成模型 HuLiGen：以参数化人体模型为条件，用 point transformer 以 flow-matching 目标训练，生成人体 LiDAR 点云；再以生成样本做 LiDAR HPE 的 synthetic-only 预训练方案。
Result: 生成点云更接近真实采集分布；纯合成预训练的 LiDAR HPE 达到 state-of-the-art，MPJPE 在低标注与低数据 regime 下最多降低 50%。
Conclusion: 参数化人体模型驱动的生成式 LiDAR 合成数据可替代稀缺真实采集用于预训练，且在数据与标注受限时收益最大。

papers.title: Broadly Applicable Approximate MCMC for Switching Stochastic Differential Equations Using Uniformization and Time-Conditioned Factorized Neural Likelihood Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Switching stochastic differential equations (SSDEs) describe continuous-time dynamics whose parameters switch according to a latent regime process that follows a continuous-time Markov chain (CTMC). By allowing dynamics to change between regimes, SSDEs represent heterogeneous system behavior and have been applied across diverse fields. However, Bayesian inference for SSDEs remains difficult, and existing SSDE inference methods have limited applicability, with restrictions such as noise-free observations, univariate states, linear drift, or state-independent diffusion. In this study, we propose an approximate Markov chain Monte Carlo sampler for SSDEs using uniformization and factorized neural likelihood estimation (FNLE), a simulation-based inference method. Uniformization provides an exact representation of the CTMC but requires SDE transition densities over arbitrary time intervals. We approximate these densities by training a time-conditioned FNLE model. The resulting sampler is broadly applicable to SSDEs without requiring analytically tractable transition densities. In synthetic-data experiments, our method recovered regime paths and parameters for three SSDE models for which previous methods have limited applicability. We also applied our method to a real dataset and detected a regime transition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于 uniformization 与 time-conditioned factorized neural likelihood estimation (FNLE) 的近似 MCMC 采样器，用于切换随机微分方程 (SSDE) 的贝叶斯推断：uniformization 精确表示 CTMC，但需要任意时间间隔上的 SDE 转移密度，作者用时间条件化的 FNLE 神经似然近似这些密度。合成数据上恢复了三种此前方法适用受限的 SSDE 模型的 regime 路径与参数，并在真实数据上检测到一次 regime 转变。
Motivation: SSDE 的贝叶斯推断困难，现有方法受限于无噪声观测、单变量状态、线性漂移或状态无关扩散等假设，适用范围窄。
Method: 用 uniformization 精确表示 latent regime 的连续时间 Markov 链 (CTMC)，其所需的任意时间间隔 SDE 转移密度由 simulation-based inference 中的 factorized neural likelihood estimation (FNLE) 近似，训练时加入时间条件 (time-conditioned)，整体构成近似 MCMC 采样器，不依赖解析可得的转移密度。
Result: 在合成数据实验中，对三种此前方法适用受限的 SSDE 模型恢复了 regime 路径与参数；并在一个真实数据集上检测到 regime 转变。
Conclusion: 把 uniformization 的精确 CTMC 表示与神经似然近似的 SDE 转移密度结合，可让 SSDE 贝叶斯推断摆脱对解析转移密度和既有简化假设的依赖，适用于更广一类 SSDE。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Universal Local Error and Realized Amplification for the First-Order EDM Predictor
papers.abstract_en: We analyze the first-order deterministic diffusion sampler of Karras et al. (2022), termed EDM, in 2-Wasserstein distance by separating two sources of error: local discretization error and its amplification by subsequent learned steps. We prove that local error admits a universal bound: for any data distribution with finite second moment, the one-step discretization error is quadratic in the step size, with an explicit constant that does not depend on the data distribution. Error propagation, in contrast, depends on the learned network. At high noise levels, we exploit the network parametrization of EDM to derive an explicit contraction criterion. At low noise levels, we measure propagation through the amplification realized on the distributions transported by the sampler; this realized amplification can be arbitrarily smaller than the worst-case Lipschitz constant. This analysis yields an $O(e^{Λ_K}/K)$ global discretization error for $K$ sampling steps, where $Λ_K$ is the low-noise log-amplification. Experiments on a one-dimensional Gaussian mixture show how measured amplification accounts for slower error decay on finite sampling grids. Diagnostics on a pretrained CIFAR-10 model illustrate related stability mechanisms without certifying the global assumptions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 Karras et al. (2022) 的一阶确定性扩散采样器 EDM 在 2-Wasserstein 距离下做误差分解：局部离散化误差对步长是二阶的且常数与数据分布无关，误差传播则由学到的网络决定。高噪声段由 EDM 参数化导出显式收缩判据，低噪声段用采样器所传输分布上的实现放大 (realized amplification) 度量，可远小于最坏 Lipschitz 常数，由此得到 K 步全局误差 O(e^{Λ_K}/K)。
Motivation: 确定性扩散采样器的离散化误差与网络误差传播耦合在一起，最坏情形 Lipschitz 界过于保守，无法解释有限步数下误差衰减变慢的现象。
Method: 在 2-Wasserstein 距离下把误差拆成局部离散化误差与其被后续学习步的放大两部分；高噪声段利用 EDM 的网络参数化给出显式收缩判据，低噪声段改用采样器所传输分布上的实现放大来度量传播，合成 K 步全局离散化误差界。
Result: 证明对任意有限二阶矩数据分布，一步离散化误差关于步长为二次，且显式常数不依赖数据分布；全局误差为 O(e^{Λ_K}/K)，其中 Λ_K 为低噪声对数放大。一维 Gaussian mixture 实验显示实测放大解释了有限采样网格上误差衰减变慢；在预训练 CIFAR-10 模型上给出诊断以说明相关稳定性机制。
Conclusion: 局部离散化误差可给出分布无关的普适二次界，而误差传播必须由网络本身刻画；用实现放大替代最坏 Lipschitz 常数才能得到紧的 K 步全局误差，CIFAR-10 上的诊断并不认证全局假设。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Kinetic Langevin Meets Split Gibbs: Accelerated Posterior Sampling for Imaging Inverse Problems with Diffusion Priors
papers.abstract_en: Split Gibbs sampling (SGS) is a popular framework for posterior sampling in Bayesian imaging inverse problems. It decouples a Gaussian data-fidelity term from a complex prior through an auxiliary variable, so the data variable is updated exactly and only the prior-side conditional is hard to sample. Existing samplers treat this conditional in one of two ways. Plug-and-play SGS runs a multi-step diffusion denoiser at every iteration, which is expensive and lacks non-asymptotic guarantees. Langevin-within-SGS takes cheap overdamped Langevin steps but needs many iterations. We propose RED-KLwSGS, which keeps the exact Gaussian update for the data variable and updates the auxiliary variable with underdamped (kinetic) Langevin diffusions driven by a one-shot denoising score, at the same per-iteration cost as Langevin-within-SGS. We prove non-asymptotic Wasserstein-2 convergence in continuous and discrete time for strongly log-concave priors. We also introduce Joint-RED-KLwSGS, which applies kinetic Langevin diffusions to both variables. Experiments with Denoising diffusion probabilistic models as diffusion priors on FFHQ and ImageNet datasets show faster convergence and high-quality image reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Bayesian 成像逆问题的 Split Gibbs sampling (SGS) 中，用 underdamped (kinetic) Langevin 扩散加 one-shot denoising score 更新辅助变量，替代每步多步 diffusion denoiser 或 overdamped Langevin。在强 log-concave 先验下证明连续与离散时间的非渐近 Wasserstein-2 收敛，且每步代价与 Langevin-within-SGS 相同；FFHQ 与 ImageNet 上以 DDPM 为先验的实验显示收敛更快、重建质量高。
Motivation: SGS 把 Gaussian 数据项与复杂先验解耦后，只剩先验侧条件分布难采样：Plug-and-Play SGS 每步跑多步 diffusion denoiser，代价高且无非渐近保证；Langevin-within-SGS 便宜但需要大量迭代。
Method: RED-KLwSGS 保留数据变量的精确 Gaussian 更新，辅助变量改用 underdamped (kinetic) Langevin 扩散，由 one-shot denoising score 驱动，每步代价与 Langevin-within-SGS 相同；另提出 Joint-RED-KLwSGS，对两个变量都施加 kinetic Langevin 扩散。收敛性在强 log-concave 先验下证明。
Result: 在强 log-concave 先验下给出连续时间与离散时间的非渐近 Wasserstein-2 收敛证明；以 Denoising diffusion probabilistic models (DDPM) 作为 diffusion prior，在 FFHQ 与 ImageNet 数据集上的实验显示收敛更快与高质量图像重建。
Conclusion: kinetic Langevin 能在与 overdamped Langevin 相同的每步成本下加速 SGS 后验采样，并补上非渐近收敛保证；Joint 变体把该扩散同时用于两个变量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Pre-training of Bayesian Optimization Algorithm through Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian optimization (BO) is widely used as a standard approach for expensive black-box optimization. However, BO algorithms often involve parameters that must be specified in advance, and their performance can strongly depend on these choices. We propose a framework for optimizing such parameters using sample paths drawn from a Gaussian process (GP) inferred from the information available at the start of BO. We use cumulative regret as the performance metric for a BO algorithm. By running the BO algorithm on the generated sample paths, we obtain an empirical estimate of its expected cumulative regret for a given parameter configuration. Optimizing this estimate allows us to identify parameter configurations that, given the currently available information, are expected to achieve low cumulative regret. Since this parameter optimization is itself a black-box optimization problem, we employ another BO procedure to solve it, which we refer to as outer BO. Through experiments, we demonstrate that the proposed framework can effectively select parameter configurations that achieve strong performance among a range of candidate configurations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用外层 Bayesian optimization (outer BO) 来自动选择内层 BO 算法超参数的框架：从 BO 开始时已有的信息推断 Gaussian process，采样样本路径，在其上运行 BO 算法并以累积遗憾 (cumulative regret) 为指标估计期望累积遗憾，再用另一层 BO 优化该估计选出参数配置。实验表明该框架能在候选配置范围内有效选出表现强的参数配置。
Motivation: BO 算法的性能强烈依赖事先指定的超参数，而这些参数通常只能靠人工经验设定，缺少基于当前可用信息的自动选择方式。
Method: 用 BO 起始时刻可得的信息推断 GP 并抽取样本路径；在生成路径上运行 BO 算法，得到给定参数配置的期望累积遗憾的经验估计；由于参数优化本身是黑箱问题，再用一层 BO（outer BO）求解该估计的最小化。
Result: 实验显示该框架能在一系列候选参数配置中有效选出性能强的配置；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: BO 超参数选择本身可以当作黑箱优化问题，用基于 GP 样本路径的累积遗憾估计加外层 BO 来自动求解。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Agentic AI-Assisted Modeling for Production Scheduling: Assessment in Constraint Programming
papers.abstract_en: Developing optimization models for production scheduling requires substantial expert effort. Research on large language models (LLMs) has followed two directions: specialized approaches for automated modeling, mostly for mixed-integer linear programming, which often rely on dedicated training or problem-specific architectures that limit industrial deployment; and agentic artificial intelligence for operational decision support, which generally assumes that the optimization model already exists. This study bridges both directions by assessing whether general-purpose LLMs, orchestrated as agents without task-specific training, can formulate and implement constraint programming models from natural-language problem descriptions. Singleagent and multi-agent architectures are integrated with a Model Context Protocol server that provides context-aware retrieval of solver documentation to mitigate hallucinations during implementation. Both are compared with a direct LLM baseline on six industry-oriented problems covering flow-shop, job-shop, flexible job-shop and resource-constrained warehouse scheduling, using three LLMs and assessing modeling accuracy, execution success, latency and token consumption. Formulation proves largely within reach of current LLMs, whereas implementation is the main barrier. The multi-agent workflow raises the share of scripts that run correctly as generated from 14.8% with a direct LLM call to 59.3%, reaching 80.6% on the four less complex problems, while tightly coupled intralogistics models remain an open challenge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用无任务训练的通用 LLM agent 从自然语言描述直接构建约束规划 (CP) 排产模型，接入提供求解器文档检索的 Model Context Protocol (MCP) server 以抑制实现阶段的幻觉。在六个工业排产问题、三种 LLM 上，多 agent 工作流把一次性可运行脚本比例从直接调用的 14.8% 提到 59.3%，四个较简单问题达 80.6%，说明建模表述基本可行、实现仍是主要瓶颈。
Motivation: 排产优化建模依赖稀缺的专家投入；现有 LLM 自动建模多针对 MILP 且需专门训练或问题专用架构，而面向运营的 agentic AI 又默认优化模型已存在，两条路线之间缺少衔接。
Method: 对比单 agent 与多 agent 架构，二者均接入 Model Context Protocol server 按上下文检索求解器文档；与直接 LLM 调用基线比较，覆盖 flow-shop、job-shop、flexible job-shop 与资源受限仓库调度六类问题，用三种 LLM，评估建模准确性、执行成功率、延迟与 token 消耗。
Result: 多 agent 工作流使按原样可正确运行的脚本占比从直接 LLM 调用的 14.8% 升至 59.3%，在四个较简单问题上达 80.6%；建模表述基本在当前 LLM 能力范围内，实现是主要障碍，紧密耦合的内物流 (intralogistics) 模型仍未解决。
Conclusion: 无需任务训练的 agent 化 LLM 已能完成 CP 模型的表述，但工业部署的瓶颈在实现环节；紧密耦合的排产模型是当前方法的明确短板。

papers.title: VideoEvolve: Co-Evolving Memory and Retrieval for Long Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Long video understanding increasingly relies on external memory to organize massive visual streams into compact representations. However, most memory-based methods dynamically adapt how information is retrieved for different questions, while largely fixing what is remembered. This mismatch makes missing details costly to recover, whereas stored information is valuable only when it can be reliably retrieved. To address this issue, we propose VideoEvolve, a novel self-evolving framework that jointly evolves memory and retrieval for long video understanding. Specifically, starting from a coarse low-frame-rate overview, VideoEvolve couples a Memory Evolver for selective memory augmentation with a Retrieval Evolver for adaptive retrieval over the evolving memory. We then co-evolve the two Evolvers through alternating agentic reinforcement learning (Agentic RL), updating one while freezing the other. To steer this alternating evolution, Bottleneck-Aware Evolution Feedback (BEF) identifies whether the current bottleneck lies in memory or retrieval and directs optimization toward the more limiting side. Furthermore, VideoEvolve introduces Capability-Aware Evolution Feedback (CEF) to alleviate downstream feedback from over-specializing memory to a fixed set of training questions, shifting training toward underdeveloped yet learnable video capabilities. By integrating Agentic RL with BEF and CEF, VideoEvolve transforms downstream reasoning experience into transferable capability updates, providing a concrete path from static long-video systems toward experience-driven, self-improving multimodal intelligence. Extensive experiments on multiple long video understanding benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of VideoEvolve.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VideoEvolve 针对长视频理解中「怎么检索在变、记什么不变」的错配，用交替式 agentic RL 同时演化记忆与检索：Memory Evolver 做选择性记忆增补，Retrieval Evolver 做自适应检索，BEF 判断当前瓶颈在记忆还是检索并把优化导向更受限的一侧，CEF 防止记忆对固定训练问题过拟合。作者在多个长视频理解基准上验证了该框架的有效性。
Motivation: 基于外部记忆的长视频方法大多动态调整检索方式却固定记忆内容，导致漏记的细节代价高昂，而存下的信息只有能被可靠检索才有价值。
Method: 从低帧率粗略概览出发，Memory Evolver 负责选择性记忆增补，Retrieval Evolver 在演化中的记忆上做自适应检索；两者通过交替 agentic 强化学习共同演化，每次更新一个并冻结另一个。Bottleneck-Aware Evolution Feedback (BEF) 判定瓶颈在记忆还是检索并引导优化，Capability-Aware Evolution Feedback (CEF) 缓解记忆对固定训练问题集的过拟合，把训练转向欠发展但可学习的视频能力。
Result: 在多个长视频理解基准上的实验展示了该框架的有效性（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把下游推理经验通过 agentic RL 与 BEF/CEF 转化为可迁移的能力更新，是从静态长视频系统走向经验驱动、自我改进多模态智能的具体路径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: EEG and Eye-Tracking Evidence That AI Disclosure Shapes Face Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: AI-generated faces can be difficult to distinguish from real ones, leaving viewers to rely on source labels when judging an image. Yet prior work has made it difficult to separate the effects of what an image actually is from what viewers are told it is. We validated faces as AI-generated or human in an online study (N=169), then crossed actual source (AI, human) with label (none, Made with AI, Made by a human) in a lab study $N=30), recording event-related potentials (ERPs) and gaze. ERP responses were equivalent for AI-generated and real faces, but varied with the label: labels drew early attention (N2), while labels that conflicted with the face's actual source prompted re-evaluation of the face (P3). Affective processing and initial gaze orienting were unchanged, but labels altered visual exploration. We provide a validated stimulus set and evidence that attributed origin shapes face processing, with implications for disclosure design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把人脸的真实来源（AI/人类）与标签（无标签、Made with AI、Made by a human）正交交叉，发现 ERP 对真实来源等价、却随标签变化：标签在早期吸引注意（N2），标签与真实来源冲突时触发对人脸的再评估（P3）。结论是被归因的来源而非图像本身塑造人脸加工，AI 披露标签的设计会直接改变观看者的认知处理。
Motivation: AI 生成人脸已难以与真人脸区分，观看者转而依赖来源标签做判断；但既有研究无法把图像实际是什么与被告知是什么的效应分开。
Method: 先在线研究 (N=169) 验证人脸作为 AI 生成或人类来源的刺激集，再在实验室研究 (N=30) 中把真实来源 (AI, human) 与标签 (none, Made with AI, Made by a human) 交叉，记录事件相关电位 (ERP) 与眼动注视。
Result: ERP 对 AI 生成与真人脸等价，但随标签变化：标签在早期吸引注意（N2），与真实来源冲突的标签引发对人脸的再评估（P3）；情感加工与初始注视定向不变，标签改变了视觉探索。
Conclusion: 被归因的来源（attributed origin）而非图像实际来源塑造人脸加工，因此 AI 披露标签的设计会实质影响观看者的处理过程；论文同时提供一套经过验证的刺激集。

papers.title: Argos: Adapt Rich Geometric Priors for Generalizable Online Scene-Change-Detection
papers.abstract_en: Robots operating in dynamic environments require reliable detection of how their surroundings change over time. Existing learning-based methods largely rely on pairwise 2D image features, which struggle under large viewpoint changes and occlusions, are sensitive to noise, and show limited generalization across domains, while explicit 3D approaches typically require costly offline optimization. We show that the implicit 3D knowledge of Geometric Foundation Models (GFMs) provides a strong basis for addressing these limitations. We introduce Argos, which adapts GFM features for joint scene change detection and 3D reconstruction. To address data scarcity and take a step toward a foundation model for scene change detection, we introduce a large-scale benchmark comprising two synthetic datasets and one real-world dataset, and train jointly across diverse datasets to improve cross-domain generalization. We further introduce Argos-SLAM, a real-time system designed for robotics, which performs online change detection and change-aware 4D mapping. Across benchmarks, our framework substantially outperforms existing baselines, with gains of up to 42.01% in change IoU and 27.91% in F1, while supporting scalable deployment in changing real-world environments.
papers.comment: More details on the project website: https://www.multyxu.com/argos/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Argos 把几何基础模型 (Geometric Foundation Model, GFM) 的隐式 3D 特征适配到联合场景变化检测与 3D 重建，并配套发布含两个合成集与一个真实集的大规模基准，跨数据集联合训练以提升跨域泛化。其 Argos-SLAM 实时系统在线做变化检测与 change-aware 4D 建图，在各基准上较现有基线最高提升 42.01% change IoU 与 27.91% F1。
Motivation: 现有学习式变化检测依赖成对 2D 图像特征，在大视角变化与遮挡下失效、对噪声敏感且跨域泛化有限；显式 3D 方法又需要昂贵的离线优化，机器人在动态环境中缺少可靠的在线变化感知手段。
Method: 适配 GFM 特征做场景变化检测与 3D 重建的联合估计；引入由两个合成数据集和一个真实数据集组成的大规模变化检测基准，并在多样数据集上联合训练以改善跨域泛化；另提出面向机器人的实时系统 Argos-SLAM，执行在线变化检测与 change-aware 4D 建图。
Result: 在各基准上相对现有基线最高取得 42.01% 的 change IoU 增益与 27.91% 的 F1 增益，并支持在持续变化的真实环境中做可扩展部署。
Conclusion: GFM 的隐式 3D 知识可作为场景变化检测的强先验，联合多数据集训练加上实时 SLAM 化能把变化检测与 4D 建图一起做到在线、跨域可用。

papers.title: Beyond Outcome Rewards: Constructing and Assigning Retrieval Credit for Search Agents
papers.abstract_en: Search agents enable Large Language Models (LLMs) to iteratively retrieve and use information for complex multi-hop questions. Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) offers a promising approach for post-training such agents, but its reliance on sparse, outcome-based supervision can make credit assignment difficult and limit learning efficiency. In this paper, we systematically investigate how intermediate supervision can improve reinforcement learning for search agents. We study a range of reward-shaping and credit-assignment strategies that provide learning signals from intermediate retrieval steps. Building on these insights, we develop a training framework that combines intermediate signals with final outcome rewards to improve learning from multi-step search trajectories. Experiments across multiple benchmarks under matched training conditions demonstrate improvements in aggregate search-agent performance and show that both the choice of intermediate signal and where its credit is assigned affect training behaviour. These findings show that reward design and credit assignment are important design dimensions for training effective search agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对搜索智能体 (search agent) 用 RLVR 训练时奖励稀疏、多步检索的 credit assignment 困难，系统比较多种来自中间检索步的 reward-shaping 与 credit-assignment 策略，并提出把中间信号与最终 outcome reward 结合的训练框架。在匹配训练条件下跨多个 benchmark，聚合搜索性能提升，且中间信号的种类与其 credit 被分配到哪一步都会改变训练行为。
Motivation: RLVR 只给稀疏的 outcome 型监督，多跳检索轨迹中中间步的贡献难以归因，导致 credit assignment 困难、学习效率受限。
Method: 系统研究一系列提供中间检索步学习信号的 reward-shaping 与 credit-assignment 策略，在此基础上构建把中间信号与最终 outcome reward 结合的训练框架，用于多步搜索轨迹的后训练。
Result: 在匹配训练条件下跨多个 benchmark 的实验显示聚合搜索智能体性能提升；同时表明中间信号的选择与其 credit 分配位置都会影响训练行为。
Conclusion: 奖励设计与 credit assignment 是训练有效搜索智能体的两个独立设计维度，中间监督能改善 RLVR 的学习效率。

papers.title: A Unified Information-Theoretic Approach to Constrained Multi-Fidelity Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian optimization often involves multiple objectives, constraints, and fidelity levels. We address the challenge of jointly selecting where and at which fidelity to evaluate to identify the highest-fidelity feasible Pareto frontier in this combined setting. From a unified information-theoretic perspective, we measure query utility by the information gain about this frontier, provided by an observation. Since this mutual information is intractable, we derive a variational lower bound using a mixture of under- and over-truncated approximations to the Pareto-consistent region. Multi-fidelity surrogate models propagate the information to arbitrary fidelities, yielding a cost-aware acquisition function without separate heuristics for fidelity selection or constraint handling. Experiments on synthetic, benchmark, and real-world problems demonstrate effectiveness across diverse objective, constraint, and fidelity settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多目标、带约束、多保真度的贝叶斯优化中，用关于最高保真度可行 Pareto 前沿的互信息统一定义查询效用，并通过欠截断与过截断混合近似推导变分下界，得到无需单独启发式的代价感知采集函数。合成、基准与真实问题实验显示该采集函数在多样的目标、约束与保真度设定下有效。
Motivation: 多目标、约束与多保真度同时存在时，选择在何处、以何种保真度评估是耦合难题，通常要为保真度选择和约束处理分别拼接启发式。
Method: 以信息论视角把查询效用定义为观测对最高保真度可行 Pareto 前沿的互信息；针对该互信息不可解，用对 Pareto 一致区域的欠截断与过截断混合近似推导变分下界；再用多保真度代理模型把信息传播到任意保真度，形成代价感知采集函数。
Result: 在合成、基准与真实问题上实验，覆盖多样的目标、约束与保真度设定，展示方法的有效性。
Conclusion: 以互信息统一刻画采集效用，可以在一个采集函数里同时处理保真度选择与约束，无需额外启发式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Does Document Structure Help Dense Retrieval? A Placebo-Controlled Ablation of Four Mechanisms Across Two Corpora
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation systems increasingly rely on document-structure treatments: structure-aligned chunking, LLM-generated chunk contexts, heading-path metadata, and hierarchical two-stage retrieval. Separate studies support each on different corpora, embedders, and metrics, and none control for a shared confound: any text prepended to a chunk perturbs its embedding. We present a mechanism-isolating ablation testing all four treatments under one protocol, matching chunk sizes across conditions and adding a semantically null placebo---heading paths that are structurally valid but shuffled across documents. We score retrieval with a coverage-aware nDCG and test four pre-registered contrasts via document-clustered bootstrap with Holm correction, on two distant corpora: 200 Wikipedia Featured Articles (951 queries) and 1,585 QASPER papers (4,303 questions). Organization helps, and the cause is content, not tokens: structure-aligned chunks with real heading paths beat contextualized fixed windows (+0.022 / +0.012 cov-nDCG@10) and the placebo (+0.010 / +0.016). Naive two-stage hierarchical retrieval hurts (-0.033 / -0.015), traceable to first-stage section recall. Gold structure beats LLM-induced structure on Wikipedia but not on QASPER. Effects are small ($dz$ 0.06-0.11) but Holm-significant and consistent across corpora.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 RAG 文档结构处理上做安慰剂对照消融：把结构对齐分块、LLM 生成块上下文、标题路径元数据、层级两段式检索四种机制放进同一协议，用跨文档打乱但结构合法的标题路径作为语义为空的安慰剂。结果是组织本身有效且原因是内容而非 token 前缀——真实标题路径的结构对齐块比上下文化固定窗口高 +0.022/+0.012 cov-nDCG@10、比安慰剂高 +0.010/+0.016；朴素两段式层级检索反而降 -0.033/-0.015。
Motivation: 四种文档结构处理各自在不同语料、嵌入器和指标下被单独支持，但共享一个未控制的混淆：任何前缀到块上的文本都会扰动其 embedding，无法区分结构收益与 token 效应。
Method: 统一协议下做机制隔离消融，跨条件匹配块大小，并加入语义为空的安慰剂（结构合法但跨文档打乱的标题路径）；用覆盖感知 nDCG（cov-nDCG@10）评分，预注册四个对比，经文档聚类 bootstrap 与 Holm 校正检验，语料为 200 篇 Wikipedia Featured Articles（951 查询）与 1,585 篇 QASPER 论文（4,303 问题）。
Result: 结构对齐块配真实标题路径优于上下文化固定窗口 +0.022/+0.012 cov-nDCG@10（Wikipedia/QASPER），优于安慰剂 +0.010/+0.016；朴素两段式层级检索为 -0.033/-0.015，可追溯到第一段的 section recall；黄金结构在 Wikipedia 上胜过 LLM 诱导结构，在 QASPER 上不胜；效应量小（dz 0.06–0.11）但经 Holm 校正显著且跨语料一致。
Conclusion: 文档组织的收益来自真实内容而非前缀 token，朴素层级两段式检索有害；黄金结构是否优于 LLM 诱导结构取决于语料。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Conformal Prediction for Spatially Dependent Data via Sequential Whitening
papers.abstract_en: Split conformal prediction uses prediction errors on held-out (calibration) data to determine how wide the prediction intervals should be. It guarantees distribution-free finite-sample coverage when these errors and the error at the target site are exchangeable. This assumption may fail under spatial dependence and nonrandom sampling geometry. Existing spatial methods use fitting residuals to remove the predictable part of spatial variation from calibration and target errors. However, the spatial variation that only the calibration residuals can predict remains in both the target and calibration errors, reducing the efficiency and stability of the interval. We address this by additionally conditioning on the calibration residuals sequentially, which scales to large networks through nearest-neighbour approximations. Under a correct working covariance and an elliptical residual law, the resulting interval has exact finite-sample coverage under any spatial design, and under further conditions it is asymptotically oracle efficient. We also bound coverage loss under covariance misspecification and develop a diagnostic that identifies regions at risk of undercoverage. In simulated data, our method produces narrower and more stable intervals than global and localized state-of-the-art alternatives. In a national PM2.5 application, it produces narrower intervals within the network and identifies regions at risk of coverage failure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对空间依赖数据下 split conformal prediction 因可交换性失效而失准，提出在拟合残差之外再对校准残差做序贯条件化（sequential whitening）的区间构造，用最近邻近似扩展到大网络。在正确工作协方差与椭圆残差律下，任意空间设计都给出精确有限样本覆盖，并在附加条件下渐近 oracle 效率；模拟中区间比全局与局部 SOTA 更窄更稳，PM2.5 全国应用中网络内区间更窄并标出覆盖失效风险区。
Motivation: 空间依赖与非随机采样几何会破坏 split conformal 所需的可交换性；现有方法只用拟合残差去掉可预测部分，校准残差才能预测的那部分空间变异仍同时留在目标与校准误差里，使区间效率与稳定性下降。
Method: 在拟合残差之外，对校准残差序贯条件化（sequential whitening）来白化剩余空间变异，用最近邻近似使方法可扩展到大网络；在正确工作协方差与椭圆残差律下推导覆盖保证，并给出协方差误设下的覆盖损失上界与识别欠覆盖风险区域的诊断。
Result: 模拟数据中，该方法比全局与局部的 state-of-the-art 空间 conformal 方法给出更窄、更稳定的区间；在全国 PM2.5 应用中，网络内区间更窄，并识别出有覆盖失效风险的区域。理论上在正确工作协方差与椭圆残差律下，任意空间设计均有精确有限样本覆盖，附加条件下渐近 oracle 效率。
Conclusion: 把校准残差的可预测空间变异也条件化掉，可以在任意空间设计下保住有限样本覆盖并提升区间效率，同时用诊断标出欠覆盖风险区；协方差误设下的覆盖损失有界。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Policy Learning with Weak Signals
papers.abstract_en: Policy learning in digital experimentation faces three challenges: weak signal-to-noise ratios, rich covariate spaces, and massive data volumes. We formalize this regime by modeling treatment-effect estimates from increasingly fine covariate partitions as Gaussian observations with bounded signal-to-noise ratios. We establish that, in general, the optimal treatment policy is not learnable in this setting. Even learning the optimal policy value suffers from impractically slow rates. However, when treatment effects vary smoothly, we derive minimax-adaptive policies based on linear smoothers that achieve vanishing welfare regret. We demonstrate the practical value of our framework by applying it to large-scale real-world experiments at Netflix, showing that personalized linear-smoothing policies can dominate unpersonalized policies even in this challenging empirical setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在数字实验的弱信噪比、高维协变量与海量数据 regime 下，把细粒度分区的处理效应估计建模为有界信噪比的高斯观测，证明一般情形下最优处理策略不可学习、最优策略价值的收敛速率也不切实际地慢；只有当处理效应平滑变化时，基于线性平滑器 (linear smoother) 的 minimax-adaptive 策略才能达到消失的 welfare regret。Netflix 大规模真实实验显示，个性化线性平滑策略在这一困难设定下可支配非个性化策略。
Motivation: 数字实验中处理效应估计信噪比弱、协变量空间丰富、数据量巨大，此时最优处理策略是否可学习、以什么速率学习缺乏理论刻画。
Method: 把随协变量分区变细而得到的处理效应估计形式化为信噪比有界 (bounded SNR) 的高斯观测；在此模型下分析最优策略与最优策略价值的可学习性，并在处理效应平滑的假设下基于线性平滑器构造 minimax-adaptive 策略。
Result: 证明一般情形下最优处理策略不可学习，且仅学习最优策略价值也只能达到不切实际地慢的速率；在处理效应平滑时导出的线性平滑策略达到消失的 welfare regret；在 Netflix 大规模真实实验中，个性化线性平滑策略可支配非个性化策略。
Conclusion: 弱信号高维实验 regime 下最优策略学习在一般条件下不可行，平滑性假设加上线性平滑是让 welfare regret 消失并取得实际收益的关键条件。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: UniSkill: Learning Actor-Aligned Skill Proposals for an Evolving Policy
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents can improve across tasks by retaining reusable skills distilled from prior interactions. Recent work jointly optimizes task execution and skill extraction, enabling the policy and skillbank to co-evolve. However, as the actor continues learning, rewarding skill proposals through their reuse in subsequent training steps may conflate skill benefits with actor improvement, while directly testing each proposed skill requires costly additional actor rollouts. In this paper, we introduce UniSkill, which uses a shared policy to interact with the environment and propose skillbank edits (Add, Update, or No Edit) from the resulting trajectories. Specifically, the actor learns from environment rewards, while contrastive action feedback guides skill proposal learning. This feedback provides an actor-alignment signal by measuring how replacing the retrieved skill with a proposed skill changes the current actor's action log-likelihood gap between previously collected successful and failed trajectories from the same task, thereby avoiding new rollouts for each proposal. Since proposal-level feedback may suppress an otherwise appropriate edit operation when the proposed skill content scores poorly, we further apply skill-edit support regularization to preserve exploration. Empirically, UniSkill achieves strong performance, reaching 98.4% success on ALFWorld and 84.7% on WebShop while maintaining stable joint training. Further ALFWorld experiments show that UniSkill remains effective when the shared policy uses a smaller backbone. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/LimOkii/UniSKill.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniSkill 用共享策略与环境交互并直接提出 skillbank 编辑（Add/Update/No Edit），以对比式动作反馈作为 actor 对齐信号：衡量用提议技能替换检索技能后，当前策略在同任务成功/失败轨迹上的动作 log-likelihood 差如何变化，从而免去逐提议的额外 rollout。ALFWorld 成功率 98.4%，WebShop 84.7%，且换用更小 backbone 后仍有效。
Motivation: LLM agent 通过沉淀可复用技能跨任务提升，但用后续复用来奖励技能提议会把技能收益与 actor 自身进步混在一起，而逐个提议做实测又需要昂贵的额外 actor rollout。
Method: 共享策略既与环境交互又提出 skillbank 编辑（Add、Update、No Edit）；actor 从环境奖励学习，技能提议学习由对比式动作反馈引导，该反馈用替换检索技能后当前 actor 在同任务成功与失败轨迹上的动作 log-likelihood 差来度量对齐程度；再加 skill-edit support regularization 保留探索，避免提议内容评分低时压制本应合适的编辑操作。
Result: ALFWorld 成功率 98.4%，WebShop 84.7%，联合训练保持稳定；在 ALFWorld 上共享策略改用更小 backbone 时仍有效。
Conclusion: 用 actor 对齐的对比动作反馈替代后续复用奖励与逐提议 rollout，可以在不额外采样的情况下驱动技能提议与策略共同进化。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: ALFWorld 成功率 98.4%，WebShop 84.7%，联合训练保持稳定；在 ALFWorld 上共享策略改用更小 backbone 时仍有效。
summary_sections.conclusion: 用 actor 对齐的对比动作反馈替代后续复用奖励与逐提议 rollout，可以在不额外采样的情况下驱动技能提议与策略共同进化。

papers.title: Beyond Anonymous Captions: Grounding Character Identity in Video Captioning and Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Linking people's appearance and actions to character identities is essential for understanding video narratives. We present a framework for identity-aware video captioning and person-centric question answering that combines automatic character identification, explicit spatial grounding, and task-specific adaptation. Starting from LSMDC v2 movie clips, our pipeline matches detected faces to actor reference images, tracks characters across frames, and builds inputs with identity-linked bounding boxes. A strong vision-language model generates identity-aware captions and questions, which are manually verified and filtered to create a benchmark of 750 captioned clips and 3,000 person-centric questions. We study five grounding strategies combining textual coordinates with visual face or estimated person boxes across Video-MLLM families at roughly 2B, 4B, and 8B parameters and larger frontier models. Combining visual face boxes with textual coordinates yields the most consistent performance across scales and significantly improves overall performance over coordinates alone. Smaller models tend to over-assign known identities when the queried person is not grounded, while larger models better recognize such UNIDENTIFIED cases. We introduce BAC by LoRA fine-tuning Qwen models at 2B, 4B, and 8B scales on about 32K identity-aware captioned clips. Across all scales, BAC outperforms every other evaluated model family of comparable size. BAC-8B reaches 93.20\% overall QA accuracy, ranking behind only GPT-5.6 Sol among the frontier models evaluated in our study. Overall, explicitly communicating who is where, together with lightweight task-specific adaptation, substantially improves identity-aware video understanding without changing the underlying architecture. We release the benchmark, training data, code, and BAC checkpoints at https://github.com/momentslab/beyond-anonymous-captions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出身份感知视频字幕与人物问答框架：把人脸匹配到演员参考图、跨帧跟踪并生成带身份绑定边框的输入，再用 LoRA 微调 Qwen 得到 BAC 系列。在自建的 750 段带字幕片段、3,000 道人物问答基准上，BAC-8B 总体 QA 准确率 93.20%，仅落后于 GPT-5.6 Sol；视觉人脸框加文本坐标的组合在各规模下最稳定，显著优于仅用坐标。
Motivation: 视频叙事理解需要把人物外观与动作绑定到具体角色身份，但现有字幕与问答多用匿名的 person 表述，缺少显式空间定位与身份关联。
Method: 以 LSMDC v2 电影片段为起点，检测人脸并与演员参考图匹配、跨帧跟踪角色，构建带身份绑定边框的输入；强视觉-语言模型生成身份感知字幕与问题，经人工核验过滤成基准。对比五种接地策略（文本坐标 × 视觉人脸框或估计人体框）在约 2B、4B、8B 及更大前沿 Video-MLLM 上的效果，并用约 32K 带身份字幕片段对 Qwen 2B/4B/8B 做 LoRA 微调得到 BAC。
Result: 基准含 750 段带字幕片段与 3,000 道人物问答；视觉人脸框加文本坐标在各规模下最一致，并显著优于仅用坐标。小模型在被查询人物未接地时倾向过度指派已知身份，大模型更能识别 UNIDENTIFIED 情形。BAC 在各规模上均优于同规模其他模型家族；BAC-8B 总体 QA 准确率 93.20%，在评估的前沿模型中仅落后于 GPT-5.6 Sol。
Conclusion: 显式传达谁在何处，加上轻量的任务特定适配，可在不改动底层架构的前提下显著提升身份感知视频理解；基准、训练数据、代码与 BAC 检查点已开源。

papers.title: BagDINO: Multi-View Baggage Re-Identification with DINOv3
papers.abstract_en: Mishandled checked baggage remains a recurrent issue in airport operations, and current recovery workflows still largely rely on tag-based tracking, which does not directly support visual identification when tag evidence is missing or unavailable. This paper investigates baggage re-identification as an instance-level retrieval problem in a multi-camera setting, leveraging DINOv3 foundation-model representations to match a query image against a gallery of registered baggage images. A Torchreid-style BNNeck re-identification head is placed on top of a DINOv3 backbone, and parameter-efficient adaptation is performed via LoRA. Experiments are conducted on the MVB benchmark using a progressive study that compares a fully frozen backbone against LoRA and fine-tuning strategies. Results indicate that parameter-efficient adaptation of foundation-model features provides an effective and stable approach for multi-view baggage re-identification under limited training data.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables, IEEE International Conference on Evolving and Adaptive Intelligent Systems 2026 (IEEE EAIS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BagDINO 把多摄像头行李重识别建模为实例级检索：在 DINOv3 backbone 上接 Torchreid 风格的 BNNeck 重识别头，用 LoRA 做参数高效适配。在 MVB 基准上对比全冻结 backbone、LoRA 与全量微调，结果显示在有限训练数据下 LoRA 适配基础模型特征是有效且稳定的方案。
Motivation: 机场行李错运恢复流程仍依赖标签条码追踪，标签缺失或不可读时缺少直接的视觉识别手段。
Method: 以 DINOv3 基础模型特征为 backbone，其上放置 Torchreid 风格的 BNNeck 重识别头，通过 LoRA 做参数高效适配；在 MVB 基准上做渐进式实验，对比全冻结 backbone、LoRA 与全量微调三种策略。
Result: 在 MVB 基准的渐进式研究中，参数高效适配（LoRA）在有限训练数据下相对全冻结 backbone 与全量微调表现出有效且稳定的多视角行李重识别性能。
Conclusion: 在训练数据有限的多视角行李重识别场景中，用 LoRA 适配基础模型特征比全冻结或全量微调更稳妥。

papers.title: HeiCo-FOCUS: A Clinically Grounded Dataset for Long-Context Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have led to rapid progress in video understanding across a wide range of benchmark tasks. However, existing evaluations largely focus on short-term reasoning, failing to assess a critical capability: maintaining cumulative temporal consistency over extended time horizons. To close this evaluation gap, we introduce HeiCo-FOCUS, a clinically grounded dataset for evaluating long-context video understanding through the task of Foreign Object Contextual Understanding in Surgery. Built on a dataset of Heidelberg Colorectal surgeries, this task requires models to continuously track multiple objects as they are inserted, manipulated, occluded, and removed over procedures lasting up to hours. HeiCo-FOCUS comprises 30,000 visual question answering (VQA) pairs covering five core capabilities: object recognition, temporal grounding, aggregation, event and procedural understanding, and complex reasoning. The dataset was constructed through a rigorous multi-stage annotation pipeline involving large-scale crowd annotation and 39 surgical domain experts to ensure high quality and clinical relevance. To systematically probe model behavior, we introduce a multi-track evaluation framework that progressively increases temporal and contextual demands from single frames to full procedures. Experiments with ten frontier VLMs show that HeiCo-FOCUS tasks are far from solved: only around half of the models clearly outperform a text-only baseline. Across the video tracks, models perform best on event and procedural understanding (mean Accuracy: 56.5% across all models), while temporal grounding remains particularly challenging for all evaluated models (mean Accuracy: 19.7%). We therefore expect HeiCo-FOCUS to serve as a catalyst for the development of models capable of reliable, temporally consistent reasoning over hours-long videos.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HeiCo-FOCUS 是一个以外科手术为场景的长上下文视频理解评测数据集，任务为手术中异物的上下文理解 (Foreign Object Contextual Understanding)，要求模型在长达数小时的手术过程里持续跟踪被插入、操作、遮挡和移除的多个物体。十个前沿 VLM 上任务远未解决：仅约一半模型明显超过纯文本基线，事件与程序理解平均准确率 56.5%，而 temporal grounding 仅 19.7%。
Motivation: 现有视频理解评测多集中在短期推理，无法衡量模型在数小时时间跨度上维持累积时间一致性的能力，这一评估缺口在手术这类长时程场景中尤为关键。
Method: 基于 Heidelberg Colorectal 手术数据集构建 30,000 条 VQA 对，覆盖物体识别、temporal grounding、聚合、事件与程序理解、复杂推理五类能力；标注经多阶段流水线，包含大规模众包与 39 名外科领域专家；提出 multi-track 评测框架，从单帧逐级提升到完整手术过程的时间与上下文要求。
Result: 十个前沿 VLM 的实验显示任务远未解决，仅约一半模型明显优于纯文本基线；跨视频 track 上事件与程序理解表现最好（全模型平均 Accuracy 56.5%），temporal grounding 对所有被评模型都最难（平均 Accuracy 19.7%）。
Conclusion: 长时程视频中的时间一致推理仍未被现有 VLM 掌握，temporal grounding 是主要瓶颈；作者预期该数据集可推动能对小时级视频做可靠、时间一致推理的模型发展。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Progress and Prospect of AI in ARPES Workflow
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) is becoming an increasingly useful tool across the experimental sciences, including angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES), which routinely produces large, multidimensional datasets of electronic structure. Recent advances in AI and machine learning (ML) have opened new opportunities across the entire ARPES workflow, from automated sample preparation and real-time data acquisition to post-experiment data analysis and comparison with theoretical calculations. Despite this progress, a comprehensive review of ML applications, their capabilities, and reliability across the different stages of ARPES workflow is still lacking. In this review, we first introduce ML methods that are most relevant to experimentalists working in condensed matter physics and materials science. We then follow the ARPES workflow, reviewing existing ML applications at each step and discussing their advantages, limitations and potential for future development. We also examine the current ARPES data landscape, where several open databases are available but remain relatively small and fragmented compared with large, shared datasets such as ImageNet. Given these limitations, we suggest that the community focus on sharing pretrained models that can be further trained, adapted to specific tasks, and redistributed, while working toward a larger and standardized open ARPES dataset repository. Finally, we discuss our perspectives on the future of AI within the ARPES workflow using a six-level framework of laboratory automation, highlighting the opportunities and challenges in moving toward a fully autonomous, self-driving ARPES laboratory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于 AI 在角分辨光电子能谱 (ARPES) 全流程应用的综述，覆盖样品制备、实时采集、数据分析与理论计算对照，并指出当前 ARPES 开放数据库相对 ImageNet 等仍小而碎片化。作者建议社区优先共享可继续训练、适配与再分发的预训练模型，同时推进更大、标准化的开放 ARPES 数据库，并以六级实验室自动化框架展望自驱动 ARPES 实验室。
Motivation: AI/ML 已渗透 ARPES 各环节，但缺少一份系统梳理各阶段方法能力与可靠性的综述；同时 ARPES 数据分散、规模小，制约模型训练与复现。
Method: 综述体：先介绍面向凝聚态与材料实验者的 ML 方法，再沿 ARPES 工作流逐步评述已有应用的优劣与前景；考察开放数据库现状，并提出社区协作建议与六级实验室自动化框架。
Result: 定性结论：现有 ARPES 开放数据库虽已存在，但相比 ImageNet 等大型共享数据集仍偏小且碎片化；文中无实验性能数字。
Conclusion: 作者主张以共享预训练模型为近期抓手，逐步建设标准化开放 ARPES 数据仓库，并沿六级自动化框架向自驱动 ARPES 实验室演进。

papers.title: Attention via Black-Box Vector Search
papers.abstract_en: Sparse attention mechanisms estimate attention over $n$ tokens using a small subset of keys. Many existing approaches use maximum inner product search (MIPS) to retrieve the heaviest keys, which motivates the following question: given black-box access to a MIPS oracle, how many keys must be retrieved to output an $\varepsilon$-accurate attention estimate? We answer this question by unifying prior approaches through the framework of priority sampling. With a single MIPS index, we show that $Θ(\sqrt{n}/\varepsilon)$ retrieved keys are both sufficient and necessary. With $Θ(\log n)$ indices, we give an algorithm that retrieves only $O(\log n+1/\varepsilon^2)$ keys and prove that this is near-optimal. More generally, we design algorithms that establish a smooth tradeoff between the number of MIPS indices and number of retrieved keys. We then show that if we allow augmentation of keys and queries, we can bypass the above lower bounds: there exists a simple priority-sampling estimator using a single MIPS index and $O(1/\varepsilon^2)$ retrieved keys. When integrated into LLM inference, our algorithms outperform top-$k$ and sampling approaches used in prior work and yield attention approximation that scales favorably to long contexts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在只有黑盒 MIPS oracle 的前提下，用 priority sampling 统一稀疏注意力近似问题：单索引下 Θ(√n/ε) 个 key 的检索量既充分也必要，Θ(log n) 个索引可降到 O(log n+1/ε²) 且近最优；若允许对 key 和 query 做增广，单索引即可用 O(1/ε²) 个 key 绕过下界。集成进 LLM 推理后优于既往的 top-k 与采样方案，长上下文扩展性更好。
Motivation: 稀疏注意力用小子集估计 n 个 token 上的注意力，既有方法多用 MIPS 检索最重 key，但黑盒 oracle 下需要取回多少 key 才能达到 ε 精度缺少紧的刻画。
Method: 把既有方法统一到 priority sampling 框架，分析黑盒 MIPS oracle 下的检索复杂度；给出多索引算法建立索引数与检索 key 数的平滑权衡，并通过对 key/query 增广构造单索引估计器；最后接入 LLM 推理与 top-k、采样基线对比。
Result: 单 MIPS 索引下 Θ(√n/ε) 个检索 key 充分且必要；Θ(log n) 个索引下算法只检索 O(log n+1/ε²) 个 key 并被证明近最优；增广后单索引 O(1/ε²) 即可。LLM 推理集成中优于既往 top-k 与采样方法，长上下文扩展更有利。
Conclusion: 黑盒 MIPS 下稀疏注意力的检索下界可被多索引或 key/query 增广突破，代价从 √n/ε 降到 1/ε² 量级。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: HarnessIR: Harnessing Multimodal Foundation Models for Universal Real-World Image Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Real-world low-quality images suffer from complex mixed degradations, including but not limited to noise, blur, atmospheric effects, etc. Recent agentic methods usually model real-world image restoration (Real-IR) as a sequential tool calling problem over task-specific single-degradation restoration models. This paradigm, however, is fundamentally limited because complex real-world degradations cannot be cleanly undone degradation by degradation, and the tool used for task-specific models caps the capability of the agent system. In this work, we present HarnessIR, an agentic framework for Real-IR by harnessing a multimodal foundation model (MFM) as the executor. HarnessIR consists of five stages: perception and diagnosis, on-demand tool invocation, prompt composition, execution, and verification-driven refinement. Unlike prior agentic Real-IR methods that rely on tool chains assembled from task-specific models, HarnessIR feeds the restoration requirements, the perceptual diagnosis, and the evidence into an MFM that performs restoration in a single pass, followed by verification stages to determine whether the result warrants further processing. Under our harness, off-the-shelf MFMs handle restoration tasks remarkably well, achieving state-of-the-art results on the widely used MiO100 synthetic benchmark. More importantly, by exploiting the strong generalization ability of MFMs, HarnessIR delivers compelling restoration quality on challenging real-world scenes where previous agentic IR systems often struggle. Codes is available at https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/HarnessIR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HarnessIR 把真实图像复原从「逐个退化调用专用模型」的工具链范式改为用多模态基础模型 (MFM) 一次执行：先感知诊断，再按需调用工具、组合提示、单次复原，最后用验证驱动的精修判断是否继续处理。在 MiO100 合成基准上达到 state-of-the-art，并在先前 agentic IR 系统表现吃力的真实场景上给出有竞争力的复原质量。
Motivation: 真实图像的混合退化无法逐个干净地逆向消除，而依赖任务专用单退化模型的工具链把 agent 系统的能力上限锁死在这些工具本身。
Method: 五阶段 agentic 框架：感知与诊断、按需工具调用、提示组合、执行、验证驱动精修。与先前方法不同，它把复原需求、感知诊断和证据一起交给 MFM 单次完成复原，再由验证阶段决定是否追加处理。
Result: 在 MiO100 合成基准上取得 state-of-the-art 结果；在先前 agentic IR 系统常感困难的真实场景上给出有竞争力的复原质量。代码发布于 github.com/PolyU-VCLab/HarnessIR。
Conclusion: 用 MFM 直接充当复原执行器、把工具链降为辅助，可让现成 MFM 在真实混合退化复原上达到 SOTA 并改善真实场景泛化。

papers.title: When Algorithmic Exploration Becomes Cheap: A Case Study of Agentic Research in EDA
papers.abstract_en: As EDA researchers, we conducted eight deliberate trials of agentic algorithm exploration, selecting several topics outside our areas of depth. One faculty member and seven students participated, including students without publication experience. With limited intervention in the algorithms, agents developed mathematical constructions, analyzed existing tools, and implemented improvements; some efforts fell short of their practical goals. We also used AI to collect, classify, and analyze 8,420 papers from four EDA conferences and two journals over 2022-2026. Among 2,380 primary-core papers, we classified 97.7% from titles and abstracts as computationally closed, including work on new formulations. Together, these observations suggest that much of EDA offers an executable environment for increasingly accessible algorithm research. We see an opportunity for tool developers to investigate ideas they previously lacked time to pursue. We also ask how EDA should validate and reward research when results become easier to produce than to examine, and what papers and venue labels will continue to tell us about a contribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EDA 研究者做 8 次刻意的 agentic 算法探索试验，让 agent 在作者非深耕方向上独立完成数学构造、工具分析与实现改进，部分未达实用目标；同时用 AI 分析 2022–2026 年六个 EDA 出版源的 8,420 篇论文，发现 2,380 篇 primary-core 论文中 97.7% 可从标题摘要判定为计算可闭合 (computationally closed)。作者据此主张 EDA 大部分内容可作为算法研究的可执行环境，并提出当结果比检验更容易产生时，同行与 venue 需要重新定义验证与奖励方式。
Motivation: 算法探索成本正在下降，但 EDA 领域缺少对 agentic 研究可行性的系统经验，也缺少对论文可复现/可闭合程度的量化刻画，导致对如何验证和奖励研究的判断仍基于旧假设。
Method: 两条路径：一是 8 次刻意试验，1 名教师与 7 名学生（含无发表经验者）在自身非深耕方向上让 agent 在有限算法干预下做数学构造、现有工具分析与改进实现；二是用 AI 收集、分类并分析 2022–2026 年 4 个 EDA 会议与 2 个期刊的 8,420 篇论文，对 2,380 篇 primary-core 论文按标题与摘要判定计算闭合性。
Result: 8 次 agentic 探索试验中 agent 完成了数学构造、工具分析与改进实现，部分工作未达其实用目标；文献分析覆盖 8,420 篇论文，其中 2,380 篇 primary-core 论文有 97.7% 被从标题和摘要分类为 computationally closed，包括提出新 formulation 的工作。
Conclusion: EDA 的大部分内容可充当日益易得的算法研究的可执行环境，工具开发者有机会追索过去无暇验证的想法；同时领域需要重新思考当结果比检验更容易产生时，论文与 venue 标签还能传递什么贡献信号。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: m-Set Adversarial Bandits with Winner Feedback
papers.abstract_en: We show upper and lower bounds on the regret of $m$-set adversarial bandits for different utilities (winner reward or sum of rewards) and feedback models (winner index, winner reward, sum of rewards, and their combinations). By comparing to standard bounds for combinatorial and MNL bandits, our results reveal how subtle changes in the setting can have a dramatic impact on the learning rates. Our main technical contributions are the information-theoretic lower bounds on the regret. Experiments on synthetic data confirm our theoretical analyses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 给出 m-set 对抗性 bandit 在不同效用（winner reward 或 sum of rewards）与反馈模型（winner index、winner reward、sum of rewards 及其组合）下的遗憾上界与下界，并与 combinatorial bandit、MNL bandit 的标准界对比，显示设定的细微改动会显著改变学习速率。核心贡献是信息论遗憾下界，合成数据实验与理论分析一致。
Motivation: m-set 选择问题中效用定义与反馈形式的组合多样，缺少各设定下遗憾阶的系统刻画，也难以判断设定的微小改动对学习速率的影响。
Method: 对四种反馈模型与两种效用分别推导遗憾上界，主要技术贡献是信息论 (information-theoretic) 遗憾下界；将结果与 combinatorial bandit 和 MNL bandit 的标准界对比，并用合成数据实验检验理论分析。
Result: 给出 m-set 对抗性 bandit 在 winner reward 与 sum of rewards 两种效用、winner index / winner reward / sum of rewards 及其组合反馈下的遗憾上下界；对比显示设定的细微变化对学习速率有 dramatic 影响；合成数据实验与理论分析相符。
Conclusion: m-set bandit 的遗憾阶由效用与反馈形式共同决定，设定上的细微差别足以显著改变学习速率，信息论下界是刻画这一差异的主要工具。

papers.title: Know the Shape, Find the Fault: Topology-Conditioned Diagnosis of Multi-Agent LLM Failures
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM systems coordinate task execution through exchanges of information among agents. When coordination breaks down, similar symptoms in execution traces can reflect different problems in how information is passed, used, or verified. Communication topology captures how agents exchange information and provides structural cues for distinguishing coordination failure modes. Using these cues for diagnosis requires establishing how topology relates to failure patterns and recovering the relevant structure from execution traces that lack explicit topology labels. We analyze the relationship between communication topology and failure patterns and introduce MAScope, a two-stage framework for topology-conditioned diagnosis. Its Trace Structural Extractor TSE recovers communication topology from heterogeneous execution traces by grounding an interaction graph in message evidence. The Topology-Conditioned Judge TC-Judge then classifies failures using the trace, predicted topology, an empirical failure prior estimated from separate labeled traces, and a short description of topology-specific failure patterns. Under a fixed orchestration structure, the recovered topology can be reused across executions. Experimental results show a statistically significant association between communication topology and failure type, with $χ^2 = 409.9$ and $p = 1.2 \times 10^{-70}$. On the \num{851} MAST-clean traces, ground-truth topology context raises gpt-mini's Macro-F1 from $0.173$ to $0.350$. With predicted topology, the pipeline achieves $0.346$, approaching the trace-only gpt-5.4 baseline of $0.372$. For \num{1000} traces under a fixed orchestration structure, the projected pipeline cost, including one topology extraction, is approximately $6\%$ of repeated gpt-5.4 diagnosis cost. These results show that topology-conditioned context improves failure diagnosis and supports lower-cost deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MAScope 用通信拓扑作为条件来诊断多智能体 LLM 的协作失败：先从无拓扑标签的执行轨迹中恢复交互图，再按拓扑条件分类失败类型。在 851 条 MAST-clean 轨迹上，真实拓扑上下文把 gpt-mini 的 Macro-F1 从 0.173 提到 0.350，预测拓扑下管线达 0.346，接近 trace-only 的 gpt-5.4 基线 0.372，而 1000 条轨迹的投影成本约为重复调用 gpt-5.4 的 6%。
Motivation: 多智能体 LLM 系统的执行轨迹中，相似症状可能对应信息传递、使用或验证上的不同故障；缺少显式拓扑标签时无法直接用结构线索区分失败模式。
Method: 两阶段框架 MAScope：Trace Structural Extractor (TSE) 以消息证据为锚点从异构轨迹中恢复通信拓扑（交互图），Topology-Conditioned Judge (TC-Judge) 结合轨迹、预测拓扑、来自独立带标签轨迹的经验失败先验以及拓扑特定失败模式描述来分类失败；固定编排结构下恢复的拓扑可跨执行复用。
Result: 通信拓扑与失败类型存在统计显著关联，χ² = 409.9，p = 1.2×10⁻⁷⁰；在 851 条 MAST-clean 轨迹上，真实拓扑上下文使 gpt-mini 的 Macro-F1 从 0.173 升至 0.350，预测拓扑下管线为 0.346，trace-only gpt-5.4 基线为 0.372；1000 条固定编排轨迹上，含一次拓扑抽取的投影管线成本约为重复 gpt-5.4 诊断成本的 6%。
Conclusion: 拓扑条件上下文能显著改善多智能体 LLM 失败诊断，并支持以约 6% 的成本部署；恢复的拓扑在固定编排结构下可跨执行复用。

papers.title: Lifelong small-object navigation in changing object layouts: a benchmark and method
papers.abstract_en: Household robots need to continually navigate to different objects in the same environment, many of which are small and portable, such as tools and toys. Their small visual footprint and frequent occlusion make reliable observation difficult, and they may be moved by people without the robot observing the changes. We formulate this challenging task as Lifelong Small-object Navigation in Changing Object Layouts (LiSoNav-COL). Agents must seek suitable viewpoints for reliable observation, accumulate and reuse scene knowledge to efficiently locate subsequent targets, and update outdated memory after object relocation. To eliminate the need for prior scene scanning, we also require agents to start navigation with empty scene memory. Although practical, this task still lacks benchmarks designed around its defining assumptions. To bridge this gap, we introduce LiSoNav-Eval, a dedicated benchmark spanning 28 indoor scenes with 45 small-object categories. Its lifelong navigation sequences include both unchanged and relocated targets to evaluate memory reuse and adaptation to object relocation. To address this challenging task, we propose a navigation method based on multi-view Inspection with Viewpoint-Anchored Memory, dubbed IVAM-Nav. IVAM-Nav actively observes supporting surfaces from complementary viewpoints for reliable small-object perception and anchors the resulting memory to their observation viewpoints, supporting relational memory reuse and revalidation under similar viewing conditions. Extensive experiments on LiSoNav-Eval demonstrate favorable performance of IVAM-Nav against representative methods. Benchmark analyses also show that smaller objects, larger environments, and longer relocation distances pose greater challenges. The dataset and code are available here.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出终身小物体导航任务 LiSoNav-COL：机器人在同一室内环境中反复寻找被人为移动的小物体，且必须从空场景记忆起步。新基准 LiSoNav-Eval 覆盖 28 个室内场景、45 类小物体，序列同时含未移动与已移动目标；方法 IVAM-Nav 用多视角 Inspection 主动观察支撑面并把记忆锚定到观察视点，在基准上优于代表性方法，且物体越小、环境越大、迁移距离越长越难。
Motivation: 小物体视觉 footprint 小、常被遮挡，且会在机器人未观察时被人移动，导致记忆过期；现有导航基准缺少围绕空场景记忆起步、记忆复用与重定位自适应这些假设的设计。
Method: 提出 IVAM-Nav：从互补视角主动观察支撑面以可靠感知小物体，并将记忆锚定到观察视点 (Viewpoint-Anchored Memory)，支持关系式记忆复用与在相似视角条件下的重验证 (revalidation)；配套发布 LiSoNav-Eval 基准，含未移动与已移动目标的终身导航序列。
Result: LiSoNav-Eval 含 28 个室内场景、45 个小物体类别；实验显示 IVAM-Nav 相对代表性方法表现更优；基准分析表明物体更小、环境更大、目标迁移距离更长时任务更难。
Conclusion: 把小物体观察可靠性与视点锚定记忆纳入导航，可在空场景记忆起步的终身小物体导航中更有效地复用与更新记忆；数据集与代码已公开。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Training with Missed Targets in Generative Recommendation: Separating Supervision from Probability Competition
papers.abstract_en: Generative recommenders return a limited candidate set and may omit observed targets before reranking. A training strategy appends these missed targets to reranker training lists, although inference still ranks only original candidates. This operation simultaneously changes retrieved-target weight, adds supervision over appended targets, and makes the two groups compete for probability. An append/no-append comparison therefore cannot explain changes in returned-item rankings. We construct three matched losses that hold retrieved-target weight fixed while introducing appended-target supervision and group competition separately. The intermediate loss trains within both groups but normalizes them separately, preventing training-only targets from competing with inference candidates. Experiments with a released OneRec model and locally trained Amazon generators show that this competition can harm returned-item ranking. In four prespecified Amazon Video Games comparisons, removing it improved full-target normalized discounted cumulative gain (FT-NDCG) by 7.8--22.2\%; 95\% intervals over users and three of four intervals over training runs excluded zero. A conservative development-set rule selected appended-target training for two of three generators in one held-out category and rejected it for all three in another, avoiding a 1.7\% loss. Candidate completion should therefore be evaluated for each generator rather than applied automatically.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 生成式推荐的候选补全（把漏掉的观测目标追加进重排训练列表）同时改变了检索目标权重、追加目标监督和两组目标的概率竞争，因此 append/no-append 对比无法解释排序变化。构造三个匹配损失把监督与竞争分离后发现：竞争会损害返回项排序，在 Amazon Video Games 四个预设对比中去掉竞争使 FT-NDCG 提升 7.8–22.2%。
Motivation: 生成式推荐器只返回有限候选集，训练时追加漏检目标这一常见策略把三种效应混在一起，append/no-append 对比无法区分究竟是哪一项在改变返回项排序。
Method: 构造三个匹配损失，在固定检索目标权重的前提下分别引入追加目标监督与组间竞争；其中中间损失在两组内分别训练但各自归一化，使仅训练期目标不与推理候选竞争。实验用已发布的 OneRec 模型与本地训练的 Amazon 生成器，并按生成器逐一制定保守的发展集选择规则。
Result: 在 Amazon Video Games 四个预设对比中，去掉概率竞争使 FT-NDCG 提升 7.8–22.2%；跨用户的 95% 区间以及跨训练运行的四个区间中有三个排除零。保守发展集规则在一个留出类目中对三个生成器中的两个选用追加目标训练，在另一个类目中对全部三个拒绝，避免了 1.7% 的损失。
Conclusion: 候选补全应按生成器逐一评估，而不是自动启用；组间概率竞争是追加目标训练损害返回项排序的原因。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What Can a Gaussian Process Design Test
papers.abstract_en: A Gaussian process (GP) model can agree with the data for two reasons: its assumptions are right, or the chosen inputs could never have shown that they are wrong. The distinction can be checked from the design before any responses are observed. Every model implies relations that its noiseless responses must satisfy at the chosen inputs, such as the middle value lies on the line through its two neighbours. For GPs built from finitely many features, these relations are exactly the null space of the kernel matrix. Gale duality gives them a geometric interpretation, in which each observation has a vector and the smallest groups of observations that can expose an error are the circuits. For other kernels the relations become soft: response patterns may be improbable under the prior rather than algebraically impossible. A standard test then combines two kinds of evidence. Structural evidence comes from a violated relation and grows without limit as the noise falls. Prior-based evidence only says that a departure is improbable under the prior. With all inputs at the two ends of an interval, for example, a GP can reject a straight line against a large curvature, but only because the implied intercept is improbable, never because curvature was seen. In simulations the predicted power matched the observed rejection rates. Choosing the next input by predicted power raised the power against a localised discrepancy from 0.48 to 0.72, against 0.51 when choosing by predictive variance, and a grid in two dimensions contained exact tests of additivity that a Latin hypercube lacked. The test itself is classical. The contribution is the prospective reading of that test: before observing the responses, the design already determines what kind of contradiction it can produce.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文指出高斯过程 (GP) 与数据吻合可能因为假设正确，也可能因为输入设计根本无法暴露错误，而这一区分可在观测响应之前由设计本身判定。有限特征 GP 的无噪声响应关系恰为核矩阵零空间，由 Gale 对偶给出几何解释，最小的可暴露错误的观测组即 circuits；结构证据随噪声下降无界增长，而仅基于先验的证据只说明偏离先验上不可信。模拟中预测功效与观测拒绝率一致，按预测功效选点把对局部偏离的功效从 0.48 提到 0.72（按预测方差选点为 0.51），二维网格包含了 Latin hypercube 缺失的可加性精确检验。
Motivation: GP 与数据一致有两种来源：假设确实正确，或所选输入在结构上不可能证伪假设；后者在观测响应前就已由设计决定，若不预先判定，实验设计可能永远无法产生真正的矛盾证据。
Method: 对由有限特征构建的 GP，把无噪声响应必须满足的关系刻画为核矩阵的零空间，并用 Gale 对偶给出几何解释，其中最小的可暴露错误的观测组是 circuits；对其他核，关系退化为软约束（响应模式在先验下不可能而非代数上不可能）。检验结合两类证据：违反关系的结构证据（随噪声下降无界增长）与仅说明偏离在先验下不可信的先验证据，并在观测响应前按预测功效选择下一输入。
Result: 模拟中预测功效与观测拒绝率一致；按预测功效选点使对局部偏离 (localised discrepancy) 的功效从 0.48 提升到 0.72，而按预测方差选点为 0.51；二维网格包含对可加性 (additivity) 的精确检验，而 Latin hypercube 设计不具备。
Conclusion: 检验本身是经典的，贡献在于对它的前瞻性解读：设计在观测响应之前就决定了它能产生哪一类矛盾，因此应按预测功效而非预测方差来选点。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: RewardWeaver: Long-Horizon Interactive Learning for Language Agents via Self-Evolving Reward Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has driven substantial progress in domains where task outcomes can be reliably evaluated, but long-horizon interaction remains challenging due to sparse terminal feedback and difficult credit assignment. Process rewards provide denser supervision, yet the capabilities most relevant for training can change as the policy evolves: a behavior that is easy to evaluate or frequently deficient need not be the bottleneck currently limiting task success. We introduce RewardWeaver, a self-evolving reward adaptation framework for language agents in long-horizon interaction. RewardWeaver maintains a validated capability space in which the semantics of admitted Rubrics remain fixed, and closes the loop between policy optimization, task evaluation, failure attribution, and reward adaptation. After each training stage, it performs outcome-grounded backward attribution on low-outcome trajectories, aggregates recurrent and policy-controlled capability bottlenecks, and dynamically selects the corresponding process rewards for the next stage. Recurrent failures not covered by the existing capability space trigger a separate, controlled expansion procedure. We evaluate REWARDWEAVER on SOTOPIA, Amazon?HistoryPrice, and a newly constructed Sales Benchmark. Across social interaction, bilateral bargaining, and domain-specific sales, REWARDWEAVER establishes new state-of-the-art (SOTA) results. Ablations further demonstrate the importance of dynamic reward allocation, failure-grounded attribution, and stable semantics for admitted capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RewardWeaver 为长程交互语言 agent 提出自演化奖励适配框架：每阶段训练后对低结果轨迹做结果导向的反向归因，聚合反复出现且受策略控制的能力瓶颈，再为下一阶段动态挑选对应过程奖励，未覆盖的反复失败触发受控的能力空间扩展。在 SOTOPIA、Amazon-HistoryPrice 与新建 Sales Benchmark 上覆盖社会交互、双边议价与销售三类任务，取得新的 SOTA。
Motivation: RLVR 在结果可验证的任务上进展显著，但长程交互中终端反馈稀疏、信用分配困难；过程奖励虽更稠密，可训练中最相关的能力会随策略演化而变化，易评估或常出错的行为未必是当前限制任务成功的瓶颈。
Method: 维护一个语义固定的能力空间（admitted Rubrics 语义不变），把策略优化、任务评估、失败归因与奖励适配闭环：每阶段后对低结果轨迹做 outcome-grounded backward attribution，聚合 recurrent 与 policy-controlled 能力瓶颈并动态选择下一阶段过程奖励；未被现有能力空间覆盖的反复失败触发独立的受控扩展流程。
Result: 在 SOTOPIA、Amazon-HistoryPrice 和新建 Sales Benchmark 上，覆盖社会交互、双边议价与领域销售三类长程任务，建立新的 SOTA；消融实验表明动态奖励分配、失败导向归因与已接纳能力的稳定语义均对性能有贡献。
Conclusion: 过程奖励必须随策略演化重新适配：以结果为锚的失败归因加语义稳定的能力空间，能在长程交互语言 agent 上持续取得最优表现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: YANchor-4B: Effective Long-Horizon Reasoning in O(N) Time with O(1) Memory
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon reasoning demands access to earlier information at a manageable generation cost. Full-history attention incurs growing storage and computation, while recurrent compression can lose precise details. Therefore, we present YANchor-4B, a general-purpose recurrent model that preserves crucial memory as ANchors for retrieval during subsequent reasoning. Beyond $O(N)$-time generation and $O(1)$ memory, YANchor enables effective long-horizon reasoning through its multidimensional memory mechanism. For example, on challenging math problems, it achieves 82.93% mean pass@1 on AIME 2024--2026 and 63.64% on HMMT, substantially outperforming linear-time, constant-state counterparts, including larger models. It also delivers several-fold higher batched long-generation throughput than Transformer and hybrid baselines on H100. Furthermore, evaluations across dozens of benchmarks demonstrate YANchor's superiority in general-purpose capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: YANchor-4B 是一个通用循环 (recurrent) 长程推理模型，把关键历史信息保留为 ANchors 供后续推理检索，实现 O(N) 时间生成与 O(1) 记忆。在 AIME 2024–2026 上 mean pass@1 达 82.93%、HMMT 63.64%，显著超过同为线性时间、常数状态的更大模型，并在 H100 上比 Transformer 与混合基线高出数倍的批量长生成吞吐。
Motivation: 长程推理既要随时取回早期信息，又要控制生成开销：全历史 attention 的存储与计算随长度增长，循环压缩又会丢掉精确细节。
Method: 提出通用循环模型 YANchor-4B，用多维记忆机制把关键内容存为 ANchors，在后续推理中按需检索，从而在 O(N) 时间与 O(1) 记忆下完成长程推理。
Result: AIME 2024–2026 mean pass@1 82.93%，HMMT 63.64%，大幅领先线性时间、常数状态的同类模型（含更大模型）；在 H100 上批量长生成吞吐比 Transformer 与混合基线高数倍；数十个基准评测显示其通用能力占优。
Conclusion: 以 Anchor 检索为核心的循环记忆可以在常数状态预算下保住长程推理所需的精确细节，同时把长生成吞吐拉到 Transformer 之上。

summary_sections.motivation: 长程推理既要随时取回早期信息，又要控制生成开销：全历史 attention 的存储与计算随长度增长，循环压缩又会丢掉精确细节。
summary_sections.method: 提出通用循环模型 YANchor-4B，用多维记忆机制把关键内容存为 ANchors，在后续推理中按需检索，从而在 O(N) 时间与 O(1) 记忆下完成长程推理。

summary_sections.conclusion: 以 Anchor 检索为核心的循环记忆可以在常数状态预算下保住长程推理所需的精确细节，同时把长生成吞吐拉到 Transformer 之上。

papers.title: A Probabilistic Perspective on Wasserstein-Based Evidential Uncertainty for Out-of-Distribution Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Semantic segmentation networks operate on a fixed set of classes and therefore fail when out-of-distribution (OOD) objects appear during deployment, a critical limitation for safety-critical applications such as autonomous driving. Reliably identifying OOD objects requires well-calibrated epistemic uncertainty, yet common softmax-based confidence scores remain overconfident, while Bayesian alternatives such as Monte Carlo dropout or deep ensembles require costly repeated forward passes. Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) offers an efficient alternative by modeling class probabilities as a Dirichlet distribution learned from a single deterministic forward pass. Existing EDL formulations rely on Euclidean objectives that push predictions towards the simplex vertices, encouraging overconfidence rather than preserving uncertainty for unfamiliar inputs. We instead employ Wasserstein-based objectives, which respect the geometry of the probability simplex, and study the influence of the Wasserstein order on segmentation accuracy and OOD detection within a unified evidential framework. We evaluate this framework on a convolutional (DeepLabV3+) and a transformer-based (SegFormer) architecture on the SegmentMeIfYouCan benchmark, including LostAndFound, RoadObstacle21, RoadAnomaly21, and Fishyscapes. Our results show the optimal Wasserstein order is architecture-dependent: second-order objectives dominate on the convolutional backbone, third-order objectives on the transformer backbone, and our framework surpasses comparable baselines on most metrics, with a single deterministic forward pass.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用基于 Wasserstein 距离的 evidential 目标替代欧氏 EDL 损失，在概率单纯形几何下学习 Dirichlet 认知不确定性，单次确定性前向即可做 OOD 分割检测。最优 Wasserstein 阶数依架构而变：卷积 DeepLabV3+ 上二阶目标最优，Transformer SegFormer 上三阶最优，在 SegmentMeIfYouCan 基准多数指标上超过可比基线。
Motivation: 语义分割网络遇到分布外 (OOD) 物体会失效，而 softmax 置信度过自信、MC dropout 与 deep ensembles 需多次前向代价高；现有 EDL 用欧氏目标把预测推向单纯形顶点，反而加剧过自信。
Method: 以 Wasserstein 距离替代欧氏目标建模类概率的 Dirichlet 分布，保持单纯形几何；在统一 evidential 框架内考察 Wasserstein 阶数对分割精度与 OOD 检测的影响，卷积 backbone 用 DeepLabV3+、Transformer backbone 用 SegFormer，仅需单次确定性前向。
Result: 在 SegmentMeIfYouCan 基准（含 LostAndFound、RoadObstacle21、RoadAnomaly21、Fishyscapes）上，最优 Wasserstein 阶数依架构而定：DeepLabV3+ 上二阶目标占优，SegFormer 上三阶目标占优；框架在多数指标上超过可比基线，且只用单次确定性前向。
Conclusion: Wasserstein 阶数是 evidential OOD 分割中需按 backbone 类型选择的超参，卷积网络取二阶、Transformer 取三阶；单次前向即可达到超越可比基线的 OOD 检测表现。

papers.title: CAFE+FNO: Fourier Kernel Generation via Multiplicative Feature Composition
papers.abstract_en: The Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) learns solution operators of partial differential equations (PDEs) through Fourier-space kernel parameterization, but frequency truncation can limit the learning of high-frequency variations. AM-FNO and SirenFNO generate kernels for all grid modes from spectral coordinates using shared networks, making coordinate encoding and generator design important. Recent work on implicit neural representations (INRs) has proposed constructing frequency interactions through explicit feature composition rather than relying on subsequent MLPs to form them implicitly. Building on this approach, we propose CAFE+FNO, which incorporates Content-Aware Frequency Encoding+ (CAFE+) into Fourier kernel generation. CAFE+ combines Fourier--Chebyshev features through parallel affine branches and a Hadamard product, forming interactions within and across the two feature families. A kernel MLP maps the resulting representation of each normalized spectral coordinate to a complex channel-mixing matrix. Each layer shares its generator across all stored modes, making the number of trainable parameters independent of the number of modes for a fixed architecture. We compare CAFE+FNO with existing FNO variants on five PDE benchmarks and conduct ablation studies on basis configuration, multiplicative composition, and bandwidth learnability. Code and experimental configurations are available at https://github.com/fabsk101/CAFEPlusFNO.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CAFE+FNO 把 Content-Aware Frequency Encoding+ (CAFE+) 引入 Fourier kernel 生成：用并行 affine 分支加 Hadamard product 显式组合 Fourier 与 Chebyshev 特征，再由共享 kernel MLP 把每个归一化谱坐标映射为复数 channel-mixing 矩阵，缓解频率截断对高频变化学习的限制。在五个 PDE benchmark 上与现有 FNO 变体对比，并对基配置、乘性组合、带宽可学习性做 ablation。
Motivation: FNO 的频率截断限制高频变化的学习；AM-FNO、SirenFNO 用共享网络从谱坐标生成全模式 kernel，使坐标编码与生成器设计成为关键，而 INR 工作表明频率交互可通过显式特征组合而非后续 MLP 隐式形成。
Method: CAFE+ 用并行 affine 分支组合 Fourier 与 Chebyshev 特征并做 Hadamard product，形成族内与跨族交互；kernel MLP 将每个归一化谱坐标映射为复数 channel-mixing 矩阵，每层在所有存储模式间共享该生成器，使固定架构下可训练参数量与模式数无关。
Result: 在五个 PDE benchmark 上与现有 FNO 变体比较，并对 basis configuration、multiplicative composition、bandwidth learnability 做 ablation；代码与实验配置发布于 github.com/fabsk101/CAFEPlusFNO。
Conclusion: 显式乘性特征组合可用于 Fourier kernel 生成，且共享生成器让参数量不随模式数增长。

papers.title: ExperienceIndex: Artifact-Grounded Memory
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge-intensive tasks require answering many questions by reasoning about a shared corpus of artifacts (e.g., court cases, or scientific literature). As humans interact with these corpora, they naturally accumulate experiential knowledge about artifacts, enabling them to quickly identify the complete set of relevant artifacts for each new task. However, existing AI agents lack appropriate memory solutions to build or reuse such artifact-grounded experience, leading to lower answer quality and higher online cost. Existing memory solutions extract and reuse information from prior task-solving traces, but they primarily focus on user preferences, factual attributes, or abstract reasoning patterns rather than persistent artifact-specific knowledge. We introduce ExperienceIndex, a novel experience layer for AI agents that captures and reuses knowledge about artifacts based on prior reasoning traces. ExperienceIndex stores two complementary forms of experience: (i) single-artifact experiences that summarize an artifact's contribution to prior tasks and (ii) artifact-pair experiences that encode structural relationships discovered during past reasoning. Integrated as lightweight middleware, ExperienceIndex uses an experience retrieval mechanism to guide agents toward the complete set of relevant artifacts for new tasks, improving both answer quality and efficiency. Across diverse corpora and agentic solutions with different search frameworks, ExperienceIndex delivers consistent gains, raising answer quality by up to 11.0 points and reducing online dollar cost by up to 50.5%. We further demonstrate two benefits: (i) cross-task generalization, where experiences accumulated from text-to-SQL tasks transfer to factoid QA tasks over the same artifact corpus, and (ii) teacher-student learning, where experiences from a stronger model enable a weaker model to reach comparable performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ExperienceIndex 为 AI agent 增加一个 artifact 层经验中间件，把先前推理轨迹沉淀为单 artifact 摘要与 artifact-pair 结构关系两类经验，检索后引导 agent 找齐新任务所需的完整相关 artifact 集合。在多种语料与不同搜索框架的 agentic 方案上，答案质量最多提升 11.0 点，在线美元成本最多下降 50.5%，且经验可从 text-to-SQL 迁移到同语料的 factoid QA、由强模型经验带动弱模型达到相当性能。
Motivation: 知识密集任务需要在共享 artifact 语料（案件、文献）上反复推理，但现有 agent 缺少沉淀与复用 artifact 级经验的记忆方案，导致答案质量低、在线成本高；已有记忆方案多针对用户偏好、事实属性或抽象推理模式，而非持久的 artifact 专属知识。
Method: 提出 ExperienceIndex，作为轻量 middleware 集成到 agent 中，存储两类互补经验：单 artifact 经验总结该 artifact 对既往任务的贡献，artifact-pair 经验编码过去推理中发现的结构关系；再用经验检索机制引导 agent 定位新任务的完整相关 artifact 集合，可搭配不同搜索框架的 agentic 方案。
Result: 在多种语料与不同搜索框架的 agentic 方案上取得一致增益：答案质量最多提升 11.0 点，在线美元成本最多下降 50.5%。跨任务泛化上，text-to-SQL 任务积累的经验可迁移到同一 artifact 语料上的 factoid QA；teacher-student 上，强模型经验可让弱模型达到相当性能。
Conclusion: 把 artifact 级经验作为独立于对话轨迹的记忆层，可以同时抬高知识密集问答的答案质量并压低在线成本，且经验可跨任务、跨模型复用。

papers.title: Temporal Residual Bottleneck for Robust Asynchronous Collaborative Perception
papers.abstract_en: Collaborative perception extends the sensing range of autonomous vehicles, but its performance degrades when shared features arrive stale or incomplete. Most latency-robust methods compensate delayed collaborator features through flow-guided alignment or direct feature transport. In this work, we formulate asynchronous collaborative perception as temporal residual prediction. Our Temporal Residual Bottleneck keeps a deterministic pose-warped collaborator feature as a conservative anchor and uses a $Δt$-conditioned xLSTM to extract residual temporal evidence from the available history. A detector-facing residual bottleneck then applies only gated, regularized corrections before ego-side fusion, reducing the risk of overwriting reliable static structure when temporal correspondence is uncertain. Experiments on DAIR-V2X and OPV2V show that our method is especially effective under severe fixed/irregular delays and packet drops. On DAIR-V2X, the reported checkpoint trades a small amount of synchronized peak accuracy for better robustness under stronger communication degradation. Controlled diagnostics further indicate that direct feature transport has oracle headroom but can become unreliable when deployed without accurate correspondence. These results support temporal residual fusion as a practical alternative for asynchronous and incomplete collaborative perception. Code will be publicly released at https://url.fzi.de/8dk38.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把异步协同感知重构为时序残差预测：以位姿对齐的协同特征作保守锚点，用 Δt 条件化的 xLSTM 从历史中提取残差时序证据，再经带门控与正则的残差瓶颈做受控修正后融合。在 DAIR-V2X 与 OPV2V 上，该方法在严重固定/不规则时延与丢包下更稳，DAIR-V2X 的检查点以少量同步峰值精度换取更强通信退化下的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 协同感知中共享特征常过期或缺失，现有延迟鲁棒方法依赖光流对齐或直接特征搬运，一旦对应关系不准就不可靠，会覆盖 ego 侧可靠的静态结构。
Method: 将异步协同感知建模为时序残差预测：Temporal Residual Bottleneck 保留位姿对齐 (pose-warped) 的协同特征作为确定性锚点，用 Δt 条件化的 xLSTM 从可用历史提取残差时序证据；面向检测器的残差瓶颈只施加带门控、带正则的修正，再进入 ego 侧融合。
Result: 在 DAIR-V2X 与 OPV2V 上，方法在严重固定/不规则时延与丢包条件下尤其有效；DAIR-V2X 上所报检查点以少量同步峰值精度换取更强通信退化下的鲁棒性。受控诊断显示直接特征搬运有 oracle 上限，但在缺乏准确对应关系部署时会变得不可靠。
Conclusion: 时序残差融合是异步、不完整协同感知的实用替代方案：对应关系不确定时宁可用保守锚点加受控修正，也不要直接搬运特征。
