papers.title: SkillSandbox: Skill Verification via Dynamic Scenario Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving agents distill task-solving experience into skills for future reuse, but these skills can encode incorrect procedures or non-transferable knowledge. It is therefore critical to verify each skill's reusability: whether its guidance remains useful beyond the experience from which it was distilled. Such verification requires observing how a skill affects execution in new tasks, yet existing tasks may not expose the situations where the target skill can actually be exercised. To construct such situations, we propose SkillSandbox, a framework that dynamically synthesizes a task and its environment for each skill that are skill-relevant yet novel. A Proposer specifies the conditions to preserve and the source-specific details to vary, a Builder constructs an executable scenario, and a Verifier compares executions with and without the skill. The Verifier assesses executability, utility, and efficiency to assign a Keep or Reject verdict, determining whether the skill enters the library. Across ALFWorld and WebShop with three models, SkillSandbox consistently yields the strongest downstream performance and improved execution efficiency. Further analyses examine whether these gains reflect accurate assessment of skill reusability and identify which components of SkillSandbox contribute to them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkillSandbox 为自进化 agent 的每条 skill 动态合成既相关又新颖的任务与环境，用带/不带 skill 的执行对比给出 Keep 或 Reject 判定。在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop、三种模型上，该框架持续取得最强下游性能并提升执行效率。
Motivation: skill 可能固化错误流程或不可迁移知识，而现有任务往往不暴露该 skill 真正可用的情境，导致复用性无法被验证。
Method: 三个组件协作：Proposer 指定需保留的条件与需变化的来源细节，Builder 构建可执行场景，Verifier 对比带与不带 skill 的执行，按可执行性、效用、效率给出 Keep/Reject 并决定 skill 是否入库。
Result: 在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上、用三种模型运行，SkillSandbox 持续取得最强下游性能并改善执行效率；另有分析检验增益是否反映对 skill 复用性的准确评估，以及哪些组件贡献了增益。
Conclusion: 通过为每条 skill 合成专属新场景并做对照执行，可以判定其是否值得入库，且该判定带来下游性能与效率的同步提升。

papers.title: Multi-Agent Coordination via Support-Preserving Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Offline MARL increasingly relies on generative policies to model multimodal joint behavior, typically by distilling a centralized teacher into decentralized one-step actors under the CTDE. We identify a failure mode at the teacher training stage: standard flow-based teachers pair noise with replay targets independently, so nearby noise samples can be routed toward conflicting coordination modes. The teacher then produces samples between valid modes, and because the distillation loss regresses each local actor onto the conditional mean of the teacher's output given local input, this error is not absorbed but propagated to the student. To remove this teacher-side artifact, we propose Mode-Support Semi-Discrete Optimal Transport (MoSDOT), which summarizes multimodal replay into a finite mode support with prescribed capacities and uses conditional semi-discrete optimal transport to assign each noise sample to a single mode before teacher training. We additionally study a shared-randomness variant that uses a shared noise component at execution to expose the residual gap intrinsic to strict-product execution. On controlled diagnostics and offline MARL benchmarks, MoSDOT improves endpoint quality and routing consistency, particularly on datasets exhibiting multimodal joint behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 离线多智能体强化学习中，把多模态联合行为蒸馏给去中心化单步 actor 时，标准 flow-based teacher 独立配对噪声与 replay 目标，会把噪声路由到冲突的协调模式，且蒸馏损失把该误差回归到条件均值并传给学生。MoSDOT 先用带容量约束的有限模式支撑概括 replay，再用条件半离散最优传输 (semi-discrete optimal transport) 在 teacher 训练前把每个噪声样本唯一指派到一个模式。在受控诊断与离线 MARL benchmark 上，MoSDOT 提升端点质量与路由一致性，在多模态联合行为数据集上改善尤其明显。
Motivation: CTDE 框架下把集中式 teacher 蒸馏为去中心化单步 actor 时，teacher 训练阶段的噪声-目标配对会把冲突协调模式的误差注入样本，而蒸馏损失按条件均值回归无法吸收该误差，直接传给学生。
Method: 提出 Mode-Support Semi-Discrete Optimal Transport (MoSDOT)：用带规定容量的有限模式支撑概括多模态 replay 数据，在 teacher 训练前用条件半离散最优传输把每个噪声样本指派到单一模式；另研究执行时共享噪声分量的 shared-randomness 变体，以暴露严格乘积执行的残余差距。
Result: 在受控诊断与离线 MARL benchmark 上，MoSDOT 改善端点质量 (endpoint quality) 与路由一致性 (routing consistency)，在呈现多模态联合行为的数据集上提升尤为明显。
Conclusion: teacher 侧的噪声-模式配对是蒸馏误差的源头，先固定模式支撑再训练 teacher 能阻止该误差传给学生；共享随机性变体用于量化严格去中心化执行本身固有的残余差距。

papers.title: Activation-Aware Weight Tensorization: A Calibration-Time Preconditioner for Tensor-Network LLM Compression
papers.abstract_en: Post-training tensor-network compression replaces Transformer linear layers with Tensor Train (TT) or Tree Tensor Network (TTN) operators, but standard decompositions minimize weight-space Frobenius error rather than functional error under the layer's activation distribution. We propose Activation-aware Weight Tensorization (AWT), a training-free calibration wrapper that preconditions each weight matrix with a diagonal activation-derived scale before an unchanged TT/TTN solver and deploys the result with only an input-side elementwise rescaling. Across Llama 3.1 8B, Ministral 8B, and Qwen2.5 7B, AWT consistently improves vanilla TT/TTN tensorization at 2-6 times compression: under single-operator replacement, AWT closes 12-35% of the WikiText perplexity gap to the dense baseline across the three model families and 2-6 times compression settings; while under multi-operator Llama suffix replacement it closes 27-60% across attention-group and all-seven-matrix settings. The gains also transfer to downstream HellaSwag and ARC-Challenge evaluations. We further show that diagonal preconditioning is a robustness-modularity tradeoff rather than a diagonal-covariance assumption: a dense full-covariance oracle wins its own weighted objective in 80/81 cases, yet diagonal AWT gives better held-out functional fidelity in 53/81 cases. Together, these results position AWT as a principled, modular preconditioner for improving functional fidelity in fixed TT/TTN compression pipelines without modifying the decomposition solver.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AWT 是一个免训练的校准包装器：用激活统计构造对角缩放对权重矩阵做预条件，再送入完全不改的 TT/TTN 分解器，部署时只加一次输入侧逐元素重缩放。在 Llama 3.1 8B、Ministral 8B、Qwen2.5 7B 的 2–6 倍压缩下，单算子替换时 AWT 弥合了 WikiText 困惑度到 dense 基线差距的 12–35%，Llama 后缀多算子替换时弥合 27–60%。
Motivation: 标准 TT/TTN 分解最小化权重空间的 Frobenius 误差，而层的真实功能误差取决于激活分布，两者不一致导致压缩后困惑度损失；现有做法需要改动分解求解器本身。
Method: AWT (Activation-aware Weight Tensorization)：先用校准数据得到的激活对角尺度对每个权重矩阵做预条件，再调用未改动的 TT/TTN 求解器，部署时仅保留输入侧逐元素重缩放；对比对象包括 dense 基线与 dense full-covariance oracle 加权目标。
Result: 在三个模型族、2–6 倍压缩的单算子替换下，AWT 弥合 WikiText 困惑度到 dense 差距的 12–35%；Llama 后缀多算子替换（attention-group 与全部七个矩阵两种设置）弥合 27–60%；收益迁移到 HellaSwag 与 ARC-Challenge。对角预条件是鲁棒性-模块性权衡而非对角协方差假设：dense full-covariance oracle 在其自身加权目标上 81 例中赢 80 例，而对角 AWT 在 81 例中 53 例给出更好的留出功能保真度。
Conclusion: 在不修改分解求解器的前提下，激活感知的对角预条件是固定 TT/TTN 压缩管线 中提升功能保真度的有原则且模块化的手段；对角形式的胜出来自鲁棒性与模块性而非协方差假设更准。

papers.title: Sharp Asymptotic Theory of Maximum Likelihood Estimation for Gaussian Processes with an RBF Kernel
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian processes (GPs) are widely used across machine learning, spatial statistics, time-series analysis, optimization, Bayesian statistics, and scientific applications. A central component of a GP model is its kernel, which is typically specified through a parametric family. Among the most widely used choices is the radial basis function (RBF), also known as the squared exponential or Gaussian kernel, owing to its simple form, smoothness, and flexibility. In practice, the kernel parameters are routinely estimated by the maximum likelihood estimators (MLEs), as implemented by standard GP software. Despite this widespread use, the asymptotic behavior of the MLEs remains poorly understood under fixed-domain asymptotics, even for the RBF kernel. The main difficulty arises from the increasingly strong dependence among densely sampled observations and the nonlinear dependence of the covariance matrix on the kernel parameters. In this paper, we address this gap by providing, to the best of our knowledge, the first complete asymptotic characterization of the joint MLE of the spatial variance, lengthscale, and nugget variance under fixed-domain asymptotics. We establish consistency, derive convergence rates for all three parameters, prove joint asymptotic normality, and show that these rates are minimax optimal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在固定域 (fixed-domain) 渐近下，给出 RBF 核高斯过程空间方差、长度尺度、nugget 方差三者联合 MLE 的首个完整渐近刻画：证明相合性、导出三个参数各自的收敛速率、证明联合渐近正态，并说明这些速率是 minimax 最优的。
Motivation: GP 软件例行用 MLE 估计核参数，但即使对最常用的 RBF 核，固定域渐近下 MLE 的渐近行为仍不清楚；难点在于稠密采样下观测间依赖越来越强，且协方差矩阵对核参数是非线性依赖。
Method: 针对 RBF（squared exponential / Gaussian）核，在固定域渐近框架下分析空间方差、长度尺度、nugget 方差的联合最大似然估计，建立相合性与联合渐近正态性，并推导各参数收敛速率及其 minimax 下界。
Result: 给出三个核参数联合 MLE 的相合性、各自收敛速率与联合渐近正态性，并证明这些速率是 minimax 最优的；这是作者所知的首个该设定下的完整渐近刻画。
Conclusion: 标准 GP 软件所用的 RBF 核 MLE 在固定域渐近下具有完整且 minimax 最优的统计理论，其不确定性可用联合渐近正态来量化。

papers.title: Towards Calibrated Probabilistic Forecasts for Events of Interest via Outcome-Conditional Recalibration
papers.abstract_en: Calibration is an essential requirement for probabilistic predictions to be useful for decision making. While state-of-the-art prediction methods often yield miscalibrated predictive distributions, several post-hoc recalibration schemes have been proposed to generate calibrated predictions. However, popular recalibration schemes can conceal miscalibration in specific regions of the outcome space. Since particular outcomes, such as extreme events, often matter most for decision making, probabilistic predictions should be calibrated when evaluation is restricted to these outcomes. Hence, in this paper, we introduce outcome-conditional recalibration, a post-hoc method to recalibrate probabilistic predictions on user-defined regions of the outcome space. The method is simple, easy to implement, and can be applied to arbitrary predictive distributions. It works by applying the quantile recalibration approach of Kuleshov et al. (2018) to forecast conditional distributions, before rescaling these conditional distributions so that forecast event probabilities match empirical occurrence frequencies. This produces valid and continuous predictive distributions that are calibrated within each region of interest. Across regression benchmarks, we demonstrate that existing recalibration schemes do not necessarily yield calibrated predictions when interest is on particular outcomes, and that our approach improves outcome-conditional calibration relative to existing conditional and unconditional recalibration methods, while retaining competitive calibration overall. In an application to day-ahead electricity price forecasting, the approach substantially improves calibration when predicting negative prices, at negligible cost to forecast accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 outcome-conditional recalibration：在用户定义的结果区域（如极端事件）上做事后重校准，先对条件分布套用 Kuleshov et al. (2018) 的分位数重校准，再缩放使事件概率匹配经验发生频率，从而在每个关注区域内得到有效且连续、校准的预测分布。在回归基准上，该方法相对已有条件与无条件重校准提升了 outcome-conditional calibration，同时整体校准保持竞争力；在日前电价预测中，预测负电价时校准大幅改善，而预报精度代价可忽略。
Motivation: 主流事后重校准方案可能把结果空间特定区域（如极端事件）的失准掩盖掉，而决策恰恰最依赖这些区域的校准。
Method: outcome-conditional recalibration：对预测条件分布套用 Kuleshov et al. (2018) 的分位数重校准，再对条件分布做缩放，使预报的事件概率与经验发生频率一致；适用于任意预测分布，可在用户自定义的结果区域上执行。
Result: 在回归基准上，已有重校准方案在关注特定结果时并不必然给出校准预测，而本方法相对已有条件与无条件重校准方法改善了 outcome-conditional calibration，同时整体校准保持竞争力；在日前电价预测 (day-ahead electricity price forecasting) 应用中，预测负电价时校准显著改善，预报精度代价可忽略。
Conclusion: 校准必须按关注的结果区域来检验和重校准，全局校准指标会掩盖局部失准；该方法以可忽略的精度代价换来关注区域内的校准改善。

papers.title: HGP:An on-device personalized agent memory via hybrid graph storage
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents face challenges in personalized interactive tasks due to heterogeneous, multi-typed, and implicitly constrained long-term traces. Existing memory mechanisms struggle with accurate routing and retrieval, especially on-device where personalization is critical. Most methods use single-vector representations, blurring type distinctions and relational structure. We propose HGP, a hybrid graph memory framework. HGP employs a lightweight self-enhancement classifier for personalized memory routing and constructs episodic, semantic, and procedural memories as graphs. It also extracts working memory as a state trajectory to capture current state and implicit constraints, ensuring reliable decision-making. The classifier reduces large-model calls, enabling on-device deployment, while graph storage enables accurate retrieval and incremental user profile refinement. Experiments on two benchmarks show that on PAL-Set solution selection, HGP achieves an S-score of 35.58, nearly 7 points above the strongest baseline. Code and data are at https://github.com/Ouan6/HGP-.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HGP 用轻量自增强分类器做个性化记忆路由，把 episodic、semantic、procedural 三类记忆分别建成图，并把 working memory 抽成状态轨迹以捕捉当前状态与隐式约束。分类器减少大模型调用从而支持端侧部署，图存储带来准确检索与用户画像的增量细化；在 PAL-Set 的 solution selection 上 S-score 达 35.58，比最强基线高近 7 分。
Motivation: LLM agent 的长期轨迹异构、多类型且带隐式约束，现有记忆机制在路由与检索上不准，单向量表示又抹掉了类型区分与关系结构，端侧个性化场景尤其受限。
Method: 提出混合图记忆框架 HGP：轻量自增强分类器负责个性化记忆路由，将 episodic、semantic、procedural 记忆分别构造成图；working memory 以状态轨迹形式抽取，用于捕捉当前状态与隐式约束；分类器替代部分大模型调用以支持 on-device 部署。

Conclusion: 按类型分图存储加轻量路由分类器，可以在端侧同时做到准确检索、可靠决策与更低的大模型调用开销。

papers.title: Efficient Provably Private Classification with a Tabular Foundation Model
papers.abstract_en: Tabular data underpin prediction and decision-making in medicine, finance, government and science, but often contain sensitive individual-level information, creating a need for accurate prediction while preserving privacy. Traditional private learning provides formal privacy guarantees, but requires slow dataset-specific optimisation, suffers substantial utility loss under strong privacy, and is often difficult to apply correctly. Tabular foundation models adapt rapidly to new datasets, but existing models lack formal privacy guarantees, and are highly vulnerable to membership-inference attacks, limiting their use on sensitive data. Here we introduce PrivTab, an easy to use tabular foundation model for differentially private classification that embeds a privacy mechanism within its architecture. Pretrained on simulated datasets, PrivTab uses in-context learning to transform sensitive rows into compact, provably private summaries---effectively learning how to learn under privacy. PrivTab outperforms private linear and neural-network baselines under moderate-to-strong privacy, shows negligible membership leakage, maintains well-calibrated predictions under strong privacy, and reduces dataset fitting time by 10,000 times, requiring only a single forward pass. By combining formal privacy, speed, and easy of use, PrivTab brings recent advances in AI to applications where sensitive individual-level data have limited their adoption.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 PrivTab：把差分隐私机制内嵌进表格基础模型架构，用 in-context learning 把敏感行压成可证明私有的紧凑摘要，实现单次前向的私有分类。在中到强隐私设定下优于私有线性与神经网络基线，成员推断泄漏可忽略，强隐私下校准良好，数据集拟合时间降低 10,000 倍。
Motivation: 传统私有学习需逐数据集优化、速度慢且强隐私下效用损失大；现有表格基础模型适配快但无形式化隐私保证，易受成员推断攻击，难以用于含敏感个体信息的医疗、金融、政务数据。
Method: PrivTab 在模拟数据集上预训练，将隐私机制嵌入架构内部，通过 in-context learning 把敏感数据行转换为紧凑的可证明私有摘要（provable private summaries），推理只需一次前向传播。
Result: 在中到强隐私 (moderate-to-strong privacy) 下优于私有线性与神经网络基线；成员推断泄漏可忽略 (negligible membership leakage)；强隐私下预测保持良好校准；数据集拟合时间降低 10,000 倍，仅需单次前向。
Conclusion: 把形式化差分隐私、速度与易用性结合进表格基础模型，可让敏感个体级数据上的分类应用摆脱隐私限制。

papers.title: From Pixel to Coding: Evaluating the Figure Reproduction Capabilities of MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in both visual understanding and code generation. However, existing benchmarks typically evaluate these two modalities in isolation, lacking a dedicated assessment of their unification, i.e., how a model can perceive complex visual structures and synthesize them into precise, executable code. Moreover, current visual code generation benchmarks often rely on simplified layouts within single programming environments, falling short of evaluating true unified multimodal reasoning. To bridge this gap, we propose FigCodeBench, a comprehensive framework for rigorously evaluating MLLMs on figure reproduction, integrating multimodal comprehension and generation. We first design a systematic dataset construction pipeline, resulting in a total of 6,194 instances that cover 7 functional categories and 4 types of programming languages. We further categorize figure reproduction into three tiers with visual and code complexity modeling, specifically targeting complex structural reasoning, varying aspect ratios, and dense geometric constraints. We introduce a multi-dimensional evaluation protocol, encompassing visual fidelity and syntactic isomorphism, that aligns highly with the Mean Machine Opinion Score (MMOS) and human preferences. Based on our framework, we conducted extensive experiments on 24 widely used proprietary and open-source MLLMs (e.g., Gemini 3.1 Pro, GPT-5.4, and Kimi-K2.5), where we observed a universal, non-linear performance cliff across different programming languages and difficulty scenarios for all models, and gained several insights, such as the significant metric decline in rigid declarative languages.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 FigCodeBench，把图像理解与代码生成统一评测，用 6,194 个实例、7 类功能与 4 种编程语言考察 MLLM 从像素复现图表到可执行代码的能力。在 24 个专有与开源模型（Gemini 3.1 Pro、GPT-5.4、Kimi-K2.5 等）上观察到跨语言、跨难度的普遍非线性性能悬崖，刚性声明式语言指标下降显著。
Motivation: 现有基准把视觉理解与代码生成分开评测，视觉代码生成基准又多用单一编程环境下的简化布局，无法衡量模型把复杂视觉结构综合成精确可执行代码的统一多模态推理能力。
Method: 设计系统化数据集构建流水线产出 6,194 个实例，覆盖 7 个功能类别与 4 种编程语言；按视觉与代码复杂度把图表复现分为三档，针对复杂结构推理、不同长宽比与密集几何约束；评测协议同时度量视觉保真度与语法同构 (syntactic isomorphism)，并与 Mean Machine Opinion Score (MMOS) 及人类偏好对齐。
Result: 在 24 个专有与开源 MLLM（含 Gemini 3.1 Pro、GPT-5.4、Kimi-K2.5）上实验，所有模型在不同编程语言与难度场景中都出现普遍的非线性性能悬崖；刚性声明式语言上指标下降显著。数据集共 6,194 个实例、7 类功能、4 种语言、3 个难度档。
Conclusion: 图表复现暴露出 MLLM 统一多模态推理的系统性短板：难度与语言刚性上升时性能非线性崩塌，声明式语言尤其脆弱。

papers.title: Comprehension Audits to Mitigate Risks from Automated AI Research
papers.abstract_en: AI is already writing a majority of code for frontier AI labs. This creates a safety risk if there is insufficient human oversight. Existing work proposes minimum comprehension thresholds and unaided checks to mitigate this. To our knowledge, however, there is currently no published frontier-AI assurance regime that requires demonstrated evidence that the responsible humans understand what they are building as a precommitted condition for continuing development or usage. We propose comprehension audits, a novel development-process assurance mechanism in which the responsible people explain R&D contributions to auditors to demonstrate understanding. With independent administration and graded reports, they provide a gate: development of a contribution stops based on a failure to demonstrate human understanding until remediated, with escalating consequences for repeated failures. Our analysis of leading open-source AI projects finds increased output of code with reduced human review commentary rates per line of code, with far lower rates for automated fleet accounts. We advocate for labs to conduct them with embedded independent auditors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 comprehension audits（理解度审计）：由责任人向独立审计者口头解释 R&D 贡献以证明其理解，作为继续开发的预承诺门槛，未通过则该贡献的开发暂停直至整改，重复失败有升级后果。对领先开源 AI 项目的分析发现，每行代码的人工评审评论率随产出上升而下降，自动化 fleet 账号的评审率远低于人类。
Motivation: AI 已为前沿实验室写多数代码，人工监督不足即成安全风险；现有工作只提出最低理解阈值与无辅助检查，没有任何已发布的前沿 AI 保障机制把“证明责任人理解所建系统”作为继续开发或使用的前置条件。
Method: 提出开发过程保障机制 comprehension audits：责任人向审计者解释 R&D 贡献，由独立管理方实施并出具分级报告，形成理解未达标即停的门槛，重复失败触发升级后果；配套分析领先开源 AI 项目的代码产出与每行代码人工评审评论率，含自动化 fleet 账号对比。
Result: 对领先开源 AI 项目的分析显示：代码产出增加的同时每行代码的人工评审评论率下降，自动化 fleet 账号的评论率远低于常规账号。论文为 23 页、2 图、11 表。
Conclusion: 理解度审计可作为前沿 AI 开发的前置保障门槛，作者主张各实验室聘用嵌入式独立审计者来执行。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Loud Failures, Quiet Failures: Fault Detection and Recovery in Tool-Using Language Model Agents
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using agents are usually scored on whether they finish a task while the tools work. Deployments are less forgiving: services time out, endpoints disappear, parameter names change, and results come back well formed but wrong. Prior work has shown that language models over-trust tool outputs that fail silently; we ask how that over-trust plays out across the stages of failure handling in multi-turn agents. Wrapping the executable environments of an established function-calling benchmark in a fault-injection layer, we inject one of four typed faults at a controlled point in the trajectory and record whether the agent notices, changes plan, recovers the task, or repeats itself. Six models from three families, half of them reasoning variants, ran 1,920 trials over 24 multi-step tasks. Agents treat a failure as a problem in 91.3% of trials when the tool returns an explicit error, but in 58.8% of trials when it returns a plausible wrong value, against a 26.8% rate of reporting problems when nothing was wrong. Reasoning models are not better placed: paired against instruct siblings, they notice less (-9.3 points, p < .001) and change plan more (+10.4 points, p < .001), and recovery is unchanged (p = .512). Because agents are stochastic, two fault-free runs of the same task end in the same state only 63.3% of the time; against that baseline, only a missing tool clearly lowers recovery (39.9%), while timeouts, schema drift, and corruption stay within run-to-run variation. After a fault, agents return to the same tool three or more times in a row in up to 22.2% of trials, though strictly identical repeats are rare. A prompt line asking the agent to check each result did not move detection. Agents respond to the error channel rather than to the content of what a tool returns, so failures that stay inside the expected format pass through.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把函数调用 benchmark 的可执行环境包上故障注入层，注入四类故障后发现：工具返回显式错误时 agent 有 91.3% 的试次会当作问题处理，返回看似合理但错误的值时只有 58.8%，而无故障时也有 26.8% 误报。agent 响应的是错误通道而非返回内容，因此格式合规的静默失败会直接穿透；提示词里加一句“检查每个结果”对检测率没有作用。
Motivation: 现有评测只看工具正常时任务能否完成，但部署中服务超时、端点消失、参数改名、结果格式正确却错误是常态；已有工作表明模型会过度信任静默失败的工具输出，却不清楚这种过度信任在多轮 agent 的失败处理各阶段如何表现。
Method: 在一个已有的函数调用 benchmark 的可执行环境外包一层 fault-injection 层，在轨迹的受控位置注入四类带类型的故障（缺失工具、超时、schema drift、corruption），记录 agent 是否察觉、是否改变计划、是否恢复任务、是否重复调用；覆盖三个模型家族共六个模型（其中一半是 reasoning 变体），在 24 个多步任务上跑 1,920 次试次，并用无故障重复运行估计随机性基线。
Result: 显式错误下 91.3% 试次被当作问题，看似合理的错误值下只有 58.8%，无故障时误报率 26.8%。reasoning 模型相对 instruct 同门兄弟察觉更少（-9.3 个百分点，p < .001）、改变计划更多（+10.4 个百分点，p < .001），恢复无差异（p = .512）。同一任务两次无故障运行仅 63.3% 收敛到同一状态；以此为基线，只有缺失工具明显拉低恢复率（39.9%），超时、schema drift、corruption 都落在运行间波动内。故障后 agent 连续三次以上调用同一工具的比例最高达 22.2%，但严格相同的重复很少。提示词要求逐条检查结果对检测率无改善。
Conclusion: agent 的失败处理由错误通道驱动而非工具返回的内容，因此保持预期格式的静默失败能穿过检测；评估这类系统时应把格式合规的错误值与显式错误分开测，并以无故障重复运行的方差作为恢复率的对照基线。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 显式错误下 91.3% 试次被当作问题，看似合理的错误值下只有 58.8%，无故障时误报率 26.8%。reasoning 模型相对 instruct 同门兄弟察觉更少（-9.3 个百分点，p < .001）、改变计划更多（+10.4 个百分点，p < .001），恢复无差异（p = .512）。同一任务两次无故障运行仅 63.3% 收敛到同一状态；以此为基线，只有缺失工具明显拉低恢复率（39.9%），超时、schema drift、corruption 都落在运行间波动内。故障后 agent 连续三次以上调用同一工具的比例最高达 22.2%，但严格相同的重复很少。提示词要求逐条检查结果对检测率无改善。
summary_sections.conclusion: agent 的失败处理由错误通道驱动而非工具返回的内容，因此保持预期格式的静默失败能穿过检测；评估这类系统时应把格式合规的错误值与显式错误分开测，并以无故障重复运行的方差作为恢复率的对照基线。

papers.title: TRACK: Telemetry-Based Racing Analysis and Coaching Kit in Sim Racing Games
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents TRACK (Telemetry-Based Racing Analysis and Coaching Kit), which is a framework for analyzing driving performance in sim racing and profiling how individual drivers behave behind the wheel. We report this framework together with its limitations: we calibrate each clustering result against a null, and when one does not separate from chance, we say so. Instead of restricting ourselves to scoring drivers or sorting them into preset labels, we represent each recording session as a compact geometry in a four-dimensional behavioral space (speed, braking, strategy, and consistency), and we group these fingerprints by their similarity using unsupervised clustering. Over time, we have developed and refined this framework on the open Assetto Corsa Gym (ACGym) dataset. Our study suggests that corner types differ along a behavioral dimension that was not used to define them. It also suggests that when the car changes, only speed and consistency carry over in the restricted population, while repeatability could not be shown there for any of the braking or strategy measures. Cluster separation becomes less distinct as the range of available telemetry widens. Until that repeatability is shown, grouping on the braking and strategy dimensions cannot treat the car as interchangeable, which divides an already small sample into smaller cells. It is also not clear whether a driver's grouping carries over from one corner type to the next. We also normalize each metric against a reinforcement-learning reference agent. The reference does not depend on the sample, so the scale does not shift when the sample does. We intend these results as an analytical foundation for a personalized improvement suggestion system. The sample is small. The cross-car result changes when the sample is defined more broadly. These outcomes are preliminary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRACK 把模拟赛车 (sim racing) 每段录制会话编码为四维行为空间（速度、制动、策略、一致性）中的紧凑几何，用无监督聚类分组驾驶风格，并把每个聚类结果对照 null 检验，无法与随机区分时直接声明。在 Assetto Corsa Gym (ACGym) 数据集上，弯道类型在一个未参与定义弯道的行为维度上分离；换车后仅速度与一致性可迁移，制动与策略指标无可重复性，且遥测范围越宽聚类分离越弱。
Motivation: 模拟赛车遥测数据已有，但把车手表现打分或塞进预设标签的做法无法刻画个体驾驶行为差异，也缺少对聚类是否真超出随机的校准，难以支撑个性化改进建议。
Method: 将每段录制会话表示为四维行为空间（speed、braking、strategy、consistency）中的紧凑几何，按相似度做无监督聚类；每个聚类结果对照 null 校准，不与随机区分时如实报告。每项指标再对一个不依赖样本的强化学习参考 agent 归一化，使量表不随样本漂移；框架在 ACGym 数据集上迭代开发。
Result: 弯道类型在一个未用于定义它们的行为维度上存在差异；换车后在受限样本中只有速度与一致性可迁移，任何制动或策略度量都未能显示可重复性；可用遥测范围变宽时聚类分离变弱；样本量小，跨车结果在更宽的样本定义下会改变，部分聚类无法与随机区分。
Conclusion: 在制动与策略维度上分组时不能把车视为可互换的，否则会把本已很小的样本切得更碎；这些结果是初步的，作者将其定位为个性化改进建议系统的分析基础。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: WxFM-XL: Adapting Univariate Foundation Models to Multi-Station Weather Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: With the rise of univariate time series foundation models (e.g., Sundial, Timer), initial efforts have been made to extend them to multivariate settings. However, these models mainly focus on modeling correlations among variables. When they are applied to multi-station weather forecasting, two important factors are often overlooked: (1) the spatial information of stations, and (2) different error priors of different stations relative to the foundation model. In this paper, we propose WxFM-XL, a model for adapting univariate time series foundation models to multi-station weather forecasting. WxFM-XL introduces a cross-station error correlation prior graph to capture stationwise error priors with respect to the foundation model. Building on this, we further propose a dynamic fusion mechanism that adaptively integrates a spatial correlation graph with the error correlation prior graph. Experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that our model outperforms state of the art baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WxFM-XL 把单变量时间序列基础模型（如 Sundial、Timer）适配到多站点天气预报：用跨站点误差相关先验图刻画各站点相对基础模型的误差先验，再用动态融合机制把空间相关图与该先验图自适应结合。在多个数据集上超过 SOTA 基线。
Motivation: 现有把单变量基础模型扩展到多变量的工作只建模变量间相关，落到多站点天气预报时忽略了站点空间信息，以及不同站点相对基础模型的误差先验差异。
Method: 提出 WxFM-XL：构建 cross-station error correlation prior graph 来捕获各站点相对基础模型的误差先验；在此之上用动态融合机制自适应整合 spatial correlation graph 与误差先验图，从而把单变量基础模型适配到多站点预报。
Result: 在多个数据集上的实验中，WxFM-XL 超过 state of the art 基线。
Conclusion: 多站点天气预报不能只建模变量相关，把站点空间图与站点级误差先验图一起融合，才能有效适配单变量时间序列基础模型。
Relevance: 62

papers.title: Transition Path Sampling Using Koopman Operators and Exit-Time Optimal Control
papers.abstract_en: Sampling transitions between metastable states is a central problem in dynamical systems theory and molecular dynamics in particular. A key challenge is the existence of high free-energy barriers that separate the states, making transitions extremely rare. Recent machine learning-based methods cast transition path sampling (TPS) as an optimal stochastic control (OSC) problem over a fixed time horizon, and parameterize the drift bias via a neural network trained by simulation-in-the-loop, requiring repeated biased rollouts. To address computational and performance guarantee issues of these models, we propose a new approach for the problem based on Koopman operators. Because Koopman operators are linear, their leading eigenfunctions reveal the metastable sets and provide an estimate of the committor function with no transition path information required. Furthermore, we formulate TPS as an OSC problem up to an exit time. Our time horizon is the first hitting time of the target set, and our running cost penalizes time spent in nonreactive regions by encoding the estimated committor function. We derive the optimal controller in closed form and approximate it in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS). This reduces the problem of constructing the optimal controller to solving a single equality-constrained quadratic program, whose solution can be characterized by a linear Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) system. On the two-channel double well and alanine dipeptide, our controller increases the fraction of trajectories reaching the target from 0% to 99.8% within 1000 steps, and from 0% to 93% within 1ps, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把过渡路径采样 (TPS) 改写成以首达时间为终点的最优随机控制问题，用 Koopman 算子的主特征函数估计 committor，无需任何过渡路径信息；最优控制器有闭式解并在 RKHS 中逼近，最终化为单个等式约束二次规划。在 two-channel double well 上 1000 步内到达目标的轨迹比例从 0% 提到 99.8%，在 alanine dipeptide 上 1ps 内从 0% 提到 93%。
Motivation: 亚稳态之间被高自由能垒隔开、跃迁极稀有；现有基于神经网络的 simulation-in-the-loop OSC 方法需要反复带偏置 rollout，带来计算开销且缺少性能保证。
Method: 用 Koopman 算子的线性结构与主特征函数识别亚稳态集并估计 committor（不需过渡路径数据）；把 TPS 表述为以目标集首达时间为时域的 exit-time OSC，running cost 通过 committor 惩罚在非反应区停留；最优控制器闭式导出后在 RKHS 中逼近，问题归结为单个等式约束 QP，由线性 KKT 系统求解。
Result: two-channel double well 上，1000 步内到达目标的轨迹比例由 0% 升至 99.8%；alanine dipeptide 上，1ps 内由 0% 升至 93%。
Conclusion: Koopman 线性化加 exit-time 最优控制可以在不依赖过渡路径信息的前提下给出闭式控制器，并把 TPS 归约为一个可解的约束二次规划。

papers.title: AdSpark: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Product-Centric Advertisement Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Product-centric advertisement video generation aims to create promotional videos that preserve fine-grained product identity while presenting selling points through coherent multi-shot narratives. However, this emerging task remains underexplored due to the lack of large-scale advertisement-specific datasets and comprehensive evaluation frameworks. To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{AdSpark}, a large-scale dataset and benchmark for product-centric advertisement video generation, based on data from a major e-commerce platform. \textit{AdSpark-300K} contains approximately 300K reference image--prompt--video triplets, comprising a real-world subset and a synthetic subset. Each sample provides structured advertisement annotations, including product identity annotations, selling-point descriptions, creative plans, and aligned audio scripts, enabling models to learn product preservation and advertisement-oriented visual storytelling. We further propose \textit{AdSpark-Bench}, a diagnostic benchmark that evaluates generated advertisements across six dimensions, including visual quality, product fidelity, instruction adherence, temporal coherence, audio alignment, and advertisement effectiveness. Based on AdSpark-Bench, we evaluate representative models, revealing key challenges in product preservation, multi-shot storytelling, and selling-point visualization. Experiments with AdSpark-300K-finetuned models further validate the effectiveness of our dataset. AdSpark provides a unified dataset and benchmark for future research, and we will release the dataset upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdSpark 提出面向产品广告视频生成的大规模数据集与诊断基准：AdSpark-300K 含约 30 万条参考图-提示-视频三元组（真实与合成子集），每条带产品身份、卖点、创意方案与音频脚本标注；AdSpark-Bench 从视觉质量、产品保真、指令遵循、时序一致、音频对齐、广告效果六个维度评测。基于该基准评测代表性模型暴露出产品保持、多镜头叙事与卖点可视化的关键挑战，用 AdSpark-300K 微调的模型验证了数据集有效性。
Motivation: 产品中心的广告视频生成需要在多镜头叙事中保持细粒度产品身份，但缺少广告专用的大规模数据集与综合评测框架，该任务长期未被充分研究。
Method: 构建 AdSpark-300K：约 300K 条参考图-提示-视频三元组，分真实与合成子集，附结构化广告标注（产品身份、卖点描述、创意方案、对齐音频脚本）；提出六维度诊断基准 AdSpark-Bench，并用 AdSpark-300K 微调模型做验证实验。
Result: AdSpark-300K 含约 300K 三元组；AdSpark-Bench 覆盖六个评测维度；在其上评测代表性模型，揭示产品保持、多镜头叙事、卖点可视化三方面关键挑战；AdSpark-300K 微调实验验证数据集有效性。
Conclusion: 广告专用的大规模结构化数据集加多维度诊断基准，可支撑产品身份保持与广告导向视觉叙事的学习，数据集计划在论文接收后发布。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning to Accumulate Knowledge with Mutual Information
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents can improve their performance by reusing knowledge distilled from past interactions. However, curating new experiences into a knowledge bank that becomes more useful as it grows remains challenging. Effective knowledge accumulation should limit redundant overlap among entries and ensure that new knowledge contributes beyond what the bank already provides. Yet training a curator with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on standalone task success can reinforce general guidance even when it duplicates existing knowledge. Therefore, we propose Knowledge Weaver, a reinforcement learning framework that trains a language model to curate reusable knowledge from agent trajectories. We couple feedback inspired by token-wise mutual information (MI) with marginal success rewards to guide knowledge accumulation. Together, these signals encourage the curator to preserve distinct information from experience and produce entries that improve task success when added to existing knowledge. Standalone success rewards also favor entries that are useful on their own. On ALFWorld and WebShop, Knowledge Weaver achieves mean success rates of 54.0\% and 42.0\% with k=10 retrieved entries, exceeding GRPO by 16.9 and 18.7 percentage points, respectively. Its knowledge banks also outperform the evaluated prompt-based and established banks, including human-written banks, in overall ALFWorld success rate and WebShop score with the executor frozen. Our codebase is available at https://github.com/LaoKuiZe/Knowledge-Weaver.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Knowledge Weaver 用强化学习训练 LLM 从 agent 轨迹中提炼可复用知识条目，把 token 级互信息 (MI) 反馈与边际成功奖励耦合，抑制与已有知识库重复的泛化条目。在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上，k=10 检索条目时平均成功率分别达 54.0% 和 42.0%，比 GRPO 高 16.9 和 18.7 个百分点。
Motivation: 用 GRPO 只按单条任务成功训练知识整理器，会强化即使与已有知识重复的泛化指导，知识库随增长无法持续变得更有用。
Method: Knowledge Weaver 是一个 RL 框架，训练语言模型从 agent 轨迹中整理可复用知识；奖励由 token 级互信息 (MI) 反馈与边际成功奖励耦合而成，前者保留经验中的独特信息，后者衡量条目加入现有知识库后对任务成功的增益，同时保留单条成功奖励。
Result: 在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上，k=10 检索条目时平均成功率分别为 54.0% 与 42.0%，超过 GRPO 16.9 与 18.7 个百分点；在 executor 冻结的设置下，其知识库在 ALFWorld 总成功率与 WebShop score 上优于所评测的 prompt-based 知识库与既有知识库（含人工撰写的知识库）。

papers.title: Evolve on the Host, Predict on the Edge: Deploying Online Neuroevolutionary Architecture Search for Cross-sectional Stock Return Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Accurate forecasting models are usually large, expensive to update online, and fixed in architecture once trained. We apply ONE-NAS, an online neuroevolutionary architecture search that evolves a population of small recurrent networks as each window of data arrives, to daily cross-sectional stock return prediction, and pilot it on a host and endpoint pipeline: the host runs the search and ships each generation's champion genomes over TCP/IP to a Raspberry Pi 4B, which predicts online. On the Pi a single champion predicts a 50-stock window in 24.6~ms and the ensemble of 40 island champions in 556~ms, far inside the daily decision cycle. On four panels of US mid-cap equities over 2022--2024, reading the population as a rank-mean ensemble of island champions returns $+27.5\%$ net of realised transaction costs, against $+11.3$ to $+14.8\%$ for online LSTM, online GRU and monthly-retrained LSTM baselines and $+4.5\%$ for the single best genome used in prior ONE-NAS work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 ONE-NAS（在线神经进化架构搜索）搬到横截面股票收益预测上：主机端随每个数据窗口进化小型循环网络种群，把每代冠军基因组经 TCP/IP 下发到 Raspberry Pi 4B 在线推理。在 2022–2024 年四组美国中盘股面板上，把种群读作 40 个岛屿冠军的 rank-mean 集合，扣掉实际交易成本后净收益 +27.5%，而在线 LSTM/GRU 与月度重训 LSTM 基线为 +11.3% 至 +14.8%。
Motivation: 准确的预测模型通常体积大、在线更新昂贵，且训练完成后架构被固定，难以随新数据到来而适应。
Method: ONE-NAS 在每个数据窗口到达时进化一个小型循环网络种群；主机运行搜索，把每代冠军基因组经 TCP/IP 传给 Raspberry Pi 4B 做在线预测，形成 host–edge 流水线；种群按岛屿冠军的 rank-mean 集合读出。
Result: Pi 上单个冠军预测 50 股窗口耗时 24.6 ms，40 个岛屿冠军集合耗时 556 ms，均远在日度决策周期内。2022–2024 年四组美国中盘股面板上，rank-mean 集合扣实际交易成本后净收益 +27.5%，在线 LSTM、在线 GRU 与月度重训 LSTM 基线为 +11.3% 至 +14.8%，此前 ONE-NAS 工作中单个最佳基因组为 +4.5%。
Conclusion: 在线进化得到的架构集合在扣费后显著跑赢固定架构的在线与重训基线，且主机搜索加边缘推理的部署方式能满足日度交易的时延预算。

papers.title: Matching of signal, noise and hardware timescales for filtering and forecasting of correlated noise signals
papers.abstract_en: Physical reservoir computing exploits the nonlinear dynamics of physical systems to process time-dependent data with greater energy efficiency than conventional machine learning approaches. However, physical reservoirs have fixed intrinsic response timescales, whereas real-world signals combine deterministic and stochastic components across multiple timescales. Here we show, using a nanoporous niobium oxide reservoir, synthetic noisy signals and cryptocurrency-price volatility, that the relationship among noise correlation time, reservoir memory and forecast horizon determines whether correlated noise is filtered or predicted. Noise varying faster than the relevant reservoir memory and forecast horizon is averaged by the reservoir, whereas the temporal structure of slower-varying noise is sufficient for algorithmic forecasting. We introduce the reservoir memory horizon and forecasting regime index to distinguish these operating regimes. These contributions demonstrate that timescale matching can guide the encoding of input time series and development of physical reservoir architectures that filter, analyse and predict stochastic signal components across distinct temporal scales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用纳米孔氧化铌物理储层 (physical reservoir computing) 证明：噪声相关时间、储层记忆与预报时窗三者的相对尺度决定相关噪声是被平均掉还是被预报出来——快于储层记忆与预报时窗的噪声被储层平均，慢变噪声的时间结构足以支撑算法预报。为此提出储层记忆时窗 (reservoir memory horizon) 与预报体制指数 (forecasting regime index) 两个量来区分这两种体制。
Motivation: 物理储层的响应时间尺度是固定的，而真实信号的确定性与随机成分跨越多个时间尺度；缺少判据说明相关噪声何时该被滤除、何时可被预报。
Method: 在纳米孔氧化铌储层上，用合成含噪信号与加密货币价格波动两类输入，考察噪声相关时间、储层记忆与预报时窗之间的匹配关系，并据此引入 reservoir memory horizon 与 forecasting regime index 两个指标划分滤波/预报体制。
Result: 快于相关储层记忆与预报时窗的噪声被储层平均（滤波），慢变噪声则可被算法预报；该判据在合成噪声信号与加密货币价格波动两类数据上得到演示。
Conclusion: 时间尺度匹配可指导输入时间序列的编码方式与物理储层架构设计，使其按需对随机信号成分做滤波、分析或预报。

papers.title: Gaussian Equivalence for Multi-Head Self-Attention
papers.abstract_en: A theoretical understanding of multi-head self-attention is fundamental to the study of modern neural networks. Using random matrix theory, we establish Gaussian equivalence for multi-head self-attention: replacing softmax attention with rescaled scores plus Gaussian noise preserves the limiting spectral law of the centered output. This equivalence also covers value and output projections that depend on the keys. The resulting laws separate the effects of head allocation and projection widths, and distinguish spectrum-preserving across-head sharing from within-head key--value dependence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用随机矩阵理论证明多头自注意力的高斯等价：把 softmax 注意力替换为重标定分数加高斯噪声，中心化输出的极限谱律保持不变。该等价还覆盖依赖 key 的 value/output 投影，得到的极限律把头数分配与投影宽度的效应分开，并区分保持谱的跨头共享与头内 key–value 依赖。
Motivation: 多头自注意力的理论理解是现代神经网络研究的基础，但 softmax 非线性使谱分析困难，需要一个可解析的等价替身来分离结构设计（头分配、投影宽度、跨头共享）对输出谱的影响。
Method: 基于随机矩阵理论建立等价：将 softmax 注意力替换为重标定分数加高斯噪声，推导中心化输出的极限谱律；等价式同时纳入依赖 key 的 value 与 output 投影，并在极限律中分解头分配、投影宽度、跨头共享与头内 key–value 依赖各项。
Result: 证明了替换前后中心化输出的极限谱律保持不变（Gaussian equivalence）；所得极限律可分离头分配与投影宽度的效应，并区分谱保持的跨头共享和头内 key–value 依赖两种结构。
Conclusion: softmax 注意力在极限谱层面可由重标定分数加高斯噪声替代，因此多头自注意力的谱性质可由该高斯模型解析刻画，结构设计的影响能在极限律中逐项读出。

papers.title: Structure alone supports efficient visual computation in the Drosophila visual system
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the extent to which measured synaptic wiring determines computation remains a central challenge. Here, we couple the proofread adult Drosophila melanogaster connectome to an anatomically faithful model of its eye. Visual information is inputted in the eye model, then passed to the connectome, and finally read from a Kenyon-cell-centered linear decoder. This creates a connectome-only model in which the anatomical graph and eye geometry are fixed and only scalar synaptic gains and neuronal thresholds may be learned. The model supports multitask vision, including color discrimination, shape classification, and numerical discrimination that follows a ratio-dependent scaling characteristic of approximate number perception. To test whether precise connectivity is consequential under wiring economy, we compare the biological graph to randomized ensembles that increasingly preserve biological synaptic constraints. At matched wiring cost, the biological network consistently yields higher accuracy, whereas less constrained rewiring surpasses it at the cost of inflated wiring. These findings indicate that the measured connectivity and eye geometry jointly set efficient operating points for visual computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把果蝇成体 connectome 与解剖学忠实的眼模型耦合，只允许学习标量突触增益和神经元阈值，该 connectome-only 模型即支持颜色辨别、形状分类和数值辨别（数值辨别呈比率依赖的标度，符合近似数量感知特征）。在匹配布线成本下，生物连接图的准确率始终高于逐步保留生物突触约束的随机化集合；约束更少的重连虽能超过它，但代价是布线开销膨胀。
Motivation: 实测突触连接在多大程度上决定计算仍是核心问题：需要在布线经济 (wiring economy) 约束下判定精确连接是否真的带来计算优势。
Method: 将 proofread 的成体 Drosophila melanogaster connectome 与解剖学忠实的眼模型耦合：视觉信息先入眼模型、再入 connectome、最后由以 Kenyon cell 为中心的线性解码器读出；图结构与眼几何固定，仅学习标量突触增益与神经元阈值。对照组为逐步保留更多生物突触约束的随机化图集合。
Result: 模型支持多任务视觉（颜色辨别、形状分类、数值辨别，后者呈比率依赖标度）；在匹配布线成本下生物网络准确率始终更高，而约束较少的重连以布线开销膨胀为代价超过生物网络。
Conclusion: 实测连接与眼几何共同为视觉计算设定了高效工作点：精确连接的价值体现在同等布线成本下的准确率优势，而非无约束的性能上限。

papers.title: Controlling Dependence in Implicit Generative Models via Spread Mutual Information
papers.abstract_en: Mutual information (MI) provides an objective for suppressing or encouraging statistical dependence in implicit generative models. However, direct MI evaluation is challenging in implicit models due to typically intractable densities. A remedy is estimating the generator gradient from the difference between conditional and marginal scores. This score difference can, in turn, be estimated by differentiating a log density ratio learned through classification. This construction nevertheless faces two difficulties: (i) singular distributions need not admit the required score functions, and (ii) poor overlap can hinder density-ratio estimation. We therefore introduce Spread Mutual Information (SMI), a weighted integral of MI across noise levels obtained by applying a common spreading kernel to the generated variable. Gaussian spreading yields smooth, strictly positive conditional and marginal densities, extending the gradient construction to distributions that may originally be singular. Across a variaty of experiments, SMI consistently achieves effective dependence control among MI-based methods and remains competitive with established task-specific approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Spread Mutual Information (SMI)：对生成变量施加共同的 spreading kernel，把互信息改写为跨噪声水平的加权积分，从而在密度奇异、条件与边缘密度不可分时仍能用 score 差估计生成器梯度。高斯 spreading 使条件与边缘密度光滑且严格为正，把原 MI 梯度构造扩展到原本奇异的分布；在多组实验中 SMI 在基于 MI 的方法里稳定实现有效的依赖控制，并与既有的任务专用方法相当。
Motivation: 隐式生成模型中直接评估互信息困难：密度通常不可积，奇异分布未必存在所需 score，且条件与边缘分布重叠差会破坏分类式 density-ratio 估计，导致依赖抑制或增强的训练信号失效。
Method: SMI 对生成变量施加统一的 spreading kernel（如高斯），把 MI 表为跨噪声水平的加权积分；用分类学到的 log density ratio 的梯度估计 score 差，进而得到生成器梯度，训练时以该梯度控制生成分布的依赖结构。
Result: 在多组实验中，SMI 在基于 MI 的依赖控制方法中持续取得有效控制效果，并与已有的任务专用方法保持竞争力；摘要未给出具体数值指标。

papers.title: Oscillatory Neural Dynamics over Sheaves
papers.abstract_en: Effective long-range propagation remains a central challenge in graph neural networks, as increasing a model's propagation depth does not guarantee that distant nodes effectively influence each other. Sheaf neural networks enrich graph propagation through matrix-valued transport between stalks; still, this expressivity alone does not automatically imply effective long-range communication. We introduce ONDA, a long-range graph learning framework based on operator-valued information waves. Stalk-valued representations evolve through second-order dynamics governed by learned sheaf transport operators, combining wave-like propagation with expressive local geometry. We characterize long-range influence through a stalk-wise sensitivity analysis and show that the cross-influence never vanishes. Across long-range propagation, severe graph bottlenecks, graph transfer, and heterophilic benchmarks, ONDA consistently improves over scalar wave propagation, diffusive sheaf baselines, and state-of-the-art models, demonstrating the benefit of coupling wave dynamics with matrix-valued transport.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ONDA 用算子值信息波做长程图学习：stalk 表示按学到的 sheaf transport 算子做二阶波动动力学演化，把波动传播与矩阵值局部几何耦合。stalk 级敏感性分析证明跨影响 (cross-influence) 永不消失，在长程传播、严重图瓶颈、图迁移与异质图基准上一致优于标量波动传播、扩散型 sheaf 基线和 SOTA 模型。
Motivation: 图神经网络加深传播深度并不保证远距离节点真正相互影响；sheaf 网络的矩阵值传输本身也不自动带来有效长程通信。
Method: ONDA 框架以算子值信息波为核心：stalk 值表示在学到的 sheaf transport 算子支配下按二阶动力学演化，结合波动式传播与局部几何；并给出 stalk 级敏感性分析来刻画长程影响。
Result: 在长程传播、严重图瓶颈、图迁移和异质图 (heterophilic) 四类基准上，ONDA 一致优于标量波动传播、扩散 sheaf 基线与 SOTA 模型；理论结果为跨影响永不为零。
Conclusion: 把波动动力学与矩阵值 sheaf 传输耦合是获得可靠长程通信的有效途径，且该性质有敏感性分析支撑。

papers.title: What the Sleeve Feels: Explainable Machine Learning for Textile Pressure-Based Postural Screening
papers.abstract_en: Pressure-sensing smart textiles convert body-surface contact into a dense, image-like signal closely tied to posture and movement, making them a promising low-cost route to wearable posture screening. Realizing that promise, however, requires more than classification accuracy: a deployable system must generalize to wearers unseen during training, expose the physical evidence behind its decisions, and tolerate the small donning offsets that occur whenever a garment is removed and re-worn. This paper addresses these three requirements jointly using a knitted piezoresistive sleeve worn on the forearm as a testbed. We regroup fine-grained everyday activities into three coarser screening categories (neutral, potentially undesirable, and functional or transitional), engineer 29 interpretable pressure-distribution features spanning global intensity, spatial center of pressure, quadrant asymmetry, distribution complexity, and short-horizon temporal change, and evaluate under a strict subject-wise split. A tuned XGBoost classifier reaches 0.818 accuracy, 0.788 balanced accuracy, and 0.801 macro F1 on unseen test subjects, with tight frame-level bootstrap 95% intervals of about plus-minus 0.01 and a subject-to-subject standard deviation near 0.06 under leave-one-subject-out cross-validation. A simple 2D-CNN baseline trained on raw frames achieves broadly similar performance, showing that hand-engineered features are not left behind by a learned spatial representation on this task. SHAP-based explanation, a feature-group ablation, per-activity error analysis inside the pooled undesirable class, class-mapping sensitivity, and a simulated donning-rotation stress test together locate what the model relies on, where it degrades, and why, directly targeting the generalization, interpretability, and robustness gaps that determine whether such a system is deployable.

TL;DR: 用前臂针织压阻袖的压力分布图做姿态筛查，把日常动作重标为 neutral / potentially undesirable / functional or transitional 三类，靠 29 个可解释压力特征加 XGBoost 在未见受试者上达到 0.818 accuracy、0.801 macro F1。2D-CNN 吃原始帧表现相当，说明手工特征在该任务上没有被学习表征甩开；SHAP、特征组消融与模拟穿脱旋转压力测试共同定位模型依赖什么、在哪里退化。
Motivation: 可穿戴姿态筛查要落地，必须同时解决对训练中未见佩戴者的泛化、决策的物理证据可解释性、以及衣物脱下重穿时的小偏移鲁棒性，单看分类准确率不够。
Method: 以针织压阻前臂袖为测试台，把细粒度日常动作重组为三类筛查标签；提取 29 个可解释压力分布特征（整体强度、压力中心、象限不对称、分布复杂度、短时程变化），按受试者严格划分训练测试；调参 XGBoost 为主模型，2D-CNN 吃原始压力帧作对照，并做 SHAP 解释、特征组消融、类映射敏感性与模拟穿脱旋转压力测试。
Result: 在未见测试受试者上 XGBoost accuracy 0.818、balanced accuracy 0.788、macro F1 0.801，帧级 bootstrap 95% 区间约 ±0.01；leave-one-subject-out 下受试者间标准差约 0.06。2D-CNN 基线在原始帧上取得大体相当的性能。
Conclusion: 在该姿态筛查任务上，29 个可解释手工特征加树模型足以匹配学习式空间表征，且泛化、可解释性与穿脱偏移鲁棒性可以被同一套评估框架联合检验。

papers.title: A Drosophila Whole-Connectome Network Can Learn Human-Designed Cognitive Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Can a biological wiring diagram serve as a useful computational substrate beyond the behaviors for which it evolved? We use the publicly released MaleCNS v1.0 connectome, reconstructed from a single adult male Drosophila specimen, as the fixed recurrent topology of an artificial network. We train separate models for bounded addition and for a controlled grounded relational language task built from a fixed 100-word lexicon. In both models, one scalar is learned per anatomical edge. The anatomical graph reaches 92.77% mean accuracy on held-out addition, compared with 67.93% for directed degree-preserving rewires. On the strict paired language endpoint, which matches original and order-reversed scenes to their corresponding descriptions, it reaches 61.59% across four fixed interfaces, compared with 44.17% for matched rewires. At the canonical interface, it ranks first in a fixed 21-graph comparison. On the matched 48-group intervention subset, shuffling task-defined sensory features reduces its score from 60.94% to 19.27%. Together, these results show that higher-order MaleCNS wiring provides a reusable inductive bias for bounded addition and grounded relational language.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把果蝇 MaleCNS v1.0 全连接组固定为递归网络拓扑，每条解剖边只学一个标量，即可学会人类设计的认知任务：有界加法 held-out 准确率 92.77%（保有向度重连对照 67.93%），严格配对关系语言任务 61.59%（重连 44.17%）。打乱任务定义的感觉特征后分数从 60.94% 跌到 19.27%，说明性能依赖真实高阶布线而非单纯容量。
Motivation: 生物连接组是否可作为进化之外任务的通用计算基质尚不清楚：固定解剖拓扑究竟是可复用的归纳偏置，还是只对原生行为有效。
Method: 以公开的 MaleCNS v1.0（单只成年雄性果蝇重建）作为人工网络的固定递归拓扑，每条解剖边学习一个标量权重；分别训练有界加法模型和基于固定 100 词词表的受控落地关系语言任务，对照为保有向度的随机重连图，并在 21 图固定比较与 48 组干预子集上检验。
Result: 解剖图在 held-out 加法上平均准确率 92.77%，保有向度重连为 67.93%；严格配对语言端点（原图与顺序反转场景匹配对应描述）在四个固定接口上 61.59%，匹配重连为 44.17%，在固定 21 图比较中排第一；48 组干预子集上打乱任务定义感觉特征使分数从 60.94% 降到 19.27%。
Conclusion: 更高阶的 MaleCNS 布线为有界加法与落地关系语言提供了可复用的归纳偏置，且该优势在打乱感觉特征后基本消失。

papers.title: Scalable Patch-Level Self-Supervised Learning
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised learning (SSL) at scale produces powerful visual representations. However, most scalable SSL methods rely on ad hoc combinations of multiple objectives and stabilization mechanisms. Taking a step back, we ask if we can design a high-performing, yet principled SSL algorithm. Starting from the multi-view assumption, stipulating that task-relevant content is captured by the information common to different views, we construct an information-theoretic objective decomposing into interpretable terms. This derivation yields JEM, a student-teacher method that learns by aligning corresponding patch representations across views, explicitly regularized by information and structure preservation losses. JEM trains stably from 300M to 7B parameters, and, to our knowledge, is the first latent-space patch-level method demonstrated at 7B scale. Across all scales, JEM reaches strong performance on both global and dense probing tasks, on segmentation benchmarks consistently surpassing the DINOv2 algorithm, an influential foundation for today's strongest visual SSL methods. Notably, at 7B parameters, it exceeds the performance of DINOv3 on panoptic segmentation, despite being trained on $12\times$ less data without refinement stages. These results demonstrate that we can indeed design an SSL algorithm that learns strong representations, is principled and stable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JEM 从多视图假设出发推导出可分解为可解释项的信息论目标，得到一个按 patch 对齐跨视图表征、并显式加信息保持与结构保持正则的 student-teacher SSL 算法。它在 300M 到 7B 参数规模上都能稳定训练，是首个在 7B 规模验证的 latent-space patch-level 方法；在分割基准上一致超过 DINOv2，7B 时以 12 倍更少数据、且无 refinement 阶段超过 DINOv3 的 panoptic segmentation 表现。
Motivation: 规模化 SSL 目前靠多个目标与稳定化机制的临时拼装，缺少有原则、可解释且能稳定扩展到十亿级参数的算法设计。
Method: 以多视图假设（任务相关信息存在于不同视图的公共信息中）为起点，构造可分解为可解释项的信息论目标，导出 student-teacher 方法 JEM：跨视图对齐对应的 patch 表征，并以信息保持损失与结构保持损失做显式正则；训练规模覆盖 300M 到 7B 参数。
Result: 在 300M 到 7B 全部规模上训练稳定，为首个在 7B 规模展示的 latent-space patch-level 方法；在 global 与 dense probing 任务上均表现强，分割基准上一致超过 DINOv2；7B 参数时 panoptic segmentation 超过 DINOv3，且训练数据少 12 倍、无 refinement 阶段。
Conclusion: 有原则的信息论推导同样能产出既强又稳定的规模化 SSL 算法，patch 级 latent 对齐在 7B 规模可行，且数据效率可高于依赖大规模数据与 refinement 的 DINOv3。

papers.title: Playing with Kruskal: algorithms for flat and hierarchical watershed cuts
papers.abstract_en: In the framework of edge-weighted graphs, watersheds have proven to be linked to well-known optimization problems, as Minimum Spanning Tree, which allowed the design of efficient algorithms for computing (hierarchical) watershed segmentations. In the present article, after reviewing the literature related to watershed segmentation, we present a detailed end-to-end pipeline of algorithms to compute (hierarchical) watershed segmentations, starting from the computation of graph-based image representations, up to the computation of connected components of the final (hierarchical) segmentation. We consider the several variations of watersheds, including their supervised and unsupervised versions, and the various ways of computing seeds, to name a few. For the first time, we bring together all these watershed notions and algorithms in a compact and understandable way. We aim at providing a reference for those interested in employing and reimplementing the watershed segmentation framework for their task at hand.
papers.journal_ref: Journal of Mathematical Imaging and Vision, 2026, 68 (5), pp.65
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于图上分水岭分割 (watershed segmentation) 的综述与算法实现指南：把从图表示构建、种子点选取、多种分水岭变体（含监督与无监督版本）到层次分割连通分量提取的端到端流程首次统一整理。论文依托分水岭与最小生成树 (MST) 等优化问题的已知联系，目标是成为复现该框架的参考。
Motivation: 分水岭分割的算法变体、种子计算方式与层次化实现散落在文献中，缺少一份可直接照做、覆盖端到端流程的统一参考，阻碍在具体任务上重新实现。
Method: 给出端到端算法流水线：从基于图的图像表示计算出发，覆盖多种分水岭变体（监督与无监督版本）、多种种子计算方法，直至最终（层次）分割的连通分量计算；论述建立在分水岭与最小生成树等优化问题的已知等价关系上。

papers.title: Perceptually Aligned Evaluation of Style Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Style transfer lacks a reliable evaluation standard: ground truth is inherently ill-defined, and existing automatic metrics often fail to reflect human preference. This paper introduces ASTRA (Assessment of Style TRansfer Algorithms), an approach for automatic evaluation of style transfer algorithms; it contains two components, ASTRA-Data and ASTRA-Score. ASTRA-Data consists of a benchmark image set of content and style references, a collection of style transfer results generated on the benchmark set, and user study data capturing human judgements through a two-stage pairwise comparison protocol. From these annotations, we derive ranking-based ground truth for content preservation, style fidelity, and overall preference. Based on ASTRA-Data, we construct ASTRA-Score, a learnt evaluator that predicts preference-aligned scores from content-style-stylization image triplets, enabling automatic and scalable evaluation of new models applied to the benchmark set. Experimental results demonstrate that ASTRA-Score achieves substantially higher correlation with human rankings compared to prior metrics. Overall, ASTRA establishes a robust mechanism for standardised evaluation of style transfer methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ASTRA（Assessment of Style TRansfer Algorithms），由 ASTRA-Data 基准与 ASTRA-Score 学习型评估器组成，从两阶段成对用户研究中导出内容保持、风格保真与总体偏好的排序真值，再训练评估器对内容-风格-风格化三元组打分。ASTRA-Score 与人类排序的相关性显著高于既有指标，使风格转移模型的评估可自动、可扩展。
Motivation: 风格转移缺少可靠评估标准：真值本身难以界定，现有自动指标常与人类偏好不一致，新模型无法被公平比较。
Method: ASTRA-Data 包含基准内容/风格参考图像集、在该集上生成的风格转移结果，以及通过两阶段成对比较 (two-stage pairwise comparison) 协议采集的用户研究数据，据此导出内容保持、风格保真与总体偏好的排序真值；ASTRA-Score 是基于该数据构建的学习型评估器，从内容-风格-风格化图像三元组预测与偏好对齐的分数。
Result: 实验结果显示 ASTRA-Score 与人类排序的相关性相比既有指标 (prior metrics) 有大幅提升；摘要未给出具体相关系数数值。
Conclusion: 用人类成对偏好训练的评估器可以替代不可界定的真值，为风格转移方法提供标准化、可扩展的评估机制。

papers.title: Beyond Reward Suppression: Near-Optimal Offline Attacks on Warm-Start Bandits with Bounded Rewards
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial attacks on bandits aim to mislead a learner toward a target arm while keeping the attack cost small. Existing attacks typically achieve this by suppressing non-target arms. In practice, however, manipulation such as fake reviews often directly promotes the target item. We study this gap through bounded offline attacks on warm-start bandits, where an attacker can inject only valid action-reward pairs into the warm-start history before deployment. We show that target promotion is not merely a heuristic: when the target arm lies near the lower reward boundary, any order-optimal-cost attack against UCB that makes it selected in nearly all online rounds must allocate a nonvanishing fraction of its cost to the target arm. We then design an attack that achieves the optimal sublinear cost and characterize its allocation between target promotion and non-target suppression. We further extend the attack to Thompson Sampling, $ε$-greedy, and a broader class of bandit algorithms. Experiments on real-world and synthetic data validate the effectiveness of our attacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 warm-start bandit 的离线有界攻击，证明当目标臂接近奖励下界时，任何让 UCB 在几乎所有在线轮次都选中目标臂的近最优成本攻击，都必须把非消失比例的成本花在提升目标臂上，而非只压制其他臂；据此设计出达到最优次线性成本的攻击并给出提升/压制的成本分配刻画。
Motivation: 现有 bandit 攻击主要靠压制非目标臂来误导学习器，但现实中（如虚假评论）操纵往往是直接提升目标项，这一差距在 warm-start 离线注入合法动作-奖励对的设定下未被刻画。
Method: 研究 warm-start bandit 上的 bounded offline attacks：攻击者只在部署前向 warm-start 历史注入合法的 action-reward 对；先对 UCB 证明目标提升的必要性下界，再构造达到最优次线性成本的攻击并刻画其在目标提升与非目标压制间的成本分配，随后扩展到 Thompson Sampling、ε-greedy 及更广一类 bandit 算法。
Result: 证明当目标臂接近奖励下界时，使 UCB 在几乎所有在线轮次选中目标臂的任何 order-optimal-cost 攻击必须给目标臂分配非消失的成本比例；构造的攻击达到最优次线性成本，并在真实数据与合成数据上的实验验证了攻击的有效性。
Conclusion: 目标提升不是启发式技巧而是近最优攻击的必需成分，且该攻击框架可推广到 Thompson Sampling、ε-greedy 及更广一类 bandit 算法。

papers.title: Temporal Predictive Multiplicity: Equally Accurate Time Series Models Yield Different Forecast Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Models with near-identical predictive performance can yield substantially different predictions, a phenomenon known as predictive multiplicity. Prior work has mostly studied this at the level of individual scalar outputs. In time-series forecasting, however, predictions across horizons jointly define a trajectory, and horizon-wise comparisons can hide important differences in predictive behavior. To address this problem, we introduce temporal predictive multiplicity, a framework that characterizes disagreement over complete forecast trajectories among models with near-identical predictive performance. We show that constraining predictive performance alone can still admit a broad range of different trajectories. We further show that constraining multiplicity at individual horizons partially reduces, but does not eliminate, trajectory-level multiplicity. Experiments with 19 neural forecasting architectures on 11 datasets confirm that near-optimal models can exhibit substantial variability in the forecast trajectories they produce, and trajectory-level disagreement is largely unrelated to horizon-wise disagreement. Our framework, therefore, exposes a gap in existing multiplicity studies: models with indistinguishable predictive performance imply fundamentally different temporal trajectories, with consequential downstream effects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 temporal predictive multiplicity：在时间序列预测中，预测性能几乎相同的模型仍可能给出差异很大的完整预报轨迹，逐 horizon 的比较会掩盖这种差异。19 个神经预测架构、11 个数据集的实验确认近最优模型的轨迹变异显著，且轨迹级分歧与逐 horizon 分歧基本无关；只约束单点 multiplicity 只能部分减少、不能消除轨迹级分歧。
Motivation: 既有 predictive multiplicity 研究停留在单个标量输出层面，而时间序列的各 horizon 联合构成一条轨迹，逐 horizon 比较会隐藏预测行为上的实质差异，导致性能不可区分的模型在下游产生不同后果。
Method: 定义 temporal predictive multiplicity 框架，刻画近同性能模型在完整预报轨迹上的分歧；分别考察只约束预测性能、以及约束单个 horizon 的 multiplicity 两种设定下轨迹级分歧的残留情况，并在 19 个神经预测架构与 11 个数据集上做实验。
Result: 实验覆盖 19 个神经预测架构和 11 个数据集：近最优模型的预报轨迹存在显著变异；轨迹级分歧与逐 horizon 分歧基本无关；仅约束预测性能仍允许很宽的轨迹范围，仅约束单 horizon 的 multiplicity 只能部分减少而不能消除轨迹级 multiplicity。
Conclusion: 预测性能不可区分并不意味着时间行为一致——近同性能模型隐含根本不同的时间轨迹，现有 multiplicity 研究在轨迹层面存在缺口，逐 horizon 的评估与约束不足以保证下游一致性。

papers.title: Efficient Patch-Based Anomaly Detection Fused with Diffusion Driven Generative Modeling for Semiconductor Wafer Bin Map Open Set Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Spatial defect signatures on wafer bin maps (WBMs) trace yield loss to specific process faults, yet supervised classifiers recognize only the defect types seen during training, and one-class detectors built on a single mechanism tend to capture either local structural deviations or global distributional violations, but rarely both. This work proposes a hybrid one-class framework that couples a patch-based student-teacher detector (EfficientAD) with a denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) used for partial-diffusion reconstruction, and fuses their percentile-calibrated scores through a fixed convex combination. Trained on only 700 normal wafers from the WM-38K mixed-type dataset and evaluated on 18,658 held-out wafers, the fused detector reached an AUROC of 0.9985 and reduced misclassifications from 852 (DDPM) and 1,412 (EfficientAD) to 618, with all pairwise differences significant at p < 0.001. Beyond aggregate accuracy, the analysis shows that the gain arises from weakly overlapping errors between the two modules, yet fixed-weight fusion recovers only 40-70% of the correction available to an oracle selector. Under the benchmark's inverted class balance, average precision and F1 saturate, while the Matthews correlation coefficient and negative predictive value expose unreliable normal predictions. Pixel-level maps further show that strong image-level separability does not imply spatial localization, and the diffusion module succeeds as a local density prior rather than through global geometric reasoning. These findings motivate sample-adaptive fusion and imbalance-aware evaluation of hybrid wafer anomaly detectors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把基于 patch 的学生-教师检测器 EfficientAD 与用于 partial-diffusion 重建的 DDPM 通过百分位校准分数做固定凸组合，用于晶圆 bin map (WBM) 的开集异常检测。在 WM-38K 上仅用 700 片正常晶圆训练、18,658 片留出晶圆测试，AUROC 达 0.9985，误分类从 DDPM 的 852 和 EfficientAD 的 1,412 降到 618，两两差异 p < 0.001；但固定权重只回收了 oracle 选择器可得修正的 40-70%，作者据此主张样本自适应融合与不平衡感知评测。
Motivation: 监督分类器只能识别训练时见过的缺陷类型；单一机制的一类检测器要么抓局部结构偏差、要么抓全局分布违背，很少两者兼顾。
Method: 混合一类框架：patch 学生-教师检测器 EfficientAD 与做 partial-diffusion 重建的 DDPM 各自输出异常分，经百分位校准 (percentile calibration) 后用固定凸组合融合；仅以 700 片正常晶圆训练，在 WM-38K mixed-type 数据集的 18,658 片留出晶圆上评测，并用 oracle 选择器估计可得修正上限。
Result: 融合检测器 AUROC 0.9985；误分类数 852 (DDPM)、1,412 (EfficientAD) → 618，所有两两差异 p < 0.001。两模块错误弱重叠，但固定权重融合只回收 oracle 可得修正的 40-70%。在该基准的倒置类平衡下 AP 与 F1 饱和，MCC 与 negative predictive value 暴露出 normal 预测不可靠；像素级图显示强的图像级可分性并不等于空间定位，扩散模块是以局部密度先验而非全局几何推理起作用。
Conclusion: 固定权重的异构融合有效但远未榨干互补性，应转向样本自适应融合，并在倒置类平衡下改用 MCC、NPV 这类不平衡感知指标评测混合晶圆异常检测器。

papers.title: Marrying Pricing and Advertising with LLMs
papers.abstract_en: We study a sequential pricing problem in which a seller jointly posts a price and an advertisement generated by a large language model (LLM). The seller aims to maximize revenue under an unknown product demand that depends on both decisions, while observing only whether each offer leads to a purchase. We propose an online actor-critic algorithm that combines low-rank adaptation (LoRA) of a pretrained LLM with a demand model fitted to available data. At each round, the actor generates an advertisement, and the critic estimates purchase probabilities to guide price selection. Then, the resulting feedback is used to update both the actor and the critic, with the critic's revenue estimates providing a baseline for policy gradient updates of the actor. To evaluate our approach, we develop an evaluation framework with three synthetic demand models and a demand simulator built from real-world marketplace data. Finally, we compare our algorithm with benchmarks that do not jointly optimize price selection and advertisement generation, achieving expected revenue gains over the reference policy of 5.69%, 5.18% and 55.96% under the three synthetic demand models and 5.81% under the marketplace simulator.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在卖家同时决定价格与 LLM 生成广告、且只能观测到是否成交的序列定价问题上，提出把 LoRA 微调的 LLM actor 与需求 critic 结合的在线 actor-critic：critic 估计购买概率指导定价，其收入估计作为基线做策略梯度更新 actor。相对不联合优化价格与广告的参考策略，三个合成需求模型下期望收入分别提升 5.69%、5.18%、55.96%，真实市场数据构建的模拟器下提升 5.81%。
Motivation: 定价与广告通常被分开优化，但需求同时依赖两者，且线上只能观测到成交与否的二值反馈，联合决策缺少可用的在线学习方法。
Method: 在线 actor-critic：actor 是 LoRA 微调的预训练 LLM，逐轮生成广告；critic 由可得数据拟合需求模型、估计购买概率以指导选价；成交反馈同时更新 actor 与 critic，critic 的收入估计作为 actor 策略梯度更新的 baseline。评测用三个合成需求模型加一个由真实市场数据构建的需求模拟器。
Result: 相对不联合优化价格与广告生成的参考策略，期望收入增益为 5.69%、5.18%、55.96%（三个合成需求模型）与 5.81%（市场数据模拟器）。
Conclusion: 用 LLM 生成广告并与其需求 critic 联合在线优化，可在只有成交反馈的序列定价中获得稳定收入增益，增益幅度强烈依赖需求模型（合成模型间从 5.18% 到 55.96%）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Extreme Binary Classification: Extreme Value Theory for Extreme Constraint on False Negative
papers.abstract_en: While binary classification is one of the most extensively studied problems in machine learning, the regime in which the goal is to learn a classifier with an almost zero false negative rate remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we introduce the Extreme Binary Classification problem, where the objective is to learn a classifier whose false negative rate $α$ is constrained by $ε_{N_1}=o_{N_1\to\infty}(1/N_1)$, with $N_1$ denoting the number of positive examples in the training set. To address this problem, we propose a threshold adaptation method theoretically grounded in guarantees derived from Extreme Value Theory, together with a feature selection procedure based on a permutation test applied to sample maxima. Experimental results on four real-world datasets of varying sizes demonstrate that our approach compares favorably with state-of-the-art methods. In addition, we illustrate its interpretability through an application to a cancer screening dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Extreme Binary Classification 问题：在正类样本数 N1 增长时，把假阴性率约束到 ε_{N1}=o(1/N1) 这一几乎为零的量级。方法是基于极值理论 (Extreme Value Theory) 保证的阈值自适应，加上对样本最大值做置换检验 (permutation test) 的特征选择；在四个真实数据集上与现有方法比较表现有利，并在癌症筛查数据上展示可解释性。
Motivation: 二分类中要求假阴性率几乎为零的体制基本未被研究：常规分类目标不处理 ε 随正类样本数以 o(1/N1) 速度收缩的极严格假阴性约束。
Method: 两部分：一是由极值理论推导保证的阈值自适应方法，把分类阈值调到满足假阴性率约束；二是基于样本最大值置换检验的特征选择流程。
Result: 在四个规模各异的真实数据集上，该方法与 state-of-the-art 方法相比表现有利 (compares favorably)；并在一个癌症筛查数据集上给出可解释性示例。约束形式为 ε_{N1}=o_{N1→∞}(1/N1)。
Conclusion: 极值理论可以把几乎零假阴性率的硬约束转成可操作的阈值选择与特征选择流程，并在真实数据上与现有方法竞争。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Expected Harmfulness to Likelihood: A Probabilistic Reformulation of Jailbreaking LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: When the harmfulness of an LLM agent's output can be quantified, a natural jailbreaking objective is to maximize expected harmfulness over admissible input modifications. An alternative approach constructs or selects harmful target outputs and modifies the input to increase their likelihood. We establish a precise connection between these two approaches through a probabilistic reformulation. Specifically, we show that the gradient of the logarithm of expected harmfulness with respect to the input equals the expected input gradient of the model's log-likelihood under a harmfulness reweighted output distribution. This identity provides a unified interpretation of expected harmfulness and target likelihood optimization. Building on this connection, we propose OPUR, a sampling distribution designed to generate highly harmful target outputs and use the resulting samples to guide likelihood-based input optimization. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the resulting method in jailbreaking LLM agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把「最大化期望危害度」与「提高有害目标输出似然」两类越狱目标用一个概率恒等式打通：期望危害度对数的输入梯度，等于在危害度重加权输出分布下模型 log-likelihood 的期望输入梯度。基于该恒等式提出 OPUR 采样分布，先生成高危害目标输出，再用这些样本引导基于似然的输入优化，实验显示其对越狱 LLM agent 有效。
Motivation: 当 LLM agent 输出的危害度可量化时，越狱目标要么直接最大化期望危害度，要么构造有害目标再提高其似然，两条路线此前缺少严格联系，优化视角难以统一。
Method: 对期望危害度取对数并对输入求梯度，证明其等于危害度重加权输出分布下模型 log-likelihood 的期望输入梯度；据此提出 OPUR 采样分布生成高危害目标输出，用所得样本驱动基于似然的输入优化。
Result: 建立期望危害度梯度与重加权似然梯度的恒等式，给出两类目标的统一解释；实验表明由 OPUR 引导的该方法在越狱 LLM agent 上有效。
Conclusion: 期望危害度优化与目标似然优化在概率重述下是同一梯度对象的两种写法，因此可以用采样高危害目标再做似然优化的路径实现越狱。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: TR-PTQ: High-Accuracy Integer-Only Transformer Post Training Quantization via Taylor Region Reformulation
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization (PTQ) enables efficient deployment, yet transformer architectures remain challenging to quantize due to nonlinear layers. While existing methods attribute accuracy loss to insufficient numerical precision, often necessitating floating-point fallbacks, we demonstrate that degradation is actually driven by specific structural error sources. We find that learned scale parameters in normalization layers and compounded approximations in GELU are the primary error contributors, whereas SoftMax remains inherently robust to aggressive quantization. To address these bottlenecks, we introduce TR-PTQ, a unified integer-only formulation using shared Taylor Region (TR) exponential and logarithm primitives. This approach allows computationally expensive operations, including division and square roots, to be performed entirely in the log-domain via standard integer arithmetic. Combined with a calibration-free, outlier-aware optimization for LayerNorm parameters, our method eliminates the need for floating-point hardware units for nonlinearities, achieving less than 1.5\% absolute accuracy degradation across vision and language benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TR-PTQ 把 Transformer PTQ 的精度损失归因到结构误差源而非数值精度不足：归一化层的可学习 scale 参数与 GELU 的复合近似是主因，SoftMax 本身对激进量化鲁棒。方法用共享的 Taylor Region (TR) 指数/对数原语，把除法与开方等昂贵运算全部放到 log 域用整数算术完成，配合免校准、outlier-aware 的 LayerNorm 参数优化，彻底去掉非线性所需的浮点硬件单元，在视觉与语言基准上绝对精度下降小于 1.5%。
Motivation: Transformer 的非线性层难以量化，现有方法把精度损失归因于数值精度不够、因而常需浮点回退，阻碍纯整数部署。
Method: TR-PTQ：统一的 integer-only 形式化，用共享 Taylor Region 指数与对数原语，把除法、开方等运算在 log 域以标准整数算术完成；配合 calibration-free、outlier-aware 的 LayerNorm 参数优化，定位 GELU 复合近似与归一化 scale 为主要误差源。
Result: 在视觉与语言基准上绝对精度下降小于 1.5%，且非线性运算无需浮点硬件单元；误差归因结论为归一化层可学习 scale 与 GELU 近似是主要误差贡献者，SoftMax 对激进量化本身鲁棒。
Conclusion: Transformer 量化的瓶颈是特定结构误差源而非整体精度位宽，用 log 域整数原语加免校准 LayerNorm 优化即可去掉浮点回退。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Successive Training Stages and Large Language Model Persuasion: Effects of Misalignment, Supervised Fine-Tuning, and Preference Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can be tuned to influence human attitudes, yet the respective contributions of successive post-training stages remain un-clear. This study examines how three successive training stages affect LLM persuasiveness: (1) misalignment through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on conspiracy data, (2) additional persuasive SFT on argumentative data, and (3) Identity Preference Optimization (IPO), a preference-optimization method. A total of 835 participants recruited on Prolific were randomly assigned to five between-subject conditions (neutral text, conspiracy-trained model, persuasion-trained model, preference-optimized model, and GPT-4) and were exposed to texts on 10 divisive political issues, personalized from their individual profiles in all model conditions. Attitude change was measured as the difference between pre- and post-exposure positions on continuous Likert scales and analyzed with an analysis of covariance (ANCOVA). A significant condition x baseline-attitude interaction, F (4, 825) = 5.33, p < .001, indicated that training effects depended on participants' initial attitudes. Persuasive SFT produced greater attitude change than conspiracy training alone, d = 0.30, whereas IPO provided no additional benefit, d = 0.03, and GPT-4 did not differ from neutral text, d = --0.01. These results show that targeted supervised training on persuasive data increases LLM persuasiveness, whereas preference optimization yields no significant gains beyond it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 835 名 Prolific 参与者的五组被试间实验拆解 LLM 说服力的三个后训练阶段：阴谋论 SFT、说服性 SFT、IPO 偏好优化。说服性 SFT 相对仅阴谋论训练带来更大态度改变 (d = 0.30)，IPO 无额外收益 (d = 0.03)，GPT-4 与中性文本无差异 (d = -0.01)。
Motivation: LLM 可被调优去影响人的态度，但连续后训练各阶段（失准 SFT、说服 SFT、偏好优化）各自贡献多少说服力尚不清楚。
Method: 三个阶段依次施加：在阴谋论数据上做失准 SFT、在论辩数据上追加说服性 SFT、再做 Identity Preference Optimization (IPO)。Prolific 招募 835 名参与者，随机分入五个被试间条件（中性文本、阴谋论模型、说服模型、偏好优化模型、GPT-4），在 10 个分裂性政治议题上阅读按个人画像个性化生成的文本；用 Likert 前后测差值测态度改变，以 ANCOVA 分析。
Result: 条件×基线态度交互显著，F(4, 825) = 5.33，p < .001，说明训练效应依赖参与者初始态度。说服性 SFT 相对仅阴谋论训练态度改变更大，d = 0.30；IPO 无额外收益，d = 0.03；GPT-4 与中性文本无差异，d = -0.01。
Conclusion: 在说服性数据上的定向监督训练提升 LLM 说服力，而其上的偏好优化不再带来显著增益；说服效果取决于受众的初始态度。

papers.title: Force without transmission: a depth-induced rank collapse that no loss on the representation reopens
papers.abstract_en: Training can drive a transformer into a rank collapse: all token representations point in one direction, and learning stops. In a related collapse of attention, a loss term with a bounded corrective force repairs the network during the run. We ask whether such a term repairs rank collapse. We collapse small transformers by weakening their skip connection and treat copies of the collapsed network. No added loss term repaired the collapse, although the stronger kind pushed with about a tenth of the task gradient. The reason was the path, not the strength. The task gradient no longer reached the query and key weights, which decide where attention looks, and the added term's gradient faded before the blocks where the collapse forms. Restoring the skip connection, which changes no weight, reopened this path at once. The rank then recovered, but only far above the scale of collapse. After a burst of high learning rate the path stayed open and the rank recovered untreated. Registered predictions from the path ranked recovery times but did not transfer to this cause. In every case the loss stayed above that of a healthy network after the rank recovered. Whether a collapsed network can be repaired depends on whether the gradient still reaches the weights that must change, not on how strongly a loss term pushes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 削弱 skip connection 会让小 transformer 进入 rank collapse（所有 token 表示指向同一方向、学习停止），此时任何附加损失项都修不回来——即便其推力约为任务梯度的十分之一。原因是梯度通路断了：任务梯度到不了决定注意力位置的 query/key 权重，附加项的梯度也在坍塌形成的 block 之前衰减；恢复 skip connection 不改任何权重却立刻重开通路，rank 随即恢复。
Motivation: 注意力坍塌已有带界修正力的损失项可在训练中修复，但 rank collapse 是否同样可修并不清楚；这决定了修复手段该选更强的损失项还是改网络结构。
Method: 通过削弱 skip connection 制造小 transformer 的 rank collapse，并对坍塌网络的多个副本施加不同附加损失项；分析任务梯度与附加项梯度沿深度的传播路径，定位其是否抵达 query/key 权重与坍塌形成的 block；对照操作为恢复 skip connection（不改动任何权重）以及一次高学习率突发。

papers.title: Possibilistic Radial Transport for Approximate IM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Probing the hypothesis space after seeing the data remains valid under possibilistic inferential models (IMs), provided the significance level stays fixed. The price is computation, as each plausibility is a supremum of the possibility contour over the hypothesis, and the contour itself is approximated at each queried parameter value. We propose a possibilistic radial transport, which hides the contour value of a parameter in the radius of its source point. When a transport that maximizes within-shell entropy is picked, sampling parameters covering a confidence cut becomes a matter of truncating the radius. We provide a deep learning algorithm that enforces the contour depth condition while maximizing the entropy within each shell. Our amortization makes coverage and power assessments of the learned approximation practical as well as predictive check of new datasets. We also use the sampler to construct a Bel-Pl spectrum for comparing and selecting interpretable hypotheses that satisfy a prescribed Bel-Pl decision criterion. In simulations the learned contours match or improve on ellipsoidal approximations to the cuts, while the coverage and power track the exact reference. Finally, we probe hypotheses about ovarian aging using synthetic AMH records, asking for each woman how many more years her median AMH level will remain above a specified reference value.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 possibilistic radial transport：把 possibility contour 的取值藏进源点半径，选壳内熵最大的 transport 后，采样覆盖某个置信截断只需截断半径。深度学习算法在强制 contour depth 条件的同时最大化壳内熵，使 coverage/power 评估与新数据预测检查可摊销化；模拟中学习到的 contour 匹配或优于截断的椭球近似，coverage 与 power 跟随精确参考。
Motivation: possibilistic inferential models 中看过数据后再探查假设空间仍成立，但每个 plausibility 都是 possibility contour 在假设上的上确界，且 contour 本身要在每个被查询的参数值处近似，计算代价高。
Method: 用 radial transport 把参数的 contour 值编码进源点半径；给出一个深度学习算法，在满足 contour depth 条件的同时最大化每个 shell 内的熵，从而把采样覆盖置信截断化为截断半径。摊销化后可做 coverage/power 评估、新数据集的 predictive check，并用该 sampler 构造 Bel-Pl spectrum，按预设 Bel-Pl 判据比较和选择可解释假设。
Result: 模拟中学习到的 contour 匹配或改进了对截断的椭球近似，coverage 与 power 跟随精确参考；应用部分用合成 AMH 记录探查卵巢衰老假设，对每位女性估计其中位 AMH 水平还能保持在指定参考值之上的年数。
Conclusion: 把 contour 值藏进半径并以壳内熵最大化来采样，可让 possibilistic IM 的近似推断既保持 coverage/power 又变得可摊销、可用于新数据预测检查与 Bel-Pl 假设选择。

papers.title: MSU Team at the Explainable Deepfake Detection Challenge 2026: Grounded Artifact Evidence for Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in generative image models have made many manipulated images highly realistic, raising the need for detectors that are not only accurate but also able to provide visual evidence for their decisions. In this paper, we present our solution to the Explainable Deepfake Detection Challenge [2] on the XPlainVerse dataset [1], where systems are required to predict whether an image is real or fake and generate both complex and simple explanations grounded in visible forensic cues. Our method follows a modular detection-and-explanation design. For the real/fake decision, we build a multi-backbone detector that combines several DINOv3 models with Mesorch manipulation-localization features, bringing together pretrained visual representations, DCT-aware cues, and multi-scale forensic information. To inject explanation evidence into the detector, we use a Grounding-DINO-based pseudo-mask generation pipeline that converts local artifact descriptions from training explanations into weak patch- level supervision for an Artifact Evidence Map. We further introduce a local patch-level contrastive objective that separates artifact and authenticity evidence in the detector feature space without requiring paired images or pixel-level manipulation masks. For language output, we use class-conditional Qwen3-VL models to generate complex explanations for fake and real predictions, followed by a GRPO-optimized text simplification model. The proposed methods were trained and evaluated on the challenge subset of XPlainVerse. On the full test split, our submission achieves 0.9349 detection accuracy, 0.5571 explanation score, and a 0.7456 final challenge score.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MSU 队伍在 Explainable Deepfake Detection Challenge 2026 的 XPlainVerse 数据集上，用多 backbone 检测器（多个 DINOv3 + Mesorch 定位特征）联合 Grounding-DINO 伪掩码弱监督的 Artifact Evidence Map 与 patch 级对比目标，再由 class-conditional Qwen3-VL 生成复杂解释、GRPO 优化的简化模型产出简单解释。在完整测试集上取得 0.9349 检测准确率、0.5571 解释分与 0.7456 最终挑战分。
Motivation: 生成图像使篡改图高度逼真，检测器不仅要判真伪，还要给出落在可见取证线索上的视觉与文字证据；挑战赛要求同时输出复杂与简单解释，单一分类器无法满足。
Method: 检测端把多个 DINOv3 与 Mesorch manipulation-localization 特征拼成多 backbone 检测器，融合预训练视觉表征、DCT-aware 线索与多尺度取证信息；用基于 Grounding-DINO 的伪掩码流水线把训练解释中的局部 artifact 描述转成 patch 级弱监督，构成 Artifact Evidence Map，并加入不依赖成对图像或像素级掩码的局部 patch 级对比目标，分离 artifact 证据与真实性证据；语言端用 class-conditional Qwen3-VL 生成复杂解释，再经 GRPO 优化的文本简化模型产出简单解释。
Result: 在 XPlainVerse 挑战赛子集上训练与评估，完整测试集提交结果为检测准确率 0.9349、解释分 0.5571、最终挑战分 0.7456。
Conclusion: 把取证证据以弱监督掩码和对比目标注入检测器、再用大模型分层生成复杂与简单解释的模块化设计，可在 XPlainVerse 上同时给出真伪判定与落地于可见线索的解释。
