papers.title: Learning Traffic Flow Dynamics with Stochastic Physics-Informed Neural Cellular Automata
papers.abstract_en: Traffic flow modeling is essential for understanding and predicting the collective dynamics of vehicles on road networks. Cellular automata provide a simple, interpretable yet powerful framework for representing these dynamics via local interaction rules, while retaining the ability to reproduce complex macroscopic traffic phenomena. However, learning local transition rules from data while preserving physically meaningful constraints remains challenging, particularly for stochastic models. In this work, we propose a physics-informed neural cellular automaton (PI-NCA) for data-driven traffic flow modeling. Building on the standard neural cellular automaton (NCA), we design a neural architecture that is physically consistent with the road topology and guarantees conservation of the total number of vehicles, thereby constraining the learned transition rules to physically admissible dynamics. We further extend this framework to stochastic dynamics by parameterizing probabilistic transition rules while preserving the same physics-informed constraints. We evaluate the proposed models on multiple traffic scenarios generated by the well-established Nagel-Schreckenberg and Kerner-Klenov-Wolf cellular automata. The results demonstrate that the PI-NCA successfully learns the dynamics of both traffic models and consistently outperforms a standard NCA, while the stochastic extension captures probabilistic transition rules without compromising the imposed physical constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出物理信息神经元胞自动机 (PI-NCA)，在标准 NCA 上加与道路拓扑一致的结构并强制车辆总数守恒，把学到的局部转移规则限制在物理可容许范围内；再把转移规则参数化为概率形式，得到保持同样约束的随机扩展。在 Nagel-Schreckenberg 与 Kerner-Klenov-Wolf 两种元胞自动机生成的多个交通场景上，PI-NCA 学到两种模型的动力学并稳定优于标准 NCA，随机扩展在不破坏物理约束的前提下捕捉概率转移规则。
Motivation: 从数据中学习元胞自动机的局部转移规则同时保住物理约束本身很难，随机模型尤其如此；交通流建模需要既简单可解释又能复现宏观现象的框架。
Method: 在标准神经元胞自动机 (NCA) 基础上设计与道路拓扑物理一致的神经架构，并保证车辆总数守恒，从而约束学到的转移规则；进一步把转移规则参数化为概率形式，扩展到随机动力学且保留同样的物理信息约束。
Result: 在由 Nagel-Schreckenberg 与 Kerner-Klenov-Wolf 元胞自动机生成的多个交通场景上评估：PI-NCA 成功学到两种交通模型的动力学，并始终优于标准 NCA；随机扩展捕捉到概率转移规则，且不牺牲所施加的物理约束。
Conclusion: 把拓扑一致性与守恒约束直接写进网络结构，可以让 NCA 学到的交通转移规则既物理可容许又比标准 NCA 更准，随机化扩展也不必放弃这些约束。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: AgentTime: Can Agents Estimate and Control Their Own Runtime?
papers.abstract_en: An essential control of AI agents is their ability to manage runtime. This ability requires a sense of time-awareness, to predict and estimate wall-clock time and to control their own actions. Prior work has focused on time-awareness, but duration-following and control in native agent harnesses remain unexplored. We present AgentTime, a benchmark for testing whether agents can work for a requested duration, predict their runtime, and estimate elapsed time afterward. It comprises 222 tasks from 18 sources spanning coding, computer use, agentic work, and automated research. Duration-following experiments append a single instruction specifying how long to work, with requests ranging from about a minute to multiple days. Accuracy on these instructions varies substantially: Fable 5.1 in Claude Code deviates from requested runtimes by a typical factor of 2.9$\times$, compared with only 1.2$\times$ for GPT-6 Astra in Codex. However, matching the requested runtime does not, by itself, establish continued work on the task. Among 158 reviewed Astra runs with classifiable transcripts, 14 explicitly slept after appearing to finish. In forecasting experiments, predictions tend to overestimate natural runtimes. In retrospective experiments, removing temporal information more than doubles deviation for Sol and Astra and nearly doubles it for Fable. An agent's ability to complete a task does not guarantee that it can control its own time or work for the whole requested duration. For agents to run reliably, safely, and autonomously over long horizons, we require the evaluation of both.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentTime 是评测 AI agent 时间掌控能力的基准，含 222 个任务、18 个来源，覆盖编码、计算机使用、agentic 工作与自动研究。追加单条时长指令后，Claude Code 中 Fable 5.1 的实际运行时长典型偏离请求 2.9×，而 Codex 中 GPT-6 Astra 仅 1.2×；回顾实验里移除时间信息使 Sol 与 Astra 的偏差翻倍以上、Fable 接近翻倍。作者主张：能完成任务不等于能控制自身时间，长时程可靠自主运行需同时评测两者。
Motivation: 既有工作只关注 agent 的时间感知 (time-awareness)，而原生 agent 运行框架中的时长遵循 (duration-following) 与自我时间控制尚无评测手段，长时程自主运行的安全性无从判断。
Method: 构建 AgentTime 基准：222 个任务、18 个来源，分三类实验——duration-following（在 prompt 中追加一条工作时长指令，请求从约 1 分钟到数天）、forecasting（预测自然运行时长）、retrospective（事后估计已流逝时间，并做移除时间信息的消融）；对可分类的 Astra 运行转录做人工审查。
Result: Fable 5.1 (Claude Code) 对请求时长的典型偏离为 2.9×，GPT-6 Astra (Codex) 为 1.2×；158 条经审查、转录可分类的 Astra 运行中 14 条在看似完成后显式 sleep；forecasting 预测普遍高估自然运行时长；移除时间信息后 Sol 与 Astra 的回顾偏差增加一倍以上，Fable 接近翻倍。
Conclusion: 任务完成能力不保证 agent 能控制自身时间或在整个请求时长内持续工作，长时程可靠、安全、自主运行需要对这两项能力同时评测。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 构建 AgentTime 基准：222 个任务、18 个来源，分三类实验——duration-following（在 prompt 中追加一条工作时长指令，请求从约 1 分钟到数天）、forecasting（预测自然运行时长）、retrospective（事后估计已流逝时间，并做移除时间信息的消融）；对可分类的 Astra 运行转录做人工审查。
summary_sections.result: Fable 5.1 (Claude Code) 对请求时长的典型偏离为 2.9×，GPT-6 Astra (Codex) 为 1.2×；158 条经审查、转录可分类的 Astra 运行中 14 条在看似完成后显式 sleep；forecasting 预测普遍高估自然运行时长；移除时间信息后 Sol 与 Astra 的回顾偏差增加一倍以上，Fable 接近翻倍。
summary_sections.conclusion: 任务完成能力不保证 agent 能控制自身时间或在整个请求时长内持续工作，长时程可靠、安全、自主运行需要对这两项能力同时评测。

papers.title: Many Ways to Succeed: Diversity-Driven RL Fine-Tuning for VLA Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning improves vision-language-action (VLA) policies through closed-loop experience, yet generalization beyond the fine-tuning distribution remains limited. Our analysis reveals a selective reshaping of exploration: RL contracts behavior globally, yet diversifies successful trajectories, elicits success with fewer rollouts, and covers more of the latent task-valid solution space than supervised fine-tuning. Broader successful-mode coverage may provide alternative strategies under distribution shifts. Inspired by this, we introduce DRIVE (Diversity-driven RL fIne-tuning for VLA gEneralization), which turns successful-behavior diversity into an explicit RL objective. DRIVE groups rollouts under matched task conditions, compares their trajectories with temporal alignment, and derives a success-conditioned intrinsic reward from relative behavioral diversity. This design encourages broader coverage of feasible solutions without rewarding diverse failures or superficial timing differences. Across LIBERO-Plus, ManiSkill3, and RoboTwin 2.0, DRIVE improves the average out-of-domain (OOD) performance over vanilla RL fine-tuning by 5.3 points on $π_0$ and 2.0 points on $π_{0.5}$. On a dual-arm AgileX PiPER-X platform, DRIVE further increases average OOD success from 64.1% to 73.3% (+9.2 points), demonstrating gains that persist under physical deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DRIVE 把「成功轨迹的多样性」直接写成 RL 内在奖励：在匹配任务条件下对 rollout 做时间对齐比较，只对成功行为按相对多样性给奖励，从而扩大可行解覆盖而不奖励失败或表面时序差异。在 LIBERO-Plus、ManiSkill3、RoboTwin 2.0 上，OOD 平均性能较 vanilla RL 微调在 π0 上高 5.3 点、π0.5 上高 2.0 点；双臂 AgileX PiPER-X 实机 OOD 成功率从 64.1% 升到 73.3%（+9.2 点）。
Motivation: VLA 策略经 RL 微调后在微调分布之外泛化有限；分析显示 RL 全局收缩行为、却只在成功轨迹上多样化，成功模式覆盖更广可能才是分布偏移下的抗性来源。
Method: DRIVE（Diversity-driven RL fIne-tuning for VLA gEneralization）在匹配任务条件下对 rollout 分组，用时间对齐 (temporal alignment) 比较轨迹，从相对行为多样性导出 success-conditioned intrinsic reward，与 RL 微调目标联合优化；评测覆盖 LIBERO-Plus、ManiSkill3、RoboTwin 2.0 与实体双臂平台。
Result: 相对 vanilla RL 微调，OOD 平均性能在 π0 上 +5.3 点、在 π0.5 上 +2.0 点（LIBERO-Plus、ManiSkill3、RoboTwin 2.0）；双臂 AgileX PiPER-X 实机平均 OOD 成功率 64.1% → 73.3%（+9.2 点）。分析层面：RL 全局收缩行为但使成功轨迹更多样、用更少 rollout 达成成功，并比监督微调覆盖更多 latent task-valid 解空间。
Conclusion: 把成功行为多样性做成显式 RL 目标，可在分布偏移下扩大可行解覆盖，且收益在物理部署上仍然保持。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Purifying Backdoored Large Vision-Language Models by Removing Hijacked Directions
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) are increasingly deployed in safety-critical applications, yet they remain vulnerable to backdoor attacks. Defending against such attacks remains costly, as existing methods require either extensive retraining on clean data or per-query intervention at inference time. To address this limitation, we propose OrthoPurify, a more efficient method to purify backdoored model weights via one-step orthogonal projection. Specifically, through structural analysis of backdoor weight updates, we find that the backdoor is encoded by diverting a small number of weight update directions from task adaptation to backdoor shortcut encoding, a phenomenon we term direction hijacking. However, identifying these hijacked directions requires a benign reference model, which is typically inaccessible to the defender. We show that a pseudo-benign model, obtained by fine-tuning the pretrained weights on only a small set of clean samples, provides a sufficient approximation, as the dominant update directions stabilize within the first few gradient steps. OrthoPurify uses this pseudo-benign reference to isolate the hijacked directions and removes them through a single projection on the weight update. Extensive experiments show that OrthoPurify reduces the attack success rate to near zero while preserving the original performance across diverse benchmarks, without retraining the backdoored model or introducing inference-time overhead. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/womeimingzi/OrthoPurify.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 OrthoPurify：用少量干净样本微调预训练权重得到 pseudo-benign 参考模型，隔离被劫持的权重更新方向 (direction hijacking)，再对权重更新做一次正交投影即完成后门清除。实验中攻击成功率降至接近零，同时在多个基准上保持原有性能，无需重训被投毒模型，也不引入推理期开销。
Motivation: LVLM 后门防御现有方法代价高：要么在干净数据上大量重训，要么在推理时对每个查询做干预。
Method: 先对后门权重更新做结构分析，提出 direction hijacking 现象；用少量干净样本微调预训练权重得到 pseudo-benign 参考模型（主导更新方向在最初几步梯度内即稳定），据此隔离被劫持方向，并对权重更新做单次正交投影移除它们。
Result: 在多个 benchmark 上，攻击成功率 (ASR) 降至接近零，同时保持模型原有性能；相比需大量重训或逐查询推理干预的现有方法，无需重训被投毒模型且无推理期开销。
Conclusion: 后门可被压缩为少数被劫持的权重更新方向，因此用廉价的 pseudo-benign 参考加一次正交投影即可净化，不必重训或改动推理流程。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Juno: Taming Predictive Latents for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) predict masked or future observations in representation space, offering a natural source of predictive latents for vision-language-action (VLA) models. Yet making these latents useful across pretraining, policy learning, and deployment requires addressing three failures: mismatch with embodiment-specific control, interference with action learning, and teacher miscalibration under distribution shifts. We introduce Juno, a unified framework built around one action-conditioned JEPA that serves as a control-aligned representation backbone, a predictive teacher, and an adaptable dynamics model. During pretraining, we train it on embodiment-matched trajectories and use a dynamic CLS loss to transfer motion-weighted patch dynamics to a compact global state. During policy learning, we fuse current-frame JEPA patches into VLA perception and use a decoupled reasoning branch with separate transformation parameters to distill future latent states for action generation. During deployment, we adapt the world model on all observed transitions, including failed rollouts, freeze the adapted teacher, and re-align the policy on verified executions using LoRA adapters and a trainable action head, without expert corrections or task rewards. On SimplerEnv, Juno raises average success from $60.9\%$ to $68.5\%$ over Qwen3GR00T, the strongest baseline, and test-time adaptation further reaches $72.7\%$; on a real robot, it retains $70\%$--$75\%$ success under background, height, and object shifts where the base policy collapses to $0\%$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Juno 把一个 action-conditioned JEPA 同时当作控制对齐表征骨干、预测教师和可适应动力学模型，贯穿 VLA 的预训练、策略学习与部署三阶段。在 SimplerEnv 上平均成功率从 Qwen3GR00T 的 60.9% 提到 68.5%，加测试时适应达 72.7%；真机上在背景、高度与物体偏移下保持 70%–75%，而基线策略塌到 0%。
Motivation: JEPA 的预测隐变量要跨预训练、策略学习和部署复用，会遇到三类失效：与具身控制目标不匹配、干扰动作学习、分布偏移下教师失准。
Method: 单一 action-conditioned JEPA 分三阶段复用：预训练用具身匹配轨迹加 dynamic CLS loss 把运动加权的 patch 动力学压到全局状态；策略学习把当前帧 JEPA patch 融入 VLA 感知，用带独立变换参数的解耦推理分支蒸馏未来隐状态生成动作；部署时在全部观测转移（含失败 rollout）上适应世界模型，冻结教师后用 LoRA 与可训练动作头在已验证执行上重对齐策略，不需专家纠正或任务奖励。
Result: SimplerEnv 上平均成功率 60.9% → 68.5%（对比最强基线 Qwen3GR00T），测试时适应进一步到 72.7%；真机在背景、高度、物体偏移下保持 70%–75% 成功率，基线策略塌到 0%。
Conclusion: 一个动作条件化的 JEPA 可以同时充当表征骨干、预测教师与可适应动力学模型，靠无专家纠正、无任务奖励的测试时适应把 VLA 的成功率与分布偏移鲁棒性一起抬起来。

papers.title: Fast holographic inversion of superconducting domes
papers.abstract_en: A holographic superconductor whose scalar mass depends on the gauge field strength, $M(\Fsq)$, reproduces a superconducting dome for a suitable $M$, and recovering that $M$ from a given dome has so far taken days for a single training run. We propose a new way of training this model, with which an inversion takes from about ten minutes to an hour. Training needs the gradient of the condition that fixes the critical temperature, which the earlier method obtains by finite differences, repeating the bulk integrations for every training parameter. Here that condition is obtained, without any fit, from two integrations started at the horizon and at the boundary, and its derivative with respect to $M$ is an integral over the same two solutions, so the gradient needs no integration of its own. We use the speed to study the part of $M$ that a dome cannot determine, on the interval between the value $\Fsq$ takes at the horizon for the lowest doping and $\Fsq=0$, at which $M$ is the scalar mass $M(0)$ that fixes the dimension of the dual operator. We hold the scalar mass at several values, which we call pinned masses, retrain everything else at each, and find that the reconstructions agree wherever the horizons of the dome reach, including the minima of $M$, and differ only on that interval. A rule that keeps the reconstruction with the simplest closed form recovers both the scalar mass and the mass function of a test dome. On Gaussian and double-Gaussian domes and on the measured phase diagrams of YBa$_{2}$Cu$_{3}$O$_{y}$ and 2M-WS$_{2}$, however, the pinned mass it keeps rests on ties or on narrow margins, so for these targets the scalar mass is left open. The dome thus constrains $M$ where its horizons reach, and fixing the dimension of the dual operator needs a second observable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把全息超导体中定临界温度条件的梯度从有限差分改为由视界与边界两端积分直接给出，使从超导穹顶反演标量质量 M(Fsq) 的单次训练从数天缩到约十分钟至一小时。用省下的算力检验穹顶无法确定的 M 区间：各 pinned mass 重建在穹顶视界所及处一致（含 M 极小值），只在视界之间分歧；最简闭式规则在高斯与双高斯穹顶上能同时复原标量质量与质量函数，但在 YBa2Cu3Oy 与 2M-WS2 实测相图上 pinned mass 仅靠并列或微弱胜出，故该区间仍开放。
Motivation: 从给定超导穹顶反演 M(Fsq) 此前单次训练要数天，因为定 Tc 条件的梯度靠有限差分、每个训练参数都要重做体积分；速度慢也使穹顶本身约束不到的 M 区间难以系统探查。
Method: 新训练方式不作拟合：分别从视界与边界起算两次积分即得定临界温度的条件，其对 M 的导数是同一对解上的积分，梯度因此无需自己的积分。再用提速后的反演做 pinned mass 实验——把标量质量固定在若干值、其余全部重训，并用保留最简闭式形式的规则挑选重建。
Result: 单次反演训练从约数天降到约十分钟至一小时。各 pinned mass 重建在穹顶视界所及处一致（含 M 极小值），仅在最低掺杂视界处 Fsq 与 Fsq=0 之间分歧；最简闭式规则在高斯与双高斯穹顶上同时复原标量质量与质量函数，但在 YBa2Cu3Oy 与 2M-WS2 实测相图上所留 pinned mass 处于并列或窄幅领先。
Conclusion: 穹顶只在其视界所及处约束 M，确定对偶算符维度（M(0)）需要第二个观测量。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Where Can a Decision Model Diagnose HVAC Faults? Reasoning Demand, Physical Representation, and Robustness Under Shift
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence supports building operations in several forms, each with its own barrier. Expert rules must be tuned for every system, supervised models need labeled data that buildings rarely record, and language models return free text that requires human-in-the-loop checking, since their stated confidence is unreliable. A newer kind of pretrained model, here called a decision model, returns a probability for every allowed answer, so one model could serve many decisions without training. This study answers three open questions for fault diagnosis in heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning systems: which decisions such a model can make, what input it needs, and whether its probabilities hold when conditions change. On 128 fault days from four public datasets of real equipment, faults are graded by the reasoning their diagnosis demands, with data given raw, as physical features, or with Brick topology. The decision model Jev, open language models, and a supervised model face nine tests that change season, control configuration, or building. Given physical features, Jev and the larger open model diagnosed faults whose evidence one feature carries, but not faults that need operating context. Under shift they kept their accuracy and calibration, while the supervised model lost 0.33 macro-F1 yet led or tied within a building. Their probabilities still needed correction, and detection was weak. The study maps which faults a decision model can diagnose and from what input, and supports a division of work in which code computes the physics and the model ranks candidate faults for an operator.

papers.title: Itgan at NADI 2026 shared task: Parameter-Efficient Whisper Adaptation for Robust, Mixed-Dialect and Code-Switched Arabic ASR
papers.abstract_en: We describe the Itgan systems for the three ASR subtasks of NADI 2026, namely robust country-level ASR (1.1), mixed-dialect ASR (1.2), and Tunisian code-switched ASR (1.3). All three share one recipe, Whisper adapted with LoRA on consumer GPUs, and each was carried by a different addition to it. On 1.1, where the dialect label is given at test time, per-dialect specialists continued from a pooled adapter gave the largest gain, and the submitted system reached 57.1% country-average WER. A post-evaluation linear probe on frozen encoder features routes utterances without the label and recovers 44% of what oracle routing gives. On 1.2 the choice of base model mattered more than adapter capacity, and system combination helped only once we added a decorrelated member, reaching 46.7% WER. On 1.3 our system placed second at 14.49% WER with the lowest CER among the leading submissions, 5.38%. Its last 0.60 WER points came without further training, mostly from an exact weight-space average of independently trained runs, with ROVER voting adding the remainder. Every comparison carries a paired-bootstrap test, and we report eight directions that did not work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NADI 2026 三个阿拉伯语 ASR 子任务共用一套配方：Whisper 加 LoRA 在消费级 GPU 上适配，各子任务靠不同增量取胜。国家级鲁棒 ASR (1.1) 国别平均 WER 57.1%，混合方言 (1.2) 达 46.7%，突尼斯语 code-switch (1.3) 以 14.49% WER 排第二、CER 5.38% 最低；作者建议在给定方言标签时用 pooled adapter 续训的 per-dialect specialist，无标签时靠冻结编码器特征的线性探针路由可恢复 oracle 路由 44% 的收益。
Motivation: 阿拉伯语多方言、跨国别与 code-switch 场景下 ASR 鲁棒性差，且测试时方言标签常不可得；需要在消费级 GPU 上以参数高效方式同时覆盖三类子任务。
Method: 统一配方为 Whisper + LoRA 适配：1.1 用从 pooled adapter 续训的 per-dialect specialists，并在冻结编码器特征上训线性探针做无标签路由；1.2 比较 base model 与 adapter 容量，加入 decorrelated 成员做 system combination；1.3 用独立训练run的精确 weight-space averaging 加 ROVER voting。所有比较配 paired-bootstrap 检验。
Result: 1.1 提交系统国别平均 WER 57.1%，线性探针路由恢复 oracle 路由 44% 的收益；1.2 WER 46.7%，base model 选择比 adapter 容量更关键，system combination 仅在加入 decorrelated 成员后起效；1.3 WER 14.49% 排名第二、CER 5.38% 为领先提交中最低，最后 0.60 WER 点来自 weight-space averaging 与 ROVER，无需再训练。
Conclusion: 一套 Whisper+LoRA 配方加子任务专属增量即可覆盖三类阿拉伯语 ASR；标签可用时 specialist 路由收益最大，标签缺失时冻结特征线性探针是可行替代，权重平均与 ROVER 能在不训练的情况下继续压低 WER。

papers.title: Expected Sample Complexity in Multi-Armed Bandits
papers.abstract_en: Sample complexity is a widely used metric in sequential decision-making problems, defined as the number of suboptimal decisions during the interaction between the agent and an environment. We study the sample complexity of stochastic multi-armed bandit problems and introduce the expected sample complexity performance measure, analyzing it in a novel framework called approximately correct in expectation (ACE). We show that ACE guarantees imply almost sure convergence to the optimal expected reward, in contrast to high-probability guarantees found in other frameworks, and also show how to convert ACE guarantees into explicit expected regret bounds. We further show that, in contrast to existing measures, deterministic algorithms cannot obtain favorable ACE bounds, and analyze stochastic algorithms in two settings: when the allowed suboptimality level $ε$ is known to the algorithm and when it is unknown. In the former, we devise an explore-then-$ε$-greedy algorithm, and in the latter, we analyze the expected sample complexity of Thompson sampling. Finally, we establish nearly matching lower bounds for both settings, showing that the algorithms are tight in $ε$ and proving a performance separation between the two regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在随机多臂老虎机中提出期望样本复杂度度量与 approximately correct in expectation (ACE) 框架，证明 ACE 保证蕴含以概率 1 收敛到最优期望奖励，并可转换为显式期望遗憾界。已知 ε 时给出 explore-then-ε-greedy，未知 ε 时分析 Thompson sampling，两者在 ε 上几乎匹配下界，并证明两个体制之间存在性能分离。
Motivation: 序列决策中的样本复杂度传统上依赖高概率保证，且既有度量允许确定性算法取得良好界，无法刻画次优决策次数的期望刻画与体制差异。
Method: 定义期望样本复杂度并建立 ACE 框架；证明 ACE 蕴含几乎必然收敛并可转为期望遗憾界；对已知 ε 设计 explore-then-ε-greedy，对未知 ε 分析 Thompson sampling，并给出两个设置的近匹配下界。
Result: 确定性算法在 ACE 下无法取得有利界；两个设置均建立近匹配下界，说明所给算法在 ε 上是紧的，并证明已知 ε 与未知 ε 两个体制之间存在性能分离。
Conclusion: ACE 提供了优于高概率框架的期望视角：保证几乎必然收敛且可导出期望遗憾，而随机算法在 ε 上可达紧界，两体制存在本质差异。

papers.title: Do Generative Priors Align with Human Naturalness Perception?
papers.abstract_en: Visual generative models are trained to capture the probability distributions of natural images, yet whether their native priors reflect the regularities governing human perception of image naturalness remains an open question. Here, we probe these priors through native prediction errors across 25 open image and video generators. Because raw single-image losses are dominated by scene content and visual complexity, we evaluate directional loss differences using content-preserving, paired relational interventions that selectively disrupt facial configurations or physical illumination consistency while limiting changes in low-level image statistics. Across both domains, these loss differences reproduce human-like selective sensitivities and tolerances, capturing the classic Thatcher effect on faces and shape-dependent responses to illumination inconsistencies. Notably, these loss differences reliably track continuous gradations of human naturalness judgments across individual stimulus pairs (peaking at $r = .84$ on faces and $.64$ on physical scenes) and retain unique human-aligned signals even after controlling for feature distances from frozen vision encoders and standard image quality metrics. We also find that while overall sensitivity to these violations broadly covaries with human alignment across models, the two systematically decouple along denoising schedules, with alignment peaking earlier than sensitivity, revealing that human-like naturalness judgments dissociate from generic violation detection. Together, these findings demonstrate that learning visual distributions yields generative loss landscapes that capture distinct aspects of human naturalness perception.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 25 个开放图像与视频生成模型的原生预测误差，检验其先验是否对齐人类对图像自然度的感知。对保持内容、只破坏面部构型或物理光照一致性的配对干预，方向性损失差能复现 Thatcher 效应与随形状变化的光照不一致性反应，并追踪逐对人类自然度判断（人脸 r=.84、物理场景 r=.64），且在控制冻结视觉编码器特征距离与标准画质指标后仍保留独立信号；总体敏感度与对齐度沿去噪调度解耦，对齐度更早达峰。
Motivation: 视觉生成模型学到的是自然图像分布，但其原生先验是否符合人类感知图像自然度的规律仍是开放问题；单图原始损失又被场景内容与视觉复杂度主导，无法直接读出先验。
Method: 在 25 个开放图像与视频生成器上探查原生预测误差，构造保持内容的配对关系干预（选择性破坏面部构型或物理光照一致性，同时尽量不改变低层图像统计），比较方向性损失差而非原始损失；再与冻结视觉编码器特征距离和标准图像质量指标做控制分析，并沿去噪调度考察敏感度与对齐度。
Result: 方向性损失差在图像与视频两个域上复现人类选择性敏感与容忍：经典 Thatcher 效应与依赖形状的光照不一致性反应；逐对追踪连续人类自然度判断的相关峰值为人脸 r=.84、物理场景 r=.64；控制冻结视觉编码器特征距离与标准画质指标后仍保留独立的人类对齐信号；对违规的总体敏感度与人类对齐度沿去噪调度系统性解耦，对齐度早于敏感度达峰。
Conclusion: 学习视觉分布所得到的生成损失地形能捕捉人类自然度感知的不同侧面，且类人自然度判断与通用违规检测是可分离的两种能力。

papers.title: KGATE : a Knowledge Graph Embedding Training Environment
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge graph embedding (KGE) models encode the entities and relations of a knowledge graph into a low-dimensional latent space, enabling tasks such as classification or link prediction. Most KGE models follow an autoencoder architecture, in which an encoder projects the knowledge graph into the latent space and a decoder reconstruct it. Combining both encoder and decoder components is increasingly needed, yet existing libraries rarely support complete autoencoders, are often unmaintained, rely on undocumented default hyperparameters, and produce results that cannot be compared across libraries. Here we present KGATE (Knowledge Graph Autoencoder Training Environment), a modular Python library built on PyTorch Geometric and TorchKGE. KGATE lets users assemble initializers, encoders, decoders, losses, negative samplers, and evaluation metrics as building blocks, or plug in their own block. KGATE includes a preprocessing procedure that controls data leakage, a builtin training pipeline, and reproducibility by design. Benchmarks against six existing KGE libraries show that KGATE training time is comparable with the fastest libraries while offering a broader set of features.
papers.comment: Main paper (7 pages, 1 figure) and supplementary materials (4 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables) provided
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KGATE 是一个基于 PyTorch Geometric 与 TorchKGE 的模块化知识图谱自编码器训练库，把 initializer、encoder、decoder、loss、negative sampler、evaluation metric 当作可插拔积木，并内置防数据泄漏的预处理与可复现训练管线。与六个现有 KGE 库的基准对比显示，其训练时间与最快的库相当，同时功能覆盖更广。
Motivation: 现有 KGE 库很少支持完整的 encoder-decoder 自编码器组合，且常缺乏维护、默认超参无文档、跨库结果不可比，阻碍了组件组合与结果复现。
Method: KGATE 用 PyTorch Geometric 与 TorchKGE 构建模块化 Python 库，用户可自由拼装或自定义 initializer、encoder、decoder、loss、negative sampler、evaluation metric；附带控制数据泄漏的预处理流程、内置训练管线，并以可复现为设计目标。
Result: 与六个现有 KGE 库的基准对比中，KGATE 训练时间与最快的库相当，同时提供更广的功能集；主文 7 页 1 图，补充材料 4 页 1 图 3 表。
Conclusion: KGE 训练可以在保持与最快库相当的训练时间的同时，获得跨库可比、可复现且支持完整自编码器组合的模块化工具链。

papers.title: Inverting Multi-Vector Visual Document Indices
papers.abstract_en: Prevailing multi-vector visual document retrievers store each page as about a thousand patch vectors, often in vector databases run by a third party. Since no one can read a page from its vectors, this index is easily treated as less sensitive than the page. However, because the index keeps one vector per patch in raster order, and each vector is computed by a vision-language model pre-trained to read documents, we hypothesize that whoever runs or breaches the store can reproduce a page from its index alone. We frame inversion as conditional document image generation and infer from the vectors what the attack needs: the encoder, the page shape and, for shuffled vectors, their order. On the ViDoRe v3 benchmark, pages inverted from raw indices recover 47% of the words and 45% of the sensitive tokens. Used as queries against the stored indices, they rank their source page first 98.4% of the time. We test two cheap protections, token pooling and shuffling, which both cut word recall to about 8%. A model that restores the order of a shuffled index raises the share of source pages ranked first from 3.8% to 93.5%, while inverting a pooled index remains open. To test generalisation, we apply the same attack unchanged to another multi-vector retriever: its inverted pages still rank their source page first 70.2% of the time, though its word recall stays below a nearest-neighbour baseline. Multi-vector visual document retrievers are therefore vulnerable to inversion through their stored index, which should be protected like the documents it encodes.

papers.title: Eigenvalues of the Hessian in Deep Learning: The Origin of Symmetry and Its Breaking
papers.abstract_en: Hessian spectra at trained models in deep learning exhibit a persistent pattern: eigenvalues organize into distinct clusters, including a large bulk near zero and a few isolated outliers. This paper shows that a natural account of these spectral phenomena emerges when the original setting is understood as a departure from a nearby, otherwise hidden, highly symmetric reference. Modifications, including changes to the architecture, data distribution, or parameter metric, expose a nearby reference configuration whose Hessian exhibits rich invariances-ones not accounted for by weight symmetries. There, symmetry enables a precise description of the spectra, forcing high-dimensional kernels and eigenvalues of large multiplicity. Returning to the original configuration breaks the Hessian symmetry and thereby produces the observed hierarchy of clusters and outliers. The framework is developed in some generality, with a detailed analysis of three-layer ReLU networks and applications to convolutional, graph, and transformer models, as well as to the NTK. The same mechanism is further shown to yield analogous spectral structures in layerwise Hessians and the Gauss-Newton matrix.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把训练后 Hessian 谱的团簇与离群特征值解释为对一个隐藏高对称参考构型的偏离：在参考构型下对称性强制高维核与高重数特征值，回到原构型时 Hessian 对称性破缺，从而产生观测到的团簇层级与离群值。框架对三层 ReLU 网络给出详细分析，并推广到卷积、图、transformer 模型与 NTK，同样机制也产生 layerwise Hessian 与 Gauss-Newton 矩阵的类似谱结构。
Motivation: 深度学习训练后 Hessian 谱普遍呈现近零大体部加少数孤立离群值的结构，但缺少统一解释：权重对称性不足以说明这些谱不变性与团簇层级。
Method: 通过修改架构、数据分布或参数度量暴露一个邻近的高对称参考构型，在该参考下用对称性精确刻画谱（高维核与高重数特征值），再回到原构型分析对称性破缺如何生成团簇与离群值；框架在一般性层面展开，详细分析对象为三层 ReLU 网络，并应用到卷积、图、transformer 模型与 NTK。
Result: 给出的谱结构为：近零大体部加少数孤立离群特征值，被解释为对称参考构型的破缺产物；同一机制在 layerwise Hessian 与 Gauss-Newton 矩阵上产生类似的谱结构。
Conclusion: 训练后 Hessian 谱的团簇与离群现象源于一个邻近高对称参考构型的破缺，而非权重对称性本身，且该机制可跨架构与 NTK、以及 Gauss-Newton 矩阵统一成立。

papers.title: NeuralZip: Reusable Setup for Fast Lossless Compression
papers.abstract_en: Lossless compression can reduce the storage and movement of model weights without changing their floating-point values, but repeated statistical analysis and code construction add computational overhead. We study whether the statistical structure of exponents can be prepared once and reused. For this, we introduce NeuralZip, which groups chunks with similar exponent distributions, shares Huffman codes, and selectively represents recurring exponent tuples using packed exponents, thereby achieving additional moderate compression ratios. A setup chooses these representations before subsequent encodings, while every encoding still processes the current tensor values. In floating-point model checkpoints, post-setup compression is 1.81-21.33$\times$ faster than the baselines and achieves exact bit-to-bit reconstruction. We show that this setup can be precomputed and transferred from another compatible architecture, preserving similar compression ratios and avoiding the need to amortize setup costs. Therefore, compression adaptation is transferable and reusable. Training checkpoints demonstrate continued reuse as the weights evolve. Finally, GPU experiments reduce active memory usage by up to 27.5$\%$ while reproducing the logits exactly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NeuralZip 把浮点模型权重的指数统计结构做成一次性可复用的 setup：按指数分布分组 chunk、共享 Huffman 码、用 packed exponents 表示重复指数元组，后续每次编码仍处理当前张量值。setup 后压缩比基线快 1.81–21.33× 且逐位完全重建，setup 还可从兼容架构迁移复用，训练过程中权重演化时也能持续复用。
Motivation: 无损压缩模型权重不动浮点值，但每次重复做统计分析与码表构造带来额外计算开销，checkpoint 频繁产生时这笔开销被反复支付。
Method: NeuralZip 先做一次 setup 决定表示方式：按相似指数分布对 chunk 分组、共享 Huffman 码、对重复出现的指数元组用 packed exponents 编码；每次编码仍读取当前张量值，setup 可预计算并从兼容架构迁移。
Result: 在浮点模型 checkpoint 上，setup 后压缩比基线快 1.81–21.33×，并实现逐位 (bit-to-bit) 完全重建；setup 迁移到兼容架构后保持相近压缩比；训练 checkpoint 上复用持续有效；GPU 实验中活跃内存最多降低 27.5%，logits 完全一致。
Conclusion: 浮点权重的指数统计结构可以一次建立、跨编码与跨兼容架构复用，从而在不损失精度的前提下把压缩开销摊掉并降低 GPU 活跃内存。

papers.title: RollVerify: Bridging Efficiency and Accuracy in Long-Tail Rollout Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning is crucial for improving large language models' reasoning and generalization. It relies on massive rollouts whose lengths become increasingly long-tailed as context windows grow. In on-policy training, these long-tail rollouts can result in GPU bubbles, reducing system utilization and limiting RL scalability. Asynchronous or partial-rollout methods improve throughput by relaxing synchronization, but inevitably introduce stale off-policy samples (trajectories) that may hurt final accuracy. Existing approaches mainly mitigate this off-policy issue by reweighting off-policy samples during training, yet they can still leave a performance gap compared to fully on-policy training. In this work, rather than passively reweighting samples during training, we propose RollVerify, a lightweight RL framework built on partial rollout that actively verifies and repairs samples before they enter training. Specifically, it introduces an off-policy shift metric OPS, to quantify the off-policy deviation of partially generated trajectories. Guided by the OPS constraint, RollVerify performs both sequence-level and token-level verification to identify and truncate invalid suffixes of trajectories. This yields high-quality samples that protect the models' accuracy while preserving the efficiency gains of partial rollout. Experiments on mathematical and tool-assisted mathematical reasoning show that RollVerify achieves accuracy comparable to on-policy training while reducing training cost. Additional code-generation results provide preliminary evidence beyond mathematics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RollVerify 是基于 partial rollout 的轻量 RL 框架：用 off-policy 偏移度量 OPS 约束，在样本进入训练前做序列级与 token 级校验并截断轨迹的无效后缀，而非训练时被动重加权。在数学与工具辅助数学推理上达到与 on-policy 训练相当的精度同时降低训练成本，代码生成上给出初步证据。
Motivation: 上下文变长使 rollout 长度呈长尾，on-policy 训练出现 GPU bubble、限制 RL 扩展；异步或 partial rollout 提吞吐却引入 stale off-policy 轨迹，仅靠重加权仍与全 on-policy 存在性能差距。
Method: 提出 RollVerify：定义 off-policy shift 度量 OPS 量化部分生成轨迹的偏离，在 OPS 约束下做序列级与 token 级校验，识别并截断无效后缀，使样本进入训练前被修复。
Result: 在数学与工具辅助数学推理实验中，RollVerify 达到与 on-policy 训练相当的精度并降低训练成本；代码生成实验提供数学之外的初步证据。
Conclusion: 在样本进入训练前主动校验并修复 partial rollout 轨迹，可以同时保住 on-policy 精度与 partial rollout 的效率收益，而不必只靠训练时重加权。

papers.title: FedSSMCoOp: SSM Encoders for light-weight Federated Prompt Learning for Few-shot Classification
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong performance across a wide range of downstream vision tasks, thanks to the complementary information contained in the respective domains. Despite the performance gains, most of these approaches rely on aligning these domains using the cosine similarity metric, which fails to capture token-level structure and cross-modal interactions prior to the classification stage. This is especially critical in biomedical applications under federated constraints, where data sharing is restricted, labeled data is scarce at each site, and it differs widely across institutions, leading to substantial statistical heterogeneity. To overcome this issue, we propose FedSSMCoOp, a federated few-shot image classification framework that enables multimodal learning while preserving data privacy. With the help of the SSM-based Vision Mamba and Cross Mamba blocks, and by optimizing only the soft-prompt and communication-prompt updates in the federated setting, the framework prioritizes both computation and performance. Importantly, this eliminates the need to use an external Large Language Model (LLM) for feature alignment. The framework is further trained and evaluated on various biomedical image datasets, and its performance is assessed. The proposed framework delivers stable performance relative to the baselines and is, on average, 1.96 times lighter. The corresponding script will be made available soon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FedSSMCoOp 在联邦少样本图像分类中用 SSM 结构的 Vision Mamba 与 Cross Mamba 替代余弦相似度对齐，只优化 soft-prompt 与 communication-prompt 更新，从而免掉外部 LLM 做跨模态特征对齐。在多个生物医学图像数据集上训练与评测，性能相对基线稳定，平均模型轻 1.96 倍。
Motivation: VLM 下游分类普遍靠余弦相似度对齐视觉与文本，抓不住分类前的 token 级结构与跨模态交互；生物医学场景又叠加联邦约束、各机构标注稀缺且统计异质性大，共享数据受限。
Method: 提出联邦少样本框架 FedSSMCoOp：用 SSM-based Vision Mamba 与 Cross Mamba 块做多模态编码，联邦训练中只更新 soft-prompt 与 communication-prompt，不引入外部 Large Language Model 做特征对齐，从而同时压低计算与通信开销。
Result: 在多个生物医学图像数据集上训练并评测，性能相对基线保持稳定，平均比基线轻 1.96 倍。
Conclusion: 在联邦少样本生物医学分类里，用 SSM 编码器加提示优化可以替代外部 LLM 的跨模态对齐，在保持基线水平的同时把模型压轻约一半。

papers.title: Constrained-Action AI Remediation for SIEM/XDR via a NeMo-Guardrails Proxy
papers.abstract_en: Security Operations Centers (SOCs) for information technology and operational technology share one incident-response problem: a flood of correlated alerts and too few analysts. Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed as reasoning engines that triage alerts and, in autonomous deployments, issue commands that block IPs, kill processes, or quarantine files on production hosts. This coupling introduces a new risk: a single adversarial alert can become a remote code path through the LLM's reasoning, leading it to recommend an action the SOC then executes. We present a constrained-action architecture with two coordinated layers: (i) a SIEM/XDR control plane that grounds remediation in correlated host events and confines the LLM's output to a closed intent vocabulary whose templated commands are executed by thin endpoint agents, backstopped by an argument validator; and (ii) a NeMo-Guardrails proxy that wraps the SOC-analyst LLM with input- and output-rail policies, evaluated out-of-the-box against a SOC-specific adversarial corpus we release. The stock proxy lifts injection recall from 25.0% to 94.5% at a 0.1% false-positive rate, and a live red-team exercise confirms that the closed intent vocabulary and argument validator contain the observed LLM failure modes before any command crosses the trust boundary. As an architectural fit (not yet a measured operational-technology deployment), the constrained-action property suits critical-infrastructure settings where a wrong remediation has physical, not merely operational, consequences. The loop is best run human-in-the-loop or delayed: the measured rail latency keeps inline control out of scope.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Cyber Security and Resilience (IEEE CSR 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向 SIEM/XDR 的受限动作架构：用闭合意图词表加模板化命令把 LLM 的处置输出锁死在控制面内，外层再套 NeMo-Guardrails 代理做输入/输出轨策略。开箱即用的代理把注入召回率从 25.0% 提到 94.5%（误报率 0.1%），实测轨延迟要求该回路以人在环或延迟方式运行。
Motivation: SOC 面对海量关联告警与分析师不足，LLM 被用作分诊与自主下发处置命令的推理引擎后，单条对抗性告警可能经 LLM 推理变成远程代码路径，诱导 SOC 执行危险动作。
Method: 两层协同：SIEM/XDR 控制面把处置锚定在关联主机事件上，将 LLM 输出限制为闭合意图词表，由薄端点代理执行模板化命令并加参数校验器兜底；外层 NeMo-Guardrails 代理包裹 SOC 分析师 LLM，配置输入与输出轨策略，并在自建的 SOC 对抗语料上开箱评测，同时做实弹红队演练。
Result: 开箱 NeMo-Guardrails 代理在自建 SOC 对抗语料上把注入召回率从 25.0% 提升到 94.5%，误报率 0.1%；实弹红队演练确认闭合意图词表与参数校验器在命令越过信任边界前遏制了观测到的 LLM 失败模式；实测轨延迟使内联控制不在可行范围内。
Conclusion: 受限动作属性适合错误处置会造成物理后果的关键基础设施场景，但该回路应以人在环或延迟方式运行，因为实测延迟排除了内联控制；论文明确该架构契合性尚非实测的 OT 部署。

papers.title: Learning joint probabilistic weather forecasts from station observations alone
papers.abstract_en: Assessing compound weather risks requires forecasts representing dependence between variables. CLARA (Calibrated Advection-Routing Attention) learns joint Gaussian predictive distributions of five surface variables from station observations alone, without numerical weather prediction or reanalysis; the approximately 28,000-parameter model supports CPU training and prediction. Across six multi-year folds on 96 stations, its lead-mean energy score is 4.9% lower than that of a learned comparator with matched temporal inputs (4.7% with a similar parameter count) and 11-65% lower than those of statistical baselines. Holding marginal variances fixed, removing learned correlations worsens joint negative log-likelihood by 1.0-2.8 nats per station. A covariance-scale estimator, proved consistent under stated assumptions, improves short-lead calibration but over-corrects at long leads. Synthetic interventions show an attention-bias coefficient alone does not measure forecast influence. Retrained in ten regions on six continents, CLARA outperforms persistence in all 60 multi-year region-lead comparisons and a similarly sized learned model in 57 of 60.
papers.comment: 62 pages, 6 figures, 3 Extended Data figures, 7 Extended Data tables; includes Supplementary Information
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CLARA (Calibrated Advection-Routing Attention) 仅用站点观测学习五个地面气象要素的联合高斯预报分布，完全不依赖 NWP 或再分析，约 28,000 参数、可在 CPU 上训练与预测。六折 96 站检验中 lead-mean energy score 比时间输入匹配的学习型对照低 4.9%（参数量相近时低 4.7%），比统计基线低 11–65%；固定边际方差、去掉学到的相关性会使联合 NLL 恶化 1.0–2.8 nats/站。
Motivation: 复合天气风险评估需要变量间依赖结构，而多数低成本预报只给单变量边际分布；同时站点观测是唯一可用数据源的场景缺少不依赖 NWP 或再分析的联合概率预报方案。
Method: CLARA 用 advection-routing attention 从站点观测直接输出五个地面变量的联合高斯预测分布，模型约 28,000 参数、支持 CPU 训练与预测；另配一个在给定假设下证明一致的 covariance-scale estimator 校准协方差尺度，并用合成干预 (synthetic interventions) 检验注意力偏置系数能否代表预报影响。
Result: 在 96 个站点的六个多年份 fold 上，lead-mean energy score 比时间输入匹配的学习型对照低 4.9%（参数量相近时低 4.7%），比统计基线低 11–65%；固定边际方差去掉学到的相关性后，联合负对数似然每站恶化 1.0–2.8 nats。covariance-scale estimator 改善短 lead 校准但在长 lead 上过度校正。合成干预显示单个 attention-bias 系数不足以度量预报影响。在六大洲十个区域重训后，60 个区域-lead 多年份比较中全部胜过持续性 (persistence)，并在 60 个中的 57 个胜过同规模学习模型。
Conclusion: 仅凭站点观测即可学到有用的变量间联合依赖并胜过持续性与统计基线，但协方差尺度校正只在短 lead 可靠，且注意力偏置系数不能当作影响归因量。

papers.title: NL2Hull: A Natural Language-Driven Constrained Ship Design Decision Framework
papers.abstract_en: Ship-form design combines smooth geometric representation, local shape editing, and constraints on the resulting hull. We present the Natural-Language-to-Hull Framework (NL2Hull Framework), which formulates ship-form editing as a typed discrete decision problem and connects language decisions to numerical geometry. Its Constrained Free-Form Deformation Engine (CFFD Engine) represents hull waterlines with non-uniform rational B-splines (NURBS), applies free-form deformation (FFD) to their control points, reconstructs the hull, and checks geometric constraints. We construct the Ship Design Decision Dataset (SDD Dataset) with 134,558 cleaned records and evaluate compared models on its subset Ship Design Decision Benchmark (SDDBench), containing 5,000 records and 43,496 typed questions. We propose Chip, a constrained ship-design decision model for processing natural-language requests. Chip reaches 95.90\% question accuracy and 99.32\% FFD exact match, with a negative log-likelihood of 0.0951, an expected calibration error of 0.0032, and a Brier score of 0.0551. The NL2Hull Framework provides a reproducible interface for evaluating language-based ship-form decisions while identifying the geometry and continuous-control components that require further development. Our code and dataset is available at https://github.com/wenhuahuo/NL2Hull.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NL2Hull 把船舶型线编辑形式化为带类型的离散决策问题，用 CFFD Engine 以 NURBS 表示水线、对控制点做 FFD 并检查几何约束，把自然语言请求接到数值几何上。配套构建 134,558 条记录的 SDD Dataset，专用决策模型 Chip 在 SDDBench（5,000 条记录、43,496 个带类型问题）上问题准确率 95.90%、FFD 精确匹配 99.32%。
Motivation: 船舶型线设计同时涉及光滑几何表示、局部形状编辑与船体约束，语言层面的决策与数值几何之间缺少可复现的对接与评测接口。
Method: 将型线编辑表述为 typed discrete decision problem，CFFD Engine 用 NURBS 表示水线、对控制点施加自由变形 (FFD)、重建船体并检查几何约束；构建 SDD Dataset（134,558 条清洗记录）及其子集 SDDBench（5,000 条记录、43,496 个 typed questions），训练受限船型决策模型 Chip 处理自然语言请求。
Result: Chip 在 SDDBench 上问题准确率 95.90%，FFD 精确匹配 99.32%，负对数似然 (NLL) 0.0951，期望校准误差 (ECE) 0.0032，Brier 分数 0.0551。
Conclusion: 语言驱动的型线决策可以经由带类型决策与 FFD 约束检查形成可复现的评测接口，几何与连续控制部分仍需进一步发展。

papers.title: QCATS: Query Context-Aware Transformer Slicing for Efficient Predictive Query Processing
papers.abstract_en: In-database predictive query processing increasingly applies Transformer-based models within relational pipelines. However, existing in-database inference typically exposes only tuple-level model inputs to the inference runtime, leaving relational predicates and metadata statistics invisible to neural execution planning. In this paper, we propose QCATS, a query context-aware transformer slicing framework that enables efficient sparse inference inside database systems. QCATS executes at query granularity: instead of routing individual tokens or tuples during inference, it uses query predicates and metadata statistics to pre-select context-aligned FFN slices before model execution. The framework comprises offline expert construction and lightweight query-level routing that dynamically selects experts during execution. QCATS further introduces system optimizations, including asynchronous CPU-GPU pipelines and routing-aware batching. Experiments on four predictive-query workloads with BERT-base and Qwen-0.6B show that QCATS achieves up to 4.42x latency reduction while preserving prediction accuracy comparable to dense baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QCATS 把数据库内的 Transformer 推理从逐 token/元组路由改为查询粒度路由：用查询谓词与元数据统计在执行前预选上下文对齐的 FFN 切片（专家），配合异步 CPU-GPU 流水线与路由感知批处理。在四类预测查询负载上用 BERT-base 与 Qwen-0.6B 测试，延迟最高降低 4.42 倍，预测精度与稠密基线相当。
Motivation: 数据库内推理通常只把元组级模型输入暴露给推理运行时，关系谓词与元数据统计对神经执行规划不可见，导致稀疏推理无法按查询上下文裁剪。
Method: 框架分两部分：离线专家构造（把 FFN 切成切片）与轻量的查询级路由，在执行期依据查询谓词和元数据统计动态选择专家；系统层加入异步 CPU-GPU 流水线与路由感知 batching。
Result: 在四个预测查询负载上，配合 BERT-base 与 Qwen-0.6B，延迟最高降低 4.42 倍，同时预测精度与稠密基线相当。
Conclusion: 把路由决策从 token/元组级上移到查询级、并让谓词与统计量参与选片，可以在数据库内 Transformer 推理中同时拿到稀疏化的延迟收益和稠密级精度。

papers.title: Defensive Sufficiency in a Stackelberg Model of AI Security
papers.abstract_en: Feedback from automated testing, human red teaming, and incident response can strengthen an AI system's defenses when discovered failures lead to effective repairs. We study when this feedback process provides sufficient protection and when investing in it is economically worthwhile. We begin by showing that an attack surface composed of finite number of inputs is defended with probability 1 if every unresolved attack has a persistent chance of discovery, repairs are effective, and subsequent updates preserve earlier protection. We derive completion-time bounds and extend the analysis to growing attack surfaces, repairs that generalize across related attacks, and multiple discovery mechanisms. These results distinguish eventual protection against each fixed attack from complete protection at a single time. We then formulate a defender-led Stackelberg game in which the defender invests in proactive discovery and reactive repair, anticipating the attacker's choice of search effort. We characterize the least-cost allocation that deters attack and the equilibrium regimes in which the defender funds neither capability, one capability, or both. Numerical experiments illustrate these regimes and show how faster repair can reduce compromise duration without reducing compromise probability.unified theory of performance limits in generative language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把 AI 系统的红队测试与事故反馈形式化为防御充分性问题：只要每个未修复攻击都有持续被发现的概率、修复有效、且后续更新不回退，有限攻击面就会以概率 1 被防御。进一步建立防御者先行的 Stackelberg 博弈，刻画以最小成本威慑攻击的投入分配，数值实验显示更快修复能缩短被攻破持续时间但不降低被攻破概率。
Motivation: 自动化测试、人工红队与事故响应的反馈投入何时才算够、何时在经济上值得，缺少可判定的理论条件；同时需要区分“对每个固定攻击最终都被防住”与“在某一时刻完全防住”这两种不同的保护概念。
Method: 先对有限攻击面给出以概率 1 防御的条件（持续发现概率、修复有效、更新保持既有保护），推导完成时间界，并推广到增长的攻击面、跨相关攻击泛化的修复与多种发现机制；再构建防御者主导的 Stackelberg 博弈，防御者在主动发现与被动修复之间投资，同时预判攻击者的搜索努力，刻画威慑攻击的最小成本配置与“都不投、投其一、都投”的均衡区间。
Result: 给出完成时间界，并区分对每个固定攻击的最终保护与单一时刻的完全保护；博弈刻画出威慑所需的最小成本配置及三种均衡区间。数值实验展示这些区间，并显示更快修复缩短被攻破持续时间、但不降低被攻破概率。
Conclusion: 反馈式防御的充分性可由发现、修复与更新保持三条条件判定，而投入多少则由 Stackelberg 均衡区间决定；修复速度改善的是受损时长而非是否被攻破。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 论文把 AI 系统的红队测试与事故反馈形式化为防御充分性问题：只要每个未修复攻击都有持续被发现的概率、修复有效、且后续更新不回退，有限攻击面就会以概率 1 被防御。进一步建立防御者先行的 Stackelberg 博弈，刻画以最小成本威慑攻击的投入分配，数值实验显示更快修复能缩短被攻破持续时间但不降低被攻破概率。
summary_sections.motivation: 自动化测试、人工红队与事故响应的反馈投入何时才算够、何时在经济上值得，缺少可判定的理论条件；同时需要区分“对每个固定攻击最终都被防住”与“在某一时刻完全防住”这两种不同的保护概念。
summary_sections.method: 先对有限攻击面给出以概率 1 防御的条件（持续发现概率、修复有效、更新保持既有保护），推导完成时间界，并推广到增长的攻击面、跨相关攻击泛化的修复与多种发现机制；再构建防御者主导的 Stackelberg 博弈，防御者在主动发现与被动修复之间投资，同时预判攻击者的搜索努力，刻画威慑攻击的最小成本配置与“都不投、投其一、都投”的均衡区间。
summary_sections.result: 给出完成时间界，并区分对每个固定攻击的最终保护与单一时刻的完全保护；博弈刻画出威慑所需的最小成本配置及三种均衡区间。数值实验展示这些区间，并显示更快修复缩短被攻破持续时间、但不降低被攻破概率。
summary_sections.conclusion: 反馈式防御的充分性可由发现、修复与更新保持三条条件判定，而投入多少则由 Stackelberg 均衡区间决定；修复速度改善的是受损时长而非是否被攻破。

papers.title: A Scoping Review and Experimental Study on Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback for Human-Robot Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: Human-Robot Collaboration (HRC) can facilitate mass customisation in Industry 4.0, with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) representing a promising approach for developing safe AI-based robots. Practical challenges remain regarding safety during AI development, human feedback quality, and bidirectional human-robot adaptation. We conducted a scoping review of RLHF in HRC systems, mapping methods that address these challenges. Following PRISMA guidelines, we screened 199 records and included 20 peer-reviewed publications (2020-2025) spanning multiple HRC domains. To our knowledge, this is the first review focused on the bidirectional, closed-loop design of RLHF. Our review found multiple feedback modalities enabling data collection in various feedback formats. Collected data can be integrated at different stages of AI training, resulting in a multi-step development process. Pilot experiments are commonly used to evaluate HRC systems based on both human and robot metrics. To empirically test a key gap identified in the review, we conducted a between-subjects VR experiment comparing system- and user-initiated feedback on robot proxemic behaviour for safe navigation. Using Bayesian models, we analysed the relation between the collected feedback and safety metrics: psychological safety (post-experiment questionnaire) and physical safety (inverse time-to-collision). Results show that user-initiated feedback captures perceived safety better than system-initiated feedback, indicating that feedback timing directly affects feedback quality. Our review and experiment findings show that RLHF relies on appropriate feedback methods to ensure AI safety in HRC, and future RLHF research should prioritise realistic HRC experiments evaluating the effects of feedback collection methods on relevant human and robot metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于人机协作 (HRC) 中 RLHF 的范围综述加受试者间 VR 实验：按 PRISMA 筛选 199 条记录、纳入 20 篇 2020–2025 年同行评议文献，梳理反馈模态、数据接入训练的阶段与评估指标。实验用贝叶斯模型比较系统发起与用户发起的反馈对机器人近体行为（安全导航）的影响，发现用户发起的反馈更好地捕捉心理安全感，说明反馈时机直接影响反馈质量。
Motivation: HRC 中 RLHF 面临开发期安全、反馈质量与人机双向适应的实际困难，且缺少聚焦双向闭环设计的综述；综述还指出反馈采集方法对人和机器人指标的影响缺乏实证检验。
Method: 综述部分按 PRISMA 指南筛选 199 条记录、纳入 20 篇 2020–2025 年文献，映射反馈模态、数据接入 AI 训练的阶段与评估指标。实验部分为受试者间 VR 实验，比较系统发起与用户发起的反馈对机器人近体行为 (proxemic behaviour) 安全导航的作用，用贝叶斯模型分析反馈与安全指标的关系。
Result: 纳入 20 篇文献（2020–2025），筛选 199 条记录。VR 实验中用户发起的反馈比系统发起的反馈更好地捕捉心理安全感（实验后问卷），物理安全用 inverse time-to-collision 度量；结论是反馈时机直接影响反馈质量。
Conclusion: RLHF 在 HRC 中的效果取决于反馈方法是否恰当，未来研究应优先开展贴近真实的 HRC 实验，评估反馈采集方法对相关人与机器人指标的影响。

papers.title: Outperformance Inverse Optimization: Learning Objective Functions that Outperform Agent Decisions
papers.abstract_en: Inverse optimization estimates the weights of an objective function that explain observed decisions as optimal solutions, and is used in a variety of fields. For mixed-integer linear programs (MILPs), existing methods aim to reproduce the observations as optimal solutions, and thus learn compromise weights when the observations are suboptimal. We propose outperformance inverse optimization, which instead seeks weights that induce, at each state, an optimal solution outperforming the observed action in every component. We give a loss function that can be evaluated with forward-problem oracles alone and is thus applicable to MILPs, together with gradient-based and DC optimization algorithms for minimizing it. For weights inducing a unique outperforming optimal solution at all observations, we prove that the probability of failing to induce such a solution at a new state (the generalization error) is bounded by a quantity inversely proportional to the number of observations, and that this bound is tight in the number of observations up to logarithmic factors. In experiments on synthetic and real data, the proposed methods improve the prediction of solutions outperforming the actions over existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 outperformance inverse optimization：不再拟合观测决策为最优解，而是学习能在每个状态下给出严格优于观测动作的最优解的目标函数权重。给出只用前向求解 oracle 即可计算的损失函数与梯度/DC 优化算法，并证明当权重在所有观测上诱导唯一优解时，泛化失败概率以观测数倒数为界且在对数因子内紧。
Motivation: 混合整数线性规划 (MILP) 的逆优化现有方法以复现观测为最优解为目标，当观测本身次优时会学到折衷权重，无法反映更优决策。
Method: 定义 outperformance 损失：要求每个状态下的最优解在每一项上都优于观测动作；该损失仅用前向问题 oracle 求值，因而适用于 MILP；配套给出基于梯度与 DC (difference-of-convex) 优化的最小化算法。
Result: 理论上证明：若权重在全部观测上诱导唯一优解，则在新状态上诱导失败的概率（泛化误差）被一个与观测数成反比的量界定，且该界在观测数上（至多差对数因子）是紧的。在合成数据与真实数据实验中，所提方法在预测优于观测动作的解这一指标上优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 把逆优化目标从复现观测改为诱导严格更优解，可以在观测次优时学到更好的权重，并有观测数反比的泛化保证。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Identifiability of a dissipative knowledge-dynamics model: exact recovery under designed excitation, degeneration on observational data
papers.abstract_en: Human learning is a dissipative dynamical process: mastery accumulates through practice, decays through forgetting, and propagates across interdependent concepts. We model it as a nonlinear dissipative system of ordinary differential equations whose parameters are mechanistically meaningful (a concept-transfer matrix encoding prerequisite coupling, per-concept forgetting rates, and a saturating practice-response gain), and we study when those parameters can actually be recovered from data. We prove a structural identifiability theorem for the associated inverse problem under explicit excitation conditions, with constructive closed-form recovery for the two-concept case, together with monotonicity, robustness and L-stability results. We derive a semi-implicit L-stable scheme for the dissipative subsystem and a batched solver numerically equivalent to the per-trajectory formulation (bit-exact predictions, gradients to $10^{-10}$) yet two orders of magnitude faster, making estimation feasible on cohorts of $10^5$ learners. The empirical study is two-sided. Under the theorem's excitation conditions, synthetic recovery is exact: parameters to machine precision, prerequisite structure at $F_1 = 1.0$. On large observational benchmarks it is not. An apparently strong recovery, with forgetting rates correlating with topic difficulty at Spearman $ρ= 0.83$, is refuted by four independent controls: it survives destroying the temporal order of the data, is matched by a classical Bayesian baseline, and is unaffected by removing real timestamps. We trace this to the stationary structure of the model and show that it is the degeneration the theorem predicts in the absence of designed excitation. The result delineates a sharp boundary between identifiable and unidentifiable regimes and yields a validation protocol for interpretability claims.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把人类学习建成非线性耗散 ODE（概念迁移矩阵、逐概念遗忘率、饱和练习增益），证明在显式激励条件下逆问题结构可辨识，两概念情形有闭式恢复；合成数据在该激励下参数恢复到机器精度、先修结构 F1=1.0。但在大型观测基准上看似强的恢复（遗忘率与题目难度 Spearman ρ=0.83）被四项独立对照推翻——打乱时间顺序仍成立、与经典 Bayesian 基线持平、去掉真实时间戳无影响——作者归因于模型的平稳结构，正是定理预言的无设计激励时的退化。
Motivation: 可解释的知识动力学模型参数若从观测数据拟合，可能只是表面可辨识：看似合理的遗忘率估计在破坏时间结构的对照下依然成立，使机制参数的解释性主张失去依据。
Method: 将学习建模为参数具机制含义的非线性耗散 ODE 系统；在显式激励条件下证明结构可辨识定理并给出两概念情形的构造性闭式恢复，配套单调性、鲁棒性与 L-稳定性结果；为耗散子系统推导半隐式 L-稳定格式与逐轨迹数值等价的批量求解器（预测 bit-exact，梯度到 10^-10），用于 10^5 量级学习者队列的估计。
Result: 定理激励条件下合成恢复精确：参数达机器精度，先修结构 F1=1.0。观测基准上遗忘率与题目难度 Spearman ρ=0.83 的强恢复被四项独立对照推翻：打乱时间顺序仍存活、被经典 Bayesian 基线匹配、去掉真实时间戳不受影响。批量求解器比逐轨迹快两个数量级，梯度一致到 10^-10，可支撑 10^5 学习者队列。
Conclusion: 可辨识性存在由设计激励决定的清晰边界：无设计激励时观测数据上的参数恢复会退化，因此机制参数的可解释性主张必须先过一套对照验证协议。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Sparsifying Stochasticity, Not Capacity: Partial Stochasticity via Deep Weight Factorization of Prior Scales
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian neural networks need not be fully stochastic to be universal conditional density approximators, but it remains open which parameters should be stochastic. We learn this split by applying deep weight factorization to the prior scales, which are the standard deviations of the parameter priors, while fitting the functional prior to a Gaussian process with a maximum mean discrepancy objective. A parameter whose prior scale falls below a cutoff becomes deterministic and is optimized during inference, so the regularizer sparsifies stochasticity rather than capacity. We give a certificate for universal conditional density approximation that is checkable in linear time, together with a minimal repair when it fails. We further show that the common hybrid scheme of sampling some parameters and optimizing the others is stochastic approximation for a type-II maximum a posteriori objective, and that coupled step sizes can leave a tracking error that does not vanish as the step size shrinks. On a bimodal target, the learned split stays close to an unconstrained reference across all budgets and is insensitive to the cutoff, while random masks that distribute the same prior scales across layers are worse by up to two orders of magnitude. On UCI benchmarks, our method performs on par with a fully stochastic network while keeping about half of its parameters deterministic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 通过深度权重分解 (deep weight factorization) 学习贝叶斯神经网络中哪些参数保持随机：先用最大均值差异 (MMD) 把函数先验拟合到高斯过程，再把先验尺度 (prior scale) 低于阈值的参数转为确定性并在推断时优化，从而稀疏化随机性而非容量。在双峰目标上该划分在各预算下都贴近无约束参考且对阈值不敏感，而把相同先验尺度随机分配到各层的随机掩码差最多两个数量级；在 UCI 基准上以约一半参数保持确定性达到全随机网络的同等水平。
Motivation: 贝叶斯神经网络不必全随机即可成为通用条件密度逼近器，但哪些参数应当保持随机仍是开放问题；常见的“采样一部分、优化一部分”混合方案缺少理论刻画。
Method: 对参数先验的标准差（先验尺度）施加深度权重分解，同时用 MMD 目标把函数先验拟合到高斯过程；先验尺度低于阈值的参数在推断阶段作为确定性参数优化。给出一个可在线性时间检验的通用条件密度逼近证书及其失效时的最小修复，并证明混合方案等价于 type-II MAP 目标下的随机逼近，耦合步长会留下不随步长缩小而消失的跟踪误差。
Result: 在双峰目标上，学到的划分在所有预算下都接近无约束参考且对阈值不敏感；把相同先验尺度随机分配到各层的随机掩码差最多两个数量级。在 UCI 基准上，该方法与全随机网络表现相当，同时保持约一半参数为确定性。
Conclusion: 随机性应当按先验尺度被选择性地稀疏化，而不是削减模型容量；证书与 type-II MAP 视角说明混合采样-优化方案的跟踪误差可能不随步长消失。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: 对参数先验的标准差（先验尺度）施加深度权重分解，同时用 MMD 目标把函数先验拟合到高斯过程；先验尺度低于阈值的参数在推断阶段作为确定性参数优化。给出一个可在线性时间检验的通用条件密度逼近证书及其失效时的最小修复，并证明混合方案等价于 type-II MAP 目标下的随机逼近，耦合步长会留下不随步长缩小而消失的跟踪误差。
summary_sections.result: 在双峰目标上，学到的划分在所有预算下都接近无约束参考且对阈值不敏感；把相同先验尺度随机分配到各层的随机掩码差最多两个数量级。在 UCI 基准上，该方法与全随机网络表现相当，同时保持约一半参数为确定性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 随机性应当按先验尺度被选择性地稀疏化，而不是削减模型容量；证书与 type-II MAP 视角说明混合采样-优化方案的跟踪误差可能不随步长消失。

papers.title: Layerwise Error Attribution for Fast and Robust Mixed-Precision Post-Training Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Mixed-precision post-training quantization is a network compression method that assigns bits layer by layer, under a global memory budget using a small calibration set. The main difficulties are to overcome the combinatorial nature of the allocation problem and to manage the sensitivity to small, potentially corrupted databases. Hence, an efficient allocation method should be fast to compute and preserve model quality when calibration data are corrupted. To design such a method, we derive a layerwise probabilistic analysis of the quantization error that separates propagated error from the local perturbation introduced at a given layer. We use this local term to build a separable score for a simple allocation algorithm, that requires no external solver. The probabilistic nature of our approach brings robustness to corrupted data. On denoising tasks with DRUNet, with an average budget of 4 bits per weight, our method matches or improves state-of-the-art mixed-precision baselines under clean calibration, and is more robust to corrupted calibration, with PSNR gains of up to 7.5 dB under the tested corruptions. Experiments show bit-allocation speed-ups from 28x to 2,570x over the studied baselines. For quantized diffusion models, our experiments show that a direct application of our framework also improves the state-of-the-art.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出逐层量化误差的概率分解，把传播误差与给定层引入的局部分离，用局部项构造可分离打分，驱动一个无需外部求解器的混合精度位分配算法。在 DRUNet 去噪任务、平均每权重 4 bit 预算下，干净校准集上匹配或改进 SOTA 混合精度基线，校准集被污染时 PSNR 最高提升 7.5 dB，位分配加速 28x 到 2,570x；直接套用到量化扩散模型也改进 SOTA。
Motivation: 混合精度训练后量化要在全局内存预算下逐层分配比特，既要面对组合爆炸的分配问题，又要应对小规模且可能被污染的校准集带来的敏感性，现有分配方法要么慢、要么在脏数据下掉点。
Method: 对量化误差做逐层概率分析，将误差拆成传播项与给定层引入的局部分离项；用局部项构造可分离打分 (separable score)，配合一个简单、无需外部求解器的分配算法；概率建模本身带来对污染校准数据的鲁棒性。
Result: 在 DRUNet 去噪任务、平均每权重 4 bit 预算下，干净校准时匹配或改进所研究的混合精度 SOTA 基线；在所测试的校准污染下 PSNR 增益最高达 7.5 dB；位分配相对所研究基线加速 28x 至 2,570x；在量化扩散模型上直接应用该框架同样改进 SOTA。
Conclusion: 把逐层量化误差按传播与局部分解并用可分离打分做分配，可以在不牺牲质量的前提下大幅加速混合精度位分配，并在校准数据被污染时保持鲁棒；该框架可直接迁移到量化扩散模型。

papers.title: Think Before You Paint: Recursive Latent Reasoning for Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models generate realistic images but often fail on visual reasoning tasks, such as filling in a Sudoku or drawing the path through a maze. When a discrete symbolic representation is available, recursive methods such as the Tiny Recursive Model (TRM) solve even hard instances of these puzzles. We ask how such reasoning can be carried over to pixels, where no symbolic representation is available. We propose Painter-Thinker (PaTh): a small recursive network (the Thinker) reasons over a grid of learned tokens that encode the noisy image and the conditioning, refines a latent state within every denoising step, and steers a frozen diffusion model (the Painter) through ControlNet adapters. The Thinker is trained with the standard reconstruction loss alone, without symbolic targets, a solver, or a verifier. PaTh solves 92.5% of hard MNIST Sudoku puzzles (prior best 75%) and 71.2% of extreme ones (prior best 4.1%), with 10M parameters against 82M for a standard diffusion model. It also improves on mazes, Queens, and CLEVR scenes with specified spatial relations, and its advantage grows with problem size. Diagnostic experiments show that PaTh recovers from injected mistakes that the diffusion model cannot repair, especially when many cells are wrong. Together, these results show that reasoning mechanisms developed for symbolic data can be integrated into pixel-space diffusion without symbolic supervision, opening a path toward generating data under increasingly complex constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PaTh 在像素空间扩散模型里嵌入一个递归的 Thinker 网络，在每个去噪步内对含噪图像与条件的 token 网格反复精炼隐状态，并经 ControlNet 适配器引导冻结的 Painter。仅用标准重建损失、无符号监督即可解 92.5% 的困难 MNIST 数独（此前最好 75%）、71.2% 的极端数独（此前 4.1%），参数量 10M 对比标准扩散模型的 82M。
Motivation: 扩散模型在数独、迷宫这类视觉推理任务上经常失败，而 TRM 等递归方法在有离散符号表示时能解难题；符号推理机制能否在没有符号表示的像素空间复现是空白。
Method: Painter-Thinker (PaTh)：小递归网络 Thinker 在编码含噪图像与条件的学习 token 网格上推理，每个去噪步内精炼隐状态，通过 ControlNet adapters 引导冻结的扩散模型 Painter；训练只用标准重建损失，不用符号目标、solver 或 verifier。
Result: 困难 MNIST Sudoku 解出 92.5%（此前最好 75%），极端数独 71.2%（此前 4.1%）；参数 10M 对比标准扩散模型 82M。在迷宫、Queens、带指定空间关系的 CLEVR 场景上也有提升，且优势随问题规模增大；注入错误的诊断实验中 PaTh 能恢复而扩散模型不能，错误单元格很多时尤其明显。
Conclusion: 为符号数据设计的递归推理机制可以在无符号监督的情况下整合进像素空间扩散，使生成在越来越复杂的约束下可控。

papers.title: SANet: Selective Attention Network for Infrared Small Target Detection
papers.abstract_en: Infrared small target detection aims to accurately identify and locate dim targets in complex backgrounds and supports applications such as maritime surveillance and military search and rescue. However, the small size and weak contrast of infrared targets make it difficult to balance detection accuracy and false alarms. This paper proposes a selective attention network (SANet) for infrared small target detection. A dual-path semantic-aware module combines standard and pinwheel-shaped convolutions to preserve local spatial consistency and capture broader contextual information. Spatial and channel attention further refine the features and improve target-background discrimination. To address the limitations of static skip connections in U-Net, a selective attention fusion module adaptively integrates features across scales using spatially varying weights. It selectively enhances salient regions and improves discrimination between true targets and false alarms. Experiments on three public benchmarks, NUAA-SIRST, IRSTD-1K, and NUDT-SIRST, show that SANet achieves competitive performance in intersection over union (IoU), normalized IoU, detection probability, and false alarm rate. Its IoU exceeds that of the second-best method by 1.93, 4.32, and 2.21 percentage points, respectively. These results support the effectiveness of SANet in dim-target perception, discriminative feature representation, and background suppression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SANet 用双路径语义感知模块（标准卷积 + 风车状卷积）与空间/通道注意力提取红外小目标特征，再用选择性注意力融合模块以空间变化权重自适应跨尺度融合，替代 U-Net 静态 skip connection。在 NUAA-SIRST、IRSTD-1K、NUDT-SIRST 三个公开基准上，IoU 分别高出次优方法 1.93、4.32、2.21 个百分点。
Motivation: 红外小目标尺寸小、对比度弱，在复杂背景下检测精度与虚警率难以兼顾；U-Net 的静态 skip connection 无法按区域调节融合强度，易把背景杂波带入检测。
Method: 双路径语义感知模块并行使用标准卷积与 pinwheel-shaped 卷积，兼顾局部空间一致性和更大范围上下文；其后接空间与通道注意力细化特征、增强目标-背景可分性；选择性注意力融合模块用空间变化权重跨尺度自适应整合特征，选择性增强显著区域。
Result: 在 NUAA-SIRST、IRSTD-1K、NUDT-SIRST 三个公开基准上，SANet 的 IoU 分别超过次优方法 1.93、4.32、2.21 个百分点，并在 normalized IoU、检测概率 (detection probability) 与虚警率 (false alarm rate) 上取得有竞争力的表现。
Conclusion: 选择性跨尺度注意力融合配合双路径卷积，可在红外小目标检测中同时改善判别性特征表示与背景抑制，从而在提升 IoU 的同时压低虚警。

papers.title: Bringing BNNs to Fast Event Processing
papers.abstract_en: Binary Neural Networks (BNNs) enable efficient deep learning deployment on resource constrained devices with weights and activations compressed to one bit, substantially reducing model size and inference cost. Event cameras offer complementary advantages, including low latency, high dynamic range, and low power consumption, by capturing asynchronous streams of events rather than dense image frames. Despite their shared emphasis on efficiency, the combination of these technologies remains largely unexplored. This work aims at adapting and evaluating modern deep BNN architectures on event data. We also show that cross-modal pretraining from RGB data can improve the classification accuracy of BNNs on neuromorphic datasets. We introduce the Polar-wise Binary Event Volume (PBEV), a binary representation that enables event-camera data to be processed directly by BNNs and represents a step toward fully binarized event-based vision systems. Best evaluated BNN on N-Caltech101 classification benchmarks shows 90.58% accuracy with 7.5x less operations than their full-precision counterparts.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. Accepted by NeVi Workshop at ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把现代深度 BNN 架构迁移到事件相机数据，并提出二值化事件表示 Polar-wise Binary Event Volume (PBEV)，使事件流可被 BNN 直接处理。在 N-Caltech101 分类上最佳 BNN 达到 90.58% 准确率，运算量比全精度对应模型少 7.5 倍；从 RGB 数据做跨模态预训练可进一步提升神经形态数据集上的分类精度。
Motivation: BNN 把权重与激活压到 1 bit 以降低部署成本，事件相机以异步事件流换取低延迟与低功耗，但两者结合的高效事件视觉方案基本空白。
Method: 在事件数据上适配并评估现代深度 BNN 架构；用 RGB 数据做跨模态预训练以提升 BNN 在神经形态数据集上的分类精度；提出二值表示 PBEV，让事件相机数据可直接由 BNN 处理，朝全二值化事件视觉系统推进。
Result: N-Caltech101 分类基准上最佳 BNN 准确率 90.58%，运算量比全精度对应模型少 7.5 倍；RGB 跨模态预训练可提升 BNN 在神经形态数据集上的分类准确率。
Conclusion: 事件相机数据可以由二值表示直接喂给 BNN，在保持高精度的同时大幅削减运算量，是通向全二值化事件视觉的可行一步。

papers.title: LiveMACE: Process-Aware Evaluation of LLM Agent Capabilities in Evolving Markets
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating agents by outcomes alone can obscure the capabilities that produce them. This problem is especially pronounced in evolving environments, where outcomes reflect a closed-loop interaction between agent behavior and changing external conditions. We introduce LiveMACEBench, a process-aware benchmark that uses live financial markets as a naturally evolving testbed for persistent LLM agents. Five frontier LLMs operate along continuous trajectories under matched Tool Use, Persistent Memory, Rule Following, and Multi-Agent Collaboration configurations. We evaluate them through both realized outcomes and mechanism-specific diagnostics derived from complete decision traces. Across 30 days of live evaluation, we find a pronounced outcome-capability gap: realized returns often diverge from capability-specific measurements, and similar outcomes can arise from markedly different patterns of mechanism use. Trace-level diagnostics further expose distinct bottlenecks across capabilities, demonstrating that mechanism access, effective mechanism use, and downstream performance are not interchangeable measures of agent capability. LiveMACEBench makes this distinction measurable, turning live markets from a performance leaderboard into a diagnostic environment for agent capability
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LiveMACEBench 用实时金融市场作为持续演化测试床，对 LLM agent 的过程能力做诊断式评测：五个前沿模型在 Tool Use、Persistent Memory、Rule Following、Multi-Agent Collaboration 四种配置下沿连续轨迹运行 30 天，同时记录实现收益与来自完整决策轨迹的机制诊断。结果出现显著的 outcome-capability gap：实现收益常与能力测量背离，相近收益可对应截然不同的机制使用模式，且机制可及、机制有效使用与下游表现三者不可互换。
Motivation: 只看结果的评测在演化环境中会掩盖真正产生结果的能力，因为结果是 agent 行为与不断变化的外部条件闭环耦合的产物。
Method: 提出过程感知基准 LiveMACEBench，让五个前沿 LLM 作为持久 agent 在实时金融市场上沿连续轨迹运行，按匹配的 Tool Use、Persistent Memory、Rule Following、Multi-Agent Collaboration 四种配置对照；既评实现结果，也从完整决策轨迹中提取机制专属诊断。

papers.title: An AI-assisted conditioning and geological interpretation workflow for usage in implicit geological modeling
papers.abstract_en: Implicit modeling and Relative Geologic Time are geological modeling techniques that enable more efficient, faster, less biased and more reproducible modeling results. For optimal operation, these techniques require many well-constrained input data. In the framework of the Horizon Europe GO-Forward and MOOI WarmingUP GOO projects and to accelerate Implicit modeling, Machine Learning (ML) methods have been tested and implemented in a toolkit for the interpretation of (onshore) seismic data from the shallow to deep range (+- 300 - 3500 m). The goal is to rapidly characterise this depth domain by efficient interpretation of horizons and faults in seismic data. The first step is to improve the signal by applying AI techniques like self-supervised and semi-supervised contrastive learning CNN's for noise reduction and interpolation. Next, horizons and faults are interpreted with minimal use of human-generated training data by using (semi-) self-supervised methods. The resulting developed toolkit supports the application of the implemented algorithms in an efficient workflow. As a first demonstration, the top of the Dutch Maassluis Formation has been interpreted in the Leeuwarden and Waalwijk 3D seismic cubes. Overall, this study demonstrates that AI-assisted interpretation workflows have reached a level of maturity that allows their integration into applied geological modeling and decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向隐式地质建模，提出一套 AI 辅助地震解释工作流：先用自监督与半监督对比学习 CNN 做降噪和插值，再以极少人工标注的（半）自监督方法解释层位与断层，覆盖约 300–3500 m 深度域。首个演示在 Leeuwarden 与 Waalwijk 3D 地震体中解释了荷兰 Maassluis 组顶面，作者据此认为该类工作流已成熟到可并入实际地质建模与决策。
Motivation: 隐式地质建模与相对地质时间 (Relative Geologic Time) 需要大量约束充分的输入数据，人工解释层位和断层慢且偏差大，成为瓶颈。
Method: 工具链分两步：先用自监督与半监督对比学习 CNN 对地震信号降噪和插值；再用（半）自监督方法在极少人工标注下解释层位与断层，各算法封装成可复用工作流工具包，服务于 Horizon Europe GO-Forward 与 MOOI WarmingUP GOO 项目。
Result: 在 Leeuwarden 和 Waalwijk 两个 3D 地震体上解释了荷兰 Maassluis 组顶面，作为首个演示；处理深度域约 300–3500 m；论文为 17 页、19 图。
Conclusion: AI 辅助解释工作流的成熟度已足以并入应用级地质建模与决策流程，可加速隐式建模所需输入数据的获取。

papers.title: Deadline-Aware Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for TSN-Based Vehicular Edge Networks
papers.abstract_en: Vehicular edge computing (VEC) enables latency-sensitive applications by bringing computing and networking resources closer to vehicles. However, existing approaches often overlook network contention among co-located services with heterogeneous and dynamic latency requirements. While time-sensitive networking (TSN) provides bounded-latency communication, conventional and reinforcement learning-based schedulers struggle to adapt to highly dynamic vehicular environments and inter-queue dependencies. To address these limitations, we propose a multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) approach for queue-level scheduling in TSN-enabled VEC. Each TSN queue is assigned an autonomous agent that jointly learns the queue service order and time-slot duration to minimize deadline misses under speed-dependent latency requirements. We employ multi-agent proximal policy optimization (MAPPO) to enable coordinated yet autonomous scheduling decisions. Evaluation against single-agent, multi-agent, and non-learning-based baselines shows that MAPPO provides robust performance across different traffic profiles. Compared with centralized single-agent methods, it reduces service latency by up to 66.2% and improves reliability by up to 271.8%. Furthermore, unlike urgency-based heuristics, MAPPO ensures balanced scheduling while achieving lower inference times compared to other MARL methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 TSN 车载边缘网络 (VEC) 中，为每条 TSN 队列各配一个智能体，用 MAPPO 联合学习队列服务顺序与时隙长度，以在速度相关的时延要求下最小化 deadline miss。相比集中式单智能体方法，服务时延最多降低 66.2%，可靠性最多提升 271.8%，且推理时间低于其他 MARL 方法。
Motivation: 共址服务的时延需求异构且动态，网络竞争被现有方案忽略；TSN 虽提供有界时延，但传统与基于 RL 的调度器难以适应高动态车载环境和队列间依赖。
Method: 每个 TSN 队列分配一个自主智能体，联合学习队列服务顺序与时隙时长；训练采用 multi-agent proximal policy optimization (MAPPO)，实现协调而自主的调度决策，并与单智能体、多智能体及非学习基线对比。
Result: 相对集中式单智能体方法，服务时延最多降低 66.2%，可靠性最多提升 271.8%；在不同流量 profile 下表现稳健，推理时间低于其他 MARL 方法，并优于 urgency-based 启发式的均衡调度。
Conclusion: 队列级多智能体调度加 MAPPO 能在 TSN 车载边缘环境中同时压低时延、抬高可靠性并保持低推理开销，优于集中式单智能体与启发式方案。

papers.title: MUNITE: Unified Multimodal Latent Inference for Any-to-Any Multimodal Generation
papers.abstract_en: We introduce MUNITE, a latent-variable framework for flexible any-to-any multimodal generation that treats encoding and latent generation as the same inference problem under different amounts of observed evidence. Given any subset of modalities, MUNITE models the conditional distribution over the latent representation associated with the complete observation. Full observation recovers deterministic encoding, no observation recovers the latent marginal, and intermediate subsets define conditional latent inference, all within a single conditional flow model. A shared latent sample captures variation that must remain consistent across generated targets, while modality-specific generative decoders model the remaining uncertainty independently. To learn these conditional distributions from incomplete training examples, we extend conditional flow matching through self-distillation: predictions conditioned on richer available observations supervise the same model conditioned on smaller subsets at the same intermediate latent state. When the richer-evidence trajectory follows the exact conditional flow, this provides the same expected learning signal as full-target denoising. Across PolyMNIST-D-Q, FFHQ64, and image-text-audio, MUNITE achieves competitive or better generation quality and source-target alignment, with higher joint-generation coherence. In particular, it attains the highest coherence in all one-to-many and unconditional image-text-audio comparisons, showing the effectiveness of unified latent inference across diverse multimodal settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MUNITE 把任意模态子集下的编码与潜变量生成统一成同一个条件推断问题，用单一 conditional flow model 建模完整观测对应潜表示的条件分布：全观测退化为确定性编码，零观测退化为潜边缘分布。用自蒸馏扩展 conditional flow matching，让证据更充分的条件预测去监督证据更少的子集，在 PolyMNIST-D-Q、FFHQ64 与 image-text-audio 上取得有竞争力或更好的生成质量与源-目标对齐，并在全部 one-to-many 与无条件 image-text-audio 对比中拿到最高 joint-generation coherence。
Motivation: any-to-any 多模态生成中，不同观测完整度下的编码与生成通常被拆成多套模型，且训练样本常缺失部分模态，难以保证多个生成目标之间的跨模态一致性。
Method: 以单一 conditional flow model 定义给定任意观测子集时完整观测潜表示的条件分布，共享潜样本承载跨目标必须一致的变化，模态专属 generative decoder 独立建模剩余不确定性；训练用扩展的 conditional flow matching 加 self-distillation，由观测更丰富的条件预测在同一中间潜状态上监督观测更少的子集，当富证据轨迹服从精确 conditional flow 时，其期望学习信号与 full-target denoising 相同。
Result: 在 PolyMNIST-D-Q、FFHQ64 和 image-text-audio 三个设定上，生成质量与 source-target alignment 达到有竞争力或更好的水平，joint-generation coherence 更高；在全部 one-to-many 与无条件 image-text-audio 对比中取得最高 coherence。
Conclusion: 编码与潜变量生成可以作为同一条件推断问题在单一条件流模型内统一处理，跨模态一致性由共享潜样本保证，而自蒸馏使不完整训练样本也能学到这些条件分布。

papers.title: Global Average Precision for Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Standard information retrieval metrics, such as mean Average Precision (mAP), assess performance one query at a time, based on how the similarities between a query and its positives compare against those with its negatives. The same holds for common representation learning losses, such as InfoNCE and per-query AP surrogates. None of them considers whether similarities are comparable across queries, which any system with a single decision threshold relies on. Global Average Precision (gAP) does, by ranking all query-candidate pairs in one list and computing a single AP. We introduce gSAP, a differentiable surrogate of gAP. It needs only a similarity matrix and a binary matrix marking the positive pairs, the same input as existing losses, so it is a drop-in replacement for them and agnostic to the encoder, the modality, and the source of supervision. Since it considers all possible pairwise comparisons in the batch jointly, it also remains trainable at low temperatures, a regime where per-query surrogates run out of gradient. Swapping it into established recipes improves supervised metric learning, cross-modal alignment, and self-supervised pretraining, where, to our knowledge, it is the first ranking loss to replace the community standard InfoNCE in the latter two. Its similarities are more consistent across queries, which drives the gains under a universal threshold. gSAP retrieves up to four times as many positive pairs as the strongest AP surrogate at the same precision, and it degrades the least when queries with no positives in the database are added. Beyond thresholding, models trained with gSAP also learn better representations, with higher transfer, $k$NN and zero-shot classification accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出全局平均精度 gAP：把所有 query-candidate 对放进同一条排序列表算单一 AP，从而约束跨 query 的相似度可比性，并给出可微代理 gSAP。gSAP 只需相似度矩阵与正样本对二值矩阵，可直接替换 InfoNCE 与 per-query AP 代理；在同等精度下检索到的正样本对最多为最强 AP 代理的 4 倍，且在无正样本 query 加入时退化最小。
Motivation: mAP 与 InfoNCE、per-query AP 代理都逐 query 独立评估，不检查相似度跨 query 是否可比，而任何依赖单一决策阈值的系统都需要这种可比性；per-query 代理在低温区还会耗尽梯度。
Method: gAP 将全部 query-candidate 对统一排序后计算单一 AP；gAP 的可微代理 gSAP 只接收相似度矩阵与标记正样本对的二值矩阵，作为现有损失的 drop-in replacement，对 encoder、模态与监督来源均无关。由于在 batch 内联合考虑所有成对比较，gSAP 在低温下仍可训练。
Result: 在同等精度下 gSAP 检索到的正样本对最多为最强 AP 代理的 4 倍；加入数据库中无正样本的 query 时退化最小。gSAP 替换既有配方后改进了有监督度量学习、跨模态对齐与自监督预训练——据作者所知是后两者中首个替换社区标准 InfoNCE 的排序损失；其相似度跨 query 更一致，驱动了通用阈值下的收益，并带来更高的 transfer、kNN 与 zero-shot 分类精度。
Conclusion: 把跨 query 的相似度可比性直接写进排序损失，可以在单一阈值设定下同时提升检索与表征质量；gSAP 因输入与现有损失相同，可作为 InfoNCE 与 AP 代理的通用替换。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: DeepTopoClustering: Unsupervised Derivation of Surface Process Taxonomy from 4D Point Clouds for Topographic Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: 4D point clouds acquired by permanent laser scanning (PLS) enable accurate high-frequency monitoring of surface change in dynamic topographic environments. However, existing methods remain limited in organizing detected surface activities into meaningful process types. We propose DeepTopoClustering (DTC), an unsupervised framework for deriving a hierarchical process taxonomy from object-based surface activities, so-called 4D objects-by-change (4D-OBCs). We transform each 4D-OBC into a GeoMorphogram, a distributional sequence representing the temporal evolution of topographic change within a spatially bounded surface activity. A convolutional autoencoder learns latent embeddings from GeoMorphograms, which are jointly optimized using a hierarchical deep clustering objective to organize surface activities into a hierarchy. We evaluate the learned hierarchy using expert annotations on two 4D datasets of sandy beach sites and their combination. DTC with GeoMorphograms achieves the highest agreement with expert judgment at the taxonomy level comprising eight major process types ($F_1=0.78$, match accuracy $=0.92$), outperforming dimensionality reduction and conventional flat clustering. The learned taxonomy separates major erosion- and deposition-dominated activities and distinguishes finer subtypes based on change magnitude, duration, compactness, and temporal evolution. DTC thus provides a scalable and interpretable route from 4D change detection to a data-driven, expert-supported surface process taxonomy, advancing automated knowledge derivation for understanding surface dynamics in topographic monitoring.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeepTopoClustering (DTC) 把永久激光扫描 (PLS) 的 4D 点云变化检测结果转成可聚类的地表过程分类体系：每个 4D objects-by-change (4D-OBC) 被编码为 GeoMorphogram 时序分布，卷积自编码器学习嵌入并与层次深度聚类目标联合优化。在两个沙质海滩 4D 数据集及其合并集上，八类主过程层级与专家标注一致性最高，F1=0.78、匹配准确率 0.92，超过降维与传统平坦聚类。
Motivation: PLS 能高频捕捉地表变化，但现有方法难以把检测到的地表活动组织成有意义的过程类型，地形监测中的过程知识仍依赖人工归纳。
Method: 将每个 4D-OBC 转为 GeoMorphogram（空间受限地表活动内地形变化的时间演化分布序列），用卷积自编码器学习潜层嵌入，并以层次深度聚类目标联合优化得到过程层级；在两个沙质海滩 4D 数据集及其组合上用专家标注评估。
Result: 在含八类主过程的层级上，DTC+GeoMorphogram 与专家判断一致性最高，F1=0.78、match accuracy=0.92，优于降维方法与常规平坦聚类；学到的层级区分侵蚀主导与沉积主导活动，并按变化幅度、持续时间、紧凑度与时序演化细分亚型。
Conclusion: GeoMorphogram 加层次聚类能把 4D 变化检测直接推进到数据驱动、专家可校核的地表过程分类体系，为地形监测提供可扩展且可解释的知识抽取路径。
