papers.title: Generative and deterministic deep learning models comparison for fine-scale precipitation retrievals from infrared brightness temperature
papers.abstract_en: Accurate precipitation estimation at fine spatial scales is critical for hydrology, agriculture, and climate studies. Infrared brightness temperatures from geostationary satellites offer excellent temporal coverage over continental-scale domains. However, because these measurements primarily characterize cloud-top properties rather than precipitation processes near the surface, their correlation with rainfall intensity remains limited, making quantitative precipitation estimation challenging. In this study, we conduct a systematic inter-comparison of state-of-the-art deep learning models for high-resolution precipitation retrieval from Meteosat Second Generation infrared brightness temperatures over metropolitan France. These models include deterministic U-Nets, transformer-based architectures, conditional GANs, and diffusion models. We construct a curated dataset spanning 2008--2023, combining M{é}t{é}o-France radar mosaics as reference with multi-channel infrared observations, and design preprocessing and sampling strategies to address the heavy-tailed, intermittent nature of rainfall. Our results show that deterministic models provide robust mean estimates and excel in pixel-wise accuracy, but systematically underestimate extreme precipitation. In contrast, generative models better capture the full precipitation distribution, including rare and heavy rainfall events, producing more realistic spatial structures at the cost of reduced pixel-wise fidelity. These results highlight a trade-off between pixel-wise accuracy and precipitation variability, showing that generative approaches are advantageous for extreme-event detection and probabilistic applications. This work establishes a reproducible framework for evaluating infrared- based precipitation retrieval methods and provides guidance for designing models that balance precision, variability, and extreme-event representation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Meteosat Second Generation 红外亮温反演法国本土高分辨率降水的任务上，系统对比确定性模型（U-Net、Transformer）与生成模型（cGAN、diffusion）。确定性模型逐像元精度更高但系统性低估极端降水；生成模型更好地还原完整降水分布与稀有强降水的空间结构，代价是逐像元保真度下降。作者据此建议按用途选型：极端事件探测与概率应用用生成式，均值估计用确定性。
Motivation: 红外亮温只表征云顶性质，与近地面降水强度相关性有限，且降水呈重尾、间歇分布，导致高分辨率定量降水反演困难，缺少对不同深度学习范式的统一评测。
Method: 构建 2008–2023 年法国本土数据集，以 Météo-France 雷达拼图为参考、配多通道红外观测，并设计针对重尾间歇降水的预处理与采样策略；对比确定性 U-Net、Transformer 类架构、条件 GAN 与 diffusion 模型。
Result: 确定性模型给出稳健的均值估计、逐像元精度占优，但系统性低估极端降水；生成模型更好地捕捉完整降水分布（含稀有强降水事件）、产生更真实的降水空间结构，但逐像元保真度下降。
Conclusion: 逐像元精度与降水变率之间存在固有取舍：极端事件探测与概率应用应选生成式方法，同时该工作提供了一个可复现的红外降水反演评测框架。
Relevance: 62

papers.title: Training Advisors for LLM Agents from Task Outcomes
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents tackle multi-step tasks by interleaving reasoning and tool calls with observations from the environment. Prior work has shown that natural-language feedback can help these agents revise their decisions during task execution. We introduce Caddie, a method for training critics to provide natural-language analysis and advice as agents work through a task. Unlike approaches that rely on step-level labels or reference critiques, Caddie learns from whether the agent ultimately succeeds after receiving the critic's feedback. We optimize the critic through reinforcement learning while keeping the base model frozen. Trained on multi-hop question answering with a single base model, our Qwen3-4B critic improves success rates across four base models of different scales and architectures, including three not used during critic training. On the MuSiQue benchmark, the trained critic improves Qwen3-4B's success rate by more than 25 percentage points, surpassing the performance of Kimi K3 without a critic. The same critic also yields gains on out-of-domain interactive benchmarks, including $τ^3$ and DeepDive, with no additional training. Our results show that agents can decide when to seek help from a critic at inference time and that outcome-based critic training can produce guidance that transfers across base models and task domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Caddie 用强化学习从任务最终成败训练 LLM agent 的自然语言批评者 (critic)，不依赖步级标签或参考评语，且冻结基座模型。在多跳问答 MuSiQue 上，训练出的 Qwen3-4B critic 使 Qwen3-4B 成功率提升超过 25 个百分点，超过无 critic 的 Kimi K3；同一 critic 在 τ³ 与 DeepDive 等域外交互基准上零额外训练仍有增益。
Motivation: 现有用自然语言反馈改进 agent 决策的方法依赖步级标签或参考评语，这类监督昂贵且难扩展，限制了 critic 在不同基座模型与任务域之间的迁移。
Method: Caddie 训练一个自然语言 critic，在 agent 执行任务时给出分析与建议；奖励来自 agent 收到反馈后最终是否成功，用强化学习优化 critic 而冻结基座模型。训练数据为多跳问答 (multi-hop QA)，只用单一基座模型 Qwen3-4B 训练。
Result: 在 MuSiQue 上，训练出的 Qwen3-4B critic 使 Qwen3-4B 成功率提升超过 25 个百分点，超过无 critic 的 Kimi K3；该 critic 在四个不同规模与架构的基座模型上均提升成功率，其中三个未参与 critic 训练；在域外交互基准 τ³ 与 DeepDive 上无需额外训练也带来增益。
Conclusion: 基于结果的 critic 训练能产出跨基座模型与跨任务域迁移的指导，且 agent 可在推理时自行决定何时向 critic 求助。

papers.title: Self-Evolve With a Reference:Anchored Training of Tool-Integrated Agents
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving tool-integrated agents learn from tasks and feedback generated within their own training loop. A Curriculum Agent generates tasks, while an Executor Agent learns from self-consistency signals through reinforcement learning. However, relying solely on the current Executor for feedback has two limitations: group-relative advantages vanish under full consensus, while uncertainty-based curriculum rewards favor disagreement without showing whether the generated tasks support further learning. These limitations motivate an additional reference beyond the current Executor. We propose \textit{AnchorLoop}, which introduces a frozen copy of the previous iteration's Executor as a historical reference and reuses it on both sides of the training loop. For the Executor, the anchor provides a cross-reference advantage that evaluates current outputs against both current and historical majority answers. For the Curriculum, it provides an agreement-based reference based on differences in sampled majority agreement. Since the Executor and anchor have identical parameters during Curriculum training, this comparison serves as a proxy for task selection rather than evidence of inter-version improvement or correctness. Across 13 reasoning benchmarks, AnchorLoop improves over Agent0 by 2.5\% on mathematical reasoning and 2.8\% on general reasoning tasks. It also maintains higher effective-advantage variance and continues improving in later iterations as the unanchored baseline shows diminishing gains. These results demonstrate the benefit of introducing a lightweight historical reference into self-evolving tool-integrated agents without external task or answer supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AnchorLoop 给自演化工具智能体训练环加一个冻结的历史 Executor 副本作参照：Executor 侧用当前与历史多数答案的交叉参照优势 (cross-reference advantage)，Curriculum 侧用采样多数一致度差作为任务选择代理。在 13 个推理基准上，相对 Agent0 数学推理提升 2.5%、通用推理提升 2.8%，且有效优势方差更高、后期迭代仍在上升，而无锚基线收益递减。
Motivation: 只用当前 Executor 提供反馈有两个缺口：完全一致时 group-relative advantage 会消失，基于不确定性的课程奖励只奖励分歧、不保证所生成任务能继续支撑学习，因此训练环需要当前模型之外的参照。
Method: AnchorLoop 把上一轮 Executor 冻结为 anchor 并复用于训练环两侧：Executor 侧按当前与历史多数答案算交叉参照优势，Curriculum 侧按采样多数一致度差打分；Curriculum 训练时两者参数相同，该比较是任务选择的代理而非跨版本改进或正确性的证据。
Result: 在 13 个推理基准上，相对 Agent0 数学推理 +2.5%、通用推理 +2.8%；有效优势方差 (effective-advantage variance) 更高，后期迭代持续提升，而无锚基线收益递减。
Conclusion: 在自演化工具智能体里引入轻量历史参照即可同时缓解优势消失与课程奖励失真，无需外部任务或答案监督。

papers.title: DeltaSplat: Iterative Gaussian Refinement for Pose-Free Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Pose-free feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) reconstructs a scene from sparse, unposed images in a single network pass, removing the need for camera calibration and per-scene optimization. However, camera estimation errors propagate into the predicted Gaussians and compound the geometric and photometric inaccuracies of single-pass prediction. To correct these errors, we introduce DeltaSplat, a lightweight Gaussian refinement module for pose-free feed-forward 3DGS. It iteratively renders the current Gaussians at the input context views and predicts per-Gaussian updates from the resulting residuals. A 2D residual alone, however, underdetermines the 3D correction. DeltaSplat therefore conditions each update on per-pixel Plücker rays and rendered depth as a soft geometric prior. A dual-branch convolutional mixer efficiently encodes these inputs, and per-attribute heads decode the fused features into position, opacity, and color updates. The module adds only ~2.2% parameters to the backbone and remains fully feed-forward at inference. On DL3DV, DeltaSplat reaches 26.64 dB PSNR in the pose-free setting, improving its state-of-the-art backbone by 1.75 dB and surpassing even baselines supplied with ground-truth cameras; consistent gains hold across 6-24 views and all camera regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeltaSplat 为无位姿前馈 3D Gaussian Splatting 加一个轻量迭代精修模块：反复渲染当前高斯并从残差预测逐高斯更新，用逐像素 Plücker ray 与渲染深度作为软几何先验约束 3D 修正。在 DL3DV 无位姿设定下 PSNR 达 26.64 dB，比其 SOTA backbone 高 1.75 dB，甚至超过给定真值相机的基线，且在 6–24 视角与全部相机体制下增益一致。
Motivation: 无位姿前馈 3DGS 单次网络前向即可从稀疏未标定图像重建，但相机估计误差会传入预测高斯，并叠加单次预测本身的几何与光度误差。
Method: DeltaSplat 迭代地在输入上下文视角渲染当前高斯，从渲染残差预测逐高斯更新；因 2D 残差欠定 3D 修正，每个更新以逐像素 Plücker rays 与渲染深度为软几何先验条件，由双分支卷积 mixer 编码，再用逐属性头解码出位置、不透明度与颜色的更新。
Result: 在 DL3DV 上，无位姿设定 PSNR 26.64 dB，比其 state-of-the-art backbone 提升 1.75 dB，并超过提供真值相机的基线；增益在 6–24 视角及所有相机体制下保持一致。模块仅给 backbone 增加约 2.2% 参数，推理仍完全前馈。
Conclusion: 把位姿误差当作可由渲染残差加几何先验迭代消掉的量，可在不牺牲前馈性的前提下让无位姿 3DGS 超过依赖真值相机的方案。

papers.title: Hard, Yet Reducible: Controlled Forward Transfer for Synthetic Degradation Curation
papers.abstract_en: Selecting synthetic degradations for dense prediction requires an estimate of their training utility, the generalization gain they bring under a finite training budget. Clean and degraded twins share content and labels, suggesting a score based on how much short training reduces the excess error caused by degradation. However, this gap can also shrink when clean performance deteriorates. Measuring the improvement on degraded images alone avoids that confound, but it still credits progress that the same amount of clean training would have produced. We propose the \textbf{controlled Reducible Degradation Gap} (cRDG) for regions defined by degradation type and severity. From a common checkpoint, cRDG runs two budget-matched probes that differ only in one augmentation slot, which holds either a synthetic degradation or a clean augmentation. The score is the gain on held-out degraded images relative to the clean-control probe. Clean harm is a separate feasibility constraint. cRDG reveals a correctable severity band in which training on the degradation yields high controlled gain under the available budget, and the band moves with the predictor, the starting checkpoint, and the training budget. \textbf{Curation of Reducible Bands} (\method) uses cRDG to select synthetic data without changing the predictor. On semantic segmentation and salient object detection, \method{} improves representative predictors under matched synthetic-data budgets and training schedules, extends to existing data-generation pipelines, and preserves clean performance. Code and supporting materials will be publicly released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出受控可约退化差距 (cRDG)：从同一 checkpoint 出发跑两个预算对齐的探针，唯一差别是一个增强槽位放合成退化还是干净增强，用在留出退化图像上的增益作为该退化类型×严重度区域的训练效用分数，干净性能损害单列为可行性约束。cRDG 揭示存在一个可纠正的严重度带 (correctable severity band)，在该带内训练退化数据能在给定预算下获得高受控增益，且带的位置随预测器、起始 checkpoint 与训练预算移动；CoRB 据此在不改预测器的前提下挑选合成数据。
Motivation: 为稠密预测挑选合成退化时缺少对训练效用的估计：干净/退化孪生样本的误差差距既可能因退化数据训练见效而缩小，也可能因干净性能变差而缩小，单看退化图像上的改进又会把同等干净训练本就能带来的进展算作功劳。
Method: cRDG 按退化类型与严重度定义区域，从共同 checkpoint 运行两个仅在一个增强槽位上不同的预算匹配探针（槽位分别放合成退化或干净增强），分数取留出退化图像上相对干净对照探针的增益，干净损害作为独立可行性约束；Curation of Reducible Bands (CoRB) 用 cRDG 在不改变预测器的条件下选合成数据。
Result: 在语义分割与显著目标检测 (salient object detection) 上，CoRB 在匹配的合成数据预算与训练流程下改进了代表性预测器，并可扩展到已有的数据生成流程，同时保持干净性能。
Conclusion: 合成退化的训练效用应按受控增益而非原始误差差距来评，且可纠正严重度带随预测器、checkpoint 与预算变化，因此退化策展需要按当前训练配置重算；代码与配套材料将公开发布。

papers.title: Stream-Based Active Learning with Cooperative Neural Networks for Data-Efficient Partial Inverse Design: An Automotive Glass Run Channel Case Study
papers.abstract_en: Inverse design in engineering often runs into a simple problem. Each labeled training sample must be produced through expensive simulation, so building a large dataset is slow and costly. This study addresses that problem for partial inverse design, where only some design variables are specified and the rest must be inferred to reach a target performance value. We propose CoNN-AL, a framework for data-efficient partial inverse design that adds stream-based active learning to the Cooperative Neural Network with Denoising Autoencoder (CoNN-DAE). The model estimates predictive uncertainty through Monte Carlo dropout and uses it to decide, in real time, which incoming candidate samples are worth labeling, so the limited labeling budget is spent on the most informative designs. We validate the framework on a real-world automotive glass run channel dataset of more than 900,000 unique simulated designs. With only 20,000 actively selected labels, about 2.3% of the training pool, CoNN-AL reaches R-squared values of 0.967 to 0.982 across all missing-variable levels, approaching the upper-bound models trained on far more data. It reaches R-squared of at least 0.95 with 30 to 40% fewer labels than random sampling at the more difficult missing-variable levels and, at the most challenging level, is the only strategy in this study to reach R-squared of 0.98. Together with this work, we publicly release the dataset to support future research on data-driven design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoNN-AL 把流式主动学习 (stream-based active learning) 接到 CoNN-DAE 上，用 Monte Carlo dropout 的预测不确定性实时筛选值得标注的候选设计，把标注预算集中到信息量最大的样本。在超过 90 万个仿真设计的汽车玻璃导槽数据集上，仅用 2 万个主动选择标签（约占训练池 2.3%），各缺失变量水平的 R² 达 0.967–0.982；在最难的缺失水平上，它是本研究中唯一达到 R² 0.98 的策略。
Motivation: 工程部分逆设计中每个带标签样本都要跑昂贵仿真，数据集构建慢且贵；只指定部分设计变量、其余需反推的 partial inverse design 尤其受限于标注预算。
Method: 在 Cooperative Neural Network with Denoising Autoencoder (CoNN-DAE) 上叠加流式主动学习：用 Monte Carlo dropout 估计预测不确定性，实时决定哪些到来的候选样本值得送仿真标注，使有限预算花在最有信息量的设计上；在真实汽车玻璃导槽数据集上验证。
Result: 数据集含超过 900,000 个唯一仿真设计；仅用 20,000 个主动选择标签（约占训练池 2.3%），各缺失变量水平 R² 为 0.967–0.982，接近用多得多数据训练的上界模型；在较难的缺失变量水平上，比随机采样少用 30–40% 标签即可达到 R² 至少 0.95；在最难水平上是唯一达到 R² 0.98 的策略。
Conclusion: 把不确定性驱动的流式主动学习接到 CoNN-DAE 上，可以在只标注约 2.3% 训练池的条件下把部分逆设计精度推到接近全量数据上界；作者同时公开发布该数据集。

papers.title: For Those Who Believe in Faithfulness: Optimizing the Area Under Insertion and Deletion Curves for Ranking Relative Feature Importance
papers.abstract_en: The adoption of machine learning for socially relevant tasks requires effective explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) methods to better understand the behavior of machine learning models. Attribution methods are a popular XAI approach in which input-output relationships are characterized by heat maps that reflect the relative importance of input features for a particular prediction. The quality of such maps is often assessed by measuring faithfulness based on the area under insertion and deletion curves, which measures changes in the model output as features are added and removed. In this study, we derive an objective function from this notion of faithfulness and a way to approximate its gradient. We establish the connection between insertion curves and top-$k$ feature selection, which leads to a loss function measuring the quality of attributions. Randomization of the loss allows us to efficiently approximate its gradient. To show the effectiveness of the general approach, we combine the loss function with the neural explanation mask framework. The resulting method, termed Ra-NEM, can be used with any differentiable model without affecting the model's performance. Experiments demonstrate that Ra-NEM provides accurate attributions robustly and efficiently. Compared to other algorithms, the attributions have not only higher faithfulness but also perform well in terms of other XAI metrics. The high inference speed of Ra-NEM makes the method suitable for online applications. The code is available online: https://github.com/baerminator/Ra_Nem
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把归因质量的 faithfulness 定义（insertion/deletion 曲线下面积，AUC）直接写成目标函数并近似其梯度，得到可训练的归因方法 Ra-NEM：由 insertion 曲线与 top-k 特征选择的对应关系导出损失，再用损失随机化 (randomization) 高效估计梯度，与 neural explanation mask (NEM) 框架结合。实验显示 Ra-NEM 稳定给出更准确的归因，faithfulness 高于其他算法且在其他 XAI 指标上同样表现良好，推理速度快、适合在线应用，且可用于任何可微模型而不影响模型本身性能。
Motivation: 归因热图的常用质量度量是 insertion/deletion 曲线下面积，但这个度量此前只用于事后评估，没有被直接当作可优化的目标，导致生成归因的方法与所要最大化的 faithfulness 之间脱节。
Method: 从 faithfulness（insertion/deletion 曲线下面积）推导目标函数及其梯度近似：建立 insertion 曲线与 top-k 特征选择的联系，得到衡量归因质量的损失函数；对该损失做随机化 (randomization) 以高效近似梯度。将此损失与 neural explanation mask (NEM) 框架结合，得到 Ra-NEM，适用于任何可微模型。
Result: 实验表明 Ra-NEM 稳定地给出准确归因：相比其他算法 faithfulness 更高，同时在其他 XAI 指标上也表现良好；推理速度快，可用于在线场景。方法不改变所解释模型本身的性能。
Conclusion: 把 faithfulness 的 AUC 直接当作可微训练目标，配合随机化梯度近似，可以在不牺牲其他 XAI 指标的前提下提高归因质量与推理速度，使归因方法适合在线使用。

papers.title: ORCA: Hunting Compositional Failures in Text-to-Image Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion models fail predictably on compositional prompts: attributes bind to the wrong objects, spatial relations invert, and multi-object scenes lose count. Recent architectures already augment CLIP with a T5 encoder precisely because CLIP's contrastive embedding loses compositional structure, yet these failures persist. We argue the binding problem is therefore not one of missing information but of misaligned information: a text encoder preserves compositional structure, but in a representation space shaped by language modelling rather than vision, and the denoising objective does not directly reward aligning the two. We show this correspondence can be supplied as an explicit training signal, that the relevant cross-modal information is concentrated in a low-rank subspace of self-supervised visual features, and that supplying it can be folded into diffusion training as a single auxiliary loss. Our method, ORCA (Orthogonal Residual Compositional Alignment), aligns the latent of a diffusion transformer with a low-rank target derived from a frozen visual encoder, through a predictor whose orthogonal basis is parameterised by a learned residual between T5 and CLIP embeddings, which provides a prompt-dependent signal for selecting the visual readout subspace. We prove that the cross-modal information recoverable at a given rank is bounded by the spectral mass of the visual encoder's covariance in the top components. Across three diffusion-transformer backbones (DiT-B/2, DiT-L/2, U-ViT-L), ORCA improves FID and GenEval over both vanilla and REPA baselines at zero inference-time cost; on DiT-L/2 it reaches FID 16.65 and GenEval 0.291 at 200K steps, exceeding the strongest 400K baseline at half the training cost, with the largest gains concentrated on attribute binding, spatial relations, and multi-object prompts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ORCA（Orthogonal Residual Compositional Alignment）把冻结视觉编码器的低秩目标作为辅助损失折入 diffusion 训练，用 T5 与 CLIP 嵌入之差的可学习残差参数化正交基，按 prompt 选择视觉读出子空间。在 DiT-B/2、DiT-L/2、U-ViT-L 三个 backbone 上，FID 与 GenEval 同时优于 vanilla 与 REPA 基线且推理零开销；DiT-L/2 在 200K 步达 FID 16.65、GenEval 0.291，超过最强的 400K 步基线而训练成本减半，增益集中在属性绑定、空间关系与多物体 prompt。
Motivation: 组合式 prompt 下属性错绑、空间关系反转、多物体计数丢失；即便架构已用 T5 补 CLIP 的组合信息，失败仍在，说明问题是表征错位而非信息缺失——denoising 目标不直接奖励跨模态对齐。
Method: ORCA 用一个 predictor 把 diffusion transformer 的 latent 对齐到冻结视觉编码器导出的低秩目标，其正交基由 T5 与 CLIP 嵌入的可学习残差参数化，提供 prompt 相关的视觉读出子空间选择信号；整套对齐折成单一辅助损失加入 diffusion 训练。并证明给定 rank 下可恢复的跨模态信息受视觉编码器协方差 top 分量谱质量的上界约束。
Result: 在 DiT-B/2、DiT-L/2、U-ViT-L 三个 backbone 上，FID 与 GenEval 均优于 vanilla 与 REPA 基线，推理零开销；DiT-L/2 在 200K 步达 FID 16.65、GenEval 0.291，超过最强 400K 步基线而训练成本减半；增益最大处为属性绑定、空间关系与多物体 prompt。
Conclusion: 组合失败源于跨模态信息错位而非缺失，把低秩视觉对齐作为辅助训练信号即可在不增加推理开销下同时改善 FID 与组合性，且半训练成本即可超过更长训的基线。

papers.title: Fully Interpretable Minimal Transformers: From Geometry to Algorithm
papers.abstract_en: We present a framework for building and interpreting minimal transformer models. By constraining a transformer's embedding dimension and head size to 2, we enable full two-dimensional visualization of its internal representations. Embeddings, query/key/value transforms, attention outputs, residual streams, and decision boundaries can all be seen directly. Our central claim is that the learned geometry implies an algorithm; the arrangement of points and boundaries in R^2 can be read as a step-by-step procedure. We train a transformer on a simple task where it must produce the most recently observed even number whenever the '+' operator appears in a sequence of digits. Once trained, we visually walk through every step of the transformer's computation. We show how the model embeds the tokens and their respective positions in the sequence, transforms them via the Q, K, and V matrices, uses the dot product between the Q and K representations to form the attention matrix, and uses the attention matrix to select values that move the representation of each input token to the region of the domain of the output layer that will correctly predict the next token. We introduce a suite of interpretability visualizations that make the algorithmic interpretation of this procedure explicit. Our framework offers a pedagogical and experimental testbed to explore how transformers use informational geometry to implement next-token prediction.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 15 figures, 2 tables. Code and training-dynamics animations: https://github.com/Raneem-mahajne/creating_transformer
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 transformer 的 embedding 维度和 head size 都压到 2，使内部表示可在 R^2 中完整可视化，并主张学到的几何本身就等价于一个可逐步读出的算法。在“序列中出现 '+' 时输出最近观测到的偶数”这一简单任务上，作者逐帧展示 token 与位置嵌入、Q/K/V 变换、Q·K 点积形成的 attention matrix，以及 attention 如何把表示搬进输出层判对下一 token 的区域。
Motivation: Transformer 的高维内部表示难以直接观察，算法级解释往往停留在事后归因；把维度压到 2 可以让表示、决策边界与计算步骤全部变成可看的几何对象。
Method: 约束 embedding 维度与 head size 为 2 训练一个最小 transformer，任务是序列中出现 '+' 时输出最近观测到的偶数；配套提出一套可解释性可视化，逐步呈现 token/位置嵌入、Q/K/V 矩阵变换、Q 与 K 点积构成的 attention matrix，以及 attention 如何把表示移入输出层的正确判别区域。
Result: 在该简单任务上给出完整的逐步视觉走查：展示模型如何嵌入 token 及其位置、经 Q/K/V 变换、用 Q·K 点积形成 attention matrix，并用它选择 value 把每个输入 token 的表示搬到能正确预测下一 token 的输出域区域；摘要未给出任何数值指标。
Conclusion: 在 2 维最小 transformer 中，学到的点与边界的几何排布可以直接读作 next-token prediction 的分步算法，该框架定位为教学与实验用的可解释性 testbed。

papers.title: Origins of Universal Machine Learning Force-Field Errors in Multicomponent Materials
papers.abstract_en: Universal machine learning force-field generalization to multicomponent environments generated by compositional design remains insufficiently assessed. We construct a benchmark of 7,599 multicomponent configurations inspired by high-entropy design, elemental substitution and anion mixing. Eleven pretrained models are evaluated against density functional theory for energies, forces and stresses, with assessment extended to elastic, vibrational and adsorption-related properties. Force errors are analysed through training-reference coverage, local geometric heterogeneity, distance directionality and elemental response. Distances to training-reference environments reveal a qualitative association between coverage differences and increasing errors, while substantial variation remains at similar distances. Higher-error groups show greater local geometric heterogeneity, although OMat24 provides broad coverage of these environments. Relative to training-reference pair medians, errors remain low near the median, rise steeply on the compression side and increase more weakly on the extension side. After matching element pairs and absolute distance deviations, compression-side force errors are 1.81-1.95 times extension-side errors. Model-predicted pairwise interaction curves show greater curvature under compression. Fitting difficulty in independent elemental systems correlates with electronic band-energy responses to atomic displacements and Fermi-level shifts, and a similar pattern is observed in multicomponent systems. In parameter-matched comparisons, spherical-harmonic representations with maximum degrees of 2 and 4 lower test force errors for 38 and 40 of 43 elements, respectively, while differences in elemental difficulty remain. These findings inform force-field selection for experimental compositional design and identify targets for training-data sampling and model representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 构建 7,599 个高熵设计启发的多组分构型基准，评测 11 个预训练通用力场对 DFT 的能量、力、应力误差。匹配元素对与距离偏差后，压缩侧力误差是拉伸侧的 1.81–1.95 倍；球谐最高阶从 2 提到 4 可在 43 个元素中的 38 和 40 个上降低测试力误差。
Motivation: 通用机器学习力场在成分设计产生的多组分环境中的泛化能力缺乏系统评估，力误差的来源（覆盖度、几何异质性、元素响应）未被拆解。
Method: 构建 7,599 个多组分构型基准（高熵设计、元素替换、阴离子混合），对 11 个预训练模型对照 DFT 评测能量、力、应力，并扩展到弹性、振动与吸附性质；从训练参考覆盖度、局部几何异质性、距离方向性、元素响应四个角度分解力误差，再做元素对与距离偏差匹配的对照。
Result: 压缩侧力误差为拉伸侧的 1.81–1.95 倍（匹配元素对与绝对距离偏差后）；参数匹配下最高球谐阶数 2 和 4 分别在 43 个元素中的 38 和 40 个上降低测试力误差；高误差组局部几何异质性更大，而 OMat24 对这些环境覆盖较广；距训练参考环境的距离与误差只有定性关联，相近距离下误差差异仍很大。
Conclusion: 力误差主要由压缩侧的几何与元素响应不对称驱动，而非单纯由训练覆盖距离决定；球谐阶数提升能普遍降误差但不消除元素间难度差异，可据此指导实验成分设计中的力场选择与训练数据采样。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Deafening Silence: Catastrophic Forgetting Lives in the Output Embeddings of Tokens the Data Never Speaks
papers.abstract_en: Continual pre-training and fine-tuning in Large Language Models (LLMs) inevitably induce catastrophic forgetting, typically mitigated by replay using often-inaccessible original data. In this data-free regime, we analyze where forgetting occurs and why. Systematic parameter freezing across five settings up to 1.4B reveals that forgetting concentrates selectively in the output embeddings of tokens rarely seen in the new corpus, whereas the same sqrt(v-hat) band of the body is inert and new learning resides elsewhere. This localization is governed by the vocabulary deficiency of the corpus rather than the training mode, allowing pre-retraining risk ranking from token counts alone within a fixed base model. Mechanistically, absent tokens receive persistent one-sided softmax gradients that Adam's second-moment (sqrt(v-hat)) normalization amplifies into full-sized updates. We therefore propose an intervention: raising Adam's epsilon exclusively for the output projection during training. Across eight settings spanning 160M to 12B parameters and four model families, this removes 39.4% to 67.9% of forgetting across all seven stable configurations without degrading target learning or requiring per-model tuning. The defense combines additively or better with replay (79.8% on Qwen/Korean) and rescues released-head LoRA from a 23-fold forgetting surge. Because post-hoc editing of the drifted rows recovers under 5% of forgetting, the intervention must operate during training. Our findings indicate that a single-line optimizer adjustment may serve as the primary defense against catastrophic forgetting where the corpus starves the vocabulary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在无原始数据可回放的持续预训练/微调中，灾难性遗忘集中在新语料里罕见 token 的输出嵌入行：这些 token 持续收到单侧 softmax 梯度，被 Adam 的二阶矩归一化放大成全尺寸更新。只在训练时把输出投影的 Adam epsilon 调大，即可在 160M–12B、四个模型族的八个设置中消除 39.4%–67.9% 的遗忘，且不损害目标任务学习。
Motivation: 持续训练必然引发灾难性遗忘，而常规缓解手段依赖往往拿不到的原始数据；需要在 data-free 条件下定位遗忘发生在哪里、为什么发生。
Method: 先在最多 1.4B 的五个设置上做系统性参数冻结以定位遗忘；再提出仅在训练期间抬高输出投影 (output projection) 的 Adam epsilon 这一单行优化器改动，并与 replay 组合、对比事后编辑漂移行。
Result: 遗忘选择性集中在新语料中罕见 token 的输出嵌入，而 body 中同一 sqrt(v-hat) 带是惰性的；风险可仅凭 token 计数在固定 base model 内预排序。八个设置（160M–12B、四个模型族）中该干预在全部七个稳定配置上消除 39.4%–67.9% 的遗忘且不损害目标学习、无需逐模型调参；与 replay 叠加在 Qwen/Korean 上达 79.8%，并挽救 released-head LoRA 的 23 倍遗忘激增；事后编辑漂移行只能恢复不到 5% 的遗忘。
Conclusion: 遗忘由语料的词汇缺失 (vocabulary deficiency) 而非训练模式决定，因此防御必须在训练中进行：单行优化器调整可作为语料饿死词汇时的首要防线。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: SkillForge: Co-Evolving Skills and Agents via Dynamic Skill Lifecycles
papers.abstract_en: Memory-augmented reinforcement learning strengthens LLM agents' ability to solve complex long-horizon tasks. Skills are one such form of memory, pairing instructions with an applicability condition over task types. However, retaining every skill indiscriminately as the policy improves lets obsolete or harmful entries accumulate and mislead the agent. We propose SkillForge, an agentic RL method that compiles and evolves the skill library through a fitness-driven skill lifecycle of trial, active, stable, and retired states, so that the skills and the model co-evolve throughout training. A pre-RL evaluation phase first uses the base model's own rollouts to pre-retire low-fitness skills, yielding a filtered library that then seeds supervised fine-tuning. Reinforcement learning takes over from this checkpoint, and at each iteration selective retirement, stabilization, and LLM-guided mutation continue to forge the skill library alongside policy optimization. Across multiple interactive agent benchmarks, SkillForge achieves the highest aggregate success rate, delivering up to 7.8% relative improvement over the strongest baseline while keeping the skill library compact throughout training. We introduce SkillFurnace, a dataset of 5k+ annotated records bundling retirement-filtered SFT trajectories, evolved skill libraries with fitness annotations, and retirement events with human-annotated failure categories to support research on skill quality and lifecycle management.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkillForge 把 LLM agent 的技能库当成有生命周期的对象来管：按 fitness 让技能经历 trial、active、stable、retired 四态，与策略训练同步演化。预 RL 阶段先用 base model 自身 rollout 退役低 fitness 技能，过滤后的库再播种 SFT，RL 中继续做选择性退役、稳定化与 LLM 引导变异。在多个交互式 agent benchmark 上取得最高综合成功率，相对最强基线最高提升 7.8%，同时全程保持技能库紧凑。
Motivation: 记忆增强 RL 中若把所有技能一律保留，过时或有害的条目会随策略改进不断累积并误导 agent，技能库与策略不同步。
Method: agentic RL 方法 SkillForge：fitness 驱动的技能生命周期（trial/active/stable/retired），预 RL 评估阶段用 base model rollout 预退役低 fitness 技能并以过滤库播种 SFT，随后 RL 每轮做选择性退役、稳定化和 LLM 引导变异，与策略优化并行。
Result: 在多个交互式 agent benchmark 上取得最高综合成功率，相对最强基线最高 7.8% 的相对提升，且训练全程保持技能库紧凑；同时发布 SkillFurnace 数据集，含 5k+ 标注记录，涵盖退役过滤后的 SFT 轨迹、带 fitness 标注的演化技能库，以及带人工标注失败类别的退役事件。
Conclusion: 让技能库按 fitness 生命周期与策略共同演化，可以在不膨胀库规模的前提下提高 LLM agent 的长程任务成功率；配套数据集用于技能质量与生命周期管理研究。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: MOTIF: Person-of-Interest Deepfake Detection Beyond 3DMM Coefficients
papers.abstract_en: Video deepfakes targeting a specific individual, the Person-of-Interest (POI), are the most harmful ones, and, since a public figure is abundantly recorded, a detector can be built from genuine footage of that individual. Such detectors commonly describe a subject through a 3D Morphable Model (3DMM) and adopt its coefficients as a whole, so which part of that description carries the signal has never been measured. We dissect it, holding the encoder, the training corpus and the enrollment protocol fixed and varying only what the encoder observes. The groups of coefficients prove largely redundant, since the shape block alone recovers almost all the accuracy of the full vector, and their temporal evolution contributes a real but bounded amount. We further show that the dense surface the same fit returns, which these detectors discard, carries identity information that the coefficients do not, and that it helps precisely where they are weakest. We assemble the best configuration into MOTIF, a visual-only detector trained on real videos only, with no manipulated video and no POI-specific data. It improves on both state-of-the-art POI detectors in every dataset and manipulation of our benchmark and at two quality levels. Our experimental code will be released at https://github.com/polimi-ispl/MOTIF.
papers.comment: 6 pages. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Workshop on Information Forensics and Security (WIFS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对特定人物 (Person-of-Interest) 的视频 deepfake 检测，系统拆解 3DMM 系数向量中究竟哪部分携带检测信号：形状块单独即可恢复几乎全部精度，时间演化贡献真实但有限，而同一拟合返回的稠密表面 (dense surface) 携带系数所没有的身份信息，恰好补上系数最弱之处。将最优组合成纯视觉检测器 MOTIF，仅用真实视频训练、不需任何伪造视频与 POI 专属数据，在基准的每个数据集、每种操纵方式和两个质量层级上均优于现有 SOTA POI 检测器。
Motivation: 针对特定公众人物的 deepfake 危害最大，可利用其大量真实影像建检测器，但现有方法把 3DMM 系数整体当作特征，从未测量过描述中究竟哪部分携带检测信号。
Method: 固定编码器、训练语料与注册 (enrollment) 协议，只改变编码器所观察的内容，逐组拆解 3DMM 系数；再引入同一拟合输出的稠密表面作为补充身份信息，将最优配置组合为 MOTIF，仅用真实视频训练，不含任何伪造视频与 POI 专属数据。
Result: 形状块单独即可恢复几乎全部精度，系数各组高度冗余；时间演化贡献真实但有限的增益；稠密表面携带系数所无的身份信息，并在系数最弱处提供帮助。MOTIF 在基准的每个数据集、每种操纵方式以及两个质量层级上均优于两个 SOTA POI 检测器。
Conclusion: 3DMM 系数向量大部分冗余，检测信号主要在形状块，而被丢弃的稠密表面提供互补身份信息；据此构建的纯视觉、仅真实视频训练的检测器可全面超越现有 POI 检测方法。代码将发布于 github.com/polimi-ispl/MOTIF。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Dual-QK: Sharp Queries and Flat Keys for Prunable 2-bit KV Caches
papers.abstract_en: Long inputs and extended generation increase the storage and access costs of the key-value (KV) cache. Low-bit quantization reduces storage and memory traffic, while query-channel pruning can further reduce key-cache reads. Rotation-based quantization redistributes the energy of key outliers across channels. To maintain computational invariance, the same orthogonal transform must be applied to queries, preserving query-key dot products. However, this rotation can disperse query energy, weakening the separation between a few large components to retain and many small ones to prune. We introduce Dual-QK, which uses paired non-orthogonal query and key transforms to address this conflict. Using calibrated query and key statistics, Dual-QK combines partial key whitening with a query-aligned basis to balance key scales for INT2 quantization and concentrate query energy for dynamic channel pruning. Channel-0 protection and bucket-relative RoPE support low-bit accuracy over long contexts. Experiments on four models across five generative benchmarks and long-context retrieval tasks show improved accuracy over OSCAR on most tasks at 40% query-channel sparsity. At a 128K context, Dual-QK provides $6.8\times$ KV-cache compression and an estimated $8.3\times$ reduction in KV read volume relative to unpruned BF16. Under the evaluated configurations, our SGLang implementation achieves up to $3.75\times$ the decoding throughput of unpruned BF16.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Dual-QK 用成对的非正交 query/key 变换拆开量化与剪枝的冲突：key 侧做部分白化以平衡 INT2 量化尺度，query 侧用对齐基集中能量以支持动态通道剪枝，配合 channel-0 保护与 bucket-relative RoPE 保住长上下文精度。在四个模型、五个生成式基准与长上下文检索任务上，40% query-channel 稀疏度时多数任务优于 OSCAR；128K 上下文下相对未剪枝 BF16 实现 6.8× KV cache 压缩、约 8.3× KV 读取量下降，SGLang 实现解码吞吐最高达 3.75×。
Motivation: 长输入与长生成使 KV cache 的存储与访问成本成为瓶颈；基于旋转的量化要求 query 施加同一正交变换以保持点积不变，但这会把 query 能量分散，削弱需保留的大分量与待剪枝小分量的可分性，量化与通道剪枝因此互相牵制。
Method: Dual-QK 采用成对非正交 query/key 变换：用校准得到的 query/key 统计量，把 key 的部分白化 (partial whitening) 与 query 对齐基 (query-aligned basis) 组合，同时平衡 key 的 INT2 量化尺度并集中 query 能量供动态通道剪枝；再加 channel-0 保护与 bucket-relative RoPE 支持低比特长上下文，实现为 SGLang 内核。
Result: 在四个模型、五个生成式基准与长上下文检索任务上，40% query-channel 稀疏度时多数任务准确率高于 OSCAR；128K 上下文下相对未剪枝 BF16 达到 6.8× KV-cache 压缩与约 8.3× KV 读取量缩减；在所评测配置下 SGLang 实现解码吞吐最高为未剪枝 BF16 的 3.75×。
Conclusion: 量化与 query 通道剪枝的冲突可以靠非正交的成对变换解耦：key 侧保量化、query 侧保可剪枝性，从而在 INT2 加 40% 稀疏下维持长上下文精度并显著降低 KV 读取与提升吞吐。

papers.title: Homogenization in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems (MAS) leverage interactions between agents to perform complex tasks. Despite their success, we show that these interactions can also lead to homogenization, i.e., agents converging to similar behaviors. Homogenization in MAS can reduce agent diversity and reinforce shared failures. In this paper, we operationalize homogenization using three metrics: conformity to the majority, polarization towards extremes, and growing inertia against changes over subsequent interactions. We evaluate homogenization in MAS for code generation, hiring, and scientific peer review. Across these tasks, we show that homogenization translates to concrete downstream risks: in code generation, it hides and amplifies correlated errors which can create systemic vulnerabilities; in hiring, it allows the influence of biased agents to persist long after their removal; and in peer review, it creates uneven evaluation standards across research areas. Our results establish homogenization as a failure mode of MAS, demonstrating that MAS evaluations must move beyond aggregate performance to carefully analyze interaction dynamics. Finally, we show that simple approaches to increase diversity---leveraging sampling stochasticity and mixed-models MAS---fail to reduce homogenization risks, highlighting the need for strategies to effectively leverage agent diversity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多智能体系统 (MAS) 的交互会让智能体行为趋同 (homogenization)，作者用多数从众、极端极化、对改变的惰性增长三个指标刻画，并在代码生成、招聘、同行评审三类任务上证明这种趋同会放大相关性错误、让有偏智能体的影响在其被移除后长期残留、造成跨研究领域评审标准不齐。靠采样随机性与混合模型 MAS 这类简单多样性手段无法降低同质化风险。
Motivation: MAS 依赖智能体交互完成复杂任务，但交互同时导致行为趋同，削弱多样性并强化共享失败；现有 MAS 评估只看聚合性能，看不到交互动力学带来的系统性风险。
Method: 把同质化操作化为三个指标：对多数的从众 (conformity to the majority)、向极端的极化 (polarization towards extremes)、以及跨多轮交互中对改变的惰性增长 (growing inertia)；在代码生成、招聘、科学同行评审三个任务上评估，并测试采样随机性与 mixed-models MAS 两类多样性干预。
Result: 代码生成中同质化掩盖并放大相关性错误，形成系统性脆弱；招聘中有偏智能体的影响在其被移除后仍长期持续；同行评审中不同研究领域出现不均的评审标准。采样随机性与混合模型 MAS 均未能降低同质化风险。
Conclusion: 同质化是 MAS 的一种失败模式，MAS 评估必须从聚合性能转向分析交互动力学；而单纯引入多样性来源不足以缓解该风险，需要真正有效利用智能体多样性的策略。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: UltraText Bench: A Comprehensive Bilingual Benchmark for Evaluating Visual Text Rendering in Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Dense visual text requires image generators to reproduce long strings across multiple regions with correct placement and legibility. As short-string rendering improves, evaluation must test sustained performance across more demanding scenes. We introduce UltraText Bench, a bilingual benchmark for prompt-only generation of dense visual text. It contains 432 prompts spanning 24 real-world scene categories and three difficulty levels, split equally between English and Chinese. Each human-reviewed prompt supplies exact strings for four to twelve text regions, paired with structured references for their content, placement, and visual attributes. We use the Q-Judger vision-language model to assess each image against the complete reference, reporting text fidelity, text clarity, spatial quality, and scene quality. Across 24 model configurations, these dimensions reveal different strengths: Z-Image-Turbo gains 3.81 clarity points over Z-Image-Base while losing 14.76 fidelity points under the reported settings. Performance also varies with workload; Qwen-Image-2512's English composite falls from 86.50 at L1 to 42.86 at L3. Ten participants took part in human evaluation of the automatic scores. Repository: https://github.com/LINs-lab/UltraText_Bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UltraText Bench 是面向密集视觉文本生成的双语基准：432 条 prompt、24 类真实场景、三档难度，中英文各半，每条给出 4–12 个文本区域的精确字符串与结构化参考。用 Q-Judger 视觉语言模型按完整参考打分，24 个模型配置显示保真与清晰度会此消彼长：Z-Image-Turbo 比 Z-Image-Base 清晰度高 3.81 分但保真低 14.76 分；Qwen-Image-2512 英文综合分从 L1 的 86.50 掉到 L3 的 42.86。
Motivation: 短文本渲染已改善，但密集、多区域、长字符串场景下的持续表现缺少系统评测；需要同时约束内容、位置与视觉属性的基准来暴露模型在难度上升时的退化。
Method: 构建 432 条人工审核 prompt，覆盖 24 个真实场景类别与 L1–L3 三档难度，中英文各半，每条给出 4–12 个文本区域的精确字符串及内容、位置、视觉属性的结构化参考；用 Q-Judger 视觉语言模型对照完整参考评估图像，报告 text fidelity、text clarity、spatial quality、scene quality 四个维度，并有 10 名参与者对自动分数做人评。
Result: 24 个模型配置上四维度呈现不同强弱：Z-Image-Turbo 相对 Z-Image-Base 清晰度 +3.81 分、保真 −14.76 分；Qwen-Image-2512 英文综合分从 L1 的 86.50 降至 L3 的 42.86；10 名参与者参与了对自动评分的人工评估。
Conclusion: 密集视觉文本的保真与清晰度是可分离的取舍，且性能随难度档位显著下滑，因此评测必须按难度分层并同时报告多个维度。

papers.title: Efficient 3D Gaussian Head Avatars for Edge Devices
papers.abstract_en: Generative 3D Gaussian head avatars provide high-quality, efficient rendering, but synthesising the Gaussian representation remains computationally expensive, limiting deployment on resource-constrained and edge devices. We introduce an efficient generator architecture for unconditional 3D Gaussian head synthesis, based on a parameter-efficient synthesis block and depth-wise separable convolutions while retaining style-based conditioning. Our architecture reduces generator complexity without requiring model compression or quantisation. Compared with the baseline model, our approach reduces FLOPs by 94%, parameter count by 70%, and model size by 81%, while maintaining competitive generation quality. We further demonstrate practical CPU inference and browser-based execution on mobile devices using ONNX Runtime, enabling 3D Gaussian avatar synthesis without dedicated GPU hardware or application-specific software. In addition to conventional image-quality metrics, we evaluate multi-view consistency, training cost, and deployment performance. Code, trained models, and evaluation tools will be released publicly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向边缘设备的 3D Gaussian 头部 avatar 生成器，用参数高效合成块与 depth-wise separable 卷积替代重型生成骨干，保留 style-based conditioning，在不做模型压缩或量化的情况下把 FLOPs 降 94%、参数量降 70%、模型体积降 81%，并保持有竞争力的生成质量。
Motivation: 生成式 3D Gaussian 头部表示渲染质量高且高效，但合成该表示本身计算开销大，难以部署到资源受限和边缘设备。
Method: 提出面向无条件 3D Gaussian 头部合成的高效生成器架构：核心是参数高效合成块 (parameter-efficient synthesis block) 与 depth-wise separable 卷积，同时保留 style-based conditioning；不依赖模型压缩或量化。用 ONNX Runtime 做 CPU 推理与移动端浏览器执行，并评估图像质量、多视角一致性、训练开销与部署性能。
Result: 相对 baseline：FLOPs 减少 94%，参数量减少 70%，模型体积减少 81%，同时保持有竞争力的生成质量；在 CPU 上可实际推理，并在移动设备浏览器中通过 ONNX Runtime 运行，无需专用 GPU 或专用软件。
Conclusion: 不靠压缩或量化、仅改生成器结构即可把 3D Gaussian 头部 avatar 合成压到无 GPU 的 CPU 与浏览器环境，代码、训练模型与评测工具将公开。

papers.title: Backdooring Acoustic Foundation Models for Physically Realizable Triggers
papers.abstract_en: Acoustic foundation models (AFMs) have democratized acoustic applications, enabling powerful models for tasks ranging from speech recognition to speaker verification with minimal resources. However, the security of applications based on AFMs remains largely underexplored. Our work addresses this gap by proposing the Foundation Acoustic model Backdoor (FAB) attack, demonstrating that state-of-the-art AFMs are susceptible to backdooring under practical settings. Despite making minimal assumptions about adversary capabilities (e.g., no access to pre-training data), we show that FAB preserves benign performance while inducing backdoors that survive fine-tuning and cause significant degradation across diverse downstream tasks when activated. Notably, FAB utilizes task-agnostic, physically realizable, inconspicuous, and sync-free triggers (e.g., a background siren). We evaluate FAB using two leading AFMs, nine downstream tasks, and four different triggers. We further demonstrate its effectiveness against established defenses and across both digital and physical domains. While extensive end-to-end fine-tuning can mitigate FAB, such a defense is resource-intensive and task-specific. Our work highlights critical risks to AFMs and calls for advanced defenses.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 声学基础模型已被广泛用于语音识别、说话人验证等任务，但基于 AFM 的应用安全性基本未被探索，缺少在实际约束下（如攻击者无法接触预训练数据）可行的后门威胁证据。
Method: 提出 Foundation Acoustic model Backdoor (FAB) 攻击，使用任务无关、物理可实现、不显眼且 sync-free 的触发器（例如背景警笛），在对手能力假设极小（无预训练数据访问）的设定下对 SOTA AFM 植入后门，并在数字与物理两种域上测试。

papers.title: Concentration, Not Uncertainty: Why Targeted Synthetic Data Doesn't Help Camouflaged Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Camouflaged object detection requires pixel-accurate masks, but obtaining such annotations is slow and costly, making synthetic training images an attractive alternative. Under a fixed generation budget, however, it remains unclear which real-image regions to target for synthetic data generation. We study an uncertainty-guided generation strategy that clusters the unlabelled real images, identifies clusters on which the model is least certain, allocates synthetic generation toward those clusters, and iteratively retrains the model. Across 103 training runs, uncertainty-based targeting does not outperform random allocation. Five independent controls further show that this null result is not an artifact: targeted training sets are measurably different from random sets, but the difference is explained by concentrating the generation budget rather than by where uncertainty is concentrated, as every concentration rule we test reproduces the effect and, on boundary accuracy, so does aiming at the clusters the model was most certain about. Separately, we find substantial data contamination in CHAMELEON, with 50 of its 76 images duplicated from training data despite the standard overlap check reporting zero overlap. Together, these results show that, under a fixed synthetic-data budget, budget concentration, not uncertainty-based targeting, accounts for the observed training-set effects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在固定合成数据预算下，对未标注真实图像做聚类并把生成配额投向模型最不确定的簇，103 次训练中并不优于随机分配；起作用的是预算集中本身，而非不确定度指向哪里——连瞄准模型最确定的簇也能在边界精度上复现同样效果。另在 CHAMELEON 上发现 76 张图中 50 张与训练数据重复，而标准重叠检查报告零重叠。
Motivation: 伪装目标检测 (camouflaged object detection) 的像素级标注昂贵，合成数据是替代路径，但在固定生成预算下该把生成投向真实图像的哪些区域一直不清楚。
Method: 研究 uncertainty-guided generation：对未标注真实图像聚类，找出模型最不确定的簇，把合成生成配额分配给这些簇并迭代重训；用 103 次训练运行加五组独立对照区分“不确定度指向”与“预算集中”两种解释，并对 CHAMELEON 做污染检查。
Result: 103 次训练运行中基于不确定度的定向不优于随机分配；五组对照显示定向训练集与随机集确有可测差异，但该差异由预算集中解释——测试的每一条集中规则都复现该效应，且在边界精度上瞄准模型最确定的簇同样复现。CHAMELEON 76 张图中 50 张从训练数据重复，而标准重叠检查报告零重叠。
Conclusion: 在固定合成数据预算下，起作用的是预算集中而非基于不确定度的定向；同时 CHAMELEON 存在大量未被标准重叠检查发现的数据污染。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: BoT-GRPO: Efficient Process-Reward RL for Reasoning via Bag-of-Token Aggregation
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning is now central to eliciting reasoning in large language models, while in the popular algorithm Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) every token in a rollout receives the same advantage. We ask how to make process supervision efficient: accelerating convergence and improving final quality without the cost of value networks. We propose Bag-of-Tokens Group Relative Policy Optimization (BoT-GRPO), which extends GRPO to token-level reward models through a length-invariant "bag of tokens" aggregation: it collects all token-level rewards across rollouts, weights each by the inverse of its source sequence length, and computes per-token advantages relative to weighted group statistics. BoT-GRPO is critic-free, and is a drop-in replacement wherever GRPO is used when token-level reward is available. On React front-end code generation, BoT-GRPO reaches $80\%$ compile rate up to $1.9\times$ faster than GRPO and converges faster than modern GRPO variants (GSPO, DAPO, PURE) while reaching higher final compile and VLM-judged win rates. On a second task, AIME mathematical reasoning, BoT-GRPO delivers absolute Pass@$k$ gains up to $8.1\%$ over GRPO in half the steps. For both tasks we compare the algorithm's performance on reasoning vs. non-reasoning base-model families (Qwen2.5-3B, SmolLM3-3B, Phi-4-mini-reasoning). Our experiments also yield a practical recipe for the reward model itself: reward stability matters more than richness: clean, bounded, stable fine-grained signals consistently accelerate learning where noisier alternatives stall.
papers.comment: Published at the COLM 2026 Workshop on Efficient Reasoning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BoT-GRPO 把 GRPO 的整条 rollout 同一 advantage 扩展到 token 级奖励：按源序列长度倒数加权聚合所有 token 级奖励，再相对加权组统计量算每个 token 的 advantage，无需 value 网络。在 React 前端代码生成上达到 80% 编译率比 GRPO 最快快 1.9 倍，AIME 上一半步数内 Pass@$k$ 绝对提升最高 8.1%。
Motivation: GRPO 中一条 rollout 内所有 token 共享同一 advantage，过程级监督粒度太粗；引入 value 网络做 token 级奖励又代价高，需要在不加 critic 的前提下加速收敛并提升最终质量。
Method: 提出 Bag-of-Tokens GRPO：跨 rollout 收集全部 token 级奖励，各按其源序列长度倒数加权，再相对加权组统计量计算逐 token advantage；critic-free，可作为 GRPO 的即插即用替换（只要有 token 级奖励）。对比 GSPO、DAPO、PURE 等现代 GRPO 变体，并在 Qwen2.5-3B、SmolLM3-3B、Phi-4-mini-reasoning 上区分 reasoning 与 non-reasoning 基座。
Result: React 前端代码生成上达到 80% compile rate 最多比 GRPO 快 1.9 倍，且比 GSPO、DAPO、PURE 收敛更快、最终 compile rate 与 VLM-judged win rate 更高；AIME 数学推理上一半步数内 Pass@$k$ 较 GRPO 绝对提升最高 8.1%。奖励模型方面：clean、bounded、stable 的细粒度信号稳定加速学习，噪声更大的替代信号会让训练停滞。
Conclusion: 长度不变的 bag-of-tokens 聚合能在无 critic 条件下把 token 级过程奖励接入 GRPO 并同时加速收敛、抬高最终质量；对奖励模型而言，稳定性比丰富度更重要。

papers.title: DisParQ: Self-Supervised Part Concepts for Interpretable Vision Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Concept-based vision models represent images through an intermediate layer of human-inspectable concepts, so what a model relies on can be traced to those concepts. However, those models are often limited to fixed categories or depend on language to define their concepts. We introduce DisParQ (Discrete Parts with Quantized attributes), a method that learns spatially grounded, discrete concept representations from a powerful frozen vision-only self-supervised backbone. It requires no class labels and no language supervision. Each image patch is assigned to exactly one concept from a learnable prototype dictionary, and only a sparse subset of concepts may activate per image. To capture how each concept varies across images (e.g., the type of a "wheel"), we learn continuous residuals alongside the concepts and then quantize them into discrete attributes. A spatial decoder reconstructs the backbone's representation from the concepts and attributes alone, so successful reconstruction means that the discrete representation preserves the backbone's information. We evaluate DisParQ across seven datasets, from general recognition (ImageNet, PartImageNet, Places) to fine-grained benchmarks (CUB, Cars, Dogs, Flowers). We show that DisParQ closely matches its frozen DINOv2 teacher on ImageNet linear probing (83.2% top-1), achieves higher concept consistency than language-aligned models, remains competitive on fine-grained recognition, and enables cross-category part-based retrieval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DisParQ 从冻结的 DINOv2 视觉自监督骨干中学习空间落地的离散概念：每个图像 patch 唯一归属一个可学习原型概念，图像只激活稀疏概念子集，连续残差再量化为离散属性，由空间解码器仅凭概念与属性重建骨干表征。在 ImageNet 线性探测上达到 83.2% top-1，接近其冻结的 DINOv2 教师，概念一致性高于语言对齐模型，并支持跨类别基于部件的检索。
Motivation: 基于概念的视觉模型可让人检查模型依赖什么，但通常受限于固定类别，或需要语言来定义概念。
Method: DisParQ (Discrete Parts with Quantized attributes)：从冻结的视觉自监督骨干 (DINOv2) 出发，无类别标签、无语言监督；每个 patch 硬分配到一个可学习原型字典概念，每张图仅稀疏激活部分概念；在概念之外学习连续残差并量化为离散属性；空间解码器仅由概念与属性重建骨干表征。
Result: 在七个数据集上评估：ImageNet、PartImageNet、Places，以及细粒度基准 CUB、Cars、Dogs、Flowers。ImageNet 线性探测 83.2% top-1，接近冻结 DINOv2 教师；概念一致性高于语言对齐模型；细粒度识别保持竞争力；支持跨类别基于部件的检索。
Conclusion: 无需语言监督也能从视觉自监督骨干中提取可检查的离散部件概念，且重建目标保证离散表征保留骨干信息。

papers.title: Beyond Masks and Trajectories: Flow-Guided Latent Action Injection for Stable Surgical Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Surgical video generation holds substantial potential for surgical education, simulation, and data augmentation, yet generating surgical videos with realistic and clinically plausible motion remains challenging. Most existing methods rely on auxiliary conditions, such as masks, trajectories, depth, or reference videos, to achieve visually plausible synthesis. Yet, these auxiliary conditions typically require additional manual annotation or specialized acquisition, making it difficult to scale such methods beyond small, curated datasets. This motivates the need for a reference-free architecture capable of generating high-quality surgical video without requiring auxiliary visual conditions at inference time. We propose FLAIR, a Flow-guided LatentAction Injection framework for Reference-free surgical video generation. FLAIR learns action priors from optical flow of real surgical videos, dynamically predicts corresponding latent action representation from an input prompt, and injects it into a frozen base model to generate surgical videos with improved action consistency. We further construct SurgActionClip-30K, the first large-scale surgical vision dataset comprising action-centric segmented clips and structured caption labels, addressing the persistent lack of fine-grained, action-centric surgical datasets. Lastly, we introduce SurgMetrics, the first surgical domain-specific evaluation metrics for quantifying the quality of generated surgical videos, addressing the persistent absence of clinically grounded evaluation standards in this domain. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FLAIR enables generating high-quality surgical videos using text-only inference without auxiliary conditions, and validation in SurgMetrics demonstrates its strength in alignment with human perception compared to traditional metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FLAIR 用真实手术视频的光流学出 action prior，推理时仅凭文本 prompt 动态预测 latent action 表示并注入冻结基座模型，实现无需 mask、轨迹、深度等辅助条件的参考无关手术视频生成。配套构建 SurgActionClip-30K（动作中心切片与结构化描述）与领域指标 SurgMetrics，验证其与人类感知的一致性强于传统指标。
Motivation: 现有手术视频生成依赖 mask、轨迹、深度或参考视频等辅助条件，需要人工标注或专门采集，难以扩展到小规模精选数据集之外；同时缺少动作粒度的手术数据集与临床可依据的生成质量评价标准。
Method: FLAIR (Flow-guided Latent Action Injection)：从真实手术视频的光流学习 action prior，由输入 prompt 动态预测 latent action 表示，注入冻结的基座生成模型；推理阶段仅用文本、不需辅助视觉条件。同时构建 SurgActionClip-30K 数据集与 SurgMetrics 领域评价指标。
Result: 实验表明 FLAIR 可在仅文本推理、无辅助条件下生成高质量手术视频；SurgMetrics 验证其与人类感知的对齐优于传统指标。
Conclusion: 参考无关的 latent action 注入路径可在无辅助条件时保持动作一致性，手术视频生成需要配套的动作中心数据集与领域专属评价标准。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MIRROR: From Imitation to Internalization in LLM Personalization
papers.abstract_en: The demand for personalized LLMs is shifting from style imitation toward content quality. We investigate whether self-distillation can bridge this gap in existing fine-tuning paradigm. To address this limitation, we introduce MIRROR(Meta- personalization by Internalizing Reference-Revealed On-policy Reflections), a novel self-distillation framework that shifts LLM personalization from imitation toward preference internalization. First, we replace reference-token imitation with reference-revealed on-policy self-distillation, aligning the model's next-token distributions along its own generation trajectories with those of its reference-conditioned self, thereby internalizing user preferences rather than reproducing reference wording.Second, we introduce MIRROR-F, a focal plug-in that augments on-policy distributional alignment with selective supervision over informative reference tokens, thereby strengthening content generation while preserving user-specific expression. Across three personalized generation benchmarks, two model scales, and complementary reference-based and LLM-based evaluations, MIRROR and MIRROR-F achieve leading overall personalization performance and superior text quality, while exhibiting less catastrophic forgetting than SFT-based baselines on three unseen personalized generation tasks. The gains are consistent across model scales and application scenarios, translating to improved performance in LLM personalization tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MIRROR 用参考揭示的 on-policy 自蒸馏 (reference-revealed on-policy self-distillation) 把 LLM 个性化从模仿参考措辞改为内化偏好：沿模型自身生成轨迹对齐其与参考条件化自身的 next-token 分布，MIRROR-F 再对信息量高的参考 token 施加选择性监督。在三个个性化生成基准、两种模型规模上取得领先的总体个性化性能与更优文本质量，且在三个未见个性化生成任务上灾难性遗忘轻于 SFT 基线。
Motivation: LLM 个性化需求正从风格模仿转向内容质量，而现有微调范式主要复现参考措辞，难以内化用户偏好并保住内容质量。
Method: 以 on-policy 自蒸馏替代 reference-token 模仿：在模型自身生成轨迹上，把其 next-token 分布与参考条件化自身的分布对齐；MIRROR-F 作为即插模块，在分布对齐之上对信息性参考 token 加选择性监督，兼顾内容生成与用户特有表达。
Result: 在三个个性化生成基准、两种模型规模、参考式与 LLM 式两类互补评测下，MIRROR 与 MIRROR-F 取得领先的总体个性化性能与更优文本质量；在三个未见个性化生成任务上灾难性遗忘少于 SFT 基线，且增益跨模型规模与应用场景一致。
Conclusion: 把个性化目标从复现参考文本改为在自身轨迹上内化参考所揭示的偏好，可同时提升内容质量并减轻 SFT 式微调的灾难性遗忘。

papers.title: A Proof-of-Concept Study of Weakly Supervised Labeling of Fine-Grained EEG Components for Artifact Attenuation
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG) is highly susceptible to electromyographic (EMG) artifacts, whose temporal heterogeneity and spatial-spectral overlap with neural activity can leave mixed sources after blind source separation. Existing artifact-removal methods are further limited by scarce reliable component-level ground truth: expert annotations are costly and subjective, while no established method provides realistic simulation-based ground truth for EMG contamination in multichannel scalp EEG. To address these limitations, we propose a framework combining a frequency-aware high-dimensional representation with Multi-Instance Learning. The representation unfolds separated components into frequency-resolved intra-components, creating a space in which mixed neural and muscular activity becomes more separable, while the weakly supervised learning formulation enables artifact-likelihood scores for individual intra-components to be learned from epoch-level labels without finer-grained ground truth. The resulting intra-component classifier supports fine-grained EMG artifact detection and score-guided attenuation. Experiments on held-out subjects show that the framework learns informative intra-component scores and reduces artifact-related spectral deviations most clearly for jaw tension, with moderate effects for raising eyebrows and limited effects for frowning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 EEG 中 EMG 伪迹成分缺乏细粒度真值的问题，提出频率感知高维表示与多实例学习 (Multi-Instance Learning) 结合的弱监督框架：把分离成分展开为频率分辨的 intra-component，仅用 epoch 级标签学出每个 intra-component 的伪迹分数并据此做分数引导的衰减。在留出被试实验中，该分数最明显地降低咬牙 (jaw tension) 引起的伪迹相关谱偏差，抬眉 (raising eyebrows) 效应中等，皱眉 (frowning) 效应有限。
Motivation: 盲源分离后 EMG 与神经活动时空-频谱重叠会留下混合成分，而专家逐成分标注昂贵且主观，也没有成熟方法能为多通道头皮 EEG 的 EMG 污染提供仿真级真值，导致伪迹去除受限于稀缺的成分级 ground truth。
Method: 先用频率感知的高维表示把分离成分展开成频率分辨的 intra-component，使混合的神经与肌肉活动更可分；再用 Multi-Instance Learning 从 epoch 级标签弱监督地学出各 intra-component 的伪迹似然分数，得到细粒度 EMG 检测器并做 score-guided attenuation。
Result: 在留出被试 (held-out subjects) 上，框架学到有信息量的 intra-component 分数，并降低伪迹相关谱偏差：咬牙最明显，抬眉中等，皱眉效应有限。
Conclusion: 无需成分级真值的弱监督分数即可支撑细粒度 EMG 伪迹检测与衰减，其效果随伪迹类型差异明显，咬牙类持续性肌电最受益。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Counterfactual Route Optimization for Gaussian Head Avatar Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Head avatar modeling requires jointly optimizing multiple objectives with different dominant effects on geometry, appearance, and cross-view consistency. However, their relative effectiveness varies across training states, while existing pipelines typically rely on fixed loss weights or handcrafted stage-wise schedules. A central challenge is therefore to identify which optimization direction is more beneficial at each training state. We propose a counterfactual route optimization framework for Gaussian head avatar modeling, which characterizes state-dependent optimization preference from the realized effects of alternative updates rather than predefined heuristic weighting. Starting from the same training state, we perform short-horizon route-restricted lookahead over geometry, appearance, and joint update routes and evaluate their outcomes under a unified utility. The resulting counterfactual evidence is factorized into a geometry--appearance preference and a residual joint advantage, separately capturing the relative preference between individual update directions and the additional benefit of coordinated optimization. We further amortize this offline evidence into a lightweight controller that directly estimates the current optimization preference and applies bounded modulation to the training objectives during full avatar optimization. Experiments on the NeRSemble dataset validate the effectiveness of the proposed design, consistently outperforming existing methods while preserving clearer local facial structures and finer details.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向 Gaussian 头部 avatar 的反事实路线优化框架：在同一训练状态下对几何、外观、联合更新三条路线做短视界受限前瞻，用统一效用评估结果，把证据分解为几何-外观偏好与联合更新的残余优势，再蒸馏成轻量控制器，在完整训练中对各目标做有界调制。在 NeRSemble 数据集上一致优于现有方法，同时保留更清晰的局部面部结构与更精细细节。
Motivation: 头部 avatar 训练需同时优化几何、外观与跨视角一致性等多个目标，但各目标的相对效果随训练状态变化；现有流程依赖固定损失权重或手工分阶段调度，无法判断当前训练状态下哪个优化方向更有利。
Method: 从同一训练状态出发，对几何、外观、联合更新三条路线做短视界路线受限前瞻 (route-restricted lookahead)，在统一效用下评估结果；把反事实证据分解为几何-外观偏好与联合更新的残余优势；再把离线证据摊销 (amortize) 成轻量控制器，直接估计当前优化偏好并在完整 avatar 优化中对训练目标施加有界调制。
Result: 在 NeRSemble 数据集上的实验验证了该设计的有效性，一致优于现有方法，并保持更清晰的局部面部结构与更精细的细节。
Conclusion: 损失权重不应靠固定值或手工阶段表设定，而应由训练状态相关的反事实前瞻证据驱动，并可摊销成轻量控制器在完整训练中实时调制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: UltraWorld: Learning Interactive Ultrasound World Models from Untracked Clinical Videos with Acoustic Sampling Map
papers.abstract_en: World models can enable autonomous ultrasound scanning by predicting the outcomes of probe motions from local observations. Learning this action--observation relationship typically relies on synchronized video--pose pairs, which are costly to collect at scale and largely unavailable in routine clinical recordings. Reliable action following further requires modeling ultrasound's cross-sectional sampling geometry. We present UltraWorld, a self-distillation recipe that transfers priors from clinical ultrasound videos into interactive world models without real action annotations. Starting from clinical videos, we adapt a video foundation model into an ultrasound generator conditioned on reference images and anatomical masks. Anatomical masks sampled along programmable trajectories through 3D anatomy provide spatial guidance for synthesizing action--video pairs. We then use these synthetic pairs to self-distill the generator into a world model that predicts future observations from local observations and actions, without requiring anatomical masks or other 3D assets at inference time. To further improve action following, we introduce the Acoustic Sampling Map (AsMap), which represents probe poses and imaging settings as pixel-wise 3D sampling positions, beam directions, and depths. Experiments demonstrate improved prediction fidelity and action following. Across nine simulated closed-loop local planning episodes, UltraWorld reduces the mean final distance to the goal and orientation error by 29\% and 38\%, respectively, compared with visual servoing. Project Page: https://ultraworld-project.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UltraWorld 用自蒸馏把临床超声视频里的先验转成可交互的超声世界模型，无需真实动作标注：以参考图像与解剖掩码为条件的视频基础模型生成器，沿 3D 解剖中的可编程轨迹采样掩码合成动作-视频对，再蒸馏成由局部观测与动作预测未来观测的模型。加入 Acoustic Sampling Map (AsMap) 把探头位姿与成像参数编码为逐像素的 3D 采样位置、波束方向与深度后，九个模拟闭环局部规划 episode 中相对视觉伺服 (visual servoing) 终点距离与朝向误差分别降低 29% 与 38%。
Motivation: 学习超声的动作-观测关系通常依赖同步的 video-pose 对，这类数据采集成本高且在常规临床录影中基本没有；同时超声的断面采样几何也必须被建模，动作跟随才可靠。
Method: 自蒸馏流程：先把视频基础模型适配为以参考图像和解剖掩码为条件的超声生成器；沿 3D 解剖的可编程轨迹采样解剖掩码提供空间指导，合成动作-视频对；再用这些合成对把生成器蒸馏成世界模型，推理时不再需要掩码或 3D 资产。AsMap 将探头位姿与成像设置表示为逐像素的 3D 采样位置、波束方向与深度，以改善动作跟随。
Result: 在九个模拟闭环局部规划 episode 中，UltraWorld 相对 visual servoing 把到目标的平均最终距离降低 29%，朝向误差降低 38%；摘要称预测保真度与动作跟随均有提升。
Conclusion: 临床超声视频的先验可以在没有真实动作标注的条件下自蒸馏成交互式世界模型，而显式编码超声采样几何的 AsMap 是提升动作跟随的关键组件。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: CIRSeg: Coarse-to-Fine Intensity-Robust Liver Segmentation with Source-Free Continual Test-Time Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Reliable liver segmentation in contrast-enhanced MRI is essential for quantitative hepatic assessment, treatment planning, and longitudinal disease monitoring. However, limited annotated data and scanner- or vendor-dependent intensity variations can cause overfitting and poor generalization to unseen acquisition domains. Moreover, simultaneously achieving robust global localization and precise boundary delineation remains challenging, while predictions may contain isolated false-positive regions outside the main liver component. To address these challenges, we propose CIRSeg, a coarse-to-fine, intensity-robust liver segmentation framework based on nnU-Netv2. CIRSeg combines 3D CutMix with stochastic intensity transfer using either Nyul augmentation or histogram matching to improve robustness to heterogeneous MRI intensities. Its cascaded architecture decouples low-resolution anatomical localization from full-resolution boundary refinement. At inference, source-free test-time adaptation based on confidence-filtered predictions and probability-prior regularization further improves robustness to out-of-distribution inputs. As a final deterministic post-processing step, largest connected component filtering removes isolated false-positive regions. On the CARE 2026 test set, CIRSeg achieves Dice scores of 97.13\% and 97.93\% on the in-domain and unseen-domain subsets, with corresponding HD95 values of 20.18 mm and 11.30 mm, respectively. These results demonstrate consistently accurate segmentation across both in-domain and unseen acquisition settings. The code is available at https://github.com/jingkunchen/MICCAI_CARE_2026
papers.comment: Accepted at the CARE 2026 Workshop at MICCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CIRSeg 是基于 nnU-Netv2 的肝脏 MRI 分割框架，用 3D CutMix 加 Nyul 增广或直方图匹配的随机强度迁移提升跨扫描仪强度鲁棒性，级联结构把低分辨率定位与全分辨率边界细化解耦，推理时用置信度过滤与概率先验正则做 source-free 测试时自适应，再用最大连通域滤除孤立假阳性。在 CARE 2026 测试集上 in-domain Dice 97.13%、unseen-domain Dice 97.93%，HD95 分别为 20.18 mm 与 11.30 mm。
Motivation: 增强 MRI 标注数据有限，且强度随扫描仪与厂商变化，导致模型过拟合、在未见采集域上泛化差；同时全局定位与精细边界难以兼顾，预测中常出现肝脏主体之外的孤立假阳性区域。
Method: 以 nnU-Netv2 为基座：训练阶段用 3D CutMix 结合随机强度迁移（Nyul augmentation 或 histogram matching）；级联架构将低分辨率解剖定位与全分辨率边界细化解耦；推理阶段采用基于置信度过滤预测与概率先验正则的 source-free test-time adaptation；最后用最大连通域滤波做确定性后处理。
Result: 在 CARE 2026 测试集上，in-domain 子集 Dice 97.13%、HD95 20.18 mm；unseen-domain 子集 Dice 97.93%、HD95 11.30 mm。
Conclusion: 强度迁移增广、级联细化与 source-free 测试时自适应结合后，CIRSeg 在域内与未见采集域上都能保持一致的高精度分割，且代码已开源。

papers.title: AdaPS-LiNGAM: Adaptive Predecessor Selection for Linear Non-Gaussian Acyclic Models under Small-Sample Settings
papers.abstract_en: Causal discovery becomes particularly challenging when the available sample size is small relative to the number of variables. This challenge also arises in the linear non-Gaussian acyclic model (LiNGAM), an identifiable framework for causal discovery from observational data. DirectLiNGAM estimates a causal order, which arranges variables so that causes precede their effects, by sequentially identifying an exogenous variable and removing its linear effect from the remaining variables. We establish a structural limitation of this procedure: when the number of variables exceeds the sample size, repeated residualization necessarily becomes degenerate before the full causal order can be determined. Our analysis further reveals that each residual can be reconstructed using only a graph-determined subset of variables already placed earlier in the causal order, termed the active boundary. This result motivates AdaPS-LiNGAM (Adaptive Predecessor Selection LiNGAM), which reconstructs each residual directly from the original observations using an adaptively chosen sparse subset of those earlier variables. The same subset-selection principle is also applied to the final pruning step for edge estimation. Experiments on synthetic data demonstrate that AdaPS-LiNGAM provides accurate causal-structure recovery in sample-limited settings and degrades more gradually as the sample size decreases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdaPS-LiNGAM 针对变量数超过样本量时 DirectLiNGAM 逐次残差化必然退化的问题，证明每个残差只需用因果序中已定位变量的一个图决定子集（active boundary）即可重构，并据此自适应选稀疏子集直接从原始观测重建残差，同一子集选择原则也用于最终剪枝估边。合成数据实验显示它在小样本下能准确恢复因果结构，且随样本量减少性能下降更平缓。
Motivation: 样本量小于变量数时，DirectLiNGAM 逐次识别外生变量并去除线性效应的过程会提前退化，无法定出完整因果序，小样本因果发现因此失效。
Method: 先刻画 DirectLiNGAM 的结构性局限：p > n 时重复残差化必然退化；再证明每个残差可仅用因果序中先前变量的图决定子集（active boundary）重构。AdaPS-LiNGAM 据此用自适应选择的稀疏先前变量子集直接从原始观测重建每个残差，并把同一子集选择原则用于最终剪枝步骤估边。
Result: 合成数据实验中，AdaPS-LiNGAM 在样本受限设定下实现准确的因果结构恢复，且随样本量减小性能退化更平缓。
Conclusion: 小样本下因果序的逐步残差化应改为用自适应稀疏先前变量子集直接重构残差，可缓解 p > n 时的退化。

papers.title: Relational Abstractions for Spatial Reasoning with Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models excel at image synthesis, but they remain limited in their ability to reliably satisfy structured spatial reasoning constraints. In conditional data distribution modeling tasks with implicit logical structure, such as puzzles defined by visible clues paired with consistent solutions, state-of-the-art generative models tend to approximate pixel-space distributions without learning the underlying logical rules required for inference. To address this limitation, we present a novel framework for spatial reasoning with diffusion models that leverages unsupervised object discovery and abstractions of object relations. We show that the relational knowledge derived from object-centric representations enriches diffusion models with structural primitives, allowing them to effectively guide the generative representation space during both training and inference, and enabling conditional image generation that satisfies reasoning constraints. Additionally, we introduce a large-scale generative spatial reasoning benchmark with four datasets inspired by human-solvable puzzles. Our results show that relational abstractions significantly improve reasoning capabilities of diffusion models on a variety of complex reasoning tasks, while enabling robust generalization in out-of-distribution settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向扩散模型的空间推理框架：用无监督物体发现得到 object-centric 表示，再抽象出物体间关系作为结构原语，在训练与推理两阶段约束生成表示空间，使条件图像生成满足谜题类逻辑约束。同时发布一个含四个受人类可解谜题启发数据集的大规模生成式空间推理基准，结果显示关系抽象显著提升扩散模型在多种复杂推理任务上的能力，并在分布外设置下保持稳健泛化。
Motivation: 带隐式逻辑结构的条件分布建模中，SOTA 生成模型只近似像素空间分布，学不到推理所需的底层逻辑规则，因而难以可靠满足结构化空间推理约束。
Method: 框架包含无监督物体发现与物体关系抽象两步：从 object-centric 表示中提取关系知识，作为结构原语在训练和推理阶段引导扩散模型的生成表示空间；并构建含四个谜题启发数据集的大规模生成式空间推理基准。
Result: 在四个数据集构成的生成式空间推理基准上，关系抽象在多种复杂推理任务中显著提升扩散模型的推理能力，并在 out-of-distribution 设置下实现稳健泛化。
Conclusion: 把物体关系抽象注入扩散模型，可以让像素级生成器学到推理所需的逻辑规则，从而在满足约束的条件生成与分布外泛化上同时成立。

papers.title: Reproducible LLM Inference Benchmarking: A Sequential Isolation Protocol for Regression Testing
papers.abstract_en: Reproducible benchmarking of Large Language Model (LLM) inference is challenging because repeated measurements can vary with execution and system state. We present the Sequential Isolation Methodology, a controlled benchmarking and regression-testing protocol designed to reduce between-run measurement variance while deliberately varying workload concurrency. We evaluate three representative open-source LLMs on an NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU using vLLM 0.9.1 across six context sizes and eight concurrency levels, with five repetitions per configuration. The final protocol reduces average coefficient of variation (CV) from 15.2% in the least controlled methodology stage to 2.2% under the final protocol; using CV computed across the five repetition-level median (P50) TTFT values per configuration, 113 of 144 configurations (78.5%) achieve CV below 3%. The measurements also show a marked latency transition between 200 and 500 concurrent users on the tested stack and descriptive differences in P99 latency across the three models. We additionally provide an explicit cost break-even model with sensitivity to API pricing. The protocol is intended to provide a stable reference for reproducible comparison and regression testing rather than to predict absolute behavior under uncontrolled production traffic. Infrastructure-as-Code and benchmark scripts support replication of the experimental environment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Sequential Isolation Methodology：一套控制执行与系统状态、同时刻意改变负载并发度的 LLM 推理基准与回归测试协议，把平均变异系数 (CV) 从最不受控阶段的 15.2% 压到最终协议的 2.2%。在 A100 80GB + vLLM 0.9.1 上，144 个配置中 113 个（78.5%）的 P50 TTFT CV 低于 3%，并观测到 200–500 并发用户之间的明显延迟跃迁。
Motivation: LLM 推理的重复测量会随执行与系统状态波动，导致基准结果不可复现、回归测试难以判定真实变化。
Method: Sequential Isolation Methodology：在受控环境下评估三个开源 LLM，用 NVIDIA A100 80GB 与 vLLM 0.9.1，覆盖六种上下文长度、八档并发、每配置五次重复；以重复级 P50 TTFT 的 CV 衡量稳定性，并附带对 API 定价敏感的成本 break-even 模型与 IaC/基准脚本。
Result: 平均 CV 从最不受控阶段的 15.2% 降至 2.2%；144 个配置中 113 个（78.5%）P50 TTFT 的 CV 低于 3%；在被测栈上 200–500 并发用户之间出现明显延迟跃迁，三个模型的 P99 延迟存在描述性差异。
Conclusion: 该协议定位为可复现比较与回归测试的稳定参照，而非预测不受控生产流量下的绝对行为。

papers.title: Decoupling Logic from Persona: Structural Immunity of Edge LLM Agents to Context Pollution
papers.abstract_en: Small language-model agents on edge devices must hold a persona and reason correctly at once, inside one context window that fills with conversational history and persona instructions. We study what happens to the logical part of such an agent when that history is long, misleading and persona-heavy (persona-logic interference), and present a Decoupling Architecture (AO-DA) that separates logical inference ("What") from persona expression ("How") into two inference paths on one INT4 base model with hot-swappable LoRA adapters. The logic path receives only the core turn and emits a verifiable structured state (Micro-State); the persona path renders it in character with the full history. In same-base-model ablations on an Apple M2 laptop (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Gemma-3-4B-it, 4-bit; 480 runs over 4 pollution levels x 3 arms x 2 tasks x 2 personas x 5 seeds) we find: (i) the decoupled logic path is structurally invariant to pollution: its prompt stays at 180 (Llama) or 167 (Gemma) tokens while the mixed single-pass prompt grows from 242 to 1,203, and its outputs are byte-identical across levels (40/40); (ii) the mixed single pass degrades monotonically (composite logic score 0.669 to 0.150 on Llama, 0.487 to 0.150 on Gemma), mostly by failing to emit the required structured output (80-95% of runs on Llama, 100% on Gemma at the two highest levels); (iii) with the same pollution fed into the decoupled logic path, the dedicated-adapter, dedicated-format path is still more robust than the single pass on the 8B model (failure 0-20% vs 80-95%; paired $Δ$ +0.30 to +0.50, Cliff's $δ$ 0.50-0.85, Holm-adjusted $p \le 0.03$) but not on the 4B model, where both collapse. Separation costs one extra decode on a topic's first turn (28.2 s vs 18.2 s on Llama) and buys persona hot-swapping in 1.7 ms without re-running the logic path. Code, rubric, fixtures, adapters and logs are released.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 3 figures. Experiment code, scoring rubric, pollution fixtures, adapters and run logs are released (see Appendix G)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对边缘设备小模型 agent 的 persona-逻辑干扰，提出解耦架构 AO-DA：把逻辑推理（What）与人格表达（How）拆成同一 INT4 基模型上的两条推理路径，逻辑路径只吃核心轮次并输出可校验的 Micro-State。在 Apple M2 上 480 次同基模消融中，解耦路径 prompt 恒为 180（Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct）或 167（Gemma-3-4B-it）token、输出跨污染等级 40/40 字节一致，而混合单遍 prompt 从 242 涨到 1,203 token、复合逻辑分从 0.669 跌到 0.150（Gemma 0.487→0.150）。
Motivation: 边缘小模型 agent 的上下文窗口被对话历史与 persona 指令填满，长且误导性的历史会让逻辑推理部分退化（persona-logic interference），需要在单个上下文窗口内同时保住人格与正确推理。
Method: AO-DA 在一个 INT4 基模型上用可热插拔 LoRA adapter 分出两条推理路径：逻辑路径只接收核心轮次、输出结构化 Micro-State，人格路径带着完整历史把该状态渲染成人格化回复。在 Apple M2 笔记本上做同基模消融，Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 与 Gemma-3-4B-it 均 4-bit，共 480 runs（4 污染等级 × 3 臂 × 2 任务 × 2 persona × 5 seeds）。
Result: 解耦逻辑路径对污染结构性免疫：prompt 稳定在 180（Llama）/167（Gemma）token，输出跨等级 40/40 字节一致；混合单遍 prompt 由 242 增至 1,203 token，复合逻辑分 Llama 0.669→0.150、Gemma 0.487→0.150，失败主因是未按要求输出结构化结果（Llama 80-95% runs，Gemma 在最高两档 100%）。同等污染喂给解耦逻辑路径时，8B 上专用 adapter+专用格式仍更稳（失败 0-20% vs 80-95%，配对 Δ +0.30 至 +0.50，Cliff's δ 0.50-0.85，Holm 校正 p ≤ 0.03），4B 上两臂同时崩溃。代价是某话题首轮多一次解码（Llama 28.2 s vs 18.2 s），换来 1.7 ms 内热插拔 persona 且无需重跑逻辑路径。
Conclusion: 把逻辑与人格拆成两条路径可让逻辑输出对上下文污染结构性免疫，但该优势依赖模型规模：8B 上成立，4B 上解耦与单遍一起失效。

papers.title: Artificial intelligence pathways from weather to climate
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning has made rapid advances in weather forecasting: autoregressive models trained on atmospheric reanalyses now rival dynamical models across nowcasting, medium-range, and subseasonal-to-seasonal lead times, producing well-calibrated ensemble forecasts at reduced cost. We review these advances and consider their extension to climate horizons, where the challenge shifts from initial-condition skill to producing reliable statistical responses under altered forcings. AI-powered climate prediction systems must produce credible forced responses to drivers (e.g., greenhouse gases, land-use change) typically outside the observed record. We propose two minimum requirements for AI in climate modeling: (i) external forcing agents must enter explicitly enough to support interventions in which they vary independently; and (ii) robustness must be stress-tested in out-of-distribution regimes, including extremes and counterfactual trajectories. Using leading AI autoregressive emulators and hybrid physics-AI models, we identify development and coupling challenges. Comparing the reported throughput of these models with that of GPU-ported dynamical models highlights how AI can reduce time-to-solution by advancing only the target variables at the required resolution and using longer time steps, rather than integrating a full high-frequency, multivariate state. Diverse AI downscaling strategies can partially substitute for explicit fine-scale resolution, paving the way toward inexpensive local hazard assessment across prediction horizons.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: AI 天气预报的技能来自初始条件，而气候时间尺度要求在观测记录之外的强迫（温室气体、土地利用变化）下给出可靠的统计响应，现有自回归模拟器缺少可干预的外强迫通道与分布外鲁棒性。
Method: 综述并检视领先 AI 自回归模拟器与混合物理-AI 模式，提出两条最低要求（外强迫显式可独立干预、分布外与反事实压力测试），再将这些模型的 reported throughput 与 GPU 移植的动力模式对比，并梳理多种 AI downscaling 策略。
Result: 自回归模式在 nowcasting、中期、次季节到季节 (S2S) 时效上已与动力模式相当，并以更低成本产出校准良好的集合预报；throughput 对比显示 AI 靠只推进目标变量、在所需分辨率上用更长时间步（而非积分全高频多变量状态）缩短 time-to-solution；多样化 downscaling 可部分替代显式高分辨率，支撑跨时效的低成本局地灾害评估。
Conclusion: AI 要从天气走向气候，必须让外强迫显式可干预并通过分布外压力测试；其速度优势来自目标变量推进与长时间步，downscaling 可部分替代显式细尺度分辨率。

papers.title: From Expert-Guided Proof Search to Automated Open-Problem Solving
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly contributing to mathematical research, where progress often depends on efficient proof search, incremental improvements and careful verification. We describe Bolzano, a multi-agent open-source system that uses parallel prover agents with a verifier agent and maintains a human-readable research state. Initial manual use on expert-selected problems yielded 8 results whose proofs were checked by domain experts. Motivated by these case studies, we ran Bolzano without problem-specific human guidance on about 3,800 open problems extracted from four sets of papers, solving about 200 open problems. One experiment used papers accepted to STOC 2026, a top conference in theoretical computer science. There, we answered four questions raised in the papers, as confirmed by their authors.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 6th Workshop on Mathematical Reasoning and AI (MATH-AI), NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Bolzano 是一个开源多智能体数学证明系统，用并行 prover agent 加 verifier agent 维护人类可读的研究状态，在无人工针对题目引导的条件下自动求解开放问题。在约 3,800 道从四组论文抽取的开放问题上解出约 200 道；在 STOC 2026 接收论文上回答了其中四篇论文提出的四个问题，并由原作者确认。
Motivation: 数学研究进展依赖高效证明搜索、增量改进与严格验证，而 LLM 辅助证明通常仍需专家逐题挑选与引导，难以规模化处理论文中提出的开放问题。
Method: Bolzano 采用多智能体架构：多个并行 prover agent 负责证明搜索，一个 verifier agent 负责检查，并维护人类可读的研究状态 (human-readable research state)；先在专家挑选的题目上做人工试用，再在无人工针对题目引导的设定下运行于从四组论文抽取的开放问题。
Result: 专家挑选题目的初步人工试用产出 8 个结果，证明由领域专家检查；随后在约 3,800 道开放问题上无人工引导运行，解出约 200 道；在 STOC 2026 接收论文上回答了四篇论文提出的四个问题，由论文作者确认。
Conclusion: 并行证明搜索加独立验证、配合可读研究状态，可以在没有逐题人工引导的情况下自动求解论文中的开放问题，并产出经原作者确认的结果。
