papers.title: Fluctuations of Nonlinear Observables in Mean Field Neural Network Training
papers.abstract_en: Mean field limits describe the training dynamics of wide neural networks through the evolution of the empirical distribution of their parameters. Although functional central limit theorems characterize the asymptotic fluctuations of this distribution, quantities of practical interest are typically nonlinear observables of the parameter distribution rather than the distribution itself. In this work, we show how these mean field fluctuations propagate to finite dimensional nonlinear observables for shallow neural networks trained by stochastic gradient descent. Working in the weighted Sobolev space in which the limiting fluctuation process is constructed, we apply a functional Delta method under ordinary Fr{é}chet differentiability, without requiring Lions derivatives with respect to the measure variable. We obtain a central limit theorem for the observables and, under a suitable representation of their differentials, an explicit covariance formula inherited from the underlying mean field fluctuation theory. We also study whether prescribed quantities of interest can be recovered from the selected observations. Under a constant rank assumption, we prove that a quantity of interest factors locally through the observation functional if and only if, throughout a neighborhood, the kernel of the differential of the observation is contained in that of the quantity of interest. Thus, a differential condition expressed directly in the ambient Sobolev space yields an exact nonlinear local factorization. These results provide a framework both for quantifying finite-width uncertainty on observable, statistically or physically meaningful quantities and for assessing whether the chosen observations contain the information required to identify them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在均场极限下，把参数分布的泛函中心极限定理经 functional Delta method 传递到浅层网络 SGD 训练下有限维非线性观测量，得到观测量的 CLT 与显式协方差公式；并在常秩假设下证明：某关注量能被观测局部因子化，当且仅当观测微分的核包含于该量微分的核。
Motivation: 均场理论给出的是参数经验分布本身的涨落，而实践中关心的是该分布的非线性泛函（统计或物理上有意义的量），二者之间的涨落传递与可识别性此前缺少直接刻画。
Method: 在构造极限涨落过程所用的加权 Sobolev 空间中，对普通 Fréchet 可微的观测量施加 functional Delta method，无需对测度变量的 Lions 导数；由微分表示导出显式协方差，并在常秩假设下用核包含条件给出非线性局部因子化的充要条件。
Result: 得到观测量的中心极限定理及其由均场涨落理论继承的显式协方差公式；证明关注量局部因子化当且仅当在某邻域内 ker(观测微分) ⊆ ker(关注量微分)，即 Sobolev 空间中的微分条件等价于精确的非线性局部因子化。
Conclusion: 均场涨落可直接量化有限宽度网络在非线性观测量上的不确定性，而核包含条件可判定所选观测是否包含识别目标量所需的信息。

papers.title: Beyond Policy Support: Interaction Constrained Offline Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Offline reinforcement learning enables reward-driven policy improvement from fixed datasets without requiring online exploration, making it particularly attractive in safety-critical domains. A central challenge, however, is distribution shift: policy optimization may favor actions that are weakly supported by the offline data, rendering value estimates unreliable. Existing approaches primarily control this shift in the policy's own action space. In interactive environments such as autonomous driving, this can be insufficient: a candidate ego trajectory may remain well supported under the marginal behavior distribution while being poorly supported jointly with the surrounding-agent behavior observed in the logged interaction. We refer to this degradation in interaction support as \emph{interaction distribution shift} (IDS), and introduce \emph{Interaction-Constrained Drive Policy} (ICDP), an offline reinforcement learning framework that explicitly controls interaction-level distribution shift. Starting from the joint data distribution over ego and surrounding-agent futures, we show that joint-support degradation decomposes exactly into an ego-support component and a residual interaction-support component. We recover the latter through contrastive density-ratio estimation, isolating interaction compatibility without explicit joint-density modeling, surrounding-agent prediction, or rollouts in reactive simulators or learned world models during policy optimization. Closed-loop evaluations on nuPlan, Interplan and real-world truck experiments show that ICDP suppresses high-value yet interaction-unsupported trajectory selections and improves performance in interaction-critical driving scenarios. Project webpage: https://mahmoud-selim.github.io/ICDP/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 离线强化学习在自动驾驶中只约束策略自身动作的分布偏移，会漏掉「自车轨迹边缘分布支持良好、但与日志中周围智能体行为联合支持很差」的情况，作者称之为 interaction distribution shift (IDS)。ICDP 从自车与周围智能体未来量的联合数据分布出发，把联合支持退化精确分解为自车支持项与残余交互支持项，用对比密度比估计恢复后者，从而在策略优化阶段抑制高价值但交互不支持的轨迹选择。
Motivation: 离线 RL 的分布偏移通常只在策略自身动作空间里控制；在自动驾驶这类交互环境中，候选轨迹可能在行为策略边缘分布下支持良好，却与日志中观测到的周围智能体行为联合支持很差，导致价值估计不可靠。
Method: 提出 Interaction-Constrained Drive Policy (ICDP)：从自车与周围智能体未来量的联合数据分布出发，证明联合支持退化可精确分解为自车支持分量与残余交互支持分量，再用对比密度比估计 (contrastive density-ratio estimation) 恢复后者，无需显式联合密度建模、周围智能体预测，也无需在反应式仿真器或学习式 world model 中做 rollout。
Result: 在 nuPlan、Interplan 以及真实卡车实验上的闭环评估显示，ICDP 抑制了高价值但交互不支持的轨迹选择，并在交互关键的驾驶场景中提升性能。
Conclusion: 交互层面的分布偏移可以与自车支持分开控制，且在不依赖周围智能体预测或反应式 rollout 的前提下改善交互关键场景的闭环驾驶表现。

papers.title: PARC-Loc: Text-to-Point-Cloud Localization with Partial Assignment and Relational Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-point-cloud localization estimates a position in a city-scale 3D map from descriptions of surrounding objects. Existing coarse-to-fine methods retrieve submaps using aggregate learned compatibility and then localize within a selected submap. However, repetitive or similar urban objects can inflate the embedding similarity between the query and multiple submaps, even when the instance layout within a submap violates the query description. Meanwhile, query-relevant instances often span submap boundaries, leaving the retrieved submap with incomplete contextual evidence. We term these failure modes layout-inconsistent aliasing and boundary evidence incompleteness, respectively. To address them, we propose PARC-Loc, a coarse-to-fine localization framework built on Partial Assignment with Relational Consistency (PARC). PARC jointly models hint-object compatibility and pairwise spatial relations, allowing unmatched elements while favoring assignments consistent with the queried layout. At the coarse stage, its candidate-level assessment complements neural similarity for layout-consistent submap selection. At the fine stage, the context is expanded with query-relevant instances from adjacent submaps, while PARC yields object-level matching weights that guide cross-modal attention. Extensive experiments on KITTI360Pose and CityLoc show that PARC-Loc outperforms conventional coarse-to-fine baselines. On KITTI360Pose, our method improves Top-1 localization recall at 5 m from 0.50 to 0.67, achieving a 34% relative gain over the strongest baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PARC-Loc 针对文本描述在城市级 3D 地图中的定位，指出两类失败模式：相似城市物体抬高嵌入相似度导致布局不一致的子图误选 (layout-inconsistent aliasing)，以及查询相关实例跨越子图边界造成证据不完整。其 PARC 模块联合建模提示物体兼容性与成对空间关系、允许未匹配元素，粗阶段补充神经相似度做布局一致的子图选择，细阶段用相邻子图实例扩展上下文并以匹配权重引导跨模态注意力。在 KITTI360Pose 上 5 m Top-1 定位召回率从 0.50 提到 0.67，相对最强基线提升 34%。
Motivation: 粗到细检索用聚合嵌入相似度选子图，重复或相似城市物体会虚高相似度，且查询相关实例常跨子图边界，导致误选与上下文证据缺失。
Method: 提出 Partial Assignment with Relational Consistency (PARC)：联合建模提示物体兼容性与成对空间关系，允许未匹配元素并偏好与查询布局一致的分配；粗阶段以候选级评估补充神经相似度选子图，细阶段从相邻子图扩展查询相关实例，PARC 输出物体级匹配权重引导跨模态注意力。
Result: 在 KITTI360Pose 与 CityLoc 上评测：KITTI360Pose 5 m Top-1 定位召回率由基线 0.50 提升至 0.67，相对最强基线提升 34%，并超过常规粗到细基线。
Conclusion: 把布局关系一致性引入粗到细文本-点云定位，可同时缓解子图误选与边界证据缺失，在 KITTI360Pose 与 CityLoc 上优于常规粗到细基线。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.method: 提出 Partial Assignment with Relational Consistency (PARC)：联合建模提示物体兼容性与成对空间关系，允许未匹配元素并偏好与查询布局一致的分配；粗阶段以候选级评估补充神经相似度选子图，细阶段从相邻子图扩展查询相关实例，PARC 输出物体级匹配权重引导跨模态注意力。
summary_sections.result: 在 KITTI360Pose 与 CityLoc 上评测：KITTI360Pose 5 m Top-1 定位召回率由基线 0.50 提升至 0.67，相对最强基线提升 34%，并超过常规粗到细基线。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把布局关系一致性引入粗到细文本-点云定位，可同时缓解子图误选与边界证据缺失，在 KITTI360Pose 与 CityLoc 上优于常规粗到细基线。

papers.title: Leaner Transformers Can Easily Learn to Cluster
papers.abstract_en: Transformers have in-context learning capabilities, where some known learning algorithms can be executed in the forward pass through the model. Recent work shows that transformers can exactly perform Lloyd's algorithm for $k$-means clustering with $n$ points in $d$ dimensions with an embedding size $d_{\textsf{emb}} = d+k$ (thus, requiring attention projection matrices of size $(d+k)^2$). In this work, we build upon this result in the following ways: First, we present an equally expressive but smaller transformer that executes Lloyd's algorithm with embedding size $d_{\textsf{emb}} = (d + \lceil \log_2 k \rceil)$. Next, we train these transformers to learn the clustering algorithms given a distribution of clustering tasks, and theoretically characterize and empirically validate the factors affecting the convergence and in-distribution generalization of learning algorithms based on stochastic gradients. Finally, we probe the general clustering abilities of these learned algorithms (in the form of transformers), and try to understand situations where they succeed and fail.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Transformer 内嵌 Lloyd's k-means 算法的嵌入维度从 d+k 压到 d+⌈log2 k⌉，表达力不变，注意力投影矩阵随之变小。随后在聚类任务分布上训练这些 Transformer，理论刻画并实证验证影响随机梯度下学习算法收敛与分布内泛化的因素，再探测其泛化到未见聚类情形时的成功与失败条件。
Motivation: 已有工作证明 Transformer 前向传播可精确执行 Lloyd's k-means，但所需嵌入维度 d_emb = d+k、注意力投影矩阵达 (d+k)^2，参数量随 k 线性增长，且学习到的算法在分布外聚类上的行为尚不清楚。
Method: 构造表达力等价但更小的 Transformer，嵌入维度降为 d_emb = d+⌈log2 k⌉；在聚类任务分布上用随机梯度训练这些 Transformer 学习聚类算法，并对影响收敛与分布内泛化的因素做理论刻画与实证验证；最后探测学到的算法（以 Transformer 形式）的通用聚类能力。
Result: 给出嵌入维度 d_emb = d+⌈log2 k⌉ 的等表达力 Transformer（对比先前的 d+k 与 (d+k)^2 投影矩阵）；理论刻画并实证验证了随机梯度下学习算法的收敛与分布内泛化的影响因素；探测了学到的聚类算法在何种情形成功与失败。
Conclusion: 执行 Lloyd's 算法的 Transformer 可以做到嵌入维度只比数据维度多 ⌈log2 k⌉ 而不损失表达力，且这类内嵌算法能从任务分布中被训练出来，其泛化边界可以被探测和刻画。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Unrolled Flow Models for Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching enables language generation in few steps, but whether additional integration steps improve reasoning remains unclear. We prove that a flow parameterized by a two-layer Transformer can solve graph reachability, with the required number of integration steps increasing with the target's distance from the root. Yet, standard flow language models can fail to benefit from additional steps on reasoning tasks. We attribute this limitation to objectives that supervise each time point independently, without explicitly training successive steps to build on one another. To address this, we instead train through the model's own latent rollout over a randomly sampled subinterval of [0, 1], decoding only at the endpoint. On ProsQA, this raises accuracy to 97% and enables performance to improve with additional integration steps. For the longer rollouts required by reasoning tasks such as Sudoku and Maze, retracting the latent state onto a sphere stabilizes the dynamics and yields substantial gains over baselines with more than three times as many parameters. Sampling multiple rollouts further improves performance when paired with a parameter-free selection score, although reliable selection remains challenging for longer answers. Together, these results establish a theoretical basis for reasoning with flows and show how rollout training, stable latent dynamics, and rollout selection help realize this capacity in practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 flow matching 语言模型改为在自身 latent rollout 的随机子区间上训练、只在端点解码，使后续积分步真正依赖前一步。ProsQA 准确率升到 97% 且随积分步数增加而提升；对 Sudoku、Maze 这类长 rollout，把 latent 状态收缩到球面 (sphere retraction) 稳定动力学，在参数量少三倍以上的情况下超过基线，再配无参数选择分数采样多条 rollout 还能继续提升。
Motivation: Flow 语言模型能少步生成，但增加积分步未必改善推理：现有目标独立监督每个时间点，没有训练相邻步互相承接，长 rollout 还会动力学不稳。
Method: 证明两层 Transformer 参数化的 flow 可解 graph reachability，所需积分步数随目标到根的距离增长；训练时在 [0,1] 随机采样子区间上跑模型自身 latent rollout，仅在端点解码；长 rollout 用 sphere retraction 稳定状态，再用 parameter-free selection score 从多条 rollout 中挑选。
Result: ProsQA 准确率 97%，且性能随积分步数增加而上升；在 Sudoku 与 Maze 上，带 sphere retraction 的方法相对参数量三倍以上的基线有显著提升；多 rollout 加无参数选择分数进一步提升，但长答案上可靠选择仍具挑战。
Conclusion: 为用 flow 做推理给出理论依据，并指出 rollout 训练、稳定 latent 动力学与 rollout 选择三者共同把这一能力落到实践。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: EntroPrefill: Renyi-Guided Context Pruning with Conditional Stability Guarantees for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Mid-prefill pruning can reduce the sequence processed by deeper transformer layers, but attention concentration alone does not certify that discarded context is dispensable. We formulate EntroPrefill as a Renyi-guided proposal mechanism coupled to explicit constraints on discarded attention mass. Sink-isolated, regularized head pooling respects grouped-query attention while exposing a quantitative trade-off between specialization and worst-head coverage. We derive a mixture-to-head deletion envelope, a computable upper bound on feasible token removal, and a finite-sample observer guarantee that remains valid when the pruning layer is selected adaptively. We then establish a conditional transformer perturbation bound with explicit sufficient Lipschitz constants and a first-token decision-margin corollary. A counterexample shows why shallow observations alone cannot imply an unconditional future-output guarantee. The systems analysis distinguishes query-head unions, physical page allocation, and KV-transfer payload, and gives an arithmetic break-even condition for pruning. This manuscript is theoretical in scope: it defines the procedure, its assumptions, and its formal limits, but does not report measured acceleration or task-accuracy preservation. Experiments are reserved for subsequent validation of the assumptions, approximation tightness, and end-to-end resource trade-offs.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 0 figures. Theoretical framework and conditional stability guarantees for context pruning; no empirical evaluation or benchmarks are included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EntroPrefill 是面向 RAG 预填充阶段的 Renyi 熵引导上下文剪枝理论框架：以 Renyi 指导的提议机制配合被丢弃注意力质量的显式约束，做 sink-isolated 正则化 head pooling，并给出 mixture-to-head 删除包络、自适应选层仍有效的有限样本观测保证，以及带显式 Lipschitz 常数的条件性 transformer 扰动界与首 token 判决间隔推论。反例说明仅凭浅层观测无法推出无条件的未来输出保证；全文为理论框架，不含实测加速或任务精度。
Motivation: 中段预剪枝 (mid-prefill pruning) 可缩短深层处理的序列，但仅靠注意力集中度无法证明被丢弃上下文确实可弃，缺少可计算的删除上限与输出扰动的条件性保证。
Method: 以 Renyi 引导的提议机制耦合被丢弃注意力质量的显式约束；采用尊重 grouped-query attention 的 sink-isolated 正则化 head pooling，暴露 specialization 与 worst-head coverage 的量化权衡；推导 mixture-to-head 删除包络、可行 token 删除量的可计算上界、自适应选剪枝层时仍成立的有限样本 observer 保证，以及带显式充分 Lipschitz 常数的条件性 transformer 扰动界和首 token 判决间隔推论；另给出 query-head union、物理页分配与 KV-transfer payload 的系统分析和剪枝的算术 break-even 条件。
Result: 给出可计算的可行 token 删除上界、自适应选层下仍有效的有限样本 observer 保证、条件性扰动界与首 token 判决间隔推论，以及剪枝的算术 break-even 条件；并以反例证明浅层观测不足以蕴含无条件未来输出保证。该稿为理论范围，不报告实测加速或任务精度保持。
Conclusion: 上下文剪枝的正确性只能在显式注意力质量约束与 Lipschitz 条件下以条件性形式保证，且必须用反例划清浅层观测的推理边界；实验留待后续验证假设、近似紧度与端到端资源权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Diffusion-Generated Image Watermarking: A Two-Axis Taxonomy and Three Protocol-Bounded Case Studies
papers.abstract_en: Watermarking diffusion-generated images requires balancing provenance signals with image quality, robustness, and computational cost. This work organizes methods along two axes: insertion mechanism and primary signal-bearing representation, and formalizes a representative $z_T$-Fourier pipeline for verification and identification. We then use the taxonomy to structure three protocol-bounded case studies. The first examines associations among frequency integrity, detection, quality, and cropping behavior. The second revisits persistence under seed-linked and seed-independent editing and formulates a scoped Semantic Imprinting Hypothesis without claiming a localized carrier or causal mechanism. The third studies single-shot VAE-latent phase modulation, including its efficiency, regeneration robustness, and robustness--quality operating points. Finally, we separate four content-level attack families from model/pipeline adaptation, propose corresponding evaluation protocols and testable conjectures for parameter-tuning threats, and identify additional temporal extensions for video. These analyses do not establish a universal ranking; instead, they provide a framework for matched, protocol-aware comparisons of watermarking systems for diffusion-generated images.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 2 figures. Accepted to the non-archival track of the ECCV 2026 LifeGenIP Workshop. English translation with partial reorganization of our article in Journal of Broadcast Engineering 31(4), 687-699 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为扩散生成图像水印给出按插入机制与承载表示划分的两轴分类学，并形式化 z_T-Fourier 管线用于验证与识别，用三个受协议约束的案例研究考察频率完整性与检测/质量/裁剪的关系、seed 相关与无关编辑下的持续性（提出有范围的 Semantic Imprinting Hypothesis），以及单次 VAE-latent 相位调制的效率与鲁棒-质量工作点。结论是这些分析不给出普适排名，而是提供协议对齐的比较框架。
Motivation: 扩散图像水印需要在来源信号、图像质量、鲁棒性与计算开销之间权衡，而现有方法缺少统一的比较坐标系，跨论文结论常因协议不同而不可比。
Method: 沿插入机制与主要信号承载表示两个轴组织方法，形式化一个代表性的 z_T-Fourier 验证/识别管线；据此设计三个协议绑定的案例研究，并把四类内容级攻击与模型/管线适配区分开，提出对应评测协议与可检验猜想，另指出面向视频的时间扩展方向。
Result: 三个案例研究分别考察频率完整性与检测、质量、裁剪行为的关联；在 seed 相关与 seed 独立编辑下重检水印持续性并给出有范围的 Semantic Imprinting Hypothesis（不主张局域载体或因果机制）；研究单次 VAE-latent 相位调制的效率、再生鲁棒性与鲁棒-质量工作点。
Conclusion: 水印系统应在匹配协议下比较而非追求普适排名；评测需把四类内容级攻击与模型/管线适配分开，并对参数调节类威胁给出可检验猜想。

papers.title: SoftSEEPS improves ML-based precipitation forecasting
papers.abstract_en: In this paper we have developed a differentiable approximation of the well-known SEEPS score, which we name SoftSEEPS. This allows the training of a Machine Learning model to forecast precipitation directly. We test SoftSEEPS on the IMERG dataset (0.1 degree resolution) by training a decoder for precipitation on the latent space of a pre-trained low-resolution forecasting model. Combining SoftSEEPS and RMSE in a joint objective is possible with marginal trade-offs in either metric.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Flow-of-Thought: A Framework for Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Mental imagery, ``seeing with the mind's eye'' is an essential aspect of human cognition. Despite rapid progress Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision Transformers (ViTs) still underperform on tasks requiring spatial understanding. To address this, we introduce Flow-of-Thought (FoT), a framework that integrates the generation of visual sketches as intermediate reasoning steps, mimicking mental imagery in humans. We train coordinate-aware trajectory flow fields on $SO(2)$ group orbits and cumulative shortest paths, then freeze the learned dynamics; same vs. different decisions compare competing generative hypotheses using foreground-weighted reconstruction energy. On locked tests FoT reaches 100.0% accuracy on Tetris and 99.0% on colored shapes. Under frozen transfer, the orbit-trained 2D flow improves over its endpoint-only control on BLINK Multi-view (72.2% vs. 63.9% on 133 public validation pairs), supporting continuous visual traces as an effective and interpretable representation for spatial reasoning in some out-of-distribution settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Flow-of-Thought (FoT)：让模型在推理中间生成视觉草图来模拟心像，用 SO(2) 群轨道上的坐标感知轨迹流场与累积最短路训练动力学后冻结，再以前景加权重建能量比较竞争生成假设。锁定测试上 Tetris 准确率 100.0%、彩色形状 99.0%；冻结迁移下轨道训练的 2D 流在 BLINK Multi-view 上以 72.2% 对 63.9% 超过仅端点控制（133 对公开验证对）。
Motivation: LLM 与 ViT 在需要空间理解的任务上仍然偏弱，缺少把空间推理过程显式外化的中间表示。
Method: 在 SO(2) 群轨道与累积最短路径上训练坐标感知的轨迹流场 (trajectory flow field)，随后冻结学到的动力学；same vs. different 判定用前景加权重建能量 (foreground-weighted reconstruction energy) 比较竞争的生成假设，中间产物是可视草图。
Result: 锁定测试上 FoT 在 Tetris 达到 100.0% 准确率、彩色形状 99.0%；冻结迁移设置下，轨道训练的 2D 流在 BLINK Multi-view 的 133 对公开验证对上取得 72.2%，端点-only 控制为 63.9%。
Conclusion: 连续视觉轨迹 (continuous visual traces) 可作为空间推理的一种有效且可解释的表示，至少在部分分布外设置下成立。

papers.title: SoccerNet-FoulRet: Retrieving Semantically Similar Soccer Foul Videos
papers.abstract_en: Refereeing decisions in professional soccer remain inconsistent because referees cannot easily compare a contentious foul against similar past cases. We cast this as a retrieval problem and introduce SoccerNet-FoulRet, the first benchmark for semantic foul retrieval. Given a query foul, the task is to retrieve past fouls judged to be relevant precedents, regardless of camera angle, teams, or appearance. This differs from prior video-to-video retrieval, which matches clips by visual similarity or a shared event. Here, relevance is defined by refereeing interpretation. We build the benchmark from the SoccerNet-MVFoul dataset and evaluate retrieval ability of zero-shot video and vision-language embedders together with a task-specific fine-tuned baseline on 693 human-verified queries and category-relevance labels. Semantic foul retrieval remains challenging. The strongest zero-shot model achieves under 5% HitRate@10 on human-verified precedents, while category-supervised fine-tuning improves category relevance but transfers only modestly to precedent retrieval. We release SoccerNet-FoulRet to establish semantic foul retrieval as an open problem: https://github.com/SoccerNet/sn-foulret.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把足球犯规判罚一致性问题转成语义检索任务，提出首个语义犯规检索基准 SoccerNet-FoulRet：给定一次争议犯规，检索被判为相关先例的历史犯规，与相机角度、球队和外观无关，相关性由判罚解释定义。在 693 条人工核验查询上，最强 zero-shot 模型 HitRate@10 不足 5%，类别监督微调能提升类别相关性但向先例检索的迁移有限。
Motivation: 职业足球裁判难以把当前争议犯规与过往类似判例对比，导致判罚不一致；现有视频到视频检索只按视觉相似或共享事件匹配，而判罚先例检索的相关性由裁判解释决定，尚无对应基准。
Method: 基于 SoccerNet-MVFoul 数据集构建基准，提供 693 条人工核验查询与类别相关性标签；评测 zero-shot 视频与视觉-语言 embedder，以及一个任务专用微调基线。
Result: 在 693 条人工核验查询上，最强 zero-shot 模型对人工核验先例的 HitRate@10 低于 5%；类别监督微调提升类别相关性，但向先例检索的迁移仅为 modest。
Conclusion: 语义犯规检索仍是开放难题：视觉与视觉-语言 embedder 的 zero-shot 检索能力不足，类别监督微调不能有效转化为先例检索性能，作者据此开源该基准。

papers.title: Healthy skepticism in AI: a data visualization research agenda
papers.abstract_en: Research in data visualization of artificial intelligence (AI) models has historically focused on enhancing trust through visual explanations of AI. The trustworthiness line of work was built at least partially on an assumption that humans were critical users unlikely to adopt AI technology. It is increasingly clear that human trust levels in AI span, in fact, a wide range from critical to over-reliant. There is an urgent need to support both trust and healthy skepticism in AI solutions. We argue that it is healthy for humans to adopt a skeptical view both on the results of AI models and on the use of such AI models. We share our thoughts on the rising phenomenon of over-reliance on AI models, the risks and opportunities in using AI models, and the role of data visualization in over-reliance situations where humans are not motivated to engage in critical thinking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文主张 AI 可视化研究应从「建立信任」转向同时支撑信任与健康怀疑：人的 AI 信任水平实际横跨从批判到过度依赖的连续谱，可视化在用户缺乏批判动机的过度依赖场景中承担关键作用。作者据此提出一份以过度依赖现象、AI 使用的风险与机会、以及可视化介入方式为核心的研究议程。
Motivation: 既往 AI 可视化研究建立在「人是批判性用户、不会轻易采纳 AI」这一假设上，因而一味追求通过视觉解释增强信任；但现实是信任水平分布很宽，过度依赖日益普遍，该假设已不成立。
Method: 以立场论文 (position paper) 形式展开论证：先检讨信任导向可视化研究的隐含假设，再讨论对 AI 模型结果与使用 AI 模型本身双重怀疑的立场，最后围绕过度依赖、风险与机会、以及人在无批判动机时可视化的作用提出研究议程。
Result: 给出的核心论断是人的 AI 信任水平覆盖从批判到过度依赖的宽谱，且在过度依赖情境中人缺乏批判性思考动机；摘要为议程性论述，未列出实验指标或数据集。
Conclusion: 健康的 AI 使用需要同时支撑信任与怀疑，可视化研究的目标不应只是提高信任度，而应针对过度依赖场景设计能重新激发批判性思考的介入方式。

papers.title: A Strength-Monotonic Law for Domain Alignment in Frozen-Embedding Bioacoustic Classification
papers.abstract_en: When does distribution alignment help a frozen foundation-model embedding generalize across acoustic domains? For cross-domain mosquito-species classification we report a strength-monotonic law: the stronger an encoder is on the target task, the more its unseen-domain generalization relies on a distribution-alignment (MMD) term, and the more it is harmed by domain-rebalanced sampling. Across four encoder families and a within-encoder HuBERT layer sweep (n=8), the rebalancing leg orders exactly with encoder strength (Spearman -1.000), while the MMD-benefit leg is monotonic within each stream and -0.857 pooled; fixing architecture and varying only representation strength flips the rebalancing effect from benefit to collapse. The law is actionable: a single MMD term is the sole lever on a strong encoder, so we reduce the field's default recipe to a frozen Perch 2.0 embedding, a lightweight probe, cross-entropy, one MMD, and input augmentation. The reduced recipe stays within seed noise of the full composite (BA_unseen 0.299+/-0.006 vs. 0.307+/-0.014). As boundary conditions of the same law, three community defaults (backbone fine-tuning, multi-modal fusion, and domain rebalancing) each hurt unseen-domain accuracy under a leave-domain protocol, shown with single-variable, multi-seed evidence. We present a mechanism and the recipe it explains, not a leaderboard entry.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在冻结的生物声学 embedding 上做跨域蚊种分类时，编码器在目标任务上越强，其未见域泛化越依赖 MMD 分布对齐项，也越被域重采样 (domain rebalancing) 损害：四个编码器家族与 HuBERT 层扫描 (n=8) 中，重采样效应与编码器强度的 Spearman 相关为 -1.000，MMD 增益为 -0.857。据此把默认配方缩减为冻结 Perch 2.0 embedding + 轻量 probe + 交叉熵 + 单个 MMD + 输入增强，BA_unseen 0.299±0.006 对完整复合 0.307±0.014，落在种子噪声内。
Motivation: 跨声学域时，冻结基础模型 embedding 的泛化该靠分布对齐还是靠域重采样，缺少可判定的规则；社区默认的 backbone 微调、多模态融合、域重采样在未见域上可能反而有害。
Method: 在跨域蚊种分类上以 leave-domain 协议检验：比较四个 encoder 家族，并在 HuBERT 内做层扫描 (n=8)，分别度量 MMD 对齐项带来的增益与域重采样的效应，用单变量、多种子证据分离表示强度与架构的影响；再据此给出缩减配方（冻结 Perch 2.0、轻量 probe、交叉熵、单个 MMD、输入增强）。
Result: 域重采样一腿与 encoder 强度的排序完全一致，Spearman -1.000；MMD 增益一腿在每个流内单调，合并后 -0.857。固定架构只改表示强度即可让域重采样从有益翻转为崩溃。缩减配方 BA_unseen 0.299±0.006，完整复合 0.307±0.014，差在种子噪声内；backbone fine-tuning、multi-modal fusion、domain rebalancing 三个默认做法在 leave-domain 下各自降低未见域准确率。
Conclusion: 强度单调律说明强编码器上唯一有效的杠杆是单个 MMD 项，域重采样应弃用；作者强调给出的是机制与配方而非排行榜成绩。

papers.title: Unbounded Characteristic and Universal Kernels
papers.abstract_en: Kernel methods are among the most powerful tools in machine learning and statistics, with a large number of successful applications. Their immense success stems from the flexible function class associated to each kernel---its reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS)---which facilitates statistical analysis, as well as from their computational tractability and applicability to many domains. Multiple notions (such as characteristic, $L_p$-universal, and integrally strictly positive definite) capture the expressivity of kernels and their RKHSs and play a key role in understanding the statistical properties of kernel methods; these concepts and their relations are well-understood for bounded kernels. Even though unbounded kernels have received significant attention over the past decade (for instance, in the construction of kernel-based discrepancy and dependence measures such as the maximum mean discrepancy, the Hilbert-Schmidt independence criterion, and the kernel Stein discrepancy), surprisingly little is known about the relations of these notions in the unbounded case. In the present paper we tackle this severe bottleneck, establishing their relations under mild assumptions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在无界核 (unbounded kernels) 上建立 characteristic、L_p-universal 与 integrally strictly positive definite 等表达力概念之间的关系，此前这些关系只在有界核情形被理解清楚。作者在温和假设下给出无界情形的蕴含结构，为 MMD、HSIC、kernel Stein discrepancy 等基于无界核的差异与相依性度量提供统计性质分析基础。
Motivation: 无界核在过去十年被广泛用于构造 MMD、HSIC、kernel Stein discrepancy 等度量，但 characteristic、L_p-universal、integrally strictly positive definite 这些刻画 RKHS 表达力的概念在无界情形下的相互关系几乎未知，构成理解核方法统计性质的瓶颈。
Method: 在温和假设下推导无界核情形下各表达力概念之间的蕴含关系，推广原本只对有界核建立的理论框架。
Result: 在温和假设下确立了无界核的 characteristic、L_p-universal、integrally strictly positive definite 等概念之间的关系；摘要未给出定量实验数字。

papers.title: Beyond Group Splits: Specimen-Level Cross-Validation and Visual Attribution for Remaining-Shelf-Life Regression in Climacteric Fruit
papers.abstract_en: Estimating remaining shelf life (RSL) from images could provide affordable decision support for perishable produce, but evaluation protocols can substantially affect reported performance when repeated images are available from the same biological specimen. We use the Hass Avocado Ripening dataset, comprising 8,834 image-RSL pairs from 426 fruits across three storage regimes, to evaluate a frozen ImageNet-pretrained visual backbone with a lightweight regression head. Our contributions are threefold: we quantify the effect of observation-level versus specimen-disjoint evaluation, compare lightweight and heavier visual backbones under specimen-disjoint cross-validation, and examine their spatial attributions using Grad-CAM. Across ten observation-level random splits, the model achieves a mean RMSE of 2.37 days with a standard deviation of 0.03 days, whereas specimen-disjoint 5-fold cross-validation yields a mean RMSE of 3.12 days with a standard deviation of 0.11 days. The corresponding mean coefficient of determination is 0.553. A matched per-specimen comparison confirms higher error under specimen-disjoint evaluation, with a probability value below 0.001 across 426 specimens, showing that observation-level partitioning gives a substantially more optimistic estimate for this dataset and model configuration. Under specimen-disjoint evaluation, MobileNetV3-Small (0.93 million parameters) achieves accuracy comparable to ResNet-18 while providing substantially higher throughput, and Grad-CAM reveals differences in spatial attribution between the lightweight backbones. These results support specimen-disjoint evaluation and attribution analysis when assessing lightweight vision models for longitudinal shelf-life prediction.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Accepted for physical presentation at the 10th IEEE Conference on Information Communications Technology and Society (ICTAS 2026), 14-16 October 2026, Durban, South Africa
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 Hass Avocado Ripening 数据集（8,834 组图像-RSL、426 个果实、3 种贮藏条件）检验评估划分方式对剩余货架期 (RSL) 回归的影响：冻结 ImageNet 预训练骨干加轻量回归头，在 observation-level 随机划分下 10 次平均 RMSE 2.37 天（标准差 0.03），换成 specimen-disjoint 5-fold 交叉验证后升至 3.12 天（标准差 0.11），说明按观测随机划分会显著高估性能。
Motivation: 同一生物个体的重复图像若被随机分到训练与测试两侧，货架期回归的报告误差会被系统性压低，评估协议本身足以改变结论，而纵向果蔬图像数据普遍存在这种泄漏风险。
Method: 冻结 ImageNet 预训练视觉骨干加轻量回归头；对比 observation-level 十次随机划分与 specimen-disjoint 5-fold 交叉验证，并在 specimen-disjoint 下比较轻量与较重骨干（MobileNetV3-Small、ResNet-18），用 Grad-CAM 比较空间归因，另做逐果实配对误差检验。
Result: observation-level 十次随机划分平均 RMSE 2.37 天（标准差 0.03），specimen-disjoint 5-fold 平均 RMSE 3.12 天（标准差 0.11），对应平均决定系数 0.553；426 个果实的配对比较中 specimen-disjoint 误差更高，p 值低于 0.001。MobileNetV3-Small（0.93M 参数）在 specimen-disjoint 下精度与 ResNet-18 相当且吞吐量明显更高，Grad-CAM 显示轻量骨干间空间归因存在差异。
Conclusion: 对纵向货架期预测的轻量视觉模型，应采用 specimen-disjoint 评估并结合归因分析；observation-level 划分在该数据集与模型配置下给出明显更乐观的估计。

papers.title: MeshCarve: Artisan Mesh Generation with Flow Matching in Compact Latent Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Prior artisan mesh generation works largely predict face tokens autoregressively, which makes inference slow. Recent methods instead flow match continuous latents built by Variational AutoEncoders (VAEs), but reconstruction quality drops significantly when geometry and topology are jointly encoded, and further when the latent space is compressed. We present MeshCarve, a flow matching method that generates entirely in compact latent spaces, generating vertex positions and edge connections separately and sidestepping the difficulty of a joint compact latent. To shorten the token sequence, we propose a hierarchical sparse transformer backbone, instantiated as VertexVAE and EdgeVAE. Instead of encoding fields over the surface voxels, both VAEs anchor on discrete vertices in their latent spaces, which drastically reduces the token sequence length, and our spatial-aware compression shortens it further without costing reconstruction. VertexVAE directly encodes vertex occupancy. For connectivity, we propose vertex-link encoding, which turns arbitrary connectivity between vertices into fixed-length continuous per-vertex embeddings and recovers complex artistic topology faithfully. MeshCarve combines these VAEs with an anchor generator and flow matches on the shortened token sequences. It shows advantages over state-of-the-art autoregressive and flow matching methods on Objaverse and generalizes to Toys4K. To the best of our knowledge, it is among the first artisan mesh generation methods whose every generative stage runs in a spatially compressed latent, with a token sequence only a fraction of the most compressed previous autoregressive and flow matching works.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MeshCarve 把手工制品网格 (artisan mesh) 生成整体搬进紧凑 latent：VertexVAE 与 EdgeVAE 分别生成顶点位置与边连接，配合 anchor generator 在缩短后的 token 序列上做 flow matching，绕开几何与拓扑联合编码导致的重建退化。在 Objaverse 上相对自回归与 flow matching 的 SOTA 方法显示优势，并可泛化到 Toys4K，token 序列长度只有此前最压缩的自回归与 flow matching 工作的一小部分。
Motivation: 自回归预测 face token 推理慢；用 VAE 连续 latent 做 flow matching 虽快，但几何与拓扑联合编码时重建质量显著下降，latent 再压缩则进一步恶化。
Method: 提出分层稀疏 transformer 骨干，实例化为 VertexVAE 与 EdgeVAE，两者在 latent 中锚定离散顶点而非表面体素以缩短序列，再用 spatial-aware compression 进一步压缩且不损重建；VertexVAE 直接编码顶点占据，EdgeVAE 用 vertex-link encoding 把任意顶点间连接转成定长的每顶点连续 embedding；最后与 anchor generator 结合，在缩短的 token 序列上做 flow matching。
Result: 在 Objaverse 上相对 SOTA 自回归与 flow matching 方法显示优势，并泛化到 Toys4K；每个生成阶段都在空间压缩的 latent 中运行，token 序列长度仅为此前最压缩的自回归与 flow matching 工作的一小部分（据作者所知属首批做到这一点的 artisan mesh 生成方法）。
Conclusion: 把顶点与连接拆开、各自放进锚定离散顶点的紧凑 latent，可以在不牺牲重建的前提下让网格生成全程跑在压缩 latent 上并加快推理。

papers.title: DynStream: Online Streaming 4D Gaussian Reconstruction of Dynamic Worlds from Unposed Video
papers.abstract_en: Online reconstruction of dynamic 4D scenes from long, unposed streaming videos requires both continuous processing and photorealistic rendering, which existing methods struggle to achieve simultaneously. Existing feed-forward Gaussian methods are restricted to offline processing, whereas online point-cloud approaches struggle to maintain dense geometry and high-fidelity rendering. We present DynStream, a framework for streaming 4D Gaussian reconstruction from long, unposed videos. Given a continuous video stream, DynStream reconstructs the scene within local temporal windows and incrementally aligns and fuses these local reconstructions into a globally consistent scene, enabling online 4D reconstruction without per-scene optimization. By jointly enforcing cross-window geometric consistency and modeling time-varying scene content, DynStream supports efficient reconstruction and photorealistic rendering over extended video streams. Experiments demonstrate that DynStream enables high-fidelity online dynamic reconstruction and rendering from long video streams, achieving state-of-the-art performance across diverse dynamic indoor and outdoor scenes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DynStream 把长段无位姿视频流切成局部时间窗，逐窗重建 4D Gaussian，再增量对齐融合成全局一致场景，实现无需逐场景优化的在线动态重建。联合约束跨窗几何一致性并建模时变内容，使长视频流上同时保持高效重建与真实感渲染，在多样动态室内外场景上达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 长无位姿流式视频的在线 4D 重建要求连续处理与真实感渲染并存：前馈 Gaussian 方法只能离线，在线点云方法难以兼顾稠密几何与高保真渲染。
Method: DynStream 在局部时间窗内重建场景，再增量对齐并融合各窗结果为全局一致场景；联合施加跨窗几何一致性约束并建模时变场景内容，全程不做逐场景优化。
Result: 在多样动态室内与室外场景上达到 state-of-the-art 的在线动态重建与渲染效果，支持长视频流上的高保真重建。
Conclusion: 局部窗口重建加跨窗一致性融合，可以在长无位姿视频上同时拿到在线处理与真实感 4D 渲染，摆脱逐场景优化。

papers.title: YUBI-STAG: Contact and Semantic-Rich Alignment for VLAs via Automated Video-Language Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models acquire broad manipulation capabilities via large-scale pretraining, yet eliciting them through language requires fine-grained alignment between instructions and physical interactions. Existing robot demonstrations typically provide only coarse task descriptions, omitting how actions are executed, including which gripper acts, which object is contacted, and how it is grasped and moved. We introduce YUBI-STAG, a framework for Spatio-Temporal Annotation and Grounding that automatically enriches manipulation demonstrations with interaction-rich semantics to align pretrained VLAs with fine-grained manipulation language. Combining contact-object segmentation with vision-language models, YUBI-STAG annotates object identities, attributes and states, per-gripper actions, bimanual coordination, and spatially grounded interactions. To address YUBI-STAG's reliance on localized sequences and multi-stage VLM inference, we distill it into YUBI-VLM. YUBI-VLM directly recovers action structure and annotations from raw, unsegmented video in few inference calls and operates from wrist views alone. We evaluate both frameworks on YUBI-STAG-Bench across temporal, semantic, and spatial grounding tasks. YUBI-VLM retains much of YUBI-STAG's annotation accuracy with fewer inference calls and shorter runtime while generalizing to unseen manipulations. Finally, post-training VLA policies on these annotations aligns them with fine-grained language and contact-aware structure. Bimanual experiments demonstrate improved performance and instruction following, including control over object identity, acting gripper, target location, and spatial relations absent from original labels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: YUBI-STAG 用接触-物体分割加视觉语言模型，自动为机器人操作演示补上物体身份、状态、单臂/双臂动作与空间接触标注，再蒸馏成只需少数几次推理、仅用腕部视角的 YUBI-VLM，直接从原始未切分视频恢复动作结构。用这些标注后训练 VLA 策略，双臂实验显示指令跟随改善，可控制物体身份、动作手爪、目标位置与空间关系。
Motivation: 机器人演示通常只有粗粒度任务描述，缺少动作如何执行的信息（哪只手爪、接触哪个物体、怎样抓取移动），导致语言难以细粒度地激发预训练 VLA 的操作能力。
Method: YUBI-STAG 框架结合 contact-object segmentation 与 vision-language model，标注物体身份/属性/状态、per-gripper 动作、双臂协调与空间接地交互；再将其蒸馏为 YUBI-VLM，从原始未切分视频、仅腕部视角在少数推理调用内直接恢复动作结构与标注。两者在 YUBI-STAG-Bench 上评测 temporal、semantic、spatial grounding 任务，并用所得标注后训练 VLA 策略。
Result: YUBI-VLM 以更少推理调用与更短运行时保留了 YUBI-STAG 的大部分标注精度，并能泛化到未见过的操作；在 YUBI-STAG-Bench 的时序、语义、空间接地任务上评测两个框架。用该标注后训练的 VLA 策略在双臂实验中提升性能与指令跟随，覆盖物体身份、动作手爪、目标位置与空间关系等原始标签中缺失的控制维度。
Conclusion: 自动的时空标注加蒸馏可以把细粒度、接触感知的语言对齐注入 VLA 策略，且腕部视角加少量推理即可支撑该标注流程。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Pareto-optimal quantum kernel selection for unsupervised anomaly detection on real malware beaconing data
papers.abstract_en: Quantum kernel methods are leading candidates for a practical quantum advantage in machine learning, but assessing that potential requires two quantities usually reported separately: how well a kernel performs on the task, and how far its geometry departs from the classical kernels available for the same problem. We introduce a fully unsupervised, multi-objective protocol that optimises simultaneously the normalised pseudo discrepancy (NPD), a label-free proxy for anomaly detection quality, and the geometric difference (GD) to a tuned classical reference kernel, selecting models from the resulting Pareto front. We apply it to malware beaconing detection in real network traffic, using a one-class support vector machine with fidelity and projected quantum kernels over four data encodings, on simulators and on IQM's 20-qubit Garnet processor. NPD-guided selection alone finds a fidelity kernel that beats the tuned classical baseline, but with a geometric difference too small to certify the gain as quantum. Projected kernels reach far larger geometric differences; the Pareto-selected one only marginally exceeds the baseline (AUC $0.782$ versus $0.765$, $g_{C\to Q}\approx 89>\sqrt{N}$ relative to that reference kernel), still below the NPD-selected fidelity kernel ($0.840$).
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: EC-EarthFlow: Probabilistic emulation of daily transient global climate model simulations with flow matching
papers.abstract_en: We introduce EC-EarthFlow, a generative flow matching model that emulates simulations from the physical climate model EC-Earth3. The model is trained on transient simulations from EC-Earth3 (1950-2166, SSP2-4.5) to predict the day ahead temperature field from the previous days temperature as well as annual mean temperature. Predictions are made auto-regressively with rollout periods of between a month and an extended season. Using only this variable of interest, we are able to reproduce the daily variability, spatial patterns, annual cycle and long-term trend from EC-Earth3 at a substantially lower computational cost than the physical model. We demonstrate that EC-EarthFlow is stable for long inference periods, and that it can learn the physical relationships as simulated in EC-Earth3.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EC-EarthFlow 用生成式 flow matching 仿真 (emulate) EC-Earth3 的逐日瞬变气候模拟：只喂前一日温度场与年平均温度，自回归外推一个月到一个延长季节。它能复现 EC-Earth3 的日际变率、空间型、年循环与长期趋势，计算成本远低于物理模式，并在长推理时段保持稳定。
Motivation: 物理气候模式跑瞬变情景代价高，而只用目标变量做低成本仿真时，日际变率、空间型与长期趋势容易失真，长自回归外推还会发散。
Method: 生成式 flow matching 模型，训练数据为 EC-Earth3 1950–2166 年 SSP2-4.5 瞬变模拟；输入前一日温度场加年平均温度，预测次日温度场，再自回归滚动 1 个月至一个延长季节。
Result: 仅用温度这一变量，即可复现 EC-Earth3 的日际变率、空间型、年循环与长期趋势，计算成本显著低于物理模型；长推理时段 rollout 稳定，并学到 EC-Earth3 中的物理关系。
Conclusion: 单变量 flow matching 足以在远低于物理模式的成本下做稳定的逐日瞬变气候仿真，前提是外推目标就是 EC-Earth3 自身的模拟关系。

papers.title: Boundary-aware Reinforcement Learning for Hypercube State Spaces via Deterministic Policy Gradient
papers.abstract_en: We develop a continuous-time deterministic policy gradient framework for reinforcement learning with reflected state dynamics, where the state process is governed by a controlled reflected stochastic differential equation on a hypercube. Under suitable regularity assumptions, we establish the connection between the value function and the Neumann Bellman equation, introduce an advantage-rate function that yields a deterministic policy gradient formula, and prove the martingale characterization theorem. Motivated by these theoretical results, we propose a continuous-time deep deterministic policy gradient algorithm for reflected stochastic systems, in which the Neumann boundary condition is imposed via either soft penalization or hard architectural constraint. We further quantify the discrepancy between the ideal continuous-time dynamics and the discretely sampled exploratory dynamics executed in practice, showing that the error decays as the time grid is refined and exploration noise vanishes. Our experiments on reservoir control problems illustrate the effectiveness of the RL framework, highlighting that boundary-aware methods substantially reduce Neumann boundary residuals and enhance learning stability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对超立方体上带反射边界的连续时间控制问题，建立反射随机微分方程下值函数与 Neumann Bellman 方程的联系，给出 advantage-rate 形式的确定性策略梯度公式并证明鞅刻画定理；据此提出边界条件以软惩罚或硬架构约束施加的连续时间 DDPG 算法，离散采样误差随时间网格加密与探索噪声消失而衰减。在水库控制实验中，边界感知方法显著降低 Neumann 边界残差并提升学习稳定性。
Motivation: 带反射边界的连续时间随机控制中，值函数在边界满足 Neumann 条件，而标准确定性策略梯度未处理该边界项，离散采样与理想连续动力学之间也存在未量化的偏差。
Method: 在超立方体上的受控反射 SDE 框架下，由值函数与 Neumann Bellman 方程导出 advantage-rate 函数，得到确定性策略梯度公式并证明鞅刻画定理；据此设计连续时间 DDPG，用软惩罚或硬架构约束施加 Neumann 边界条件，并量化理想连续动力学与离散采样探索动力学之间的误差。
Result: 误差随时间网格细化与探索噪声消失而衰减；在水库控制 (reservoir control) 实验中，边界感知方法显著降低 Neumann 边界残差并增强学习稳定性。
Conclusion: 把 Neumann 边界条件显式纳入确定性策略梯度，可在反射随机系统上得到更稳的学习并压低边界残差；理论保证建立在适当正则性假设之上。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Pretraining Shapes Spectral Structure: Architecture- and Strategy-Conditional Prediction of OOD Robustness in Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Can we determine whether a foundation model will generalize out-of-distribution (OOD) before any target data is available? Existing diagnostics require source or target data, which rules them out before a target domain exists. Those that use the weights alone apply one statistic to every architecture, and do not separate robust models from fragile ones. We show the answer is encoded in the spectral structure of pretrained weights. Two forces shape that structure. Architecture determines how information is stored in weight matrices. Pretraining strategy determines what is rewarded. Together they set a spectral geometry that governs OOD robustness. We prove that the OOD accuracy gap is bounded by how tightly the source representations concentrate. A statistic computed from the pretrained weights alone serves as a proxy for that concentration. The direction of that proxy reverses between architecture families. We operationalize it: the direction is stable within one (architecture X strategy) combination, the finest grouping we test, which we call a cell. Pooled over 116 models spanning 7 modalities, a single statistic ranks OOD robustness weakly, because cells of opposite direction cancel. Within a cell, the statistic selected for it orders 92% of model pairs by OOD robustness in-sample. The selection does not leak the target: for each model family outside the matrix we logged the cell, metric and sign before running its OOD evaluation, and the predicted direction held in every case: EEG, genomic and protein. Acting on spectral concentration narrows the OOD gap by 24% at 87.5% ID retention. The diagnostic operates on released weights alone, so OOD robustness becomes checkable at model-selection time, before data or compute is committed to a target domain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在目标域数据尚不存在时，仅凭预训练权重的谱结构即可预判基础模型的 OOD 鲁棒性：架构决定信息在权重矩阵中的存储方式、预训练策略决定被奖励的内容，二者共同设定谱几何。OOD 精度差被证明受源表示集中程度约束，而由权重算出的集中度代理统计量在不同架构族之间方向会反转，因此必须按 (架构 × 策略) 的 cell 分组选统计量与符号。116 个模型、7 种模态上全局池化排序很弱，cell 内该统计量排序 92% 的模型对；按其方向干预谱集中度可在保留 87.5% ID 精度的同时把 OOD 差距收窄 24%。
Motivation: 现有 OOD 诊断要么需要源域或目标域数据，因而在目标域尚不存在时无法使用；只用权重的诊断又对所有架构套用同一统计量，无法区分鲁棒与脆弱模型。
Method: 从预训练权重本身计算一个表示集中度的代理统计量，作为 OOD 精度差上界的代理；按 (架构 × 策略) 的 cell 分组，为每个 cell 选定统计量方向（符号），并在留出的模型族上先记录 cell、指标与符号再跑 OOD 评测以避免目标泄漏；同时以干预谱集中度的方式做因果检验。
Result: 116 个模型、7 种模态上，单一统计量全局池化只能弱排序 OOD 鲁棒性（相反方向的 cell 相互抵消）；cell 内选定的统计量在样本内排序 92% 的模型对；留出族 EEG、genomic、protein 上预测方向全部成立；干预谱集中度在 87.5% ID 保留下把 OOD 差距收窄 24%。
Conclusion: OOD 鲁棒性由架构与预训练策略共同决定的谱几何编码在权重里，因此可在模型选择阶段、投入目标域数据与算力之前用纯权重诊断检查；诊断必须按 cell 分方向使用，全局单一符号无效。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Enhancing Multi-Region Stylization with Interior-Guided Boundary Repair
papers.abstract_en: Region-based neural style transfer enables fine-grained artistic control by allowing independent stylization of semantic image regions. However, compositing these regions often leads to boundary artifacts, degrading visual quality. We propose Interior-Guided Boundary Repair (IGBR), a lightweight and model-agnostic method that improves boundary handling in multi-region stylization. IGBR repairs boundary pixels using interior-guided propagation and applies inward, distance-based blending restricted to object-background boundaries, preventing inter-object style leakage. The method is derived from a region-wise constrained formulation with a closed-form solution and can be seamlessly integrated into existing stylization pipelines without retraining. To evaluate efficiency of our IGBR, we introduce quantitative metrics that measure boundary consistency, gradient artifacts, inter-object leakage, and interior preservation without requiring annotated stylized images. Our experiments and evaluations demonstrate that the proposed IGBR consistently produces plausible boundaries, outperforming prior blending techniques in boundary consistency, gradient stability, and interior preservation. The code is available at https://github.com/Son-SDT/IGBR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IGBR 用内部引导传播修复多区域风格迁移的边界像素，并只在物体-背景边界上做向内距离加权融合，防止物体间风格泄漏。该方法由区域约束形式化推导出闭式解，可无重训练接入现有风格迁移管线，并在边界一致性、梯度稳定性与内部保持上优于既有融合技术。
Motivation: 区域式神经风格迁移中各语义区域独立风格化后拼接会产生边界伪影，物体间风格还会互相渗漏，降低视觉质量。
Method: 提出 Interior-Guided Boundary Repair (IGBR)：用 interior-guided propagation 修复边界像素，再在物体-背景边界内做 inward、distance-based blending；由区域约束形式化推导闭式解，模型无关、无需重训练即可接入现有管线。同时提出无需标注风格化图像的量化指标，度量边界一致性、梯度伪影、物体间泄漏与内部保持。
Result: 实验与评测显示 IGBR 在边界一致性、梯度稳定性与内部保持上持续优于既有融合技术；效率通过新提出的四类无标注指标衡量。
Conclusion: 边界修复应由内部信息引导并限制在物体-背景边界上做向内融合，这样既能给出合理边界又能保住区域内部风格，且无需重训练。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Understanding and Mitigating Token-Pruning-Induced Vulnerabilities in VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Token-Pruning accelerates Vision-Language Models by removing redundant visual tokens, yet its safety implications remain underexplored. In this work, we present the first comprehensive safety evaluation of Token-Pruning mechanisms and find that: most pruning strategies significantly degrade safety as pruning ratios increase, whereas Query-based Compression shows the opposite, with extreme pruning (up to 99.8%), unexpectedly improves model safety. This sharp contrast prompts a key question: How do different Token-Pruning strategies reshape model safety behavior, and is it possible to enhance safety without sacrificing acceleration? To answer this, we identify an unrecognized mechanism, termed Pruning-Induced Malicious Amplification, where removal of background tokens triggers a side effect: forcing the model's attention to collapse onto a few retained malicious anchors within the foreground, inadvertently amplifying their toxic semantics under jailbreak. To address that, we propose an inference-time and plug-and-play Safety-Aware Pruning (SAP) mechanism that counteracts such dominance via three steps: (1) identifying malicious anchors, (2) restoring pruned benign tokens, and (3) reallocating excessive attention from malicious anchors to benign tokens. Extensive experiments across three safety and four utility benchmarks demonstrate that SAP mitigates pruning-induced vulnerabilities, i.e., reducing ASR by up to 62%, without compromising efficiency or utility.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 306:128879-128894, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLM 的 Token-Pruning 安全评估显示：多数剪枝策略随剪枝率上升显著削弱安全性，而 Query-based Compression 反向，在极端剪枝（最高 99.8%）下反而提升安全。作者把劣化归因于 Pruning-Induced Malicious Amplification——背景 token 被剪掉后注意力塌缩到前景少数恶意锚点，越狱下放大其毒性语义；据此提出推理时即插即用的 Safety-Aware Pruning (SAP)，三步识别恶意锚点、恢复被剪良性 token、把过量注意力重新分配给良性 token，在三个安全与四个 utility 基准上把 ASR 最多降低 62%，且不牺牲效率与效用。
Motivation: Token-Pruning 加速 VLM 的安全影响此前缺乏系统评估：剪枝在提升推理效率的同时可能改变模型的越狱脆弱性，且不同剪枝策略的安全走向相反。
Method: 先对多种 Token-Pruning 策略做安全评估并随剪枝率扫描；再提出推理时即插即用的 Safety-Aware Pruning (SAP)，三步执行：识别恶意锚点 (malicious anchors)、恢复被剪掉的良性 token、把恶意锚点上过量的注意力重新分配给良性 token。
Result: 多数剪枝策略随剪枝率上升显著降低安全性，Query-based Compression 则相反，极端剪枝至 99.8% 反而提升安全；SAP 在三个安全基准与四个 utility 基准上将 ASR 最多降低 62%，同时不损失效率与效用。
Conclusion: 剪枝诱导的安全劣化源于注意力塌缩到恶意锚点这一可识别机制，因此可以在保留加速的前提下用注意力再分配修复安全性。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Latent Watermarks under Generative Editing: A Benchmark and Analysis of Detection Survival
papers.abstract_en: Ordinary prompt-based editing can cause latent watermark detection to fail without explicitly targeting the watermark. We benchmark eight watermark methods against five editors across four generative backbones, four editing strengths, and five semantic categories, with edit-validity and threshold checks. Separating editing from seven subsequent distortions reveals that editing alone primarily distinguishes Tree-Ring, while added distortions expose a broader spectrum of detection survival. Sequential edits reveal a second hidden difference: score separation can decline while detection rates remain near their ceiling. Across methods, standardized clean score separation ($d'$) organizes composite-survival tiers, whereas spatial overlap adds little to predicting edit-only survival beyond clean detectability. Embedding-strength interventions in two methods link higher clean separation to higher post-edit separation. In HSTR, the margin contrast is positive, while the angular layout contrast at matched clean separation remains unresolved. Together, outcome decomposition and continuous separation expose differences hidden by aggregate TPR. Method tiers are stable under threshold recalibration at the main operating points and alternative composite weights. Clean $d'$ is thus a useful empirical diagnostic within this benchmark, with mixed transfer to unseen methods. Code and supporting artifacts are planned for a separate release.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文把生成式编辑下潜空间水印 (latent watermark) 的失效拆成“编辑本身”与“编辑后七种失真”两段做基准测试，发现干净图上的标准化分数分离 d' 能组织复合存活层级，而空间重叠度对预测仅编辑存活几乎无增益。编辑单独主要区分出 Tree-Rung 类方法，连续编辑下会出现分数分离下降但检测率仍贴近上限的隐藏差异。
Motivation: 普通基于 prompt 的图像编辑会在不针对水印的情况下让潜空间水印检测失效，而聚合 TPR 掩盖了方法间的真实差异，缺少可分解、可复现的存活基准。
Method: 对 8 种水印方法 × 5 个编辑器 × 4 个生成 backbone × 4 种编辑强度 × 5 个语义类别做基准，带编辑有效性与阈值检查；把编辑与随后 7 种失真分离评估，并做连续编辑序列；用干净图 d'、空间重叠度、HSTR 的 margin/angular 对比作预测量，含阈值重标定与替代复合权重的稳健性检验。
Result: 编辑单独主要区分 Tree-Ring；加入失真后暴露更宽的检测存活谱；连续编辑中分数分离可下降而检测率仍近上限；跨方法干净 d' 组织复合存活层级，空间重叠度在预测仅编辑存活上相对干净可检测性增益很小；两种方法的嵌入强度干预显示更高的干净分离对应更高的编辑后分离；HSTR 的 margin 对比为正，而匹配干净分离下的 angular 布局对比仍未解决；方法层级在主工作点阈值重标定与替代复合权重下稳定，干净 d' 对未见方法迁移性混合。
Conclusion: 结果分解加连续分离度量能暴露聚合 TPR 掩盖的差异，干净 d' 是该基准内有用的经验诊断量，但对未见方法的迁移有限。

papers.title: What Makes Synthetic Hard Negatives Work in Vision-Language Pretraining?
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic hard negatives generated in the representation space have proven effective for unimodal self-supervised learning, but transferring this idea to vision-language pretraining is not straightforward. We analyze six representation-space synthesis strategies and identify two failure modes in their transfer to vision-language pretraining: cross-modal constructions that produce overly easy negatives or pull them toward the query, and intra-modal constructions that incorporate the matched positive. We also observe logit-scale saturation when training with synthetic hard negatives and a learnable temperature, and find that fixing the temperature improves downstream performance. Using this geometric analysis we propose SNAP, which generates intra-modal hard negatives that never involve the positive from either modality, avoiding both failure modes entirely. SNAP is model-agnostic, requires no external generative models, and adds less than 10% training time overhead. Evaluated on top of CLIP and FLIP across multiple architectures and datasets, SNAP delivers consistent improvements on zero-shot retrieval, zero-shot classification, and linear probe evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SNAP 在表示空间生成模态内合成难负样本 (synthetic hard negatives)，且构造时完全排除两个模态的匹配正样本，从而同时避开跨模态构造产生过易负样本或把负样本拉向查询、以及模态内构造混入正样本这两类失败模式。在 CLIP 与 FLIP 之上跨多种架构与数据集评测，零样本检索、零样本分类与 linear probe 一致提升，训练时间开销不到 10%。
Motivation: 单模态自监督学习中表示空间合成难负样本已见成效，但直接迁移到视觉-语言预训练不成立：现有构造会产出过易的负样本、把负样本拉向查询，或把匹配正样本混进负样本。
Method: 先分析六种表示空间合成策略，归纳出跨模态与模态内两类失败模式，并诊断出配合可学习温度训练时的 logit-scale 饱和；据此提出 SNAP，只在模态内生成不涉及任一模态正样本的难负样本，模型无关、无需外部生成模型。
Result: 诊断出可学习温度下的 logit-scale 饱和，固定温度可改善下游性能；SNAP 在 CLIP 与 FLIP 之上、跨多种架构与数据集，在零样本检索、零样本分类与 linear probe 上均带来一致提升，训练时间开销低于 10%。
Conclusion: 合成难负样本在视觉-语言预训练中起效的前提是负样本既不混入正样本也不被拉向查询，同时训练温度需固定以避免 logit-scale 饱和。

papers.title: Do Better Visual Representations Always Lead to Better End-to-End Autonomous Driving?
papers.abstract_en: Visual foundation models (VFMs) are increasingly integrated into end-to-end autonomous driving for their powerful representations, yet it remains unclear when these representations improve driving performance. To investigate this question, we introduce ViRA, a planner-agnostic visual representation alignment framework that keeps the planner architecture and inference cost unchanged. Our study reveals three findings: (1) VFM-guided visual representations consistently improve driving performance across diverse end-to-end planners, with gains extending to zero-shot closed-loop evaluation. (2) The choice of VFM target matters for planning performance, and alignment to a different VFM can further benefit planners with pre-trained VFM encoders. (3) Auxiliary perception supervision reduces sensitivity to VFM target selection, narrowing the EPDMS spread across five targets from 2.7 to 0.5 points and potentially compensating for less effective VFM targets. Guided by these findings, we develop ViRA-Diffusion, a diffusion-based planner trained without auxiliary perception supervision, which achieves 92.3 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 navtest, outperforming recent methods in our comparison by at least 1.9 points. The results motivate jointly considering target selection and planner supervision when integrating VFMs into end-to-end autonomous driving. The results and demo are available at https://github.com/OpenDriveLab/ViRA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出与 planner 无关的视觉表征对齐框架 ViRA，在保持规划器结构与推理开销不变的前提下把视觉基础模型 (VFM) 表征对齐到端到端驾驶。VFM 引导的表征在多种 planner 上一致提升驾驶性能并迁移到零样本闭环；辅助感知监督把五个 VFM 目标之间的 EPDMS 差距从 2.7 分压到 0.5 分。据此训练的 ViRA-Diffusion（不带辅助感知监督）在 NAVSIM v2 navtest 上拿到 92.3 EPDMS，比对比方法至少高 1.9 分。
Motivation: 视觉基础模型被大量接入端到端自动驾驶，但其表征究竟在什么条件下改善驾驶性能并不清楚，且 VFM 目标选择会带来明显波动。
Method: ViRA 是 planner-agnostic 的视觉表征对齐框架，固定 planner 架构与推理开销，只对齐 VFM 表征；对比不同 VFM 目标、是否给 planner 预训练 VFM encoder、以及是否加辅助感知监督。再据此提出 ViRA-Diffusion，一个不使用辅助感知监督的 diffusion-based planner。
Result: VFM 引导表征在多样端到端 planner 上一致提升驾驶性能，收益延伸到零样本闭环评测；对齐到另一个 VFM 可进一步帮助带预训练 VFM encoder 的 planner；辅助感知监督使五个 VFM 目标间的 EPDMS spread 从 2.7 分收窄到 0.5 分。ViRA-Diffusion 在 NAVSIM v2 navtest 上达到 92.3 EPDMS，比对比的近期方法至少高 1.9 分。
Conclusion: 把 VFM 接入端到端自动驾驶时要同时考虑 VFM 目标选择与 planner 的监督方式：目标选择影响性能，辅助感知监督能降低这种敏感度。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Tale of Two Error Categories: Exploring Concealed Trade-Offs in the Errors of Automated Judges in Evaluation of Uncertainty Quantifiers
papers.abstract_en: The wide adoption of LLMs across broad NLG applications heightens the importance of providing users with the means to avert errors and hallucinations. Uncertainty quantification is poised to fill that gap; with low uncertainty (high confidence), as a proxy for correctness, allowing users to be selective (e.g., reject low-confidence, likely incorrect responses). Correlation between confidence and correctness then serves as a useful criterion for evaluation of uncertainty quantifiers (UQs). But in NLG, where diverse responses can be adequate to a prompt, obtaining reliable correctness judgements is not simple, especially without human intervention. Errors in automated judgement are hardly avoidable and known to diminish the reliability of evaluation protocols (Santilli et al., 2025; Ielanskyi et al., 2025). In a meta-analysis of published work, we show that automated judgement is the present norm. Besides, automated judgements are rarely validated against human ones, and the validation of the UQ evaluation they automate is even rarer. With experiments in question answering, using 4 LLMs, human and automated judgements and 7 popular UQs, we find that i) a judge's performance can only coarsely predict the observed impact of its errors on the reliability of UQ evaluation, and that ii) judgement errors tend to misrepresent informative UQs most. We link these observations to patterns of correlation between confidence and categories of judgement error.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 NLG 不确定性量化 (UQ) 评测中，自动评判 (automated judge) 的错误会系统性扭曲置信度与正确性的相关性。用 4 个 LLM、7 种主流 UQ 方法在问答任务上对比人工与自动评判，发现评判者自身性能只能粗略预测其错误对 UQ 评测可靠性的影响，且评判错误最倾向于歪曲信息量高的 UQ 方法；作者把这一现象归因于置信度与各类评判错误之间的相关模式。
Motivation: NLG 中回答可有多种合理形式，正确性判定难以在无人工介入下做可靠；自动评判已成常态却很少与人工对照验证，其错误会削弱 UQ 评测协议的可靠性。
Method: 先对已发表工作做元分析说明自动评判是当前常态，再在问答任务上做实验：4 个 LLM 作为被评模型，人工评判与自动评判并行，覆盖 7 种常用 UQ 方法，分析评判者性能与其错误对 UQ 评测影响之间的关系，并考察置信度与评判错误类别之间的相关模式。
Result: 元分析显示自动评判是当前已发表工作的常态，且极少与人工评判对照验证。问答实验（4 个 LLM、7 种 UQ、人工与自动评判）发现：评判者性能只能粗略预测其错误对 UQ 评测可靠性的实际影响；评判错误最倾向于歪曲信息量高的 UQ 方法。

papers.title: Few-Shot Learning for Personalised Automated Pain Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Pain perception varies substantially across individuals, making it difficult for population-based classifiers to generalise across all subjects in a dataset. One way to account for subject variability is to train personalised classifiers. In this work, we evaluate Few-Shot Learning, a sub-area of Meta-Learning, as an approach to personalisation in automated pain assessment. We re-interpret the shift from population-level to subject-level evaluation as a task-domain shift, where the observed classes remain fixed but the target subject changes. We evaluate our method on the BioVid Pain Database, the SenseEmotion Database, and the PainMonit Experimental Dataset (PMED), reaching 85.75% and 35.49% accuracy on BioVid and 82.37% and 41.88% on SenseEmotion in the binary and multi-class settings under a Leave-One-Subject-Out CV protocol respectively, and 90.47% on PMED, for which only a binary benchmark exists. Using samples to implement k-shot conditioning, the accuracies can be improved to 86.25%, 40.06%, 83.43%, 44.08%, and 91.25%, respectively. To further evaluate the effects and robustness of our method, we provide additional ablation experiments and investigate the personalisation effects. Our results suggest that support-conditioned few-shot adaptation can improve average performance under inter-subject variability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把疼痛评估中从群体级到个体级的评测转变重新解释为任务域偏移（类别固定、目标被试变化），用少样本学习 (Few-Shot Learning) 做个体化适配。在 BioVid、SenseEmotion、PMED 三个数据库的 Leave-One-Subject-Out CV 下，二分类准确率分别为 85.75%、82.37%、90.47%，加入 k-shot 条件化样本后提升到 86.25%、83.43%、91.25%。
Motivation: 疼痛感知个体差异大，群体级分类器难以跨被试泛化；个体化分类器需要按人训练，成本高。
Method: 将群体级到个体级评测视为任务域偏移（类不变、目标被试变），用元学习子领域 Few-Shot Learning 做个体化适配，通过 k-shot conditioning 注入目标被试样本；评测协议为 Leave-One-Subject-Out CV，并附消融实验与个体化效应分析。
Result: Leave-One-Subject-Out CV 下：BioVid 二分类 85.75%、多分类 35.49%；SenseEmotion 二分类 82.37%、多分类 41.88%；PMED（仅二分类基准）90.47%。加入 k-shot 条件化样本后分别提升至 86.25%、40.06%、83.43%、44.08%、91.25%。
Conclusion: 支持集条件化的少样本适配能在被试间变异下改善疼痛评估的平均表现，多分类设置仍明显更难。

papers.title: Optimal Regret for Online Market Making with Limit Order Book
papers.abstract_en: We study online learning in market making, where, at each round, a market maker posts bid and ask prices before observing the market price and the private valuation of an incoming trader. In this setting, Maran et al. 2026 introduce a feedback model motivated by limit order books, in which the trader's valuation is revealed only if no transaction occurs. Assuming that trader valuations are drawn i.i.d. from an unknown distribution while market prices are chosen adversarially, they establish an expected regret bound of $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{2/3})$. In this work, we improve upon this guarantee by establishing a high-probability regret bound of $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{T})$. As a warm-up, we first consider the full-feedback setting. We introduce a discretization of the bid-ask space based on two coupled grids and combine it with Hedge to achieve the desired regret rate. Building on these ideas, we then address the substantially weaker feedback induced by a limit order book and develop an algorithm that achieves the same guarantee. Finally, we investigate the limits of learnability in fully adversarial environments, where the valuations may vary arbitrarily as well. Perhaps surprisingly, we show that when both market prices and trader valuations are chosen adversarially, sublinear regret is impossible even under full feedback, thereby motivating our stochastic assumption on the valuations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Maran et al. 2026 的限价单簿 (limit order book) 反馈模型下，把做市在线学习的期望 regret 从 $~\mathcal{O}(T^{2/3})$ 改进到高概率 $~\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T})$：先在全反馈设定用双向网格离散化买卖价空间并结合 Hedge，再把同一保证移植到仅成交后才揭示估值的弱反馈。完全对抗环境下即使全反馈也无法获得次线性 regret，因此估值的 i.i.d. 随机假设是可学习性的必要条件。
Motivation: 限价单簿反馈下交易未成交才揭示交易者估值，反馈远弱于全反馈；已有工作在此模型下只给出 $~\mathcal{O}(T^{2/3})$ 的期望 regret，且估值与市场价格同时对抗时可学习性边界未知。
Method: 先在全反馈 warm-up 中用两组耦合网格 (two coupled grids) 离散化 bid-ask 空间并结合 Hedge 达到目标速率；随后针对 limit order book 诱导的弱反馈设计算法，取得同样的高概率保证。设定为交易者估值 i.i.d. 采样自未知分布、市场价格由对手自适应选择。
Result: 高概率 regret 界 $~\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T})$，优于 Maran et al. 2026 的期望 $~\mathcal{O}(T^{2/3})$；在市场价格与交易者估值均对抗时，即使全反馈也不存在次线性 regret。
Conclusion: 把估值限制为 i.i.d. 而让市场价格保持对抗，是在限价单簿反馈下把做市 regret 压到 $\sqrt{T}$ 级的关键；完全对抗设定下可学习性根本不存在。

papers.title: NAViLoss: An Underwater Navigation-Aware Dual-Residual Objective for Physics-Consistent Learning
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) commonly rely on inertial navigation systems (INS) aided by Doppler velocity logs (DVLs) for reliable underwater navigation. Accurate DVL velocity estimation is therefore essential for successful operation. Recent learning-based methods have demonstrated improved DVL velocity estimation, particularly under degraded measurement conditions. However, their training objectives typically rely on conventional regression losses that are highly sensitive to large residuals and corrupted observations. Additionally, they do not explicitly account for the physical consistency and measurement uncertainty associated with the underlying sensing process. To address these limitations, this paper introduces navigation-aware loss (NAViLoss), a robust and uncertainty-aware objective function for learning-based AUV velocity estimation. NAViLoss jointly penalizes the velocity-estimation residual in the navigation-state domain and the beam-consistency residual in the DVL measurement domain. Its bounded formulation limits the influence of large residuals, while an adaptive mechanism regulates the uncertainty in beam geometry. Furthermore, NAViLoss is integrated with a DeepONet architecture to form a novel NAVi-DeepONet model for seamless estimation of an underwater vehicle's velocity. Lastly, our model is evaluated using approximately 10,000m of semi-synthetic AUV experimental data collected during multiple real-world sea trials. Experimental results demonstrate a 44% improvement in velocity-estimation accuracy compared with conventional and learning-based baselines. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of navigation-aware and uncertainty-adaptive loss design for robust learning-based underwater velocity estimation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 NAViLoss：一个面向 AUV 速度估计的鲁棒、不确定性感知损失，同时惩罚导航状态域的速度残差与 DVL 测量域的波束一致性残差，有界形式限制大残差影响，自适应机制调节波束几何不确定性。与 DeepONet 结合得到 NAVi-DeepONet，在约 10,000 米半合成 AUV 海试数据上速度估计精度比传统与学习型基线提升 44%。
Motivation: 基于学习的 DVL 速度估计常用回归损失，对大残差和污染观测敏感，且未显式建模传感过程的物理一致性与测量不确定性，在退化观测条件下不可靠。
Method: NAViLoss 联合惩罚导航状态域的速度估计残差与 DVL 测量域的波束一致性残差；有界形式 (bounded formulation) 抑制大残差的梯度影响，自适应机制调控波束几何的不确定性；与 DeepONet 架构结合构成 NAVi-DeepONet 做水下载具速度的无缝估计。
Result: 在约 10,000 米、来自多次真实海试的半合成 AUV 实验数据上评测，速度估计精度相比传统与学习型基线提升 44%。
Conclusion: 导航感知与不确定性自适应的损失设计能提升学习型水下速度估计的鲁棒性，物理一致性约束应直接写进训练目标而非仅靠数据。

papers.title: The Silhouette Operator: Identifiability of Low-Rank Measures from One-Dimensional Projections
papers.abstract_en: Structured recovery phenomena, such as restricted isometry properties in compressed sensing, have shown that high-dimensional objects can often be reconstructed from remarkably low-dimensional linear measurements. This work develops an analogous recovery framework for low-rank signed measures on $\mathbb{R}^2$, defined here as measures that can be expressed as finite sums of product measures with one-dimensional factors. The framework is based on linear operators, termed "silhouette operators," that map a measure to a fixed finite collection of one-dimensional linear pushforwards. The main results show that a suitably chosen collection of $2k$ projected marginals suffices to identify every compactly supported rank-$\le k$ signed measure, that this number is optimal, and that the projection directions cannot be chosen arbitrarily. The framework is also extended to higher-dimensional sums of product measures by establishing sufficient conditions under which collections of pairwise marginals identify the full model. Building on this framework, a computationally efficient estimator, termed "silhouette mixture estimation" (SME), is introduced for constructing a low-rank empirical measure from data by matching its one-dimensional projected marginals to the corresponding empirical marginals in Wasserstein distance. When combined with one-dimensional density estimators, SME yields an efficient nonparametric density estimator that performs strongly relative to a range of parametric, nonparametric, and deep-learning baselines in settings of moderate dimension and sample size.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 silhouette operator：把 R^2 上的低秩符号测度（有限个一维因子的乘积测度之和）映射为固定有限个一维线性 pushforward。证明 2k 个恰当选取的投影边缘分布足以唯一识别所有紧支撑 rank≤k 测度且该数目最优、投影方向不能任意选；据此给出 silhouette mixture estimation (SME)，在 Wasserstein 距离下匹配一维投影经验边缘来估计低秩经验测度。
Motivation: 压缩感知的 RIP 表明高维对象常可由极低维线性测量重建，但低秩符号测度从一维投影恢复缺少对应的可识别性框架与可计算估计器。
Method: 定义 silhouette operator，收集一维线性 pushforward；证明 2k 个投影边缘的识别定理与最优性、并给出投影方向的必要条件，再扩展到高维乘积测度和的 pairwise marginals 充分条件。估计端提出 SME：用 Wasserstein 距离匹配一维投影经验边缘构造低秩经验测度，配合一维密度估计器得到非参数密度估计。
Result: 2k 个投影边缘足以识别任意紧支撑 rank≤k 一维因子和测度，且 2k 是最优数目，投影方向不可任意选取；SME 结合一维密度估计器在中等维度与样本量下相对一系列参数化、非参数与深度学习基线表现强劲。
Conclusion: 一维投影的有限集合对低秩测度具有可识别且数目最优的恢复能力，SME 把这一结构转化为高效的非参数密度估计。

papers.title: From Pareto to Preference: Personalized Test-Time Scaling via Amortized Agentic Policy Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Test-time scaling (TTS) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models by allocating additional inference computation. Existing approaches to improving TTS efficiency largely optimize accuracy against one resource dimension at a time, advancing either the accuracy--cost or accuracy--latency Pareto frontier. Yet user requirements are multidimensional: users may specify accuracy, latency, and inference-cost requirements jointly, and different requirements can favor different controllers. We formulate Personalized Test-Time Scaling as discovering executable controllers that maximize the joint satisfaction rate of user-specific requirements. To reduce the overhead of repeated policy discovery for new user profiles, we propose PersonTTS, an amortized agentic policy-discovery framework that reuses prior search experience through requirement-matched controller initialization and source-distilled procedural guidance, while retaining target-profile evaluation for every candidate. Experiments on AIME and HMMT show that PersonTTS substantially outperforms strong TTS baselines in joint requirement satisfaction on unseen user profiles and held-out problems. Under the same candidate-evaluation budget, cross-user experience reuse further improves policy quality while substantially reducing discovery-agent time and cost.

papers.title: System Switch: When Should a Fast Decision Model Stop and Think?
papers.abstract_en: Dual-process agents pair a fast policy with a slow deliberative model. In real-time settings the slow model usually runs continuously; in turn-based agents and robot planners it is invoked on events such as uncertainty or a detected failure. We study a fast learned actor that takes every decision and hands control to a reasoning vision-language model only when a gate opens, while the game keeps running. We use closed-loop Doom and the new open "System One" typed-decision models, served through a common llama.cpp interface. On 900 held-out questions, (i) zero-shot decision models from 0.15B to 9B parameters choose to collect items 1.6-1.8 times more often than chance among their errors, in any option order, although the order changes some models' accuracy; (ii) accuracy, calibration and sensitivity (how well confidence separates right from wrong answers) are distinct: models of similar accuracy differ widely in AUROC, and the confidence of the most sensitive one tracks which kinds of situation it fails, not which answers are wrong; (iii) offline, deferring the least confident 30% of decisions to a reasoning model gains over random deferral in proportion to the actor's AUROC (rank correlation 0.87); with actor and rate chosen on held-out games the gain is +0.13 [0.08, 0.18] with doomLaya's option order and +0.08 [0.02, 0.14] with shuffled options, and reasoning carries about half of it; (iv) in closed loop (33 games, three seeds) no variant reaches the exit. Committing to plans, the reasoner's or a fixed explore rule's, opens more doors and makes an actor that stands still play; with the rule the agent dies more often. Told that some doors need keys, the reasoner takes ordinary doors for locked ones, which the state cannot tell apart; without that knowledge it goes back to collecting. We release code, prompts, data and logs.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Code, prompts and data: https://github.com/dexmac221/doomgemma (branch system-switch)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究双过程 agent 中快速决策模型何时应把控制权交给慢速推理 VLM：在闭环 Doom 中由一个学习型 actor 每步决策，仅在 gate 打开时调用推理模型。离线 900 道题上，把最不自信的 30% 决策转交给推理模型的收益与 actor 的 AUROC 成正比（秩相关 0.87），选定 actor 与转交率后增益 +0.13 [0.08, 0.18]（doomLaya 选项顺序）与 +0.08 [0.02, 0.14]（打乱顺序）；但闭环 33 局、三个种子下没有任何变体到达出口。
Motivation: 双过程 agent 里慢速模型通常持续运行或按事件触发，缺少对“何时切换”的量化依据；且准确率、校准与 sensitivity 是三个不同维度，仅凭准确率无法决定转交策略。
Method: 用学习型 fast actor 逐步决策，仅在 gate 打开时把控制交给经 llama.cpp 统一接口服务的推理 VLM；评测用闭环 Doom 与开源 “System One” typed-decision 模型，含 900 道留出题的零样本测试（0.15B–9B）以及离线随机转交对比和闭环 33 局三种子实验。
Result: 零样本决策模型在其错误中选择收集道具的频率是随机的 1.6–1.8 倍，与选项顺序无关；相似准确率的模型 AUROC 差异很大，最敏感模型的置信度对应其失败情境类型而非具体对错；离线转交最不自信的 30% 决策，收益随 actor AUROC 变化（秩相关 0.87），留出游戏上调参后增益 +0.13 [0.08, 0.18]（doomLaya 顺序）与 +0.08 [0.02, 0.14]（打乱顺序），其中约一半来自推理；闭环 33 局三种子无变体到达出口，承诺计划（推理模型的或固定探索规则的）能开更多门并让静止的 actor 动起来，用规则时 agent 死亡更频繁。
Conclusion: 转交收益由 actor 的 sensitivity（AUROC）而非准确率决定，离线可测的转交增益能预测在线收益；但闭环中被告知“有些门需要钥匙”会让推理模型把普通门误判为锁住的门，说明状态无法区分二者时该先验知识反而有害。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: Cost-Efficient Theorem Proving via Agent Orchestration in Program Verification
papers.abstract_en: Program verification establishes software correctness through machine-checkable proofs constructed in theorem provers. It's a guarantee especially valuable for code generated by large language models (LLMs), which is fluent but carries no assurance of correctness. Almost all existing provers, however, pursue pass rates alone at whatever sampling or search budget it takes, and overlook the success-vs-cost frontier; yet real software often carries hundreds of interdependent proof obligations, so what matters at scale is not whether one theorem can be proved, but how many can be proved economically. We introduce CoCo-Prover, which formalizes cost-efficient program proving as metalevel decision-making under cost, grounded on two-level proof graphs: an AND/OR proof hypergraph within each declaration is joined to a lemma-dependency graph across declarations; and at each step, it answers two questions: which open goals to select, and which actions to purchase on these goals. Selection stays symbolic as a topological pass over the proof graphs. Action choice is agent orchestration via metalevel decision-making: an agentic router treats every bounded specialist invocation as a separately priced, best-effort computation, matching heterogeneous specialist agents together with configurations, under evolved routing rules as evidence accumulates. On five program verification benchmarks in Lean 4 including function-level CLEVER, VERINA, and AlgoVeri, and repository-level NTP4VC and Vero, we show that CoCo-Prover achieves a better success-vs-cost frontier than baselines including frontier coding agents and state-of-the-art LLM-based provers: it achieves the best solve rate on every benchmark and up to 100% on two benchmarks. It also reduces cost by up to 30.9% compared to the strongest baseline with the strongest LLM in our evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoCo-Prover 把程序验证中的定理证明形式化为成本约束下的元层决策：以声明内 AND/OR 证明超图连接声明间 lemma 依赖图，用符号拓扑扫描选开放目标，用可演化的路由规则把异构专家 agent 按定价组合购买。在五个 Lean 4 程序验证基准上取得每个基准的最佳求解率，其中两个基准达 100%，相对最强基线加最强 LLM 最高降本 30.9%。
Motivation: 现有证明器只追求 pass rate 而不计采样与搜索成本，但真实软件有成百个相互依赖的证明义务，规模化时关键不是单条定理能否证出，而是能经济地证出多少条。
Method: CoCo-Prover 用两层证明图（声明内 AND/OR 证明超图 + 声明间 lemma 依赖图）支撑元层决策：符号拓扑扫描决定选哪些开放目标，agentic router 把每次有界的专家调用当作单独计价、尽力而为的计算来匹配专家 agent 与配置，路由规则随证据累积而演化。
Result: 在 Lean 4 的五个程序验证基准（函数级 CLEVER、VERINA、AlgoVeri，仓库级 NTP4VC、Vero）上，成功-成本前沿优于包括前沿 coding agent 与 SOTA LLM 证明器在内的基线；每个基准求解率最佳，其中两个基准最高达 100%，相对最强基线加最强 LLM 最高降低成本 30.9%。
Conclusion: 把专家 agent 调用当作按价购买的元层决策，可以在程序验证中同时抬高求解率并压低成本，成功-成本前沿比单打 pass rate 的证明器更值得优化。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CERO: Where and When to Allocate Rollouts for RL Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive rollout methods for group-relative reinforcement learning typically allocate a fixed per-update budget across prompts. We instead study how to coordinate a finite rollout budget over the entire training horizon. We formulate this problem using a concave surrogate utility of cumulative prompt exposure and introduce CERO, an online primal dual scheduler for prompt admission and budget pacing. In our experiments, each admitted prompt receives a fixed-size response group. CERO instead adapts which prompts are selected, how often they are revisited across rounds, and how many groups are generated in each round. A compact Fenchel representation linearizes the dependence on cumulative exposure, while projected online gradient descent updates prompt-specific supporting slopes and a shared budget price using reward-variation feedback and budget deviations. We establish pathwise guarantees for the surrogate allocation objective against fixed-rate and same-path time-varying benchmarks, with explicit terms for proxy discrepancy and rate variation. Under matched training-response budgets, CERO attains the highest avg@16 macro-average on each of three backbones across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks. Mechanistic analyses link CERO's prompt choices to within-group reward contrast, while multi-seed ablations show gains from adaptive pacing over both uniform and preset spending schedules.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CERO 把 RL 后训练中的 rollout 预算当作整个训练周期的调度问题而非每次更新的固定配额，用凹代理效用 + Fenchel 线性化构造在线 primal-dual 调度器，同时决定 prompt 准入、跨轮回访频率与每轮生成组数。在匹配训练响应预算下，CERO 在三个 backbone × 五个数学推理 benchmark 上均取得最高 avg@16 宏平均。
Motivation: 现有自适应 rollout 方法只在单次更新内分配固定预算，缺少跨整个训练周期协调有限 rollout 配额的机制，prompt 的选择、回访节奏与每轮开销无法联合优化。
Method: 以累计 prompt 暴露量的凹代理效用建模，引入 CERO 在线 primal-dual 调度器：Fenchel 表示把暴露量依赖线性化，投影在线梯度下降 (projected OGD) 用组内奖励变化反馈与预算偏差更新 prompt 专属支撑斜率和共享预算价格；每个被准入 prompt 仍接收固定大小的 response group。
Result: 在匹配训练响应预算下，CERO 在三个 backbone、五个数学推理 benchmark 上均取得最高 avg@16 宏平均；多 seed 消融显示自适应 pacing 相对均匀与预设花费调度均有增益；机制分析把 CERO 的 prompt 选择与组内 reward contrast 关联起来；并给出针对 fixed-rate 与同路径时变基准的 pathwise 保证，含 proxy discrepancy 与 rate variation 显式项。
Conclusion: 把 rollout 预算跨训练全程做在线 primal-dual 调度，比每次更新固定配额更能提升数学推理 RL 后训练的 avg@16，且收益来自按组内奖励对比度自适应地准入与回访 prompt。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: A Multi-Source Ultrasound Benchmark Revealing the Limits of Contemporary Self-Supervised Anomaly Detection Methods
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised anomaly detection is a promising paradigm for medical ultrasound, as normal images are often easier to obtain than exhaustive annotations of all possible pathologies. However, most existing evaluations are limited to a single anatomy or task, making it unclear whether models learn a robust notion of normal ultrasound appearance or only a source-specific representation. We introduce the SADUSI benchmark, a multi-source ultrasound dataset designed to train and evaluate anomaly detection methods across a broad range of anatomical regions, views, and acquisition protocols. The goal of SADUSI is to provide a diverse normal ultrasound distribution and a benchmark for visible structural anomalies that can be assessed from single images. We evaluate representative self-supervised anomaly detection methods and find that current approaches struggle in this setting. In particular, reconstruction-based diffusion methods such as AnoDDPM and DeCo-Diff achieve pixel-level AUROC values of 0.56-0.72 and maximum F1 scores of 0.10-0.26, indicating limited separation of pathology from normal image regions. Feature-based PatchCore variants perform better, reaching pixel-level AUROC values of 0.76-0.83, but remain limited with maximum F1 scores of 0.14-0.40. These findings suggest that broad multi-source ultrasound anomaly detection remains an open challenge and that SADUSI can serve as a resource for developing methods that generalize beyond anatomy-specific settings.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出多来源超声异常检测基准 SADUSI，覆盖多种解剖部位、扫查视角与采集协议，用单图可见的结构异常评测自监督异常检测方法。重建式扩散方法 AnoDDPM 与 DeCo-Diff 的像素级 AUROC 仅 0.56–0.72、最大 F1 0.10–0.26，特征式 PatchCore 变体 AUROC 0.76–0.83、最大 F1 0.14–0.40，说明现有方法难以跨解剖泛化。
Motivation: 现有超声异常检测评测多局限于单一解剖或单一任务，无法判断模型学到的是通用的正常超声表征，还是只对某个数据来源过拟合。
Method: 构建 SADUSI 多来源超声数据集，提供多样化的正常超声分布与单图可判的可见结构异常标注；在此之上评测代表性自监督异常检测方法，包括重建式扩散模型 AnoDDPM、DeCo-Diff 与特征式 PatchCore 变体，指标为像素级 AUROC 与最大 F1。
Result: AnoDDPM 与 DeCo-Diff 像素级 AUROC 0.56–0.72、最大 F1 0.10–0.26；PatchCore 变体像素级 AUROC 0.76–0.83、最大 F1 0.14–0.40。
Conclusion: 广覆盖多来源超声异常检测仍是开放难题，现有自监督方法在该设定下难以把病理与正常区域分开；SADUSI 可作为检验跨解剖泛化能力的资源。
Relevance: 4
