papers.title: Gauss-Newton Accuracy and Indefinite Hessians: Uniform Coexistence in Low-Cost Sets
papers.abstract_en: We study the accuracy of Gauss-Newton curvature in ridge-regularized nonlinear least squares. Under local regularity and persistence of level-set curvature magnitude along an exact-fit section, we prove uniform coexistence of two curvature regimes. Global minimizers exist, and every global minimizer has relative Hessian error below $(1+\sqrt2)/8$, while the same low-cost set contains a point with an indefinite Hessian and relative error at least $15/8$. One positive ridge cap works for all independent center and label perturbations in fixed neighborhoods and every positive ridge weight up to the cap. These neighborhoods do not shrink as the ridge weight tends to zero. A pointwise certificate based on the current prediction level set controls the normal, mixed, and tangent parts of the Hessian correction. We prove a sharp relative-error bound over the stated pointwise class when the prediction map and ridge vary. Analytic examples describe the roles of output alignment, curvature orientation, and persistence. A separate structural result gives full Jacobian row rank throughout low-cost sets and exact interpolation near a rank-deficient reference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 ridge 正则化非线性最小二乘中，Gauss-Newton 曲率的精度与 Hessian 不定性可在同一低代价集合内共存：所有全局极小点的相对 Hessian 误差低于 (1+√2)/8≈0.309，而同一集合中存在相对误差至少 15/8=1.875 的不定 Hessian 点。一个正的 ridge 上界对固定邻域内所有独立中心/标签扰动以及该上界以下的每个正 ridge 权重统一有效，且这些邻域在 ridge 权重趋于零时不收缩。
Motivation: Gauss-Newton 近似在非线性最小二乘中何时可信缺少统一判据：全局最优点误差小并不排除同一低代价集合里藏着误差极大且 Hessian 不定的点，而 ridge 权重趋于零时的鲁棒性此前没有不随权重收缩的邻域刻画。
Method: 在局部正则性与精确拟合截面上水平集曲率幅值持续性 (persistence of level-set curvature magnitude) 假设下证明两种曲率体制的统一共存；用基于当前预测水平集的逐点证书 (pointwise certificate) 分别控制 Hessian 修正的 normal、mixed、tangent 分量，并在预测映射与 ridge 变化时给出该逐点类上的尖锐相对误差界；辅以解析例子说明输出对齐、曲率方向与持续性的作用，并给出低代价集合上 Jacobian 行满秩与近秩亏参考点处精确插值的结构性结果。
Result: 每个全局极小点的相对 Hessian 误差 < (1+√2)/8 ≈ 0.309，而同一低代价集合含相对误差 ≥ 15/8 = 1.875 且 Hessian 不定的点；存在一个对固定邻域内所有独立中心与标签扰动、以及每个不超过该上界的正 ridge 权重都通用的正 ridge 上界，且邻域在 ridge→0 时不收缩；逐点证书在预测映射与 ridge 变化时给出尖锐相对误差界；低代价集合上 Jacobian 行满秩，秩亏参考点附近精确插值。
Conclusion: Gauss-Newton 的低误差与 Hessian 不定性并非互斥，可在同一低代价集合内并存，且 ridge 上界可对扰动与正则权重统一选取；逐点水平集证书是控制 Hessian 修正各分量的有效工具。
Relevance: 12

papers.title: Quasi-Binarized Autoencoders: An Architecture-Independent Information Bottleneck for Medical Image Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised anomaly detection, which learns only from normal images, is a central task in medical image analysis and remains an open problem. Reconstruction-based methods pass an image through an encoder-decoder network trained on normal data and detect anomalies from the residual between the image and its reconstruction. This works only if the information passed from the encoder to the decoder is limited; otherwise the network learns an identity mapping and reconstructs anomalies too. This limit is usually imposed through architectural choices, tuned per dataset, that cannot be stated in bits. We introduce the quasi-binarizing (QB) layer, which squashes each latent element into [0, 1] and adds Laplace noise of scale 1/epsilon. Each element is then epsilon-locally differentially private, and the mutual information between an image and its reconstruction is bounded by a quantity that depends only on epsilon and the number of QB elements, whatever the encoder and decoder. Placing a QB layer on every encoder-decoder path, including all skip connections, we build QBAE, a seven-level attention U-Net with 32,768 QB elements. On the seven datasets of the MedIAnomaly benchmark, QBAE with one architecture and one configuration reaches a mean image-level AUROC of 0.828, the highest among methods that do not adapt to each dataset, and the best reported results on BraTS2021 (AUROC 0.911, pixel-level AP 0.838). The noise is kept at test time, so that every reconstruction satisfies the bound. Without input corruption, the bottleneck alone prevents identity collapse (mean AUROC 0.805 vs. 0.590). Code is available at https://github.com/hanaokalog/MedIAnomalyQB.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 quasi-binarizing (QB) 层：把每个隐变量压到 [0,1] 并加尺度 1/ε 的 Laplace 噪声，使每个元素满足 ε-局部差分隐私，从而把图像与重建之间的互信息上界写成只依赖 ε 和 QB 元素数的量，与编解码器结构无关。在 MedIAnomaly 七个数据集上，单一架构单一配置的 QBAE 平均图像级 AUROC 0.828，为不按数据集自适应的方法中最高；仅靠瓶颈本身（无输入破坏）平均 AUROC 0.805 对 0.590。
Motivation: 重建式无监督异常检测依赖编码器到解码器的信息受限，否则网络学成恒等映射、把异常也重建出来；现有瓶颈靠逐数据集调的架构手段施加，无法用比特数表述。
Method: QB 层将每个隐元素 squash 到 [0,1] 并注入尺度 1/ε 的 Laplace 噪声，使元素满足 ε-局部差分隐私并给出只依赖 ε 与 QB 元素数的互信息上界；在每条编解码路径（含全部 skip connections）上放置 QB 层，构成七层 attention U-Net 的 QBAE，共 32,768 个 QB 元素，测试时保留噪声以维持上界。
Result: MedIAnomaly 七个数据集上 QBAE 单架构单配置平均图像级 AUROC 0.828，为不按数据集自适应方法中最高；BraTS2021 上图像级 AUROC 0.911、像素级 AP 0.838 为已报告最佳；无输入破坏时仅靠瓶颈平均 AUROC 0.805，对照 0.590。
Conclusion: 把信息瓶颈写成与架构无关的比特级上界（由 ε 与 QB 元素数决定）足以阻止恒等坍缩，且测试时保留噪声是维持该上界的必要条件。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Statistical Oceanography of Profiling Floats and Surface Drifters
papers.abstract_en: The Global Ocean Observing System is key to understanding oceanic variability and climate change. The ocean is vast and often sparsely and irregularly sampled in time and space by various instruments and systems. Statistical models, especially spatio-temporal ones, are useful for enabling inferences, forecasts and decisions from sparse oceanic observations. This article focuses on the statistical treatment of two types of in situ observations in the Global Ocean Observing System: from profiling floats and surface drifters, focusing on the Argo and Global Drifter Programs. We describe the spatio-temporal models that have been developed in recent years for these data, to give a picture of the statistical challenges faced in modern physical oceanography. We will discuss in detail two types of reference frames when modeling such data: Eulerian and Lagrangian, the former of which is more appropriate for profiling floats and the latter for surface drifters.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the Annual Review of Statistics and Its Application, Volume 14
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于海洋原位观测统计建模的综述：Argo 剖面浮标与 Global Drifter Program 表层漂流浮标在时空上稀疏不规则采样，需用时空统计模型从中做推断、预报与决策。作者主张按观测类型选参考系——剖面浮标用 Eulerian 框架、表层漂流浮标用 Lagrangian 框架更合适。
Motivation: 海洋广阔且观测在时空上稀疏不规则，直接从原位数据做推断与预报困难；不同仪器的运动方式不同，统一用一种参考系建模会失真。
Method: 综述近年针对 Argo 剖面浮标与 Global Drifter Program 漂流浮标发展的时空统计模型，系统对比 Eulerian 与 Lagrangian 两类参考系在建模中的适用性，并归纳现代物理海洋学面临的统计挑战。
Result: 给出的核心判据是参考系选择：Eulerian 框架更适合剖面浮标，Lagrangian 框架更适合表层漂流浮标；文章为这两类原位数据梳理了近年来的时空模型及其所应对的统计问题。
Conclusion: 稀疏海洋原位观测的统计建模应依观测的运动学性质选参考系——固定位置的剖面浮标走 Eulerian，随流漂移的表层浮标走 Lagrangian。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Shared and structured inputs undermine collective random choice by reasoning AI agents
papers.abstract_en: Random selection is widely used in resource allocation and auditing, making reliable implementation essential for AI-agent systems. Behavioural tests across six reasoning models uncovered threshold and divisibility rules used in identifier-based choices. For threshold-following GPT-6 Sol and Gemini 3.8 Flash, single-agent measurements prospectively predicted correlated participation under shared identifiers and biased participation under distinct identifiers with common timestamp bits. Changing dates, formats and identifier labels revealed when these predictions held. Explicit instructions to randomize independently reduced but did not eliminate shared-input correlation. To test implications for oversight, we asked four models to select customer requests randomly for human review. GPT-6 Sol approached the target rate while selecting predictably from identifiers; the others rarely selected requests. All four closely followed supplied random draws. These findings expose collective and audit vulnerabilities that selection rates alone miss, making input-dependent bias, correlation and predictability central targets for agent evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对六个推理模型做行为测试，发现基于标识符的随机选择普遍遵循阈值与整除规则：共享标识符使参与高度相关，不同标识符但含公共时间戳位则产生偏置选择。显式要求独立随机化只能降低而不能消除这种相关；在人工审查抽样任务中，GPT-6 Sol 虽接近目标抽取率但选择可从标识符预测，其余模型几乎不选，四个模型都紧随给定随机数。
Motivation: 随机选择是资源分配与审计的常用机制，但仅看选择率无法暴露 AI agent 系统中由输入决定的偏置、相关性与可预测性，从而带来集体协作与监督审查层面的漏洞。
Method: 对六个推理模型做行为测试，识别其标识符选择中的阈值与整除规则；用单模型测量前瞻性预测共享标识符下的相关参与和含公共时间戳位的不同标识符下的偏置参与，并通过更换日期、格式与标识符标签检验预测成立条件；另设四模型为客户请求做人工审查的随机抽样任务。
Result: 阈值型模型 GPT-6 Sol 与 Gemini 3.8 Flash 的单模型测量能前瞻性预测共享标识符下的相关参与与不同标识符下的偏置参与；显式独立随机化指令降低但未消除共享输入相关。审查任务中 GPT-6 Sol 接近目标率但选择可从标识符预测，其余三个模型很少选择请求，四个模型都紧密跟随提供的随机抽取。
Conclusion: 输入依赖的偏置、相关与可预测性是仅看选择率会漏掉的核心评估目标，agent 评估必须把这三项纳入考量。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 阈值型模型 GPT-6 Sol 与 Gemini 3.8 Flash 的单模型测量能前瞻性预测共享标识符下的相关参与与不同标识符下的偏置参与；显式独立随机化指令降低但未消除共享输入相关。审查任务中 GPT-6 Sol 接近目标率但选择可从标识符预测，其余三个模型很少选择请求，四个模型都紧密跟随提供的随机抽取。
summary_sections.conclusion: 输入依赖的偏置、相关与可预测性是仅看选择率会漏掉的核心评估目标，agent 评估必须把这三项纳入考量。

papers.title: Real-world application of deep learning in large-scale seismic interference attenuation: A case study in the Camie field of Angola
papers.abstract_en: In marine seismic acquisition, seismic interference (SI) occurs when energy from nearby external seismic source(s) is captured. It typically appears as coherent noise with linear or non-linear movement and varying amplitudes across different sail lines. SI is commonly observed and poses a challenge for seismic data processing. We present a case history of a previously proposed deep neural network (DNN)-based workflow applied for SI attenuation across a marine seismic block in the Camie Field of Angola. This field survey covers over 345 km2 and is marked by the challenge of multiple SI types. The employed DNN-based workflow performs SI attenuation in the common shot domain based on a supervised learning framework: a small subset of the SI-contaminated data was first processed by a conventional geophysical algorithm to obtain an estimate of the SI noise, which was then manually blended with the SI-free common shot gathers from the same survey to generate the training pairs. To ensure signal fidelity, several techniques were applied to improve the DNN's performance. A key highlight of this case history is its scale: this represents a real-world, large-scale processing project and we present a comprehensive comparison of the DNN-based workflow with the conventional geophysical algorithm across the entire survey block, focusing on both processing quality and processing time. The results demonstrate the outstanding performance of the employed DNN-based workflow, which achieved higher SI removal accuracy, with less signal leakage and more complete SI removal. The promising results of this application also open up possibilities for integrating deep learning into other seismic denoising tasks. In addition, we discuss the limitations of this case history, aiming to provide insights for future research and applications in the field.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在安哥拉 Camie 油田超过 345 km² 的海上地震区块上，用监督式 DNN 工作流在 common shot 域做 seismic interference (SI) 衰减：先用常规地球物理算法处理少量受污染数据得到 SI 噪声估计，再与同工区无 SI 的 common shot gather 人工混合生成训练对。全区块对比显示该工作流 SI 去除精度更高、信号泄漏更少、SI 去除更完整，且处理时间更短。
Motivation: 海上地震采集常被邻近外部震源的 SI 干扰，SI 在不同 sail line 上呈线性或非线性移动、振幅多变，是地震数据处理中的长期难题；常规算法在含多种 SI 类型的大区块上处理质量与耗时都受限。
Method: 监督学习框架下的 DNN 工作流在 common shot 域执行 SI 衰减：取少量 SI 污染数据经常规地球物理算法得到 SI 噪声估计，与同工区无 SI 的 common shot gather 人工混合构成训练对；另用若干技术提升 DNN 性能以保证 signal fidelity。
Result: 在覆盖超过 345 km²、含多种 SI 类型的 Camie 油田整区块上，与常规地球物理算法就处理质量与处理时间做全面对比：DNN 工作流取得更高 SI 去除精度、更少信号泄漏、更完整的 SI 去除。
Conclusion: 深度学习 SI 衰减可在真实大规模海上地震项目中落地并超越常规算法，同时可推广到其他地震去噪任务；作者也讨论了本案例的局限以指导后续应用。

papers.title: DSTNet: Dynamic Spectral Trajectory Network for Causal Multi-Horizon Financial Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Wavelet-based financial forecasters typically use the transform only to denoise, or reduce it to a single spectral snapshot at the forecast origin, and the convolution that produces the coefficients is usually bilateral, so it can read past the forecast origin. DSTNet instead retains the recent evolution of filter-bank magnitudes as a causal Dynamic Spectral Trajectory, built from seven trailing technical indicators over a twenty-day lookback with a one-sided Morlet-derived filter bank and an explicit burn-in for the left-boundary transient. A factorized Scale-Temporal Spectral Transformer attends along the time and filter-bank axes separately, a learned gate fuses the spectral branch with a CNN-BiLSTM, and horizon-specific gates emit one, three, five, and ten day forecasts in a single pass. We evaluate seven equity indices and gold under a common expanding-window protocol and an untouched one-year hold-out, against nine learned baselines and a random-walk persistence benchmark. Under MAE and MAPE, persistence is the strongest of the ten fixed competitors in 29 of the 32 series-horizon cells and DSTNet is the only model below it in every cell, by 0.7 to 0.9 percent at one day and 3.4 to 4.5 percent at ten days. At one day, paired testing favours DSTNet against the weaker learned baselines but is inconclusive against persistence and the strongest learned forecasters. A downstream allocation diagnostic does not support an equity-timing advantage on any of the seven indices.
papers.comment: 27 Pages, 8 figures, 19 tables, Paper in Review

TL;DR: DSTNet 用因果 Dynamic Spectral Trajectory（单边 Morlet 滤波器组 + 左边界 burn-in）保留滤波器幅值的近期演化，配合 Scale-Temporal Spectral Transformer 与 CNN-BiLSTM 门控融合，单次输出 1/3/5/10 天金融预测。在 7 个股指加黄金共 32 个 series-horizon 单元上，它是唯一在每个单元都优于随机游走 persistence 的模型，1 天领先 0.7–0.9%、10 天领先 3.4–4.5%。
Motivation: 小波金融预测器通常只用变换去噪，或只在预测起点取单一谱快照，且卷积是双边的、可读到预测起点之后，破坏因果性。

Conclusion: 因果谱轨迹加因子化注意力能在多 horizon 上稳定小幅击败 persistence，但 1 天尺度对最强对手优势不显著，且预测优势未转化为股票择时收益。

papers.title: MeshSIPP: Efficient Lattice Planning in Dynamic Environment
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous navigation in dynamic environments requires computing spatiotemporal trajectories that satisfy non-holonomic motion constraints. When the trajectories of the moving obstacles are predictable or known, a promising approach is to rely on the combination of state lattices constructed from precomputed feasible motion primitives and Safe Interval Path Planning -- a search-based algorithm with strong theoretical guarantees. While this approach yields feasible paths, the rich primitive sets needed for smooth navigation induce a large branching factor, which becomes costly when coupled with time-dependent obstacle intervals. To this end, we present MeshSIPP, an efficient planner that removes the computational bottleneck by exploiting the fact that many primitives sweep the same regions and can therefore be validated together. MeshSIPP propagates primitives as spatial bundles, screens them with lightweight bounding-interval checks, and defers the expensive exact departure-time search until a primitive reaches its terminal state. A time-aware pruning rule additionally discards redundant space-time branches early in the search. We prove that the resulting search is complete and optimal. Extensive experiments over more than 6,000 benchmark instances and real-time ROS~2 simulations show that MeshSIPP achieves up to a 3$\times$ speedup over state-of-the-art spatiotemporal planners.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MeshSIPP 把动态环境下带非完整约束的时空轨迹规划中，原语 (primitive) 扫过相同区域这一事实利用起来：按空间束 (spatial bundle) 传播原语、用轻量 bounding-interval 检查批量筛选、把昂贵的精确出发时间搜索推迟到原语到达终态，并用时间感知剪枝提前丢弃冗余时空分支。作者证明该搜索完备且最优，在 6,000 余个基准实例与 ROS 2 实时仿真中相对最先进时空规划器最高取得 3× 加速。
Motivation: state lattice 与 Safe Interval Path Planning 组合能给出可行路径，但平滑导航所需的丰富原语集带来大分支因子，再叠加时间依赖的障碍物区间后搜索代价急剧上升。
Method: MeshSIPP 以预计算可行运动原语构成的 lattice 为基础，把原语作为 spatial bundle 传播并批量验证，先做轻量 bounding-interval 筛选，仅当原语到达终态时才执行精确 departure-time 搜索；另加一条时间感知剪枝规则在搜索早期丢弃冗余时空分支。
Result: 在超过 6,000 个 benchmark 实例和 ROS 2 实时仿真上，MeshSIPP 相对 state-of-the-art 时空规划器取得最高 3× 加速；作者证明所得搜索具备完备性与最优性。
Conclusion: 动态环境中 lattice+SIPP 的瓶颈来自原语级重复验证，把验证按空间束合并并延迟精确时间搜索，可在保持完备与最优的同时把搜索代价压下来。

papers.title: Closed-Form Noise Calibration Against Membership Inference for Random-Allocation DP-SGD
papers.abstract_en: DP-SGD protects training data by adding Gaussian noise to clipped gradients. The amount of noise is usually chosen by running a numerical privacy accountant inside a search. We study DP-SGD with random allocation, where each epoch uses every record once, at a randomly chosen step. For this setting we give a one-line formula that bounds the accuracy of every membership inference attack (MIA) on the trained model. With $M$ steps per epoch, $E$ epochs and noise multiplier $σ$, and with membership and non-membership equally likely a priori, the attack accuracy is at most $\frac12+\frac14\sqrt{(1+(e^{1/σ^2}-1)/M)^E-1}$. The formula comes from the chi-square divergence between a Gaussian distribution and a Gaussian mixture that dominates random allocation. It is interpretable and gives $σ$ in about a microsecond. Where applicable, our formula needs at most about half the noise of the state-of-the-art closed-form bound. To measure how close the bound is, we also derive an exact expression for the attack accuracy of these two distributions and evaluate it numerically. Calibrating to this exact expression requires $13.0\%$ to $20.2\%$ less noise than the formula in our main experiments, and since it is exact, no accountant that knows only $M$, $E$ and $σ$ can certify a smaller $σ$. In training, the resulting $σ$ outperforms the formula and matches a published accountant in test accuracy. It is found in seconds and certified in minutes, whereas every search we ran with that accountant took longer or returned at least $0.62\%$ more noise. We show that MIAs on the trained models stay below the bound.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 random-allocation DP-SGD 的噪声标定，给出一行闭式公式，用 χ² 散度界定任意成员推断攻击 (MIA) 的准确率上界：1/2 + 1/4·sqrt((1+(e^{1/σ²}-1)/M)^E - 1)，并据此直接解出 σ，耗时约微秒。适用情形下所需噪声至多约为最先进闭式界的一半；按其精确表达式标定还需再少 13.0%–20.2% 噪声，训练测试精度与已发表 accountant 持平，而搜索式 accountant 每次耗时更长且至少多返回 0.62% 噪声。
Motivation: DP-SGD 的噪声量通常要靠数值 privacy accountant 在搜索循环里反复计算，代价高且不直观；对 random-allocation（每个 epoch 每条记录恰用一次、随机步）这一设置缺少可直接求解 σ 的闭式界。
Method: 在 random-allocation 下把高斯分布与支配该分配的高斯混合做 χ² 散度分析，导出含 M（每 epoch 步数）、E（epoch 数）、σ（噪声乘子）的一行攻击准确率上界（先验上成员/非成员等可能）；再对同样两个分布推导攻击准确率的精确表达式并数值评估，用它衡量上界的紧度。
Result: 上界为 1/2 + 1/4·sqrt((1+(e^{1/σ²}-1)/M)^E - 1)，求 σ 约需微秒；适用情形所需噪声至多约为最先进闭式界的一半。按精确表达式标定比该公式少 13.0%–20.2% 噪声（主实验），且因表达式精确，只知 M、E、σ 的 accountant 无法认证更小的 σ。训练中由此得到的 σ 在测试精度上优于该公式并追平已发表 accountant：秒级求出、分钟级认证，而与该 accountant 的每次搜索耗时更长或至少多返回 0.62% 噪声；实测对训练模型的 MIA 准确率保持在界以下。
Conclusion: 对 random-allocation DP-SGD，攻击准确率可由一个可解释的闭式式子直接界定并反解噪声，比搜索式 accountant 又快又省噪声，且实测 MIA 不越界。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: When Rank Rises as LLMs Degrade
papers.abstract_en: Post-training adapts language models in non-stationary environments. Practitioners monitor representation health with RankMe and related spectral statistics, often assuming that rank falls when representations degrade. We show that this assumption is unsafe for LLM post-training. In a controlled study of Qwen3-0.6B with four degradation modes and three seeds, data duplication worsens held-out loss by 75% relative to healthy while increasing both original and centred RankMe; the latter changes by 13.5 pooled standard deviations. Covariance effective rank rises to nearly twice its healthy value. This failure is spectral dispersion rather than collapse, so a one-sided monitor rates the worst checkpoint as the healthiest. By contrast, a learning-rate misconfiguration lowers centred RankMe and k95, while uncentred RankMe is inconsistent across seeds. Direction is therefore a property of the regime-statistic pair and cannot be fixed by recalibration alone. We also distinguish two often-conflated statistics: RankMe normalises singular values, whereas covariance effective rank normalises eigenvalues. On raw intermediate-layer states in the pretrained model, massive activations pin the latter near 1 out of dimension d while RankMe retains usable range. We then test a two-sided, multichannel sequential monitor with separate calibration and test data. In a pre-registered shared-prefix, leave-one-seed-out evaluation, it detects all three damage regimes in every fold 10 to 60 steps after the fork and separates dispersion from downward-rank damage by firing direction. However, it never precedes held-out probe loss, and calibration with two seeds produces false alarms on the held-out healthy seed. Spectral monitoring can diagnose failure regimes, but it does not warn earlier than held-out loss, and validity claims require held-out healthy data.

Motivation: 实践者用 RankMe 等谱统计监控 LLM post-training 的表征健康，并默认退化时秩下降；这一假设在非平稳后训练中不成立，单侧监控会给出与 held-out loss 相反的判断。
Method: 在 Qwen3-0.6B 上做四种退化模式 × 三种 seed 的受控研究，比较 RankMe（归一化奇异值）与 covariance effective rank（归一化特征值）；提出双侧多通道序贯监控，校准集与测试集分离，采用 pre-registered shared-prefix、leave-one-seed-out 评估。
Result: 数据重复使 held-out loss 相对健康状态恶化 75%，同时抬高原始与中心化 RankMe，后者偏移 13.5 个合并标准差，协方差有效秩升至健康值近两倍；学习率误配则降低中心化 RankMe 与 k95，而未中心化 RankMe 跨 seed 不一致。监控在每个 fold 中于 fork 后 10 到 60 步检出全部三种损伤 regime，并按触发方向区分弥散与降秩损伤，但从未早于 held-out probe loss 报警，用两个 seed 校准会在留出的健康 seed 上产生误报。

papers.title: Automatically Building and Updating a Knowledge Graph of MLIP Models
papers.abstract_en: Complementing the many efforts in providing semantic representations of concepts, notions, and entities in materials science, we report and illustrate a process by which we can automatically build a knowledge graph of the fast evolving field of machine learning applied to the prediction of material properties, focusing on MLIP (Machine Learning Interatomic Potential). This LLM-based process relies on multiple steps, from information extraction in documents and articles to a validation loop using SHACL constraints to detect and correct errors. It is carried out on a model-by-model basis, focusing on the consistency of representation, therefore enabling an iterative construction where the addition of new models is facilitated. We illustrate the process by showing a few interesting aspects that can be queried from a knowledge graph built from the models listed in the Matbench Discovery leaderboard.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一套基于 LLM 的多步流程，自动构建并持续更新机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 领域的知识图谱：从文献中抽取信息，再用 SHACL 约束做验证回路以检测并纠正错误，按模型逐个增量构建，保证表示一致性。在 Matbench Discovery leaderboard 所列模型构成的图谱上演示了可查询的若干特征。
Motivation: 材料科学中机器学习预测材料性质的领域演化快，已有语义表示多针对概念与实体，缺少能随新模型持续更新的自动化构建方式。
Method: LLM 驱动的多步流程：先从文档与论文中做信息抽取，再用 SHACL 约束构成验证回路 (validation loop) 检测并纠正错误；按 model-by-model 粒度构建，强调表示一致性，使新增模型可迭代加入。
Result: 在 Matbench Discovery leaderboard 所列模型上构建知识图谱并演示了若干可查询的方面；摘要未给出定量指标。
Conclusion: 以 LLM 抽取加 SHACL 约束验证的迭代流程，可以自动构建并持续更新 MLIP 模型知识图谱，且新模型的加入被流程本身所便利。

papers.title: CircuitATLAS: Agentic reasoning over a systems neuroscience knowledge graph for target discovery in circuitopathies
papers.abstract_en: Drug discovery for neurological disease has traditionally centered on the molecules altered by disease. But the molecules that cause pathology are not necessarily the best points from which to reverse it. Here, we ask which otherwise unaltered molecular control points can be engaged to restore pathological neural circuits toward functional states. We present CircuitATLAS, a provenance-grounded systems-neuroscience knowledge graph and agentic framework for target discovery in circuitopathies. It structures literature-derived relationships across diseases, phenotypes, electrophysiology, circuits, brain regions, cell types and molecular effectors, while deliberately excluding direct disease-gene and disease-protein edges to reduce shortcut reasoning. The graph contains 3.83 million nodes and 7.66 million edges, including 5.31 million LLM-extracted relations, and incorporates structured datasets such as the Human Cell Atlas and new multimodal in vivo measurements. We then introduce an agentic workflow that reasons from measurable disease phenotypes through their circuit and cellular substrates to molecular interventions, therapeutic feasibility and clinical constraints. Finally, we introduce a human-governed in vivo lab-in-the-loop linking hypothesis generation to experimental iteration. Within this framework an agent nominated ATP1A3, the neuronal alpha3 Na+/K+-ATPase, as a control point on cortical excitability; interneuron-restricted expression of ATP1A3 abolished the beta- and gamma-band response to a focal 4-aminopyridine challenge in vivo, and the validated target was then carried into a structure-guided small-molecule campaign terminating in a defined assay to resolve the direction of modulation. CircuitATLAS thus provides a framework for discovering therapeutics based not only on what is molecularly disrupted in disease, but on what can be controlled to restore circuit function.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CircuitATLAS 构建了一个带溯源的系统神经科学知识图谱与 agentic 推理框架，用于在神经回路病 (circuitopathy) 中寻找未被疾病改变、却能调控回路功能的分子控制点。图谱含 383 万节点、766 万边（其中 531 万条为 LLM 抽取关系），刻意剔除疾病-基因/疾病-蛋白直连边以抑制捷径推理；agent 据此提名 ATP1A3，其在中间神经元特异表达可在体内消除局灶 4-aminopyridine 挑战引发的 beta 与 gamma 频段响应，随后进入结构导向的小分子筛选。
Motivation: 神经疾病药物研发长期围绕疾病中被改变的分子，但致病分子未必是逆转病理的最佳切入点；缺少从可测表型经回路与细胞基质回溯到可干预分子控制点的系统化推理路径。
Method: 构建 provenance-grounded 知识图谱，组织疾病、表型、电生理、回路、脑区、细胞类型与分子效应因子之间的文献关系，并纳入 Human Cell Atlas 与新的多模态在体测量数据；图谱刻意排除疾病-基因与疾病-蛋白直接边以减少捷径推理。其上运行 agentic workflow，从可测疾病表型推理到回路/细胞基质、分子干预、治疗可行性与临床约束，并配以 human-governed 的 in vivo lab-in-the-loop，把假设生成接到实验迭代。
Result: 图谱含 3.83 million 节点、7.66 million 边，其中 5.31 million 条为 LLM 抽取关系。agent 提名 ATP1A3（神经元 alpha3 Na+/K+-ATPase）作为皮层兴奋性的控制点；interneuron-restricted 的 ATP1A3 表达在体内消除了局灶 4-aminopyridine 挑战引起的 beta 与 gamma 频段响应，该经验证靶点随后进入结构导向小分子筛选，终点为判定调控方向的明确 assay。
Conclusion: 药物发现可以基于「什么能被控制以恢复回路功能」而非仅「什么在分子层面被破坏」，且知识图谱约束加 agentic 推理加实验室在环的组合能把该路径落到经体内验证的靶点与后续化合物发现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Q-PhotoMarket: A Design Space Exploration Framework for Photonic Hybrid Quantum Neural Networks in Financial Market Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Photonic quantum computing has recently emerged as a promising platform for hybrid quantum machine learning due to its native realization of linear-optical circuits and the computational complexity of boson sampling. However, despite growing interest in quantum methods for finance, the influence of photonic circuit design choices on predictive performance remains largely unexplored. Existing studies typically evaluate a single architecture, leaving the broader photonic design space unexamined. In this work, we present Q-PhotoMarket, a systematic design space exploration (DSE) framework for photonic hybrid quantum neural networks (HQNNs) applied to financial market prediction. We explore over 5,000 valid photonic configurations spanning input photon states, circuit architectures, entangling models, and measurement strategies across their compatible computation spaces, for U.S., Indian, and cryptocurrency markets. To improve search efficiency, the exhaustive exploration is complemented with Bayesian optimization. We further incorporate threshold calibration and prediction-collapse diagnostics to enable reliable evaluation under increasingly imbalanced return thresholds. Experimental results show that systematic exploration of more than 5,000 photonic HQNN configurations reveals consistent architectural patterns across financial markets, identifies robust high-performing designs, and demonstrates competitive performance relative to classical machine learning baselines.
papers.comment: To appear at the IEEE International Conference on Quantum Artificial Intelligence (QAI), Nottingham, UK, December 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Q-PhotoMarket 把光子混合量子神经网络 (photonic HQNN) 的电路设计空间做成可系统搜索的框架，在美国、印度与加密货币市场上穷举加贝叶斯优化共 5,000+ 个合法光子配置（输入光子态、电路结构、纠缠模型、测量策略），并给出跨市场一致的高表现架构模式，性能相对经典机器学习基线具有竞争力。
Motivation: 现有量子金融研究通常只评估单一架构，光子电路设计选择如何影响预测性能基本未被探索，设计空间整体处于未检验状态。
Method: 提出设计空间探索 (DSE) 框架：在各兼容计算空间内穷举 5,000+ 个光子配置，维度覆盖输入光子态、电路架构、纠缠模型与测量策略；用贝叶斯优化 (Bayesian optimization) 提升搜索效率，并加入阈值校准 (threshold calibration) 与预测塌缩诊断 (prediction-collapse diagnostics) 以应对日益不平衡的收益率阈值。
Result: 在美股、印度股市与加密货币市场上探索超过 5,000 个光子 HQNN 配置，发现跨金融市场一致的架构模式与稳健的高表现设计，且相对经典机器学习基线表现出竞争力。
Conclusion: 光子 HQNN 的设计选择存在跨市场可复现的优劣结构，系统化设计空间探索比单架构评估更能找到有竞争力的金融预测模型。

papers.title: Tracing Inputs, Verifying Outputs: Validating Attribution in Music Generation
papers.abstract_en: How can we verify whose music contributed to an AI-generated output? This paper demonstrates how input-based attribution can provide verifiable evidence of which audio sources were used in a generation and whether they shaped the output. To do so, we condition the generation solely on audio without any text input, then trace the inputs behind each output, and establish their musical effect. In prompt adherence tests and controlled input swaps, the stems generated by our generator, MixAudio, follow the prompt audio in timbre and the context audio in harmony. Yet these outputs may still reproduce training data not supplied as inputs. We therefore audit memorization with our musical version identification model, musicDNA, and find few reproductions outside the input records. On human-judged cases within the flagged pool, it achieves higher precision and recall than the other tested memorization detectors. The two evaluations suggest that input records and output analysis provide complementary evidence for attribution, on which rights-holder reporting and compensation can draw as the AI music economy takes shape. Audio examples are available at https://neutune.github.io/attr2027demo/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 纯音频条件的音乐生成模型 MixAudio 可对每个输出追溯输入来源：受控输入替换显示生成 stem 的音色跟随 prompt audio、和声跟随 context audio；用 musicDNA 版本识别模型审计记忆化，标记池外复现很少，且在人工判定的标记案例上精度与召回均高于其他被测记忆化检测器。
Motivation: AI 音乐生成无法回答“哪些音频真正贡献了输出”，也无法证明输出是否复现了未作为输入的训练数据，权利方报告与补偿缺少可核验证据。
Method: 生成仅以音频为条件、不使用文本输入；通过 prompt adherence 测试与受控输入替换 (controlled input swaps) 追踪每个输出背后的输入并确定其音乐作用；再用音乐版本识别模型 musicDNA 审计记忆化，并与其他记忆化检测器对比，人工判定标记池中的案例。
Result: 生成 stem 的音色跟随 prompt audio、和声跟随 context audio；标记池外很少出现训练数据复现；在人工判定的标记案例上，musicDNA 的 precision 与 recall 均高于其他被测 memorization detectors。
Conclusion: 输入记录与输出分析构成互补的归属证据，可支撑 AI 音乐经济下的权利方报告与补偿。

papers.title: Quantum anomaly detection in real scarce data
papers.abstract_en: Anomaly detection on small and unbalanced datasets remains very challenging in machine learning, although this scenario is common in several domains, including healthcare, cybersecurity, finance, and energy. Data augmentation and generative AI may mitigate training-data scarcity, but they often fall short because anomalies are, by definition, unpredictable, rare, and highly diverse events compared to high-probability normal data. Overfitting to pseudo-anomalies, model collapse, high-dimensional data, uninterpretable black-box models, and validation challenges are typical issues limiting their practical applicability. In this context, quantum machine learning may provide a promising and more sustainable avenue because it can enable more interpretable models with far fewer trainable parameters and smaller datasets, implementable on energy-efficient quantum hardware. Here, we propose a novel two-step hybrid classical--quantum architecture for sequential data and test it on a realistic scenario in the global energy-transition domain, i.e., automated anomaly detection in large-scale photovoltaic plants. The achieved generalization capability and competitive prediction accuracy may pave the way for new hybrid learning models able to exploit the continuously increasing power of cloud-available and more sustainable quantum accelerators integrated with more traditional energy-hungry High Performance Computing resources.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出两步式经典-量子混合架构，用于小样本、不平衡的序数据异常检测，并在大规模光伏电站的真实场景上测试。摘要报告其泛化能力与有竞争力的预测精度，且可训练参数远少于经典模型，指向用云端量子加速器与 HPC 协同的低能耗异常检测路线。
Motivation: 小且不平衡数据集上的异常检测仍是难题：数据增强与生成式 AI 会过拟合伪异常、发生 model collapse，且异常本身不可预测、稀有、多样，黑箱模型还带来可解释性与验证困难。
Method: 提出两步式经典-量子混合序数据架构（two-step hybrid classical-quantum architecture），以更少可训练参数与更小数据集实现可解释模型；测试场景为大规模光伏电站的自动异常检测，属全球能源转型领域的真实用例。
Result: 在大规模光伏电站异常检测这一真实场景上，该混合架构展现出泛化能力与有竞争力的预测精度（competitive prediction accuracy），并以远少于经典模型的可训练参数和更小数据集运行。
Conclusion: 量子机器学习可在小数据、少参数条件下支撑可解释的异常检测，混合模型有望借云端量子加速器与传统 HPC 协同实现更可持续的部署。

papers.title: Coding-Agent Benchmarks Should Match Their Users' Task Flows
papers.abstract_en: The evaluation of coding agents generally strives to be as realistic as possible. In our study, we collect 4,782 agent sessions of real software engineers in JetBrains IDEs, which we call Production Sessions. Since our subject is interactive agents, we study the sessions with at least three user messages (33% of the sample). These long sessions differ from issue-derived benchmark tasks in two ways: (i) user requests span a far wider mix of task types - questions about the project's code, planning, review, refactoring, execution - and (ii) users switch between types throughout a session. Long-session samples from three public interaction corpora exhibit markedly different Task Flows (the distributions of session lengths, task types, and type-to-type transitions), so no single interaction distribution is universally realistic: benchmarks should name a target use case and calibrate to measurements from it. We present SWE-TaskFlow, an approach for transforming any issue-derived benchmark: it preserves the verified tasks and tests while steering the interaction toward a target Task Flow through prompt splitting and verifiable repository QA, with a TaskFlow Alignment Score (TFAS) for selecting among generated trajectories. In a pilot on 700 SWE-Bench Pro tasks, solving the task sequentially in several steps approximately doubles agent cost without a stable change in resolve rate: the interaction protocol itself is an important dimension of evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SWE-TaskFlow 把任意 issue 型编码基准改造成匹配目标用户 Task Flow 的交互评测：保留原任务与测试，用 prompt splitting 和可验证的仓库 QA 重塑交互，并以 TaskFlow Alignment Score (TFAS) 挑选轨迹。在 700 个 SWE-Bench Pro 任务的试点中，把任务拆成多步顺序求解使 agent 成本约翻倍，而 resolve rate 没有稳定变化。
Motivation: 真实工程师的长会话（≥3 条用户消息，占样本 33%）里任务类型混合且频繁切换，与 issue 派生基准的单一任务形态差距很大；三个公开交互语料的 Task Flow 分布互不相同，说明不存在普适“真实”的交互分布。
Method: 从 JetBrains IDE 收集 4,782 条真实软件工程师的 Production Sessions，用会话长度、任务类型分布与类型间转移概率刻画 Task Flow；SWE-TaskFlow 通过 prompt splitting 与 verifiable repository QA 把 issue 型基准的交互引向目标 Task Flow，同时保留已验证的任务与测试，用 TFAS 在生成轨迹间选择。
Result: 样本中 33% 的会话含至少 3 条用户消息；三个公开交互语料的 Task Flow 显著不同。在 700 个 SWE-Bench Pro 任务的 pilot 中，分多步顺序求解使 agent 成本约翻倍（approximately doubles），resolve rate 无稳定变化。
Conclusion: 交互协议本身是评测的一个重要维度：基准应先声明目标使用场景，再按该场景实测的 Task Flow 校准，而不是假设单一分布普适真实。

papers.title: How Do Agentic LLMs Decide to Call Tools? A Tool-Call Vector Shaped by Suppression
papers.abstract_en: Tool calling, invoking external tools on demand, is central to agentic LLMs, yet the mechanism that decides whether a model calls a tool or responds directly remains poorly understood. Agentic prompts are long and heavily scaffolded, combining role instructions, tool schemas, format templates, and the user's request across hundreds of tokens, creating a noisy, highly entangled context in which no single controllable variable for mechanistic analysis is obvious. To obtain such a variable, we propose a method that converts complex agentic prompts into minimal contrastive pairs in which a single request verb determines the tool-call decision: replacing an execution-verb (e.g., \textit{write}) with an analysis-verb (e.g., \textit{discuss}) reliably flips the decision, suggesting it is mediated by a compact internal state. We construct 500 such paired prompts across Python, Java, and C++ (300 for mechanistic analysis, 200 held out for evaluation). We trace the decision to a vector, $μ_Δ$, that is both causally necessary and sufficient and generalizes beyond the discovery prompts to native multi-turn $τ^2$-Bench trajectories and verb-free requests. Behavioral ablations show that the scaffold establishes a tool-call prior; Transcoder decomposition then reveals that analysis verbs suppress this prior through features signaling that tool use is unnecessary, whereas execution verbs largely leave it intact. Downstream scaffold-reading attention heads and MLP features read out the resulting state, and the same mechanism recurs across seven models from the Qwen, Mistral, and Granite families. Our code is available at https://github.com/XijieGo/MI4ToolCalling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把冗长 agentic prompt 压成只差一个请求动词的最小对比对，定位到决定是否调用工具的内部向量 μ_Δ：执行类动词（write）保留 scaffold 建立的调用先验，分析类动词（discuss）通过“无需用工具”的特征抑制该先验，从而翻转决策。该向量因果上既必要又充分，并在 Qwen、Mistral、Granite 三族共七个模型上复现。
Motivation: agentic prompt 混合角色指令、工具 schema、格式模板与用户请求，长达数百 token 且高度纠缠，缺少可用于机制分析的单一可控变量，工具调用决策的内部机制长期不清楚。
Method: 构造 500 组最小对比 prompt（Python、Java、C++，300 组做机制分析、200 组留出评测），仅替换请求动词即可翻转决策；追踪到向量 μ_Δ 并做因果必要性与充分性检验，再用 Transcoder 分解特征、分析 scaffold-reading 注意力头与 MLP 特征的读出通路。
Result: 500 组对比 prompt 中替换执行动词为分析动词可靠翻转工具调用决策；μ_Δ 在发现 prompt 之外泛化到原生多轮 τ²-Bench 轨迹与无动词请求；行为消融显示 scaffold 建立调用先验、分析动词抑制之而执行动词基本不动，同一机制在 Qwen、Mistral、Granite 七模型复现。
Conclusion: 工具调用决策由一个被抑制调控的紧凑内部状态承载：先验由 scaffold 建立，请求动词通过抑制或保留该先验决定调用与否，且这一机制跨模型族通用。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: When does a network's training history predict its future learning better than its current state? Evidence from a response probe and a forecasting screen
papers.abstract_en: Networks that behave alike now can still learn differently when training continues. Work on loss of plasticity and critical periods shows that the path to a state shapes what follows; it does not show whether the path carries information that a measurement of the state itself misses. We ask when the training history of a network predicts its future learning better than its current state. In a main study, small multilayer perceptrons were trained under three history regimes (42 histories), and future learning was measured at four checkpoints by a short probe: a copy of the network trained for 100 updates on a new task. Before the prediction result was read, the protocol checked the probe. It responded monotonically to a function-preserving rescaling of hidden units, repeated measurements agreed (intraclass correlation 0.940, [0.903, 0.997], in the least reliable class, mean of three repeats), and a re-initialisation of units was visible directly after it but not 100 to 200 updates later. A history state of at most four dimensions did not improve on a calibrated model of the current state (gain -21.4%, 90% interval [-91.9, 8.1]; required in advance: 10%). A companion screen on 1,560 synthetic regression runs asked the same question for a target further away, the final error of the run. There, history models forecast better than the current validation error after 12 of up to 240 epochs (compact state 30.3%, [15.8, 39.4], a contextual comparison) and were not distinguishable from it after 48. In both studies the history was informative only while the current state was not yet informative about the target; this reading was formed after the results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 问网络的训练历史能否比当前状态更好地预测未来学习：主实验中小 MLP 在三种历史制度（42 条历史）下训练，用训练 100 步的探针网络测未来学习，历史状态（≤4 维）相对校准后的当前状态模型增益 -21.4%（90% 区间 [-91.9, 8.1]，事先要求 10%），即不占优；1,560 次合成回归的伴随筛选中，历史模型在 12 个 epoch 之后（上限 240）比当前验证误差更好地预测最终误差（紧凑状态 30.3%，[15.8, 39.4]），到 48 个 epoch 后不可区分。结论是历史只在当前状态尚未携带目标信息时才有用。
Motivation: loss of plasticity 与 critical periods 说明到达某状态的路径会影响后续学习，但没有回答路径本身是否携带了对状态的测量所遗漏的信息。
Method: 主研究用小型多层感知机在三种历史制度下训练（42 条历史），在四个检查点用短探针测未来学习：把网络复制后在新任务上训 100 步；读预测结果前先校验探针，包括对保持函数的隐藏单元重缩放的单调响应、重复测量一致性（组内相关系数 ICC 0.940，[0.903, 0.997]，最不可靠一类，三次重复均值），以及单元重初始化在探针上立即可见、100–200 步后消失。伴随筛选在 1,560 次合成回归上预测更远的目标——该次运行的最终误差。
Result: 探针 ICC 0.940，90% 区间 [0.903, 0.997]（最不可靠类，三次重复均值）；主研究中 ≤4 维历史状态相对校准的当前状态模型增益 -21.4%，90% 区间 [-91.9, 8.1]，事先声明的门槛为 10%；合成回归筛选中历史模型在 12 个 epoch（上限 240）后优于当前验证误差，紧凑状态增益 30.3%，区间 [15.8, 39.4]（上下文对比），48 个 epoch 后与之不可区分。
Conclusion: 历史信息只在当前状态尚未对目标提供信息时才有预测价值；一旦当前状态变得有信息，历史不再带来增益。该判读是在看到结果之后形成的。

papers.title: The Identifiability and Observability of Deep Normalized Attention
papers.abstract_en: We study which parameters of deep, unmasked, single-head attention are determined by its input--output function. For known positive nonconstant real-analytic normalizers, the function generically determines the effective scores and combined value map up to the signs induced by even normalizers. This proves the real-analytic case of a conjecture of Henry--Marchetti--Kohn, including softmax. We then classify exceptional fibers under explicit normalizer conditions, identifying when collapse makes later scores unobservable, and establish sharp Taylor orders for local identification. Near simultaneous query/key collapse, we compute the complete native Jacobian decay spectrum on separating finite input banks. For common first nonconstant normalizer degree $k$, layer $i$ has contact order $2k3^{i-1}-1$, with exact multiplicities and kernel dimension. High-precision and automatic differentiation calculations illustrate the resulting loss of numerical sensitivity.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Second-order optimization of variable projection SVM models and road abnormality detection
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a novel second-order optimization framework for minimizing so-called variable projection functionals. We demonstrate that the proposed framework is especially usefulfor the training of variable projection based kernel methods. In particular, the problem of efficiently training variable projection support vector machines (VP-SVMs) is considered. We show the effectiveness of the proposed training methodology in a real-world application, namely we demonstrate how second-order trust region algorithms can be used to train VPSVM models to recognize road surface abnormalities based on 1D signals obtained from a tire sensor.
papers.journal_ref: Proc. IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech and Signal Processing (ICASSP 2026), Barcelona, Spain, 2026
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 变量投影类核方法（如 VP-SVM）的训练需要高效最小化变量投影泛函，一阶方法不足以高效求解该类问题。
Method: 构造变量投影泛函的二阶优化框架，具体采用二阶信赖域算法训练 VP-SVM 模型；应用侧输入为轮胎传感器采集的 1D 信号，任务是路面异常识别。
Result: 在真实应用中演示二阶信赖域算法可成功训练 VP-SVM 以识别基于轮胎传感器 1D 信号的路面异常；摘要未给出定量指标。

papers.title: Identity-Duplication Auditing in National-Scale Neuroimaging Repositories
authors: for the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative
Aging Brain Study : Health Disparities (HABS-HD) Study Team
papers.abstract_en: National-scale magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) repositories increasingly integrate data from different studies and institutions. However, subject identifiers that are valid only within individual datasets are no longer guaranteed to remain globally unique after aggregation, making it possible for the same subject to be assigned multiple identifiers, which we define as identity duplication. Such duplication can create leakage between training and test data and inflate apparent performance in downstream biomedical studies. Existing methods do not provide an end-to-end, image-based workflow for auditing this problem at repository scale. In this work, we present HAPPEN, a human-in-the-loop pipeline for auditing identity duplication in T1-weighted brain MRI repositories. It combines SHA-256 fingerprinting for exact-duplicate detection with supervised contrastive retrieval of non-identical scans that may originate from the same person. Retrieved pairs are reviewed as candidates in a locally hosted interface rather than automatically classified as duplicates. We deployed the workflow in a 95,129-scan aggregated repository and assessed end-to-end recovery using 54 genetic-reference pairs. Transferability was assessed by locally deploying the same workflow on 22,386 scans at an independent institution without model retraining or image transfer. Deployment in the study repository identified 1,316 exact-duplicate scan groups and 1,275 reviewer-supported near-duplicate subject groups. Of these groups, 56% and 82%, respectively, crossed dataset boundaries. All 54 genetic-reference pairs were recovered. The external team independently completed the full workflow using a locally selected operating threshold and review standard.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HAPPEN 是面向全国尺度 T1 脑 MRI 库的身份重复审计流水线：SHA-256 指纹抓精确重复，监督对比检索抓非同一扫描的疑似同一人，候选对交由本地人工界面复核而非自动判重。在 95,129 扫描的聚合库中识别 1,316 个精确重复组与 1,275 个人工支持的近重复个体组，其中 56% 与 82% 跨数据集边界，54 对遗传参考对全部找回。
Motivation: 多机构聚合后各数据集内部有效的受试者 ID 不再全局唯一，同一人可能被分配多个标识，造成训练/测试泄漏并虚高下游生物医学研究性能；现有方法缺少仓库尺度、端到端、基于图像的审计流程。
Method: HAPPEN 是 human-in-the-loop 流水线：SHA-256 指纹检测精确重复，监督对比检索 (supervised contrastive retrieval) 找出可能来自同一人的非同一扫描，检索到的候选对在本地托管界面中由人工复核而非自动分类；工作流在独立机构本地部署，使用本地选定的操作阈值与复核标准，无需模型重训练或图像外传。
Result: 在 95,129 扫描的聚合库中识别 1,316 个精确重复扫描组与 1,275 个人工支持的近重复个体组，跨数据集边界的比例分别为 56% 和 82%；54 对遗传参考对全部被找回。外部团队在 22,386 扫描的独立机构本地部署同一工作流，未重训练、未传输图像，独立完成全流程。
Conclusion: 哈希指纹与监督对比检索加人工复核的组合能在仓库尺度端到端找回身份重复，且跨机构本地部署即可迁移，无需共享图像或重训练。

papers.title: Residual Learning in Empirical Asset Pricing
papers.abstract_en: Shallow models are special cases of deep models, and deep models theoretically have the potential to outperform the shallow ones. However, the existing empirical asset pricing literature provides strong benchmarks for shallow models. Residual learning allows neural network models in asset pricing to go deeper by preserving and refining their shallow counterparts. The out-of-sample Sharpe ratio for value-weighted long-short portfolios of deep residual models (2.07) is higher than that for the corresponding shallow ones (1.92) and more than twice that of the deep feedforward models (0.89). We show that model depth is a source of additional economic value in asset pricing. Residual learning can be used to deepen other neural-network-based asset pricing models if they contain intermediate layers. Our design also provides one way to scale asset pricing models, making native "large asset pricing models" more feasible.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把残差学习 (residual learning) 引入实证资产定价：深度残差网络保留并精修浅层基准模型，使深度真正带来增量经济价值。价值加权多空组合的样本外 Sharpe 比从浅层模型的 1.92 提到 2.07，是对应深度前馈网络 0.89 的两倍以上。
Motivation: 实证资产定价文献中浅层模型基准很强，而深度模型理论上虽有优势却难以在样本外超越浅层基准，深度带来的经济价值缺乏直接证据。
Method: 用残差学习让神经网络在保留浅层对应模型输出的基础上叠加精修，从而在含中间层的神经网络资产定价模型上加深；设计同时提供一种扩展资产定价模型规模的路径。
Result: 价值加权多空组合样本外 Sharpe 比：深度残差模型 2.07，对应浅层模型 1.92，深度前馈模型 0.89（残差模型为其两倍以上）。
Conclusion: 模型深度是资产定价中额外经济价值的来源；凡含中间层的神经网络资产定价模型都可用残差学习加深，并使原生“大型资产定价模型”更可行。

papers.title: Sequential Pretraining Favors Large Models
papers.abstract_en: Large neural networks often acquire capabilities that small models fail to learn. Does this stem from large models learning more representative features, or from being more robust to unaccounted-for adverse effects introduced during training? We define and quantify one such adverse effect, primacy bias, as the extent to which exposure to early data distributions impairs later learning. We show that small models can allocate learning capacity inefficiently toward early distributions, whereas sufficiently overparameterized models are robust to this effect. This inefficiency is particularly consequential in pretraining, where foundation models often encounter heterogeneous data distributions sequentially rather than jointly. As a result, small foundation models can struggle to learn distributions encountered late in training, which is particularly harmful when later data emphasizes desirable capabilities such as code, mathematics, and reasoning. Motivated by these findings, we introduce Exposure Therapy (ET), a simple regularization that promotes more efficient allocation of learning capacity during sequential pretraining. We demonstrate that ET improves foundation models' performance on late data distributions as well as overall capability in models up to the billion-parameter scale. Overall, our results suggest that some benefits of large foundation models may arise from greater robustness to adverse training effects, rather than from learning more representative features, and that improved training algorithms can recover some of these advantages in smaller models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 定义并量化 primacy bias（早期数据分布损害后续学习的程度），指出小模型会把容量低效地分配给早期分布，而足够过参数化的模型对此稳健。据此提出正则化方法 Exposure Therapy (ET)，在十亿参数量级内提升基础模型对后期数据分布的性能与整体能力。
Motivation: 基础模型预训练常按顺序而非联合地遇到异构数据分布，小模型难以学到训练后期的分布，尤其当后期数据强调代码、数学与推理等能力时损失明显。
Method: 先定义并量化 primacy bias 这一训练中的不利效应，展示小模型与过参数化模型在容量分配上的差异；再据此提出正则化方法 Exposure Therapy (ET)，促进顺序预训练中学习容量的高效分配。
Result: ET 改善基础模型在后期数据分布上的性能与整体能力，验证规模达到十亿参数量级 (billion-parameter scale)。
Conclusion: 大模型的部分收益来自对不良训练效应的稳健性而非更具代表性的特征，改进训练算法可在小模型上回收这些优势。

papers.title: Decoupled Optimization for Teacher-Student Semi-Supervised Learning via a Pioneer Student
papers.abstract_en: Semi-supervised learning (SSL) relies on two core mechanisms: self-training under the Teacher-Student (T-S) framework and joint optimization of labeled and unlabeled losses. Despite their effectiveness, we find both mechanisms introduce distinct optimization pathologies. First, parameter coupling enforces strict synchronization between teacher and student, where strong regularization on the student degrades the teacher's fitting ability, thereby limiting the permissible generalization intensity. Second, the imbalance in gradient update consistency between labeled and unlabeled losses drives the shared parameters to prematurely converge to labeled-dominated local minima, creating a bottleneck for global optimization. To address both issues, we propose the Pioneer Student (PiS), an auxiliary branch that operates in an independent parameter space and periodically transfers accumulated knowledge back to the T-S model. Extensive experiments show that PiS is a universal plug-and-play module that consistently improves mainstream SSL methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 半监督学习中，师生 (Teacher-Student) 参数耦合使学生的强正则拖垮教师拟合能力，且有标/无标损失梯度更新不一致让共享参数过早收敛到有标主导的局部极小。提出的 Pioneer Student (PiS) 在独立参数空间训练并周期性把累积知识回传给 T-S 模型，作为即插即用模块一致提升主流 SSL 方法。
Motivation: 自训练与有标/无标联合优化是 SSL 的两大机制，但前者受参数耦合限制了可允许的泛化强度，后者使共享参数过早收敛到有标主导的局部极小，形成全局优化瓶颈。
Method: 提出 Pioneer Student (PiS)：一个运行在独立参数空间的辅助分支，周期性地将累积知识迁移回 Teacher-Student 模型，分别针对参数耦合与梯度更新不一致两类优化病理。
Result: 在主流 SSL 方法上的广泛实验显示 PiS 是通用即插即用模块，能一致提升其性能。
Conclusion: 把辅助学生放到独立参数空间并周期回传知识，可同时缓解 T-S 耦合与有标/无标梯度失衡两类病理，作为通用模块接入现有 SSL。

papers.title: Which Language Should a Skeleton Speak? Language Choices in Multilingual Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Skeleton-based reasoning prompting is a promising training-free approach for structuring LLM reasoning, but prior work largely assumes an English-centric setting. We propose the Language-Aware Skeleton Exploration Framework (LASEF) to study skeleton-language choice in multilingual mathematical reasoning. Across math benchmarks, model scales, and languages, we show that English skeletons yield a small positive tendency on average, most visible for smaller models and low-resource languages. However, few language-level gains remain significant after correction, and English is not universally optimal. Combining greedy decoding, multi-rollout evaluation, translation ablation, and cross-benchmark validation, we further find three patterns of skeleton-language effects: directionally consistent, evaluation- and benchmark-dependent, and asymmetric negative. These effects cannot be fully explained by generation quality alone. Overall, skeleton language is a context-dependent design variable that requires multi-level exploration. All resources are released at https://github.com/lhsstn/LASEF.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LASEF 系统考察多语言数学推理中 skeleton-based reasoning prompting 该用哪种语言写骨架，发现英语骨架平均只有小幅正向倾向，在小模型和低资源语言上最明显，但经多重比较校正后多数语言级增益不再显著，英语并非普遍最优。骨架语言效应分为方向一致、依赖评测与基准、非对称负向三类，且无法仅由生成质量解释，因此骨架语言应作为依赖上下文的设计变量做多层级探索。
Motivation: Skeleton-based prompting 是免训练的 LLM 推理结构化方法，但既有工作基本默认英语中心设定，多语言场景下骨架语言如何选择缺乏系统研究。
Method: 提出 Language-Aware Skeleton Exploration Framework (LASEF)，跨多个数学基准、模型规模与语言考察 skeleton-language 选择，结合 greedy decoding、multi-rollout evaluation、translation ablation 与 cross-benchmark validation，并对语言级增益做显著性校正。
Result: 英语骨架平均呈小幅正向倾向，在小模型与低资源语言上最明显；但校正后仅少数语言级增益仍显著。骨架语言效应呈现三类模式：方向一致、依赖评测与基准、非对称负向，且不能完全由生成质量解释。
Conclusion: 骨架语言不是可默认英语的固定选择，而是依赖上下文的设计变量，需要在模型规模、语言与基准多个层级上分别检验；资源已在 github.com/lhsstn/LASEF 开源。

papers.title: Lightweight and Versatile Learned Optimization by Recombination of Gradient History
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a lightweight and versatile learned optimizer that dynamically recombines gradient history, represented as averages over disjoint time spans. The optimizer reduces the prediction space to one scalar coefficient per gradient average, shared by multiple parameters. Progressively averaging older gradients minimizes memory cost of long history, while keeping their contributions independently accessible. A 37k-parameter network trained in 0.87 GPU-hours generalizes zero-shot to unseen tasks, lowering validation loss by 9.1% and 0.4% on BERT-Tiny and GPT-Tiny, and improving test accuracy over Adam by 3.5 %p on a Vision Transformer and by 2.7 %p on average across nine graph models, with FLOPs overhead as low as 0.3%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种轻量可迁移的学习型优化器：把梯度历史按不相交时间窗取平均，网络只预测每个梯度均值的一个标量系数并由多参数共享，从而把长历史的显存压到最低。37k 参数、0.87 GPU-hours 训练后零样本迁移到未见任务，BERT-Tiny 与 GPT-Tiny 验证损失分别降 9.1% 与 0.4%，Vision Transformer 测试精度比 Adam 高 3.5 %p，九个图模型平均高 2.7 %p，FLOPs 开销低至 0.3%。
Motivation: 学习型优化器通常参数多、显存开销大且难以零样本迁移到未见任务，长梯度历史的存储成本是核心瓶颈。
Method: 将梯度历史表示为若干不相交时间窗上的平均，逐步平均更老的梯度以降低长历史显存；预测空间压缩为每个梯度均值一个标量系数并由多个参数共享，由一个 37k 参数网络生成，训练成本 0.87 GPU-hours。
Result: 零样本迁移到未见任务：BERT-Tiny 验证损失降低 9.1%，GPT-Tiny 降低 0.4%；Vision Transformer 测试精度比 Adam 高 3.5 %p；九个图模型上平均高 2.7 %p；FLOPs 开销低至 0.3%。
Conclusion: 把梯度历史压缩成按时间窗平均的标量系数，可以用极小网络与极低训练成本得到跨任务通用的优化器，且计算开销可忽略。

papers.title: Cluster-Robust Prediction-Powered Inference
papers.abstract_en: Data collection is often costly or logistically demanding, limiting both the questions researchers can pursue and how precisely they can answer them. Prediction-powered inference (PPI) can reduce the amount of data needed for precise parameter estimation by combining labeled data with machine learning predictions. However, ignoring dependence within clusters can produce confidence intervals that cover the true parameter less often than their nominal rate. We introduce Cluster-Robust PPI++, which provides standard errors in closed form and asymptotically valid confidence intervals under arbitrary dependence within independent clusters, requiring no bootstrap or resampling. Our central contribution is to accommodate partially labeled clusters, a common empirical setting in which clusters contain both labeled and unlabeled units. As units are dependent within clusters, partially labeled clusters violate the independence assumption of PPI++. We also show how precision increases depend on the labeling design, and derive a cluster-aware power tuning rule that minimizes asymptotic variance. In an application to television news, standard PPI++ confidence intervals have coverage below 60%, whereas Cluster-Robust PPI++ can achieve nominal 95% coverage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Cluster-Robust PPI++ 在独立簇内允许任意相关，给出闭式标准误与渐近有效置信区间，无需 bootstrap 或重采样，并处理簇内部分标注这一常见设定。在电视新闻应用中，标准 PPI++ 的置信区间覆盖率低于 60%，而 Cluster-Robust PPI++ 可达到名义 95% 覆盖率。
Motivation: 预测驱动推断 (PPI) 用机器学习预测加少量标注数据降低参数估计所需样本量，但忽略簇内依赖会让置信区间覆盖率低于名义水平；部分标注簇还直接违反 PPI++ 的独立性假设。
Method: 提出 Cluster-Robust PPI++：在独立簇内允许任意依赖，推导闭式标准误与渐近有效置信区间，无需 bootstrap 或重采样；核心是处理同时含标注与未标注单元的部分标注簇，并推导依赖标注设计的精度增益与最小化渐近方差的簇感知功效调参规则 (cluster-aware power tuning rule)。
Result: 在电视新闻应用中，标准 PPI++ 置信区间覆盖率低于 60%，Cluster-Robust PPI++ 可达到名义 95% 覆盖率；精度增益随标注设计变化，并给出最小化渐近方差的调参规则。
Conclusion: 簇内依赖必须在 PPI 推断中显式处理：簇稳健版本在部分标注簇下恢复名义覆盖率，且无需重采样即可给出闭式标准误。

papers.title: SafeEvo: Deciphering the Safety Alignment Mechanism and Evolution in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Safety interpretability advances the study of Large Language Model (LLM) alignment from behavioral constraints driven by data or algorithms towards a deeper understanding of internal mechanisms. However, existing works have focused primarily on safety-related representations, attention heads, or neurons after alignment, while largely overlooking the safety mechanisms in pretrained-only models and their evolution across alignment checkpoints. To address this, we propose SafeEvo, an interpretability framework from the circuit (sparse subgraphs of an LLM) perspective. SafeEvo first applies an optimization-based extraction algorithm to identify weak refusal circuits in pretrained base LLMs that can independently express refusal behavior. Causally ablating these circuits completely eliminates the base model's refusal of harmful inputs. SafeEvo then traces the evolution of refusal circuits across successive alignment checkpoints and finds that their structures change progressively, suggesting that the alignment tax may result from refusal-circuit updates affecting utility-related parameters. To validate this, SafeEvo introduces Safety Circuit Alignment (SCA), which confines safety updates to the refusal circuits. Experiments across three LLMs and two alignment algorithms show that, on average, SCA outperforms vanilla alignment in three aspects: \textbf{(1) stronger alignment}, lowering harmfulness score by 63.21\%; \textbf{(2) less over-refusal}, yielding a 58.44\% decrease in refusal rates for benign queries; and \textbf{(3) better utility}, retaining 99.58\% of the original model capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SafeEvo 从 circuit（LLM 稀疏子图）视角解剖安全对齐：先用基于优化的提取算法在预训练基座模型中找出可独立表达拒绝行为的弱拒绝电路，因果消融后基座模型对有害输入的拒绝被完全消除；再追踪这些电路在各对齐 checkpoint 间的演化，发现其结构渐进变化，提示 alignment tax 源于拒绝电路更新波及效用相关参数。据此提出 Safety Circuit Alignment (SCA)，把安全更新限制在拒绝电路内，在三个 LLM、两种对齐算法上平均使 harmfulness score 降低 63.21%、良性查询拒绝率下降 58.44%、保留原模型能力的 99.58%。
Motivation: 现有安全可解释性工作只看对齐后的安全表征、注意力头或神经元，忽略了预训练基座模型内部的安全机制及其跨对齐 checkpoint 的演化，因而无法解释 alignment tax 的来源。
Method: SafeEvo 分两步：用基于优化的提取算法在预训练基座 LLM 中定位弱拒绝电路并做因果消融验证其充分性；随后跨连续对齐 checkpoint 追踪拒绝电路结构演化，据此设计 Safety Circuit Alignment (SCA)，把安全更新约束在拒绝电路内，在三个 LLM 与两种对齐算法上与 vanilla alignment 对比。
Result: SCA 在三个 LLM、两种对齐算法上平均相比 vanilla alignment：harmfulness score 下降 63.21%，良性查询拒绝率下降 58.44%，保留原模型能力 99.58%；因果消融弱拒绝电路使基座模型对有害输入的拒绝完全消除。
Conclusion: 安全对齐可以只更新拒绝电路而同时改善对齐强度、减少过度拒绝并保住效用，alignment tax 很可能来自拒绝电路更新对效用相关参数的连带改动。

papers.title: STORK: Spatio-Temporal Observation of uterine contRactions via neural networKs
papers.abstract_en: Uterine contractions in fetal MRI are typically identified manually and discarded, limiting insights into contraction dynamics. We formalize Uterine Contractile Activity Detection (UCAD) as a weakly-supervised learning problem and introduce STORK, a multi-instance learning model trained on dynamic MRI series using only coarse, series-level labels. STORK factorizes 3D spatio-temporal convolutions into parallel branches across temporal hyperplanes to capture coherent tissue motion without the cost of full 4D convolutions. Per-frame embeddings, combining intensity and Demons-estimated displacement fields, are aggregated by a linear mean-pooling head. This ensures that frame-level contraction scores can be recovered post-hoc without frame-level training supervision. Evaluated on around 700 multi-vendor dynamic fetal MRI series, STORK achieves a series-level AUROC of 95.0% and AUPRC of 94.6%, substantially outperforming 3D ResNet and ConvNeXt baselines. Grad-CAM analysis suggests that the model draws on predictive features extending beyond the placenta into the uterine tissue, offering an automated tool for richer phenotyping of uterine behavior.
papers.comment: Accepted at the PIPPI Workshop at MICCAI 2026 and will appear in the workshop proceedings (Springer)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把胎儿 MRI 中的子宫收缩检测形式化为弱监督多实例学习问题 UCAD，STORK 用分解的时空卷积分支加 Demons 位移场特征，在约 700 个多厂商动态胎儿 MRI 序列上取得序列级 AUROC 95.0%、AUPRC 94.6%，明显优于 3D ResNet 与 ConvNeXt 基线，并可在无帧级标注下事后恢复逐帧收缩分数。
Motivation: 胎儿 MRI 中的子宫收缩目前靠人工识别并被直接丢弃，既费力又使收缩动力学信息流失，缺少自动检测手段。
Method: STORK 是多实例学习 (multi-instance learning) 模型，只用序列级粗标签训练：把 3D 时空卷积分解为沿时间超平面的并行分支以捕捉组织相干运动，逐帧 embedding 融合强度与 Demons 估计的位移场，再由线性 mean-pooling 头聚合，从而事后恢复逐帧收缩分数。
Result: 在约 700 个多厂商动态胎儿 MRI 序列上，序列级 AUROC 95.0%、AUPRC 94.6%，大幅优于 3D ResNet 与 ConvNeXt 基线；Grad-CAM 显示模型利用的判别特征超出胎盘、延伸到子宫组织。
Conclusion: 仅靠序列级弱标签即可自动检测子宫收缩并给出可解释的逐帧分数，为子宫行为表型提供自动化工具。

papers.title: COPC: Coupled Off-Policy Correction for Asynchronous LLM Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Asynchronous RL accelerates large language model post-training by decoupling rollout generation from optimization, but trains on stale trajectories. Existing methods primarily correct token-level policy mismatch through importance-ratio control in the actor objective. We show that this \emph{policy-side correction} alone is insufficient: advantage estimates also inherit mismatch from behavior-policy continuations, which we term \emph{advantage staleness}. We derive exact bias and variance decompositions for a general two-channel actor update, revealing nonseparable coupling between policy-weight and advantage-estimation errors: their interaction induces multiplicative bias terms, while squared policy weights amplify advantage uncertainty in gradient variance. This motivates the hypothesis that policy- and advantage-side correction should be coordinated. We introduce Coupled Off-Policy Correction (COPC), an actor--critic method combining token-level ratio masking with two-sided clipped-ratio weighting of TD residuals for return and advantage estimation. Joint parameter sweeps across staleness levels support this hypothesis: the effect of one correction parameter depends on, and can reverse with, the other. COPC achieves the highest reported performance on tool-integrated mathematical reasoning and search, outperforming the strongest reported asynchronous baseline in each setting. It also offers a broad high-performing parameter region and improved training stability. In search, COPC remains stable throughout training, while most evaluated asynchronous baselines collapse late in training. These gains persist at 64-step policy staleness. COPC adds minimal step-time overhead over asynchronous PPO and retains a $1.7\times$ step-time speedup over synchronous PPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: COPC 指出异步 LLM 强化学习中只在 actor 目标里做 token 级重要性比校正不够，因为 advantage 也继承了 behavior-policy 续写带来的失配（advantage staleness）。它把 ratio masking 与对 TD 残差的双侧 clipped-ratio 加权联合起来，在 64 步策略陈旧度下仍保持稳定，并保留相对同步 PPO 的 1.7× 步时加速。
Motivation: 异步 RL 把 rollout 与优化解耦以加速 LLM 后训练，但训练用的是陈旧轨迹；现有方法只在 actor 目标里用重要性比控制 token 级策略失配，忽略了 advantage 估计同样失配。
Method: COPC 是 actor–critic 方法：token 级 ratio masking 加上对 TD 残差做双侧 clipped-ratio 加权，用于回报与 advantage 估计；作者先对一般两通道 actor 更新推导精确的偏差与方差分解，显示策略权重误差与 advantage 估计误差非可分耦合（交互产生乘性偏差、平方策略权重放大梯度方差中的 advantage 不确定性），再做跨陈旧度的联合参数扫描。
Result: 联合参数扫描显示一个校正参数的作用依赖于另一个、甚至可随其反号；COPC 在工具集成数学推理与搜索两个设定上均取得所报告的最高性能，各自超过最强的异步基线，并在搜索任务中全程稳定而多数被评异步基线在训练后期崩溃；这些增益在 64 步策略陈旧度下保持，相对同步 PPO 保留 1.7× 步时加速，相对异步 PPO 步时开销极小。
Conclusion: 策略侧与 advantage 侧的陈旧度校正必须协调设计，单侧重要性比控制不足以支撑高陈旧度下的异步 LLM RL；COPC 提供了宽的高性能参数区与更好的训练稳定性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Structured pre-generation elicitation versus single-shot prompting in AI-assisted enterprise decision-making: a randomised online experiment
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI speeds, and mostly improves, professional work, but there is concern that users who delegate both the production and the evaluation of an answer may accept weak output and engage less with the underlying reasoning (cognitive surrender). Interventions proposed so far, such as unassisted practice or slowing adoption, sit outside the working task. We tested a different approach: an interactive metacognitive scaffolding layer (Cognistance, a prototype developed at the Oxford Centre for Impact Research (OCIR) that asks users to clarify context, choose a strategic direction and explain their reasoning before the AI generates a deliverable). Mean composite quality was 32% higher with the scaffold, with the same direction for every rater. Gains were largest for trade-off articulation and strategic coherence and absent for technical specificity. A large part of the aggregate effect reflected rescue of weak prompts: floor-scored (off-task) deliverables fell from 34% to 5%. Among participants whose own prompt already stated the data-localisation problem, the advantage was 21%. Treatment participants reported greater involvement and took about 2.4 minutes longer on average (10.46 minutes). Immediate recall scores were higher, which tentatively suggests better retention, but in this limited experiment, was not robust to sensitivity analyses. Self-ratings of quality did not track rated quality in either condition. Structured elicitation before generation improved the rated quality and task relevance of AI-assisted strategy documents at modest cost in time. Delayed retention, error detection and effects in live organisations are the priorities for the next stage of research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在企业战略文档的 AI 辅助写作中，先让用户澄清背景、选定战略方向并说明推理、再让 AI 生成（Cognistance 交互式元认知脚手架），比单次提示 (single-shot prompting) 把文档平均综合质量提高 32%，且所有评分者方向一致。质量提升主要来自挽救弱提示：离题 (floor-scored) 交付物从 34% 降到 5%；参与者自己已写出数据本地化问题时优势缩到 21%。代价是人均多花约 2.4 分钟（处理组 10.46 分钟）。
Motivation: 用户把生成与评估都交给 AI 时容易接受弱输出、不再参与底层推理（cognitive surrender）。已有对策（无辅助练习、放慢采用）都在工作流程之外，需要一个嵌在任务内的干预。
Method: 随机在线实验比较两条件：结构化生成前引导（Cognistance，Oxford Centre for Impact Research 原型，先澄清上下文、选战略方向、解释推理，再由 AI 生成交付物）对比单次提示；由多名评分者对战略文档打综合质量分，并记录离题比例、自评质量与即时回忆得分。
Result: 脚手架组平均综合质量高 32%，每位评分者方向一致；增益最大的是 trade-off articulation 与 strategic coherence，technical specificity 无增益。离题交付物从 34% 降至 5%；在参与者提示已点明 data-localisation 问题的子组中优势为 21%。处理组报告更高投入，平均多用约 2.4 分钟（总时长 10.46 分钟）。即时回忆得分更高但对敏感性分析不稳健；两组自评质量都与评分者质量不对应。
Conclusion: 生成前的结构化引导以小幅时间成本提升 AI 辅助战略文档的评分质量与任务相关性，作用主要来自兜住弱提示；延迟保持、错误检测与真实组织中的效果是下一阶段重点。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Scalable Logistic Gaussian Process Density Regression with Kinetic Langevin Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Conditional density estimation targets the full distribution of a response given covariates, as required, for example, for per-galaxy photometric redshifts. We develop a scalable Bayesian estimator based on the logistic Gaussian process. The log conditional density has a separable covariance: a Matérn kernel along the response, represented in a truncated Fourier basis on a circle, and a covariate kernel represented by Nyström features, which accommodate non-stationary kernels with input-dependent amplitudes and length scales. Instead of a Laplace or variational approximation, we sample the latent field of this finite-feature model. Given the hyperparameters, its posterior is strongly log-concave with a uniformly bounded Hessian, and we draw from it by simulating kinetic Langevin dynamics with symmetric minibatch splitting in Kronecker-whitened coordinates. Marginal-likelihood gradients follow from Fisher's identity as posterior expectations. Under the conditions of our analysis their bias is controlled by the sampler's step size and run length, and the predictive averages over the non-Gaussian latent posterior instead of a Gaussian around its mode. On photometric-redshift benchmarks with up to 3.9 million training observations, trained on a single GPU, the estimator is competitive with state-of-the-art tabular foundation models on density and calibration metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可扩展的 logistic Gaussian process 条件密度估计器：对数密度协方差可分离（响应维用 Matérn 核 + 圆上截断 Fourier 基，协变量维用 Nyström 特征），并用 kinetic Langevin 动力学直接采样有限特征模型的潜场后验。在多达 390 万训练样本、单 GPU 的光度红移基准上，其密度与校准指标与表格基础模型 (tabular foundation models) 相当。
Motivation: 条件密度估计需要给出响应的完整分布（如逐星系光度红移），但大规模表格数据上常用的 Laplace 或变分近似会损失后验的非高斯性，且难以扩展到百万级样本。
Method: log 条件密度采用可分离协方差：响应维为 Matérn 核并在圆上以截断 Fourier 基表示，协变量维用 Nyström 特征以容纳非平稳核（输入依赖的幅度与长度尺度）。给定超参数后潜场后验强对数凹且 Hessian 一致有界，用 Kronecker 白化坐标下对称 minibatch 划分的 kinetic Langevin 动力学采样；边缘似然梯度由 Fisher's identity 转化为后验期望，其偏差由步长与运行长度控制，预测对非高斯潜后验取平均而非在众数处的高斯。
Result: 在多达 390 万条训练观测的光度红移基准上、单 GPU 训练，该估计器在密度与校准指标上与最先进表格基础模型相当。
Conclusion: 不依赖 Laplace/变分近似、直接采样强对数凹潜后验的 logistic GP 可以扩展到百万级表格条件密度估计，并在光度红移上达到表格基础模型的竞争力。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Learning Situation-Conditioned Thinking Policies for Long-Term LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-running autonomous agents must reuse accumulated reasoning experience without allowing explicit historical memory and LLM context to grow indefinitely. However, existing memory mechanisms mainly retrieve, summarize, or compress past content and do not directly learn when particular kinds of thinking should be activated or discover new thinking knowledge from temporally dispersed experiences. This paper proposes a situation-conditioned thinking memory framework that transforms historical reasoning experience into a lightweight policy for predicting what should be thought about in the current situation, while leaving detailed reasoning to a large language model. Situations may represent temporal or spatiotemporal evolution rather than only current states. Temporary experiences are also periodically analyzed across multiple independent episodes to identify repeated long-range regularities, which are consolidated into new thinking knowledge and further internalized by the lightweight policy. Experiments show that the learned policy achieves 1.000 F1 on temporal-rule generalization, improves DeepSeek reasoning F1 from 0.789 to 0.868, reduces online processing time from 0.3636 ms to 0.0382 ms per query at 30,000 historical situations, and reaches 1.000 relation-discovery F1 and future-thinking accuracy after sufficient repeated cross-experience evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 situation-conditioned thinking memory：把历史推理经验压成一个轻量策略，只预测当前情境该想什么，具体推理仍交给 LLM。在时间规则泛化上 F1 达 1.000，DeepSeek 推理 F1 从 0.789 提到 0.868，30,000 个历史情境下每查询在线处理时间从 0.3636 ms 降到 0.0382 ms。
Motivation: 长时自主 agent 的显式历史记忆与 LLM 上下文会无限增长；现有记忆机制只做检索、摘要或压缩，不学习何时激活某类思考，也无法从时间上分散的经验中发现新的思考知识。
Method: 把历史推理经验转成情境条件的轻量思考策略，情境可表示时间或时空演化而非仅当前状态；定期跨多个独立 episode 分析临时经验，识别长程重复规律并固化为新思考知识，再由该轻量策略内化，详细推理留给 LLM。
Result: 时间规则泛化 F1 1.000；DeepSeek 推理 F1 由 0.789 提升到 0.868；在 30,000 个历史情境下每查询在线处理时间由 0.3636 ms 降至 0.0382 ms；关系发现 F1 与 future-thinking accuracy 在充分的跨经验重复证据后达到 1.000。
Conclusion: 把「何时思考什么」学成轻量情境策略、把细节推理留给 LLM，可在不扩张上下文的前提下保住长时 agent 的推理质量并大幅降低在线开销。

papers.title: Dual- versus Single-Suggestion AI Support for Radiographic Interpretation in Residents: Randomized Multireader Study
papers.abstract_en: Purpose: To compare dual- and single-suggestion AI support for radiographic interpretation by residents, particularly when the shared AI suggestion was incorrect. Materials and Methods: This prospective, multicenter, randomized three-arm reader study was conducted at three hospitals in China from July to September 2026 (ChiCTR2600129243). After specialty stratification, 132 residents with fewer than 3 years of clinical experience were randomized 1:1:1 to GPT-5.4 alone (group A), GPT-5.4 plus Kimi-K2.6 (group B), or GPT-5.4 plus Gemini-3.6 Flash (group C); 123 were analyzed. Participants interpreted 60 radiographs before and after AI support. The primary outcome was accuracy change. Welch ANOVA and Holm-adjusted t tests compared support conditions; HC3 linear models assessed specialty interaction. Results: Among 123 residents (mean age, 24.1 years +/- 1.4; 65 women), radiology residents showed greater accuracy improvement with dual- than single-suggestion support (B-A, 6.69 percentage points [95% CI, 0.97-12.40]; C-A, 7.87 percentage points [95% CI, 1.64-14.11]; Holm-adjusted P = .030 for both), whereas accuracy change did not differ in non-radiology residents (P = .20). When GPT-5.4 was incorrect, AI-assisted accuracy was higher with dual- than single-suggestion support in radiology residents (40.1% and 40.4% vs 20.0%) and non-radiology residents (31.3% and 31.0% vs 12.1%) (all Holm-adjusted P < .001). The dual-suggestion effect differed by specialty (interaction difference, 10.44 percentage points; 95% CI, 4.36-16.52; P < .001). Conclusion: Dual-suggestion support may mitigate the influence of erroneous AI suggestions, with greater accuracy improvement observed in radiology but not non-radiology residents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在三中心随机三臂读者研究中，132 名住院医师（分析 123 名）分别用 GPT-5.4 单建议、GPT-5.4+Kimi-K2.6 或 GPT-5.4+Gemini-3.6 Flash 辅助读片。放射科住院医师双建议比单建议的准确率提升多 6.69–7.87 个百分点，且在 GPT-5.4 判断错误时双建议组准确率约 40% 对单建议 20%，非放射科无差异。
Motivation: AI 建议本身可能出错，住院医师（<3 年经验）容易被错误建议带偏；需要判断多来源第二建议能否在共享建议错误时保住读片准确率。
Method: 前瞻多中心随机三臂读者研究（ChiCTR2600129243，中国三家医院，2026 年 7–9 月），按专业分层后 1:1:1 随机 132 名住院医师至 GPT-5.4 单用、GPT-5.4+Kimi-K2.6、GPT-5.4+Gemini-3.6 Flash；每人解读 60 张影像的 AI 辅助前后各一次，主结局为准确率变化，用 Welch ANOVA、Holm 校正 t 检验与 HC3 线性模型检验专业交互。
Result: 分析 123 人（平均 24.1±1.4 岁，65 名女性）。放射科住院医师双建议较单建议准确率提升更多：B-A 6.69 个百分点（95% CI 0.97–12.40），C-A 7.87 个百分点（95% CI 1.64–14.11），Holm 校正 P=.030；非放射科无差异（P=.20）。GPT-5.4 错误时，放射科双建议组准确率 40.1%/40.4% 对单建议 20.0%，非放射科 31.3%/31.0% 对 12.1%（均 Holm 校正 P<.001）。专业交互差异 10.44 个百分点（95% CI 4.36–16.52，P<.001）。
Conclusion: 双建议支持可在共享 AI 建议出错时减轻其负面影响，且效果主要出现在放射科住院医师，非放射科住院医师未见准确率改善。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Adaptive Code Generation for Controlling Robots
papers.abstract_en: Deploying robots as Complex Adaptive Systems (CAS) in unknown and dynamic environments necessitates a transition from rigid command libraries toward intention-based autonomy, as natural language represents the only medium capable of articulating complex goals beyond the capacity of finite instruction sets. While Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a path toward natural language goal description, their integration introduces significant challenges: the formalization gap between imprecise intentions and executable actions, the taxonomy gap induced by unpredictable environments, and the challenge of maintaining temporal state and progress awareness. This work introduces an architectural framework that enables robotic control by leveraging generative AI. The system follows a dual-AI design: an LLM translates high-level intentions into executable program code restricted to a formal robotic library and constrained by verifiable syntax, while a Vision-Language Model (VLM) provides semantic grounding via a distillation process. To ensure robustness, the framework incorporates environment-driven replanning triggers based on geometric and semantic thresholds, complemented by continuous runtime monitoring and an adaptive planning loop. Benchmarked across frontier models, our framework architecture demonstrates that grounding generative AI in a reactive, constrained loop enables robust fulfillment of complex intentions in dynamic and unknown environments.
papers.comment: International Symposium on Leveraging Applications of Formal Methods, Verification, and Validation 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出双 AI 机器人控制框架：LLM 把高层意图翻译成受限于形式化机器人指令库、且语法可验证的可执行代码，VLM 通过蒸馏提供语义 grounding，并由几何与语义阈值触发的环境驱动重规划、持续运行时监控和自适应规划闭环兜底。在前沿模型上的基准测试表明，把生成式 AI 放进这个反应式受约束循环，能在动态未知环境中稳健完成复杂意图。
Motivation: 机器人作为复杂自适应系统 (CAS) 在未知动态环境中部署时，有限的固定指令库无法表达复杂目标，而 LLM 引入意图到可执行动作的形式化鸿沟、不可预测环境带来的分类学鸿沟，以及时间状态与进度感知三重难题。
Method: 双 AI 架构：LLM 将高层意图生成受限于形式化机器人库、带可验证语法的程序代码；Vision-Language Model (VLM) 经蒸馏过程提供语义 grounding；以几何与语义阈值为环境驱动的重规划触发条件，配合持续运行时监控与自适应规划循环。
Result: 在 frontier 模型上进行基准测试，结果显示该框架架构使生成式 AI 在反应式受约束循环中能够稳健完成动态未知环境中的复杂意图；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 把 LLM 代码生成约束在可验证的形式化指令库内、并用 VLM grounding 与阈值触发重规划闭环兜底，是让自然语言意图在动态未知环境中可靠落地为机器人控制的可行架构路径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Collaborative Reasoning Distillation via Cross-Feedback and Coherent Curation
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning capabilities are critical for advancing Large Language Models, yet current approaches either require massive computational budgets or struggle to effectively distill reasoning to smaller models. Standard distillation methods rely on outcome-based rewards, failing to distinguish between sound reasoning and lucky guesses. We propose Collaborative Reasoning Distillation (CRD), a framework that enhances reasoning in compact models through three innovations: (1) interactive cross-feedback where teachers iteratively critique each other's reasoning, (2) fine-grained step-wise quality assessment capturing logical validity independent of final answers, and (3) coherence-aware step stitching that synthesizes complementary strengths. Students are trained via Reasoning Quality Optimization (RQO) with budget constraints. Our model, CRD-4B, achieves 97.3% on MATH-500 and 70.3% on AIME'25, surpassing baselines while using only 50K training examples, up to 12 times smaller than the datasets of comparable models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出协作式推理蒸馏 (CRD)，让多个教师互相批评推理过程、按步骤而非按最终答案打分，再用一致性感知的步骤拼接合成训练数据，学生以带预算约束的 Reasoning Quality Optimization (RQO) 训练。CRD-4B 在 MATH-500 上达到 97.3%、AIME'25 上 70.3%，仅用 50K 训练样本即超过基线，数据量最多比同类模型小 12 倍。
Motivation: 现有推理蒸馏依赖基于结果的奖励，无法区分严密推理与蒙对答案；同时大模型推理训练算力开销高，向小模型迁移效果差。
Method: CRD 含三部分：教师间迭代互相批评的交互式 cross-feedback；独立于最终答案的细粒度 step-wise 质量评估（捕捉逻辑有效性）；coherence-aware step stitching 综合互补优势。学生用带预算约束的 Reasoning Quality Optimization (RQO) 训练。
Result: CRD-4B 在 MATH-500 上 97.3%，AIME'25 上 70.3%，超过基线；仅用 50K 训练样本，数据集规模最多比可比模型小 12 倍。
Conclusion: 以过程质量（而非结果奖励）驱动的协作蒸馏，能在远小于同类数据量的预算下把强推理能力压进 4B 级模型。

papers.title: Correct Answers, Unsupported Findings: Evidence Binding in Forensic Reconstruction of LLM Agent Logs
papers.abstract_en: Forensic reconstruction of LLM-agent actions requires not only recovering the correct value, but establishing which preserved record supports that finding. Tool logs, generated explanations, and local citation identifiers capture different parts of this evidence, yet a citation identifier does not establish a source unless its binding to a record is preserved. We audit this distinction using 64 mechanically checkable cases from saved AgentDojo Banking executions. Two LLM readers reconstruct source relationships under controlled variations in visible evidence and identifier-to-record bindings. We separately evaluate complete-record agreement, evidence-grounded findings, justified abstention, and unsupported assertions. With original identifiers and no binding table, Sonnet recovered every literal source location but made unsupported citation-source assertions in 26 of 28 cases requiring the missing relation; 22 nevertheless matched the complete reference. Adding explicit bindings improved grounded reconstruction for both readers, whereas identifier renaming alone provided no consistent remedy. A deterministic same-packet comparator correctly resolved the bounded task or abstained throughout. These results show that factual agreement alone is insufficient for evaluating forensic reconstruction of agent logs and motivate preserving explicit record bindings to distinguish supported findings from correct guesses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 LLM agent 日志的取证重建中，仅凭引用标识符无法证明其绑定到哪条记录，导致「答案正确但证据无支撑」。在 AgentDojo Banking 的 64 个可机械检验案例上，Sonnet 在缺少绑定表时对 28 个需要该关系的案例全部恢复了字面来源位置，却在 26 个案例中做出了无支撑的引用-来源断言；加入显式绑定后有据可依的重建改善，而单纯重命名标识符无一致效果。作者主张取证评估必须区分有据发现与正确猜测，并保留显式记录绑定。
Motivation: LLM agent 取证重建不仅要恢复正确值，还要指出哪条被保存的记录支撑该发现；工具日志、生成解释与本地引用标识符各自只覆盖证据的一部分，标识符若不保留与记录的绑定就无法确立来源，而仅看答案正确性会掩盖无支撑断言。
Method: 从已保存的 AgentDojo Banking 执行中构造 64 个可机械检验的案例，用两个 LLM reader 在可见证据与标识符-记录绑定的受控变化下重建来源关系；分别评估完整记录一致性 (complete-record agreement)、有据发现 (evidence-grounded findings)、合理弃答 (justified abstention) 与无支撑断言 (unsupported assertions)，并对照一个确定性 same-packet comparator。
Result: 在保留原始标识符但无绑定表的条件下，Sonnet 恢复了全部字面来源位置，但在 28 个需要该缺失关系的案例中有 26 个做出无支撑的引用-来源断言，其中 22 个仍与完整引用一致；加入显式绑定后两个 reader 的有据重建均改善，仅重命名标识符无一致补救效果；确定性 same-packet comparator 在整个有界任务上要么正确解析要么弃答。
Conclusion: 仅凭事实一致性不足以评估 agent 日志的取证重建，必须保留显式记录绑定才能把有支撑的发现与正确猜测区分开。
