papers.title: Gradient-Based Trajectory Optimisation over Continuous Poses for Sparse-View Cone-Beam CT
papers.abstract_en: Trajectory optimisation for cone-beam computed tomography (CT) determines which information sparse-view scans acquire. Fixed candidate pools prevent off-grid refinement and require new object-specific precomputation for each acquisition manifold. We make every source pose an individual continuous variable and move all poses jointly by gradient ascent on the scanner's kinematic manifold. The objective combines soft-Tuy plane coverage, continuous View Covariance Loss, and an analytic attenuation-aware ray-bundle penalty. The same optimiser handles circular, limited C-arm, two-axis, and freesphere parametrisations. On a Defrise flange, continuous selection recovers laminar defects invisible to a circular orbit, matches discrete swap search on the free sphere at the sparser budget, and leads at the denser one, with the same objective evaluated in every arm. A moderate elevation band already recovers most of the free-sphere gain at the defects, so the same optimiser transfers to bounded scanner envelopes. Photon noise preserves the ordering on the flange and compresses it on a dense fuel nozzle. Sparseprescan planning benefits from matching prescan and planned acquisition manifolds. Selection takes seconds rather than minutes without an object-specific reconstruction basis. Prescan-planned poses were executed on a robot CT bench and reconstructed in a common frame, demonstrating feasibility but no consistent metric gain over uniform band sampling. Continuous pose optimisation incorporates attenuation and scanner constraints directly into sparse-view acquisition design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把锥束 CT 稀疏视角轨迹优化中每个源位姿改成连续变量，在扫描器运动学流形上做梯度上升，目标函数由 soft-Tuy 平面覆盖、连续 View Covariance Loss 与解析的衰减感知射线束惩罚组成，同一优化器可处理 circular、limited C-arm、two-axis 与 free-sphere 参数化。在 Defrise flange 上连续选择恢复了圆形轨道看不见的层状缺陷，在 free sphere 稀疏预算下追平离散 swap search、更密预算下领先；选择耗时从分钟级降到秒级，但机器人 CT 台架实测只证明可行、未见相对均匀带采样的一致指标增益。
Motivation: 固定候选池限制了离网格的位姿细化，且每换一个采集流形都要为具体物体重新预计算，使稀疏视角扫描能获取什么信息被候选集而非扫描器本身约束。
Method: 将每个源位姿设为独立连续变量，沿扫描器运动学流形对联合位姿做梯度上升；目标函数融合 soft-Tuy 平面覆盖、连续 View Covariance Loss 与解析的 attenuation-aware ray-bundle penalty，同一优化器覆盖 circular、limited C-arm、two-axis 与 free-sphere 参数化，无需基于具体物体的重建基。
Result: 在 Defrise flange 上，连续选择恢复了圆形轨道不可见的层状缺陷；在 free sphere 上稀疏预算时追平离散 swap search、更密预算时领先，各臂评估同一目标函数；中等 elevation band 即可拿到 free-sphere 在缺陷上的大部分增益；光子噪声在 flange 上保持排序、在密集 fuel nozzle 上压缩差距；选择耗时为秒级而非分钟级；机器人 CT 台架执行了 prescan 规划位姿并在统一坐标系重建，显示可行但相对均匀带采样无一致指标增益。
Conclusion: 连续位姿优化可把衰减与扫描器约束直接写进稀疏视角采集设计，并在受限扫描器包络上迁移；prescan 规划的收益取决于 prescan 与实际采集流形是否匹配，台架实验只证明可行性而非稳定增益。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Online Resource Allocation with an Endogenous Markov State: Fewer LP Solves Earn More
papers.abstract_en: We study finite-horizon online resource allocation with i.i.d. requests and an endogenous Markov state on a finite state space: each action affects the transition of the state that governs future rewards and resource consumption. In this problem, a transient fluid LP benchmark upper bounds the expected reward of every nonanticipating policy, while a stationary LP supplies randomized state-dependent controls. We assume that the stationary LP has a unique optimum and identify primal nondegeneracy and irreducibility of the optimal induced kernel as important regularity conditions in this framework. With a known request prior, we show that, under nondegeneracy and irreducibility, both frequent and infrequent re-solving attain $O(1)$ regret. However, under a degenerate optimum, irreducibility yields the sharp worst-case $Θ(\sqrt{T})$ rate for infrequent re-solving, while frequent re-solving can incur $Ω(T)$ regret. Thus, more frequent optimization can perform asymptotically worse. With an unknown request prior, we develop a three-phase U-shaped infrequent re-solving policy that coordinates learning and inventory correction with $O(\log\log T)$ LP solves. When the optimal induced kernel is irreducible and the algorithm is given the optimal target state class and a constant-cost entrance policy, it attains $O(1)$ regret under nondegeneracy and $O(\sqrt{T})$ regret under degeneracy. Without the target-class information, linear minimax regret is unavoidable. Numerical experiments further illustrate the instability of round-by-round re-solving relative to epoch-wise infrequent re-solving, show that thresholding greatly mitigates its loss, and find that infrequent schemes remain dominant under both known and estimated priors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线资源分配中动作会改变决定未来收益与消耗的内生 Markov 状态，频繁逐轮重解 LP 反而可能更差：在退化最优解下，频繁重解可达 Ω(T) regret，而不频繁重解的最坏情形为 Θ(√T)。作者据此给出三阶段 U 形不频繁重解策略，用 O(log log T) 次 LP 求解在未知先验下取得 O(1)（非退化）与 O(√T)（退化）regret。
Motivation: 内生状态的在线资源分配里，动作本身改变未来状态，逐轮重解 LP 的常见做法在退化最优解下会累积线性 regret，需要判定何时该少解优化问题。
Method: 以 transient fluid LP 为非预期策略的上界基准、stationary LP 提供随机化状态相关控制；在最优诱导核不可约与原始非退化条件下分析频繁/不频繁重解；未知先验时提出三阶段 U 形不频繁重解策略，协调学习与库存修正，并给出最优目标状态类与常数代价进入策略的假设。
Result: 已知先验下，非退化且不可约时频繁与不频繁重解均为 O(1) regret；退化最优解下不频繁重解最坏 Θ(√T)，频繁重解可达 Ω(T)。未知先验下三阶段策略用 O(log log T) 次 LP 求解达到非退化 O(1)、退化 O(√T)，缺少目标状态类信息时线性 minimax regret 不可避免。数值实验显示逐轮重解相对按 epoch 的不频繁重解不稳定，thresholding 可大幅缓解其损失，且在已知与估计先验下不频繁方案均占优。
Conclusion: 更频繁的优化在内生状态问题中可能渐近更差，不频繁重解配合 thresholding 是更稳的默认选择；线性 regret 只在缺少目标状态类信息时不可避免。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: PEACE: Covariant learning of nonadiabatic manifolds with parity-resolved Hamiltonians
papers.abstract_en: Nonadiabatic molecular dynamics provides mechanistic insight into light-driven processes and informs the design of molecules and materials for solar energy conversion, photocatalysis and photo switching. Accurately describing these processes requires a representation that respects electronic symmetry and consistently relates energies to interstate couplings. Here we introduce PEACE, which combines a parity-equivariant latent Hamiltonian with a learned electronic connection. Controlled ablations reveal the complementary roles of symmetry-allowed state mixing and electronic-frame variation in reproducing crossing structures and relaxation dynamics. PEACE closely reproduces excited-state population dynamics from first-principles simulations, while its extension to spin-orbit coupling enables simulations of intersystem crossing. These results demonstrate that a more complete incorporation of the underlying physics into learned electronic representations leads to more accurate predictions of nonadiabatic dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PEACE 把宇称等变 (parity-equivariant) 的隐空间 Hamiltonian 与学习得到的 electronic connection 结合，使能量与 interstate coupling 在同一表示下自洽并尊重电子对称性。消融显示对称允许的态混合与 electronic-frame 变化对复现交叉结构和弛豫动力学各有不可替代的作用；模型紧密复现第一性原理的激发态布居动力学，扩展到自旋轨道耦合后可模拟系间窜越 (intersystem crossing)。
Motivation: 非绝热分子动力学的机器学习表示若不同时尊重电子对称性并一致关联能量与 interstate coupling，就难以准确描述光驱动过程中的交叉结构与弛豫。
Method: PEACE 组合 parity-equivariant 的隐空间 Hamiltonian 与学习得到的 electronic connection；通过受控 ablation 分离对称允许的态混合与 electronic-frame 变化两种成分，并将模型扩展到自旋轨道耦合以处理系间窜越。
Result: 受控 ablation 揭示对称允许的态混合与 electronic-frame 变化在复现交叉结构和弛豫动力学上作用互补；PEACE 紧密复现第一性原理模拟给出的激发态布居动力学，其自旋轨道耦合扩展可模拟系间窜越。
Conclusion: 把底层物理更完整地纳入学习得到的电子表示，能带来更准确的非绝热动力学预测。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: How Do LLMs Change Predictions Under Negation?
papers.abstract_en: Negation is an essential feature of human language, yet large language models (LLMs) remain unreliable in processing it. We evaluate recent open-source and closed-source LLMs on our negation benchmark and find that, in 37-71% of cases, they repeat the same answer under negation (e.g., "Madrid" for "What is not the capital of Spain?"). To understand and address this brittleness, we mechanistically examine how models operate under negation. Our main finding is that specialized attention heads and MLP neurons jointly implement negation by (1) suppressing retrieval of the original answer (e.g., "Madrid") while (2) promoting a favored candidate within the answer category (e.g., "Paris"). This contrasts with accounts of human negation processing, in which information about the original answer helps to determine what should be excluded. Furthermore, we find that this difference from human processing is a key source of negation failures: the model's mechanism relies on suppressing the original answer rather than using it to determine what to exclude, so the model can repeat the original answer when suppression is too weak or when a bias toward particular answers prevents it from selecting an alternative. To address this weakness in the model's negation mechanism, we propose a training objective that requires larger shifts in answer preference for more confident original predictions, and show that it reduces negation failures with less degradation of general capabilities than standard fine-tuning baselines. Together, our results demonstrate how mechanistic analysis can reveal why a linguistic capability fails and guide training that targets the underlying limitation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在自建否定 (negation) 基准上，开源与闭源 LLM 有 37–71% 的案例在加否定后重复原答案（如「西班牙的首都不是哪里」仍答 Madrid）。机制分析显示注意力头与 MLP 神经元靠抑制原答案检索、同时提升类别内偏好候选来实现否定，抑制不足或答案偏置过强时即失败；据此提出的训练目标要求原预测越自信、答案偏好偏移越大，比标准微调基线更少降低通用能力。
Motivation: LLM 处理否定不可靠，且现有解释未说明失败的机制来源：模型靠抑制原答案而非用原答案推导排除项，与人类否定加工方式相反。
Method: 在自建否定基准上评测多个开源与闭源 LLM；用机制可解释性方法定位专门的注意力头与 MLP 神经元，检验其联合实现「抑制原答案检索 + 促进类别内偏好候选」；提出按原预测置信度加权答案偏好偏移的训练目标，并与标准微调基线对比。
Result: 37–71% 的案例中模型在否定下重复原答案；机制上否定由抑制原答案与提升类别内候选两步实现；所提训练目标在减少否定失败的同时，比标准微调基线更少损害通用能力。
Conclusion: 机制分析能定位语言能力失败的具体环节，并据此设计针对该环节的训练目标；模型否定失败源于抑制机制而非利用原答案推导排除。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: EvoSignal: LLM-Guided Evolutionary Design of Modular Traffic Signal Control Programs
papers.abstract_en: Effective traffic signal control (TSC) requires policies that respond to changing traffic demand and network conditions while meeting different control objectives. However, adapting existing strategies often involves repeated manual design and adjustment, making it difficult to systematically explore better control rules for a target network. Large language models (LLMs) can automate this process, but directly using them to select signal phases leaves decision rules embedded in black-box models and incurs recurring inference costs and latency. This paper formulates TSC as a modular program design problem and proposes EvoSignal, an LLM-guided evolutionary framework using traffic knowledge and performance feedback. The modular representation separates traffic feature extraction, local phase prioritization, and optional network-based priority adjustment. Starting from several established strategies, EvoSignal improves programs through feedback on congestion and signal operation, retaining strategies with different performance trade-offs. The resulting programs operate without online LLM inference. Simulation experiments across five scenarios on two real-world road networks show that the selected default EvoSignal program reduces waiting time by 16.8--49.2\% relative to the lowest waiting time achieved by the 20 conventional, reinforcement learning-based, and LLM-based baselines in each scenario. A program prioritizing travel time and queue length outperforms all 20 baselines on all three metrics in the search scenario and remains among the top three on each metric when transferred unchanged to the other four scenarios. These findings support automated design of inspectable control programs that transfer across the evaluated road networks and traffic demands.Code is available at https://github.com/georgewanglz2019/EvoSignal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvoSignal 把交通信号控制写成模块化程序设计问题，用 LLM 结合拥堵与信号运行反馈做进化搜索，产出可检查、无需在线 LLM 推理的控制程序。在两个真实路网的五个场景仿真中，默认程序相对每个场景 20 个传统、强化学习与 LLM 基线中最低等待时间再降 16.8–49.2%；侧重行程时间与排队长度的程序在搜索场景三项指标上全部胜过 20 个基线，原样迁移到其余四个场景后每项指标仍保持前三。
Motivation: 现有信号策略适配依赖反复人工设计与调参，难以系统探索目标路网的更优控制规则；直接让 LLM 选相位则把决策规则锁在黑盒里，并带来持续推理开销与延迟。
Method: 将 TSC 形式化为模块化程序设计，模块划分交通特征提取、局部相位优先级、可选的路网级优先级调整；以若干既有策略为起点，用 LLM 结合拥堵与信号运行的性能反馈进化改进程序，并保留不同性能权衡的策略，最终程序运行时不含在线 LLM 推理。
Result: 在两个真实路网的五个场景仿真中，默认 EvoSignal 程序的等待时间相对各场景 20 个传统、RL 与 LLM 基线中的最低等待时间降低 16.8–49.2%；优先行程时间与排队长度的程序在搜索场景的三项指标上全部超过 20 个基线，原样迁移到其余四个场景后每项指标仍位居前三。
Conclusion: LLM 引导的进化可以产出可检查、可跨路网与交通需求迁移的信号控制程序，且部署时无需在线 LLM 推理。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: World Potential Model: Pretrained World Knowledge as Progress Potentials
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon language agents often receive supervision only from terminal task outcomes, leaving little signal for distinguishing productive intermediate behavior from stagnation or even regression. Rather than learning a separate value function or process reward model for every task, we ask whether pretrained models can recognize task progress from their existing world knowledge. We formalize this capability with a World Potential Model (WPM), a goal-conditioned evaluator of task-relative realized progress in agent contexts. In ALFWorld and ScienceWorld, off-the-shelf pretrained models substantially outperform chance at recovering realized-progress structure without task-specific evaluator fine-tuning. We further anchor these progress judgments to task-specific milestones to obtain scalar world potentials, whose temporal differences provide process-sensitive step-level credit for policy optimization. Under matched comparisons, WPM-guided optimization improves success over outcome-only GRPO across all evaluated configurations. Together, these results provide initial evidence that pretrained world knowledge can support reusable realized-progress evaluation and provide useful supervision for long-horizon agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 World Potential Model (WPM)：用预训练模型已有的世界知识，对智能体上下文做目标条件化的“已实现进度”评估，再锚定任务里程碑得到标量 world potential，其时间差作为过程敏感的逐步 credit 信号。在 ALFWorld 与 ScienceWorld 上，未经任务级微调的现成预训练模型显著高于随机水平恢复进度结构；在全部评估配置中，WPM 引导的优化成功率均高于仅用结果奖励的 GRPO。
Motivation: 长时程语言智能体通常只拿到最终任务结果的监督，无法区分有进展的中间行为与停滞甚至回退；而为每个任务单独训练价值函数或过程奖励模型成本高。
Method: 定义目标条件化的进度评估器 WPM，度量智能体上下文中任务相对的已实现进度；将进度判断锚定到任务特定里程碑得到标量 world potentials，用其时间差 (temporal differences) 生成逐步 credit，接入策略优化并与结果导向的 GRPO 在匹配设置下对比。
Result: 在 ALFWorld 与 ScienceWorld 上，未经任务特定评估器微调的现成预训练模型在恢复已实现进度结构上大幅高于随机水平；在全部评估配置中，WPM 引导的优化成功率均超过 outcome-only GRPO。
Conclusion: 预训练世界知识本身可支撑可复用的进度评估，并为长时程智能体提供有用监督，无需为每个任务训练独立的价值函数或过程奖励模型。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: UniCSI Towards a Universal Wi-Fi CSI Encoder for Ubiquitous Human Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Wi-Fi sensing promises to turn the everyday wireless signals that already surround us into ubiquitous sensors for human sensing. However, a fundamental obstacle is that CSI is acquired under diverse device-specific configurations, including different subcarrier counts, bandwidths, and carrier bands. Consequently, the resulting CSI tensors vary in both spectral resolution and tensor shape, making heterogeneous modeling challenging. Standard architectures struggle with such heterogeneity, forcing lossy pre-processing which compromises the underlying signal. To bridge this gap, we present UniCSI, a unified foundation architecture that directly operates on heterogeneous CSI while preserving the integrity of the native waveform. UniCSI hinges on two core innovations: (1) a physics-informed RF tokenizer that encodes each frequency channel based on its fractional position within the physical spectrum rather than rigid array indices. It preserves intrinsic spectral coherence and enables seamless, frequency resolution-agnostic processing across arbitrary sensing configurations. (2) a spectral aggregator that distills variable-length channel sequences into a fixed-size spectral signature, effectively decoupling the feature dimensionality from the physical subcarrier spacing. Extensive evaluations on a large-scale corpus of 25 heterogeneous public datasets, spanning 14 to 2048 subcarriers, 20 to 160 MHz bandwidth, and the 2.4 and 5 GHz bands, demonstrate that native heterogeneous ingestion substantially improves cross-domain transfer under both supervised and self-supervised training schemes, particularly in regimes where fixed-grid architectures fail to generalize.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniCSI 提出统一的 Wi-Fi CSI 基础架构，直接吃进异构 CSI 而不做有损重采样：物理信息 RF tokenizer 按子载波在物理频谱中的分数位置（而非数组下标）编码每个频率通道，spectral aggregator 把变长信道序列压成固定大小的频谱签名。在 25 个异构公开数据集（14–2048 子载波、20–160 MHz 带宽、2.4 与 5 GHz）上，原生异构输入显著改善跨域迁移，尤其在固定网格架构泛化失败的场景。
Motivation: CSI 采集配置高度异构（子载波数、带宽、载波频段不同），导致张量形状与频谱分辨率不一致；标准架构只能做有损预处理，损害原始信号，阻碍跨设备的通用人体感知建模。
Method: UniCSI 由两部分组成：物理信息 RF tokenizer 按子载波在物理频谱中的分数位置编码，保持频谱相干性并支持任意配置下的频率分辨率无关处理；spectral aggregator 将变长信道序列蒸馏为固定大小频谱签名，解耦特征维度与物理子载波间距。在监督与自监督两种训练方案下评测。
Result: 在 25 个异构公开数据集的大规模语料上评测，覆盖 14 到 2048 子载波、20 到 160 MHz 带宽、2.4 与 5 GHz 频段；原生异构摄取在监督与自监督训练下均显著改善跨域迁移，尤其在固定网格架构无法泛化的场景中。
Conclusion: 直接在原生异构 CSI 上建模、以物理频谱位置而非数组下标为编码基准，是实现跨设备通用 Wi-Fi 人体感知的可行路径，优于强制统一网格的有损预处理。
Relevance: 12

papers.title: DrugTargetWorld: A Synthetic Biobank for Training and Benchmarking AI Scientists
papers.abstract_en: Drug target discovery requires distinguishing molecules that causally drive disease from those that are merely associated with it. Training and evaluating AI agents to perform this workflow end-to-end is difficult because real world biobanks lack known causal ground truth and participant-level data is access controlled. We introduce DrugTargetWorld, a framework that procedurally generates simulated biobanks, or "worlds," with known but concealed causal structure. Each world contains genotypes, proteins, health records, outcomes, and synthetic magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) for 54,000 participants. Agents must construct a disease phenotype, identify causal driver proteins, infer the beneficial direction of modulation, and optionally conduct virtual 'wet lab' experiments. We evaluated nine agents in 540 episodes across 20 cardiovascular worlds and three experimental budgets. Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol achieved the highest mean composite scores, 39.98 and 35.38 of 100, respectively, and both recovered 64% of causal drivers on average. However, no agent reliably distinguished misleading non-causal proteins, and performance remained limited by the integrative judgments required to connect phenotype construction, causal evidence, and intervention decisions. By making each world's causal structure known to the evaluator but hidden from the agent, DrugTargetWorld turns end-to-end drug target discovery into a scalable training and evaluation problem with verifiable reward.
papers.comment: 34 pages main text, 92 pages supplementary material; 6 main figures. Project: https://DrugTargetWorld.vercel.app. Code: https://github.com/sammargolis/DrugTargetWorld. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/sammargolis/DrugTargetWorld-assets
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DrugTargetWorld 用程序化生成的合成生物库 (synthetic biobank) 把端到端药物靶点发现变成可验证奖励的训练与评测问题：每个 world 含 54,000 名参与者的基因型、蛋白、健康记录、结局与合成 MRI，因果结构对评测者已知但对 agent 隐藏。在 20 个心血管 world、三种实验预算下评测 9 个 agent 共 540 episodes，Opus 5 与 GPT-5.6 Sol 平均综合分 39.98 与 35.38（满分 100），平均各找回 64% 因果驱动蛋白，但没有 agent 能可靠排除误导性的非因果蛋白。
Motivation: 真实生物库缺少已知因果真值且个体级数据受访问控制，端到端训练和评测执行药物靶点发现流程的 AI agent 因此困难。
Method: 程序化生成带已知但被隐藏因果结构的模拟生物库 worlds，每个 world 含基因型、蛋白、健康记录、结局与合成 MRI（54,000 参与者）；agent 需构建疾病表型、识别因果驱动蛋白、推断调控的有益方向，并可选做虚拟 wet lab 实验；因果结构仅对评测者可见，形成可验证奖励。
Result: 在 20 个心血管 world、三种实验预算下评测 9 个 agent 共 540 episodes：Opus 5 与 GPT-5.6 Sol 平均综合分最高，分别为 39.98 与 35.38（满分 100），两者平均各找回 64% 的因果驱动蛋白；但没有 agent 能可靠区分具误导性的非因果蛋白，性能受限于串联表型构建、因果证据与干预决策所需的整合判断。
Conclusion: 把因果真值藏起来只给评测者，可将药物靶点发现变成可扩展、带可验证奖励的训练与评测问题；当前 agent 的短板在排除非因果蛋白与跨环节整合判断。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Reliability of LLM Judges for Evaluating Entity Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Entity Alignment (EA) identifies equivalent entities across knowledge graphs and is critical for knowledge base integration and ontology merging. Evaluating EA systems at scale requires expensive expert annotation, making systematic assessment across diverse domains practically infeasible. LLM-as-judge evaluation offers a potentially scalable alternative, yet its reliability for structured prediction tasks like EA remains unstudied. We present the first systematic benchmarking study across three frontier models, three datasets, and four EA systems, using perturbation bias diagnostics, meta-evaluation across all dataset-judge-prompt combinations, and counterfactual label-flip tests. We identify anchor bias, a failure mode in which judges invert discrimination when the system's decision label is visible. Label exposure causally collapses judge discrimination (J-ROC-AUC 0.12-0.87), while a label-free protocol recovers near-ceiling capability on distinctive-name datasets (0.93-1.00) and significant recovery on biomedical pairs (0.93-0.95). Counterfactual experiments confirm causality (FSR 53-99%) and reveal a frontier model paradox: stronger judges exhibit greater label sensitivity, not less. A blinded two-annotator human evaluation (102 pairs, Cohen's kappa=0.902) confirms this mechanism directly. We release the first biomedical EA benchmark (MeSH-SNOMED CT, 15K pairs) and a reproducible auditing framework for LLM judge reliability in EA. Code and data are available at https://github.com/vaibhavalakshmiravideshik/llm-as-a-judge-entity-alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在实体对齐 (EA) 评测中，LLM-as-judge 一旦看到系统决策标签就会反转判别力：标签暴露使 J-ROC-AUC 崩到 0.12–0.87，改用无标签协议后在特征名数据集上回到 0.93–1.00、生物医学实体对上回到 0.93–0.95。反事实翻转证实因果 (FSR 53–99%)，且更强的 judge 标签敏感性反而更高；建议 EA 评测一律用盲化、无标签的 judge 协议。
Motivation: EA 系统在多领域规模化评测依赖昂贵的专家标注，LLM-as-judge 是可扩展替代，但其在结构化预测任务上的可靠性此前未被研究。
Method: 对三个前沿模型、三个数据集、四个 EA 系统做系统基准测试，用扰动偏差诊断、覆盖全部 dataset-judge-prompt 组合的 meta-evaluation，以及反事实标签翻转 (counterfactual label-flip) 测试；另做盲化双标注员人工评测 (102 对)。
Result: 标签暴露使 judge 判别力因果性坍缩，J-ROC-AUC 0.12–0.87；无标签协议在特征名数据集上恢复到 0.93–1.00，生物医学实体对恢复到 0.93–0.95；反事实实验 FSR 53–99%，并显示更强 judge 标签敏感性更高；人工评测 102 对，Cohen's kappa=0.902。发布 MeSH-SNOMED CT 生物医学 EA 基准 15K 对。
Conclusion: anchor bias 是 LLM judge 的真实因果失效模式，盲化无标签协议可恢复接近上限的判别力；更强的模型并不更免疫标签泄漏。

papers.title: MARS: Malware Analysis with Rule-Based Scoring of LLM Claims
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can triage malware through direct verdicts or behavioral claims scored by an external policy. We present MARS, a malware triage framework, and compare direct classification with single-pass claim scoring using the same evidence collector and identical static evidence bundles for each model. The evaluation covers 1,195 PE and ELF binaries grouped into 1,001 near-duplicate clusters and six language models, with deterministic rules providing a baseline. Direct classification is more accurate for all six models. On samples with usable outputs from both paths, its accuracy advantage ranges from 3.7 to 20.9 percentage points, with all 95% cluster-bootstrap confidence intervals for the differences above zero. It also achieves higher malicious alert recall in ten of twelve platform and model combinations. Claim mediation provides no consistent reduction in performance variation across models. Separate subset studies find more consistent alert decisions for direct classification and a larger recall loss for the claim path when predefined indicator fields are removed. In a family identification probe, claims yield higher accuracy than verdict labels but lower accuracy than evidence text. Retained claims expose the inputs to verdict computation and permit policy revision without another model call. We reproduce archived verdicts exactly and apply a revised policy to the same records, including outputs from two additional models withdrawn by their provider. Under the evaluated claim taxonomy and additive policy, these results favor direct classification when only a verdict is required, while demonstrating that retained claims support explicit policy inspection and revision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MARS 是恶意软件分诊框架，在同一证据收集器与相同静态证据包下对比直接分类与单次 claim 打分：1,195 个 PE/ELF 二进制（1,001 个近重复簇）、六个语言模型上，直接分类在全部六个模型上更准，准确率优势 3.7 至 20.9 个百分点，且 95% 簇自助置信区间下界均大于零。结论是只需最终判定时选直接分类，需要可审查与可改策略时保留 claim。
Motivation: LLM 恶意软件分诊有两条路径：直接给判定，或让外部策略对行为 claim 打分。两条路径在相同证据下谁更准、claim 是否带来可审查性，此前缺少受控对比。
Method: MARS 用同一证据收集器为每个模型生成完全相同的静态证据包，对比直接分类与单次 (single-pass) claim 打分；以确定性规则作基线，评估覆盖 1,195 个 PE 与 ELF 二进制、按 1,001 个近重复簇分组、六个语言模型，并用簇级 bootstrap 算 95% 置信区间。
Result: 直接分类在全部六个模型上更准确，准确率优势 3.7 至 20.9 个百分点，所有差值的 95% 簇自助置信区间均高于零；恶意告警召回在 12 个平台×模型组合中的 10 个更高。claim 中介未带来跨模型性能方差的一致下降；移除预定义指标字段时 claim 路径召回损失更大。家族识别探针中 claim 准确率高于 verdict 标签、低于证据原文。可复现归档 verdict，并对同一批记录套用修订后策略，含两个已被提供方撤回模型的输出。

papers.title: Constitution-Guided Watermarking
papers.abstract_en: Watermarking enables language model providers to identify text generated by their models. However, its desired properties can conflict (\ie~stronger watermark signals can degrade text quality), while designs that resist editing may also facilitate forgery. Providers address these trade-offs by choosing configurations that balance competing objectives or prioritize particular properties. Either approach imposes a shared operating point on requests with different requirements, potentially sacrificing quality where wording preservation matters or robustness where reliable attribution is essential. To allow flexible and adaptable designs, we introduce \emph{Constitution-Guided Watermarking}, a framework that selects request-appropriate trade-offs from provider requirements, listed as natural-language principles. \emph{Offline}, a pretrained reasoning agent examines constitutional rules alongside watermark implementations and iteratively refines rule-specific configurations using empirical feedback. \emph{At deployment}, a separate monitor identifies applicable rules and retrieves the corresponding policy, including watermarking exemptions, without modifying the serving model. Furthermore, our framework supports offline parallel optimization and refinement of rule-specific configurations based on evolving provider requirements without affecting deployment, and binds each deployed configuration to its evaluation evidence, making deployment decisions auditable. In a proof-of-concept evaluation using KGW and a five-rule constitution, our framework selects configurations responsive to provider priorities and improves post-paraphrase detection on robustness-prioritized requests by up to $14$ percentage points over fixed configurations, while matching or exceeding all baselines in aggregate quality and clean detection at a nominal $0.1\%$ false-positive rate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Constitution-Guided Watermarking：把提供商对水印的相互冲突要求写成自然语言规则（constitution），由预训练推理 agent 离线为每条规则搜索并精化专属水印配置，部署时由独立 monitor 识别适用规则并检索对应策略，不改动 serving 模型。概念验证用 KGW 与五条规则的 constitution，在改写鲁棒性优先的请求上，改写后检测率比固定配置最高提升 14 个百分点，同时在名义 0.1% 假阳性率下聚合质量与干净文本检测匹配或超过全部基线。
Motivation: 水印的强度、文本质量、抗编辑与抗伪造之间相互冲突，提供商只能选一个共享工作点，导致对措辞保真要求高的请求牺牲质量、对可靠归因要求高的请求牺牲鲁棒性。
Method: 离线阶段由预训练推理 agent 结合 constitution 规则与水印实现，用经验反馈迭代精化每条规则专属的水印配置；部署阶段由独立 monitor 判定适用规则并检索对应策略（含豁免），配置与评估证据绑定以保证可审计，并支持离线并行优化而不影响线上服务。
Result: 在 KGW 与五条规则 constitution 的概念验证中，改写鲁棒性优先请求上的改写后检测率比固定配置最高提升 14 个百分点；在名义 0.1% 假阳性率下，聚合质量与干净文本检测匹配或超过全部基线。
Conclusion: 把水印权衡写成可检索的自然语言规则并离线按规则调参，可以在不改 serving 模型的前提下让不同请求各取所需的工作点，且部署决策可审计。

papers.title: A Framework for the Systematic Review of ML Assets in AI Registries
papers.abstract_en: Background: Modern software systems increasingly rely on Machine Learning (ML) assets (i.e., pre-trained models, datasets, benchmarks) for building, evaluating, and integrating ML-based systems. However, current exploration, selection and reuse practices of ML assets are not supported by systematic retrieval methodologies comparable to those used in traditional evidence synthesis. Consequently, in practice, ML asset selection is often presented as a settled design decision, supported by informal justification rather than a traceable, evidence-based, and updatable selection process. Aims: This paper explores how systematic review methods can support ML asset retrieval. In doing so, we aim to make their selection transparent and reproducible, grounded in explicit evidence, and ultimately better suited to its intended use. Method: We analyze established systematic review practices from scientific literature and adapt their phases (i.e., planning, conducting, and documenting) to Artificial Intelligence (AI) registries, treating ML assets as first-class units of analysis. The resulting framework integrates registry-aware search strategies, cross-registry schema alignment, and dependency-driven ML asset exploration. Results: We conceptualize ML asset retrieval as a systematic and reproducible process rather than an ad hoc activity, and propose a framework for structured ML asset discovery. \textbf{Conclusions:} This work illustrates how systematic review principles can be extended beyond scientific literature to support evidence synthesis over evolving AI registries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把文献系统综述 (systematic review) 的 planning、conducting、documenting 三阶段搬到 AI registry 上，把预训练模型、数据集、benchmark 当作一等分析单元，形成含 registry-aware 检索、跨 registry schema 对齐与依赖驱动探索的 ML 资产检索框架，使资产选择从非正式论证变成可追溯、可复现、可更新的证据合成过程。
Motivation: ML 资产的探索、选择与复用缺少可与传统证据合成相比的系统检索方法，实践中选型常被当作已定的设计决定，只靠非正式理由支撑。
Method: 分析科学文献中的成熟系统综述实践，把其三个阶段适配到 AI registry；框架整合 registry-aware 检索策略、跨 registry 的 schema 对齐，以及依赖驱动的 ML 资产探索。
Result: 将 ML 资产检索概念化为系统、可复现的过程而非临时活动，并提出用于结构化 ML 资产发现的框架；摘要为概念性工作，未给出实验数字。
Conclusion: 系统综述原则可以从科学文献扩展到持续演化的 AI registry，支撑对 ML 资产的证据合成与透明选型。

papers.title: Visual Evidence Under Cross-Examination: Evaluating and Controlling Decision-Level Evidence Use in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models increasingly reason through crops, regions, and tool-produced observations. Yet an observation can influence the answer without benefiting the candidate it supports. We study candidate-bound visual contribution: valid evidence should help, invalidating its supporting relation should remove its additional effect, and valid rebinding should redirect that effect to the newly supported candidate. We introduce CROSS-Bench, a benchmark of 28,000 decision problems, with matched invalidation and rebinding tests on a dedicated evaluation subset. Our RIVET interface preserves evidence identity and uncertainty, composes a candidate-conditioned response, and separately controls its strength. Shared-evidence experiments show that task accuracy and evidence ownership can diverge. Under matched capacity and training, RIVET increases normalized effect transfer from 0.512 to 0.651 where clean evidence has a positive effect. The advantage persists on common evaluation examples and across repeated decision-layer fits. With evidence predicted from raw inputs, RIVET improves CROSS-Bench accuracy by an average of 5.70 pp across four frozen backbones, relative to the same models without auxiliary evidence. These results separate the utility of visual evidence from the candidate-specific destination of its effect.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CROSS-Bench（28,000 个决策问题，含配对的 invalidation 与 rebinding 测试子集）与 RIVET 接口：保留证据身份与不确定性，构造候选条件化响应并单独控制其强度。在匹配容量与训练下，RIVET 把 clean evidence 为正效应处的 normalized effect transfer 从 0.512 提到 0.651；从原始输入预测证据时，在四个 frozen backbone 上平均提升 CROSS-Bench 准确率 5.70 个百分点。
Motivation: VLM 靠裁剪、区域和工具观测推理时，一个观测可能影响答案却并不真正惠及它所支持的候选；任务准确率与证据归属可以脱节，缺少衡量候选绑定视觉贡献的评测。
Method: CROSS-Bench 含 28,000 个决策问题，并在专用评测子集上做 matched invalidation 与 rebinding 测试；RIVET 接口保留证据身份与不确定性，组合 candidate-conditioned response，并对效应强度单独设控；证据可由原始输入预测得到，实验在四个 frozen backbone 上进行并做重复 decision-layer 拟合。
Result: 匹配容量与训练下，clean evidence 为正效应处 normalized effect transfer 由 0.512 升至 0.651，优势在常见评测样本与多次重复 decision-layer 拟合中保持；从原始输入预测证据时，相对不加辅助证据的同一模型，CROSS-Bench 准确率在四个 frozen backbone 上平均提高 5.70 pp。
Conclusion: 任务准确率与证据归属会分离，因此视觉证据的效用必须与其效应所指向的候选分开度量；RIVET 让效应随证据绑定重定向，从而同时控制证据用在哪一个候选上。

papers.title: CircuitGate: Logic-Consistent Circuit-Level Functional Modeling for And-Inverter Graphs
papers.abstract_en: And-Inverter Graphs (AIGs) are fundamental representations for logic synthesis and verification in Electronic Design Automation (EDA). As structured representations of complex digital systems, AIGs require models to capture functional dependencies beyond local structure and remain robust to functionality-preserving transformations. In learning-based AIG representation, existing approaches are predominantly based on GNNs and rely on local gate-level message passing, limiting their ability to capture circuit-level functional context and making the learned representations sensitive to topology-specific patterns. Therefore, we propose CircuitGate, a function-aware AIG representation learning framework that advances from gate-level semantics to circuit-level functional modeling. CircuitGate explicitly encodes global primary-input (PI) support and models support-overlap-aware reconvergence between fanins, while incorporating logic-inspired Boolean constraints to encourage functionally consistent representations. We evaluate CircuitGate on the large-scale ForgeEDA benchmark and further validate it on the EPFL and ITC'99 benchmarks. Across equivalent-gate identification and signal-probability prediction tasks, CircuitGate consistently outperforms existing methods, achieving up to 21.7% and 14.2% reductions in MAE, respectively. Under direct ForgeEDA-to-OpenABC transfer without fine-tuning, CircuitGate also achieves the best equivalent-gate identification performance, demonstrating strong cross-dataset generalization. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of modeling circuit-level functional dependencies beyond local topology.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 11 tables. Qifan Zhang and Ruijie Li contributed equally. Qian Ma is the corresponding author
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CircuitGate 把 AIG 表示学习从门级消息传递升级为电路级功能建模：显式编码全局主输入 (PI) support、建模扇入间 support-overlap 感知的重汇聚 (reconvergence)，并加入逻辑启发的 Boolean 约束保证表示与功能一致。在 ForgeEDA、EPFL、ITC'99 上的等价门识别与信号概率预测中，MAE 最多分别下降 21.7% 和 14.2%，且 ForgeEDA→OpenABC 零微调迁移取得最佳等价门识别性能。
Motivation: 现有基于 GNN 的 AIG 表示依赖门级局部消息传递，抓不住电路级功能上下文，且对保持功能的拓扑变换敏感，容易学到 topology-specific pattern。
Method: CircuitGate 是 function-aware 的 AIG 表示学习框架：显式编码全局 primary-input (PI) support，对 fanin 之间做 support-overlap-aware 的重汇聚建模，并引入逻辑启发的 Boolean 约束鼓励功能一致的表示；在大规模 ForgeEDA 上评估，并在 EPFL 与 ITC'99 上验证，任务为等价门识别与信号概率预测。
Result: 在 ForgeEDA 上，等价门识别与信号概率预测的 MAE 分别最多下降 21.7% 与 14.2%，两项任务上均持续优于现有方法；EPFL 与 ITC'99 上进一步验证；ForgeEDA→OpenABC 直接迁移（不微调）取得最佳等价门识别性能。
Conclusion: 超越局部拓扑、显式建模电路级功能依赖（PI support、重汇聚、Boolean 约束）能提升 AIG 表示的功能鲁棒性与跨数据集泛化。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Certified by Abstention: Distribution-Free Guarantees for Chain-of-Thought Verifiers at Small Calibration Budgets
papers.abstract_en: Signals that predict whether a chain-of-thought (CoT) trace is correct are compared by AUC, but deploying one requires a threshold with a guarantee. We ask what distribution-free selective guarantees deliver for CoT verifiers at realistic calibration budgets of tens to a few hundred labelled problems, using seven open models, five verifier signals and 37,000 graded traces. The central observation is validity by abstention: an $(α,δ)$-valid procedure that issues a certificate with probability $P_{\rm fire}$ bounds the failure probability of an issued certificate only by $δ/P_{\rm fire}$, so a certificate that rarely fires can be valid and wrong every time it is used. In a simulation with known risk the standard certificate fails in at most 0.3% of calibration draws but in up to 69% of those in which it fires. A certification floor and a lattice condition for Benjamini-Hochberg conformal selection explain why certificates abstain at these budgets, and the data bear them out: the standard certificate returns nothing or a large accepted set, and an unreadable residual-stream probe buys two to three times the coverage of the readable signals, an edge a cross-fitted reconstruction cannot recover linearly from the readable features. We then give a floor-started fixed-sequence certificate, valid without monotonicity assumptions, that covers more than the Bonferroni certificate on every model-signal pair and raises coverage at the non-vacuous target $0.75π_0$ from 0.05 to 0.16, although the floor keeps absolute coverage small. Finally, a certificate cannot see what matters after deployment: under benchmark shift the error among accepted traces tracks the new task's base error, and under best-of-$n$ selection against the verifier it rises past the target while the empirical failure frequency stays below $δ$, because abstention absorbs the failures.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 7 figures, 12 tables. Under submission at AISTATS 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在几十到几百条标注问题的小校准预算下，CoT 验证器的分布自由选择性保证 (selective guarantees) 会大量弃权：(α,δ)-valid 证书只把已签发证书的失败概率界在 δ/P_fire，因此低触发率的证书可以“有效却每次用都错”。作者提出 floor-started fixed-sequence 证书，在不假设单调性的前提下，于每个模型-信号对上覆盖都超过 Bonferroni 证书，并把非空目标 0.75π_0 处的覆盖率从 0.05 提到 0.16。
Motivation: CoT 正确性信号目前只用 AUC 比较，但部署需要带保证的阈值；在现实的小校准预算下，标准证书要么什么都不给、要么给出过大的接受集，且已签发证书的真实失败率可能远超 δ。
Method: 用七个开源模型、五种验证器信号和 37,000 条已评分 CoT trace 做实证研究；先在已知风险的仿真中检验标准证书，再给出 certification floor 与 Benjamini-Hochberg conformal selection 的 lattice 条件解释弃权，最后提出 floor-started fixed-sequence 证书（无需单调性假设），并考察可读信号与不可读 residual-stream probe、cross-fitted reconstruction 以及 benchmark shift 和 best-of-n selection 下的行为。
Result: 仿真中标准证书在校准抽样里至多 0.3% 失败，但在其签发的抽样中失败率高达 69%；不可读 residual-stream probe 带来可读信号 2–3 倍的覆盖率，cross-fitted reconstruction 无法线性补回；新证书在每个模型-信号对上覆盖超过 Bonferroni 证书，非空目标 0.75π_0 处覆盖率 0.05 → 0.16；benchmark shift 下被接受 trace 的错误率跟随新任务基础错误率，best-of-n 对抗选择下超过目标而经验失败频率仍低于 δ。
Conclusion: 小预算下分布自由证书的覆盖率受 floor 与 lattice 条件限制而天然偏低，且证书无法看到部署后才出现的分布偏移与对抗选择，因此 AUC 高的验证器信号不等于可部署的保证。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: WAPR: A Foundation Model for Wide-Angle Refinement in Unseen Object Pose Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Real-world applications require 6D pose estimation to be accurate, fast, and scalable to unseen objects. This paper introduces WAPR, a zero-shot wide-angle pose refinement model that refines candidate poses with rotational deviations up to 90 degrees. With as few as 12 candidate poses per detected object instance, WAPR supports fast inference within 1 s per frame and reaches a pose-estimation throughput of up to 25 detected object instances per second. To support wide-angle training for rotationally symmetric objects, WAPR uses rotational symmetry priors to canonicalize symmetry-equivalent pose targets before loss computation. We further construct SA6D, a large-scale 6D training dataset with such priors. SA6D obtains KASAL-assisted rotational symmetry priors for 944 GSO scans and expands them through geometry and texture augmentation into about 50K augmented object instances and about 2M rendered RGB-D images. In addition, an angle-balanced loss stabilizes learning across different angular ranges by reducing the influence of uninformative large-error cases. Experiments on seven BOP core datasets show that WAPR achieves state-of-the-art performance in unseen-object 6D pose localization and detection under both fast and unconstrained inference settings. Project page: https://github.com/WangYuLin-SEU/WAPR.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. 19 pages, 4 figures. Yulin Wang and Mengting Hu contributed equally. Corresponding author: Chen Luo
papers.journal_ref: In: Computer Vision - ECCV 2026, LNCS vol. 17016, pp. 221-239. Springer, Cham (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WAPR 是零样本大角度 6D 位姿细化模型，可把旋转偏差最大达 90° 的候选位姿直接细化，每个检测实例只需 12 个候选位姿即可在 1 秒内完成单帧推理，吞吐最高达每秒 25 个检测实例。它用旋转对称先验在损失计算前把对称等价位姿目标规范化，并以角度平衡损失削弱无信息量的大误差样本对学习的干扰。在七个 BOP core 数据集上，WAPR 在未见物体的 6D 位姿定位与检测任务中，于快速与非受限两种推理设置下均取得 state-of-the-art 表现。
Motivation: 真实场景要求 6D 位姿估计同时做到准确、快速并能扩展到未见物体，而旋转对称物体的等价位姿目标与大角度误差样本会让大角度细化训练不稳定。
Method: WAPR 是零样本大角度位姿细化模型，先在损失计算前用旋转对称先验 (rotational symmetry priors) 把对称等价位姿目标规范化，再用角度平衡损失 (angle-balanced loss) 降低无信息量大误差样本的影响。配套构建大规模训练集 SA6D：由 KASAL 提供 944 个 GSO 扫描的旋转对称先验，经几何与纹理增强扩展到约 50K 增强物体实例与约 200 万张渲染 RGB-D 图像。
Result: 每个检测实例仅需 12 个候选位姿，单帧推理在 1 秒内完成，位姿估计吞吐最高达每秒 25 个检测实例；在七个 BOP core 数据集上，未见物体的 6D 位姿定位与检测在快速与非受限推理设置下均达到 state-of-the-art。SA6D 覆盖 944 个 GSO 扫描、约 50K 增强物体实例与约 200 万张渲染 RGB-D 图像。
Conclusion: 把对称先验规范化与角度平衡损失放进大角度细化训练，可以在未见物体上同时拿到 90° 级细化能力、秒内推理与 SOTA 精度。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: KASALv2: Fully Automatic 3D Rotational Symmetry Classification and Axis Localization
papers.abstract_en: Rotational symmetry is an important prior in 6D pose estimation, improving pose accuracy and supporting symmetry-aware evaluation. However, current symmetry annotations for 3D objects remain largely manual or semi-automatic, often requiring predefined types or orders, which limits scalability. This work introduces a fully automatic, reference-free framework for symmetry-type classification, rotational-order identification, and full-axis localization across all eight canonical 3D rotational symmetry types. The method localizes a dominant high-order axis, infers its rotational order through self-consistency analysis, and reconstructs the complete symmetry structure under a hierarchy-guided formulation. A texture-aware extension further models appearance-induced reductions in rotational order while preserving axis orientations. Experiments on idealized and real-world datasets demonstrate strong accuracy and generalization, achieving 94.75% accuracy on 438 symmetric objects in GSO. Training FoundationPose with these priors improves accuracy by up to 0.9% across five BOP datasets, showing that automatically estimated rotational priors improve downstream 6D pose estimation. Code is available at https://github.com/WangYuLin-SEU/KASAL.
papers.comment: CVPR 2026. 10 pages, 4 figures. Mengxin Zhang and Yulin Wang contributed equally. Corresponding authors: Chen Luo and Yijun Zhou
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 2026, pp. 13866-13875
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KASALv2 提出全自动、免参考的 3D 旋转对称性框架，一次完成八类规范旋转对称的类型分类、旋转阶数判定与完整轴定位：先定位主导高阶轴，用自一致性分析推断旋转阶数，再在层级引导 (hierarchy-guided) 形式下重建完整对称结构，并以纹理感知扩展刻画外观导致的阶数降低。在 GSO 的 438 个对称物体上达到 94.75% 准确率，用其先验训练 FoundationPose 在五个 BOP 数据集上最多提升 0.9%。
Motivation: 3D 物体的对称性标注仍以人工或半自动为主，且需预定义类型与阶数，难以规模化，制约了旋转对称先验在 6D 位姿估计与对称感知评估中的复用。
Method: 免参考框架分三步：定位主导高阶轴，通过自一致性分析推断其旋转阶数，在层级引导形式下重建完整对称结构，覆盖全部八种规范 3D 旋转对称类型；另加纹理感知扩展，建模外观引起的旋转阶数降低并保持轴方向不变，随后将这些先验用于训练 FoundationPose。
Result: 在 GSO 的 438 个对称物体上取得 94.75% 准确率，并在理想化与真实数据集上展示强准确性与泛化；用该先验训练 FoundationPose，在五个 BOP 数据集上精度最多提升 0.9%。
Conclusion: 自动估计的旋转对称先验可替代人工标注并直接改善下游 6D 位姿估计，对称类型、阶数与轴可由单一免参考流程同时恢复。

papers.title: Unpaired Canonical Correlation Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Canonical Correlation Analysis (CCA) is a fundamental method for multiview shared space learning. However, its strict reliance on paired data poses a significant limitation, as such data is often difficult to obtain or entirely unavailable. In this paper, we present Unpaired CCA (UCCA), a novel method that learns linear projections to maximize the correlation of the true underlying pairing without access to any paired samples during training. We first establish theoretical results connecting the Quadratic Assignment Problem (QAP) to CCA. Leveraging these theoretical insights, we derive a practical method to maximize correlation exclusively from unpaired data. To the best of our knowledge, UCCA is the first approach to learn maximally correlated projections in a strictly unpaired setting. We validate UCCA on real-world multi-modal datasets, demonstrating that it significantly outperforms recent unpaired alignment baselines in recovering the underlying true correlation. This work fills a critical gap between traditional statistical multiview learning and the growing field of unpaired data learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Unpaired CCA (UCCA)：在训练中完全不接触配对样本的前提下学习线性投影，使真实底层配对关系的相关性最大化。通过建立二次分配问题 (Quadratic Assignment Problem, QAP) 与 CCA 的理论联系导出可从纯非配对数据最大化相关的实用算法，在真实多模态数据集上恢复底层真实相关性显著优于近期非配对对齐基线。
Motivation: CCA 是多视图共享空间学习的基础方法，但严格依赖配对数据，而配对样本往往难以获得或根本不存在，限制了其在非配对多模态场景中的使用。
Method: 先建立 Quadratic Assignment Problem (QAP) 与 CCA 之间的理论联系，再据此推导出仅用非配对数据即可最大化相关性的实用方法，学习线性投影；训练阶段不使用任何配对样本。
Result: 在真实世界多模态数据集上验证，UCCA 在恢复底层真实相关性 (underlying true correlation) 上显著优于近期的非配对对齐 (unpaired alignment) 基线；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: UCCA 据称是首个在严格非配对设定下学习最大相关投影的方法，填补了传统统计多视图学习与非配对数据学习之间的空白。

papers.title: Align Before You Combine: Reference Space Calibration for Supervision Without Ground Truth
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a calibration-first framework that produces supervision scores without access to ground-truth labels or a shared annotation space. Our framework aligns subset-specific scorers using a synthetic ordinal reference space before fusion. This reference space is constructed from ordered calibration features that represent the latent concept, providing a common scale on which otherwise incomparable scorer outputs can be aligned. Because our calibration procedure uses the reference space rather than training samples, it is independent of the training set's empirical distribution. Across three benchmark datasets, our framework consistently outperforms uncalibrated averaging and achieves higher primary-metric point estimates on the evaluation metrics than the best individual scorer. Performance relative to sample-dependent baselines varies by domain, with absolute differences below 0.02 on Ames Housing and below 0.01 on Breast Cancer Wisconsin and Wine Quality. After Bonferroni correction, differences remain significant for all three comparisons on Ames Housing and one on Breast Cancer Wisconsin. Additionally, we show that using fewer calibration levels per feature can closely approximate higher-resolution results at substantially lower computational cost. Together, these results support our framework as a viable approach to construct supervision scores when neither ground-truth labels nor a shared annotation space is available.
papers.comment: 25 pages; 14 tables; 4 figures; 5 appendices; code available at https://github.com/Lafayette-EshbaughSilveyra-Group/calibration-first
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 calibration-first 框架：在无 ground-truth 标签、也无共享标注空间时，先用有序校准特征构造合成序数参考空间 (synthetic ordinal reference space)，把各子集独立打分器对齐到同一尺度再融合。在 Ames Housing、Breast Cancer Wisconsin、Wine Quality 三个基准上，主指标点估计均高于未校准平均与最优单个打分器，相对样本依赖基线的绝对差距分别低于 0.02 与 0.01。
Motivation: 多个子集各自的打分器输出量纲与尺度不同，既没有真值标签可回归，也没有共享标注空间可比，直接平均会把不可比的分数混在一起。
Method: 用代表潜在概念的有序校准特征构造合成序数参考空间，把 subset-specific scorers 先对齐到该公共尺度再融合；校准只依赖参考空间而非训练样本，因此与训练集经验分布无关；另用减少每特征校准级数 (calibration levels) 的版本降低计算量。
Result: 在三个基准数据集上一致优于未校准平均，且主指标点估计高于最优单个打分器；相对样本依赖基线的绝对差异在 Ames Housing 上低于 0.02，在 Breast Cancer Wisconsin 与 Wine Quality 上低于 0.01；Bonferroni 校正后 Ames Housing 三项比较仍显著、Breast Cancer Wisconsin 一项显著；减少每特征校准级数能以显著更低的计算代价逼近高分辨率结果。
Conclusion: 在既无真值标签也无共享标注空间的条件下，先对齐参考空间再融合是构造监督分数的可行路径，且校准不依赖训练样本分布，少级数校准即可逼近高分辨率效果。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Reflected Anchored Langevin Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: First order Langevin algorithms for constrained sampling in machine learning, such as projected Langevin Monte Carlo which are based on discretizations of reflected Langevin dynamics, require differentiable log densities that limits their applicability. This paper introduces reflected anchored Langevin dynamics (RALD), a reflected diffusion that converges to non-differentiable targets on constrained domains. The method uses a smooth anchored reference potential and multiplies the drift and noise covariance of its reflected Langevin dynamics by the same state dependent scaling factor. Its Euler-Maruyama discretization with projection gives reflected anchored Langevin Monte Carlo (RALMC) algorithm. We prove explicit convergence bounds and iteration complexity for RALMC in the 2-Wasserstein distance to the target distribution. Numerical experiments are provided to illustrate the theoretical predictions and the empirical performance of the method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出反射锚定 Langevin 动力学 (RALD)：用光滑的锚定参考势替代可微 log 密度，并对反射 Langevin 动力学的漂移与噪声协方差乘以同一个状态相关缩放因子，使其能在约束域上采样非可微目标分布。其 Euler-Maruyama 加投影离散化得到 RALMC 算法，作者证明了 2-Wasserstein 距离下的显式收敛界与迭代复杂度，并用数值实验说明理论预测与经验表现。
Motivation: 投影 Langevin Monte Carlo 等一阶约束采样算法基于反射 Langevin 动力学的离散化，但要求 log 密度可微，限制了其在非可微目标上的适用性。
Method: 构造反射锚定 Langevin 动力学 (RALD)：引入光滑锚定参考势，将反射 Langevin 动力学的漂移项与噪声协方差乘以同一个状态相关缩放因子；对其做 Euler-Maruyama 离散化并加投影，得到 RALMC 算法；理论上给出 2-Wasserstein 距离下的显式收敛界与迭代复杂度。
Result: 证明了 RALMC 在 2-Wasserstein 距离下到目标分布的显式收敛界与迭代复杂度；提供数值实验以说明理论预测与方法的经验表现。
Conclusion: 通过状态相关缩放的反射锚定 Langevin 动力学，可以在约束域上对非可微目标做带理论收敛保证的一阶采样，绕开投影 LMC 对可微 log 密度的依赖。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Not All Uncertainty Matters: Simulation-in-the-Loop Fast-Slow Reasoning for Decision-Critical Autonomous Driving System
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (VLMs) provide powerful open-world perception and reasoning for autonomous driving, but their high computational cost and inference latency make continuous cloud-side use impractical. This motivates fast--slow collaboration, where efficient onboard modules handle real-time perception and control while cloud models provide high-level reasoning only when needed. The key challenge is deciding when cloud reasoning should influence time-critical driving decisions. Existing methods often rely on perception uncertainty, heuristic triggers, or resource-driven policies, without assessing whether resolving an uncertainty will improve planning. We propose \textbf{SIGMA}, a simulation-in-the-loop framework for task-oriented fast--slow collaboration. SIGMA embeds the planner into uncertainty assessment and evaluates how plausible scene realizations under semantic and geometric uncertainty affect feasible trajectories and planning cost. Based on these outcomes, it estimates the expected reduction in planning cost from resolving uncertainty. We further introduce expected planning gain (EPG), a decision-level metric for cloud invocation, cloud-guidance integration, and request prioritization under deadline and resource constraints. Experiments in CARLA show that SIGMA reduces unnecessary cloud interactions while improving planning, efficiency, and navigation success in static and dynamic obstacle scenarios. Compared with fixed-period collaboration, SIGMA reduces unnecessary cloud interactions by 50\%, improves navigation success by more than 6\%, and cuts finish time by up to 26.2\% in dynamic scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SIGMA 把规划器嵌入不确定性评估，用仿真在环 (simulation-in-the-loop) 的快慢协同判定何时该调用云端 VLM：只有当解析语义与几何不确定性预计能降低规划代价时才触发云端推理，并以 expected planning gain (EPG) 统一做云端调用、引导融合与请求排序。在 CARLA 静态与动态障碍场景中，相比固定周期协同，不必要云端交互减少 50%，导航成功率提升超过 6%，动态场景完成时间最多缩短 26.2%。
Motivation: 云端 VLM 推理延迟与算力开销使持续调用不可行，而现有触发策略只看感知不确定性、启发式或资源条件，不判断解析该不确定性是否真能改善规划，导致时间紧迫决策下的无效云端交互。
Method: SIGMA 是面向任务的快慢协同框架：把规划器纳入不确定性评估，对语义与几何不确定性下的 plausible 场景实现做仿真，考察其对可行轨迹与规划代价的影响，据此估计解析不确定性的期望规划代价下降；提出决策层指标 EPG，用于云端调用、云端引导融合以及截止期与资源约束下的请求优先级排序。
Result: 在 CARLA 的静态与动态障碍场景实验中，相比 fixed-period collaboration，SIGMA 减少不必要云端交互 50%，导航成功率提高超过 6%，动态场景完成时间最多缩短 26.2%，同时在规划、效率与导航成功率上均有改善。
Conclusion: 是否调用云端推理应由解析不确定性对规划的预期收益决定，而非感知不确定性本身；按 EPG 触发可在节省云端交互的同时提升规划与导航表现。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Differential Refresh Policies for Models Trained on Lagging Data Snapshots: From a Single-Age Equivalence Limit to an Optimal Per-Segment Allocation
papers.abstract_en: Production machine-learning models are derived artifacts of time-bounded training snapshots: a deployed model is a materialized view over a training cut that ages the instant it is built. A common response is to replace the fixed retraining cadence with an adaptive trigger -- a weighted staleness score that retrains when accumulated source risk crosses a threshold. We show this is the wrong lever, and identify the right one. First, an equivalence limit: any refresh trigger that is a static, strictly monotone function of a single shared global training-data age is operationally equivalent to a calibrated uniform age timer, so a global staleness budget, however elaborately it weights segments, sources, and sensitivities, carries no scheduling information a clock does not. The limit also shows how to escape it: refresh segments differentially, giving each its own age and refresh interval, which is meaningful when refresh cost is separable across segments (incremental training or per-segment models). We solve the resulting budget-allocation problem. In the frequent-refresh regime each segment's optimal refresh rate is proportional to the square root of its risk $w_j λ_j$ (weight times change rate), and the optimal policy never costs more than the uniform timer, beating it by a closed-form Cauchy-Schwarz "price of uniformity" that is zero for homogeneous workloads and grows with heterogeneity. In a discrete-event simulation with real Poisson change events, the optimal policy lowers realized weighted stale exposure by 8-29% relative to the uniform timer at matched refresh budget, winning on 86-100% of seeds; a naive exposure-threshold policy does not, showing the allocation is what helps; and the advantage survives 50% rate-estimation noise. The leverage in model refresh is not a better score but a better action.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文证明：任何只依赖单一全局训练数据年龄、且严格单调的刷新触发器，都等价于一个标定过的均匀年龄定时器，加权 staleness 分数本身不携带任何调度信息。出路是按 segment 差异化刷新，在频繁刷新区间每段最优刷新率正比于 sqrt(w_j λ_j)，仿真中在同等刷新预算下把加权陈旧暴露降低 8–29%。
Motivation: 生产 ML 模型是随时间老化的训练快照的物化视图，常见做法是用加权 staleness 分数触发重训练；论文指出这个杠杆选错了，全局 staleness 预算无论怎么加权都不含时钟之外的调度信息。
Method: 先给出单一年龄等价极限（静态严格单调的全局年龄触发器 ≡ 标定均匀定时器），再在刷新成本可按 segment 分离的假设下求预算分配问题：频繁刷新区间最优率 ∝ sqrt(w_j λ_j)，并用 Cauchy-Schwarz 导出相对均匀定时器的闭式 price of uniformity；最后在含真实 Poisson 变更事件的离散事件仿真中检验。
Result: 最优策略在同等刷新预算下将实现的加权陈旧暴露相对均匀定时器降低 8–29%，在 86–100% 的种子上取胜；朴素 exposure-threshold 策略做不到，说明起作用的是分配而非分数；优势在 50% 的速率估计噪声下仍然保持。price of uniformity 对同质负载为 0，随异质性增长，且最优策略成本从不高于均匀定时器。
Conclusion: 模型刷新的关键不是更好的分数而是更好的动作：把刷新预算按 segment 差异化分配，而不是调全局 staleness 权重。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: ActiveLang: Active Open-Vocabulary 3D Mapping with Semantic-Uncertainty-Guided Exploration
papers.abstract_en: As robots increasingly assist humans with diverse tasks, they need both geometric and semantic understanding of their surroundings. Moreover, robots often operate in unfamiliar environments and take on new tasks without knowing the relevant concepts ahead of time. This motivates language-annotated 3D maps that support open-vocabulary scene understanding and human-robot interaction. We introduce ActiveLang, an autonomous system for active open-vocabulary 3D mapping with semantic-uncertainty-guided exploration. ActiveLang performs online language-feature adaptation on a compact dual-Gaussian representation to jointly reconstruct scene geometry, appearance, and open-vocabulary semantics with modest memory overhead. Its planner efficiently selects informative viewpoints, enabling effective mapping with fewer observations and lower computational cost. Experiments on Replica and ScanNet++ demonstrate substantial improvements in 2D and 3D open-vocabulary segmentation over both online and offline baselines, highlighting that actively exploring scenes builds language-annotated 3D maps more efficiently.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ActiveLang 让机器人在未知环境中主动探索并构建带语言标注的开放词汇 3D 地图：在紧凑的 dual-Gaussian 表示上做在线语言特征适配，同时重建几何、外观与开放词汇语义，规划器按语义不确定性选择信息量大的视点。在 Replica 与 ScanNet++ 上，其 2D 与 3D 开放词汇分割相对在线与离线基线均有显著提升，且所需观测更少、计算开销更低。
Motivation: 机器人在陌生环境执行事先未知概念的新任务时，需要既含几何又含开放词汇语义的地图；离线建图依赖大量观测且语义无法在线适配，难以支撑人机交互。
Method: 在紧凑的 dual-Gaussian 表示上进行在线语言特征适配 (online language-feature adaptation)，联合重建几何、外观与开放词汇语义，内存开销较小；语义不确定性引导的规划器选择信息量大的视点，以更少观测完成建图。
Result: 在 Replica 与 ScanNet++ 上，2D 与 3D 开放词汇分割相对在线和离线基线均有显著提升，同时观测数量更少、计算成本更低。
Conclusion: 主动探索（按语义不确定性选视点）比被动采集更高效地构建语言标注 3D 地图，且在线语义适配可在有限内存下支撑开放词汇理解。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: It Is Not Seeing the Hazard: A Frozen Vision-Language Safety Score Measures Its Caption Bank
papers.abstract_en: Frozen vision-language models increasingly provide safety signals for reinforcement learning. Their use assumes that similarity to language describing danger indicates the hazard itself. Yet policy return and collision rate cannot reveal whether a score detects hazards or responds to correlated features of the scene. VLM-based methods have reported gains in driving and safe-RL benchmarks by converting image-text similarity into rewards, costs, or confidence weights. Such signals promise to reduce reliance on manually designed feedback. They may also reflect prompt structure, embedding geometry, or camera viewpoint, leaving their safety meaning unverified. To address this gap, we present a controlled evaluation of a frozen CLIP prompt-margin safety score. We apply the score to trajectories generated by policies that never receive it, match pre-contact observations to contact-free observations with comparable hazard geometry, and vary the captions, encoder, and camera view. Across three policies, 180 episodes, and 130 isolated contact onsets, the score decreases for about twenty steps before contact. Mechanism controls indicate that the score mainly tracks resemblance to the scene shared by its captions and changes with caption separation and camera view. A constant-confidence control retains the lower catastrophe-rate point estimate, so policy gains do not establish hazard perception.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 冻结 CLIP 的 prompt-margin 安全分数在接触前约 20 步下降，但机制对照显示它主要追踪与 caption 所共享场景的相似度，而非危险本身：改变 caption 间隔与相机视角会改变分数。因此在 3 个策略、180 条轨迹、130 次孤立接触起始上，恒定置信度对照仍保留更低的灾难率点估计，说明策略收益不能证明模型具备危险感知。
Motivation: 用冻结 VLM 的图文相似度当安全奖励/代价的做法默认相似即危险，但回报与碰撞率无法区分分数是在检测危险还是在响应场景中的相关特征，其安全含义未经验证。
Method: 对冻结 CLIP 的 prompt-margin 安全分数做受控评测：把分数施加到从未接收该分数的策略生成的轨迹上，将接触前观测与危险几何相当的无接触观测配对，并系统改变 captions、编码器与相机视角；另设恒定置信度 (constant-confidence) 对照。
Result: 在 3 个策略、180 条 episodes、130 次孤立接触起始 (contact onsets) 上，分数在接触前约 20 步下降；机制对照表明分数主要追踪其 captions 共享场景的相似度，并随 caption 分隔与相机视角变化；恒定置信度对照仍保留更低的灾难率点估计。
Conclusion: 策略侧的回报与碰撞率改善不能证明危险感知，这类分数的安全含义必须由机制对照而非任务收益来确立。

papers.title: STRIKE: Learning Visual State Transitions for Physical World Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Physical world modeling requires predicting how interactions change a scene, not merely generating coherent motion. We propose STRIKE, a framework that separates visual state transition learning from dense video generation. We construct event-aligned supervision by extracting observed states from training videos and pairing them with transition descriptions and temporal offsets. An image-based transition model learns to predict the next scene configuration from the current image, a local transition specification, and elapsed time. At inference, a pretrained vision-language planner predicts time transition specifications, and recursive application of the learned transition model produces a sequence of future visual states. A separately trained dynamic model then generates the complete rollout conditioned on these states and their temporal locations. Experiments on Physics-IQ Verified, PhyGenBench, Pisa-Experiments, and RoboTwin2.0 show improvements of STRIKE over the corresponding video-backbone baselines in benchmark measures of physical consistency and manipulation-video fidelity. These results support learned visual state transitions as an effective intermediate representation for physical world modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STRIKE 把物理世界建模拆成「视觉状态转移学习」与「稠密视频生成」两步：先从训练视频抽取观测状态，配对转移描述与时间偏移做事件对齐监督，训练图像式转移模型预测下一场景构型，再由预训练视觉-语言规划器给出时间转移规格、递归 rollout 出未来状态序列，最后单独训练的动态模型按这些状态与时刻生成完整视频。在 Physics-IQ Verified、PhyGenBench、Pisa-Experiments 与 RoboTwin2.0 上，STRIKE 在物理一致性与操作视频保真度的基准度量上优于对应的 video-backbone 基线。
Motivation: 物理世界建模需要预测交互如何改变场景，而不只是生成看起来连贯的运动；直接做稠密视频生成难以保证状态演化符合物理。
Method: 从训练视频中抽取观测状态并与转移描述、时间偏移配对，构造事件对齐监督；图像式转移模型以当前图像、局部转移规格和经过时间为输入预测下一场景构型；推理时由预训练视觉-语言规划器预测时间转移规格，递归调用转移模型得到未来视觉状态序列，再由单独训练的动态模型按这些状态及其时间位置生成完整 rollout。
Result: 在 Physics-IQ Verified、PhyGenBench、Pisa-Experiments 和 RoboTwin2.0 四个基准上，STRIKE 在物理一致性与操作视频保真度的基准度量上相对各自的 video-backbone 基线均有提升。
Conclusion: 学到的视觉状态转移可以作为物理世界建模的有效中间表示，把转移预测与稠密视频生成分开训练比端到端视频骨干更管用。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: OmniCam: Omni-Camera Trajectory Generation via Geometry-Grounded Pose Token Learning
papers.abstract_en: Camera trajectories control viewpoint changes in video generation, scene reconstruction, and robotic perception. Generating them from language requires both scene geometry and target-aware framing. We introduce OmniCam, an autoregressive model that generates camera pose sequences from a single panorama and textual trajectory descriptions. Its geometry-grounded pose token learning combines three components: a panoramic point-cloud encoder for omnidirectional geometric context; hybrid absolute-rotation and relative-translation tokenization with temporally consistent quaternion signs; and separate geometric and semantic conditioning streams with an explicit 3D target anchor. We also construct OmniCaT, containing 267,700 trajectories across four camera behaviors. On the reported OmniCaT evaluation, OmniCam reduces trajectory errors by 28--47% and collision rate by 65.8% relative to GenDoP retrained on OmniCaT. Against the best baseline for each metric, the ATE and collision reductions are 43.0% and 62.3%, respectively. Component ablations support the use of geometric and target-aware conditioning, while downstream experiments examine camera-controlled video generation and robotic active perception.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OmniCam 是一个自回归相机位姿序列生成模型，从单张全景图加文本轨迹描述直接生成相机轨迹，用全景点云编码器提供全向几何上下文，并把几何条件与带显式 3D 目标锚点的语义条件分成两路。在自建的 OmniCaT（267,700 条轨迹、四种相机行为）上，相对在该数据集重训的 GenDoP，轨迹误差降低 28–47%、碰撞率降低 65.8%；对各指标最强基线，ATE 与碰撞分别降低 43.0% 与 62.3%。
Motivation: 从语言生成相机轨迹需要同时掌握场景几何与目标导向取景，而现有方法在这两点上不足，导致轨迹误差与碰撞率偏高。
Method: geometry-grounded pose token learning 含三部分：全景点云编码器提取全向几何上下文；混合绝对旋转与相对平移 token 化并保证四元数符号的时间一致性；几何条件与语义条件分设两条流并加入显式 3D 目标锚点。自回归生成位姿序列，训练数据为自建 OmniCaT。
Result: 在 OmniCaT 评测上，相对在 OmniCaT 重训的 GenDoP，轨迹误差降低 28–47%，碰撞率降低 65.8%；对每个指标各自的最强基线，ATE 降低 43.0%、碰撞率降低 62.3%。OmniCaT 含 267,700 条轨迹、覆盖四种相机行为。组件消融支持几何条件与目标感知条件的使用，下游实验涉及相机可控视频生成与机器人主动感知。
Conclusion: 把几何上下文与目标锚点显式注入位姿 token 学习，可在全景到文本驱动的轨迹生成上同时压低轨迹误差与碰撞率，且该收益在消融与下游任务中得到支持。

papers.title: LiG-DETR: Local-in-Global Reassembly in Latent Space for Aerial Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Aerial object detection faces substantial scale and density variations. Small objects are easily degraded by downsampling and feature compression, while medium and large objects require sufficient global context. Existing methods mainly follow two paradigms: image slicing provides clearer local evidence but relies on independent crop-level prediction and post-processing, whereas feature- and query-level optimization preserves unified inference but operates on already compressed full-image representations, limiting recovery of fine-grained information. This raises a key question: can aerial detection directly acquire high-fidelity local evidence before feature degradation and integrate it into a unified end-to-end framework? To this end, we propose LiG-DETR, an Efficient Global-Local Reassembly framework that reformulates image slicing as high-fidelity local feature acquisition. A shared encoder extracts global and locally magnified features, which are projected into the detector feature space. The projected local features are reassembled according to their original spatial locations to form a globally aligned local feature level, and a single DETR decoder jointly decodes global and local features. To reduce redundant computation, Context-Preserved Selective Reassembly focuses high-resolution encoding on informative regions while preserving a dense feature layout, and Density-Aware Adaptive Query Allocation adapts the decoder query budget using encoder proposal scores. Experiments show substantial gains on small and medium objects while retaining strong large-object performance, with favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-offs and improved cross-domain generalization. The code will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LiG-DETR 把图像切片重定义为高保真局部特征获取：共享编码器同时提取全局与局部放大特征并投影到检测器特征空间，局部特征按原始空间位置重组为全局对齐的局部特征层，由单个 DETR decoder 联合解码。Context-Preserved Selective Reassembly 把高分辨率编码集中在信息量大的区域，Density-Aware Adaptive Query Allocation 用编码器 proposal 分数调节 decoder query 预算，从而在小中目标上取得明显增益并保持大目标性能。
Motivation: 航拍检测中尺度与密度差异大：小目标被下采样和特征压缩破坏，中大目标又需要全局上下文。现有切片范式依赖独立 crop 级预测与后处理，特征/query 级方法只能在已压缩的全图表示上优化，难以恢复细粒度信息。
Method: Efficient Global-Local Reassembly 框架：共享编码器提取全局与局部放大特征并投影到检测器特征空间；局部特征按原始空间位置重组为全局对齐的局部特征层；单个 DETR decoder 联合解码全局与局部特征；Context-Preserved Selective Reassembly 只对信息区域做高分辨率编码并保持稠密特征布局，Density-Aware Adaptive Query Allocation 依据 encoder proposal 分数分配 decoder query 预算。
Result: 实验显示小目标与中目标上有明显增益，同时保持较强的大目标性能，并取得有利的精度-效率权衡与更好的跨域泛化；代码将开源。
Conclusion: 在特征退化前直接获取高保真局部证据并重组进统一端到端框架，可在航拍检测中同时改善小中目标精度、效率与跨域泛化。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Neural Plasticity: PDE Solvers That Reshape Themselves
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed neural PDE solvers adapt their parameters to satisfy governing equations, yet their representational structure typically remains fixed throughout training. This rigidity is poorly matched to PDE solutions with strongly heterogeneous complexity across space and space--time, leaving capacity insufficient where the physics is difficult and redundant where it is simple. We introduce physics-informed neural plasticity, a paradigm in which the representation itself reshapes during optimization in response to unresolved physics. We instantiate this principle with Representation Capacity Adaptation for PDEs (ReCAP), a Gaussian-localized solver that dynamically redistributes capacity through local enrichment, residual-directed splitting, gate-based pruning, and function-aware merging. ReCAP uses responsibility-weighted error indicators and the geometry of residual energy to determine where and how to refine. To limit the disturbance introduced by splitting, we introduce quiet-child refinement, which initializes new components by transporting the parent representation while controlling instantaneous functional perturbation. We further establish conditional a posteriori reliability and structural-stability guarantees linking localized physics residuals to solution error and stable refinement. Across five challenging 3D and 4D PDE benchmarks against 11 physics-informed solvers, ReCAP achieves the lowest relative $L^2$ error on every problem, reducing error by $10.7\%$--$27.5\%$ relative to the strongest competing result. These results suggest that physics-informed solvers need not merely learn their parameters---they can learn how their representational capacity should be organized.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出物理信息神经可塑性范式与其实例 ReCAP：Gaussian 局部化的 PDE 求解器在优化中按未解物理动态重分配容量，通过局部富集、残差导向分裂、门控剪枝与函数感知合并重塑表示。在 5 个 3D/4D PDE 基准上对 11 个物理信息求解器，ReCAP 每题相对 L2 误差最低，较最强竞争结果降低 10.7%–27.5%。
Motivation: 物理信息神经求解器参数虽自适应，表示结构在训练中固定，无法匹配空间与时空上强异质的解复杂度：物理难处容量不足、简单处冗余。
Method: ReCAP 用责任加权误差指示子 (responsibility-weighted error indicators) 与残差能量几何决定在何处、如何细化；机制含局部富集、残差导向分裂、门控剪枝、函数感知合并；分裂扰动由 quiet-child refinement 控制——搬运父表示初始化新分量并约束瞬时函数扰动；另给出条件 a posteriori 可靠性与结构稳定性保证，把局部物理残差与解误差、稳定细化挂钩。
Result: 在 5 个具挑战性的 3D 与 4D PDE 基准上对比 11 个物理信息求解器，ReCAP 在每个问题上取得最低相对 L2 误差，较最强竞争结果降低 10.7%–27.5%。
Conclusion: 物理信息求解器不必只学参数，还可以学表示容量应如何组织；容量按局部残差重分配能同时改善精度并附带条件 a posteriori 可靠性与结构稳定性保证。

papers.title: TERRA: Learning Transportable Latent Actions through Temporal Effect Representation and Relational Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Latent actions supervise robot policies with action-like codes inferred from visual transitions, and their usefulness hinges on two questions: what a code keeps from a transition, and whether it still means the same thing when reused in a different initial state. The first is a tension in time: an endpoint difference discards how motion unfolds, while the full sequence admits nuisance variation. The second is left open by reconstruction, which only ever observes a latent together with the state it came from. We argue that both questions can be answered in the same place. TERRA (Temporal Effect Representation and Relational Alignment) describes a transition by a compact temporal effect, its net feature change together with a low-order within-window dynamics component, and learns a continuous latent from this effect. The same effect space then serves as the reference for reuse: Effect-Anchored Transport (EAT) decodes a latent in other initial states and anchors the resulting effect to the one observed at its source, so that the latent is shaped by what it does across contexts rather than only by the transition it came from. With frozen linear readers, TERRA predicts actions more accurately than UniVLA and a LAPA-style baseline, degrades more slowly under visual distractors, and keeps transported transitions faithful to the donor action as the recipient context moves farther away; a same-budget control shows that these gains come largely from EAT. At matched pretraining scale, the complete system reaches 93.4% average success on LIBERO, compared with 91.8% for UniVLA.
papers.comment: Preprint. Code and project page coming soon
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TERRA 用「时间效应表示 + 关系对齐」学习可迁移的潜在动作 (latent actions)：把视觉转移压缩为净特征变化加低阶窗内动力学分量，并用 Effect-Anchored Transport (EAT) 让同一潜在码在其他初始状态下解码后锚定到源端观测到的效应上。在匹配预训练规模下，LIBERO 平均成功率 93.4%，高于 UniVLA 的 91.8%，且在视觉干扰下退化更慢。
Motivation: 潜在动作的两个核心问题悬而未决：码从转移中保留什么（端点差分丢掉运动过程，全序列又引入干扰变化），以及码在不同初始状态复用时是否仍表示同一件事——重建目标无法回答后者。
Method: TERRA 用紧凑的时间效应（净特征变化 + 低阶窗内动力学分量）描述转移，并从该效应学习连续潜在码；EAT 在其他初始状态解码该潜在码，并把产生的效应锚定到源转移观测到的效应，使潜在码受跨上下文作用而非仅受源转移塑造；评测用冻结的线性读出器 (frozen linear readers)。
Result: 在冻结线性读出器下，TERRA 的动作预测精度高于 UniVLA 和 LAPA 式基线；视觉干扰下性能退化更慢；受体上下文离供体越远，被迁移转移仍保持对供体动作的忠实性；同预算对照显示这些增益主要来自 EAT。匹配预训练规模下 LIBERO 平均成功率 93.4%（UniVLA 91.8%）。
Conclusion: 把「转移描述」与「复用参照」统一到同一个效应空间，可以让潜在动作按其跨上下文的实际作用而非来源转移被塑造；增益主要由 EAT 贡献。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Safe on Average, Unsafe in the Tail: When Is the Episodic-Cost Tail Controllable?
papers.abstract_en: Safe reinforcement learning seeks policies that maximize return while satisfying constraints on cumulative cost. Most methods impose these constraints on expected episodic cost. Consequently, standard evaluations report mean episodic cost without characterizing how cost is distributed across episodes. A policy that satisfies the mean-cost criterion may therefore remain unsafe in its worst episodes. Mean-cost reporting neither identifies this tail violation nor shows whether it can be brought within budget while preserving return. In this work, we measure the episodic-cost tail using $\mathrm{CVaR}_{0.1}$, the average cost of the worst $10\%$ of episodes. We classify a policy as tail-safe when $\mathrm{CVaR}_{0.1}$ is within the safety budget. This allows us first to identify policies that are safe on average but unsafe in the tail and then to study whether their tail violations can be controlled while preserving return. To identify tail-unsafe policies, we evaluate five standard algorithms on three Safety-Gymnasium navigation tasks. We then examine four constraint families on dense-hazard navigation and assess tail control across four navigation and four locomotion tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 安全强化学习把约束写在期望 episodic cost 上，导致均值达标但最差 10% episode 仍超预算的策略被漏检。作者用 CVaR_0.1（最差 10% episode 的平均 cost）定义 tail-safe，在 Safety-Gymnasium 上评估五个标准算法识别这类策略，并考察能否在保住 return 的前提下把尾部违规压回预算内。
Motivation: 标准安全 RL 评测只报平均 episodic cost，既看不出尾部违规，也不说明该违规能否在不牺牲 return 的情况下被控制，均值达标因此可能掩盖最差 episode 的不安全。
Method: 以 CVaR_0.1（最差 10% episode 的平均 cost）度量 episodic-cost 尾部，CVaR_0.1 落在安全预算内即判为 tail-safe；先在三个 Safety-Gymnasium 导航任务上评估五个标准算法筛出均值安全但尾部不安全的策略，再在 dense-hazard 导航上考察四类约束族，并在四个导航与四个运动 (locomotion) 任务上评估尾部控制。
Result: 在三个 Safety-Gymnasium 导航任务上评估五个标准算法以识别均值安全而尾部不安全的策略；在 dense-hazard 导航上分析四类约束族，并在四个导航任务和四个 locomotion 任务上评估尾部违规能否在保持 return 的同时被控制。
Conclusion: 期望 episodic cost 约束不足以刻画安全性，需用 CVaR_0.1 这类尾部指标判定 tail-safe，并把尾部违规能否在保 return 下受控作为独立问题来检验。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Adjoint-Based Calibration and Optimal Control of Stochastic Multiscale Bioprocess Digital Twins
papers.abstract_en: We develop a bias-aware digital-twin calibration and control framework for multiscale bioprocess models within a biological systems-of-systems (Bio-SoS) paradigm. The digital twin is represented by a stochastic differential equation (SDE) model and calibrated from sparse, discrete observations using quasi-likelihood estimation and adjoint sensitivity analysis. SDE generator-based moment expansions characterize truncation-induced parameter bias, while forward-backward adjoints quantify how calibration uncertainty propagates to value functions and policy performance. The resulting parameter-error distribution supports both policy-directed adaptive experimental design and uncertainty-aware policy optimization through a second-order Gaussian-averaged objective. We characterize the asymptotic behavior of the resulting exploration criterion and derive a physical-system performance under the optimized policy. To implement these ideas, we develop an Actor-Simulator algorithm that jointly updates model parameters, selects informative experiments, and optimizes control policies. Numerical studies demonstrate improved calibration accuracy, sample efficiency, and control performance relative to state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对生物过程 (bioprocess) 随机多尺度数字孪生，提出偏差感知的校准与控制框架：用 SDE 模型加准似然估计与伴随灵敏度分析从稀疏离散观测校准参数，再把参数误差分布喂给二阶高斯平均目标做不确定性感知策略优化，并由 Actor-Simulator 算法联合更新参数、选实验、优化控制策略。数值研究显示校准精度、样本效率与控制性能相对 state-of-the-art 基线均有提升。
Motivation: 多尺度生物过程模型在稀疏离散观测下校准时存在截断诱导的参数偏差，且校准不确定性会沿 value function 传播到策略性能，需要在偏差与不确定性同时存在时做校准和控制。
Method: 数字孪生用随机微分方程 (SDE) 表示，以准似然估计 (quasi-likelihood estimation) 和伴随灵敏度分析 (adjoint sensitivity analysis) 从稀疏离散观测校准；用 SDE generator 的矩展开刻画截断导致的参数偏差，用 forward-backward adjoint 量化校准不确定性向 value function 与策略性能的传播；再以二阶高斯平均目标做不确定性感知策略优化，并刻画探索准则的渐进行为、推导优化策略下物理系统性能，最终实现为 Actor-Simulator 算法联合更新参数、选择信息量大的实验、优化控制策略。
Result: 数值研究中，校准精度、样本效率与控制性能相对 state-of-the-art 基线均有改善；摘要给出的是定性比较，未列具体数值。
Conclusion: 把偏差刻画、不确定性传播与策略优化放进同一个伴随驱动的闭环，可在稀疏观测下同时改进生物过程数字孪生的校准与控制；探索准则的渐进行为与优化策略下的物理系统性能有解析刻画。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: RT-DETR-World: Transferring Rich LLM Semantics to Real-Time Open-Vocabulary Detection
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary detection (OVD) recognizes categories unseen during training through textual category queries, yet achieving strong generalization with real-time efficiency remains challenging. Beyond vocabulary scaling, zero-shot generalization may benefit from reusable visual--semantic cues learned from seen data, including attributes, actions, states, and contextual relations. Existing real-time OVD methods primarily emphasize vocabulary coverage and efficient region/query--text matching; under strict efficiency constraints, compact detectors may struggle to absorb rich instance semantics and scene context. We propose RT-DETR-World, a compact DETR-style detector that transfers the rich semantics conveyed by descriptions during training while retaining lightweight query--text matching at inference. We construct GroundingCapv2 with three levels of supervision: category names for standard OVD, object descriptions conveying instance-level semantics, and image descriptions conveying object relations and scene context. These descriptions serve only as training-time semantic supervision. To help the compact detector absorb these semantics, we propose Dual-Path Description Alignment (DDA), combining a deployment-consistent MiniLM pathway with a training-only LLM teacher. MiniLM provides query--category supervision and object-description alignment, while offline teacher features supervise matched queries and global visual representations at the object and image levels, respectively. All teacher features are precomputed, and the teacher-side modules are removed after training. We further propose Relation-Aware Negative Relaxation (RNR), which uses teacher-derived semantic similarities to relax related negatives while preserving exact positives. Experiments demonstrate competitive zero-shot accuracy and a favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-off. The code will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RT-DETR-World 在实时开放词汇检测 (OVD) 中把 LLM 生成的描述语义蒸馏给紧凑 DETR 检测器：训练时用 GroundingCapv2 的三级监督（类别名、物体描述、图像描述）加双路径描述对齐 (DDA) 吸收实例与场景语义，推理时只保留轻量 MiniLM query–text 匹配。实验显示零样本精度具竞争力且精度–效率权衡良好，代码将开源。
Motivation: 实时 OVD 现有方法侧重词表覆盖与高效区域/query–text 匹配，紧凑检测器在严格效率约束下难以吸收丰富实例语义与场景上下文，零样本泛化受限。
Method: 构建 GroundingCapv2 三级监督数据集（类别名、物体描述、图像描述，描述仅作训练期语义监督）；提出 Dual-Path Description Alignment (DDA)，部署一致的 MiniLM 路径提供 query–类别与物体描述对齐，训练专用 LLM teacher 的离线预计算特征在物体与图像级监督匹配 query 与全局视觉表征，训练后移除 teacher 模块；再加 Relation-Aware Negative Relaxation (RNR)，用 teacher 语义相似度放松相关负样本、保留精确正样本。
Result: 实验展示具竞争力的零样本精度与良好的精度–效率权衡（摘要未列具体数值）；代码将发布。
Conclusion: 把丰富描述语义在训练期蒸馏进紧凑检测器、推理期只留轻量匹配，是实时开放词汇检测兼顾泛化与效率的可行路径。

summary_sections.motivation: 实时 OVD 现有方法侧重词表覆盖与高效区域/query–text 匹配，紧凑检测器在严格效率约束下难以吸收丰富实例语义与场景上下文，零样本泛化受限。
summary_sections.method: 构建 GroundingCapv2 三级监督数据集（类别名、物体描述、图像描述，描述仅作训练期语义监督）；提出 Dual-Path Description Alignment (DDA)，部署一致的 MiniLM 路径提供 query–类别与物体描述对齐，训练专用 LLM teacher 的离线预计算特征在物体与图像级监督匹配 query 与全局视觉表征，训练后移除 teacher 模块；再加 Relation-Aware Negative Relaxation (RNR)，用 teacher 语义相似度放松相关负样本、保留精确正样本。

papers.title: SpatialUQ: Post-Hoc Uncertainty Quantification from Spatial Consistency in Black-Box Vision Models
papers.abstract_en: Clinical vision models are often deployed as frozen black boxes with no access to internals, retraining, or ground truth at inference time. We introduce \textbf{SpatialUQ}, a post-hoc uncertainty method using only output probabilities. It measures the Jensen-Shannon divergence between the global prediction and the mean of five fixed spatial crops in six deterministic forward passes. The premise is simple, trustworthy predictions are spatially consistent. On NIH ChestX-ray14 (DenseNet-121, $N{=}25{,}596$), our Multicrop Uncertainty Score (MUS) reaches $0.784$ failure-detection AUC versus $0.664$ for MC-Dropout ($p{<}10^{-6}$) at one-fifth the compute, with native calibration ($\text{SCE}{=}0.049$ vs.\ $0.127$ for $\ell_1$), the best-calibrated among methods above 0.78 AUC. A supervised fusion of MUS with entropy, confidence, and $\ell_1$ reaches $0.832$, outperforming a five-member ensemble ($0.813$). MUS scales with model quality, reaching $0.899$ with BiomedCLIP ($ρ= 0.846$), while this relationship remains meaningful in-distribution ($ρ= 0.523$) but breaks down under severe distribution shift (VinBigData, $ρ= 0.027$). MUS is well-suited to diffuse findings but is less dependable for small focal lesions such as nodules. Code and experimental materials are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/kawsher11/SpatialUQ.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpatialUQ 是面向冻结临床视觉黑盒的事后不确定性方法，只用输出概率：计算全局预测与五个固定空间裁剪均值之间的 Jensen-Shannon 散度，六次确定性前向即得 Multicrop Uncertainty Score (MUS)。在 NIH ChestX-ray14 (DenseNet-121, N=25,596) 上 MUS 的 failure-detection AUC 为 0.784，对比 MC-Dropout 的 0.664 (p<10⁻⁶)，计算量为其五分之一。
Motivation: 临床视觉模型常以冻结黑盒部署，推理时无法访问内部、无法重训练、也没有真值，现有不确定性方法依赖内部访问或昂贵采样。
Method: 只用输出概率做六次确定性前向，取全局预测与五个固定空间裁剪均值的 Jensen-Shannon 散度作为 MUS；另做 MUS 与 entropy、confidence、ℓ₁ 的有监督融合，并与 MC-Dropout、五成员 ensemble 对比。
Result: 在 NIH ChestX-ray14 (DenseNet-121, N=25,596) 上，MUS failure-detection AUC 0.784 vs MC-Dropout 0.664 (p<10⁻⁶)，计算量为后者 1/5；原生校准 SCE=0.049 vs ℓ₁ 的 0.127，是 AUC 超过 0.78 的方法中校准最好的。有监督融合达 0.832，超过五成员 ensemble 的 0.813。换用 BiomedCLIP 时 MUS 达 0.899，与模型质量相关 ρ=0.846；分布内 ρ=0.523，而在 VinBigData 严重分布偏移下 ρ=0.007 量级的 0.027，关系失效。
Conclusion: 空间一致性可作为黑盒模型失败检测的可信代理，但其随模型质量缩放的关系在严重分布偏移下失效，且对结节等小局灶病灶不够可靠。
