papers.title: Ream: Unfolding Mutual Awareness in Human-Agent Workspaces
papers.abstract_en: As AI agents work alongside humans in shared workspaces, a mutual awareness challenge arises: agents act at speeds that outpace human monitoring, and users' evolving interests are not always expressed in chat. This challenge is especially pressing in literature review, where both parties retrieve, read, and synthesize a growing body of papers. We present Ream, a literature review workspace that supports mutual awareness through structured artifacts, bidirectional engagement tracking, and localized visualizations. Users can see each party's activity within these documents, and agents can retrieve the same history to guide their work. In studies with eighteen researchers, participants used these traces to inspect evidence, steer agents, communicate through annotations, and reflect on their research focus. Shared histories also helped agents build on earlier work. These findings inform how engagement traces within shared documents can support transparency, personalized assistance, and coordination in human-agent knowledge work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Ream 是一个文献综述共享工作区，用结构化文档工件、双向参与度追踪 (bidirectional engagement tracking) 和局部可视化，让人类与 AI agent 在同一份文档里互相看到对方的检索、阅读与综合活动，agent 也能取回同一份历史来指导后续工作。在 18 名研究者的使用研究中，参与者用这些轨迹核查证据、引导 agent、通过批注沟通并反思自身研究焦点，共享历史也帮助 agent 在前期工作之上继续推进。
Motivation: AI agent 在共享工作区中的行动速度远超人类监控节奏，而用户不断变化的兴趣并不总在对话里表达出来；文献综述场景中双方都要检索、阅读、综合不断增长的论文，这一互知 (mutual awareness) 缺口尤其突出。
Method: Ream 由三部分组成：结构化文档工件承载双方活动、双向参与度追踪记录人类与 agent 各自在文档内的行为、局部可视化把轨迹呈现给用户；同一份历史也可被 agent 检索以指导其后续工作。评估为一项有 18 名研究者参与的用户研究。
Result: 在 18 名研究者的研究中，参与者用共享轨迹核查证据、引导 agent、通过批注与 agent 沟通，并反思自己的研究焦点；共享历史同样帮助 agent 在早期工作基础上继续推进。
Conclusion: 共享文档内的参与轨迹可以同时支撑透明度、个性化辅助与人机在知识工作中的协调，即互知不必依赖对话，可由文档内的双向痕迹承载。

papers.title: Sparse Feature Policy Unlearning Mitigates State Hallucination in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong generalization in robotic manipulation by leveraging rich representations from pretrained vision-language models. However, their deployment in real-world environments remains limited by recurring unreliable behaviors. In this work, we study state hallucination, a recurring failure pattern in which a VLA continues acting as if an unrealized robot-object state had been achieved. Our analyses find that state hallucination coincides with weakened attention to task-relevant visual regions, and a mechanistic interpretation via sparse autoencoders reveals that hallucination-associated sparse features are activated when these failures occur. Based on this analysis, we propose SOUL (Sparse feature pOlicy UnLearning), which selectively unlearns policy knowledge associated with state hallucination behaviors, where sparse features identified from hallucination failures and successful behaviors serve as explicit forgetting and retention targets, respectively. Experiments across VLA architectures in simulated and real-world environments show that our method substantially reduces hallucinated failures and improves task success without substantially compromising the existing manipulation capabilities. These results suggest that interpretable feature analysis provides a practical basis for selectively modifying undesirable knowledge in robot policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLA 模型的状态幻觉 (state hallucination) 表现为机器人持续按未达成的物体状态行动，分析发现它与任务相关视觉区域注意力减弱同时出现，稀疏自编码器 (sparse autoencoder) 找到的幻觉相关稀疏特征在失败时被激活。据此提出 SOUL (Sparse feature pOlicy UnLearning)，把幻觉失败对应的稀疏特征作为遗忘目标、成功行为的特征作为保留目标，选择性地对策略做反学习。跨 VLA 架构在仿真与真实环境的实验显示幻觉失败大幅减少、任务成功率提升，且原有操作能力基本不受损。
Motivation: VLA 模型靠预训练视觉-语言表征获得强泛化，但真实部署被反复出现的不可靠行为限制：状态幻觉让机器人在物体状态并未达成时仍按已达成来行动。
Method: 先用注意力分析定位幻觉与任务相关视觉区域注意力减弱的关联，再用稀疏自编码器 (sparse autoencoder) 提取幻觉失败与成功行为各自的稀疏特征；SOUL 以幻觉特征为显式遗忘目标、成功特征为保留目标，对策略知识做选择性反学习。
Result: 在多种 VLA 架构、仿真与真实环境的实验中，SOUL substantially reduces hallucinated failures 并提升任务成功率，同时不 substantially 削弱已有操作能力；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 可解释的特征分析可以作为定向修改机器人策略中不良知识的实用依据，即用稀疏特征把遗忘与保留目标显式分开就能压住状态幻觉。

papers.title: Cognitive Schemas, Laws and Tasks
papers.abstract_en: This paper asks how explicit representations can support reusable cognitive schemas in knowledge-based problem solving. We develop a structural framework in which schemas are organized by the information and relations required for their use, rather than introduced as unrelated primitives. The framework also distinguishes context-dependent relations from more stable structures that can be reused across different representations. Tasks are described through the information available, the unknowns to be determined, and the constraints that admissible solutions must satisfy. This makes it possible to separate limitations of the representation from limitations of the solving procedure. In particular, we distinguish inconsistency, underdetermination, and contextual insufficiency, where the current representation lacks distinctions or relations required by the external task meaning. We also show formally when a reduction of representation preserves the task-relevant solution structure. The resulting task--schema interface offers a structured way to describe representational conditions relevant to problem solving. It supports the reuse and stabilization of derived knowledge while remaining independent of the particular mechanism used to generate candidate solutions. This may provide a useful component for future solver architectures that combine structured knowledge, verification, and learned proposal mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个任务—模式 (task–schema) 接口的形式框架：按使用所需的信息与关系组织认知 schema，区分依赖上下文的关系与可跨表示复用的稳定结构，并用「可用信息、待定未知量、可行解约束」描述任务，从而把表示本身的局限与求解过程的局限分开。框架给出三类局限——不一致 (inconsistency)、欠定 (underdetermination)、上下文不足 (contextual insufficiency)，并形式化刻画何种表示约简能保持任务相关的解结构。
Motivation: 知识驱动的问题求解中，schema 常作为互不相关的原语被引入，且无法区分「表示缺信息」与「求解器能力不足」这两种本质不同的失败，导致派生知识难以复用与稳定化。
Method: 构建结构化框架：schema 按其使用所需的信息与关系分层组织，分离上下文相关关系与跨表示稳定结构；任务用可用信息、待定未知量、可行解约束三元描述；在此之上形式化证明表示约简保持任务相关解结构的条件，得到与具体求解机制无关的 task–schema 接口。
Result: 给出三类表示局限的严格区分（不一致、欠定、上下文不足），并形式化地刻画表示约简何时保持任务相关的解结构；产出为一个结构化描述框架与一篇 25 页、含 1 表的论文。
Conclusion: 任务—schema 接口能在不绑定具体求解机制的前提下描述问题求解所需的表示条件，支持派生知识的复用与稳定化，可作为未来融合结构化知识、验证与学习式候选生成的求解器架构组件。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: The Attribution Blind Spot: Layerwise Trajectory Diagnostics for Source Reliance in Retrieval-Augmented Language Models
papers.abstract_en: A retrieval-augmented model can match a document without relying on it. Controlled knowledge conflicts make source choice observable and let us ask a second question that prediction alone cannot answer: which internal-state properties define useful intervention directions? We study paired hidden-state changes with Latent Trajectory Shift (LTS), a signed projection onto a training-fitted first principal component (PC1), and keep verified training exposure separate from behavioral source choice. Across the evaluated conflicts, state-change magnitude is often the stronger predictor, whereas signed PC1 is the stronger selective controller: equal-norm interventions change source preference while better preserving non-target behavior, and the frozen direction transfers across the tested datasets and aligned model pairs. A same-system OLMo study further combines positive choice and control results with inconclusive exposure detection at the achieved power. The central result is a separation: representations that diagnose what a model will choose need not be the representations that best control that choice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在检索增强语言模型的受控知识冲突中，用 Latent Trajectory Shift（LTS，配对隐状态变化在训练拟合 PC1 上的带符号投影）区分「诊断模型会选谁」与「控制模型选谁」的表征。结果是二者分离：状态变化幅度通常更能预测来源选择，而带符号 PC1 更适合做选择性干预——等范数干预改变来源偏好且更好保留非目标行为，冻结方向可跨数据集与对齐模型对迁移。
Motivation: 检索增强模型可能匹配到文档却不依赖它，仅凭预测无法判断哪些内部状态属性定义了有用干预方向；受控知识冲突让来源选择可观测，从而把「诊断」与「控制」拆成两个问题。
Method: 构造配对知识冲突，测量配对隐状态变化并计算 LTS（在训练数据拟合的第一主成分 PC1 上的带符号投影），将训练暴露（training exposure）与行为层面的来源选择分开分析；做等范数方向干预并检验跨数据集、跨对齐模型对的方向迁移，另在 OLMo 同系统上做研究。
Result: 在所评估的冲突中，状态变化幅度常是更强的预测因子，带符号 PC1 则是更强的选择性控制器：等范数干预改变来源偏好且更好保留非目标行为，冻结方向在所测数据集与对齐模型对间迁移；OLMo 研究在当前检验功效下同时给出正向的选择与控制结果，以及不确定（inconclusive）的暴露检测。
Conclusion: 诊断模型将作何选择的表征，与最佳控制该选择的表征不必相同，这是本文的核心分离结论；OLMo 上的暴露检测在当前功效下无定论。

papers.title: Gaussian Material Fields for Volumetric Multi-Energy CT Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Volumetric material decomposition in multi-energy computed tomography requires a representation that organizes multiple three-dimensional material fields in a common spatial domain while retaining differences in composition and local structure. We observe that spatial primitives can be shared across materials without tying their coefficients, but their local capacity must respond to material-specific reconstruction needs. We introduce Gaussian material fields, which represent multiple material distributions with shared anisotropic 3D Gaussian primitives and independent nonnegative material coefficients. The shared geometry defines a continuous spatial basis, while the coefficients determine each primitive's contribution to the individual material fields. To reconstruct this representation from multi-energy projections, a differentiable spectral forward model combines Gaussian material path integrals with a calibrated basis matrix, enabling joint optimization of spatial geometry and material composition. Material-aware adaptive density control retains material-specific refinement evidence before aggregation and adjusts local representation capacity to accommodate both spatially extensive components and sparse details. Experiments use synthesized multi-energy projections generated from pseudo-reference material maps constructed by conventional methods from publicly available CT data. Across 15 cases, our approach improves average PSNR by 4.03 dB and SSIM by 4.96% over the strongest baseline, while reducing NRMSE by 33.45%. Material-wise comparisons and component ablations support improved recovery of localized structures, while runtime and memory measurements show favorable computational scaling. These results establish Gaussian material fields as an explicit, adaptive representation for volumetric multi-material reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Gaussian material fields：用共享的各向异性 3D Gaussian 几何加独立非负材料系数表示多材料体数据，配合可微谱前向模型与材料感知自适应密度控制，从多能投影联合优化几何与材料组成。在 15 例合成多能投影上，较最强基线平均 PSNR 提升 4.03 dB、SSIM 提升 4.96%、NRMSE 下降 33.45%。
Motivation: 多能 CT 体材料分解需要在统一空间域中组织多个三维材料场，同时保留成分与局部结构差异；现有表示难以让局部容量随各材料的重建需求调整。
Method: 共享各向异性 3D Gaussian 原语作连续空间基，每个原语配独立非负材料系数；可微谱前向模型把 Gaussian 材料路径积分与标定基矩阵结合，联合优化几何与材料组成；材料感知自适应密度控制在聚合前保留各材料的细化证据，再调整局部表示容量。
Result: 在由公开 CT 数据构造的伪参考材料图生成的合成多能投影上，15 例中较最强基线平均 PSNR 提高 4.03 dB、SSIM 提高 4.96%、NRMSE 降低 33.45%；材料级对比与组件消融支持局部结构恢复改善，运行时间与内存测量显示有利的计算扩展性。
Conclusion: Gaussian material fields 是一种显式、自适应的体多材料重建表示，共享几何加独立系数的分解方式能同时容纳空间广布成分与稀疏细节。

papers.title: Correspondences as Decisions: JevNexus for Decision-Centric Schema Matching
papers.abstract_en: Schema matching increasingly uses generative language models to rerank retrieved column candidates, although the underlying task is a bounded correspondence decision. We present JevNexus, which combines typed pairwise decisions with schema/instance evidence and invokes listwise refinement only when the evidence disagrees and the fused margin is small. The evaluation covers 561 cases from six benchmark families. JevNexus obtains dataset-macro MRR and Hits@1 of 0.930 and 0.909, compared with 0.926 and 0.903 for Magneto, while reducing mean latency from 123.452 to 15.929 seconds (7.750). Paired analysis finds no statistically significant difference in either MRR or Hits@1. The gate invokes listwise refinement for only 5.665% of source columns and avoids the degradation caused by unconditional refinement. Code and experimental artifacts are available at https://github.com/RazeenLI/JevNexus.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JevNexus 把 schema matching 视为有界的对应决策：先做带类型的成对判定并融合 schema/instance 证据，仅在证据冲突且融合 margin 小时才触发 listwise 精化。在六个 benchmark 家族共 561 个案例上，dataset-macro MRR 0.930、Hits@1 0.909（Magneto 为 0.926/0.903），平均延迟从 123.452 秒降到 15.929 秒（7.750 倍），配对分析显示 MRR 与 Hits@1 均无统计显著差异。
Motivation: 生成式 LLM 被用来对检索到的列候选重排，但对应判定本质是有界决策，无条件的 listwise 精化既拖慢延迟又会带来性能退化。
Method: JevNexus 组合带类型的成对决策 (typed pairwise decisions) 与 schema/instance 证据，设置门控：仅当证据不一致且融合 margin 较小时才调用 listwise 精化，否则跳过。
Result: 在 561 个案例、六个 benchmark 家族上，dataset-macro MRR 0.930、Hits@1 0.909，对比 Magneto 的 0.926 与 0.903；平均延迟由 123.452 秒降至 15.929 秒（7.750 倍）；配对分析显示 MRR 与 Hits@1 均无统计显著差异；门控仅对 5.665% 的源列触发 listwise 精化。
Conclusion: 按证据冲突与 margin 触发的条件式精化能在保持与 Magneto 相当的匹配质量的同时大幅降低延迟，并避免无条件精化导致的性能退化。

papers.title: MIMESIS: Learning User Simulators as Training Environments for Interactive Agents
papers.abstract_en: Training and evaluating interactive language agents typically requires rich user interactions, yet collecting human feedback is expensive and difficult to scale. Simulated users offer a scalable alternative, but they must both resemble real user behavior and provide useful learning experiences for agents. In contrast, most agent-training frameworks rely on off-the-shelf assistant LLMs, whose helpfulness can make them overly cooperative, explicit, and behaviorally homogeneous compared with real users. We introduce MIMESIS, a purpose-built user simulator trained on human conversations with explicit reasoning supervision and 13 realistic behavioral patterns derived from real user interactions. Empirically, our 9B model achieves a SOUL-Index of 65.7, surpassing the strongest frontier model. Compared with Claude-Opus-5, the strongest baseline on RealUserSim and SimulatorArena, MIMESIS improves behavioral fidelity by 13.4 points and reduces Turing distance by 3.6 points, respectively. We then freeze the simulator and train an agent by interacting with the frozen simulator using multi-turn reinforcement learning. Across eight environments, training with MIMESIS yields better agent performance than training with GPT-5.5 under all nine unseen user simulators, demonstrating stronger generalization to new user simulators. Moreover, we propose Coached On-Policy Self-Distillation (CSD), which leverages simulator-generated private reasoning traces and subsequent utterances as feedback on how well the agent addresses user needs. A coach converts this information into concise coaching notes that describe how the agent can better anticipate user needs and adapt its behavior over the course of an interaction. CSD turns this feedback into dense, token-level supervision beyond sparse task rewards, yielding further gains across all nine evaluation user models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MIMESIS 用真实用户对话加显式推理监督训练专用用户模拟器，内置 13 种真实行为模式，9B 模型 SOUL-Index 达 65.7 并超过最强前沿模型。冻结该模拟器做多轮强化学习训练智能体，在 8 个环境、9 个未见用户模拟器上全面优于用 GPT-5.5 训练；再叠加 Coached On-Policy Self-Distillation (CSD) 的 token 级稠密监督，九个评测用户模型上进一步提升。
Motivation: 交互式语言智能体的训练依赖丰富用户交互，但人工反馈昂贵难扩展；现成助手 LLM 过于乐于助人、显式且行为同质，与真实用户差异大，难以同时保证模拟真实性和训练价值。
Method: 在真实人机对话上训练专用用户模拟器，加入显式推理监督与从真实交互中提炼的 13 种行为模式；随后冻结模拟器，用多轮强化学习与之交互训练智能体；再提出 Coached On-Policy Self-Distillation (CSD)，把模拟器的私有推理轨迹与后续话语交给 coach 转成简洁 coaching notes，形成超越稀疏任务奖励的 token 级稠密监督。
Result: 9B 的 MIMESIS 取得 SOUL-Index 65.7，超过最强前沿模型；在 RealUserSim 与 SimulatorArena 上相对 Claude-Opus-5 分别把行为保真度 (behavioral fidelity) 提高 13.4 点、Turing distance 降低 3.6 点。冻结模拟器训练的智能体在 8 个环境、全部 9 个未见用户模拟器上优于用 GPT-5.5 训练的结果；CSD 在全部 9 个评测用户模型上再带来增益。
Conclusion: 专用用户模拟器加冻结环境的多轮 RL 能比用通用助手 LLM 训练出泛化更好的交互智能体，而 CSD 用模拟器私有推理做稠密监督可在此之上继续增益。

papers.title: InstanceBench: Diagnosing Referential Reasoning and Target Identity in Referring Expression Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Referring Expression Segmentation (RES) links natural-language descriptions to pixel-level object masks. Yet standard evaluation provides limited insight into instance-level referential reasoning: it does not systematically distinguish referential logics, test target preservation across valid grounding paths, or separate target-selection from mask-generation errors. We introduce InstanceBench, an instance-centered diagnostic benchmark comprising 6,194 images, 9,264 target instances, and 25,077 human-verified expressions. Each target-centric expression set (TCES) fixes the image and target mask while pairing a minimal expression with a same-target variant that uses another valid cue or grounding path. A compact referential-logic taxonomy spans direct target evidence, same-class selection, relational and compositional grounding, and exclusion, while logic-critical construction suppresses simpler shortcuts. Identity-aware metrics measure target retention and set-level success while separating selection from mask-generation errors. Across 22 native-mask RES checkpoints from 18 model families, the strongest checkpoint reaches 67.1% mIoU but only 59.6% All@0.7. Controlled interventions confirm language sensitivity, while failure decomposition identifies target selection rather than mask decoding as the main bottleneck. On a controlled training subset, matched supervision improves identity-aware performance, showing that the diagnosed capability responds to targeted supervision. Collectively, InstanceBench supports a measure-diagnose-improve cycle: measuring target consistency across grounding paths, localizing failure sources, and evaluating targeted interventions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: InstanceBench 是一个以实例为中心的指代分割诊断基准，用 6,194 张图、9,264 个目标实例和 25,077 条人工核验表达，通过固定图像与目标掩码、配对最小表达与同目标变体来分离指代逻辑与掩码生成错误。在 22 个原生掩码 RES checkpoint（18 个模型家族）上，最强者 mIoU 达 67.1% 但 All@0.7 仅 59.6%，失败分解指向目标选择而非掩码解码是主要瓶颈。
Motivation: 标准 RES 评测无法系统区分指代逻辑、检验目标在不同有效接地路径上的保持，也分不开目标选择错误与掩码生成错误，实例级指代推理能力无从诊断。
Method: 构建目标中心表达集 (TCES)：固定图像与目标掩码，配对最小表达与使用另一有效线索或接地路径的同目标变体；指代逻辑分类涵盖直接目标证据、同类选择、关系与组合接地、排除，并用逻辑关键构造抑制简单捷径；提出 identity-aware 指标度量目标保持与集合级成功，同时分离选择与掩码生成错误。
Result: 在 22 个原生掩码 RES checkpoint、18 个模型家族上，最强 checkpoint 达 67.1% mIoU 但 All@0.7 仅 59.6%；受控干预确认模型对语言敏感，失败分解显示目标选择而非掩码解码是主要瓶颈；在受控训练子集上，匹配监督提升了 identity-aware 表现。
Conclusion: RES 的主要短板在目标选择而非掩码生成，且该能力可通过针对性监督改善，InstanceBench 支撑测量—诊断—改进的闭环。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.method: 构建目标中心表达集 (TCES)：固定图像与目标掩码，配对最小表达与使用另一有效线索或接地路径的同目标变体；指代逻辑分类涵盖直接目标证据、同类选择、关系与组合接地、排除，并用逻辑关键构造抑制简单捷径；提出 identity-aware 指标度量目标保持与集合级成功，同时分离选择与掩码生成错误。
summary_sections.result: 在 22 个原生掩码 RES checkpoint、18 个模型家族上，最强 checkpoint 达 67.1% mIoU 但 All@0.7 仅 59.6%；受控干预确认模型对语言敏感，失败分解显示目标选择而非掩码解码是主要瓶颈；在受控训练子集上，匹配监督提升了 identity-aware 表现。
summary_sections.conclusion: RES 的主要短板在目标选择而非掩码生成，且该能力可通过针对性监督改善，InstanceBench 支撑测量—诊断—改进的闭环。

papers.title: CHASE: Channel-Aligned Structure Exploitation for Geometry-Aware Model Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Geometric and Spectral Alignment (GSA) characterizes trained networks through spectral concentration, physical-channel alignment, support structure, and changes in singular bases. In this paper, we propose CHASE (Channel-Aligned Structure Exploitation) to use these structures in practical model design. CHASE covers six applications across model modification, reconfiguration, and compression. CORA, COEC, and CORAM apply GSA to parameter-efficient finetuning, structured-pruning compensation, and model merging. We further develop three new methods. CAGA uses GSA to identify multi-head attention heads that can share a KV representation and constructs the shared key and value heads through geometric alignment and low-rank subspace extraction. SAKV uses GSA to determine which adjacent layers can share a low-rank KV-cache representation and the retained rank for each layer group. CAPS uses GSA spectral structure to group output neurons and selects retained input channels separately for each group. Results from CORA, COEC, and CORAM establish the effectiveness of GSA for adaptation, pruning compensation, and model merging. Experiments on CAGA show that geometric shared-head construction substantially improves MHA-to-GQA conversion, and SAKV and CAPS improve over representative baselines for KV-cache compression and structured pruning. These results show that the structures identified by GSA can be used directly to design methods for a range of model operations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CHASE 把几何与谱对齐 (GSA) 对训练网络刻画出的谱集中、物理通道对齐、支撑结构与奇异基变化，直接转成六种模型改造、重配置与压缩方法。CAGA 用 GSA 找出可共享 KV 表示的注意力头并做几何共享头构造，SAKV 用它决定相邻层共享低秩 KV-cache 及各层组保留秩，CAPS 用谱结构分组输出神经元并逐组选保留输入通道；实验显示共享头构造显著改善 MHA 到 GQA 的转换，SAKV 与 CAPS 在 KV-cache 压缩与结构化剪枝上超过代表性基线。
Motivation: 参数高效微调、结构化剪枝补偿、模型合并与 KV-cache 压缩各自依赖启发式选择（哪些头共享、哪些层合并、保留哪些通道），缺少一个统一刻画训练网络几何结构的依据。
Method: 以 GSA（谱集中、物理通道对齐、支撑结构、奇异基变化）为统一工具，覆盖六项应用：CORA、COEC、CORAM 分别把 GSA 用于参数高效微调、结构化剪枝补偿与模型合并；新方法 CAGA 通过几何对齐加低秩子空间抽取构造共享 key/value 头，SAKV 决定相邻层共享低秩 KV-cache 表示及每层组保留秩，CAPS 按谱结构分组输出神经元并逐组选择保留输入通道。
Result: CORA、COEC、CORAM 的结果确立 GSA 在适配、剪枝补偿与模型合并上的有效性；CAGA 实验显示几何共享头构造显著改善 MHA-to-GQA 转换；SAKV 与 CAPS 在 KV-cache 压缩与结构化剪枝上优于代表性基线。
Conclusion: GSA 识别出的结构可以直接用来设计覆盖适配、剪枝、合并与压缩的模型操作方法，而不只是事后分析工具。

papers.title: MORA: Modeling Observed Changes for Drift-Robust Time-Series Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Time-series anomaly detection (TSAD) identifies deviations from patterns learned from historical data. In non-stationary settings, distribution drift and true anomalies can cause similar local changes, making it difficult to tell whether a deviation reflects abnormality or evolving context. Existing methods typically adapt to detected shifts or learn drift-insensitive representations, but do not resolve this ambiguity. We define this problem as \emph{temporal change disambiguation}: determining whether a local deviation is explained by broader temporal evolution. We introduce MORA, a drift-robust TSAD framework that reconstructs the same local target from paired short- and long-term views. The reconstruction gap measures contextual support for a local deviation, and a data-dependent correction mechanism conservatively adjusts the primary local anomaly score. Context can only reduce the score when it improves reconstruction of the same target. MORA needs neither drift annotations nor online adaptation. Experiments on four TSAD benchmarks show strong robustness to non-stationarity while preserving sensitivity to genuine anomalies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MORA 把时序异常检测中的分布漂移与真实异常混淆问题形式化为“时序变化消歧”，用同一局部目标的短程与长程视图重建差来度量上下文支持度，并以数据依赖的保守修正调整主局部异常分：只有当上下文能改善对同一目标的重建时才允许降分。在四个 TSAD 基准上对非平稳性表现出强鲁棒性，同时保持对真实异常的敏感性。
Motivation: 非平稳场景下分布漂移与真实异常产生相似的局部变化，现有方法或适应检测到的偏移、或学习漂移不敏感表示，都无法判定偏差是异常还是上下文演化。
Method: MORA 是漂移鲁棒的 TSAD 框架：从短程与长程成对视图重建同一局部目标，以重建差度量上下文对局部偏差的支持度，再用数据依赖的修正机制保守调整主局部异常分，约束是上下文仅在改善同一目标重建时才能降分；无需漂移标注，也无需在线适应。
Result: 在四个 TSAD 基准上实验，结果显示对非平稳性的强鲁棒性，同时保持对真实异常的敏感性。
Conclusion: 把漂移与异常的判定归结为“上下文能否解释该局部偏差”的重建检验，可以在不依赖漂移标注和在线适应的前提下兼顾鲁棒性与灵敏度。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: When Should an In-Context Learner Expand Its Hypothesis Space?
papers.abstract_en: Learning systems adapt quickly inside a familiar family of models. The harder step comes earlier: deciding, from observations that could be noise, an exception, a change within the family or structure outside it, whether opening a richer family is worth its cost. We treat this as a costly sequential decision: prediction failure must be turned into structural evidence, evidence into a value of expansion, and value into action. The Structural Revision Environment produces matched failures from each source, varies the price of expansion and the remaining horizon independently of the evidence, and admits exact Bayesian calculations and an exact normative solution of the one-shot decision. Its solution shows that revision is a value boundary and not an evidence threshold: one history has different optimal actions under different prices, horizons and announced queries, the boundary between local repair and expansion is set by the inputs a rule predicts and a repair cannot cover, and belief in the richer family crosses long before the decision does. Transformers trained in the environment reproduce this boundary from utility alone. Language models of three post-training lineages carry a failure-sensitive signal in their predictions that is not reflected in their revision decisions, and given the gain of expanding they read it without weighing it against price and horizon. Three models allowed to reason weigh the stated gain in the reference's proportions and still do not turn the history into an estimate of what expansion would buy. Controlled post-training of the meta-trained learners moves the prior and the sharpness of predictions, and neither moves the criterion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把「何时扩展假设空间」形式化为有代价的序贯决策：Structural Revision Environment 能生成噪声、例外、族内变化、族外结构四类匹配失败，独立改变扩展代价与剩余时域，并给出精确贝叶斯计算与一次性决策的精确规范解。结论是扩展由价值边界而非证据阈值决定——同一历史在不同代价、时域与已宣布查询下最优动作不同，对更丰富族的信念远早于决策发生翻转；仅靠效用训练的 Transformer 能复现该边界，而语言模型虽在预测中携带失败敏感信号，却不把它与代价和时域权衡。
Motivation: 学习系统在熟悉模型族内适应很快，难的是更早的一步：判断观测究竟只是噪声、例外、族内变化还是族外结构，从而决定打开更丰富模型族是否值得其代价。
Method: 把扩展决策当作有代价的序贯决策，经由 Structural Revision Environment 生成四类来源的匹配失败，独立改变扩展价格与剩余时域，并允许精确贝叶斯计算与一次性决策的精确规范解；再用该环境中仅由效用训练的 Transformer，以及三个后训练谱系的语言模型做对照，考察受控后训练对预测先验与锐度的影响。
Result: 规范解显示扩展是价值边界而非证据阈值：同一历史在不同价格、时域和已宣布查询下最优动作不同，局部修复与扩展的分界由规则能预测而修复覆盖不了的输入设定，对更丰富族的信念远早于决策翻转。仅由效用训练的 Transformer 从效用本身复现该边界；三个后训练谱系的语言模型在预测中携带失败敏感信号但修订决策不体现，给定扩展收益后不按代价与时域加权；三个允许推理的模型按参考比例权衡所述收益，仍不把历史转成对扩展收益的估计；受控后训练移动预测先验与锐度，但都不移动判据。
Conclusion: 扩展与否应按价值边界而非证据阈值来判定，且该判据不能由预测先验或锐度的移动来改变；语言模型需要把失败证据换算成扩展能买到什么，而不只是读出收益。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Secure-CUA: Controlling Untrusted Influence in Computer-Use Agents
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents (CUAs) perform tasks across applications (such as desktops, mobile apps, and web browsers) by observing graphical interfaces and issuing commands such as clicks and keystrokes. These interfaces combine trusted controls and content with untrusted content needed for legitimate tasks. An adversary controlling this untrusted content can embed instructions or misleading visual cues to change the agent's intended action or redirect its commands to the wrong interface target. We formalize security requirements for both the agent's decisions and their execution through GUI commands. In an ideal execution model, we show that enforcing both requirements at each step protects execution traces. We instantiate this model in Secure-CUA, our system for secure CUA execution. Its key idea is to commit to an explicit per-action program, called an $\textit{action transaction}$, before accessing untrusted content. Each transaction fixes its queries to untrusted content and the permitted uses of their responses. The system masks untrusted regions and evaluates each transaction to produce the next action, using an isolated query model to answer its queries. It then locates the intended interface target using the masked interface. Under the model's assumptions, Secure-CUA is secure by design, while generating a new transaction at each step helps maintain high task utility by adapting to changing interfaces. We evaluate Secure-CUA under benign conditions on 400 WebArena tasks using three frontier models across $5$ seeds, yielding $6,000$ execution traces. Secure-CUA achieves an average task success rate of $53.55\%$, compared with $55.12\%$ for Vanilla-CUA and $13.17\%$ for CaMeL-CUA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Secure-CUA 在接触不可信界面内容前，先为每一步动作写下显式的 action transaction，固定对不可信内容的查询及其响应的允许用途，再用隔离的查询模型作答并在遮蔽后的界面上定位目标，从而在模型假设下按设计保证执行轨迹安全。在 400 个 WebArena 任务、3 个前沿模型、5 个种子共 6,000 条执行轨迹的良性评测中，任务成功率 53.55%，接近 Vanilla-CUA 的 55.12%，远高于 CaMeL-CUA 的 13.17%。
Motivation: 计算机使用代理 (CUA) 的界面同时含可信控件与任务必需的不可信内容，攻击者可在其中嵌入指令或误导性视觉线索，改写代理意图动作或把命令重定向到错误的界面目标。
Method: 形式化代理决策与其 GUI 命令执行两方面的安全要求，并证明在理想执行模型中逐步同时强制这两项要求可保护执行轨迹；据此实现 Secure-CUA：每步先提交固定查询与响应用途的 action transaction，遮蔽不可信区域，用隔离的查询模型回答查询，再在遮蔽界面上定位预期目标，每步生成新事务以适应界面变化。
Result: 在良性条件下于 400 个 WebArena 任务、3 个前沿模型、5 个种子上评测，共 6,000 条执行轨迹；平均任务成功率 53.55%，Vanilla-CUA 为 55.12%，CaMeL-CUA 为 13.17%。
Conclusion: 在模型假设成立时 Secure-CUA 可按设计保证安全，同时靠逐步生成新事务维持接近无防护基线的任务效用。

summary_sections.method: 形式化代理决策与其 GUI 命令执行两方面的安全要求，并证明在理想执行模型中逐步同时强制这两项要求可保护执行轨迹；据此实现 Secure-CUA：每步先提交固定查询与响应用途的 action transaction，遮蔽不可信区域，用隔离的查询模型回答查询，再在遮蔽界面上定位预期目标，每步生成新事务以适应界面变化。
summary_sections.result: 在良性条件下于 400 个 WebArena 任务、3 个前沿模型、5 个种子上评测，共 6,000 条执行轨迹；平均任务成功率 53.55%，Vanilla-CUA 为 55.12%，CaMeL-CUA 为 13.17%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 在模型假设成立时 Secure-CUA 可按设计保证安全，同时靠逐步生成新事务维持接近无防护基线的任务效用。

papers.title: LLM-Enabled UAV Dispatch: A System-Level Survey and Taxonomy
papers.abstract_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) dispatch is beginning to move beyond isolated path planning and optimization-driven resource allocation toward system-level coordination supported by semantic reasoning and LLM-based interfaces. This survey provides a unified characterization of LLM-enabled UAV dispatch systems that bridges semantic intent, symbolic decision-making, and physical UAV execution. Rather than treating LLMs as standalone add-ons, we conceptualize them as a cross-layer semantic orchestration layer connecting human instructions, external solvers, and distributed control modules. We organize the literature into four representative dispatch paradigms: pipeline dispatch, global assignment dispatch, decentralized agentic dispatch, and divide-and-conquer dispatch. For each paradigm, we analyze its decision logic, system structure, control flow, representative methods, and potential LLM roles. We further examine how LLMs support semantic parsing, retrieval-grounded planning, solver orchestration, local agent reasoning, multi-agent coordination, safety assessment, and human-facing explanation. We discuss the implications of these paradigms for scalability, robustness, coordination burden, and verification requirements, and identify open challenges including latency-aware reasoning, grounding reliability, physical feasibility guarantees, edge deployment, privacy protection, and distributed consistency. This survey provides a system-level taxonomy and design perspective for integrating LLMs into safety-critical UAV dispatch systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇综述把 LLM 从外挂工具重新定位为跨层语义编排层，统一刻画 LLM-enabled UAV dispatch 系统如何衔接人类指令、外部求解器与分布式控制模块，并按决策逻辑把文献分成 pipeline dispatch、global assignment dispatch、decentralized agentic dispatch、divide-and-conquer dispatch 四种范式。作者据此列出 latency-aware reasoning、grounding reliability、物理可行性保证、边缘部署、隐私与分布式一致性等开放挑战。
Motivation: UAV 调度正从孤立路径规划与优化式资源分配走向系统级协同，但语义意图、符号决策与物理执行之间的衔接缺少统一刻画，LLM 常被当作孤立附加模块而非跨层组件。
Method: 提出统一系统级分类法：把 LLM 定义为连接人类指令、外部求解器与分布式控制模块的语义编排层；按四种调度范式逐一分析决策逻辑、系统结构、控制流、代表方法与 LLM 可能角色，并梳理 LLM 在语义解析、检索接地规划、求解器编排、局部 agent 推理、多 agent 协同、安全评估与面向人类解释中的作用。
Result: 综述给出四类调度范式（pipeline、global assignment、decentralized agentic、divide-and-conquer）的对照分析，以及各范式在 scalability、robustness、coordination burden、verification requirements 上的含义，并列出六项开放挑战：latency-aware reasoning、grounding reliability、物理可行性保证、边缘部署、隐私保护、分布式一致性。
Conclusion: 把 LLM 当作跨层语义编排层而非独立附加件，是把语义意图接到安全关键 UAV 执行上的系统级设计视角；落地瓶颈集中在延迟、接地可靠性与物理可行性保证。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: An Invariant Tangent-Angle Descriptor and a Band U-Net for 2D Fragment Adjacency Prediction
authors: Fadel Touré (Université du Québec à Trois-Rivières
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses the prediction of adjacency between pairs of 2D fragments based on their contours. We improved the two-stage architecture proposed in Beaulac's thesis, in which a rotation-equivariant Siamese convolutional neural network scores pairs of local image windows along the two contours of two fragments. The scores are gathered in an adjacency matrix in which a ResNet detects the partial anti-diagonal band that reveals the adjacency of two fragments. In the current work, we keep the pipeline and replace the local score by a comparison of tangent-angle profiles of contour windows, making it, by construction, invariant to fragment rotation and agnostic to the selected contour-starting point. These adaptations may be either a training-free likelihood ratio or a small one-dimensional convolutional model trained on corresponding points. We also replaced the final classifier by a band U-Net that segments the band and classifies the pair, so that the shared arc is obtained along with the decision. In the synthetic data set of the original thesis, the tangent descriptor performs as well as or better than the image-window approach in all tested configurations. The proposed pipeline reaches an accuracy of 98%, vs 93% to 95% for the original approach once its evaluation is corrected. We tested our pipeline, with models trained only on synthetic data, on the PairingNet benchmark, and obtained an AUC of 0.93. Furthermore, under the PairingNet pair-searching protocol conditions, our learned descriptor obtains a Recall@10 of 0.82 on the real set against 0.56 from the best model of the original paper.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 2D 碎片轮廓邻接预测中的局部图像窗口打分替换为切线-角描述子 (tangent-angle descriptor)，使其对碎片旋转不变、对轮廓起点不敏感，末端分类器换成 band U-Net 同时分割共享弧并判定配对。在原论文合成集上准确率 98%（原方法修正评估后 93%–95%），PairingNet 真实集 AUC 0.93、Recall@10 0.82（原论文最佳模型 0.56）。
Motivation: Beaulac 两阶段架构依赖旋转等变 Siamese CNN 对图像窗口打分，对轮廓起点敏感，且末端 ResNet 只给配对判定不给共享弧位置。
Method: 保留两阶段流水线：以轮廓窗口的切线-角剖面比较替代图像窗口打分，实现方式为免训练似然比或在对应点上训练的一维小卷积模型；末端用 band U-Net 对邻接矩阵中的反对角带做分割并分类配对，同时输出共享弧。
Result: 在原论文合成数据集上，切线描述子在所有测试配置中不劣于或优于图像窗口方法；整条流水线准确率 98%，原方法修正评估后为 93%–95%。仅用合成数据训练后在 PairingNet benchmark 上 AUC 0.93；在 PairingNet 配对搜索协议下，学习型描述子在真实集 Recall@10 为 0.82，原论文最佳模型为 0.56。
Conclusion: 轮廓几何描述子加带状分割分类器可以在合成到真实的迁移下超过基于图像窗口的邻接预测，并同时给出共享弧。

papers.title: DSReg: Provably Recovering Individual World Latents without Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Methods that recover individual latent variables of the world, from nonlinear ICA to dictionary learning and causal representation learning, anchor the latents to observations through reconstruction, auxiliary supervision, or distributional asymmetries such as non-Gaussianity. Methods without these anchors, including joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs), identify the latent state only up to a linear transformation, so individual latents remain mixed. We close this gap: individual world latents can be provably recovered with no reconstruction, no decoder, and no labels. The key condition is Structural Diversity: different latents leave distinct dependency footprints on observations, just as no two snowflakes are alike. Building on the linear identifiability that LeJEPA provides, we prove that under Structural Diversity, DSReg (Dependency-Sparsity Regularization) recovers individual world latents up to signed permutation, without reconstruction or a decoder. It applies post hoc to any linearly identified representation, reusing trained checkpoints at no loss over joint training, and establishes the first fully identifiable JEPA that recovers every world latent. Moreover, as a condition on dependency footprints, Structural Diversity is strictly weaker than all structural conditions of prior identifiable latent variable models. Across synthetic regimes, world model probes, learned visual encoders, and external renderers, DSReg preserves dense prediction while improving individual-latent recovery and downstream use with scales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DSReg (Dependency-Sparsity Regularization) 在无需重建、解码器和标签的条件下，可证明地恢复单个世界隐变量：关键条件是 Structural Diversity（不同隐变量在观测上留下可区分的依赖足迹），在此条件下对任意线性可辨识表示做后处理即可把隐变量恢复到 signed permutation 精度。该条件严格弱于以往可辨识隐变量模型的全部结构条件，且在合成设定、world model 探针、学习到的视觉编码器与外部渲染器上保持稠密预测能力的同时改善单隐变量恢复与下游使用。
Motivation: 非线性 ICA、字典学习与因果表示学习需靠重建、辅助监督或非高斯等分布不对称来锚定隐变量；而 JEPA 一类无锚方法只能把隐状态辨识到线性变换，单个隐变量仍然混在一起。
Method: 以 LeJEPA 提供的线性可辨识性为基础，加入 Dependency-Sparsity Regularization（DSReg）作为依赖稀疏正则；要求 Structural Diversity 条件成立，且该正则可后处理地施加到任意线性可辨识表示上，复用已训练 checkpoint，无需 decoder。
Result: 在合成设定、world model 探针、学习到的视觉编码器与外部渲染器上，DSReg 保持稠密预测 (dense prediction) 的同时改善单隐变量恢复与下游使用（with scales）；理论结果为在 Structural Diversity 下恢复到 signed permutation，且该条件严格弱于先前可辨识隐变量模型的全部结构条件。
Conclusion: 无需重建或解码器也能把世界隐变量辨识到单变量级别，前提是隐变量在观测上的依赖足迹彼此可区分；DSReg 成为首个可恢复全部世界隐变量的完全可辨识 JEPA，且后处理不损失联合训练效果。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: GeoPrior-Mamba: Structured Process Priors with Mamba for Fine-Resolution XCO2 Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing fine-resolution column-averaged dry-air CO2 (XCO2) fields from sparse satellite observations requires models to infer spatial structure that is only weakly constrained by direct measurements. Existing learning-based methods typically treat environmental covariates as ordinary numerical inputs and must therefore learn heterogeneous source-sink relationships largely from sparse supervision. We introduce GeoPrior-Mamba, a multi-directional Mamba framework augmented with offline language-model-induced structured process priors. Rather than using a language model to predict XCO2, we use it before training to organize relative process knowledge for biospheric uptake, ecosystem respiration, and anthropogenic emissions into deterministic prior tables. These priors are spatially instantiated using geographic, ecological, emission-related, and seasonal information and are adaptively injected into the reconstruction backbone through a lightweight knowledge adapter. Using OCO-2 observations from 2018-2020, GeoPrior-Mamba achieves an RMSE of 0.81 ppm and an R2 of 0.93 on held-out observations, reducing RMSE by 48.2% relative to CAMS background interpolation and by 3.1% relative to Trans-XCO2 under the same evaluation protocol. Ablation experiments show a measurable contribution from the knowledge-prior branch and substantially faster convergence than the knowledge-free Mamba backbone. Independent TCCON evaluation further supports the consistency of the reconstructed fields with ground-based column CO2 measurements. These results suggest that language models can provide a practical mechanism for constructing structured process priors when globally consistent process-response representations are difficult to obtain directly, while remaining outside the numerical prediction loop.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoPrior-Mamba 用离线语言模型把生物吸收、生态系统呼吸与人为排放的相对过程知识整理成确定性先验表，经地理、生态、排放与季节信息空间实例化后由轻量 knowledge adapter 注入多方向 Mamba 重建骨干。在 OCO-2 2018–2020 观测上，held-out RMSE 0.81 ppm、R2 0.93，较 CAMS 背景插值降 RMSE 48.2%，较 Trans-XCO2 降 3.1%。
Motivation: 稀疏卫星 XCO2 观测对空间结构约束弱，现有学习方法把环境协变量当普通数值输入，只能靠稀疏监督学异质源汇关系，难以获得全球一致的过程-响应表示。
Method: 训练前用语言模型组织过程知识生成确定性先验表（不参与数值预测），用地理、生态、排放与季节信息做空间实例化，再经轻量 knowledge adapter 自适应注入多方向 Mamba (multi-directional Mamba) 重建骨干；用 OCO-2 2018–2020 观测训练并做消融。
Result: held-out 观测上 RMSE 0.81 ppm、R2 0.93；相对 CAMS background interpolation RMSE 降低 48.2%，相对 Trans-XCO2 在同一评估协议下降低 3.1%。消融显示 knowledge-prior 分支有可测贡献，且比无知识 Mamba 骨干收敛明显更快；独立 TCCON 评估支持重建场与地面柱 CO2 测量一致。
Conclusion: 语言模型可在数值预测回路之外提供构建结构化过程先验的实用机制，从而在稀疏监督下改善细分辨率 XCO2 重建并加快收敛。

papers.title: RLHND: Video Foundation Models as Physically Grounded Hand Trackers for Robot Learning
papers.abstract_en: Recently, approaches that leverage human video datasets for robot policy training have become increasingly prevalent. However, most existing hand trackers regress pose from cropped frames with limited priors on hand motion and object interaction, resulting in inaccurate and physically inconsistent estimates. Moreover, the lack of physical cues, e.g., contact and force, limits the use of human videos for robot policy training. To this end, we propose RLHND, a video foundation model-based hand tracking model that jointly estimates hand pose and realistic tactile information from monocular egocentric videos. RLHND turns the pre-trained Cosmos 3 video diffusion backbone into a deterministic clip-level feature extractor via clean-latent conditioning, carrying its learned priors on hand motion and hand-object interaction into tracking. For pose estimation, RLHND (i) predicts hand poses with anatomically plausible joint angles and (ii) enables optional conditioning on the shape parameter to maintain consistent hand shape within the same video and even across videos recorded by the same actor. For tactile estimation, a separate tactile expert stream, trained with the pose stream frozen, predicts dense contact and force over the hand surface. We further adopt LBS-based feature spreading to enable vertex-wise feature extraction without costly per-vertex attention. papers.title: Finite-Rank Logistic Gaussian Processes with Exact Likelihood for Conditional Density Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Conditional density estimation describes how the entire distribution of a response changes with covariates, and in imaging studies also with location. Logistic Gaussian processes (LGP) give a flexible prior for such densities. However, the normalizing constant of an LGP has no closed form, so existing methods approximate or replace the likelihood. We propose the exact likelihood finite-rank LGP (ExFR-LGP), which writes the log density as the sum of two bivariate functions, one of the response and a location-varying linear index of the covariates, and one of the response and the location. Each function is assigned a finite-rank Gaussian process prior that is piecewise linear on a regular grid, enabling the normalizing constant, the conditional mean and the quantiles to enjoy closed form representations. Posterior samples are drawn from the exact posterior under this prior via a Gibbs sampler that updates the Gaussian components by elliptical slice sampling. When the true log density is the sum of two such bivariate functions, we show that the posterior contracts at the minimax rate of an $α$-smooth bivariate density up to a logarithmic factor. Numerical experiments using synthetic data demonstrate the effectiveness of ExFR-LGP in conditional density estimation. Furthermore, application to fractional anisotropy responses along the corpus callosum in the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative data yields covariate-adjusted percentile bands with uncertainty, elucidating how diagnosis changes the distribution along the tract.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ExFR-LGP：把对数密度写成两个二元函数之和，各赋有限秩、网格上分段线性的 GP 先验，使归一化常数、条件均值与分位数都有闭式，从而在精确似然下做 Gibbs + 椭圆切片采样。当真实对数密度确为这种两二元函数之和时，后验以 α-光滑二元密度的 minimax 速率（差一个对数因子）收缩。
Motivation: Logistic Gaussian process 虽是灵活的条件密度先验，但其归一化常数无闭式，现有方法只能近似或替换似然，难以在成像研究中同时给出带不确定性的分位数。
Method: ExFR-LGP 将 log density 拆为「响应 × 协变量位置相关线性指标」与「响应 × 位置」两个二元函数，各配有限秩、规则网格上分段线性的 GP 先验，使归一化常数、条件均值与分位数闭式可得；后验用 Gibbs 采样，高斯分量由 elliptical slice sampling 更新。
Result: 当真实对数密度为两个此类二元函数之和时，后验以 α-光滑二元密度的 minimax 速率收缩（差一个对数因子）；合成数据的数值实验展示其条件密度估计效果；在 ADNI 数据的胼胝体各向异性分数 (fractional anisotropy) 上给出带不确定性的协变量调整百分位带，显示诊断如何沿纤维束改变分布。
Conclusion: 通过把 LGP 限制为有限秩分段线性结构，可以在不近似似然的前提下得到闭式归一化与 minimax 率后验收缩，并在成像数据上输出可解释的协变量调整分位数带。

papers.title: Iris-3B: Going Beyond the Latent with Pixel-Space Diffusion Training, Conversion and Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Pixel-space diffusion models avoid the lossy VAE of latent models, which suggests an advantage on downstream tasks where fine-grained detail matters. We test this claim along both routes to a pixel-space backbone. We pretrain Iris-3B, a 3B-parameter pixel-space text-to-image transformer, from scratch through a $256\to512\to1024$ curriculum, after first ablating the prediction target and representation alignment at $256^2$ to decide what to scale. We also convert a pretrained latent model, FLUX.2 Klein base 4B, to pixel space. We fine-tune both families for monocular depth estimation and for image restoration/super-resolution. We find no significant improvement from using a pixel-space generative prior. Fine-tuned for depth with one matched direct-regression recipe, Iris-3B is level with the latent FLUX.2 Klein and the converted pixel FLUX.2 Klein falls behind it, and on $4\times$ DIV2K restoration neither pixel model beats a latent FLUX.2 Klein fine-tune, the converted one trailing it slightly. We document the recipes, the failure modes and the remaining confounds behind this negative result. Nevertheless, Iris-3B shows that pixel-space pretraining with the pixel-transformer (PiT) head of PixelDiT scales to 3B parameters and to text-to-image quality competitive with latent models, matching Qwen-Image on OneIG under the official evaluators at $1024^2$. We release its weights and training code in the hope that they help pave the way for further work on pixel-space generation.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 13 figures, 6 tables. Project lead: Hanqiu Li Cai. Code and models: https://github.com/speridlabs
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Iris-3B 是一个 3B 参数的像素空间文生图 Transformer，从零按 256→512→1024 课程预训练，并把预训练的潜空间模型 FLUX.2 Klein 4B 转换到像素空间，两者再分别微调做单目深度估计与图像修复/超分。结论是负的：像素空间生成先验没有带来显著提升，深度任务上 Iris-3B 与潜空间 FLUX.2 Klein 持平、转换版反而落后，4× DIV2K 修复上两个像素模型都没超过潜空间微调；但 Iris-3B 证明 PixelDiT 的 pixel-transformer (PiT) 头可扩展到 3B 参数，且在 OneIG 官方评测器下 1024² 质量与 Qwen-Image 持平。
Motivation: 像素空间扩散绕开潜空间模型的 VAE 有损压缩，理论上应在需要细粒度细节的下游任务上占优，但这一主张此前缺少沿两条建像素空间骨干路径的直接检验。
Method: 两条路线：一是从零预训练 Iris-3B（3B 参数像素空间文生图 Transformer），先在 256² 上消融预测目标与表示对齐再决定扩展方案，随后按 256→512→1024 课程扩展，采用 PixelDiT 的 pixel-transformer (PiT) 头；二是把预训练潜空间模型 FLUX.2 Klein base 4B 转换到像素空间。两族模型再用同一套直接回归配方微调到单目深度估计，以及 4× DIV2K 图像修复/超分。
Result: 深度估计上 Iris-3B 与潜空间 FLUX.2 Klein 持平，转换后的像素 FLUX.2 Klein 落后于它；4× DIV2K 修复上两个像素模型均未超过潜空间 FLUX.2 Klein 微调，转换版略微落后。Iris-3B 在 OneIG 上按官方评测器在 1024² 与 Qwen-Image 质量持平，展示像素空间预训练可扩展到 3B 参数。
Conclusion: 像素空间生成先验在深度与修复/超分这两类细粒度任务上未带来显著收益，负结果背后的配方、失败模式与残余混淆因素被记录下来；Iris-3B 的权重与训练代码已发布，供后续像素空间生成研究使用。

papers.title: From Global Alignment to Local Grounding: Zero-Shot Chinese Character Recognition with Radical Verification
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot Chinese character recognition (ZS-CCR) aims to recognize characters whose categories are never observed during training, and typically relies on the compositional structure shared between seen and unseen characters. Recent CLIP-style methods represent this structure with the Ideographic Description Sequence (IDS) and align it with glyph images in a shared embedding space. However, they rely on a single global image--IDS similarity that discards the spatial layout of radicals and, being learned only implicitly from seen classes, generalizes poorly to unseen ones; moreover, global matching often retrieves the correct character within the top candidates yet fails to rank it first when characters differ only in subtle local radicals. To address these issues, we propose a global-to-local two-stage framework. In the first stage, STG-CLIP augments the IDS with explicit tree-position and radical-level geometric priors, yielding a spatial-aware prototype that provides a consistent spatial description across seen and unseen categories for high-recall global retrieval. In the second stage, the Radical Verification Module (RVM) uses the radical instances of each retrieved candidate as queries to verify whether the corresponding radicals can be matched to spatially compatible regions in the input glyph. A margin-based gating rule activates the RVM only when the leading global candidates receive similar similarity scores. Experiments on the ICDAR2013 benchmark demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance under the character-level zero-shot setting, obtaining 83.06% top-1 accuracy with 2,755 seen classes. Ablation studies further show that the explicit geometric priors and radical-level verification provide complementary improvements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对零样本中文字符识别 (ZS-CCR) 中全局图像–IDS 相似度丢失部首空间布局、且仅靠全局匹配常把正确字排在前列却非第一的问题，提出全局到局部两阶段框架：STG-CLIP 为 IDS 加入树位置与部首几何先验做高召回检索，Radical Verification Module (RVM) 用部首实例作 query 验证空间兼容性，并由 margin 门控仅在前几名分数接近时触发。在 ICDAR2013 字符级零样本设定下取得 83.06% top-1 准确率（2,755 个 seen 类），达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: CLIP 式方法用单一全局图像–IDS 相似度对齐字形与部件结构，丢掉部首空间布局、只从 seen 类隐式学习，遇到仅差细微部首的字时正确候选常排不进第一。
Method: 两阶段框架：STG-CLIP 在 IDS 上加入显式树位置与部首级几何先验，生成跨 seen/unseen 一致的空间感知原型做全局检索；第二阶段 Radical Verification Module (RVM) 以候选的部首实例为 query，在输入字形中匹配空间兼容区域，并用 margin 门控规则仅当前导候选分数相近时激活 RVM。
Result: 在 ICDAR2013 基准的字符级零样本设定下，top-1 准确率 83.06%，seen 类 2,755 个，达到 state-of-the-art；消融显示显式几何先验与部首级验证带来互补提升。
Conclusion: 把全局检索与部首级空间验证分开、并用门控控制验证触发，可在字符级零样本中文识别上把正确字排到第一，几何先验与部首验证的作用互补。

papers.title: Arctic Questions, Missing Answers: A Dataset and Benchmark for LLM Abstention in Arctic Science
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) should abstain from scientific multiple-choice questions when no option is valid, but frequent abstention alone does not demonstrate sensitivity to answer availability. We introduce ArcticQA, a dataset of 194 questions derived from primary Arctic research, with automated checks of answer support and distractor contradiction against source evidence. We further develop ArcticAbstain, a paired benchmark comparing answer-present and answer-absent conditions, with the correct answer replaced by a distractor in the latter and an explicit abstention option in both. We evaluate eight models from the Gemini, Claude, and ChatGPT families at high reasoning effort, with three trials per condition, yielding 9,312 recorded responses. Answer-present abstention rates range from 0.0% to 63.0%, whereas replacing the correct answer increases abstention by 5.05 percentage points on average. These findings highlight substantial baseline differences and the need to evaluate abstention frequency and responsiveness jointly. The dataset and benchmark are available at https://github.com/BenWilcox8/arctic-qa.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ArcticQA（194 道北极科学多选题，带答案支撑与干扰项矛盾的自动校验）与配对基准 ArcticAbstain：把正确答案换成干扰项构成 answer-absent 条件，与 answer-present 条件对照，检验 LLM 的弃答是否随答案可得性变化。在 Gemini、Claude、ChatGPT 三家八个模型、高推理档、每条件三次试验共 9,312 条回答中，answer-present 弃答率跨度 0.0%–63.0%，而移除正确答案平均只让弃答率上升 5.05 个百分点，说明高频弃答并不等于对答案可得性敏感。
Motivation: LLM 在科学多选题上应当在无正确选项时弃答，但单纯统计弃答频率无法判断模型是否真的感知到答案缺失，北极研究这类证据稀疏领域尤其缺少可检验的评测。
Method: ArcticQA 从北极一手研究文献构造 194 道题，并对每题自动校验选项是否有源证据支撑、干扰项是否与证据矛盾；ArcticAbstain 为配对设计，answer-absent 条件把正确答案替换为干扰项，两个条件都保留显式弃答选项；评测八个 Gemini、Claude、ChatGPT 系模型，高推理档，每条件三次试验。
Result: 共记录 9,312 条回答；answer-present 条件弃答率在 0.0% 到 63.0% 之间；把正确答案换成干扰项后弃答率平均只提高 5.05 个百分点。
Conclusion: 模型间基线弃答率差异巨大，且弃答对答案可得性的响应普遍偏弱，因此评测必须同时报告弃答频率与弃答响应性，二者缺一不可。

papers.title: LighTROcc: Lightweight 4D Occupancy Forecasting via Instance-Centric 3D Gaussians
papers.abstract_en: Forecasting future 3D occupancy from surround-view cameras is essential for autonomous driving, yet existing approaches rely on dense voxel or bird's-eye-view representations whose cost grows rapidly with spatial resolution and prediction horizon. Because these representations do not explicitly maintain object identities, they also struggle to preserve instance consistency over time. We present LighTROcc, a lightweight instance-centric framework that represents movable objects with a compact set of learned queries and predicts present and future occupancy in a single forward pass. LighTROcc localizes each query through attention-guided forward lifting, combining image-space cross-attention, query-specific depth, and camera geometry to estimate its 3D center. Each instance is modeled as a mixture of anisotropic 3D Gaussians and propagated across future steps using predicted displacements, producing continuous, temporally consistent occupancy forecasts. Experiments on nuScenes and supplemented nuScenes-Occupancy show that LighTROcc outperforms the evaluated dense and instance-wise baselines in instance-level forecasting accuracy while maintaining strong voxel-level occupancy quality. Across different model configurations, LighTROcc achieves a favorable balance between forecasting accuracy and computational efficiency, demonstrating the potential of compact instance-centric modeling for camera-based 4D occupancy forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LighTROcc 用一组可学习的 instance query 表示可移动物体，单次前向同时给出当前与未来占据：attention-guided forward lifting 结合图像 cross-attention、query 专属深度与相机几何估计 3D 中心，每个实例用各向异性 3D Gaussian 混合建模并按预测位移传播到未来时刻。在 nuScenes 与 nuScenes-Occupancy 上，实例级预报精度超过所评测的稠密与实例类基线，同时保持较强的 voxel 级占据质量，并在精度与计算开销之间取得较好平衡。
Motivation: 自动驾驶的 4D 占据预报依赖稠密 voxel 或 BEV 表示，代价随空间分辨率与预报时长快速上升；这些表示不显式维护物体身份，难以在时间上保持实例一致性。
Method: 以紧凑的可学习 query 集合表示可移动物体，单次前向同时预测当前与未来占据；attention-guided forward lifting 融合图像空间 cross-attention、query-specific depth 与相机几何得到 3D 中心；每个实例建模为各向异性 3D Gaussian 混合，用预测位移跨未来步传播，输出连续且时间一致的占据预报。
Result: 在 nuScenes 与补充的 nuScenes-Occupancy 上，实例级预报精度超过所评测的稠密基线与实例类基线，同时保持较强的 voxel 级占据质量；不同模型配置下在预报精度与计算效率之间取得有利平衡。
Conclusion: 紧凑的实例中心建模（query + 3D Gaussian）足以支撑基于环视相机的 4D 占据预报，用实例身份替代稠密体素表示即可兼顾时间一致性与效率。

papers.title: TIRA: Tumor Immune Representation Adaptation for Zero-Shot Cross-Cancer MSI and TMB Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Microsatellite instability-high (MSI-H) and high tumor mutational burden (TMB-H) are clinically relevant biomarkers, yet their histopathological prediction remains challenging when models are transferred across morphologically distinct cancer types. Immune-associated spatial patterns can persist across cancers despite these morphological differences, but foundation-model-based predictors trained on a single cancer do not explicitly use this information, limiting cross-cancer generalization. To address this limitation, we propose TIRA (Tumor Immune Representation Adaptation), a target-free framework that refines frozen foundation-model representations using spatial immune topology, without requiring target-domain data during model development or test-time adaptation. TIRA uses a topology-supervised biology representation to condition tile-level attention while pooling only morphological features for joint MSI and TMB prediction. We train TIRA on TCGA-COAD+READ and evaluate it zero-shot on CPTAC-COAD, TCGA-STAD, TCGA-UCEC, and CPTAC-UCEC, covering cross-site, cross-cancer, and combined cross-cancer-site distribution shifts under UNI2, CONCH, and Virchow2. With UNI2, TIRA improved zero-shot AUROC on TCGA-STAD from 0.633 to 0.766 for MSI and from 0.651 to 0.772 for TMB. Source-derived spatial immune topology improved the cross-cancer robustness of frozen pathology foundation-model representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TIRA 是零样本跨癌种病理组学预测框架：用拓扑监督的免疫空间表征去调制 tile 级注意力，只池化形态学特征，联合预测 MSI 与 TMB，开发与测试均无需目标域数据。在 UNI2 骨干下，TCGA-STAD 零样本 AUROC 从 0.633 提到 0.766（MSI）、0.651 提到 0.772（TMB）。
Motivation: 病理基础模型在单一癌种上训练后跨形态差异大的癌种迁移时 MSI-H 与 TMB-H 预测退化，而免疫相关空间模式本可跨癌种保留，却未被显式利用。
Method: 在 TCGA-COAD+READ 上训练，冻结病理基础模型（UNI2、CONCH、Virchow2），用拓扑监督的生物学表征条件化 tile 级注意力，仅池化形态学特征做 MSI 与 TMB 联合预测；目标域数据在开发与测试时均不使用。
Result: 零样本评测覆盖 CPTAC-COAD、TCGA-STAD、TCGA-UCEC、CPTAC-UCEC，含跨站点、跨癌种与跨癌种-站点混合分布偏移。以 UNI2 为骨干，TCGA-STAD 上 MSI AUROC 0.633 → 0.766，TMB AUROC 0.651 → 0.772。
Conclusion: 源自源域的空间免疫拓扑能够提升冻结病理基础模型表征的跨癌种稳健性，使零样本 MSI 与 TMB 联合预测在分布偏移下更可靠。

papers.title: Mixture of Layers: Dynamic Layer Routing for Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Pre-trained vision encoders contain layer-wise visual representations that differ in spatial granularity, semantic abstraction, and sensitivity to local details. However, most Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) rely on only the final or penultimate vision encoder representations or fixed aggregation rules, making visual abstraction largely query-agnostic and limiting access to fine-grained cues such as small objects, spatial details, text, and subtle visual attributes. In this work, we propose Mixture of Layers (MoL), an instruction-conditioned layer routing approach at the visual patch level that dynamically aggregates query-relevant latent representations from intermediate vision encoder layers. Given a text query, MoL predicts routing probabilities over vision encoder layers and performs a top-k sparse aggregation over selected hidden states at either the image level, patch level, or through a hybrid routing mechanism. In doing so, MoL enables query-adaptive access to layer-specific visual features for fine-grained visual reasoning. Our experiments across 7 fine-grained visual reasoning tasks demonstrate substantial performance improvements, especially across fine-grained visual grounding and understanding tasks such as +18.9% improvement on V* in overall accuracy, +4.5% on HRBench4K, and +16.3% on CharXiv compared to the baseline MLLMs, without resorting to multi-resolution inputs, simple interleaving of multiple vision encoders, or increasing the number of patch tokens. We study vision encoders' receptive field scales across different layers and their sampling behaviors to provide an in-depth analysis of why layer-wise sampling is helpful, demonstrating that conditional visual representations are a key step towards better visual perception and reasoning in MLLMs. Our project page is available at https://wjdghks950.github.io/mol.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Mixture of Layers (MoL)：按文本查询在视觉编码器各层上预测路由概率，做 top-k 稀疏聚合，可在图像级、patch 级或混合粒度上动态取用中间层特征。在 7 个细粒度视觉推理任务上相对基线 MLLM 提升，V* 总体准确率 +18.9%、HRBench4K +4.5%、CharXiv +16.3%，且不引入多分辨率输入、多编码器拼接或更多 patch token。
Motivation: 多数 MLLM 只取视觉编码器最后一或倒数第二层表示或用固定聚合规则，使视觉抽象与查询无关，难以取用小目标、空间细节、文字等细粒度线索。
Method: 给定文本查询，MoL 在视觉编码器各层上预测路由概率，对选中隐藏状态做 top-k 稀疏聚合，粒度可选图像级、patch 级或混合路由；并分析不同层感受野尺度与采样行为以解释逐层采样为何有效。
Result: 在 7 个细粒度视觉推理任务上相对基线 MLLM 显著提升：V* 总体准确率 +18.9%，HRBench4K +4.5%，CharXiv +16.3%，且未使用多分辨率输入、多视觉编码器简单交错或增加 patch token 数。
Conclusion: 条件化的逐层视觉表示（按查询路由中间层）是提升 MLLM 视觉感知与推理的关键一步，尤其对细粒度视觉定位与理解任务。

papers.title: InscriptionOCR: A Dataset and Method for Understanding Inscriptions
papers.abstract_en: Ancient script image restoration is a fundamental problem in computer vision, as it directly affects the reliable analysis and interpretation of historical documents and inscriptions. Ashokan Brahmi is an ancient script extensively used during the reign of Emperor Ashoka in the 3rd century BC, primarily for inscriptions in Prakrit. These inscriptions, including major and minor rock and pillar edicts, constitute a valuable yet largely unexplored source of data for computational analysis. The degraded nature of inscription imagery and the lack of standardized digital resources pose significant challenges for automated processing. We present an end-to-end AI-based framework for understanding ancient inscriptions that encompasses image enhancement, optical character recognition (OCR), transliteration, and neural machine translation (NMT). The proposed pipeline processes low-quality images captured directly from stone inscriptions, performs image restoration and Brahmi script character recognition, maps the recognized characters to the Roman script, and finally translates the resulting Prakrit text into English. We also introduce two new datasets: (i) InscriptionOCR Dataset: the largest publicly usable digital OCR dataset for Brahmi script to date, consisting of over 200,000 character images across about 600 classes, and (ii) a bilingual Prakrit-English parallel corpus comprising over 2,000 sentence pairs for NMT. We believe that the proposed framework and datasets will facilitate future research in ancient script analysis, low-resource OCR, and digital epigraphy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出端到端的古铭文理解框架：对石刻低质图像做增强与修复，识别 Ashokan Brahmi 字符并转写为罗马字母，再把 Prakrit 译成英文。同时发布 InscriptionOCR 数据集（逾 200,000 张字符图像、约 600 类，称是迄今最大的可公开使用的 Brahmi OCR 数据集）和含 2,000 余句对的 Prakrit-English 平行语料。
Motivation: Ashokan Brahmi 铭文图像退化严重、缺乏标准化数字资源，低资源 OCR 与数字铭文学 (digital epigraphy) 的自动化处理因此受限。
Method: 流水线依次为图像增强/修复、Brahmi 字符 OCR、字符到罗马字母的转写 (transliteration)、以及 Prakrit 到英语的神经机器翻译 (NMT)；输入为直接拍摄的低质量石刻图像，配套两个新数据集支撑训练。
Result: 发布 InscriptionOCR Dataset：逾 200,000 张字符图像、约 600 类；发布 Prakrit-English 双语平行语料：逾 2,000 个句对。
Conclusion: 图像修复到 OCR、转写、NMT 的完整流水线加上两个公开数据集，可支撑古文字分析、低资源 OCR 与数字铭文学的后续研究。

papers.title: Controllable Crowd Generation through World-Model Planning
papers.abstract_en: Crowd simulation plays a central role in robot navigation, autonomous driving, and urban planning. For these applications, realistic simulation requires crowds to adapt their behavior to environmental changes and user objectives. However, existing methods that rely on predefined control settings have limited flexibility in accommodating new user-specified objectives. To address this limitation, we propose Ctrl-CWM, a multi-agent Controllable Crowd World Model that integrates crowd generation and run-time control. Our key idea is to adapt the world-model principle of planning using imagined futures to crowd simulation. To this end, Ctrl-CWM consists of an encoder that learns a representation of human motion dynamics, an actor that proposes pedestrian displacements, a critic that evaluates imagined crowd trajectories, and a planner that selects actions. We first learn human motion dynamics through trajectory prediction on real-world pedestrian videos and then freeze the encoder to preserve them. Using this representation, the actor generates imagined crowd trajectories through repeated state updates, and the planner combines the critic's scores with user costs to select actions. Repeated planning advances the simulated crowd, while additional user costs introduce new control objectives without retraining. We extensively evaluate crowd generation under varied agent arrival conditions and run-time control across avoidance and attraction scenarios. Ctrl-CWM outperforms the state-of-the-art method on most crowd realism and collision metrics, and adapts crowd behaviors to user-specified objectives introduced during simulation. The project page is available at https://jungyu0413.github.io/Ctrl-CWM

Conclusion: 把世界模型规划用于人群仿真，可以在不重训的前提下同时拿到高质量人群生成与运行时可控性。

papers.title: An extended deep energy method for thermo-mechanical crack propagation
papers.abstract_en: Thermo-mechanical fracture couples transient heat conduction on a cracked domain with a crack that grows as the temperature and the displacement evolve. Neural energy solvers have been proposed for phase-field fracture and later extended to represent a sharp crack through the network input, but heat conduction on the cracked domain and crack propagation under the resulting thermal stresses have not yet been treated together in these solvers. We present an extended deep energy method for thermo-mechanical crack propagation in which the crack remains a sharp polyline. Two networks represent the temperature and the displacement and receive the crack through a scalar embedding function, discontinuous across the crack and smooth elsewhere, so that both fields can jump across it without a regularization length, and the displacement is enriched near the tip by the Williams expansion with trainable amplitudes. The two fields are obtained by minimizing an incremental conduction functional and the thermoelastic potential energy in a staggered sequence, with Monte Carlo integration on points stratified over background elements, densified near the tip and redrawn during training. The stress intensity factors are extracted by the interaction integral with the area term of Wilson and Yu and checked by a sweep of the contour radius, and the crack advances at the maximum hoop stress angle when the energy release rate of the kink reaches the critical value at the crack-tip temperature. On a stationary thermal edge crack the extracted stress intensity factor agrees with the published value to 0.11%, in a functionally graded shear test initiation agrees with an independent sharp-crack finite element solution to within one load step, and on a notched cruciform specimen the crack paths follow the published solutions under mechanical, thermal and combined loading.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用于热力耦合裂纹扩展的扩展深度能量法 (extended deep energy method)：温度与位移各用一个网络，通过跨裂纹不连续的标量嵌入函数表示尖锐折线裂纹，尖端用 Williams 展开富集，交错最小化导热泛函与热弹性能。稳态热边缘裂纹的应力强度因子与已发表值偏差 0.11%，功能梯度剪切起裂与独立尖裂纹有限元解相差不超过一个载荷步。
Motivation: 神经能量求解器已用于相场断裂并以网络输入表示尖锐裂纹，但裂纹域上的瞬态热传导与由此产生的热应力驱动的裂纹扩展尚未在同一求解器中耦合处理。
Method: 两个网络分别表示温度与位移，输入含跨裂纹不连续、其余处光滑的标量嵌入函数，使两场可跨裂纹跳跃而无需正则化长度；位移在尖端用可训练幅值的 Williams 展开富集。按交错次序最小化增量导热泛函与热弹性能，采样用背景单元分层的 Monte Carlo 积分并在尖端加密、训练中重采。应力强度因子由 interaction integral（含 Wilson 与 Yu 的面积项）提取并做围道半径扫描，裂纹在 kink 能量释放率达到裂纹尖端温度下的临界值时沿最大 hoop 应力角扩展。
Result: 稳态热边缘裂纹提取的应力强度因子与已发表值一致到 0.11%；功能梯度剪切试件的起裂与独立尖裂纹有限元解在同一个载荷步内一致；带缺口十字试件在机械、热及组合载荷下的裂纹路径跟随已发表解。
Conclusion: 把尖锐裂纹嵌入函数、尖端 Williams 富集与热-力交错能量最小化结合，可在无正则化长度下同时求解热传导与热应力驱动的裂纹扩展，并复现已发表的应力强度因子、起裂时刻与裂纹路径。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: SkillCycle: Co-Evolving Agent Policies and Skill Banks
papers.abstract_en: Internalizing external skills changes a language agent's capabilities and, with them, the value of its remaining guidance: rules can become redundant, misleading, or insufficient for newly encountered decisions. This creates a coupled problem of learning from skills and adapting the skills that supervise further learning. We introduce SkillCycle, a framework for co-evolving agent policies and skill banks through a feedback loop between skill internalization and rule revision. Our central contribution is to give distillation feedback a second role: token-level contextual differences help locate rules for inspection, while interaction outcomes guide edits to their content and applicability. SkillCycle alternates between two phases: policy learning with a fixed skill bank and router, and rule revision with a frozen policy. Candidate edits undergo rule-level and whole-bank environment comparisons before they guide the next learning cycle. On WebShop, SkillCycle with a 3B model achieves a success rate of 74.74% and a score of 88.37 without inference-time skill inputs, representing relative improvements of 0.73% and 3.96% over the state-of-the-art (SOTA) model, respectively. In Cycle 3 ablations on ALFWorld and WebShop, SkillCycle's no-skill success rates improve by 10.18% and 18.11% relative to a static skill bank, and by 2.41% and 2.50% relative to a single bank update, respectively. These results show that continually revising skill guidance as the agent's capabilities change helps transform external skills into policy capabilities that require no skill inputs at inference. We will release code, configurations, skill banks, and evaluation protocols.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkillCycle 让语言体的策略与技能库 (skill bank) 交替共进化：技能内化后规则会变得冗余或误导，框架用蒸馏反馈既定位待检规则又指导其内容修订。在 WebShop 上 3B 模型无推理期技能输入达到 74.74% 成功率与 88.37 分，相对 SOTA 提升 0.73% 与 3.96%。
Motivation: 体从外部技能学习会改变其能力，使监督后续学习的规则变得冗余、误导或不足，形成技能内化与规则修订相互耦合的问题。
Method: SkillCycle 交替两个阶段：固定技能库与 router 下做策略学习，冻结策略下做规则修订；蒸馏反馈的 token 级上下文差异用于定位待检规则，交互结果用于编辑规则内容与适用范围；候选编辑先经过规则级与整库的环境比较再进入下一学习周期。
Result: WebShop 上 3B 模型无推理期技能输入成功率 74.74%、得分 88.37，相对 SOTA 分别提升 0.73% 与 3.96%；Cycle 3 消融中，ALFWorld 与 WebShop 的无技能成功率相对静态技能库分别提升 10.18% 与 18.11%，相对单次技能库更新分别提升 2.41% 与 2.50%。
Conclusion: 随体能力变化持续修订技能引导，能把外部技能转化为无需推理期技能输入的策略能力；代码、配置、技能库与评测协议将开源。

papers.title: Event-Aligned Visual Action Reasoning for World Action Models
papers.abstract_en: World-Action Models (WAMs) utilize future visual prediction as an intermediate reasoning process to guide action generation. However, existing WAMs typically structure visual imagination according to predefined temporal intervals, without explicitly accounting for the different roles of task-critical interactions and connecting transitions. We argue that effective visual foresight should align directly with task-relevant interactions and their corresponding reasoning demands. To this end, we introduce an event-aligned visual action reasoning framework that organizes visual-action prediction around interaction events. Through event-aligned visual-action supervision, WAM learns to generate event-aligned visual context in each imagined rollout, placing greater emphasis on critical state changes that inform action generation. This shapes the visual reasoning granularity according to the underlying interaction dynamics, with detailed reasoning around task-critical events and coarser progression through connecting transitions. Furthermore, we introduce an execution validity head that identifies the valid portion of each predicted action sequence, avoiding redundant actions during chunked inference. Experiments demonstrate a 10.26 percentage point improvement in DOMINO success rate over baseline and competitive performance on RoboTwin 2.0. It also transfers from DOMINO Level 1 to Levels 2 and 3 without target-level adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出事件对齐的视觉动作推理框架，把 World-Action Model 的视觉想象围绕交互事件而非固定时间间隔组织，并加一个执行有效性头 (execution validity head) 截断动作块中的冗余动作。在 DOMINO 上成功率较基线提升 10.26 个百分点，RoboTwin 2.0 表现有竞争力，且从 DOMINO Level 1 直接迁移到 Level 2、3 无需目标级适配。
Motivation: 现有 WAM 按预设时间间隔铺开视觉想象，把任务关键交互与过渡段一视同仁，导致关键状态变化上的推理粒度不足。
Method: 框架以交互事件为单位组织视觉-动作预测，用事件对齐的视觉动作监督 (event-aligned visual-action supervision) 让每次 rollout 生成事件对齐的视觉上下文，在关键事件附近做细粒度推理、过渡段粗粒度推进；另加执行有效性头识别预测动作序列中有效的部分，避免分块推理 (chunked inference) 时的冗余动作。
Result: 在 DOMINO 上成功率较基线提升 10.26 个百分点；在 RoboTwin 2.0 上取得有竞争力的表现；从 DOMINO Level 1 迁移到 Level 2 和 Level 3 时无需目标级适配。
Conclusion: 视觉推理的粒度应由底层交互动态决定：围绕任务关键事件加密想象、过渡段放粗，再配合动作序列的有效性截断，可在跨难度级别迁移时保持成功率。

papers.title: RSI-Forge: From Research Papers to Environments for Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.abstract_en: Environments are the foundation of recursive self-improvement: they provide the problems agents work on and the feedback used to evaluate progress. Yet constructing challenging research environments with reliable evaluation still depends on domain experts, limiting their scale and disciplinary coverage. We introduce RSI-Forge, a multi-agent pipeline that turns published papers into executable environments for self-improvement. Three agents coordinate construction, reproduction, and review to produce tasks with automated evaluators; each paper's method is independently reimplemented to establish a baseline score. We present 210 environments across 18 fields, including 90 reviewed by independent human domain experts. Both experts and agent judges give high ratings to the potential for improving the provided starting solutions and the evaluators' ability to distinguish solution quality, whereas experts are more critical of shortcut resistance, faithfulness to the source paper, and whether a single idea can exhaust a task. To validate their use for repeated improvement, we evaluate four models over 3 successive attempts on 120 environments, with each attempt inheriting prior code and notes while model weights remain fixed. At least one model improves after the first attempt in 84% of environments. Models also outperform the reproduced paper methods in 68 of the 120 environments, demonstrating room for gains beyond these baselines. Transcript analysis identifies work beyond parameter tuning in 95% of these successful attempts. Analysis of the resulting trajectories shows that models scoring lower on these tasks explore less, more often accept gains smaller than the reported standard error, and rely more heavily on tuning to the development set. RSI-Forge provides a scalable approach to constructing research environments for training and evaluating self-improving agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RSI-Forge 用三个协作 agent 把已发表论文转成可执行的递归自我改进 (RSI) 环境，每篇论文的方法被独立复现作为基线分数。在 120 个环境上让 4 个模型连续尝试 3 次（权重固定、继承前次代码与笔记），至少一个模型在 84% 的环境首次尝试后提升，68/120 个环境上超过复现的论文方法。
Motivation: 构建带可靠评测的研究环境仍依赖领域专家，限制了规模与学科覆盖，而环境正是 agent 反馈与递归自我改进的基础。
Method: 多 agent 流水线：construction、reproduction、review 三个 agent 协调生成带自动评测器的任务，并独立复现每篇论文的方法作为基线；共 210 个环境、18 个学科，其中 90 个由独立人类专家评审。
Result: 210 个环境覆盖 18 个领域，90 个经独立人类专家评审；专家与 agent 评判对“改进起始解的潜力”和“评测器区分解质量的能力”给高分，但对 shortcut resistance、对原论文的忠实度、单一想法能否穷尽任务更苛刻。4 个模型在 120 个环境上做 3 次连续尝试，84% 的环境至少一个模型首次尝试后提升；68/120 个环境上模型超过复现的论文方法；成功尝试中 95% 存在超出参数调优的工作。轨迹分析显示得分更低的模型探索更少、更常接受小于报告标准误的增益、更依赖开发集调参。
Conclusion: 论文方法复现分数只是可被超越的下界，递归自我改进需要探索而非调参；RSI-Forge 提供了可扩展构造此类环境的路径。

summary_sections.method: 多 agent 流水线：construction、reproduction、review 三个 agent 协调生成带自动评测器的任务，并独立复现每篇论文的方法作为基线；共 210 个环境、18 个学科，其中 90 个由独立人类专家评审。
summary_sections.result: 210 个环境覆盖 18 个领域，90 个经独立人类专家评审；专家与 agent 评判对“改进起始解的潜力”和“评测器区分解质量的能力”给高分，但对 shortcut resistance、对原论文的忠实度、单一想法能否穷尽任务更苛刻。4 个模型在 120 个环境上做 3 次连续尝试，84% 的环境至少一个模型首次尝试后提升；68/120 个环境上模型超过复现的论文方法；成功尝试中 95% 存在超出参数调优的工作。轨迹分析显示得分更低的模型探索更少、更常接受小于报告标准误的增益、更依赖开发集调参。
summary_sections.conclusion: 论文方法复现分数只是可被超越的下界，递归自我改进需要探索而非调参；RSI-Forge 提供了可扩展构造此类环境的路径。

papers.title: What a Reporting Convention Hides: A Matched-Budget Audit of Quantum Natural Gradient with an Exactly Computed Metric
papers.abstract_en: Several published comparisons of variational quantum optimizers time only runs that reach a target loss, or read the verdict at a single target. Either convention could decide whether an optimizer's costlier steps pay off. We measure how much each convention changes verdicts among Adam, simultaneous perturbation stochastic approximation (SPSA) and quantum natural gradient (QNG), on initializations held out from the selection of settings. We compute the exact metric that preconditions QNG, price every step in circuit evaluations and give every method the same budget. In a median pooled over circuit widths, cost families and a sweep of settings with common misses, SPSA needs more than twice Adam's evaluations to reach a loose target. Dropping the censored runs that miss the target hides this gap. On the global-cost family we hold fixed the settings selected for a strict target. QNG then usually reaches the loose target after Adam but the strict target first. QNG's strict-target lead disappears when the metric's simulator price, linear in the number of parameters, is replaced by an assumed hardware count quadratic in that number. We recommend charging every miss the budget and reporting verdicts across targets.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 6 figures, 12 tables. Lu Wei and Yufeng Wang contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 变分量子优化器的两种常见报告惯例——只计到达目标损失的运行、或只在单一目标上读结论——会改变 Adam、SPSA 与 QNG 的优劣判定。在按电路评估数计价、给各方法相同预算、并用精确计算的度量做 QNG 预条件的审计中，SPSA 达到宽松目标所需评估数超过 Adam 的两倍，而丢掉未达标的删失运行会掩盖这一差距；QNG 在严格目标上领先 Adam 的优势在把度量的模拟器计价（线性于参数量）换成硬件二次计价后消失。作者建议把每次未命中也计入预算，并跨多个目标报告结论。
Motivation: 已发表的变分量子优化器对比常只统计到达目标损失的运行，或只在单一目标上判定胜负，这两种惯例本身就能决定昂贵步是否划算，而初始化与设置选择的泄漏也会左右结论。
Method: 在从设置选择中留出的初始化上比较 Adam、SPSA 与 QNG；为 QNG 精确计算预条件度量 (metric)，把每一步按电路评估数 (circuit evaluations) 计价并给所有方法相同预算；在电路宽度、代价函数族与含共同未命中的设置扫描上做中位数汇总，并在全局代价族上固定为严格目标选出的设置。
Result: 跨电路宽度与代价族的中位数汇总中，SPSA 达到宽松目标所需评估数超过 Adam 的两倍；删除未达目标的删失运行会掩盖这一差距。在全局代价族上固定严格目标所选设置后，QNG 通常晚于 Adam 达到宽松目标、但先于严格目标；当度量的模拟器计价（线性于参数量）换成假设的硬件计数（二次于参数量）时，QNG 的严格目标领先消失。
Conclusion: 报告惯例（是否计入未命中、在哪个目标读结论、度量按模拟器还是硬件计价）足以翻转优化器优劣判定，因此应把每次未命中计入预算并跨多个目标报告结论。

papers.title: Democratizing MoE inference on commodity GPUs with CoMoE
papers.abstract_en: Deploying Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models relies heavily on Expert Parallelism, which generates intense inter-GPU communication. Consequently, state-of-the-art inference systems require high-bandwidth, P2P interconnects (e.g., NVLink) in datacenter GPUs to handle massive token routing, making deployment prohibitively expensive. Consumer GPUs offer comparable compute power at significantly lower cost, promising to democratize MoE inference for individuals and enable privacy-preserving local deployments. However, their bandwidth-limited (only weak PCIe bus bandwidth) and host-mediated interconnects (no P2P support) introduce severe communication bottlenecks. We present CoMoE, a communication-efficient MoE inference system that resolves this mismatch through novel host-centric routing. Our key insight is that the unique communication topology provides the opportunity to elevate the host to an active routing hub, which can fundamentally reduce communication volume and eliminate global synchronization-induced stalls. Specifically, for token dispatch, we introduce host-backed token multicast to write shared tokens to the host exactly once, eliminating outbound transmission redundancy. For token combine, we propose a fine-grained, token-level aggregation mechanism using host staging buffers, which replaces rigid global synchronization and mitigates straggler effects. Evaluation on RTX 5090 GPUs shows that CoMoE improves inference throughput by up to 1.46x, approaching the performance of NVLink-capable A800 GPUs at only 23.4% of the hardware cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoMoE 把 MoE 推理的 token 路由上移到主机侧：dispatch 用 host-backed token multicast 让共享 token 只写一次主机，combine 用主机暂存缓冲做 token 级细粒度聚合，取代全局同步。在 RTX 5090 上吞吐最高提升 1.46 倍，达到 NVLink A800 性能的水平而硬件成本仅 23.4%。
Motivation: MoE 推理依赖 Expert Parallelism，产生大量 GPU 间通信，数据中心方案靠 NVLink 等高带宽 P2P 互连；消费级 GPU 只有弱 PCIe 带宽且无 P2P，通信成为瓶颈，部署成本高。
Method: 提出以主机为中心的路由 (host-centric routing)：token dispatch 采用 host-backed token multicast，共享 token 只向主机写一次以消除出站冗余；token combine 用主机暂存缓冲做 token 级细粒度聚合，替代刚性全局同步并缓解 straggler 效应。
Result: 在 RTX 5090 上评估，推理吞吐最高提升 1.46 倍，接近具备 NVLink 的 A800 的性能，而硬件成本仅为后者的 23.4%。
Conclusion: 把主机提升为活跃路由枢纽可以削减通信量并消除全局同步带来的停顿，使消费级 GPU 上的 MoE 推理在低成本下逼近数据中心 GPU 的性能。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Spatial Latent Reasoning for Embodied Reference Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Pointing-gesture visual grounding requires connecting hand geometry with the visual identity and extent of a referred object. A central challenge for continuous latent reasoning is how to organize these complementary cues into useful intermediate supervision. We propose Spatial Latent Reasoning (SLR), a framework that structures this supervision around an ordered sequence of geometric and visual states. A spatial ray state is supervised by fingertip position and pointing direction, followed by four states aligned with target-region features. To construct the visual targets, we introduce parity pooling, which applies polyphase grouping to average region tokens on four interleaved spatial supports. All states are generated recurrently during training and inference; auxiliary annotations are required only during training. On EgoPoint-Ground, the framework improves mIoU over same-backbone supervised fine-tuning by 2.8, 17.5, and 21.1 percentage points on Qwen3.5-4B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and Qwen3-VL-8B, respectively, with improvements on both hard subsets. On YouRefIt, it achieves 77.6% precision at IoU 0.5, a numerical margin of 5.2 percentage points over the reported state of the art under differing evaluation protocols. Ablations support joint geometric and visual supervision on the standard and similar-object sets, and favor parity over three alternative pooling operators on the standard set. These results support task-structured supervision for continuous pointing grounding. We will release the code and supporting materials.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Spatial Latent Reasoning (SLR)，把指向手势视觉接地 (pointing-gesture visual grounding) 的中间监督组织成有序的几何与视觉状态序列：先由指尖位置与指向方向监督 spatial ray state，再接四个与目标区域特征对齐的状态，视觉目标用 parity pooling 在四个交错空间支撑上对区域 token 做多相分组平均。在 EgoPoint-Ground 上，相对同骨干监督微调，mIoU 在 Qwen3.5-4B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B、Qwen3-VL-8B 上分别提升 2.8、17.5、21.1 个百分点，两个 hard 子集均有提升；在 YouRefIt 上 IoU 0.5 精度 77.6%，比所报告 SOTA 高 5.2 个百分点（评测协议不同）。
Motivation: 指向接地需要把手指几何与被指对象的视觉身份、范围两类互补线索组织成可用的中间监督，而连续 latent reasoning 缺少这种结构化监督的构造方式。
Method: SLR 以有序状态序列组织监督：spatial ray state 由指尖位置与指向方向监督，随后四个状态对齐目标区域特征；视觉目标由 parity pooling 构造，即对四个交错空间支撑 (interleaved spatial supports) 上的区域 token 做 polyphase grouping 平均。所有状态在训练与推理中循环生成，辅助标注仅训练时需要。
Result: EgoPoint-Ground 上 mIoU 相对同骨干监督微调提升 2.8（Qwen3.5-4B）、17.5（Qwen2.5-VL-7B）、21.1（Qwen3-VL-8B）个百分点，hard 子集同样提升；YouRefIt 上 IoU 0.5 精度 77.6%，较所报告 SOTA 高 5.2 个百分点（评测协议不同）。消融支持在 standard 与 similar-object 集上联合几何+视觉监督，并在 standard 集上 parity 优于另外三种 pooling 算子。
Conclusion: 任务结构化的监督（几何 ray 状态加区域对齐视觉状态）能持续提升连续指向接地的精度，代码与配套材料将发布。
