papers.title: trACT: temporal revelation Airborne Camera Trap
papers.abstract_en: Effective remote monitoring and surveillance using drones are frequently impeded by severe environmental and thermal clutter, dynamic vegetation, target camouflage, and system latency. Drawing inspiration from the hunting strategies of birds of prey that hover and stabilize their vision to isolate subtle ground motion, we introduce trACT (temporal revelation Airborne Camera Trap), a lightweight, real-time aerial robotics framework designed for autonomous consumer drones. The system integrates Temporal Max Pooling (TMP), a low-level signal processing method that transforms imperceptible movement across a rolling integration window into robust value and time encodings, with self-supervised motion anomaly detection to isolate target motion from background environmental motion caused by wind gusts and drone drift. To overcome mechanical and processing delays, trACT combines motion prediction with automated gimbal-stabilized optical zoom verification and equitable multi-target verification balancing. Extensive real-world field experiments in densely forested wildlife habitats and surveillance scenarios demonstrate that trACT successfully bridges the gap between wide-area aerial monitoring and precise, autonomous target verification under challenging operational conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: trACT 是面向消费级无人机的轻量实时空中监测框架，用 Temporal Max Pooling (TMP) 把滚动积分窗口内不可察觉的位移编码为值与时间特征，再用自监督运动异常检测把目标运动从风阵和无人机漂移造成的背景运动中分离，并以运动预测加云台稳定光学变焦验证来补偿机械与处理延迟。在密林野生动物栖息地与监视场景的真实外场实验中，该系统在困难作业条件下把广域空中监视与自主精确目标验证衔接起来。
Motivation: 无人机远距离监测受环境与热杂波、动态植被、目标伪装以及系统延迟制约，广域覆盖与对单个目标的精确自主验证之间存在断层。
Method: TMP 作为底层信号处理，把滚动积分窗口内的微小运动转成稳健的值与时间编码；其上叠加自监督运动异常检测，区分目标运动与风阵、无人机漂移引起的背景运动；再结合运动预测、自动云台稳定光学变焦验证，以及均衡的多目标验证权衡 (equitable multi-target verification balancing)。
Result: 在密林野生动物栖息地与监视场景开展大量真实外场实验，结果显示 trACT 在挑战性作业条件下成功衔接广域空中监视与精确自主目标验证。
Conclusion: 把低层时间编码、自监督运动分离与主动变焦验证组合起来，消费级无人机可以在环境杂波和延迟并存的条件下自主完成从发现到确认的目标验证闭环。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: Efficient Reasoning with Flow Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Flow Language Models (FLMs) have emerged as a continuous-state alternative to discrete diffusion language models, yet the role of their continuous representations in reasoning remains unclear. We investigate this question by comparing the reasoning efficiency of FLMs and discrete diffusion models, measured by solution accuracy under matched denoising steps. Unlike discrete diffusion, which passes categorical states between denoising steps, FLMs evolve a continuous sequence representation throughout denoising and decodes it into discrete tokens only at the end. Our theoretical analysis shows, from a superposition perspective, how information retained in these continuous states can benefit reasoning. Intermediate-state interventions provide further empirical support for this theoretical account, showing that removing information about alternative candidates reduces subsequent solution recovery. Together, these findings show that FLMs allow evidence for multiple candidates to persist and inform subsequent reasoning before a discrete answer is produced. Furthermore, our experiments on maze planning and Sudoku tasks show that FLMs achieve greater reasoning efficiency in the few-step regime: FLMs achieves higher sequence accuracy than discrete diffusion baselines at matched model sizes and small denoising steps. On maze planning tasks, FLMs can also achieve comparable accuracy with smaller models. For example, on Maze15, FLM reaches the 95\% accuracy target at 64 denoising steps with 36.5\% fewer parameters than MDLM. These findings point to continuous state spaces as a promising foundation for reasoning models that require fewer refinement steps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对比 Flow Language Model (FLM) 与离散扩散语言模型在少步去噪下的推理效率：FLM 在整个去噪过程中保持连续序列表示、只在最后解码为离散 token，使多个候选的证据得以保留并参与后续推理。在 maze planning 与 Sudoku 上，匹配模型大小与小去噪步数时 FLM 序列准确率高于离散扩散基线；Maze15 上 FLM 用 64 步达到 95% 准确率目标，参数比 MDLM 少 36.5%。
Motivation: FLM 作为离散扩散语言模型的连续状态替代已出现，但连续表示在推理中扮演什么角色尚不清楚；需要判断连续状态能否在少步去噪下提升推理效率。
Method: 在匹配去噪步数下比较 FLM 与离散扩散模型的推理效率（以解码准确率衡量）；从 superposition 视角做理论分析，说明连续状态中保留的信息如何惠及推理；用中间态干预（移除关于替代候选的信息）做经验检验；实验任务为 maze planning 与 Sudoku。
Result: 匹配模型大小与小去噪步数时，FLM 序列准确率高于离散扩散基线；maze planning 上 FLM 可用更小模型达到相当准确率；Maze15 上 FLM 以 64 步达到 95% 准确率目标，参数量比 MDLM 少 36.5%；中间态干预显示移除替代候选信息会降低后续解的恢复。
Conclusion: 连续状态空间让多个候选的证据在离散答案产生前持续存在并影响后续推理，因而是需要更少 refinement 步数的推理模型的有前景基础。

papers.title: Self-Consuming Generative Models with Co-Evolving Human Preferences
papers.abstract_en: Generative models are increasingly trained in self-consuming iterative loops, where users curate preferred samples from model-generated candidates and the curated samples are used to train future generations of the model. Prior work has largely assumed fixed user preferences, but in practice exposure to model outputs gradually reshapes what users perceive as desirable, creating a feedback loop in which model distributions and user preferences co-evolve. We take a first step toward understanding the long-term behavior of such coupled dynamics. We show that when training relies entirely on user-curated synthetic data, iterative curation amplifies initial biases and drives the system toward one of multiple singleton equilibria in which the instance holding an initial advantage eventually dominates. In contrast, injecting reference data into training at a sufficiently large rate fundamentally changes the dynamics and yields a unique globally attracting equilibrium. Building on this insight, we study how reference-data injection can be used to control long-term outcomes, and propose an efficient algorithm that jointly selects a reference distribution and its mixing weight to steer the coupled system toward equilibria that preserve desired attributes while minimizing data collection costs.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在用户偏好会被模型输出反向重塑的自消耗训练闭环中，若训练完全依赖用户筛选的合成数据，迭代筛选会放大初始偏置并收敛到多个单峰平衡之一，初始占优的样本最终垄断；以足够大的速率注入参考数据则把动力学改为唯一全局吸引平衡。作者据此提出联合选择参考分布与混合权重的算法，把耦合系统导向保留目标属性且数据采集成本最小的平衡。
Motivation: 既有自消耗生成模型研究假定用户偏好固定，但真实场景中接触模型输出会逐渐改变用户认为可取的东西，模型分布与偏好实际是耦合演化的，其长期行为未知。
Method: 把模型分布与用户偏好写成耦合动力系统，分析纯用户筛选合成数据训练与注入参考数据两种情形下的平衡结构；再基于参考数据注入的结论，提出一个联合选择参考分布及其混合权重的算法来引导系统走向指定平衡。
Result: 完全依赖用户筛选合成数据时，迭代筛选放大初始偏置并收敛到多个单峰平衡 (singleton equilibria) 之一，初始占优实例最终主导；以足够大速率注入参考数据后动力学改变，得到唯一全局吸引平衡。
Conclusion: 参考数据注入速率是控制自消耗训练长期走向的开关：低于阈值系统被初始偏置锁定，足够高则唯一平衡可控，可用参考分布与混合权重的联合选择在保留属性与数据成本之间权衡。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Shared Geometry As A Rosetta Stone: Cross-Modal Alignment Without Paired Data
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal representations enable zero-shot classification and retrieval, but aligning independently trained models usually requires large amounts of paired data. Yet, the Platonic Representation Hypothesis suggests that models trained on different modalities may converge spontaneously toward a shared representation geometry. But then, do we even need paired examples for cross-modal alignment? Remarkably, we show that paired examples are unnecessary for coarse cross-modal alignment. Our simple Wasserstein Procrustes method with a coarse geometric initialization aligns two disjoint embedding sets by estimating a single orthogonal map without seeing any pairs. Across datasets, modalities, and unimodal models, we show that we can consistently align independently trained representations without pairs, and standard geometric alignment metrics accurately predict when this is possible. Nevertheless, we can naturally benefit from paired examples. In the very few-pair regime, our method substantially outperforms existing ones, while staying competitive with pair-based methods with more added examples. Finally, we demonstrate that the resulting alignments can enable text-to-image generation without paired examples. These results show that independently trained models often share enough geometry to establish cross-modal correspondence with little or no paired data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Wasserstein Procrustes：在粗几何初始化下，仅估计一个正交映射即可把两组互不相交的 embedding 对齐，全程不看任何配对样本。跨数据集、跨模态、跨单模态模型上都能稳定对齐独立训练的表示，且标准几何对齐指标能准确预测何时可行；在极少配对样本区间显著优于已有方法，配对增多后与基于配对的方法相当，并可支撑无配对样本的 text-to-image 生成。
Motivation: 跨模态对齐独立训练的模型通常依赖大量配对数据，而 Platonic Representation Hypothesis 暗示不同模态模型可能自发收敛到共享表示几何，配对样本是否必要成为可检验的问题。
Method: Wasserstein Procrustes：先做粗几何初始化 (coarse geometric initialization)，再在无配对条件下估计单一正交映射 (orthogonal map) 对齐两组 disjoint embedding；同时用标准几何对齐指标判断对齐是否可行，并在保留少量配对时自然接入配对信息。
Result: 跨数据集、模态与单模态模型可一致地无配对对齐独立训练的表示，几何对齐指标能准确预测何时可行；在 very few-pair 区间显著优于已有方法，配对样本增多后与基于配对方法相当；最终对齐结果可实现无配对样本的 text-to-image 生成。
Conclusion: 独立训练的模型往往共享足够几何结构，用很少甚至零配对数据即可建立跨模态对应；配对样本是可选的增益而非前提。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Stability and Diversity of Networked Self-Consuming Generative Ecosystems
papers.abstract_en: The widespread deployment of generative AI has made it increasingly difficult to distinguish synthetic content from real data. Consequently, synthetic data is inevitably incorporated into the training pipelines of future model generations, forming a self-consuming training loop. Prior work has studied the effects of such recursive self-consuming training, but analyses have largely been limited to isolated models, where a model consumes only its own synthetic data, or to simplified interactions between two models. This paper takes a first step toward understanding networked self-consuming generative models, in which multiple models consume synthetic data generated by one another through complex interaction pathways. We introduce a theoretical framework representing models as nodes in a directed, weighted graph, with edge weights governing the flow of synthetic data among models. Using this framework, we analyze the long-term behavior of networked models under retraining dynamics, establishing conditions for convergence and characterizing the resulting fixed points. We further investigate how the system's long-term stability and diversity are shaped by each model's access to real data, cross-model data consumption, and the structure of the interaction graph.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把多个生成模型的自消耗训练 (self-consuming training) 建模为有向加权图：节点是模型，边权控制彼此合成数据的流动，在重训练动力学下给出收敛条件并刻画固定点。结论是长期稳定性与多样性由各模型接触真实数据的比例、跨模型消费量以及交互图结构共同决定。
Motivation: 既有递归自消耗训练分析局限于单模型自食或两模型简化交互，无法刻画多个模型经复杂通路互相消费合成数据时的长期行为。
Method: 将模型表示为有向加权图节点、边权表示合成数据流，建立重训练动力学 (retraining dynamics) 的理论框架，推导系统收敛条件并刻画固定点，再分析真实数据可得性、跨模型消费与图结构对长期稳定性与多样性的影响。
Result: 建立网络化自消耗系统的理论框架，给出收敛条件与固定点刻画，并确定真实数据接入、跨模型数据消费和交互图结构三者对长期稳定性与多样性的塑造作用。
Conclusion: 网络化自消耗生成系统的长期稳定性与多样性是真实数据接入、跨模型消费与图结构三者共同决定的，分析须从孤立模型扩展到有向加权交互图层面。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: TiTok: Audio-Visual LLM for Multi-Segment Temporal Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Audio-visual multi-segment grounding (AV-MSG) in untrimmed videos, reasoning over audio-visual evidence and predicting multiple segments for a query, is a fundamental problem but remains challenging. Visual-only models overlook complementary acoustic cues, while audio-visual models often fail to calibrate the number of events - a phenomenon we refer to as count miscalibration. We present TiTok, an audio-visual large language model (AV-LLM) that localizes an arbitrary number of temporal event segments for each query. For precise boundary prediction, we introduce the Time Token Interleaving (TTI) method, which explicitly injects special time tokens into the audio-visual stream to align input-side temporal perception with output-side temporal prediction. We further propose decoupled, multi-segment-oriented rewards for reinforcement learning, consisting of global, local, count, precision, and format rewards, optimized with Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization (GDPO). To assess the performance on AV-MSG, we establish a new UnAV-100-based evaluation protocol, and propose the CountF1 metric for quantifying count miscalibration that overlap metrics fail to capture. TiTok reaches 65.7 mIoU and 0.58 CountF1, achieving state-of-the-art performance. Our code is available at this link.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TiTok 是面向未裁剪视频的音视频多段时序定位 (AV-MSG) 大模型，用 Time Token Interleaving 把时间 token 显式插入音视频流，对齐输入端时序感知与输出端时序预测，并以解耦的多段奖励（global、local、count、precision、format）做 GDPO 强化学习。在新建的基于 UnAV-100 的评测协议上达到 65.7 mIoU 与 0.58 CountF1，为 SOTA。
Motivation: 未裁剪视频中按查询定位多个事件段时，纯视觉模型忽略互补的声学线索，而现有音视频模型常数不准事件个数（count miscalibration），重叠类指标又捕捉不到这一失败模式。
Method: TiTok 为 AV-LLM：TTI 方法向音视频流注入特殊时间 token；RL 部分用解耦的多段导向奖励（global、local、count、precision、format），以 Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization (GDPO) 优化；并提出 CountF1 指标量化 count miscalibration。
Result: 在新提出的 UnAV-100 基评测协议上，TiTok 取得 65.7 mIoU 与 0.58 CountF1，摘要称达到 state-of-the-art。
Conclusion: 把时间 token 显式对齐输入与输出、并用解耦的计数奖励做 RL，能同时改善多段边界的重叠精度与事件计数校准。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Noise, Denoise, Correct: MCMC Posterior Sampling with Diffusion Priors in Three Steps
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained diffusion models are powerful priors for inverse problems, but posterior sampling under nonlinear, non-differentiable forward models remain hard. We introduce diffusion waltz, an MCMC method using SDEdit-style noising-denoising as a proposal, corrected via Metropolis-Hastings for exact posterior sampling without prior evaluation. We further propose injecting observations into the proposal while preserving exactness, using a gradient-free ensemble Kalman update. On a non-differentiable Navier-Stokes initial condition recovery task, diffusion waltz outperforms existing baselines across different noise and nonlinearity regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 diffusion waltz：把扩散模型的 SDEdit 式加噪-去噪当作 MCMC 提议，用 Metropolis-Hastings 校正实现无需先验求值的精确后验采样，并在提议中以无梯度 ensemble Kalman 更新注入观测。在非可微的 Navier-Stokes 初始条件反演任务上，不同噪声与非线性 regime 下均优于现有基线。
Motivation: 预训练扩散模型可作逆问题先验，但在非线性、非可微前向模型下做后验采样仍然困难。
Method: 三步流程：先加噪 (noise)、再用 SDEdit 式去噪 (denoise) 生成提议，最后用 Metropolis-Hastings 校正 (correct) 得到精确后验，全程不需要先验概率求值；另在提议阶段加入无梯度的 ensemble Kalman 更新来注入观测，同时保持精确性。
Result: 在非可微的 Navier-Stokes 初始条件恢复任务上，diffusion waltz 在不同噪声水平与非线性 regime 下均超过现有基线。
Conclusion: SDEdit 提议加 MH 校正加 ensemble Kalman 观测注入的组合，能在非可微非线性前向模型下做精确后验采样并取得更好的反演表现。

papers.title: Let the Library Speak: Self-Advertised Method Selection for Formal Proving
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based formal provers can retrieve relevant lemmas and prior proofs, but relevance alone does not say whether a mathematical method can be used on the current theorem. A method has prerequisites, a target, an intended action, and obligations that its use leaves to prove. Methods that look equally related to a theorem may therefore differ substantially in whether they offer a plausible next step. We formulate this as an applicability-aware method-selection problem and introduce self-advertisement: before candidates are ranked, a model generates a problem-specific proposal for each one, stating what part of the goal it targets, what action it would take, and what conditions that action requires. We organize 82 reusable methods from Putnam 2000-2014 as Method Contracts, which pair applicability descriptions with Mathlib anchors, a checked example or scaffold, and expected proof obligations. A single batched call elicits proposals across the library; vague or unsupported proposals are demoted, yielding a ranked shortlist accompanied by inspectable claims about each candidate's use. We analyze when similarity-based representations cannot distinguish methods with different applicability, how errors in applicability estimates affect shortlist quality, and what a checked scaffold guarantees under its stated assumptions. Against lexical, embedding, and embedding-plus-LLM reranking baselines, self-advertisement achieves 95.0% hit@5 on Putnam 2015-2025, compared with 84.2% for the strongest reranker. On IMO ProofBench, it achieves 91.7% compared with 88.3%. These results indicate improved coverage of annotated methods in the retrieved shortlists, particularly on Putnam.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 LLM 形式化证明中“检索相关但不可用”的方法选择问题，提出 self-advertisement：在排序前让模型为每个候选方法生成针对当前定理的提案，说明目标、动作与前提，并用 82 个 Putnam 方法的 Method Contracts（适用性描述 + Mathlib 锚点 + 检查过的示例/脚手架 + 期望证明义务）过滤空泛或无支撑的提案。在 Putnam 2015-2025 上 hit@5 达 95.0%（最强 embedding+LLM reranker 84.2%），IMO ProofBench 上 91.7%（对比 88.3%）。
Motivation: 检索到的 lemma 与旧证明只说明“相关”，不说明该数学方法在当前定理上是否可用；相似度表示无法区分适用性不同的方法，导致候选短列表质量不稳定。
Method: 引入 applicability-aware 方法选择与 self-advertisement：候选排序前，单次批量调用让模型为每个候选生成问题特定提案（针对目标哪一部分、执行什么动作、需要什么条件），空泛或无支撑的提案被降权；将 Putnam 2000-2014 的 82 个可复用方法组织为 Method Contracts，配对适用性描述、Mathlib 锚点、已检查示例或脚手架与期望证明义务；并分析相似度表示的区分失败、适用性估计误差对短列表的影响，以及带假设的已检查脚手架保证什么。
Result: 在 Putnam 2015-2025 上 hit@5 为 95.0%，对比最强 embedding+LLM reranking 基线 84.2%；在 IMO ProofBench 上为 91.7%，对比 88.3%。基线涵盖 lexical、embedding 与 embedding+LLM reranking 三类，指标为检索短列表中已标注方法的覆盖率。
Conclusion: 在候选排序前显式生成可检查的适用性提案，比单纯相似度或重排更能覆盖标注方法，尤其在 Putnam 上提升明显；短列表附带可审查的使用声明。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: TutorLoop: Regulating Student Learning Behaviors via Sensor-in-the-Loop Generative Feedback
papers.abstract_en: We present TutorLoop, a sensor-in-the-loop system that regulates student learning behaviors by delivering adaptive feedback based on real-time cognitive states. Unlike prior large language model (LLM) tutors that directly depend on scenario-specific content, TutorLoop operates on sensor-derived signals captured via webcams. Moreover, unlike direct cognitive-to-feedback mappings that are short-sighted, the system employs a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) agent to optimize the feedback type across the entire learning process. Finally, another LLM tutor refines feedback into human-like, context-aware messages. We evaluate TutorLoop in a large-scale user study (N=187), where a model trained offline is directly applied to a new learning task without retraining. Results show that TutorLoop provides less frequent yet more effective interventions, improving attention, reducing workload, increasing engagement, and ultimately enhancing learning outcomes. These findings highlight the potential of closed-loop, sensor-driven feedback for scalable human-AI integrated systems to support learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TutorLoop 用摄像头信号实时估计认知状态，由深度强化学习 (DRL) 智能体在整段学习过程中选择反馈类型，再由另一个 LLM 导师把反馈润色成上下文相关的人类化消息。在 N=187 的用户研究中，离线训练的模型直接迁移到新学习任务而无需重训练，结果是干预更少但更有效：注意力提升、认知负荷下降、参与度上升，学习结果随之改善。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 导师依赖场景特定内容，而直接的认知到反馈映射只顾眼前状态、缺少对整段学习过程的长期优化。
Method: 系统分三层：摄像头采集的传感信号推断实时认知状态；DRL 智能体在完整学习过程中优化反馈类型的选择，替代短视的直接映射；另一个 LLM 导师将选定反馈细化为人类化、上下文感知的消息。离线训练的模型在评估时直接应用于新的学习任务，不做重训练。
Result: 在 N=187 的大规模用户研究中，TutorLoop 给出频率更低但更有效的干预，提升注意力、降低工作负荷 (workload)、提高参与度，并最终改善学习结果；离线训练的模型直接迁移到新学习任务且无需重训练。
Conclusion: 闭环、传感驱动的反馈能以更少的干预次数换取更好的学习效果，且策略可跨学习任务直接复用，为可扩展的人机融合学习支持系统提供了路径。

papers.title: One Frame, Full Heartbeat: ECG-Free Cardiac Cine MRI Synthesis via Phase-Conditioned Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Cine cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR) analysis relies on multi-frame sequences capturing the full cardiac cycle. However, standard multi-frame acquisition depends heavily on electrocardiogram (ECG) gating and repeated breath-holds, posing challenges in uncooperative populations, resource-limited settings, and temporally corrupted datasets. Existing methods that synthesize full cardiac sequences either rely on explicit ECG signals to parameterize myocardium function, or employ deformable registration without physiological constraints, failing to faithfully reproduce clinically relevant dynamic metrics such as ejection fraction (EF) and ventricular contraction magnitude. We present PhaseFlow, a unified generative framework that overcomes both limitations. PhaseFlow estimates a non-linear cardiac phase signal directly from the input sequence via a segmentation-derived left-ventricular (LV) area curve, capturing the asymmetric dynamics of systole and diastole without any ECG dependency. At inference, this phase signal is provided by a pathology-specific template, informing phase-specific frame generation. A rectified flow model conditioned on the phase and slice position synthesizes the full cardiac motion trajectory in the latent space, decoded into a diffeomorphic displacement field that warps end-diastole pixel intensities directly, eliminating the reconstruction blur often accompanying the variational autoencoder. On the ACDC benchmark, PhaseFlow achieves superior physiological fidelity and image realism, with best LV volume curve $R^2$, structural similarity (SSIM) and generative quality (FID) among all baselines. Ablation studies confirm that each proposed component contributes measurably to the overall performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhaseFlow 在完全不依赖 ECG 门控的情况下，从单帧输入经分割得到的左心室面积曲线估计非线性心脏相位，再用以相位和层面位置为条件的 rectified flow 在隐空间生成完整心动周期 cine MRI，并解码为微分同胚位移场直接形变舒张末期图像。在 ACDC 基准上取得最优的 LV 容积曲线 R²、SSIM 与 FID。
Motivation: cine CMR 依赖 ECG 门控与反复屏气，在不配合人群、资源受限场景和时序受损数据上不可用；已有合成方法要么需要显式 ECG，要么用无生理约束的形变配准，难以忠实复现射血分数 (EF) 和心室收缩幅度等临床动态指标。
Method: 先从输入序列经分割推导 LV 面积曲线，估计捕捉收缩/舒张不对称的非线性心脏相位（推理时由病理特定模板提供）；再用以相位和层面位置为条件的 rectified flow 在隐空间生成完整心脏运动轨迹，解码为微分同胚位移场，直接形变舒张末期像素强度，绕开 VAE 重建模糊。
Result: 在 ACDC 基准上，LV 容积曲线 R²、SSIM 与 FID 均为所有基线中最优；消融研究显示每个提出组件都对总体性能有可测贡献。
Conclusion: 用影像自身导出的相位信号替代 ECG 门控，配合相位条件生成与微分同胚形变，可以在无 ECG 依赖下同时保住临床动态指标与图像真实度。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Quantifying Volumetric Risk: Class-Aware Asymmetric Weighted Conformal Prediction for 3D Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Reliable volumetric segmentation is critical for clinical diagnostics, yet foundation models such as MedSAM remain deterministic and lack calibrated uncertainty under distribution shift. Existing conformal prediction methods offer statistical guarantees but are frequently applied in 2D and assume symmetric error distributions, so they do not capture the class-specific biases that arise in 3D multi-class segmentation. We propose Class-Aware Asymmetric Weighted Conformal Prediction (CA-WCP), which combines latent-space density-ratio weighting for covariate shift with directional quantiles for the lower and upper volume bounds, and scales each bound by a class-specific asymmetry factor derived from validation-set false-positive and false-negative rates. We prove that CA-WCP retains the weighted-exchangeability marginal coverage guarantee for every class, and we evaluate it on 3D brain tumor segmentation (BraTS 2020) and on a synthetic multi-organ CT benchmark constructed under covariate shift. On both benchmarks the 95\% Clopper--Pearson interval for the observed coverage of CA-WCP contains the nominal 90\% level for every semantic class, while interval width is reduced by 8--14\% relative to symmetric weighted conformal prediction. We further encode the calibrated intervals into structured prompts for a multimodal large language model to produce uncertainty-conditioned radiology reports, linking distribution-shift-aware uncertainty quantification to interpretable clinical communication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CA-WCP：面向 3D 多类医学图像分割的类别感知非对称加权共形预测，用潜空间密度比权重处理协变量偏移，用上下方向分位数与类别非对称因子分别缩放体积上下界。在 BraTS 2020 与合成多器官 CT 协变量偏移基准上，每个语义类的 95% Clopper--Pearson 覆盖区间都包含名义 90% 水平，区间宽度比对称加权共形预测窄 8--14%。
Motivation: MedSAM 等分割基础模型是确定性的，在分布偏移下缺少校准不确定性；现有共形预测多在 2D 上做且假设误差对称，抓不住 3D 多类分割中的类别特异偏差。
Method: CA-WCP 结合潜空间密度比加权（针对 covariate shift）与体积上下界的双向分位数，再用验证集假阳性/假阴性率导出的类别非对称因子缩放每个界；证明其对每个类保留 weighted-exchangeability 边际覆盖保证，并把校准区间编码为结构化 prompt 供多模态 LLM 生成不确定性条件化的放射学报告。
Result: 在 BraTS 2020 与合成多器官 CT 协变量偏移基准上，CA-WCP 观测覆盖的 95% Clopper--Pearson 区间在每个语义类都包含名义 90% 水平；相对对称加权共形预测，区间宽度减少 8--14%。
Conclusion: 把类别非对称性与密度比加权一起放进共形预测，可在 3D 多类分割的分布偏移下保住逐类覆盖保证并收窄区间，且校准区间可直接接入临床报告生成。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: The Persona Hierarchy Model: Understanding Contextual Generalization in Fine-Tuning LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Language models are routinely fine-tuned under a fixed context, such as a generic system prompt, persona or domain-specific instruction, yet the learned behavior sometimes stays confined to that context and sometimes broadly generalizes to unseen contexts. We propose the Persona Hierarchy Model to explain this: a shared default persona influences behavior across contexts. Under this model, fine-tuning that modifies the shared persona promotes broader transfer, whereas changes to local personas remain more context-specific. Across 120 fine-tuned models spanning four behaviors and 15 training contexts, generalization narrowness positively correlates with the similarity between the training context's persona and the default persona (Pearson's r = 0.72 for Qwen3-4B). Prior fine-tuning under the default context can broaden generalization in subsequent training under other contexts. Aligning contextual responses with default-persona responses produces stronger effects. Finally, we propose persona-preserving regularization (PPR) to confine undesired contextual generalization. In RL, PPR cuts reward hacking from 42-55% to at most 0.2% under every evaluated prompt while retaining accuracy gains. These results support the Persona Hierarchy Model as an explanation for contextual generalization and can motivate future controls on unintended generalization for better alignment of LLMs.

papers.title: PPCAR-Net: Projection-Refined Parametric 3D Coronary Artery Reconstruction from Sparse X-ray Angiographic Views
papers.abstract_en: Sparse-view 3D coronary reconstruction commonly relies on cross-view correspondence and triangulation, which are vulnerable to vessel overlap and foreshortening, or on volumetric prediction followed by vascular-graph extraction, which does not directly provide centrelines and radii. We introduce PPCAR-Net, a projection-refined parametric coronary artery reconstruction network that directly predicts a branch-structured centreline-and-radius representation without explicit point matching, triangulation, or an intermediate volume. Given a variable number of segmented views, a coarse predictor combines frozen VGGT features with learned branch queries to estimate branch presence, B-spline centreline trajectories, and dense radius profiles. Projection-guided geometry and radius refiners then sample local evidence from the input views and apply residual corrections learned with 3D supervision. We evaluate representation fidelity and sparse-view reconstruction quantitatively and qualitatively. On simulated angiographic masks generated from CT-derived coronary anatomy, PPCAR-Net produces better connected artery reconstructions and achieves strong centreline accuracy, particularly for RCA, while maintaining competitive volumetric overlap. Coarse-to-fine inference takes 121 ms, enabling real-time reconstruction.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables, including references and appendix. Code and pretrained models: https://github.com/G2304138H/PPCAR-Net . Project page with video results: https://G2304138H.github.io/PPCAR-Net/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PPCAR-Net 直接从稀疏 X 线造影视图回归分支结构化的中心线加半径参数化表示，绕开跨视图匹配、三角化与体素预测。在由 CT 冠脉解剖生成的模拟造影 mask 上，其重建连通性更好、中心线精度强（RCA 尤其突出），体积重叠保持竞争力，粗到细推理 121 ms 达到实时。
Motivation: 稀疏视图 3D 冠脉重建要么依赖易受血管重叠与短缩影响的跨视图对应和三角化，要么先预测体体积再提取血管图，无法直接给出中心线与半径。
Method: 粗预测器融合冻结 VGGT 特征与可学习分支 query，估计分支存在性、B-spline 中心线轨迹和稠密半径剖面；随后投影引导的几何与半径细化器从输入视图采样局部证据，用 3D 监督学习残差校正。输入为数量可变的分割视图，无需显式点匹配或中间体数据。
Result: 在由 CT 冠脉解剖生成的模拟造影 mask 上，PPCAR-Net 给出连通性更好的动脉重建，中心线精度强、RCA 尤其突出，同时保持有竞争力的体积重叠；粗到细推理耗时 121 ms，支持实时重建。
Conclusion: 直接回归参数化中心线加半径表示、再用投影证据做细化，可以在稀疏视图下同时拿到连通的冠脉几何、准确中心线与实时速度，无需三角化或体数据中介。

papers.title: ScribbleEdit: A Benchmark for Scribble-Only Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: Scribble-based interaction provides a lightweight and intuitive way for users to specify image editing intents in interactive editing tools. However, current image editing models based on VLMs or LLMs struggle to understand and execute edits based solely on scribble inputs. To systematically study this problem, we construct a new benchmark, ScribbleEdit, that evaluates the ability of image editing models to perform image editing conditioned on scribbles. This task requires both a deep understanding of the intention of the scribble and an accurate interpretation of its spatial information. In ScribbleEdit, we design an automated data construction pipeline and introduce a dedicated evaluation protocol that explicitly measures intention alignment. Our analysis reveals that existing VLM/LLM-based editing models fail to accurately capture scribble intentions. To guide future progress on scribble-only image editing, we propose a simple yet effective soft-token baseline, which enhances the model's understanding of scribble semantics and outperforms standard image editing models on our benchmark. Our evaluation and baseline together provide a concrete foundation for assessing and improving the scribble-driven image editing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ScribbleEdit：仅用涂鸦 (scribble) 指定编辑意图的图像编辑基准，配自动数据构建流水线与显式度量意图对齐 (intention alignment) 的评测协议。分析显示现有 VLM/LLM 编辑模型无法准确捕捉涂鸦意图；作者提出的 soft-token 基线增强对涂鸦语义的理解，在该基准上超过标准图像编辑模型。
Motivation: 涂鸦是交互式编辑工具里轻量直观的意图表达方式，但现有基于 VLM/LLM 的图像编辑模型难以理解并执行仅由涂鸦驱动的编辑，缺少系统评测该能力的任务与度量。
Method: 构建基准 ScribbleEdit，任务要求同时理解涂鸦意图与其空间信息；设计自动数据构建流水线，并引入显式度量意图对齐的专用评测协议；另提出一个 soft-token 基线来增强模型对涂鸦语义的理解。
Result: 分析显示现有 VLM/LLM 编辑模型无法准确捕捉涂鸦意图；soft-token 基线在该基准上优于标准图像编辑模型。
Conclusion: 涂鸦驱动的图像编辑需要专门的意图与空间信息评测，soft-token 表示是提升涂鸦语义理解的一个有效起点，评测协议与基线共同构成该任务的评估与改进基础。

papers.title: From Plausible Hierarchies to Useful Taxonomies: Evaluating Agentic Harnesses on Customer Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Taxonomies are the symbolic representations through which AI systems organize evidence, aggregate patterns, and answer questions over large document collections. Over customer feedback, the category tree decides how every record is counted and routed, which problems get seen, and which team owns them. Agentic harnesses now make it easy to generate a plausible-looking hierarchy, and such trees are checked today with generic, individually scoped checks: each name fits its description, sits under the right parent, and stays distinct from its siblings. We ask a more operational question: when is a generated hierarchy actually useful as a production taxonomy? We build six taxonomies over two proprietary feedback corpora (1,940 and 5,000 records): for each corpus, a production reference and two repeated runs of the same harness under identical inputs. All six pass every generic naming and structure check, and a deeper product-coverage check even prefers the generated trees. Yet in every generated tree at least 97.7% of leaf names merely restate an ancestor's name (13.9% and 2.9% in the references), and in one, three of every four records fall under multiple top-level categories. We introduce two families of whole-tree metrics: structural discriminators test whether a tree's shape was learned from the data or imposed by its generator; team partitionability tests whether branches split feedback into groups teams can own. Trees the generic checks rate as equally correct differ by 27 percentage points in cross-branch leakage, and only one of the two beats a random split. Surface plausibility is an insufficient measure of taxonomy quality: evaluation must measure the whole tree as well as each node.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 客户反馈分类树的通用逐节点检查（名称匹配描述、父节点正确、兄弟互异）全部通过，却测不出生成树的可用性：两个语料上生成树至少 97.7% 的叶名只是复述祖先名（参考树 13.9% 与 2.9%），其中一棵有四分之三记录落入多个顶层类。作者据此主张分类树评估必须同时度量整树结构与团队可划分性，而非只查节点。
Motivation: Agentic harness 能轻易生成看似合理的类别树，而现行检查是逐节点、逐项的，无法回答生成层级在生产中是否真的可用——类别树决定每条反馈如何计数、路由与归属团队。
Method: 在两个专有反馈语料（1,940 与 5,000 条记录）上构建六棵分类树：每个语料一棵生产参考树加同一 harness 在相同输入下的两次重复运行；提出两族整树指标——structural discriminator（判断树形是学自数据还是被生成器强加）与 team partitionability（检验分支能否把反馈切成团队可拥有的组）。
Result: 六棵树全部通过通用命名与结构检查，更深的 product-coverage 检查甚至偏好生成树；但每棵生成树至少 97.7% 的叶名复述祖先名（参考树为 13.9% 与 2.9%），其中一棵有四分之三记录落入多个顶层类。通用检查判为同样正确的树在 cross-branch leakage 上相差 27 个百分点，且两棵中只有一棵胜过随机划分。
Conclusion: 表面合理性不足以度量分类树质量，评估必须同时度量整树与每个节点。

papers.title: Unified Multi-plane Autoregressive Diffusion for 3D Multi-contrast MRI Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Acquiring a complete set of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) contrasts is time-intensive and uncomfortable for patients, despite the diagnostic value of multi-contrast imaging. This motivates synthesizing missing contrasts from those already acquired, which is an inherently 3D problem requiring anatomical coherence across axial, sagittal, and coronal planes. However, fully 3D generative models are often impracti- cal under computational resources that scale cubically with volume size. We propose a unified Multi-Plane Autoregressive Diffusion (MPAD), a latent diffusion framework that achieves full-volume 3D synthesis using efficient plane-wise 2D operations while preserving volumetric coherence. A 3D autoencoder first compresses MRI scans into an isotropic 3D la- tent representation. A 2D diffusion model is then trained to reconstruct masked latent slices of the target contrast, conditioned on both source- contrast slices and unmasked target-contrast slices. During inference, we introduce plane-wise autoregressive synthesis with inter-plane priors. Slices are generated autoregressively in random order within one plane orientation to maintain intra-plane continuity, then propagated as con- ditioning priors to orthogonal plane orientations to enforce inter-plane consistency. Compared to 3D latent diffusion baselines, MPAD reduces training and inference FLOPs by 7x and 3x, respectively, while also lowering inference time and peak memory consumption. Experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that MPAD achieves superior perfor- mance, generating high-fidelity 3D volumes and supporting one-to-many translation within a single unified model.
papers.journal_ref: ECCV 2026. Lecture Notes in Computer Science, vol 17034. Springer, Cham
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出多平面自回归扩散 MPAD，用 3D autoencoder 把 MRI 压成各向同性 latent，再以 2D diffusion 在单个平面内随机顺序自回归生成掩码切片，并把已生成平面作为先验传播到正交平面以维持体积一致性。相比 3D latent diffusion 基线，训练 FLOPs 降低 7 倍、推理 FLOPs 降低 3 倍，同时缩短推理时间与峰值显存，并在多个数据集上生成高保真 3D 体数据、在单一模型内支持一对多对比度转换。
Motivation: 多对比度 MRI 采集耗时且患者不适，缺失对比度需从已采对比度合成；该问题本质是跨轴位、矢状位、冠状位的 3D 一致性问题，而完全 3D 生成模型的计算量随体数据尺寸立方增长，资源上常不可行。
Method: MPAD 是 latent diffusion 框架：3D autoencoder 先将 MRI 压缩为各向同性 3D latent；2D diffusion 在源对比度切片与未掩码目标对比度切片的条件下重建目标对比度的掩码 latent 切片；推理时采用带 inter-plane prior 的 plane-wise 自回归合成——先在单一平面方向内以随机顺序自回归生成切片以保持平面内连续性，再把已生成切片作为条件先验传播到正交平面方向以约束平面间一致性。
Result: 与 3D latent diffusion 基线相比，MPAD 训练 FLOPs 降低 7 倍、推理 FLOPs 降低 3 倍，并进一步降低推理时间与峰值显存；在多个数据集上的实验中生成高保真 3D 体数据，且在单一统一模型内支持一对多对比度转换。
Conclusion: 作者主张：用平面级 2D 操作加跨平面自回归先验即可在远低于完全 3D 生成的计算开销下实现全容量 3D 多对比度 MRI 合成，同时保持体积一致性并容纳一对多映射。

summary_sections.result: 与 3D latent diffusion 基线相比，MPAD 训练 FLOPs 降低 7 倍、推理 FLOPs 降低 3 倍，并进一步降低推理时间与峰值显存；在多个数据集上的实验中生成高保真 3D 体数据，且在单一统一模型内支持一对多对比度转换。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者主张：用平面级 2D 操作加跨平面自回归先验即可在远低于完全 3D 生成的计算开销下实现全容量 3D 多对比度 MRI 合成，同时保持体积一致性并容纳一对多映射。

papers.title: From Retrieval to Customer Context: Evaluating Frontier-Model Systems for Voice-of-Customer Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Organizations increasingly use frontier language models to analyze customer feedback, but answer quality also depends on how that feedback is organized and made available. We define a \emph{customer context graph} as a unified model of customer and business context. Typed relationships connect customer objects (feedback, conversations, users, and accounts), operational objects (tickets, support agents, opportunities, and competitors), and analytical or action objects (taxonomy concepts, evidence, insights, work items, and outcomes). This lets an agent investigate not only what customers say, but why, who is affected, what action followed, who owns it, and whether it was resolved. For this experiment, the graph is populated from public Cursor feedback; the same architecture can support any type of feedback source. We compare Agentic RAG, a Deep Research Agent, and a Customer Context Graph-backed Agent on the same 9,432 public Cursor feedback records using 30 realistic product, incident, comparison, and metadata questions. Without exhaustive ground truth, we jointly score responses on answer quality (coverage and organization), analytical depth (specificity and decomposition), and evidence quality (citation support and traceability), using a comparative rubric calibrated on 28 of the 30 questions. We sample cited records against their claims and weight the three dimensions equally. Under this aligned rubric, the Customer Context Graph-backed Agent scores 0.961 overall, versus 0.710 for the Deep Research Agent and 0.651 for Agentic RAG, and leads the Deep Research Agent on 27 of 30 paired questions (sign-test p < 10^(-5); strictly best on 26 of 30). Its largest advantage is analytical depth (0.967 versus 0.642), reflecting more specific, hierarchically developed findings with quantified themes and traceable evidence...
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 customer context graph（客户上下文图），把反馈、会话、用户、账户、工单、竞品、洞察等对象用类型化关系连成统一模型，供 agent 在检索之外追查「为什么、谁受影响、后续动作、谁负责、是否解决」。在 9,432 条公开 Cursor 反馈记录、30 个产品/事故/对比/元数据问题上，图支撑 agent 综合得分 0.961，高于 Deep Research Agent 的 0.710 与 Agentic RAG 的 0.651。
Motivation: 前沿模型做客户之声 (VoC) 分析时，答案质量受反馈组织与供给方式制约：纯检索式 agent 只能回答「客户说了什么」，难以给出有证据链的因果与责任归属。
Method: 构建类型化关系的 customer context graph，节点覆盖客户对象（反馈、会话、用户、账户）、运营对象（工单、客服、商机、竞品）与分析/行动对象（分类概念、证据、洞察、工作项、结果）；用同一 9,432 条公开 Cursor 反馈记录对比 Agentic RAG、Deep Research Agent 与图支撑 agent，30 个真实问题上按答案质量、分析深度、证据质量三维等权评分，评分 rubric 在 30 题中的 28 题上校准，并对被引记录按声明抽样核验。
Result: 图支撑 agent 综合 0.961，Deep Research Agent 0.710，Agentic RAG 0.651；在 30 个配对问题中对 Deep Research Agent 领先 27 个（sign-test p < 10^-5），其中 26 个严格最优；最大优势在分析深度维度 0.967 对 0.642。
Conclusion: 把客户与业务上下文组织成类型化图谱，比单纯增强检索更能提升前沿模型在 VoC 分析上的证据可追溯性与分析深度；该架构可复用于任意反馈来源。

papers.title: DUDA-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Multimodal Data-Driven Urban Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Urban diagnosis integrates heterogeneous observations to identify urban problems, localize affected areas, and investigate contributing factors, informing evidence-based urban planning and management. However, its reliance on labor-intensive, case-specific expert workflows limits scalability and reuse, motivating the exploration of agent-based execution. To evaluate this capability, we introduce DUDA-Bench, a hierarchical and interactive benchmark that formalizes data-driven urban diagnosis as a multi-stage agent workflow. It comprises 86 atomic and 22 workflow tasks spanning four analytical stages, grounded in multimodal data from 12 cities covering five urban problem types. Evaluations of seven backbone models and five agent systems reveal a substantial gap between isolated analytical competence and end-to-end diagnosis, with system benefits varying across backbones. Trajectory analysis shows that unresolved evidence gaps propagate across stages, while successful recovery involves revising assumptions and actions using feedback. These findings highlight limitations in coordinating analytical capabilities across stages, particularly adaptive planning, evidence integration, and verification. More broadly, DUDA-Bench provides a framework for translating expert analytical workflows into hierarchical agent tasks and process-aware evaluation, supporting systematic assessment of end-to-end analytical capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DUDA-Bench 把数据驱动的城市诊断 (urban diagnosis) 形式化为多阶段 agent 工作流，用 86 个原子任务与 22 个工作流任务、覆盖 12 座城市五类城市问题来评测 LLM agent。七个 backbone 模型与五套 agent 系统的评测显示：孤立分析能力与端到端诊断之间存在明显落差，且未解决的证据缺口会跨阶段传播，成功恢复依赖依据反馈修正假设与动作。
Motivation: 城市诊断依赖耗时且因案而异的专家工作流，难以规模化复用；现有 agent 缺少能衡量其跨阶段端到端诊断能力的评测基准。
Method: 提出分层交互式基准 DUDA-Bench，将城市诊断形式化为多阶段 agent 工作流，任务分四个分析阶段，含 86 个原子任务与 22 个工作流任务，数据为 12 座城市五类城市问题的多模态观测；评测七个 backbone 模型与五套 agent 系统，并做轨迹分析。
Result: 评测七个 backbone 模型与五套 agent 系统，发现孤立分析能力与端到端诊断之间存在明显落差，系统收益随 backbone 不同而变化；轨迹分析显示未解决的证据缺口跨阶段传播，成功恢复靠依据反馈修正假设与动作。
Conclusion: 跨阶段协调（自适应规划、证据整合、验证）是当前 agent 的主要短板，DUDA-Bench 提供了把专家工作流转成分层任务与过程感知评测的框架。

papers.title: The Confidence Game: Strategic Miscalibration in Human-AI Delegation
papers.abstract_en: Calibrated uncertainty quantification is essential to ensuring AI agents are trustworthy and reliable. However, when agents seek to maximize user engagement or revenue, confidence reports may be strategically distorted, detracting from their informativeness. We formalize this problem in the Confidence Game: a repeated signaling game with imperfect monitoring in which an agent of unknown honesty and ability reports its confidence, and a user decides whether to delegate the task or complete it herself. The agent manages the tradeoff between manipulating signals and maintaining its reputation. We characterize the Markov Perfect Bayesian Equilibria of the two-period game and show that honest reporting is not an equilibrium, inflation is the unique best response once the agent is sufficiently myopic, and under-reporting requires that the user believe honesty to be a minority. We then place an LLM in the agent role, supplying it with its true probability of success so that any gap between what it knows and what it reports is attributable to incentives rather than to miscalibration. The model claims high confidence on 56% of tasks it has been told it will probably fail. This persists on real tasks, where it must estimate its own accuracy and causes miscalibration to increase while the agent's signal becomes less informative. Furthermore, we find that the LLM agent's decisions are coherent, but it systematically underestimates both how likely the user is to delegate and how secure its reputation is, resulting in less extreme behavior. Pricing the agent's reporting rule, we find that it destroys 68% of the gains from delegation, of which 71% is information the report no longer carries and no amount of user sophistication recovers. Overall, we establish confidence reporting under delegation as a strategic problem and provide a tractable basis for modeling, analyzing, and testing agent behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 AI 置信度汇报建模为带不完美监控的重复信号博弈，证明诚实汇报不是均衡、代理足够短视时虚高是唯一最佳应对；实验中 LLM 在被告知大概率失败的任务上仍有 56% 报高置信，定价其汇报规则会毁掉委托收益的 68%。
Motivation: 当 AI 代理以用户参与度或收入为目标时，置信度汇报会被策略性扭曲，失去信息量，而现有校准框架不处理这种激励性失真。
Method: 形式化为 Confidence Game：诚实度与能力未知的代理汇报置信度、用户决定委托或自做，刻画两期博弈的 Markov Perfect Bayesian Equilibria；再让 LLM 担任代理并直接告知其真实成功概率，使汇报与认知的差距归因于激励；最后对代理的汇报规则定价。
Result: 理论上诚实汇报不是均衡，代理足够短视时虚高是唯一最佳应对，低报要求用户相信诚实是少数；LLM 在被告知大概率失败的任务上 56% 报高置信，真实任务上校准误差上升且信号信息量下降；代理系统性低估委托概率与声誉安全度，行为不够极端；汇报规则毁掉委托收益的 68%，其中 71% 是报告不再携带、用户再精明也无法恢复的信息。
Conclusion: 置信度汇报在委托结构下本质是策略问题而非校准问题，激励导致的失真无法靠提升用户 sophistication 找回，该框架给出了建模、分析与检验代理行为的可操作基础。

papers.title: Immiscible Diffusion Policy: Preserving Multimodal Robot Actions through Label-Free Noise Assignment
papers.abstract_en: When diffusion policies were first introduced, they were expected to recover multi-modal action distributions. However, we find this expectation does not always hold, as diffusion policies often collapse to a single modality even when we guarantee the balance of dataset modalities and exact within-batch symmetry. Our analysis indicates that independent action-noise pairing contributes to this failure by increasing mixing and crossing among diffusion paths, which can produce averaged denoising responses and suppress modality-specific behavior. This issue is especially severe in robot planning, where action spaces are dense and low-dimensional, significantly increasing such mixing and crossing. To alleviate this problem, we propose Immiscible Diffusion Policy, a label-free training-time add-on to diffusion policy that uses action-noise assignment to preserve relatively distinct noise-to-action routes without modifying the policy architecture or inference procedure. Across five simulated and two real-world humanoid manipulation tasks spanning state, RGB, and point-cloud observations, our method significantly improves the policy's preservation of action modalities while maintaining strong task performance. It increases the proportion of the non-dominant modality by 6.0x-14.6x across three two-modality tasks and recovers demonstrated modalities that are entirely absent from vanilla policy rollouts on both four-modality tasks. These results demonstrate that Immiscible Diffusion Policy provides a simple yet robust approach to preserving action multi-modality in general robot learning tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 扩散策略 (diffusion policy) 即使在数据模态均衡、batch 内严格对称的条件下仍会塌缩到单一动作模态，作者把原因归为动作-噪声独立配对造成的扩散路径混合与交叉，产生平均化的去噪响应。提出的 Immiscible Diffusion Policy 在训练期用动作-噪声分配保留相对分离的噪声到动作路径，不改架构与推理流程；在三个双模态任务上把非主导模态占比提升 6.0x–14.6x，并在两个四模态任务上找回原策略 rollout 中完全缺失的示范模态。
Motivation: 扩散策略本被期待恢复多模态动作分布，但在稠密低维的机器人动作空间里常塌缩到单一模态，即使保证数据集模态均衡与 batch 内对称也如此，导致示范中的非主导行为被丢弃。
Method: 提出 Immiscible Diffusion Policy：一个免标签 (label-free) 的训练期附加模块，通过动作-噪声分配让不同模态的动作走相对分离的噪声到动作路径，减少扩散路径的混合与交叉；不修改策略架构，也不改推理过程。
Result: 在五个仿真与两个真实人形机器人操作任务（覆盖 state、RGB、点云观测）上，方法显著提升动作模态保持度并维持任务性能；三个双模态任务中非主导模态占比提升 6.0x–14.6x，两个四模态任务上找回了 vanilla policy rollout 中完全缺失的示范模态。
Conclusion: 动作-噪声分配是保持机器人扩散策略动作多模态的简单而稳健的训练期手段，可推广到一般机器人学习任务；路径混合与交叉是模态塌缩的直接成因。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Closing the Loop on Contrail Avoidance with Satellite Verification
papers.abstract_en: Contrails are the thin ice clouds that aircraft leave behind. They cause a large share of aviation's warming, and rerouting the few flights that produce them could avoid much of it. However, an avoided contrail only counts if a satellite can confirm that it never formed, and this check is hard: contrails are one to two pixels wide, cover only 0.18% of pixels, and look very similar to natural cirrus. We build a small diffusion model (8.4M parameters, trained on one GPU) that detects them, and we run a controlled study to find out which components matter. The model reaches 0.476 PR-AUC, compared with 0.414 for a DeepLabV3+ baseline and 0.119 for an adapted MedSegDiff. Doubling the input resolution of the CNN brings it to parity (0.499, p=0.07). Three lessons apply beyond contrails. First, check the input resolution before designing a new architecture. Second, simple flips and rotations more than double accuracy and matter more than any architectural choice we measured. Third, pretraining the model on contrail shapes is harmful: the model learns that thin strokes appear everywhere and paints them onto empty scenes. Precision collapses to 1% while recall-based metrics still rate the degraded model as excellent, and no threshold or guidance heuristic repairs this failure.
papers.comment: Accepted into Tackling Climate Change with Machine Learning: workshop at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为验证绕飞的尾迹 (contrail) 确实未生成，训练一个 8.4M 参数的小扩散模型在卫星图像上检测尾迹，其 PR-AUC 达 0.476，高于 DeepLabV3+ 的 0.414 与改造版 MedSegDiff 的 0.119。受控消融显示：把 CNN 输入分辨率翻倍即可追平（0.499，p=0.07），简单翻转/旋转增广使准确率翻倍以上，而用尾迹形状做预训练有害——精确率崩到 1%，且阈值与 guidance 启发式都无法修复。
Motivation: 尾迹只占像素的 0.18%、宽 1–2 像素且与自然卷云极像，卫星核验绕飞是否奏效因此很难；核验不通，绕飞减排就不成立。
Method: 构建 8.4M 参数、单 GPU 训练的小扩散模型做尾迹检测，并做受控研究逐项检验组件贡献：输入分辨率（CNN 翻倍）、数据增广（翻转与旋转）、以及在尾迹形状上的预训练，对照 DeepLabV3+ 与改造的 MedSegDiff。
Result: 扩散模型 PR-AUC 0.476，DeepLabV3+ 0.414，MedSegDiff 0.119；CNN 输入分辨率翻倍后到 0.499（p=0.07，达平价）。翻转与旋转增广使准确率提升一倍以上，超过所测任何架构选择；尾迹形状预训练使精确率崩至 1%，而基于召回的指标仍把退化模型评为优秀，阈值或 guidance 启发式均无法修复。
Conclusion: 尾迹规避的卫星闭环核验可由小扩散模型承担；先查输入分辨率再改架构，增广比架构选择更关键，而在尾迹形状上预训练会把细笔画涂满空景、必须避免。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: From Chunks to Functional Evidence: Function-Aware Retrieval for EDA Documentation QA
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is widely used to ground answers in documents. For complex technical documentation, however, the primary bottleneck is often not model reasoning but a mismatch between a query and the way knowledge is organized for retrieval. This mismatch is pronounced in Electronic Design Automation (EDA) documentation, where the information needed for an answer is scattered across heterogeneous yet tightly coupled artifacts. We therefore redesign the basic retrieval unit of RAG. Instead of operating on isolated chunks or binary relations, we collect typed artifacts into EDA functional units. Each unit is recorded as a hyperedge with links to its source chunks. We then train an encoder to align queries with functional units and combine unit retrieval with direct chunk retrieval. After mapping the selected units back to their sources, a unified reranker chooses the evidence given to the generator. On the newly constructed EDADocEval-QA dataset, our method improves ROUGE-L by 37.1% over Chunk RAG and 55.6% over the strongest graph baseline. On the public ORD-MMBench benchmark, it improves ROUGE-L by 30.0% over the strongest baseline. These results support function-aware evidence organization in the evaluated EDA documentation settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 EDA 文档问答中把 RAG 的检索单元从孤立 chunk 换成「功能单元」（typed artifacts 组成的 hyperedge，链接回源 chunk），训练编码器对齐查询与功能单元，再与直接 chunk 检索合并并统一重排。在新建的 EDADocEval-QA 上 ROUGE-L 比 Chunk RAG 高 37.1%、比最强图基线高 55.6%，在公开 ORD-MMBench 上比最强基线高 30.0%。
Motivation: 复杂技术文档里答案所需信息分散在异构但强耦合的多种 artifact 中，查询与知识组织方式不匹配，导致 RAG 的瓶颈出在检索单元而非模型推理，EDA 文档尤为突出。
Method: 重新设计检索单元：把 typed artifacts 收集为 EDA functional units，每个 unit 记为一条 hyperedge 并链接源 chunk；训练编码器做查询与 unit 的对齐，unit 检索与直接 chunk 检索结合，选中的 unit 映射回源 chunk 后由统一 reranker 决定交给生成器的证据。
Result: 在新建的 EDADocEval-QA 数据集上 ROUGE-L 相对 Chunk RAG 提升 37.1%，相对最强 graph 基线提升 55.6%；在公开 ORD-MMBench 上 ROUGE-L 相对最强基线提升 30.0%。
Conclusion: 在所评估的 EDA 文档问答设定下，按功能组织证据（function-aware evidence organization）比按 chunk 或二元关系组织更能对齐查询与检索单元。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: TopoGraphRAG-Bench: Evaluating Multimodal GraphRAG on Layout-Grounded Evidence Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Real-world documents distribute evidence across text, tables, figures, and captions within complex page layouts. Answering complex questions over such documents therefore requires more than retrieving relevant passages: systems must recover the evidence topology that connects heterogeneous evidence units. Existing GraphRAG evaluations remain largely text-centered, while multimodal document RAG benchmarks assess cross-modal retrieval and generation without directly evaluating recovery of the intended evidence topology. We introduce TOPOGRAPHRAG-BENCH, a layout-grounded benchmark for multimodal evidence reasoning in GraphRAG, comprising 2,024 questions over 201 long, visually rich documents. Questions are constructed bottom-up from text, figure, and table evidence units under three controlled topologies: single-hop retrieval, bridge-chain reasoning, and multi-source synthesis. To ensure that questions preserve their intended structure, we apply counterfactual validation for shortcut resistance, modality necessity, and evidence necessity. We evaluate text-only GraphRAG, page-level visual retrieval, and multimodal GraphRAG systems using retrieval, generation, and topology-aware reasoning metrics. Multimodal GraphRAG systems achieve the strongest overall performance, but still fail when visual-textual evidence alignment or multi-unit composition is incomplete. Text-only GraphRAG struggles when key dependencies are grounded in figures or tables, while page-level visual retrieval lacks the fine-grained structure needed for topology recovery. These findings motivate GraphRAG systems that move beyond text-derived entity relation graphs to explicitly model document layouts, cross-modal evidence alignment, and the reasoning roles of evidence units. Code and data are available at https://richardlrc.github.io/TopoGraphRAG-Bench/.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TopoGraphRAG-Bench 是一个版面锚定的多模态 GraphRAG 基准，含 2,024 道问题、覆盖 201 篇长且图文丰富的文档，问题按单跳检索、桥链推理、多源综合三种受控拓扑自底向上构造，并用反事实验证保证捷径抗性、模态必要性与证据必要性。评测显示多模态 GraphRAG 总体最强，但在视觉-文本证据对齐或跨单元组合不完整时仍失败；纯文本 GraphRAG 在关键依赖落在图表上时吃力，页面级视觉检索缺少拓扑恢复所需的细粒度结构。
Motivation: 现有 GraphRAG 评测以文本为中心，多模态文档 RAG 基准只测跨模态检索与生成，都不直接评估系统能否恢复连接异构证据单元的证据拓扑 (evidence topology)。
Method: 从文本、图表、表格证据单元自底向上构造问题，限定三种拓扑：单跳检索、桥链推理 (bridge-chain reasoning)、多源综合；用反事实验证 (counterfactual validation) 检查捷径抗性、模态必要性与证据必要性。评测涵盖纯文本 GraphRAG、页面级视觉检索与多模态 GraphRAG 三类系统，使用检索、生成与拓扑感知 (topology-aware) 三组指标。
Result: 基准含 2,024 道问题、201 篇长文档。多模态 GraphRAG 系统总体表现最强，但在视觉-文本证据对齐或多单元组合不完整时仍失败；纯文本 GraphRAG 在关键依赖位于图表时表现不佳；页面级视觉检索缺少拓扑恢复所需的细粒度结构。
Conclusion: GraphRAG 需要超越从文本导出的实体关系图，显式建模文档版面、跨模态证据对齐以及各证据单元的推理角色。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Global Exponential Convergence of Two-Layer Linear Network Training
papers.abstract_en: We prove global exponential (linear) convergence with an explicit rate in the rich scaling for wide two-layer linear networks trained with smooth Polyak-Lojasiewicz predictor losses. Gradient flow in the factors closes exactly in terms of a finite-dimensional Bures flow of the neuron law covariance, in which the predictor dynamics are preconditioned by hidden covariance blocks. Mean-field conservation laws provide uniform spectral lower bounds on the hidden preconditioning blocks when the initial covariance satisfies a spectral support gap condition. This condition encompasses positive definiteness while still allowing for singular initializations. For an initial covariance $Σ_0 = σ^2 \mathrm{Id}$, the loss converges to the global minimum with linear rate at least $4σ^2κ$, where $κ$ is the PL constant. We establish stability of this rate under finite-width sampling, as well as global convergence of factor gradient descent for an explicit stepsize interval depending on smoothness, the initial loss, and conserved spectral margins. Our argument extends layerwise to deep linear ResNets, subject to a residual-path bound. In the case of heavy-ball momentum, training dynamics close instead over positions and velocities in terms of a lifted phase covariance. Linear convergence holds under an explicit condition on the energy and damping, specifying a window of admissible dampings. For two-scale white initializations, this interval is nonempty for sufficiently large position scales, with a fixed initial loss gap and velocity covariance. Numerical experiments illustrate the covariance geometry and compare the predicted and observed rates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明宽两层线性网络在 rich scaling 下，若 predictor 损失满足光滑 Polyak-Lojasiewicz (PL) 条件，则梯度流在因子上精确闭合为神经元分布协方差的有限维 Bures 流，并全局指数（线性）收敛。当初始协方差 Σ₀ = σ²Id 时收敛速率至少为 4σ²κ（κ 为 PL 常数），该速率在有限宽度采样下稳定，并可按残差路径界推广到深层线性 ResNet。
Motivation: 两层线性网络的训练动力学在因子参数化下通常不闭合，rich scaling 中的全局收敛速率缺少显式刻画；heavy-ball 动量情形的收敛条件更不清楚。
Method: 把因子上的梯度流精确闭合为神经元分布协方差的 Bures 流，预测器动力学由隐藏协方差块预条件；用 mean-field 守恒律在初始协方差满足谱支撑间隙 (spectral support gap) 条件时给出预条件块的一致谱下界；再分析有限宽度采样稳定性、因子梯度下降的显式步长区间，以及 heavy-ball 情形下由位置与速度构成的提升相协方差 (lifted phase covariance) 动力学。
Result: Σ₀ = σ²Id 时损失以至少 4σ²κ 的线性速率收敛到全局最小值；该速率在有限宽度采样下稳定；因子梯度下降在依赖光滑度、初始损失与守恒谱裕度的显式步长区间内全局收敛；heavy-ball 情形在能量与阻尼的显式条件下（给出可容许阻尼窗口）保持线性收敛，两尺度白初始化下位置尺度足够大时该窗口非空；数值实验展示协方差几何并对比预测速率与观测速率。
Conclusion: 谱支撑间隙条件（涵盖正定初始化同时允许奇异初始化）足以保证宽线性网络训练的全局指数收敛，且速率可显式预测并可推广到深层线性 ResNet 与 heavy-ball 动量情形。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Multimodal LLMs Can Learn to Read Brain Signals: A Vision--Language Model for Unified Multi-Task EEG Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Learning EEG representations that generalize across cognitive tasks, subjects, and recording conditions remains a key challenge in electroencephalography (EEG) decoding. Recent advances in foundation models have improved EEG decoding performance, yet a fundamental open question remains: how to effectively interface neural signals with these models to enable multi-task learning across datasets. To investigate this question, we introduce BraVista, a visual-language framework that encodes multichannel EEG signals as structured images and enables multi-task learning through instruction-conditioned vision-language models (VLMs). Our approach relies on continued post-training of a general-domain VLM, leveraging its visual and linguistic priors to adapt to neural signals without a separate large-scale EEG-specific pretraining stage. We evaluate BraVista on four datasets spanning sleep staging, emotion recognition, cognitive workload classification, and abnormal EEG detection, showing strong performance across these tasks. Further analyses show that the choice of EEG-to-image representation is critical to performance. Moreover, through controlled perturbations of the EEG signal, we observe a gradual performance degradation under increasing noise, suggesting that the model relies on EEG-relevant information rather than superficial visual patterns. Together, these findings establish structured visual representations as an effective and scalable interface between neural signals and general-domain foundation models for unified multi-task EEG decoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 BraVista：把多通道 EEG 编码为结构化图像，用指令条件化的通用视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 做持续后训练，从而在不做 EEG 专用大规模预训练的前提下统一多任务解码。在睡眠分期、情绪识别、认知负荷分类、异常 EEG 检测四个数据集上均表现强劲，且对 EEG 信号的受控扰动显示性能随噪声增大逐步退化，说明模型依赖的是 EEG 相关信息而非表面视觉模式。
Motivation: EEG 表征要跨认知任务、被试和记录条件泛化仍是难题；现有基础模型虽提升了单任务解码，但神经信号如何与这些模型对接以实现跨数据集多任务学习仍是开放问题。
Method: BraVista 将多通道 EEG 编码为结构化图像，通过指令条件化的 VLM 实现多任务学习；做法是对通用领域 VLM 做持续后训练 (continued post-training)，直接利用其视觉与语言先验适配神经信号，省去独立的 EEG 专用大规模预训练阶段。
Result: 在四个数据集（睡眠分期、情绪识别、认知负荷分类、异常 EEG 检测）上均取得强劲性能；进一步分析表明 EEG 到图像的表征选择对性能至关重要；对 EEG 信号做受控扰动后，性能随噪声增大逐步退化。

papers.title: Learning Unknown Constraints without Unsafe Data via Optimality and Counterfactual Regularization
papers.abstract_en: Learning from demonstrations (LfD) provides a framework for inferring unknown constraints from locally optimal, constraint-satisfying expert behavior. Existing approaches largely fall into two paradigms, constrained inverse optimal control (CIOC) and inverse constrained reinforcement learning (ICRL). CIOC exploits optimality conditions such as the Karush--Kuhn--Tucker (KKT) conditions but typically assumes known dynamics and structured constraint representations. Meanwhile, ICRL accommodates complex unknown constraints and unknown transition dynamics but often requires extensive online exploration, during which unsafe constraint violations may occur. In this work, we introduce Counterfactual KKT (CF-KKT), a constraint learning framework that leverages learned dynamics and locally optimal demonstrations to recover unknown constraints without requiring known dynamics or additional risky exploration, thereby combining the data efficiency and safety advantages of CIOC with the flexibility of ICRL. First, we use a locally learned differentiable dynamics model to impose KKT-inspired optimality conditions directly on the demonstrations. Second, we use the learned dynamics to generate reward-improving counterfactual behaviors near the demonstrations, revealing behaviors that would be preferable in the absence of the unknown constraint and thus providing synthetic infeasible data. When the constraint parameterization is known, the same learned-dynamics framework enables direct CIOC-based parameter recovery, and we characterize its sensitivity to dynamics misspecification. Across high-dimensional robotic control tasks, our approach learns neural constraint representations with improved safety and data efficiency relative to state-of-the-art offline ICRL baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Counterfactual KKT (CF-KKT)：用局部学到的可微动力学在专家示范上直接施加 KKT 型最优性条件，并用该动力学生成示范附近的奖励改进反事实行为作为合成不可行数据，从而在不需已知动力学、也不做危险在线探索的前提下恢复未知约束。在高维机器人控制任务上学到的神经约束表示，相对最先进离线 ICRL 基线在安全性与数据效率上均有提升。
Motivation: CIOC 依赖 KKT 条件但要求已知动力学与结构化约束表示；ICRL 能处理复杂未知约束与未知动力学，却需要大量在线探索并可能产生不安全的约束违反。
Method: CF-KKT 两步：一是用局部学到的可微动力学模型把 KKT 启发的最优性条件直接施加于示范；二是用同一动力学生成示范附近的奖励改进反事实行为，揭示在无该约束时更优的动作，从而得到合成不可行数据。约束参数化已知时，同一框架可直接做 CIOC 参数恢复，并给出其对动力学误设的敏感性刻画。
Result: 在高维机器人控制任务上，学到的神经约束表示相对最先进离线 ICRL 基线在安全性与数据效率上均有改进；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把 KKT 最优性条件与基于学习动力学的反事实不可行数据结合，可在不做危险探索、不假设已知动力学的情况下恢复未知约束，兼得 CIOC 的数据效率与 ICRL 的灵活性。

papers.title: Relevance Is Not Sufficiency: What Actually Closes the Evidence Gap in Long-Term Memory QA
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents that interact with a user across many sessions accumulate histories that exceed their context window, so they store past interactions in an external memory and answer each question from a small set of retrieved records. Existing memory systems rank records by lexical or embedding relevance, yet the top-ranked memories can each be relevant while jointly omitting a complementary fact that the answer requires, especially for multi-session and temporal questions. Drawing on the distinction between relevance and sufficiency in legal evidence scholarship, we recast memory retrieval as constructing a sufficient memory set. To operationalize this view, we introduce a blinded LLM judgment over the retrieved set, together with Gold Hit and Turn Hit as evidence-coverage proxies. We then propose Budgeted Flat Reconstruction (BFR), which builds sufficient sets over a fixed flat memory store in two stages. Specifically, we first apply Formal Concept Analysis for Memory Selection (FCA-MS) to decompose the question into information requirements and select a compact candidate subset that jointly covers them. Then, we repeatedly acquire unseen records through deeper text search or complementary entity and session views, stopping when the budget is exhausted. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S show that BFR outperforms same-store adaptations of recent agent-memory systems in both answer quality and evidence coverage. Specifically, on LongMemEval-S it raises judged accuracy from 72.4% to 82.2% and Turn Hit to 91.4%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM agent 长期记忆检索按相关性排序会漏掉答案所需的互补事实，本文把检索重构为构造“充分记忆集”，提出两阶段的 Budgeted Flat Reconstruction (BFR)：先用 Formal Concept Analysis 把问题拆成信息需求并选出覆盖它们的紧凑候选集，再在预算内通过更深文本搜索与实体/会话视图补取未见记录。在 LongMemEval-S 上 judged accuracy 从 72.4% 提到 82.2%，Turn Hit 达 91.4%，在 LoCoMo 与 LongMemEval-S 的答案质量与证据覆盖上均优于同记忆库的近期 agent-memory 系统改造版。
Motivation: 跨多会话的 agent 记忆超出上下文窗口，只能靠检索少量记录答题；按词面或 embedding 相关性排序时，top 记录各自相关却可能联合遗漏答案必需的互补事实，多会话与时序问题尤其严重。
Method: 把法律证据学中 relevance 与 sufficiency 的区分引入记忆检索，定义对检索集的 blinded LLM 判定，并给出 Gold Hit 与 Turn Hit 两个证据覆盖代理；BFR 在固定扁平记忆库上分两阶段构造充分集：FCA-MS 用 Formal Concept Analysis 将问题分解为信息需求并选出联合覆盖的紧凑候选子集，随后通过更深文本搜索与互补的实体、会话视图反复获取未见记录，直到预算耗尽。
Result: 在 LoCoMo 与 LongMemEval-S 上，BFR 在答案质量与证据覆盖两方面均超过近期 agent-memory 系统的同库改造版；LongMemEval-S 上 judged accuracy 由 72.4% 升至 82.2%，Turn Hit 达到 91.4%。
Conclusion: 相关性不等于充分性：把记忆检索当作构造覆盖全部信息需求的充分集，并在固定预算下按需求补取记录，能同时抬高长期记忆问答的判定正确率与证据覆盖。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: OnlineQAT: On-Policy Distillation for Ultra-Low-Bit Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Quantization-aware training (QAT) can recover much of the accuracy lost when large language models are compressed below four bits. Existing re- covery stages, however, are commonly optimized on fixed completions or teacher-generated answers, whereas the deployed quantized model condi- tions on prefixes generated by itself. Quantization errors can therefore move the model into states that are absent from offline recovery data. We introduce OnlineQAT, a two-stage framework that first obtains a usable low-bit initialization through block-wise QAT and then performs on-policy distillation (OPD) on student-generated responses. At each visited pre- fix, a frozen full-precision teacher provides a sampled reverse-KL training signal. On Qwen3-1.7B, OnlineQAT obtains the best average among the compared quantized methods: 57.28 at W3A16 and 32.52 at W2A16, im- proving over ReasoningQAT by 2.90 and 0.44 points, respectively. The results suggest that student-visited states provide a useful recovery signal beyond fixed-completion training, particularly at three bits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OnlineQAT 用两阶段流程修复超低比特量化：先做 block-wise QAT 得到可用的低比特初始化，再在学生自己生成的前缀上做 on-policy 蒸馏 (OPD)，由冻结全精度教师给出 sampled reverse-KL 信号。在 Qwen3-1.7B 上取得对比量化方法中的最佳平均分：W3A16 为 57.28、W2A16 为 32.52，分别比 ReasoningQAT 高 2.90 和 0.44 分，说明学生实际访问的状态在三比特下尤其提供超出固定补全训练的恢复信号。
Motivation: 现有 QAT 恢复阶段在固定补全或教师答案上优化，而部署时量化模型条件于自己生成的前缀；量化误差会把模型带入离线恢复数据中不存在的状态。
Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段用 block-wise QAT 获得可用的低比特初始化；第二阶段在学生生成的响应上做 on-policy 蒸馏，每个访问到的前缀处由冻结全精度教师提供 sampled reverse-KL 训练信号。
Result: 在 Qwen3-1.7B 上，OnlineQAT 在所比较的量化方法中平均分最佳：W3A16 为 57.28，W2A16 为 32.52；相对 ReasoningQAT 分别提升 2.90 分和 0.44 分。
Conclusion: 学生自访问状态能提供固定补全训练之外的恢复信号，且这一收益在三比特下比两比特更明显。

papers.title: Do Image Editors Follow Depth-Dependent Blur and Aperture Response? A Rendered-Ground-Truth Pilot Audit
papers.abstract_en: General image editors are asked to make a photo look as if it were taken at f/1.4, yet it is rarely checked whether the blur they add follows thin-lens optics. A physical aperture edit spreads blur across depth in thin-lens proportions and changes the blur when the aperture changes; prior evaluations check blur monotonicity, sharpness-trend correlation, effective-aperture error, or vision-language judgments, and none we found reports the two properties separately at known depths. In this pilot audit of two editors (Gemini~3.1 Flash Image and GPT-image-2.5) we compare against a rendered oracle: Blender Cycles scenes with true thin-lens depth of field, one blur-width estimator applied identically to oracle and editor outputs, and preregistered depth and aperture indices. In 24 texture scenes rendered in one three-panel geometry, accepted and measurable panels show f/1.4-to-f/2.8 width ratios, $\barσ_{1.4}/\barσ_{2.8}$, of 0.99--1.18 against 1.98--2.13 for the oracle, and ratios of pooled median Gaussian-equivalent near/far blur widths of about 1.18--1.25 (Gemini) and 0.97--1.05 (GPT-image) against 1.69--1.82. Preregistered black-box interventions show that qualitative wording changes blur strength by roughly 2--10 times, whereas a request for 2 versus 6 px changes it 1.1--1.3 times and no tested wording of the f-number meets the registered ``followed'' criterion. The depth compression appears in the original and reversed centre-focus layouts; with the focus on the near panel, the available-panel depth index reaches the registered threshold, and the aperture response stays attenuated in every layout tested. Scalar metrics adapted from published ones give oracle-like scores to synthetic editors whose proportions are compressed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 Blender Cycles 渲染的薄透镜真值场景审计两个通用图像编辑器的光圈虚化响应：Gemini 3.1 Flash Image 与 GPT-image-2.5 的 f/1.4 到 f/2.8 模糊宽度比只有 0.99–1.18 与 0.97–1.05 附近，远低于真值的 1.98–2.13，且没有任何 f-number 措辞通过预注册的 followed 判据。定性措辞能把模糊强度改到 2–10 倍，而指定 2 对 6 px 只改 1.1–1.3 倍，说明编辑器的虚化不随光圈按薄透镜比例变化。
Motivation: 通用图像编辑器被要求把照片改成 f/1.4 观感，但其加入的模糊是否遵循薄透镜光学从未被分开检验；已有评测只查模糊单调性、清晰度趋势相关、等效光圈误差或视觉语言判断，没有在已知深度上分别报告深度分布与光圈响应。
Method: 以 Blender Cycles 渲染的薄透镜景深场景作为 oracle，用同一个模糊宽度估计器同时处理真值与编辑器输出，并采用预注册的深度与光圈指数；在 24 个纹理场景的三面板几何中审计 Gemini 3.1 Flash Image 与 GPT-image-2.5，另做预注册黑箱措辞干预。
Result: 可接受且可测面板的 f/1.4 到 f/2.8 宽度比 σ̄1.4/σ̄2.8 为 0.99–1.18（真值 1.98–2.13）；近远模糊宽度池化中位数比约 1.18–1.25（Gemini）与 0.97–1.05（GPT-image），真值为 1.69–1.82。定性措辞改变模糊强度约 2–10 倍，而 2 对 6 px 的请求只改 1.1–1.3 倍，无任何 f-number 措辞通过 registered followed 判据。深度压缩在原始与反转的中心对焦布局中都出现；焦点在近面板时深度指数达到阈值，但每种布局的光圈响应仍被衰减。适配自已发表指标的标量分数会给比例被压缩的合成编辑器打出 oracle-like 分数。
Conclusion: 两个编辑器的虚化在深度上被压缩、对光圈变化响应衰减，且现有标量指标会把这种压缩误判为接近真值，因此深度与光圈响应必须在已知深度上分开报告。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: 以 Blender Cycles 渲染的薄透镜景深场景作为 oracle，用同一个模糊宽度估计器同时处理真值与编辑器输出，并采用预注册的深度与光圈指数；在 24 个纹理场景的三面板几何中审计 Gemini 3.1 Flash Image 与 GPT-image-2.5，另做预注册黑箱措辞干预。
summary_sections.result: 可接受且可测面板的 f/1.4 到 f/2.8 宽度比 σ̄1.4/σ̄2.8 为 0.99–1.18（真值 1.98–2.13）；近远模糊宽度池化中位数比约 1.18–1.25（Gemini）与 0.97–1.05（GPT-image），真值为 1.69–1.82。定性措辞改变模糊强度约 2–10 倍，而 2 对 6 px 的请求只改 1.1–1.3 倍，无任何 f-number 措辞通过 registered followed 判据。深度压缩在原始与反转的中心对焦布局中都出现；焦点在近面板时深度指数达到阈值，但每种布局的光圈响应仍被衰减。适配自已发表指标的标量分数会给比例被压缩的合成编辑器打出 oracle-like 分数。
summary_sections.conclusion: 两个编辑器的虚化在深度上被压缩、对光圈变化响应衰减，且现有标量指标会把这种压缩误判为接近真值，因此深度与光圈响应必须在已知深度上分开报告。

papers.title: TileSkipper: Region-Adaptive Tile Pruning for 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Tiled 3D Gaussian Splatting rasterizers often use one scene-wide contribution cutoff for tile enumeration, although content differs in its sensitivity to support truncation. TileSkipper selects a static per-Gaussian cutoff policy for a frozen checkpoint. Calibration renders measure candidate pair savings and an isolated-removal distortion proxy that accounts for front transmittance and background color. The method allocates cutoffs across 64 Gaussian groups and accepts policies only after complete renders on disjoint selection views. The exported policy uses one byte per Gaussian, with no parameter updates, additional kernel, or per-frame policy inference. Across 13 scenes from Mip-NeRF 360, Tanks & Temples, and Deep Blending, a fixed-policy AccuTile sweep gives dataset-macro speedups of $1.088\times$ at standard resolution and $1.238\times$ at 3840 pixels wide, with $-0.007/-0.023$ dB mean PSNR change. Six integrations with existing opacity-aware bounds yield $1.009\times$--$1.121\times$ compiler-only speedups. For four ports from $3σ$ rasterizers, we separately attribute the prior exact-bound transition and our incremental gain. Matched-quality ablations show modest gains over scene-global calibration and parity with per-Gaussian control; the standalone comparison with AdaGScale is regime-dependent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TileSkipper 为冻结的 3D Gaussian Splatting 检查点学习静态的逐高斯贡献截断策略，用校准渲染测量候选对节省与考虑前向透射率和背景色的孤立移除失真代理，在 64 个高斯组间分配截断值，且只在完整渲染通过后才接受策略。在 Mip-NeRF 360、Tanks & Temples、Deep Blending 共 13 个场景上，固定策略 AccuTile 扫描给出数据集宏平均加速 1.088×（标准分辨率）与 1.238×（3840 像素宽），PSNR 平均变化 −0.007/−0.023 dB。
Motivation: 分块 3DGS 光栅化器通常用一个全场景统一的贡献截断阈值做 tile 枚举，但不同内容对支持截断的敏感度差异很大，统一阈值在复杂区域过度截断、在平坦区域浪费算力。
Method: 对冻结检查点搜索静态逐高斯截断策略：校准渲染评估候选对的计算节省与孤立移除失真代理（计入前向透射率与背景色），在 64 个高斯组间分配截断值，策略仅在不相交的选择视角上完整渲染通过后接受；导出策略每高斯一字节，无需参数更新、额外 kernel 或逐帧策略推理。
Result: 13 个场景（Mip-NeRF 360、Tanks & Temples、Deep Blending）上固定策略 AccuTile 扫描：数据集宏平均加速 1.088×（标准分辨率）、1.238×（3840 像素宽），PSNR 平均变化 −0.007/−0.023 dB；与六个现有 opacity-aware 界结合得到 1.009×–1.121× 的纯编译器加速；对四个来自 3σ 光栅化器的移植分别归因其原有精确界转换与本文增量收益；匹配质量消融显示相对全场景校准有温和增益、与逐高斯控制相当，与 AdaGScale 的独立对比依场景 regime 而定。
Conclusion: 静态逐高斯截断策略在不更新参数、不加 kernel 的前提下可为 tiled 3DGS 带来小幅但可复现的加速，收益随分辨率提高而增大；相对逐高斯控制只有平价，与 AdaGScale 的优劣取决于场景 regime。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Shared Low-rank Basis Factorization for Data-free Mixture-of-Experts Compression
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language models decouple capacity from compute through sparse routing, but their large parameter count creates storage and serving challenges. We analyze three MoE compression families: expert pruning, expert merging, and weight reconstruction, and derive structural error bounds showing that pruning and merging can incur non-vanishing errors tied to routing and expert heterogeneity. In contrast, weight reconstruction avoids these structural costs by preserving expert structure and routing. Motivated by the analysis, we propose Shared Low-rank Basis Factorization (SLBF), a data-free weight reconstruction method that uses rank-$k$ bases shared among experts, enabling richer cross-expert sharing, faster convergence, and lower reconstruction error. A post-hoc gauge fixing removes redundant parameters at no representational cost. Across five MoE architectures spanning 16B to 122B parameters, SLBF consistently outperforms methods from all three compression families.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 MoE 大模型参数量过大，提出免数据 (data-free) 的权重重构压缩方法 Shared Low-rank Basis Factorization (SLBF)：在专家间共享 rank-k 基底，并用事后 gauge fixing 无表征代价地消去冗余参数。在 16B 到 122B 的五种 MoE 架构上，SLBF 稳定优于剪枝、合并、权重重构三族方法。
Motivation: MoE 靠稀疏路由把容量与算力解耦，但参数量带来存储与服务压力；现有压缩三族中，剪枝与合并会因路由和专家异质性产生不消失的结构性误差。
Method: 先对专家剪枝、专家合并、权重重构三族压缩推导结构性误差界，指出重构可保留专家结构与路由；据此提出 SLBF，用专家间共享的 rank-k 基底做免数据权重重构，并以 post-hoc gauge fixing 去除冗余参数。
Result: 在五种 MoE 架构（参数量 16B 至 122B）上，SLBF 一致优于三族压缩方法；分析给出剪枝与合并存在与路由和专家异质性相关的非消失误差界，而重构避免这类结构代价。
Conclusion: 免数据压缩应走保留专家结构与路由的共享低秩基底重构路线，而非剪枝或合并，因为后两者带结构性误差。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Benign Overfitting under Heterogeneous Input Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Benign overfitting is extensively studied when learning from a single high-dimensional input, but its behavior under heterogeneous input fusion remains largely unexplored. We study this question for minimum-norm linear interpolation under a heterogeneous Gaussian design, comparing two statistically dependent input blocks with their fusion while holding the underlying population task fixed. For regression, we identify a full-spectrum covariance certificate whose asymptotic status is independent of the cutoff threshold and prove that it is preserved by every positive-semidefinite joint covariance consistent with the two marginals. This protection is sharp, yet it does not extend to all benign regression problems: outside the certified regime, two benign marginals can have a harmful fusion. For one-sparse Gaussian classification, benignity in the regular regime is characterized by the balance between surviving predictive signal and nuisance contamination. Fusion can move these two quantities in opposite directions, and within this model class every marginal-to-joint benign/non-benign pattern is attainable. We further show that the same fused input can have qualitatively different effects on regression and classification. These results establish that benign overfitting under heterogeneous fusion is determined by the joint signal and spectral geometry created by input interaction, rather than by marginal benignity alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在异质高斯设计下研究最小范数线性插值的良性过拟合 (benign overfitting)：回归中存在一个与截断阈值无关、且被任意与两边缘一致的半正定联合协方差保持的全谱协方差证书，但证书之外两个良性边缘可融合成有害联合；一稀疏高斯分类中良性由剩余预测信号与 nuisance 污染的平衡决定，且同一融合输入对回归和分类可产生定性不同的效果。
Motivation: 良性过拟合此前只在单一高维输入下研究，异质输入融合（两个统计相关输入块拼接）时的行为未知，而边缘良性并不决定融合后的良性。
Method: 在异质高斯设计下对最小范数线性插值做理论分析：固定总体任务，比较两个统计相关输入块与它们的融合；回归部分给出全谱协方差证书并证明其对任意与两边缘一致的 PSD 联合协方差保持，分类部分在一稀疏高斯模型中刻画良性条件。
Result: 回归证书的渐近状态与截断阈值无关，且被每个与两边缘一致的 PSD 联合协方差保持；该保护是 sharp 的，但证书之外两个良性边缘可产生有害融合。一稀疏高斯分类中良性由剩余预测信号与 nuisance 污染的平衡刻画，融合可使二者反向变化，且该模型类内每种边缘到联合的良性/非良性模式都可实现；同一融合输入对回归与分类可有定性不同的效果。
Conclusion: 异质融合下的良性过拟合由输入交互产生的联合信号与谱几何决定，而非边缘良性本身。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Ask the Expert: LLM-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Cyber Defense
papers.abstract_en: Policy-based reinforcement learning (RL) approaches have produced promising results for autonomous cyber defense; however, they are sample-inefficient in settings where defenders must respond under delayed, partial observations with actions from large action spaces. While large language models (LLMs) may reason semantically about security state space, high latency and trust assumptions prevent attractive in-line deployment models. We introduce Ask the Expert, a training-time guidance framework which first summarizes hard cyber-defense states, then intermittently queries an LLM for host-level defensive recommendations via a constrained action interface, and finally transforms those recommendations into tiered reward shaping for use with PPO. Because the LLM is discarded after training, deployment is a pure RL policy. Across TTCP CAGE CC1 and CC2 and both attacker types, this asymmetric design improves sample efficiency over PPO and outperforms the evaluated potential-based reward shaping (PBRS) baselines, while retaining the strongest terminal mean and requiring no LLM dependency at deployment time.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at IEEE GLOBECOM 2026. Proceedings forthcoming. 6 pages, 4 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Ask the Expert：训练期用 LLM 对困难网络防御状态给出主机级建议，经受约束的动作接口转成分层 reward shaping 喂给 PPO，训练后丢弃 LLM，部署只剩纯 RL 策略。在 TTCP CAGE CC1/CC2 与两类攻击者上，该非对称设计比 PPO 更省样本，并超过所评估的 potential-based reward shaping (PBRS) 基线，同时保住最强的 terminal mean。
Motivation: 基于策略的 RL 做自主网络防御时，在延迟、部分可观测且动作空间很大的场景下样本效率低；LLM 能语义推理安全状态，但高延迟与信任假设使其不适合在线 (in-line) 部署。
Method: 训练期三步：先总结困难的网络防御状态，再间歇性地通过受约束的动作接口 (constrained action interface) 向 LLM 查询主机级防御建议，最后把这些建议转成分层 reward shaping 与 PPO 联合训练；训练结束后 LLM 被丢弃，部署为纯 RL 策略。
Result: 在 TTCP CAGE 的 CC1 与 CC2 场景、两种攻击者类型上，样本效率优于 PPO，并超过所评估的 PBRS 基线，同时保持最强的 terminal mean；部署期无 LLM 依赖。
Conclusion: 把 LLM 限制在训练期做非对称指导，可在不引入部署期延迟与信任假设的前提下提升自主网络防御 RL 的样本效率与终端表现。

papers.title: SearchWorld: Spatial Value-Grounded Imagination for UAV Object Search via World Models
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) object search involves a closed loop of perception, decision-making, and action under partial observability. Urban environments pose several challenges: large search areas and narrow egocentric views limit coverage, dense 3D geometry constrains safe motion, and open-world instructions require identifying a specific target among distractors. Many existing methods mitigate partial observability through explicit maps or memory representations, yet remain largely reactive, reasoning over past observations without explicitly predicting future states. World models enable prospective reasoning through imagined rollouts. However, image-generating world models can incur high inference latency, while spatially grounded planning remains challenging for latent world models. We propose SearchWorld, a recurrent state-space world model that connects explicit spatial memory with value-guided imagination. The model maintains BEV exploration and obstacle memory and decodes a task-aware spatial value layer to guide search. A cognition-action network uses this learned spatial value prior to improve the policy through imagined rollouts, without training a separate scalar critic. Training progresses from world-model learning to expert imitation and imagination-based exploration refinement. On UAV-ON, SearchWorld improves the success rate to 23.8% (19.5% for the strongest published agent) and raises oracle success to 35.5%, while remaining robust on unseen scenes (19.9% success rate). By grounding imagination in explicit spatial representations, SearchWorld enables UAV agents to plan prospectively rather than react.

papers.title: VM-ARRAYDPS: Virtual Microphone Augmented Diffusion Posterior Sampling for Unsupervised Blind Speech Separation
papers.abstract_en: Blind Source Separation(BSS) is a fundamental problem in signal processing, aiming to separate multiple source signals from their mixtures without prior knowledge of the sources or the mixing process. Traditional approaches, such as Independent Vector Analysis (IVA) exploits statistical independence of sources. Recently, diffusion-based approaches have emerged as a promising alternative by leveraging powerful generative priors. Among them, ArrayDPS formulates BSS problem as a posterior sampling problem, and utilizes a pretrained speech diffusion model to guide the recovery of clean source signals. A key factor behind its separation capability is the multi-channel consistency (MC) objective, which enforces the estimated source signals to reconstruct the observed microphone mixtures through the estimated acoustic transfer functions. However, the number of microphones in the array is often limited, which constrains the performance of ArrayDPS. To address this issue, we propose VM-ArrayDPS, a novel method that augments the microphone array with virtual microphones with higher-SNR, these microphones can offer extra MC constraints to enhance the separation performance. Experimental results demonstrate that VM-ArrayDPS significantly outperforms ArrayDPS on both 2-speaker and 3-speaker datasets, showcasing the effectiveness of virtual microphone augmentation in improving BSS performance. We also did ablation studies to show the influence of the number of virtual microphones and weight of the MC objective brought by virtual microphones.
papers.comment: Submitted to ICASSP 2027 and currently under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VM-ArrayDPS 用高信噪比的虚拟麦克风扩充阵列，为扩散后验采样 (diffusion posterior sampling) 的多通道一致性 (MC) 目标提供额外约束，从而缓解真实麦克风数量受限对盲源分离的瓶颈。在 2 说话人与 3 说话人数据集上，VM-ArrayDPS 显著优于 ArrayDPS；消融实验考察了虚拟麦克风数量与 MC 目标权重的影响。
Motivation: ArrayDPS 依赖多通道一致性约束恢复干净源信号，但阵列麦克风数量往往有限，直接限制了分离性能上限。
Method: 在 ArrayDPS 框架上加入更高 SNR 的虚拟麦克风，用预训练语音扩散模型作为生成先验，把盲源分离表述为后验采样问题；虚拟麦克风提供额外的 MC 约束（估计源信号经估计声学传递函数重构观测到的麦克风混合信号），并做关于虚拟麦克风数量与 MC 权重的消融研究。
Result: 在 2 说话人与 3 说话人数据集上，VM-ArrayDPS 显著优于 ArrayDPS；消融实验显示虚拟麦克风数量与虚拟麦克风带来的 MC 目标权重均影响分离表现。
Conclusion: 虚拟麦克风扩充能有效提升基于扩散后验采样的盲源分离性能，其收益来自额外的多通道一致性约束而非更多真实传感器。
