papers.title: CRT-HMAR: Causal Requirement Tracing-Guided Hierarchical Multi-Agent Regulation for Open-Task-Aware Infrared-Visible Image Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Infrared and visible (IR-VIS) image fusion integrates complementary multimodal information into a single fused image to support downstream vision tasks. However, existing methods are typically tailored to seen tasks within a fixed task set and struggle to generalize to unseen tasks, which restricts their applicability in real-world open-task scenarios. To address this issue, this paper proposes CRT-HMAR, a Causal Requirement Tracing-Guided Hierarchical Multi-Agent Regulation Framework for open-task-aware IR-VIS image fusion. CRT-HMAR introduces a Causal Requirement Tracing Task Localization mechanism, which actively intervenes in key image information and observes task-network response variations to map task-specific semantic preferences into image-level causal requirement maps. Based on these maps, a requirement analysis agent aggregates task-specific requirement knowledge to adaptively guide requirement-customized image fusion. Moreover, CRT-HMAR incorporates History-Analysis Multi-Objective Balancing and Task-Level-Correction Conflict Mitigation mechanisms, jointly constructing a hierarchical regulation chain of "requirement interpretation - task balancing - conflict mitigation". Through multiple collaborative agents, CRT-HMAR dynamically regulates key processes including open-task requirement modeling, multi-task balanced optimization, and gradient conflict mitigation. Extensive experiments on open-task scenarios involving five downstream tasks demonstrate that CRT-HMAR significantly improves generalization to unseen tasks while maintaining the performance and balance of seen tasks. Overall, CRT-HMAR shifts IR-VIS image fusion from task-oriented modeling toward requirement-oriented modeling, promoting its extension from closed-task settings to real-world open-task scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CRT-HMAR 把红外-可见光 (IR-VIS) 图像融合从固定任务集的 task-oriented 建模改为 requirement-oriented：用因果需求追踪 (Causal Requirement Tracing) 主动干预关键图像信息并观察任务网络响应，生成图像级因果需求图，再由需求分析 agent 定制融合，配合历史分析多目标平衡与任务级冲突消解构成层级调节链。在涉及五个下游任务的 open-task 场景实验中，模型对未见任务的泛化显著提升，同时保持已见任务的性能与平衡。
Motivation: 现有 IR-VIS 融合方法针对固定任务集内的已见任务设计，遇到未见任务时泛化差，限制了真实开放任务场景的可用性。
Method: CRT-HMAR 含三个部件：Causal Requirement Tracing Task Localization 通过干预关键图像信息并观测任务网络响应变化，把任务语义偏好映射为图像级因果需求图；requirement analysis agent 聚合任务级需求知识以引导定制化融合；History-Analysis Multi-Objective Balancing 与 Task-Level-Correction Conflict Mitigation 组成“需求解释—任务平衡—冲突消解”的层级调节链，分别处理多任务平衡优化与梯度冲突。
Result: 在涉及五个下游任务的 open-task 场景实验中，CRT-HMAR 显著提升对未见任务的泛化，同时保持已见任务的性能与平衡。
Conclusion: IR-VIS 融合应从 task-oriented 建模转向 requirement-oriented 建模，才能从封闭任务设定扩展到真实开放任务场景。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: GRC-Net: Global Representation Consistency Network for Unsupervised Multimodal Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Automated quality inspection is essential for ensuring product reliability in manufacturing.While image-based methods effectively capture appearance-related defects, these methods are limited in detecting structural and geometric anomalies, motivating multimodal approaches incorporating 3D information. However, existing methods mainly rely on local patch-level representations, which often lead to unstable reconstruction errors even in normal regions. To address this limitation, we propose GRC-Net, which integrates a global-attention MLP to enforce global representation consistency across patch embeddings with a stable reconstruction module to improve reconstruction stability. The proposed method captures holistic contextual information through a global token and suppresses reconstruction noise by minimizing discrepancies between original and predicted embeddings. Experiments on MVTec 3D-AD and Eyecandies demonstrate that GRC-Net consistently outperforms existing methods at both image and pixel levels. Qualitative results further demonstrate reduced reconstruction errors in normal regions and more distinct reconstruction differences between normal and anomalous regions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GRC-Net 用全局注意力 MLP 与全局 token 约束各 patch 嵌入的表示一致性，配合稳定重建模块压低正常区域的重建噪声，从而在多模态异常检测中把正常与异常区域的重建差异拉开。在 MVTec 3D-AD 与 Eyecandies 上，图像级与像素级均一致优于现有方法。
Motivation: 制造质检中纯图像方法抓不住结构与几何缺陷，而现有 3D 多模态方法依赖局部 patch 表示，正常区域的重建误差也不稳定，导致误报。
Method: GRC-Net 由全局注意力 MLP（global-attention MLP）与稳定重建模块组成：以全局 token 汇总上下文、强制各 patch 嵌入的全局表示一致，并通过最小化原始与预测嵌入之差抑制重建噪声，做无监督多模态异常检测。
Result: 在 MVTec 3D-AD 与 Eyecandies 两个基准上，图像级与像素级指标均一致超过现有方法；定性结果显示正常区域重建误差降低、正常与异常区域的重建差异更明显。
Conclusion: 把全局表示一致性引入 patch 级重建，可稳定正常区域的重建误差，从而提升无监督多模态异常检测的判别力。

papers.title: Visual Jev Rewards: Reference-Bound Verification for Multi-Subject Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-subject image generation requires rewards that verify whether requested attributes, actions, and relations hold for the specified reference subjects. Subject presence alone does not establish that the correct subjects participate in a requested interaction. We present reference-bound Visual Jev rewards that turn these visual decisions into generator training signals. Each subject-related question receives a positive label only when the requested condition and the relevant reference identities hold jointly. We construct fixed questions offline, train a Qwen3.5-4B verifier with binary supervision, and directly read Yes probabilities from its language-model head. Their mean supplies a GRPO reward while retaining individual judgments for inspection. Using 200 MICo-150K training tasks and 30 updates, the framework raises a GPT-5.4 composite score from 41.78 to 52.50 on a manually selected 897-task MICo-Bench subset; direct 27B rewards yield 51.84. Each reward is tested in one GRPO run, and offline human evaluation does not establish a statistically significant advantage over direct scoring. The study provides an initial implementation and evaluation of Visual Jev as a reference-bound reward for multi-subject image generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 reference-bound 的 Visual Jev 奖励：为多主体图像生成构造离线固定问题，用二元监督训练 Qwen3.5-4B 验证器，从语言模型头直接读取 Yes 概率并取均值作为 GRPO 奖励。在 MICo-150K 的 200 个训练任务、30 次更新后，GPT-5.4 复合分在人工挑选的 897 任务 MICo-Bench 子集上从 41.78 升到 52.50，超过直接用 27B 模型打分的 51.84。
Motivation: 多主体图像生成需要奖励来判定请求的属性、动作与关系是否真的落在指定参考主体上，但仅判断主体是否出现无法确认是正确的主体参与了请求的交互。
Method: 离线构造固定问题，每个主体相关问题仅在请求条件与相关参考身份同时成立时给正标签；用二元监督训练 Qwen3.5-4B 验证器，直接从其语言模型头读取 Yes 概率，均值作为 GRPO 奖励，同时保留单条判断供检查。
Result: 用 200 个 MICo-150K 训练任务、30 次更新，GPT-5.4 复合分在人工挑选的 897 任务 MICo-Bench 子集上从 41.78 提升到 52.50；直接 27B 奖励为 51.84。每个奖励只在一次 GRPO 运行中测试，离线人工评估未确立相对直接打分的统计显著优势。
Conclusion: Visual Jev 作为多主体图像生成的 reference-bound 奖励给出了初步实现与评估，复合分高于直接 27B 打分，但单次运行加离线人工评估不足以确立显著优势。

papers.title: VIS-Ground: Video Interactive Storytelling with Contextual Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Video interactive storytelling enables viewers to actively steer how a video unfolds. However, once we allow viewers to intervene during generation, a new challenge arises: The viewer's request can have latent dependencies on both the grounding source and the current rendered video state. These dependencies may not be explicitly stated in any individual input, but emerge only when the source, rendered history, and new viewer intent are considered jointly. Existing interactive video generation systems primarily emphasize following viewer instructions, while source-grounded video generation methods focus on aligning generated content with an external narrative or knowledge source. This leaves a fundamental question underexplored: What context should a generation model ground on during interactive continuation, and how can heterogeneous, unstructured inputs be transformed into such grounding context? In this work, we formulate contextual grounding as the process of transforming heterogeneous input context into an executable constraint model for video generation. To address this challenge, we introduce VIS-Ground, which performs Structured Context Abstraction to recover grounded states and cross-context dependencies, Generation Constraints Induction to project relevant dependencies into candidate-specific constraints, and Constrained Video Generation to enforce these constraints through planning, verification, revision, and rendering. Across three video generation backbones, VIS-Ground consistently achieves the highest overall composite score, reaching an average absolute improvement of 10.3 points over the strongest per-backbone baselines. Detailed analysis further shows gains across both narrative and knowledge grounding, and reveals remaining challenges in dependency extraction, and faithful realization during video rendering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VIS-Ground 把交互式视频续写中的上下文接地形式化为「将异构输入转成可执行生成约束模型」，用 Structured Context Abstraction 恢复接地状态与跨上下文依赖，再经 Generation Constraints Induction 与含规划-验证-修订-渲染的 Constrained Video Generation 强制执行。在三个视频生成 backbone 上均取得最高综合分，较各 backbone 最强基线平均绝对提升 10.3 分。
Motivation: 交互式视频生成中观众指令的隐含依赖同时取决于接地源与当前已渲染视频状态，单看任一输入都显不出来；现有系统要么只跟随观众指令，要么只对齐外部叙事/知识源，续写时该以什么为接地上下文这一问题未被研究。

Conclusion: 把异构上下文显式转成约束模型再在生成中强制执行，能在交互续写中同时改善叙事与知识接地；依赖抽取和渲染阶段的忠实实现仍是未解决问题。

papers.title: Constrained Diffusion for Data-Scarce Orbital Monte Carlo in Constellation Tasking
papers.abstract_en: Constellation Monte Carlo results depend on the orbital population used to evaluate a tasking policy. With scarce reference trajectories, replay limits geometric diversity, while independent orbital-element jitter can violate physical constraints. We study constrained diffusion for orbital-population augmentation. A force-conditioned diffusion model learns a 13-dimensional orbital prior, recovering semimajor axis from perigee altitude and eccentricity; Basilisk propagates each sample under one of five force-model tiers. Using 800 reference trajectories, we compare diffusion with jittered bootstrap, per-tier Gaussian mixtures, and a conditional variational autoencoder, and evaluate distributional fidelity, support shift, classical astrodynamics diagnostics, and 4,000 paired GoDSAT-compatible campaigns. The largest diffusion model achieves held-out trajectory MMD of 0.0171 +/- 0.0239, similar to bootstrap (0.0170) and the mixture (0.0198), but samples farther from training priors (median nearest-training distance 2.7 versus 0.10 standardized units). All generators fail to match the shifted-blind population (classifier AUC 0.991-0.998). Endpoint-conditioned samples satisfy Lambert boundaries but have greater interior error than the matched Lambert reference (29.2 versus 5.7 km mean RMSE). Residual diffusion improves selected sparse forecasts and catalog-mode recall but does not outperform classical estimators on custody ranking. In a fixed 16-satellite configuration, diffusion yields similar mean custody to replay and bootstrap, while the force-tier mixture shifts custody by about 5.5 percentage points. Constrained diffusion supports local, in-support augmentation but cannot replace orbital dynamics or serve as an operational posterior. Orbital-population construction is a consequential source of uncertainty in constellation analysis.
papers.comment: 16 pages. Submitted to the 2027 IEEE Aerospace Conference; under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 星座任务编排的蒙特卡洛结果依赖所用轨道种群，参考轨迹稀缺时 replay 多样性不足、独立轨道根数抖动又会破坏物理约束。力条件扩散 (force-conditioned diffusion) 学习 13 维轨道先验并由 Basilisk 按五档力模型传播：800 条参考轨迹下 MMD 0.0171±0.0239 与 jittered bootstrap 0.0170、分层高斯混合 0.0198 相当，但离训练先验更远（最近训练样本中位距离 2.7 对 0.10 标准化单位），且所有生成器都无法匹配 shifted-blind 种群（分类器 AUC 0.991–0.998）。结论是受约束扩散只支持局部、in-support 的种群增广，不能替代轨道动力学或充当业务化后验。
Motivation: 参考轨迹稀缺时星座蒙特卡洛的 replay 无法覆盖几何多样性，而对轨道根数独立加抖动会违反物理约束，导致任务编排策略评估被种群构建这一不确定性源左右。
Method: 训练力条件扩散模型学习 13 维轨道先验（由近地点高度与偏心率恢复半长轴），每个样本用 Basilisk 在五档力模型之一下传播；以 800 条参考轨迹对比 jittered bootstrap、分层高斯混合与条件 VAE，评估分布保真度、support shift、经典天体力学诊断，并做 4,000 次配对 GoDSAT-compatible 任务编排仿真；另含端点条件采样（Lambert 边界）与残差扩散 (residual diffusion) 的稀疏预报/目录模式召回。
Result: 最大扩散模型 held-out 轨迹 MMD 0.0171±0.0239，bootstrap 0.0170、混合模型 0.0198；扩散最近训练样本中位距离 2.7 对 bootstrap 0.10 标准化单位。所有生成器均无法匹配 shifted-blind 种群，分类器 AUC 0.991–0.998。端点条件样本满足 Lambert 边界但内部误差大于匹配 Lambert 参考（平均 RMSE 29.2 对 5.7 km）。残差扩散改善部分稀疏预报与目录模式召回，但 custody ranking 上不优于经典估计器。固定 16 星构型下扩散的平均 custody 与 replay、bootstrap 相当，而力档混合使 custody 偏移约 5.5 个百分点。
Conclusion: 受约束扩散可用于局部、in-support 的轨道种群增广，但不能替代轨道动力学，也不能充当业务化后验；轨道种群构建本身是星座分析中一个实质性的不确定性源。

papers.title: SAREO-FM: Decoupled Semantic Supervision for SAR-EO Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) and electro-optical (EO) imagery provide complementary observations: SAR enables day-and-night, weather-resilient sensing, whereas EO provides rich appearance and fine-grained semantic cues. We introduce SAREO-FM, which avoids forcing a single token stream to serve two distinct roles: modality tokens preserve how each sensor observes the scene through masked reconstruction, while learnable semantic queries capture what the scene contains under guidance from a pretrained vision foundation model (VFM). By jointly encoding these queries with SAR and EO tokens, the queries acquire modality-grounded semantic context, while the modality-token outputs remain the explicit targets of masked reconstruction. This design assigns semantic and reconstruction supervision to separate token streams while preserving their interaction within the shared encoder. Pretrained on the million-scale SAR-1M corpus, SAREO-FM achieves strong unimodal transfer for both SAR-only and EO-only inputs, while delivering substantial gains from joint SAR--EO observations on tasks that benefit from complementary sensing.
papers.comment: Please visit our project page at https://kaist-viclab.github.io/SAREO-FM_site/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAREO-FM 把 SAR 与 EO 基础模型中的语义监督和重建监督解耦到两条 token 流：模态 token 用掩码重建保留传感器成像方式，可学习语义 query 在预训练视觉基础模型 (VFM) 引导下刻画场景内容，二者在同一编码器内交互。在百万级 SAR-1M 语料上预训练后，SAR-only 与 EO-only 输入均取得强单模态迁移，联合 SAR-EO 观测在受益于互补感知的任务上带来显著提升。
Motivation: SAR 与 EO 观测互补，但让单一 token 流同时承担模态保真重建与语义理解两种角色会互相牵制，削弱基础模型的迁移能力。
Method: 解耦双流设计：模态 token 以掩码重建为显式目标，可学习语义 query 由预训练 VFM 提供语义监督，二者共同编码并与 SAR/EO token 联合交互；在百万级 SAR-1M 语料上预训练。
Result: 在 SAR-1M 上预训练后，SAR-only 与 EO-only 输入均实现强单模态迁移；在受益于互补感知的任务上，联合 SAR-EO 观测取得 substantial gains（摘要未给出具体指标数值）。
Conclusion: 把语义监督与重建监督分派到不同 token 流并保留其交互，是 SAR-EO 基础模型兼顾单模态迁移与联合观测增益的有效设计。

papers.title: Why VLMs Miss Small Objects, and When Zooming In Is Safe
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) often miss small objects in large images. We ask three questions: what limits them, which of these limits better models can remove, and whether the classical way of handling large images, local decomposition, still has a future. We answer them with a theory built on two quantities of the image interface: S, the number of visual tokens across an object's side, and L, the content a call must cover. The limits: a W x H image sent whole within N tokens gives an object of side m at most m*sqrt(N/(WH)) tokens per side. Doubling the token budget N therefore raises the largest S a whole image can reach by only 41%, and seeing an image at the S an object needs costs at least order S^2 tokens whatever the model. If recognition improves gradually with S, any search strategy, zoom agents included, obeys a recall-cost frontier. What better models can change: the S an object needs and how much one call can carry, measured in bits per object found; the coverage cost remains. Decomposition: yes. Assuming only that more tokens per object and less content per call do not hurt on average, splitting an image cannot lower recall if no view zooms out relative to the whole image and views overlap by one object. Neither part of this condition can be dropped; we bound the cost of every such decomposition, and a simple rule approaches the bound as the image grows. We test the theory in about 177,000 requests on 797 images. On controlled images, none of 40 orderings predicted for 8 VLMs is violated. Checked after the fact on drawings, floor plans, natural and synthetic images, 61 of 89 implied orderings hold significantly and 4 fail, all for OpenAI models given more pixels than their default path. On construction drawings the rule never significantly lowered recall relative to the whole image and raised it by up to 0.28. Code and data: https://github.com/shijunzhe/vlm-small-objects
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文用两个量——物体每边视觉 token 数 S 与单次调用需覆盖的内容 L——给出 VLM 在大图中漏检小物体的理论上界：整图在 N token 内发送时，边长 m 的物体每边至多 m*sqrt(N/(WH)) 个 token，把 token 预算翻倍只能让整图可达的最大 S 提高 41%，而按物体所需 S 观看的代价至少是 S^2 量级。由此推出任何搜索策略（含 zoom agent）都受召回-代价前沿约束；在“更多 token、每调用更少内容不伤害平均表现”的假设下，只要没有任何视图相对整图缩小、且视图按一个物体重叠，切分图像不可能降低召回。约 177,000 次请求、797 张图上受控图 8 个 VLM 的 40 条预测排序无一违反，事后检验 89 条隐含排序中 61 条显著成立、4 条失败（均为 OpenAI 模型拿到超过默认路径的像素），施工图上该规则相对整图召回最高提升 0.28。
Motivation: VLM 在大图中系统性漏检小物体，而整图发送受 token 预算硬约束、局部切分 (local decomposition) 是否仍有效缺乏理论判据。
Method: 以图像接口的两个量 S（物体每边视觉 token 数）和 L（单次调用覆盖内容）建理论：导出整图 token 上界 m*sqrt(N/(WH))、S^2 量级观看代价与召回-代价前沿；给出切分不降召回的充分条件（无视图相对整图 zoom out、视图按一个物体重叠）并界定每种分解的代价，附一条随图像增大逼近界的简单规则；用约 177,000 次请求、797 张图在 8 个 VLM 上检验预测排序。
Result: 整图 token 预算翻倍仅使可达最大 S 提高 41%；按物体所需 S 观看代价至少为 S^2 量级。受控图上 8 个 VLM 的 40 条预测排序无一违反；事后在 drawings、floor plans、自然与合成图上检验 89 条隐含排序，61 条显著成立、4 条失败，全部为 OpenAI 模型获得超过其默认路径的像素。施工图上该规则相对整图召回从未显著下降，最高提升 0.28。
Conclusion: 小物体漏检的覆盖代价是接口固有的、更好的模型只能改善每物体所需 S 与单次调用承载量；在给定条件下局部切分仍是安全且有界的召回手段。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Denoising Blocks, Not Tokens: Efficient Compressed Continuous Diffusion with Branching Token Realization
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion language models (DLMs) generate text through iterative parallel refinement, offering the potential for higher throughput than autoregressive (AR) decoding. However, most DLMs still maintain one generative state per token, so every denoising step processes a state sequence as long as the output sequence, limiting the throughput gains from parallel generation. Continuous DLMs provide an additional degree of freedom: a single continuous state can represent multiple tokens, allowing diffusion to operate on a much shorter latent sequence. We introduce \emph{Branching Latent Diffusion (BLD)}, which exploits this flexibility by compressing a 1024-token sequence into only 64 block latents, a $16\times$ reduction. BLD combines latent compression with \emph{branching token realization}, where each latent is decoded by a local AR branch and all branches run in parallel. Because strong compression makes joint latent generation difficult, BLD generates the latents in groups, conditioning each group on previously generated latents. In end-to-end evaluation on the same GPU, BLD reduces generation FLOPs by more than $80\times$ and increases throughput by more than $6\times$ relative to the similarly sized ELF-L baseline. Compared with the AR baseline, BLD achieves more than $6\times$ higher throughput and more than $4\times$ lower latency. Despite the compression, BLD maintains competitive local fluency and diversity, although long-range coherence remains challenging. Overall, BLD shows that moving diffusion from token-level states to compressed latent sequences can substantially improve the efficiency of long-sequence generation.

papers.title: The Geometry of Anisotropic Dilation for Optimal Regularization
papers.abstract_en: A central question in data-driven inverse problems is how to construct a regularizer that adapts to the geometry of the data distribution. Recent work in optimal regularization shows that, within a broad Gibbs class, the regularizer best matched to a distribution $P$ is determined by a single, direction-dependent radial summary statistic $ρ_P$. This suggests a way to control regularizer geometry by transforming the data. In particular, which transformations act on $ρ_P$ in a simple, explicit way? Can they improve the optimization properties of the resulting variational problems or adapt a fixed base regularizer to data? To address these questions, we introduce anisotropic dilation, a direction-preserving map that rescales each point along its Euclidean ray by a positive profile on the sphere. Despite its simplicity, this family acts transitively on the space of radial summary statistics: any target regularizer in the Gibbs class can be reached from any source distribution by a single explicit profile. We characterize the resulting orbit structure on distributions, derive in closed form the profile that optimally adapts a fixed base regularizer to the data, and show that its improvement over isotropic rescaling is governed by a Jensen gap that is provably positive for several natural families. We also establish finite-sample generalization bounds for jointly learning the base regularizer and anisotropic profile, with explicit rates when the logarithm of the profile is parameterized by linear feature models or sparse ReLU networks. Building on this theory, we parameterize the base regularizer and anisotropic profile and learn them jointly from samples, yielding a data-adaptive regularizer for variational inverse problems. Experiments on a controlled two-dimensional family and MNIST denoising show that learning the profile further improves performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Gibbs 正则器类中引入各向异性膨胀 (anisotropic dilation)：沿欧氏射线按球面上的正 profile 重标数据、保持方向，该变换族对径向汇总统计量 ρ_P 传递作用，可用一个显式 profile 从任意源分布到达任意目标正则器。闭式给出最优适配 profile，其相对各向同性缩放的改进由一个可证为正的 Jensen gap 控制，并给出联合学习的有限样本泛化界；MNIST 去噪实验显示学习 profile 进一步提升性能。
Motivation: 数据驱动逆问题中正则器需适配数据分布几何，而已知 Gibbs 类中最优正则器由方向依赖的径向统计量 ρ_P 决定，缺少能显式、简单地操控 ρ_P 从而改进变分问题优化性质的变换工具。
Method: 定义各向异性膨胀（沿欧氏射线按球上正 profile 重标、保方向），证明其在 ρ_P 空间上传递；闭式推导适配固定基正则器的最优 profile，用 Jensen gap 刻画其相对各向同性缩放的改进；对 profile 的对数取线性特征模型或稀疏 ReLU 网络参数化，建立联合学习基正则器与 profile 的有限样本泛化界，并据此从样本联合学习得到数据自适应正则器。
Result: 各向异性膨胀族对 Gibbs 类径向统计量传递，单个显式 profile 可达任意目标正则器；相对各向同性缩放的改进由 Jensen gap 度量且对若干自然分布族可证为正；给出线性特征模型与稀疏 ReLU 参数化下的显式泛化速率；在受控二维分布族与 MNIST 去噪实验中，学习 profile 进一步改善性能。
Conclusion: 用保方向的各向异性膨胀作为控制正则器几何的统一机制：可闭式适配数据、严格优于各向同性缩放，并能与基正则器一起从样本联合学习。

papers.title: MovieSTAGE: Scene, Transition, and Global Encoding for Movie-fMRI ADHD Classification
papers.abstract_en: Naturalistic movie-fMRI provides a shared, temporally structured probe of brain dynamics, yet predictive models commonly rely on whole-run functional connectivity (FC) or temporally generic representations that are not aligned with narrative events. We introduce MovieSTAGE (Scene, Transition, and Global Encoding), a multiscale framework that combines hypergraph-structured FC-profile organization within scenes, unsigned FC-profile differences across adjacent scenes, and whole-movie FC. We evaluated 260 participants from the CMI-HBN Despicable Me cohort on case-control, ADHD-subtype, and three-class classification using 10 repetitions of stratified five-fold cross-validation, complete out-of-fold (OOF) predictions, and paired subject-cluster bootstrap and permutation tests. MovieSTAGE achieved AUROCs of 0.69, 0.73, and 0.75 and balanced accuracies of 67.6%, 69.8%, and 58.3%, respectively, yielding the highest mean point estimates among the evaluated methods. On the three-class task, the full model outperformed all two-branch variants, the HGNN scene encoder outperformed MLP, GAT, and BNT alternatives under matched settings, and the human-annotated partition outperformed duration-matched random and fixed-count GSBS controls. These controlled results support incremental predictive value from event-aligned scene and transition representations when combined with whole-movie FC in this cohort. Post-hoc model-derived analyses generated network-level hypotheses involving frontoparietal and default-mode systems.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Bioinformatics and Biomedicine (BIBM 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MovieSTAGE 把自然观影 fMRI 的功能连接按时序事件切成场景内超图编码、相邻场景差分与全片 FC 三支融合，用于 ADHD 分类。在 CMI-HBN Despicable Me 260 人上，病例-对照、亚型、三分类 AUROC 分别为 0.69、0.73、0.75，事件对齐的场景与过渡表示在全片 FC 之上提供增量预测价值。
Motivation: 现有 movie-fMRI 预测模型依赖整段 run 的功能连接或与叙事事件不对齐的时序通用表征，丢掉了与情节结构对应的脑动态信息。
Method: MovieSTAGE 为多尺度框架：场景内用超图结构组织 FC-profile，相邻场景间取无符号 FC-profile 差分，再加全片 FC；在 CMI-HBN Despicable Me 队列 260 名被试上做病例-对照、ADHD 亚型与三分类，采用 10 次分层五折交叉验证、完整 out-of-fold 预测，以及被试聚类配对 bootstrap 与置换检验。
Result: 三项任务 AUROC 分别为 0.69、0.73、0.75，balanced accuracy 分别为 67.6%、69.8%、58.3%，在所评估方法中平均点估计最高。三分类上完整模型优于全部两分支变体；HGNN 场景编码器在匹配设置下优于 MLP、GAT、BNT；人工标注划分优于时长匹配随机与固定数目 GSBS 对照。
Conclusion: 在该队列中，事件对齐的场景与过渡表示与全片 FC 结合具有增量预测价值；事后模型分析给出涉及额顶网络与默认网络的网络级假设。

papers.title: Kuration SDK: Addressing the Virtual2Real Gap via Data Curation
papers.abstract_en: Benchmarks for measuring the quality of action-conditioned world models are still evolving and shifting away from visual similarity-based metrics to action-semantic and physically-grounded metrics. However, for domain and task-agnostic action-conditioned world model training, existing benchmarks provide a limited signal. By training and evaluating diffusion world models on CounterStrike gameplay data, we confirm that qualitative playability does not correspond with metrics such as FVD, LPIPS, and JEDi. We term this the Virtual2Real gap. We posit that, in lieu of reliable benchmarks, curating raw gameplay data and measuring a variety of diagnostic properties provides a more robust signal to bridge the gap, before the training even begins. We present several curation strategies and a general-purpose kit for physical AI data curation called Kuration SDK, which is being open-sourced with this paper. The SDK was instrumental in uncovering the root cause of the virtual2real gap in a specific case: why two world models trained on identical gameplay map, action and state distribution, behaved very differently when played in spite of having very similar LPIPS and FVD scores. Thus, Kuration SDK has the potential to uncover the root causes of Virtual2Real gap in specific datasets and accelerate development of sample-efficient training datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Kuration SDK 是面向物理 AI 动作条件世界模型 (action-conditioned world model) 的数据筛选工具包，主张在训练开始前用原始游戏数据的多种诊断属性替代失灵的评测指标。在 CounterStrike 玩法数据上训练与评测扩散世界模型后确认：可玩性与 FVD、LPIPS、JEDi 不对应，即所谓 Virtual2Real gap；该 SDK 定位为在具体数据集上找出这一 gap 的根因。
Motivation: 动作条件世界模型的评测正从视觉相似度转向动作语义与物理一致性指标，但面向领域与任务无关的训练，现有 benchmark 给出的信号有限，无法可靠指导样本高效的数据集构建。
Method: 在 CounterStrike 玩法数据上训练并评测扩散世界模型，对比定性可玩性与 FVD、LPIPS、JEDi 等指标；提出若干数据筛选 (curation) 策略，并打包为通用物理 AI 数据筛选工具包 Kuration SDK，随论文开源。
Result: 确认定性可玩性与 FVD、LPIPS、JEDi 指标不一致；用该 SDK 定位一个具体案例的根因：两个世界模型在完全相同的地图、动作与状态分布上训练，LPIPS 与 FVD 分数非常接近，实机游玩行为却差异很大。
Conclusion: 在可靠 benchmark 缺位时，对原始数据做多属性筛选与诊断比事后看指标更能解释 Virtual2Real gap 的根因，并有助于加速构建样本高效训练集。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: emg2face: Expressive Facial Animation with High-Density Surface EMG
papers.abstract_en: Facial movements convey subtle and important information that is critical for human social communication. Optical methods for face capture are difficult or impossible to use when the face is occluded by head-mounted devices (HMDs), such as VR headsets. Even with a clear line of sight, such methods raise privacy concerns and require head-mounted capture rigs that offset cameras and lighting from the face. We show that high-density surface electromyography (HD-sEMG) provides a viable non-optical alternative that addresses these challenges. We measured 64 EMG channels, using two textile EMG grids, with 32 from the forehead (typically occluded by an HMD) and 32 from the side of the face. EMG data were digitized at 2048 Hz and filtered. Facial movements were simultaneously recorded and used to estimate 478 3D facial landmarks using MediaPipe's Face Landmarker. A major challenge in such multimodal recordings is synchronizing EMG and video data, which have different sampling frequencies and independent clocks. We developed a novel synchronization method using analog audio bursts that is capable of sub-millisecond synchronization. We also developed a staged fitting method that fits a recent high-resolution parametric head model (GNM), with 253 identity blendshapes and 383 expression blendshapes, to the MediaPipe landmarks as participants performed different facial expressions. We trained a deep neural network comprising per-grid spatial encoders followed by a dilated temporal convolutional network (TCN) to predict blendshape parameters from HD-sEMG signals at 100 Hz. Once trained, the network can predict expression blendshapes solely from HD-sEMG recordings. The output can be rendered using standard real-time blendshape animation methods. We demonstrate the methods using recordings from 25 participants, and direct expression transfer to a variety of human faces and non-human characters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: emg2face 用高密度表面肌电 (HD-sEMG) 替代光学面部捕捉：64 通道（前额 32 + 侧脸 32）、2048 Hz 采样，经空间编码器加膨胀时序卷积网络 (dilated TCN) 以 100 Hz 直接从肌电预测表情 blendshape，遮挡（如戴 VR 头显）时仍可驱动实时动画。
Motivation: 头显等 HMD 遮挡面部时光学捕捉失效，且光学方案涉及隐私问题并需外挂相机与灯光的头戴采集装置。
Method: 两块织物电极栅共 64 通道采集 HD-sEMG，2048 Hz 数字化并滤波；用模拟音频脉冲 (analog audio bursts) 实现亚毫秒级 EMG-视频同步；以 MediaPipe Face Landmarker 估计 478 个 3D 关键点，再用分阶段拟合把高分辨率参数化头模 GNM（253 个身份 blendshape、383 个表情 blendshape）拟合到关键点作为标签；网络为每栅格一个空间编码器加膨胀 TCN，以 100 Hz 预测 blendshape 参数。
Result: 在 25 名参与者记录上演示，训练后可仅凭 HD-sEMG 预测表情 blendshape，并把表情直接迁移到多种人脸与非人角色；同步方法达到亚毫秒精度；采样 2048 Hz、输出 100 Hz，关键点 478 个，GNM 含 253 身份与 383 表情 blendshape。
Conclusion: HD-sEMG 可作为遮挡条件下的非光学面部捕捉通道，配合同步与参数化头模拟合即可输出可直接用于标准实时 blendshape 动画的信号。

summary_sections.method: 两块织物电极栅共 64 通道采集 HD-sEMG，2048 Hz 数字化并滤波；用模拟音频脉冲 (analog audio bursts) 实现亚毫秒级 EMG-视频同步；以 MediaPipe Face Landmarker 估计 478 个 3D 关键点，再用分阶段拟合把高分辨率参数化头模 GNM（253 个身份 blendshape、383 个表情 blendshape）拟合到关键点作为标签；网络为每栅格一个空间编码器加膨胀 TCN，以 100 Hz 预测 blendshape 参数。
summary_sections.result: 在 25 名参与者记录上演示，训练后可仅凭 HD-sEMG 预测表情 blendshape，并把表情直接迁移到多种人脸与非人角色；同步方法达到亚毫秒精度；采样 2048 Hz、输出 100 Hz，关键点 478 个，GNM 含 253 身份与 383 表情 blendshape。
summary_sections.conclusion: HD-sEMG 可作为遮挡条件下的非光学面部捕捉通道，配合同步与参数化头模拟合即可输出可直接用于标准实时 blendshape 动画的信号。

papers.title: Node-level Graph Neural Architecture Search Framework
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and architecture search frameworks have gained extensive application in non-Euclidean data processing, attributable to their superior capacity in managing unstructured data. Nevertheless, traditional approaches typically apply uniform convolution operations to all nodes, regardless of their varying structural and feature characteristics, which can undermine model performance and result in over-smoothing issues as the number of layers increases. To overcome this limitation, in this work, we propose a \textbf{N}ode-Level \textbf{G}raph \textbf{N}eural \textbf{A}rchitecture \textbf{S}earch (N-GNAS) algorithm. It can automatically choose an appropriate network architecture for each subset of nodes when updating node features. N-GNAS also introduces a contrastive learning loss to separate sample features from different categories and vice versa. In experiments conducted on eight datasets for node and graph classification, our methodology outperforms current leading GNAS techniques and traditional human-designed GNNs. For example, it achieves an accuracy rate of 78.26\% on the CiteSeer dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出节点级图神经架构搜索 N-GNAS，为节点子集分别选择卷积架构并加入对比学习损失，在八个节点与图分类数据集上超过现有 GNAS 与人工设计 GNN，CiteSeer 节点分类准确率 78.26%。
Motivation: 传统 GNN 对所有节点施加同一卷积操作，忽略节点结构与特征差异，导致性能受损并随层数加深出现 over-smoothing。
Method: N-GNAS 在更新节点特征时为每个节点子集自动搜索合适的网络架构，并引入对比学习损失分离不同类别样本特征、拉近同类特征，用于节点分类与图分类任务。
Result: 在八个节点与图分类数据集上超过当前领先的 GNAS 技术与人工设计 GNN，其中 CiteSeer 数据集准确率 78.26%。
Conclusion: 按节点子集差异化选择架构并配合对比损失，可以缓解统一卷积带来的 over-smoothing 并提升图分类与节点分类表现。

papers.title: The AI Evaluation Ecosystem
papers.abstract_en: AI evaluation shapes the decisions of model providers, users, funders, and regulators. We argue that designing valid benchmarks requires contextualizing design choices in the dynamics of this ecosystem of actors. We develop a simulation architecture that combines rule-based market dynamics with LLM-driven strategic actors, building on advances in Generative Agent-Based Modeling (GABM). We model benchmarks, consumer needs, and provider capabilities as vectors over a six-dimensional capability space (reasoning, coding, knowledge, safety, communication, agentic), with structural information partitions across actors. As a case study, we apply this stylized simulation to explore benchmark holdout design. We find that moving from public benchmarks to private holdout benchmarks shrinks the gap between benchmark scores and user satisfaction on most benchmarks but widens it on a few, depending on where holdout weights shift scoring credit. We stress-test our findings at both the instrument and case-study level, drawing on the V&V framework of Sargent (2013) and GABM-specific evidence criteria. Beyond holdout design, our simulation is a hypothesis-generating sandbox for studying how evaluator and policy choices, in turn, reshape the ecosystem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 AI 评测生态建为规则化市场动力学加 LLM 驱动策略主体的生成式 agent-based 模拟 (GABM)，在六维能力空间中把基准、用户需求、提供方能力表示为向量并带主体间信息分区。案例研究发现：从公开基准转向私有 holdout 基准会在多数基准上缩小分数与用户满意度的差距，但在少数基准上反而拉大，方向取决于 holdout 权重把评分信用移向何处。
Motivation: 基准设计的选择脱离了模型提供方、用户、出资方与监管方构成的生态动力学，导致分数与真实用户满意度脱节，而 holdout 设计的影响此前缺少可推演的机制模型。
Method: 构建结合规则化市场动力学与 LLM 驱动策略主体的 GABM 模拟架构；把基准、消费需求、提供方能力编码为六维能力空间（reasoning、coding、knowledge、safety、communication、agentic）上的向量，并在主体间设置结构性信息分区；以 benchmark holdout 设计为案例研究，按 Sargent (2013) 的 V&V 框架与 GABM 专属证据标准在工具层和案例层做压力测试。
Result: 从公开基准切到私有 holdout 基准，在多数基准上缩小了基准分数与用户满意度的差距，但在少数基准上拉大差距，方向取决于 holdout 权重把评分信用转移到哪里；结论经工具层与案例层双重压力测试。
Conclusion: holdout 设计不是单纯防污染手段，它会通过评分信用的重新分配改变分数与用户满意度的对应关系，因此基准设计选择必须放在评测生态的动力学中审视；该模拟定位为生成假设的沙盒。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RT-Safe: Benchmarking Agent Safety in Real-Time Embodied Environment
papers.abstract_en: Rapid progress in AI agents has brought growing attention to agent safety, with extensive evaluation focused on digital environments. As agents move into the physical world, embodied safety becomes increasingly important: failures can cause human injury and costly hardware damage. Beyond selecting safe actions, embodied agents must also operate under real-time constraints: the physical world does not pause while an agent reasons. As pedestrians move and vehicles approach during inference, an action that appears safe at observation time may become unsafe before execution. Real-time embodied safety therefore depends on both decision quality and decision latency. We introduce RT-SAFE, a simulated urban benchmark for evaluating embodied-agent safety under real-time constraints. RT-SAFE combines navigation tasks with moving actors, environmental hazards, and traffic rules, while allowing the world to evolve throughout inference and action execution. Across eight VLMs, agents achieve high task completion yet almost never complete safely: in the hardest setting, only 0.7% of episodes finish without a safety event. More strikingly, matched static and real-time evaluations yield task completion rates of 91.3% and 94.1%, respectively, while real-time execution increases collisions by $12.3\times$. These results reveal that standard task success can mask substantial safety failures, and that decision latency itself can become a source of physical risk. Finally, we show that RT-SAFE can support offline RL training and substantially reduce collision rates while achieving strong task completion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RT-SAFE 是一个仿真城市环境中的具身智能体实时安全基准：世界在推理与执行期间持续演化，行人在动、车辆在逼近，安全因此同时取决于决策质量与决策延迟。八个 VLM 上任务完成率很高但几乎从不安全完成——最难设定中仅 0.7% 的 episode 无安全事件；匹配的静态与实时评测完成率分别为 91.3% 与 94.1%，而实时执行使碰撞增加 12.3 倍。
Motivation: 现有智能体安全评测集中在数字环境，而具身智能体进入物理世界后，推理期间世界不暂停：观察时看似安全的动作在执行前可能已不安全，标准任务成功率掩盖了这类安全失败。
Method: 提出 RT-SAFE：仿真城市基准，把导航任务与移动角色、环境危险、交通规则结合，允许世界在推理与动作执行过程中持续演化；对八个 VLM 做匹配的静态与实时评测，并用它支持离线 RL 训练。
Result: 八个 VLM 上任务完成率高但几乎从不安全完成：最难设定仅 0.7% episode 无安全事件；匹配评测中静态与实时任务完成率为 91.3% 与 94.1%，实时执行使碰撞增加 12.3 倍；RT-SAFE 上的离线 RL 训练显著降低碰撞率并保持较强任务完成。
Conclusion: 标准任务成功会掩盖大量安全失败，决策延迟本身就是物理风险来源；用 RT-SAFE 这类实时基准做离线 RL 训练可同时压低碰撞率并保住任务完成。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: FaceKit: a Toolkit for Interpretable Facial Phenotyping, Synthetic Image Generation and Privacy Analysis in Rare Diseases
papers.abstract_en: Many rare genetic diseases are associated with recognizable craniofacial features. However, traditional approaches for describing facial morphology rely largely on qualitative clinical observation and free-text descriptions, which are often subjective, non-standardized, and difficult to reproduce across observers and institutions. Although the Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO) provides controlled terms for describing facial features, these terms are typically categorical rather than quantitative and may vary depending on examiner experience and interpretation. Here, we present FaceKit, a computational framework for quantitative facial phenotyping from frontal facial photographs. FaceKit extracts standardized measurements of facial landmarks and derived 120 morphological features, then reports feature-level z-scores representing deviation from population reference distributions. The reference distributions are built from the FairFace dataset spanning diverse ancestral groups. We evaluated FaceKit on a curated subset of the GestaltMatcher Database covering 50 rare-disease cohorts. In addition to quantitative facial analysis, FaceKit includes synthetic facial image generation to support rare disease model development and data augmentation. We also performed privacy evaluation to assess whether synthetic images reveal identifiable information from real patient photographs and could compromise patient privacy. Across disease case studies, FaceKit-derived quantitative measurements captured known facial features associated with rare genetic disorders and provided objective support for clinical phenotyping. Together, these results establish FaceKit as a useful tool for quantitative phenotyping, and has the potential to improve rare disease diagnosis, support genotype-phenotype studies, and enable more reproducible clinical characterization across diverse patient populations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FaceKit 把正面照片的面部形态变成可复现的定量表型：提取标准化 landmark 测量并派生 120 个形态特征，按 FairFace 参考分布给出 z-score。在 GestaltMatcher Database 的 50 个罕见病队列子集上，这些定量测量捕捉到已知的罕见遗传病面部特征，同时附带合成人脸生成与隐私评估。
Motivation: 罕见遗传病的面部描述依赖主观、非标准化的临床观察与自由文本，HPO 术语又是类别型而非定量，跨观察者与机构难以复现。
Method: 从正面面部照片提取标准化 landmark 测量，派生 120 个形态特征并计算相对参考分布的 z-score；参考分布由覆盖多祖先群体的 FairFace 数据集构建。框架另含合成人脸图像生成用于模型开发与数据增强，并对合成图是否泄露真实患者可识别信息做隐私评估。
Result: 在 GestaltMatcher Database 精选的 50 个罕见病队列子集上评估，FaceKit 的定量测量捕捉到与罕见遗传病相关的已知面部特征；派生特征数为 120，参考分布来自 FairFace。
Conclusion: 面部形态可以按 landmark 测量加参考分布 z-score 的方式做成客观、可复现的定量表型，从而支持罕见病诊断与基因型-表型研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LeCuration: A Tiny World Model as a Data Curation Multi-Tool
papers.abstract_en: Many applications of physical AI run within finite or closed physical worlds with a limited set of physical laws governing object behavior. Examples include robots working in a warehouse and agents moving around in a video game. In order to better organize, filter, and curate data for physical AI applications, we propose a new approach centered on the unique settings and physical laws of individual datasets. We train LeCuration, a small world model intended to serve as a data curation tool for a separate, larger downstream model. To build this model, we choose LeWorldModel (LeWM)as our latent encoder and predictor, adding a diffusion transformer (DiT) decoder to add visuals to autoregressive gameplay rollout. We find that the embeddings of this model can be used as an anomaly detection signal and as a content-based clustering heuristic, and that auto-regressively predicting the game state with this model allows us to qualitatively check for action-state consistency. This paper presents a qualitative, proof-of-concept case study on CS:GO gameplay data; we do not yet report quantitative curation metrics or downstream training results, which we identify as the key next step.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LeCuration 训练一个小型世界模型 LeWM 加 DiT 解码器，用其 embedding 做 CS:GO 游戏数据的异常检测、内容聚类与自回归 rollout 的动作-状态一致性检查，作为面向物理 AI 下游大模型的数据策展工具。这是定性概念验证，作者把量化策展指标与下游训练结果列为下一步。
Motivation: 物理 AI 数据集受各自封闭世界的物理规律约束，需要按数据集自身设定来组织、过滤和策展数据，而现有做法缺少针对单一数据集规律的专用工具。
Method: 以 LeWorldModel (LeWM) 作为 latent 编码器与预测器，外接 diffusion transformer (DiT) 解码器为自回归 gameplay rollout 补上视觉输出；用其 embedding 做异常检测信号与基于内容的聚类启发式，并自回归预测游戏状态以检查动作-状态一致性。
Result: 在 CS:GO 游戏数据上给出定性概念验证：embedding 可作异常检测信号与内容聚类启发式，自回归 rollout 可定性核验动作-状态一致性；论文明确不报告量化策展指标与下游训练结果。
Conclusion: 小型世界模型可以充当数据策展多用工具，但其量化策展效果与对下游模型训练的收益是该路线成立的关键下一步。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.conclusion: 小型世界模型可以充当数据策展多用工具，但其量化策展效果与对下游模型训练的收益是该路线成立的关键下一步。

papers.title: Self-attention summary networks for subsurface velocity-model building from common-image gathers
papers.abstract_en: Common-image gathers (CIGs) contain physically meaningful information about velocity-model errors through reflector focusing and residual moveout, but in conventional imaging workflows they are typically used only as diagnostic tools. In this work, we propose a multiscale self-attention summary network that maps high-dimensional 3D CIG volumes into compact conditioning embeddings for probabilistic subsurface velocity inversion. These learned embeddings preserve offset-dependent kinematic structure and spatial coherence while reducing variability caused by background-velocity mismatch. Conditioned on these summary embeddings, a flow-matching model learns a transport from a Gaussian source distribution to the posterior distribution of plausible velocity fields. Numerical experiments show that, compared with direct conditioning on raw CIGs, the proposed summary network improves posterior velocity inference. In particular, the multiscale attention design provides greater robustness to background-model mismatch, yielding more accurate posterior reconstructions and lower predictive uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出多尺度自注意力摘要网络，把高维 3D common-image gathers (CIG) 压成紧凑条件嵌入，再用 flow-matching 模型从高斯源分布输运到速度场后验分布。相比直接用原始 CIG 做条件，摘要嵌入提升后验速度反演，且对背景速度模型失配更稳健，后验重建更准、预测不确定性更低。
Motivation: CIG 中的反射聚焦与残余时差携带速度模型误差信息，但在常规成像流程里只当诊断工具用；直接把高维 3D CIG 送入反演又受背景速度失配带来的变异干扰。
Method: 多尺度自注意力 summary network 将 3D CIG 体映射为紧凑 conditioning embedding，保留 offset 相关运动学结构与空间相干性、抑制背景速度失配引起的变异；以该嵌入为条件，flow-matching 模型学习从高斯源分布到可信速度场后验分布的输运。
Result: 数值实验显示，相对直接以原始 CIG 作条件，所提 summary network 改进后验速度推断；多尺度注意力设计对背景模型失配更稳健，给出更准确的后验重建与更低的预测不确定性。
Conclusion: 把 CIG 压缩成保留运动学结构的注意力嵌入再做条件化，是比直接喂原始 CIG 更稳健的概率性地下速度反演路径，尤其在背景模型不准时。

papers.title: Twist Flow for Inverse Problems
papers.abstract_en: In Bayesian inverse problems, posterior sampling requires generating samples that are consistent with given observations while capturing the range of plausible solutions. Direct conditional generative models introduce latent noise to model this ambiguity, but paired inverse-problem training can still encourage an almost deterministic map from the observation to the target. As a result, generated samples may be observation-consistent while under-representing posterior variability, especially when the posterior is multimodal, leading to undercoverage, mode distortion, or artificial transitions between distinct feasible solutions. We propose joint twist-flow, an augmented flow-matching formulation that learns a continuous transport from the augmented source state $(z_x, y)$ to the augmented terminal state $(x, z_y)$. Here x is the target variable, $y$ is the observation, $z_x$ is the Gaussian reference coordinate for posterior sampling, and $z_y$ is a Gaussian likelihood-side coordinate associated with the observation branch. Under a Gaussian observation model, $z_y$ is motivated by the normalized observation residual associated with observation compatibility. Its role is not to replace uncertainty in $x$, but to couple generated samples of x to observation consistency, helping reduce likelihood-inconsistent variation while preserving variability in weakly constrained directions. We validate the method on low-dimensional inverse problems with reference posterior samples, where joint twist-flow better preserves multimodal posterior support than a direct conditional-flow baseline. We further evaluate the method on image restoration and seismic subsurface velocity-model inversion, showing increased posterior variability while maintaining observation consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对贝叶斯逆问题中条件生成模型把观测到目标学成近似确定性映射、导致后验欠覆盖与模式失真的问题，提出 joint twist-flow：在增广源状态 (z_x, y) 到增广终态 (x, z_y) 之间学连续输运，其中 z_y 是与观测分支关联的高斯似然侧坐标（由归一化观测残差启发），用于把生成样本耦合到观测一致性而非替代 x 的不确定性。在有参考后验样本的低维逆问题上，它比直接条件流基线更好地保持多峰后验支撑；在图像复原与地震速度模型反演上，在维持观测一致性的同时增加了后验变异性。
Motivation: 直接条件生成模型虽以潜噪声表达观测歧义，但配对训练仍会鼓励从观测到目标的近似确定性映射，使样本观测一致却低估后验变异性，尤其在后验多峰时出现欠覆盖、模式失真或不同可行解之间的人工过渡。
Method: 提出 joint twist-flow，一种增广 flow-matching 形式：在增广源状态 (z_x, y) 与增广终态 (x, z_y) 之间学习连续输运，x 为目标变量、y 为观测、z_x 为后验采样的高斯参考坐标、z_y 为与观测分支关联的高斯似然侧坐标；在高斯观测模型下 z_y 由归一化观测残差（观测兼容性）驱动，作用是耦合 x 的生成样本与观测一致性，抑制似然不一致的变化，同时保留弱约束方向上的变异性。
Result: 在带参考后验样本的低维逆问题上，joint twist-flow 比直接条件流基线更好地保持多峰后验支撑；在图像复原与地震地下速度模型反演上，方法在维持观测一致性的同时提升了后验变异性。
Conclusion: 把观测一致性通过似然侧坐标 z_y 显式耦合进 flow matching，可以在不牺牲观测一致性的前提下缓解条件生成模型的后验欠覆盖与模式失真，适用于多峰后验的逆问题采样。

papers.title: CATune: Structural Constraint-Aware Bayesian Optimization for DBMS Configuration Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Modern DBMSs expose hundreds of configuration knobs, resulting in a high-dimensional and heterogeneous search space that makes automated tuning costly. Existing ML-based tuning systems typically treat the configuration domain as box-constrained and rely on workload feedback to implicitly capture inter-knob relationships. However, DBMS documentation specifies deterministic knob dependency constraints, particularly ordering constraints, that characterize structurally valid regions of the configuration space. We present CATune, a constraint-aware Bayesian optimization (BO) framework that models deterministic inter-knob ordering constraints as structural components of the search domain. Instead of learning feasibility boundaries through sampled violations, CATune performs optimization within a constraint-consistent subspace. We develop a topology-aware sampling strategy that respects dependency structure during exploration and avoids the inefficiencies of post-hoc constraint handling. To enable automated constraint discovery, we further design a precision-first extraction pipeline that combines LLM-based parsing with reliability safeguards to mitigate hallucinated dependencies. Experiments on PostgreSQL and MySQL using TPC-C and TPC-H workloads show that CATune substantially improves both sample efficiency and final tuning quality across surrogate models and BO frameworks. Under default ranges, CATune reaches the baseline optimum up to 12.5x faster and improves throughput by up to 63.37%. The improvements persist under knowledge-guided reduced ranges and alternative optimization implementations. These results demonstrate that explicitly modeling system-defined deterministic ordering constraints enhances optimization robustness and system stability.
papers.comment: 14 pages including references, 10 figure, 2 tables. Accpeted by PVLDB, Volume 19, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CATune 把 DBMS 文档中确定性的 knob 顺序依赖当作搜索域的结构约束，直接在约束一致子空间内做贝叶斯优化，而不是靠采样违反去学可行边界。在 PostgreSQL 与 MySQL 的 TPC-C、TPC-H 负载上，它在默认参数范围内最快以 12.5 倍速度达到基线最优，吞吐最高提升 63.37%。
Motivation: DBMS 有数百个配置 knob，现有 ML 调参把配置域当盒约束、靠负载反馈隐式捕捉 knob 关系，而文档规定的确定性顺序依赖被忽略，导致采样浪费与事后约束处理的低效。
Method: CATune 是约束感知贝叶斯优化框架：以确定性 inter-knob 顺序约束构造约束一致子空间，在其中优化；配 topology-aware 采样策略在探索时尊重依赖结构；另设 precision-first 约束抽取管线，用 LLM 解析文档并加可靠性防护以抑制幻觉依赖。
Result: 在 PostgreSQL 与 MySQL 上用 TPC-C、TPC-H 负载实验，跨多种 surrogate model 与 BO 框架均提升样本效率与最终调参质量：默认范围内最快 12.5 倍达到基线最优，吞吐最高提升 63.37%；在知识引导的缩减范围与替代优化实现下改进仍保持。
Conclusion: 显式建模系统定义的确定性顺序约束能增强优化的鲁棒性与系统稳定性，比事后约束处理和隐式学习可行边界更有效。

papers.title: EM-SNN: Efficiently Modulated Spiking Neural Network for Remote Sensing Image Dehazing
papers.abstract_en: Although spiking neural networks (SNNs) provide an energy-efficient alternative to artificial neural networks (ANNs), their application to remote sensing image dehazing remains limited. A key challenge arises from the coupling between haze-induced high-frequency attenuation and discrete spike thresholding. This interaction suppresses weak responses and fundamentally limits the recovery of edges, textures, and fine details in spiking dehazing models. To address this challenge, we propose the Efficiently Modulated Spiking Neural Network (EM-SNN), a dedicated spiking framework tailored to remote sensing image dehazing. EM-SNN integrates a statistics-driven Threshold-Modulated Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (TM-LIF) neuron to adaptively compensate for haze-induced contrast compression, together with a Spike Sobel Modulation (SSM) module that enhances structural cues and reduces depth-wise attenuation during spiking feature propagation. By jointly modulating activation scales and structural representations, EM-SNN improves dehazing performance while preserving the inherent event-driven sparsity of SNNs. Experiments on HRSD, RICE, RRSHID, and SateHaze1K demonstrate that EM-SNN achieves competitive dehazing performance while consuming only one quarter of the energy of the strong ANN baseline SFRDP-Net.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EM-SNN 用统计驱动的 Threshold-Modulated LIF (TM-LIF) 神经元自适应补偿雾霾导致的对比度压缩，配合 Spike Sobel Modulation (SSM) 模块增强结构线索、抑制脉冲特征传播中的深度衰减，在保持事件驱动稀疏性的同时提升遥感图像去雾性能。在 HRSD、RICE、RRSHID、SateHaze1K 上取得有竞争力的去雾效果，能耗仅为强 ANN 基线 SFRDP-Net 的四分之一。
Motivation: SNN 虽然比 ANN 能效高，但在遥感图像去雾上应用有限：雾霾引起的高频衰减与离散脉冲阈值耦合，压制弱响应，从根本上限制边缘、纹理和细节的恢复。
Method: 提出专用于遥感去雾的 EM-SNN 框架：一是统计驱动的 TM-LIF 神经元，自适应补偿雾霾引起的对比度压缩；二是 Spike Sobel Modulation (SSM) 模块，增强结构线索并减少脉冲特征传播中的深度衰减；两者联合调制激活尺度与结构表示，同时保留 SNN 的事件驱动稀疏性。
Result: 在 HRSD、RICE、RRSHID、SateHaze1K 四个数据集上实验，EM-SNN 取得有竞争力的去雾性能，能耗仅为强 ANN 基线 SFRDP-Net 的四分之一。
Conclusion: 通过联合调制激活尺度与结构表示，SNN 可以在遥感去雾上做到性能有竞争力且能耗大幅低于 ANN 基线，同时保留事件驱动稀疏性。

papers.title: Hardware-aware Calibrated Clustered Attention for Efficient Visual Geometric Transformers
papers.abstract_en: The Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT) marks a significant leap forward in 3D scene reconstruction, as it is the first model that directly infers all key 3D attributes (camera poses, depths, and dense geometry) jointly in one pass. However, this joint inference mechanism requires global attention layers with extremely long sequences that causes a significant latency bottleneck. In this paper, we propose blockwise clustered attention (BC attention) to accelerate the global attention layers in VGGT. By limiting the clustering within HW-friendly neighborhood blocks, BC attention reduces the computation overhead of query clustering as well as the costly data movement between on- and off-chip memory. This enables BC attention to scale to long sequences and deliver practical latency improvements on GPUs. Moreover, we introduce a hashing hyperplane calibration method and a threshold-based error compensation method to reduce clustering errors efficiently, which is a bottleneck in the current clustered attention mechanism. Overall, our experiments on GPU demonstrate that calibrated BC attention accelerates the global attention layers by 2.10-2.63$\times$ and the whole backbone by 1.77-2.35$\times$ with negligible loss (1%) for large scenes. With a small performance loss (< 5%), calibrated BC attention further achieves a 2.26-2.87$\times$ latency improvement on the global attention layers and a 1.90-2.55$\times$ improvement on the backbone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 VGGT 单次联合推断 3D 场景（相机位姿、深度、稠密几何）时全局注意力超长序列带来的延迟瓶颈，提出块内聚类注意力 (blockwise clustered attention, BC attention)，把聚类限制在硬件友好的邻域块内以减少查询聚类开销与片上/片外内存搬运，并用哈希超平面校准与阈值误差补偿修正聚类误差。GPU 实验中校准后 BC attention 使全局注意力层加速 2.10–2.63×、整条 backbone 加速 1.77–2.35×（大场景精度损失约 1%）；允许 <5% 性能损失时注意力层加速 2.26–2.87×、backbone 加速 1.90–2.55×。
Motivation: VGGT 的联合推断依赖超长序列的全局注意力层，造成显著延迟瓶颈；现有 clustered attention 的聚类误差本身也是效率瓶颈，且查询聚类与片内外内存数据搬运开销大。
Method: 提出 BC attention：把查询聚类限制在硬件友好的邻域块 (HW-friendly neighborhood blocks) 内，降低聚类计算与 on-/off-chip 内存搬运开销，使方法可扩展到长序列；再引入哈希超平面校准 (hashing hyperplane calibration) 与基于阈值的误差补偿 (threshold-based error compensation) 来高效减少聚类误差，在 GPU 上加速 VGGT 的全局注意力层。
Result: GPU 实验：校准 BC attention 加速全局注意力层 2.10–2.63×、整条 backbone 1.77–2.35×，大场景精度损失约 1%；在可接受 <5% 性能损失的设置下，注意力层延迟改善 2.26–2.87×、backbone 改善 1.90–2.55×。
Conclusion: 把聚类限制在硬件友好块内并配合校准与误差补偿，可在 VGGT 上以约 1% 或 <5% 的精度代价换取 2× 量级的注意力层与 backbone 延迟加速。

papers.title: Evaluating Trajectory Features for Routing Final-Layer Attention
papers.abstract_en: Attention routing requires a signal that predicts the value of attention on the current prefix. We evaluate whether hidden-state extrapolation error, curvature and error change improve this prediction beyond uncertainty, one-step displacement, position and state projections. Paired executions of the final attention layer supply signed next-token loss differences in frozen SmolLM3-3B-Base and Qwen3.5-4B-Base checkpoints. Utility-supervised routers are tested on 100 held-out PG-19 books at an identical causal 20 percent invocation quota. None of six prespecified comparisons shows a positive gain after familywise correction. In Qwen3.5, a parameter-matched fixed-projection control lowers NLL by 0.00356 nats/token relative to the trajectory router (95 percent interval 0.00218 to 0.00487). Secondary results depend on the operation removed, feature location and scoring horizon; frozen thresholds also drift substantially at longer horizons. Actual selected-query execution yields small long-sequence latency reductions with increased NLL, while learned routers remain slower during cached continuation. The study identifies limits on the incremental value of these trajectory summaries and separates allocation quality from measured inference benefit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在冻结的 SmolLM3-3B-Base 与 Qwen3.5-4B-Base 上，用配对执行的末层注意力产生带符号 next-token 损失差，检验轨迹特征（外推误差、曲率、误差变化）能否在不确定性、单步位移、位置与状态投影之外改进注意力路由。六项预设比较经族错误率校正后均无正增益；Qwen3.5 中参数量匹配的固定投影对照反而比轨迹路由低 0.00356 nats/token（95% 区间 0.00218 至 0.00487）。
Motivation: 注意力路由需要一个能预测当前前缀上注意力价值的信号，而已有信号（不确定性、位移、位置、状态投影）之外，轨迹类特征是否带来增量价值并不清楚。
Method: 对末层注意力做配对执行，得到带符号 next-token 损失差作为监督；训练 utility-supervised router，在 100 本 PG-19 留出书上以统一的 20% 因果调用配额测试，并与参数量匹配的固定投影对照比较，六项预设比较做族错误率校正。
Result: 六项预设比较在校正后均无正增益；Qwen3.5 中固定投影对照相对轨迹路由降低 NLL 0.00356 nats/token（95% 区间 0.00218 至 0.00487）。次要结果随被移除的操作、特征位置与打分时距而变，冻结阈值在更长时距上明显漂移；实际选查询执行带来小幅长序列延迟下降但 NLL 上升，学习型 router 在缓存续写阶段反而更慢。
Conclusion: 这些轨迹摘要对路由价值预测的增量价值有限，且分配质量与实测推理收益是两件应分开报告的事。

papers.title: Package Hallucination Attacks on Coding Agents through Prompt Injection in Rule Files
papers.abstract_en: Modern agentic coding frameworks increasingly rely on community-shared rule files (e.g., AGENTS.md or .cursorrules) to guide autonomous code generation, yet the security risks of this pipeline remain underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce the package hallucination attack, where an attacker injects malicious prompts into benign rule files to induce coding agents to replace legitimate dependencies with attacker-controlled packages. To obtain effective malicious prompts injected into rule files, we propose PackHallu, an evolutionary optimization framework that iteratively rewrites these injected prompts using trajectory-level feedback and LLM-guided mutations. Evaluations across multiple benchmarks, LLMs, and agent frameworks show that PackHallu achieves high attack success rates and strong transferability across diverse models and agent combinations. Our findings demonstrate that coding agents are vulnerable to package hallucination attacks, highlighting the urgent need for stronger security safeguards in autonomous coding systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对共享规则文件（AGENTS.md、.cursorrules）这一未被审视的注入面，提出 PackHallu：用轨迹级反馈加 LLM 引导变异，进化式改写注入的恶意提示，诱导编码智能体把合法依赖替换成攻击者控制的包。跨多个 benchmark、LLM 与 agent 框架的评测显示攻击成功率高且跨模型-框架组合迁移性强。
Motivation: 自主编码框架普遍依赖社区共享规则文件指导代码生成，但这条管线的安全风险几乎未被研究，攻击者可借此操纵依赖选择。
Method: 定义 package hallucination attack：向良性规则文件注入恶意提示，诱导 agent 替换依赖；提出 PackHallu 进化优化框架，用轨迹级反馈评估注入提示效果，并由 LLM 引导执行变异，迭代重写提示。
Result: 在多个 benchmark、LLM 和 agent 框架上的评测中，PackHallu 取得高攻击成功率，并在多样的模型与 agent 组合间表现出强迁移性（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 编码智能体对基于规则文件注入的 package hallucination 攻击是脆弱的，自主编码系统需要更强的安全防护。

papers.title: The Symbol of the Surrogate: Measuring Numerical Provenance in Neural PDE Solvers
papers.abstract_en: Neural PDE surrogates are trained on numerical solver outputs that contain both physical evolution and solver-specific discretization errors. Because surrogates are also evaluated against held-out trajectories from the same solver, standard benchmarks cannot distinguish fidelity to the exact evolution from imitation of the numerical scheme. We introduce an empirical Fourier-symbol diagnostic that probes a trained surrogate's linearized one-step operator with individual Fourier modes and compares it with both exact-evolution and training-scheme references. To address architectural spectral bias, we train identical networks on schemes with orthogonal dissipative and dispersive signatures and compare their learned operators. In linear advection, the learned surrogates reproduce the training schemes' amplitude and phase errors, with the twin-scheme difference reaching more than 99.8\% of the analytically predicted full-imitation ceiling. The same behavior occurs for a non-local Fourier neural operator and at the operator level for nonlinear Burgers dynamics. These results show that agreement with solver-generated test data does not by itself establish fidelity to the exact evolution. Fourier-symbol measurements provide a direct diagnostic of numerical provenance.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 AI for Science Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 神经 PDE 代理模型在数值求解器输出上训练、又用同一求解器的留出轨迹评测，因此无法区分它学到的是精确演化还是求解器的离散化误差。作者提出经验 Fourier symbol 诊断，用单个 Fourier 模式探测训练后代理的线性化单步算子，并同时对照精确演化与训练格式两条参考；在对流方程中，学习到的代理复现了训练格式的幅值与相位误差，双格式差异达到解析预测的完全模仿上限的 99.8% 以上。
Motivation: 代理模型的训练数据与测试数据都来自同一数值求解器，标准基准把模仿数值格式误当作逼近精确演化，无法度量代理的数值来源 (numerical provenance)。
Method: 提出经验 Fourier-symbol 诊断：以单个 Fourier 模式探测代理的线性化单步算子，与精确演化参考和训练格式参考同时比较；为对抗架构的谱偏差，在具有正交耗散与频散特征的两种格式上训练相同网络并对比其学到的算子，覆盖线性对流、非局部 Fourier neural operator 与非线性 Burgers 动力学的算子层面。
Result: 在线性对流中，学习到的代理复现了训练格式的幅值与相位误差，双格式差异达到解析预测的完全模仿上限的 99.8% 以上；同样的行为出现在非局部 Fourier neural operator 上，并在非线性 Burgers 动力学的算子层面复现。
Conclusion: 与求解器生成的测试数据一致并不能证明代理忠实于精确演化；Fourier symbol 测量可直接诊断代理的数值来源。

papers.title: PhyDiCT: Plug-and-Play CT Reconstruction from Sparse X-Rays via Differentiable Rendering and Strong Priors
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing 3D Computed Tomography (CT) images from a few X-ray projections is a highly ill-posed inverse problem due to the loss of volumetric information. We propose PhyDiCT, a training-free framework that integrates a differentiable Physics-based forward model, grounded in the Beer-Lambert law, with a text-conditioned Diffusion as a strong prior to reconstruct 3D lung CT images. We refer to our approach as training-free since the prior model is used without fine-tuning, and our goal is to steer the denoising procedure to generate samples consistent with X-ray observations. We guide the diffusion generation using Split Gibbs sampling to jointly optimize for projection fidelity (reward) and consistency with prior knowledge. Also, we introduce a test-time refinement step that enhances image realism and anatomical coherence. We extensively evaluate our method on publicly available 3D CT datasets using both perceptual and semantic metrics, demonstrating that it surpasses existing plug-and-play diffusion and fully trained reconstruction approaches. Our findings highlight that combining a strong generative prior with the underlying physics of image formation substantially improves reconstruction quality, e.g., 7.5\% improvement on SSIM compared to full training methods. Code will be released at https://github.com/batmanlab/PhyDiCT.
papers.comment: Accepted at MICCAI 2026; to appear in LNCS 16888
papers.journal_ref: MICCAI 2026, LNCS 16888, pp. 392-402, Springer (2027)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhyDiCT 是一个免训练的稀疏 X 射线到 3D 肺 CT 重建框架：用基于 Beer-Lambert 定律的可微物理前向模型约束文本条件 Diffusion 先验，通过 Split Gibbs 采样同时优化投影保真与先验一致性，并加一步测试时细化提升解剖连贯性。在公开 3D CT 数据集上，其感知与语义指标超过现有 plug-and-play diffusion 与完全训练的重建方法，SSIM 相对全训练方法提升 7.5%。
Motivation: 从少量 X 射线投影重建 3D CT 是高度病态的逆问题，体积信息大量丢失；现有方案要么依赖训练好的重建网络，要么 plug-and-play 先验与成像物理结合不紧。
Method: 免训练框架：可微物理前向模型（Beer-Lambert 定律）提供投影一致性，文本条件 Diffusion 作为强先验且不做微调；用 Split Gibbs 采样引导生成，联合优化投影保真（reward）与先验一致性，再加一个测试时细化步骤提升图像真实感与解剖一致性。
Result: 在公开 3D CT 数据集上用感知与语义指标评估，超过现有 plug-and-play diffusion 与完全训练的重建方法，其中 SSIM 相比全训练方法提升 7.5%。
Conclusion: 强生成先验与成像物理结合能显著提升稀疏投影 CT 重建质量，且无需对先验模型微调；代码将在 github.com/batmanlab/PhyDiCT 发布。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Adaptive Visual Token Reduction for Accelerated Image Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Large Vision-Language Models achieve strong VQA performance, but processing high-resolution, information-rich images requires substantial computation, motivating visual token reduction. However, existing methods often prune individual tokens or rely on fixed-size cropping, limiting their ability to preserve spatially structured information such as horizontally or vertically elongated text. To address this limitation, we propose ReFIT, an instruction-guided visual token reduction framework for efficient LVLM inference. ReFIT consists of Relevance-Guided Window Reshaping (RWR) and Instruction-Guided Token Refinement (ITR), where RWR captures instruction-relevant regions by adapting to their spatial characteristics, while ITR further removes unnecessary visual tokens. Experiments on four VQA benchmarks demonstrate that ReFIT improves answer accuracy while reducing computational cost, and qualitative results demonstrate its effectiveness in localizing relevant regions and removing unnecessary visual information.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Efficient Best-of-N policy evaluation for inference-time alignment
papers.abstract_en: Best-of-N (BoN) is a common inference-time alignment method that selects the highest-scoring response among N samples from a reference model. Evaluating BoN policies from logged data is challenging under sample-only access because standard off-policy estimators require density ratios that depend on unavailable response likelihoods. In this paper, we propose a sample-only framework for evaluating and selecting BoN policies without access to these likelihoods. We show that the order-statistic structure of BoN allows the required density ratios to be expressed through score-rank probabilities that are estimable from samples alone. We then develop a doubly robust estimator of the BoN policy value (BoN-DR) that efficiently reuses a shared auxiliary sample pool across candidate budgets. We establish valid asymptotic inference even under reward estimator misspecification and prove the efficiency of our BoN-DR estimator. Since larger budgets can amplify errors in the score function and lead to reward overoptimization, we derive two selection rules: (i) maximizing the estimated policy value and (ii) maximizing a lower confidence bound on the improvement over the reference policy, which accounts for estimation uncertainty and provides a no-harm guarantee. Across synthetic experiments and GSM8K with multiple reference and reward models, our framework accurately estimates BoN policy values and selects effective sampling budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在只有样本、拿不到响应似然的条件下，Best-of-N (BoN) 策略值可以用 score-rank 概率表达所需密度比，从而做样本级评估。由此构造的双重稳健估计量 BoN-DR 在候选预算间共享辅助样本池，并给出两条预算选择规则：最大化估计策略值，或最大化相对参考策略改进的置信下界 (LCB) 以获得 no-harm 保证。
Motivation: BoN 是常用的推理时对齐方法，但只有 logged data 且样本级访问时，标准 off-policy 估计量需要依赖不可得响应似然的密度比，导致无法评估与选择 BoN 策略。
Method: 利用 BoN 的 order-statistic 结构，把所需密度比改写成仅靠样本即可估计的 score-rank 概率；据此提出 BoN-DR 双重稳健估计量，跨候选预算 N 复用同一辅助样本池；在奖励估计量误设 (misspecification) 下仍建立有效渐近推断并证明 BoN-DR 的效率；再推导两条预算选择规则。
Result: 在合成实验与 GSM8K（含多个 reference 与 reward 模型）上，框架准确估计 BoN 策略值并选出有效的采样预算；渐近推断在 reward estimator misspecification 下仍有效，BoN-DR 被证明具有效率性。
Conclusion: 样本级访问下 BoN 策略值可由 score-rank 概率识别并高效估计，配合考虑估计不确定性的 LCB 选择规则可在放大 reward 过优化风险时提供 no-harm 保证。

papers.title: An Informational Curse of Horizon in Goal-Conditioned Policy Learning
papers.abstract_en: The difficulty of learning goal-reaching policies is often attributed to a "curse of horizon" that manifests as bias accumulation in temporal-difference backups and noisy advantage estimates. In this work, we identify an additional informational curse of horizon in goal-conditioned policy learning, where increasing the goal relabeling horizon can significantly reduce policy generalization and performance. Through a series of controlled experiments with oracle planners, we decouple the goal horizons sampled during training from those that the policy is asked to reach at test time. Even when evaluated only on a sequence of nearby subgoals, goal-conditioned behavioral cloning (BC) policies suffer from severe, training horizon-dependent performance degradation that is mitigated by reinforcement learning (RL) objectives. We explain this phenomenon as a horizon-dependent decrease in the conditional mutual information between actions and hindsight-relabeled goals, and find empirically that both BC and RL policies trained on longer-horizon goals exhibit a shift in sensitivity from goal to state information, as measured by the policy's input Jacobians. Motivated by this observation, we find that distilling the input Jacobians of short-horizon policies into long-horizon policies yields significant performance gains, especially in combinatorial manipulation tasks. Taken together, our results highlight goal relabeling horizon as an important consideration when learning generalist policies from offline data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 目标条件策略学习中存在独立于 TD 偏差累积的“信息视界诅咒”：训练时用更长的 goal relabeling horizon 会显著削弱策略泛化，即使测试只问邻近子目标，长视界训练的 BC 策略也严重退化，而 RL 目标可缓解。作者把原因归结为动作与 hindsight 重标注目标之间条件互信息随视界下降，并发现把短视界策略的输入 Jacobian 蒸馏进长视界策略能在组合操作任务上带来显著性能提升。
Motivation: goal-conditioned 策略的困难通常被归因于 TD backup 的偏差累积与 advantage 估计噪声，但训练目标重标注视界本身对泛化的独立影响尚未被识别和解耦。
Method: 用 oracle planner 做受控实验，把训练采样的 goal horizon 与测试要求到达的 horizon 解耦；对比 goal-conditioned behavioral cloning 与 RL 目标；用策略输入 Jacobian 度量对 goal 与 state 的敏感度迁移，并将短视界策略的输入 Jacobian 蒸馏进长视界策略。
Result: 即使只在邻近子目标序列上评测，长视界训练的 BC 策略也出现严重的、依赖训练视界的性能退化，RL 目标可缓解；BC 与 RL 策略在更长视界目标上训练时，输入 Jacobian 显示敏感度从 goal 转向 state；Jacobian 蒸馏在组合操作任务 (combinatorial manipulation tasks) 上带来显著性能提升。
Conclusion: goal relabeling horizon 是从离线数据学习通用策略 (generalist policies) 时必须显式考虑的设计变量，且可用短视界策略的输入 Jacobian 蒸馏来补救长视界训练的损失。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Beyond Nominal Equilibria: Risk-Averse Multi-Population Mean-Field Games
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in mean-field games and its multi-population variants enable large-scale heterogeneous multi-agent systems to be modeled through representative agents and their associated mean-field distributions. However, existing approaches do not explicitly account for uncertainty in the behavior of other populations. To this end, we introduce a new paradigm: risk-averse multi-population mean-field games, where each population optimizes a worst-case expected reward over dynamically feasible ambiguity sets of mean-field flows of a subset of the other populations. Employing an occupation-measure formulation along with tools from set-valued analysis, we establish, under mild assumptions, several theoretical properties of the multi-population game, including the geometric properties of the ambiguity sets and the existence of a novel risk-averse multi-population mean-field equilibrium. Further, we derive contractivity results of the fixed-point operator under entropy regularization and show that it can be utilized to learn the equilibrium. Finally, we propose a risk-averse fictitious-play scheme and show that exploitability decays to zero, despite the additional nonlinearity introduced by the worst-case objective. We report several numerical experiments to illustrate convergence and risk-averse behavior.
papers.comment: Submitted to a conference; comments are welcome
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出风险规避多群体平均场博弈 (risk-averse multi-population mean-field games)：每个群体在其他部分群体平均场流的动态可行歧义集 (ambiguity sets) 上优化最坏情形期望回报。在熵正则下不动点算子具收缩性并可用于学习均衡，所提风险规避虚构博弈 (fictitious play) 即使引入最坏情形目标的额外非线性，exploitability 仍衰减到零。
Motivation: 现有均值场博弈及其多群体变体用代表性 agent 与平均场分布刻画大规模异质多智能体系统，但不显式处理其他群体行为的不确定性。
Method: 采用 occupation-measure 表述并结合集值分析 (set-valued analysis)，在温和假设下刻画歧义集的几何性质与风险规避多群体均值场均衡的存在性；在熵正则下推导不动点算子的收缩性以支持均衡学习，并提出风险规避虚构博弈方案。
Result: 在温和假设下证明歧义集几何性质与新的风险规避多群体均值场均衡存在性；熵正则下不动点算子收缩；虚构博弈的 exploitability 衰减到零；并报告若干数值实验说明收敛性与风险规避行为。
Conclusion: 把歧义集上的最坏情形目标与 occupation-measure 表述结合，可以在保留均衡可学习性的同时让多群体均值场博弈显式承担对其他群体不确定性的风险。

papers.title: We Query, Therefore We Compute: On Oracle Computation beyond the Machine, with an Application to Agents
papers.abstract_en: Agentic systems use large language models (LLMs) to carry out concrete tasks. Prior work often borrows abstractions such as scheduling, caching or isolation piecemeal from operating systems, so the mechanisms it builds share little common ground, and the shared view of the two forms of agentic system, Workflows and Agents, is limited. We construct an abstract machine that provides both. We treat the LLM as an Oracle and extend a two-stack pushdown automaton with one instruction, which hands the Oracle a whole stack as its query and appends the answer to that same stack. The machine thus performs two computations, the Oracle's and a Turing-complete one that we call the Priestess. A stack that the program only appends to grows autoregressively, as an agent's context does. Two symmetry breakings, S in storage and T in transitions, make a Priestess program the operating system of the programs the Oracle runs, and produce the Agent and the Workflow as the two placements of a task's program. For internally autoregressive Oracles, the two computations synchronize at the end of every answer under certain conditions, and through that synchronization we model caching and analyse scheduling. No guarantee that holds for every Oracle can fix which content crosses between the two computations, but such a guarantee does fix the boundary itself. The construction V fits the machine to a von Neumann computer. To show that it is realizable, we propose ArchNights, an extended RISC-V ISA and a Linux-style operating system implementing the machine by design. ArchNights-SE runs on gem5 as a computer system, becomes an agentic system when it runs an LLM as the Oracle, and will be open source. Agentic systems can then be designed as computer systems are. With a foundation built and a unified view, future work can share invariants and bounds, each with its conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM 当作 Oracle，在双栈下推自动机上加一条「整栈查询、答案追加回栈」指令，构造出同时执行 Oracle 计算与图灵完备 Priestess 计算的抽象机，并用两处对称性破缺统一 Agent 与 Workflow 两种形态。给出 ArchNights（扩展 RISC-V ISA + Linux 风格 OS）在 gem5 上的可实现方案，声称 agentic 系统可像计算机系统一样被设计。
Motivation: 既有 agentic 工作零散借用调度、缓存、隔离等 OS 抽象，机制之间缺乏共同基础，Workflows 与 Agents 两种形态也缺少统一视图。
Method: 以 LLM 为 Oracle 扩展双栈下推自动机，新增把整栈作为查询并把答案追加回该栈的指令；栈只追加即对应 agent 上下文的自回归增长。存储上的 S 与转移上的 T 两处对称性破缺使 Priestess 程序成为 Oracle 所运行程序的操作系统，从而导出 Agent 与 Workflow 两种任务程序放置方式；构造 V 把机器拟合到 von Neumann 计算机，并提出 ArchNights 扩展 RISC-V ISA 与 Linux 风格操作系统在 gem5 上实现。
Result: 对内部自回归的 Oracle，在一定条件下两路计算在每个答案末尾同步，据此建模缓存并分析调度；对任意 Oracle 都成立的保证无法固定两路计算间交换的内容，但能固定该边界本身。ArchNights-SE 在 gem5 上作为计算机系统运行，接入 LLM 作为 Oracle 时即成为 agentic 系统，将开源。
Conclusion: 作者主张：一旦抽象机与统一视图就位，agentic 系统可以像计算机系统一样被设计，后续工作可共享带条件的不变量与界。

papers.title: Pooling Representation Autoencoders for Efficient Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Representation Autoencoders (RAEs) generate images from pre-trained visual fea- tures, but their dense token grids make generative modeling expensive. Motivated by local feature correlations, we introduce PoolDINO, a learned affine pooling operator that merges neighboring tokens. Training the pooling operator jointly with the RGB decoder preserves the standard two-stage RAE procedure without a separate feature auto-encoder. On ImageNet-256, 4x token compression retains comparable generation quality under internal guidance, while 16x compression trades some quality for greater efficiency. At a fixed budget of 100 sampling steps, latent-sampling throughput increases by 3.7x and 9.0x, respectively, relative to the unpooled baseline. Classification and dense prediction evaluations show that comparable guided generation quality can coexist with weaker performance on other tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PoolDINO 是一个可学习的仿射池化算子，把 RAE 的稠密 token 网格按邻域合并，与 RGB decoder 联合训练，从而在保留标准两阶段 RAE 流程的前提下压缩生成成本。在 ImageNet-256 上，4x 压缩在 internal guidance 下保持可比生成质量，100 步采样时 latent 采样吞吐提升 3.7x；16x 压缩吞吐提升 9.0x 但牺牲部分质量，且分类与稠密预测等任务上表现变弱。
Motivation: Representation Autoencoders 用预训练视觉特征生成图像，但稠密 token 网格让生成建模代价高昂，需要在不引入独立 feature auto-encoder 的前提下降低 token 数。
Method: 提出可学习的仿射池化算子 PoolDINO，按局部特征相关性合并相邻 token；池化算子与 RGB decoder 联合训练，保留标准两阶段 RAE 流程，无需单独的 feature auto-encoder。
Result: 在 ImageNet-256 上，4x token 压缩在 internal guidance 下保持可比生成质量，固定 100 采样步时 latent 采样吞吐相对未池化基线提升 3.7x；16x 压缩吞吐提升 9.0x，但以部分质量下降换取效率。分类与稠密预测评测显示，可比的 guided 生成质量可以与其他任务上更弱的表现共存。
Conclusion: 用可学习池化压缩 RAE token 可以在生成质量基本不变时显著提速，但压缩比越高、且生成质量与其他任务表现之间存在权衡。

papers.title: Adversarial Images Hijack Web Agents from Visual Grounding to Browser Execution
papers.abstract_en: Modern web agents built on large vision-language models process webpages, select relevant UI elements, and translate model outputs into browser actions. Existing visual red-teaming approaches use adversarial visual content to manipulate this process. However, they primarily target model inference and do not explicitly account for structured input processing or action post-processing. Consequently, model-level success does not establish control over browser execution and cannot reliably characterize end-to-end agent robustness. To address this gap, we formulate red teaming for vision-grounded web agents as an end-to-end grounding-to-execution problem, and introduce WebMirage, a framework that crafts localized visual perturbations that cause agents to select attacker-controlled content and execute the corresponding browser action across varying webpage renderings. It uses a role-slot abstraction and webpage recomposition to capture competition among webpage elements, and dataflow analysis to align optimization with action post-processing. We evaluate WebMirage across four agent configurations and six VLM backbones on 2,250 tasks covering 13 public websites and a sandbox benchmark. WebMirage achieves an average attack success rate of 91.9%, compared with 17.4% for the strongest baseline, and remains effective against three agent-level defenses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WebMirage 把视觉 web agent 的红队测试从模型层推理操纵改写为端到端的 grounding-to-execution 问题：生成局部视觉扰动，使 agent 选中攻击者控制的内容并执行对应浏览器动作。在 4 种 agent 配置、6 个 VLM backbone、覆盖 13 个公开网站与沙箱基准的 2,250 个任务上，平均攻击成功率 91.9%，最强基线仅 17.4%，且对三种 agent 级防御仍有效。
Motivation: 现有视觉红队方法只操纵模型推理，未显式处理结构化输入处理与动作后处理，模型层成功无法证明对浏览器执行的控制，也无法刻画端到端 agent 鲁棒性。
Method: WebMirage 用 role-slot 抽象与网页重组 (webpage recomposition) 建模网页元素间的竞争，用 dataflow 分析把优化目标与动作后处理对齐，从而生成跨不同网页渲染都生效的局部视觉扰动。
Result: 在 4 种 agent 配置、6 个 VLM backbone、2,250 个任务（13 个公开网站加一个沙箱基准）上，平均攻击成功率 91.9%，最强基线 17.4%；对三种 agent 级防御仍保持有效。
Conclusion: 模型层的对抗成功不等于端到端控制，必须把 grounding 到浏览器执行的整条链路纳入红队评估；WebMirage 表明局部视觉扰动足以跨渲染劫持实际浏览器动作。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Winner's Curse in LLM Self-Improvement Loops: Selection Noise, Lock-in, and Acceptance Rules
papers.abstract_en: Self-improving LLM systems propose changes to themselves and keep those that score better on a small evaluation set. We treat this keep-if-better step as selection under measurement noise, model the correlated errors of the candidates in a single decision, and study empirically what happens when the evaluation set is reused. In runs where Qwen models rewrite their own instructions and every candidate is also scored on 600 held-out items, most proposals after the first are harmful, and the model gives the size of the winner's curse of a generation's best candidate. With a prior from a separate pilot, it matches the average overstatement of first-generation commits in native loops, though not setting by setting. In a pre-registered study, the final selection-set score of greedy loops exceeded held-out accuracy by 13 to 20 points with 16 selection items and by 1 to 5 points with 256. Held-out gains grew with the selection set on TREC but not on GSM8K, and the tested acceptance rules did not beat greedy acceptance over whole runs. Gains measured on the selection set also exceeded held-out gains when a current model refined a competent instruction, and in the validation scores of GEPA and MIPROv2. Scoring the starting and the current instruction on 64 items never used for selection removes the average bias of a loop's reported gain, but single estimates remain off by about 6 points. Self-improvement studies should report held-out gains with their uncertainty.
papers.comment: 34 pages, 4 figures, 18 tables; code and saved experimental records included as ancillary files
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 自改进循环里“留优”这一步本质是带测量噪声的选择，复用小评估集会让每代最优候选被系统性高估。预注册实验显示：16 个选择样本时贪心循环的选择集分数比 held-out 准确率虚高 13–20 个百分点，256 个样本仍虚高 1–5 个百分点；用 64 个从未参与选择的条目打分可消除平均偏差，但单次估计仍偏差约 6 个百分点。作者主张自改进研究必须报告 held-out 增益及其不确定性。
Motivation: 自改进 LLM 用小评估集反复筛选候选改动，选择集被复用后测量噪声会累积成赢家诅咒，报告的增益可能与真实泛化脱节，使自改进研究的结论不可信。
Method: 把 keep-if-better 建模为测量噪声下的选择问题，并刻画单次决策中候选间相关误差；Qwen 模型改写自身指令的循环中，每个候选额外在 600 个 held-out 条目上打分，并用独立 pilot 的先验对第一代提交的平均高估做匹配；另做预注册研究比较贪心接受与多种接受规则，并在 TREC、GSM8K 以及 GEPA、MIPROv2 的验证分数上检验。
Result: 首次之后的多数提案是有害的；预注册研究中贪心循环的选择集分数超出 held-out 准确率 13–20 个百分点（16 个选择条目）与 1–5 个百分点（256 个条目）；held-out 增益随选择集增大在 TREC 上升、在 GSM8K 上不升；被测接受规则在整个运行上未胜过贪心接受；当前模型改进一份合格指令时，选择集增益同样高于 held-out 增益，GEPA 与 MIPROv2 的验证分数亦然；用 64 个从未用于选择的条目给起始与当前指令打分可去掉循环报告增益的平均偏差，但单次估计仍偏差约 6 个百分点。
Conclusion: 选择集复用会把赢家诅咒注入自改进循环，报告的增益系统性高于真实泛化；自改进研究应报告 held-out 增益及其不确定性，且更严的接受规则并未在整轮运行上优于贪心接受。
Relevance: 2
