papers.title: Train4Merge: A Controlled Single-Teacher Study of RL vs. SFT Teachers for OPD-Based Model Merging
papers.abstract_en: Domain experts trained from a shared checkpoint can transfer their specialized capabilities to a single student through on-policy distillation (OPD). Existing research primarily focuses on improving this merging process, while the algorithms used to train the experts have received limited systematic comparison. We investigate which training algorithm produces teachers better suited to OPD through controlled single-teacher comparisons of supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) across Agentic, Reasoning, and Perception. Teachers and students share the same Qwen3.5-9B initialization, and the two teacher types are compared at similar task performance. Our experiments show that RL teachers yield stronger students and higher recovery of teacher performance gains across all three domains. At their best checkpoints, RL-guided students outperform SFT-guided students by 4.27, 1.50, and 0.86 percentage points, respectively. In Agentic, the best SFT-guided student recovers only 44.44% of its teacher's performance gain over the base model, whereas the best RL-guided student recovers 115.00%, surpassing its teacher. Our further analysis shows that RL teachers undergo smaller parameter displacements from the shared initialization than SFT teachers. These findings support the hypothesis that RL teachers' smaller departures from the student's starting point facilitate learning through OPD, resulting in stronger students.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在共享初始化下做受控单教师对比，RL 教师经 on-policy distillation (OPD) 蒸馏出的学生在 Agentic、Reasoning、Perception 三个域都强于 SFT 教师的学生，最佳检查点分别领先 4.27、1.50、0.86 个百分点。Agentic 域 RL 学生恢复教师相对 base model 增益的 115.00%（超过教师），SFT 仅 44.44%。作者归因于 RL 教师相对共享初始化的参数位移更小，更贴近学生起点。
Motivation: OPD 把多个专家能力合并进单个学生，但现有工作集中在改进合并过程本身，训练专家所用算法（RL 还是 SFT）缺少系统对比。
Method: 受控单教师对比：教师与学生共享 Qwen3.5-9B 初始化，在 Agentic、Reasoning、Perception 三域分别训练 SFT 教师与 RL 教师，并在相近任务性能水平上比较；随后各自通过 OPD 蒸馏到同一学生，并测量教师相对共享初始化的参数位移。
Result: 最佳检查点处 RL 指导学生在三域分别领先 SFT 指导学生 4.27、1.50、0.86 个百分点；Agentic 域最佳 SFT 学生仅恢复教师相对 base model 增益的 44.44%，最佳 RL 学生恢复 115.00% 并超过其教师；分析显示 RL 教师相对共享初始化的参数位移小于 SFT 教师。
Conclusion: RL 教师因偏离学生起点更小而更利于 OPD 学习，产出更强的学生；在相近任务性能下，选 RL 而非 SFT 作为 OPD 教师。

papers.title: HGPTrans: Hierarchical Graph-Pooling Transolver for Automotive Aerodynamic Drag Coefficient Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Accurate and rapid prediction of the aerodynamic drag coefficient ($C_D$) is essential for vehicle design, particularly during early-stage design, where many candidate geometries must be evaluated. Although computational fluid dynamics (CFD) provides reliable aerodynamic estimates, its high computational cost limits large-scale design exploration. This paper proposes the hierarchical graph-pooling Transolver (HGPTrans), which combines hierarchical graph pooling with Transolver-based attention to directly predict $C_D$ from vehicle surface meshes. Motivated by the fact that vehicle aerodynamics depends on both local geometric features and long-range interactions among spatially distant surface regions, HGPTrans integrates three complementary components. Graph isomorphism convolutions encode discriminative local geometry, Transolver-style slice attention captures global interactions with linear computational complexity, and information-redundancy-aware hierarchical pooling progressively removes redundant nodes while preserving informative geometric structures. The model is trained and evaluated on the large-scale DrivAerNet and DrivAerNet++ datasets, where it achieves the lowest mean absolute error and mean squared error among the evaluated baselines. Its generalization capability is further assessed through transfer learning on a real-vehicle dataset containing both sedans and sport utility vehicles (SUVs), achieving relative $L_1$ errors of 1.56\% (sedans) and 2.12\% (SUVs) with an inference time of approximately $0.293$ s per vehicle. This corresponds to an acceleration of several orders of magnitude relative to high-fidelity CFD while keeping the predicted drag coefficients within a few percent of the CFD reference. Ablation studies confirm each component's contribution and reveal the effects of depth and pooling ratio.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HGPTrans 把分层图池化与 Transolver 的 slice attention 结合，直接从车辆表面网格预测气动阻力系数 C_D：GIN 卷积编码局部几何，slice attention 以线性复杂度捕捉远距离表面区域的全局相互作用，冗余感知的分层池化逐步删冗余节点。在 DrivAerNet 与 DrivAerNet++ 上取得所评估基线中最低的 MAE 与 MSE，迁移到真实车型数据集后相对 L1 误差为轿车 1.56%、SUV 2.12%，单车推理约 0.293 s。
Motivation: CFD 精度可靠但计算代价高，早期设计阶段需要评估大量候选几何，无法支撑大规模设计探索。
Method: 三个互补组件：图同构卷积 (GIN) 编码判别性局部几何，Transolver 式 slice attention 以线性复杂度捕捉全局交互，信息冗余感知的分层池化在保留几何结构的同时逐步移除冗余节点；在 DrivAerNet 与 DrivAerNet++ 上训练评估，并用真实车辆数据集做迁移学习，另有消融研究考察各组件、深度与池化比例的作用。
Result: 在 DrivAerNet 与 DrivAerNet++ 上取得所评估基线中最低的 MAE 与 MSE；迁移学习到含轿车与 SUV 的真实车辆数据集，相对 L1 误差分别为 1.56%（轿车）与 2.12%（SUV），单车推理时间约 0.293 s，相对高保真 CFD 加速若干数量级，预测 C_D 与 CFD 参考值偏差在几个百分点以内。
Conclusion: 局部几何、全局交互与冗余池化三者结合即可从表面网格直接回归 C_D，在保持几个百分点精度的同时把推理压到亚秒级，适合早期设计阶段的大规模几何筛选。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Ordinary Nonconvex SGD under Distance-Dependent Moments: Finite-Horizon Stationarity and Nagaev Bounds
papers.abstract_en: Uniform noise-moment bounds exclude stochastic gradients whose variability increases with the iterate. We study ordinary, single-sample stochastic gradient descent for smooth, lower-bounded, possibly nonconvex objectives under distance-dependent conditional moments. Under second moments alone, a direct descent--displacement argument yields $T^{-1/3}$ expected average squared-gradient stationarity with a horizon-dependent stepsize. An explicit oracle-complexity corollary matches the known smooth Blum--Gladyshev (BG-0) lower bound, including the $Lb_2Δ^3\varepsilon^{-6}$ and $LΔσ^2\varepsilon^{-4}$ stochastic terms, where $Δ$ is the initial objective gap and $σ^2+b_2\|x-x_1\|^2$ bounds the variance. Thus unchanged SGD attains the minimax stochastic complexity in this second-moment class. For $p>2$, predictable localization and a Hilbert-space Fuk--Nagaev inequality yield a high-probability bound separating logarithmic variance and polynomial rare-shock contributions. The localization radius is derived from the recursion: no bounded-iterate assumption, clipping, normalization, momentum, or increasing batch size is needed. We also give increasing-confidence rates, an objective-gap-growth refinement recovering root-$T$ stationarity, and stochastic $L^p$-Lipschitz examples. The broad BG-0 optimality statement is distinguished from the smaller mean-square-smooth class, in which additional oracle structure permits faster algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文研究非凸目标下普通单样本 SGD 在方差随迭代点距离增长（distance-dependent moments）时的收敛速率：二阶矩下用下降-位移论证得到期望平均平方梯度 T^{-1/3} 的驻点率，其 oracle 复杂度匹配已知 Blum–Gladyshev (BG-0) 下界，说明未改动的 SGD 在该二阶矩类中即达 minimax 随机复杂度。
Motivation: 传统 SGD 收敛分析假设噪声矩一致有界，排除了随机梯度方差随迭代点发散的情形；需要在更一般的距离相关矩条件下重新判定普通 SGD 能达到的最优复杂度。
Method: 对光滑、下有界、可非凸的目标，在条件矩随距离增长的设定下：二阶矩情形用 descent–displacement 论证配 horizon-dependent 步长；p>2 情形用 predictable localization 加 Hilbert 空间 Fuk–Nagaev 不等式做高概率界，定位半径由递推导出，不需有界迭代、clipping、归一化、动量或增大批量。
Result: 二阶矩下得到期望平均平方梯度 T^{-1/3} 驻点率；oracle 复杂度含 Lb_2Δ^3ε^{-6} 与 LΔσ^2ε^{-4} 两个随机项，匹配 BG-0 下界（Δ 为初始目标间隙，方差界为 σ^2+b_2‖x−x_1‖²）；p>2 时高概率界把对数方差项与多项式 rare-shock 贡献分离；另给出 increasing-confidence 速率、恢复 root-T 驻点率的目标间隙增长细化，以及随机 L^p-Lipschitz 例子。
Conclusion: 在距离相关二阶矩这一大类下，不改动的 SGD 已达 minimax 随机 oracle 复杂度；但作者强调 BG-0 的最优性是宽泛陈述，在均方光滑这一更小类中额外 oracle 结构可支持更快算法。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Heartian: Physiology-Aware Relightable Gaussian Head Avatar
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian head avatars typically model intrinsic facial appearance as temporally static, omitting subtle cardiac-induced skin-color variation. We propose Heartian, a physiology-aware modulation framework that learns cardiac-cycle-dependent per-frame albedo modulation of facial skin-region Gaussians within a relightable head avatar to encode remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) signals. Using synchronized contact PPG supervision, Heartian models the prescribed cardiac waveform as the sum of two Gaussian functions and learns per-frame spatial residuals via a lightweight MLP. Across 152 stationary recordings from UBFC-rPPG, PURE, and MMPD, attribute-space recovery of the supplied signal achieves a pooled recording-level heart-rate MAE of 0.29 bpm and MAPE of 0.38%. The signals remain detectable after rendering by benchmark rPPG methods, with the best tested configuration - a motion-augmented TS-CAN decoder pretrained on UBFC-rPPG - recovering heart rate from the rendered MMPD avatars at 0.97 bpm MAE and 1.21% MAPE. Meanwhile, Heartian maintains reconstruction quality comparable to the baseline, with negligible average PSNR degradation of 0.005 dB. Overall, our work embeds recoverable rPPG signals as controllable material attributes to subject-specific Gaussian head avatars while retaining the reconstruction quality.
papers.comment: 4 pages of manuscript and 2 pages of supplementary material; SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Technical Communications
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Heartian 把心跳周期相关的逐帧反照率调制写进可重光照 Gaussian 头身 avatar，使皮肤颜色携带可恢复的 rPPG 信号。在 UBFC-rPPG、PURE、MMPD 共 152 段静止录像上，属性空间恢复心率 MAE 0.29 bpm、MAPE 0.38%；渲染后由 motion-augmented TS-CAN 解码器在 MMPD avatar 上恢复 MAE 0.97 bpm、MAPE 1.21%，同时 PSNR 平均仅降 0.005 dB。
Motivation: Gaussian 头身 avatar 通常把面部固有外观当作时间静态，遗漏心跳引起的细微皮肤颜色变化，渲染结果因此不含可被 rPPG 检测的生理信号。
Method: 在可重光照头身 avatar 中对皮肤区域 Gaussian 学习随心动周期变化的逐帧反照率调制：用心电同步的接触式 PPG 作监督，把规定的心动波形写成两个 Gaussian 函数之和，再用轻量 MLP 学习逐帧空间残差；渲染结果交给 benchmark rPPG 方法检测。
Result: 在 UBFC-rPPG、PURE、MMPD 的 152 段静止录像上，属性空间恢复所注入信号的记录级心率 MAE 0.29 bpm、MAPE 0.38%；渲染后信号仍可被 benchmark rPPG 方法检出，最佳配置（在 UBFC-rPPG 预训练的 motion-augmented TS-CAN 解码器）从渲染的 MMPD avatar 恢复心率 MAE 0.97 bpm、MAPE 1.21%；重建质量与基线相当，平均 PSNR 仅下降 0.005 dB。
Conclusion: 把可恢复的 rPPG 信号作为可控材质属性嵌入 subject-specific Gaussian 头身 avatar 是可行的，且几乎不损失重建质量。

papers.title: Do Language Models Need Music Supervision? Verifiable Rewards for Multi-Constraint Symbolic Music Generation
papers.abstract_en: Language models now generate symbolic music from text, and research has focused on musicality. However, many applications require a score that meets explicit constraints, which models struggle to satisfy jointly: on MusicConstraintBench, our benchmark of 2,180 items over eight families of programmatically verifiable constraints, Llama-3.1-70B satisfies 0.630 of single-constraint items but only 0.044 of four-constraint ones. As a remedy, we introduce MusicRLVR, which trains a language model with group relative policy optimisation (GRPO) on verifier rewards alone, needing no human annotation, reward model or music-domain supervised fine-tuning. MusicRLVR incorporates (1) a hard validation gate that rejects malformed scores, (2) graded per-family credit that, unlike a binary reward, separates partially correct outputs, and (3) an all-satisfied bonus for meeting every constraint at once. Extensive experiments show that, in under four hours of training, MusicRLVR raises Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 from 0.160 to 0.797 on mixed constraints, outperforming Llama-3.1-70B, and generalises to unseen property combinations, out-of-range parameters and more constraints than any training prompt. The recipe transfers to Qwen3-8B, and neither trained model loses significant accuracy on general benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 符号音乐生成中语言模型难以同时满足多条显式约束：Llama-3.1-70B 在 MusicConstraintBench 单约束项满足率 0.630，四项约束时骤降至 0.044。仅用可验证奖励的 GRPO 训练（MusicRLVR）把 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 在混合约束上从 0.160 提到 0.797，超过 Llama-3.1-70B，且训练不足四小时、无需人工标注、奖励模型或音乐领域监督微调。
Motivation: 文本到符号音乐的模型只优化音乐性，而实际应用需要乐谱同时满足多条可程序化验证的显式约束，现有模型在约束数量增加时联合满足率崩溃。
Method: MusicRLVR 用 GRPO 仅以验证器奖励训练语言模型，含三部分：硬校验门拒绝格式错误的乐谱、按约束族分级的部分正确信用、以及全部满足时的额外奖励；训练数据为自建的 MusicConstraintBench（2,180 项、八族可程序化验证约束）。
Result: MusicConstraintBench 上 Llama-3.1-70B 单约束满足 0.630、四约束仅 0.044；MusicRLVR 训练不足四小时使 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 混合约束满足率 0.160 → 0.797 并超过 Llama-3.1-70B；可泛化到未见属性组合、超范围参数和比任何训练提示更多的约束；配方迁移到 Qwen3-8B，两个模型在通用基准上均无显著精度损失。
Conclusion: 纯验证器奖励的 RLVR 配方（硬校验门 + 分级信用 + 全满足奖励）足以让小模型在多约束符号音乐生成上超过大模型，且不牺牲通用能力。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Kinks vs. Smoothness: Identifiability of Real Analytic nICA for Laplace-like Sources
papers.abstract_en: Many machine learning systems try to explain complex data - like images or financial time series - in terms of hidden, independent factors that generated them. Recovering the true underlying factors, rather than some scrambled version of them, is the central challenge of nonlinear Independent Component Analysis (nICA). We prove identifiability (exact recovery) up to trivial ambiguities for real analytic generating functions when source probability density functions have a finite number of discontinuities in the first derivative. The Laplace distribution is the most prominent example satisfying this assumption. Our proof relies on the contrast between kinks in the source distribution and the smoothness of real analytic functions. Real analytic functions comprise a broad class of generating mechanisms, and can be approximated with Normalizing Flows or Variational Autoencoders with standard activation functions (e.g., tanh, softplus, GELU), so our result applies with minimal changes to existing training pipelines. We perform experiments on real and synthetic data with both Normalizing Flows and Variational Auto-Encoders demonstrating their identifiability properties. In experiments on CelebA data we recover several interpretable latent factors controlling unique attributes across the dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明当源分布的一阶导数只有有限个间断点（Laplace 分布为典型例）时，实解析生成函数的非线性独立成分分析 (nICA) 可辨识到平凡歧义，靠的是源分布的 kink 与实解析函数光滑性的对比。该结论可经 Normalizing Flows 或 VAE（tanh、softplus、GELU 等标准激活）以最小改动接入现有训练流程，并在真实与合成数据上验证可辨识性。
Motivation: nICA 的核心难题是恢复真实隐因子而非任意打乱版本，而以往对生成函数的可辨识性条件往往过窄，难以覆盖实际使用的生成模型类。
Method: 对实解析生成函数证明可辨识性，假设源概率密度的一阶导数仅有有限个间断点（Laplace 分布满足）；证明利用源分布 kink 与实解析函数光滑性的对比。结论可由 Normalizing Flows 或配标准激活（tanh、softplus、GELU）的 VAE 承载，实验在真实与合成数据上用这两类模型进行。
Result: 在 CelebA 数据上用 Normalizing Flows 与 VAE 恢复出若干控制数据集独特属性的可解释隐因子；同时在真实与合成数据上展示了所提可辨识性性质。
Conclusion: 源分布的有限个一阶导数间断点足以让实解析 nICA 精确恢复真实因子，且该条件与现有 NF/VAE 训练管线兼容。

papers.title: Hiding in Plain Sight: A Diffusion-based Mitigation of Geolocation Privacy Leakage in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large reasoning models (MLRMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in complex visual understanding. However, this very power introduces a critical yet underexplored privacy threat: adversaries can exploit MLRMs to precisely infer users' geographic locations from casually shared photographs, by performing structured reasoning over subtle visual cues such as architectural styles, vegetation, and lighting conditions. In this work, we present a systematic study of MLRM-driven geolocation privacy leakage. We first reveal that refusal-based safeguards are critically insufficient, as carefully crafted jailbreak prompts can raise model response rates to 100%. We further identify that existing defenses, which inject imperceptible perturbations into shared images, suffer from structural limitations intrinsic to their pixel-space optimization, resulting in degraded black-box transferability and pronounced visual artifacts. Motivated by these findings, we propose a diffusion-based framework that provides targeted, proactive defense against geolocation privacy leakage. By injecting perturbations into the latent space of a diffusion model during reverse sampling, our method operates directly on high-level semantic representations, thereby resolving the effectiveness-utility bottlenecks by construction. We further ground our optimization with GeoCLIP, a model explicitly aligned with GPS coordinates, as a surrogate to pinpoint and disrupt the geographic signals that MLRMs exploit for location inference. This targeted semantic disruption yields significantly stronger black-box transferability while preserving perceptual image quality, offering a seamless integration on social media platforms. Code is available at https://github.com/RachelWolowitz/Hiding_in_plain_sight.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对多模态大推理模型 (MLRM) 从日常照片推断地理位置的隐私泄露，提出在扩散模型反向采样时向潜空间注入扰动、并以 GeoCLIP 作为代理目标定向破坏地理语义信号的防御框架。仅靠拒绝式防护会被精心构造的越狱提示打穿，模型响应率可达 100%；该潜空间方法在保持感知画质的同时取得显著更强的黑盒迁移性。
Motivation: MLRM 能通过建筑风格、植被、光照等线索精确推断照片拍摄地，而拒绝式防护可被越狱提示绕过；现有像素空间扰动防御存在结构性缺陷，黑盒迁移性差且产生明显视觉伪影。
Method: 在扩散模型反向采样过程中向潜空间注入扰动，直接作用于高层语义表征；用与 GPS 坐标对齐的 GeoCLIP 作为代理目标，定位并破坏 MLRM 用于位置推理的地理信号，实现定向语义破坏。
Result: 精心构造的越狱提示可将模型响应率提升至 100%；所提方法相对像素空间防御取得显著更强的黑盒迁移性，同时保持感知图像质量，可无缝集成到社交媒体平台。
Conclusion: 拒绝式防护不足，像素空间扰动受优化空间限制；把扰动放到扩散潜空间并以 GeoCLIP 定向破坏地理语义，可同时解决有效性与可用性瓶颈。

papers.title: DataCanvas-EDU: An Agentic Framework for Instructor-Guided Synthetic Data Generation in Business Analytics Education
papers.abstract_en: Business analytics education requires diverse datasets to support different learning objectives, student backgrounds, and analytical tasks. Real-world data can be difficult to obtain and offer limited flexibility for adapting a case to a particular course. Even when suitable data are available, instructors must investigate the patterns, verify the results, and prepare assignments and reference solutions, requiring substantial time and effort. The use of large language models (LLMs) introduces an additional concern about training data contamination. Widely used public datasets often have extensive tutorials and worked analyses that models may have encountered during training. Students may therefore receive explanations drawn from existing analyses without practicing how to investigate unfamiliar data in collaboration with AI. This paper presents DataCanvas-EDU, an agentic framework for instructor-guided synthetic data generation in business analytics education. Instructors specify teaching goals and intended patterns through conversation, while an AI agent writes generation code, checks the resulting data, and prepares assignments, reference analyses, and rubrics. Four phases, Plan, Create, Verify / Test Analysis, and Evaluate, organize the process and support instructor review and revision. The framework is intended to simplify case preparation while creating opportunities for students to investigate newly designed patterns with AI. We illustrate the approach with WindowDash, a food delivery case containing 15,000 orders and nine designed patterns. DataCanvas-EDU is packaged as a reusable AI Agent Skill for compatible agent environments, with the package and installation instructions available at https://github.com/BANG23333/datacanvas-edu
papers.comment: Synthetic Dataset, Agentic Framework, Data Analytics Education, Data Visualization
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DataCanvas-EDU 是面向商科分析教学的 agentic 框架：教师通过对话指定教学目标与预期模式，AI agent 自己写生成代码、校验数据，并产出作业、参考分析与评分标准，流程按 Plan、Create、Verify/Test Analysis、Evaluate 四阶段组织。用含 15,000 条外卖订单和 9 个设计模式的 WindowDash 案例演示，并打包为可复用的 AI Agent Skill，以规避公开数据集被 LLM 训练数据污染的问题。
Motivation: 商科分析课难以获得既多样又能贴合课程目标的真实数据，教师还需自行核查模式、准备作业与参考解；而常用公开数据集往往已有大量教程，LLM 可能直接复述现成分析，学生失去在陌生数据上与 AI 协作探究的机会。
Method: 教师以对话方式给出教学目标与预期模式，agent 生成数据生成代码、检查产出数据，并生成作业、参考分析与 rubric；Plan、Create、Verify/Test Analysis、Evaluate 四阶段支持教师逐轮审阅与修订；整体以 AI Agent Skill 形式发布在 GitHub。
Result: 以 WindowDash 外卖配送案例演示该流程，数据集含 15,000 条订单和 9 个设计模式；框架以可复用 AI Agent Skill 打包并附安装说明。
Conclusion: 教师引导的合成数据生成可以简化案例准备，同时让学生在新设计的模式上与 AI 一起做探究，而不是复述公开数据集的既有分析。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Building Trust in Artificial Intelligence: A Necessity for Railway Applications
papers.abstract_en: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is currently only applied to non-safety critical applications due to the strict standards and regulations for railway industries. We propose to review the three main fields necessary to increase trust in data science and AI algorithms and reach compliance: robustness, Operational Design Domain (ODD), and explainability. Robustness is the ability of an AI system to maintain its level of performance under any circumstances (ISO24029). ODDs allow the explicit definition of operating conditions under which a system is intended to operate, according to the recently published DIN DKE SPEC 99004. Explainability is the property of an AI system to express important factors influencing the AI system results in a way that humans can understand. Those 3 domains of research are already well investigated by nonrailway actors, with algorithms and methods ready to use for railway applications. A system view is necessary to ensure all trustworthy requirements interact continuously in a safe MLOps environment thereby fostering acceptance from regulators, operators and the public. Beyond safeguarding safety-critical applications, we aim to show that fostering deep trust in AI, as now required by regulatory frameworks worldwide, will unlock its full potential and transform the pace of adoption across mission-critical domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文主张铁路安全关键 AI 落地的前置条件是同时满足鲁棒性 (ISO24029)、运行设计域 (ODD, DIN DKE SPEC 99004) 与可解释性三方面要求，并用系统视角把三者放进持续交互的安全 MLOps 环境。作者认为这三项在非铁路领域已有可直接复用的算法与方法，建立深度信任才能解锁 AI 在关键任务领域的应用速度。
Motivation: 铁路行业标准与法规严格，AI 目前只能用于非安全关键场景；鲁棒性、ODD、可解释性各自被非铁路界研究，但缺少把三者作为相互作用的整体来满足合规要求的框架。
Method: 综述式框架：分别梳理鲁棒性（ISO24029 定义的性能保持能力）、ODD（按 DIN DKE SPEC 99004 显式定义系统预期运行条件）与可解释性（以人可理解方式表达影响结果的关键因素）三个领域，再以系统视角整合到安全 MLOps 环境中，使各项可信需求持续交互。
Result: 论文给出三项可信要求的标准化定义来源（ISO24029、DIN DKE SPEC 99004）并指出这三类研究在非铁路领域已成熟、算法与方法可直接用于铁路；提出系统级 MLOps 整合视角以服务监管方、运营方与公众的接受度。
Conclusion: 满足全球监管框架要求的深度可信 AI 不只是安全合规的保障，还会解锁 AI 潜力并加快其在关键任务领域的采用节奏。

papers.title: Loop-Back Authority in LLM Agent Teams: A Paired Experiment on Flat and Hierarchical Coordination
papers.abstract_en: Does authority in AI teams improve the outcome? Organizational theory asserts that authority facilitates decision making, improving quality. Meanwhile, some nascent AI research suggests that revision under authority makes LLM output worse. Multi-agent LLM frameworks default to giving a Manager agent the authority to send a worker's output back for revision. Prior comparisons test the effect of authority using verifiable tasks. We conduct an experiment on an open-ended task, business-intelligence reporting, using a sample of 43 paired laptop products and 86 runs. Each report is written once by a hierarchical team and once by a flat team. We find that flat teams produce higher-quality reports, scoring higher on Utility (d = 0.42, p = 0.009) and Writing Clarity (d = 0.34, p = 0.030). The reports are the same length, but hierarchical team reports use 53% more hedging words such as "may" and "could", and each revision is associated with a 0.14-point drop in Writing Clarity on a 1 to 5 scale. Before any revision, the hierarchical team's first draft is indistinguishable from the flat team's report. In other words, the quality gap can be traced to revision. Authority improves quality when the Manager can verify the work, else when it can only provide feedback it has a negative effect on quality.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables, plus 21 pages of supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/cihatburak/loop-back-authority-llm-agents
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在开放式任务（商业智能报告）上，让 Manager 拥有把工人产出打回重写的权力反而降低质量：43 对笔记本产品、86 次运行的配对实验中，扁平团队报告在 Utility（d=0.42, p=0.009）与 Writing Clarity（d=0.34, p=0.030）上更高，且每次重写伴随 Writing Clarity 下降 0.14 分（1–5 分制）。结论是：Manager 能验证结果时权威有益，只能给反馈时权威为负。
Motivation: 组织理论认为权威促进决策、提升质量，而新兴 AI 研究发现 LLM 在权威下重写反而变差；此前对比多用可验证任务，开放式任务上权威（回环打回重写）的净效应未知。
Method: 配对实验：同一开放式任务（商业智能报告）分别由层级团队（Manager 可打回重写）与扁平团队各写一次，样本为 43 对笔记本产品、共 86 次运行；按 Utility、Writing Clarity 评分并统计 hedging 词与每次重写的效应。
Result: 扁平团队报告质量更高：Utility d=0.42（p=0.009）、Writing Clarity d=0.34（p=0.030）；报告长度相同，但层级团队多用 53% 的 hedging 词（如 may、could）；每次重写与 Writing Clarity 下降 0.14 分（1–5 分制）相关；重写前层级团队初稿与扁平团队报告无差别。
Conclusion: 权威的作用取决于 Manager 能否验证工作：可验证时提升质量，只能给反馈时为负效应；本例中的质量差距可归因于重写环节本身。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Finite-Sample FDR Control for Greedy Aggregation over Networks
papers.abstract_en: Distributed multiple testing asks $N$ sites, each holding p-values for its own hypotheses, to control the false discovery rate (FDR) of the discoveries made across the whole network while communicating only a small number of bits. Greedy interval aggregation (Pournaderi and Xiang, IEEE TSIPN, 2023) meets the communication budget but controls FDR only asymptotically, and its FDR can exceed the target at finite sample sizes; the same interval counts both select the rejection regions and calibrate the stopping rule, which biases the selected interval densities upward. We propose \emph{budgeted BONuS-GA}: each site mixes synthetic uniform p-values into its data, the center ranks candidate p-value intervals across sites using the pooled counts, and each site's false discoveries are estimated from its own synthetic counts under a per-site share of the level. The procedure needs no knowledge of the null proportions, uses every p-value for both selection and inference, and controls $FDR\leα$ at every sample size for any fixed assignment of hypotheses to sites, assuming only that the null p-values are independent uniforms, independent of the non-null p-values. It keeps the original $O(\sqrt m\log m)$ communication, $m$ being the total number of p-values, when $N=O(\sqrt m)$. We also give a sample-splitting alternative, cross-fit greedy aggregation, with finite-sample control under a random-site model, and we quantify the selection bias behind the original procedure's failure. In a monitoring-network simulation the budgeted procedure retains most of the power of its heuristic counterpart at moderate-to-large site sizes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 分布式多重检验中，贪心区间聚合 (greedy interval aggregation) 用同一份区间计数既选拒绝域又标定停止规则，导致有限样本下 FDR 可能超过目标。作者提出 budgeted BONuS-GA：各站点混入合成均匀 p 值，中心用合并计数排序候选区间，各站点的假发现由自身合成计数在分站点水平份额下估计，从而在任意样本量下保证 FDR≤α，且在 N=O(√m) 时保持 O(√m log m) 通信量。
Motivation: 分布式多重检验要求各站点只用少量比特通信就控制全网 FDR；已有 greedy interval aggregation 满足通信预算，但只在渐近意义下控制 FDR，有限样本时 FDR 可能超出目标，根因是同一区间计数同时用于选择与推断造成的选择偏差。
Method: budgeted BONuS-GA：每个站点把合成均匀 p 值混入自身数据，中心用合并计数对跨站点候选 p 值区间排序，各站点的假发现由其自身合成计数在分站点水平份额 (per-site share of the level) 下估计；无需知道 null 比例，每个 p 值同时用于选择与推断。另给出样本分裂版本 cross-fit greedy aggregation，在 random-site 模型下提供有限样本控制，并量化原方法失效背后的选择偏差。
Result: 在 null p 值独立均匀且独立于非 null p 值的假设下，对任意固定的假设-站点分配，FDR≤α 在每个样本量都成立；N=O(√m) 时通信量保持 O(√m log m)，m 为 p 值总数。在监测网络仿真中，该 budgeted 过程在中等至大站点规模下保留了启发式版本的大部分功效。
Conclusion: 用合成均匀 p 值为每个站点单独校准假发现，可以在不牺牲通信预算的前提下把贪心区间聚合的渐近 FDR 控制提升为有限样本控制，代价是在中等站点规模下损失少量功效。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Data Scarcity and Model Sparsity: Mixtures-of-Experts Overfit More to Repeated Data
papers.abstract_en: As the supply of human-written text is exhausted, it has become standard practice to repeat language model training data. Prior work has studied data repetition for densely activated Transformers, but the effects of data repetition remains largely unexplored for recently dominant sparse architectures such as Mixture-of-Experts (MoE), despite their increased compute efficiency. We vary data repetition rates across single- and multi-domain data mixes, and across MoE settings, including expert count and granularity. We consistently find, for models ranging from 80M to 1B active (8.5B total) parameters, that MoEs degrade more rapidly under data repetition. This effect increases with sparsity, dictated by total rather than active parameters. While 80M dense models can repeat data over 8x with minimal degradation, MoEs instead begin to suffer at 4x, and deteriorate rapidly, ceding their performance benefits in all-unique data settings to underperform dense models after 32x. We experiment with existing regularization methods as a potential remedy. We find that some methods, such as dropout, can mitigate overfitting. In particular, with strong masking-based regularization, MoEs are able to outperform dense models even when data is repeated more than 64 times. However, no method fully matches the performance of all-unique training data. Finally, we analyze internal mechanisms correlated with MoE overfitting in high repetition regimes, and find that MoE routing universally stabilizes early in training, and that expert specialization correlates with overfitting to repeated data. In sum, our work addresses the adverse interactions between sparsity and data repetition: we present evidence for the core mechanisms of overfitting and its potential remediation, and suggest promising avenues for future methods to reduce over-specialization in model parameters by disrupting memorization patterns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在数据重复训练下，稀疏 MoE 比稠密 Transformer 过拟合更快，且稀疏度越高退化越严重，由总参数量而非激活参数量决定。80M 稠密模型可重复 8x 数据几乎无损，MoE 在 4x 就开始受损，32x 时性能优势完全丧失并低于稠密模型；强 masking 正则可让 MoE 在 64x 以上重复时反超稠密模型。
Motivation: 人类文本供给见顶，重复训练数据已成常态；此前数据重复研究只覆盖稠密 Transformer，对已成为主流的 MoE 稀疏架构影响几乎未被探索。
Method: 在单域与多域数据混合上系统改变数据重复率，并变化 MoE 的专家数与 granularity；模型规模覆盖 80M 到 1B 激活参数（8.5B 总参数），对照稠密模型；随后试验 dropout 等既有正则方法作为补救，并分析与 MoE 过拟合相关的内部机制。
Result: MoE 在 4x 重复即开始退化，稠密 80M 模型可承受 8x 重复且退化极小；32x 重复后 MoE 丧失全唯一数据下的性能优势并低于稠密模型。dropout 等方法可部分缓解过拟合，强 masking 正则使 MoE 在超过 64x 重复时仍优于稠密模型，但没有任何方法能完全恢复到全唯一数据训练的性能。机制分析显示 MoE 路由在训练早期即普遍稳定，专家 specialization 与对重复数据的过拟合相关。
Conclusion: 稀疏度与数据重复存在不利交互：过拟合由总参数量驱动，缓解方向是通过打散 memorization 模式来降低参数的过度 specialization，但现有正则方法均无法完全替代全唯一数据。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Generalised Score Matching on Convex Domains
papers.abstract_en: Score matching avoids computing the normalising constant that maximum-likelihood estimation requires. On constrained domains, its generalised variants weight the Fisher divergence so that boundary terms vanish. We derive generalised score matching on open convex subsets of $\mathbb{R}^{d}$ as the small-neighbourhood limit of minimum probability flow, in which the geometry of the neighbourhoods determines the weight. Every $C^{2}$ positive definite weight arises in this way, including those of classical score matching on $\mathbb{R}^{d}$ and of its variants for non-negative data on $\mathbb{R}_{+}^{d}$. For exponential families, we extend the standard convexity, consistency and asymptotic normality results to every such weight and show that the estimator converges to the true parameter under certain boundary conditions. For a truncated Gaussian on a polytope and a Dirichlet distribution on the simplex, proposed estimators attain the lowest median error of all methods compared, in at least 42 of 50 ground-truth configurations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把约束域上的广义 score matching 统一为 minimum probability flow 的小邻域极限，邻域几何决定权重，从而覆盖 R^d 经典形式与 R_+^d 非负数据变体。对指数族把凸性、一致性、渐近正态性推广到任意 C^2 正定权重，并在多面体上的截断高斯与单纯形上的 Dirichlet 分布中，所提估计量在至少 42/50 组真实参数配置上取得所有对比方法中最低的中位误差。
Motivation: 约束域上 score matching 需手工设计权重使边界项消失，各变体彼此孤立，缺少统一推导与理论保证。
Method: 在 R^d 的开凸子集上把广义 score matching 推导为 minimum probability flow 的小邻域极限，由邻域几何决定权重，证明每个 C^2 正定权重都可由此产生；对指数族把标准的凸性、一致性与渐近正态性结果推广到任意该类权重，并给出估计量在一定边界条件下收敛到真参数的条件。
Result: 对多面体上的截断高斯与单纯形上的 Dirichlet 分布，所提估计量在至少 42/50 组真实参数配置上取得所有对比方法中最低的中位误差。
Conclusion: 约束域上的广义 score matching 可由 minimum probability flow 的几何极限统一生成，且该框架下估计量在指数族上仍保持一致性与渐近正态性。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: The Semantic Bottleneck: Leveraging Semantic Representations for Non-Invasive Speech Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Non-invasive speech decoding remains constrained by the low signal-to-noise ratio of neural recordings, which makes fine-grained reconstruction of phonemes or individual words difficult. Motivated by neuroscientific evidence that high-level semantic representations are distributed across cortical regions and evolve over slower temporal scales, we hypothesize that semantic content may provide a more suitable target for non-invasive decoding than low-level acoustic or lexical features. We introduce Brain2Semantics2Text, a method that reconstructs text through an intermediate semantic embedding space. Our model maps sentence-level MEG responses into a semantic manifold and then inverts the predicted embeddings into natural language. This semantic bottleneck enables recovery of high-level meaning without word-level alignment. We describe the core principles of the approach, its implementation, and the strategies used to mitigate the challenges of learning a reliable neural-to-semantic mapping. Finally, we compare against prior non-invasive Brain2Text methods and show improved sentence-level results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Brain2Semantics2Text：把句子级 MEG 反应映射到语义嵌入流形，再反演回自然语言，用语义瓶颈绕开低信噪比神经信号下逐音素、逐词重建的困难。与既有非侵入式 Brain2Text 方法比较，句子级重建结果更优。
Motivation: 非侵入式神经信号信噪比低，音素与单词级细粒度重建困难；而高层语义表征跨皮层分布、时间尺度更慢，可能比声学或词汇特征更适合做解码目标。
Method: Brain2Semantics2Text 以句子级 MEG 响应为输入，先回归到语义嵌入空间形成语义瓶颈，再由预测的嵌入反演生成自然语言文本，无需词级对齐；摘要同时提到针对神经到语义映射可靠性的缓解策略。
Result: 与先前非侵入式 Brain2Text 方法比较，在句子级重建上取得更优结果（摘要未给出具体指标数值）。
Conclusion: 以语义嵌入为中间瓶颈，非侵入式解码可以恢复高层语义内容而不依赖词级对齐，句子级表现优于既有 Brain2Text 路线。

papers.title: What Does Multi-Agent Debate Actually Change?
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent debate, in which several LLMs exchange arguments before producing an answer, raises a basic question: does expressed disagreement reflect changes in the members' own positions? No single signal can settle this question, so we organize the analysis around five questions: (A) does the debater say it disagrees; (B) does its reply text actually argue; (C) does its own position change after each debate turn; (D) how much, quantitatively, does the position change; and (E) how do members' final positions compare with their initial ones? We evaluate two- and three-member committees on 50 curated opinion questions from GlobalOpinionQA, using same-model, same-family, and mixed-family configurations with friendly, neutral, and hostile instructions assigned at each turn. (A) Tone changes reported agreement: the share of replies reporting strong agreement is 70.7-96.3% under friendly instructions, compared with 9.5-19.3% under hostile ones, varying with model choice. (B) Self-reports broadly align with text judgments, but consistency varies by agreement level and model choice. (C) Position changes depend on the interaction: after a peer's leaning-disagree reply, members reporting strong agreement switch options more often than those reporting leaning disagreement. (D) For open-weight members, the probability of the option a member already holds stays near saturation, even after a peer's pushback, while endorsement of its earlier position text drops after a peer's argument relative to neutral filler, more for Qwen3.8-27B than Inkling. (E) The selected option is unchanged from members' initial to final positions in over 90% of comparisons in every configuration. Taken together, expressed disagreement need not translate into position revision, either within individual exchanges or over a complete debate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多智能体辩论 (multi-agent debate) 中表达出的分歧基本不等于立场被改写：在 GlobalOpinionQA 的 50 道观点题上，友好指令下报告强同意的回复占 70.7–96.3%，敌对指令下仅 9.5–19.3%，说明语气信号被指令直接操纵；但每种配置下超过 90% 的比较中成员最终选项与初始选项一致。作者据此把辩论效果拆成五个问题分别检验，结论是表达分歧不必转化为立场修正。
Motivation: 多智能体辩论被当作提升 LLM 判断的手段，但缺少能区分“嘴上不同意”和“自己立场真的变了”的证据；单一信号无法回答这一问题。
Method: 围绕五个问题组织分析：(A) 辩手是否自称不同意、(B) 回复文本是否真在论证、(C) 每轮辩论后自身立场是否改变、(D) 改变幅度、(E) 最终立场与初始立场对比。评测 2 人与 3 人委员会，覆盖 same-model、same-family、mixed-family 三种配置，每轮随机赋予 friendly、neutral、hostile 指令。
Result: 友好指令下报告强同意的回复占 70.7–96.3%，敌对指令下为 9.5–19.3%，随模型选择变化；自报与文本判断大体一致但一致性随同意程度和模型而变；同伴给出 leaning-disagree 回复后，报告强同意的成员比报告 leaning-disagree 的成员更常切换选项；对开放权重成员，其已持选项概率在同伴反驳后仍接近饱和，而对先前立场文本的认可度在同伴论证后较 neutral filler 下降，Qwen3.8-27B 降幅大于 Inkling；每种配置下超过 90% 的比较中最终选项与初始选项相同。
Conclusion: 指令语气能大幅摆动“是否同意”的表达，却几乎不动摇实际选项，因此多智能体辩论中的表达分歧不必等于立场修正，无论单次交换还是整场辩论。

papers.title: Decomposition-Guided Diffusion Language Models for Inertial Confinement Fusion Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Inertial confinement fusion (ICF) is a leading pathway toward clean energy, but each shot at the National Ignition Facility costs on the order of one million dollars, making accurate AI surrogates a high-value target. We study exogenous-driven ICF waveform prediction, where a 512-step neutron-rate diagnostic must be inferred directly from a laser pulse and target design parameters, with no historical response observed. The regime stresses standard time-series predictors with temporal sparsity (picosecond peak in a nanosecond window), input-output scale mismatch (under 300 real shots), and peak sensitivity (picosecond timing). We propose ICF-DLM, to our knowledge the first LM-based ICF predictor, combining (i) a physics-typed decomposition into yield $Y_{DT}$, peak timing $t_{\mathrm{peak}}$, and local waveform $w_{\mathrm{local}}$; (ii) bidirectional denoising that defers commitment to peak location; and (iii) a physics-driven PPO reward re-injecting metric structure across numeric tokens. On ICFBench (50K simulations + 232 experimental shots), ICF-DLM cuts peak-timing error from 11.6 to 9.2 steps over a matched autoregressive LLaMA-3-8B and outperforms classical sequence models and LLM-based time-series predictors. Beyond ICF, the recipe shows potential to address science domains with low data and sparse events.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ICF-DLM 把惯性约束聚变中 512 步中子率波形预测拆成产额 Y_DT、峰值时刻 t_peak 与局部波形 w_local 三个物理量，用双向去噪延迟对峰值位置的承诺，再以物理驱动的 PPO 奖励把度量结构重新注入数值 token。在 ICFBench（5 万次模拟 + 232 发实验 shot）上，峰值时刻误差相对同规模自回归 LLaMA-3-8B 从 11.6 步降到 9.2 步，并优于经典序列模型与 LLM 时间序列预测器。
Motivation: NIF 每发 shot 成本约一百万美元，需要 AI surrogate；但外生驱动的 ICF 波形预测没有历史响应可观测，512 步诊断里峰值只占皮秒级、真实 shot 不足 300 发，标准时间序列模型在时间稀疏、输入输出尺度失配和峰值敏感三方面同时失效。
Method: 提出 ICF-DLM，据称为首个基于语言模型的 ICF 预测器：物理类型化分解（Y_DT、t_peak、w_local）+ 双向去噪（bidirectional denoising）推迟对峰值位置的判定 + 物理驱动 PPO 奖励在数值 token 上重新注入度量结构；输入为激光脉冲与靶设计参数，直接推断 512 步中子率诊断。
Result: 在 ICFBench（50K 模拟 + 232 发实验 shot）上，峰值时刻误差相对匹配的自回归 LLaMA-3-8B 从 11.6 步降至 9.2 步，并优于经典序列模型与基于 LLM 的时间序列预测器；训练数据规模上限为不足 300 发真实 shot。
Conclusion: 作者认为这套分解 + 双向去噪 + 物理奖励的配方是首个 LM 路线的 ICF 预测器，并可推广到低数据、稀疏事件的科学领域。

papers.title: Shallow neural network approximation in mixed Sobolev spaces
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the best $L_2$ approximation of mixed Sobolev spaces by shallow neural networks with $n$ neurons and general activation functions. We first establish an activation-independent Fourier-block principle: if an activation has univariate approximation order $ρ$ in the sense of the Fourier-block property, then the global approximation rate has algebraic order $\min\{α,ρ\}$ for target functions of mixed smoothness $α$, up to explicit logarithmic factors. To verify this property for concrete activations, we introduce a structured univariate approximation condition that implies the Fourier-block property with explicit parameters. For $\mathrm{ReLU}^k$, a matching algebraic lower bound identifies $\min\{α,k+1\}$ as the optimal algebraic approximation exponent in any dimension, up to logarithmic factors in the upper bound. The framework also yields the exponent $\min\{α,k+1\}$ for cardinal B-splines and soft-$\mathrm{ReLU}^k$, and the full mixed-smoothness exponent $α$ for ELU and cosine activations, again up to logarithmic~factors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明浅层神经网络在混合 Sobolev 空间上的最优 L2 逼近率由激活函数的单变量逼近阶 ρ 与目标混合光滑度 α 共同决定，代数阶为 min{α,ρ}（含显式对数因子）。对 ReLU^k 给出匹配下界，证明 min{α,k+1} 是任意维数下的最优代数指数；ELU 与 cosine 激活可达到完整指数 α。
Motivation: 混合光滑度下浅层网络的逼近阶此前缺少与激活函数无关的统一判据，也缺少与上界匹配的下界来确定最优指数。
Method: 提出与激活无关的 Fourier-block principle：若激活具有单变量逼近阶 ρ 的 Fourier-block 性质，则全局逼近率为 min{α,ρ}（含显式对数因子）；再引入一个结构化的单变量逼近条件，以显式参数推出该性质，并用于 ReLU^k、cardinal B-splines、soft-ReLU^k、ELU、cosine 等具体激活。
Result: ReLU^k 的匹配代数下界确定 min{α,k+1} 为任意维数下的最优代数逼近指数（上界含对数因子）；cardinal B-splines 与 soft-ReLU^k 同样得到 min{α,k+1}；ELU 与 cosine 激活得到完整混合光滑度指数 α（均含对数因子）。
Conclusion: 浅层网络在混合 Sobolev 空间的逼近能力可由激活的单变量阶与目标光滑度的最小值刻画，且 ReLU^k 的该指数是紧的。

papers.title: HalluPeer: A Taxonomy-driven Benchmark for Detecting Hallucinations in Scientific Peer Reviews
papers.abstract_en: The growing scale of academic peer review has motivated the use of Large Language Models (LLMs) as review assistants, yet LLMs can generate fluent but unsupported claims that undermine review reliability. Existing hallucination benchmarks are not designed for peer review, where verification requires grounding claims in long, technical papers. We introduce HalluPeer, a benchmark for detecting hallucinations in scientific peer reviews, providing aligned triples of paper content, human-written reviews, and hallucination-injected reviews, annotated for detection, classification, and localization. Our pipeline induces a peer-review-specific hallucination taxonomy, identifies review contexts, and injects hallucinations with automated filtering. Experiments on 12K papers and 38K reviews show that existing detectors struggle to separate hallucinations from legitimate critique, while evaluation on authentic reviews demonstrates that HalluPeer-defined hallucination patterns occur in real peer reviews, highlighting the critical need for source-aware verification. Our project page can be found in https://github.com/Lin-TzuLing/HalluPeer.git
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 HalluPeer：面向科学同行评审的 LLM 幻觉检测基准，用论文内容、人工评审、注入幻觉评审的对齐三元组，覆盖检测、分类与定位三项任务。在 12K 篇论文、38K 条评审上，现有检测器难以把幻觉与合理批评区分开；在真实评审中也观察到 HalluPeer 定义的幻觉模式。
Motivation: 同行评审规模扩大促使 LLM 充当评审助手，但其会生成流畅却无依据的论断；现有幻觉基准并非为同行评审设计，而该场景的核验需要把论断锚定到长篇技术论文上。
Method: 流水线先归纳出同行评审专用的幻觉 taxonomy，再定位评审上下文并注入幻觉，配合自动过滤；产出论文内容、人工评审与注入评审的对齐三元组，标注支持检测、分类与定位。

papers.title: Generative Nested Sampling of Atomistic Thermodynamic Landscapes
papers.abstract_en: Nested sampling (NS) resolves the thermodynamics of an atomistic system from a single simulation, but its practical reach is limited by the Markov-chain updates needed to decorrelate walkers within each likelihood-constrained ensemble. Flow-based NS has reduced this bottleneck for gravitational-wave (GW) inference, yet its transfer to atomistic systems is not merely a change of application. Comparing a GW150914-like binary-black-hole likelihood with an eight-particle two-dimensional Lennard-Jones (LJ) system of comparable dimensionality, we show that the two landscapes differ fundamentally: atomistic multimodality is discrete and combinatorial, generated by particle permutations separated by hard collision walls, and its coordinate coupling is dense and collective, whereas the GW posterior exhibits smooth degeneracies and localized parameter coupling. Guided by this diagnosis, we introduce NS-Flows: a single conditional normalizing flow, conditioned on the NS energy bound and trained on a sliding window of recent live sets, that replaces MCMC by direct parallel draws corrected by importance-weighted rejection resampling. Live sets supply the data self-consistently, allowing flow training without structured priors or a pre-existing dataset. For LJ disks under periodic boundary conditions, the algorithm can reduce energy evaluations by two orders of magnitude and wall-clock time by about 30%, an advantage that becomes more favorable as the cost of the potential grows. The flow's generative efficiency further acts as a physical diagnostic: it varies non-monotonically along the annealing trajectory, is lowest in the dense disordered regime, and is quantitatively captured by the constrained ensemble's internal mode complexity together with target drift across the training window, identifying liquid-like ensembles, not prior-target separation, as the hard case for current flow architectures.
papers.comment: Revised version: numerical results remeasured and updated throughout; conditioning comparison extended to ten independently trained networks; Supplementary Material added, including run-to-run variability of reported costs; figures improved; link to the public code and data repository provided
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NS-Flows 用一个以 NS 能量界为条件、在最近 live set 滑动窗上训练的条件归一化流替代嵌套采样中的 MCMC 更新，直接并行抽样并用重要性加权拒绝重采样校正。对周期边界下的 LJ 磁盘体系，能量评估次数降低两个数量级、墙钟时间约降 30%，且势函数越贵优势越大；流的生成效率沿退火轨迹非单调，在致密无序（液态样）系综处最低。
Motivation: 嵌套采样 (NS) 的可达性受限于每个似然约束系综内 walker 去相关的 MCMC 更新；流式 NS 在引力波推断中已缓解该瓶颈，但原子体系的多峰性是离散组合式、坐标耦合稠密集体，与引力波后验的光滑简并根本不同，不能直接移植。
Method: 提出 NS-Flows：单一条件 normalizing flow，以 NS 能量界为条件、在最近 live set 的滑动窗口上训练，用直接并行抽样加重要性加权拒绝重采样 (importance-weighted rejection resampling) 取代 MCMC；live set 自洽提供训练数据，无需结构化先验或预存数据集。诊断阶段对比 GW150914 类双黑洞似然与维数相当的八粒子二维 Lennard-Jones (LJ) 体系。
Result: 周期边界 LJ 磁盘上能量评估减少两个数量级、墙钟时间约降 30%，势函数计算成本越高优势越有利。流的生成效率沿退火轨迹非单调变化，在致密无序区最低，可由约束系综的内部模态复杂度加训练窗内目标漂移定量刻画，指向液态样系综而非先验-目标分离是当前流架构的难点。arXiv comment 另述修订版将条件化对比扩展到十个独立训练网络并补充运行间波动性。
Conclusion: 把引力波的流式 NS 移植到原子体系前需先诊断能量地形差异；按此设计的条件流可自洽利用 live set 训练并大幅削减 NS 的采样开销，而流效率本身可作为识别液态样难例的物理诊断量。

papers.title: The Answer Is Not the Argument
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is proposed for AI oversight, yet evaluations often provide monitors with a trusted reference answer. We ask whether answer access improves verification of the reasoning or mainly supplies information about its conclusion. We collected 237 naturally generated, step-numbered solutions to 79 Humanity's Last Exam physics questions and independently labelled final-answer correctness and the first false step. Eight LLM monitors evaluated the traces with varying access to the reference answer. Certification raised mean balanced accuracy from 0.637 to 0.796, but its effect on error detection depended strongly on the conclusion: recall increased by +0.299 on wrong-answer traces, while there was no evidence of improvement on correct-answer traces containing a reasoning error (-0.083, 95% CI [-0.196, +0.030]). We then held the reasoning trace fixed in a seven-monitor certificate-congruence intervention. Replacing the true certificate with the trace's own incorrect conclusion reduced flagging by 0.659 (95% CI [0.602, 0.711]) and left flagging 0.389 below the answer-blind level. Conversely, a conflicting false certificate increased flagging of clean traces by 0.580, with 82.9% of newly flagged cases assigning the alleged error to an interior reasoning step. Trusted-answer access can therefore make monitoring appear substantially stronger because aggregate performance combines independent reasoning verification with a powerful certificate-conclusion consistency signal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文检验 AI 监督中给监控模型看可信参考答案是否真的提升推理核查：在 79 道 Humanity's Last Exam 物理题的 237 条分步解答上，看答案使平均 balanced accuracy 从 0.637 升到 0.796，但错误检出的增益几乎全部来自答案本身错误的轨迹（recall +0.299），对答案正确却含推理错误的轨迹没有改善（-0.083，95% CI [-0.196, +0.030]）。固定推理轨迹、把证书换成轨迹自身错误结论会使 flagging 下降 0.659，说明聚合指标的提升主要来自证书-结论一致性信号而非真正的推理验证。
Motivation: Chain-of-thought 监控评估常把可信参考答案直接给监控模型，于是无法区分它是在核查推理，还是只在比对结论；这使监督能力被高估。
Method: 收集 79 道 HLE 物理题的 237 条自然生成分步解答，独立标注最终答案正误与第一个错误步骤；8 个 LLM monitor 在不同参考答案访问条件下评估轨迹，再做七 monitor 的 certificate-congruence 干预：保持推理轨迹不变，把真证书替换为轨迹自身错误结论，或换成冲突的假证书。
Result: 看答案使平均 balanced accuracy 从 0.637 升至 0.796；错误答案轨迹 recall +0.299，正确答案但含推理错误的轨迹 -0.083（95% CI [-0.196, +0.030]）。换成轨迹自身错误结论使 flagging 降低 0.659（95% CI [0.602, 0.711]），仍比 answer-blind 低 0.389；冲突假证书使干净轨迹 flagging 升 0.580，其中 82.9% 新增 flag 把所谓错误定位到中间步骤。
Conclusion: 可信答案访问让监控看起来更强，是因为聚合表现把独立的推理验证与强大的证书-结论一致性信号混在一起；评估推理监控时应把这两者拆开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Online Estimation of Dynamic Origin-Destination Matrices Using Reinforcement Learning with Link-Flow Propagation Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic origin-destination (OD) matrix estimation calibrates time-dependent input demand for simulations to reproduce observed link flows. Reinforcement learning is well suited to online estimation because a trained policy estimates demand in a single evaluation, but varying target flows complicate learning from aggregate rewards. We propose reinforcement learning with link-flow propagation guidance (LFPG-RL), combining simulated vehicle propagation records with downstream errors to guide individual OD components. Using 250 weekday link-flow trajectories from a Melbourne arterial network, LFPG-RL achieves a mean test root mean squared error (RMSE) of 7.41 vehicles per 15-minute interval, mean absolute percentage error of 31.24%, and Pearson correlation of 0.987. Comparisons with optimisation, filtering and reinforcement learning without guidance show a 40.1% RMSE reduction over the strongest baseline, gradient descent with propagation guidance. LFPG-RL enables rapid demand updates that keep traffic simulations consistent with observed conditions, supporting the evaluation of traffic management strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LFPG-RL 用强化学习在线估计动态 OD 矩阵，把仿真车辆传播记录与下游路段流量误差结合，逐个 OD 分量给出引导信号，避免聚合奖励下目标流量变化导致的学习困难。在墨尔本干道网络 250 条工作日路段流量轨迹上，测试 RMSE 为 7.41 辆/15 分钟、MAPE 31.24%、Pearson 相关 0.987，比最强基线（带传播引导的梯度下降）RMSE 降低 40.1%。
Motivation: 动态 OD 矩阵估计要为仿真标定时变需求以复现观测路段流量，但目标流量随时间变化，聚合奖励难以把误差归到具体 OD 分量上，制约了强化学习的在线估计。
Method: 提出 LFPG-RL：把仿真车辆传播记录与下游流量误差结合，为单个 OD 分量提供引导信号；训练后的策略单次前向即可估计需求，实现在线更新。
Result: 在墨尔本干道网络 250 条工作日路段流量轨迹上，测试 RMSE 7.41 辆/15 分钟、MAPE 31.24%、Pearson 相关 0.987；相对优化、滤波以及无引导强化学习基线，RMSE 较最强基线（带传播引导的梯度下降）降低 40.1%。
Conclusion: 逐 OD 分量的传播引导使强化学习能在线快速更新需求，让交通仿真持续与实测条件一致，可用于评估交通管理策略。

papers.title: EDGE: Engine for Deterministic Graph Evaluation through Conversation Simulation from Graph Structured DSL Configuration
papers.abstract_en: As agentic systems evolve into complex multi agent orchestration workflows, there is a growing and critical need for systematic frameworks that measures an agent's behavioral consistency and determinism. In this paper, we introduce a formal evaluation methodology that is grounded in AgentGraph, a planner powered by a domain specific language that represents agent reasoning through a dynamically adjustable directed graph. We leverage this structural formalism and utilize graph traversal algorithms that exhaustively enumerate conversational paths, forming a comprehensive evaluation set that captures the agent's complete behavioral space. We then systematically replay these reproducible trajectories to compare observed outputs and state transitions against the intended DSL specification. To quantify reliability, we define novel metrics that measure response and trajectory determinism, structural adherence and semantic consistency across both exact replays and their linguistic variants. Our system's results demonstrate that agents configured using frameworks like AgentGraph and LangGraph with explicitly structured node transitions show superior determinism over agents that are not configured with controlled transitions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EDGE 提出一套基于 AgentGraph（用 DSL 把 agent 推理表示为可动态调整的有向图）的确定性评估方法：用图遍历算法穷举对话路径构成评估集，再系统重放这些轨迹，把实际输出与状态转移同 DSL 规格比对，并定义响应/轨迹确定性、结构依从性与语义一致性指标。结果表明，用 AgentGraph、LangGraph 这类显式结构化节点转移配置的 agent，其确定性优于未用受控转移配置的 agent。
Motivation: 多 agent 编排工作流日益复杂，缺少系统性框架来度量 agent 行为的一致性与确定性。
Method: 以 AgentGraph 这一 DSL 驱动的 planner 为结构形式化基础，用图遍历算法穷举对话路径生成覆盖完整行为空间的评估集；随后可复现地重放这些轨迹，将观测输出与状态转移对照 DSL 规格，并在精确重放及其语言变体上度量响应确定性、轨迹确定性、结构依从性与语义一致性。
Result: 采用 AgentGraph、LangGraph 等显式结构化节点转移配置的 agent，在确定性上优于未用受控转移配置的 agent；评估覆盖精确重放与语言变体两类场景。
Conclusion: 把 agent 推理显式写成受控的图结构转移，是提升 agent 行为确定性与可评估性的有效途径。

summary_sections.result: 采用 AgentGraph、LangGraph 等显式结构化节点转移配置的 agent，在确定性上优于未用受控转移配置的 agent；评估覆盖精确重放与语言变体两类场景。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把 agent 推理显式写成受控的图结构转移，是提升 agent 行为确定性与可评估性的有效途径。

papers.title: Forward-Deployed Full-Stack Engineering for Autonomous Cloud MLOps
papers.abstract_en: Across industries, machine-learning systems support applications ranging from prediction and anomaly detection to forecasting, optimization, and scheduling, yet operationalizing these systems requires coordinating application development, model pipelines, cloud infrastructure, security, deployment, monitoring, retraining, recovery, and rollback. We present an evidence-gated multi-agent framework for transforming a natural-language MLOps cloud engineering task into a verified repository and operational cloud deployment. The framework combines graph engineering, loop engineering, and agent harness engineering. A stateful Graph Orchestrator coordinates specialized agents for repository generation, review, execution, verification, release, and monitoring while governing workflow dependencies, evidence gates, retry bounds, recovery paths, and termination. Consequential lifecycle transitions proceed only when their required predicates are supported by verifiable execution or runtime evidence. Verification failures activate bounded reflection, repair, and re-verification, while runtime evidence of failure, drift, degradation, or policy violation can trigger bounded adaptation, recovery, or rollback. Agent harness engineering constrains repository generation, review, and repair, artifact execution, and cloud operations through controlled capabilities and isolated execution environments. We realize the framework on Google Cloud Platform and evaluate repository completeness, controlled execution, evidence-gated transitions, cloud promotion, and bounded recovery. Our experimental results show that the framework prevents unsupported lifecycle transitions and drives each run toward either a verified operational deployment or an auditable terminal failure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出证据门控的多智能体 MLOps 框架，把自然语言云工程任务转成经过验证的代码仓库与可运行的云部署：有状态 Graph Orchestrator 协调生成、评审、执行、验证、发布、监控等专职智能体，关键生命周期迁移只有在可验证执行或运行时证据支撑其前置条件时才放行。在 Google Cloud Platform 上的评估显示，该框架能阻止无证据支撑的生命周期迁移，并把每次运行导向「已验证的生产部署」或「可审计的终止失败」两种结局之一。
Motivation: 把 ML 系统投入生产需要协调应用开发、模型管线、云基础设施、安全、部署、监控、重训、恢复与回滚，链条长且迁移环节容易在缺乏证据时被跳过。
Method: 框架由 graph engineering、loop engineering 与 agent harness engineering 三部分组成：有状态 Graph Orchestrator 管理仓库生成、评审、执行、验证、发布、监控等专职智能体的工作流依赖、证据门、重试上限、恢复路径与终止条件；验证失败触发有界的反思、修复与再验证，运行时的失败、漂移、性能退化或策略违规证据可触发有界的自适应、恢复或回滚；agent harness 通过受控能力与隔离执行环境约束仓库生成、评审修复、制品执行与云操作。
Result: 在 Google Cloud Platform 上评估仓库完整性、受控执行、证据门控迁移、云上晋级 (cloud promotion) 与有界恢复；实验结果显示框架阻止了无证据支撑的生命周期迁移，并使每次运行收敛到已验证的生产部署或可审计的终止失败。
Conclusion: 把关键生命周期迁移绑定到可验证执行或运行时证据，可以让自主 MLOps 智能体在云上既不越权推进、也不静默失败，而是留下可审计的终态。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: TACS: Trajectory-Aware Candidate Selection for LLM Jailbreak Suffix Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Gradient-based jailbreak suffix optimization methods typically update the suffix by retaining the candidate with the lowest current loss. We show that this seemingly natural design is fundamentally myopic: candidates that look better under the current-step proxy often fail to produce better jailbreak outcomes later in the search, revealing a form of selection-stage reward hacking. This suggests that candidate selection, rather than candidate generation alone, is a hidden bottleneck in suffix optimization. To address this issue, we propose TACS, a trajectory-aware candidate selection framework for jailbreak suffix optimization. Instead of selecting candidates solely by their immediate loss, TACS augments per-step evaluation with a trajectory-aware proxy and stabilizes selection with reference-policy regularization and a discriminator-estimated chi-squared correction, encouraging choices that remain effective beyond the current step. Experiments on HarmBench show that TACS consistently outperforms strong baselines under the same search budget, substantially improving attack success rates while exhibiting more stable optimization behavior throughout the search. Our findings highlight that mitigating selection-stage reward hacking caused by myopic candidate selection is critical for improving jailbreak suffix optimization.
papers.comment: We identified an error in the theoretical analysis, which affects the validity of the main conclusions of the manuscript. Since the current version does not adequately support this conclusion, we have decided to withdraw the paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TACS 指出梯度式越狱后缀优化中「每步只保留当前损失最低候选」是短视的，会引发 selection-stage reward hacking：当前步代理下更好的候选后续往往并不更有效。它用轨迹感知代理补充逐步评估，配合 reference-policy 正则与判别器估计的 chi-squared 修正稳定选择，在 HarmBench 上同搜索预算下持续优于强基线并提高攻击成功率。
Motivation: 后缀优化把候选生成当作唯一瓶颈，但按当前步损失做选择本身是短视的，导致搜索后期收益失效，攻击成功率受限。
Method: 提出 TACS（trajectory-aware candidate selection）：在每步损失之外加入轨迹感知代理评估候选，并用 reference-policy 正则与判别器估计的 chi-squared 修正稳定选择，使所选候选在当前步之后仍保持有效。
Result: 在 HarmBench 上，相同搜索预算下 TACS 持续优于强基线，攻击成功率显著提升，且整个搜索过程中优化行为更稳定。
Conclusion: 缓解由短视候选选择造成的 selection-stage reward hacking，是改进越狱后缀优化的关键；作者已因理论分析出错、主结论无法支撑而撤回该稿。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: How Language Models Organize and Structure Moral Knowledge
papers.abstract_en: How do large language models (LLMs) organize moral knowledge? Models detect moral content broadly, but detection is a low bar. We ask whether they go further, distinguishing moral foundations from one another and organizing the relationships between them geometrically. We train six independent linear probes on open-weight language models, one per Moral Foundations Theory (MFT) category (care/harm, fair/cheat, lib/oppress, loy/betray, auth/subv, sanc/degrade), and examine how the resulting directions relate to each other in representation space. We find the directions neither collapse into a single moral detector nor isolate from one another. Rather, they span a near-maximal number of independent dimensions while sharing a positive common component. The shared component is the signature of integration, and it is moral-specific relative to a matched non-moral concept battery built identically (mean pairwise cosine 0.26 vs. 0.013). The geometry is consistent across architectures and scale and reaches its integration regime early in pre-training, well before probe accuracy saturates. The structure the model discovers shows no evidence of the individualizing/binding distinction predicted by Moral Foundations Theory (an underpowered test: only 10 distinct splits exist, so it cannot reject at the 0.05 level) but rather reflects corpus statistics. Extending to moral dilemmas, each dilemma direction partially composes from its component foundations, at 2.7x a mismatched-pair baseline, while the majority of its variance encodes conflict-specific structure. The model represents moral tension itself, not a pre-resolved judgment.
papers.comment: 32 pages, 16 figures. Code and outputs at https://github.com/deepsteer/deepsteer
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用六个独立线性探针测量开源 LLM 中 MFT 六类道德基础的表征方向，发现它们既不塌缩成单一“道德检测器”也不彼此隔离：共享正向成分使道德概念的平均两两余弦达 0.26（匹配的非道德概念库仅 0.013），且该整合结构在预训练早期即形成、早于探针准确率饱和。道德困境方向按成分基础部分组合，强度为错配基线的 2.7 倍，但多数方差编码冲突特异结构，即模型表征的是道德张力本身而非已裁决的判断。
Motivation: LLM 能宽泛检出道德内容只是低门槛能力；尚不清楚模型是否区分不同道德基础，并在表征空间中几何化地组织它们之间的关系。
Method: 在开源权重 LLM 上训练六个独立线性探针，分别对应 Moral Foundations Theory (MFT) 的 care/harm、fair/cheat、lib/oppress、loy/betray、auth/subv、sanc/degrade 六类，考察这些方向在表征空间中的相互关系；用同样方式构建的匹配非道德概念库作对照，并跨架构与规模比较、追踪预训练进程，再扩展到道德困境方向的组合分析。
Result: 道德方向共享正向公共成分，平均两两余弦 0.26，对照非道德概念库为 0.013；几何结构跨架构与规模一致，并在预训练早期进入整合状态，早于探针准确率饱和。结构不支持 MFT 预测的 individualizing/binding 区分（仅 10 种不同划分，属检验力不足，无法在 0.05 水平上拒绝）。每个困境方向由其成分基础部分组合而成，强度为错配对基线的 2.7 倍，多数方差编码冲突特异结构。
Conclusion: LLM 的道德知识按“近最大独立维度 + 正向共享成分”的几何方式组织，且该结构反映语料统计而非 MFT 理论区分；困境表征保留冲突本身而非预先解决的判断。

papers.title: Auditing Privacy Risks in LLM-Enhanced Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have recently advanced graph neural networks (GNNs) by enriching node representations with semantic information, giving rise to LLM-enhanced GNNs that achieve substantial performance gains. However, how such semantic enhancement affects privacy risks remains largely underexplored. To bridge this gap, we systematically audit the privacy risks of LLM-enhanced GNNs through a unified framework consisting of five stages: (1) dataset preparation, (2) victim model training, (3) privacy attack, (4) risk assessment, and (5) defense analysis. Specifically, our evaluation spans ten text-attributed graph datasets across diverse domains, six privacy attacks, 42 LLM-enhanced GNN configurations, and three more recent language-model backbones. Extensive experiments show that, despite their utility improvements, LLM-enhanced GNNs consistently exhibit greater empirical privacy vulnerability than shallow text representation baselines under the evaluated attacks across diverse models and datasets. Further analysis shows that LLM-enhanced representations exhibit more distinguishable link-, label-, and membership-related signals in the embedding space, making them more exploitable by inference attacks. Finally, we evaluate representative defenses and examine their effectiveness in mitigating these privacy risks. Overall, this work provides a systematic audit of privacy risks in LLM-enhanced GNNs and offers insights for developing more secure and trustworthy graph learning systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 系统审计 LLM 增强图神经网络 (LLM-enhanced GNNs) 的隐私风险：在十个文本属性图数据集、六种隐私攻击、42 种 LLM-enhanced GNN 配置与三个语言模型骨干上，尽管效用提升，这类模型在所评估攻击下始终比浅层文本表示基线更易被推断攻击利用，其嵌入空间中 link、label、membership 信号更可分。
Motivation: LLM 语义增强显著提升 GNN 性能，但这种增强如何改变隐私风险基本未被研究，图学习系统的安全性缺少系统证据。
Method: 提出五阶段统一审计框架：数据集准备、受害模型训练、隐私攻击、风险评估、防御分析；覆盖十个跨领域文本属性图数据集、六种隐私攻击、42 种 LLM-enhanced GNN 配置与三个近期语言模型骨干，并评估代表性防御手段。
Result: 实验显示 LLM-enhanced GNNs 在所评估攻击下、跨多样模型与数据集始终比浅层文本表示基线表现出更高的经验隐私脆弱性；嵌入空间中 link、label、membership 相关信号更可区分，因而更易被推断攻击利用；并检验了代表性防御的缓解效果。
Conclusion: 语义增强在带来效用提升的同时系统性放大推断攻击可利用的隐私信号，开发更安全的图学习系统需把这类风险纳入设计与防御评估。

papers.title: The Shadow Price of Intelligence: Quality Degradation in LLM Inference as a Supply Chain Problem
papers.abstract_en: Large language model providers are compute constrained, and a common response to congestion is to degrade service. A degraded answer fails with some probability, and a failed answer either returns as a retry or departs as churn, destroying LTV on an unaccounted ledger. We model inference allocation as a newsvendor whose stockout cost is churned lifetime value, a geometric retry multiplier in which the recycled product is dissatisfaction, and a two-regime transient fluid queue whose arrival rate is made endogenous by retries. Statically, there is a regime in which a cheaper model saves energy per initiated task while consuming strictly more capacity per initiated task, so the discount inverts when capacity binds. Dynamically, a reactive throttle fired during a surge can cross an ignition threshold beyond which it manufactures more traffic than it sheds, and a release rule set below the degraded equilibrium converts a transient surge into a permanent degraded regime. With heterogeneous customers, throttling is a transportation problem in retry-inflated load whose optimal policy rations intelligence by critical ratio, and whose dual, the shadow price of intelligence, prices a marginal query by class and by hour. Under congestion, throttling is not a cost lever but a demand lever.

TL;DR: 把 LLM 推理容量分配建模为报童 (newsvendor) 问题，缺货成本是流失的 LTV，配两状态瞬态流体队列且到达率被重试内生化。结论是：容量受限时便宜模型按每任务能耗更省却严格占用更多容量，折扣反转；突发期触发的反应式限流可能越过点火阈值制造的流量多于削减的流量，把瞬态突发固化为永久降级态；拥塞下限流是需求杠杆而非成本杠杆，最优策略按临界比 (critical ratio) 配给智能，其对偶给出按时段与客群定价的“智能影子价格”。
Motivation: LLM 供应商算力受限时普遍降级服务，但失败答案带来的重试与流失把 LTV 消耗在没有记账的账本上；降级、重试与容量之间的反馈缺少可分析的模型。
Method: 将推理分配建模为缺货成本为 churned LTV 的报童问题，叠加几何重试乘子（回收的产品是不满），以及到达率由重试内生化的两状态瞬态流体队列；异质客户下把限流写成重试膨胀负载上的运输问题，用临界比求最优配给并取对偶得到影子价格。数值算例按五家 LLM 供应商的公开基准数据校准（28 页、12 图）。
Result: 静态存在一个机制：便宜模型每个发起任务更省能耗，却严格占用更多容量，故当容量成为约束时折扣反转。动态上，突发期触发的反应式限流可越过点火阈值，制造的流量多于其削减的流量；释放规则设在降级均衡之下会把瞬态突发转成永久降级态。异质客户下最优限流按临界比配给智能，对偶的影子价格按类别与小时为边际查询定价。
Conclusion: 在拥塞条件下限流应被当作需求杠杆而非成本杠杆，其真实代价由按客群和时段计价的智能影子价格刻画。

papers.title: Quantifying geographic domain shift to decouple the geospatial transferability of human mobility flow generation models
papers.abstract_en: Human mobility serves as an essential proxy for understanding social, economic, and environmental dynamics in urban systems. Geospatial transferability, which measures a model's capability in a new location or unseen region, is a critical dimension for comparing different human mobility generation models. However, few studies have studied the intrinsic characteristics of geospatial transferability. To this end, this study systematically investigates the geospatial transferability of four representative human mobility generation models using a large-scale benchmark dataset of census tract level commuting flows across 2265 counties in the United States. Inspired by the domain adaptation theory in machine learning, we introduce geographic domain shift to describe the intrinsic differences in geographic feature distributions and spatial structures between source and target regions, which may jointly affect model transferability. Moreover, we propose two metrics, mutual information and spatial shift, to quantify the geographic domain shift. To examine their associations with model transferability, we employ linear mixed-effects regression to analyze the associations between geographic domain shifts and transferability. Our results reveal substantial spatial heterogeneity and asymmetry in transfer performance across regions. Both information shift and spatial shift exhibit statistically significant and complementary explanatory power. This indicates that geospatial transferability depends not only on model design but also on intrinsic geographic differences. These findings provide a novel methodological framework for evaluating and improving the geospatial transferability of human mobility generation models and support more robust and fair human mobility data synthesis across diverse regions. It also offers insights on spatial transferability for GeoAI model development.
papers.journal_ref: Annals of the American Association of Geographers, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用美国 2265 个县、普查区级通勤流的大规模基准，评估四类人类移动流生成模型的地理可迁移性，并提出互信息与空间偏移两个指标量化 geographic domain shift。线性混合效应回归显示信息偏移与空间偏移对迁移性能均有显著且互补的解释力，且跨区域迁移表现存在明显空间异质性与不对称性。
Motivation: 人类移动生成模型换到新地区后性能差异大，但地理迁移性这一维度的内在特征少有研究，缺少可量化的域偏移刻画手段。
Method: 借鉴机器学习域适应理论提出 geographic domain shift，用互信息 (mutual information) 与空间偏移 (spatial shift) 两个指标量化源区与目标区在地理特征分布和空间结构上的差异，再用线性混合效应回归 (linear mixed-effects regression) 检验其与四类人类移动生成模型迁移性的关联，数据为美国 2265 个县普查区级通勤流基准。
Result: 迁移表现在区域间呈现显著的空间异质性与不对称性；信息偏移与空间偏移对模型迁移性均具有统计显著且互补的解释力。
Conclusion: 地理可迁移性既取决于模型设计，也取决于源区与目标区的内在地理差异，该框架可用于评估和改进人类移动生成模型的跨区域迁移与数据合成的公平性。

papers.title: Chronocooked: A Benchmark for Interval Timing in Reinforcement Learning Agents
papers.abstract_en: Interval timing is extensively studied as an important aspect of human behaviour. As artificial agents are increasingly designed to function alongside humans, their interval timing abilities also needs to be studied. However, research in this area remains limited and scattered. This paper presents Chronocooked, a reinforcement learning (RL) benchmark environment that enables a systematic study of interval timing abilities in RL agents. Inspired by Overcooked, the suite comprises cooking scenarios involving interval timing tasks drawn from the psychology literature. The tasks and reward functions are designed such that temporal information is unobserved but critical for optimal performance. The environment is intentionally kept simple to enable controlled experiments and support biologically plausible models. Each task is accompanied by evaluation metrics to study different aspects of interval timing in RL agents, namely, task performance, human-like timing and scalability. We report baselines using a non-recurrent architecture (CNN), a recurrent architecture (LSTM), and a biologically inspired recurrent architecture (CTRNN). The baseline model analysis shows that, although RL agents can successfully perform time-dependent tasks, they do not necessarily process and perceive time in the same way as humans. Understanding these differences is important for anticipating their impact on human-robot interactions (HRI).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Chronocooked：一个受 Overcooked 启发的强化学习基准，用烹饪场景承载心理学文献中的 interval timing 任务，时间信息对最优表现关键但不可直接观测。基线对比 CNN、LSTM 与生物启发的 CTRNN，发现 RL 智能体虽能完成时间依赖任务，其处理与感知时间的方式并不与人类相同。
Motivation: 智能体 increasingly 与人协作，但其 interval timing 能力的研究有限且分散，缺少可系统、可控比较的实验环境。
Method: 构建基于 Overcooked 的烹饪场景套件，任务与奖励设计使时间信息不可观测却对最优性能关键；环境保持简单以支持受控实验与生物合理模型；每个任务配评估指标，覆盖任务表现、类人计时 (human-like timing) 与可扩展性三个面向，并报告 CNN、LSTM、CTRNN 三类架构基线。
Result: 基线分析显示 RL 智能体可以成功完成时间依赖任务，但并不必然以与人类相同的方式处理和感知时间；评估维度为任务表现、类人计时与可扩展性。
Conclusion: RL 智能体的计时行为与人类存在系统性差异，理解这些差异对预判其在人机交互 (HRI) 中的影响是必要的。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Self-Indexing Attention for Compression-Compatible Sparse Long-Context LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Sparse long-context inference requires efficient token retrieval in both prefill and decode. Existing methods often use different retrieval strategies for the two stages, preventing one retrieval representation from being reused throughout inference. We propose Self-Indexing Attention, a training-free framework built on a shared transform-domain sign-magnitude representation. The key signs provide a reusable token-level index for grouped prefill selection and decode retrieval, while the same representation remains compatible with external KV-cache compression without separate indexer metadata. This 1-bit index enables efficient retrieval through bitwise operations widely supported by modern accelerators. At 5% attention density, Self-Indexing Attention remains close to dense attention on LongBench and RULER and achieves up to 6.1x prefill and 10.3x decode attention-operator speedups. Experiments with TurboQuant and DeepSeekV4-Flash further demonstrate compatibility with low-bit KV-cache compression and pretrained sparse-attention indexers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出训练免费的 Self-Indexing Attention：用共享变换域 sign-magnitude 表示的符号位做 1-bit token 索引，同时服务 prefill 分组选择与 decode 检索，并与外部 KV-cache 压缩共用同一表示。在 5% attention density 下 LongBench 与 RULER 接近 dense attention，prefill 与 decode attention 算子分别最高加速 6.1x 与 10.3x。
Motivation: 稀疏长上下文推理中 prefill 与 decode 常用两套检索策略，一个检索表示无法贯穿全程复用，且与 KV-cache 压缩共存时还需额外 indexer 元数据。
Method: 训练免费框架 Self-Indexing Attention：构造共享变换域 sign-magnitude 表示，取关键符号位作为可复用的 token 级索引，供 prefill 分组选择与 decode 检索共用；1-bit 索引用现代加速器广泛支持的按位操作完成检索，同一表示兼容外部 KV-cache 压缩而无需独立 indexer 元数据。
Result: 在 5% attention density 下，LongBench 与 RULER 上接近 dense attention；attention 算子最高 6.1x prefill 加速、10.3x decode 加速；与 TurboQuant 和 DeepSeekV4-Flash 的实验显示其兼容低位 KV-cache 压缩与预训练稀疏注意力 indexer。
Conclusion: 一个共享的 1-bit 符号索引即可贯穿 prefill 与 decode 的稀疏检索，并同时兼容 KV-cache 压缩与既有稀疏注意力 indexer，无需为两阶段分别维护检索表示。

papers.title: LittleLearner: Language Models Under Pedagogically Controlled Knowledge Exposure
papers.abstract_en: Modern language models are trained on heterogeneous web-scale text corpora. Consequently, studying knowledge and skill acquisition is difficult, as prior exposure to related content is hard to characterize. To address this challenge, we introduce LittleCurriculum, a curated 88B-token pretraining corpus tailored to U.S. elementary school material, explicitly excluding concepts, facts, and vocabulary taught above Grade 5. Training a 5B-parameter LLM from scratch on LittleCurriculum yields LittleLearner, a model with sufficient language competence for open-ended evaluation, yet with clear knowledge and capability boundaries mapped to interpretable curriculum guidelines. We release LittleCurriculum and LittleLearner as a developmentally restricted sandbox to study how models acquire, represent, and use data under a well-defined training scope. We illustrate the sandbox's utility in a first suite of experiments on injecting new knowledge through post-training and in-context learning. These methods let LittleLearner better utilize existing knowledge, but do not raise out-of-scope capabilities. Our findings underscore the value of this controlled environment for future investigations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LittleCurriculum 是一个 88B token、只含美国小学五年级及以下内容的预训练语料，用它从零训练 5B 参数 LLM 得到 LittleLearner：语言能力足以做开放式评测，但知识边界与可解释课程指南对齐。后训练与 in-context learning 注入新知识只能让模型更好利用已有知识，不提升超出课程范围的能力。
Motivation: 网页规模语料异质，模型此前接触过什么难以刻画，因而知识与技能的获得过程难以研究。
Method: 构建 LittleCurriculum：88B token、面向美国小学材料、显式排除五年级以上的概念事实与词汇；从零预训练 5B 参数模型得到 LittleLearner，作为训练范围明确的发展受限沙盒，并在其上做后训练与 in-context learning 注入新知识的首批实验。
Result: LittleLearner 具备足以进行开放式评测的语言能力，同时知识与能力边界清晰对应到可解释的课程指南；后训练与 in-context learning 两种注入方式让 LittleLearner 更好利用已有知识，但不提升 out-of-scope 能力。
Conclusion: 训练范围可界定的沙盒能把知识获得与边界变成可研究对象，且注入知识的收益局限于课程内已有知识的利用。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Sign Language Video Synthesis via Loss-Guided Multi-Expert GANs
papers.abstract_en: This preliminary technical report presents a framework for sign language video synthesis using a loss-guided multi-expert Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) to enhance communication for individuals with hearing impairments. Three specialized discriminators--global, hand, and head--each guide a corresponding expert branch in the generator toward a distinct visual region, enabling implicit feature specialization without explicit diversity losses. To stabilize this multi-discriminator system, whose early-phase training otherwise exhibits chaotic dynamics, we introduce a United Loss consensus mechanism that regularizes each discriminator toward the ensemble average at a 10% weight. Each branch further adopts a dual-pathway convolutional-transformer design with learnable AdaptiveFeatureFusion, balancing the stability of convolutions against the detail of windowed self-attention. The generator is trained using an alternating three-mode schedule (discriminator, holistic generation, branch-specialized generation). On a custom 156GB dataset with a filtered evaluation set that removes easy and repetitive samples, our 0.2B-parameter variant achieves 29.78 PSNR (0.9593 SSIM), the 0.66B variant reaches 30.52 PSNR (0.9631 SSIM) after 7.37M steps, and the 1.3B variant achieves 30.72 PSNR (0.9650 SSIM). The gain from 0.66B to 1.3B is only +0.20 PSNR despite nearly doubling the parameters, demonstrating sharply diminishing returns. Inference VRAM footprints are 1.5 GB, ~5 GB, and 8 GB respectively, enabling deployment on consumer-grade hardware. Full ablation studies remain ongoing due to the 2-3 month training cycle on a single GPU. The system was showcased at the 2025 Hong Kong Frontier Technology Summit.

TL;DR: 提出损失引导的多专家 GAN 做手语视频合成：生成器三个专家分支分别由全局、手部、头部判别器监督，用 United Loss 共识机制把每个判别器向集成平均正则（权重 10%）以稳定早期混沌训练。在自建 156GB 数据集的过滤评测集上，0.66B 变体达 30.52 PSNR / 0.9631 SSIM，扩到 1.3B 仅 +0.20 PSNR，参数近翻倍收益急剧递减。
Motivation: 多判别器 GAN 早期训练呈混沌动力学、不稳定；同时手语视频需要手部与面部细节各自被专门建模，单一判别器难以引导不同视觉区域。
Method: 生成器含三个专家分支，各由 global、hand、head 判别器监督，实现隐式特征专门化而不依赖显式多样性损失；United Loss 把每个判别器向集成平均正则，权重 10%。每分支用卷积-Transformer 双通路加可学习 AdaptiveFeatureFusion，训练采用三模式交替调度（判别器、整体生成、分支专门生成）。
Result: 自建 156GB 数据集、过滤掉简单重复样本的评测集上：0.2B 变体 29.78 PSNR / 0.9593 SSIM；0.66B 变体 30.52 PSNR / 0.9631 SSIM（7.37M 步）；1.3B 变体 30.72 PSNR / 0.9650 SSIM。0.66B→1.3B 仅 +0.20 PSNR 而参数近翻倍；推理显存分别为 1.5 GB、约 5 GB、8 GB。
Conclusion: 参数规模到 0.66B 后收益急剧递减，1.3B 级别已可在消费级硬件上以约 5–8 GB 显存部署；完整消融因单 GPU 上 2–3 个月训练周期仍在进行。

papers.title: Practice Makes Unsafe: Skill Misevolution in Self-Improving LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly save experience from past tasks as reusable skills through skill evolution. When an agent completes an unsafe task, skill evolution can keep the unsafe procedure inside an otherwise useful skill, and a later benign task can repeat the harm after the unsafe instruction is gone. We call this failure *skill misevolution*. It requires that the agent write the unsafe procedure into a skill and that a later task retrieve and follow that skill. We introduce SkillMisevo-Gym, which clears every task session but keeps the skill library, so each of these steps can be checked separately. We also build SkillMisevo-Bench with 525 tasks in 25 episodes, where each episode alternates malicious and related benign tasks before three benign tasks in a new session. Across 21 combinations of agents and evolution methods, all of them write unsafe skills and 15 carry the harm into the new session, so the risk comes from skill evolution itself. Evolution raises benign utility in 15 combinations but also raises malicious-task harm in 17, so ranking methods by utility alone would hide this risk. We propose SafeEvolve, which checks each skill when it is written and when a later task retrieves it. It cuts unsafe retrieval in the new session from 35.3% to 8.7% and harm from 21.3% to 4.0% while keeping benign utility during learning within 0.4 points. SafeEvolveUp cuts new-session harm by 16.0 points and keeps its utility within 1.3 points of evolution without this mitigation. As agents learn from their own experience, safety must cover the skills that carry past behavior into future tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/henrymao2004/misevolve.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM agent 的技能演化 (skill evolution) 会把不安全任务的执行过程写进技能库，之后良性任务检索并照做就会复现伤害，作者称之为 skill misevolution。在 SkillMisevo-Bench（525 个任务、25 个 episode）上，21 种 agent 与演化方法组合全部写出不安全技能，15 种把伤害带进新会话；提出的 SafeEvolve 在写入与检索两处检查技能，把新会话不安全检索率从 35.3% 降到 8.7%、伤害从 21.3% 降到 4.0%，良性效用只损失 0.4 分以内。
Motivation: 技能演化让 agent 把过往经验沉淀为可复用技能，但不安全任务的危险步骤会被一并固化，且在原始恶意指令消失后仍能被良性任务触发；仅按良性效用给演化方法排序会掩盖这一风险。
Method: 提出 SkillMisevo-Gym：清空每个任务会话但保留技能库，从而可分别检验“写入不安全技能”与“后续检索并遵循”两步；配套 SkillMisevo-Bench，每个 episode 交替恶意与相关良性任务，再在新会话中跑三个良性任务。SafeEvolve 在技能写入时和后续任务检索时各做一次检查，SafeEvolveUp 为带该缓解的演化变体。
Result: 在 21 种 agent 与演化方法组合中，全部写出不安全技能，15 种把伤害带入新会话；演化使 15 种组合的良性效用上升，同时使 17 种组合的恶意任务伤害上升。SafeEvolve 将新会话不安全检索率从 35.3% 降至 8.7%、伤害从 21.3% 降至 4.0%，学习期良性效用保持在 0.4 分以内；SafeEvolveUp 使新会话伤害下降 16.0 个点，效用与无缓解演化相差 1.3 分以内。
Conclusion: 风险来自技能演化机制本身而非某个具体 agent，只按效用排名会隐藏它；随着 agent 从自身经验学习，安全防护必须覆盖那些把过往行为带入未来任务的技能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Parser Already Knows: Lightweight Bias Correction in Constrained Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Grammar Constrained Decoding (GCD) forces Language Models (LMs) to produce syntactically valid outputs by masking out non-conforming tokens at each step. However, because masking only checks whether each token is valid so far, the resulting distribution over complete outputs diverges from the LM's own distribution conditioned on the grammar, biasing generation toward valid but suboptimal outputs. Online sampling can restore this distribution, but only through costly iterative resampling. Our key insight is that the parser and lexer states that GCD tools already maintain carry a strong signal about future grammatical validity. We introduce SHIM, a lightweight, offline-trained correction of the LM's next-token probabilities, conditioned on this syntactic and lexical state together with candidate next tokens. Since GCD tools already compute these states, SHIM leaves the LM itself untouched. Across bit-vector and text-to-SQL grammars, this correction substantially narrows the gap to the LM's grammar-conditioned distribution compared to masking and online sampling, while running at nearly masking's speed. Even a variant that sees only the next token can improve on both baselines, making SHIM usable with GCD tools that do not expose their parser state.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SHIM 用离线训练的轻量校正器修正语法约束解码 (GCD) 的下一 token 概率，输入是 GCD 工具本就维护的 parser/lexer 状态与候选下一 token，不动 LM 本身。在 bit-vector 与 text-to-SQL 语法上，它比 masking 和 online sampling 明显缩小与 LM 语法条件分布的差距，速度接近 masking；只看下一 token 的变体也同时优于两个基线。
Motivation: GCD 逐步掩码只保证当前 token 合法，导致完整输出上的分布偏离 LM 自身以语法为条件的分布，把生成推向合法但次优的结果；online sampling 能恢复该分布但需代价高昂的迭代重采样。
Method: SHIM：以 parser/lexer 状态加候选下一 token 为条件，离线训练一个对 LM 下一 token 概率的轻量校正；由于 GCD 工具已计算这些状态，无需改动 LM，也提供只看下一 token 的变体以适配不暴露 parser 状态的工具。
Result: 在 bit-vector 与 text-to-SQL 语法上，SHIM 相对 masking 与 online sampling 明显缩小与 LM 语法条件分布的差距，运行速度接近 masking；只看下一 token 的变体也同时优于 masking 和 online sampling 两个基线。
Conclusion: parser/lexer 状态已携带未来语法有效性的强信号，用它做离线校正即可在几乎不增加开销的情况下逼近 LM 的语法条件分布，且不必依赖在线重采样。
Relevance: 1
