papers.title: RA-CAD: Learning Post-Execution Critique for State-Aware Text-to-CAD Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-CAD generation translates natural-language design intent into editable and executable parametric computer-aided design (CAD) codes, reducing the expertise and effort required for manual modeling. Existing methods incorporate fixed, externally supplied, prompt-induced, or separately optimized critique mechanisms to optimize the generation process, but they do not necessarily optimize how feedback is interpreted and translated into effective corrective actions throughout the generation process. To bridge this feedback-utilization gap, we present RA-CAD (ReAct Agent for CAD), a state-aware agent that interacts with the CAD environment through a Generate--Execute--Critique--Rewrite loop. At each iteration, RA-CAD executes the current code and observes its outcome. Conditioned on the design instruction, current code, and execution feedback, the agent then generates an explicit post-execution critique as an intermediate policy action. This critique either validates the current result for termination or provides revision-oriented guidance that conditions the next rewrite. CAD Code Bootstrapping (CCB) first establishes fundamental parametric CAD coding capabilities through supervised fine-tuning. Feedback-Driven Agent Optimization (FAO) subsequently applies trajectory-level Group Relative Policy Optimization to both policy-generated code and critique sequences, assigning terminal F1 and Chamfer Distance rewards to the complete interaction trajectory. This formulation makes critique an outcome-aligned, learnable policy decision rather than an unoptimized auxiliary output. Experiments on CADFusion and Text2CAD show that RA-CAD achieves state-of-the-art execution validity and geometric quality compared with existing methods and strong proprietary language models, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed state-aware text-to-CAD agent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RA-CAD 用 Generate–Execute–Critique–Rewrite 循环把执行后批评 (post-execution critique) 作为可学习的策略动作：先用 CAD Code Bootstrapping (CCB) 监督微调建立参数化 CAD 代码能力，再用轨迹级 GRPO 对代码与批评序列联合优化，奖励取终端 F1 与 Chamfer Distance。在 CADFusion 与 Text2CAD 上取得 SOTA 的执行有效性与几何质量，优于现有方法与强闭源语言模型。
Motivation: 现有 Text-to-CAD 的批评机制是固定、外部给定、prompt 诱导或单独优化的，没有优化反馈如何被解读并转成后续修正动作，形成 feedback-utilization gap。
Method: RA-CAD (ReAct Agent for CAD) 在 CAD 环境中执行当前代码并观察结果，以设计指令、当前代码和执行反馈为条件生成显式执行后批评，用于终止判定或指导下一次改写；CCB 用 SFT 建立基础参数化 CAD 编码能力，FAO 再对策略生成的代码与批评序列做轨迹级 GRPO，把终端 F1 与 Chamfer Distance 作为整条交互轨迹的奖励。
Result: 在 CADFusion 和 Text2CAD 两个基准上，RA-CAD 在执行有效性 (execution validity) 与几何质量上达到 SOTA，对比对象包括现有方法和强专有语言模型；奖励指标为终端 F1 与 Chamfer Distance。
Conclusion: 把批评从事程外的辅助输出改成与结果对齐、可学习的策略决策，能同时提升生成代码的可执行性与几何精度，使 state-aware 交互式 agent 优于固定或外部批评机制。

papers.title: SKT: Skill-Use Training at Scale via Verified Synthetic Data Generation
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills have become an important mechanism for equipping language-model agents with reusable procedural knowledge. However, providing skills alone does not guarantee that current models can effectively identify, apply, and coordinate them. To improve skill-use capabilities, we introduce SKT, a verified data synthesis pipeline that constructs skill-grounded tasks and executable trajectories from large collections of agent skills. SKT selects suitable single-skill and multi-skill configurations, synthesizes tasks through rule-based and agent-based verification with feedback-guided repair, and retains only successful trajectories that substantially use every required skill. Using 2,000 public skills, SKT produces 4,000 task packages and 27,164 verified trajectories. Based on the same pipeline and a disjoint test pool, we further construct SkillEval, a held-out executable benchmark for evaluating skill use. Experiments across diverse models, benchmarks, and agent harnesses show that supervised fine-tuning on SKT-generated trajectories consistently improves skill-use performance. Verification ablations, cross-harness evaluation, and scaling experiments further demonstrate that these gains depend on high-quality supervision, extend beyond a single agent interface, and increase with broader skill coverage. Together, these results establish verified data synthesis as an effective and scalable approach for skill-use training.
papers.comment: 24 pages,8 figures, Version 2, New Data release
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SKT 用可执行验证的合成数据流水线，从 2,000 个公开 agent skill 生成 4,000 个任务包与 27,164 条验证轨迹，只保留真正用到全部所需 skill 的成功轨迹。在这些轨迹上做监督微调，跨模型、基准与 agent harness 一致提升 skill 使用表现，且增益随 skill 覆盖面扩大而上升。
Motivation: 仅向语言模型 agent 提供 skill 并不能保证模型能识别、应用与协同调用这些 skill，缺少大规模、可验证的 skill 使用训练与评测数据。
Method: SKT 流水线先筛选单 skill 与多 skill 配置，再用基于规则与基于 agent 的双重验证合成任务并以反馈引导修复，只保留充分使用每个必需 skill 的成功轨迹；同一管线加不相交测试池另建 SkillEval 可执行基准，并做监督微调、验证消融、跨 harness 评测与 scaling 实验。
Result: 用 2,000 个公开 skill 产出 4,000 个任务包与 27,164 条验证轨迹；在 SKT 轨迹上的监督微调跨多样模型、基准与 agent harness 一致提升 skill-use 表现，增益依赖高质量监督、可跨 agent 接口迁移，并随 skill 覆盖面扩大而增加。
Conclusion: 经验证的合成数据是可扩展的 skill-use 训练路径，其收益来自监督质量而非单一 harness 的接口特性。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: SKT 流水线先筛选单 skill 与多 skill 配置，再用基于规则与基于 agent 的双重验证合成任务并以反馈引导修复，只保留充分使用每个必需 skill 的成功轨迹；同一管线加不相交测试池另建 SkillEval 可执行基准，并做监督微调、验证消融、跨 harness 评测与 scaling 实验。
summary_sections.result: 用 2,000 个公开 skill 产出 4,000 个任务包与 27,164 条验证轨迹；在 SKT 轨迹上的监督微调跨多样模型、基准与 agent harness 一致提升 skill-use 表现，增益依赖高质量监督、可跨 agent 接口迁移，并随 skill 覆盖面扩大而增加。
summary_sections.conclusion: 经验证的合成数据是可扩展的 skill-use 训练路径，其收益来自监督质量而非单一 harness 的接口特性。

papers.title: UniCross: Unified Cross-Skill Dexterous Manipulation Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Many dexterous manipulation tasks require the object to remain securely held throughout the interaction. From the perspective of hand-object relational motion, such manipulation comprises four canonical skills: grasping, relocation, in-hand rotation, and in-hand translation. Human hands flexibly compose these skills to accomplish complex tasks. Existing approaches, however, model these skills separately with skill-specific action constraints, objectives, or even dedicated hand morphologies, which breaks the compatibility and continuity required for long-horizon composition. In this work, we present a unified framework that models all four skills in a single formulation that shares the same state and action spaces and a common objective structure. This formulation enables distillation of a single cross-skill policy conditioned on the relational motion objectives, which achieves strong performance across all four skills, generalizes to unseen objects, remains robust to disturbances, and chains skills into long-horizon manipulation without switching policies. The framework also transfers effectively across different hand morphologies. Overall, our results suggest that different dexterous manipulation skills can be viewed as instantiations of a shared task formulation, revealing the intrinsic consistency. Project page: https://zdchan.github.io/UniCross/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniCross 把抓取、重定位、手内旋转、手内平移四类灵巧操作技能统一到共享的状态空间、动作空间与目标结构中，按关系运动目标条件化蒸馏出单一跨技能策略。该策略在四类技能上均取得强表现，能泛化到未见物体、抗扰动，并在不切换策略的情况下把技能串成长时程操作，且可跨不同手部形态迁移。
Motivation: 现有方法为每类技能单独设计动作约束、目标甚至专用手部形态，导致技能间不兼容、不连续，长时程组合必须切换策略。
Method: 以手-物体关系运动 (relational motion) 为统一视角，把四类技能写进同一状态空间、动作空间与共同目标结构的单一形式化；在此形式化上以关系运动目标为条件蒸馏出一个跨技能策略 (cross-skill policy)，并检验跨手部形态迁移。
Result: 单一跨技能策略在抓取、重定位、手内旋转、手内平移四类技能上均取得强表现，泛化到未见物体，对扰动保持鲁棒，可在不切换策略的情况下串联成长时程操作，并能跨不同手部形态有效迁移。
Conclusion: 不同灵巧操作技能可视为同一共享任务形式化的不同实例，其内在一致性足以支撑单一策略的长时程组合与跨形态迁移。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning for Code Optimization
papers.abstract_en: RL for code correctness is now established: have the model generate a program, run it against hidden test cases, and reward solutions that pass. Extending this to code optimization seems straightforward: just add execution time to the reward. But in practice, once timing drives the reward, small problems in measurement noise, reward sparsity, or GRPO instability overwhelm the signal and make RL fail: generated solutions are barely faster, and more of them can fail. We make execution time learnable through three stages: (1) how code is tested, by building DMC-Optim with large optimization tests and a calibrated sandbox; (2) how speed is turned into reward, by composing correctness and speed in the RL environment and using an offline simulator to predict the most promising configurations; and (3) how the model learns from that reward, by adapting GRPO and evaluation to the sparser, noisier timed-execution setting. On DMC-Optim, the strongest optimization-aware configurations improve strict top-50% pass@1 from 18.0% to 31.3% on Qwen 2.5 7B and from 30.7% to 50.4% on CWM 32B. These gains further increase at stricter percentiles such as top-30%, with 125% relative improvement for CWM 32B, while preserving pure-correctness scores. When the timing sandbox is degraded, robust optimization RL reaches 100% to 200% improvement over standard RLVR, depending on the evaluation criterion. On LCB, CWM 32B wins up to 83% of median-sample speed comparisons against standard RLVR. Relative to the fastest correct human submissions per problem, it reaches about half the human rate of complexity-class improvements (13% vs. 22%).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把代码优化做成可学习的 RL 目标：先建 DMC-Optim 大型优化测试集与校准计时沙箱，再在奖励里组合正确性与速度并用离线模拟器挑配置，最后改造 GRPO 与评测以适配稀疏带噪的计时信号。在 DMC-Optim 上 strict top-50% pass@1 从 18.0% 提到 31.3%（Qwen 2.5 7B）、30.7% 提到 50.4%（CWM 32B），同时保持纯正确性分数不降。
Motivation: RL 做代码正确性已成熟，但把执行时间直接加进奖励后，测量噪声、奖励稀疏与 GRPO 不稳定会淹没信号：生成解几乎没变快，甚至更多失败。
Method: 三阶段：构建 DMC-Optim（大型优化测试与校准沙箱）；在 RL 环境中组合正确性与速度奖励，并用离线模拟器预测最有希望的配置；针对稀疏带噪的计时执行改造 GRPO 与评测流程。
Result: DMC-Optim 上 strict top-50% pass@1：Qwen 2.5 7B 18.0%→31.3%，CWM 32B 30.7%→50.4%；更严的 top-30% 提升更大，CWM 32B 相对提升 125%，且纯正确性分数保持。计时沙箱被破坏时，robust optimization RL 相对标准 RLVR 提升 100%–200%（视评测准则）。LCB 上 CWM 32B 在中位样本速度对比中最多赢 83%；相对每题最快正确人类提交，复杂度类改进率达人类的一半（13% vs 22%）。
Conclusion: 执行时间要先在测试、奖励与优化三处同时变得可学习，RL 才能把速度信号转成真实加速，且不牺牲正确性。

papers.title: What do Reward Models Memorize?
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies what discriminatively trained reward models (RMs) memorize by measuring counterfactual memorization on two human preference datasets. We show that RMs 1) misallocate memorization to easy, high margin preference pairs, 2) memorize dataset-specific shortcuts (e.g., model identity, user sampling strategy), and 3) overgeneralize simple heuristic correlates of human preference (e.g., length, compliance) when confronted with unseen preference pairs. Overall, our findings indicate that discriminative training of RMs from human preference data results in biased RMs not yet capable of judging response quality in context-dependent scenarios.
papers.comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对判别式训练的 reward model (RM) 做反事实记忆度量，发现记忆被错配到易分、高 margin 的偏好对上，且模型记住数据集特有捷径（模型身份、用户采样策略），并在未见偏好对上把长度、服从性等简单启发式相关当成质量判据。结论是判别式 RM 尚不能在依赖上下文的场景中判断回答质量。
Motivation: 判别式 RM 被广泛用于偏好对齐，但其记忆内容与泛化失败模式缺乏直接度量，导致无法解释 RM 在上下文相关场景下给出的有偏质量判断。
Method: 在两个人类偏好数据集上以反事实记忆度量 (counterfactual memorization) 刻画判别式训练的 RM，考察记忆在偏好对 margin 与难度上的分布、数据集特有捷径特征，以及在未见偏好对上的启发式过泛化。
Result: 三项发现：RM 把记忆错配到易分、高 margin 的偏好对；记住数据集特有捷径（如模型身份、用户采样策略）；在未见偏好对上过泛化长度与服从性等人类偏好的简单启发式相关。
Conclusion: 判别式训练从人类偏好数据得到的 RM 是有偏的，尚不具备在上下文依赖场景中判断回答质量的能力。

papers.title: ModPack: Extensible Teleoperation Interface for Bimanual Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Existing teleoperation systems are often tailored to specific robot hardware and task domains, limiting their scalability and adaptability. We present ModPack, a modular and extensible teleoperation system designed to support diverse robot embodiments and task requirements within a unified framework. At the core of ModPack is a self-contained wearable "backpack" that integrates onboard computation, power, communication, and data storage. Built on top of this shared interface, the system supports plug-and-play capability modules including joint-level teleoperation with haptic feedback, mobile manipulation, and active perception. Experiments across two distinct robot platforms and real-world mobile manipulation tasks demonstrate that ModPack provides a flexible and reusable framework for data collection and policy learning and collects higher quality data than a robot-free alternative. To support future research, we open-source the complete hardware design and software stack. Project website: https://modpack-robotics.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ModPack 用一个自带算力、供电、通信与存储的可穿戴“背包”作为共享接口，在其上插拔关节级遥操作（含触觉反馈）、移动操作与主动感知模块，统一适配不同机器人本体与任务。在两个不同机器人平台和真实移动操作任务上，它比一个 robot-free 替代方案采集到更高质量的数据，可用于数据采集与策略学习，并开源全部硬件设计与软件栈。
Motivation: 现有遥操作接口与特定机器人硬件和任务域强绑定，换平台或换任务就要重做，数据采集与策略学习难以规模化复用。
Method: 核心是自包含可穿戴背包，集成机载计算、电源、通信与数据存储；其上构建即插即用能力模块，包括带触觉反馈的关节级遥操作、移动操作 (mobile manipulation) 与主动感知 (active perception)，构成统一框架。
Result: 在两个不同机器人平台与真实世界移动操作任务上开展实验，ModPack 作为数据采集与策略学习框架表现出灵活性与可复用性，采集的数据质量高于一个 robot-free 替代方案。
Conclusion: 把算力与通信下沉到可穿戴共享接口、能力做成插拔模块，可让同一套遥操作栈跨本体复用并产出更高质量的训练数据；完整硬件设计与软件栈已开源。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections for Parameter-Efficient Finetuning
papers.abstract_en: Finetuning methods for foundation models usually change weights, prompts, or hidden states, while leaving the residual topology fixed. We ask whether residual topology itself can become a finetuning object. To study this, we adapt manifold-constrained hyper-connections (mHC), recently introduced for pre-training, to frozen-backbone finetuning. mHC turns a Transformer into an input-dependent multi-stream residual architecture, routing representations through multiple streams at every sub-layer. Across mHC variants, we find that dynamic residual routing can finetune Transformers, but that its role differs from pre-training: by preserving stream mixing and learning only how sub-layers access streams, loss is improved and trainable parameters are reduced. Overall, our results identify residual routing as a promising architectural axis for efficient finetuning of foundation models.
papers.comment: NeurIPS 2026, AXIOM: Foundations of Efficient Deep Learning workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把预训练用的流形约束超连接 (manifold-constrained hyper-connections, mHC) 移植到冻结骨干的微调中，让 Transformer 变成输入相关的多流残差结构，每个子层把表示路由到多条 stream。保留 stream 混合、只学习子层如何访问 stream，可在减少可训练参数的同时改善 loss。
Motivation: 现有微调方法改权重、prompt 或隐藏状态，却把残差拓扑固定不动；本文追问残差拓扑本身能否成为微调对象。
Method: 将 mHC 适配到冻结骨干 (frozen-backbone) 微调：Transformer 转为输入依赖的多流残差架构，每个子层做动态流路由；跨多个 mHC 变体比较，保留 stream 混合、仅学习子层访问 stream 的方式。
Result: 在 mHC 各变体上，动态残差路由可用于微调 Transformer，且作用与预训练阶段不同：该配置改善 loss 并减少可训练参数。
Conclusion: 残差路由是基础模型高效微调的一个有前景的架构维度，其在微调中的角色与预训练不同。

papers.title: ReViV: Reconstructing the Viewer and the View in 4D from Monocular Egocentric Video
papers.abstract_en: Egocentric devices, such as wearable front-facing cameras, provide a unique perspective for capturing the continuous interaction between a human viewer and the surrounding environment. A holistic and efficient multimodal model capable of reconstructing this 4D representation is therefore highly desirable. However, existing approaches often rely on auxiliary inputs such as pre-computed camera trajectories, treat scene perception and human ego-motion modeling as separate problems despite their strong interdependency, and suffer from slow inference time. To address these limitations, we present ReViV, the first unified framework for holistic egocentric 4D reconstruction that extracts both viewer and view dynamics from a single monocular RGB video. We formulate the task as learning the full joint probability distribution over multimodal signals, including RGB video, camera trajectory, gaze direction, full-body motion, hand motion, and depth. Powered by a Masked Generative Egocentric Transformer, ReViV operates within a single feed-forward architecture to simultaneously reconstruct the temporally consistent 4D reconstruction across the viewer and the view with fast inference speed. Extensive experiments on diverse benchmarks, including HoloAssist, HOT3D, ARCTIC, Aria Digital Twin, and TACO, demonstrate that ReViV achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and efficiency across holistic ego-body, hand, and gaze reconstruction, camera tracking, while maintaining highly competitive egocentric depth estimation without relying on heavy task-specific priors. Code and models are fully open-sourced: https://reviv4d.github.io/.

papers.title: Linear Independent Component Analysis via Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: Linear Independent Component Analysis (ICA) recovers jointly independent source signals from their linear mixtures. To achieve this, classical ICA algorithms attempt to maximize non-Gaussianity, measured by negentropy, which is linked to independence by information theory. Because exact negentropy optimization is intractable, they rely on proxy contrast functions, such as fourth-order cumulants and parametric log-likelihoods. We propose instead to use the squared $L_2$-Wasserstein distance to a standard Gaussian as the ICA contrast. We show that the Wasserstein distance between a standard normal distribution and linear projections of the data is maximized when the projection recovers an independent component, and that under a regularity condition on the sources this maximum is separated from every genuine mixture by an explicit margin. We uncover the advantageous properties of the resulting estimator: for sources with a smooth density it is $\sqrt{N}$-consistent and asymptotically normal with a closed-form variance, whereas for a source with an atom the contrast has a kink at the true direction, which makes the estimator exact with probability tending to one. The proposed OT-ICA algorithm finds this projection by gradient-based optimization. Empirical evaluation on simulated data shows that OT-ICA outperforms proxy-based methods and that the $W_2^2$ contrast provides more robust signal than proxy contrasts in measuring non-Gaussianity for different distributional mixtures of the latent variables. Application to linear causal disentanglement and EEG artifact removal, along with further applications detailed in the appendix, confirms OT-ICA can be used for applied ICA tasks without distributional assumptions.
papers.comment: 49 pages, 16 figures. A preliminary version appeared at the 9th Workshop on Tractable Probabilistic Modeling (TPM), UAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OT-ICA 用数据线性投影到标准高斯的平方 L2-Wasserstein 距离替代传统 negentropy 代理对比函数做线性 ICA；证明该距离在投影恢复独立成分时取极大且与真实混合方向有显式间隔，平滑密度源下估计量 √N 一致、渐近正态且方差有闭式，含原子的源下对比在真方向出现 kink，估计量以概率趋于 1 精确。模拟数据上优于代理对比法，EEG 伪迹去除与线性因果解耦验证其可无分布假设地用于应用 ICA。
Motivation: 经典 ICA 靠四阶累积量或参数对数似然等代理对比函数逼近 negentropy，而精确 negentropy 优化本身难解，代理在不同潜变量分布混合下对非高斯性的度量不够稳健。
Method: 以投影分布到标准高斯的平方 L2-Wasserstein 距离 (W2^2) 作为 ICA 对比函数，证明其在恢复独立成分的投影上取极大并给出与所有真混合方向分离的显式 margin；用基于梯度的 OT-ICA 算法搜索该投影，并给出平滑密度源与含原子源两种正则条件下的估计理论。
Result: 理论结果：源密度光滑时估计量 √N 一致、渐近正态且方差有闭式；源含原子时对比在真方向有 kink，估计量以概率趋于 1 精确。模拟数据上 OT-ICA 优于基于代理对比的方法，W2^2 对不同潜变量分布混合测度非高斯性比代理对比给出更稳健的信号；在线性因果解耦与 EEG 伪迹去除任务上验证可用。
Conclusion: 用最优传输的 Wasserstein 对比替代 negentropy 代理，可在无分布假设下同时得到可证明的分离性、√N 一致性与含原子源的精确恢复，并支撑实际 ICA 应用。

papers.title: Adapting Generalist Vehicle Models for High-Speed MPC Across Terrains
papers.abstract_en: High-speed off-road autonomy requires precise closed-loop control for a target vehicle while remaining robust across changing terrains. Recent forward kinodynamic (FKD) prediction foundation models suggest a promising path, starting from a generalist model and specializing it to the target platform. However, effective specialization remains challenging, as it often requires substantial real-world data, and models adapted to one setting can still overfit to specific terrains or driving regimes. We present OptCar (Optimized Car), a recipe for bridging the gap from generalist to specialist FKD models that preserves cross-terrain generalization while optimizing performance for a specific vehicle. OptCar introduces a transformer FKD architecture that uses FiLM to condition multi-step predictions on a single dynamics context token summarizing recent state-action history. It then specializes the generalist model using limited real-world data and targeted synthetic rollouts from environment-specific system identification. In closed-loop model predictive control (MPC) experiments across three terrains and an out-of-distribution cart-pulling task, the largest gains appear at 6 m/s, the highest speed evaluated and the regime in which slip dominates tracking error. On vegetation + dirt, the most slip-diverse terrain, OptCar reduces 6 m/s trajectory tracking error by roughly 55% relative to AnyCar fine-tuned on real data alone, and remains the most accurate even when an unseen cart payload changes the dynamics. With 5 minutes of real data per terrain, OptCar is competitive on road with a specialist trained on 30 minutes of road data and outperforms it when the terrain changes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OptCar 把通用前向运动学 (FKD) 基础模型特化到目标车辆：transformer FKD 架构用 FiLM 把多步预测条件化在一个汇总近期状态-动作历史的 dynamics context token 上，再用少量真实数据加环境系统辨识产生的定向合成 rollout 特化。在三种地形与一个分布外拉车任务的闭环 MPC 实验中，6 m/s（最高评测速度、slip 主导跟踪误差的工况）增益最大：vegetation + dirt 上相对仅用真实数据微调的 AnyCar 把 6 m/s 轨迹跟踪误差降低约 55%。
Motivation: FKD 基础模型从通用模型特化到目标平台需要大量真实数据，且适配到某一设置的模型仍会过拟合特定地形或驾驶工况，跨地形泛化与单车性能难以兼得。
Method: OptCar 是一条从通用到专用 FKD 模型的特化配方：transformer FKD 架构用 FiLM 将多步预测条件化在单个 dynamics context token（汇总近期 state-action 历史）上；特化阶段结合有限真实数据与来自环境特定系统辨识 (system identification) 的定向合成 rollout，随后接入闭环 MPC。
Result: 在三种地形加一个分布外 cart-pulling 任务的闭环 MPC 实验中，最大增益出现在 6 m/s（最高评测速度、slip 主导跟踪误差）；vegetation + dirt（slip 最多样）上 OptCar 相对仅用真实数据微调的 AnyCar 把 6 m/s 轨迹跟踪误差降低约 55%，且在未见过的 cart payload 改变动力学时仍最准确。每地形仅 5 分钟真实数据时，OptCar 在道路上与用 30 分钟道路数据训练的专用模型相当，地形变化时超过它。
Conclusion: 用系统辨识驱动的合成 rollout 加少量真实数据做特化，可以在保住跨地形泛化的同时逼近甚至超过用 30 倍真实数据训练的专用模型，尤其在 slip 主导的高速工况。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: VIA: Visual Interface Agent for Robot Control
papers.abstract_en: Robot manipulation is a complex task that requires visual perception, physical reasoning, planning, and closed-loop control. General-purpose foundation models (FMs) have grown remarkably capable of some of these, especially perception and reasoning. Inspired by the growing ability of FM-powered agents to operate software through visual interfaces, we ask whether that same competence suffices to control a robot directly given the right interface. We present VIA (Visual Interface Agent), a framework that recasts robot control as an agentic task where an off-the-shelf agent drives a manipulator directly through an interface. The interface is a virtual workspace of interactable visual components where the agent can probe pixels of interest with mouse-like tools and command a virtual end-effector to set new target poses with a small set of general tools. We show that VIA enables agents of varying capabilities to perform diverse tabletop manipulation tasks in simulation. We also use VIA to drive an off-the-shelf mobile manipulation robot in the real world to complete tasks that require both navigation and manipulation. Both settings are zero-shot, requiring no robot training or additional action primitives. Performance scales well with the size and strength of the underlying FMs. These results suggest that frontier agents already possess skills that transfer directly to robot control given the right interface: your coding or computer-use agent is, in a sense, secretly a robot-control agent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VIA 把机器人控制改写成视觉界面操作任务：给现成 FM agent 一个由可交互视觉组件构成的虚拟工作区，用鼠标式工具探查像素、用少量通用工具指令虚拟末端执行器设定目标位姿，直接驱动机械臂。仿真中不同能力的 agent 都能完成多种桌面操作任务，真机上还驱动移动操作机器人完成需导航加操作的零样本任务，性能随底层 FM 规模与能力提升。
Motivation: 通用 foundation model 在感知与推理上已很强，但机器人控制通常仍需专门训练与动作原语；作者要检验 FM agent 操作软件界面的能力是否足以直接控制机器人。
Method: VIA (Visual Interface Agent) 框架：把机械臂控制建模为 agentic 任务，接口是含可交互视觉组件的虚拟工作区，agent 用 mouse-like 工具探查感兴趣像素、用少量通用工具命令虚拟末端执行器设定新目标位姿；全程零样本，不做机器人训练、不加额外动作原语。
Result: 在仿真中，能力各异的 agent 借 VIA 完成多种桌面操作任务；在真实世界用现成移动操作机器人完成同时需要导航与操作的任务；两种设定均为零样本，且性能随底层 FM 的规模与强度良好扩展。
Conclusion: 前沿 agent 已具备可直接迁移到机器人控制的技能，前提是给出合适接口——你的编码或计算机使用 agent 在某种意义上就是机器人控制 agent。

papers.title: Can Agentic Trading Systems Pay for Their Own Intelligence?
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used in trading systems, where model reasoning, tool use, and continual decisions incur costs that are expected to produce trading value. Existing evaluations typically report performance metrics, but rarely examine agentic viability: whether dynamic LLM-mediated decisions convert their induced costs into measurable incremental profit. To apply this criterion, we introduce TradeLens, a trace-grounded diagnostic toolkit for evaluating agentic trading systems from their trading records, runtime traces, and deployment configurations. It reconstructs trading trajectories, attributes profit and cost to interpretable evidence, and diagnoses whether and why an agent pays for its own intelligence. We conduct extensive analysis across backbone models, capital scales, trading frequencies, and system architectures, together with deployment discussion. Our results show that viability hinges on intelligence-to-profit conversion: models exhibit different failure patterns, such as poor asset selection in DeepSeek-V3.2 and negative timing in GLM-4.7, while capital scale, trading frequency, and architecture matter primarily in these runs, especially through their effects on decision-attributed timing value. These findings reframe the evaluation of LLMbased trading agents from capability-centric performance ranking to trace-grounded diagnosis of intelligence-to-profit conversion. Our code is available at https://github.com/ParadooxAI/TradeLens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 TradeLens：一个基于交易记录、运行时轨迹与部署配置的诊断工具包，判断 LLM 交易智能体的推理与工具调用成本是否真的转化为可归因的增量利润。跨骨干模型、资金规模、交易频率与系统架构的分析显示，可行性取决于“智能到利润的转化”，且失败模式因模型而异（DeepSeek-V3.2 选资产差、GLM-4.7 择时为负）。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 交易智能体评测只报性能指标，不检验 agentic viability：动态 LLM 决策带来的成本是否真能换回可测量的增量利润。
Method: TradeLens 从交易记录、运行时轨迹和部署配置重建交易轨迹，把利润与成本归因到可解释证据，并诊断智能体是否、以及为何“为自己的智能买单”；分析维度覆盖骨干模型、资金规模、交易频率与系统架构。
Result: 跨骨干模型、资金规模、交易频率和系统架构的分析显示：可行性取决于智能到利润的转化；DeepSeek-V3.2 表现为资产选择差，GLM-4.7 表现为择时为负；资金规模、交易频率与架构主要通过影响决策归因的择时价值 (decision-attributed timing value) 起作用。
Conclusion: LLM 交易智能体的评测应从以能力为中心的性能排名，转向基于轨迹的“智能到利润转化”诊断；代码已开源。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: RUBRIC: Realism--Utility Balanced Ranking for Imbalanced Classification
papers.abstract_en: Class imbalance poses a fundamental challenge in risk-sensitive applications such as fraud detection and medical diagnosis, where minority-class samples are scarce yet critical for accurate classification. Existing oversampling methods generate synthetic samples to rebalance class distributions; however, they often produce large numbers of low-quality candidates that distort decision boundaries or introduce artifacts, leading to overfitting and degraded generalization. In this work, we introduce \textbf{RUBRIC}, a generator-agnostic filtering framework that formulates synthetic sample selection as a quality-over-quantity optimization problem. RUBRIC ranks candidates using a realism-utility trade-off: realism is estimated via a neural density-ratio discriminator from each candidate's resemblance to real minority samples, while utility captures proximity to the decision boundary through a concave, margin-based scoring function $g_-(t)=-\log(1+e^{-t/τ})$. The discriminator uses the same architecture and training protocol on every benchmark and is fit independently to that dataset's real minority class versus its synthetic pool. We show that, under mild regularity conditions, the proposed filtering framework monotonically tightens the generalization bound for margin-based classifiers by jointly reducing distribution shift and suppressing near-negative tail contributions. Through extensive experiments on standard public imbalanced-classification benchmarks, we demonstrate that RUBRIC boosts minority-class recall while preserving overall discriminative ability across multiple data generators. Sensitivity analyses in $λ$ and the selection budget $K$ further characterize performance trade-offs oriented toward ranking quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RUBRIC 是一个生成器无关的合成样本过滤框架，把不平衡分类的过采样改写成质量优先于数量的优化：用神经密度比判别器估计样本对真实少数类的 realism，用凹的 margin 打分函数 g₋(t)=−log(1+e^{−t/τ}) 度量靠近决策边界的 utility，按二者权衡排序筛选。在多个标准公开不平衡分类基准与多种生成器上，它提升少数类 recall 同时保持整体判别能力，并给出 λ 与选择预算 K 的敏感性分析。
Motivation: 过采样方法会生成大量低质量合成样本，扭曲决策边界或引入伪影，导致过拟合与泛化下降，而欺诈检测、医学诊断这类风险敏感场景中少数类样本稀缺却关键。
Method: 把合成样本选择形式化为质量-数量优化：realism 由神经密度比判别器给出，且在每个基准上用相同架构与训练协议、针对该数据集的真实少数类 vs 合成池独立拟合；utility 用凹的 margin 打分函数 g₋(t)=−log(1+e^{−t/τ}) 刻画到决策边界的邻近度，再按 realism-utility 权衡排序并施加选择预算 K。
Result: 在标准公开不平衡分类基准上、跨多个数据生成器，RUBRIC 提升少数类 recall 同时保持整体判别能力；在温和正则条件下，该过滤框架通过同时减小分布偏移与抑制近负类尾部贡献，单调收紧基于 margin 的分类器泛化界；λ 与选择预算 K 的敏感性分析刻画了面向排序质量的性能权衡。
Conclusion: 合成少数类样本应当按 realism 与 utility 的权衡筛选而非全量保留：联合压低分布偏移和近负尾贡献即可单调收紧 margin 分类器的泛化界，并在实验中换来少数类 recall 的提升。

papers.title: LightCrafter: PBR-Conditioned Video Diffusion Refinement for Controllable and Consistent Relighting
papers.abstract_en: Video relighting requires balancing long-form temporal consistency with a physically grounded understanding of light transport, which depends on accurate estimation of intrinsic scene properties such as materials, geometry, and illumination. Existing methods follow two paradigms: (1) reconstruct a video's photometric properties via inverse rendering and relight them to a target illumination via forward rendering, using physically-based rendering (PBR) or a neural renderer; these suffer from noisy reconstructions and struggle with hard-to-model effects such as global illumination. (2) Frame the task as generative video-to-video translation conditioned on relighting targets (a target environment map or text); this limits relighting control and temporal stability, since diffusion models struggle to translate long-form videos, and is constrained by the availability of input/relit training pairs. We propose LightCrafter, a hybrid pipeline that reformulates video relighting as video translation of a proxy video: rather than translating the input video directly to the target, we translate a PBR rendering of the input under the target illumination to the final target. This bakes illumination targets into the PBR proxy, removing the need to teach the diffusion model illumination concepts like environment maps, and enables more intricate lighting control while naturally providing long-form temporal consistency. We show PBR renders alone already outperform some prior art but struggle with effects like global illumination; to capture these, we leverage photometric priors in video generation models by post-training CogVideoX on synthetic video pairs and real-world unpaired videos. We outperform prior state-of-the-art on existing real-world relighting benchmarks and contribute a synthetic benchmark for further analysis. We will release our dataset, benchmark, metrics, and code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LightCrafter 把视频重打光重构为对 PBR 代理视频的翻译：先用目标光照渲染输入视频得到 PBR proxy，再用视频扩散模型把它精修成最终结果，从而把光照目标烘焙进代理、免去教模型环境贴图概念。纯 PBR 渲染已超过部分先前方法但缺全局光照，经合成视频对与真实无配对视频后训练的 CogVideoX 补足后，在现有真实重打光基准上超过先前 SOTA。
Motivation: 逆渲染路线重建噪声大且难建模全局光照，生成式路线受限于可控性、长视频时序稳定性以及成对重打光训练数据的稀缺。
Method: 混合管线：以目标光照对输入做 PBR 渲染生成 proxy video，再用视频扩散模型将 proxy 翻译为最终目标；在合成视频对与真实无配对视频上对 CogVideoX 做后训练，借视频生成模型的光度先验捕捉全局光照等难建模效应。
Result: 纯 PBR 渲染已优于部分先前方法；完整管线在现有真实重打光基准上超过先前 SOTA，并贡献一个合成基准；将发布数据集、基准、指标与代码。
Conclusion: 把光照目标烘焙进 PBR 代理再做扩散精修，可同时获得更细的光照控制与长视频时序一致性，绕开成对训练数据稀缺的约束。

papers.title: Hallucination Self-Play: Bootstrapping Reinforced Detector via Evolved Generator
papers.abstract_en: Identifying faithfulness hallucinations in LLM-generated outputs remains challenging due to the scarcity of high-quality annotated data. Recent work relies on advanced LLMs to synthesize training data, including rationales, labels, and hallucinated claims. However, these methods treat the generator as a static component, limiting iterative improvement of the detector. To address this limitation, we introduce Hallucination Self-Play (HSP), a novel framework that enables the detector to bootstrap with an evolved generator. HSP involves two roles initialized from the same base model, a detector that assesses the faithfulness of model outputs, and a generator that produces increasingly hard-to-detect hallucinated responses. Specifically, the detector is first fine-tuned on human-labeled data and then employed as a reward model to train the generator via reinforcement learning from AI feedback (RLAIF). In turn, the evolved generator synthesizes hallucination data to further optimize the detector through rule-based reinforcement learning. Experiments on RAGTruth and LLM-AggreFact across three model families demonstrate that the proposed framework can progressively enhance a small LLM to match or even outperform advanced LLMs without external supervision. Our code is available at https://github.com/maybenotime/Hallucination_Self-Play.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HSP 让检测器与生成器从同一基座模型出发交替自博弈：检测器先在人工标注数据上微调，再作为奖励模型用 RLAIF 训练生成器，生成器随后合成更难检出的幻觉数据，用基于规则的强化学习反哺检测器。在 RAGTruth 与 LLM-AggreFact 上跨三个模型家族，该框架把小 LLM 逐步提升到匹配甚至超过先进 LLM，且不依赖外部监督。
Motivation: 忠实性幻觉 (faithfulness hallucination) 检测缺少高质量标注数据；用强 LLM 合成训练数据的做法把生成器当成静态组件，检测器无法随难度上升而迭代改进。
Method: 同一基座模型初始化两个角色：检测器先在人工标注数据上微调，再充当奖励模型，通过 RLAIF 训练生成器产出越来越难检出的幻觉回复；生成器合成的幻觉数据再经基于规则的强化学习 (rule-based RL) 优化检测器，形成闭环自博弈。
Result: 在 RAGTruth 与 LLM-AggreFact 两个基准、三个模型家族上，HSP 能持续增强一个小 LLM，使其匹配甚至超越先进 LLM，且无需外部监督。
Conclusion: 把生成器纳入与检测器的交替进化回路，可以在没有外部监督的条件下让小模型的幻觉检测能力追平或超过大模型。

papers.title: ECGLight: Compute-Light Framework For Paper ECG Digitization and Myocardial Infarction Screening
papers.abstract_en: Electrocardiography (ECG) is one of the most widely used tests for diagnosing cardiovascular disease. Yet several remote clinics still utilize paper ECG printouts for their analysis due to limited connectivity and computational capacity. As a result, vast numbers of physical ECGs obtained in remote areas still remain incapable of being accessed by contemporary artificial-intelligence (AI)-based decision support as they require high computational resources or strong high-speed internet connectivity. This causes several cases where conditions like acute coronary occlusion (ACS) is overlooked and reperfusion therapy delayed. Although prior work has tackled digitization and diagnosis separately, and utilized advanced AI models for them, there still remains a lack of a compute-light, on-device framework that reconstructs paper ECGs at high fidelity, while accurately supporting multiple clinically relevant endpoints. We address this need with an end-to-end lightweight on-device digitization-to-diagnosis pipeline that converts a smartphone photo or scan of a paper ECG into a calibrated 12-lead signal and screens for Myocardial Infarction (MI) pathologies, with SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) to support interpretability. Trained and evaluated on 21,799 ECGs from the PTB-XL dataset and further validated on hospital-acquired ECG-Matrix dataset, the complete system runs in <30 s per ECG on CPU-only resources, achieving 95.51% accuracy (F1 = 0.9519) for MI detection on PTB-XL and 88.89% accuracy (F1 = 0.8862) for OMI detection on ECG-Matrix. This work showcases that legacy paper records can be reliably democratized in any part of the world, providing a scalable decision support when digital ECG export, connectivity, or high-end compute are unavailable. Github: https://github.com/nshreyasvi/ECGLight
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ECGLight 把纸质心电图照片直接变成可诊断信号：手机拍照或扫描输入，端到端轻量流水线重建校准的 12 导联信号并筛查心肌梗死 (MI)，配 SHAP 做可解释性。在 PTB-XL 的 21,799 份 ECG 上训练与评估，MI 检测准确率 95.51%（F1 = 0.9519）；在医院采集的 ECG-Matrix 上验证 OMI，准确率 88.89%（F1 = 0.8862）。整套系统在纯 CPU 上每份 ECG 运行不足 30 秒，适用于无高速网络与高端算力的偏远诊所。
Motivation: 偏远诊所仍依赖纸质心电图打印件，现有 AI 决策支持需要高算力或高速联网，导致大量纸质 ECG 无法接入，急性冠脉闭漏诊、再灌注治疗被延误。已有工作把数字化与诊断分开做，缺少一个在设备端、算力轻量、同时高保真重建并支持多个临床终点的框架。
Method: 端到端轻量 on-device 流水线：输入智能手机照片或扫描件，输出校准的 12 导联信号，再接心肌梗死病理筛查模块，并用 SHAP 提供可解释性。在 PTB-XL 上训练与评估，并在医院采集的 ECG-Matrix 数据集上进一步验证；推理限定 CPU-only 资源。
Result: PTB-XL 上 21,799 份 ECG 训练与评估，MI 检测准确率 95.51%、F1 = 0.9519；医院采集的 ECG-Matrix 上 OMI 检测准确率 88.89%、F1 = 0.8862。完整系统在纯 CPU 上每份 ECG 运行时间 <30 秒。
Conclusion: 纸质心电图记录可以在无数字 ECG 导出、无联网、无高端算力的地区被可靠数字化并转成可扩展的决策支持，前提是把数字化与多临床终点诊断压进一个 CPU 可跑的端到端流水线。

papers.title: Information Gain-based Rollout Policy Optimization: An Adaptive Tree-Structured Rollout Approach for Multi-Turn Search Agents
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) improves large language model (LLM) agents on long-horizon search tasks that require multiple intermediate decisions before a final outcome. However, rollout budgets are often allocated without assessing intermediate-state utility, which can waste computation on unpromising branches. We propose Information Gain-based Rollout Policy Optimization (IGRPO), a framework that organizes rollout collection around intermediate-state informativeness. Specifically, IGRPO performs budget-aware tree-structured rollouts in which expansion probabilities depend on node-level informativeness, allowing informative branches to receive more computation while less informative branches are expanded less frequently within a fixed rollout budget. By directly shaping how training trajectories are generated, IGRPO induces a limiting teacher distribution over search trajectories that favors higher cumulative informativeness. The resulting distribution provides an explicit policy optimization target, connecting adaptive rollout collection with principled policy learning. Experiments on seven search-augmented question answering benchmarks show that IGRPO achieves higher average accuracy than strong baselines on both 3B and 7B backbones under comparable rollout budgets, supporting informativeness-guided trajectory generation for training search agents. Code is available at https://github.com/e3trange/IGRPO.

papers.title: Target-Guided Selective Reweighting for Physics-Informed Neural Network Inverse Problems: A Transfer Learning Approach
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) often face ill-posed optimization, competing losses, and parameter compensation in partial differential equation (PDE) inverse problems. Transfer learning can reuse source-task representations, but direct fine-tuning may induce negative transfer when source and target physics differ, leading to low field error but inaccurate parameter recovery. To address this issue, we propose Target-Guided Selective Reweighting PINN (TGSR-PINN), a target-evidence-driven representation correction method for PINN inverse transfer learning. TGSR-PINN transfers source network weights and biases but initializes target physical parameters independently. After target short adaptation, it scores neurons using first-order Taylor sensitivity and pre-activation variance on fixed batches. These scores are converted into continuous weak-adaptation signals using a Gaussian mixture model with rank fallback. TGSR-PINN then applies bounded selective soft decay to the corresponding input weight rows and biases without pruning or resetting them. Experiments on a zero-source high-Péclet inflow-outflow problem with nonzero Dirichlet data and an outflow boundary layer, Allen-Cahn to Burgers cross-PDE transfer, and 5\%-noise reaction-diffusion inverse problems show that TGSR-PINN improves parameter recovery while maintaining low field error. Ablation studies indicate that neuron target scoring, weak-adaptation estimation, layer protection, and selective soft decay jointly contribute to the observed benefits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 TGSR-PINN：PINN 反问题迁移学习中，先独立初始化目标物理参数、短适应后用一阶 Taylor 敏感度与 pre-activation 方差给神经元打分，再经高斯混合模型（带 rank fallback）转成连续弱适应信号，对相应输入权重行与偏置做有界选择性软衰减。在零源高 Péclet inflow-outflow、Allen-Cahn 到 Burgers 跨 PDE 迁移与 5% 噪声 reaction-diffusion 反问题上，参数恢复改善且场误差保持低。
Motivation: PINN 反问题存在不适定优化、损失竞争与参数补偿；直接微调在源与目标物理不同时会负迁移，表现为场误差低但参数恢复不准。
Method: TGSR-PINN 迁移源网络权重与偏置但独立初始化目标物理参数；目标短适应后在固定 batch 上用一阶 Taylor 敏感度与 pre-activation 方差打分，经高斯混合模型（GMM，rank fallback）转为连续弱适应信号，再对对应输入权重行与偏置施加有界选择性软衰减，不剪枝不重置。
Result: 在零源高 Péclet inflow-outflow（非零 Dirichlet 数据、出流边界层）、Allen-Cahn→Burgers 跨 PDE 迁移、5% 噪声 reaction-diffusion 三个反问题上，参数恢复改善同时保持低场误差；消融显示神经元目标打分、弱适应估计、层保护与选择性软衰减共同贡献收益。
Conclusion: 以目标证据驱动的选择性表征修正可在源目标物理不同时避免负迁移，做到参数恢复与场误差兼顾，且四个组件缺一不可。

papers.title: Non-asymptotic Convergence of Stochastic Gradient Descent in Score-based Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: Score-based Generative Models (SGMs) have achieved impressive performance in data generation across a wide range of applications. While the statistical properties of their sampling procedures are increasingly well understood, the optimization dynamics underlying their training remain less explored. SGMs are typically trained by minimizing a weighted denoising score-matching objective, yet optimization guarantees with stochastic gradients remain limited. In this work, we study Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) for SGMs, contributing results in two complementary regimes. For general score parameterizations, we derive a non-convex analysis of SGD for the weighted denoising score-matching objective, making explicit how the resulting optimization bound depends on the loss weighting and time-sampling distribution. We then consider overparameterized two-layer ReLU networks and develop a Neural Tangent Kernel analysis tailored to diffusion training with stochastic gradients, yielding score-approximation error bounds along the SGD trajectory. Our analysis quantifies the role of the reweighting factor in these bounds, providing a theoretical characterization of weighting choices used in practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 给出 score-based 生成模型 (SGM) 训练中 SGD 的非渐近收敛理论：对一般 score 参数化给出加权去噪分数匹配目标的非凸分析，对过参数化两层 ReLU 网络给出适配扩散训练随机梯度的 NTK 分析。界显式依赖损失加权与时间采样分布，从而为实践中常用的 weighting 选择提供理论刻画。
Motivation: SGM 的采样程序统计性质已较清楚，但训练背后的优化动力学研究不足，带随机梯度的优化保证仍然有限。
Method: 两条互补路线：对一般 score 参数化推导加权 denoising score-matching 目标的 SGD 非凸分析，显式追踪优化界对 loss weighting 与 time-sampling distribution 的依赖；对过参数化两层 ReLU 网络建立面向扩散训练随机梯度的 Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) 分析，沿 SGD 轨迹给出 score-approximation error 界。
Result: 得到两类非渐近界：一般参数化下依赖加权与时间采样分布的 SGD 优化界，以及过参数化两层 ReLU 网络沿 SGD 轨迹的 score 近似误差界；两类界都显式量化 reweighting 因子的作用。
Conclusion: SGM 训练的随机梯度优化可以在非凸与过参数化 NTK 两个体制下给出非渐近保证，实践中沿扩散时间的 weighting 选择由此获得理论依据。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Directional Curvature from Armijo Backtracking: A Low-Cost Sharpness Probe and a Calibration-Free Learning-Rate Safeguard for Adam
papers.abstract_en: Local sharpness, defined by the largest Hessian eigenvalue $λ_1$, sets the maximum stable gradient update size, but its computation would usually require running Lanczos or Hessian-vector products. However, we notice that even a single Armijo backtracking line search already contains this information with just a few forward passes, as the accepted step $α$ determines the directional curvature along the search direction up to the multiplicative band set by the backtracking factor. The correlation between $\logα$ and $\logλ_1$ on CIFAR-10, Fashion-MNIST and Imagenette reaches $-0.91$ to $-0.95$ in Pearson correlation, and even after removing the trend per run the correlation remains at $-0.60$ to $-0.70$. This allows for a cheap online Edge-of-Stability estimate of the slow sharpness component. The employed probing mechanism searches along Adam's first-step update direction, at initialisation and nine times over the course of the first 50 optimiser steps. The learning-rate cap is set as twice the smallest observed step size, and in the studied learning-rate ranges ($10^{-3}$ to $3.0$) and GPT-2 pretraining experiments all capped runs avoid divergence; in the general architecture analysis, one MLP architecture is still sensitive to the initial batch order. This probing protocol incurs an approximately one percent overhead, and using a non-binding cap means that the optimiser's state and first update are bit-identical. There is no fine-tuning of any of the protocol parameters to any specific architecture; this is the sense in which this is a calibration-free safeguard. It is meant as a way of avoiding divergence, not achieving accuracy. At GPT-2 scale, multiple measurements also illustrate why an initialisation-only cap is insufficient: directional curvature rises substantially in the first five optimiser steps, which motivates the short probationary window.
papers.comment: 38 pages, 7 figures. Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (10/2026): https://openreview.net/pdf?id=foLGwG3ne4. Code: https://github.com/jfrochte/armijo-curvature-probe

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用单次 Armijo 回溯线搜索的接受步长 α 直接估计沿 Adam 首步更新方向的方向曲率，替代 Lanczos 或 Hessian-vector product 的 λ1 计算，并据此设置免标定的学习率上限。CIFAR-10、Fashion-MNIST、Imagenette 上 logα 与 logλ1 的 Pearson 相关为 -0.91 至 -0.95（去趋势后仍为 -0.60 至 -0.70）；在 10^-3 至 3.0 的学习率范围与 GPT-2 预训练中，所有加上限的运行都避免了发散。
Motivation: 局部尖锐度（最大 Hessian 特征值 λ1）决定梯度更新的稳定上限，但常规计算需要 Lanczos 或 Hessian-vector product，代价高，无法在线用作发散保护。
Method: 在 Adam 首步更新方向上做 Armijo 回溯探测：初始化时加后续共九次，覆盖前 50 个优化器步；由接受步长 α 推出方向曲率（精度受回溯因子限定的乘性带约束），学习率上限取观测到的最小步长的两倍。协议参数不对任何架构做微调，上限不生效时优化器状态与首次更新逐位一致。
Result: logα 与 logλ1 的 Pearson 相关在 CIFAR-10、Fashion-MNIST、Imagenette 上为 -0.91 至 -0.95，逐 run 去趋势后为 -0.60 至 -0.70；学习率范围 10^-3 至 3.0 及 GPT-2 预实验中所有加上限的运行均避免发散，探测开销约 1%；一般架构分析中一个 MLP 架构仍对初始 batch 顺序敏感，GPT-2 规模下方向曲率在前 5 个优化器步内显著上升。
Conclusion: 单次回溯线搜索已含尖锐度信息，可作为约 1% 开销的免标定在线发散保护；其目标是避免发散而非提升精度，且仅初始化时设上限不够，需要覆盖前几步的短探测窗口。

papers.title: Evaluating Time Series Foundation Models for Electricity Price Forecasting: Contamination Risk, Distributional Shifts, and Covariate Dependence
papers.abstract_en: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) have shown strong zero-shot forecasting performance, but their generalization in covariate-driven, non-stationary settings is underexplored. Electricity price forecasting (EPF) presents a challenging testbed due to complex temporal dependencies, distributional shifts, and strong reliance on structural and contextual information. We propose a two-dataset-benchmarking framework for EPF to mitigate contamination risk and enable fair evaluation of TSFMs. We examine key aspects of EPF including point and probabilistic forecasting performance, tail behavior, price spikes, and comparisons against domain-specific methods. We find that TSFMs are highly competitive and often outperform general-purpose baselines. Yet, their performance depends critically on covariate support, and they do not consistently surpass domain-specific methods tailored to EPF. Interestingly, simple ensembles of TSFMs and domain-specific methods appear to have significant potential, suggesting that the two approaches capture complementary predictive information.
papers.journal_ref: ICML 2026 Foundation Models for Structured Data Workshop, 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML), Seoul, South Korea
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对电价预报 (EPF) 中时序基础模型 (TSFM) 的训练数据污染风险，提出双数据集基准框架，把协变量支持、分布偏移与价格尖峰纳入零样本评测。结论是 TSFM 零样本表现常优于通用基线，但性能关键取决于协变量支持，且并不稳定超过 EPF 领域专用方法；TSFM 与领域方法的简单集成显示出显著互补潜力。
Motivation: TSFM 的零样本能力已被验证，但在协变量驱动、非平稳设定下的泛化性研究不足；电价预报因时序依赖复杂、分布偏移强、依赖结构与上下文信息，成为检验污染风险与公平评测的难点场景。
Method: 提出双数据集基准框架 (two-dataset-benchmarking) 以规避训练数据污染并公平评测 TSFM；评测覆盖点预报与概率预报性能、尾部行为、价格尖峰，并与 EPF 领域专用方法对比，同时考察协变量依赖。
Result: TSFM 表现极具竞争力，常优于通用基线；但其性能关键依赖协变量支持，且未持续超过面向 EPF 的领域专用方法；TSFM 与领域方法的简单集成被认为具有显著潜力。
Conclusion: TSFM 与领域专用方法捕捉的是互补的预测信息，因此在 EPF 中应结合协变量支持来使用 TSFM，并优先考虑两者集成而非单方替代。
Relevance: 14

summary_sections.method: 提出双数据集基准框架 (two-dataset-benchmarking) 以规避训练数据污染并公平评测 TSFM；评测覆盖点预报与概率预报性能、尾部行为、价格尖峰，并与 EPF 领域专用方法对比，同时考察协变量依赖。
summary_sections.result: TSFM 表现极具竞争力，常优于通用基线；但其性能关键依赖协变量支持，且未持续超过面向 EPF 的领域专用方法；TSFM 与领域方法的简单集成被认为具有显著潜力。
summary_sections.conclusion: TSFM 与领域专用方法捕捉的是互补的预测信息，因此在 EPF 中应结合协变量支持来使用 TSFM，并优先考虑两者集成而非单方替代。

papers.title: FAR: Failure-Aware Retry for Test-Time Recovery and Continual Policy Improvement
papers.abstract_en: Robot policies inevitably encounter failures when deployed in real environments. Naive retries often repeat the same mistakes, while many existing recovery methods rely on human intervention. In this paper, we propose Failure-Aware Retry (FAR), a framework that enables robots to learn from previous failures at test time, adapt their behavior accordingly, and eventually complete the task autonomously. FAR combines Failure-Contrastive Preference Adaptation, which constructs preference learning data from failures to steer the policy away from previously unsuccessful behaviors, with lightweight action perturbations during retries to encourage local exploration. We further incorporate successful recovery trajectories into a training loop for continual policy improvement. Experiments in both simulation and real-world manipulation tasks show that FAR substantially improves success rates and robustness, with average gains of 17.6% over the standard diffusion policy in simulation and 11.7% in the real world. In addition, FAR improves data efficiency under both reset and timestep budgets during continual policy improvement by exploiting informative failure cases. Videos and code are available at https://hoar012.github.io/FAR-Project.
papers.comment: Accepted by CoRL 2026. Project Page: https://hoar012.github.io/FAR-Project
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FAR 让机器人在测试时从自身失败中学习重试：用 Failure-Contrastive Preference Adaptation 把失败轨迹转成偏好学习数据使策略远离已失败行为，重试时加轻量动作扰动做局部探索，再把成功恢复轨迹并入训练循环持续改进。仿真与真机操作任务上相对标准 diffusion policy 平均成功率分别提升 17.6% 与 11.7%。
Motivation: 机器人部署必然遇到失败，朴素重试会重复同样的错误，而现有恢复方法多依赖人工干预，缺少测试时自主从失败中学习并最终独立完成任务的机制。
Method: FAR 框架包含两部分：Failure-Contrastive Preference Adaptation 从失败构造偏好学习数据引导策略避开先前不成功的行为，重试阶段叠加轻量动作扰动鼓励局部探索；随后把成功恢复轨迹纳入训练循环做持续策略改进 (continual policy improvement)。
Result: 在仿真操作任务上 FAR 相对标准 diffusion policy 平均成功率提升 17.6%，真机操作任务提升 11.7%；在持续改进中，利用有信息量的失败案例在 reset 预算与 timestep 预算两种设定下均提高数据效率。
Conclusion: 把失败本身当作偏好信号并配合重试期局部探索，机器人可以测试时自主恢复并持续改进策略，无需人工干预即可提升成功率与鲁棒性。

papers.title: In-Context Residual Calibration for Uncertainty Quantification of Energy Time Series over Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Accurate energy demand forecasting is essential for the reliable operation and planning of modern sustainable energy systems. Spatial-temporal graph neural networks (STGNNs) have recently achieved strong performance in point forecasting by jointly modeling temporal dynamics and relational dependencies across interconnected energy nodes. However, in real-world energy systems, accurate point forecasts alone are insufficient, as operators also require reliable uncertainty estimates to support risk-aware decision-making, grid stability, and operational planning under uncertainty. Conformal prediction provides a principled and model-agnostic framework for uncertainty quantification under exchangeability assumptions, making it particularly attractive for safety-critical energy applications. However, existing conformal prediction approaches often fail to fully capture the complex spatial-temporal structure of energy systems. To address these limitations, we propose STOIC (Spatial-Temporal uncertainty quantificatiOn via In-Context learning), a conformal-inspired post-hoc residual calibration framework that integrates graph-based forecasting with the in-context learning capabilities of tabular foundation models. STOIC first generates point forecasts using an STGNN and subsequently reformulates spatial-temporal residuals into a tabular representation suitable for in-context learning. Leveraging a tabular foundation model, STOIC estimates feature-conditional residual quantiles without task-specific retraining of the calibration model, effectively capturing both sequential and relational dependencies. STOIC should be viewed as a conformal-inspired residual calibration method and does not by itself provide a finite-sample distribution-free coverage guarantee under arbitrary temporal dependence...
papers.comment: Accepted to Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 STOIC：先用时空图神经网络 (STGNN) 做能源时序点预报，再把时空残差重排成表格形式，交给表格基础模型 (tabular foundation model) 通过 in-context learning 估计特征条件残差分位数，实现免重训的后校准不确定性量化。该方法是 conformal-inspired 的残差校准，本身不提供任意时间依赖下的有限样本无分布覆盖保证。
Motivation: 能源系统运行方仅有点预报不足以支撑风险感知决策与电网稳定，而现有 conformal prediction 方法难以刻画能源系统复杂的时空结构。
Method: STOIC 分两步：STGNN 生成点预报，随后将时空残差重构为表格表示，输入表格基础模型做 in-context learning，估计特征条件残差分位数；校准模型无需针对任务重训练，属 conformal-inspired 后校准框架。
Result: 摘要给出的是方法性结论：STOIC 能同时捕捉残差的序列依赖与关系依赖，并在不重训校准模型的条件下给出条件分位数估计；同时明确其不自带任意时间依赖下的有限样本无分布覆盖保证。
Conclusion: 把时空残差转成表格形式交给基础模型做 in-context 分位数校准，是绕开 conformal 方法难以建模时空结构的一条可行路径，但覆盖保证需另行论证。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: AI-Assisted Computational Reproducibility on the FABRIC Testbed
papers.abstract_en: Computational reproducibility remains difficult despite being central to scientific research. In this paper, we show how the international FABRIC testbed, combined with a large language model (LLM) coding agent through LoomAI, can simplify reproducing published experiments across multiple domains. We reproduced three case studies on FABRIC, covering BBR-family congestion-control evaluations, LAMMPS molecular dynamics scaling benchmarks on a CPU-only MPI cluster, and stress protein homeostasis genomics pipelines. Rather than focusing only on matching numerical outputs, we evaluate whether the reproduced experiments support the same scientific conclusions as the original studies. The AI assistant was effective in setting up the environment, adapting code, and debugging, but struggled with the analysis stages that lacked clearly defined workflows, which required human guidance to establish execution order and data dependencies. Across the case studies, the AI-assisted workflow reduced reproduction effort by roughly 4--6 times. We conclude with practical recommendations for improving AI-assisted reproducibility on research testbeds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 FABRIC 测试床上用 LoomAI 接入的 LLM 编码代理复现三个已发表实验（BBR 系族拥塞控制评估、CPU-only MPI 集群上的 LAMMPS 分子动力学扩展基准、应激蛋白稳态基因组学流程），判定标准是复现结果是否支持与原研究相同的科学结论而非数值逐位对齐。AI 助手在环境搭建、代码适配和调试环节有效，但在缺少明确工作流的分析环节需要人工指定执行顺序与数据依赖；整体复现工作量降低约 4–6 倍。
Motivation: 计算可复现性长期是科研痛点，跨领域复现已发表实验需要大量人工搭建与调试；论文要检验 LLM 编码代理加研究测试床能把这部分工作压缩到什么程度，以及 AI 在哪一步失效。
Method: 在国际 FABRIC 测试床上通过 LoomAI 调用 LLM 编码代理，复现三个跨领域案例：BBR 系族拥塞控制评估、CPU-only MPI 集群上的 LAMMPS 分子动力学扩展基准、应激蛋白稳态基因组学流程；评价维度是复现实验是否支撑原研究的科学结论，而非仅比对数值输出。
Result: 三个案例的 AI 辅助复现工作量降低约 4–6 倍；AI 助手在环境搭建、代码适配、调试环节有效，而在缺乏清晰工作流的分析环节表现不佳，需要人工给出执行顺序与数据依赖。
Conclusion: LLM 编码代理加研究测试床能把复现工作量压缩数倍，但分析阶段的流程编排仍需人来定；作者据此给出提升研究测试床上 AI 辅助可复现性的实践建议。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: BehaviorBench: Benchmarking Foundation Models for Behavioral Science Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models have been increasingly applied to behavioral science domains such as psychology, sociology, and economics. While these models show promise in tasks such as survey response prediction and human-subject experiment simulation, there remains no systematic understanding of how well they perform across diverse behavioral science tasks. We introduce BehaviorBench, a comprehensive benchmark that evaluates foundation models along four core capabilities: (1) behavior prediction and simulation, (2) strategic decision-making, (3) subject-trait inference, and (4) behavioral knowledge application. Crucially, BehaviorBench evaluates model outputs at both the individual and distributional levels, capturing not only per-subject accuracy but also population-level alignment, an essential requirement for behavioral validity. Our evaluation shows that BehaviorBench remains challenging for leading general-purpose LLMs and behavior foundation models that are specifically trained with behavioral data. We find that individual-level and distributional performance do not always align. General-purpose LLMs tend to underestimate the diversity of human responses, whereas behavior foundation models often lag behind at individual-level prediction. Our investigation further demonstrates how fine-tuning on diverse behavioral data can improve both individual-level prediction and distributional alignment, balancing these two objectives. Our results highlight the importance of evaluation at both individual and distributional levels, establishing BehaviorBench as a foundation for developing and assessing behaviorally aligned AI systems. Our BehaviorBench and models can be accessed via https://umich-foreseer.github.io/behaviorbench/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 BehaviorBench，从行为预测与模拟、策略性决策、个体特质推断、行为知识应用四类能力评估基础模型，并同时在个体与分布两个层面打分。结果显示通用 LLM 低估人类反应的多样性，而专门用行为数据训练的 behavior foundation model 个体级预测更差；用多样化行为数据微调可同时改善个体预测与分布对齐。
Motivation: 基础模型已用于问卷回答预测与人类被试实验模拟等行为科学任务，但缺少跨多样行为任务的系统性评估框架，且个体级准确性与群体分布对齐这两个行为有效性要求此前未被同时度量。
Method: BehaviorBench 沿四类核心能力组织任务：行为预测与模拟、策略性决策、个体特质推断、行为知识应用；对每个任务同时在个体层面（per-subject accuracy）与分布层面（population-level alignment）评估模型输出，覆盖通用 LLM 与专门用行为数据训练的 behavior foundation model，并考察多样化行为数据上的微调。
Result: 评估显示 BehaviorBench 对领先的通用 LLM 和 behavior foundation model 仍具挑战性；个体级与分布级表现并不总是一致：通用 LLM 倾向低估人类反应的多样性，behavior foundation model 则在个体级预测上落后；在多样化行为数据上微调可同时提升个体级预测与分布对齐。
Conclusion: 行为有效性要求同时看个体级与分布级两个层面，只报其中一个会掩盖模型的真实表现；BehaviorBench 被定位为开发与评估行为对齐 AI 系统的基础，配套数据集与模型在 umich-foreseer.github.io/behaviorbench 公开。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Walk fast but be careful: Understanding Parallel Sampling in Masked Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we use random walks on graphs as a verifiable sandbox for studying parallel sampling strategies in masked diffusion models (MDMs). We train an MDM on random walk samples from a fixed graph. The graph and transition kernel are never shown to the model and serve as latent structure that is both controllable and enables evaluation. The framework provides a validity check for generated walks and a measure of distributional fidelity through the estimated transition kernel. Using simple graphs, we theoretically prove that parallel unmasking via widely used scores such as lowest entropy is not uniformly better than random parallel sampling; even with exact conditional probabilities, performance critically depends on the conditional dependence structure induced by the graph, a phenomenon difficult to isolate in benchmarks like Sudoku. We also develop training-free bisection samplers for MDMs, which take logarithmically many steps in the sequence length and are provably exact for random walks if the learned marginals are exact. Experiments on graph-walk tasks confirm that different parallel samplers perform better on different graph structures. Experiments on pretrained MDMs show that bisection-style samplers provide strong speed-quality tradeoffs on OpenWebText generation and reasoning benchmarks including GSM8K, MBPP, and HumanEval. Together, these results use graph walks to uncover conditional dependence as a key principle of parallel MDM sampling and translate this insight into efficient samplers that transfer to language generation and reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用图上随机游走作为可验证沙盒研究掩码扩散模型 (MDM) 的并行采样，理论上证明按最低熵等分数并行解掩码并不一致优于随机并行采样，性能取决于图诱导的条件依赖结构。作者提出训练无关的二分 (bisection) 采样器，步数对序列长度取对数，在学到的边缘分布精确时对随机游走可证精确；在 OpenWebText 与 GSM8K、MBPP、HumanEval 上给出强速度-质量折衷。
Motivation: 并行解掩码策略孰优孰劣在 Sudoku 这类基准上难以把条件依赖结构单独隔离出来，缺少一个可控、可验证、能同时检查有效性与分布保真度的沙盒。
Method: 在固定图的随机游走样本上训练 MDM，图与转移核对模型不可见、作为可控潜结构；用生成游走的有效性检查与估计转移核的分布保真度作评估。在简单图上给出理论证明，并设计训练无关的二分采样器，其步数为序列长度的对数级。
Result: 理论上证明最低熵等常用分数的并行解掩码不一致优于随机并行采样，即使条件概率精确，表现仍关键依赖图诱导的条件依赖结构；二分采样器在学到的边缘精确时对随机游走可证精确且只需对数步。图游走实验确认不同并行采样器在不同图结构上各有优势；在预训练 MDM 上，二分式采样器在 OpenWebText 生成及 GSM8K、MBPP、HumanEval 推理基准上呈现强速度-质量折衷。
Conclusion: 条件依赖结构是决定并行 MDM 采样表现的关键原则，把这一洞见转化为的高效采样器可迁移到语言生成与推理任务。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Online Scheduling for LLM Serving: From Theoretical Bound to System Practice
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of interactive Large Language Model serving has made efficient management of dynamic Key-Value cache footprints increasingly important for inference performance. Modern inference systems overwhelmingly rely on time-centric scheduling heuristics, such as Shortest Job First. However, their classical guarantees are rooted in traditional scheduling modeling, failing to capture the highly dynamic, 2D spatio-temporal geometric growth specific to LLM inference mechanisms. To resolve this, we propose the geometry-aware online scheduling by introducing the Smallest Volume First (SVF) algorithm and its highly efficient variant, 1-bit SVF. Via a novel volume-certificate proof, we establish a worst-case approximation ratio for SVF that approaches \textbf{3} in the high-concurrency regime of LLM serving, substantially improving upon the prior best constant of 48. Building upon this core breakthrough, we complete a comprehensive theoretical taxonomy analyzing our algorithms across different traffic scenarios and information availability. Practically, we seamlessly integrate our approach as a plug-and-play layer in vLLM. Extensive evaluations on Llama-3.1 models demonstrate comprehensive performance gains: SVF delivers strong reductions in both average and tail latency, while 1-bit SVF, with merely a single bit of information, achieves competitive throughput and latency. This work establishes a theoretically sound and empirically proven approach for resolving memory-constrained scheduling in modern LLM deployments. To facilitate future research, our code is available at https://github.com/Li-Beverly-Kong/Geometry-Aware-Online-Scheduling.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 LLM 推理中动态 KV cache 的二维时空几何增长，提出 Smallest Volume First (SVF) 调度及其 1-bit 变体，用 volume-certificate 证明高并发下最坏情形逼近比接近 3，把此前最优常数 48 大幅压低。作为即插即用层集成进 vLLM 后，Llama-3.1 上 SVF 同时降低平均与尾延迟，1-bit SVF 仅用 1 bit 信息即取得有竞争力的吞吐与延迟。
Motivation: 现有 LLM serving 调度几乎都用 Shortest Job First 这类时间中心启发式，其经典保证来自传统调度模型，无法刻画 LLM 推理特有的高度动态、二维时空几何增长，导致内存受限下的调度缺少可靠理论依据。
Method: 提出 geometry-aware online scheduling：核心算法 Smallest Volume First (SVF) 按 KV cache 体积排序，配一个高效变体 1-bit SVF 只用单比特信息；用 novel volume-certificate 证明给出最坏情形逼近比，并构建覆盖不同流量场景与信息可得性的理论分类；实践上作为 plug-and-play 层集成进 vLLM。
Result: SVF 在高并发 serving 下的最坏情形逼近比接近 3，此前最优常数为 48；在 Llama-3.1 上的评测中 SVF 同时降低平均延迟与尾延迟，1-bit SVF 仅凭 1 bit 信息取得有竞争力的吞吐与延迟。
Conclusion: 以 KV cache 几何体积而非作业时长做在线调度，能在理论上把逼近比从 48 压到接近 3，并在 vLLM 实测中转化为延迟与吞吐收益，可作为内存受限 LLM 部署的通用调度层。

papers.title: MixedPEFT: Combining Multiple PEFT Methods with Mixed Objectives for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Applying pre-trained language models to new domains through full fine-tuning is computationally expensive and prone to catastrophic forgetting. To address this limitation, we introduce a novel parameter-efficient strategy for unsupervised domain adaptation that combines a custom PEFT architecture with mixed-objective training. The proposed method integrates invertible adapters with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and jointly optimizes classification on labeled source-domain data and masked language modeling on unlabeled target-domain data. This joint training scheme supports task adaptation while preserving knowledge of the target domain. We evaluate the method on the Multi-Genre Natural Language Inference (MNLI) dataset across 20 domain shifts. Our approach achieves average performance improvements of 1.41 percentage points over the parameter-efficient state-of-the-art UDapter, 1.26 percentage points over the fully tuned DANN baseline, and 0.86 percentage points over DSN, while updating only 7% of the model parameters. These findings establish a new state-of-the-art result for parameter-efficient unsupervised domain adaptation and demonstrate that carefully designed PEFT combinations with concurrent optimization can outperform both parameter-efficient and conventional fully tuned approaches.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 5 tables. Accepted at UBMK 2026. Builds upon our preliminary work presented at UBMK 2024. v2: revised text, references and tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MixedPEFT 把 invertible adapters 与 LoRA 组合，用源域有标签分类损失和目标域无标签掩码语言建模 (MLM) 联合优化做无监督域适应 (UDA)。在 MNLI 的 20 个 domain shift 上，平均比参数高效 SOTA 的 UDapter 高 1.41 个百分点、比全参数微调的 DANN 高 1.26 个百分点、比 DSN 高 0.86 个百分点，且只更新 7% 的模型参数。
Motivation: 对预训练语言模型做全量微调计算开销大且易灾难性遗忘，而现有参数高效方法在跨域 NLU 上仍落后于全量微调基线。
Method: 自定义 PEFT 架构：invertible adapters 与 Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) 串联，mixed-objective training 同时优化源域有标签分类损失与目标域无标签 MLM 损失，只更新 7% 参数。
Result: 在 MNLI 数据集的 20 个 domain shifts 上，平均性能比参数高效 SOTA UDapter 高 1.41 个百分点，比全量微调 DANN 基线高 1.26 个百分点，比 DSN 高 0.86 个百分点，仅更新 7% 的模型参数。
Conclusion: 精心设计的 PEFT 组合加上并发多目标优化，可以在参数效率上同时超过参数高效方法与常规全量微调方法，为 UDA 建立新的 SOTA。

papers.title: Hand-4DGS: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting for 4D Hand Reconstruction from Egocentric Videos
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic 3D hand reconstruction from egocentric videos is essential for next-generation computing platforms such as AR/VR and AI glasses. Despite its importance, most prior works focus either on multi-view 3D hand reconstruction or on 4D human body reconstruction. Egocentric 4D hand reconstruction remains difficult due to rapid hand and camera motion, hand-object and inter-hand interactions, and inherent ambiguity from single-view observations. To address these challenges, we introduce Hand-4DGS, a feed-forward framework for dynamic 4D hand reconstruction from egocentric videos. Our approach incorporates a mesh-guided representation for structural priors and temporal convolutions to model dynamic motion. We evaluate our framework on H2O and ARCTIC, two egocentric hand-object interaction datasets, and show improvements over baselines. Our model can efficiently adapt to unseen videos from datasets that are not included in training. In addition, image supervision through differentiable Gaussian rasterization provides an additional signal for appearance optimization and pose adjustment during training and test-time optimization, without ground-truth 3D hand pose annotations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Hand-4DGS 是一个前馈式 (feed-forward) 4D 手部重建框架，用 mesh-guided 表示提供结构先验、用 temporal convolution 建模动态运动，并以可微 Gaussian rasterization 的图像监督做外观优化与姿态调整，无需真值 3D 手部姿态标注。在 H2O 与 ARCTIC 两个第一人称手-物交互数据集上相对基线有提升，并能高效适配训练集之外的未见视频。
Motivation: 第一人称视频的 4D 手部重建因手与相机快速运动、手-物与双手交互、以及单视角固有歧义而困难；已有工作多聚焦多视角手部重建或 4D 人体重建，缺少针对该场景的前馈方案。
Method: 提出前馈框架 Hand-4DGS：以 mesh-guided representation 注入结构先验，用 temporal convolution 建模动态运动；训练与测试时的优化均通过可微 Gaussian rasterization 施加图像监督，不需要真值 3D 手部姿态标注。
Result: 在 H2O 与 ARCTIC 两个第一人称手-物交互数据集上相对基线取得改进，并可高效适配训练中未包含的数据集里的未见视频。
Conclusion: 结构先验加时序建模的前馈 Gaussian 表示可在无 3D 姿态标注的条件下完成动态第一人称手部重建，并具备跨数据集泛化能力。

papers.title: ED3R: Energy-Aware Distributed Disaster Detection via Cooperative Agents in Robotic Systems
papers.abstract_en: Robotics are expected to support environmental monitoring and disaster detection, where decisions must be made under uncertainty, resource limitations, and strict operational constraints. In critical missions, such as wildfires, robots must not only identify hazardous events with sufficient confidence, but also manage the energy cost and time until detection. This paper introduces ED3R, an energy-aware distributed framework for wildfire detection under uncertainty that enables hierarchical cooperative decision-making between a robot and a remote controller. The remote controller decides upon the robot's motion, while the robot senses the environment and decides where to execute the wildfire detection (onboard or remotely) and how. The common goal is to detect wildfires with a required confidence while minimizing the energy consumed by any robot operation. ED3R further integrates mechanisms to avoid nearby obstacles, prevent redundant exploration, enable adaptive early mission completion, and ensure feasibility through a custom penalty function. ED3R also introduces a forward-looking capability, enabled through distributed neural regression models that allow the agents to anticipate the future by evaluating candidate strategies before execution. The framework is evaluated through realistic robotics simulations, ablation studies, and baseline comparisons. ED3R achieves a mission success rate of up to 97.18%, defined as the percentage of missions with true positive detections meeting the required confidence, excluding false positives and battery depletions. Especially in the most demanding missions, it reduces energy consumption by up to 36.4% and detects wildfires up to 41% faster than baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ED3R 是面向野火探测的能耗感知分布式协同框架：远程控制器决定机器人运动，机载端决定在本地还是远程、以何种方式执行探测，并用分布式神经回归模型前瞻评估候选策略后再执行。在真实感机器人仿真中任务成功率最高 97.18%，在最严苛任务上比基线节能最多 36.4%、探测速度最高快 41%。
Motivation: 野火等关键任务中，机器人须在不确定性、能量与时间约束下以足够置信度发现危险事件，而单体方案既不划分机载/远程决策职责，也不把能耗与探测置信度放进同一个决策目标。
Method: 分层协同决策：远程控制器负责机器人运动，机载端决定探测执行位置（onboard 或 remote）与方式；以自定义惩罚函数保证可行性，并加入避障、去冗余探索、自适应提前结束任务机制；分布式神经回归模型对候选策略做执行前前瞻评估。
Result: 在真实感机器人仿真、消融实验与基线对比中，任务成功率（真阳性探测达到所需置信度、且排除误报与电量耗尽的任务占比）最高 97.18%；在最严苛任务上能耗最多降低 36.4%，野火探测速度比基线最多快 41%。
Conclusion: 把运动决策与探测执行决策分层交给异构智能体、并让能耗与置信度共同进入目标，可在严苛任务上同时提高成功率、降低能耗并缩短探测时间。

papers.title: Operator Calculus for Population-Based Optimization: Modular Convergence and Finite-Population Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: Population-based optimizers combine update rules such as mutation, selection, and recombination. When one rule changes, it is often unclear which convergence guarantees survive or how the new combination should be assessed. We develop an operator calculus: an operator is a population-update rule, and the calculus specifies how separately checked effects can be combined. Under explicit regularity and small-step conditions, the leading changes caused by the updates add, yielding reusable building blocks for convergence analysis. The framework distinguishes finding and retaining a good solution, reducing the population's mean objective, and concentrating candidates near an optimizer, and identifies the extra approximation conditions needed for finite evaluation-budget guarantees. Applications include distribution adaptation, recombinative evolution, and consensus dynamics, with verified nonconvex cases. Controlled experiments on a common nonconvex problem collection show how component effects change with population geometry and the performance measure: a rule can worsen the mean objective yet produce better candidates.

papers.title: Cross-Agent Learning Signals Enable Coordinated Role-Decomposed LLM Training
papers.abstract_en: Agentic search systems must coordinate evidence acquisition and response generation, yet existing approaches either couple both roles under a single agent objective or decompose them without disentangling their respective contributions to the final outcome. We introduce DAC (Divide and Cooperate), a role-decomposed training framework that, given task-specific external verification signals, trains a searcher and a generator with role-specific cross-verification rewards. DAC allows the generator to abstain when the retrieved evidence appears insufficient, and uses this decision together with externally evaluated search sufficiency to assign appropriate credit to each role. To prevent degenerate over-abstention, we further introduce hard-positive evidence augmentation, which discourages abstaining on sufficient but hard evidence. Across seven general and multi-hop QA benchmarks and two model backbones, DAC consistently outperforms strong single-agent and multi-agent baselines. Controlled evaluations show that these gains arise from coordinated improvements in both search and generation. Our results highlight the importance of explicitly and properly assigning credit across interacting roles when training agentic search systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出角色分解训练框架 DAC（Divide and Cooperate），用外部验证信号对 searcher 与 generator 分别给角色交叉验证奖励，并允许 generator 在证据不足时弃答，再用弃答决定与外部评估的搜索充分性分配信用。为防止过度弃答，加入 hard-positive evidence augmentation，即在充分但困难的证据上不鼓励弃答；在七个通用与多跳 QA 基准、两种骨干模型上，DAC 一致优于强单智能体与多智能体基线，受控评估显示增益来自搜索与生成两方面的协同提升。
Motivation: 智能体搜索系统中证据获取与回答生成两种角色要么被单一目标耦合，要么被分解却无法区分各自对最终结果的贡献，导致跨角色信用分配不当。
Method: DAC 框架训练一个 searcher 和一个 generator，使用任务相关的外部验证信号构造角色特定的交叉验证奖励；generator 可对证据不足弃答，该决定与外部评估的搜索充分性共同用于分配信用；另加 hard-positive evidence augmentation 抑制在充分但困难证据上的弃答。
Result: 在七个通用与多跳 QA 基准、两个模型骨干上，DAC 一致优于强单智能体与多智能体基线；受控评估表明增益来自搜索与生成两方面的协同改进。
Conclusion: 训练智能体搜索系统时，跨交互角色显式且恰当地分配信用是关键，角色分解加交叉验证奖励能同时改善搜索与生成。

papers.title: Targeting World Models to Compromise Robot Learning Pipelines
papers.abstract_en: World models have recently seen a rapid growth in both their popularity and capability as more data efficient tools for generating robot training data or simulating real world environments, with many works proposing their integration into the robot learning pipeline. While highly practical, in this work we demonstrate that world models introduce a uniquely stealthy and effective data poisoning entry point into the robot learning supply chain that can result in the deployment of unsafe or otherwise compromised robotic policies despite training on seemingly safe ground truth training data. In contrast to traditional data poisoning techniques which directly implant dangerous trajectories into sold or uploaded datasets, our novel attack methods inject malicious prompts or compromising transition dynamics into visibly safe teleoperated datasets which are only activated once fed through a world model as input. This can result in the generation of synthetic, dangerous robot training trajectories and subsequently unsafe or compromised robot policies. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our attacks against both state of the art action conditioned and text conditioned world models, showing a full end-to-end backdoor on a downstream DRL policy and a proof-of-concept for the VLA setting. Overall these findings necessitate research into more secure world models and reevaluating their position within the robot learning supply chain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文证明世界模型 (world model) 是机器人学习供应链中隐蔽的数据投毒入口：攻击者在表面安全的遥操作数据集里注入恶意 prompt 或被篡改的转移动力学，只有数据经世界模型处理时才被激活，从而合成危险轨迹并产出不安全策略。在面向动作条件与文本条件的 SOTA 世界模型上，攻击实现了对下游 DRL 策略的完整端到端后门，并给出 VLA 场景的概念验证。
Motivation: 世界模型被大量用于生成机器人训练数据或仿真环境，但传统数据投毒需要直接植入危险轨迹，而世界模型引入了一条更隐蔽的入口：训练数据本身看似安全，却能在生成环节被激活为危险行为。
Method: 提出两类新攻击：向可见安全的遥操作数据集注入恶意 prompt，或注入被妥协的转移动力学 (transition dynamics)，二者仅在数据作为输入流经世界模型时被激活，进而生成合成的危险机器人训练轨迹并训练下游策略。
Result: 在 SOTA 的 action-conditioned 与 text-conditioned 世界模型上均演示了攻击有效性：对下游 DRL 策略实现了完整的端到端后门 (end-to-end backdoor)，并在 VLA 设定给出概念验证 (proof-of-concept)。
Conclusion: 世界模型使在看似安全的训练数据上部署不安全或被妥协的机器人策略成为可能，因此需要研究更安全的世界模型，并重新评估其在机器人学习供应链中的位置。

papers.title: Unifying Object-Centric World Models and Diffusion Policy: A Hierarchical Framework for Multi-Stage Robotic Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Visual world models have shown great potential in learning complex system dynamics. Recent advancements leverage these models as transition functions within Model Predictive Control (MPC) frameworks to solve various control tasks. When applied to robotics, however, they are limited to single-stage tasks such as reaching or grasping, and struggle with multi-stage ones that demand complex sequential planning. In this work, we introduce WorldDP, a world model framework designed for multi-stage robotic manipulation. Our hierarchical approach utilizes a high-level world model as a transition function to optimize for feasible subgoals during runtime, which are subsequently reached by a low-level Diffusion Policy. To further aid in learning dynamics and planning, we incorporate object-centric representations that decouple environmental entities and enable us to plan sequentially with respect to each. Evaluated across several robotics benchmarks, WorldDP consistently outperforms existing baselines, validating that coupling the world model's physically grounded planning with diffusion policy's efficient execution yields superior multi-stage performance. Project Page: https://raktimgg.github.io/worlddp-website/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 WorldDP：高层以 object-centric world model 作为转移函数在运行时优化可行子目标，低层用 Diffusion Policy 逐段执行，把多阶段机器人操作拆成顺序规划加高效执行。在多个机器人基准上持续优于现有基线，说明世界模型的物理一致规划与扩散策略的执行耦合能带来更好的多阶段表现。
Motivation: 以世界模型作转移函数的 MPC 在机器人上多限于 reaching、grasping 等单阶段任务，难以处理需要复杂顺序规划的多阶段操作。
Method: 分层框架：高层 world model 作为转移函数在运行时优化可行子目标，低层 Diffusion Policy 负责到达各子目标；引入 object-centric 表征把环境实体解耦，从而可按实体逐个顺序规划。
Result: 在多个机器人基准 (robotics benchmarks) 上持续优于现有基线，验证高层物理一致规划与低层扩散执行的耦合带来更优的多阶段性能。
Conclusion: 把 world model 的规划与 Diffusion Policy 的执行分层耦合，是让机器人从单阶段走向多阶段任务的有效路径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Execution Realism and Reproducibility in LLM-Based Trading Systems: A Systematic Scoping Review and Evidence Audit
papers.abstract_en: Execution realism remains weakly standardized in research on large-language-model-based trading systems, limiting comparison and reproduction across backtests, simulations, and portfolio benchmarks. This article presents a PRISMA-ScR systematic scoping review with a nested execution-reproducibility evidence audit. Eight reproducible query families returned 796 query-level records; DOI/title deduplication left 687 unique records, 101 reports were sought for retrieval, and 59 full texts were recovered through direct and fallback open-access routes. Fifty-three reports are provisionally eligible for expanded evidence charting, subject to reconciliation of two blind author-validation packets. The charting framework separately evaluates point-in-time controls, temporal splits, held-out evaluation, trading costs and turnover, execution semantics, universe construction, architecture reporting, and artifact availability. Direct-trading, portfolio or alpha-construction, and benchmark studies are retained as distinct descriptive subgroups rather than pooled as a common performance estimand. Search responses, retrieval attempts, file hashes, evidence excerpts, screening decisions, and coding worksheets are archived with the review materials. Final field-level counts are intentionally withheld until author validation is complete.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇 PRISMA-ScR 系统性范围综述加嵌套执行可复现性证据审计，指出 LLM 交易系统的执行真实度 (execution realism) 缺乏统一标准，导致回测、仿真与组合基准之间无法比较和复现。检索得到 796 条记录、去重后 687 条唯一记录，59 篇全文可获取、53 篇暂定合格；作者按点位时点控制、时间切分、交易成本与换手、执行语义等维度分列编码，并把直接交易、组合/alpha 构造、基准研究保留为独立子群而非合并成单一性能估计量。
Motivation: LLM 交易系统研究在回测、仿真与组合基准之间的执行真实度标准松散，跨研究的性能比较与复现因此受阻。
Method: 采用 PRISMA-ScR 范围综述加嵌套执行可复现性证据审计：8 个可复现检索式族产出 796 条记录，DOI/标题去重后 687 条，尝试获取 101 篇报告，经直接与回退开放获取途径恢复 59 篇全文；编码框架分列点位时点控制、时间切分、留出评估、交易成本与换手、执行语义、股票池构建、架构报告与工件可得性，并归档检索响应、文件哈希、证据摘录、筛选决策与编码工作表，含两份盲法作者验证包。
Result: 8 个检索式族返回 796 条记录，去重后 687 条唯一记录；101 篇报告被申请获取，59 篇全文经直接与回退开放获取途径恢复；53 篇报告暂定合格进入扩展证据制表，待两份盲法作者验证包核对；最终字段级计数在作者验证完成前暂不公布。
Conclusion: 执行真实度应按点位时点控制、执行语义、成本与工件可得性等维度分列审计，且直接交易、组合/alpha 构造与基准研究不可合并为同一性能估计量；字段级结论须待作者验证完成后再发布。
Relevance: 1
