papers.title: Are Good Generators Good Decision-Makers? Policy Learning for General Interventions via Retargeted Counterfactual Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generative models are increasingly used to support decision-making in complex systems, where interventions may be joint and high-dimensional, and outcomes are high-dimensional. However, using generators for these decision-making settings are challenged by three problems. First, they are often trained on noisy logs with limited intervention data. Second, generator learning can be noisy across different environments. Third, generators are not optimized for the decisions they support. We introduce policy learning via retargeted counterfactual generation, which trains a generator for the decisions it supports in three steps. We (1) learn a doubly-robust, invariant counterfactual generator for high-dimensional interventions and outcomes, (2) conduct policy-learning based on its rollouts, and (3) retarget the generator toward the learned policy's interventions and relearn the policy, so the generator is accurate where decisions are made. Theoretically, our generator's excess counterfactual risk has a doubly robust product remainder, and retargeting removes the worst-case density ratio between the logged and learned policies from the regret. We demonstrate the efficacy of our approach across synthetic data, Cell Painting images of SARS-CoV-2-infected cells, and physical video simulations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出通过重定向反事实生成做策略学习 (policy learning via retargeted counterfactual generation)：先学一个双重稳健、跨环境不变的高维反事实生成器，再在其 rollout 上学策略，最后把生成器重定向到所学策略的干预分布并重学策略，使生成器在决策发生处更准。理论上生成器的超额反事实风险含双重稳健乘积余项，重定向从 regret 中去掉日志策略与学习策略间最坏情形的密度比；在合成数据、SARS-CoV-2 感染细胞的 Cell Painting 图像与物理视频仿真上验证有效性。
Motivation: 生成模型支撑复杂系统决策时受三重限制：干预数据稀缺且日志含噪、生成器跨环境学习不稳定、生成器并未针对所支撑的决策优化，导致高维联合干预下的决策质量不可靠。
Method: 三步流程：(1) 学习面向高维干预与结果的双重稳健、不变反事实生成器 (doubly-robust, invariant counterfactual generator)；(2) 基于该生成器的 rollout 做策略学习；(3) 把生成器重定向 (retarget) 到所学策略的干预分布并重新学策略。理论分析给出生成器超额反事实风险的双重稳健乘积余项，以及重定向对 regret 中日志/学习策略密度比的消去。
Result: 理论结果：生成器超额反事实风险具有双重稳健乘积余项，重定向从 regret 中移除日志策略与学习策略之间最坏情形的密度比。实证在三类数据上展示方法有效性：合成数据、SARS-CoV-2 感染细胞的 Cell Painting 图像、物理视频仿真。
Conclusion: 让生成器针对其支撑的决策进行重定向并重学策略，可使反事实估计在决策密集区域更准确，从而把「好的生成器」与「好的决策者」对齐。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Synthetic Benchmarks Overstate Forward-Forward Scaling: Real-Data Limits of Layer-Local Training
papers.abstract_en: Forward-Forward (FF) learning [Hinton, 2022] replaces backpropagation with strictly layer-local goodness updates. Recent FF-CNN work has narrowed the gap to BP on 32x32 benchmarks, raising the question of whether layer-local training is becoming a viable alternative at realistic scale. To probe this rigorously, we develop DTG-FF -- dynamic temperature goodness, decoupled normalization, and multi-layer fusion -- as an instrument that sets FF-family state of the art across nine real-data benchmarks at the time of our submission (91.8% CIFAR-10 and an FF baseline at ImageNet-100 224x224), and use it to audit how far layer-local training actually scales. (1) Real-data scaling. Under identical recipe and backbone, an architecture-matched BP-DeepSup baseline beats DTG-FF by 2.40/5.93 pp on CIFAR-10/CIFAR-100, and the gap widens with class count. At 224x224 the same instrument reaches only 49.4% on ImageNet-100, versus 75.6% even for a self-supervised BP-trained ResNet-50 with linear evaluation [Tian et al., 2020] -- exposing a real-data ceiling invisible at 32x32. (2) Synthetic vs. real K-conflict. DTG-FF increasingly outperforms BP as class count K grows on synthetic teacher-student tasks, yet on real images the FF-BP gap reverses sign and widens with K. A within-dataset CIFAR-100 coarse vs. fine probe isolates label-hierarchy from image distribution: synthetic K-sweeps confound output dimensionality with fine-grained discrimination difficulty and thereby overstate FF transferability. (3) Systems audit. FF can be implemented without storing depth-wide activations, but on commodity 8 GB hardware standard BP+gradient-accumulation reaches 4.18 GB / 157 imgs/s versus DTG-FF's 7.90 GB / 138 imgs/s, so a memory-based justification for FF at this scale is not supported under fair baselines.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 6 figures. v2: corrected bibliography (several v1 references were erroneous or nonexistent) and errors in descriptions of prior work; qualified state-of-the-art claims as of submission and added concurrent work; corrected minor factual and arithmetic errors
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DTG-FF（动态温度 goodness、解耦归一化、多层融合）作为测量工具，审计层局部 Forward-Forward 训练在真实数据上的可扩展性。九个真实数据基准上它刷新 FF 家族 SOTA（CIFAR-10 91.8%、ImageNet-100 224×224 为 FF 基线），但同配方同骨干下 BP-DeepSup 在 CIFAR-10/CIFAR-100 上反超 2.40/5.93 pp 且差距随类别数扩大；合成 teacher-student 上 FF 随 K 增长反超 BP 的结论在真实图像上符号反转。
Motivation: 近期 FF-CNN 在 32×32 基准上逼近 BP，引发层局部训练是否已在现实规模可用的疑问；但合成任务与小图像基准可能掩盖真实数据上的天花板。
Method: 构建 DTG-FF：动态温度 goodness、解耦归一化 (decoupled normalization) 与多层融合，作为统一测量工具；在相同配方与骨干下与 BP-DeepSup 对比，并用 CIFAR-100 coarse vs. fine 标签层次探针分离标签层次与图像分布，另做 8 GB 消费级硬件的内存/吞吐系统审计。
Result: DTG-FF 在提交时点于九个真实数据基准上设 FF 家族 SOTA：CIFAR-10 91.8%，ImageNet-100 224×224 达 49.4%；同配方同骨干的 BP-DeepSup 在 CIFAR-10/CIFAR-100 上分别领先 2.40/5.93 pp 且差距随类别数扩大；ImageNet-100 上自监督 BP 训练的 ResNet-50 线性评估为 75.6%（Tian et al., 2020）。合成 teacher-student 任务中 DTG-FF 随 K 增大反超 BP，真实图像上 FF-BP 差距符号反转并随 K 扩大。8 GB 硬件上 BP+梯度累积为 4.18 GB / 157 imgs/s，DTG-FF 为 7.90 GB / 138 imgs/s。
Conclusion: 合成 K-sweep 把输出维度与细粒度判别难度混为一谈，从而高估 FF 的可迁移性；在公平基线下，该规模的 FF 既无精度优势也无内存优势，基于内存的辩护不成立。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Detecting Control and Response Events for AI-Enabled Radio Access Networks
papers.abstract_en: Next-generation wireless networks are moving toward the use of concurrent AI-driven control functions to optimize different objectives, particularly in AI-RAN and O-RAN architectures. When these functions interact, they can interfere with one another in ways that are difficult to detect from raw network data alone. A key missing piece for managing such interactions is a reliable, interpretable dependency structure that captures which control parameters are actively influencing which network performance outcomes at any given time. This paper focuses on the event-detection step needed to support such dependency learning: given noisy continuous parameter and KPI telemetry, we seek to determine when a genuine control action occurs and when a KPI exhibits a corresponding control-induced response. The difficulty is that KPI fluctuations may also arise from background or exogenous variation, so observed changes cannot be treated directly as control events. To address this challenge, we develop a significance-based event-detection procedure that converts continuous parameter and KPI increments into binary control-activity and KPI-response indicators. To evaluate this procedure, we construct a controlled closed-loop telemetry generator with planted parameter--KPI dependencies and tunable background variation. Experiments show that the proposed procedure reliably detects control-induced events and recovers the underlying dependency structure, outperforming alternative event-detection methods across a range of background-variation levels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向 AI-RAN/O-RAN 中多个并发 AI 控制功能互相干扰的问题，提出基于显著性的事件检测流程，把连续的控制参数与 KPI 增量转成二值的控制活动与 KPI 响应指示，以区分真实控制动作与背景外生波动。在带植入参数-KPI 依赖、背景变化可调的闭环遥测生成器上，该流程可靠检出控制诱导事件并恢复底层依赖结构，在一系列背景变化水平上优于其他事件检测方法。
Motivation: AI-RAN/O-RAN 中并发控制功能的交互难以从原始网络数据直接察觉，缺少可靠且可解释的依赖结构来刻画哪些控制参数在何时影响哪些网络性能指标；而 KPI 波动也可能来自背景或外生变化，不能直接当作控制事件。
Method: 开发基于显著性 (significance-based) 的事件检测流程，将连续的参数与 KPI 增量转换为二值的控制活动指示与 KPI 响应指示，作为后续依赖学习的前置步骤；评测用一个受控闭环遥测生成器，其中植入参数-KPI 依赖并可调节背景变化强度。
Result: 在可控闭环遥测生成器实验中，该流程可靠检测控制诱导事件并恢复底层依赖结构，在一系列背景变化水平上优于其他事件检测方法。
Conclusion: 把事件检测做成显著性判定的二值化步骤，可以在含背景噪声的网络遥测中分离控制动作与其 KPI 响应，从而支撑后续可解释依赖结构的学习。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: EasyLens: A Training-Free Plug-and-Play Subtle-Lesion Representation Amplifier for Medical Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) have shown increasing potential for clinical image interpretation, including lesion detection and report generation. However, their practical utility remains limited by insufficient sensitivity to subtle lesions, whose visual evidence is often sparse, low-contrast, and embedded within complex anatomical context. As local visual tokens are aggregated, these weak lesion cues can become underrepresented in global image representations, making them difficult for medical VLMs to recognize. Existing efforts to improve lesion sensitivity mainly rely on medical-domain vision-encoder pre-training, clinical-term-guided alignment, or trainable pathological representation enhancement. Although effective, these approaches usually require additional training or model-specific adaptation and may overfit to particular disease morphologies, limiting their applicability to frozen medical VLMs. To address these limitations, we propose EasyLens, a training-free plug-and-play subtle-lesion representation amplifier for medical VLMs. EasyLens first constructs EasyBank, a pathology-anatomy prototype space that provides lesion-related prototypes and anatomy-aware normal references for comparing suspicious patches against both pathological and normal anatomical patterns. To avoid blindly amplifying normal tissues, EasyTag selects lesion-relevant patches through counterfactual prototype reasoning. To counteract the dilution of subtle lesion cues in global image representations, EasyAmplifier strengthens the selected lesion-relevant patch representations through morphology-guided residual enhancement, thereby increasing their contribution to the global image embedding. Experiments on multiple medical image datasets and frozen medical VLM backbones show that EasyLens improves subtle-lesion detection and outperforms existing encoder-enhancement baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EasyLens 是面向医学 VLM 的免训练即插即用模块：用 EasyBank 病理-解剖原型空间对比可疑 patch，EasyTag 以反事实原型推理筛出病灶相关 patch，EasyAmplifier 再用形态学引导的残差增强放大其表征，使其在全局图像 embedding 中不被稀释。在多个医学图像数据集与冻结 VLM 骨干上提升细微病灶检测并超过现有编码器增强基线。
Motivation: 医学 VLM 对细微病灶敏感度不足：局部视觉 token 聚合时稀疏、低对比的病灶线索在全局表征中被稀释。现有方法依赖视觉编码器医学预训练、临床术语引导对齐或可训练增强，需要额外训练或模型特定适配，且可能过拟合特定疾病形态，无法用于冻结的医学 VLM。
Method: 三个组件：EasyBank 构建病理-解剖原型空间，提供病灶原型与解剖感知的正常参考，用于将可疑 patch 同时与病理和正常解剖模式对比；EasyTag 通过反事实原型推理 (counterfactual prototype reasoning) 选出病灶相关 patch，避免盲目放大正常组织；EasyAmplifier 以形态学引导的残差增强 (morphology-guided residual enhancement) 强化所选 patch 表征，提高其对全局图像 embedding 的贡献。全程免训练 (training-free)、即插即用，作用于冻结的医学 VLM。
Result: 在多个医学图像数据集与冻结医学 VLM 骨干上的实验显示，EasyLens 改善细微病灶检测，并在与现有编码器增强基线的对比中胜出。
Conclusion: 无需训练或模型特定适配，仅在推理阶段放大病灶相关 patch 表征即可提升冻结医学 VLM 的细微病灶敏感度，避免对特定疾病形态过拟合。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: An RRAM-based Hardware Implementation of a Radial Basis Function Neuron for Edge Classifiers
papers.abstract_en: The deployment of modern machine learning (ML) solutions on resource-constrained edge devices highlights implementation challenges. This is especially true for extreme edge applications that include safety-critical components, such as autonomous navigation tasks. This paper demonstrates an artificial neural network (ANN) design leveraging Metal-Oxide Resistive RAM (RRAM) -based Analogue Content Addressable Memory (ACAM) as an efficient hardware substrate for performing metric-based classification and online adaptation on the edge. The proposed design is based on a custom Template piXeL (TXL) cell used for building the ACAM module, where each TXL cell acts as a configurable receptive field neuron. These cells employ a Radial Basis activation function to calculate the distance of an input from the programmed receptive field. The TXL can be organised into dense arrays for calculating the distance of a high-dimensional input against all stored prototypes, effectively performing fast and energy efficient similarity search. This hardware engine enables on-the-fly learning, where the receptive field parameters can be tuned to track domain shift. Through simulation of the proposed TXL-RBF classifier we can achieve 89.1\% accuracy on the MNIST dataset while consuming 185fJ per cell per operation when operating at 10MHz.

papers.title: Text-to-Image Models Need Less from Text Encoders Than You Think
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image models rely on text prompts as their primary interface to human intent. Prompts are encoded by a text encoder into embeddings that condition the image generation process. Beyond individual token meanings, text embeddings encode contextual information across the full prompt, such as compositionality and attribute binding. However, whether image models actually exploit this richer information remains underexplored. Here, we address the question: Which aspects of text representation are essential for image generation? We show that text-to-image diffusion transformer-based models commonly rely only on two relatively straightforward aspects of text representations: (i) the merging of adjacent tokens into a word representation, for words spanning multiple tokens, and (ii) word order, which is imprinted by the positional embedding of the text-encoder. To show this, we construct a new text embedding that encodes only individual word meanings and order but lacks any contextual information about the full prompt. We find that this bag of position-tagged words representation is sufficient to successfully guide image generation, achieving visual quality and text fidelity that are on par with full text embedding-guided generation. This demonstrates that, contrary to common belief, text-to-image models often do not use the rich information encoded in the text embedding beyond individual word meanings and word order. Instead, the decoding of complex linguistic structures is performed by the image model itself. Project webpage: https://nsping13.github.io/contextless-TTI/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 文本到图像扩散 Transformer 实际只用到文本嵌入中的两件事：跨 token 的词合并与文本编码器位置嵌入带来的词序。作者构造只含单词语义加位置标记、完全不含全句上下文的嵌入（bag of position-tagged words），引导生成的视觉质量与文本保真度与完整文本嵌入相当，复杂语言结构的解码由图像模型自身完成。
Motivation: 文本嵌入除词义外还携带组合性、属性绑定等全句上下文信息，但图像模型是否真的利用这些信息一直缺乏检验，直接影响对文本条件通路的理解。
Method: 构造一种新的文本嵌入表示，仅编码单个词的含义与词序（词合并加位置嵌入），刻意去除任何全句上下文信息，再用它替代完整文本嵌入去条件化基于 diffusion transformer 的文本到图像模型，对比两种引导下的生成。
Result: bag of position-tagged words 表示足以成功引导图像生成，其视觉质量与文本保真度与完整文本嵌入引导的生成持平；结论针对 diffusion transformer 类文本到图像模型。
Conclusion: 与通常认知相反，文本到图像模型在词义与词序之外很少使用文本嵌入中的丰富信息，复杂语言结构的解码由图像模型本身完成。

papers.title: Gradient-based optimization of nuclear criticality experiments using neural surrogate eigenvalue sensitivities
papers.abstract_en: The validation of advanced nuclear reactor designs and fuel concepts will require the design of new critical experiments with high neutronic similarity to the target technology. Neutronic similarity can be quantified by the correlation coefficient $c_k$, which captures the shared bias in $k_\text{eff}$ induced by uncertainties in nuclear data. Generally, a $c_k\geq0.9$ is needed for an experiment to be sufficiently similar to a target technology. In this work, a physics-informed deep neural network is trained to predict the neutronic sensitivity of grid-based critical experiment geometries. The differentiability of the neural network is used to enable gradient-based design optimization of new experiment geometries to maximize $c_k$ with the sensitivity profile of a target technology. This approach allows for optimization over the combinatorial design space of potential material combinations within the grid, moving beyond traditional parametric optimization approaches. The method is applied to the validation of the TN-Americas TN-LC transportation cask with HALEU fuel, for which existing critical experiment coverage is limited. This application is shown to produce experiment geometries achieving $c_k$ scores of 0.97757, 0.81324, and 0.93276 for three configurations of interest.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用物理信息神经网络 (physics-informed DNN) 预测网格型临界实验几何的中子学灵敏度，并利用网络可微性对材料组合的组合设计空间做梯度优化，以最大化与目标技术的中子学相似度 c_k。对 TN-Americas TN-LC 运输容器（HALEU 燃料）三种关注构型优化得到 c_k 分别为 0.97757、0.81324、0.93276，其中两构型达到通常要求的 c_k≥0.9。
Motivation: 先进堆型与燃料概念的验证需要与目标技术中子学相似的新临界实验，而 TN-LC 这类 HALEU 运输容器现有临界实验覆盖有限；相似度由 c_k 量化，通常要求 c_k≥0.9，传统参数化优化无法覆盖网格内材料组合的组合设计空间。
Method: 训练一个物理信息深度神经网络来预测网格型临界实验几何的中子学灵敏度谱；利用网络可微性对新实验几何做基于梯度的设计优化，目标是最大化与目标技术灵敏度谱的相关系数 c_k，从而在网格材料组合的组合空间上直接优化，超越传统参数化优化。
Result: 在 TN-Americas TN-LC 运输容器（HALEU 燃料）验证应用中，优化得到的实验几何对三种关注构型给出 c_k = 0.97757、0.81324、0.93276；判据为 c_k≥0.9 才算与目标技术足够相似，其中 0.81324 低于该阈值。
Conclusion: 神经网络代理的可微性使临界实验几何能在组合材料空间中按 c_k 直接梯度优化，可为实验覆盖有限的 HALEU 运输容器生成高相似度构型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WRIT: Write-Read Intensive Trajectory Synthesis for Multi-Turn User-Facing Agents
papers.abstract_en: Multi-turn user-facing agents must infer user intent from incomplete requests, collect missing information through dialogue and tools, and execute valid actions. A training trajectory records this process as an interleaved sequence of user messages, agent responses, tool calls, etc. Synthesizing sufficiently complex trajectory has become a central route to train agents: existing pipelines often increase difficulty by composing multiple user requests into longer tasks, producing write-intensive trajectories that train sequential execution. We argue that a single write decision can itself be difficult when the agent must gather and compare substantial read-tool evidence before its arguments become identifiable, a challenge that write-intensive data alone cannot address. Guided by this insight, we propose WRIT (\uline{W}rite-\uline{R}ead \uline{I}ntensive \uline{T}rajectory Synthesis), a pipeline for synthesizing multi-turn agent training trajectories along two complexity axes: the number of write decisions in a task and the evidence burden of each individual decision. WRIT first generates write-intensive and read-heavy tasks. It then diversifies user behavior instructions to reflect realistic conversational variation, and finally simulates agent-user interactions in an executable environment to produce complete training trajectories. The resulting data trains agents not only for longer task execution, but also for robust, evidence-grounded decision making under high information load. With only 2K synthesized trajectories, a 4B model trained on WRIT outperforms GPT-5.1 no-think on $τ^2$-bench and substantially reduces inference-time token usage, showing that compact SFT data can convert part of expensive test-time reasoning into efficient agent behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WRIT 提出按两条复杂度轴（任务中 write 决策数量、单个决策的 evidence burden）合成多轮 agent 训练轨迹，先生成 write-intensive 与 read-heavy 任务，再多样化用户行为指令，最后在可执行环境中模拟 agent-user 交互产出完整轨迹。仅用 2K 条合成轨迹做 SFT，4B 模型在 τ²-bench 上超过 GPT-5.1 no-think，并显著降低推理时 token 用量。
Motivation: 现有轨迹合成管线靠把多个用户请求拼成更长任务来加难度，只训练顺序执行；但单个 write 决策本身可以很难——agent 需先大量读取、比较工具证据才能让参数可辨识，这类高信息负载下的决策是 write-intensive 数据覆盖不到的。
Method: WRIT 管线分三步：沿 write 决策数与单决策证据负担两条轴生成 write-intensive 和 read-heavy 任务；多样化 user behavior instructions 以覆盖真实对话变化；在可执行环境中模拟 agent-user 交互，产出含用户消息、agent 回复、工具调用交错序列的完整训练轨迹，用于 SFT。
Result: 仅 2K 条 WRIT 合成轨迹训练的 4B 模型在 τ²-bench 上超过 GPT-5.1 no-think，同时显著减少推理时 token 用量；摘要未给出具体数值差距。
Conclusion: 紧凑的 SFT 数据可以把部分昂贵的 test-time reasoning 转化为高效的 agent 行为：加难度应加在单个决策的证据负担上，而不只是把任务拼长。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Regret Guarantees for One-Step Lookahead Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies theoretical guarantees of a one-step lookahead Bayesian optimization (BO) method. Although the empirical effectiveness of one-step lookahead BO methods, such as entropy search, has been studied extensively, they often rely on computationally intractable approximations, and their regret guarantees remain underdeveloped. Thus, this paper analyzes a one-step lookahead BO method, which we refer to as optimal-point variance reduction (OVR), that requires only posterior sampling and Monte Carlo approximations. We obtain a uniform Monte Carlo estimation error bound over an input domain in an acquisition function computation. Furthermore, we show that the regularized OVR, with a slight modification to facilitate exploration, achieves a vanishing Bayesian expected simple regret upper bound. Finally, we validate the performance of OVR and regularized OVR through numerical experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对一步前瞻贝叶斯优化 (one-step lookahead BO) 缺少可处理的遗憾保证，提出只需后验采样与 Monte Carlo 近似的 optimal-point variance reduction (OVR)，并给出采集函数计算中一致 Monte Carlo 估计误差界；加了促进探索的正则化后，regularized OVR 达到消失的 Bayesian expected simple regret 上界，并通过数值实验验证 OVR 与 regularized OVR 的性能。
Motivation: entropy search 等一步前瞻 BO 方法依赖计算上难以处理的近似，其 regret 保证长期不完善，理论与可计算性之间存在缺口。
Method: 提出 OVR：采集函数计算只用后验采样与 Monte Carlo 近似；先给出输入域上采集函数 Monte Carlo 估计的一致误差界，再对采集函数加正则项以促进探索，得到 regularized OVR。
Result: 得到采集函数计算中输入域上一致的 Monte Carlo 估计误差界；regularized OVR（经小幅修改以促进探索）达到消失的 Bayesian expected simple regret 上界；并通过数值实验验证 OVR 与 regularized OVR 的性能。
Conclusion: 一步前瞻 BO 可以只靠后验采样与 Monte Carlo 近似实现，并在此基础上建立消失的 Bayesian expected simple regret 上界，无需计算上难处理的近似。

papers.title: Modeling Robotics Dataset Construction as an Artifact-Based Build Process
papers.abstract_en: Robotic systems generate large volumes of multimodal sensor data, but converting ROS bag recordings into machine learning datasets is often handled by ad hoc sequential scripts, creating engineering overhead and slow iteration cycles. We model dataset construction as an artifact-based build process over a dependency graph and implement this approach in Bagzel, an open-source Bazel extension for reproducible, incremental dataset generation (including nuScenes-format export). We compare Bagzel and Bagzel-xattr (server-side digest management) against a sequential rosbag2nuscenes baseline. Bagzel reduces runtime in all evaluated execution modes, with the largest gains in iterative workflows (up to 386.26x in warm builds and 7.21x in incremental builds on a 20.4 GB dataset). Across dataset sizes from 5.1 to 20.4 GB, Bagzel variants show markedly better scaling behavior than the baseline, especially in warm and incremental modes. Bagzel-xattr provides additional gains, with a mean runtime reduction of 5.9% compared to Bagzel in the input granularity study. Overall, modeling robotics dataset construction as an artifact-based build process substantially reduces dataset update latency while maintaining a deterministic build design that supports reproducibility.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE 22nd International Conference on Automation Science and Engineering (CASE 2026). 7 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Code: https://github.com/UniBwTAS/bagzel
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把机器人数据集构建建模为基于 artifact 的依赖图构建过程，并实现为开源 Bazel 扩展 Bagzel（含服务端 digest 管理的 Bagzel-xattr），支持可复现、增量式的数据集生成与 nuScenes 格式导出。相对顺序执行的 rosbag2nuscenes 基线，warm 构建最高加速 386.26x、增量构建 7.21x（20.4 GB 数据集），且在 5.1–20.4 GB 全区间扩展性更好。
Motivation: 把 ROS bag 录制转成机器学习数据集通常靠临时顺序脚本，工程开销大、迭代周期慢，数据集更新延迟高。
Method: 将数据集构建抽象为依赖图上的 artifact 构建过程，用 Bazel 扩展 Bagzel 实现可复现的增量生成，并提供 Bagzel-xattr 变体做服务端 digest 管理；与顺序 rosbag2nuscenes 基线在多种执行模式下对比，含输入粒度研究。

papers.title: Score Broadcast and Decorrelation: A General Framework for Broadcast-Based Credit Assignment
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Score Broadcast and Decorrelation (SBD), a principled framework for broadcast-based credit assignment for general families of differentiable losses. Error broadcast is a biologically plausible alternative to backpropagation that sends output information to hidden layers without weight transport. The Error Broadcast and Decorrelation (EBD) framework, recently introduced for the mean-squared-error (MSE) setting, grounded this mechanism in the stochastic orthogonality of optimal estimators, under which the optimal residual is orthogonal to functions of the input. We generalize that foundation by introducing an orthogonality principle between the output score (the gradient of loss with respect to the final-layer output) and hidden-layer activations, which holds whenever the optimal score has conditional mean zero. This single principle unifies broadcast-based credit assignment across the standard differentiable-loss families, including cross-entropy, Bregman divergences, proper scoring rules, and exponential-family negative log-likelihoods. The framework supplies a theoretical grounding for the three-factor learning rule under general losses, with the neuromodulatory factor derived as the broadcast loss score. We derive the cross-entropy case explicitly, characterize the admissible loss class, and introduce a score vector expansion technique that enriches the broadcast signal while preserving the orthogonality framework. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and Tiny ImageNet show that SBD substantially improves over existing broadcast approaches, with score vector expansion delivering further gains. Overall, this work identifies the loss score as the signal to broadcast, supplies the orthogonality theory and theoretical grounding for the three-factor learning rule from neuroscience, and shows how score vector expansion enriches the decorrelation directions of the resulting objective.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Score Broadcast and Decorrelation (SBD)，把广播式信用分配 (broadcast-based credit assignment) 的可广播信号统一为损失对末层输出的 score（条件均值为零时与隐层激活正交），从而覆盖 cross-entropy、Bregman 散度、proper scoring rules 与指数族负对数似然。CIFAR-10 与 Tiny ImageNet 上 SBD 明显优于已有广播方法，score vector expansion 带来进一步提升。
Motivation: Error Broadcast 类方法想替代反向传播、避免 weight transport，但此前只在 MSE 设定下由最优估计量的随机正交性奠基，cross-entropy 等常用损失缺少统一的理论根据。
Method: 以输出 score 与隐层激活的正交性原理（最优 score 条件均值为零时成立）统一各损失族的广播机制，显式推导 cross-entropy 情形并刻画 admissible loss class；提出 score vector expansion 在保持正交框架的同时丰富广播信号，并为神经科学的三因子学习规则给出理论依据，其中 neuromodulatory 因子即广播的 loss score。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10 与 Tiny ImageNet 上，SBD 相比已有 broadcast 方法有实质提升，score vector expansion 在此基础上进一步增益。
Conclusion: loss score 就是应当广播的信号，一条正交性原理即可把基于广播的信用分配推广到标准可微损失族，并为三因子学习规则提供理论支撑。

papers.title: Latent Performance Profiling of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) frequently achieve impressive scores on standardized benchmarks, yet accuracy alone offers a limited view of their capabilities. Evaluating open-source LLMs on leaderboards faces persistent issues such as data contamination, a narrow task scope, and poor alignment with real-world reliability. Benchmark-based evaluations such as MMLU-Pro, BBH, or IFEval primarily capture \textit{what} a model outputs on fixed test sets, not \textit{how} it processes information, calibrates uncertainty, or structures internal knowledge. In this article, we advocate for a shift from benchmark-centric evaluation toward a complementary, \textit{state-centered intrinsic assessment} of LLMs. To this end, we introduce \textbf{Latent Performance Profiling (LPP)} --- a framework that derives task-agnostic diagnostics from hidden activations and output distributions. LPP defines a set of scalar metrics on a model's latent representations and dynamics, revealing traits that enable interpretable comparisons and uncover hidden vulnerabilities. Unlike static accuracy scores, LPP provides stable, architecture-sensitive signatures across models of similar size. With extensive empirical analyses across eight LLMs, spanning a size range of 0.5B-14B, we demonstrate that models with similar benchmark scores can exhibit contrasting latent profiles, such as differences in entropy or compressibility. Guided by these insights, we design synthetic probes for uncertainty and symbolic reasoning that align with intrinsic metrics while decoupling from leaderboard bias. We recommend reporting LPP alongside benchmarks to provide a deeper, interpretable understanding of model behavior, enabling more reliable model selection, safety assessment, and evaluation beyond surface-level accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Latent Performance Profiling (LPP)：从隐藏激活与输出分布中导出任务无关的标量诊断指标，刻画模型的不确定性校准、熵与可压缩性等内在特质。在 8 个 0.5B–14B 的 LLM 上，基准分数相近的模型呈现截然不同的 latent profile，说明排行榜分数掩盖了真实能力差异。作者建议把 LPP 与基准分数一起报告。
Motivation: MMLU-Pro、BBH、IFEval 等基准评测只反映模型在固定测试集上输出什么，且受数据污染、任务范围窄、与真实可靠性脱节困扰，无法刻画模型如何处理信息与校准不确定性。
Method: LPP 框架从隐藏激活与输出分布定义一组作用于 latent 表征及其动态的标量指标，得到任务无关、架构敏感的签名；并据此设计与内在指标对齐、同时与排行榜偏差解耦的合成探针（uncertainty 与 symbolic reasoning probes）。
Result: 在 8 个 LLM、参数规模 0.5B–14B 上的实证分析显示：基准分数相近的模型 latent profile 明显不同，差异体现在熵与可压缩性等指标上；LPP 签名在相近规模的模型间保持稳定且对架构敏感。
Conclusion: 准确率不足以代表模型能力，应把 LPP 与基准分数并列报告，以支持更可靠的选择、安全评估与超越表面准确率的评测。

papers.title: LoopFM: Learning frOm HistOrical RePresentations of Foundation Model for Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge distillation (KD) transfers a single scalar prediction from a large foundation model (FM) to compact vertical models (VMs), suffering from diminishing transfer ratio -- the fraction of FM improvement captured by the VM -- as a single scalar cannot convey the rich intermediate knowledge that larger FMs learn. To address this bottleneck, we propose LoopFM (Learning frOm HistOrical RePresentations of FM), a framework that opens a high-bandwidth transfer channel by structuring FM intermediate embeddings as input features (e.g., user history sequence) for downstream VMs, without requiring real-time FM inference at serving and architectural coupling between FM and VM. We provide a theoretical framework for LoopFM with a gain decomposition and transfer-ratio analysis. On three public benchmarks, LoopFM demonstrates strong AUC improvements (e.g., 6%+ on TaobaoAd) and complementary knowledge transfer capability with KD. On industrial-scale systems (billions of examples, trillion-parameter FMs), LoopFM approximately doubles the knowledge transfer ratio on top of KD, delivering a +0.5% conversion improvement in the first half after its initial launch, and +1.03% and +1.22% conversion improvement from two individual launches in the subsequent half. Through systematic experiments, LoopFM demonstrates a scaling law in sequence length, embedding dimension, and upstream FM size.
papers.comment: Hua Zheng, Shali Jiang, Boyang Liu contributed equally to this work
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LoopFM 把大 foundation model 的中间 embedding 作为下游 vertical model 的输入特征（如用户历史序列），绕开单标量知识蒸馏 (KD) 的带宽瓶颈，且服务时无需实时调用 FM、也不要求 FM 与 VM 架构耦合。在三个公开基准上 AUC 提升 6%+（如 TaobaoAd），并与 KD 互补；在十亿级样本、万亿参数 FM 的工业系统上，KD 之上的知识迁移率约翻倍，上线后转化率提升 0.5%、后续两次单独上线分别 +1.03% 与 +1.22%。
Motivation: KD 只向紧凑 VM 传递 FM 的单个标量预测，无法承载大 FM 学到的丰富中间知识，导致迁移率（VM 捕获的 FM 改进比例）随 FM 变大而衰减。
Method: LoopFM 将 FM 中间 embedding 结构化为下游 VM 的输入特征（例如用户历史序列），打开高带宽迁移通道，服务阶段不做实时 FM 推理、也不做架构耦合；配套给出含 gain decomposition 与 transfer-ratio 分析的理论框架。
Result: 三个公开基准上 AUC 提升 6%+（TaobaoAd 为例），且与 KD 互补；工业规模系统（数十亿样本、万亿参数 FM）上在 KD 之上把知识迁移率约翻倍，首次上线后半年转化率 +0.5%，随后两次单独上线分别 +1.03% 与 +1.22%；实验显示在序列长度、embedding 维度和上游 FM 规模上存在 scaling law。
Conclusion: 把 FM 中间表征当作离线特征喂给 VM，可以在不增加服务时推理成本的前提下突破单标量 KD 的迁移率上限，并随序列长度、embedding 维度与 FM 规模呈 scaling law。

papers.title: Residualized Temporal Sparse Autoencoders for Interpreting Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion models generate images by iterative denoising, so their internal layers produce trajectories of activations rather than single static representations. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have recently been used to decompose diffusion activations into interpretable features, but most approaches analyze individual timesteps or condition on time rather than learning from full trajectories. Training one SAE on whole trajectories would make each feature a single trajectory across timesteps, but adjacent activations are largely linearly predictable from one another, so such an SAE spends its latents on content carried forward from step to step. We introduce residualized temporal SAEs (ReSAE), which fit linear predictors between neighboring timesteps and represent each trajectory by its initial activation and the residuals these dynamics leave unexplained. Training an SAE on this representation is equivalent to training it on raw trajectories under a metric induced by the linear dynamics, and it encourages latents to capture structure beyond what is linearly predictable. Each latent's decoder direction maps back to activation space as a feature trajectory over denoising time. Across Stable Diffusion~1.5 and a Diffusion Transformer, ReSAE features span the whole trajectory while pinpointing when changes enter it, making ReSAE a natural tool for studying how a diffusion model generates an image over time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReSAE 先在相邻去噪时间步之间拟合线性预测器，用初始激活加线性动力学无法解释的残差来表示整条激活轨迹，再在该表示上训练 SAE，使 latent 捕获超出线性可预测部分的结构。在 Stable Diffusion 1.5 与 Diffusion Transformer 上，ReSAE 特征覆盖整条轨迹并能定位变化何时进入，每个 latent 的解码方向映射回激活空间即为随去噪时间演化的特征轨迹。
Motivation: 扩散模型各层产生的是随迭代去噪演化的激活轨迹而非静态表征，现有 SAE 多按单时间步分析或以时间为条件；直接在整条轨迹上训练 SAE 会把容量浪费在相邻步之间线性传递的内容上。
Method: 提出 residualized temporal SAEs (ReSAE)：在相邻时间步之间拟合线性预测器，用初始激活与残差重构轨迹，再在其上训练 SAE；该表示等价于在线性动力学诱导的度量下训练原始轨迹 SAE，鼓励 latent 捕获线性不可预测的结构，每个 latent 的解码方向映射回激活空间成为随去噪时间的特征轨迹。
Result: 在 Stable Diffusion 1.5 与一个 Diffusion Transformer 上，ReSAE 特征跨越整条去噪轨迹，并能精确定位变化何时进入轨迹；摘要给出的是定性结果，无定量指标。
Conclusion: 把时间线性动力学残差化后再做稀疏分解，可让 SAE latent 表示超出线性可预测部分的结构，ReSAE 因此成为研究扩散模型随时间生成图像的工具。

papers.title: PHGNet: Prototype-Guided Hypergraph Construction for Heterogeneous Spatiotemporal Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: As a core task in intelligent transportation systems, traffic forecasting plays a critical role in urban traffic management. Accurate traffic forecasting relies on modeling complex spatiotemporal dependencies, which is inherently challenging due to spatial heterogeneity in traffic systems.Despite significant progress, most existing methods are still limited to pairwise spatial dependency modeling, making it difficult to capture dynamic high-order interactions among nodes with similar traffic patterns. To address this issue, we propose PHGNet, a novel spatiotemporal forecasting framework based on prototype-guided hypergraph construction. At the core of PHGNet, a prototype learning mechanism is designed to adaptively assign pattern-similar nodes to hyperedges, thereby capturing high-order interactions with time-varying structures. To improve the reliability of dynamic hypergraph construction, we further develop a global-local node representation module to extract time-consistent features. For forecasting, iterative residual refinement and Temporal Query Attention are introduced to improve forecasting accuracy while supporting efficient parallel decoding. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world datasets demonstrate that PHGNet achieves superior predictive performance compared with state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PHGNet 用原型学习 (prototype learning) 把交通模式相似的节点自适应分到超边，构造时变超图来捕捉高阶空间交互，并以迭代残差细化加 Temporal Query Attention 做并行解码。在多个真实交通数据集上，其预测性能优于现有 SOTA 方法。
Motivation: 交通系统存在空间异质性，现有方法多停留在成对 (pairwise) 空间依赖建模，难以捕捉相似模式节点之间的动态高阶交互。
Method: 核心是原型引导的超图构建：原型学习机制自适应分配模式相似节点到超边，形成时变结构；全局-局部节点表示模块提取时间一致特征以稳定动态超图；预测端用迭代残差细化与 Temporal Query Attention，支持高效并行解码。
Result: 在多个真实世界交通数据集上的实验中，PHGNet 取得优于 state-of-the-art 方法的预测性能（摘要未列出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把空间建模从成对关系升级为原型引导的时变超图，可在异质交通网络上提高时空预测精度并保持并行解码效率。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: MambaDSF: Multi-Scale SSM with Dilated Feature Fusion for Sonar Small Target Detection
papers.abstract_en: Sonar imaging is the primary modality for underwater target detection, yet small targets remain difficult to detect due to insufficient pixel coverage, low acoustic contrast, and scale ambiguity across imaging ranges. CNN-based detectors extract local features efficiently but cannot suppress noise-induced false alarms without global acoustic context. Transformer-based methods capture long-range dependencies at quadratic computational cost. Existing Mamba-based vision models offer efficient linear-cost scanning but lack multi-scale semantic alignment across pyramid levels, multi-receptive-field fusion, and small-target-aware training supervision needed for reliable sonar detection. This letter proposes Mamba Dilated-Scale Fusion (MambaDSF), a hybrid framework addressing these limitations through three contributions: a Mamba Enhanced Feature Pyramid (MambaEFP) backbone that jointly captures local echo cues and global acoustic context at linear complexity; a Dilate Fusion Mamba (DFMamba) encoder that enforces multi-scale feature alignment across pyramid levels; and Scale-Adaptive Weighted IoU (SA-WIoU) and Cross-Scale Coherence (CSC) losses that stabilize small-target training. MambaDSF achieves 91.5% mAP50 on the UATD forward-looking sonar benchmark with 28.7 million parameters, surpassing all compared detectors. On a small-target subset the gain reached +2.2 percentage points, and cross-domain evaluation on FLS and MD-FLS confirms the generalization of the proposed architecture. The codes are publicly available at https://github.com/IDontKnowAAA/MambaDSF.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, under review at IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Letters (GRSL)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向前视声呐小目标检测提出 MambaDSF：以线性复杂度的 Mamba 特征金字塔骨干联合局部回波线索与全局声学上下文，配合跨尺度对齐编码器与两个小目标监督损失。在 UATD 前视声呐基准上取得 91.5% mAP50、28.7M 参数，超过全部对比检测器，小目标子集增益 +2.2 个百分点。
Motivation: 声呐小目标像素覆盖不足、声学对比度低且随成像距离尺度模糊；CNN 缺全局声学上下文难以抑制噪声虚警，Transformer 依赖以二次代价捕获长程关系，已有 Mamba 视觉模型缺少跨金字塔层的多尺度语义对齐与小目标训练监督。
Method: 三个组件：Mamba Enhanced Feature Pyramid (MambaEFP) 骨干以线性复杂度同时提取局部回波线索与全局声学上下文；Dilate Fusion Mamba (DFMamba) 编码器强制跨金字塔层的多尺度特征对齐；Scale-Adaptive Weighted IoU (SA-WIoU) 与 Cross-Scale Coherence (CSC) 损失稳定小目标训练。
Result: 在 UATD 前视声呐基准上 mAP50 达 91.5%，参数量 28.7M，超过全部对比检测器；小目标子集增益 +2.2 个百分点；在 FLS 与 MD-FLS 上的跨域评估确认架构泛化性。
Conclusion: 线性复杂度的 Mamba 金字塔配合跨尺度对齐与小目标感知监督，可在前视声呐小目标检测上以 28.7M 参数超过所比较的检测器并保持跨域泛化；代码已公开。

papers.title: Smart-Insertion-V: Photorealistic Video Insertion via a Closed-Loop Feedback Dual-Stream Framework
papers.abstract_en: Mask-free video object insertion has emerged as a challenging task, requiring harmonious integration of reference objects into source videos. However, existing methods struggle when references exhibit severe stylistic domain gaps with the source scene. To overcome this, we propose \textit{\textbf{Smart-Insertion-V}}, an end-to-end \textbf{Dual-Stream} framework that concurrently conducts video insertion and image style transfer. Within this framework, the image stream synchronously guides the video generation process, while a \textbf{Closed-loop Feedback} mechanism is further incorporated to ensure robust insertion. Inevitably, integrating these diverse conditioning signals results in feature entanglement and style leakage. To tackle this issue, we design \textbf{Dual-World-View RoPE} to distinguish different signals via spatial-temporal offsets without incurring heavy training overhead. Furthermore, to facilitate spatial grounding and stylistic adaptation, we introduce a \textbf{Decoupled Guidance Module} that leverages a Vision-Language Model for semantic reasoning while preserving original temporal guidance with native text encoder. To bridge data gap for harmonious reference insertion task, we propose a data curation pipeline and will release an \textbf{open-source dataset}. Experiments demonstrate that our method can insert objects into plausible positions while achieving the most harmonious results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Smart-Insertion-V 是一个无掩码视频物体插入 (mask-free video object insertion) 的端到端双流框架，同步做视频插入与图像风格迁移：图像流引导视频生成，闭环反馈 (Closed-loop Feedback) 保证插入稳健。用 Dual-World-View RoPE 以时空偏移区分不同条件信号、Decoupled Guidance Module 借 Vision-Language Model 做语义推理并保留原生文本编码器的时序引导，实验显示能插入到合理位置且融合最和谐。
Motivation: 无掩码视频物体插入要求把参考物体自然融进源视频，当参考物体与源场景存在严重风格域差距时，现有方法难以保持和谐。
Method: 端到端 Dual-Stream 框架并行执行视频插入与图像风格迁移，图像流同步引导视频生成并加入闭环反馈；Dual-World-View RoPE 通过时空偏移区分多路条件信号以缓解特征纠缠与风格泄漏；Decoupled Guidance Module 用 Vision-Language Model 做语义推理、同时用原生文本编码器保留时序引导；另提出数据整理流程并开源数据集。
Result: 实验表明该方法能把物体插入到合理位置并取得最和谐的融合结果；同时提出数据 curation pipeline 并将发布开源数据集。
Conclusion: 双流同步加闭环反馈的条件解耦设计，可在参考物体与源场景风格差距大时实现和谐的无掩码视频插入。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Which Way Did It Move? Diagnosing and Overcoming Directional Motion Blindness in Video-LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) have made rapid progress on temporal video understanding, yet many fail at a basic perceptual primitive: signed image-plane motion direction. On simple videos of a single object moving left, right, up, or down, most Video-LLMs perform near chance, with above-chance cases largely attributable to prediction biases rather than genuine direction understanding. We call this failure directional motion blindness. We localize the failure by tracing motion direction information through the Video-LLM pipeline. Motion direction remains linearly accessible from the vision encoder, projector, and LLM hidden states, but the readout fails to bind this signal to the correct verbal answer option, revealing a direction binding gap. Although synthetic motion direction instruction tuning reduces this gap on the source domain, motion direction concept vector analysis shows that visual complexity weakens the signal magnitude and limits out-of-domain generalization. We introduce MoDirect, a dataset family for motion direction instruction tuning and evaluation, and DeltaDirect, a diagnosis-driven, projector-level objective that predicts normalized 2-D motion vectors from adjacent-frame feature deltas. On MoDirect-SynBench, instruction tuning with DeltaDirect improves motion direction accuracy from 25.9% to 85.9%. On MODIRECT-REALBENCH, DeltaDirect improves realworld motion direction accuracy by 21.4 points over the vanilla baseline without real-world tuning data, while preserving standard video-understanding performance. Our project page is available at https://jong980812.github.io/which-way-did-it-move/
papers.comment: NeurIPS 2026 (Accept). 50 pages including Appendix. Project page: https://jong980812.github.io/which-way-did-it-move/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Video-LLM 在最简单的单物体左右上下运动视频上方向判别接近随机，作者定位为方向绑定缺口 (direction binding gap)：方向信息在线性可读的视觉编码器、projector 与 LLM 隐状态中都存在，但读出时无法绑定到正确文字选项。提出 projector 级目标 DeltaDirect，从相邻帧特征差预测归一化 2-D 运动向量，MoDirect-SynBench 上方向准确率从 25.9% 提到 85.9%。
Motivation: Video-LLM 在带符号的图像平面运动方向这一基本感知原语上失败，多数接近随机且高于随机的表现主要来自预测偏置而非真正的方向理解，需要定位信息在管线中丢失的位置。
Method: 引入 MoDirect 数据集族（含 MoDirect-SynBench 与 MoDirect-RealBench）用于运动方向指令微调与评测；DeltaDirect 是诊断驱动的 projector 级目标，从相邻帧特征差 (adjacent-frame feature deltas) 预测归一化 2-D 运动向量；配合运动方向概念向量分析定位视觉复杂度对信号幅度的削弱。
Result: 在 MoDirect-SynBench 上，指令微调配合 DeltaDirect 将运动方向准确率从 25.9% 提升到 85.9%；在 MoDirect-RealBench 上，DeltaDirect 在不使用真实世界微调数据的情况下比 vanilla baseline 高 21.4 个百分点，同时保持标准视频理解性能。诊断结果显示方向信息在视觉编码器、projector 与 LLM 隐状态中均线性可读。
Conclusion: 方向运动盲区是读出端的绑定问题而非编码端的信息缺失，因此在 projector 层直接监督运动向量即可同时修复源域与真实域的方向判别，且不牺牲通用视频理解。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Open-CHOIR: Open-World Contact-Aware 4D Hand-Object Interaction Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: We ask whether everyday open-world monocular videos can be turned into reusable 4D interaction primitives: articulated hand motion, object shape with 6D pose over time, and the when/where of contact. Such a capability would enable scalable mining of real interactions and, beyond reconstruction, support scene-aware synthesis and planning. However, reconstructing hand-object interaction (HOI) from challenging monocular videos remains difficult: methods often assume known objects or curated scenes, and separately estimated hands and objects easily become misaligned under clutter, occlusion, and unseen object geometries. Targeting this setting, we present Open-CHOIR, an Open-world Contact-aware HOI Reconstruction framework for a monocular camera, using contact as an explicit coupling signal between hands and objects. Open-CHOIR first initializes a coarse, contact-agnostic 4D HOI sequence from open-world visual priors. It then introduces a generative HOI spatial rectification module to predict ray-depth corrections and rectify hand-object relative placement, then derive initial per-frame contact correspondences on the rectified geometry. Last, a contact-aware joint optimization with dynamically updated contact constraints enforces geometric, temporal, and contact consistency. Experiments on controlled and challenging videos show that Open-CHOIR improves object reconstruction, physical plausibility, and temporal consistency over state-of-the-art methods. Code, data, and pretrained weights are available at https://github.com/hxwork/CHOIR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Open-CHOIR 把开放世界单目视频转成可复用的 4D 手-物交互原语：先用开放世界视觉先验初始化粗的、无接触约束的 HOI 序列，再用生成式空间校正模块预测 ray-depth 修正并重对手-物相对位置，最后在动态更新的接触约束下做接触感知联合优化。在受控与挑战性视频上，物体重建、物理合理性和时序一致性均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 从杂乱、遮挡、未见物体几何的单目视频重建手-物交互仍困难：现有方法多假设已知物体或精选场景，且手与物分别估计时容易失配。
Method: 三阶段：开放世界视觉先验初始化粗 4D HOI 序列；生成式 HOI 空间校正模块预测 ray-depth 修正、校正手-物相对摆放并导出逐帧接触对应；接触感知联合优化以动态更新的接触约束强制几何、时序与接触一致性。
Result: 在受控与挑战性视频上，Open-CHOIR 在物体重建、物理合理性和时序一致性方面优于 SOTA 方法；代码、数据与预训练权重已发布。
Conclusion: 把接触作为手与物之间的显式耦合信号并纳入联合优化，可在开放世界单目视频中得到更一致、更物理合理的 4D 交互重建。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Set-Valued Policy Learning
papers.abstract_en: Conventional treatment policies map patient covariates to a single recommended intervention in order to maximize expected clinical outcomes. However, when multiple treatments yield statistically indistinguishable outcomes or when treatment has no effect, recommending a single intervention may result in somewhat arbitrary interventions, undermining clinical adoption and trust. To address this, we propose a set-valued policy learning paradigm. By outputting sets of valuable treatments whose cardinality reflects the recommendation's ambiguity, our approach better supports clinical decision-making. Evaluating a set-valued policy proves subtle due to the range of possible downstream decisions. To do so, we define the set-policy value using a choice function to model clinical decision-making, and we develop doubly robust estimators thereof. Despite its practical importance, set-valued policy learning for categorical treatments remains largely unexplored. In this context, we introduce two complementary approaches: the Greatest Lower Bound method, which extends the learning-to-defer framework to multiple treatments, and conformal set-valued policy learning, which bridges the gap between unobserved ground-truth optimal treatments and estimated optimal treatment rules. Through experiments on synthetic data and real-world applications to trauma care and in-vitro fertilization (IVF), we demonstrate that our methods produce robust and actionable policies that naturally incorporate clinical considerations while effectively balancing performance and reliability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把临床策略学习从单一推荐改成输出治疗集合，集合大小反映推荐的模糊程度：当多个治疗效果统计上不可区分、或治疗本身无效时，单点推荐会给出任意干预。用 choice function 定义集合策略价值并构造双重稳健估计，配合 Greatest Lower Bound 与 conformal 两条路线，在合成数据、创伤救治和 IVF 上给出兼顾性能与可靠性的策略。
Motivation: 常规策略学习只输出一个最优干预，当多治疗效果无显著差异或治疗无效时，单点推荐带有任意性，削弱临床采纳与信任；而分类治疗下的 set-valued policy learning 基本未被探索。
Method: 提出 set-valued policy learning 范式：用 choice function 建模临床决策过程来定义 set-policy value，并为其构造双重稳健 (doubly robust) 估计量；两条互补方法是 Greatest Lower Bound（把 learning-to-defer 扩展到多治疗）和 conformal set-valued policy learning（连接不可观测的真实最优治疗与估计出的最优治疗规则）。
Result: 在合成数据以及创伤救治 (trauma care) 和体外受精 (IVF) 两个真实应用上，所提方法产出稳健且可执行的策略，自然纳入临床考量，并在性能与可靠性之间取得平衡；集合基数直接编码推荐的模糊程度。
Conclusion: 当治疗间效果难以区分时，输出治疗集合而非单点推荐，能同时保留策略价值并把不确定性显式交给临床决策者。

papers.title: Generative Recursive Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: How should future neural reasoning systems implement extended computation? Recursive Reasoning Models (RRMs) offer a promising alternative to autoregressive sequence extension by performing iterative latent-state refinement with shared transition functions. Yet existing RRMs are largely deterministic, following a single latent trajectory and converging to a single prediction. We introduce Generative Recursive reAsoning Models (GRAM), a framework that turns recursive latent reasoning into probabilistic multi-trajectory computation. GRAM models reasoning as a stochastic latent trajectory, enabling multiple hypotheses, alternative solution strategies, and inference-time scaling through both recursive depth and parallel trajectory sampling. This yields a latent-variable generative model supporting conditional reasoning via $p_θ(y \mid x)$ and, with fixed or absent inputs, unconditional generation via $p_θ(x)$. Trained with amortized variational inference, GRAM improves over deterministic recurrent and recursive baselines on structured reasoning and multi-solution constraint satisfaction tasks, while demonstrating an unconditional generation capability. https://ahn-ml.github.io/gram-website
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GRAM 把递归隐状态推理 (Recursive Reasoning) 从确定性单轨迹改成随机隐轨迹的生成式多轨迹计算，通过递归深度与并行轨迹采样两路做推理时扩展。用摊销变分推理训练后，在结构化推理与多解约束满足任务上优于确定性 recurrent/recursive 基线，并展示无条件生成能力。
Motivation: 现有 Recursive Reasoning Models (RRM) 是确定性的，只走一条隐轨迹、收敛到单一预测，无法表达多假设或替代解法，也缺少推理时扩展的自由度。
Method: GRAM 将推理建模为随机隐轨迹，形成隐变量生成模型：有条件推理 p_θ(y|x)，输入固定或缺失时无条件生成 p_θ(x)；训练用摊销变分推理 (amortized variational inference)，推理时沿递归深度与并行轨迹采样两个方向扩展。
Result: 在结构化推理与多解约束满足任务上优于确定性 recurrent 与 recursive 基线，并展示无条件生成能力；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把递归推理改成概率式多轨迹计算，可同时获得多假设/多解表达与推理时扩展，是相对确定性 RRM 的改进框架。

papers.title: Brain alignment of reasoning and action representations from vision-language and action models during naturalistic gameplay
papers.abstract_en: Understanding how humans and artificial intelligence systems predict and plan by interacting with their environment is a fundamental challenge at the intersection of neuroscience and machine learning. Most brain-encoding studies focus on aligning artificial models with brain activity during language comprehension or passive visual processing, while interactive brain alignment studies have to date been largely limited to reinforcement-learning (RL) agents and theory-based models. To address this gap, we study brain alignment of representative models from two foundation-model types, namely vision-language models (VLMs) and large-action models (LAMs), using fMRI recordings from participants playing naturalistic Atari-style video games. Specifically, we examine how action-focused and reasoning-focused prompts shape the models' internal representations and their alignment with fMRI brain activity. First, we find that both VLMs and LAMs achieve significantly higher voxel-wise encoding performance than RL baselines, with the advantage holding even under matched feature dimensionality. Second, compared to a no-prompt baseline, prompt-driven gains are larger in higher-order frontal-parietal and motor-planning regions than in early visual cortex, roughly 2-2.5$\times$ when averaged over region-of-interest (ROI) groups, although individual regions are heterogeneous. Third, variance partitioning reveals a qualitatively different representational organization. VLM representations are prompt-symmetric (12.4% unique action vs. 9.5% unique reasoning), whereas LAM representations are action-dominant (25.6% unique action vs.-8.2% unique reasoning), with the asymmetry strongest in frontal-motor cortex. Together, these results associate action specialization with distinct cortical alignment patterns in multimodal game-state representations, revealing differences hidden by similar prediction accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用玩 Atari 风格游戏时的 fMRI 数据比较 VLM 与 LAM 的脑对齐：两类模型的逐体素编码性能都显著高于 RL 基线（匹配特征维度后仍成立），动作导向与推理导向 prompt 带来的增益在额顶与运动规划区约为早期视觉皮层的 2–2.5 倍。方差分解显示 VLM 表征 prompt 对称（独特动作 12.4% vs 独特推理 9.5%），LAM 则动作主导（25.6% vs -8.2%），不对称在额运动皮层最强。
Motivation: 现有脑编码研究多对齐语言理解或被动视觉处理，交互式脑对齐又局限于 RL 代理与理论模型，缺少对基础模型中动作与推理表征如何对应皮层活动的刻画。
Method: 以参与者玩自然 Atari 式游戏时的 fMRI 记录为脑信号，选取 VLM 与 LAM 两类基础模型的代表模型，用动作导向与推理导向两类 prompt 激发内部表征，做逐体素脑编码并与 RL 基线在匹配特征维度下比较，再用方差分解 (variance partitioning) 分离动作与推理的独特贡献。
Result: VLM 与 LAM 的逐体素编码性能均显著高于 RL 基线，且在匹配特征维度后优势保持；相对无 prompt 基线，prompt 增益在高阶额顶与运动规划区大于早期视觉皮层，按 ROI 组平均约 2–2.5 倍，但单个脑区异质。方差分解：VLM 独特动作 12.4%、独特推理 9.5%（prompt 对称），LAM 独特动作 25.6%、独特推理 -8.2%（动作主导），不对称在额运动皮层最强。
Conclusion: 相似的预测精度会掩盖表征组织差异：动作专化对应独特的皮层对齐模式，LAM 的游戏状态表征明显偏动作，VLM 则在动作与推理间更均衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: QLIF-CAST: Quantum Leaky-Integrate-and-Fire for Time-Series Weather Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Accurate and efficient time-series forecasting remains a challenging problem for both classical and quantum neural architectures, particularly in multivariate environmental settings. This work adapts the Quantum Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (QLIF) spiking neural network for time-series regression tasks, specifically short-term multivariate weather forecasting. We extend QLIF beyond classification and demonstrate its applicability to continuous-valued prediction problems. The QLIF-CAST model encodes neuron excitation states as single-qubit quantum superpositions, driven by R_x rotation gates and T1 relaxation decay, and is embedded within a hybrid quantum-classical recurrent architecture. We conduct two distinct evaluations. First, a controlled comparison against a parameter-matched classical LIF baseline on a multivariate weather dataset shows that QLIF-CAST achieves 15.4% lower MSE and 4.4% lower MAE, demonstrating that quantum neuronal dynamics reduce prediction error over classical equivalents. Second, a cross-domain comparative analysis with state-of-the-art quantum LSTM (QLSTM) and quantum neural network (QNN) models on air quality and wind speed benchmarks reveals that QLIF-CAST converges in up to 94% less training time, occupying a distinct position in the speed-error trade-off space. Hardware verification on IBM Marrakesh (156-qubit QPU) confirms reliable circuit execution with only 1.2% average deviation from simulation.
papers.comment: To appear at the IEEE International Conference on Quantum Artificial Intelligence (QAI), Nottingham, UK, December 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QLIF-CAST 把 Quantum Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (QLIF) 脉冲神经网络从分类扩展到连续值回归，用单量子比特叠加编码神经元激发态、由 R_x 旋转门与 T1 弛豫衰减驱动，嵌入混合量子-经典循环架构做多变量短期天气预报。参数匹配的对照中其 MSE 低 15.4%、MAE 低 4.4%，跨域对比中训练时间最多省 94%，在速度-误差权衡空间占据独立位置。
Motivation: 多变量环境时间序列的短期预报对经典与量子神经架构都仍是难题，而 QLIF 此前只用于分类，未覆盖连续值预测这类回归任务。
Method: QLIF-CAST 将神经元激发态编码为单量子比特量子叠加，由 R_x 旋转门与 T1 弛豫衰减驱动，嵌入混合量子-经典循环架构；评测分两部分：与参数匹配的经典 LIF 基线在多变量天气数据集上受控对比，以及与 QLSTM、QNN 在空气质量与风速基准上的跨域对比，并在 IBM Marrakesh（156-qubit QPU）上做硬件验证。
Result: 受控对比中 QLIF-CAST 比参数匹配的经典 LIF 基线 MSE 低 15.4%、MAE 低 4.4%；与 QLSTM、QNN 在空气质量与风速基准的对比中训练时间最多减少 94%；IBM Marrakesh（156-qubit QPU）实测与仿真平均偏差仅 1.2%。
Conclusion: 量子神经元动力学在参数匹配条件下可降低多变量天气回归误差，且 QLIF-CAST 在训练速度与误差的权衡空间中占据 QLSTM/QNN 之外的独立位置，电路在真实 QPU 上执行可靠。

papers.title: Exact Convex Reformulations of Linear Neural Networks via Completely Positive Lifting
papers.abstract_en: We show that the training problem of a deep linear neural network under the squared loss admits an exact convex reformulation in a lifted space over a generalized completely positive cone. The reformulation has the same optimal value as the original nonconvex problem and is linear in the lifted variables, with all nonconvexity encoded in the cone constraint. Its ambient lifted dimension depends only on the input and output dimensions, independent of the network depth and the number of data points, and the bottleneck width enters only through scalar constraints. The construction proceeds by reducing the multilayer parameterization to a bilinear factorization, lifting it to a rank-constrained semidefinite program, expressing the rank constraint via a complementarity condition, and applying a completely positive lifting. The resulting formulation gives a conic representation of the nonconvexity induced by linear factorization and connects linear neural network training with copositive programming.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 深度线性网络在平方损失下的训练问题可被精确改写为广义完全正锥 (generalized completely positive cone) 上的 lifted 凸问题：最优值与原非凸问题相同，目标对 lifted 变量是线性的，全部非凸性被压进锥约束。提升后的维数只依赖输入输出维度、与网络深度和数据点数无关，瓶颈宽度仅以标量约束出现。
Motivation: 深度线性网络训练是非凸问题，标准分析依赖深度与数据规模；作者要给出一个与深度、样本数解耦的精确凸表示，把线性因子化诱导的非凸性单独刻画出来。
Method: 四步构造：把多层参数化化为双线性因子化，提升为带秩约束的半定规划 (SDP)，用互补性条件 (complementability condition) 表达秩约束，再做 completely positive lifting；由此把线性神经网络训练与 copositive programming 联系起来。
Result: 所得凸重构与原非凸问题最优值相同，目标在 lifted 变量上是线性的；提升空间维数只依赖输入与输出维度，与网络深度和数据点数无关，瓶颈宽度只通过标量约束进入。
Conclusion: 深度线性网络的非凸性可以被完整地编码进一个完全正锥约束，从而在凸优化 (copositive programming) 框架内精确刻画线性因子化带来的非凸性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Constrained latent state modeling: A unifying perspective on representation learning under competing constraints
papers.abstract_en: Learning latent representations from temporal, multimodal, and partially observed data requires specifying what information a latent state should retain, discard, and organize. Existing approaches encode these requirements through heterogeneous objectives, making methods difficult to compare and learned representations difficult to interpret. We propose Constrained Latent State Modeling (CLSM), a conceptual framework that characterizes latent states through six complementary properties: predictive sufficiency, minimality, temporal coherence, observation compatibility, invariance to nuisance factors, and structural constraints. CLSM separates these properties from the surrogate objectives used to induce them and from the diagnostics used to evaluate them, and clarifies how combinations of constraints can improve identifiability by restricting the space of admissible representations. We reinterpret major representation-learning families through this common design space and illustrate the framework with a controlled synthetic benchmark. The experiments show how objectives produce distinct latent organizations and empirical trade-offs depending on the prediction target, surrogate formulation, parameterization, and optimization. Companion repository containing the reference implementation, reproducible experiments, documentation, and model cards: https://github.com/gwenole-quellec/clsm
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CLSM（Constrained Latent State Modeling）框架，用六条互补性质刻画潜状态——预测充分性、最小性、时间一致性、观测兼容性、对干扰因素的不变性、结构性约束，并把性质本身与诱导它的代理目标、评估它的诊断三者分离。受控合成基准显示：不同目标函数会组织出不同的潜表示结构，其经验权衡随预测目标、代理目标形式、参数化与优化方式而变。
Motivation: 时序、多模态、部分观测数据的潜表示学习中，「潜状态应保留/丢弃/组织什么信息」散落在各类异构目标里，导致方法难以比较、学到的表示难以解释。
Method: CLSM 以六条互补性质刻画潜状态，并将性质与其代理目标（surrogate objectives）和诊断指标解耦；论证约束组合可通过收窄可接受表示空间提升可辨识性（identifiability），再把主要表示学习家族重新纳入这一统一设计空间，并用受控合成基准（controlled synthetic benchmark）加以说明。
Result: 受控合成实验显示：不同目标函数产生不同的潜表示组织，且经验权衡取决于预测目标、代理目标形式、参数化与优化方式；配套仓库提供参考实现、可复现实验、文档与 model cards。
Conclusion: 把「表示应满足的性质」与「用来诱导它的目标」和「用来评估它的诊断」分开，是统一比较与解释表示学习方法的可行框架，约束组合可提升可辨识性。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Agentic Discovery of Neural Architectures: AIRA-Compose and AIRA-Design
papers.abstract_en: Toward recursive self-improvement, we investigate LLM agents autonomously designing foundation models beyond standard Transformers. We introduce a dual-framework approach: AIRA-Compose for high-level architecture search, and AIRA-Design for low-level mechanistic implementation. AIRA-Compose uses 11 agents to explore fundamental computational primitives under a 24-hour budget. Agents evaluate million-parameter candidates, extrapolating top designs to 350M, 1B, and 3B scales. This yields 14 architectures across two families: AIRAformers (Transformer-based) and AIRAhybrids (Transformer-Mamba). Pre-trained at 1B scale, these consistently outperform Llama 3.2 and Composer-found baselines. On downstream tasks, AIRAformer-D and AIRAhybrid-D improve accuracy by 2.4% and 3.8% over Llama 3.2. Furthermore, AIRA-Compose finds models with highly efficient scaling frontiers: AIRAformer-C scales 54% and 71% faster than Llama 3.2 and Composer's best Transformer, while AIRAhybrid-C outscales Nemotron-2 by 23% and Composer's best hybrid by 37%. AIRA-Design tasks 20 agents with writing novel attention mechanisms for long-range dependencies and high-performing training scripts. On the Long Range Arena benchmark, agent-designed architectures reach within 2.3% and 2.6% of human state-of-the-art on document matching and text classification. On the Autoresearch benchmark, Greedy Opus 4.5 achieves 0.968 validation bits-per-byte under a fixed time budget, surpassing the published minimum. Together, these frameworks show AI agents can autonomously discover architectures and algorithmic optimizations matching or surpassing hand-designed baselines. This establishes a powerful paradigm for discovering next-generation foundation models, marking a clear step toward recursive self-improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 LLM agent 自主发现 Transformer 之外的基础模型架构：AIRA-Compose 负责高层架构搜索（11 个 agent、24 小时预算、百万参数候选再外推到 350M/1B/3B），AIRA-Design 负责底层机制实现（20 个 agent 写新注意力机制与训练脚本）。产出 14 个架构，1B 预训练后在下游任务上比 Llama 3.2 高 2.4%（AIRAformer-D）与 3.8%（AIRAhybrid-C 同族），Long Range Arena 上距人类 SOTA 2.3% 与 2.6%，说明 agent 可自主发现匹配或超越人工设计的架构。
Motivation: 递归自我改进要求 LLM agent 不只调参，而能自主设计基础模型的计算原语与机制实现；标准 Transformer 之外的架构搜索目前仍主要靠人工。
Method: AIRA-Compose 用 11 个 agent 在 24 小时预算下探索基本计算原语，评估百万参数候选并把最优设计外推到 350M、1B、3B 规模，得到 AIRAformers（Transformer 系）与 AIRAhybrids（Transformer-Mamba）两族共 14 个架构，在 1B 规模预训练；AIRA-Design 用 20 个 agent 撰写面向长程依赖的新注意力机制与高性能训练脚本。
Result: 1B 预训练的 AIRAformer-D 与 AIRAhybrid-D 在下游任务上比 Llama 3.2 准确率分别高 2.4% 与 3.8%，并一致优于 Llama 3.2 与 Composer-found 基线；AIRAformer-C 的 scaling frontier 比 Llama 3.2 快 54%、比 Composer 最佳 Transformer 快 71%，AIRAhybrid-C 比 Nemotron-2 高 23%、比 Composer 最佳 hybrid 高 37%；Long Range Arena 上 agent 设计架构在 document matching 与 text classification 上距人类 SOTA 分别 2.3% 与 2.6%；Autoresearch 基准上 Greedy Opus 4.5 在固定时间预算下达到 0.968 validation bits-per-byte，超过已发表最优值。
Conclusion: LLM agent 能自主发现架构与算法优化，匹配或超越手工设计基线，构成通向递归自我改进与下一代基础模型发现的范式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Few Steps Further: Why Defenses Against Malicious Finetuning Erode Under Continued Training
papers.abstract_en: Model providers increasingly release the weights of large language models. Although these models are safety-aligned before release, their safeguards can often be removed by fine-tuning on harmful data. A growing class of defenses aims to make alignment robust to such malicious fine-tuning, but these defenses are typically evaluated against attacks with a fixed training budget, even though an attacker who holds the weights can simply train for longer. We ask whether current defenses withstand this simplest escalation. Surveying fifteen recent defenses, we find that they share a common weakness: each is built around a limited model of the attacker, such as a bounded perturbation, a short simulated attack, or a trained link between harmful and benign behavior, and nothing enforces that protection once the weights are released. We then test six representative defenses on four open-weight models by continuing the same harmful-only fine-tuning attack for three epochs and measuring harmfulness and capability along the way. In all 72 defended runs, the model is more harmful at the end of training than at release, and on Llama-3.1 at the highest learning rate the defended models end almost as harmful as the undefended one. The defenses are not equally weak: one defense kept harmfulness low on one model, and some attacks recovered harmfulness only at the cost of general capability. Current defenses can delay or disrupt malicious fine-tuning, but in most cases their measured resistance does not persist under continued training, and they should not yet be treated as durable protection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对开放权重 LLM 的恶意微调防御，指出其防护只在固定攻击预算下成立：持续训练会绕过防御。对 4 个开放模型上的 6 个代表性防御连续做 3 个 epoch 的纯有害数据微调，72 次受防御运行结束时全部比发布时更有害；Llama-3.1 最高学习率下受防御模型最终几乎与未防御模型一样有害。
Motivation: 现有针对恶意微调的对齐防御都按固定训练预算评测，但持有权重的攻击者可以简单地训练更久；作者要检验当前防御能否扛住这种最简单的升级。
Method: 先综述 15 个近期防御，归纳其共同弱点——都建立在受限的攻击者模型上（有界扰动、短模拟攻击、有害与良性行为之间的训练关联），权重发布后无机制强制维持保护；再在 4 个开放权重模型上测试 6 个代表性防御，沿同一纯有害微调攻击持续 3 个 epoch，逐步测量 harmfulness 与 capability。
Result: 全部 72 次受防御运行在训练结束时都比发布时更有害；Llama-3.1 在最高学习率下受防御模型最终几乎与未防御模型一样有害。防御强弱不一：其中一个防御在某个模型上保持了低 harmfulness，部分攻击恢复 harmfulness 的代价是一般能力下降。
Conclusion: 当前防御可以延缓或扰乱恶意微调，但在持续训练下测得的抵抗大多不能维持，尚不应被视为持久保护。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dual-Pathway Circuits of Object Hallucination in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in bridging visual perception and natural language understanding, enabling a wide range of multimodal reasoning tasks. However, they often produce object hallucinations, describing content absent from the input image, which limits their reliability and interpretability. To address this limitation, we propose Dual-Pathway Circuit Analysis, a framework that identifies and characterizes hallucination-related circuits in VLMs for mechanistic understanding and causal probing. We first apply activation patching across five architecturally diverse VLMs to identify a visual grounding pathway that supports correct predictions and a hallucination pathway that drives erroneous outputs. We then introduce Conditional Pathway Analysis (CPA) to characterize pathway-level interactions, revealing that grounding components remain strongly redundant in both correct and hallucinating samples but undergo a consistent polarity flip, shifting from supporting the ground truth on correct samples to aligning with the hallucinated answer on erroneous ones. We further perform targeted suppression of hallucination-pathway components, showing that scaling these components reduces object hallucination by up to 76% with minimal accuracy cost, and validate that the same circuit selectively transfers to relational but not attribute hallucination. Evaluations on POPE-adversarial and AMBER show that the identified circuits are consistent across architectures, support causal intervention, and transfer selectively across hallucination types. Code is available at https://github.com/jiaxin26/DualPath-VLM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Dual-Pathway Circuit Analysis，用 activation patching 在五个 VLM 中分离出支撑正确预测的视觉 grounding 通路与驱动错误输出的 hallucination 通路，并用 Conditional Pathway Analysis (CPA) 刻画两者交互：grounding 组件在正确与幻觉样本中都高度冗余，但极性发生一致翻转，从支持真值转为对齐幻觉答案。定向抑制幻觉通路组件并放大 grounding 成分，可使 object hallucination 最多下降 76% 且精度损失极小；同一电路可选择性迁移到 relational hallucination，但不迁移到 attribute hallucination。
Motivation: VLM 常描述输入图像中不存在的物体（object hallucination），损害可靠性与可解释性；现有做法缺少对幻觉内部因果电路的机制性刻画。
Method: 先对五个架构各异的 VLM 做 activation patching，分离 grounding 通路与 hallucination 通路；再引入 Conditional Pathway Analysis (CPA) 刻画通路级交互与极性翻转；随后对幻觉通路组件做定向抑制（scaling），并在 POPE-adversarial 与 AMBER 上评测电路的一致性、因果干预性与跨幻觉类型迁移。
Result: 放大 grounding 通路组件使 object hallucination 最多减少 76%，精度代价极小；同一电路选择性迁移到 relational hallucination 而不迁移到 attribute hallucination；在 POPE-adversarial 与 AMBER 上，识别出的电路跨架构一致、支持因果干预。
Conclusion: object hallucination 由可定位、可因果干预的双通路电路驱动，grounding 组件的极性翻转是幻觉的机制特征；该电路可跨架构复用并选择性迁移到 relational 幻觉。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Cooperative Simulators: Generating Realistic User Personas for Robust Evaluation of LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in settings where they interact with diverse users, including those who are unclear, impatient, or reluctant to share information. However, collecting real interaction data at scale remains expensive. The field has turned to LLM-based \emph{user simulators} as stand-ins, but these simulators inherit the behavior of their underlying models: cooperative and homogeneous. As a result, agents that appear strong in simulation often fail in real human interactions. To narrow this gap, we introduce Persona Policies (PPol), a plug-and-play control layer that induces realistic behavioral variation in user simulators while preserving original task goals. Rather than hand-crafting personas, we employ an evolutionary coding agent to discover persona generation programs optimized for human-likeness and behavioral coverage over real user conversations. The evolved program generates diverse, human-like personas for any task in the domain. Across 4 benchmarks--including $τ^2$-bench Retail and Airline, ColBench, and WildChat--evolved PPol yield 28-72% absolute gains in fitness score over the baseline simulator. In blinded evaluations, annotators judged PPol users as 'human' 80.4% of the time, nearly 2x more than the baseline simulators. Training agents with PPol also improves real-world performance: our user study with live human-agent interactions showed that fine-tuning with our method boosted task success by +23% over default baselines. PPol thus offers a novel approach to strengthen simulator-based evaluation and training without changing underlying tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Persona Policies (PPol)，即在不改变原任务目标的前提下给 LLM 用户模拟器加一层可插拔控制，用进化式编码 agent 在真实用户对话上搜索能生成兼顾 human-likeness 与行为覆盖度的人格生成程序。在 τ²-bench Retail/Airline、ColBench、WildChat 四个基准上，evolved PPol 相对基线模拟器的 fitness score 绝对提升 28–72%；盲评中 80.4% 的时间被标注者判为“像真人”，约为基线的 2 倍；用 PPol 微调 agent 使真人交互任务成功率再提高 23%。
Motivation: LLM 用户模拟器继承底层模型的合作与同质行为，导致在模拟中表现强的 agent 换成真实用户（含糊、不耐烦、不愿透露信息）就失效；而大规模采集真实交互数据成本高。
Method: PPol 是包在用户模拟器外的即插即用控制层：不用手工设计人格，而是让一个进化式编码 agent 搜索人格生成程序，优化目标是对真实用户对话的 human-likeness 与行为覆盖度；生成的人格保留原任务目标，可套用到该领域的任意任务。
Result: 在 4 个基准（τ²-bench Retail 与 Airline、ColBench、WildChat）上，evolved PPol 相对基线模拟器的 fitness score 绝对增益为 28–72%；盲评中 80.4% 的时间 PPol 用户被判为“human”，约为基线模拟器的 2 倍；在与真人交互的 user study 中，用 PPol 微调使任务成功率比默认基线提高 23%。

papers.title: The Value of Mechanistic Priors in Sequential Decision Making
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid mechanistic models, physical priors with learned residuals, promise to reduce the data required for good decisions, but have no computable criterion to test this. We characterize the value of mechanistic priors in sequential decision-making within both asymptotic and burn-in regimes. To formalize this, we introduce the mechanistic information of a model: the mutual information between the model's recommended policy $\hatπ$ and the true optimal policy $π^*$, bounded via a centered, occupancy-weighted bias. In the asymptotic regime (large $N$), matched bounds reveal that Bayesian regret scales with the residual entropy $H_{\mathrm{mech}}$, delivering a theoretical sample complexity reduction of $H(μ)/H_{\mathrm{mech}}$ compared to an uninformed baseline. We further provide a computable pre-trial model certificate. Complementarily, in the clinically relevant burn-in regime (small $N$), we establish a lower bound on the penalty incurred by confidently wrong priors. We demonstrate both the asymptotic and burn-in bounds on an illustrative in-silico 5-fluorouracil (5-FU) chemotherapy plant whose structure follows published FOLFOX pharmacokinetics. The hybrid prior reduces cumulative regret by $1.79\times$ relative to standard body-surface-area dosing and $1.85\times$ relative to an uninformed learner, and remains below both under every calibration bias tested. Finally, we show that priors sensitive to distribution shift can lose half of their mechanistic information under a small distribution shift, motivating physically grounded priors for safety-critical applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为混合机理模型（物理先验 + 学习残差）建立可计算的价值度量：提出 mechanistic information，即推荐策略与真实最优策略之间的互信息，并用中心化、占用测度加权的偏差给出上界。大 N 渐近体制下 Bayesian regret 按残差熵 H_mech 缩放，相对无信息基线给出 H(μ)/H_mech 的样本复杂度缩减；小 N burn-in 体制下给出对自信错误先验的惩罚下界。在按已发表 FOLFOX 药代动力学构建的 5-FU 化疗 in-silico 实验中，混合先验使累积 regret 相对标准体表面积给药降低 1.79×、相对无信息学习器降低 1.85×，且在所测全部标定偏差下都低于二者；对分布偏移敏感的先验在小幅偏移下损失约一半 mechanistic information。
Motivation: 物理先验加学习残差的混合模型被寄望于减少好决策所需数据，但此前没有可计算的判据来检验这一主张，也无法刻画自信错误先验在小样本阶段的代价。
Method: 引入 mechanistic information：推荐策略 π̂ 与真实最优策略 π* 的互信息，通过中心化、occupancy-weighted bias 界定；分别在渐近（大 N）与 burn-in（小 N）两个体制推导匹配的 regret 界，并给出一个可计算的 pre-trial model certificate；验证用结构遵循已发表 FOLFOX 药代动力学的 5-FU 化疗 in-silico plant。
Result: 渐近体制下 Bayesian regret 随残差熵 H_mech 缩放，相对无信息基线的样本复杂度缩减为 H(μ)/H_mech；burn-in 体制下对自信错误先验给出惩罚下界。5-FU in-silico 实验中混合先验累积 regret 相对标准体表面积 (BSA) 给药降低 1.79×、相对无信息学习器降低 1.85×，并在所测每一种标定偏差下都保持低于二者；对分布偏移敏感的先验在小幅分布偏移下丢失约一半 mechanistic information。
Conclusion: 机理先验的价值可以用 mechanistic information 与 regret 界在试验前计算，且只有对分布偏移稳健、物理上站得住的先验才能在安全攸关场景中保住这份价值。

papers.title: Restricting the Model, Missing the System: Measurement and Accountability in Offensive AI Governance
papers.abstract_en: We show that the instruments used to measure AI offensive capability fail in two ways: (i) they overstate harm, and (ii) they credit the model with capability that belongs to the surrounding system. We argue that restricting access to a model is therefore necessary but not sufficient and that policy and procurement also need system-level, harm-grounded capability assessment. In June 2026, two frontier models were suspended under US export controls, reportedly prompted by a jailbreak that asked a model to read a codebase and fix its flaws. This finding measured an elicitation \emph{system} of model, prompt, and task. We support our argument with a study of an open-source framework in which lightweight large language model (LLM) agents coordinate through shared memory and evolutionary optimization, providing two pieces of evidence. First, jailbreak metrics overstate harm: over 225 swarm-generated attacks per target, LLM-as-judge scoring rated Claude Sonnet 4 compromised in 40% of attacks, yet manual verification found actionable harmful content in none, against a 45.8\% Effective Harm Rate for GPT-4o. Second, scaffolded evaluations misattribute capability: on a planted-vulnerability target, a full pipeline built around a 1.2B-parameter model recovers 9 of 9 weaknesses, while the same model without the hand-crafted components recovers 0 of 9 by crash verification and 2 of 9 by cited source line. Offensive capability is a property of model, scaffold, and evaluation protocol together. The duty to assess it should lie with whoever controls the system, shapes its behaviour, and can foresee what it will do. In our setting, that is the party who builds the harness around the model, a role that current regulation does not clearly cover.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文指出 AI 攻击能力的测量工具系统性高估危害、并把属于周边系统的能力记到模型名下：LLM-as-judge 把 Claude Sonnet 4 判为 40% 攻击被攻破，人工核查实际可操作有害内容为 0（对照 GPT-4o 的 45.8% Effective Harm Rate）；同一 1.2B 模型在带手工组件的完整 pipeline 下 9/9 找出漏洞，裸模型仅 9 中 0（崩溃验证）或 2（引用源码行）。作者据此主张限制模型访问必要但不充分，评估义务应落在构建 harness 的一方。
Motivation: 2026 年 6 月两个前沿模型因一次 jailbreak 被美国出口管制暂停，而该 jailbreak 测的是模型+提示+任务构成的 elicitation system；现有政策把系统级能力误记为模型级危害，导致监管对象错位。
Method: 以一个开源框架为证据来源：轻量 LLM agent 通过共享记忆与进化优化协同生成 jailbreak，每个目标生成 225+ 攻击；用 LLM-as-judge 打分后人工核查，并在植入漏洞 (planted-vulnerability) 目标上对比完整 scaffold pipeline 与裸 1.2B 模型，按崩溃验证与引用源码行两种口径计数。
Result: Claude Sonnet 4 被 LLM-as-judge 判为 40% 攻击沦陷，人工核查可操作有害内容为 0，对照 GPT-4o 的 45.8% Effective Harm Rate；1.2B 模型在完整 pipeline 下 9/9 找出漏洞，裸模型崩溃验证 0/9、引用源码行 2/9。
Conclusion: 攻击能力是模型、scaffold 与评估协议共同的属性，评估义务应归于控制该系统、塑造其行为并可预见其后果的一方，即当前监管未明确覆盖的 harness 构建者。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: APCD: Adaptive Path-Contrastive Decoding for Reliable Large Language Model Generation
papers.abstract_en: Reliable text generation is critical for deploying large language models (LLMs) in real-world applications, particularly in high-stakes domains such as medicine. To improve factual reliability, various inference-time methods have been proposed, including logit-level methods that modify token probability distributions and representation-level methods that manipulate intermediate model representations. However, most existing approaches operate on a single decoding trajectory, limiting their ability to explore alternative reasoning paths and making them susceptible to error accumulation. To address this limitation, we propose Adaptive Path-Contrastive Decoding (APCD), an adaptive multi-path contrastive decoding framework that improves factual reliability without model retraining or fine-tuning. APCD comprises two key components: Entropy-Driven Path Expansion, which adaptively expands the decoding process only at high-uncertainty decision points, and Divergence-Aware Path Contrast, which dynamically regulates contrastive interactions among parallel decoding paths based on their distributional divergence to balance diversity and coherence. We evaluate APCD on four LLM backbones across eight benchmarks spanning both general-domain and medical question answering tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that APCD consistently outperforms strong inference-time baselines in factual accuracy while maintaining competitive inference efficiency. These results demonstrate the robustness and generalizability of APCD across diverse models and tasks, highlighting its effectiveness as a practical multi-path decoding framework for reliable LLM deployment, particularly in high-stakes domains such as medicine. Code is available at https://github.com/zty-king/APCD.
papers.comment: This is an extended journal version submitted to ESWA. It builds upon a previously withdrawn conference manuscript (ACL format). The core research work remains unchanged, with substantial extensions including additional ablation experiments and deeper analysis to meet journal requirements
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: APCD 在解码时只于高不确定节点自适应分叉出多条路径，再按路径间分布散度调节对比强度，从而在不重训模型的前提下提升事实可靠性。在 4 个 LLM 主干、8 个通用与医学 QA 基准上，其事实准确性一致优于强推理时基线，同时保持有竞争力的推理效率。
Motivation: 现有推理时对齐方法（logit 级与 representation 级）都只在单一解码轨迹上操作，无法探索替代推理路径，容易累积错误，限制了 LLM 在医学等高风险场景的可靠部署。
Method: 提出自适应多路径对比解码框架 APCD，含两个组件：Entropy-Driven Path Expansion 仅在高不确定性决策点自适应扩展解码；Divergence-Aware Path Contrast 依据并行路径的分布散度动态调节对比交互，以平衡多样性与一致性。无需重训或微调。
Result: 在 4 个 LLM 主干、覆盖通用与医学问答的 8 个基准上评测，APCD 的事实准确性一致优于强推理时基线，同时保持有竞争力的推理效率；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 多路径对比解码是无需重训即可提升 LLM 事实可靠性与部署稳健性的实用框架，且跨模型与任务具有泛化性。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Discretization Error of Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Practical diffusion sampling requires simulating a reverse-time ODE or SDE with a limited number of denoising steps, making the choice of sampling parameters crucial for minimizing discretization error. Non-asymptotic convergence bounds characterize sampling complexity, but their worst-case constants can obscure target geometry and thereby limit guidance on parameter optimization. Rather than bounding the error, we derive asymptotically exact small-stepsize expansions of Euler-Maruyama weak and Frechet errors for general smooth reverse diffusions, with explicit formulas for Gaussian data. These formulas provide tractable objectives for optimizing diffusion parameters, including the noise and rescaling schedules and the stochasticity coefficient, according to the target's covariance spectrum. In particular, our theory predicts lower optimal stochasticity at smaller step budgets, shows how to adapt the rescaling coefficient to the data power spectrum, and motivates a new family of effective noise schedules. A perturbative extension to Gaussian scale mixtures (GSMs) quantifies how departures from Gaussianity shift the optimal parameters. Finally, experiments on different real image datasets show that FID-optimal parameters agree with the qualitative theoretical predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文不给扩散采样的最坏情形误差界，而是推导小步长下 Euler-Maruyama 弱误差与 Fréchet 误差的渐近精确展开（一般光滑反向扩散，高斯数据有显式公式），把离散化误差写成可按目标协方差谱优化的关于噪声表、重标度表与随机性系数的显式目标。理论预测步长预算越小最优随机性越低、重标度系数应随数据功率谱调整，并给出高斯尺度混合 (GSM) 的微扰扩展；真实图像数据集上的 FID 最优参数与这些定性预测一致。
Motivation: 少步长扩散采样中采样参数选择决定离散化误差，但现有非渐近收敛界的最坏情形常数掩盖了目标几何，无法指导参数调优。
Method: 对一般光滑反向扩散推导小步长下 Euler-Maruyama 弱误差与 Fréchet 误差的渐近精确展开，高斯数据给出显式公式；将噪声表、重标度表与随机性系数按目标协方差谱写成可优化目标，并以高斯尺度混合 (GSM) 的微扰扩展刻画偏离高斯性时最优参数的移动。
Result: 理论预测小步长预算下最优随机性更低，重标度系数应随数据功率谱调整，并导出一族有效噪声表；GSM 微扰扩展量化非高斯性对最优参数的偏移；在多个真实图像数据集上，FID 最优参数与理论定性预测一致。
Conclusion: 少步长扩散采样的参数应按目标几何（协方差谱）而非最坏情形界来选：随机性、重标度与噪声表都随步长预算和数据谱系统移动，且这一预测在真实图像上与 FID 最优吻合。
Relevance: 1
