papers.title: SkillRL: Evolving Agents via Recursive Skill-Augmented Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have shown stunning results in complex tasks, yet they often operate in isolation, failing to learn from past experiences. Existing memory-based methods primarily store raw trajectories, which are often redundant and noise-heavy. This prevents agents from extracting high-level, reusable behavioral patterns that are essential for generalization. In this paper, we propose SkillRL, a framework that bridges the gap between raw experience and policy improvement through automatic skill discovery and recursive evolution. Our approach introduces an experience-based distillation mechanism to build a hierarchical skill library SkillBank, an adaptive retrieval strategy for general and task-specific heuristics, and a recursive evolution mechanism that allows the skill library to co-evolve with the agent's policy during reinforcement learning. These innovations significantly reduce the token footprint while enhancing reasoning utility. Experimental results on ALFWorld, WebShop and seven search-augmented tasks demonstrate that SkillRL achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming strong baselines over 15.3% and maintaining robustness as task complexity increases. Code is available at this https://github.com/aiming-lab/SkillRL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkillRL 把 LLM agent 的原始轨迹蒸馏成分层技能库 SkillBank，用自适应检索取出通用与任务特定启发式，并在强化学习中让技能库与策略递归协同进化。在 ALFWorld、WebShop 及七个搜索增强任务上达到 state-of-the-art，相对强基线提升超过 15.3%，且随任务复杂度上升保持稳健，同时显著压缩 token 占用。
Motivation: LLM agent 各自孤立运行、无法从历史经验中学习；现有基于记忆的方法只存原始轨迹，冗余且噪声重，难以提炼可复用的高层行为模式，阻碍泛化。
Method: 三部分：经验蒸馏机制构建分层技能库 SkillBank；自适应检索策略分别处理通用启发式与任务特定启发式；递归进化机制使技能库与 agent 策略在强化学习过程中共同演化，从而把原始经验接到策略改进上。
Result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和七个搜索增强任务上取得 state-of-the-art 表现，相对强基线提升超过 15.3%，并在任务复杂度上升时保持稳健；同时显著降低 token footprint 并提升推理效用。
Conclusion: 把原始经验蒸馏为可检索、可与策略共同进化的技能库，是比存储原始轨迹更有效的 LLM agent 记忆与改进路径，且在高复杂度任务上不失稳健。

papers.title: BONSAI: Bayesian Optimization with Natural Simplicity and Interpretability
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian optimization (BO) is a popular technique for sample-efficient optimization of black-box functions. In many applications, the parameters being tuned come with a carefully engineered default configuration, and practitioners only want to deviate from this default when necessary. Standard BO, however, does not aim to minimize deviation from the default and, in practice, often pushes weakly relevant parameters to the boundary of the search space. This makes it difficult to distinguish between important and spurious changes and increases the burden of vetting recommendations when the optimization objective omits relevant operational considerations. We introduce BONSAI, a default-aware BO policy that prunes low-impact deviations from a default configuration while explicitly controlling the loss in acquisition value. BONSAI is compatible with a variety of acquisition functions, including expected improvement and upper confidence bound (GP-UCB). We theoretically bound the regret incurred by BONSAI, showing that, under appropriate conditions, it retains the no-regret property of vanilla GP-UCB and removes irrelevant changes. Across many real-world applications, we empirically find that BONSAI substantially reduces the number of non-default parameters in recommended configurations while maintaining competitive optimization performance with little effect on wall time. Its candidate-generation cost averages only $1.5\times$ that of standard BO, compared with $7$-$34\times$ for prior sparse-BO methods.
papers.journal_ref: NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BONSAI 是一种默认配置感知的贝叶斯优化策略，在采集函数 (acquisition function) 层面剪掉对目标影响低的参数偏离，同时显式控制采集值损失。理论上它在适当条件下保留 vanilla GP-UCB 的 no-regret 性质并消除无关改动；实测候选生成开销仅为标准 BO 的 1.5 倍，而先前 sparse-BO 方法为 7–34 倍。
Motivation: 被调参数通常已有精心工程化的默认值，但标准 BO 不以贴近默认为目标，常把弱相关参数推到搜索空间边界，使评审者难以区分真实改动与噪声改动。
Method: 提出 default-aware 策略 BONSAI：在采集值上加约束，剪除低影响偏离，兼容 expected improvement 与 GP-UCB 等多种采集函数；并给出 regret 界，说明在适当条件下保留 vanilla GP-UCB 的 no-regret 性质。
Result: 在多个真实应用中，BONSAI 显著减少推荐配置中的非默认参数数量，同时保持有竞争力的优化性能，对 wall time 影响很小；候选生成开销平均仅为标准 BO 的 1.5 倍，先前 sparse-BO 方法为 7–34 倍。
Conclusion: 把默认配置作为先验并显式约束偏离，可以在不牺牲优化性能的前提下让 BO 推荐更可审查，且开销远低于既有 sparse-BO。

papers.title: DiTS: Multimodal Diffusion Transformers Are Time Series Forecasters
papers.abstract_en: While generative modeling facilitates probabilistic time series forecasting, incorporating heterogeneous exogenous information remains challenging. Diffusion Transformers (DiT) provide a scalable framework for conditional generation, yet their adaptation to forecasting calls for conditioning mechanisms tailored to time series. Endogenous targets and exogenous covariates differ in sources, semantics, and statistical characteristics, while sharing temporal coordinates that support fine-grained conditional guidance. Covariates can describe future variability and temporal dependence beyond the conditional mean targeted by direct regression. Motivated by these considerations, we propose Diffusion Transformers for Time Series (DiTS), a Multimodal Diffusion Transformer for covariate-aware forecasting. DiTS models endogenous targets and exogenous covariates as distinct modalities, jointly conditioning future generation on target history and available covariates. Flow matching makes covariate-dependent distributional information relevant to velocity prediction conditioned on noisy future states. We introduce Time-aligned Modulation, extending AdaLN with the temporal-alignment prior to generate patch-wise modulation parameters from aligned covariates and diffusion time. Across diverse covariate-aware forecasting tasks, DiTS achieves strong performance in both deterministic and probabilistic forecasting, demonstrating the effectiveness of conditional generation for both point and distributional forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DiTS 把内生目标与外生协变量当作两个模态，用多模态 Diffusion Transformer 在含噪未来状态上做流匹配速度预测，并提出 Time-aligned Modulation（扩展 AdaLN，从对齐的协变量与扩散时间生成逐 patch 调制参数）实现细粒度条件引导。在多类协变量感知预测任务上，确定性与概率预测均取得强表现。
Motivation: 生成式概率时间序列预测中，异质外生信息难以纳入条件；而协变量能描述条件均值之外的未来变率与时间依赖，直接回归抓不到。
Method: DiTS 将内生目标与外生协变量建模为不同模态，联合以目标历史和可用协变量为条件生成未来；用 flow matching 让协变量相关的分布信息进入含噪未来状态条件下的速度预测；Time-aligned Modulation 在 AdaLN 上加入时间对齐先验，由对齐协变量与扩散时间生成 patch 级调制参数。
Result: 在多样化的协变量感知预测任务上，DiTS 在确定性预测与概率预测两方面均取得强表现，验证了条件生成对点预测与分布预测的有效性。
Conclusion: 把协变量作为独立模态并以时间对齐的调制注入 Diffusion Transformer，可同时支撑点预测与概率预测的条件生成式时间序列预报。
Relevance: 37

papers.title: Attention-Mass Condensation for Sparse Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Attention-mass concentration creates an opportunity for sparse decoding, but retained mass alone does not guarantee a stable greedy decision: retrieval error, omitted value directions, and recursive decoding all matter. We formalize this distinction with an exact omitted-mass identity and a sufficient downstream margin condition, then characterize a query-dependent mean-pooled block selector. On Qwen2-0.5B, a paired fresh-selection sweep covers supports of 97--769 positions, contexts of 2K--16K, and five prefixes per context. The primary exact-match result is that none of 60 runs remains identical to dense decoding through 128 tokens. Distributional quality is distinct: for supports of at least 193, seven of nine context-support conditions have median teacher-forced continuation perplexity changes within 5\% of dense, but prompt-level ranges include severe 16K outliers. All seven runs with teacher-forced match below 70\% have perplexity increases above 100\%; these observations come from two prefixes and suggest a warning regime, not a general threshold. The measured perplexity is teacher-forced on the dense model's own continuation, not the sparse model's free-running output. Separate retrieval and attention-mass probes illustrate why captured mass alone is not a retrieval or decision guarantee. Isolated operator timings do not establish matched-quality acceleration or end-to-end serving speed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇论文把注意力质量集中 (attention-mass concentration) 能否支撑稀疏解码形式化：给出精确的遗漏质量恒等式 (exact omitted-mass identity) 与充分的下游间隔条件，并刻画 query 依赖的均值池化块选择器。在 Qwen2-0.5B 上 60 次配对扫描中，没有一次稀疏解码在前 128 token 内与 dense 解码完全一致；支持集 ≥193 时九个条件中有七个的 teacher-forcing 续写困惑度变化在 dense 的 5% 以内，但 16K 上下文存在严重离群。
Motivation: 注意力质量集中被视为稀疏解码的机会，但仅保留质量并不保证贪心决策稳定：检索误差、被忽略的 value 方向和递归解码都会破坏等价性，缺少刻画这一区分的判据。
Method: 推导精确的遗漏质量恒等式与充分的下游 margin 条件，刻画 query 依赖的均值池化块选择器；在 Qwen2-0.5B 上做配对 fresh-selection 扫描，支持集 97–769 个位置、上下文 2K–16K、每个上下文五个前缀，并辅以独立的检索与注意力质量探针。
Result: 60 次运行中没有一次在前 128 token 与 dense 解码保持完全一致（exact-match）。支持集 ≥193 时，九个上下文-支持条件中有七个的 teacher-forcing 续写困惑度变化落在 dense 的 5% 以内，但 prompt 级区间包含严重的 16K 离群。teacher-forcing 匹配率低于 70% 的全部七次运行困惑度增幅都超过 100%；困惑度是在 dense 模型自身续写上测得，而非稀疏模型自由运行输出。孤立的算子计时不能证明等质量加速或端到端服务速度。
Conclusion: 捕获的注意力质量本身不是检索或决策保证，稀疏解码需要遗漏质量恒等式加 margin 条件这类判据；匹配率低于 70% 与困惑度增幅超 100% 的关联只来自两个前缀，作者明确称其为警示区间而非通用阈值。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Routing-Aware Safety Alignment for Mixture-of-Experts Models
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models introduce unique challenges for safety alignment due to their sparse routing mechanisms, which can enable degenerate optimization behaviors under standard full-parameter fine-tuning. In our preliminary experiments, we observe that naively applying full-parameter safety fine-tuning to MoE models can reduce attack success rates through routing or expert dominance effects, rather than by directly repairing Safety-Critical Experts. To address this challenge, we propose RASA, a routing-aware expert-level alignment framework that explicitly repairs Safety-Critical Experts while preventing routing-based bypasses. RASA identifies experts disproportionately activated by successful jailbreaks, selectively fine-tunes only these experts under fixed routing, and subsequently enforces routing consistency with safety-aligned contexts. Across two representative MoE architectures and a diverse set of jailbreak attacks, RASA achieves near-perfect robustness, strong cross-attack generalization, and substantially reduced over-refusal, while preserving general capabilities on benchmarks such as MMLU, GSM8K, and TruthfulQA. Our results suggest that robust MoE safety alignment benefits from targeted expert repair rather than global parameter updates, offering a practical and architecture-preserving alternative to prior approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RASA 针对 MoE 语言模型稀疏路由下的安全对齐退化，先定位被越狱攻击异常高频激活的 Safety-Critical Experts，再在固定路由下只微调这些专家，最后强制其与安全上下文的路由一致性。在两种代表性 MoE 架构和多种越狱攻击上取得近乎完美的鲁棒性与跨攻击泛化，同时显著降低过度拒答，并在 MMLU、GSM8K、TruthfulQA 上保持通用能力。
Motivation: MoE 的稀疏路由使标准全参数安全微调出现退化优化：攻击成功率的下降来自路由或专家主导效应，而非真正修复安全关键专家，导致对齐脆弱且易被路由绕过。
Method: RASA 是路由感知的专家级对齐框架：识别被成功越狱异常过度激活的专家，仅在固定路由下选择性微调这些专家，随后强制其在安全对齐上下文下的路由一致性，避免基于路由的绕过。
Result: 在两种代表性 MoE 架构和多种越狱攻击上，RASA 实现近乎完美的鲁棒性、强跨攻击泛化，并大幅降低过度拒答；在 MMLU、GSM8K、TruthfulQA 等基准上保持通用能力。摘要另述初步实验观察到全参数安全微调降低攻击成功率是通过路由或专家主导效应而非修复安全关键专家。
Conclusion: 鲁棒的 MoE 安全对齐应做定向专家修复而非全局参数更新，这是一种保留架构的实用替代方案。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Multiparameter Uncertainty Mapping in Quantitative Molecular MRI using a Physics-Structured Variational Autoencoder (PS-VAE)
papers.abstract_en: Quantitative imaging methods, such as magnetic resonance fingerprinting (MRF), aim to extract interpretable pathology biomarkers by estimating biophysical tissue parameters from signal evolutions. However, the pattern-matching algorithms or neural networks used in such inverse problems often lack principled uncertainty quantification, which limits the trustworthiness and transparency, required for clinical acceptance. Here, we describe a physics-structured variational autoencoder (PS-VAE) designed for rapid extraction of voxelwise multi-parameter posterior distributions. Our approach integrates a differentiable spin physics simulator with self-supervised learning, and provides a full covariance that captures the inter-parameter correlations of the latent biophysical space. The method was validated in a multi-proton pool chemical exchange saturation transfer (CEST) and semisolid magnetization transfer (MT) molecular MRF study, across in-vitro phantoms, tumor-bearing mice, healthy human volunteers, and a subject with glioblastoma. The resulting multi-parametric posteriors are in good agreement with those calculated using a brute-force Bayesian analysis, while providing an orders-of-magnitude acceleration in whole brain quantification. In addition, we demonstrate how monitoring the multi-parameter posterior dynamics across progressively acquired signals provides practical insights for protocol optimization and may facilitate real-time adaptive acquisition.

papers.journal_ref: A. Finkelstein et al., "Multiparameter Uncertainty Mapping in Quantitative Molecular MRI using a Physics-Structured Variational Autoencoder (PS-VAE)", IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PS-VAE 把可微自旋物理模拟器嵌入变分自编码器，用自监督学习直接输出体素级多参数后验分布及其完整协方差，捕捉生物物理参数间的相关性。在多质子池 CEST 与半固体 MT 分子 MRF 中，跨体模、荷瘤小鼠、健康志愿者与胶质母细胞瘤受试者，后验与暴力穷举贝叶斯分析一致，同时全脑定量加速若干个数量级。
Motivation: MRF 等定量成像的逆问题依赖模式匹配或神经网络，普遍缺少有原则的不确定性量化，限制临床可接受所需的可信度与透明度。
Method: PS-VAE 将可微自旋物理模拟器 (differentiable spin physics simulator) 与自监督学习整合，快速抽取体素级多参数后验分布，并给出刻画潜在生物物理空间参数间相关性的完整协方差；验证对象为多质子池 CEST 与半固体 MT 分子 MRF。
Result: 多参数后验与暴力穷举贝叶斯分析 (brute-force Bayesian analysis) 计算结果吻合良好，同时全脑定量获得若干数量级 (orders-of-magnitude) 的加速；验证覆盖体模、荷瘤小鼠、健康人志愿者与一名胶质母细胞瘤患者。跨逐步采集信号监测后验动态，可为协议优化提供实际信息。
Conclusion: 把物理模拟器放进 VAE 的不确定性量化可以在保持贝叶斯一致性的同时把全脑多参数定量提速若干数量级，后验随采集进程的动态还可用于协议优化与实时自适应采集。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Persuasion Propagation: Does Persuasion Change AI Agent Behavior?
papers.abstract_en: AI agents combine normal conversation with autonomous task execution, allowing earlier context to shape how later tasks are executed. Yet studying this possibility is challenging because agent behavior is noisy and costly to reproduce, and observed behavioral changes can be difficult to separate from generic context sensitivity. We first ask whether task-irrelevant persuasion changes how agents act, a phenomenon we call \emph{persuasion propagation}, and whether persuasion susceptibility explains variation in these effects. We show that persuasive interaction leaves a measurable, task-dependent behavioral footprint on downstream agent execution. In web research, it increases execution time by 56\% and domains visited by 16.3\% relative to a baseline, while coding shows faster execution with larger revisions. However, agents that are more susceptible to persuasive conversational context do not reliably predict the magnitude of the downstream behavioral shifts. This motivates behavior-level evaluation of persuasion in AI agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出 persuasion propagation 概念，检验与任务无关的说服性对话是否会改变 AI agent 后续自主任务的执行方式。说服性交互留下可测量且依赖任务的行为足迹：web research 中执行时间增加 56%、访问域名数增加 16.3%，coding 中执行更快但代码修订量更大；而 agent 的说服易感性并不能可靠预测下游行为偏移的幅度。
Motivation: AI agent 把日常对话与自主任务执行结合在一起，使早期上下文会影响后续任务执行，但 agent 行为噪声大、复现成本高，且观察到的行为变化难以与一般性的上下文敏感性区分开。
Method: 先定义 persuasion propagation 现象并测量说服易感性 (persuasion susceptibility)，再在 web research 与 coding 两类下游任务上对比有无说服性交互时的执行行为，检验易感性是否解释行为偏移幅度。
Result: 在 web research 任务中，说服性交互使执行时间相对基线增加 56%、访问域名数增加 16.3%；在 coding 任务中表现为执行更快但修订量更大。说服易感性更高的 agent 并不能可靠预测下游行为偏移的幅度。
Conclusion: 说服对 AI agent 的影响应在行为层面直接评估，而不能用说服易感性这类对话层面的指标来替代。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Doc2Spec: Synthesizing Formal Programming Specifications from Natural Language via Grammar Induction
papers.abstract_en: Ensuring that API implementations and usage comply with natural language programming rules is critical for software correctness, security, and reliability. Formal verification can provide strong guarantees but requires precise specifications, which are difficult and costly to write manually. To address this challenge, we present Doc2Spec, a multi-agent framework that automatically induces a domain-specific grammar from natural-language API rules and uses it to guide specification generation. Doc2Spec fixes a domain-agnostic logical skeleton as a grammar template, prompts LLMs to infer domain-specific predicates and sorts, and formalizes each rule within the resulting grammar, turning an unreliable one-shot translation into a sequence of constrained, checkable steps. Across six benchmarks spanning Solidity and Rust, Doc2Spec improves precision by 0.28 and recall by 0.37 over baselines that lack grammar induction or perform it in one unstaged step, demonstrating the benefits of grammar-guided formalization and the staged pipeline. Moreover, its formalized rules enable symbolic-execution tools to uncover 142 previously unknown rule violations, confirming the rules' correctness and practical usefulness.

papers.title: Toward Realistic Remote Sensing Dataset Distillation with Discriminative Prototype-guided Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Recent years have witnessed the remarkable success of deep learning in remote sensing image interpretation, driven by the availability of large-scale benchmark datasets. However, this reliance on massive training data also brings substantial storage and computational costs. To address this challenge, this study introduces the concept of dataset distillation into the field of remote sensing image interpretation for the first time. Specifically, we propose discriminative prototype-guided diffusion (DPD), a diffusion-based generative distillation framework that condenses a large-scale remote sensing dataset into a compact and representative distilled dataset. To improve the semantic fidelity and diversity of the synthesized samples, we extract representative prototypes for each category in the latent space. We then construct hyperspherical semantic anchors around the prototypes to guide the reverse denoising trajectory. Furthermore, to enhance the discriminative quality of the generated samples, multiple candidates are generated for each prototype and ranked by a latent classifier using a logit-margin criterion, with the most discriminative candidates selected to form the final distilled dataset. Experiments on three high-resolution remote sensing scene classification benchmarks show that the proposed method can distill realistic, diverse, and discriminative samples for downstream model training. Code and pre-trained models are available online (https://github.com/YonghaoXu/DPD).
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DPD 把数据集蒸馏 (dataset distillation) 引入遥感影像解译：在 latent space 提取每类原型，围绕原型构造超球面语义锚点引导扩散反向去噪轨迹，再对每个原型生成多个候选并用 latent classifier 按 logit-margin 排序，取判别性最强的候选组成蒸馏集。在三个高分辨率遥感场景分类基准上，该方法能为下游模型训练蒸馏出真实、多样且具判别性的样本。
Motivation: 遥感深度解译依赖大规模基准数据集，带来沉重的存储与计算开销；数据集蒸馏此前未被引入遥感影像解译领域。
Method: 提出判别原型引导扩散 (discriminative prototype-guided diffusion, DPD)，一个基于扩散的生成式蒸馏框架：latent space 中为每类提取代表性原型，围绕原型构建超球面语义锚点约束反向去噪轨迹；每个原型生成多个候选样本，由 latent classifier 以 logit-margin 准则排序，保留判别性最强者构成最终蒸馏数据集。

papers.title: Machine learning modularity
papers.abstract_en: Based on a transformer based sequence-to-sequence architecture combined with a dynamic batching algorithm, this work introduces a machine learning framework for automatically simplifying complex expressions involving multiple elliptic Gamma functions, including the $q$-$θ$ function and the elliptic Gamma function. The model learns to apply algebraic identities, particularly the SL$(2,\mathbb{Z})$ and SL$(3,\mathbb{Z})$ modular transformations, to reduce heavily scrambled expressions to their canonical forms. Experimental results show that the model achieves over 99\% accuracy on in-distribution tests and maintains robust performance (exceeding 90\% accuracy) under significant extrapolation, such as with deeper scrambling depths. This demonstrates that the model has internalized the underlying algebraic rules of modular transformations rather than merely memorizing training patterns. Our work presents the first successful application of machine learning to perform symbolic simplification using modular identities, offering a new automated tool for computations with special functions in quantum field theory and the string theory.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于 Transformer seq2seq 架构与动态批处理 (dynamic batching) 的机器学习框架，自动化简含 q-θ 函数与 elliptic Gamma 函数的复杂表达式，让模型学会套用 SL(2,Z) 与 SL(3,Z) 模变换把打乱的表达式化到标准形。在分布内测试准确率超过 99%，在更深打乱深度等显著外推下仍超过 90%，说明模型内化了模变换的代数规则而非记忆训练模式。
Motivation: 量子场论与弦论中涉及特殊函数的表达式化简高度依赖人工推导 SL(2,Z)/SL(3,Z) 模变换恒等式，繁琐且易错，缺少自动化工具。
Method: Transformer seq2seq 模型配合动态批处理算法，训练目标是把经模变换打乱的 elliptic Gamma 函数表达式还原为标准形，学习应用模恒等式化简。
Result: 在分布内测试准确率超过 99%；在更深打乱深度等显著外推条件下准确率仍超过 90%。

papers.title: Towards Explainable Conversational AI for Early Diagnosis with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Healthcare systems around the world are grappling with issues such as inefficient diagnostics, rising costs, and limited access to specialists. These challenges often contribute to delays in treatment and poorer health outcomes. Most existing AI and deep learning based health assessment systems offer limited interactivity and transparency, reducing their usefulness for user-centered health support. This research introduces a conversational chatbot powered by a Large Language Model (LLM), using GPT-4o, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, and explainable AI techniques. The chatbot engages users in a dynamic conversation to extract and normalize symptoms while identifying and ranking potential health conditions through similarity matching and adaptive questioning. Using Chain-of-Thought prompting, the system also provides more transparent explanations of its reasoning process. When evaluated against traditional machine learning models, including Naive Bayes, Logistic Regression, SVM, Random Forest, and KNN using both TF-IDF and CountVectorizer feature extraction, the proposed LLM-based system achieved a Top-1 accuracy of 90% and a Top-3 accuracy of 100%. The system was additionally evaluated through a cross-sectional expert evaluation involving 17 physicians across all 14 conditions, with the results indicating generally favorable assessments of conversational quality, early diagnostic plausibility, and safety-related criteria. These findings demonstrate the potential of explainable conversational AI as a health and well-being support tool for early symptom assessment. However, the proposed system is not intended for clinical diagnosis or clinical decision-making, and further validation would be required before any use in healthcare practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于 GPT-4o 的可解释对话式健康评估系统，用 RAG 与相似度匹配从对话中抽取并归一化症状，配合自适应提问和 Chain-of-Thought 解释对 14 种疾病排序。Top-1 准确率 90%、Top-3 100%，17 名医生跨全部 14 种疾病的横断面评估给出总体正面评价；系统定位为早期症状自评支持，不用于临床诊断。
Motivation: 现有 AI 健康评估系统交互性与透明度不足，加上诊断效率低、成本上升、专科资源有限，导致治疗延迟。
Method: 以 GPT-4o 为核心，结合 Retrieval-Augmented Generation 与可解释 AI 技术：对话中抽取并归一化症状，通过相似度匹配与自适应提问识别并排序潜在疾病，用 Chain-of-Thought prompting 生成推理解释；对照 Naive Bayes、Logistic Regression、SVM、Random Forest、KNN，特征提取用 TF-IDF 与 CountVectorizer。
Result: Top-1 准确率 90%，Top-3 准确率 100%（对比上述传统机器学习模型）；另有 17 名医生参与、覆盖全部 14 种疾病的横断面专家评估，对对话质量、早期诊断合理性与安全性指标给出总体有利评价。
Conclusion: 可解释对话式 AI 可作为早期症状评估的健康支持工具，但不用于临床诊断或临床决策，投入医疗实践前仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: PrismSSL: One Interface, Many Modalities; A Single-Interface Library for Multimodal Self-Supervised Learning
papers.abstract_en: We present PrismSSL, a Python library that unifies state-of-the-art self-supervised learning (SSL) methods across audio, vision, graphs, and cross-modal settings in a single, modular codebase. The goal of the demo is to show how researchers and practitioners can: (i) install, configure, and run pretext training with a few lines of code; (ii) reproduce compact benchmarks; and (iii) extend the framework with new modalities or methods through clean trainer and dataset abstractions. PrismSSL is packaged on PyPI, released under the MIT license, integrates tightly with HuggingFace Transformers, and provides quality-of-life features such as distributed training in PyTorch, Optuna-based hyperparameter search, LoRA fine-tuning for Transformer backbones, animated embedding visualizations for sanity checks, Weights & Biases logging, and colorful, structured terminal logs for improved usability and clarity. In addition, PrismSSL offers a graphical dashboard - built with Flask and standard web technologies - that enables users to configure and launch training pipelines with minimal coding. The artifact (code and data recipes) will be publicly available and reproducible.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PrismSSL 是一个把音频、视觉、图与跨模态自监督学习 (SSL) 统一到单一模块化代码库的 Python 库，通过干净的 trainer 与 dataset 抽象支持几行代码完成预文本训练、复现紧凑基准、并扩展新模态或新方法。它与 HuggingFace Transformers 深度集成，提供 PyTorch 分布式训练、Optuna 超参搜索、Transformer 骨干的 LoRA 微调、W&B 日志，以及基于 Flask 的图形化配置面板。
Motivation: SSL 方法分散在各模态的独立实现中，研究者复现基准、切换模态或加入新方法时需要重复搭建训练与数据管线，成本高且难以比较。
Method: 单一代码库内统一 audio、vision、graph 与 cross-modal 的 SSL 方法；以 trainer 和 dataset 抽象支持扩展；集成 HuggingFace Transformers、PyTorch 分布式训练、Optuna 超参搜索、LoRA 微调、Weights & Biases 日志与嵌入可视化；另提供 Flask 图形面板配置并启动训练。
Result: 发布为 PyPI 包，MIT 许可证；演示目标为几行代码完成预文本训练、复现紧凑基准、并以新模态或新方法扩展框架；代码与数据配方将公开且可复现。
Conclusion: 跨模态 SSL 可以用统一接口和可扩展抽象收敛到一个可复现的库中，降低复现与扩展的工程门槛。

papers.title: Estimating Model-Level Membership Inference Vulnerability Without Reference Models
papers.abstract_en: Membership inference attacks (MIAs) have emerged as the standard tool for evaluating the privacy risks of AI models. However, state-of-the-art attacks require training numerous, often computationally expensive, reference models, limiting their practicality. We present a novel approach for estimating model-level vulnerability to the Likelihood Ratio Attack (LiRA), the strongest available attack, directly from the train and test loss distributions of the target model and without training any reference models. We show that LiRA's per-sample signal decomposes into a variance-ratio term and a residual mean-shift term, with the relative contribution of each determined by how much training collapses model uncertainty at the trained sample. This places models on a continuum, with different regimes calling for different reference-free loss-based statistics as proxies for LiRA TPR. The shapes of the loss distributions themselves indicate which proxy applies. We instantiate the framework with two natural proxies. At the heavy-tailed end, the LOSS attack TNR predicts LiRA TPR@FPR=$10^{-3}$ with RMSE 0.036 across 10 image classification architectures and 4 datasets, outperforming low-cost reference-model attacks such as RMIA. At the symmetric end, the LOSS attack AUC predicts LiRA TPR with RMSE 0.018 across five GPT-2 sizes from 10M to 1B parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 无需训练任何 reference model，直接用目标模型的 train/test loss 分布估计其对 LiRA 的成员推断 (membership inference) 脆弱性：把 LiRA 的逐样本信号分解为方差比项与残余均值偏移项，按训练在样本上压缩不确定性的程度把模型放到连续谱上，用分布形状选择对应的无参考代理。重尾端的 LOSS attack TNR 在 10 个图像分类架构、4 个数据集上预测 LiRA TPR@FPR=10⁻³ 的 RMSE 为 0.036，并优于 RMIA 等低成本 reference-model 攻击；对称端的 LOSS attack AUC 在 10M 到 1B 参数的五种 GPT-2 规模上预测 LiRA TPR 的 RMSE 为 0.018。
Motivation: SOTA 成员推断攻击需要训练大量昂贵的 reference model，实用性受限；而 LiRA 又是最强可用攻击，其脆弱性评估因此难以在真实部署中执行。
Method: 从目标模型自身的 train/test loss 分布出发，将 LiRA 逐样本信号分解为方差比项与残余均值偏移项，两项相对贡献由训练在该样本上压缩模型不确定性的程度决定；据 loss 分布形状判断模型落在重尾端还是对称端，并实例化两个无参考代理——重尾端用 LOSS attack TNR，对称端用 LOSS attack AUC——作为 LiRA TPR 的代理。
Result: 重尾端：LOSS attack TNR 预测 LiRA TPR@FPR=10⁻³ 的 RMSE 为 0.036，跨 10 个图像分类架构与 4 个数据集，且优于 RMIA 等低成本 reference-model 攻击。对称端：LOSS attack AUC 预测 LiRA TPR 的 RMSE 为 0.018，跨五个 GPT-2 规模（10M 至 1B 参数）。
Conclusion: LiRA 的逐样本信号可由 loss 分布的两个可分离项刻画，因此模型级脆弱性可以不训练任何 reference model 就被估计，且不同 loss 分布形状对应不同的合适代理统计量。

papers.title: Semantics-Aware Hierarchical Consensus Learning for Remote Sensing Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning has become increasingly important in remote sensing image classification due to its ability to extract semantic information from complex data. Classification tasks often include predefined label hierarchies that represent the semantic relationships among classes. However, these hierarchies are frequently overlooked, and most approaches focus only on fine-grained classification schemes. In this paper, we present a novel Semantics-Aware Hierarchical Consensus (SAHC) approach that integrates hierarchical-level-specific classification heads within a deep network architecture and combines their output through cross-level probability projectors. Direct and projected predictions are fused into a geometric consensus distribution, which is used for self-consistent training and optional hierarchy-aware inference. This mechanism acts as a geometric ensemble that leverages the inherent structure of the hierarchical classification task. The projectors are initialized from the user-defined taxonomy (i.e., the hierarchical label structure), and can be adaptively refined during optimization. The proposed SAHC method is evaluated on two benchmark datasets with different degrees of hierarchical complexity on different tasks, considering varying spectral and spatial resolutions. Experimental results show both the effectiveness of the proposed approach in guiding network learning and the robustness of the hierarchical consensus for remote sensing image classification tasks. The source code is available at https://github.com/rslab-unitrento/sahc.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 8 figures, accepted version for publication
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing, vol. 64, 2026, Art no. 4417518
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出语义感知分层共识 (SAHC)：在深度网络中并列各层级分类头，用由用户定义的类别树初始化的跨层概率投影器把输出投到同一分布，再与直接预测融合成几何共识分布，用于自洽训练和可选的层级感知推理。在两个层级复杂度不同的遥感基准上，该方法同时体现对网络学习的引导作用与层级共识的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 遥感分类任务普遍带有表达类间语义关系的预定义标签层级，但现有方法大多只做细粒度分类、忽略层级结构，层级信息未被用于约束学习。
Method: SAHC 在单一深度网络内挂接层级专属分类头，跨层概率投影器 (cross-level probability projectors) 由用户给定的 taxonomy 初始化并在优化中自适应修正；直接预测与投影预测融合为几何共识分布 (geometric consensus distribution)，既作为自洽训练目标，也支持层级感知推理，整体相当于利用层级结构的几何集成 (geometric ensemble)。
Result: 在两个层级复杂度不同、光谱与空间分辨率各异的遥感基准数据集上评估，结果表明 SAHC 能有效引导网络学习，且层级共识在遥感图像分类任务上表现鲁棒；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 把标签层级显式编码进多头加投影的几何共识，可以在不改变主干的前提下提升遥感分类的自洽性与鲁棒性，层级结构本身即可充当集成先验。

papers.title: HomID : Benchmarking Intrinsic Dimension Estimators on Homogenous Manifolds with Anisotropic Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: The manifold hypothesis suggests that data lies on manifolds with smaller intrinsic dimension (ID) than their ambient dimension. However there is no empirical agreement on the estimates for ID from different estimators for realistic datasets. Thus it is important to test ID estimators (IDEs) with targeted stressors. In this work, we consider the role of anisotropy. To this end, we propose HomID, a collection of homogeneous spaces with anisotropic embedding, for benchmarking ID estimators. We observe that methods that perform well on standard benchmarks systematically degrade on HomID under identical resource allocation. We further observe that anisotropic distortion of such benchmarks also results in performance degradation. Finally, we demonstrate that controlled anisotropic distortions induce systematic shifts in the distributions on which these methods rely, providing a concrete mechanism for the resulting estimation errors in two particular IDEs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HomID 是一套带各向异性嵌入的齐性空间 (homogeneous spaces) 合成基准，用于压力测试本征维数估计器 (intrinsic dimension estimators, IDEs)。在相同资源分配下，标准基准上表现好的方法在 HomID 上系统性退化；对既有基准施加各向异性扭曲同样导致性能下降，并且受控的各向异性扭曲会系统性移动两个特定 IDE 所依赖的分布，从而给出估计误差的具体机制。
Motivation: 流形假设认为数据位于本征维数低于环境维数的流形上，但不同 IDE 在真实数据集上的估计结果缺乏经验上的一致性，说明现有基准缺少有针对性的应力源 (stressor)。
Method: 提出 HomID：一族齐性空间加上各向异性嵌入构成的基准集合，在统一资源分配下评测多种 IDE；并施加受控的各向异性扭曲，追踪两个具体 IDE 所依赖分布的移动。
Result: 在相同资源分配下，标准基准上表现良好的方法在 HomID 上系统性退化；对标准基准做各向异性扭曲也导致性能下降；受控各向异性扭曲使两个特定 IDE 依赖的分布发生系统性位移，为估计误差给出具体机制。
Conclusion: 各向异性嵌入是 IDE 评测中必须显式控制的应力源：忽略它会让标准基准上的好成绩无法迁移到真实数据，且退化有可追溯的分布层面机制。

papers.title: RoboPilot: Generalizable Dynamic Robotic Manipulation with Dual-thinking Modes
papers.abstract_en: Despite rapid progress in robotics, complex or long-horizon tasks remain a fundamental challenge. Most current approaches follow an open-loop paradigm with limited reasoning and no feedback, resulting in poor robustness to environmental changes and severe error accumulation. We present RoboPilot, a dual-thinking closed-loop agentic framework for robotic manipulation that supports adaptive reasoning for complex tasks in real-world dynamic environments. RoboPilot leverages primitive actions for structured task planning and flexible action generation as a agentic system, while introducing feedback to enable replanning from dynamic changes and execution errors. Chain-of-Thought reasoning further enhances high-level task planning and guides low-level action generation. The agentic system dynamically switches between fast and slow thinking to balance efficiency and accuracy. To systematically evaluate the robustness of RoboPilot in diverse robot manipulation scenarios, we introduce RoboPilot-Bench, a benchmark spanning 21 tasks across 10 categories, including infeasible-task recognition and dynamic recovery. Experiments show that RoboPilot outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by 11% in task success rate, and the real-world deployment on an industrial robot further demonstrates its robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RoboPilot 是面向机器人操作的双思维闭环 agentic 框架：用 primitive actions 做结构化任务规划，Chain-of-Thought 驱动高层规划并引导底层动作生成，同时在快慢两种思维模式间动态切换以平衡效率与精度。在自建的 RoboPilot-Bench（21 个任务、10 个类别，含不可行任务识别与动态恢复）上，任务成功率比 SOTA 基线高 11%，并在工业机器人实机部署中验证鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有机器人操作方法多为开环范式，推理受限且无反馈，面对环境变化时鲁棒性差、误差累积严重，复杂或长时程任务因此难以完成。
Method: 提出 RoboPilot 双思维闭环 agentic 框架：以 primitive actions 支撑结构化任务规划与灵活动作生成，引入反馈以针对动态变化和执行错误重规划；Chain-of-Thought 推理增强高层任务规划并指导底层动作生成；系统在 fast/slow thinking 之间动态切换。评测用自建 RoboPilot-Bench，覆盖 10 类共 21 个任务。
Result: RoboPilot-Bench 含 21 个任务、10 个类别，包括不可行任务识别与动态恢复；实验中任务成功率比 state-of-the-art 基线高 11%，并在工业机器人上完成真实部署。
Conclusion: 闭环反馈加双思维切换的 agentic 规划能提升复杂机器人操作任务的成功率与对动态环境的鲁棒性，开环无反馈的范式是误差累积的主因。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Agentic Scene Policies
papers.abstract_en: Designing or learning robot policies that generalize zero-shot across a range of language instructions and objects is a core problem in robotics. Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) learn such policies end-to-end by repurposing existing Vision-Language Models (VLMs), but generalization to new instructions and objects remains challenging. An alternative is to implement a modular policy by leveraging an explicit VLM-based 3D scene representation and motion planning. While modular policies show strong zero-shot potential, they typically retrieve objects based on semantics without explicit spatial reasoning, severely restricting their overall grounding capabilities. They also interact with objects using basic grasping and navigation skills. In this work, we address these limitations by unifying grounding capabilities and robot skills in a single agentic action space through a scene-agent tool interface. By leveraging part-level affordances, our skills generalize across diverse objects and enable zero-shot interactions such as unplugging chargers and opening drawers. We name the resulting framework Agentic Scene Policies (ASP). Through extensive real-world experiments, we show how ASP consistently outperforms leading VLAs in the zero-shot setting. We also demonstrate the extensibility of our framework by introducing a mobile version of ASP to tackle room-level queries. See our project page (https://montrealrobotics.ca/agentic-scene-policies.github.io/) for more results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出机器人策略框架 Agentic Scene Policies (ASP)：用基于 VLM 的显式 3D 场景表示加场景-智能体工具接口 (scene-agent tool interface)，把物体定位与机器人技能统一到单一 agentic 动作空间，并借助部件级可供性 (part-level affordances) 实现跨物体泛化。真实世界实验中 ASP 在零样本设定下持续优于领先 VLA 模型，可零样本完成拔充电器、开抽屉等交互，并有面向房间级查询的移动版 ASP。
Motivation: VLA 端到端学习的策略对新指令和新物体泛化困难；模块化策略虽有零样本潜力，但通常只按语义检索物体、缺乏显式空间推理，且仅用基础抓取与导航技能交互，定位与操作能力被割裂。
Method: ASP 通过 scene-agent tool interface 把基于 VLM 的显式 3D 场景表示的定位能力与机器人技能合并进单一 agentic 动作空间；技能建立在 part-level affordances 之上以跨多样物体泛化；另引入移动版 ASP 处理房间级查询。
Result: 在大量真实世界实验中，ASP 在零样本设定下持续优于领先 VLA 模型；演示了拔掉充电器、打开抽屉等零样本交互，并展示了移动版 ASP 应对房间级查询的可扩展性。
Conclusion: 把语义-空间定位与可供性驱动的技能统一到一个 agentic 动作空间，可以在零样本指令与新物体上取得比端到端 VLA 更强的泛化与接地能力。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: SEER: Self-Enhancing Chain-of-Thought Compression for Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting can substantially improve the reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs), but it often comes with high inference cost due to long and poorly controlled reasoning traces. This overhead is particularly problematic in software engineering tasks (e.g., code generation), where both latency and output reliability matter. To better understand this trade-off, we conduct an empirical study on widely used code generation benchmarks and observe that many modern reasoning models produce excessively verbose CoTs (often thousands of tokens), which frequently leads to truncation and unstable generation. Using a strict n-gram repetition detector, we find that most observed truncations are associated with degenerate looping behaviors. In addition, a HumanEval/129 case study shows that failed generations can be longer than successful ones, suggesting limited returns from overlong reasoning. Motivated by these findings, we propose SEER (Self-Enhancing Efficient Reasoning), a self-enhancing framework for adaptive CoT compression. SEER improves the conciseness of reasoning while preserving output quality, without relying on external compression tools. SEER refines self-generated CoT data via Best-of-N sampling to suppress looping and redundant traces, then applies a lightweight, data-driven filter to encourage concise yet correct reasoning. It then fine-tunes the model on the filtered data to internalize concise reasoning behaviors. Across four software engineering benchmarks on the evaluated DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B backbone, SEER reduces CoT length by 34.6% on average while improving task performance, with reduced truncation and fewer reasoning loops.
papers.journal_ref: Proc. ACM Softw. Eng. 3, ISSTA, Article ISSTA029 (October 2026), 23 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SEER 用 Best-of-N 采样自净化模型自己生成的 CoT，再用轻量数据驱动过滤器挑出简洁且正确的推理轨迹并微调，使模型内化简洁推理。在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 上跨四个软件工程基准，CoT 长度平均缩短 34.6%，任务性能同时提升，截断与推理循环减少。
Motivation: 推理模型的 CoT 常长达数千 token，导致截断与生成不稳定；在代码生成这类同时要求延迟与可靠性的任务上，过长推理的回报有限（HumanEval/129 案例中失败生成反而比成功生成更长）。
Method: SEER（Self-Enhancing Efficient Reasoning）分三步：先用严格 n-gram 重复检测器定位退化循环，再以 Best-of-N 采样精炼自生成 CoT 以抑制循环与冗余，接着用轻量数据驱动过滤器保留简洁且正确的推理，最后在过滤数据上微调模型；不依赖外部压缩工具。
Result: 在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B backbone 上、四个软件工程基准上，CoT 长度平均减少 34.6%，任务性能同时提升，截断减少、推理循环变少；实证观察显示多数截断与退化循环相关，HumanEval/129 案例中失败生成可长于成功生成。
Conclusion: 压缩 CoT 不必牺牲质量：自生成数据的采样加过滤再微调，就能同时缩短推理、保住并提升代码任务表现，且无需外部压缩工具。

papers.title: Circuit realization and hardware linearization of monotone operator equilibrium networks
papers.abstract_en: It is shown that the port behavior of a resistor-diode network corresponds to the solution of a ReLU monotone operator equilibrium network (a neural network in the limit of infinite depth), giving a parsimonious construction of a neural network in analog hardware. We furthermore show that the gradient of such a circuit can be computed directly in hardware, using a procedure we call hardware linearization. This allows the network to be trained in hardware, which we demonstrate with a device-level circuit simulation. We extend the results to cascades of resistor-diode networks, which can be used to implement feedforward and other asymmetric networks. We finally show that different nonlinear elements give rise to different activation functions, and introduce the novel diode ReLU which is induced by a non-ideal diode model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明电阻-二极管网络的端口行为等价于 ReLU 单调算子均衡网络（无限深极限的神经网络），从而用模拟硬件简洁实现该网络；并提出硬件线性化 (hardware linearization) 直接在电路上计算梯度，使网络可在硬件中训练，器件级电路仿真演示了这一训练过程。
Motivation: 把神经网络落到模拟硬件通常需要复杂映射；单调算子均衡网络这类无限深极限结构缺少直接的电路对应与片上训练手段。
Method: 建立电阻-二极管网络端口行为与 ReLU 单调算子均衡网络解的对应；用硬件线性化过程在硬件中直接计算该电路的梯度以支持片上训练；把结果推广到电阻-二极管网络级联以实现前馈等非对称网络，并用非理想二极管模型导出新的 diode ReLU 激活函数。
Result: 器件级电路仿真演示了硬件内训练；结果扩展到级联网络可实现前馈与非对称网络；不同非线性元件产生不同激活函数，并由非理想二极管模型引出新的 diode ReLU。
Conclusion: 电阻-二极管网络可作为 ReLU 单调算子均衡网络的简洁模拟硬件实现，梯度可直接在硬件中算出并用于训练；非线性元件的选择决定等效激活函数。

papers.title: Modified Loss of Momentum Gradient Descent: Fine-Grained Analysis
papers.abstract_en: We analyze gradient descent with Polyak (1964) heavy-ball momentum (HB) whose fixed momentum hyperparameter $β\in (0, 1)$ provides exponential decay of memory. Building on Kovachki and Stuart (2021), we prove that on an exponentially attractive invariant manifold the algorithm is exactly plain gradient descent with a modified loss, provided that the step size $h$ is small enough. Although the modified loss does not admit a closed-form expression, we describe it up to $O(h^{\mathcal{R}})$-errors for arbitrary finite order $\mathcal{R}$, and prove global (finite "time" horizon) trajectory approximation bounds $O(h^{\mathcal{R}})$. We then conduct a fine-grained analysis of the combinatorics underlying the memoryless approximations of HB, in particular, finding a rich family of polynomials in $β$ hidden inside which include and lie coefficient-wise in between Eulerian and Narayana polynomials. We prove that these polynomials are $h$-polynomials of certain graph-associahedra. As corollaries of the main results, we derive continuous modified equations of arbitrary finite approximation order (with rigorous bounds) and the principal flow that approximates the HB dynamics, generalizing Rosca et al. (2023). Approximation theorems cover both full-batch and mini-batch HB. The results shed new light on the main features of HB and outline a roadmap for similar analysis of other optimization algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明带固定动量 β∈(0,1) 的 Polyak heavy-ball (HB) 在指数吸引不变流形上、步长 h 足够小时等价于对某个修改损失做普通梯度下降，该修改损失可按任意有限阶 R 展开到 O(h^R) 误差并给出全局轨迹逼近界。组合结构分析发现一族 β 的多项式，逐系数介于 Eulerian 与 Narayana 多项式之间，且是若干 graph-associahedra 的 h-多项式；推论包括任意有限阶连续修正方程与逼近 HB 动力学的 principal flow，覆盖 full-batch 与 mini-batch 两种情形。
Motivation: heavy-ball 动量的记忆衰减如何改变优化动力学缺少精细刻画：修改损失无闭式表达，其组合结构与高阶修正方程此前不清楚。
Method: 在 Kovachki 与 Stuart (2021) 的指数吸引不变流形框架下，把 HB 约化为带修改损失的普通梯度下降，按任意有限阶 R 展开到 O(h^R)；再对无记忆近似的组合结构做细粒度分析，识别 β 多项式族并证明其为 graph-associahedra 的 h-多项式，推广 Rosca et al. (2023) 的 principal flow。
Result: 得到 O(h^R) 的修改损失描述与有限时间全局轨迹逼近界，R 为任意有限阶；识别出的 β 多项式族逐系数介于 Eulerian 与 Narayana 多项式之间；推导出任意有限逼近阶的连续修正方程（带严格界）与 principal flow，结论同时覆盖 full-batch 与 mini-batch HB。
Conclusion: 固定动量 HB 在小步长下可视为修改损失上的普通梯度下降，其高阶修正由 graph-associahedra 的 h-多项式控制；该分析框架可推广到其他优化算法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Scaling Legal AI: Benchmarking Mamba and Transformers for Statutory Classification and Case Law Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Statutory corpora and judicial decisions are growing faster than legal professionals can read them, while individual judgments often exceed the context limits of standard encoder models. Transformer architectures dominate legal NLP benchmarks, but their quadratic attention complexity can require truncating or fragmenting documents that demand whole-document reasoning. Selective state-space models (SSMs), such as Mamba, offer linear-time sequence modeling and are a promising alternative for long legal documents, yet their performance on legal classification and retrieval remains underexplored. We present a preliminary benchmark comparing Mamba and SSD-Mamba with BERT, DeBERTa, and Longformer across four legal classification tasks (ECtHR, EUR-Lex, SCOTUS, and ILDC/ILC) and two case-retrieval tasks (ECtHR and ILDC), using a shared windowing and aggregation pipeline. The strongest SSM performs within approximately 1.3 percentage points of the strongest transformer across tasks and metrics. SSD-Mamba achieves the best results on most metrics for ECtHR classification, ILDC classification, and ECtHR retrieval, while processing approximately 3 times more tokens per second than DeBERTa and 4 times more than Longformer. DeBERTa remains strongest on SCOTUS and EUR-Lex F1. These results are preliminary because they do not include variance estimates across random seeds or statistical significance testing. Rather than presenting a definitive ranking, we use these findings to motivate further evaluation with repeated-seed experiments, statistical testing, and controls for model capacity and computational efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在法律 NLP 上把 Mamba 与 SSD-Mamba 同 BERT、DeBERTa、Longformer 用统一窗口切分与聚合流程对比，四个法条分类任务与两个案例检索任务上最强 SSM 与最强 Transformer 差距约 1.3 个百分点，SSD-Mamba 吞吐约为 DeBERTa 的 3 倍、Longformer 的 4 倍。作者据此主张先做重复随机种子与显著性检验再谈排名。
Motivation: 法条与判决数量增长快于法律从业者阅读速度，单个判决常超出标准 encoder 的上下文窗口；Transformer 的二次注意力复杂度迫使截断或切分需要全文推理的文档，而 SSM 在法律分类与检索上的表现尚少被系统考察。
Method: 用共享的窗口切分与聚合 pipeline，对 Mamba 与 SSD-Mamba 同 BERT、DeBERTa、Longformer 做初步基准对比，覆盖四个法律分类任务（ECtHR、EUR-Lex、SCOTUS、ILDC/ILC）与两个案例检索任务（ECtHR、ILDC）。
Result: 最强 SSM 在各任务与指标上距最强 Transformer 约 1.3 个百分点；SSD-Mamba 在 ECtHR 分类、ILDC 分类、ECtHR 检索的多数指标上最佳，吞吐约为 DeBERTa 的 3 倍、Longformer 的 4 倍；DeBERTa 在 SCOTUS 与 EUR-Lex F1 上仍最强。
Conclusion: 结果为初步结论，未含跨随机种子的方差估计与显著性检验；作者主张以重复种子实验、统计检验以及对模型容量与计算效率的控制来替代当前的确定性排名。

papers.title: MAGIC: Learning from Visibility Asymmetry for Unsupervised Stereo Matching
papers.abstract_en: Learning disparity in occluded regions remains difficult for unsupervised stereo matching. Photometric supervision lacks valid target-view correspondences in these regions, while the teacher and student in conventional binocular self-training share the same target view and therefore the same occlusions. Even when supervision is available, the small proportion of occluded pixels limits their contribution to training. We propose MAGIC, a multi-baseline geometric consistency framework for reliable and effective occlusion supervision. The teacher and student share a reference image but use different target views, allowing the teacher to observe correspondences that are occluded from the student. After aligning disparities across baselines, MAGIC uses predictions from teacher-visible regions to supervise student-occluded regions. An occlusion-aware weighting strategy strengthens supervision on teacher-visible but student-occluded pixels, preventing their training signal from being overwhelmed by non-occluded regions. We also introduce MBS20K, a synthetic multi-baseline stereo dataset spanning diverse scenes, weather, and lighting. Pre-trained on MBS20K, MAGIC generalizes to real-world datasets with consistently fewer occluded-region outliers. On KITTI, the pre-trained model already outperforms several fine-tuned unsupervised methods. Fine-tuning this model on standard binocular pairs achieves state-of-the-art unsupervised performance on KITTI 2015 and 2012. Incorporating synthesized multi-baseline views during fine-tuning further improves performance. Our code and dataset will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MAGIC 用多基线几何一致性做无监督立体匹配的遮挡监督：师生共享参考图但用不同目标视图，教师能看到被学生遮挡的对应点，对齐视差后用教师可见区监督学生遮挡区，并用遮挡感知加权防止该信号被非遮挡像素淹没。在 MBS20K 预训练后于 KITTI 上以更少的遮挡区外点泛化，微调后在 KITTI 2015/2012 达到无监督最先进水平。
Motivation: 无监督立体匹配中遮挡区缺少有效的目标视图对应，常规双目自训练的师生共享同一目标视图因而共享同样的遮挡；即使有监督，遮挡像素占比小，对训练贡献有限。
Method: 提出多基线几何一致性框架 MAGIC：教师与学生共享参考图但使用不同目标视图，使教师观察到对学生而言被遮挡的对应；跨基线对齐视差后，用教师可见区的预测监督学生遮挡区，并引入遮挡感知加权 (occlusion-aware weighting) 强化教师可见、学生遮挡像素的监督。同时构建合成多基线立体数据集 MBS20K，覆盖多样场景、天气与光照。
Result: 在 MBS20K 预训练后模型泛化到真实数据集，遮挡区外点 (occluded-region outliers) 一致减少；预训练模型在 KITTI 上已超过若干微调过的无监督方法；在标准双目对上微调后在 KITTI 2015 与 KITTI 2012 达到无监督最先进性能，微调时加入合成多基线视图可进一步提升。
Conclusion: 让教师与学生使用不同目标视图，可以把教师可见而学生遮挡的对应转化为有效监督，从而在无监督设定下改善遮挡区视差估计；代码与数据集将在接收后发布。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: MAGIC 用多基线几何一致性做无监督立体匹配的遮挡监督：师生共享参考图但用不同目标视图，教师能看到被学生遮挡的对应点，对齐视差后用教师可见区监督学生遮挡区，并用遮挡感知加权防止该信号被非遮挡像素淹没。在 MBS20K 预训练后于 KITTI 上以更少的遮挡区外点泛化，微调后在 KITTI 2015/2012 达到无监督最先进水平。

papers.title: Bridging MOOCs, Smart Teaching, and AI-Assisted Learning: A Unified Quantitative Model
papers.abstract_en: MOOCs, Smart Teaching (ST), and AI-assisted learning support different stages of higher education, yet a unified quantitative basis for analyzing their contributions, course design, and resource allocation remains limited. This study develops a mathematical model integrating MOOC-based pre-class learning, ST-based in-class adaptation, and AI-assisted post-class personalization. Learner mastery is represented as a bounded multidimensional state, with a common exponential learning-response function describing how instructional resources reduce remaining knowledge gaps. The stages differ in their allocation rules: predefined course-content emphasis for MOOCs, feedback-driven class-level adaptation for ST, and individualized gap-based allocation for AI-assisted learning. Simulations across 100 independently generated classes demonstrate stable cumulative progression and quantify stage-wise gains, while budget analysis reveals diminishing returns from additional AI support. For a fixed learner and learning mechanism, varying course-content emphasis shows a strong association between course-learner alignment and post-MOOC mastery. An optimal AI allocation is also derived under a fixed budget: supported components reach a common residual mastery gap, while components below this threshold receive no resources. A controlled comparison yields over 14% greater learning gain than proportional allocation. These analyses make the instructional process quantitatively analyzable and provide a basis for examining course-learner fit and coordinating limited learning resources. The model offers an analytical foundation for instructional decisions, with practical application requiring empirical estimation of learner states and calibration of learning-response parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个把 MOOC 课前学习、智慧教学 (Smart Teaching) 课中调整、AI 辅助课后个性化统一起来的数学模型：学习者掌握度表示为有界多维状态，用同一个指数学习响应函数刻画教学资源如何缩小剩余知识缺口。在固定预算下推导出最优 AI 资源分配——各被支持的知识成分收敛到共同的剩余掌握缺口，低于该阈值的成分不再分配资源；受控对比中该分配比按比例分配的学习增益高出 14% 以上。
Motivation: MOOC、智慧教学与 AI 辅助学习分别作用于高等教育的不同阶段，但缺少一个统一的定量基础来分析各自贡献、课程设计与资源分配。
Method: 建立统一数学模型：学习者掌握度为有界多维状态，共用一个指数学习响应函数；三阶段采用不同分配规则——MOOC 按预设课程内容侧重、ST 按反馈做班级层面调整、AI 辅助按个体缺口分配。在固定预算下解析推导最优 AI 分配，并做预算敏感性分析。
Result: 在 100 个独立生成的班级上仿真，显示稳定的累积掌握进程并量化了各阶段增益；预算分析显示额外 AI 支持存在边际回报递减；固定学习者与学习机制时，课程内容侧重的变化与课后 MOOC 掌握度呈强关联；受控对比中最优 AI 分配比按比例分配的学习增益高出 14% 以上。
Conclusion: 该模型让教学过程变得可定量分析，可作为课程-学习者匹配与有限学习资源协调的解析基础；但实际应用需要对学习者状态做经验估计、对学习响应参数做标定。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Environmental Change Detection for Real-World Change Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Scene Change Detection (SCD) evaluates changes using predefined query-reference (i.e., present-past) image pairs. However, this formulation overlooks a critical dependency: the corresponding query-reference pair is assumed to be prepared in advance. In real-world applications, such as mobile robots, future query views cannot be known in advance, and thus their corresponding reference images cannot be predefined. To remove this dependency and push change detection toward more practical applications, we introduce Environmental Change Detection (ECD). A key aspect of ECD is to avoid unrealistically predefined and aligned query-reference pairs and instead retrieve environmental cues from an uncurated image database of reference scenes. To tackle this new challenging task, we additionally introduce an initial solution that enables change detection under unknown and imperfect query-reference conditions. The main idea of our solution is to retrieve multiple reference candidates and aggregate semantically rich representations for change detection. We further construct ECD benchmark sets by reformulating three standard change detection datasets. Extensive experimental results demonstrate the efficacy of our solution in both ECD and SCD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把场景变化检测 (SCD) 从预设配对的 query-reference 形式改成环境变化检测 (ECD)：参考图不再预先给定，而是从未整理的参考图像库中检索多个候选并聚合语义表示来判定变化。该方案在重构自三个标准变化检测数据集的 ECD benchmark 上以及原 SCD 设定下都验证有效。
Motivation: SCD 假设 present-past 图像对已提前备好且对齐，但移动机器人等真实场景中未来 query 视角无法预知，参考图因而无法预先指定，这一依赖使现有设定脱离实际应用。
Method: 提出 ECD 任务，取消预定义配对，从未整理的参考场景图像库检索线索；初始方案先检索多个 reference 候选，再聚合语义丰富的表示做变化判定；并把三个标准变化检测数据集重构成 ECD benchmark 集。
Result: 在重构自三个标准变化检测数据集的 ECD benchmark 上，实验结果表明该方案在 ECD 与原 SCD 两种设定下均有效。
Conclusion: 变化检测可以摆脱预先配对的 query-reference 依赖，靠检索式多候选参考聚合在未知、不完美的配对条件下成立。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: Geometry-Centered 3D Latent World Models for Growing Surfaces
papers.abstract_en: Many physical systems do not merely move or deform; they grow, adding material and changing the geometry that a world model must represent. Existing world models are typically optimized for pixel prediction, reward prediction, or fixed-support physical dynamics, leaving open how to model systems whose underlying physical support expands over time and whose future morphology depends on hidden material response. We introduce FOLIAGE, a geometry-centered latent world model for growing surfaces. Within a fixed state budget, FOLIAGE represents mature regions as a compact scaffold while allocating higher-resolution state to regions predicted to drive near-future growth. This focuses representation and computation where new material and geometric change occur while retaining compact global context. FOLIAGE further separates observation, action, and privileged physics: heterogeneous RGB, point-cloud, and mesh observations are fused into a deployable geometric state; material controls condition the latent dynamics; and hidden physical energies guide training but are not required at deployment. To evaluate this setting, we introduce SURF-GARDEN and SURF-BENCH, providing controlled counterfactual branches, dense cross-modal correspondences, hidden physical signals, and stress tests for growing-geometry state learning. FOLIAGE reduces inverse-material error by $\approx40\%$ and 5-step mesh forecasting Chamfer error by $\approx30\%$ relative to strong baselines, while improving cross-modal retrieval by +14 mAP points. Stress tests show graceful degradation under sensor loss and correspondence corruption. On temporal 3D plant scans, FOLIAGE also improves passive future-geometry forecasting, while transfer experiments show that the learned geometry-centered state remains useful beyond the simulator.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 FOLIAGE：面向「生长型表面」的几何中心隐世界模型，在固定状态预算下用紧凑骨架表示成熟区域、把高分辨率状态分配给预测将驱动近期生长的区域。在自建 SURF-GARDEN/SURF-BENCH 上，逆材料误差相对强基线降约 40%，5 步 mesh 预报 Chamfer 误差降约 30%，跨模态检索 +14 mAP 点。
Motivation: 现有世界模型面向像素预测、奖励预测或固定支撑的物理动力学，无法表示物理支撑随时间扩张、未来形态取决于隐藏材料响应的生长系统。
Method: FOLIAGE 在固定状态预算内以紧凑骨架表示成熟区、对预测驱动近期生长的区域分配更高分辨率状态；分离观测、动作与特权物理：融合 RGB、点云、mesh 异构观测为可部署几何状态，材料控制量条件化隐动力学，隐藏物理能量仅用于训练、部署时不需要。配套提出 SURF-GARDEN 与 SURF-BENCH，含受控反事实分支、稠密跨模态对应、隐藏物理信号与压力测试。
Result: 相对强基线，逆材料误差降低约 40%，5 步 mesh 预报 Chamfer 误差降低约 30%，跨模态检索提升 +14 mAP 点；压力测试显示传感器丢失与对应关系损坏下性能平缓退化；在真实 3D 植物扫描上改善被动未来几何预报，迁移实验表明学到的几何中心状态在仿真之外仍有用。
Conclusion: 把状态预算按几何变化集中分配、并把物理能量作为特权训练信号，可以在不增加部署依赖的前提下同时改善生长系统的材料反演与未来形态预报。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Causal Posterior Estimation
papers.abstract_en: We present Causal Posterior Estimation (CPE), a novel method for Bayesian inference in simulator models, where evaluating the likelihood function is intractable or computationally expensive, but generating outputs given parameter values is straightforward. CPE approximates the posterior distribution using flow matching while directly incorporating the conditional dependence structure induced by the model's graphical representation into the neural network architecture. Across extensive experiments, we demonstrate that hard-coding these conditional dependencies into the network, rather than requiring them to be learned from data, enables CPE to achieve highly accurate posterior inference that matches or outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CPE（Causal Posterior Estimation）用 flow matching 近似仿真器模型的后验，并把模型图结构诱导的条件依赖直接硬编码进网络架构，而不是让网络从数据里学。作者称在大量实验中，这种硬编码条件依赖使后验推断精度匹配或超过最先进基线。
Motivation: 仿真器模型的似然不可解或计算昂贵，但给定参数生成输出容易，常规贝叶斯推断在此失效；图结构中的条件依赖若交给网络从数据学习，会浪费可用的先验结构信息。
Method: 用 flow matching 近似后验分布，并将模型图表示诱导的条件依赖结构直接写入神经网络架构（硬编码而非数据驱动学习），面向似然不可解或昂贵的 simulator models 做贝叶斯推断。
Result: 在作者所述的大量实验中，硬编码条件依赖的 CPE 达到高精度后验推断，匹配或优于 state-of-the-art 基线；摘要未给出具体数据集或数值指标。
Conclusion: 把因果图的条件依赖作为架构先验注入后验估计网络，可以在似然不可解的仿真器模型上取得不逊于最先进基线的推断精度。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: RoboFAC: A Comprehensive Framework for Robotic Failure Analysis and Correction
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently advanced robotic manipulation by translating natural-language instructions and visual observations into control actions. However, existing VLAs are primarily trained on successful expert demonstrations and lack structured supervision for failure diagnosis and recovery, limiting robustness in open-world scenarios. To address this limitation, we propose the Robotic Failure Analysis and Correction (RoboFAC) framework. We construct a large-scale failure-centric dataset comprising 9,440 erroneous manipulation trajectories and 78,623 QA pairs across 53 scenes in both simulation and real-world environments, with systematically categorized failure types. Leveraging this dataset, we develop a lightweight multimodal model specialized for task understanding, failure analysis, and failure correction, enabling efficient local deployment while remaining competitive with large proprietary models. Experimental results demonstrate that RoboFAC achieves a 34.1% higher failure analysis accuracy compared to GPT-4o. Furthermore, we integrated RoboFAC as an external supervisor in a real-world VLA control pipeline, yielding a 29.1% relative improvement across four tasks while significantly reducing latency relative to GPT-4o. These results demonstrate that RoboFAC enables systematic failure diagnosis and recovery, significantly enhancing VLA recovery capabilities. Our model and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/MINT-SJTU/RoboFAC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RoboFAC 为 Vision-Language-Action 机器人操作构建以失败为中心的监督框架：9,440 条错误操作轨迹、78,623 个 QA 对、覆盖仿真与真实共 53 个场景，并按失败类型系统分类，训练出一个轻量多模态模型做任务理解、失败分析与纠正。其失败分析准确率比 GPT-4o 高 34.1%，作为外部监督器接入真实 VLA 控制管线后四项任务相对提升 29.1%，延迟显著低于 GPT-4o。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型只在成功专家演示上训练，缺少失败诊断与恢复的结构化监督，在开放世界场景中鲁棒性受限。
Method: 构建失败中心数据集（9,440 条错误操作轨迹、78,623 个 QA 对、53 个仿真与真实场景，失败类型系统分类），据此训练一个轻量多模态模型，覆盖任务理解、失败分析与失败纠正，并可本地高效部署；再将其作为外部监督器接入真实 VLA 控制管线。
Result: 失败分析准确率比 GPT-4o 高 34.1%；作为外部监督器接入真实 VLA 控制管线后，四项任务取得 29.1% 的相对提升，延迟相对 GPT-4o 显著降低。

papers.title: Graph-Based Floor Separation Using Node Embeddings and Clustering of WiFi Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Indoor positioning systems (IPSs) are increasingly vital for location-based services in complex multi-storey environments. This study proposes a novel graph-based approach for floor separation using Wi-Fi fingerprint trajectories, addressing the challenge of vertical localization in indoor settings. We construct a graph where nodes represent Wi-Fi fingerprints, and edges are weighted by signal similarity and contextual transitions. Node2Vec is employed to generate low-dimensional embeddings, which are subsequently clustered using K-means to identify distinct floors. Evaluated on the Huawei University Challenge 2021 dataset, our method outperforms traditional community detection algorithms, achieving an accuracy of 68.97%, an F1- score of 61.99%, and an Adjusted Rand Index of 57.19%. By publicly releasing the preprocessed dataset and implementation code, this work contributes to advancing research in indoor positioning. The proposed approach demonstrates robustness to signal noise and architectural complexities, offering a scalable solution for floor-level localization.

papers.title: Batch Augmentation with Unimodal Fine-tuning for Multimodal Fusion of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose batch augmentation with unimodal fine-tuning for multimodal learning. We start with pre-trained unimodal models. We fine-tune the unimodal models with the application data. After that, we form a Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) head that takes information from unimodal models and provides output. Finally, we train the MLP layer and unimodal parts with batch augmentation. Depending on the data, some unimodal models can be replaced by hard-coded scripts or AI agents. The unimodal training can also follow batch augmentation when the data is augmentable. We write a multimodal batch augmentation dataloader script that implements the batch augmentation for the multimodal data. We investigate the proposed method on the FPU23 ultrasound and UPMC Food-101 multimodal datasets. The multimodal large language model (LLM) with the proposed training achieves the best average result among the investigated methods across both datasets. According to our literature search, the proposed method achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) accuracy of 93.29% on the UPMC Food-101 dataset, while we apply the ViT-L/16 model for vision and the GPT-2 model for text. We share the scripts of the proposed method with traditional counterparts at the following repository: github.com/dipuk0506/multimodal
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向多模态大模型的 batch augmentation 训练流程：先用应用数据微调各单模态模型，再接 MLP head，最后对 MLP 与单模态部分一起做 batch augmentation 联合训练。在 FPU23 超声与 UPMC Food-101 两个多模态数据集上，该训练在所考察方法中取得两数据集上的最佳平均结果，其中 UPMC Food-101 上用 ViT-L/16（视觉）与 GPT-2（文本）达到 93.29% 的 SOTA 准确率。
Motivation: 多模态融合通常直接在融合层上训练，单模态模型未针对具体应用数据调整，且缺少一种把 batch augmentation 同时施加到单模态与融合部分的统一训练方式。
Method: 流程分四步：以预训练单模态模型为起点，用应用数据微调各单模态模型；构建接收单模态信息的 Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) head；再对 MLP 层与单模态部分做 batch augmentation 联合训练；单模态训练在数据可增广时同样遵循 batch augmentation。部分单模态模型可替换为硬编码脚本或 AI agent，并提供实现多模态 batch augmentation 的 dataloader 脚本。
Result: 在 FPU23 ultrasound 与 UPMC Food-101 两个多模态数据集上，所提训练在考察的方法中取得两数据集上的最佳平均结果；UPMC Food-101 上以 ViT-L/16 作视觉、GPT-2 作文本，达到 93.29% 的 SOTA 准确率（据作者文献检索）。
Conclusion: 先单模态微调再以 batch augmentation 联合训练融合头与单模态部分，可在多模态 LLM 上取得所考察方法中的最佳平均表现，并在 UPMC Food-101 上刷新准确率。

papers.title: Zero-shot Video Moment Retrieval via Off-the-shelf Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: The target of video moment retrieval (VMR) is predicting temporal spans within a video that semantically match a given linguistic query. Existing VMR methods based on multimodal large language models (MLLMs) overly rely on expensive high-quality datasets and time-consuming fine-tuning. Although some recent studies introduce a zero-shot setting to avoid fine-tuning, they overlook inherent language bias in the query, leading to erroneous localization. To tackle the aforementioned challenges, this paper proposes Moment-GPT, a tuning-free pipeline for zero-shot VMR utilizing frozen MLLMs. Specifically, we first employ LLaMA-3 to correct and rephrase the query to mitigate language bias. Subsequently, we design a span generator combined with MiniGPT-v2 to produce candidate spans adaptively. Finally, to leverage the video comprehension capabilities of MLLMs, we apply VideoChatGPT and span scorer to select the most appropriate spans. Our proposed method substantially outperforms the state-ofthe-art MLLM-based and zero-shot models on several public datasets, including QVHighlights, ActivityNet-Captions, and Charades-STA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Moment-GPT 是一个冻结 MLLM、无需微调的零样本视频时刻检索 (video moment retrieval) 流水线：先用 LLaMA-3 改写查询以削弱语言偏置，再由 span generator 结合 MiniGPT-v2 自适应生成候选片段，最后用 VideoChatGPT 加 span scorer 选出最匹配片段。在 QVHighlights、ActivityNet-Captions、Charades-STA 上大幅超越现有 MLLM 与零样本方法。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 时刻检索依赖昂贵的高质量标注数据与耗时微调；近期零样本方案又忽略查询中的内在语言偏置，导致定位出错。
Method: 三段式冻结 MLLM 流水线：LLaMA-3 对查询做纠错与改写以缓解语言偏置；span generator 与 MiniGPT-v2 联合自适应生成候选时间片段；VideoChatGPT 结合 span scorer 挑选最合适的片段，全程 tuning-free。
Result: 在 QVHighlights、ActivityNet-Captions、Charades-STA 多个公开数据集上，大幅优于基于 MLLM 的最先进模型与零样本模型（摘要未列出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 冻结 MLLM 配合查询改写与候选片段生成重排，可在不微调的前提下完成零样本时刻检索并取得领先表现。

papers.title: BiPO: Bidirectional Partial Occlusion Network for Text-to-Motion Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Generating natural and expressive human motions from textual descriptions is challenging due to the complexity of coordinating full-body dynamics and capturing nuanced motion patterns over extended sequences that accurately reflect the given text. To address this, we introduce BiPO, Bidirectional Partial Occlusion Network for Text-to-Motion Synthesis, a novel model that enhances text-to-motion synthesis by integrating part-based generation with a bidirectional autoregressive architecture. This integration allows BiPO to consider both past and future contexts during generation while enhancing detailed control over individual body parts without requiring ground-truth motion length. To relax the interdependency among body parts caused by the integration, we devise the Partial Occlusion technique, which probabilistically occludes the certain motion part information during training. In our comprehensive experiments, BiPO achieves state-of-the-art performance on the HumanML3D dataset, outperforming recent methods such as ParCo, MoMask, and BAMM in terms of FID scores and overall motion quality. Notably, BiPO excels not only in the text-to-motion generation task but also in motion editing tasks that synthesize motion based on partially generated motion sequences and textual descriptions. These results reveal the BiPO's effectiveness in advancing text-to-motion synthesis and its potential for practical applications.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 11 figures. Accepted to WACV 2026 (Oral). Project page: https://seoneun.github.io/BiPO-page/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BiPO 把基于身体部件的生成与双向自回归架构结合，使文本到动作合成在生成时同时利用过去与未来上下文，并在训练中用 Partial Occlusion 概率性遮蔽部分动作信息以放松部件间耦合，且无需真实动作长度。在 HumanML3D 上取得 SOTA，FID 与整体动作质量超过 ParCo、MoMask、BAMM，并可扩展到基于部分已生成序列的动作编辑任务。
Motivation: 文本到动作合成要协调全身动力学并在长序列上捕捉细腻动作模式，同时部件集成会加剧身体部位间的相互依赖，且现有方法常需真实动作长度。
Method: BiPO（Bidirectional Partial Occlusion Network）采用双向自回归架构做基于部件的生成，生成时同时考虑过去与未来上下文；训练时引入 Partial Occlusion 技术，概率性遮蔽特定动作部件信息以放松部件间依赖，且不依赖 ground-truth motion length。
Result: 在 HumanML3D 数据集上达到 state-of-the-art，在 FID 分数与整体动作质量上超过近期方法 ParCo、MoMask、BAMM；同时在动作编辑任务（基于部分生成的动作序列与文本描述合成动作）上表现突出。
Conclusion: 部件级生成加双向自回归与 Partial Occlusion 训练策略能推进文本到动作合成，并在动作编辑等实际应用中有潜力。

papers.title: Learning in the Recurrent State: Gradient Descent with Linear Recurrent Networks
papers.abstract_en: In-context learning lets a sequence model adapt to a new task from examples in its input. A prominent line of work shows how self-attention can be constructed to implement gradient descent on a linear predictor fit to the in-context examples during the forward pass. State-space models (SSMs) and other linear recurrent networks (LRNNs) model sequences at linear time cost, but it is unclear how their recurrent update could carry out the same in-context gradient descent. We introduce Gradient-based Recurrent In-context Learner (GRIL), a diagonal LRNN that factorizes a supervised gradient step into a short-window cross-product write and a multiplicative readout of the next query. For linear regression, this construction accumulates the context gradient in a matrix state and applies it in a single forward pass, with $O(f^2)$ learned degrees of freedom. The same design extends to multi-step updates and cross-entropy classification, with a limited MLP-based extension to non-linear regression. We show empirically that trained GRILs recover the behavior and parameters analytically predicted by the construction on synthetic ICL tasks. Furthermore, the same architecture can be extended and trained on general-purpose benchmarks, including Long Range Arena, language modeling and associative recall. Together, these results establish windowed cross-product self-attention as a concrete inductive bias that lets LRNNs learn in context through gradient-descent-like updates, while remaining trainable on general-purpose tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 GRIL（Gradient-based Recurrent In-context Learner），一种对角线性循环网络 (diagonal LRNN)，把有监督梯度步分解为短窗口叉积写入与下一查询的乘性读出，使循环更新在单次前向中完成对线性回归上下文梯度的累积与应用，自由度为 O(f^2)。训练后的 GRIL 在合成 ICL 任务上复现了解析构造预测的行为与参数，并可扩展到 Long Range Arena、语言建模与联想记忆等通用基准。
Motivation: 自注意力已被证明可在前向过程中实现对上下文样本的梯度下降，但线性时间的 SSM 与 LRNN 的循环更新如何承载同样的上下文梯度下降尚不清楚。
Method: GRIL 将一个有监督梯度步分解为短窗口叉积 (cross-product) 写入与下一查询的乘性读出，在矩阵状态中累积上下文梯度；同一设计可扩展到多步更新与交叉熵分类，并以基于 MLP 的有限扩展处理非线性回归。
Result: 线性回归下该构造在单次前向中累积上下文梯度，仅用 O(f^2) 个学习自由度；训练后的 GRIL 在合成 ICL 任务上恢复了解析预测的行为与参数，并在 Long Range Arena、语言建模与联想记忆等通用基准上完成训练。
Conclusion: 窗口化叉积自注意力是让 LRNN 通过类梯度下降更新实现上下文学习的具体归纳偏置，同时在通用任务上保持可训练性。

summary_sections.result: 线性回归下该构造在单次前向中累积上下文梯度，仅用 O(f^2) 个学习自由度；训练后的 GRIL 在合成 ICL 任务上恢复了解析预测的行为与参数，并在 Long Range Arena、语言建模与联想记忆等通用基准上完成训练。
summary_sections.conclusion: 窗口化叉积自注意力是让 LRNN 通过类梯度下降更新实现上下文学习的具体归纳偏置，同时在通用任务上保持可训练性。

papers.title: Requirement-Based Testing: Enhancing Reinforcement Learning with Game Theory
papers.abstract_en: We consider the automatic online synthesis of black-box test cases from functional requirements specified as automata for reactive implementations. The goal of the tester is to reach some given state, so as to satisfy a coverage criterion, while monitoring the violation of the requirements. We develop an approach based on Monte Carlo Tree Search, which is a classical technique in reinforcement learning for efficiently selecting promising inputs. Seeing the automata requirements as a game between the implementation and the tester, we develop a heuristic by biasing the search towards inputs that are promising in this game. We experimentally show that our heuristic accelerates the convergence of the Monte Carlo Tree Search algorithm, thus improving the performance of testing.
papers.journal_ref: FMCAD 2026 - Formal Methods in Computer-Aided Design, Sep 2026, Graz, France
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把用自动机给出的功能需求视为实现与测试者之间的博弈，用博弈启发式偏置 Monte Carlo Tree Search 的输入选择，在线合成黑盒测试用例以覆盖目标状态并监控需求违反。实验显示该启发式加快了 MCTS 的收敛，从而提升测试性能。
Motivation: 对反应式实现做黑盒测试时，需要在线合成能到达指定状态以满足覆盖准则、同时监控需求违反的输入序列；朴素 MCTS 选输入效率低。
Method: 以自动机规格描述功能需求，把实现与测试者建模为博弈；在 MCTS 的选择阶段用博弈启发式把搜索偏向对该博弈更有希望的输入，目标是到达给定状态以满足覆盖准则并监测需求违反。
Result: 实验表明该博弈启发式加速了 MCTS 算法的收敛，从而改善测试性能；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把需求自动机转成博弈并据此偏置 MCTS，是提升反应式实现在线测试用例合成效率的有效做法。

papers.title: Combining additivity and active subspaces for high-dimensional Gaussian process modeling
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian processes are a widely embraced technique for regression due to their good prediction accuracy, analytical tractability, and built-in capabilities for uncertainty quantification. However, they suffer from the curse of dimensionality whenever the number of variables increases. This challenge is generally addressed by assuming additional structure in the problem, the preferred options being either additivity or low intrinsic dimensionality. After discussing their relative merits, our contribution for high-dimensional Gaussian process modeling is to combine them with a multi-fidelity strategy. We detail the corresponding construction and showcase the advantages through experiments on synthetic functions and datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把可加性 (additivity) 与 active subspaces 低维结构结合，并接入多保真 (multi-fidelity) 策略，用于缓解高维高斯过程 (Gaussian process) 的维数灾难。作者讨论两种结构的相对优劣，并在合成函数与数据集上展示该组合构造的优势。
Motivation: 高斯过程回归随变量数增加遭遇维数灾难，通常只能在可加性与低内在维数两种结构假设中择一，单一结构在高维建模中各有局限。
Method: 在高维高斯过程建模中同时引入可加性结构与 active subspaces 低维结构，并结合 multi-fidelity 策略构造模型；相对优劣通过讨论与实验展示。
Result: 在合成函数 (synthetic functions) 和若干数据集上展示了该组合构造的优势，摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 可加性与 active subspaces 可以互补并配合多保真策略共同缓解高斯过程的维数灾难。

papers.title: FREIDA: A Framework for developing quantitative agent based models based on qualitative expert knowledge
papers.abstract_en: Agent Based Models (ABMs) often deal with systems where there is a lack of quantitative data or where quantitative data alone may be insufficient to fully capture the complexities of real-world systems. Expert knowledge and qualitative insights, such as those obtained through interviews, ethnographic research, historical accounts, or participatory workshops, are critical in constructing realistic behavioral rules, interactions, and decision-making processes within these models. However, there is a scarcity of systematic approaches that are able to incorporate both qualitative and quantitative data across the entire modeling cycle. To address this, we propose FREIDA, a systematic mixed-methods framework to develop, train, and validate ABMs, particularly in data-sparse contexts. The main technical innovation introduced within this framework is the extraction of what we call Expected System Behaviors (ESBs) from qualitative data, which are testable statements evaluated through model simulations. Divided into Calibration Statements (CS) for model calibration and Validation Statements (VS) for model validation, ESBs underpin a rigorous evaluation mechanism on the same footing as quantitative data. By structuring qualitative insights as explicit model constraints, FREIDA creates a transparent foundation for applying established modelling practices such as Sensitivity Analysis (SA) and Uncertainty Quantification (UQ), allowing modellers to assess parameter influence, model robustness, and remaining uncertainties in a systematic manner. Through this, qualitative insights can inform not only model specification but also parameterization, validation, and continuous improvement of model reliability and fitness for purpose, addressing a long-standing challenge in agent-based modeling. We illustrate the application of FREIDA through a case study of criminal cocaine networks in the Netherlands.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FREIDA 把访谈、民族志等定性专家知识抽成可由模型仿真检验的 Expected System Behaviors (ESBs)，并拆成用于标定的 Calibration Statements (CS) 与用于验证的 Validation Statements (VS)，使定性约束与定量数据在建模全流程中同等参与评估。框架同时为 Sensitivity Analysis (UQ/SA) 提供结构化输入，案例是荷兰可卡因犯罪网络的 ABM。
Motivation: 数据稀缺场景下 ABM 依赖访谈、历史记述等定性知识，但缺少把定性与定量数据贯穿建模、标定、验证全流程的系统方法，定性洞见难以被检验。
Method: 提出混合方法框架 FREIDA：从定性数据抽取可测试的 ESBs，分为 CS 与 VS 两类语句，作为与定量数据同等地位的评估机制；再据此做参数化、Sensitivity Analysis 与 Uncertainty Quantification，并以荷兰可卡因犯罪网络案例演示流程。
Result: 给出 ESB 抽取与 CS/VS 划分的评估机制，以及在荷兰可卡因犯罪网络案例上的应用演示；摘要未给出定量指标或基线对比。
Conclusion: 把定性洞见写成显式模型约束，可让 ABM 在数据稀缺条件下同时支撑标定、验证、敏感性分析与不确定性量化，提升模型可靠性与 fitness for purpose。

papers.title: Research on Deep Learning-Based Semantic Segmentation Algorithms for Subcortical Brain Structures
papers.abstract_en: Segmentation of subcortical brain structures is fundamental to computer-aided diagnosis and treatment in neurology and related clinical fields. To improve the accuracy of subcortical structure segmentation, this thesis develops two related deep learning approaches for brain MR images: DenseMedic and the alternate connected neural network (ACNN). The first part of the work develops DenseMedic. First, the OreoDown method accelerates receptive-field growth by introducing larger convolutional strides at earlier layers and restores network depth by interleaving size-preserving convolutional layers, thereby translating faster receptive-field growth into an effective increase in receptive field. Second, DenseMedic instantiates the OreoDown framework using the construction principle of DenseNet and obtains multiscale contextual information through densely connected feature-extraction operations. The second part develops ACNN. First, alternate connections between layers are proposed to instantiate OreoDown as a single-path ACNN. Second, the single path is divided centrally to form a multipath ACNN without changing the stated parameter count, providing a unified architecture for single- and multimodal segmentation. Experiments were conducted on the public IBSR and MRBrainS18 datasets for subcortical brain segmentation. Performance was evaluated using the Dice similarity coefficient (DSC), intersection over union (IoU), 95th-percentile Hausdorff surface distance (HSD95), and average surface distance (ASD). The experimental results showed greater regional overlap and closer boundary agreement between the predicted and reference structures, supporting the accuracy and robustness of both methods for the evaluated subcortical structures.
papers.comment: Substantially revised and expanded version of arXiv:1907.09194. FD-FCN was further developed into DenseMedic, and this version additionally presents the OreoDown framework and ACNN. Complete English translation of the 2020 Chinese master's thesis; 65 pages, 22 figures, 8 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向脑 MR 亚皮层结构分割提出 OreoDown 框架及其两个实例化：DenseMedic 用 DenseNet 式密集连接获取多尺度上下文，ACNN 用层间交替连接并在不改变参数量的前提下中心切分成多路径结构以统一单模态与多模态分割。在 IBSR 与 MRBrainS18 公开数据集上以 DSC、IoU、HSD95、ASD 评估，结果显示预测与参考结构的区域重叠更大、边界更贴合。
Motivation: 亚皮层脑结构分割是计算机辅助神经诊断与治疗的基础，需要在有限参数量下获得更大的有效感受野与多尺度上下文，以提升重叠精度与边界一致性。
Method: OreoDown 在浅层用更大卷积步长加速感受野增长，再交错插入保尺寸卷积层恢复网络深度；DenseMedic 按 DenseNet 构造原则实例化该框架，用密集连接的特征提取操作获取多尺度上下文；ACNN 以层间交替连接实例化为单路径，再中心切分为多路径，在参数量不变下支持单模态与多模态分割。
Result: 在公开 IBSR 与 MRBrainS18 数据集上做亚皮层脑分割实验，用 DSC、IoU、95 分位 Hausdorff 表面距离 (HSD95) 与平均表面距离 (ASD) 评估；结果显示预测与参考结构的区域重叠更大、边界更贴合，支持两种方法在所评估结构上的准确性与稳健性。
Conclusion: 以加速感受野增长的 OreoDown 为统一骨架，密集连接与交替连接两种实例化都能在亚皮层脑结构分割上取得更贴合的重叠与边界。

papers.title: Trajectory Abstraction for the Science of Language Agent Behavior
papers.abstract_en: Scientific studies of language agents need behavioral variables that support hypotheses across tasks and models. We formulate this research problem as learning and testing a hierarchy of trajectory abstractions. A concrete recursive procedure first measures role- and phase-indexed events, proposes temporally constrained relations, and tests their stability across conditions. It then constructs episode-level motif variables from selected relations and repeats the analysis on those variables. Explicit measurement functions connect every abstraction level to the original trajectories. Observations and randomized protocol experiments assess the resulting hypotheses, while comparisons between intervention realizations determine whether an abstraction should be retained, refined, or restricted. We derive a finite-depth bound for accepted reductions, identify protocol effects on fixed abstractions, and characterize realization disagreement and composition of abstraction error. A finite-sample test makes projected intervention consistency operational, and constructed examples illustrate motif construction and abstraction refinement. The formulation distinguishes this experimental approach from semantic taxonomies, qualitative theory induction, and behavior-model recovery. It specifies a proposed research procedure for discovering generalizable behavioral hypotheses, with literature-relative novelty assessed separately from model-relative surprise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把语言 agent 行为研究形式化为轨迹抽象 (trajectory abstraction) 层级的学习与检验：递归地先测角色与阶段索引事件、提出时间受限关系并检验其跨条件稳定性，再由入选关系构造 episode 级 motif 变量并重复分析，每层都有显式测量函数回连原始轨迹。给出被接受约化的有限深度界、协议效应对固定抽象的影响、实现分歧与抽象误差的分解，并用有限样本检验使投影干预一致性可操作。
Motivation: 语言 agent 的科学研究缺少能跨任务、跨模型支撑假设的行为变量，语义分类学、定性理论归纳与行为模型恢复都无法给出可检验、可回溯到原始轨迹的测量层级。
Method: 递归程序：测角色/阶段索引事件 → 提出时间受限关系 → 检验跨条件稳定性 → 构造 episode 级 motif 变量并重复分析；用显式测量函数连接各抽象层与原始轨迹，以观测加随机化协议实验评估假设，并用干预实现之间的比较决定抽象应保留、细化还是限制。
Result: 推导出被接受约化的有限深度界，识别协议效应对固定抽象的作用，刻画实现分歧与抽象误差的构成，并给出使投影干预一致性可操作的有限样本检验；构造性示例演示 motif 构造与抽象细化。
Conclusion: 该形式化给出一套发现可泛化行为假设的实验程序，并明确区分于语义分类学、定性理论归纳与行为模型恢复；文献相对新颖性与模型相对惊奇性分开评估。
Relevance: 0
