papers.title: Symmetry-Informed Causal Partial Identification
papers.abstract_en: Partial identification (PI) entails estimating bounds on causal effects by encoding different assumptions on data generation as a constrained optimization problem. Such bounds can suffice to inform policy decisions even if the causal effect itself is not identifiable. Often vacuous in practice, practitioners seek to exhaustively encode domain knowledge as additional constraints to make the PI bounds more informative. We introduce known data symmetries -- invariance of the causal effect under certain data transformations -- as a new source of constraints to inform PI. We operationalize this as a shape constraint on the causal function, and via a change of measure against which PI is posed using simple data pre-processing. Both approaches are shown to sharpen bounds under two canonical PI models. This is shown both theoretically for the population case, and via experiments in the finite-sample case. More broadly, our framework establishes data symmetries as a natural, underutilized source of background knowledge for robust causal inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把已知数据对称性（因果效应在某些数据变换下不变）作为新约束引入部分识别 (partial identification)，操作化为因果函数上的 shape constraint，以及通过简单数据预处理改变 PI 所依托的测度 (change of measure)。两种途径在两个经典 PI 模型上都能收紧因果效应界，理论上在总体情形成立，并在有限样本实验中验证。
Motivation: 部分识别的界常因约束不足而空洞 (vacuous)，实践者只能不断编码领域知识来让界更有信息量；对称性这一背景知识来源此前未被系统利用。
Method: 将数据对称性编码为两条互补路径：一是因果函数上的 shape constraint，二是针对 PI 优化问题的 change of measure，两者都通过简单的数据预处理实现，并在两个 canonical PI 模型上给出总体情形的理论结果与有限样本实验。
Result: 两种对称性约束途径在两个经典 PI 模型上均收紧了因果效应界；总体情形有理论刻画，有限样本情形由实验支持。
Conclusion: 数据对称性是稳健因果推断中一种自然且未被充分利用的背景知识来源，可作为收紧部分识别界的额外约束。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Conditional Accuracy Profiles: Diagnosing LLM Judges across Deployment Conditions
papers.abstract_en: LLM-as-judge is now a standard tool for scalable evaluation, but judge performance is still often summarized by a single accuracy number. This aggregate view hides the deployment conditions under which a judge succeeds or fails. We introduce \textbf{Conditional Accuracy Profiling} (CAP), a post-hoc diagnostic framework that decomposes pairwise LLM-judge accuracy into eight conditions organized into content sensitivity, robustness, and rationale quality. CAP is benchmark-agnostic: it can be applied directly when a benchmark provides the required annotations, approximately through task-subset proxies, or through controlled augmentation when perturbation pairs can be generated. We instantiate CAP on seven LLM judges across six pairwise judging benchmarks, including \textsc{judgerEva-Standard}, a controlled testbed we created to support all eight conditions. CAP exposes profile differences hidden by aggregate accuracy: on \textsc{judgerEva}'s judge-independent Hard-Constructed subset, the two judges most sensitive to omitted qualifications rank in the bottom three of seven by overall accuracy, so omission sensitivity is not predicted by aggregate accuracy. Across benchmarks, Position Robustness shows the strongest rank stability (mean Spearman $\barρ{=}0.87$) but is itself fragile under JudgeBench-Pro adversarial stress, showing the largest mean accuracy drop among the shared conditions, though the dominant degradation channel varies by judge. Condition-level profiles provide a more actionable basis than aggregate accuracy for selecting LLM judges.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出后验诊断框架 Conditional Accuracy Profiling (CAP)，把 LLM judge 的成对判断准确率拆成内容敏感性、鲁棒性、rationale 质量三组共八个条件，暴露单一聚合准确率掩盖的失败模式。在 7 个 judge、6 个成对判断基准上，遗漏敏感性与聚合准确率不相关，Position Robustness 排名最稳（平均 Spearman 0.87）却在 JudgeBench-Pro 对抗压力下出现共享条件中最大的平均准确率下降。
Motivation: LLM-as-judge 已成规模化评估的标准工具，但只用一个聚合准确率汇报，掩盖了 judge 在哪些部署条件下成功或失败，选 judge 缺少可操作依据。
Method: CAP 是 post-hoc 诊断框架，将成对判断准确率分解为八个条件，分属 content sensitivity、robustness、rationale quality 三类；框架 benchmark-agnostic，可直接用基准自带标注、用任务子集代理近似，或在能生成扰动对时用受控增强实现。作者在 7 个 LLM judge、6 个成对判断基准上实例化，并自建受控测试床 JudgerEva-Standard 以覆盖全部八个条件。
Result: 在 JudgerEva 的 judge-independent Hard-Constructed 子集上，对遗漏限定语 (omitted qualifications) 最敏感的两个 judge 在 7 个 judge 中总体准确率排倒数前三，说明遗漏敏感性无法由聚合准确率预测。跨基准 Position Robustness 的排名稳定性最强（平均 Spearman ρ̄=0.87），但在 JudgeBench-Pro 对抗压力下最脆弱，在共享条件中平均准确率降幅最大，且主导退化通道因 judge 而异。
Conclusion: 条件级 profile 比单一聚合准确率更能支持 LLM judge 的选择，因为聚合分数既预测不了特定失败模式，也会掩盖对抗压力下的脆弱性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Quantize by Drift: Label-Free Mixed-Precision Post-Training Quantization for Text Embedders
papers.abstract_en: Mixed-precision post-training quantization needs a per-module sensitivity signal; for a text embedder the obvious one -- the retrieval quality a module costs when quantized -- needs relevance labels that deployments rarely have. We measure a label-free substitute: quantization-induced representation drift, obtained by quantizing one module, re-encoding the corpus, and recording how far the output embeddings moved from their full-precision positions. What is specific is the observable: the deployed output representation a dense retriever ranks with. Across five development embedders, configuration-level drift orders sampled mixed-precision plans against held-out retrieval quality at a macro Spearman of 0.911, the sensitivity transports across calibration corpora and retrieval domains in the usable regime, module drifts compose rank-consistently but not numerically, and relevance-derived sensitivity adds no consistent value. The method is one additive allocation under a hard packed-byte budget, with no labels and no search. On three embedders held untouched until method, baselines and hypotheses were frozen and sealed, the pre-registered directional hypothesis against the prior LieQ criterion holds (3/3 at the main budget, no collapse) and drift scores above a two-sided LieQ steelman in 2/3; but at the main budget drift is numerically lower than same-budget uniform precision on all three (-0.99, -0.85, -1.01 points), having reduced module and whole-model drift as designed. Output drift is thus a robust coarse sensitivity signal, not a universally optimal allocation objective: it avoids the catastrophic failures of the transferred signed-geometry adaptation and can remain usable at stressed budgets where uniform collapses, but fine-grained redistribution around a strong uniform operating point remains unresolved.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出无标签混合精度训练后量化 (PTQ) 敏感度信号：量化单个模块、重编码语料、记录输出嵌入相对全精度的位移 (quantization-induced representation drift)。在五个开发 embedder 上，配置级 drift 对留出检索质量的 macro Spearman 达 0.911，且跨校准语料与检索域可迁移；但在三个预注册的封存 embedder 上，主预算下 drift 分配的检索分数反而低于同预算均匀精度 -0.99、-0.85、-1.01 点。
Motivation: 混合精度 PTQ 需要逐模块敏感度信号，文本 embedder 最自然的信号是量化后损失的检索质量，但部署场景通常没有相关性标签 (relevance labels)。
Method: 以量化诱导的表示漂移替代标签敏感度：逐个模块量化、重编码语料、度量输出嵌相对全精度位置的移动；在硬打包字节预算下做一次加性分配，无标签、无搜索。方法、基线与假设在三个封存 embedder 上冻结后做预注册检验，对照 prior LieQ criterion 与均匀精度。
Result: 五个开发 embedder 上配置级 drift 对留出检索质量 macro Spearman 0.911，敏感度可跨校准语料与检索域迁移，模块 drift 可按秩组合但数值不可加，相关性标签导出的敏感度无一致增益。封存三模型上预注册方向性假设对 LieQ 3/3 成立（主预算无崩溃），drift 在 2/3 上胜过双侧 LieQ steelman；但主预算下 drift 数值低于同预算均匀精度，三点分别为 -0.99、-0.85、-1.01。
Conclusion: 输出 drift 是稳健的粗粒度敏感度信号而非普适最优分配目标：它避开迁移 signed-geometry adaptation 的灾难性失败，并在均匀精度崩溃的紧张预算下保持可用，但围绕强均匀工作点的细粒度再分配仍未解决。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: FLoRa: Flight-Assisted Data Collection from Duty Cycling LoRa Nodes under Energy Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Data collection using Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) is challenging when LoRa IoT Devices (IoTDs) duty-cycle to conserve battery. Under energy constraints, a UAV must decide which IoTDs to visit, in what order, where to hover, and how many times to probe each node, while time-based data freshness decays. Tractably solving this problem requires a multi-level optimization architecture: discrete combinatorial optimization for routing, continuous global optimization for spatial positioning, and sequential decision-making under uncertainty. We propose FLoRa, a Flight-assisted LoRa data collection architecture using Simulated Annealing (SA) for path planning, Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES) for hover positioning, and Partially Observable Markov Decision Processes (POMDPs) for probing IoTDs. To quantify collection utility from duty-cycling nodes, we introduce the Value of Information for Pull-based systems (VIP), a metric that rewards fresh data and penalizes failed probes, imposing well-posedness and preventing indefinite probing when an IoTD is off. Tracking hard battery constraints on every POMDP sample path requires state augmentation, worsening the curse of dimensionality. For tractability, SA and CMA-ES work on the hard battery constraints, while at the POMDP layer we relax them into soft average constraints via Lagrangian relaxation. Since solving the network-wide POMDP is computationally complex, we decompose it into node-level POMDPs by approximating inter-node time dependency using a forward-decomposition technique. Evaluation shows FLoRa outperforms metaheuristic, greedy, and deep reinforcement learning baselines by 30.6%, 27.8%, and 15.2% in total expected VIP, while increasing node coverage by 24.5%, 29.2%, and 8.8%, and successful collections by 24.3%, 25.6%, and 15.2%, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FLoRa 面向占空比休眠的 LoRa 节点，用 Simulated Annealing 规划 UAV 路径、CMA-ES 优化悬停位置、POMDP 决定探测时机，并提出 VIP 指标奖励新鲜数据、惩罚失败探测。相比元启发式、贪心与深度强化学习基线，总期望 VIP 分别提升 30.6%、27.8%、15.2%，节点覆盖率提升 24.5%、29.2%、8.8%。
Motivation: LoRa IoT 节点为省电占空比休眠，UAV 采集需在能量与时效约束下同时决定访问顺序、悬停位置与探测次数，而网络级 POMDP 与逐节点硬电池约束使问题难以求解。
Method: 三层架构：Simulated Annealing 做离散路径规划，CMA-ES 做连续悬停定位，POMDP 处理探测决策；提出 Pull-based 的 Value of Information (VIP) 指标。SA 与 CMA-ES 层保留硬电池约束，POMDP 层用 Lagrangian relaxation 松弛为软平均约束，并用 forward-decomposition 把网络级 POMDP 分解为节点级子问题。
Result: 总期望 VIP 相对元启发式、贪心、深度强化学习基线分别高 30.6%、27.8%、15.2%；节点覆盖率分别高 24.5%、29.2%、8.8%；成功采集数分别高 24.3%、25.6%、15.2%。
Conclusion: 把硬电池约束分层处理（组合/连续层保留、POMDP 层松弛）并按节点分解，可在占空比 LoRa 网络的 UAV 采集上同时提高数据新鲜度效用、覆盖率与成功采集数。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: PVSync: A Unified Lip-Sync Expert for Timing and Articulation
papers.abstract_en: Lip movements can match the timing of speech without matching the spoken sounds. We introduce PVSync, a unified model for audio-visual offset estimation and phoneme-level articulation scoring. PVSync combines window-level contrastive learning for synchronisation with a phoneme-level articulation objective that aligns audio and video embeddings of the same viseme class across clips. Visemes group phonemes with similar visible articulation. Viseme labels are derived automatically from forced-aligned transcripts, without manual annotations. On offset-corrected videos from 13 talking-head video generation models, PVSync matches human rankings of lip-sync quality more closely than LSE-C, achieving a Spearman correlation of 0.83 versus 0.34. On an automatically constructed benchmark from held-out speech, PVSync distinguishes viseme-matched from mismatched audio-visual pairs with an ROC AUC of 0.91. PVSync also outperforms SyncNet and MTD-VocaLiST in temporal offset recovery on held-out in-the-wild clips. Code and benchmark data will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PVSync 把唇形同步拆成时间对齐与发音质量两件事：窗口级对比学习估音画偏移，音素级目标对齐同一 viseme 类的音视频嵌入。在 13 个说话头生成模型的偏移校正视频上，其与人工唇同步质量排序的 Spearman 相关为 0.83（LSE-C 为 0.34），在留出语音构造的基准上区分 viseme 匹配/失配对的 ROC AUC 为 0.91。
Motivation: 唇形可以对上说话节奏却对不上实际发音，现有同步指标（如 LSE-C）与人工质量排序相关性低，无法衡量发音层面的正确性。
Method: PVSync 联合窗口级对比学习（同步/偏移估计）与音素级 articulation 目标，把同一 viseme 类的跨片段音视频嵌入拉近；viseme 标签由强制对齐 (forced alignment) 的转写自动导出，无需人工标注。
Result: 在 13 个说话头视频生成模型的偏移校正视频上，与人工排序的 Spearman 相关 0.83，对比 LSE-C 的 0.34；在由留出语音自动构造的基准上，区分 viseme 匹配与失配音视频对的 ROC AUC 为 0.91；在留出野外片段的时序偏移恢复上优于 SyncNet 与 MTD-VocaLiST。
Conclusion: 把时间同步与 viseme 级发音分开建模，能比纯同步指标更贴近人类对唇同步质量的判断；代码与基准数据计划在接收后发布。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Consistent Distribution Matching for Data-Free Diffusion Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Flow and diffusion models suffer from slow inference due to computationally expensive numerical integration. Distillation provides a promising way for a student model to learn from a teacher's dynamics, enabling one-step or few-step generation. However, existing methods often depend on curated distillation datasets, costly teacher rollouts, or auxiliary proxy networks, which complicate model training and scaling. In this work, we propose Consistent Distribution Matching, a simulation-free and data-free distillation method for accelerating diffusion and flow models while preserving strong generative capacity. Our key insight is to unify sample generation and score estimation with one student network. Thus, our framework uses only two models, a frozen teacher and a trainable student, and optimizes one objective. We prove that minimizing our objective indicates Wasserstein convergence of the student flow-map pushforwards to the teacher marginals. On ImageNet 256$\times$256, our method attains an FID of 2.04 with a single function evaluation (1-NFE) and a 4-NFE FID of 1.37 within 40 epochs of training, surpassing the state-of-the-art distillation baselines without data. Our code code and model are available at https://consistentdmd.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Consistent Distribution Matching：用一个学生网络同时承担样本生成与 score 估计，仅靠冻结教师与可训练学生两个模型、单一目标做无模拟无数据的扩散/流模型蒸馏。在 ImageNet 256×256 上 1-NFE FID 2.04、4-NFE FID 1.37，训练 40 epochs 内超过无数据蒸馏的 SOTA 基线。
Motivation: 扩散与流模型推理需多步数值积分，代价高；现有蒸馏方法依赖精选蒸馏数据集、昂贵的 teacher rollout 或额外代理网络，训练与扩展都变复杂。
Method: Consistent Distribution Matching：把样本生成与 score 估计统一到同一个学生网络，框架只含冻结 teacher 与可训练 student 两个模型，优化单一目标，且无需模拟 (simulation-free) 与数据 (data-free)；并证明最小化该目标意味着学生 flow-map pushforward 在 Wasserstein 距离下收敛到 teacher 边缘分布。
Result: ImageNet 256×256 上，1-NFE FID 2.04，4-NFE FID 1.37，训练 40 epochs 内达成，超过无数据设置下的 SOTA 蒸馏基线。
Conclusion: 把生成与 score 估计合到一个学生网络并用单一分布匹配目标，可在不依赖数据、teacher rollout 或代理网络的前提下做出少步蒸馏且保留强生成能力。

papers.title: CM-DPO: Constraint-Margin Direct Preference Optimization for LLM Planning
papers.abstract_en: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) treats all constraint violations equally: a $1 budget overshoot and a $1,000 overshoot induce the same training signal. It is also susceptible to length and style bias when preference pairs come from different model families. We introduce Constraint-Margin DPO (CM-DPO), which replaces DPO's binary preference signal with a continuous margin derived from a deterministic symbolic verifier and scaled by violation severity. Hard and soft constraints are separated through a lexicographic objective, ensuring hard constraints are never traded off against preferences. To supply CM-DPO with bias-reduced training pairs, we generate preference data through procedurally generated constraint profiles (DCCG) and minimal-edit distillation from a reasoning teacher (RT-MED), within a framework we call SynPlan-R. On TravelPlanner, NaturalPlan, and out-of-distribution PlanBench, an 8B model fine-tuned with CM-DPO achieves 89.2% pass rate and 93.4% solve rate, matching multi-agent systems at 13x lower latency while outperforming GPT-4o on unseen Blocksworld by 9.2 points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CM-DPO 用确定性符号验证器给出的连续 margin 替换 DPO 的二元偏好信号，按违规严重度缩放，并用字典序目标把硬约束与偏好分开，硬约束永不被偏好抵消。在 TravelPlanner、NaturalPlan 与分布外 PlanBench 上，8B 模型微调后 pass rate 89.2%、solve rate 93.4%，延迟比多智能体系统低 13 倍，在未见 Blocksworld 上超 GPT-4o 9.2 个百分点。
Motivation: DPO 把 1 美元与 1,000 美元的预算超支当成同等强度的训练信号，且当偏好对来自不同模型族时易受长度与风格偏置影响，约束规划场景下这两种缺陷都会误导优化。
Method: CM-DPO 由确定性符号验证器生成按违规严重度缩放的连续 margin，替代 DPO 的二元偏好信号；用字典序目标 (lexicographic objective) 分离硬约束与软约束。训练数据由程序化生成的约束 profile (DCCG) 与从推理教师做最小编辑蒸馏 (RT-MED) 得到，两者合称 SynPlan-R 框架。
Result: 在 TravelPlanner、NaturalPlan 与分布外 PlanBench 上，CM-DPO 微调的 8B 模型 pass rate 89.2%、solve rate 93.4%；与多智能体系统持平而延迟低 13 倍；在未见 Blocksworld 上比 GPT-4o 高 9.2 个百分点。
Conclusion: 把约束违规的严重度编码进偏好信号并用字典序保住硬约束，可以在单个 8B 模型上以低延迟达到多智能体系统的规划表现，并在分布外规划任务上超过 GPT-4o。

papers.title: RLDISCOVER: LLM-driven co-evolution of reinforcement learning algorithms
papers.abstract_en: LLM-guided program evolution has enabled discoveries in mathematics and computational optimization, raising the prospect of reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms that self-evolve to improve how agents learn. However, realizing this prospect faces two obstacles. Joint search over coupled algorithmic components is difficult to scale: simultaneous changes can disrupt learning, while isolated changes overlook their dependencies. Evaluating candidate algorithms also requires costly training, with fitness remaining uncertain across random seeds. We introduce RLDiscover, a framework for the self-evolution of model-free deep RL algorithms. Progressive Co-Evolution advances from targeted component edits to joint evolution, while Progressive Probabilistic Evaluation balances search breadth and evaluation fidelity through staged training and repeated evaluation. Experiments across SAC, PPO, and DQN on four benchmark suites show substantial improvements in mean return, with per-family median gains of 32%-84% and a peak return ratio of approximately 363x over a near-zero baseline. These gains include transitions from failed learning to successful task completion, and improvements persist when evolution starts from stronger open-source implementations. On measured SAC locomotion runs, evaluation uses approximately one-fifteenth the estimated compute required to fully evaluate the same candidate pool. Remarkably, independent searches repeatedly discover interpretable combinations of adaptive robust losses, progress-dependent value targets, and running statistics, with selected programs transferring to unseen tasks. These findings point toward a broader role for self-evolution in AI: discovering interpretable algorithms that improve how agents learn.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RLDiscover 让 LLM 驱动的程序进化自动生成无模型深度 RL 算法：Progressive Co-Evolution 从单组件编辑推进到联合进化，Progressive Probabilistic Evaluation 用分阶段训练与重复评估控制评测成本。在 SAC、PPO、DQN 四个基准套件上，各族中位回报提升 32%–84%，峰值回报比约 363 倍于近零基线，且评测只用约 1/15 的估计算力。
Motivation: LLM 引导的程序进化已在数学与组合优化中成功，但 RL 算法的耦合组件难以联合搜索：单独改会忽略依赖，同时改又会破坏学习；候选算法还要昂贵训练且跨随机种子 fitness 不稳。
Method: RLDiscover 含两个核心组件：Progressive Co-Evolution 先做定向组件编辑再转向联合进化，Progressive Probabilistic Evaluation 用分阶段训练 (staged training) 与重复评估在搜索广度和评测保真度之间折中；在 SAC、PPO、DQN 上进化。
Result: 四个基准套件上各族中位回报增益 32%–84%，峰值回报比约 363 倍于近零基线；部分任务从学习失败转为完成；从更强开源实现起步进化仍有提升；SAC locomotion 实测中评测只用约 1/15 估计算力即可评完同一候选池。
Conclusion: 自进化能反复找到可解释的组合（adaptive robust losses、progress-dependent value targets、running statistics），选出的程序可迁移到未见任务，指向用自进化发现可解释学习算法这条路。

papers.title: A Deterministic Evidence Layer for Vision-Language Autism Screening from Naturalistic Home Video
papers.abstract_en: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is diagnosed through specialist observation of a child's social behavior, and access to that expertise is the bottleneck for early identification. Vision-language models (VLMs) describe a child's behavior from video well; the verdict drawn from the description is unstable: at temperature~0, across eight pipeline configurations on one backbone, 16--37\% of clips change their predicted label between repeated runs, and the cause lies in the serving stack. We keep the VLM frozen and move the decision out of the model. Under our grounded perception constraints the VLM writes an event table of timestamped, glossary-labeled events that names the eliciting press and logs counter-evidence; a text-only stage age-calibrates the confidence of each row; a deterministic weight-of-evidence scorer sums it into an evidence total and stratifies it into a risk category, so every decision decomposes into named per-feature contributions and can be re-scored from the saved table. On 43 caregiver-recorded, protocol-free home free-play clips of preschool children, the pipeline reaches AUC $0.851 \pm 0.012$, 86.0\% accuracy, and F$_1$ 71.8 over three runs. It labels 74.4\% of clips correctly in every run (60.5\% for the zero-shot baseline) and flags no typically developing clip in every run (9 of 31 at zero-shot). An ablation on the same backbone attributes the gain to the grounded perception constraints read through the deterministic scorer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 自闭症筛查中 VLM 即使在 temperature=0 下判定也不稳定：同一 backbone 的八种 pipeline 配置里有 16–37% 的片段在重复运行间改变预测标签，问题出在 serving stack。作者冻结 VLM，让它在 grounded perception constraints 下写出带时间戳和术语表标签的事件表，再由纯文本阶段做年龄校准、确定性 weight-of-evidence 打分器汇总成分级风险类别，使每个判定可拆解为具名特征贡献并可从保存的事件表重算。在 43 段学龄前儿童家庭自由玩耍录像上，三次运行 AUC 0.851±0.012、准确率 86.0%、F1 71.8。
Motivation: 自闭症早期识别的瓶颈是专科医生稀缺，而 VLM 虽能描述儿童行为，其从描述得出的判定在重复运行间不稳定，无法支撑可复核的筛查结论。
Method: 冻结 VLM，把决策移出模型：在 grounded perception constraints 下由 VLM 输出带时间戳、术语表标签的事件表（记录触发性动作与反证），纯文本阶段对每行做年龄校准，确定性 weight-of-evidence 打分器求和得到证据总量并分层为风险类别；同一 backbone 上做消融。
Result: 在 43 段照护者录制、无协议的家庭自由玩耍录像上，三次运行 AUC 0.851±0.012、准确率 86.0%、F1 71.8；74.4% 的片段三次全部判对（zero-shot 基线 60.5%）；三次均不误标任何典型发育片段（zero-shot 为 31 段中的 9 段）。基线在 temperature=0 时 16–37% 的片段重复运行间标签改变。
Conclusion: 把判定从冻结的 VLM 中移出、交给可审计的确定性证据打分，能在家庭录像筛查上同时提高稳定性与准确率；消融把增益归因于经确定性打分器读取的 grounded perception constraints。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: AGAR: a reinforcement learning substrate for LLM program evolution
papers.abstract_en: Given a task and an evaluator, a language model can rewrite a candidate program while a search loop decides which rewrites survive, offering a practical route to algorithm discovery. But that loop is governed by five constants set by hand: which parent to select, how hard to mutate, how to keep diversity, what to remember, and a scalar score that never says which part of the program earned it. Reinforcement learning already has an estimator for each. The obstacle is that program evolution is not usually written down as a decision process. We formalize it as a Markov decision process whose action is the modular prefix the model is conditioned on, rather than the program it emits. Credit assignment, value estimation, adaptive exploration, and experience memory can then attach to distinct components. AGAR (Algorithm Generation As RL) provides the resulting substrate: any estimator can be replaced or switched off without changing the controller, making the transfer auditable one mechanism at a time, with no gradient training of the backend model. Across 19 tasks, two backends, and three seeds under one harness, AGAR improves on the stronger of two published baselines on most tasks, with gains concentrated in the competitive-programming family. The formalization also yields a checkable reading of prior work: these systems are implicitly zero-discount, not by choice, but because fitness is exogenous to an individual rather than a return over successors, leaving a discount factor nothing to act on.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AGAR 把 LLM 程序进化重写为 MDP，动作是模型被条件化的模块化前缀而非其输出程序，从而让 credit assignment、value estimation、adaptive exploration、experience memory 各自挂到独立组件上，且后端模型无需梯度训练。在 19 个任务、2 个后端、3 个种子的统一 harness 下，AGAR 在多数任务上超过两个已发表基线中较强的一个，增益集中在竞赛编程类任务。
Motivation: LLM 程序搜索循环由五个手工常数控制（选父代、变异强度、多样性、记忆、标量分数），标量分数不指出程序哪部分挣得奖励，且程序进化通常没有被写成决策过程，RL 的估计器无处可挂。
Method: 将程序进化形式化为 MDP，动作取为模型被条件化的模块化前缀；在此之上提供 AGAR (Algorithm Generation As RL) 基底，credit assignment、value estimation、adaptive exploration、experience memory 分别对应可替换或关闭的估计器，控制器不变，后端模型不做梯度训练。
Result: 在 19 个任务、2 个后端、3 个种子、单一 harness 下，AGAR 在多数任务上优于两个已发表基线中较强的一个，收益集中在竞赛编程 (competitive programming) 任务族。形式化还给出对既有工作的可检验解读：这些系统隐式地是零折扣 (zero-discount)，因为 fitness 对个体是外生的而非后继上的 return。
Conclusion: 把程序进化写成 MDP 后，五个手工常数可逐个换成 RL 估计器并单独审计迁移效果；零折扣不是设计选择，而是 fitness 外生于个体导致折扣因子无事可做的必然结果。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.motivation: LLM 程序搜索循环由五个手工常数控制（选父代、变异强度、多样性、记忆、标量分数），标量分数不指出程序哪部分挣得奖励，且程序进化通常没有被写成决策过程，RL 的估计器无处可挂。

papers.title: CurveTQ: Rotation-Free Trellis Quantization of LLM Weights via Curvature-Weighted Search
papers.abstract_en: The best two-bit weight quantizers for large language models, such as QTIP and Proteus, rotate each weight matrix by a random orthogonal transform, which must be undone at every decoding step, then encode it with a trellis or lattice code under a Euclidean search; the layer Hessian enters only through error feedback between coding blocks. We show that this leaves part of the Hessian unused. Error feedback turns the loss into a weighted sum of per-coordinate rounding errors whose weights, the diagonal of the Hessian's LDL factorization, existing quantizers compute but never read. We put these weights into the Viterbi branch metric, so the search follows the curvature within each coding block. This also explains the rotation: it removes this within-block variation, so weighting in the native basis and rotating are substitutes. On three models the weighted native search matches a full-dimension randomized Hadamard to within about one point of downstream accuracy, and weighting after the rotation gains little. Around this search we build CurveTQ, a trellis codec with no rotation, which handles the weights' amplitude and marginal shape with a factored scale field and a closed-form quantile table, and stores a start state per coding block so the trellis can adapt to the residual that error feedback carries into it. At two bits CurveTQ is 1-3 points higher in mean downstream accuracy than QTIP and Proteus on three 4-8B Instruct models, even after both are given our start state, which alone lifts either baseline by 1-3 points. It also leads on a 35B mixture of experts, to our knowledge the first trellis-coded result on such a model. With no rotation to undo, our decoder is the fastest of the three at all tested batch sizes and bit widths.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CurveTQ 把 Hessian 的 LDL 对角权重直接放进 Viterbi 分支度量，使 trellis 搜索沿块内曲率走，从而免去随机正交旋转：在三个 4–8B Instruct 模型的 2-bit 权重上，平均下游精度比 QTIP 和 Proteus 高 1–3 点，且解码器在所有测试 batch 与位宽下最快。
Motivation: QTIP、Proteus 等 2-bit 量化器每步解码都要撤销随机正交变换，且 Hessian 只用于编码块间的误差反馈，LDL 分解对角这一已算出的曲率权重从未被读取，块内搜索仍是欧氏度量。
Method: 把 Hessian LDL 分解的对角权重写入 Viterbi 分支度量，让搜索在编码块内沿曲率走；据此解释旋转的作用是消除块内变化，故原生基加权与旋转互为替代。CurveTQ 进一步去掉旋转，用 factored scale field 处理幅度与边缘形状、闭式分位数表 (closed-form quantile table) 量化，并为每个编码块存一个起始状态以承接误差反馈传入的残差。
Result: 在三个模型上，加权原生搜索与全维随机 Hadamard 的下游精度差距约 1 点，旋转后再加权收益很小。2-bit 下 CurveTQ 在三个 4–8B Instruct 模型上平均下游精度比 QTIP 和 Proteus 高 1–3 点，即使给两个基线同样的起始状态（该起始状态单独可给任一基线带来 1–3 点提升）；在 35B MoE 上同样领先，据作者所知是该规模模型上首个 trellis 编码结果；无旋转使其解码器在所有测试 batch 尺寸与位宽下均为三者最快。
Conclusion: 块内曲率加权可以取代随机旋转：把 Hessian 权重读进搜索本身，就能在免旋转的同时超过需要逐步撤销旋转的 QTIP 与 Proteus。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Multi-Objective Aligned Small Language Model Framework for SUD Patient Dialogue Generation
papers.abstract_en: Substance Use Disorder (SUD) counseling requires patient responses that reflect underlying cognitive states such as beliefs, coping strategies, and readiness for change. Although large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent text, they often fail to produce cognitively coherent and clinically realistic patient behavior, especially under ethical and data-scarce clinical settings. Moreover, deploying frontier-scale LLMs in healthcare applications presents practical challenges including high computational cost, latency, privacy concerns, and limited deployability in resource-constrained environments, motivating the need for cognitively aligned small language models (SLMs). We propose a cognitively grounded framework for SUD patient dialogue generation that explicitly models and aligns latent cognitive components with patient histories and counselor questions. Our pipeline consists of two stages: cognitive component detection and cognitive component-aligned dialogue generation. To enable effective learning with smaller models, we combine knowledge distillation from high-capacity teacher models, preference optimization from human-annotations, and attention-guided reward shaping. Extensive evaluations using automatic scores like BERTScore, ROUGE, METEOR and BLEU, and LLM-as-judge hit-metrics against both human and teacher-model references show that cognitively informed fine-tuning substantially improves cognitive realization and alignment over a generic instruction-tuned baselines and mental health domain specific SLMs, with particularly strong gains for open-ended cognitive components.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向物质使用障碍 (SUD) 咨询的患者对话生成，提出两阶段认知对齐框架：先检测认知成分（信念、应对策略、改变准备度），再生成与之对齐的患者回应。用知识蒸馏 + 人工标注偏好优化 + 注意力引导的奖励塑形训练小语言模型，自动指标与 LLM-as-judge 命中率均显示认知实现度和对齐度显著优于通用指令微调基线与心理健康领域 SLM，开放式认知成分提升尤其明显。
Motivation: LLM 生成的 SUD 患者回应缺乏认知一致性与临床真实性，而前沿大模型在医疗场景面临算力、延迟、隐私与可部署性约束，需要认知对齐的小语言模型。
Method: 两阶段流水线：认知成分检测 + 认知成分对齐的对话生成；训练上结合高容量教师模型的知识蒸馏、人工标注的偏好优化 (preference optimization) 与注意力引导的奖励塑形 (attention-guided reward shaping)。
Result: 评测用 BERTScore、ROUGE、METEOR、BLEU 自动指标及 LLM-as-judge 命中率，对照人类参考与教师模型参考；认知信息微调在认知实现与对齐上显著优于通用指令微调基线和心理健康领域专用 SLM，开放式认知成分增益尤其大。
Conclusion: 把潜在认知成分显式建模并对齐到患者历史与咨询师提问，能让小语言模型在数据稀缺的临床对话中生成更认知一致、更临床真实的患者行为。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Sketched Calibration for Conformal Prediction under Covariate Shift
papers.abstract_en: Weighted conformal prediction corrects for covariate shift by reweighting calibration scores with the likelihood ratio between target and source covariates. Its cost grows with the chi-square divergence between the two covariate laws, typically exponentially in the size of the shift, and much of it can be paid for shift in directions that do not affect the response. We propose sketched calibration: weighted conformal prediction with the ratio of compressed covariates $Z=T(X)$, used in the weights and optionally in the score. Compression never increases the shift-dependent calibration cost, and target coverage is at least $1-α-Δ_T$, where the leakage $Δ_T$ measures how much of the discarded shift reappears as a change in the law of the response, or of the score, given $Z$. The leakage is a covariance between the discarded shift and the response on the fibres of the sketch; it vanishes when the sketch is sufficient or retains the shift, and a minimax construction shows that no threshold rule for a fixed score can avoid it. In a heteroscedastic simulation where unweighted calibration fails, a one-dimensional sketch cuts the fraction of infinite prediction sets from $37.8\%$ to $8.0\%$ at mean coverage $92.3\%$ for a $90\%$ target; nonlinear and real-data experiments show when learned sketches succeed and when they fail.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在协变量偏移下用压缩后的协变量 Z=T(X) 计算加权共形预测 (weighted conformal prediction) 的似然比权重，把校准代价压到与偏移方向中不影响响应的部分无关。压缩永不增加随偏移增长的校准代价，目标覆盖率至少为 1-α-Δ_T，其中泄漏 Δ_T 度量被丢弃的偏移在给定 Z 时对响应或分数分布的重现；异方差模拟中一维 sketch 把无限预测集比例从 37.8% 降到 8.0%。
Motivation: 加权共形预测的校准代价随目标与源协变量分布的卡方散度增长、通常随偏移规模指数上升，而其中相当一部分代价花在对响应毫无影响的偏移方向上。
Method: 提出 sketched calibration：先用压缩映射 Z=T(X) 得到压缩协变量，用其似然比做加权共形预测的权重，并可选地用于分数；给出覆盖率界 1-α-Δ_T，把泄漏 Δ_T 刻画为被丢弃偏移与响应在 sketch 纤维上的协方差，并用 minimax 构造证明固定分数下任何阈值规则都无法避免该泄漏。
Result: 在无加权校准即失效的异方差模拟中，一维 sketch 使无限预测集比例从 37.8% 降到 8.0%，平均覆盖率 92.3%（90% 目标）；另有非线性与真实数据实验说明学习型 sketch 何时成功、何时失败。
Conclusion: 只要 sketch 对偏移充分或保留了偏移，泄漏 Δ_T 就消失，压缩因此不会牺牲覆盖率；但 minimax 构造表明固定分数下阈值规则无法完全规避泄漏，学习型 sketch 有成败之分。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: An Accuracy--Information Tradeoff for Loss-Difference Conditional Mutual Information
papers.abstract_en: Loss-difference conditional mutual information (ld-CMI) uses the smallest of the standard observations in the supersample hierarchy of generalization bounds: it measures what a learner's loss differences reveal about which candidate of each pair it was trained on. Accuracy is known to force information into the model; data processing does not carry such lower bounds to losses. We show, by bounding three moments of the loss differences, that accuracy also forces ld-CMI. For linear predictors with a smooth convex loss of nonzero slope at zero, such as the logistic loss, plus a regularizer whose curvature and growth are both of power $r\ge2$, on product distributions over a scaled sign cube in dimension at least linear in $n$, every proper learner with expected excess risk at most $\varepsilon$ on these distributions at the optimal sample size $n\asymp\varepsilon^{-2+2/r}$ has worst-case ld-CMI of order $n$ bits, and $Θ(n/(1+(τ/\varepsilon)^2))$ bits under Gaussian noise of standard deviation $τ$ on the loss differences. The same holds without a regularizer, at $n\asymp\varepsilon^{-2}$. Consequently, range-scaled ld-CMI bounds cannot vanish on these distributions, although every proper learner's generalization gap is $O(n^{-1/2})$. We also show that model-level information does not determine noisy loss-difference information, and that the growth, slope and dimension conditions are needed, the last up to a logarithm.
papers.comment: 61 pages, of which 8 pages main text. Code, data and the Lean 4 formalization are in the ancillary files
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明在一般化理论中，精度会强制学习器的损失差条件互信息 (ld-CMI) 达到 n 比特量级：对线性预测器加光滑凸损失（如 logistic）与幂次 r≥2 的正则化，在 scaled sign cube 的乘积分布上，任何期望超额风险 ≤ ε 的 proper learner 在最优样本量 n≈ε^{-2+2/r} 下最坏情形 ld-CMI 为 Θ(n) 比特；高斯噪声标准差 τ 下为 Θ(n/(1+(τ/ε)²)) 比特。结论是范围缩放的 ld-CMI 界在这些分布上不可能趋零，即便所有 proper learner 的 generalization gap 只有 O(n^{-1/2})。
Motivation: supersample 层级的一般化界中，ld-CMI 用的是最小的标准观测量；已知精度会把信息压进模型，但 data processing 无法把该下界传到损失上，导致基于 ld-CMI 的界可能与实际泛化差距脱节。
Method: 通过界定损失差的三个矩来证明精度强制 ld-CMI；设定为线性预测器 + 在零点非零斜率的光滑凸损失（如 logistic loss）+ 曲率与增长均为幂次 r≥2 的正则化，分布为 scaled sign cube 上的乘积分布且维度至少与 n 同阶；另给出无正则化时 n≈ε^{-2} 的情形，并用 Lean 4 形式化。
Result: 最优样本量 n≈ε^{-2+2/r} 下，任何期望超额风险 ≤ ε 的 proper learner 最坏情形 ld-CMI 为 Θ(n) 比特；损失差上高斯噪声标准差 τ 时为 Θ(n/(1+(τ/ε)²)) 比特；无正则化时在 n≈ε^{-2} 同样成立。范围缩放的 ld-CMI 界在这些分布上不趋零，而 generalization gap 为 O(n^{-1/2})。另证模型级信息不决定含噪损失差信息，且增长、斜率与维度条件均必要（维度条件差一个对数）。
Conclusion: 精度本身强制 ld-CMI 达到 n 比特量级，因此范围缩放的 ld-CMI 界在这些分布上无法消失，即便实际泛化差距随 n^{-1/2} 收敛；增长、斜率与维度条件对该下界是必要的。

summary_sections.tldr: 证明在一般化理论中，精度会强制学习器的损失差条件互信息 (ld-CMI) 达到 n 比特量级：对线性预测器加光滑凸损失（如 logistic）与幂次 r≥2 的正则化，在 scaled sign cube 的乘积分布上，任何期望超额风险 ≤ ε 的 proper learner 在最优样本量 n≈ε^{-2+2/r} 下最坏情形 ld-CMI 为 Θ(n) 比特；高斯噪声标准差 τ 下为 Θ(n/(1+(τ/ε)²)) 比特。结论是范围缩放的 ld-CMI 界在这些分布上不可能趋零，即便所有 proper learner 的 generalization gap 只有 O(n^{-1/2})。

summary_sections.method: 通过界定损失差的三个矩来证明精度强制 ld-CMI；设定为线性预测器 + 在零点非零斜率的光滑凸损失（如 logistic loss）+ 曲率与增长均为幂次 r≥2 的正则化，分布为 scaled sign cube 上的乘积分布且维度至少与 n 同阶；另给出无正则化时 n≈ε^{-2} 的情形，并用 Lean 4 形式化。
summary_sections.result: 最优样本量 n≈ε^{-2+2/r} 下，任何期望超额风险 ≤ ε 的 proper learner 最坏情形 ld-CMI 为 Θ(n) 比特；损失差上高斯噪声标准差 τ 时为 Θ(n/(1+(τ/ε)²)) 比特；无正则化时在 n≈ε^{-2} 同样成立。范围缩放的 ld-CMI 界在这些分布上不趋零，而 generalization gap 为 O(n^{-1/2})。另证模型级信息不决定含噪损失差信息，且增长、斜率与维度条件均必要（维度条件差一个对数）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 精度本身强制 ld-CMI 达到 n 比特量级，因此范围缩放的 ld-CMI 界在这些分布上无法消失，即便实际泛化差距随 n^{-1/2} 收敛；增长、斜率与维度条件对该下界是必要的。

papers.title: Do Vision Models Learn Physical Constraints or Rendering Shortcuts? A Counterfactual Benchmark for Grounded Physical Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Modern image editing models can satisfy a text instruction while breaking the physics of the edited scene. A new object may cast no shadow, a mirror may fail to reflect visible geometry, or an object may float above a surface that should support it. We study physical plausibility diagnosis, detecting whether an edited image violates scene physics, naming the violation type, localizing the affected region, and explaining the failure in language. We introduce a counterfactual benchmark whose controlled synthetic component uses Mitsuba~3 to generate 5,500 images from 500 scene families. Each family contains one clean image and ten matched violations involving shadows, reflection, support, surface response, and occlusion. The renderer pipeline provides category labels, affected-region masks and boxes, scene metadata, and explanation targets. We use LLaVA-1.5-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and InternVL3.5-8B as diagnostic baselines rather than proposed methods. On a 1,650-image synthetic test set, the adapted baselines reach 64.0--67.8\% category macro-F1 on standard held-out scenes. For LLaVA-1.5-7B, category macro-F1 falls from 64.0\% on the standard split to 40.8\% under intervention shift. This gap shows that high in-distribution accuracy partly reflects cues tied to rendering and counterfactual construction.
papers.comment: Accepted in NeurIPS 2026 the 1st Workshop on Physical World AI
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出物理一致性反事实基准：用 Mitsuba 3 渲染 5,500 张图（500 个场景族，每族 1 张干净图 + 10 种匹配违规），诊断图像编辑是否违反阴影、反射、支撑、表面响应、遮挡等场景物理。在 1,650 张合成测试集上，适配后的 LLaVA-1.5-7B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B、InternVL3.5-8B 类别 macro-F1 达 64.0–67.8%，但 LLaVA-1.5-7B 在干预偏移下从 64.0% 跌到 40.8%，说明高分布内准确率部分来自渲染与反事实构造的捷径。
Motivation: 图像编辑模型可以满足文本指令却破坏场景物理（无阴影、镜面不反射、物体悬空），而现有评测无法区分模型真的懂物理约束还是记住了渲染线索。
Method: 构建受控合成反事实基准：Mitsuba 3 渲染 500 个场景族共 5,500 张图，每族含 1 张干净图与 10 种匹配违规，管线输出类别标签、受影响区域 mask/box、场景元数据与解释目标；用 LLaVA-1.5-7B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B、InternVL3.5-8B 作为诊断基线（非所提方法），在标准留出与干预偏移两种划分上测类别 macro-F1。
Result: 1,650 张合成测试集上，适配基线在标准留出场景的类别 macro-F1 为 64.0–67.8%；LLaVA-1.5-7B 从标准划分的 64.0% 降至干预偏移下的 40.8%。
Conclusion: 高分布内准确率部分反映与渲染和反事实构造绑定的线索，物理一致性诊断必须在干预偏移下检验才算数。

papers.title: Few Bits, One Law: Toward W2A4KV2
papers.abstract_en: Extreme low-bit LLM compression is most challenging when weights, activations, and KV caches are quantized together: their distributions differ, and quantization errors interact throughout the network. We introduce CanonQ, a unified quantization-aware training framework that addresses these challenges by separating source canonicalization from task-aware adaptation. Fixed rotations and energy normalization map heterogeneous tensor sources to canonical coordinates, enabling frozen Gaussian-reference codebooks to be reused across layers and models. Joint training then adapts the network to the coupled errors of weight, activation, and cache quantization within a common scalar/vector interface. We bound frozen-codebook transfer error and local task loss, and derive an exact normalization-aware straight-through Jacobian that links quantization distortion to gradient bias. The strongest gains arise under joint W2A4KV2 compression: across LLaMA3-1B/3B/8B, CanonQ-Omni achieves up to 14.28x lower WikiText-2 perplexity and up to 57.9% higher mean zero-shot accuracy than prior state-of-the-art and representative quantization baselines. The benefits extend to Qwen3-1.7B, code generation, and mathematical reasoning: on instruction-tuned MobileLLM-Pro-1B at W2A16KV16, CanonQ achieves relative improvements of 41.7% in HumanEval pass@1 and 39.1% in GSM8K exact match over the strongest evaluated quantization baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CanonQ 把权重、激活、KV cache 联合低比特量化拆成两步：固定旋转与能量归一化把异构张量映射到规范坐标，使冻结高斯参考码本可跨层跨模型复用，再用任务感知联合训练适配耦合量化误差。在 LLaMA3-1B/3B/8B 的联合 W2A4KV2 下，CanonQ-Omni 相对先前 SOTA 与代表性量化基线最高 14.28 倍更低的 WikiText-2 perplexity、最高 57.9% 更高的平均零样本准确率。
Motivation: 权重、激活与 KV cache 三者分布不同且量化误差在全网络内相互耦合，极端低比特联合压缩因此最难，现有码本与校准方案难以跨层跨模型复用。
Method: CanonQ 分离源规范化与任务适配：固定旋转加能量归一化把异构张量源映射到规范坐标，冻结高斯参考码本跨层跨模型复用；随后在统一标量/向量接口下联合训练，使网络适配 W/A/KV 耦合误差。理论上给出冻结码本迁移误差与局部任务损失的界，并推导归一化感知的 straight-through Jacobian，把量化失真与梯度偏置联系起来。
Result: 联合 W2A4KV2 下，CanonQ-Omni 在 LLaMA3-1B/3B/8B 上相对先前 SOTA 与代表性量化基线最高 14.28 倍更低的 WikiText-2 perplexity、最高 57.9% 更高的平均零样本准确率；收益延伸到 Qwen3-1.7B、代码生成与数学推理：在指令微调 MobileLLM-Pro-1B 的 W2A16KV16 设置下，HumanEval pass@1 相对提升 41.7%，GSM8K exact match 相对提升 39.1%（对最强被评估量化基线）。
Conclusion: 把异构张量先规范化到共享码本坐标、再联合适配耦合误差，是在 W2A4KV2 这类极端联合压缩下同时保住困惑度与零样本/下游任务精度的可行路径。

papers.title: StyleFields: Multi-Scale AdaIN-Modulated Implicit SDFs for Coarse-to-Fine 3D Shape Reconstruction and Editing
papers.abstract_en: We introduce StyleFields, a DeepSDF-based architecture for high-fidelity 3D reconstruction that enables controllable geometric style mixing: the coarse structure of one object can be combined with the fine-scale details of another. The core idea is depth-aware modulation: instead of a single global code, we inject latents via multi-level Adaptive Instance Normalization at several decoder depths, and supervise matching auxiliary heads with a coarse-to-fine schedule while gradually growing network depth. This aligns early layers with global shape and later layers with high-frequency detail, achieving content-style decoupling without part labels or adversarial training. StyleFields delivers faithful reconstructions, convincing cross-instance hybrids, and consistent gains in ablations over injection depth and supervision granularity. We further demonstrate a practical application in automotive aerodynamics: a learned surrogate drag predictor serves as a differentiable objective to optimize reconstructed cars, allowing targeted edits of global form or surface details by freezing the complementary latent stream. StyleFields offers a simple, effective recipe for controllable implicit reconstruction and downstream performance-driven design.
papers.comment: 39 pages, 20 figures, 3 tables. Includes supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StyleFields 在 DeepSDF 上用多层深度注入的 Adaptive Instance Normalization (AdaIN) 调制隐式 SDF，把粗粒度形状与高频细节分到不同解码深度，从而在无部件标签、无对抗训练的条件下实现内容-风格解耦，可把一个物体的粗结构与另一个物体的细节混合。消融显示注入深度与监督粒度带来一致增益；在汽车气动应用中，学习到的阻力代理预测器作为可微目标优化重建车身，通过冻结互补 latent 流实现对整体外形或表面细节的定向编辑。
Motivation: DeepSDF 类隐式重建通常只用单一全局 latent，几何风格混合与粗细结构的可控编辑难以实现，也往往依赖部件标签或对抗训练。
Method: 以 DeepSDF 为基础架构，在解码器多个深度注入多层 AdaIN 调制的 latent，替代单一全局码；用由粗到细的调度监督对应的辅助输出头 (auxiliary heads)，并逐步增长网络深度，使早期层对齐整体形状、后期层对齐高频细节。下游用学习得到的汽车阻力代理预测器作为可微目标，通过冻结互补 latent 流做定向编辑。
Result: 重建保真、跨实例混合自然，注入深度与监督粒度的消融给出一致增益；汽车气动演示中阻力代理作为可微目标驱动对重建车辆的定向编辑（整体外形或表面细节）。
Conclusion: 深度感知的多层 AdaIN 调制是实现可控隐式重建与下游性能驱动设计的简单有效配方，无需部件标签或对抗训练。

papers.title: FreeEvolve: Learning to Evolve Beyond Fixed Loops
papers.abstract_en: Agent evolvers automate the design of the prompts, skills and workflows around language model agents, yet the optimization process they follow is still designed by hand: a fixed search loop decides how candidates are evaluated, which are kept and when the search stops. We propose FREEEVOLVE, which automates this process as well. An environment specifies the goal, target agent, evaluator, data and resource limits; within these limits, the evolver itself decides what to test, how much evidence to collect, which candidates to pursue and when to stop. These decisions follow an editable evolution skill, which we improve through meta-evolution by scoring each candidate skill on the fresh target agent it produces. The optimization process thus becomes a capability learned from experience rather than a loop engineered in advance. On tau3-bench, ARC-AGI-2, ARC-AGI-3 and Terminal-Bench 2.1, FREEEVOLVE controls the evolution campaign by itself, yet improves the primary held-out metric by 13.6 points on average and matches or exceeds hand-designed evolvers. The learned process keeps improving with experience: meta-evolved skills add 6.9 points over the seed skill on fresh target agents, demonstrating transferability across environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FREEEVOLVE 把 agent evolver 的固定搜索循环本身变成可学习对象：由环境给定目标、被优化 agent、评估器、数据与资源上限，evolver 依据可编辑的 evolution skill 自行决定测什么、收集多少证据、追哪些候选、何时停止，skill 再通过 meta-evolution 按其产出的新 target agent 打分改进。在 tau3-bench、ARC-AGI-2、ARC-AGI-3 与 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上，自主控制的进化流程使主要 held-out 指标平均提升 13.6 点，达到或超过手工设计的 evolver。
Motivation: Agent evolver 虽然自动化了 prompt、skill 与 workflow 的设计，但优化过程本身仍是手工固定的搜索循环：评估方式、保留策略与停止时机都预先写死，无法随经验调整。
Method: 环境声明目标、target agent、evaluator、数据与资源上限；在此约束内 evolver 依据可编辑的 evolution skill 决定测试内容、证据量、候选取舍与停止时机。skill 通过 meta-evolution 迭代改进，打分依据是该 skill 产出的 fresh target agent 上的表现。
Result: 在 tau3-bench、ARC-AGI-2、ARC-AGI-3、Terminal-Bench 2.1 上，FREEEVOLVE 自主掌控进化流程，主要 held-out 指标平均提升 13.6 点，匹配或超过手工设计的 evolver；meta-evolved skill 相对 seed skill 在 fresh target agent 上再加 6.9 点。
Conclusion: 优化过程本身可以作为从经验中习得的能力而非预先工程化的循环，且学到的 skill 能跨环境迁移、随经验持续改进。

papers.title: Exact Dynamics and Finite-Sample Trajectory Recovery of Linear Recursive Feature Machines
papers.abstract_en: Recursive feature machines (RFMs) learn representations of data by alternating between fitting a predictor to a dataset and updating features of that predictor using the average gradient outer product (AGOP). Connections between AGOPs and feature learning in neural networks motivate linear RFMs as a simple setting for analyzing how representations evolve during training. Here, we study the dynamics and statistics of linear RFM in noisy multi-output regression with isotropic sub-Gaussian input data and targets generated by a low-rank teacher matrix of dimension $d$. We extend the known connection between linear RFM and iteratively reweighted least squares from the interpolating setting to ridge-regularized multi-output regression with noise. We show that the learned feature matrix remains close to its infinite-data ideal counterpart at every iteration. Namely, for $n$ samples, we show the error in the feature matrix decays as $O(\sqrt{d/n})$ with high probability. Experiments on real-world text and single-cell gene-expression data illustrate the features learned by this simple linear model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线性 recursive feature machine (RFM) 的含噪多输出回归中，交替的 IRLS 式拟合与 AGOP 特征更新使学到的特征矩阵在每一步都贴近无限数据理想值，n 个样本下特征矩阵误差以高概率按 O(√(d/n)) 衰减。真实文本与单细胞基因表达数据上的实验展示了该线性模型学到的特征。
Motivation: AGOP 与神经网络特征学习的联系使线性 RFM 成为分析训练中表征演化的简化对象，但含噪、正则化、多输出情形下的动力学与有限样本统计尚缺刻画。
Method: 在各向同性 sub-Gaussian 输入、低秩 teacher 矩阵（维度 d）生成目标的含噪多输出回归设定下，把线性 RFM 与 iteratively reweighted least squares (IRLS) 的已知联系从插值设定推广到 ridge 正则化的含噪多输出回归，并逐步分析特征矩阵相对无限数据理想值的偏差。
Result: 以高概率，n 个样本时特征矩阵误差按 O(√(d/n)) 衰减，且每一步都贴近无限数据理想对应物；在真实文本与单细胞基因表达数据上给出实验，展示该线性模型学到的特征。
Conclusion: 线性 RFM 的特征演化可由 IRLS 视角精确刻画，其有限样本特征误差随样本数以 √(d/n) 速率收敛到无限数据理想轨迹。

papers.title: StableGrasp: Reconstructing Physically Stable Human Hand Grasps from Single Images
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing a physically stable human grasp from a single RGB image is challenging because physically modeling grasps is itself difficult, and the problem requires estimating not only a visually constrained hand pose but also a control target that stabilizes the grasp. Existing methods either model only visual hand geometry without considering physics, or rely on less plausible physical modeling, which limits the physical validity of the resulting grasps. In this paper, we present StableGrasp, a differentiable simulation-based optimization framework that explicitly separates the visual hand pose from the control target that determines the grasping forces. Our method jointly optimizes hand geometry and control by minimizing the kinetic energy of the grasp in a differentiable simulator, while regularizing the hand geometry to preserve visual consistency and geometric plausibility. The reconstructed grasps are substantially more stable under rigorous physical simulation, while remaining visually consistent with the input images and geometrically plausible. Experiments show that our approach produces far more stable grasps than alternative hand-control strategies, benefiting visual-only grasp reconstruction pipelines by turning their outputs into physically stable grasps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StableGrasp 用可微仿真优化从单张 RGB 图重建人手抓取，把视觉手型与决定抓取力的控制目标显式分离，联合优化手型几何与控制，以最小化抓取动能为目标并正则手型保持视觉一致与几何合理。在严格物理仿真下，重建抓取的稳定性显著优于其他手部控制策略，同时仍与输入图像视觉一致。
Motivation: 从单图重建物理稳定抓取本身困难：既要估计受视觉约束的手型，又要估计稳定抓取的控制目标。现有方法要么只建模视觉手型几何而不考虑物理，要么依赖不够合理的物理建模，导致重建抓取的物理有效性受限。
Method: 提出基于可微仿真 (differentiable simulation) 的优化框架 StableGrasp，显式分离视觉手型与决定抓取力的控制目标；在可微仿真器中联合优化手型几何与控制，最小化抓取动能，并对手型几何加正则以保持视觉一致性与几何合理性。
Result: 在严格物理仿真下，重建抓取比替代的手部控制策略 (hand-control strategies) 稳定得多，同时保持与输入图像的视觉一致性与几何合理性；该方法可把纯视觉抓取重建管线的输出转化为物理稳定的抓取。
Conclusion: 把视觉手型与控制目标分开、用可微仿真按动能优化，能将纯视觉抓取重建的输出转成物理稳定的抓取。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Patient, Place, Prior (P$^3$): What Counts as Personalization in Medical World Models?
papers.abstract_en: Longitudinal models forecast how a patient's imaging state evolves, but accuracy does not show whether the patient's observed trajectory drives the prediction. A population-average forecast may be useful but cannot establish a patient-specific world-model claim. We introduce Patient, Place, Prior (P$^3$), an audit asking whether a forecast benefits from the patient's longitudinal imaging history (Patient), benefits from patient-matched externally supplied spatial support (Place), and gains predictive value beyond a population-average prediction under matched support and context (Prior). We also propose Cancer JEPA, a one-step model that forecasts frozen representations of future breast dynamic contrast-enhanced MRI examinations during neoadjuvant therapy. It adds a lesion-constrained neural correction, trained with an occlusion-based latent objective, to a patient-conditioned low-complexity reduced-rank regression baseline. This factorization permits a post-hoc P$^3$ audit of the frozen model. In a validation cohort previously used in development, forecast error is lower when the neural correction receives the patient's history rather than another patient's and patient-matched lesion occupancy maps rather than substituted maps. However, the descriptive 95% interval comparing the correction computed from patient history with the population-average neural correction includes zero. P$^3$ thus separates input use from evidence of patient-specific predictive value beyond a population-level pattern.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 P³ 审计框架，把医学世界模型的“个性化”拆成三项可分别检验的证据：预测是否用到该患者的纵向影像历史 (Patient)、是否用到患者匹配的空间支持 (Place)、以及在匹配支持与上下文下是否超出群体平均预测 (Prior)。配套提出 Cancer JEPA，在新辅助治疗期间一步预报未来乳腺动态对比增强 MRI 的冻结表征；验证队列中用本患者历史与患者匹配病灶占据图时预报误差更低，但区分“用患者历史”与“群体平均神经校正”的描述性 95% 区间包含零。
Motivation: 纵向影像模型的预报精度无法说明预测是否真由该患者的轨迹驱动；群体平均预报虽可能有用，却不足以支撑“患者特异世界模型”的主张，需要把输入使用与超出群体模式的预测价值分开审计。
Method: P³ 审计从三个问题分别取证：是否受益于患者纵向影像历史、是否受益于患者匹配的外部空间支持、在匹配支持与上下文下是否比群体平均预测更有预测价值。配套的 Cancer JEPA 是一步模型，预报未来乳腺 DCE-MRI 检查的冻结表征，结构为患者条件化的低复杂度降秩回归基线加病灶约束的神经校正，神经校正用基于遮挡 (occlusion) 的 latent 目标训练；该分解使冻结模型可做事后 P³ 审计。
Result: 在先前用于开发的验证队列中，当神经校正接收本患者历史而非另一患者历史、以及患者匹配的病灶占据图而非替换图时，预报误差更低。然而比较“由患者历史计算的校正”与“群体平均神经校正”的描述性 95% 区间包含零。
Conclusion: P³ 把“输入被使用”与“存在超出群体模式的患者特异预测价值”区分开：本例中输入使用方向正确，但超出群体平均的证据在该区间下不成立。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Bookkeeping, Composition, or Unreachable Gold? Reading MemoryAgentBench's Conflict-Resolution Scores Against a Frozen Last-Write Resolver
papers.abstract_en: MemoryAgentBench's Conflict Resolution split is read as measuring "selective forgetting". We execute the benchmark's own rule - the newest statement about a fact wins - as a zero-learning resolver frozen on one of the four fact lists. Under the official metric the rule answers 80.25% of the questions (74.5% on the three held-out lists). Of the rest, 67 items have a released gold that the last-write graph cannot reach but overwritten statements would ("The capital of India is New Delhi." superseded by "The capital of India is Grosseto."; gold New Delhi); such items are a third of the multi-hop questions at 262K. Two long-context models and our pre-registered approximate re-implementation of the benchmark's BM25 agent, one retained run per item and outcomes only, score 84.7%, 82.6% and 41.6% on the items the rule solves against 10.4%, 11.9% and 6.0% on those 67. The failures are a reachability split plus a small parser-scope residual; the per-item split, not the aggregate, is the unit at which a score here can be read.
papers.comment: Accepted at the IAB Workshop (Interpreting Agent Behavior) at NeurIPS 2026 (non-archival). 19 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MemoryAgentBench 的 Conflict Resolution 被当作「选择性遗忘」能力测试，但直接执行基准自带规则（同一事实以最新陈述为准）的零学习冻结 resolver，在官方指标下已答对 80.25%（三个 held-out 列表 74.5%）。剩余题目中 67 条的 gold 是 last-write 图不可达、只有被覆盖陈述可达的「不可达 gold」；两个长上下文模型与 BM25 agent 复现在这 67 条上仅得 10.4%、11.9%、6.0%，而在规则可解题上为 84.7%、82.6%、41.6%。作者主张按逐题可达性拆分而非聚合分数解读该基准得分。
Motivation: Conflict Resolution split 被读作衡量 selective forgetting，但聚合分数混合了「规则可解」与「gold 不可达」两类题目，使分数无法归因到记忆能力本身。
Method: 把基准自带的 last-write 规则作为零学习、冻结的 resolver 跑在四条 fact list 之一上；另跑两个长上下文模型与一个预注册的 BM25 agent 近似复现，每题保留一次运行、只记录结果；按逐题可达性把失败拆成 reachability split 与 parser-scope residual。
Result: 冻结 last-write resolver 在官方指标下答对 80.25%，三个 held-out 列表 74.5%；剩余中 67 条 gold 不可达但被覆盖陈述可达（如 New Delhi 被 Grosseto 覆盖而 gold 为 New Delhi），这类题占 262K 上下文中多跳题的三分之一。规则可解题上两长上下文模型与 BM25 复现得 84.7%、82.6%、41.6%，在这 67 条上仅 10.4%、11.9%、6.0%。
Conclusion: 该基准的聚合分数主要由规则可解题支撑，失败来自可达性拆分加少量 parser-scope 残差；分数应在逐题拆分层面解读，而非聚合值。

papers.title: R-CNN-Based Chess Position Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Performing chess game position recognition solely from a single image of a three-dimensional board requires predicting the position and orientation of the board relative to the camera, the occupancy of squares and the piece type, which includes its colour. We propose an R-CNN-based framework with independent components for piece recognition and board geometry estimation, whose predictions are combined to reconstruct the position. For piece recognition, we adapt Faster R-CNN using a class-weighted objective and a deeper classification head. The detector operates directly on the input image, retaining alternative piece hypotheses that are subsequently refined using constraints on piece counts and square occupancy. For board detection, we introduce an octagonal arrangement of eight labelled boundary keypoints, predicted using the keypoint head of Mask R-CNN. These provide redundant correspondences for homography estimation and encode board orientation. The estimated homography maps representative points from the piece boxes to an 8x8 grid. On a synthetic dataset, the modifications to piece detection increase mean average precision from 61.59% to 90.14%. Of the predicted board keypoints, 97.11% are within 1% of the image diagonal of their labelled targets. Using ground-truth piece boxes with the predicted homographies gives correct square assignments for every test position. The complete framework recovers 76.61% of test positions exactly and 96.49% with at most one incorrect square.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于 R-CNN 的单图三维棋盘局面识别框架：Faster R-CNN 加类别加权目标与更深分类头识别棋子并保留候选假设，Mask R-CNN 关键点头预测八个边界关键点估计单应矩阵 (homography) 映射到 8x8 网格，再用棋子数量与占位约束精炼。合成数据集上棋子检测 mAP 从 61.59% 提到 90.14%，完整框架精确复原 76.61% 的测试局面、96.49% 至多错一格。
Motivation: 仅凭单张三维棋盘图像识别局面，需同时预测棋盘相对相机的位置与朝向、格子占用和棋子类型（含颜色），三者耦合使端到端识别困难。
Method: 框架分棋子识别与棋盘几何估计两部分：改造 Faster R-CNN，用类别加权目标 (class-weighted objective) 与更深分类头直接在图像上检测并保留备选棋子假设，随后用棋子数量与格子占用约束精炼；棋盘检测用 Mask R-CNN 的 keypoint 预测八个带标签的边界关键点构成八边形排布，提供冗余对应做单应估计并编码朝向，再把棋子框代表点映射到 8x8 网格。

papers.title: From Probabilities to Decisions: Search and Multi-Teacher Distillation with Jev
papers.abstract_en: Probability-only models, which TypeSafe calls System One models, return calibrated probabilities for fixed choices in milliseconds and generate no text. We study one such model, Jev, through two tasks that require decisions under tight constraints. In bullet chess, a bot that places Jev's judgment inside Stockfish search alongside an opening book and endgame tablebases climbs above a 2200 Lichess bullet rating against other bots. Live model calls are too slow for search, so we distill pairwise judgments into a compact evaluator that runs at every position. We then ask how best to spend a fixed labeling budget when an LLM, Qwen3-32B, is available as a second teacher. In chess, averaging both judges' labels beats spending the whole budget on Qwen alone by 9.6 Elo (95% interval 4.3 to 14.9), and the gain replicates on fresh openings; a second answer from the same judge is no substitute, and Jev is the strongest partner for Qwen among the models tested. In passage reranking, Jev's labels alone train a reranker that scores as high as Qwen's, from 21 minutes of API calls instead of 5.1 GPU-hours, and adding Qwen gains at most a few thousandths in ranking quality. Search supplies the lookahead, distillation makes the judgment cheap enough to use at every position, and an LLM partner pays off in chess.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究概率型模型 Jev 在两个受约束决策任务中的用法：把 Jev 的成对判断蒸馏成紧凑评估器嵌入 Stockfish 搜索，在 bullet 棋上超过 2200 Lichess bot 等级分；固定标注预算下混合 Jev 与 Qwen3-32B 两个教师比全押 Qwen 高 9.6 Elo。检索重排任务中 Jev 单独标注即可达到与 Qwen 相当的分数，成本从 5.1 GPU 小时降到 21 分钟 API 调用。
Motivation: 概率型模型（TypeSafe 称之为 System One 模型）只输出校准概率、不生成文本，毫秒级返回但无法直接用于需要文本或逐步搜索的决策场景；同时实时模型调用对搜索来说太慢，标注预算如何在多个教师间分配缺少依据。
Method: 两个任务：一是把 Jev 的成对判断蒸馏成紧凑评估器，在 bullet 棋中嵌入 Stockfish 搜索，配合开局库与残局库；二是固定标注预算下比较单教师（Qwen3-32B）与双教师（Jev + Qwen）标签的分配策略。另一任务为 passage reranking，用 Jev 标注训练重排器。
Result: 棋类中双教师平均标签比全预算投 Qwen 高 9.6 Elo（95% 区间 4.3 至 14.9），且在新开局上复现；同一教师的第二次回答无法替代第二教师，Jev 是所测模型中与 Qwen 搭档最强的。蒸馏后的 bot 在 Lichess bullet bot 对局中超过 2200 等级分。检索重排中仅用 Jev 标签训练的重排器得分与 Qwen 相当，成本为 21 分钟 API 调用而非 5.1 GPU 小时，加入 Qwen 最多只提升千分之几的排序质量。
Conclusion: 搜索提供前瞻、蒸馏让判断便宜到可在每个局面调用，而 LLM 伙伴只在棋类这类任务中划算；在检索重排上第二教师的边际收益极小。

papers.title: The Dichotomy Between Pattern Recognition and Step-by-Step Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: We argue that pattern recognition and step-by-step reasoning are two ends of a spectrum. A large language model (LLM) learns to reason step-by-step when data is structured such that the next token depends on a small amount of preceding context. Inference in LLMs resembles pattern recognition when the next token depends on a large amount of preceding context. If the next token depends on only the $c$ most recent tokens, reasoning traces are paths on a De Bruijn graph whose nodes are $c$-length contexts and edges are next-token transitions between contexts. The set of reasoning traces of a task forms a directed acyclic subgraph of the De Bruijn graph. An LLM that has learned all edges of this subgraph can compose them to solve longer, unseen tasks, i.e., it reasons step-by-step. We prove that the number of edges is vanishingly small compared to the number of reasoning traces. Empirically, the number of training samples a transformer needs is a power law in the number of edges, so learning to reason step-by-step is sample efficient. We can induce De Bruijn structure in any task by maintaining a ``state'' that makes future reasoning independent of the past. The frequency of states in the reasoning trace determines $c$. We show, by fine-tuning Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct to solve equations and answer questions about stories, that frequent states (small $c$) result in higher accuracy but greater fragility to perturbations at test time. LLMs trained with a large $c$ are only as good as models that perform pattern recognition without reasoning. A moderate density of states balances accuracy and robustness. We show that real-world data has De Bruijn structure: Qwen3-14B and Qwen3-32B retain over 75% of their accuracy on GSM8K, MATH-500 and GPQA-Diamond when attention is restricted to a sliding window less than 15% as long as the full reasoning trace.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文主张 LLM 的逐步推理与模式识别是同一谱的两端：当下一 token 只依赖最近 c 个 token 时，推理轨迹是 De Bruijn 图上的一条路径，任务轨迹构成其有向无环子图，学全子图的边即可组合出更长的未见任务。微调 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 解方程与故事问答显示，高频状态（小 c）精度更高但对测试期扰动更脆弱；中等状态密度在精度与鲁棒性之间折中。
Motivation: LLM 何时真正逐步推理、何时只是模式识别缺少可判定的结构条件，也缺少训练样本量与该结构之间的定量关系。
Method: 把下一 token 依赖限制在最近 c 个 token，将推理轨迹建模为 De Bruijn 图（节点为 c 长上下文、边为转移）上的路径，任务轨迹为其中的 DAG；通过维护使未来推理独立于过去的状态在任意任务中诱导该结构，状态出现频率决定 c。实证部分微调 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 解方程与回答故事问题，并在 Qwen3-14B 与 Qwen3-32B 上把注意力限制为滑动窗口。
Result: 证明子图的边数相对推理轨迹总数是 vanishingly small；实证上 transformer 所需训练样本数是边数的幂律，故逐步推理是样本高效的。高频状态（小 c）精度更高但对测试期扰动更脆弱，大 c 训练的模型只与纯模式识别模型相当。Qwen3-14B 与 Qwen3-32B 在注意力窗口不足完整推理轨迹 15% 长度时，于 GSM8K、MATH-500、GPQA-Diamond 上保留超过 75% 的准确率。
Conclusion: 真实数据带有 De Bruijn 结构，适度的状态密度可在准确率与鲁棒性之间取得平衡；样本效率由边数而非轨迹数决定。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: One Frame, Full Heartbeat: ECG-Free 4D Cardiac Cine MRI Synthesis via Radial-Decomposed Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Cine cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR) captures the cardiac cycle as a four-dimensional (4D) sequence, but standard acquisition requires electrocardiogram (ECG) gating and repeated breath holds. Visual realism alone does not establish accurate patient-specific ejection fraction (EF) or ventricular volumes. We present PhaseFlow3D, a generative framework that synthesizes a complete 4D cine sequence from a single end-diastolic (ED) three-dimensional (3D) volume without ECG. To capture asymmetric systolic and diastolic dynamics, it represents the cardiac cycle as a piecewise linear phase anchored at ED and end-systolic (ES) time points. At inference, a population-level canonical template supplies this phase without patient-specific temporal information. A phase-conditioned rectified flow model generates a cardiac motion trajectory in latent space. Radial Contraction Decomposition converts each latent state into a 3D displacement field, combining a physics-informed radial component for centripetal myocardial contraction with an image-conditioned residual for rotation and out-of-plane motion. Each frame is generated by directly warping the ED volume, bypassing variational autoencoder decoding. On the combined ACDC and M&Ms benchmark, PhaseFlow3D achieves the lowest EF mean absolute error, the only positive left-ventricular volume-curve $R^2$, and the best distributional quality among compared methods. Ablations confirm each component's contribution. Downstream evaluations demonstrate the utility of the synthesized sequences and displacement fields for segmentation, pathology classification, label propagation, and myocardial strain analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhaseFlow3D 用单帧舒张末期 (ED) 3D 体积在无 ECG 门控条件下合成完整 4D 心脏 cine MRI：以 ED/ES 锚点的分段线性相位作条件，经相位条件 rectified flow 在 latent 空间生成运动轨迹，再用 Radial Contraction Decomposition 拆成物理先验的径向向心收缩分量与图像条件残差，逐帧直接 warp ED 体积。在 ACDC 与 M&Ms 合并基准上取得最低 EF 平均绝对误差、唯一为正的左室容积曲线 R² 与最好的分布质量。
Motivation: 标准 cine CMR 需要 ECG 门控与反复屏气，且仅靠视觉真实感无法保证患者特异的射血分数 (EF) 与心室容积准确。
Method: 以 ED/ES 时间点锚定的分段线性相位表示心动周期，推理时由人群级 canonical template 提供相位；相位条件 rectified flow 在 latent 空间生成心脏运动轨迹，Radial Contraction Decomposition 将每个 latent 状态转为 3D 位移场（物理先验径向分量 + 图像条件残差处理旋转与层面外运动），每帧直接 warp ED 体积，绕过 VAE 解码。
Result: 在 ACDC 与 M&Ms 合并基准上，PhaseFlow3D 取得最低的 EF 平均绝对误差、对比方法中唯一为正的左室容积曲线 R²，以及最好的分布质量；消融实验确认各组件均有贡献，下游任务验证合成序列与位移场可用于分割、病理分类、标签传播与心肌应变分析。
Conclusion: 单帧 ED 体积加人群级相位模板足以合成可用于定量与下游任务的 4D 心脏 cine，无需 ECG 门控；径向分解与直接 warp 是保证容积曲线准确的关键组件。

papers.title: Q-PACE: Dynamic Precision Allocation for Quantization-Aware Training
papers.abstract_en: Quantization-aware training (QAT) leverages lower-precision arithmetic to reduce the cost of LLM deployment, but aggressive quantization degrades final model performance. A common remedy is mixed-precision training, in which high precision is assigned to some of the layers to maintain performance while keeping the cost constrained. This approach then requires precision assignments for model layers during training. We provide a new approach, called Q-PACE, consisting of a second-order sensitivity model that predicts the loss increase as a sum of quantization noise MSE weighted by per-layer curvature coefficients. During training, we periodically re-compute these coefficients using perturbations across layers, and re-assign precision. Pretraining and supervised fine-tuning experiments on LLMs of up to 4B parameters show that Q-PACE consistently improves over existing mixed-precision training recipes, and achieves comparable loss at substantially lower total memory budgets. We further find that quantization sensitivity is highly predictable by depth and layer type, and its stability during training allows for infrequent, cheap recalibration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Q-PACE 为量化感知训练 (QAT) 提出动态精度分配：用二阶敏感度模型把损失上升写成各层量化噪声 MSE 乘以逐层曲率系数之和，训练中周期性重算系数并重新分配精度。在最大 4B 参数的 LLM 预训练与监督微调中，它稳定优于现有混合精度训练配方，在显著更低的总内存预算下达到相当 loss。
Motivation: 激进量化会拉低 LLM 最终性能，混合精度训练需为每层指定精度，但现有分配方案静态且缺乏对损失上升的可计算预测。
Method: Q-PACE 的二阶敏感度模型将 loss 增量表示为各层量化噪声 MSE 加权逐层曲率系数之和；训练过程中跨层施加扰动周期性重算系数，据此重新分配各层精度，用于 LLM 预训练与监督微调。
Result: 在最大 4B 参数的 LLM 预训练与 SFT 实验中，Q-PACE 一致优于已有混合精度训练配方，并在显著更低的总内存预算下取得相当 loss；量化敏感度可由深度与层类型高度预测，且训练期间稳定，允许低频、廉价的重校准。
Conclusion: 动态二阶敏感度驱动的精度分配能在更低内存下守住 QAT 性能，且敏感度随深度和层类型稳定，因此重校准不必频繁进行。

papers.title: Similar evapotranspiration responses mask contrasting modes of water access during drought in California
papers.abstract_en: Atmospheric warming raises evaporative demand, but actual evapotranspiration (ETa) may track demand or decouple under water limitation. Here, we quantified demand-tracking ability from regression slopes relating deseasonalized ETa and reference evapotranspiration (ETo) anomalies across California during 2008-2024. Forests and croplands retained similar positive tracking under severe drought, whereas grasslands and shrublands showed weak or negative responses. Despite similar demand tracking, forest responses were consistent with subsurface-storage access, whereas cropland responses reflected managed water access and crop-system adjustment. Positive ETa-ETo coupling on active fields coexisted with a higher statewide crop-attributed fallow share of managed cropland than under no drought, showing that active-field estimates alone did not capture whole-crop-system adjustment. Late-period demand-tracking ability was lower at 54.9% of grid cells, with larger regional declines accompanying greater groundwater-storage losses. Our results indicate that similar ETa responses mask contrasting modes of water access, requiring joint consideration of hydrology and management when interpreting drought responses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 2008–2024 年加州去季节化的 ETa 与 ETo 异常回归斜率量化蒸散的需求追踪能力：森林与农田在严重干旱下都保持相似的正向追踪，草地与灌木则弱或负响应。追踪能力相似但水源模式相反——森林对应地下储水补给，农田对应灌溉管理与作物系统调整；晚期有 54.9% 网格单元追踪能力下降，且下降大的区域地下水储量损失更大。
Motivation: 干旱下 ETa 可能跟随蒸发需求也可能因水分受限而脱钩，仅凭相似的 ETa 响应无法区分自然植被与灌溉农业实际的取水途径，从而误判干旱影响。
Method: 对加州 2008–2024 年去季节化的实际蒸散 (ETa) 与参考蒸散 (ETo) 异常做回归，以斜率作为需求追踪能力指标，按森林、农田、草地、灌木及管理状态分组比较，并将晚期追踪变化与地下水储量损失对照。
Result: 严重干旱下森林与农田均保持相似的正向追踪，草地与灌木呈弱或负响应；活跃农田的 ETa-ETo 正耦合与全州农田休耕份额高于无干旱情形并存；晚期 54.9% 网格单元追踪能力下降，区域降幅越大对应地下水储量损失越大。
Conclusion: 相似的 ETa 响应掩盖了截然不同的取水模式，解读干旱响应必须同时考虑水文过程与人为管理，仅看活跃田块的估计无法捕捉整个作物系统的调整。

papers.title: LayerRoPE: Dynamic Depth-wise Magnitude & Angular Superposition
papers.abstract_en: As data propagates through a Transformer, the norm of its hidden states grows by orders of magnitude with depth, a phenomenon framed as 'curse of depth' and nearly universally treated as a pathology to be suppressed. We take the opposite view. Across 16 pre-trained LLMs from 9 families, spanning dense, mixture-of-experts and hybrid architectures and Pre-, Peri- and Post-Norm designs, we find that this growth reflects an emergent depth-positional encoding, carried by the only learned per-layer gain on the residual stream, the normalization weight $γ$: with depth, $γ$ grows in magnitude and rotates in direction, jointly encoding the layer index. We make this depth-conditioned encoding explicit with LayerRoPE, an implicit analog of RoPE along the depth axis, which replaces all layerwise $γ$ vectors with a single shared vector and depth-conditioned scalars, at a net reduction in parameters and $<0.02\%$ change in FLOPs. Across a model ladder scaled up to $100$B+ tokens, LayerRoPE consistently outperforms Pre-, Post- and Peri-Norm and Layer-Norm Scaling, reaching Pre-Norm's 1.3B loss with $3.4\times$ less compute; LayerRoPE is the only approach that shows strong convergence and improves near monotonically as depth scales to 512 layers. It improves learning-rate sensitivity by $3$-$10\times$, and transfers naively to and consistently improves looped latent models and Vision Transformers. Inspecting its learned schedule inverts the prevailing premise: LayerRoPE does not shrink the residual stream but widens it, damping what each block reads while amplifying what it writes. Depth stability, our results suggest, calls not for suppressing the residual stream, but for depth-conditioned regulation of the computational blocks it feeds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LayerRoPE 把 Transformer 中随深度增长的残差流范数重新解释为一种涌现的深度位置编码：唯一逐层可学增益 γ 随深度既增大模长又旋转方向，共同编码层号。该方法用单一共享向量加深度条件标量替换全部逐层 γ 向量，参数净减少、FLOPs 变化 <0.02%，在最高 100B+ token、512 层的模型阶梯上比 Pre/Post/Peri-Norm 与 Layer-Norm Scaling 收敛更强，达到 Pre-Norm 1.3B 的 loss 只需 1/3.4 的算力。
Motivation: 隐藏状态范数随深度按数量级增长的 curse of depth 几乎被普遍当作需要压制的病理，但作者认为这其实是携带层号信息的深度位置编码，压制它反而丢掉了可用结构。
Method: 先在 9 个家族、16 个预训练 LLM（含 dense、MoE、hybrid 架构与 Pre-/Peri-/Post-Norm 设计）上统计 γ 的模长与方向随深度的演化，再提出 LayerRoPE：沿深度轴做 RoPE 的隐式类比，用一个共享向量加深度条件标量取代逐层 γ；在最高 100B+ token、深度扩到 512 层的模型阶梯上与 Pre/Post/Peri-Norm、Layer-Norm Scaling 对比，并检验 looped latent models 与 Vision Transformers 的直接迁移。
Result: 参数量净减少且 FLOPs 变化 <0.02%；达到 Pre-Norm 1.3B 的 loss 只用 3.4× 更少算力；是唯一在深度扩到 512 层时仍强收敛、性能近单调提升的方案；学习率敏感性改善 3–10×；直接迁移即一致提升 looped latent models 与 Vision Transformers。
Conclusion: 深度稳定性不应靠收缩残差流获得，而应对残差流所喂的计算块做深度条件化的调节：LayerRoPE 不缩小残差流反而把它展宽，抑制每个 block 读入、放大其写入。

papers.title: Context-aware Attention-based Gaussian Mixture Models for Vehicular Trajectory Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Reliable and interpretable trajectory prediction is critical for cooperative and autonomous driving in complex and uncertain environments. This paper introduces a Context-Aware Attention-based Gaussian Mixture Model (CAA-GMM) for multimodal, uncertainty-aware motion forecasting. The proposed approach models future motion as a probabilistic mixture conditioned on both scene context and agent dynamics, capturing diverse behavioral modes with interpretable Gaussian components. A lightweight attention mechanism adaptively encodes inter-agent interactions and contextual salience, enabling efficient fusion of rasterized environment cues and motion history in dense traffic scenes. Comprehensive evaluations on the nuScenes and Argoverse 2 datasets demonstrate that CAA-GMM achieves competitive or superior accuracy compared with state-of-the-art raster-based baselines, while maintaining low computational complexity. Ablation analyses confirm the importance of the attention module for robust contextual reasoning and predictive precision. Furthermore, evaluations under imperfect communication and perception conditions highlight the framework's resilience to uncertainty, establishing CAA-GMM as an efficient and scalable solution for cooperative trajectory prediction in intelligent transportation systems.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 3 figures. Presented at the 2026 IEEE 104th Vehicular Technology Conference (VTC2026-Fall), Boston, MA, USA, 6-9 September 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向协同驾驶的 CAA-GMM：用轻量 attention 编码车间交互与场景显著性，把未来运动建模为以场景上下文和智能体动力学为条件的高斯混合分布，输出可解释的多模态轨迹。在 nuScenes 与 Argoverse 2 上达到与最先进 raster 基线相当或更优的精度且计算复杂度低，消融确认 attention 模块对上下文推理和预测精度不可或缺，在通信与感知不完美条件下仍保持稳健。
Motivation: 复杂不确定环境下协同与自动驾驶需要既可靠又可解释的多模态轨迹预测，同时密集交通场景要求模型在通信与感知不完美时仍稳健且计算开销低。
Method: CAA-GMM 把未来运动表示为条件于场景上下文与智能体动力学的概率混合，用可解释的 Gaussian component 捕获不同行为模式；轻量 attention 机制自适应编码 inter-agent 交互与上下文显著性，融合 rasterized environment cues 与 motion history，并做消融与不完美通信/感知条件下的评测。
Result: 在 nuScenes 和 Argoverse 2 上，CAA-GMM 相对最先进 raster-based 基线达到相当或更优的精度，同时保持低计算复杂度；消融分析确认 attention 模块对稳健上下文推理与预测精度重要；在不完美通信与感知条件下评测显示框架对不确定性有韧性。
Conclusion: 轻量 attention 加可解释高斯混合足以在密集交通中同时拿到有竞争力的轨迹预测精度、低开销与对感知通信不确定性的韧性，适合作为协同轨迹预测方案。

papers.title: RDGSplat: Render-Dedicated Geometry for Novel View Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: 3D foundation models enable efficient novel view synthesis by carrying a Gaussian head on the representation they already use for reconstruction. However, the views they render fall short of the geometry they recover, because that geometry is estimated under a metric objective and never scored on how it renders. Recent methods alleviate this by updating the backbone weights, but they thereby discard the metric predictions the model was built for and must be repeated for every new backbone. To this end, we propose RDGSplat, a framework that decodes a second geometry dedicated to rendering from a frozen 3D foundation model, leaving its metric predictions intact. In particular, we devise Render-Dedicated Geometry Decoding, which duplicates the pretrained decoders and optimizes the duplicates under photometric supervision alone. Then, a Target-Pose Conditioned Adapter is introduced to reformulate the representation those decoders read, conditioned on the target camera pose rather than the target image. Extensive experiments show that RDGSplat improves novel view synthesis across three feed-forward backbones on four benchmarks, with every pretrained weight frozen. On RE10K, it raises WM2.0 from 20.918 to 24.266\,dB while training 205.5\,M added parameters against a frozen 1.4\,B backbone, and the depth and pose the same model predicts are unchanged.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RDGSplat 在冻结的 3D foundation model 上再解码一套专供渲染的几何，用复制的 pretrained decoder 加目标相机位姿条件化的 Adapter，在纯光度监督下优化，从而在不动度量预测的前提下提升新视角合成。RE10K 上 WM2.0 从 20.918 提到 24.266 dB，新增 205.5 M 参数对 1.4 B 冻结 backbone，同一模型的 depth 与 pose 输出保持不变。
Motivation: 3D foundation model 的 Gaussian head 渲染出的视图质量落后于其恢复的几何，因为几何是在度量目标下估计、从未按渲染效果打分；已有方法靠更新 backbone 权重来补救，却丢掉了模型原本的度量预测，且换 backbone 就要重做。
Method: 提出 Render-Dedicated Geometry Decoding：复制 pretrained decoder 并只用光度监督 (photometric supervision) 优化副本；再引入 Target-Pose Conditioned Adapter，把 decoder 读取的表示改为以目标相机位姿（而非目标图像）为条件。整个流程中 3D foundation model 的预训练权重全部冻结。
Result: 在四个 benchmark、三个 feed-forward backbone 上改进新视角合成且所有预训练权重冻结：RE10K 上 WM2.0 从 20.918 dB 提升到 24.266 dB，训练新增 205.5 M 参数，对照 1.4 B 的冻结 backbone，同一模型预测的 depth 与 pose 不变。
Conclusion: 渲染质量与度量几何可以解耦：为渲染单独解码一套几何并冻结原模型，就能在保留 depth/pose 度量预测的同时提升新视角合成，且不必为每个新 backbone 重训。

papers.title: Lower Bounds for Parallel Diffusion Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Standard diffusion samplers generate samples through repeated evaluations of a learned score function. Parallel sampling methods seek to accelerate generation by trading additional evaluations for fewer sequential rounds. This raises the question of how much sequential dependence is unavoidable, even when many score queries can be made simultaneously. We establish the first polynomial parallel-round lower bounds for diffusion sampling with approximate scores. Specifically, we prove (1) a $\widetildeΩ(d^{1/3})$-round lower bound for sampling smooth, near-isotropic Gaussian mixtures in $R^d$, and (2) an $Ω(d)$-round lower bound for uniform sampling from anisotropic axis-aligned boxes contained in the unit ball. Both bounds hold for arbitrary randomized algorithms making polynomially many queries per round at arbitrary locations and noise levels, with inverse-polynomial score error and constant total variation accuracy. The linear bound is tight for our box family. Our constructions use fixed approximate score oracles that enforce sequential access to hidden information while satisfying the accuracy guarantee at every noise level.

papers.title: Training Language Models To Be Coherent Decision-Makers
papers.abstract_en: Reliable decision-making requires more than accurate prediction: a model must preserve its beliefs, apply the relevant utilities, and recognize when the information needed to justify an action is missing. We study whether language models can learn this decision procedure from supervised fine-tuning and generalize it across domains and differing natural-language expressions of the decision challenge. Across 20 datasets, we explore challenges of belief instability and decision-making errors by first eliciting probabilities of outcomes and then varying only the utilities and the framing of the decision problems, while holding the evidence fixed. We train models to preserve elicited beliefs while selecting the action that maximizes expected utility, and evaluate transfer to unseen application domains, held-out framings, and different classes of payoff structures. We further introduce incomplete-information settings in which required utilities are withheld and replaced with irrelevant text, testing whether models can distinguish missing decision-relevant information from merely additional context. We find that targeted fine-tuning substantially improves coherent decision-making and that in many situations, learning transfers across domains and framings to situations unobserved during training. Further, models trained for decidability learn to identify when action cannot be justified based on missing information. Finally, we show the value of a routed system that considers separately the recognition of decision completeness and utility-sensitive decision execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 训练语言模型在决策中保持已引出的概率信念、按期望效用选动作，并识别决策所需信息是否缺失。在 20 个数据集上固定证据、只改效用与表述的监督微调，使连贯决策显著改善，且在许多情形下迁移到未见过的领域与表述；为可判定性训练的模型学会判断信息缺失时行动无法被证成。
Motivation: 可靠决策不只要预测准，还要保持信念、套用正确效用，并识别支撑行动的信息是否缺失；语言模型在效用与表述变化时容易出现信念不稳定和决策错误。
Method: 监督微调 (SFT)：先引出模型对结果的概率，再固定证据、只改变效用与问题表述，训练模型保持引出信念并选择期望效用最大的动作；评测覆盖未见应用领域、留出表述与不同收益结构类别，并加入效用被无关文本替换的不完整信息设定，另引入分别处理决策完整性识别与效用敏感执行的路由系统 (routed system)。
Result: 在 20 个数据集上，针对性微调大幅改善连贯决策，且在许多情形下学习迁移到训练中未观察到的领域与表述；为可判定性训练的模型能识别信息缺失、行动无法被证成；路由系统分别处理决策完整性识别与效用敏感执行，摘要称其有价值。
Conclusion: 连贯决策这一过程本身可从监督微调中学到并跨领域、跨表述迁移，而把信息完整性识别与效用执行分开路由是提升决策可靠性的有效设计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ToolRACER: A Robust Agentic Conversation Emulation Resource for Agent Training and Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Task-oriented conversational agents remain fragile under real world conversation scenarios as they rarely follow a predictable script, especially when users exhibit non-cooperative behavior. Existing function-calling benchmarks often emphasize successful, cooperative interactions and underrepresent adversarial conversation trajectories, thereby limiting the training resources available for developing robust agents. We present ToolRACER, a synthetic data generation pipeline that coordinates user, assistant and tool emulation models to generate and validated multi-turn interactions between a user and an agent. Using \sysn, we construct ToolRACERBench a robust multi-turn conversation benchmark spanning six domains, ranging over 55 varied personas, generating a validated corpus of 5.6K conversation trajectories, with approximately 66\% of conversations containing failure-prone conversation scenarios. We inject adversarial behaviors, producing validated conversational interaction trajectories that capture realistic, robust scenarios. We evaluate models trained on ToolRACERBench against internal benchmarks, as well as on function calling benchmarks such as $τ^2$-bench, BFCLv3 and ACEBench to evaluate agentic accuracy and robustness. Models trained on ToolRACERBench improve end to end agentic accuracy across $τ^2$-bench and ACEBench, demonstrating significant gains when mixed with in-domain dataset in small language models for agent capability tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ToolRACER 是一条合成数据生成流水线，用 user、assistant、tool 三个模拟模型协同生成并校验多轮对话，专门注入非合作与对抗性用户行为。由此构建的 ToolRACERBench 覆盖 6 个领域、55 种 persona、5.6K 条已校验对话轨迹，其中约 66% 含易失败场景；在其上训练的模型在 τ²-bench 与 ACEBench 上端到端 agentic accuracy 提升，且与同域数据混合时在小模型上增益明显。
Motivation: 现有 function-calling benchmark 偏重成功、合作式交互，低估对抗对话轨迹，导致训练鲁棒 agent 的资源不足。
Method: 提出合成数据生成流水线 ToolRACER，协调 user、assistant、tool 三个模拟模型生成并校验多轮交互；在此之上构建 ToolRACERBench，跨 6 个领域、55 种 persona 生成 5.6K 条轨迹，并注入对抗性用户行为。
Result: ToolRACERBench 含 5.6K 条已校验对话轨迹，约 66% 含易失败场景；在其上训练的模型在 τ²-bench 与 ACEBench 上端到端 agentic accuracy 提升，与同域数据混合时在小语言模型上增益显著；评测同时覆盖内部 benchmark 与 τ²-bench、BFCLv3、ACEBench。
Conclusion: 把对抗性用户行为系统性地合成进训练数据，可以提升任务型对话 agent 在非合作场景下的准确性与鲁棒性，小模型受益尤其明显。
