papers.title: SpecGuard: Proving a Task Is Broken Before the Agent Cheats
papers.abstract_en: As autonomous coding agents get increasingly deployed, the risk that accidental or adversarially injected misspecifications in tasks lead to dangerous agent behavior is critical to address. Prior work has shown that agents given such tasks rarely flag the conflict and instead cheat, editing tests or hard-coding expected outputs, and the actions taken to cheat can cause real damage, such as deleting a security defense to make a corrupted test pass. It remains unclear whether such conflicts can be established with independently verifiable evidence before the agent acts. We present SpecGuard, which detects and formally certifies these conflicts between task intent and tests. Given only the task description and codebase, SpecGuard autoformalizes the intended behaviour into a Lean 4 specification. The tests are formalized independently, and the Lean kernel checks whether any implementation could satisfy both formalizations, producing a machine-checked certificate when none can. On conflicted SWE-bench tasks, SpecGuard detects up to 72.8% of conflicts and formally certifies up to 51.1%, with a nearly five-fold lower conflict miss rate than model-based judgment. SpecGuard provides a pre-execution safety check that identifies reward-hacking opportunities through formal certification of task-level conflicts, before any agent behavior is observed. Our code is available at https://github.com/prmbiy/specguard.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpecGuard 在编码 agent 执行前用 Lean 4 形式化任务意图与测试两套规范，由内核判定是否存在任何实现能同时满足二者；在冲突的 SWE-bench 任务上检测出至多 72.8% 的冲突、形式化认证至多 51.1%，漏检率比基于模型的判断低近五倍。
Motivation: 任务描述与测试之间的错配会让 agent 通过改测试、硬编码输出等方式作弊，甚至删除安全防线；此前不清楚能否在 agent 行动之前用独立可验证的证据确立这种冲突。
Method: 仅给定任务描述与代码库，先把预期行为自动形式化 (autoformalize) 为 Lean 4 规范，再独立形式化测试；由 Lean kernel 检查是否存在任何实现能同时满足两套形式化，若不存在则产出机器校验证书 (machine-checked certificate)。
Result: 在冲突的 SWE-bench 任务上，SpecGuard 检测出至多 72.8% 的冲突，形式化认证至多 51.1%，冲突漏检率比基于模型的判断 (model-based judgment) 低近五倍。
Conclusion: 任务级冲突可以在 agent 行为出现之前被形式化认证，从而作为执行前的安全检查定位 reward-hacking 机会，而不必依赖观察到的实际作弊行为。

papers.title: Relative Wasserstein Spatial Depth for Cluster Number Selection in Distributional Data
papers.abstract_en: Contemporary data in many scientific domains, such as images, media streams, biomedical omics, are naturally modeled as probability distributions in Wasserstein space instead of points in Euclidean space. Consequently, clustering methods for distributions are in high demand, as they provide exploratory frameworks to group objects with similarity. Clustering distribution-valued data in Wasserstein space often requires choosing the number of clusters in advance. We propose Relative Wasserstein Spatial Depth (RWSD) as a selection criterion for optimal number of clusters. It compares the depth of each distribution in its assigned cluster with its depth in competing clusters. We pair this criterion with Wasserstein K-means or a proposed K-medians algorithm. Under suitable assumptions, we establish consistency of the cluster centers and of the selected optimal number of clusters. We also give an error rate under two-stage sampling and characterize the robustness of RWSD under any fixed partition. In extensive simulations, RWSD selects the intended number of clusters under unequal separations, heterogeneous dispersion, heavy tails, and outliers, where silhouette score or the Davies-Bouldin Index often fails. Applications to MNIST images and flow cytometry data illustrate the practical value of RWSD. In some cases where a cluster is not geodesically convex and lacks a meaningful depth center, the RWSD can fail.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出相对 Wasserstein 空间深度 (RWSD) 作为分布值数据的聚类簇数选择准则：比较每个分布在所属簇内与竞争簇中的深度，配合 Wasserstein K-means 或新提出的 K-medians 使用。在不等分离度、异质离散、重尾与离群点的模拟中，RWSD 能选出预设簇数，而 silhouette score 与 Davies-Bouldin Index 常失效。
Motivation: 图像、媒体流、生物组学等数据天然建模为 Wasserstein 空间中的概率分布，分布聚类需要事先定簇数，而现有通用指标在分布值数据的困难情形下不可靠。
Method: 定义 RWSD 准则，度量每个分布在指派簇内相对于竞争簇的深度；与 Wasserstein K-means 或作者提出的 K-medians 算法配对求解；在适当假设下证明簇中心与所选最优簇数的一致性，并给出两阶段抽样下的误差率与固定划分下的鲁棒性刻画。
Result: 在不等分离度、异质离散、重尾与离群点的广泛模拟中，RWSD 选出预设簇数，silhouette score 或 Davies-Bouldin Index 常失败；在 MNIST 图像与流式细胞术 (flow cytometry) 数据上展示实用价值；理论上给出两阶段抽样误差率与固定划分下的鲁棒性刻画。
Conclusion: 相对深度比较可以作为分布值数据选簇数的一致准则，但当某簇非测地线凸、不存在有意义的深度中心时 RWSD 会失效。

papers.title: sk-bench: A Native-First Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Slovak
papers.abstract_en: Multilingual LLM benchmarks omit Slovak, a morphologically rich West Slavic language of five million speakers, or cover it only by machine translation. We present sk-bench, a native-first Slovak benchmark with 30 datasets (33 scored task variants) across ten skill categories. Eleven resources are introduced or first packaged for generative-LLM evaluation, including IFEval-SK with Slovak-adapted instruction checkers and native Chiby/SKJ1 resources for Slovak grammar and morphology. We evaluate 55 open- and closed-weights models under one harness. The best open model trails proprietary APIs by 12.6 points. Model rankings are similar for native and translated closed-form data ($ρ\geq0.98$), though translation separates the strongest models less well. By contrast, human-authored and LLM-generated QA questions rank models differently ($ρ=0.72$). For Qwen3-14B, continued Slovak pretraining lowers the overall score by 13.9 points. A small instruction set restores three quarters of that loss. Test-time reasoning improves scores by 8.5 to 12.5 points for models of 9B and above. Together, these findings suggest four design lessons for other under-resourced languages: use native data where translation fails, plan instruction repair after language adaptation, enable test-time reasoning before scaling up, and avoid overinvesting in target-language prompts. We release the data and code at https://github.com/slovak-nlp/sk-bench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: sk-bench 是原生优先的斯洛伐克语 LLM 基准，含 30 个数据集（33 个计分任务变体）、十大技能类别，在同一评测框架下测 55 个开放与闭源权重模型。最强开源模型落后闭源 API 12.6 分；原生与翻译封闭式数据的模型排名高度一致（ρ≥0.98），但人写与 LLM 生成的 QA 题会把模型排成不同次序（ρ=0.72）。
Motivation: 多语言 LLM 基准要么完全不覆盖斯洛伐克语这一五百万人口的西斯拉夫语言，要么只用机器翻译填充，无法反映原生语言能力与翻译数据的排名偏差。
Method: 构建 native-first 的 sk-bench：30 个数据集、33 个计分任务变体、十大技能类别，其中 11 项资源为首次引入或首次打包用于生成式 LLM 评测，包括带斯洛伐克语指令检查器的 IFEval-SK 与原生 Chiby/SKJ1 语法形态资源；在统一 harness 下评测 55 个开放与闭源权重模型，并对 Qwen3-14B 做继续斯洛伐克语预训练、指令集修复与测试时推理的对照。
Result: 最强开源模型比闭源 API 低 12.6 分；原生与翻译封闭式数据的排名相关 ρ≥0.98，而人写与 LLM 生成 QA 的排名相关仅 ρ=0.72；Qwen3-14B 继续斯洛伐克语预训练使总分下降 13.9 分，小规模指令集可挽回其中约四分之三；测试时推理对 9B 及以上模型提升 8.5 至 12.5 分。
Conclusion: 对欠资源语言，翻译数据在封闭式任务上可近似替代原生数据，但人写 QA 必须用原生数据；语言适配后要补指令修复，扩大规模前先开测试时推理，且不必过度投入目标语言 prompt。

papers.title: Sampling SU(N) gauge theory on a 2D lattice from independent plaquettes via holonomies and corner reweighting
papers.abstract_en: In the Wilson formulation of lattice gauge theory, the fundamental degrees of freedom are group-valued link variables, while the action is a sum over the trace of the plaquettes, the smallest Wilson loops. For generative sampling methods such as normalizing flows, this poses a challenge: the distribution of an individual plaquette is easy to model, but mapping sampled plaquettes to the links is the obstruction. We explore a statistical way around this in two dimensions for the $\mathrm{SU}(N)$ gauge theory with the Wilson plaquette action. The action can be written in terms of holonomy variables, which determine the links once a consistency condition at the four corners of an extended lattice is satisfied. Using a boundary condition that only affects the holonomies, we trade this consistency condition for a conditional sampling problem, which reduces to sampling $X,Y\in\mathrm{SU}(N)$ given the group commutator $Z=XYX^\dagger Y^\dagger$, where $Z\in\mathrm{SU}(N)$ depends on the four corners. Plaquettes are sampled independently, and the resulting configurations carry weights due to the additional conditional sampling. We obtain the density of $Z$, which determines these weights, in closed form for $\mathrm{SU}(2)$ and $\mathrm{SU}(3)$. A normalizing flow models the single-plaquette distribution for $\mathrm{SU}(2)$ and $\mathrm{SU}(3)$; for the group-commutator problem we use a closed-form sampler for $\mathrm{SU}(2)$ and a trained normalizing flow for $\mathrm{SU}(3)$. In our tests on $2\times2$ and $32\times32$ lattices at two couplings each, per-plaquette acceptance rates exceed $99\%$ and the effective sample size of the final weights is moderate, typically above one half.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 2D SU(N) Wilson 格点规范理论的作用量改写为 holonomy 变量，用只作用于 holonomy 的边界条件把四角一致性条件换成条件采样问题，从而让 plaquette 可独立采样再用 corner reweighting 加权。SU(2)/SU(3) 的 Z=XYX†Y† 密度有闭式解，配 normalizing flow 采单 plaquette；在 2×2 与 32×32 格点、各两个耦合常数上，单 plaquette 接受率超过 99%，最终权重的有效样本量通常高于一半。
Motivation: Wilson 形式下自由度是 link 变量而作用量按 plaquette trace 求和：单个 plaquette 的分布好建模，但把采出的 plaquette 拼回 link 是生成式采样（如 normalizing flow）的障碍。
Method: 把作用量写成 holonomy 变量形式，用只影响 holonomy 的边界条件把扩展格点四角的一致性条件替换为条件采样问题，归结为在给定群换位子 Z=XYX†Y† 下采样 X,Y∈SU(N)；plaquette 独立采样后按条件采样产生的权重做 reweighting。SU(2) 与 SU(3) 的 Z 密度取闭式，单 plaquette 分布用 normalizing flow 建模，换位子问题对 SU(2) 用闭式采样器、对 SU(3) 用训练好的 normalizing flow。
Result: 在 2×2 与 32×32 格点、每种尺寸各两个耦合常数的测试中，单 plaquette 接受率超过 99%，最终权重的有效样本量 (effective sample size) 为中等水平，通常高于二分之一。
Conclusion: 在 2D SU(N) Wilson 理论中，holonomy 加 corner reweighting 能绕开 plaquette 到 link 的映射障碍，让独立 plaquette 采样成为可行的生成式采样路径。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Frozen Models, Evolving Expertise: Model-Agnostic Learning from Deployment Experience for Multimodal Medical AI
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) are usually frozen after deployment, so they do not learn from the cases they solve. This is especially concerning in medicine, where new clinical evidence, updated guidelines, and new therapies can change established practice. Fine-tuning can update the model, but it requires access to model weights and additional training. Parameter-free methods avoid training, but they may overfit a fixed validation set, lack reliable domain knowledge, or lose visual details by saving experience only as text. To address these limitations, we present a model-agnostic framework that allows frozen LLMs and VLMs to learn from deployment experience through three forms of external expertise: a Skill that guides reasoning and tool use, a Knowledge Memory that stores reliable facts supported by earlier cases or trusted external evidence, and a Multimodal Knowledge Base that keeps visual examples and guides the model to relate each retrieved case to the current image. Instead of relying on a fixed validation set, a validation strategy keeps an update only if it helps on new cases without degrading performance on earlier ones. Across six benchmarks covering clinical diagnosis, clinical workflows, medical reasoning, and medical and non-medical visual reasoning, and with four open-weight and closed-source base models, our framework improves performance during online deployment by up to 34.2% over the base model on medical tasks, generalizes to unseen cases, transfers to other models without further optimization, and works in non-medical domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出模型无关的部署期学习框架，让冻结的 LLM/VLM 通过三种外部专长（Skill、Knowledge Memory、Multimodal Knowledge Base）在部署中持续进化，无需微调权重。在六个覆盖临床诊断、临床工作流、医学推理与视觉推理的基准上，相对基座模型在线部署性能最高提升 34.2%，可迁移到其他模型。
Motivation: LLM/VLM 部署后通常冻结，无法从已解决的病例中学习；医学中新证据、指南更新会改变既有实践。微调需访问权重和额外训练，参数无关方法又易过拟合固定验证集、缺乏可靠领域知识或仅以文本保存经验而丢失视觉细节。
Method: 模型无关框架，通过三种外部专长让冻结模型学习部署经验：Skill 引导推理与工具使用，Knowledge Memory 存储由既往病例或可信外部证据支持的事实，Multimodal Knowledge Base 保留视觉样例并引导模型将检索病例与当前图像关联。更新策略仅在新病例上改善且不损害既往表现时才保留更新，替代固定验证集。
Result: 在六个基准（覆盖临床诊断、临床工作流、医学推理、医学与非医学视觉推理）和四个开放权重与闭源基座模型上，在线部署性能相对基座模型最高提升 34.2%；可泛化到未见病例，无需额外优化即可迁移到其他模型，并在非医学领域有效。
Conclusion: 冻结模型可以通过外部化的技能、知识记忆与多模态知识库在部署期持续学习，无需微调权重即可跨模型、跨领域提升性能。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Noise Your Prompt: Noising Conditioning Tokens in Continuous Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We revisit a standard accepted practice in the continuous diffusion language model literature of fixing conditioning prompt tokens clean during training. We make a very simple modification: also noise the conditioning prompt tokens during training. We demonstrate that under this modified training objective, we achieve better generalization in combinatorial reasoning tasks such as Sudoku and N-Queens, with the largest gains on harder variants ($3.73\% \to 24.65\%$ solve rate on Sudoku Hard), and increased diversity of generated solutions ($50.60\% \to 73.79\%$ coverage on 10x10 N-Queens). We also show measurable improvements to natural language generation quality in modest dataset regimes with Gigaword summarization, but notably demonstrate that gains do not transfer to all natural language tasks (e.g open ended dialogue generation). Our method is a single line change to the training objective, requires no additional inference costs by default, and provides the flexibility of classifier-free guidance inspired guided sampling. Our \href{https://github.com/LateralIntelligence/noise-your-prompt} {code} is publicly available.
papers.comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在连续扩散语言模型 (continuous diffusion language model) 训练中，把原本保持干净的条件 prompt token 也加噪，可提升组合推理任务的泛化与生成多样性：Sudoku Hard 解题率 3.73% → 24.65%，10x10 N-Queens 解覆盖度 50.60% → 73.79%。但收益不迁移到开放式对话生成。
Motivation: 扩散语言模型文献的标准做法是训练时固定条件 prompt token 为干净状态，这使模型在推理时面对带噪或偏离训练分布的条件输入缺乏鲁棒性，组合推理与多样性受限。
Method: 修改训练目标：对条件 prompt token 也施加扩散加噪（Noise Your Prompt），是一行改动；默认不增加推理开销，并保留 classifier-free guidance 式的引导采样灵活性。
Result: Sudoku Hard 解题率 3.73% → 24.65%（最大增益）；10x10 N-Queens 生成解覆盖度 50.60% → 73.79%；Gigaword 摘要在 modest dataset regime 下自然语言生成质量有可测提升；开放式对话生成无增益。
Conclusion: 对条件 token 加噪是零额外推理成本的单行改动，能显著改善组合推理泛化与解多样性，但收益依赖任务类型，不普遍迁移到所有自然语言任务。

papers.title: DIVA: Dual-Space Intent-Aware Visual Attenuation for Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies typically feed dense visual patch tokens into a language-action backbone, preserving scene context but offering no explicit mechanism to regulate how strongly different visual tokens influence policy computation. We introduce DIVA, a Dual-Space Intent-Aware Visual Attenuation module with an anchor-then-attenuate design. DIVA combines high-level task intent with low-level visual evidence to estimate patch-wise relevance anchors, then applies them in two complementary spaces: it reweights projected visual tokens before backbone entry and persistently attenuates low-relevance visual states within the backbone. DIVA preserves the full visual token sequence and requires no external grounding supervision. On LIBERO, DIVA improves OpenVLA-OFT from 96.6% to 98.0% average success and raises its zero-shot LIBERO-Plus score from 69.6 to 72.6. Real-world experiments further show consistent gains under task-irrelevant visual perturbations, supporting the robustness of intent-aware visual attenuation beyond simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DIVA 用 anchor-then-attenuate 设计在双空间里按任务意图调节视觉 token 对 VLA 策略计算的影响强度：先融合高层意图与低层视觉证据估计 patch 级相关性锚点，再在 backbone 入口前重投影加权、并在 backbone 内持续衰减低相关视觉状态。在 LIBERO 上把 OpenVLA-OFT 平均成功率从 96.6% 提到 98.0%，零样本 LIBERO-Plus 从 69.6 提到 72.6，真实实验在任务无关视觉扰动下也保持一致增益。
Motivation: VLA 策略把稠密视觉 patch token 直接喂进语言-动作 backbone，保留了场景上下文却没有显式机制去调控不同视觉 token 对策略计算的影响强度，任务无关视觉信息容易干扰动作输出。
Method: DIVA（Dual-Space Intent-Aware Visual Attenuation）采用 anchor-then-attenuate：把高层任务意图与低层视觉证据结合估计 patch 级相关性锚点，随后在两个互补空间施加——backbone 入口前对投影视觉 token 重加权，并在 backbone 内部持续衰减低相关视觉状态；保留完整视觉 token 序列，且不需要外部 grounding 监督。
Result: 在 LIBERO 上，DIVA 使 OpenVLA-OFT 平均成功率从 96.6% 提升到 98.0%，零样本 LIBERO-Plus 分数从 69.6 提升到 72.6；真实世界实验在任务无关视觉扰动 (task-irrelevant visual perturbations) 下显示一致增益。
Conclusion: 按任务意图对视觉 token 做双空间衰减可以在不裁剪 token 序列、不加外部 grounding 监督的前提下提升 VLA 成功率与零样本鲁棒性，且收益能从仿真延续到真实系统。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.result: 在 LIBERO 上，DIVA 使 OpenVLA-OFT 平均成功率从 96.6% 提升到 98.0%，零样本 LIBERO-Plus 分数从 69.6 提升到 72.6；真实世界实验在任务无关视觉扰动 (task-irrelevant visual perturbations) 下显示一致增益。
summary_sections.conclusion: 按任务意图对视觉 token 做双空间衰减可以在不裁剪 token 序列、不加外部 grounding 监督的前提下提升 VLA 成功率与零样本鲁棒性，且收益能从仿真延续到真实系统。

papers.title: Finding Blind Spots in AppWorld and WorkArena Task Verifiers
papers.abstract_en: Execution-based task verifiers decide whether an agent succeeded. We audit shipped AppWorld and WorkArena verifiers with source-informed mutation tests. The main audit never modifies a shipped checker. In AppWorld, duplicating a non-idempotent write creates an extra record while preserving every checked field value. The verifier accepts all three task variants from two of five eligible generators: 6/15 constructed effects. A cardinality patch applied to checker copies after the census makes all six cells fail while preserving valid controls. In WorkArena, we prospectively rerun 23 extra-field candidates selected for earlier checker-PASS outcomes. Independent Table API readback confirms nondefault persisted values in 21, while all 23 receive PASS. Two requested strings are aliases of stored defaults. The 21 confirmed wrong effects span three form templates. These selected cases confirm wrong effects under the audit's protocol; they do not estimate a population rate. No other construction produces an independently confirmed false accept. Other checker-PASS cases are effect-correct degeneracies. We report zero-PASS families separately because retained evidence differs. In fixed intent-swap grids, the checkers return no PASS on 2,689 off-diagonal executions. This is a rejection census: 57 WorkArena cells use session-scoped evidence; the other 2,632 lack classified rejection causes and independent target ground truth. Each increment is specified before its own cells are scored. A supplement accompanies the OpenReview submission with the construction grammar, evidence, content-bound stage lineage and count reproducer.
papers.comment: 14 pages. Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 workshop "Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development". OpenReview paper and supplement: https://openreview.net/forum?id=uR6EWsGE48
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 AppWorld 与 WorkArena 的执行型任务验证器 (execution-based task verifiers) 做源码知情的变异审计：在不改动已发布 checker 的前提下构造重复非幂等写入等效应，AppWorld 五个合格生成器中两个的验证器接受全部三种任务变体（6/15 构造效应），WorkArena 中 23 个候选经 Table API 独立回读确认 21 个持久化了非默认值却全部 PASS。对 checker 副本加基数补丁后六格全部转为 FAIL 且保留有效对照；intent-swap 网格 2,689 次非对角执行零 PASS。
Motivation: 执行型验证器直接判定 agent 是否成功，其误接受会让训练与评测信号失真；已有 AppWorld、WorkArena 验证器是否存在可被构造效应触发的盲点缺少系统审计。
Method: 采用源码知情的变异测试 (source-informed mutation tests)，主审计不修改任何已发布 checker：AppWorld 侧复制非幂等写入以保留全部被检字段值，WorkArena 侧前瞻性重跑 23 个早期 checker-PASS 的 extra-field 候选并用 Table API 独立回读核验；另在 checker 副本上施加 cardinality 补丁，并运行固定 intent-swap 网格。
Result: AppWorld 中两个合格生成器接受全部三种变体，共 6/15 构造效应被接受；cardinality 补丁使这六格全部 FAIL 且保留有效对照。WorkArena 的 23 个候选中 21 个经独立回读确认非默认持久化值（另两个请求字符串是存储默认值的别名），23 个全部 PASS，21 个确认错误效应跨三个表单模板。intent-swap 网格 2,689 次非对角执行零 PASS，其中 57 格使用 session-scoped 证据，其余 2,632 格缺少已分类拒绝原因与独立目标真值。
Conclusion: 这些被选中的案例在审计协议下确认了错误接受，但不估计总体发生率；其余 checker-PASS 案例属于效应正确的退化情形，零 PASS 家族因留存证据不同而单独报告。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Cognitive-Aware QML-CRL Framework for Detecting Affinity and Romance-Investment Fraud
papers.abstract_en: We present a hybrid quantum-classical framework that detects affinity and romance-investment fraud by modelling the cognitive biases in a manipulative conversation. In our proposed framework, cognitive biases central to this fraud class are carried by dedicated qubits in a structured parameterized quantum circuit, together with a frame qubit makes the encoding sensitive to the temporal order of manipulative reframing, and a narrative qubit that aggregates co-occurrence through a trainable entanglement layer. The circuit parameters are trained jointly with a classical reinforcement-learning agent that decides, turn by turn, whether to flag the conversation, modeled as an optimal stopping problem. We evaluate the model's performance on synthetic conversations that include hard negatives, legitimate but urgent, and legitimate but pushy sales conversations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出认知感知的量子-经典混合框架 QML-CRL，用参数化量子电路的专用 qubit 编码操纵性对话中的认知偏差，并与经典强化学习智能体联合训练，把逐轮是否标记对话建模为最优停止问题。在含 hard negatives、合法但紧急、合法但激进推销等合成对话上评估其检测表现。
Motivation: 杀猪盘类 affinity/romance-investment fraud 通过逐轮重构话术操纵受害者认知，传统文本分类难以刻画偏差的时序演化与共现结构。
Method: 结构化参数化量子电路中，认知偏差各占专用 qubit，frame qubit 使编码对操纵性重构的时序顺序敏感，narrative qubit 经可训练纠缠层 (entanglement layer) 聚合共现；量子电路参数与经典 RL 智能体联合训练，智能体逐轮决定是否标记，建模为最优停止 (optimal stopping) 问题。
Result: 在包含 hard negatives、合法但紧急、合法但 pushy 销售对话的合成对话数据集上评估该模型的检测表现。
Conclusion: 把认知偏差显式编码进量子电路并配合 RL 最优停止决策，可构成检测 affinity 与 romance-investment fraud 的混合框架。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Breaking the Space Barrier and its Application to Language Model Inference
papers.abstract_en: Language models are more and more often asked for structured output: JSON that follows a schema, or a tool call with typed arguments. A small machine, an automaton, enforces the format by forbidding the tokens that would break it. We observe that this machine has a rare property: from any of its states, each token leads along exactly one path. Graphs in which only a few paths join any two points are a classical object of complexity theory, and our theoretical result settles an open question about them: one can decide whether such a graph connects two points while verifying that it really has few paths, with very little memory. Precisely, the problem lies in the classes ReachUL, LOGDCFL, C=L and SC2, and needs only O(log2 n/ log log n) space, below the classical O(log2 n) of Savitch's theorem. The constructions behind the proofs become an inference engine: text the format forces is written without running the model, the mask is recomputed on the GPU without any table, recursive formats use a small stack, every output stays valid under a token limit, and independent fields are decoded in parallel and verified. On one 16 GB Apple M2 Pro with Qwen3.5-2B and 4B, against MLX with llguidance, the standard setup for this hardware, schema-constrained extraction finishes 1.2- 1.3x sooner with the same answers, a grammar costs 3 MB instead of up to 1.5 GB, one server holds sixteen grammars where tables run out of memory, and sixteen tool-calling agents finish 2.5x sooner.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把约束解码自动机的单路径性质接到复杂性理论结果上，用 O(log²n / log log n) 空间判定少路径图的可达性，并据此在 GPU 上直接重算 token mask、不查表地做 schema 约束解码。在 16GB Apple M2 Pro 上跑 Qwen3.5-2B/4B，对 MLX+llguidance，schema 抽取快 1.2–1.3 倍、语法占 3MB（对照最高 1.5GB）、单机可驻留 16 份语法，16 个 tool-calling agent 快 2.5 倍。
Motivation: 结构化输出靠自动机屏蔽破坏格式的 token，但传统实现要预计算大表，内存开销可达 GB 级，单机放不下多份语法；同时少路径图的可达性判定在复杂性理论上是长期未决问题。
Method: 利用约束自动机“从任一状态每个 token 只走一条路径”的性质，把可达性问题归入 ReachUL、LOGDCFL、C=L 与 SC²，得到 O(log²n / log log n) 空间算法（低于 Savitch 定理的 O(log²n)）；证明构造直接实现为推理引擎：格式强制的文本不跑模型就写好，mask 在 GPU 上现算不查表，递归格式用小栈，token 上限内保证输出合法，独立字段并行解码再校验。
Result: 在 16GB Apple M2 Pro 上用 Qwen3.5-2B 与 4B，对比该硬件标准方案 MLX+llguidance：schema 约束抽取快 1.2–1.3 倍且答案相同；单份语法 3MB，对照方案最高 1.5GB；单服务器可容纳 16 份语法而查表方案内存耗尽；16 个 tool-calling agent 快 2.5 倍。理论侧给出 O(log²n / log log n) 空间的可达性判定，归入 ReachUL、LOGDCFL、C=L、SC²。
Conclusion: 少路径图的低空间可达性结果可以直接变成不查表的约束解码引擎，在消费级 GPU 上同时压低延迟与语法内存，并让多语法、多 agent 并发成为可行配置。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: SwarmReconGuard: Black-Box Detection of Distributed Collective Reconnaissance by Individually Benign-Looking Agent Populations
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous and agentic clients can distribute reconnaissance across many identities so that each request remains valid, low-rate, and benign-looking while the population collectively acquires broad system knowledge. We formalize this threat as Distributed Collective Reconnaissance (DCR) and present SwarmReconGuard, a reproducible black-box benchmark in which the defender observes only service-boundary telemetry. The Docker-isolated study evaluates 11 benign and attack behaviors across 10-10,000 virtual identities, comprising 440 test runs and 3,666,300 requests, with complete telemetry integrity. We compare semantic, Gaussian, conditional, graph, kernel, hybrid, and CUSUM-based detectors. Gaussian likelihood-ratio detection achieves 100$\%$ detection with 0$\%$ observed false positives on known attacks but only 3$\%$ on unseen policies. CUSUM yields 36.1$\%$ overall detection at 1.25$\%$ false positives, while hybrid CUSUM reaches 85.7$\%$ detection with 0$\%$ observed false positives at 10,000 identities. Results expose a major policy-generalization gap and motivate exposure-aware, scale-aware defenses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SwarmReconGuard 把分布式协同侦察 (DCR) 形式化为威胁并给出黑盒基准：防守方只看服务边界遥测，在 Docker 隔离下跑 11 种良性与攻击行为、10–10,000 个虚拟身份、440 次测试与 3,666,300 个请求。高斯似然比检测对已知攻击达 100% 检出、0% 观测误报，但对未见策略仅 3%；hybrid CUSUM 在 10,000 身份下 85.7% 检出、0% 观测误报，暴露明显的策略泛化缺口。
Motivation: 自主 agentic 客户端可把侦察摊到大量身份上，使每个请求都合法、低速率、看似良性，而整体却获取了广泛系统知识；现有检测难以在只看服务边界遥测的黑盒条件下识别这种群体行为。
Method: 提出可复现的黑盒基准 SwarmReconGuard，Docker 隔离部署，覆盖 11 种良性与攻击行为、10–10,000 个虚拟身份，共 440 次测试运行与 3,666,300 个请求且遥测完整；对比 semantic、Gaussian、conditional、graph、kernel、hybrid 与 CUSUM 七类检测器。
Result: Gaussian 似然比检测在已知攻击上 100% 检出、0% 观测误报，对未见策略仅 3%；CUSUM 整体 36.1% 检出、1.25% 误报；hybrid CUSUM 在 10,000 身份下 85.7% 检出、0% 观测误报。
Conclusion: 检测器在已知策略上可近完美，但跨策略泛化存在重大缺口，防守应做成 exposure-aware 与 scale-aware。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Directional Evidence Guided Search-Space Reduction for Exact DAG Learning
papers.abstract_en: Learning a directed acyclic graph (DAG) from observational data is a challenging combinatorial problem due to the exponential growth in the number of candidate parent-set configurations. Existing exact score-based methods often require computationally intensive combinatorial search, whereas constraint-based methods can become unreliable or computationally demanding as graph size and conditioning-set complexity increase. We develop a non-parametric hybrid framework, referred to as DECO (Directional Evidence-guided Configuration Optimization), that extracts dependency and directional evidence from observation data to construct admissible parent sets prior to exact optimization. It reduces the optimization search space by eliminating empirically unsupported parent configurations while preserving flexibility for all plausible edge orientations. Theoretical analysis establishes an exponential reduction in the admissible parent-set configuration space and quantifies how bounded edge-level omission affects the probability of retaining the true parent structure. Experiments on benchmark Bayesian networks and synthetic discrete and continuous DAGs demonstrate substantial search-space reduction while achieving competitive structure-recovery performance, with favorable structural Hamming distance across many evaluated settings. These results show that directional evidence can provide an effective preprocessing mechanism for reducing the computational burden of exact DAG learning without requiring a fixed parametric structural~model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DECO（Directional Evidence-guided Configuration Optimization）在精确 DAG 学习前先用观测数据提取依赖与方向证据，剔除经验上不支持的父集配置，从而在保留所有合理边方向的前提下压缩精确优化的搜索空间。理论分析证明可容许父集配置空间呈指数级缩减，并量化了有界边级遗漏对保留真实父结构概率的影响；在基准 Bayesian network 与合成离散/连续 DAG 上取得有竞争力的结构恢复表现，多数设置下 structural Hamming distance 占优。
Motivation: 精确基于分数的 DAG 学习需在指数级父集配置上做组合搜索，计算代价高；基于约束的方法随图规模与条件集复杂度上升而变得不可靠或昂贵。
Method: 提出非参数混合框架 DECO：先从观测数据中抽取依赖证据与方向证据，构造可容许父集 (admissible parent sets)，再进入精确优化；该预处理只剔除经验不支持的父集配置，不固定参数化结构模型，同时保留全部合理边方向。
Result: 理论分析给出可容许父集配置空间的指数级缩减，并量化有界边级遗漏对保留真实父结构概率的影响；在基准 Bayesian network 与合成离散、连续 DAG 上，搜索空间大幅缩减，多数评估设置下 structural Hamming distance 表现有利、结构恢复性能有竞争力。
Conclusion: 方向证据可作为精确 DAG 学习的有效预处理机制，在不引入固定参数结构模型的前提下降低计算负担，且结构恢复质量不因此明显受损。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Impact of Likelihood Tempering on the Limiting Predictive Moments of Variational Bayesian Linear Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: In wide Bayesian neural networks, Gaussian mean-field variational inference is prone to "prior dominance": the Kullback-Leibler (KL) regularization term of the ELBO outweighs the expected log-likelihood, and the variational predictive distribution collapses to the prior predictive as the width $M$ grows. Tempering the likelihood, by raising it to the power $1/T$ for a temperature $T < 1$, is equivalent to scaling the KL term by $T$. We ask in this paper how fast $T$ must decrease with $M$ to counteract this degeneracy and strike a good balance between the two terms. For single-hidden-layer linear networks with isotropic Gaussian priors, we derive the limiting predictive distribution under schedules of the form $T = τ/M^{c}$, with constants $τ, c > 0$, as $M \to \infty$ and compare it with the untempered neural network Gaussian process (NNGP) posterior, the infinite-width limit of the exact posterior. Our main result is that the predictive expectation and variance undergo phase transitions at different scales: the limiting expectation leaves its prior value at $c = 1/2$, once $τ$ falls below an explicit threshold, and equals the least-squares prediction for $c > 1/2$, whereas the limiting variance keeps its prior value for $c < 1$, matches the NNGP's for $c=1$, and vanishes for $c > 1$. With suitable choices of $τ,c$, one can recover either the NNGP posterior expectation or its variance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在宽单隐层线性贝叶斯神经网络中，似然回火 (likelihood tempering) 温度按 T=τ/M^c 调度可对抗均场变分推断的先验主导退化：预测期望在 c=1/2 且 τ 低于显式阈值时离开先验值，c>1/2 时收敛到最小二乘预测；预测方差则在 c<1 保持先验值、c=1 与 NNGP 后验一致、c>1 时消失。取合适的 τ、c 可分别复原 NNGP 后验的期望或方差。
Motivation: 宽贝叶斯神经网络的均场变分推断中，ELBO 的 KL 项随宽度 M 增长压过期望对数似然，变分预测分布退化为先验预测；需要确定温度 T 随 M 的下降速度以平衡两项。
Method: 对单隐层线性网络、各向同性高斯先验，推导 T=τ/M^c（τ,c>0）调度下 M→∞ 的极限预测分布，并与未回火的 NNGP 后验（精确后验的无限宽极限）对比；似然取 1/T 次幂等价于把 KL 项缩放 T。
Result: 预测期望与方差在不同尺度发生相变：期望在 c=1/2 且 τ 低于显式阈值时离开先验值，c>1/2 时等于最小二乘预测；方差在 c<1 保持先验值、c=1 与 NNGP 一致、c>1 时消失。
Conclusion: 似然回火的温度调度指数 c 分别控制预测的一阶与二阶矩，选对 τ、c 即可复原 NNGP 后验的期望或方差，从而绕开先验主导退化。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: CADFather: Autonomous CAD Reconstruction through Coordinated Tool Use
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing an editable CAD model from a 3D shape remains a challenging engineering task. Existing methods can propose CAD operations, but no single source of proposals works equally well across different part geometries and stages of reconstruction. We introduce CADFather, an autonomous agentic system that coordinates complementary tools to recover parametric CAD programs from 3D meshes. A vision-language assistant inspects renders of the target and intermediate reconstructions, then decides which candidate CAD programs to extend, which tools to invoke, how many proposals to generate, and when to finish. Learned and algorithmic tools propose CAD operations, while numerical optimization refines the parameters of existing programs. Proposed or refined programs are executed and evaluated to provide feedback for subsequent decisions. The agent maintains alternative candidate programs for each target part and preserves the best valid result throughout reconstruction. CADFather uses pretrained generation and assistant models without additional training. We evaluate reconstruction quality and execution validity on the full DeepCAD, Fusion360, and MCB test sets, as well as on CADENA-Bench, CADBench, and BenchCAD. We additionally analyze computational cost and the trade-off between cost and reconstruction quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CADFather 是一个自主 agent 系统，用视觉-语言助手协调学习式与算法式 CAD 操作生成器和数值优化器，从 3D mesh 恢复可编辑的参数化 CAD 程序。助手根据目标与中间重建的渲染图决定扩展哪些候选程序、调用哪个工具、生成多少提案以及何时结束，并为每个零件保留备选程序与最优有效结果；全程只用预训练模型，无需额外训练。
Motivation: 从 3D 形状重建可编辑 CAD 模型仍是难题：现有方法能提出 CAD 操作，但没有任何单一提案来源在不同零件几何与重建阶段都同样有效。
Method: 视觉-语言助手检查目标与中间重建的渲染图，决定扩展哪些候选程序、调用哪些工具、生成多少提案、何时终止；学习式与算法式工具提出 CAD 操作，数值优化器细化已有程序参数，程序执行后以结果作为后续决策反馈；每个目标零件维护多个候选并保留最优有效结果，全部使用预训练生成与助手模型，不做额外训练。
Result: 在完整 DeepCAD、Fusion360、MCB 测试集以及 CADENA-Bench、CADBench、BenchCAD 上评估重建质量与执行有效性，并分析计算成本及成本与重建质量的权衡。
Conclusion: 协调互补工具的自主 agent 路径可在不重新训练的前提下，跨不同几何与阶段恢复参数化 CAD 程序，且成本与质量的权衡可被显式分析。

papers.title: Domain-informed Adaptive Sampling for Generalizable PINNs in Metal Additive Manufacturing via Conditional Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Accurate thermal modeling is essential in metal additive manufacturing (AM) for understanding the process-structure-property chain. Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) offer effective surrogate thermal modeling by minimizing physics-based residual losses at collocation points. However, prior works typically rely on manually-crafted, static collocation sampling strategies, which are neither principled nor scalable across process conditions, hindering their generalization capability. In this work, we provide theoretical analysis through empirical risk minimization, showing that process condition-aware adaptive sampling is strictly more favorable than conventional static sampling for generalization. Building on this insight, we propose an adaptive sampling strategy within a two-stage framework: (1) a conditional Flow Matching model that learns approximate high-residual distributions across different process conditions, and (2) a mixed sampling strategy combining this distribution with a domain-informed base distribution to generate adaptive collocation points for refining the PINN predictor. Experiments on metal AM numerical benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art PINN baselines, achieving an average 62.1\% reduction in relative $L_2$ error under an identical collocation budget, by capturing process-dependent heat dissipation regions often overlooked in the literature. To the authors' knowledge, this is the first adaptive sampling strategy for PINNs in metal AM, contributing to the enhanced generalization and broader applicability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对金属增材制造热模拟中 PINN 静态配点采样难以跨工艺条件泛化的问题，提出两阶段自适应采样：条件 Flow Matching 学习各工艺条件下的高残差分布，再与 domain-informed 基分布混合生成配点。在金属 AM 数值基准上，相同配点预算下相对 L2 误差平均降低 62.1%，优于 SOTA PINN 基线。
Motivation: PINN 热代理模型依赖人工设计的静态配点策略，既不 principled 也难以跨工艺条件扩展，导致泛化能力受限。
Method: 先用经验风险最小化 (ERM) 做理论分析，论证工艺条件感知的自适应采样严格优于静态采样；再提出两阶段框架：条件 Flow Matching 模型学习跨工艺条件的近似高残差分布，与 domain-informed 基分布混合生成自适应配点，用于细化 PINN 预测器。
Result: 在金属 AM 数值基准上，相同配点预算下相对 L2 误差平均降低 62.1%，持续优于 SOTA PINN 基线；机制上捕捉到文献中常被忽略的、依赖工艺条件的散热区域。
Conclusion: 工艺条件感知的自适应配点是金属 AM 中 PINN 泛化的关键，作者称这是金属 AM 中 PINN 的首个自适应采样策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Depth-to-RGB: Repurposing a Frozen Depth Estimator for Geometry-Guided Compositing
papers.abstract_en: Reference-based object compositing inserts or replaces an object using a background image, a reference image, and a 2D compositing mask. These inputs guide appearance and placement but leave the completed scene's geometry implicit, which can distort object structure or alter the surroundings. Our Depth-to-RGB (D2R) framework predicts composite depth for a scene not yet observed in the RGB inputs. It learns reference-conditioned corrections to a frozen depth estimator using encoder features of paired completed scenes as targets. The unchanged decoder maps the corrected representation to the intended scene's depth, which a separately trained renderer holds fixed during RGB synthesis. Under matched architecture and training, encoder-feature supervision reduces OOD Stage-1 AbsRel by 31.4% relative to decoded-depth supervision. We also introduce AnyInsertion++ with paired in-distribution and category-disjoint splits to evaluate generalization beyond compositing training categories. The complete D2R system leads 12 open-source and 3 closed-source baselines in estimator-derived geometry and photometric quality on both paired splits. On category-disjoint data, D2R reduces AbsRel by 43.7% and improves PSNR by 2.4 dB over the matched RGB baseline. Across three unpaired benchmarks, D2R leads both identity metrics and reduces mean CLIP reference cosine distance by 55% relative to the strongest baseline. Project page: https://shjo-april.github.io/Depth2RGB/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: D2R 把冻结的深度估计器改造成合成场景的几何先验：用配对完成场景的 encoder 特征去校正深度表征，decoder 保持不变输出尚未在 RGB 输入中出现的合成深度，渲染器再据此固定几何做 RGB 合成。在 OOD Stage-1 上 encoder 特征监督比 decoded-depth 监督把 AbsRel 降低 31.4%；在类别不相交的 AnyInsertion++ 划分上，相对匹配的 RGB 基线 AbsRel 降 43.7%、PSNR 提 2.4 dB，并在三个非配对基准上把 CLIP 参考余弦距离相对最强基线降 55%。
Motivation: 参考式物体合成只靠背景图、参考图和 2D mask 引导外观与位置，场景几何是隐式的，容易扭曲物体结构或改变周围环境；同时合成模型在训练类别之外的泛化缺少成套评测划分。
Method: Depth-to-RGB (D2R) 用配对完成场景的 encoder 特征作为监督目标，学习对冻结深度估计器的参考条件校正，未改动的 decoder 把校正后的表征映射为目标场景深度；一个单独训练的渲染器在 RGB 合成阶段把该深度固定住。配套提出 AnyInsertion++，含配对 in-distribution 与 category-disjoint 两种划分，用于评测跨类别泛化。
Result: 在匹配架构与训练下，encoder 特征监督相对 decoded-depth 监督把 OOD Stage-1 AbsRel 降低 31.4%。完整 D2R 在两种配对划分上于估计器几何与光度质量两方面领先 12 个开源与 3 个闭源基线；category-disjoint 数据上相对匹配 RGB 基线 AbsRel 降 43.7%、PSNR 提升 2.4 dB。三个非配对基准上 D2R 领先两项 identity 指标，CLIP 参考余弦距离均值相对最强基线降低 55%。
Conclusion: 把冻结深度估计器的中间表征而非解码深度作为监督目标，可以在不改 decoder 的前提下为合成场景提供可用几何，使 RGB 合成在训练类别之外仍保持结构与身份一致性。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.result: 在匹配架构与训练下，encoder 特征监督相对 decoded-depth 监督把 OOD Stage-1 AbsRel 降低 31.4%。完整 D2R 在两种配对划分上于估计器几何与光度质量两方面领先 12 个开源与 3 个闭源基线；category-disjoint 数据上相对匹配 RGB 基线 AbsRel 降 43.7%、PSNR 提升 2.4 dB。三个非配对基准上 D2R 领先两项 identity 指标，CLIP 参考余弦距离均值相对最强基线降低 55%。

papers.title: Spatial Induction Heads: In-Context Learning of Multidimensional Cellular Automata
papers.abstract_en: Induction heads provide a mechanistic account of in-context learning in sequential data, but existing theory largely assumes that the context relevant to a prediction forms a contiguous block. In multidimensional data, serialization breaks this assumption by scattering spatial neighbors across distant positions in the token sequence. We study how transformers overcome this routing problem in multidimensional stochastic and deterministic cellular automata, where each trajectory is generated by an unknown local rule and presented as a flattened sequence without an explicit coordinate-based spatial inductive bias. We introduce spatial induction heads, two-layer gather-and-match circuits in which the first layer reconstructs the relevant spatial neighborhood and the second matches the resulting configuration against earlier occurrences. We give two explicit realizations of the gather and show that the positional dimension required for spatial routing depends only on the local neighborhood and spatial dimension, not on grid volume or trajectory horizon. We further construct a matching layer which implements Bayesian counting. The end-to-end circuit can approximate the Bayesian posterior arbitrarily closely for stochastic rules and can predict exactly for deterministic rules. Empirically, trained two-layer transformers generalize to unseen rules in one and two dimensional settings, achieving near-perfect deterministic rollouts and less than 0.005 nats KL from the Bayes-optimal predictor on stochastic rules. Attention patterns and layerwise probes align with the predicted gather-and-match computation, providing mechanistic evidence for spatial induction in trained transformers.
papers.comment: Under review at ICLR 2027. Project page: https://kimzemian.github.io/spatial-induction-heads/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 spatial induction heads：两层 gather-and-match 电路，第一层从被序列化的多维元胞自动机 token 流中重建空间邻域，第二层把该构型与历史出现匹配，从而在无坐标归纳偏置的 transformer 中实现上下文学习。该电路对随机规则可任意逼近 Bayes 后验、对确定性规则可精确预测；训练出的两层 transformer 在未见规则上确定性 rollout 接近完美，随机规则下与 Bayes 最优预测器的 KL 差距小于 0.005 nats。
Motivation: 现有 induction head 理论假设与预测相关的上下文在序列中连续，而多维数据序列化会把空间邻居打散到相距很远的位置，路由问题使该假设失效。
Method: 在未知局部规则生成的一维与二维随机/确定性元胞自动机构造上，训练无显式空间归纳偏置的两层 transformer；提出两层 gather-and-match 电路，给出两种显式 gather 实现，并构造实现 Bayesian counting 的匹配层；用注意力模式与逐层探针检验计算是否与预测的 gather-and-match 一致。
Result: 空间路由所需的 positional 维度只依赖局部邻域大小与空间维数，不随网格体积或轨迹时长增长；端到端电路对随机规则可任意逼近 Bayes 后验、对确定性规则可精确预测；训练后的两层 transformer 在一维和二维未见规则上泛化，确定性 rollout 接近完美，随机规则下距 Bayes 最优预测器不到 0.005 nats KL。
Conclusion: 空间归纳可以由可解释的 gather-and-match 电路给出机制性解释，且其路由开销由局部邻域而非问题规模决定；注意力与探针证据表明训练出的 transformer 确实在执行这一计算。

papers.title: Are Parameter-Efficient Fine-tuning Methods Really Different?
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) offers many parameterizations, yet their methodological and functional differences remain unclear. We compare six methods in language and diffusion models to examine how their parameterizations relate to task performance, forgetting, and changes in pretrained weight geometry. Motivated by the spectrum-preserving design of orthogonal fine-tuning (OFT), we first ask whether spectral preservation is itself important for adaptation and retention. We find that the selected LoRA-family methods also approximately preserve pretrained geometry, and that restoring their slightly drifted singular-value spectra largely preserves task performance, questioning the necessity of explicit geometric preservation. Beyond this, we observe that some methods exhibit distinct adaptation--retention trade-offs that vary across settings: LoRA most consistently limits forgetting at competitive performance, DoRA achieves higher mean task scores than LoRA in most comparisons, while PiSSA often incurs greater retention costs. Further intervention experiments suggest that while performance gains from different PEFT methods can be attributed to modifications in different groups of spectral components, we consistently find that restoring dominant rather than intermediate or trailing components produces the largest mean reduction in general-text NLL or base-image drift. Together, these results motivate evaluating geometric constraints through their functional consequences rather than preservation alone. Code is available at https://github.com/Kuaaannn/PEFT_methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在语言与扩散模型上对比六种参数高效微调 (PEFT)，发现 LoRA 系方法本就近似保持预训练权重几何，把轻微漂移的奇异值谱恢复回去基本不损失任务性能，说明显式几何保持并非必要。LoRA 最稳定地限制遗忘，DoRA 多数比较中平均任务分更高，PiSSA 保留代价更大；恢复主导奇异值分量比恢复中间或尾部分量带来更大的通用文本 NLL 或基础图像漂移下降。
Motivation: PEFT 参数化形式众多，但方法间在任务性能、遗忘与预训练权重几何变化上的功能差异并不清楚，OFT 式谱保持设计是否真的必要缺乏检验。
Method: 在语言模型与扩散模型上比较六种 PEFT 方法，测量任务性能、遗忘与预训练权重几何（奇异值谱）变化；以 OFT 的谱保持设计为出发点做谱恢复干预，并对不同谱分量（主导、中间、尾部）做干预实验，归因性能增益来源。
Result: LoRA 系方法近似保持预训练几何，恢复其轻微漂移的奇异值谱后任务性能基本保留；多数比较中 DoRA 平均任务分高于 LoRA，LoRA 最一致地限制遗忘，PiSSA 常带来更大保留代价；恢复主导分量而非中间或尾部分量，对通用文本 NLL 或基础图像漂移的平均下降最大。
Conclusion: 显式几何保持本身不是适应与保留的必要条件，评估几何约束应看其功能后果而非是否保持；性能增益可归因于对不同谱分量组的修改。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Deceptive Bandit Problem: Exploratory Coupling and the Fragility of Multi-Agent Learning
papers.abstract_en: Randomized exploration is central to bandit learning, multi-agent reinforcement learning, and zeroth-order policy search, yet its independence and privacy are usually only treated as technical assumptions. We show that these properties are critical for security purposes and demonstrate how an adversarial agent can exploit privileged information on another agent's exploration. We analyze a deceiver-victim pair in the minimal two-player strongly monotone setting, where a deceptive player obtains leaked signals that are merely correlated with the victim's exploration. We show that, by coupling their own exploratory action with this information, the deceptive player injects an externality that steers the learning dynamics to a new steady state, called the deceptive Nash equilibrium (DNE). We prove that the deceptive bandit learning (DBL) dynamics converge to an arbitrarily small neighborhood of the DNE while retaining optimal convergence rates. Interestingly, our analysis attains these optimal rates while relaxing second-order smoothness conditions from standard bandit optimization literature. We characterize conditions under which deception strictly shifts the steady state and its effect on the deceiver's cost, illustrating the results in a resource-allocation game.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在两玩家强单调 bandit 博弈中，欺骗者把与受害者探索相关的泄露信号耦合进自己的探索动作，注入外部性把学习动力学推到新的稳态——欺骗 Nash 均衡 (DNE)。DBL 动力学收敛到 DNE 的任意小邻域且保持最优收敛速率，同时放松了标准 bandit 优化文献中的二阶光滑性条件。
Motivation: bandit 学习、多智能体 RL 与零阶策略搜索中随机探索的独立性与隐私通常只被当作技术假设，本文指出它们实为安全关键：对手可利用对他人探索的特权信息操纵学习结果。
Method: 在最小的两玩家强单调设定下分析 deceiver-victim 对：欺骗者获得仅与受害者探索相关的泄露信号，并将其与自身探索动作耦合；证明 deceptive bandit learning (DBL) 动力学的收敛性，并在资源分配博弈 (resource-allocation game) 中刻画欺骗严格移动稳态的条件及其对欺骗者代价的影响。
Result: 证明 DBL 动力学收敛到 DNE 的任意小邻域并保持最优收敛速率；该最优速率在放松标准 bandit 优化文献的二阶光滑性条件下达成；给出欺骗严格改变稳态的条件，并在资源分配博弈中说明对欺骗者代价的效果。
Conclusion: 探索的独立性与隐私不是可忽略的技术假设而是安全属性：耦合泄露信号足以把多智能体学习推向被操纵的稳态 DNE，且这一操纵在弱于二阶光滑的条件下仍保持最优收敛速率。

papers.title: Which Buildings Are Artificial Intelligence-Ready? A Measurement-Based Assessment Framework for AI Question Answering and Actuation
papers.abstract_en: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) systems are becoming the interface to buildings, answering questions and controlling operations, but a building's readiness for them has not been systematically assessed. This study proposes a framework to quantify it. First, a building's knowledge graph sets two ceilings. The answerable-readiness ceiling is the share of operational questions its data could answer, and the actuation-readiness ceiling is the share of control actions it exposes. Second, a reference AI agent's accuracy on a fixed set of these questions shows how much of the ceilings is realized. On a simulated office, the agent realizes 0.62 of a 0.64 answerable ceiling, so missing data, not the AI, limit readiness, except in naming a fault's cause. Across 37 public real-building graphs, the median answerable ceiling is 0.16, and in 15 of 45, unlinked sensors lower it. The framework turns "is this building AI-ready?" into an auditable, ranked retrofit question.
papers.comment: 47 pages, 11 figures, 23 tables. Code, results and data supplement: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23197610
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出建筑 AI 就绪度测量框架：用知识图谱设定两个上限——可回答就绪上限（数据能回答的运营问题占比）与可执行就绪上限（暴露的控制动作占比），再用参考 AI agent 在固定问题集上的准确率衡量上限被实现的比例。模拟办公室中 agent 实现了 0.64 可回答上限中的 0.62，说明限制就绪度的是数据缺失而非 AI（命名故障原因除外）；37 个真实建筑图谱的可回答上限中位数仅 0.16，其中 45 个里有 15 个因传感器未链接而被拉低。
Motivation: Agentic AI 正成为建筑的交互界面，但一栋建筑是否具备被 AI 使用的条件此前没有系统化的量化评估方法，改造决策缺少可审计依据。
Method: 框架分两步：先由建筑知识图谱计算可回答就绪上限与可执行就绪上限，再用一个参考 AI agent 在固定问题集上的准确率度量上限实现程度；在模拟办公室与 37 个公开真实建筑图谱上应用，并把问题转成可审计、可排序的改造清单。
Result: 模拟办公室中 agent 实现 0.64 可回答上限中的 0.62，仅在命名故障原因一项上未达标；37 个公开真实建筑图谱的可回答上限中位数为 0.16；45 个中有 15 个因传感器未链接 (unlinked sensors) 拉低上限。
Conclusion: 建筑 AI 就绪度的瓶颈通常是数据完备性而非模型能力，因此应把“是否 AI-ready”转成可审计、可排序的改造问题，优先补齐缺失与未链接的数据。

papers.title: TopoCurve: Geometry-Aware Topology Reasoning via Bézier Curves in Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Topology reasoning jointly detects 3D lanes and traffic elements from multi-view images and infers their structural connectivity. Current methods model lanes as discrete polylines, lacking smoothness, analytical tangent directions, and global spatial support for attention, while providing sparse topology supervision. We propose TopoCurve, a geometry-driven architecture for 3D topology reasoning grounded in a structured parametric lane representation. Lanes are modeled as endpoint-fixed cubic Bézier curves, enabling continuous geometry with exact endpoints and analytically defined directionality. We exploit this shared curve geometry across the entire pipeline. Endpoint distance and tangent alignment are encoded with multi-scale Fourier features and injected into the topology head. Sampled curve points serve as geometry-aligned references for deformable cross-attention spanning the full lane. Parallel curve-anchored attention branches provide diverse predictions for one-to-many topology supervision. These components form a tightly coupled cascade where representation enables geometric reasoning, guides feature aggregation, and supports denser supervision. TopoCurve achieves 50.6 OLS on the OpenLane-V2 benchmark without any post-processing, establishing a new state-of-the-art among end-to-end camera-only methods, and outperforms all existing approaches on endpoint detection (56.8 vs. 52.6 on DET_p).

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TopoCurve 把自动驾驶 3D 车道建模为端点固定的三次 Bézier 曲线而非离散折线，用共享曲线几何贯穿整条流水线：端点距离与切线方向经多尺度 Fourier 特征注入 topology head，采样曲线点作为 deformable cross-attention 的几何对齐参考，并用并行曲线锚定注意力分支支撑 one-to-many 拓扑监督。在 OpenLane-V2 上不做任何后处理即取得 50.6 OLS，端点检测 DET_p 56.8 对比既有方法 52.6。
Motivation: 现有方法把车道表示为离散折线，缺少平滑性、解析切线方向和注意力所需的全局空间支撑，拓扑监督也稀疏，限制了多视图图像下 3D 车道与交通要素结构连接的联合推理。
Method: 以端点固定的三次 Bézier 曲线作为结构化参数化车道表示，得到连续几何、精确端点与解析方向；端点距离和切线对齐用多尺度 Fourier 特征编码后注入 topology head；整条车道上采样的曲线点作为 deformable cross-attention 的几何对齐参考；并行的曲线锚定注意力分支为同一目标给出多样预测，支撑 one-to-many 拓扑监督，各组件级联耦合。
Result: 在 OpenLane-V2 基准上取得 50.6 OLS，且不做任何后处理，在端到端纯相机方法中达到新的 state-of-the-art；端点检测 DET_p 为 56.8，对比既有方法的 52.6。
Conclusion: 结构化参数曲线表示既能驱动几何推理、引导特征聚合，也能支撑更稠密的拓扑监督，因此端到端相机方法可以在无后处理条件下刷新 OpenLane-V2 的 OLS 与 DET_p 记录。

papers.title: Workhorse: Learning Robust Whole-Body Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from Human Data
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid robots still struggle to plan contact-rich whole-body manipulation from egocentric RGB and proprioception. Workhorse learns such manipulation from robot-free human demonstrations. A visual planner predicts five-link targets: the poses of the torso, both wrists, and both feet. A reinforcement-learning whole-body tracker follows them on the robot. Both policies train separately on the same recorded human poses, without retargeting. We augment the training data of each policy to imitate the errors that the other makes at deployment. On a real Unitree G1, Workhorse sorts boxes with its hands and a kick, catches a thrown box, and topples and climbs a suitcase. During box sorting, we show recoveries after a person pushes the robot or takes the box away. In a simulated copy of the demonstration room, the system completes box sorting in 77% of episodes, and in 64% under 40 N.s pushes. With both policies retrained from the same demonstrations, a simulated second humanoid completes box sorting in 83% of episodes without pushes.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 8 figures, 2 tables. Project page: https://hsb0508.github.io/workhorse/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Workhorse 从无机器人的人类演示中学习全身 loco-manipulation：视觉规划器预测躯干、双腕、双足共五个连杆目标，强化学习全身跟踪器在机器人上跟随，两者各自训练且不做 retargeting，并互相用对方部署期误差增广训练数据。仿真中整理箱子成功率 77%，在 40 N.s 推挤下 64%，换第二个 humanoid 重训后 83%。
Motivation: 人形机器人难以从第一人称 RGB 与本体感觉规划接触密集的全身操作，而人类演示数据易得、机器人演示数据稀缺。
Method: 视觉规划器从 egocentric RGB 预测五连杆目标（躯干、双腕、双足位姿），强化学习全身跟踪器在 Unitree G1 上跟随；两策略在同一批录制人类位姿上分别训练、不做 retargeting，并用对方部署期产生的误差增广各自训练数据。
Result: 真机 Unitree G1 完成用手加踢整理箱子、接住抛来的箱子、推倒并爬上行李箱；整理箱子时可在人推机器人或拿走箱子后恢复。仿真演示房间中整理箱子成功率 77%，在 40 N.s 推挤下 64%；两策略用同一演示重训后，第二个 humanoid 在无推挤时 83%。
Conclusion: 不依赖机器人演示、也不做 retargeting，靠两个策略互相吸收对方的部署误差，就能在真机与仿真中完成接触密集的全身 loco-manipulation。

papers.title: SPLATIFY: Reproduce, Discover, Innovate! From Papers and Ideas to Trainable 3DGS Code
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) research demands significant effort to reimplement papers before building on them. We introduce SPLATIFY, a multi-agent framework that converts 3DGS papers into trainable gsplat-based implementations, where generic paper-to-code methods and frontier models fail. SPLATIFY achieves this through five innovations: (1) A context-free grammar for gsplat over a modular method template with extension points for losses, densification, rendering, and optimization, constraining synthesis so generated code satisfies gsplat's architectural invariants by construction. (2) Architectural elements for faithful reproduction: fork-aware citation recovery retrieving component-level code at function-level granularity, Graph-of-Thought synthesis in topological dependency order, RAG-guided in-context example selection from over 20 verified implementations, and visual feedback combining PSNR-guided regeneration, Gaussian-level structural checks, and VLM-driven patching. (3) Knowledge-driven compositional improvement that autonomously finds weaknesses and composes complementary regularizers, losses, and densification strategies to improve upon original results. (4) Interdisciplinary method discovery where agents retrieve physical priors from outside the 3DGS literature and compose them with rendering knowledge to produce methods for previously unaddressed scene types. (5) SPLATIFY-Bench, an evaluation framework across 30 diverse 3DGS papers. On papers without public code, SPLATIFY matches expert implementations while reducing development time from weeks to minutes, and through compositional discovery further improves PSNR by up to 2.4 dB. We additionally demonstrate novel methods for volumetric nebula rendering and other scientific domains, synthesized entirely by SPLATIFY.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPLATIFY 是把 3DGS 论文自动转成可训练 gsplat 代码的多智能体框架，用上下文无关文法约束合成、fork 感知引用恢复与 Graph-of-Thought 拓扑综合，并在 30 篇 3DGS 论文上评测。在无公开代码的论文上匹配专家实现、开发时间从数周缩到数分钟，组合式改进把 PSNR 最多再提 2.4 dB。
Motivation: 3DGS 论文数量激增，复现需要大量人力，通用 paper-to-code 方法与前沿模型在该领域失效。
Method: 五项设计：面向 gsplat 模块化模板（损失、致密化、渲染、优化扩展点）的上下文无关文法，使生成代码按构造满足架构不变式；函数级粒度的 fork 感知引用恢复、按拓扑依赖序的 Graph-of-Thought 综合、基于 20 多个已验证实现的 RAG 引导 in-context 示例选择，以及结合 PSNR 引导重生成、Gaussian 级结构检查与 VLM 打补丁的视觉反馈；另有知识驱动的组合式改进与跨领域物理先验检索。
Result: 在 SPLATIFY-Bench（30 篇多样 3DGS 论文）上，对无公开代码的论文匹配专家实现，开发时间由数周降到数分钟；组合式发现使 PSNR 最多提升 2.4 dB，并合成了星云体积渲染等新方法。
Conclusion: 论文到可训练代码的合成在 3DGS 领域可行，且能进一步改进原结果并产出跨学科新方法。

papers.title: From Uncertainty to Action: Learning to Steer LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Steering an LLM agent means deciding whether to correct it, at which step, and with which mechanism. Uncertainty is often used to decide when to correct an agent, but whether it can guide these decisions remains unclear. We steer agent trajectories separately at every non-terminal step with each of four mechanisms and run each continuation to completion. The resulting stepwise outcome table (SOT) holds about 82,000 counterfactual continuations of 1,864 trajectories from three benchmarks and two agents. It shows that uncertainty can identify failing trajectories, but that no single signal reliably locates the step at which steering helps. We therefore propose VoS (Value of Steering), a trajectory-level monitor, offline or online, that learns from SOT the value of steering at each step and decides where to steer by it. A harm-budgeted trigger decides whether to steer, limiting the fraction of successful trajectories that VoS disturbs. VoS improves on unmodified execution in all 12 settings of benchmark, agent, and offline or online use, by 7.8 points on average, and outperforms the strongest of five existing uncertainty-triggered methods in 11, by 2.9 points on average. Ablations show that training on measured outcomes and a tight harm budget are both essential.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM agent 的不确定性只能识别会失败的轨迹，却无法定位在哪一步干预才有用。作者用四种干预机制在每个非终止步各跑一次完整续写，构造含约 82,000 条反事实续写、1,864 条轨迹的 stepwise outcome table (SOT)，据此训练轨迹级监控器 VoS 决定干预时机，并用 harm-budget 触发器限制对成功轨迹的破坏比例。在三个 benchmark、两种 agent、离线与在线共 12 个设置上，VoS 相对不干预提升平均 7.8 个点，比五个既有不确定性触发方法中最强者在其中 11 个设置上高 2.9 个点。
Motivation: 不确定性常被用来决定是否纠正 LLM agent，但它能否同时回答「在哪一步、用哪种机制纠正」并不清楚；缺这一步，干预要么过早要么无效。
Method: 在每条轨迹的每个非终止步分别用四种干预机制各续写一次并跑到终点，汇总成 SOT（约 82,000 条反事实续写、1,864 条轨迹，来自三个 benchmark 和两个 agent）。VoS 从 SOT 学习每步干预的价值，可离线或在线给出干预位置；harm-budgeted trigger 决定是否干预，约束被打扰的成功轨迹比例。
Result: VoS 在 benchmark × agent × 离线/在线的全部 12 个设置上都优于不干预，平均提升 7.8 个点；在其中 11 个设置上超过五个既有不确定性触发方法中最强者，平均高 2.9 个点。消融显示用实测结果训练与紧的 harm budget 两者都必不可少。
Conclusion: 干预决策应由「干预的价值」而非不确定性信号驱动：不确定性足以发现失败轨迹，但定位干预步需要从反事实结果表中学习，并配合严格的成功轨迹保护预算。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: GeoNatureAgent (GNA): A Framework and Benchmark for Pre-Production Evaluation of Tool-Using Agents on Geospatial and Environmental Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Before tool-using LLM agents are deployed in environmental and geospatial workflows, teams need evidence that an agent reliably selects the right operations against real APIs. We introduce GeoNatureAgent (GNA), a framework for pre-production evaluation of tool-using agents: a fixed sixteen-tool geospatial interface published as a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, so the agent under test is the only variable, scored against an identical tool layer, task suite, and deterministic scorer. Its flagship instance is a 103-task benchmark (a 93-task main suite across 18 categories plus a ten-task comparison expansion) evaluated against an open, self-hostable geospatial API serving three environmental indicators across Spain and Portugal. We evaluate nine LLMs under three temperature-1.0 seeds, reporting capability and per-case cost as orthogonal axes. (1) Claude Sonnet 4 achieves the highest capability (61.7% +/- 0.7% on all 103 tasks; 60.8% on the main suite), followed closely by DeepSeek V3.2 (57.9%), while no other model exceeds 53%; (2) the cost-accuracy Pareto frontier is mostly open-weight, with DeepSeek V3.2 offering 93% of Claude's capability at 11.3x lower list-price cost; (3) under strict all-checks scoring the best model sits 24-36 points below the 85-97% reported on general-purpose GIS benchmarks, whereas per-check partial credit for the top four models (86-90%) is comparable, so much of that gap reflects scoring strictness rather than task difficulty alone. The MCP server, evaluation harness, benchmark, and API are publicly available; swapping the tool executors and task suite instantiates an equivalent benchmark for any geospatial domain.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 4 figures. Extended version of arXiv:2606.12821 (ACM SIGSPATIAL 2026 poster paper). Published at GeoIndustry '26 (ACM SIGSPATIAL Workshop)
papers.journal_ref: The 5th ACM SIGSPATIAL International Workshop on Spatial Big Data and AI for Industrial Applications (GeoIndustry '26), November 03-06, 2026, Riverside, CA, USA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoNatureAgent (GNA) 用固定十六工具的 MCP 地理空间接口、统一任务套件与确定性打分器，把被测 LLM 作为唯一变量做部署前评估。在覆盖西班牙、葡萄牙三种环境指标的 103 任务基准上，Claude Sonnet 4 能力最高（61.7% ± 0.7%），DeepSeek V3.2 以 11.3 倍更低标价拿到其 93% 的能力；严格全检打分下最好模型比通用 GIS 基准的 85–97% 低 24–36 点，而部分给分口径下前四名为 86–90%，说明差距主要来自打分严格度而非任务难度。
Motivation: 工具型 LLM agent 上线到环境与地理空间工作流前，团队缺少证据说明它能否稳定对真实 API 选对操作；现有通用 GIS 基准的分数又受打分口径影响，难以横向比较。
Method: 发布固定十六工具地理空间接口作为 Model Context Protocol (MCP) server，使被测 agent 成为唯一变量，共享同一工具层、任务套件与确定性 scorer；旗舰实例为 103 任务基准（93 任务主套件、18 个类别，外加 10 任务对比扩展），对接一个可自托管的开源地理空间 API，覆盖西班牙与葡萄牙的三种环境指标；对 9 个 LLM 各跑 3 个 temperature 1.0 随机种子，把能力与单例成本作为正交两轴报告。
Result: Claude Sonnet 4 在全部 103 任务上能力最高，61.7% ± 0.7%（主套件 60.8%）；DeepSeek V3.2 次之 57.9%，其余模型均不超过 53%。成本-准确率 Pareto 前沿以开放权重模型为主，DeepSeek V3.2 以 11.3 倍更低的标价成本达到 Claude 93% 的能力。严格全检打分下最好模型比通用 GIS 基准报告的 85–97% 低 24–36 点，而对前四名模型按 per-check 部分给分为 86–90%，与之相当。
Conclusion: 作者主张通用 GIS 基准与 GNA 的分数差距很大程度反映打分严格度而非任务难度本身；MCP server、评测框架、基准与 API 公开，替换工具执行器与任务套件即可为任意地理空间领域实例化等价基准。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Same Text, Different Prediction: Serving-Context Nondeterminism in Text Classifiers
papers.abstract_en: Deterministic inference is essential for reliable and trustworthy machine learning. Prior studies of text generation have shown that changing factors such as batch size, batch composition, hardware, or inference engine can alter the generated text, even when the prompt, model parameters, and sampling randomness are fixed. These differences have been attributed in part to floating-point non-associativity, shape-dependent kernel selection, and other implementation-level differences in numerical execution. However, it remains unclear whether, when, and to what extent the same factors affect text classification. We present a systematic study of serving-context non-invariance in text classifiers, which prior work has measured only through generated text. We train 180 models spanning discriminative, pseudo-generative, and fully generative classifier formulations and evaluate each across four categories of serving contexts, holding the checkpoint and the text fixed. Label stability does not imply score stability. Changing only the batch shape changes no labels across fp32 comparisons, yet under bf16 it moves up to 56.7 percentage points of predicted probability mass, with label changes concentrated at small margins. Fully generative classifiers change more labels than their discriminative counterparts under the same serving changes. We derive sufficient conditions for label stability under each serving change and give a separate mitigation for each mechanism. Our results identify and quantify the serving conditions that must be fixed for reproducible text classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 文本分类在推理服务环境变化下并不确定：固定 checkpoint 与输入文本，仅改变 batch 形状等服务上下文，fp32 下标签完全不变，但 bf16 下最多可移动 56.7 个百分点的预测概率质量，且标签翻转集中在小间隔样本上。作者对每类服务改动推导标签稳定的充分条件并给出对应缓解手段，结论是可复现的文本分类必须固定所识别的服务条件。
Motivation: 文本生成的非确定性已被广泛测量，但同样的 batch 形状、硬件、推理引擎等因素何时、多大程度影响文本分类尚不清楚，此前只能通过生成文本间接观测。
Method: 训练 180 个模型，覆盖判别式、伪生成式与完全生成式三类分类器表述；在固定 checkpoint 与固定文本的前提下，跨四类服务上下文 (serving contexts) 逐一评测，并对每种机制推导标签稳定的充分条件、给出独立的缓解方案。
Result: 仅改变 batch 形状时，fp32 对比下没有任何标签改变；bf16 下最多移动 56.7 个百分点的预测概率质量，标签变化集中在小间隔 (small margins) 处。相同服务改动下，完全生成式分类器比判别式分类器改变更多标签。
Conclusion: 标签稳定不等于分数稳定，可复现的文本分类必须固定论文所识别的那组服务条件，并按机制分别采用对应缓解手段。

papers.title: Breaking Adversarial Transferability in Fine-Tuned Speech Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Many organizations fine-tune publicly available pretrained Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) models and deploy them in black-box settings, assuming limited access provides protection. We show this assumption is fragile: adversarial perturbations crafted on the public base model transfer effectively to fine-tuned target models, severely degrading performance and posing concerns for safety-critical applications. We propose TransferBreaker, a unified fine-tuning framework that suppresses adversarial transfer by integrating Base Adversarial Fine-Tuning, which restricts adversarial training to base-effective perturbations; Latent Jacobian Regularization, which enforces latent-space invariance by suppressing adversarially sensitive directions; and HybridGrad-AFT, which improves robustness against adaptive attacks by interpolating transferable perturbations from base and target gradients. We theoretically justify all components and evaluate TransferBreaker across three languages and four large ASR models, reducing adversarial WER from 92.6 to 27.8. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/rohban-lab/TransferBreaker.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对微调后 ASR 模型仍被基座模型对抗样本迁移攻击的问题，提出 TransferBreaker 微调框架，把对抗训练限制在基座有效扰动上，并压制隐空间中对抗敏感方向。在三种语言、四个大型 ASR 模型上，对抗 WER 从 92.6 降到 27.8。
Motivation: 组织方以为黑盒部署、只暴露微调模型即可防攻击，但基于公开基座模型构造的对抗扰动能有效迁移到微调目标模型，使性能严重下降，威胁安全关键应用。
Method: TransferBreaker 联合三个组件：Base Adversarial Fine-Tuning（仅对基座有效扰动做对抗训练）、Latent Jacobian Regularization（压制对抗敏感方向以强制隐空间不变性）、HybridGrad-AFT（在基座与目标梯度间插值可迁移扰动以抵御自适应攻击）；三者均给出理论论证。
Result: 在三种语言、四个大型 ASR 模型上评估，对抗 WER 从 92.6 降至 27.8。
Conclusion: 限制对抗训练的作用范围并约束隐空间敏感方向，可显著削弱跨微调的对抗迁移，使黑盒部署假设在对抗扰动下更站得住。

papers.title: Convex-Concave Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Policy learning drives many of the most consequential and heavily-invested applications of reinforcement learning today. Yet the core optimization problem it rests on (maximizing expected return) is notoriously non-convex, even under a direct policy parameterization, and the field has largely responded by avoiding it: optimizing convex surrogate approximations of the return under trust-region constraints (NPG, TRPO, PPO, AWR). We show that this seemingly unstructured problem is not actually structureless. In log-density-ratio coordinates $y := \log[π/π_n]$, the exact per-iteration objective, computable via per-decision importance sampling (PDIS), is a difference-of-convex-constrained difference-of-convex (DC-constrained DC) program. This structure lets us move beyond surrogate approximations: it recovers CPI, NPG, TRPO, and AWR as special cases along interpretable axes, and it opens a multi-step axis $k$ that couples consecutive decisions. We solve the per-iteration program with sequential convex programming (SCP), the standard solver for difference-of-convex problems, and give convergence guarantees under mild conditions, bridging the difference-of-convex optimization and RL literatures. Empirically, multi-step Convex-Concave RL (CCRL) wins on diagnostic MDPs where credit must propagate across a horizon (its advantage growing with the dependency length), is competitive with a tuned PPO on classic control, and on a realistic, stochastic, mid-horizon healthcare domain converges markedly faster than tuned PPO to the same near-optimal survival, with an 11.3% higher area under the training curve.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在对数密度比坐标 y := log[π/π_n] 下，把策略迭代的精确目标（可用 per-decision importance sampling 计算）写成 DC-constrained DC 规划，用序列凸规划 (SCP) 直接求解，从而绕开凸代理近似。该框架把 CPI、NPG、TRPO、AWR 统一为可解释轴上的特例，并新增耦合连续决策的多步轴 k；在需要跨时域传播信用的诊断 MDP 上优势随依赖长度增长，在随机医疗域上比调好的 PPO 收敛明显更快、训练曲线下面积高 11.3%。
Motivation: 策略学习的核心优化问题（最大化期望回报）即使在直接策略参数化下也高度非凸，领域内普遍做法是回避它，转而在信赖域约束下优化回报的凸代理近似（NPG、TRPO、PPO、AWR），代价是丢掉了精确目标本身的结构。
Method: 在对数密度比坐标 y := log[π/π_n] 下，用 per-decision importance sampling (PDIS) 构造精确的单步迭代目标，证明其为 DC-constrained DC 规划；用差分凸优化的标准求解器序列凸规划 (SCP) 求解，并在温和条件下给出收敛保证。CPI、NPG、TRPO、AWR 成为该结构沿可解释轴的特例，另开多步轴 k 耦合连续决策。
Result: 多步 Convex-Concave RL (CCRL) 在需要信用跨时域传播的诊断 MDP 上获胜，且优势随依赖长度增长；在经典控制上与调好的 PPO 相当；在真实的随机、中等时域医疗域上收敛速度明显快于调好的 PPO，达到相同的接近最优存活率，训练曲线下面积 (area under the training curve) 高 11.3%。
Conclusion: 最大化期望回报的策略优化并非无结构问题：在对数密度比坐标下它是 DC-constrained DC 规划，可用 SCP 直接求解并带收敛保证，从而在跨时域信用传播场景中胜过信赖域凸代理方法。

papers.title: Constraint Tree Exploration for Learning from Language Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Natural-language feedback in interactive learning often explains why an action failed by pointing to violated requirements. Misinterpreting this feedback can lead an agent to rule out valid solutions. We study this setting by modeling user intent as latent constraints over an action space and formulating learning from language feedback as pure exploration over feasible regions. We introduce TRACE, an algorithm that organizes candidate constraints in a tree and tests each proposed refinement by generating actions that satisfy it. TRACE commits to the refinement only if the resulting feedback does not contradict it over repeated tests. We distinguish two ways of using the same feedback: (i) falsification, which detects contradictions to the constraint set currently being tested, and (ii) identification, which may additionally name a violated constraint. We prove high-probability coverage bounds with dependence on the candidate class size $H$ for TRACE-Falsification. With reliable identification, TRACE-Identification can replace this dependence by $K/p_{\mathrm{ext}}$, where $K$ is the number of latent constraints and $p_{\mathrm{ext}}$ lower-bounds the probability of extracting a missing true constraint from informative feedback. We evaluate TRACE across six language-feedback tasks. On RecMovie, TRACE-Identification achieves 73% and 86% final-output success under caps of 20 and 60 evaluated outputs, compared with at most 42% and 48% for the evaluated prompting baselines given the same feedback and output caps. Controlled identity-corruption experiments further show greater robustness than direct accumulation when the falsification detector remains reliable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRACE 把语言反馈学习形式化为可行区域上的纯探索 (pure exploration)，用约束树组织候选约束，只有在多次生成满足该细化的动作且反馈不与之矛盾时才提交。在六个语言反馈任务上，RecMovie 中 TRACE-Identification 在 20/60 个输出上限下最终输出成功率达 73%/86%，同反馈同上限的 prompting 基线至多 42%/48%。
Motivation: 交互学习中语言反馈常通过指出被违反的约束来解释失败，误读会把合法解排除掉；需要一种能区分反馈是反驳当前约束集还是直接指认被违反约束的学习机制。
Method: TRACE 将用户意图建模为动作空间上的隐约束，把语言反馈学习写成可行区域上的纯探索：候选约束组织成树，对每个提出的细化生成满足它的动作并反复测试，反馈不矛盾才提交。区分 falsification（只检测与当前约束集的矛盾）与 identification（额外指认被违反的约束）两种用法，并给出高概率覆盖界。
Result: TRACE-Falsification 的覆盖界依赖候选类规模 H；在可靠 identification 下 TRACE-Identification 可将该依赖替换为 K/p_ext（K 为隐约束数，p_ext 为从信息性反馈中抽取缺失真约束概率的下界）。在六个语言反馈任务的评测中，RecMovie 上 TRACE-Identification 在 20 与 60 个输出上限下最终输出成功率分别为 73% 与 86%，同反馈同上限的 prompting 基线至多 42% 与 48%；受控的身份损坏实验显示，只要 falsification 检测器保持可靠，其鲁棒性优于直接累积反馈。
Conclusion: 把语言反馈拆成反驳与指认两种用法，可让覆盖界从候选类规模 H 降到 K/p_ext，并在反馈可靠时比直接累积更抗身份损坏噪声。

papers.title: On the Computational Complexity of Hidden Markov Model Identification
papers.abstract_en: Identification is the task of recovering the parameters of an unknown ground-truth model from sampled data. When parameters other than the ground truth induce the same output distribution, data alone does not provide enough information to recover the ground truth, and the model is thus called unidentifiable. We study the identifiability problem for hidden Markov models (HMMs): given an HMM, is it identifiable? Existing work on HMM identification establishes conditions under which the ground-truth HMM can be identified. However, most of these conditions are sufficient but not necessary, meaning that, when a model does not satisfy them, its identifiability remains inconclusive. We instead take a computational perspective: is there a sound and complete algorithm that decides whether a given HMM is identifiable, and if so, what is the complexity of this decision problem? We consider the decision problems arising from the various notions of identifiability in the literature, including deterministic, generic, global, local, state-permutation- invariant, and finite-alphabet identifiability. We show that all of these problems are decidable in PSPACE, via reductions to the theory of the reals at various levels of its quantifier-alternation hierarchy. We further show that the deterministic variants are already coETR-hard (and hence coNP-hard) for simply parameterized families.

Motivation: 已有 HMM 可识别性条件多为充分而非必要，模型不满足这些条件时其可识别性无从判定；作者改从计算复杂度角度问是否存在 sound and complete 的判定算法及其复杂度。

papers.title: Are We Really Benchmarking Forecasting Models? The Impact of Preprocessing on Time Series Performance
authors: Paulo Salgado Gomes de Mattos Neto
papers.abstract_en: While established literature underscores the pivotal role of preprocessing in forecasting accuracy, this stage remains largely overlooked in current research. Modern benchmarks typically resort to simple scaling, failing to account for critical transformations required to address nonstationarity, such as differencing. This omission creates a significant structural preprocessing bias that favors models with built-in data treatments while obscuring the true potential of simpler architectures. We study this effect through a preprocessing-aware benchmark that evaluates 11 forecasting models across 16 reversible preprocessing pipelines on 29,000 M4 time series. Our results identify preprocessing as a key driver of forecasting performance. Optimizing preprocessing per series yields gains of approximately 27\% to 87\% across all evaluated models, with architectures lacking internalized preprocessing experiencing the most substantial improvements. This allows simpler architectures to become highly competitive with complex, state-of-the-art models in modern forecasting benchmarks. All resources and experimental results from this benchmark are stored in a comprehensive metadataset to support future metalearning tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 通用时间序列基准只用简单缩放、不做差分等处理，形成偏向内置去非平稳模型的结构性预处理偏差。在 M4 的 29,000 条序列上，为每条序列单独优化 16 种可逆预处理管线，11 个模型全部提升约 27% 到 87%，无内置预处理的简单架构获益最大，足以与复杂 SOTA 模型竞争。
Motivation: 现代基准忽略差分等非平稳处理，结构性预处理偏差掩盖了简单架构的真实潜力，使模型排名失真。
Method: 提出预处理感知基准 (preprocessing-aware benchmark)：在 29,000 条 M4 时间序列上，对 11 个预测模型分别评估 16 种可逆预处理管线，并按序列优化预处理选择；全部实验结果整理为 metadataset 供后续 metalearning 使用。
Result: 按序列优化预处理在全部 11 个被评估模型上带来约 27% 到 87% 的性能提升，其中缺少内部预处理机制的架构改善幅度最大，简单架构因此在现代预测基准中变得高度有竞争力。
Conclusion: 预处理是预测性能的关键驱动因素，模型比较必须在预处理感知的基准下进行，否则排名反映的是内置数据处理而非架构本身。

papers.title: MaRK: Markov-adapted Recurrent Kernels for Dynamic Operator Conditioning in State Space Models
papers.abstract_en: State Space Models (SSMs) offer an efficient alternative to Transformers for sequence modeling, yet conditioning pre-trained SSMs for iterative generation typically operates outside the recurrent operator, through input injection or activation modulation. While such mechanisms expose the model to conditioning information, they leave the underlying temporal dynamics fixed. We introduce MaRK (Markov-adapted Recurrent Kernels), a dynamic operator-conditioning framework that maps context vectors directly into bounded modulations of a frozen SSM's recurrence ($A$), read-in ($B$), read-out ($C$), skip ($D$), and discretization ($Δ$) parameters. Viewed through the lens of LPV-SSM systems, MaRK induces a context-indexed family of Markov parameter sequences, allowing each diffusion timestep to reshape the model's input-output memory kernel. We instantiate MaRK on a frozen 111M-parameter Hydra SSM backbone and study three adapter geometries: Hypernet, Chebyshev polynomial, and Discrete Cosine Transform kernels. Since these adapters modify the Markov parameter sequence through low-rank auxiliary maps on the frozen backbone, parameter-efficient fine-tuning arises as a structural consequence of the adaptation mechanism itself, requiring only 6.3--11M trainable auxiliary parameters to transition from a bidirectional objective to an iterative diffusion regime. The bounded recurrence parameterization further yields an analytic Affine Quadratic Stability certificate for the modulated recurrence. Through synthetic LPV recovery experiments and Markov-operator diagnostics, we show that MaRK recovers coordinate-invariant temporal operators under matched assumptions and produces distinct, stable timestep-conditioned memory profiles. Empirically, the Chebyshev variant yields the strongest performance, achieving an average validation loss of 2.55, followed by the DCT (2.59) and Hypernet (3.77) geometries.
papers.journal_ref: NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MaRK 把上下文向量直接映射为对冻结 SSM 递推参数（A、B、C、D、Δ）的有界调制，使每个扩散时间步都能重塑输入输出记忆核。在 111M 参数 Hydra 骨干上，Chebyshev 变体平均验证损失 2.55，优于 DCT 的 2.59 与 Hypernet 的 3.77，且仅需 6.3–11M 可训练辅助参数。
Motivation: 预训练 SSM 的迭代生成条件化通常走输入注入或激活调制，绕开递推算子本身，时序动态保持固定，无法按条件改变模型的记忆核。
Method: MaRK 经 LPV-SSM 视角诱导上下文索引的 Markov 参数序列，用 Hypernet、Chebyshev 多项式、DCT 三种 adapter 几何在冻结骨干上做低秩辅助映射；有界递推参数化给出解析 Affine Quadratic Stability 证书，并以合成 LPV 恢复实验与 Markov 算子诊断检验。
Result: 冻结 111M 参数 Hydra 骨干上，Chebyshev 变体平均验证损失 2.55，DCT 2.59，Hypernet 3.77；从双向目标转到迭代扩散只需 6.3–11M 可训练辅助参数。合成 LPV 恢复实验显示在匹配假设下可恢复坐标不变的时序算子，并产生各异且稳定的、时间步条件化的记忆剖面。
Conclusion: 把条件化放进递推参数本身，可在参数高效微调的同时给出调制递推的解析稳定性证书；三种几何中 Chebyshev 表现最强。

papers.title: FedRSPO+: A Heterogeneity-aware Algorithm for Decision-focused Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Decision-focused learning (DFL) trains predictive models for downstream optimization, but existing methods largely assume centralized data. In cross-silo settings, federated learning offers a natural alternative, yet standard federated methods optimize prediction over decision quality and do not address heterogeneity in downstream objectives or feasible sets. This heterogeneity is especially challenging for DFL because small perturbations in polyhedral problems can cause discontinuous changes in optimal decisions, destabilizing client updates and aggregation. We propose FedRSPO+, a heterogeneity-aware framework for decision-focused federated learning, built on RSPO+, a regularized predict-then-optimize surrogate that smooths the decision map through projection. We show that RSPO+ upper bounds decision error and regret for the regularized decision and, under exact regularization and consistent LP solution selection, for the original LP decision. We further derive cross-client heterogeneity bounds that depend on both objective and feasible-set heterogeneity, vanish at homogeneity, and require no strong convexity. FedRSPO+ uses an annealed, modular training procedure compatible with standard federated personalization and aggregation methods. Experiments on synthetic knapsack, shortest-path, and real-world energy pricing tasks compare against prediction-only federated learning and DFL baselines under varying heterogeneity and communication budgets. Results suggest that smoothing is a useful ingredient for stable collaborative decision learning and provide a heterogeneity-aware foundation for federated DFL.
papers.comment: 10 pages main paper + appendix. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 main track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FedRSPO+ 把正则化 predict-then-optimize 代理 RSPO+ 引入联邦决策聚焦学习 (decision-focused federated learning)，用投影平滑决策映射，缓解下游目标与可行集异质性导致的客户端更新不稳定。理论上给出决策误差与 regret 上界，以及随同质化消失、且不需强凸的跨客户端异质性界；在合成背包、最短路与真实能源定价任务上对比预测型联邦学习与 DFL 基线，结果支持平滑是稳定协同决策学习的有效成分。
Motivation: 跨 silo 场景下联邦方法只优化预测质量而非决策质量，且未处理下游目标与可行集的异质性；多面体问题的微小扰动会使最优决策不连续跳变，破坏客户端更新与聚合的稳定性。
Method: 以 RSPO+ 这一正则化 predict-then-optimize 代理为核心，通过投影平滑决策映射；训练采用退火式模块化流程，兼容标准联邦个性化与聚合方法。理论上证明 RSPO+ 对正则化决策（在精确正则与一致 LP 解选择下也对原始 LP 决策）给出决策误差与 regret 上界，并推导依赖目标异质性与可行集异质性的跨客户端界，无需强凸假设。
Result: 在合成 knapsack、shortest-path 与真实能源定价任务上，对比 prediction-only 联邦学习与 DFL 基线，覆盖不同异质性程度与通信预算设置；结果表明平滑对稳定协同决策学习有用。
Conclusion: 平滑决策映射是联邦 DFL 中应对异质性与不稳定聚合的有效成分，FedRSPO+ 提供了一个异质性感知的联邦 DFL 基础框架。

papers.title: Tucker Bottleneck Attention for Multi-Dimensional Sequence Modeling
papers.abstract_en: The quadratic cost of self-attention limits scalability to long sequences from multidimensional data. We introduce Tucker bottleneck attention (TuBA), which exploits low-rank tensor structure for efficient global token mixing. TuBA projects hidden tensors into compact Tucker cores, performs multi-head self-attention and linear projections on the cores, and writes updates back to the ambient space, enabling subquadratic computation. Its autoregressive extension combines bidirectional interactions within cores with causal attention across cores. On video prediction and global weather forecasting, TuBA achieves favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-offs over standard and efficient attention and task-specific models. Compared to standard self-attention, TuBA reduces error and computation by up to 24.7% and 66.6% for video prediction and 37.1% and 85.1% for autoregressive weather forecasting, with speedups up to 4.27 times. Low-rank Tucker cores and multi-frame generation also outperform full-rank attention and frame-by-frame generation, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Tucker bottleneck attention (TuBA)：把隐藏张量投影到低秩 Tucker core 上做多头自注意力再写回原空间，实现次二次复杂度的全局 token 混合。在自回归全球天气预报上，相比标准 self-attention 误差最多降 37.1%、计算量最多降 85.1%，加速最高 4.27 倍；低秩 core 与多帧生成分别优于全秩注意力和逐帧生成。
Motivation: self-attention 的二次代价限制了对多维长序列（视频、全球天气场）的扩展能力，需要在保持全局混合的前提下降低计算与误差。
Method: TuBA 将隐藏张量投影为紧凑 Tucker core，在 core 上做多头 self-attention 与线性投影，再把更新写回 ambient space；自回归扩展在 core 内做双向交互、core 之间做因果注意力。
Result: 视频预测上相比标准 self-attention 误差最多降 24.7%、计算量最多降 66.6%；自回归全球天气预报上误差最多降 37.1%、计算量最多降 85.1%，加速最高 4.27 倍；低秩 Tucker core 优于全秩注意力，多帧生成优于逐帧生成。
Conclusion: 低秩 Tucker 瓶颈注意力在视频预测与全球天气预报上同时取得更好的精度-效率权衡，优于标准与高效注意力及任务专用模型。

papers.title: RippleCP: Measuring Counterfactual Checkpoint Advantage in Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: Agent checkpoint systems decide what state is recovery-relevant, how to snapshot it, and whether rollback is admissible. None decides which of the safe boundaries they expose are worth materializing. We formulate this as counterfactual checkpoint advantage, the reduction in future recovery cost obtained by checkpointing a candidate rather than skipping it, and measure it by driving a CP branch and a SKIP branch to the same logical failure and recovering both under matched model, tool, verifier, and stopping conditions. On a frozen pilot of 12 SWE-bench Verified tasks and 106 real recovery branches, checkpointing saves 49.4 s per task, and that figure resolves into two regimes two orders of magnitude apart. The first checkpoint returns 100.0 s on 156.5 s of protected work, a conversion of 0.64; a second one step later returns-1.1 s on 41.8 s, a conversion of -0.03. Recovery is a re-derivation rather than a replay, so preserved work is a poor guide to saved work, and the classical elapsed-work rule misprices the second checkpoint by its full nominal cost. We identify where placement can pay, and set the bar a placement policy must clear.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RippleCP 把「该不该在某个边界打 checkpoint」形式化为反事实 checkpoint 优势 (counterfactual checkpoint advantage)：把 CP 分支与 SKIP 分支驱动到同一逻辑故障，在模型、工具、验证器与停止条件对齐下同时恢复，测出打点相对跳过的恢复成本节省。在 12 个 SWE-bench Verified 任务、106 个真实恢复分支的冻结试点上，checkpoint 平均每任务省 49.4 秒，但收益分成相差两个数量级的两个 regime：首个 checkpoint 用 156.5 秒受保护工作换回 100.0 秒（转换率 0.64），一步之后的第二个 checkpoint 在 41.8 秒工作上倒亏 1.1 秒（转换率 -0.03）。
