Method: 对每个候选边界同时跑 CP 与 SKIP 两条分支，把它们驱动到同一逻辑故障，并在匹配的模型、工具、验证器与停止条件下恢复两边，两者恢复成本之差即反事实 checkpoint 优势；试点冻结在 12 个 SWE-bench Verified 任务、106 个真实恢复分支上。
Result: 冻结试点中 checkpoint 平均每任务节省 49.4 秒；首个 checkpoint 在 156.5 秒受保护工作上回报 100.0 秒，转换率 0.64，紧随其后的第二个 checkpoint 在 41.8 秒工作上回报 -1.1 秒，转换率 -0.03，两个 regime 相差两个数量级；经典 elapsed-work 规则对第二个 checkpoint 的错价等于其全部名义成本。
Conclusion: checkpoint 收益高度不均匀，只有特定位置的打点才付得出代价，作者据此指出放置策略 (placement policy) 必须跨过的门槛，并给出放置可能盈利的位置。

papers.title: U-Space: Uncovering When and Why Uncertainty Arises in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are informing decisions with ever-higher stakes. As the consequences of their errors grow, a central question becomes harder to ignore: how much can we trust an individual answer? Yet recognizing when to defer remains difficult because language models can present incorrect conclusions with fluent explanations and an authoritative tone. Uncertainty quantification seeks to address this disconnect by estimating the reliability of individual predictions. However, many existing methods require repeated generations or separately trained components, and their scalar estimates do not reveal where uncertainty arises or how it evolves during reasoning. Recent work has also shown that generation length can be strongly associated with uncertainty estimates and correctness, raising the question of how much of an estimator's predictive power comes from uncertainty-specific information rather than output length alone. Mechanistic interpretability offers a way to address these limitations by connecting human-interpretable concepts to intermediate model states. Building on this capability, we introduce the U-Space, a low-dimensional subspace that makes a model's evolving uncertainty measurable and interpretable. We identify semantic anchors for doubt and certainty, map their unembedding directions back into the residual space, and combine their contrasts into an orthogonal basis. The U-Lens projects each token state onto these basis vectors, yielding an interpretable token-level uncertainty map that can be inspected directly or aggregated into a scalar uncertainty score. Our approach requires no correctness labels, repeated generations, or training. Across reasoning benchmarks, its confidence score outperforms established baselines under both standard and length-controlled evaluation and transfers more reliably than supervised estimators. Code: https://github.com/s2labres/U-Space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: U-Space 在语言模型残差空间中构造一个低维不确定性子空间：把“怀疑”与“确定”的语义锚点经 unembedding 映回残差空间，取其对比并正交化为基，U-Lens 将每个 token 状态投影到该基上得到可解释的 token 级不确定性图，可直接查看或聚合成标量置信度。该方法无需正确性标签、重复生成或训练，在推理基准上其置信度分数在标准评测与长度受控评测下均优于既有基线，且比有监督估计器迁移更可靠。
Motivation: 大模型以流畅、权威的语气给出错误结论，难以判断何时该拒答；现有不确定性量化方法多依赖重复采样或单独训练的组件，且标量输出无法说明不确定性在推理中何处、如何产生，其预测力还可能主要来自输出长度而非不确定性本身。
Method: 识别“怀疑”与“确定”的语义锚点，将其 unembedding 方向映回残差空间并组合成正交基，构成低维 U-Space；U-Lens 把每个 token 的中间状态投影到该基上，输出可直接检查的 token 级不确定性图，也可聚合成标量置信度；整个流程不需要正确性标签、重复生成或训练。
Result: 在推理基准上，U-Space 的置信度分数在标准评测和长度受控 (length-controlled) 评测两种设置下均优于既有基线，并且比有监督 (supervised) 不确定性估计器迁移得更可靠。
Conclusion: 不确定性可以在模型残差空间中用可解释的低维方向直接测量，且不依赖标签或重复采样；长度受控评测下仍占优说明其预测力并非只来自输出长度。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Anaximander: Interactively Running Geospatial Deep Learning Models on Any Compute Backend
papers.abstract_en: Applying deep learning models to satellite imagery from within geographic information systems (GIS) remains high-friction for remote sensing practitioners. Models arrive in incompatible formats and target different compute environments, from local workstations to serverless cloud services. As a result, every evaluation demands custom deployment, tiling, and georeferencing code before a single prediction reaches the analyst's map. This friction discourages systematic comparison in a domain where model choice directly affects operational outcomes such as field delineation, crop monitoring, and disaster response. We present Anaximander, an open-source system that unifies model source and compute location choice behind one interactive interface. The system's backend is an inference server that loads models from multiple commonly-used sources and serves them on any accessible compute backend. The server provides session management and model caching, and streams results back per tile. The backend is paired with a QGIS plugin that drives tiling, result reassembly, georeferencing, and real-time per-tile status visualization. An additional user-interface path injects layer legends as prompts into vision-language models. We demonstrate the system in a code-free side-by-side comparison of three heterogeneous models on an agricultural field delineation task: gpt-image-1 via a cloud API, Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3) on a remote GPU, and DelineateAnything on a local CPU. The inference backend and protocol are open-source and available at https://github.com/microsoft/nxmndr.
papers.comment: Accepted as a poster at the TerraBytes II workshop, ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Anaximander 把遥感模型来源与算力位置统一到一个交互接口：开源推理服务器加载多来源模型、按 tile 流式返回结果，配 QGIS 插件完成切片、拼接、地理配准与逐 tile 状态显示。在农业地块勾画任务上以无代码方式并排跑 gpt-image-1（云 API）、SAM 3（远程 GPU）与 DelineateAnything（本地 CPU）三个异构模型。
Motivation: GIS 内使用卫星影像深度学习模型摩擦高：模型格式不兼容、算力环境各异，每次评估都要自写部署、切片与地理配准代码，抑制了系统性模型比较。
Method: 开源推理服务器从多个常用来源加载模型并部署到任意可达算力后端，提供会话管理与模型缓存，按 tile 流式回传；QGIS 插件驱动切片、结果重组、地理配准与实时逐 tile 状态可视化；另一条 UI 路径把图层图例作为 prompt 注入视觉-语言模型。
Result: 在农业地块勾画 (agricultural field delineation) 任务上以无代码方式并排演示三个异构模型：gpt-image-1 走云 API、Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3) 跑远程 GPU、DelineateAnything 跑本地 CPU；推理后端与协议开源（github.com/microsoft/nxmndr）。
Conclusion: 把模型来源与算力位置的选择藏到统一接口后面，遥感模型的部署与比较可以做到无代码、跨后端。

papers.title: Large-scale Repository Engineering via Agent-Native Reusable Code Primitives
papers.abstract_en: Large language models equipped with development environments have moved code generation toward repository-scale construction, yet building complete repositories remains difficult because interacting modules, interfaces, configurations, tests, and dependencies must work together. We introduce Code Primitives, agent-native reusable executable components with interface contracts, dependency closures, validation tests, and provenance. Each primitive uses a resident LLM to assess relevance and adapt its implementation, interfaces, and dependencies to the target repository, and we organize 1,424 validated primitives in CodeFace, a searchable library for repository construction. We introduce LEGO (Large-scale repository Engineering via aGent-native reusable cOde primitives), which activates task-relevant primitives, integrates their adapted implementations with task-specific code while resolving cross-component constraints, and revises the result against executed tests. To measure construction end to end, we build LEGO-REPO, a benchmark of 522 executable reconstruction tasks spanning seven software domains, 22 capability tracks, and five difficulty levels, scored against native test suites between an empty-package floor and original-source ceiling. The strongest of 13 evaluated backbones reaches a delivery score of 0.318 and scores zero on 41.0% of tasks; LEGO improves all 13 by 0.1474 on average and raises GPT-5.6-terra from 0.3180 to 0.5134 (+61.4%). In controlled comparisons, adapted primitives outperform retrieved code supplied as context or vendored unchanged. The effect persists against independent repository agents, across three external benchmarks, and with a disjointly re-mined CodeFace; GPT-OSS-20B for adaptation and diagnosis retains 95.1% of the homogeneous score at 24.0% lower cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Code Primitives（带接口契约、依赖闭包、验证测试与 provenance 的可复用可执行组件）与激活-集成-按测试修订的 LEGO 流程，在 522 个仓库重建任务上把 13 个 backbone 的交付分平均提高 0.1474，最强 backbone 从 0.3180 提到 0.5134（+61.4%）。
Motivation: LLM 加开发环境已把代码生成推向仓库级，但模块、接口、配置、测试与依赖必须协同工作，完整仓库构建仍然困难。
Method: 每个 primitive 用常驻 LLM 评估相关性并适配实现、接口与依赖；1,424 个已验证 primitive 存入可检索库 CodeFace。LEGO 激活相关 primitive、把适配后的实现与任务代码集成并解冲突，再按执行的测试修订结果；评测用 LEGO-REPO 基准，522 个可执行重建任务、7 个软件领域、22 条能力轨道、5 个难度档，以原生测试套件在空包下限与原源上限之间打分。
Result: 13 个被评 backbone 中最强者交付分 0.318，41.0% 的任务得零分；LEGO 平均提升 0.1474，GPT-5.6-terra 从 0.3180 升到 0.5134（+61.4%）。受控对比中适配后的 primitive 优于作为上下文提供的检索代码与原样 vendored 代码；效果在独立仓库 agent、三个外部基准与重新挖掘的不相交 CodeFace 上保持，用 GPT-OSS-20B 做适配与诊断保留 95.1% 的同构分数且成本低 24.0%。
Conclusion: 带契约与测试的可复用 primitive 经适配后集成，比直接把检索代码塞进上下文更能提高仓库级构建的端到端交付率，且小模型适配可大幅降本。

papers.title: DISRQAD: Diffusion Image Super-Resolution Quality Assessment Dataset and Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based image super-resolution (SR) can create visually plausible detail that is not supported by the low-resolution input. We introduce DISRQAD, a subjective-quality dataset and diagnostic benchmark for this setting. It contains mean opinion scores (MOS) for 14,000 SR outputs from ten diffusion and four non-diffusion methods, spanning four low-resolution degradation conditions and x2/x4 upscaling. We evaluate 51 standard full-reference and no-reference metric configurations and 11 adapted variants. Agreement with MOS is substantially weaker on diffusion outputs: the strongest standard no-reference baseline reaches 0.431 SRCC on diffusion SR versus 0.813 on non-diffusion SR. As a case study in benchmark use, a pruned and distilled Q-ReAlign-mini student reaches 0.496 SRCC on diffusion SR. DISRQAD measures perceived output quality, not faithfulness to the input; it enables analysis of metric behavior across generator families and input conditions. Our findings reveal a substantial gap in the assessment of diffusion-based SR and provide a basis for developing quality models sensitive to diffusion-specific artifacts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DISRQAD 是针对扩散模型图像超分辨率 (diffusion SR) 的主观质量数据集与诊断基准：14,000 个 SR 输出的 MOS，覆盖 10 个扩散方法、4 个非扩散方法、4 种退化条件与 x2/x4 放大。核心发现是现有画质指标在扩散 SR 上严重失准：最强标准无参考基线在扩散 SR 上 SRCC 仅 0.431，而非扩散 SR 上为 0.813；蒸馏剪枝后的 Q-ReAlign-mini 学生模型在扩散 SR 上达到 0.496 SRCC。
Motivation: 扩散式 SR 会生成低分辨率输入并不支持的视觉细节，而现有画质指标主要针对传统 SR 校准，无法可靠评估这类输出，导致生成器之间与输入条件之间的质量比较缺乏可信依据。
Method: 构建 DISRQAD：对 10 个扩散与 4 个非扩散 SR 方法在 4 种退化条件、x2/x4 放大下的 14,000 个输出采集 MOS；评测 51 种标准全参考与无参考指标配置及 11 个改造变体，并以剪枝蒸馏的 Q-ReAlign-mini 学生模型作为基准使用案例。
Result: 最强标准无参考基线在扩散 SR 上 SRCC 0.431，在非扩散 SR 上 0.813，一致性大幅下降；作为基准使用案例，剪枝蒸馏的 Q-ReAlign-mini 学生模型在扩散 SR 上达到 0.496 SRCC。
Conclusion: 现有画质指标对扩散 SR 存在系统性评估缺口，DISRQAD 可用于跨生成器家族与输入条件分析指标行为，并为开发对扩散特有伪影敏感的质量模型提供基础；该数据集衡量的是感知输出质量，而非对输入的忠实度。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Towards AI-Generated Music Plagiarism Detection as a Version Identification Problem
papers.abstract_en: The rapid expansion of text-to-music generative models challenges traditional paradigms of music creation and intellectual property. Plagiarism in this context is rarely an absolute mathematical binary, but an ambiguous threshold negotiated over harmonic structure, melodic contours, or overall perceived stylistic character. In this work, we test the transferability of state-of-the-art music version identification architectures from the human-to-human cover domain to the human-to-AI plagiarism setting. To evaluate this task, we introduce COPYCAT, a benchmark derived from real-world plagiarism cases and extended through generative re-synthesis and digital signal processing obfuscations, yielding 350,654 evaluation pairs. We show that scalar distance thresholding collapses under generative re-synthesis, while a supervised framework leveraging coordinate-wise embedding shifts recovers the dispersed plagiarism signal, raising overall $F_{0.5}$ from $0.612$ to $0.803$.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, submitted to 2027 IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 AI 生成音乐抄袭检测重构为版本识别 (version identification) 问题，用从真人翻唱域迁移来的监督式坐标级嵌入偏移 (coordinate-wise embedding shifts) 框架替代标量距离阈值。在由真实抄袭案例扩展出的 COPYCAT 基准（350,654 个评测对）上，标量阈值在生成式重合成下失效，监督框架把整体 F0.5 从 0.612 提到 0.803。
Motivation: 文本生成音乐模型让抄袭判定变成和声结构、旋律轮廓与风格特征上的模糊阈值问题，而现有版本识别与标量距离阈值方法是针对真人翻唱域设计的，未必能应对生成式重合成带来的信号弥散。
Method: 构建 COPYCAT 基准：源自真实抄袭案例，并通过生成式重合成 (generative re-synthesis) 与数字信号处理混淆 (DSP obfuscations) 扩展；将 SOTA 音乐版本识别架构从人-人翻唱域迁移到人-AI 抄袭设定，采用利用坐标级嵌入偏移的监督式框架而非标量距离阈值。
Result: COPYCAT 含 350,654 个评测对；标量距离阈值在生成式重合成下崩溃，监督式嵌入偏移框架把整体 F0.5 从 0.612 提升到 0.803。
Conclusion: AI 音乐抄袭更适合作为版本识别任务处理，标量距离阈值不足以捕捉生成式重合成后的抄袭信号，监督式嵌入偏移能将其恢复。

papers.title: TAP: Efficient Long-Horizon Agent Pruning via Trajectory-Anchored Recovery
papers.abstract_en: Emerging long-horizon agentic tasks require repeated model calls, worsening the inference cost of already-costly language models. While narrow agentic tasks suggest potential for aggressive model pruning without performance drop, empirical results show existing methods proposed for question answering tasks severely degrade task performance when applied to agentic models. We trace this failure to two decisions: what to prune and how to recover. For pruning, one-shot importance estimates fail to track how the pruned model adapts. For recovery, offline distillation covers only teacher prefixes, while full-trajectory on-policy distillation causes student errors to compound across turns. In this work, we propose Trajectory-Anchored Pruning (TAP), the first structural pruning framework for reinforcement learning (RL)-trained agents. TAP couples structural pruning with efficient on-policy recovery, anchoring interactions to teacher trajectories while allowing the student to generate each reasoning-action response. A frozen dense teacher supervises the student's response prefixes, addressing within-response training-inference mismatch while preventing student-induced deviations from propagating across training turns. Instead of one-shot pruning, TAP re-scores channels using gradients of the recovery objective on the recovered student, connecting iterative channel selection to the evolving policy. With 60% of FFN channels removed, TAP retains 99.2% and 88.0% of the dense 7B agents' task success rates on ALFWorld and WebShop, respectively, while reducing GPU time per successful task by approximately 22% and 17%. These results demonstrate effective structural compression of long-horizon agents under a limited recovery budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TAP 把结构化剪枝与轨迹锚定的 on-policy 恢复耦合，用于 RL 训练的长时程 agent：剪枝后用冻结稠密教师监督学生每个 reasoning-action 响应的前缀，同时用恢复目标梯度对 FFN 通道重打分以跟随策略演化。移除 60% FFN 通道后，7B agent 在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上分别保留 99.2% 与 88.0% 的任务成功率，单次成功任务 GPU 时间约降 22% 与 17%。
Motivation: 长时程 agentic 任务需反复调用模型，推理成本高；面向问答的激进剪枝方法直接套到 agentic 模型上会严重掉点，失败源于剪枝重要性一次性估计与恢复阶段的误差跨轮累积。
Method: 提出 Trajectory-Anchored Pruning (TAP)，首个面向 RL 训练 agent 的结构化剪枝框架：恢复阶段把交互锚定在教师轨迹上、由学生自行生成每个 reasoning-action 响应，冻结稠密教师只监督响应前缀，抑制学生偏差跨训练轮传播；剪枝阶段不再一次性估计重要性，而是用恢复目标在已恢复学生上的梯度重打分通道，迭代选通道以匹配演化中的策略。
Result: 移除 60% FFN 通道后，稠密 7B agent 的任务成功率在 ALFWorld 保留 99.2%、在 WebShop 保留 88.0%；每个成功任务的 GPU 时间分别下降约 22% 与 17%。
Conclusion: 在有限恢复预算下，把剪枝决策与 on-policy 恢复绑在一起，长时程 RL agent 可以在大幅压缩 FFN 通道的同时基本保住任务成功率与推理开销收益。

papers.title: OverLay++: Dense-Overlap Layout-to-Image Generation Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Layout-to-Image generation has made substantial progress in spatial and object-level control. However, existing methods still struggle with complex scenes containing many overlapping and interacting objects. We argue that training data is a particular bottleneck: existing datasets lack examples with dense, complex object interactions. To address this gap, we introduce OverLay++, a large-scale Layout-to-Image dataset with structurally complex scenes. OverLay++ contains approximately 500K images with an average of 6.6 objects per image, exceeding existing datasets by 1.67 times in annotation density. Beyond annotation density, OverLay++ provides rich semantic detail with object captions over six times longer than in current datasets. Our dataset generation pipeline is simple and produces dense, overlapping object annotations with rich per-object captions. Across multiple benchmarks, state-of-the-art Layout-to-Image methods trained on the OverLay++ dataset show consistent improvement and faster convergence, demonstrating the importance of dense, overlap-aware, and caption-rich supervision for controllable image generation.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations & Datasets Track. Project website: https://mlpc-ucsd.github.io/OverLayPP . Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/mlpcucsd/OverLayPP
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OverLay++ 是一个面向布局生成图像 (Layout-to-Image) 的大规模数据集，用简单流水线生成密集重叠、带逐物体长描述的场景标注，约 500K 张图、平均每图 6.6 个物体。在其上训练的 SOTA 布局生成方法在多个基准上一致提升且收敛更快，说明密集重叠与富描述监督是可控图像生成的关键瓶颈。
Motivation: 现有布局生成图像方法在多物体重叠、交互的复杂场景上仍然吃力，根因是训练数据缺少密集复杂的物体交互样本。
Method: 提出 OverLay++ 数据集及其简单生成流水线，产出密集、重叠的物体标注与逐物体富语义 caption；再用该数据训练现有 SOTA Layout-to-Image 方法并在多个基准上检验。
Result: 约 500K 张图像，平均每图 6.6 个物体，标注密度超出既有数据集 1.67 倍；逐物体 caption 长度是现有数据集的六倍以上；在其上训练的 SOTA 方法在多个基准上一致提升并收敛更快。
Conclusion: 密集、重叠感知且描述丰富的监督是可控图像生成的训练数据瓶颈，补齐这一层即可带来一致增益与更快收敛。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Covariate-dependent Joint Modeling of Multivariate Ordinal Preferences and Its Connections with Comparison Models
papers.abstract_en: Multivariate ordinal data along with covariates are commonly collected in problems ranging from alignment of language models with human preferences, as well as in recommender systems. For example, data sets such as MovieLens contain several movies rated on a scale 1--5 by human users, along with their demographic information such as age or gender. Similarly, data sets such as HelpSteer collect human feedback on several attributes such as "helpfulness" or "verbosity" of LLM response on an ordinal scale, with covariates depending on the LLM prompt--response pairs. Unfortunately, the standard approaches for modeling these data (a) look at the attributes individually rather than jointly, and (b) often convert the data into pairwise or list-wise win--loss comparisons for fitting models such as Bradley--Terry and Plackett--Luce. Both of these lead to a coarsening of what is actually observed, which we address via a joint covariate-dependent consecutive ratio Markov random field model. We also show pairwise or listwise comparison models are obtained under restrictions of our joint model, and that joint modeling improves comparisons. We also develop a maximum likelihood inference procedure even in the presence of an intractable normalizer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出协变量依赖的联合建模框架：把多变量序数偏好直接建成 consecutive ratio Markov random field，而非逐属性单独拟合或先压成 pairwise/listwise 胜负比较。该框架在限制条件下退化为 Bradley–Terry、Plackett–Luce 等比较模型，并给出在配分函数不可积时仍可用的最大似然推断流程。
Motivation: MovieLens、HelpSteer 等数据同时含多属性序数评分与协变量，现有做法要么逐属性独立建模，要么把数据粗化成成对/列表胜负比较，丢失了原始观测信息。
Method: 构建协变量依赖的 consecutive ratio Markov random field 联合模型，直接对多变量序数响应与协变量（用户人口统计、LLM prompt–response 对）建模；证明在特定限制下该模型导出 Bradley–Terry 与 Plackett–Luce 比较模型；并设计针对不可积 normalizer 的最大似然推断方法。
Result: 证明 pairwise/listwise 比较模型是该联合模型的限制情形，并给出联合建模可改进比较分析的结论；提出可处理不可积配分函数的最大似然推断流程。
Conclusion: 多属性序数偏好应联合建模而非粗化为胜负比较，比较模型可作为该框架的特例统一处理。

papers.title: GUARD: Geometric Uncertainty-Aware Point Cloud Denoising and Segmentation for Robotic Hard Disk Drive Disassembly
papers.abstract_en: Reliable robotic disassembly requires part-level representations that distinguish genuine component geometry from scanning and reconstruction artifacts. In point clouds of hard disk drives (HDDs), structured ghost artifacts can resemble valid components locally while remaining inconsistent with the overall geometry, allowing erroneous measurements to receive plausible semantic labels. This creates an engineering information problem: semantic prediction confidence alone does not establish whether the underlying geometry is reliable. We propose \textbf{GUARD}, a geometric uncertainty-aware framework that performs point filtering and segmentation within a single forward pass by modeling the reliability of learned geometric representations. GUARD combines a multi-scale geometric transformer with a multi-bandwidth random Fourier feature Gaussian Process to estimate per-point geometric uncertainty, complemented by predictive entropy to suppress unreliable measurements while preserving informative structures. Evaluation on 2,745 real HDD point clouds shows that GUARD improves PointNet++ segmentation mean intersection over union from 0.7739 to 0.8318. Additional experiments on ShapeNetPart and ScanNet examine robustness across corruption types, point-cloud domains, and segmentation backbones. On manually annotated ScanNet samples, geometric uncertainty achieves a corrupted-point detection F1 score of 0.7931, compared with 0.2212 for predictive entropy. The results demonstrate the value of distinguishing geometric reliability from semantic confidence and reveal a tradeoff between artifact suppression and preservation of informative structures. GUARD contributes a reliability-aware approach to interpreting imperfect 3D measurements for component identification and subsequent robotic handling. Project website: https://001-wang.github.io/GUARD_Point_denoiser/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GUARD 在单次前向里同时做点云滤波与分割，用多尺度几何 Transformer 加多带宽随机傅里叶特征高斯过程 (multi-bandwidth RFF GP) 估计逐点几何不确定性，再与预测熵结合抑制不可靠测量。在 2,745 个真实 HDD 点云上把 PointNet++ 分割 mIoU 从 0.7739 提到 0.8318；在人工标注的 ScanNet 样本上，几何不确定性对损坏点的检测 F1 为 0.7931，预测熵仅 0.2212。
Motivation: HDD 点云中的结构化 ghost 伪影局部上像真实部件，却与整体几何不一致，导致错误测量拿到看似合理的语义标签；仅靠语义预测置信度无法判断底层几何是否可靠。
Method: 单次前向同时完成点滤波与分割：多尺度几何 Transformer 学习几何表示，多带宽随机傅里叶特征高斯过程给出逐点几何不确定性，再用预测熵补充，以抑制不可靠测量同时保留有信息的结构。
Result: 在 2,745 个真实 HDD 点云上，PointNet++ 分割 mIoU 由 0.7739 提升至 0.8318；在人工标注的 ScanNet 样本上，几何不确定性的损坏点检测 F1 为 0.7931，对比预测熵的 0.2212；另在 ShapeNetPart 与 ScanNet 上考察跨损坏类型、跨点云域与跨分割骨干的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 几何可靠性必须与语义置信度分开建模，才能在伪影抑制与保留有信息结构之间取得权衡，并支撑后续部件识别与机器人抓取。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Talking with Language Models
papers.abstract_en: When we interact with large language models (LLMs), are we having a conversation? They are designed to invite us to treat them as intelligent interlocutors who remember, act, and make commitments. But appearances deceive. We introduce the artifactual stance, a framework that reconceives human-AI interaction as artifact-mediated exchanges of candidate texts. LLM outputs are candidate texts optimized for utility, not utterances bearing meaning or force. LLMs are sophisticated text generators, not speakers. Between sessions, nothing runs; between turns, no one remembers. What persists is a configuration and a transcript. The "conversation" is a user's solo performance, interpretive labour disguised by interface and artifact design. This shift dissolves recent philosophical puzzles. Questions about what 'I' and 'you' refer to in AI exchanges, about whether systems can lie or be held to promises, about the identity of our supposed interlocutors all rest on a false presupposition. There is no speaker behind the screen, hence no one to refer to, no one to hold responsible. What feels like dialogue with someone is interaction with an artifact that generates text at unprecedented scale and fit. By abandoning the conversational framing, we see these systems for what they are: immensely sophisticated artifacts that afford varied uses. The philosophical questions that matter are about the normative underpinnings of design, adoption, authorization, and human practices of use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 artifactual stance：与 LLM 的互动不是对话，而是以文本工件为中介的候选文本交换，输出是为效用优化的候选文本而非承载意义或语力的言语行为。会话之间无任何运行、轮次之间无人记忆，持久存在的只有配置与转写；所谓“对话”是用户独自的表演。由此，关于指代、说谎、承诺与身份的哲学难题都建立在错误预设上，真正该问的是设计、采纳、授权与使用实践的规范基础。
Motivation: LLM 界面诱导用户把系统当作有记忆、能行动、能承诺的智能交谈者，使一批关于指代与责任的哲学问题建立在错误预设上。
Method: 提出 artifactual stance 框架，把人机互动重述为 artifact-mediated 的候选文本交换：LLM 输出是为 utility 优化的 candidate texts，系统是文本生成器而非 speaker，持久状态仅为 configuration 与 transcript。
Result: 定性论断：会话之间 nothing runs、轮次之间 no one remembers，所谓对话是用户的 solo performance，其解释性劳动被界面与工件设计掩盖；据此可消解关于 I/you 指代、系统能否说谎或被追责、交谈者身份的近期哲学难题。
Conclusion: 放弃对话框架后，LLM 应被看作用途多样的复杂工件；有意义的哲学问题转向设计、采纳、授权与使用实践的规范基础。

papers.title: Multi-Label Topic Assignment via LLM Distillation: A Comparative Analysis of Generative vs. Discriminative Student Models
papers.abstract_en: Multi-label topic assignment for user-generated content (UGC) -- including product reviews and buyer-seller conversations -- poses unique scalability challenges in large-scale e-commerce due to informal language, extreme label sparsity, and rapidly evolving taxonomies. While utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs) as labeling oracles to distill ground-truth data has emerged as an industry standard to bypass prohibitive manual annotation costs, determining the optimal, low-latency architecture for the resulting student models remains an open challenge. To address this, we conduct a comprehensive evaluation across Small Language Model (SLM) parameter scales (1B, 4B, and 8B) and architectural paradigms (causal generative versus bidirectional discriminative). Comparing generative text-to-label classifiers against discriminative baselines (DeBERTa-V3 and ModernBERT), our analysis reveals a crucial data-dependent trade-off: while discriminative models outperform ultra-lightweight generative models on structured product reviews, even the smallest 1B generative model surpasses discriminative baselines on complex, multi-turn conversational data. Furthermore, generative models maintain robust performance under massive label-set expansion (up to 112 topics) and severe long-tail distributions, whereas discriminative baselines suffer a 35% drop in Macro-F1 at scale. Finally, we detail the successful production deployment of these optimized models across both product review and conversational domains, demonstrating strict latency compliance and tangible business impact at a global marketplace scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在电商 UGC 多标签主题分配上，用 LLM 作标注 oracle 蒸馏出学生模型，比较 1B/4B/8B 因果生成式与判别式 (DeBERTa-V3、ModernBERT) 架构。结构化商品评论上判别式更强，而多轮对话上最小的 1B 生成式即超过判别式基线；标签扩到 112 个且长尾严重时判别式 Macro-F1 掉 35%，生成式保持稳健。
Motivation: 电商 UGC 语言非正式、标签极度稀疏、分类体系快速演化，人工标注成本过高；LLM 蒸馏已成行业惯例，但低延迟学生模型该选生成式还是判别式仍是开放问题。
Method: 以 LLM 作为 labeling oracle 蒸馏训练数据，跨 SLM 参数规模 1B、4B、8B 与两种架构范式（因果生成式 text-to-label 对双向判别式）做对照评估，判别式基线为 DeBERTa-V3 与 ModernBERT，覆盖商品评论与买家-卖家多轮对话两类域。
Result: 结构化商品评论上判别式超过超轻量生成式；复杂多轮对话上最小的 1B 生成式即超过判别式基线。标签集扩到 112 个主题并处于严重长尾分布时，生成式保持稳健，判别式基线 Macro-F1 下降 35%。模型在商品评论与对话两域完成生产部署，满足严格延迟要求。
Conclusion: 架构选择取决于数据形态：结构化评论用判别式，多轮对话与大规模长尾标签集用生成式；蒸馏出的模型可在全球 marketplace 规模上线并带来业务收益。

papers.title: EDiS: Edge Disjoint Subgraph Sparsification Framework for Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Sparse GNN training reduces computation, but deciding which edges to keep can be costly. Reusing one sparse graph is cheap, but locks training to a fixed topology, while varying it across epochs can require repeated sampling or recomputation. We introduce EDiS (Edge-Disjoint Subgraph sparsification framework), which separates one-time structural extraction from per-epoch graph composition. EDiS decomposes the graph once into cacheable edge-disjoint subgraphs, then recombines them into graphs with edge-budget constraints across epochs and retention ratios without re-extracting structure. Our default construction uses feature-based scores and successive maximum score covering forests, while the same composition mechanism also supports alternative edge selection rules. We provide a combinatorial analysis of the per-epoch sampler, the composition step that draws a training graph from the cached decomposition. We show that, under the default covering-forest selector, the stored decomposition deterministically preserves high-score cut edges, and we derive a selector-agnostic conditional bound on high-score cut survival in composed training graphs. Across 19 homophilic, heterophilic, and large-scale node classification benchmarks against 17 baselines under the same edge budget, EDiS achieves the highest mean benchmark score (accuracy/ROC-AUC) and the lowest average rank and gap-to-best among ranked methods. Ablations show the clearest benefits of structural decomposition and epoch variation at tight edge budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EDiS 把稀疏 GNN 训练的图结构抽取与逐轮图组合解耦：一次性把图分解为可缓存的 edge-disjoint 子图，再在边预算与保留率约束下跨 epoch 重组，无需重复采样或重算结构。在 19 个同质、异质与大规模节点分类基准上对 17 个基线、同一边预算下，取得最高平均基准分（accuracy/ROC-AUC）、最低平均排名与最小 best 差距。
Motivation: 稀疏 GNN 训练能省计算，但选边本身开销大：复用同一稀疏图便宜却把训练锁死在固定拓扑，逐 epoch 变拓扑又需要反复采样或重算结构。
Method: EDiS 将结构抽取与逐 epoch 组合分离：先一次性分解出可缓存的 edge-disjoint 子图，默认用基于特征的打分与逐次最大打分覆盖森林 (successive maximum score covering forests) 生成分解，再由组合机制在边预算与保留率下重组出每个 epoch 的训练图，同一组合器也支持其他选边规则。作者对逐 epoch 采样器给出组合分析，并证明默认覆盖森林选择器下缓存分解确定性保留高分 cut edge，同时给出与选择器无关的高分 cut 存活条件界。
Result: 在 19 个同质、异质与大规模节点分类基准上，与 17 个基线在相同边预算下比较，EDiS 取得最高平均基准分（accuracy/ROC-AUC）、最低平均排名以及 ranked 方法中最小的 gap-to-best。消融显示结构分解与 epoch 变化的收益在紧边预算下最明显。
Conclusion: 把结构抽取一次性缓存、把逐 epoch 图组合作为独立步骤，可以在不重复抽取结构的前提下保持拓扑多样性，并在紧边预算下带来最清晰的收益。

papers.title: Learning Cross-Model Activation Alignments with Explicit Many-to-Many Layer Maps
papers.abstract_en: LLMs are released at a rapid pace, raising a natural question: how do two independently trained models relate, both in which layers correspond and in how features transform between them? We study this by learning an activation alignment, a map from a source model's layerwise activations to a target's. Our method, MATCHA, factors this map into a layer map, whose output is an explicit target-by-source matrix that can be extracted and inspected, and a layer-shared feature map between hidden spaces. Most of prior work fixes the layer correspondence in advance, pairing layers at roughly the same relative depth; in contrast, we learn both factors jointly from prompts. Across 42 pairs of seven models spanning three different families, MATCHA reconstructs the target's activations more faithfully and improves retrieval-based metrics substantially, w.r.t. previous approaches. The recovered maps are broadly monotone in depth but, in contrast with most previous approaches, are consistently many-to-many: each target layer draws on a band of source layers. Our alignments also enable transfer of activation-space interventions, allowing steering vectors and probes developed for one model to transfer to another.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MATCHA 把跨模型激活对齐分解为可显式提取的 many-to-many 层映射矩阵与层共享特征映射，两者从 prompt 联合学习，而非预先按相对深度配对。在 7 个模型的 42 对组合上，它比先前方法更忠实地重建目标模型激活并显著提升检索类指标，恢复出的映射在深度上大体单调但一致呈 many-to-many：每个目标层依赖一段源层带。
Motivation: 两个独立训练的 LLM 之间层对应关系与特征变换方式未知，而先前工作大多预先固定层配对（按大致相同相对深度配对），无法同时学习对应关系与特征变换。
Method: MATCHA 将激活对齐（activation alignment）分解为两个因子：输出可提取、可检查的 target-by-source 层映射矩阵，以及 hidden space 之间的层共享特征映射；两个因子从 prompt 中联合学习，而非预先固定层对应。
Result: 在跨三个模型家族的 7 个模型、共 42 对组合上，MATCHA 比先前方法更忠实地重建目标模型激活，并显著提升基于检索 (retrieval-based) 的指标；恢复的层映射在深度上大体单调，但一致为 many-to-many，每个目标层取用一段源层带。
Conclusion: 层对应关系应与特征变换一起从数据中联合学得，且真实对应是 many-to-many 的带状结构而非逐层一一配对；这种对齐还使 steering vectors 与 probes 可从一个模型迁移到另一个模型。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Epistemic Uncertainty-Aware Defect Detection for Quality Control in Medical Device Manufacturing
papers.abstract_en: Objective: We investigate whether accounting for epistemic uncertainty can improve the reliability of automated defect detection in medical device manufacturing. Methods: We consider a machine learning framework that operates on heterogeneous manufacturing and device-report data represented with Knowledge Graphs. To mitigate errors arising from uncertainty in the decision model, we analyze a principled rejection strategy to abstain from predictions whose estimated epistemic uncertainty exceeds a specified threshold. We evaluate the approach using standard synthetic benchmarks and real-world medical device report data. Results: The theoretical results establish the validity of the method characterizing the regimes under which it is expected to be effective. Empirically, the rejection strategy enables explicit control of coverage, that is, the proportion of samples for which the model issues predictions, while improving performance on the retained samples. On 266,170 real-world FDA MAUDE device reports, a 10% abstention rate reduces classification error by 48%, and more aggressive rejection (approximately 70% coverage) yields near-perfect accuracy on the retained samples. On standard synthetic manufacturing benchmarks, abstaining on 9% of the decisions, our approach reduces the risk up to 63% compared with the standard no-abstention approach. Conclusions: Abstaining from predictions with high epistemic uncertainty can provide a practical tool for controlling the reliability of machine learning-based defect detection, especially in high-stakes medical device manufacturing applications. Significance: Uncertainty-aware defect detection may support safer and more reliable quality assurance in medical device manufacturing by identifying cases that require additional inspection rather than issuing potentially harmful predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在医疗器械制造缺陷检测中，对认知不确定性 (epistemic uncertainty) 超阈值的样本主动弃答 (abstention)，可在保留样本上显著降低错误。在 266,170 条 FDA MAUDE 报告上，10% 弃答率使分类错误下降 48%，覆盖率降到约 70% 时保留样本接近完美准确；合成基准上弃答 9% 决策使风险最多降低 63%。
Motivation: 医疗器械制造中的自动缺陷检测一旦出错代价高，模型在不确定样本上仍强行给出预测会损害质量控制的可靠性。
Method: 框架处理由 Knowledge Graph 表示的异构制造与设备报告数据，估计决策模型的认知不确定性，当其超过指定阈值时按拒绝策略弃答；理论上刻画方法有效的适用区间，并用标准合成制造基准与真实医疗器械报告数据评估。
Result: 在 266,170 条真实 FDA MAUDE 设备报告上，10% 弃答率使分类错误降低 48%，更激进的拒绝（约 70% 覆盖率）使保留样本接近完美准确；在标准合成制造基准上，弃答 9% 决策后相较不弃答方案风险最多降低 63%。
Conclusion: 对高认知不确定性样本弃答可显式控制覆盖率并提升保留样本性能，是高风险医疗器械制造中控制 ML 缺陷检测可靠性的实用手段，用于标记需额外检验的样本。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: A Geometry-Based Capacity Theory for Finite-Feature Associative Memory
papers.abstract_en: We develop a geometry-based capacity theory for exact-key retrieval in compressed finite-feature Hebbian associative memory. For random or approximately isotropic values, retrieval interference separates into finite-feature noise, which decreases with feature dimension, and structural interference, which is determined by squared kernel overlap among stored keys and persists in the infinite-feature limit. This yields a fit-free prediction of retrieval quality, reveals a geometry-dependent capacity ceiling, and predicts the feature budget required for a target retrieval quality. When stored values are correlated, we show that retrieval depends jointly on the key kernel and value Gram matrix, and derive finite-feature approximations that account for this interaction. We validate the theory on synthetic, visual, and medical-image representations. Overall, the framework links representation geometry directly to memory capacity and distinguishes when performance can be improved by increasing the feature budget and when the representation itself must be changed. Across these settings, the predicted retrieval curves closely match empirical behavior and correctly identify changes in the preferred memory design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为压缩有限特征 Hebbian 联想记忆的精确键检索建立几何容量理论：检索干扰分解为随特征维度下降的有限特征噪声，以及由存储键平方核重叠决定、在无限特征极限下仍存在的结构干扰，从而无需拟合即可预测检索质量与达到目标质量所需的特征预算。当存储值相关时，检索同时取决于键核与值 Gram 矩阵。在合成、视觉与医学图像表示上，预测的检索曲线与实测行为高度吻合，并正确识别偏好的记忆设计何时改变。
Motivation: 压缩有限特征联想记忆中，检索质量受特征维度与键几何共同限制，缺少无需拟合即可预测容量上限、并区分「加特征预算」与「必须改表示」两种情形的理论。
Method: 对压缩有限特征 Hebbian 联想记忆的精确键检索建立几何容量理论：将检索干扰分解为有限特征噪声与结构干扰（由存储键平方核重叠决定）；值相关时引入键核与值 Gram 矩阵的联合分析，并推导有限特征近似；在合成、视觉与医学图像表示上验证。
Result: 给出免拟合的检索质量预测与几何依赖的容量上限，并预测达到目标检索质量所需特征预算；在合成、视觉与医学图像表示上，预测检索曲线与实测行为高度吻合，且正确识别偏好的记忆设计变化；结构干扰在无限特征极限下仍存在，而有限特征噪声随特征维度下降。
Conclusion: 表示几何直接决定联想记忆容量：加特征预算只在有限特征噪声主导时有效，结构干扰主导时必须改变表示本身。

papers.title: MimicX: Policy-in-the-Loop Supervision Refinement for Video-Driven Humanoid Motion Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Human videos provide rich motion targets for humanoid learning, yet visually plausible references can still produce persistent failures under physics-based execution. These failures reveal where training supervision should change. We present MimicX, a policy-in-the-loop framework that uses execution feedback to refine video-driven humanoid motion tracking. Starting from reconstructed and retargeted motion, MimicX localizes difficult transitions and affected body regions, then jointly adapts tracking objectives and the reset curriculum for policy continuation. Repeated rollout verification selects execution-priority improvements subject to tracking guards. Across four core video tasks, MimicX consistently improves tracking accuracy and Robust Execution Horizon relative to the Fixed Reference baseline. Task-averaged results show a 25.7% reduction in body-tracking error and a 255.6% increase in execution horizon. Additional video, motion-reference, and collision-scene studies evaluate the method beyond the core tasks, while MimicX-HLoop accelerates feedback through heterogeneous execution. Overall, MimicX turns policy failure into actionable supervision for deciding what to refine and which refinement to retain.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 26 figures, 19 tables, including references and appendices. Project website: https://nebulis-lab.com/MimicX
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MimicX 把人形机器人策略在物理执行中的失败反向转成可操作的监督信号：从重建与重定向后的动作出发，定位难过渡片段与受影响身体部位，联合调整跟踪目标与 reset 课程，并用重复 rollout 验证在跟踪护栏约束下筛选保留的改进。四个核心视频任务上，相对 Fixed Reference 基线任务平均体部跟踪误差降低 25.7%，执行时长 (Robust Execution Horizon) 提升 255.6%。
Motivation: 视频驱动的人形动作跟踪中，视觉上合理的参考动作在物理执行下仍会持续失败，而固定参考的训练监督不会随这些失败调整。
Method: policy-in-the-loop 框架：以重建并重定向的动作 (reconstructed and retargeted motion) 为起点，定位困难过渡与受影响身体区域，联合自适应调整跟踪目标与策略续训的 reset 课程；再用重复 rollout 验证在 tracking guards 约束下筛选执行优先的改进，MimicX-HLoop 用异构执行加速反馈。
Result: 四个核心视频任务上相对 Fixed Reference 基线一致提升跟踪精度与 Robust Execution Horizon：任务平均体部跟踪误差下降 25.7%，执行时长提升 255.6%；另有视频、动作参考与碰撞场景的扩展研究，以及 HLoop 异构执行的反馈加速。
Conclusion: 把策略失败当作监督信号来决定改什么、留什么，可以同时降低视频驱动人形跟踪的误差并大幅延长有效执行时长。

papers.title: Justice After Identity: Large Language Models and the View from Everywhere
papers.abstract_en: The search for a common view of justice and fairness has challenged human collective activity, as our diverging judgments are unavoidably shaped by the self-interests of social position, personal benefit, cultural inheritance, and historical circumstance. John Rawls famously attempted to overcome this limitation through popularizing a philosophical tradition known by the phrase "the original position" - a thought experiment by which people select principles of justice without knowing the identities or advantages they will possess. Critics, however, have long questioned whether people can meaningfully suspend their social identities and suppress morally relevant forms of lived experience. Artificial intelligence engaged to calculate algorithmic and agentic fairness introduces a novel possibility. LLMs have no singular class, race, gender, nationality, or biography, yet their parameters encode linguistic representations of a vast range of human identities and moral traditions. Perhaps the ethical judgments of LLMs could approximate an integrative original position - a "view from everywhere" generated not by excluding social identities but by computationally incorporating their diversity.It is unlikely that humankind will "hand over the keys" to computational systems by simply delegating complete agentic control of distributive and procedural collective processes. But AI may play a role, perhaps a positive one, interacting with individual and collective human judgment as we often confront increasingly polarized views on what is fair and just. We present data comparing human, base model, and frontier/fine-tuned model judgments about classic moral dilemmas while systematically varying identity relationships and Rawlsian constraints on identity. We conclude by speculating whether, if advanced AI systems provide humans with thoughtful advice, humans would actually be likely to accept it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把 Rawls 的「原初状态」(original position) 移植到 LLM 上，主张模型没有单一阶级、种族、性别或传记，却在参数中编码了多样的身份与道德传统，因而可能生成一种「无处不在的视角」的公平判断。作者给出人类、base model 与 frontier/fine-tuned model 在经典道德困境上的判断数据，并系统改变身份关系与 Rawls 式身份约束，最后讨论人类是否会接受高级 AI 的公平性建议。
Motivation: 人类对正义的判断被社会位置、自身利益与历史处境绑定，Rawls 的原初状态要求人们悬置身份，而批评者认为这在现实中做不到；算法公平的兴起提供了一个新可能，即用 LLM 的跨身份表征来近似这种整合视角。
Method: 收集人类、base model 与 frontier/fine-tuned model 对经典道德困境 (classic moral dilemmas) 的判断数据，并系统操纵两个自变量：参与者与情境之间的身份关系，以及 Rawls 式的身份约束条件。
Result: 呈现了人类、base model、frontier/fine-tuned model 三方在经典道德困境上的判断对比数据，实验设计中身份关系与 Rawls 式身份约束被系统变化；摘要未给出具体数值或指标。
Conclusion: LLM 或许能近似一种通过纳入而非排除身份多样性而生成的「view from everywhere」，但作者以推测收尾：即便高级 AI 提供深思熟虑的建议，人类也未必愿意接受。

papers.title: BeatFlow-ECG: Rectified Flow for ECG Reconstruction from Indirect Wearable Signals
papers.abstract_en: Continuous cardiac monitoring outside clinical settings requires signals that are both informative and practical to collect during daily life. Electrocardiography (ECG) provides rich information about cardiac rhythm and waveform morphology, while wearable photoplethysmography (PPG) is easier to acquire continuously but is only an indirect cardiovascular measurement and is highly sensitive to motion. We present BeatFlow-ECG, a conditional rectified-flow model for reconstructing single-channel ECG from synchronized PPG and inertial measurements. BeatFlow-ECG models reconstruction as conditional transport from noise to ECG using a convolutional encoder-decoder with a transformer bottleneck and explicit flow-time conditioning. Motion information is incorporated through IMU-derived conditioning features, motion-dependent loss weighting, and an easy-to-hard training curriculum. We evaluate the model under leave-one-subject-out protocols on PPG-DaLiA and WESAD. BeatFlow-ECG achieves the best results among the evaluated deterministic, adversarial, and diffusion-based baselines across all reported waveform and beat-timing metrics, with Pearson correlations of 0.983 and 0.986 and R-peak F1 scores of 0.946 and 0.955, respectively. Compared with Conditional DDPM-1D, L1 error decreases from 0.085 to 0.062 on PPG-DaLiA and from 0.074 to 0.055 on WESAD. Additional analyses on PPG-DaLiA show higher correlation in fixed R-peak-relative waveform regions and lower reconstruction error across low-, medium-, and high-motion subsets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BeatFlow-ECG 用条件 rectified flow 从同步 PPG 与 IMU 重建单通道 ECG，把重建写成从噪声到 ECG 的条件传输。在 PPG-DaLiA 与 WESAD 的 leave-one-subject-out 协议下，Pearson 相关达 0.983/0.986、R-peak F1 达 0.946/0.955，L1 误差相对 Conditional DDPM-1D 从 0.085 降到 0.062、0.074 降到 0.055。
Motivation: ECG 信息丰富但难以日常连续采集，PPG 易得却只是间接心血管测量且对运动高度敏感，需要从可穿戴间接信号恢复可用的 ECG 波形。
Method: 条件 rectified flow 将重建建模为从噪声到 ECG 的条件传输，网络为卷积 encoder-decoder 加 transformer bottleneck，并显式加入 flow-time 条件；运动信息通过 IMU 派生条件特征、motion-dependent 损失加权与 easy-to-hard 训练课程注入。
Result: 在 PPG-DaLiA 与 WESAD 的 leave-one-subject-out 评测中，BeatFlow-ECG 在全部所报告波形与心跳计时指标上优于 deterministic、adversarial 与 diffusion 基线：Pearson 相关 0.983 与 0.986，R-peak F1 0.946 与 0.955；相对 Conditional DDPM-1D，L1 误差在 PPG-DaLiA 从 0.085 降至 0.062、WESAD 从 0.074 降至 0.055；PPG-DaLiA 上固定 R-peak 相对波形区相关更高，低、中、高运动子集重建误差均更低。
Conclusion: 带显式 flow-time 条件与运动感知训练的 rectified flow 能从 PPG+IMU 重建出接近真实 ECG 的波形与心跳计时，且在不同运动强度下都保持较低误差。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: A Self-Pruning Transformer: Extreme KV-Cache Compression with Universal Attention
papers.abstract_en: The large KV-cache size of modern LLMs creates a barrier to efficient deployment. Recent work has explored replacing attention layers' RoPE positional embeddings with alternative decay-based mechanisms, which can then be used to prune KV-cache during inference. However, these decay functions have limited expressivity, and in practice devolve into sliding-window-like eviction patterns. In this work, we propose a unifying framework for complementary and novel decay mechanisms, capturing complex key statistics and interactions while preserving expressive RoPE embeddings and Softmax attention. The resulting Universal Attention is a highly expressive and end-to-end trainable architecture, whose composite decay mechanism acts as a natural, $\textit{adaptive}$ pruning criterion, removing tokens that contribute least to attention computation. Experimentally, Universal Attention achieves state-of-the-art $10\times$ compression on natural language and synthetic task data, while $\textit{improving}$ downstream performance compared to both state-of-the-art baselines and unpruned oracles. It further demonstrates superior long-context generalization with unprecedented $25\times$ compression at length 16k.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Universal Attention：在保留 RoPE 位置编码与 Softmax 注意力的前提下，用可端到端训练的复合衰减机制刻画 key 统计与交互，该衰减本身即自适应剪枝准则，推理时自动剔除对注意力贡献最小的 token。在自然语言与合成任务上达到 SOTA 的 10× KV-cache 压缩，且下游性能优于 SOTA 基线与未剪枝 oracle；在 16k 长度上进一步实现 25× 压缩并展现更强长上下文泛化。
Motivation: 现代 LLM 的 KV-cache 体积过大，成为高效部署的瓶颈；已有用衰减机制替代 RoPE 的剪枝方法表达能力有限，实践中退化成滑窗式淘汰，无法保留真正重要的 token。
Method: 提出统一框架，组合互补且新颖的衰减机制以捕捉复杂 key 统计与交互，同时保留表达性强的 RoPE 嵌入与 Softmax 注意力；得到的 Universal Attention 可端到端训练，其复合衰减机制直接充当自适应剪枝准则。
Result: 在自然语言与合成任务数据上达到 SOTA 的 10× KV-cache 压缩，下游性能优于 SOTA 基线以及未剪枝 oracle；在长度 16k 上实现前所未有的 25× 压缩，并展示更优的长上下文泛化。
Conclusion: 保留 RoPE 与 Softmax、把表达力更强的衰减机制作为可训练的自适应剪枝准则，可以在极端 KV-cache 压缩下同时提升而非牺牲下游性能，长上下文场景尤其受益。

papers.title: Towards Financial World Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Building a world model requires a state representation useful for planning and decision-making---potentially over tasks unknown at training time. In the context of financial markets, planning and decision-making may require a model to reason about market-wide conditions, asset-specific expected returns, liquidity, volatility, and cross-asset relationships. Yet financial representation learning has largely been evaluated on individual predictive tasks, oftentimes on a single time period using comparatively narrow datasets. We address this through three primary contributions. First, we introduce Market-1T, a dataset containing nearly one trillion observations across U.S. equities from 2008 to 2025 at 1 Hz resolution. Second, we develop and implement a rigorous evaluation protocol. Third, we conduct a systematic large-scale study of financial representation learning, comparing 18 encoder-training strategies across nearly two decades of market regimes. We evaluate learned representations both by their predictive utility on common finance tasks and through probes of latent structure. We find that encoders with similar predictive performance can organize market state very differently. Collectively, we establish a foundation for training and evaluating financial market representations in support of world models such as DINO-WM, V-JEPA 2, and LeWM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出金融世界模型的基础设施：近 1 万亿条 1 Hz 美股观测数据集 Market-1T（2008–2025）、一套严格评测协议，并用它系统比较 18 种编码器训练策略。核心发现是预测性能相近的编码器对市场状态的潜在组织方式可以截然不同，因此只看预测分数不足以筛选世界模型的状态表征。
Motivation: 金融表征学习长期只在单个预测任务、单一时间段和窄数据集上评测，无法支撑需要推理市场整体状态、资产收益、流动性、波动率与跨资产关系的世界模型规划与决策。
Method: 三项贡献：构建 Market-1T 数据集（美股 2008–2025 年、1 Hz、近 1e9 条观测）；设计覆盖常见金融任务预测效用与潜在结构探测 (probes of latent structure) 的评测协议；在近二十年市场体制上比较 18 种编码器训练策略。
Result: 系统研究覆盖 18 种编码器训练策略、近二十年市场体制；发现预测性能相近的编码器可能以非常不同的方式组织市场状态，即预测分数无法区分潜在结构。
Conclusion: 金融世界模型（如 DINO-WM、V-JEPA 2、LeWM）的状态表征需要同时用预测效用和潜在结构探测来训练与评测，单任务预测分数不足以选型。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Learning Transition Kernels of Jump-Diffusion Processes with Conditional Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of learning transition kernels for time-homogeneous jump-diffusion processes using conditional diffusion models, with the goal of generating new sample paths from training data consisting of N independent trajectories observed on a high-frequency discrete time grid. On the theoretical side, we establish non-asymptotic bounds for the conditional score estimation error and for the KL divergence between the laws of the true and generated discretely observed paths. On the numerical side, we first evaluate our method on synthetic data to assess the theoretical findings and benchmark its performance against the approach of Gao et al. (2025). We then apply our method to real-world data and investigate its performance on a probabilistic forecasting task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用条件扩散模型学习时间齐次跳扩散过程 (time-homogeneous jump-diffusion) 的转移核，从 N 条高频离散网格轨迹生成新样本路径，并给出非渐近的条件 score 估计误差与离散观测路径 KL 散度界。合成数据上对照 Gao et al. (2025) 检验理论结论，真实数据上用于概率预报任务。
Motivation: 从有限条高频观测轨迹中学习跳扩散过程的转移核并生成新路径，需要同时控制 score 估计误差与生成路径分布相对真实分布的 KL 偏差，这一非渐近保证此前缺少。
Method: 以条件扩散模型作为转移核的参数化：训练数据为 N 条在高频离散时间网格上观测的独立轨迹，模型学习给定当前状态的条件 score 以采样下一步转移；理论上推导条件 score 估计误差与离散观测路径真实/生成分布 KL 散度的非渐近界，数值上先用合成数据检验这些界并与 Gao et al. (2025) 的方法对比，再在真实数据上做概率预报。
Result: 给出两类非渐近界：条件 score 估计误差，以及真实与生成的离散观测路径分布之间的 KL 散度；合成数据实验用于评估这些理论结论并与 Gao et al. (2025) 基准对比，真实数据上在概率预报任务中检验方法表现。
Conclusion: 跳扩散过程的转移核可由条件扩散模型从高频离散轨迹中学习，并带有 score 估计与路径分布 KL 的非渐近理论保证，方法同时适用于合成基准与真实数据的概率预报。

papers.title: Quadratic Weak-to-Strong Generalization in Random Feature Networks via Random Matrix Theory
papers.abstract_en: Weak-to-strong generalization is the phenomenon where a strong student model trained with labels produced by a weak teacher model is able to generalize better than the teacher. In this paper, we study this phenomenon in two-layer random feature networks where the model strength is determined by its width. Using tools from random matrix theory, we derive deterministic equivalents for the population errors of an optimally trained teacher and a student trained with gradient flow. For ReLU activation and a pure spherical harmonic target, we obtain sharp asymptotics under a Gaussian universality assumption, showing a quadratic improvement: the student error scales as the square of the teacher error. These results attain the general lower bound of Medvedev at al (2025). We also analyze how the student behaves under more general stopping times and targets supported on multiple harmonic degrees, characterizing the regimes in which weak-to-strong generalization occurs and identifying the transition between quadratic, non-quadratic, and no improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在两层随机特征网络（宽度决定模型强弱）中，用随机矩阵理论推导教师与梯度流训练学生的总体误差的确定性等价，证明 ReLU 激活加纯球谐目标下学生误差按教师误差的平方缩放，即二次弱到强泛化，并达到 Medvedev et al (2025) 的一般下界。对更一般停止时间与多谐波次数目标，刻画出现弱到强泛化的条件，以及二次改进、非二次改进与无改进之间的转变。
Motivation: 弱到强泛化（弱教师标签训练的学生反而更强）缺少可解析的误差刻画；在随机特征极限下何时出现改进、改进是几阶，此前没有闭式条件。
Method: 研究两层随机特征网络，宽度作为模型强度；用随机矩阵理论推导最优训练教师与梯度流训练学生的总体误差的确定性等价 (deterministic equivalents)；在 ReLU 激活与纯球谐目标下，基于 Gaussian universality 假设给出尖锐渐近，并分析一般停止时间与多谐波次数支撑的目标。
Result: ReLU 加纯球谐目标下得到尖锐渐近：学生误差按教师误差的平方缩放（二次改进），且达到 Medvedev et al (2025) 的一般下界；对一般停止时间与多谐波次数目标，刻画出二次、非二次、无改进三种区间及其转变。
Conclusion: 弱到强泛化在随机特征网络中可由随机矩阵理论精确刻画，二次改进是可达的最优阶，但其出现依赖目标的谐波结构与停止时间，存在从二次到无改进的相变。

papers.title: Careful Judge: Safe and Efficient Human-AI Collaborative Decision Making
papers.abstract_en: In human-AI collaborative decision making, human review can prevent unsafe AI decisions, but each human judgment is costly. Treating human intervention after AI abstention as a one-off fallback misses the opportunity to improve future AI decisions for greater automation, yet AI adaptively learning from selectively queried human feedback breaks safety guardrails calibrated for old models. We approach this challenge with CARE---calibrated adaptive rectification and escalation---an end-to-end pipeline that combines AI models and human reviewers to guarantee safe, human-aligned decisions, while continuously learning from human feedback to achieve greater automation with fewer human queries. CARE is principled, general, modular, and works with any black-box AI model. Our novel adaptive calibration module guarantees risk control at every time step for any rectification module. We further show how CARE improves query efficiency when the AI model is well trained and the human-AI misalignment has a clear structure. Experiments on four safety-critical real-world datasets spanning driving, language, and robotics demonstrate that CARE achieves human-aligned decisions while reducing human queries by 25-81% relative to baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出人机协同决策管线 CARE（calibrated adaptive rectification and escalation）：AI 弃权后由人工复核，同时用自适应校准模块在每一步保证风险受控，并把人工反馈持续回流以提升自动化率。在覆盖驾驶、语言、机器人的四个安全关键真实数据集上，CARE 在达成与人类对齐的决策同时，相对基线减少 25–81% 的人工查询。
Motivation: 人工复核能拦住不安全的 AI 决策但每次判断都有成本；把弃权后的人工干预当作一次性兜底会浪费提升后续自动化的机会，而让 AI 从选择性查询的反馈中自适应学习又会破坏针对旧模型标定的安全护栏。
Method: CARE 是端到端管线，组合任意黑盒 AI 模型与人工评审者，含自适应校准 (adaptive calibration) 模块与 rectification 模块；校准模块对任意 rectification 模块在每个时间步保证风险控制，管线从人工反馈持续学习以在更少查询下提高自动化。
Result: 在四个横跨驾驶、语言与机器人的安全关键真实数据集上，CARE 达到与人类对齐的决策，同时相对基线减少 25–81% 的人工查询；当 AI 模型训练充分且人机失配具有清晰结构时，查询效率进一步改善。
Conclusion: 把人工干预做成可持续回流的校准闭环，可以在保持每步风险受控的前提下大幅压缩人工查询成本，且该保证对任意黑盒模型与 rectification 模块成立。

summary_sections.method: CARE 是端到端管线，组合任意黑盒 AI 模型与人工评审者，含自适应校准 (adaptive calibration) 模块与 rectification 模块；校准模块对任意 rectification 模块在每个时间步保证风险控制，管线从人工反馈持续学习以在更少查询下提高自动化。
summary_sections.result: 在四个横跨驾驶、语言与机器人的安全关键真实数据集上，CARE 达到与人类对齐的决策，同时相对基线减少 25–81% 的人工查询；当 AI 模型训练充分且人机失配具有清晰结构时，查询效率进一步改善。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把人工干预做成可持续回流的校准闭环，可以在保持每步风险受控的前提下大幅压缩人工查询成本，且该保证对任意黑盒模型与 rectification 模块成立。

papers.title: ORACLE: Optimizer-Relative Alignment for Constrained LEarning
papers.abstract_en: Constraint handling methods typically intervene before the optimizer acts, by modifying the objective or the gradient. Yet momentum, adaptive scaling, and structured preconditioning can substantially reshape that signal before it becomes a parameter update. We formulate optimizer relative constrained learning, where constraint compatibility is assessed on the post optimizer update. Building on this view, we introduce ORACLE, which evaluates the native optimizer's realized step through a joint endpoint linearization of heterogeneous constraint families, constructs the resulting alignment in the optimizer's own geometry, bounds its authority, and commits it only after validation. We evaluate ORACLE across eight Partial Differential Equation benchmarks and four optimizers spanning Euclidean, diagonal adaptive, and structured preconditioned geometries, where it improves or matches native optimizer in 94% of configurations. Cross model analysis shows the same behavior in 92% of configurations, while matched comparisons show improvements over alternative constraint-handling methods acting at the objective, gradient, and post-optimizer levels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ORACLE 把约束兼容性判定从优化器之前移到优化之后：对原生优化器实际走的那一步做异质约束族的联合端点线性化，在优化器自身几何中构造对齐、限制其权限，验证通过才提交更新。在 8 个 PDE 基准、4 种覆盖欧氏/对角自适应/结构预条件几何的优化器上，94% 配置中改进或持平原生优化器，跨模型分析中 92% 配置复现同一行为。
Motivation: 现有约束处理方法都在优化器动作之前介入（改目标或改梯度），但动量、自适应缩放和结构化预条件会在信号变成参数更新之前大幅重塑它，导致事前判定的约束兼容性与实际更新方向脱节。
Method: ORACLE 对原生优化器的 realized step 做异质约束族的联合端点线性化 (joint endpoint linearization)，在优化器自身几何中构造约束对齐量，对其权限加上界，并只在验证通过后提交该更新；评估覆盖 8 个 PDE 基准与 4 种优化器几何。
Result: 在 8 个 PDE 基准 × 4 种优化器（欧氏、对角自适应、结构预条件）的配置中，94% 改进或持平原生优化器；跨模型分析中 92% 配置表现同一行为；与作用在目标、梯度和优化后三个层面的其他约束处理方法的 matched comparison 显示 ORACLE 有改进。
Conclusion: 约束兼容性应在优化器实际产生的更新上判定，而不是在被优化器几何重塑之前的信号上判定；这一视角在多种优化器几何与跨模型设置下都成立。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From High Recall to High Utility: Dataset-Adaptive Post-Processing of LLM-Generated Customer Intents
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can extract useful signals from heterogeneous enterprise data, but high-recall extraction often produces outputs that are duplicated, uneven in granularity, semantically overlapping, or too numerous for downstream systems and human reviewers to use effectively. We present a dataset-adaptive post-processing architecture developed for Customer Intent Extraction (CIE), where unstructured customer language is transformed into stable, traceable intent units. The approach separates recall-oriented extraction from utility-oriented reduction. Source-specific preprocessing first isolates evidence from multimodal plans, sparse operational records, and structured opportunity data. Candidate intents are then standardized and deduplicated, optionally enriched with metadata for embedding computation, represented in a shared semantic vector space, and grouped using a clustering strategy selected according to the candidate set's characteristics. Cluster-level keywords provide an explainability layer, while singleton reassignment requires agreement between embedding and keyword similarity. Finally, constrained language-model aggregation produces one concise intent per cluster without introducing unsupported concepts, and the resulting unit retains provenance, clustering, embedding, and generation metadata. This treats post-processing not as cosmetic cleanup, but as a semantic reduction layer converting high-recall LLM outputs into reusable enterprise intelligence. We also describe two downstream applications: Machine-Generated Intents, which infer likely objectives for customers lacking direct evidence from peer customers with similar profiles, and intent-guided semantic retrieval and mapping, which uses the stable intent as a query against a downstream decision space, illustrated here by mapping customer intents to business outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向客户意图抽取 (CIE) 提出数据集自适应后处理架构，把高召回的 LLM 抽取与面向效用的削减分开：先标准化去重、嵌入到共享语义空间，再按候选集特征选择聚类策略，最后用受约束的语言模型聚合每簇生成一条带溯源的意图。单例重分配要求嵌入相似度与关键词相似度同时一致，产出的意图单元保留 provenance、聚类、嵌入与生成元数据。
Motivation: LLM 从异构企业数据中高召回抽取的结果重复、粒度不一、语义重叠且数量过多，下游系统与人工审核难以直接使用。
Method: 流程为：源特定预处理分离多模态计划、稀疏运营记录与结构化商机证据；候选意图标准化与去重，可选补充元数据后计算嵌入并映射到共享语义向量空间；按候选集特征选择聚类策略，簇级关键词作可解释层，单例重分配需嵌入与关键词相似度一致；最后由受约束语言模型聚合为每簇一条简洁意图，不引入无支撑概念。
Result: 摘要给出的是架构与两个下游应用的描述：Machine-Generated Intents 用相似画像的同行客户推断缺乏直接证据客户的目标；意图引导的语义检索与映射把稳定意图作为查询映射到业务结果。
Conclusion: 后处理应被当作把高召回 LLM 输出转成可复用企业情报的语义削减层，而非表面清理；意图单元需携带溯源与生成元数据以保持稳定可追溯。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: When the Governor Becomes the Disturbance: Control-Generated Disturbance and Cost-Aware Backoff in Governed Tool-Using Agents
papers.abstract_en: Supervisory governors can interfere with the tool-using agents they regulate. We study this possibility in a controlled file-recovery environment where increases in regulatory intensity trigger experimentally imposed tool failures. A cost-blind governor can turn these failures into persistent blocking that prevents task completion. We compare this governor with a backoff rule that reduces intervention probability using a moving average of known induced events. On a hand-coded stochastic-policy agent, the failure pattern appears under both result replacement and execution of corrupted tool arguments. For the persistent policy, adaptive backoff improves completion relative to a fixed weak governor with approximately matched intervention frequency. A Gemini 2.5 Flash experiment comprising 576 episodes across 6 tasks also shows reduced blocking and improved completion under backoff; among the tested settings, intermediate backoff strength achieves the highest observed aggregate success. These results identify an interaction between intervention cost and persistent action blocking, together with a possible mitigation. The cost mechanisms are imposed and their induced events are directly observable to the backoff rule; applicability beyond this controlled environment remains an empirical question.
papers.comment: Includes ancillary experimental data and a Python script for reproducing numerical summaries. Code: https://github.com/CriticalAttentionSystems/CASAgentGovernor
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 监管型 governor 本身会成为干扰源：在受控文件恢复环境中，监管强度上升会触发工具故障，cost-blind governor 把故障放大成持续阻塞、任务无法完成。用已知诱导事件的滑动平均降低干预概率的 backoff 规则能减少阻塞、提高完成率；Gemini 2.5 Flash 的 576 个 episode、6 个任务上同样如此，且中等 backoff 强度取得最高聚合成功率。
Motivation: 工具使用 agent 的监督型 governor 可能把自身干预造成的工具故障固化为持续阻塞，cost-blind 设计无法区分故障来自任务还是来自干预本身，导致任务无法完成。
Method: 在受控文件恢复环境中，人为设定监管强度上升触发工具故障；对比 cost-blind governor 与基于已知诱导事件滑动平均的 backoff 规则（降低干预概率）。测试对象包括手写随机策略 agent（覆盖结果替换与执行损坏工具参数两种故障模式）、持久策略 agent，以及 Gemini 2.5 Flash，共 576 个 episode、6 个任务。
Result: cost-blind governor 将故障转成持续阻塞、阻止任务完成；在干预频率近似匹配下，adaptive backoff 相对 fixed weak governor 提升持久策略的完成率。Gemini 2.5 Flash 的 576 episode、6 任务实验中 backoff 同样降低阻塞、提高完成率，受测设置里中等 backoff 强度取得最高观测聚合成功率。
Conclusion: 干预成本与持续动作阻塞之间存在交互，backoff 是一种可行缓解手段；但成本机制是人为施加、诱导事件对 backoff 规则直接可观测，向受控环境之外的推广仍是经验问题。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Shared-Roadmap Generation and Evaluator for Multi-Agent Path Planning Using Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent path planning (MAPP) in continuous environments often relies on roadmaps to balance safety and search efficiency. However, traditional roadmap generation methods, such as lattice grids or standard sampling-based approaches, frequently face a trade-off between graph density and the likelihood of finding feasible, high-quality solutions. In this paper, we propose a scalable heterogeneous Graph Neural Network (GNN) framework for the automated generation and evaluation of shared multi-agent roadmaps. Our model covers the representation of waypoints, agent locations, and task locations as distinct nodes in a heterogeneous graph, allowing it to reason over global connectivity and inter-agent interactions. By training on occupation density maps aggregated and collected from expert solver trajectories, the GNN learns to identify critical points of interest and prune redundant nodes and edges. This process produces a compact, coordination-aware roadmap that is invariant to task permutations and is reusable for multi-agent pick and delivery tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework can reduce planning effort and can potentially find better solutions, reaching at least 40% reduction in runtime and in graph size for dense roadmaps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用异构 GNN 自动生成并评估多智能体共享路图：把 waypoint、agent 位置、任务位置建成异构图节点，用专家求解轨迹聚合出的占据密度图训练，识别关键兴趣点并剪掉冗余节点与边。生成的路图对任务排列不变、可复用于多智能体取送货任务，稠密路图下运行时间与图规模至少各降 40%。
Motivation: 连续环境多智能体路径规划依赖路图平衡安全与搜索效率，但 lattice grid 与传统采样式生成方法在图密度与找到可行高质量解之间存在权衡，且难以随智能体数量扩展。
Method: 异构 GNN 框架：waypoint、agent 位置、任务位置作为异构图中不同节点类型，模型据此推理全局连通性与智能体间交互；训练数据为专家求解轨迹聚合而成的占据密度图，学习目标是识别关键兴趣点并剪除冗余节点与边，输出紧凑、协调感知、对任务排列不变的共享路图。
Result: 实验显示该框架能降低规划开销并可能找到更优解：在稠密路图上运行时间与图规模均至少下降 40%。
Conclusion: 用学习到的共享路图替代传统采样式路图生成，可以在稠密路图场景下同时压缩图规模并缩短规划时间，且路图可跨取送货任务复用。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Quad-State Safety Evaluation of Open-Weight Large Language Models on Non-Canonical Inputs
papers.abstract_en: Standard safety evaluations of large language models assess harmful requests written in canonical plain text, while models in real-world deployment routinely receive inputs containing emojis, altered spellings, encoded strings, and character-level variations. This work introduces the Adversarial Surface-Form Robustness Dataset (ASRD), comprising 2,100 prompts across seven distinct surface-form families. Five open-weight language models are evaluated across these prompts, producing 10,500 responses. The Quad-State Evaluation Rubric classifies each response into one of four outcomes: harmful compliance, safe response, comprehension failure, or indeterminate. Emoji and invisible Unicode variations cause almost no comprehension failure, with pooled harmful compliance of 20.27% and 17.20% against a 22.87% baseline that is driven mainly by Mistral 7B, whereas leetspeak, encoded wrappers, and hybrid transformations score 2.40%, 0.13%, and 2.40% while comprehension failure rises to 36.47%, 65.60%, and 34.47%. Inspection of raw model outputs reveals three response behaviors: hallucinated benignity, structural collapse, and language drift. Project page: www.pavanmaddula.com/quadstate
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Self-Evolving Diversity-Driven Search for Robust AI Systems (EvoRobust). 12 pages, 11 tables. Project page: https://www.pavanmaddula.com/quadstate Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/pavanmaddula/ASRD-Dataset
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ASRD 表面形式鲁棒性数据集（2,100 条 prompt、7 类表面形式族）与 Quad-State 评测准则，把开放权重模型对非规范输入的回应分为有害顺从、安全回应、理解失败、不确定四态。五个模型共 10,500 条回应显示：emoji 与不可见 Unicode 几乎不引发理解失败，有害顺从 20.27% 与 17.20%，接近 22.87% 的基线；leetspeak、编码包装与混合变换把有害顺从压到 2.40%、0.13%、2.40%，代价是理解失败升到 36.47%、65.60%、34.47%。
Motivation: 标准安全评测只测规范纯文本请求，而真实部署中模型常收到 emoji、改写拼写、编码串与字符级变体，安全与可用性会同时失效。
Method: 构建 ASRD：2,100 条 prompt、7 个表面形式族；用 Quad-State Evaluation Rubric 将每条回应归为 harmful compliance、safe response、comprehension failure、indeterminate 四类，对五个开放权重模型共 10,500 条回应打标，并人工检查原始输出归纳响应行为。
Result: emoji 与不可见 Unicode 变体的 pooled harmful compliance 分别为 20.27% 与 17.20%，对照 22.87% 的基线（该基线主要由 Mistral 7B 驱动），理解失败几乎为零；leetspeak、encoded wrappers、hybrid transformations 的 harmful compliance 为 2.40%、0.13%、2.40%，对应理解失败升至 36.47%、65.60%、34.47%。原始输出中出现三类行为：hallucinated benignity、structural collapse、language drift。
Conclusion: 表面形式变换在安全与可理解性之间形成取舍：字符级扰动几乎不破坏理解却仍保留约两成有害顺从，而 leetspeak 与编码类变换大幅压低有害顺从、却让模型大量无法理解输入。

papers.title: Shape-Bayes: Bayesian Inference of Structured Shapes under Visual Ambiguity
papers.abstract_en: Perceiving structured shapes, such as human faces, from pixels is an inherently ambiguous task in real-world conditions. Yet, shape inference is largely posed as a deterministic regression task predicting fixed spatial coordinates. We find that deterministic regression is brittle when visual evidence is ambiguous or incomplete; under severe occlusions deterministic models exhibit structural collapse, predicting incoherent shapes or reverting to generic averages. To address this, we introduce Shape-Bayes, a probabilistic framework that couples uncertainty-aware visual perception with Bayesian shape reasoning. Rather than forcing point estimates, Shape-Bayes dynamically weights visual evidence against geometric priors to infer a structurally valid shape posterior. Demonstrated on human face shape regression, a rigorous testbed featuring complex non-rigid deformations and strict anatomical constraints, Shape-Bayes comprises: (1) a base model predicting noisy landmarks alongside distilled aleatoric uncertainties; (2) a lightweight Transformer encoding these observations into an adaptive prior over a PCA shape manifold; and (3) a differentiable Bayesian solver computing closed-form posteriors by balancing the noisy predictions against this prior. By guaranteeing complete structural integrity, Shape-Bayes achieves an absolute improvement of up to ~34% IDR over state-of-the-art deterministic models. Simultaneously, it yields highly calibrated uncertainty bounds and reduces relative error by up to 12.5%, establishing a new state-of-the-art for robust 2D face shape regression under severe occlusion. The project page is at https://shape-bayes.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Shape-Bayes 把人脸形状回归从确定性点估计改成概率后验推断：基线模型输出带 aleatoric 不确定度的噪声关键点，轻量 Transformer 把这些观测编码成 PCA 形状流形上的自适应先验，再用可微 Bayesian solver 闭式求解后验。在严重遮挡下确定性模型会出现结构坍缩，而 Shape-Bayes 相对 SOTA 确定性模型 IDR 绝对提升最高约 34%，相对误差最多降低 12.5%。
Motivation: 形状推断长期被当作确定性回归，直接预测固定空间坐标；在视觉证据含糊或不完整（尤其严重遮挡）时这类模型会结构坍缩，输出不连贯形状或退回通用平均脸。
Method: 三段式框架：(1) 基线模型预测噪声关键点并蒸馏出 aleatoric 不确定度；(2) 轻量 Transformer 将这些观测编码为 PCA 形状流形上的自适应先验；(3) 可微 Bayesian solver 在噪声预测与先验之间权衡，计算闭式后验，保证结构完整性。测试床为人体人脸形状回归，含复杂非刚性形变与严格解剖约束。
Result: 相对 SOTA 确定性模型，IDR 绝对提升最高约 34%，相对误差最多降低 12.5%，同时给出校准良好的不确定度区间；评估设定为严重遮挡下的 D 人脸形状回归。
Conclusion: 在视觉证据含糊时用几何先验平衡噪声观测的贝叶斯后验推断，比确定性回归更能维持结构有效形状，确立了严重遮挡下 2D 人脸形状回归的新 SOTA。

papers.title: Beyond Explanation: Debugging Medical Imaging Models via Concept Intervention
papers.abstract_en: Medical imaging models often operate as black boxes, limiting interpretability and systematic debugging. We introduce an easy-to-use, plug-and-play framework for concept-based interpretation and model refinement. By aligning a single-modality encoder to BioMedCLIP, we construct a Concept Bottleneck Model (CBM) that enables concept-level interventions. These interventions allow us to isolate causal versus spuriously correlated concepts, validate insights with domain experts, and generate counterfactual samples for targeted fine-tuning. We evaluate our framework on a Mayo Clinic ultrasound dataset and the CheXpert 5x200 chest X-ray dataset. Results demonstrate that concept intervention enables reliable model diagnosis while maintaining, and occasionally improving predictive performance via guided fine-tuning. Our findings highlight the practical value of this framework for controlled, interpretable refinement of clinical deep learning models.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 5th Workshop on Applications of Medical AI (AMAI), MICCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出即插即用的概念干预框架：把单模态编码器对齐到 BioMedCLIP 构建 Concept Bottleneck Model (CBM)，在概念层面区分因果概念与虚假相关概念，再用领域专家验证并生成反事实样本做定向微调。在 Mayo Clinic 超声与 CheXpert 5x200 胸片数据集上，概念干预能可靠诊断模型，同时保持、偶尔提升预测性能。
Motivation: 医学影像模型是黑箱，既难解释也难系统性调试，无法区分真正起作用的概念与虚假相关。
Method: 将单模态编码器对齐到 BioMedCLIP，构建支持概念级干预的 Concept Bottleneck Model (CBM)；用干预隔离因果与虚假相关概念，经领域专家验证洞察，并生成反事实样本用于定向微调 (guided fine-tuning)。
Result: 在 Mayo Clinic 超声数据集与 CheXpert 5x200 胸部 X 光数据集上评估：概念干预实现可靠的模型诊断，同时保持预测性能，并在引导微调下偶尔提升性能。
Conclusion: 概念干预可作为临床深度学习模型受控、可解释的调试与微调手段，且不必牺牲预测性能。

papers.title: Graph-monotone entrywise guarantees for MLE and Rank Centrality on general comparison graphs
papers.abstract_en: Pairwise comparisons are widely used to infer latent scores and identify top-ranked items. Although sharp statistical guarantees are available under uniform sampling, real data often induce irregular comparison graphs with heterogeneous observation counts across pairs. In this paper, we study an arbitrary fixed comparison graph under the Bradley--Terry--Luce model with minimal assumptions. We prove that both the standard maximum likelihood estimator and Rank Centrality achieve a high-probability entrywise error rate of order $1/\sqrt{λ_{\mathcal{D}}}$ up to logarithmic and dynamic-range factors, where $λ_{\mathcal{D}}$ is the algebraic connectivity of the count-weighted observation graph. This guarantee is graph-monotone since $λ_{\mathcal{D}}$ cannot decrease when additional comparisons are added. Under heterogeneous sampling, where comparison pairs are sampled independently with unequal probabilities, our guarantee improves existing error bounds or requires weaker assumptions. We further extend our analysis to show that both estimators are robust against outcome-adaptive augmentation, where an adversary can choose additional comparison pairs after observing the initial outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Bradley–Terry–Luce 模型下，对任意固定比较图证明 MLE 与 Rank Centrality 的逐项 (entrywise) 误差高概率为 1/√λ_D 量级（含对数与动态范围因子），λ_D 为计数加权观测图的代数连通度。因加边不会降低 λ_D，该保证对图是单调的；在非均匀采样下改进已有误差界或放宽假设，并可推广到对手在看到初始结果后再选边的 outcome-adaptive 增广。
Motivation: 均匀采样下的尖锐统计保证难以覆盖真实数据产生的不规则比较图，各边观测数异质时现有逐项误差界较弱或需更强假设。
Method: 在最小假设的 BTL 模型下分析任意固定比较图，对标准 MLE 与 Rank Centrality 给出以计数加权图代数连通度 λ_D 表示的高概率逐项误差界，并把分析扩展到 outcome-adaptive augmentation（对手在观察初始结果后选择追加比较对）。
Result: 两个估计量的逐项误差均为 1/√λ_D 量级（至多差对数与动态范围因子）且高概率成立；保证对加边单调（λ_D 不降）；在比较对独立但概率不等的非均匀采样下，该保证改进已有误差界或仅需更弱假设；结论对 outcome-adaptive 增广稳健。
Conclusion: 逐项精度可由计数加权比较图的代数连通度统一刻画，图越密保证越强，且该框架能承受非均匀与对抗性追加的比较数据。

papers.title: Assessment of sky brightness in central Portugal: the Dark Sky destination "Aldeias do Xisto" case study
papers.abstract_en: A combination of remote sensing techniques, open space data and field testing was developed to derive astronomical and meteorological parameters and assess Dark Sky brightness of the hitherto unstudied Schist Villages region in the mountainous Interior Center of Portugal. This study covered the period 2012-2017 and established the methodology for regular light pollution and sky brightness studies in the region using satellite imagery to reduce cost and time and increase accuracy of the final analysis. Long-term Artificial Light At Night (ALAN) data from VIIRS instrument aboard the Suomi-NPP satellite along with cloud cover inferred from MODUS/AQUA satellite data and orographic data, were analyzed in a Geographical Information Systems (GIS) environment. The derived ALAN values were consistent with a preliminary site survey selection, confirming the accuracy of the identified dark sky spots in the region. The analyzed region area spans 1624 Km$^2$ and the darkest site within it showed a sky brightness of 21.4 mag/arcsec$^2$. Ground-based SQM photometer observations of the Night Sky Brightness (NSB) at the zenith validated the satellite derived ALAN data. The devised field testing is itself a low cost solution that can be used by teams in developing countries to easily assess dark sky potential prior to the development of local observatories and astro-tourism activities. This study supported the initial certification of this region as a Dark Sky Starlight Tourist Destination since 2018, an important milestone for dark sky protection in central Portugal.
papers.comment: 38 pages, 16 figures. Submitted to Advances in Space Research, COSPAR - Elsevier
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 VIIRS 夜间灯光 (ALAN)、MODIS/AQUA 云量与地形数据在 GIS 中反演葡萄牙中部 Schist Villages 山区 2012–2017 年的夜空亮度，最暗点达 21.4 mag/arcsec²，并经地面 SQM 光度计验证。该方法把区域光污染普查成本与时间压低，支撑该区 2018 年获 Dark Sky Starlight Tourist Destination 认证。
Motivation: Schist Villages 区域此前缺乏夜空亮度与光污染基线资料，传统地面普查成本高、耗时长，难以支撑暗夜认证与天文旅游规划。
Method: 融合遥感、开放空间数据与实地测试：分析 Suomi-NPP 卫星 VIIRS 长期 ALAN 数据、MODIS/AQUA 反演云量及地形数据，在 GIS 环境中推导天文与气象参数，并用低成本地面 SQM 光度计观测天顶夜空亮度 (NSB) 验证卫星反演结果。
Result: 研究覆盖 2012–2017 年、区域面积 1624 km²，最暗点夜空亮度 21.4 mag/arcsec²；反演 ALAN 与初步选址调查一致，地面 SQM 天顶观测验证了卫星反演数据。
Conclusion: 卫星遥感加低成本地面验证可作为暗夜潜力快速评估的可行方案，支撑区域暗夜认证与天文旅游开发。

papers.title: Visual Memory Attacks Can Persist Through The KV Cache
papers.abstract_en: Modern language model systems operate autonomously over increasingly long contexts containing untrusted text and images. Can an adversarial input continue to steer a model even after that input is removed from its context? We show that attacks can be trained to persist through the key/value (KV) cache of subsequent tokens, allowing adversarial influence to outlive direct access to its source.We consider the Visual Memory Injection (VMI; Schlarmann and Hein, 2026) attack setting, in which an adversarial image that stays in the context plants a hidden backdoor: the model behaves normally until a chosen trigger elicits an attacker-chosen response. We first demonstrate persistence in this setting with optimized soft prompts, which remain effective after we mask the prompt from attention. We then introduce Persistent Visual Memory Injection (P-VMI), which optimizes images to preserve this adversarial behaviour after they are masked from attention. These attacks persist over conversations substantially longer than those used during optimization. On Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, P-VMI achieves up to approximately $90\%$ target success in its strongest configuration and remains effective under a stricter removal setting that exposes the image only on the first turn. A cache-swap ablation localizes the persistent influence to the KV cache. Finally, we show that these attacks can be trained to survive compaction that retains the KV cache of a summary generated by the same model, demonstrating that adversarial behaviour can persist in cached state without continued access to its source.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 长上下文自主系统会接触不可信文本与图像，但输入一旦移出上下文通常被当作已失去影响；若对抗影响能在源被移除后仍通过 KV cache 延续，移除输入这一缓解手段就不再可靠。
Method: 沿用 Visual Memory Injection (VMI) 设定，用优化后的 soft prompt 与对抗图像植入触发式后门，并在训练时把图像从注意力中 mask 掉以迫使影响写入 KV cache，得到 Persistent Visual Memory Injection (P-VMI)；用 cache-swap 消融定位持久影响的来源，并测试模型自生成摘要的 KV cache 压缩场景。

papers.title: BEACON-SP: Ontology-Grounded GraphRAG Framework for Clinical Suicide Risk Assessment
papers.abstract_en: We present BEACON-SP, an ontology-grounded Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) framework for clinician-facing decision support in behavioral health settings such as suicide prevention, where effective assessment requires integrating heterogeneous clinical, behavioral, social, and temporal evidence. BEACON-SP combines patient knowledge graphs with ontology-guided retrieval to support multi-hop reasoning across diagnoses, medications, risk and protective factors, life events, and temporal relationships. The framework is enabled by a comprehensive suicide prevention ontology that integrates the Three-Step Theory, the Integrated Motivational-Volitional Model, and the Suicide Social Determinants of Health Ontology into a unified representation of patient risk factors. We construct ontology-grounded patient knowledge graphs and evaluate BEACON-SP for clinician-facing question answering. Compared with a vector-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) baseline on a 1,500-query benchmark spanning 15 clinical categories and 100 patients, BEACON-SP improves completeness, clinical relevance, and evidence grounding under a corrected comparative evaluation protocol, with a small gain on factual accuracy. In paired criterion-level comparisons, GraphRAG is preferred in 76.4% of cases. These results demonstrate the potential of ontology-guided GraphRAG to provide structured, contextualized patient evidence for clinical decision support.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BEACON-SP 把自杀预防本体（整合 Three-Step Theory、Integrated Motivational-Volitional Model 与 Suicide Social Determinants of Health Ontology）与患者知识图谱结合，用本体引导的 GraphRAG 做多跳检索，供临床医生问答。在 1,500 条查询、15 个临床类别、100 位患者的基准上，相对向量 RAG 基线提升完整性、临床相关性与证据锚定，配对准则级比较中 GraphRAG 在 76.4% 的案例中更受偏好。
Motivation: 自杀风险评估需要跨诊断、用药、风险与保护因素、生活事件和时间关系整合异构证据，纯向量检索的 RAG 难以提供结构化、可溯源的多跳临床证据。
Method: 构建统一的自杀预防本体，据此生成 ontology-grounded 患者知识图谱；检索时由本体引导在图上做跨实体多跳推理，再生成面向临床医生的回答；评测采用修正后的对比评估协议 (corrected comparative evaluation protocol) 与配对准则级比较。
Result: 在 1,500 查询、15 个临床类别、100 位患者的基准上，相对向量 RAG 基线，BEACON-SP 在完整性、临床相关性与证据锚定上提升，事实准确性小幅提升；配对准则级比较中 GraphRAG 在 76.4% 的案例中被偏好。
Conclusion: 本体引导的 GraphRAG 能为临床决策支持提供结构化、带上下文的患者证据，其优势主要体现在完整性、相关性与证据锚定而非事实准确性。

papers.title: SPIN: Shadow Predictive Indexer for Sparse Attention
papers.abstract_en: Indexer-based sparse attention reduces the cost of core attention by passing only a fixed, small number of important tokens to it. However, the indexer must still score the entire KV cache at every decoding step. This scoring overhead becomes a major bottleneck as the context length grows. We propose SPIN (Shadow Predictive Indexer) to reduce this indexer overhead. SPIN uses lightweight, history-based prediction to identify important KV blocks, avoiding the need to score the full KV cache at every decoding step. SPIN treats KV blocks and speculative decoding as first-class design and implementation considerations. Across extensive evaluations on long-context and agentic benchmarks, SPIN achieves 30-40% sparsity while preserving task quality. In end-to-end vLLM serving, SPIN improves output throughput by up to 14.9% and reduces median inter-token latency by up to 13.2%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPIN 用轻量的历史信息预测重要 KV 块，避免 indexer 在每个解码步对整个 KV cache 打分，从而消除长上下文下稀疏注意力的打分开销。在长上下文与 agentic 基准上保持任务质量的同时达到 30-40% 稀疏度，vLLM 端到端服务吞吐最高提升 14.9%、中位 token 间延迟最高下降 13.2%。
Motivation: 基于 indexer 的稀疏注意力只把少量重要 token 送入核心注意力，但 indexer 仍需在每个解码步对整个 KV cache 打分，上下文变长后该打分开销成为主要瓶颈。
Method: SPIN (Shadow Predictive Indexer) 用轻量的基于历史的预测来识别重要 KV 块，跳过逐步全量打分；把 KV 块与 speculative decoding 作为一等设计与实现考量。
Result: 在长上下文与 agentic 基准上保持任务质量的同时达到 30-40% 稀疏度；在 vLLM 端到端服务中输出吞吐最高提升 14.9%，中位 inter-token latency 最高下降 13.2%。
Conclusion: 稀疏注意力的瓶颈可以移到 indexer 打分本身，用历史预测替代逐步全量打分即可在保持质量前提下提高长上下文服务吞吐。
