papers.title: Not Every Call Needs a Frontier Model: Per-Call-Site Evaluation of Small Language Models in a Deployed Agentic Home-Automation System
papers.abstract_en: An agentic system issues several structurally different kinds of LLM calls. It routes intent, classifies actions, grounds language in a device registry, plans multi-agent pipelines and writes the Python code those pipelines run. The difficulty of these call sites varies by an order of magnitude, yet in practice a single model, chosen for the hardest site, serves all of them. In this work, we evaluate 9 models from 0.8B to a frontier hosted model across the five call sites of a deployed open-source home-automation framework (Wactorz), using its unmodified production prompts and two real Home Assistant installations (280 cases, 2520 scored calls). We find that capability is not ordered the same way at every site, and that larger models are not uniformly better: one 4B model is worse than its 2B sibling at grounded actuation. Paired testing shows the best local model to be statistically indistinguishable from both hosted models at four of five sites. Only code generation separates them, against a small hosted model (p = 0.039) as well as a frontier one (p = 0.002). Aggregate accuracy also hides a safety failure specific to actuation, where small models resolve the accuracy/refusal trade-off in degenerate ways: one model (Gemma4 E2B) actuates on 87.2% of requests for devices the site does not own, while another refuses every request it receives. Routing each site to its best local model reaches 91.8% against 95.4% at no per-call cost. In a live deployment judged by a user, hosting only the two generative sites matches hosting everything (39/43 against 39/43) for 28% of the spend, and the actuation gap the benchmark predicted appears as exactly one case in twenty-six. Benchmark, harness and all records are released at https://github.com/waldiez/slm-callsite-eval.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, accepted in NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on SLMs for Agentic Systems, Paris,
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在已部署的开源家庭自动化框架 Wactorz 上，对 9 个 0.8B 至前沿托管模型按五个结构不同的调用点逐一评测（280 例、2520 次打分调用），发现能力排序随调用点变化、更大模型并非处处更好：一个 4B 模型在 grounded actuation 上反而差于其 2B 同门。按调用点路由到各自最佳本地模型可达 91.8%（对照 95.4%），线上只托管两个生成式调用点以 28% 成本匹配全托管的 39/43。
Motivation: 智能体系统里意图路由、动作分类、设备注册表 grounding、多智能体规划与代码生成这五类调用点难度相差一个数量级，实践中却按最难的调用点统一选一个模型，成本与安全都被最坏情况绑架。
Method: 在 Wactorz 的未改动生产 prompt 上评测 9 个模型（0.8B 到前沿托管模型）覆盖五个调用点，使用两套真实 Home Assistant 安装，共 280 例、2520 次打分调用；用配对检验比较本地与托管模型，并在真实部署中由用户评判。
Result: 配对检验显示最佳本地模型在五个调用点中的四个与两个托管模型均无统计显著差异，仅代码生成区分得开（对小型托管模型 p = 0.039，对前沿模型 p = 0.002）；一个 4B 模型在 grounded actuation 上差于其 2B 版本。安全上 Gemma4 E2B 对不属于本站点的设备请求有 87.2% 直接执行，另一模型则全部拒绝。按调用点路由最佳本地模型达 91.8% 对 95.4%；线上只托管两个生成式调用点得 39/43，与全托管 39/43 持平，成本为 28%，基准预测的 actuation 差距在 26 例中只出现 1 例。
Conclusion: 调用点难度不等于模型能力排序，按调用点选型可在几乎不增调用成本的前提下把大部分开销省下来；但 actuation 处的准确率/拒绝权衡会以退化方式崩坏，聚合准确率会掩盖这类安全失败，代码生成是仍需前沿模型的唯一调用点。

papers.title: Neighborhood Smoothing for Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Modern neural networks are often miscalibrated, with a tendency to overconfidence. Existing train-time calibration methods largely modify task losses or calibration penalties, leaving neighborhood structure in learned representations underexploited. We introduce graph smoothing as a general principle for train-time calibration, which encourages similar predictive distributions across neighboring samples in representation space. We analyze the effects of graph smoothing, deriving bounds that connect predictive divergence between neighboring samples to local confidence variation and to the propagation of pointwise calibration error, and characterize the conditions under which smoothing can or cannot improve calibration. In light of this analysis, we propose \modelNoSpace, a graph-based train-time regularizer that penalizes the Jensen--Shannon divergence between predictive distributions of neighboring samples. We present a thorough empirical analysis, showing that across standard calibration benchmarks, \model improves predictive quality, and the improvement is complementary to post-hoc calibration: after temperature scaling, \model attains the lowest NLL of all evaluated train-time methods in seven of the eight image and tabular settings. These findings demonstrate the value of graph smoothing over learned representations for neural network calibration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出把图平滑 (graph smoothing) 作为训练期校准的一般原则：在表示空间中惩罚相邻样本预测分布之间的 Jensen-Shannon 散度，使邻域内预测趋于一致。理论分析给出相邻样本预测散度与局部置信度变化、逐点校准误差传播之间的界，并刻画平滑何时能或不能改善校准。在八个图像与表格校准设定中的七个，该方法叠加温度缩放后取得所有训练期方法中最低的 NLL。
Motivation: 现代神经网络普遍过度自信、校准不良；现有训练期校准方法主要改动任务损失或校准惩罚项，学习表示中的邻域结构基本未被利用。
Method: 提出 �modelNoSpace（图结构训练期正则器），对表示空间中相邻样本的预测分布施加 Jensen-Shannon 散度惩罚；配套推导连接邻域预测散度、局部置信度变化与逐点校准误差传播的界，并给出平滑可否改善校准的条件刻画。
Result: 在标准校准基准上 �model 改善预测质量；与事后校准互补，在八个图像与表格设定中的七个，经温度缩放后 �model 取得所有被评估训练期方法中最低的 NLL。
Conclusion: 对学习表示施加图平滑是训练期校准的有效原则，且与温度缩放等事后方法叠加使用仍有增益。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: PAIR: Bridging Perception and Action in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models map visual observations and language instructions to continuous robot actions. This task requires a transition from representations that describe the scene and instruction to representations that support action generation. Many continuous-action VLAs leave this transition implicit and supervise it mainly through the final action-prediction loss. We introduce PAIR, a framework that learns a shared perception-action representation between these two spaces. During training, a Masked Action Autoencoder encodes expert action chunks into horizon-aligned Action Latent Tokens. A Bridge Module extracts task-relevant features from the current visual-language representations. PAIR aligns these features with the Action Latent Tokens to form Bridge Tokens that preserve task information and capture the structure of expert actions. The Bridge Tokens are then projected into the action-token space and injected into the initial Action Tokens, providing an action-ready starting point for Action Expert refinement. At inference, the autoencoder is removed, and the Bridge Tokens are generated only from the current observation and instruction. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and CALVIN ABC-D show gains for the evaluated OpenVLA-OFT and VLA-Adapter models. On LIBERO-Plus, PAIR raises VLA-Adapter's success rate from 59.1% to 64.2%. On CALVIN, it increases VLA-Adapter's average completed sequence length from 4.42 to 4.53. Across seven real-world tasks, PAIR raises OpenVLA-OFT's success rate from 51.4% to 65.0%. Representation analyses show that Bridge Tokens retain task information while making continuous-action information accessible before Action Expert refinement. These results support a shared intermediate representation as a useful interface between perception and action in continuous-action VLAs.

papers.title: Personalize at Test Time: Learning User Preferences for Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models can generate high-quality images, yet aligning their outputs with individual user preferences remains challenging. A key bottleneck is accurately modeling diverse user preferences from limited feedback. Existing approaches often rely on labor-intensive manual preference annotations or vision-language models (VLM) to extract preference information from user interaction histories, introducing substantial annotation or computational costs that limit scalability. We propose an approach that learns personalized reward models directly from users' historical image preference pairs. First, we use an autoencoder to compress hundreds of visual attributes into 50 attribute-anchored preference dimensions and train an evaluator to score images along these dimensions. We then represent each user's preferences as a linear combination of the shared dimension scores, estimating the user-specific weights by maximizing the likelihood of their observed pairwise preferences under the Bradley-Terry model. This formulation reduces per-user adaptation to optimizing a low-dimensional weight vector, simplifying optimization and enabling data-efficient personalization from sparse feedback. The learned personalized rewards guide image generation at inference time while keeping the diffusion model frozen. Experiments on real-user preference data show that our approach achieves approximately 77% held-out pairwise preference prediction accuracy and improves the alignment of generated images with individual user preferences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在冻结的 diffusion 模型上做测试时 (test-time) 个性化：用 autoencoder 把数百个视觉属性压成 50 个 attribute-anchored 偏好维度并训练打分器，再在 Bradley-Terry 模型下以最大似然估计每个用户的线性权重向量，用该个性化 reward 在推理阶段引导生成。在真实用户偏好数据上，留出配对偏好预测准确率约 77%，生成图像与个体偏好的对齐得到改善。
Motivation: 扩散模型输出与个体用户偏好对齐困难，现有方法依赖人工标注偏好或 VLM 从交互历史抽取偏好信息，标注与计算成本高、难以规模化。
Method: 先用 autoencoder 将数百个视觉属性压缩为 50 个属性锚定的偏好维度，并训练 evaluator 沿这些维度打分；把用户偏好表示为共享维度得分的线性组合，在 Bradley-Terry 模型下最大化观测配对偏好的似然来估计用户专属权重，把逐用户适配化简为低维权重向量优化；推理时用学到的个性化 reward 引导生成，diffusion 模型保持冻结。
Result: 在真实用户偏好数据上，留出 (held-out) 配对偏好预测准确率约 77%，生成图像与个体用户偏好的对齐得到提升。
Conclusion: 把个性化压缩成在共享属性维度上的低维权重估计，可在稀疏反馈下以低成本实现测试时对齐用户偏好的图像生成。

papers.title: Enabling Dynamic Computation in Looped LMs
papers.abstract_en: Looped LMs are parameter efficient and promise dynamic computation (saving memory and FLOPs on easy tokens). However, state-of-the-art open Looped LMs trained with this dynamic computation capability (Ouro models) do not realize it in practice as each loop iteration (depth) requires its own level of KV-cache, necessitating all loop computations. Moreover, Ouro's early-exit prior is enforced on each token equally, which results in static lower-depth like processing of all tokens regardless of difficulty. In this work, we propose a simple "best-available" KV caching strategy that works out-of-the-box, creating a new frontier in the performance vs depth space. Our approach enables up to 30% reduction in FLOPs and KV memory while retaining full-depth performance, showing the true flexibility of Looped LMs. Furthermore, training looped LMs with awareness about this KV caching strategy improves performance and efficiency. Finally, we apply a small but effective fix to the early-exit prior enforcement objective that makes tokens exit at truly heterogeneous depths based on effort. Our findings are validated on Ouro models as well as smaller looped LMs pre-trained from scratch.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Ouro 类循环 LM 虽以动态计算为卖点，但每个 loop 深度都要独立 KV-cache 层级，且 early-exit prior 对所有 token 等权施加，导致实际仍是全深度静态计算。提出开箱即用的 best-available KV 缓存策略，在保持全深度性能的同时最多省 30% FLOPs 与 KV 显存；再配合让 token 按难度退出到真正异构深度的 early-exit prior 修正，并在训练时感知该缓存策略可进一步提升性能与效率。
Motivation: 循环 LM 承诺在简单 token 上省显存与 FLOPs，但 Ouro 模型因每层深度需各自 KV-cache 而被迫跑满全部循环，early-exit prior 又对所有 token 一视同仁，动态计算在实践中落空。
Method: 提出 best-available KV caching 策略，直接套用到现有循环 LM；训练时让模型感知该缓存策略；并对 early-exit prior 的施加目标做小修正，使 token 按努力程度退出到异构深度。
Result: 在保持全深度性能的前提下最多减少 30% FLOPs 与 KV 显存；结论在 Ouro 模型与从头预训练的更小循环 LM 上均得到验证。
Conclusion: 循环 LM 的动态计算瓶颈在 KV-cache 与等权 early-exit prior，修好这两处即可在不损失性能的情况下兑现深度灵活性。

papers.title: Whose Memory Is It? Scope-Aware Commit Rules for Long-Term LLM Memory
papers.abstract_en: Persistent memory allows an LLM agent to carry experience across conversations, but it also turns a local reasoning mistake into a durable one. During deliberation, an agent may consider a plan, simulate a tool result, report another speaker's belief, and then reject all of them. If memory retains only the resulting sentences, those once-useful possibilities can later return as facts. The record is neither fabricated nor irrelevant; it has simply been detached from the context in which it was valid. We identify this missing context as \emph{discourse ownership}: the world, branch, or speaker that licenses a proposition. Our first finding is counterintuitive. Language models already carry a causally active signal for ownership, yet conventional memory interfaces discard it when they convert reasoning into records. We introduce CASK (Causally Anchored Scoping Keys), a commit rule that preserves this signal so that shared-world facts enter durable memory while provisional content remains available only within its original scope. Our second finding is that the most obvious way to preserve the signal---storing the discovered internal coordinates---is unreliable because equivalent representations need not keep the same coordinates. CASK instead preserves the stable relations that express ownership. Controlled long-conversation conflicts and tool-agent traces show that this design improves memory admission and prevents provisional content from contaminating later answers while complementing runtime provenance. The resulting commit boundary lets agents explore more possibilities without granting every intermediate sentence authority over future behavior.
papers.journal_ref: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop LP4FM Poster, https://openreview.net/forum?id=jXE0A1Pv0T
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CASK（Causally Anchored Scoping Keys）提交规则：LLM 内部已带有因果活跃的 ownership 信号，但常规记忆接口把推理压成记录时丢弃它；CASK 保留表达 ownership 的稳定关系而非内部坐标，使共享世界事实进入持久记忆、暂定内容只在其原始 scope 内可用。受控长对话冲突与 tool-agent 轨迹显示该设计改善记忆准入并阻止暂定内容污染后续回答。
Motivation: 持久记忆把一次局部推理错误固化为长期事实：被否决的计划、模拟的工具结果、转述他人信念若只剩结果句，日后会以事实形式返回，因为记录脱离了它原本有效的语境（discourse ownership）。
Method: 识别缺失语境为 discourse ownership（许可某命题的世界、分支或说话者）；CASK 作为 commit 规则保留模型内部因果活跃的 ownership 信号，且不存发现的内部坐标（等价表示不保证坐标一致），而是保留表达 ownership 的稳定关系，与运行时 provenance 互补。
Result: 两项发现：语言模型已携带因果活跃的 ownership 信号而常规记忆接口将其丢弃；存储内部坐标不可靠，因等价表示无需保持相同坐标。受控长对话冲突与 tool-agent 轨迹上，CASK 改善记忆准入、阻止暂定内容污染后续回答。
Conclusion: 记忆提交应按 ownership 的稳定关系划边界，而非按句子本身或内部坐标，这样 agent 可多探索中间可能性而不让每句中间产物获得对未来行为的权威。

papers.title: Sigma-Hunter: A Domain-Specific Language Model for Threat Hunting and Detection Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Detection engineers must translate threat reports, forensic observations, and hunt hypotheses into precise, testable rules. General-purpose large language models (LLMs) can draft such rules, but often produce invalid YAML, incorrect log sources, unsupported fields, or overly broad detection logic. This paper presents \emph{Sigma-Hunter}, a domain-adapted LLM for analyst-assistive Sigma rule generation and threat hunting. We build an instruction-tuning dataset from 3,635 validated open-source Sigma rules, expanded into 7,663 question-answer and analyst-reasoning examples. Each source rule is assigned to a single train, validation, or test partition before this expansion, so no rule leaks across splits. We fine-tune a 7B Mistral model and a Phi-4 model with LoRA and score held-out rule generations on syntax, approximate field consistency, and a semantic judgment of detection logic, completeness, selectivity, and log-source alignment. Sigma-Hunter-Mistral scores 8.17 overall, against 7.88 for the strongest general-purpose baseline and 4.61 for untuned Mistral. Two findings stand out: domain adaptation enables a compact 7B model to perform competitively with larger general-purpose models on this structured task, and syntactic validity is a weak proxy for semantic rule quality, as several baselines emit well-formed YAML carrying weak detection logic. The adapted models run locally, which suits detection engineering in disconnected environments where analysts cannot reach hosted model services.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Sigma-Hunter 是面向威胁狩猎与检测工程的领域适配 LLM：用 3,635 条已验证开源 Sigma 规则扩成 7,663 条指令样本，以 LoRA 微调 7B Mistral 与 Phi-4，按规则先划分再扩增以防泄漏。Sigma-Hunter-Mistral 综合得分 8.17，高于最强通用基线 7.88 与未微调 Mistral 4.61，说明紧凑 7B 模型在该结构化任务上可与更大通用模型竞争，且语法有效只是语义质量的弱代理。
Motivation: 检测工程师要把威胁报告、取证观测与狩猎假设转成精确可测的规则，通用 LLM 起草时经常产出无效 YAML、错误日志源、不支持字段或过宽的检测逻辑。
Method: 从 3,635 条已验证开源 Sigma 规则构建指令微调数据集，扩增为 7,663 条问答与分析师推理样本；每条源规则在扩增前先整体划入单一 train/validation/test 分区以避免跨集泄漏。用 LoRA 微调 7B Mistral 与 Phi-4，并在留出规则生成上按语法、近似字段一致性，以及检测逻辑、完整性、选择性与日志源对齐的语义判断打分。
Result: Sigma-Hunter-Mistral 综合得分 8.17，最强通用基线 7.88，未微调 Mistral 4.61；数据集含 3,635 条源规则与 7,663 条扩增样本。多个基线输出格式良好但检测逻辑薄弱的 YAML，显示语法有效性是语义规则质量的弱代理。
Conclusion: 领域适配能让紧凑 7B 模型在 Sigma 规则生成这类结构化任务上与更大通用模型竞争；适配后的模型可本地运行，适合分析师无法访问托管服务的隔离环境。

summary_sections.motivation: 检测工程师要把威胁报告、取证观测与狩猎假设转成精确可测的规则，通用 LLM 起草时经常产出无效 YAML、错误日志源、不支持字段或过宽的检测逻辑。
summary_sections.method: 从 3,635 条已验证开源 Sigma 规则构建指令微调数据集，扩增为 7,663 条问答与分析师推理样本；每条源规则在扩增前先整体划入单一 train/validation/test 分区以避免跨集泄漏。用 LoRA 微调 7B Mistral 与 Phi-4，并在留出规则生成上按语法、近似字段一致性，以及检测逻辑、完整性、选择性与日志源对齐的语义判断打分。

papers.title: Removing Information Content Does Not Certify Tamper Resistance in Open-Weight Models
papers.abstract_en: Does removing harmful information make open-weight models resistant to fine-tuning attacks? We show that mutual information at release alone cannot universally certify slow recovery. Function-preserving reparameterizations leave information unchanged while altering gradient-descent geometry, so an invariant certificate is bounded by the fastest reachable parameterization. We apply this principle to weight--data mutual information under training-data filtering and label--representation mutual information under capability removal. Training order can change recovery time at fixed weight--data information, while exact representation-level independence can preserve the entire parameter Jacobian. An explicit construction has both information quantities equal to zero and recovers in one gradient step. Controlled experiments illustrate order-dependent recovery and parameterization-dependent attack speed. These results identify the missing requirement for certification: constraints on attack dynamics beyond mutual information at release.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文证明在开放权重模型发布时删除有害信息（互信息归零）并不能认证抗微调攻击能力：函数保持的重参数化不改变互信息却改变梯度下降几何，使任何不变证书受限于最快可达参数化。显式构造可让权重-数据互信息与标签-表示互信息同时为零，却在一步梯度更新内恢复；训练顺序在固定权重-数据信息下改变恢复时间。作者主张认证必须约束攻击动力学，而不能只看发布时的互信息。
Motivation: 开放权重发布前删除训练数据或能力被视为防微调攻击的手段，但缺少对恢复速度的可认证保证：发布时互信息为零是否真能保证信息缓慢恢复并不清楚。
Method: 以函数保持重参数化论证不变证书受限于最快可达参数参数化；分析训练数据过滤下的权重-数据互信息与能力去除下的标签-表示互信息，给出两个信息量均为零的显式构造，并用受控实验展示恢复顺序与参数化依赖的攻击速度。
Result: 显式构造中权重-数据互信息与标签-表示互信息均等于 0，却在一次梯度步骤内恢复；训练顺序可在固定权重-数据信息下改变恢复时间，精确的表示级独立可保留整个参数 Jacobian；受控实验展示了顺序依赖的恢复与参数化依赖的攻击速度。
Conclusion: 发布时的互信息不足以认证抗微调攻击，认证的缺失要件是对攻击动力学（参数化与训练顺序）的约束。

papers.title: Algorithmic Scratchpads and Curriculum Staging for Arithmetic Reasoning in Tiny Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive Large Language Models (LLMs) frequently struggle with deterministic multi-step algorithmic tasks such as multi-digit multiplication and long division. In this paper, we investigate the mechanics of multi-step arithmetic in compact "Tiny" Transformers (~10.6M non-embedding parameters, 49.3M total) trained on synthetic data across four basic operations (+, -, *, /) unrolled as step-by-step scratchpads. First, we establish the necessary training foundations: (1) dataloader sequence padding creates an 83% gradient starvation artifact that collapses accuracy from 40% to 1%, remediated via continuous sequence packing; (2) linguistic pretraining is an essential prerequisite (<= 2.0% without it); and (3) modern architectural primitives (RoPE, RMSNorm, SwiGLU) and Sparse Mixture of Experts (MoE) substantially improve additive reasoning over baseline GPT-2. Second, we demonstrate that algorithmic scratchpad formulation directly dictates success. Introducing a deterministic Digit-by-Digit Long Division scratchpad within a 4-stage Hierarchical Developmental Curriculum dramatically elevates single-digit division from 4.0% to 86.7% accuracy on a 4,000-problem held-out benchmark. In contrast, multi-digit multiplication remained challenging: detailed error analysis revealed that while the model correctly computed single-digit sub-products and place-value zeros, our FOIL scratchpad failed because it forced a simultaneous summation of up to nine multi-digit terms in a single step without pairwise intermediate accumulation. Finally, we identify two key boundaries: performance collapses to 0.00% on unseen 4-digit operands, and unbuffered training induces catastrophic forgetting, collapsing division accuracy from 86.7% down to 0.00%.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 5 figures. Code and benchmark datasets available at https://github.com/SoKasl/AIMathLab
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用约 10.6M 非嵌入参数的 Tiny Transformer 在合成四则运算数据上按 scratchpad 逐步展开训练，发现 scratchpad 的形式直接决定成败：确定性逐位长除法 scratchpad 配合 4 阶段分层发育课程，把个位数除法准确率从 4.0% 提到 86.7%（4000 题留出集），而 FOIL 乘法 scratchpad 因要求单步同时累加最多九个多位数项而失败。同时给出三条硬边界：未见的 4 位数操作数上准确率塌到 0.00%，无缓冲训练导致灾难性遗忘使除法从 86.7% 跌回 0.00%。
Motivation: 自回归 LLM 在多位数乘法、长除法这类确定性多步算法任务上普遍失败，而小模型上失败机制（数据管线、课程、scratchpad 设计）缺少可复现的诊断。
Method: 在合成数据上训练约 10.6M 非嵌入参数（49.3M 总参数）的 Tiny Transformer，覆盖加减乘除四运算并按 scratchpad 逐步展开；对比 GPT-2 基线与 RoPE、RMSNorm、SwiGLU 及 Sparse MoE 架构；用连续序列打包 (continuous sequence packing) 替代 dataloader 序列 padding，并引入 4 阶段 Hierarchical Developmental Curriculum 与确定性 Digit-by-Digit Long Division scratchpad。
Result: dataloader padding 造成 83% 的梯度饥饿 (gradient starvation)，准确率从 40% 崩到 1%，连续序列打包可修复；无语言学预训练时准确率 ≤2.0%；RoPE/RMSNorm/SwiGLU 与 Sparse MoE 显著优于 GPT-2 基线的加法推理；逐位长除法 scratchpad + 4 阶段课程把个位数除法从 4.0% 提到 86.7%（4,000 题留出集）；FOIL scratchpad 乘法失败，错误分析显示模型能正确算出个位子积与占位零，但单步需同时累加最多九个多位数项；未见 4 位数操作数上性能塌到 0.00%；无缓冲训练使除法从 86.7% 塌到 0.00%。
Conclusion: scratchpad 的中间步骤结构（是否逐步两两累加）比模型容量更决定多步算术能否学会，且这类算法能力对操作数位数泛化和训练缓冲策略极其脆弱。

papers.title: Learning to Report Unsafe Tasks in a Multi-Agent Game
papers.abstract_en: When agents share a reward for completed tasks, reporting unsafe work can reduce the reporter's reward by stopping a task. Audits can make reporting optimal without ensuring that further training teaches a silent team to report. We study this learning problem in a game where any witness can stop a task by reporting. With $k$ witnesses per task sharing a policy and drawing independently, the expected-reward derivative with respect to their shared silence probability counts each task's benefit $k$ times at universal silence. The comparison with universal reporting counts it once. For arbitrary policy groups, we give an audit condition sufficient for exact policy-gradient updates to reach universal reporting and, apart from boundary cases, necessary near universal silence. In a balanced family, the cheapest audits meeting the condition with prescribed positive margins cost exactly $k$ times as much for full sharing as for one policy per role. We train PPO policies on 24 witness graphs from learned silence. Separating co-witnesses reduces unsafe completion by 33.59 percentage points compared with shuffled groups of the same sizes under the same audits (95% graph-bootstrap interval: 21.03-45.13). Only 9 of 48 witness-group runs achieve below 1% unsafe completion while retaining at least 90% legitimate completion. At the same audit budget, a fully shared network meets both thresholds in none of 48 runs with independent action draws and all 48 with a common draw.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在共享奖励的多智能体任务博弈中，见证者 (witness) 报告不安全任务会因终止任务而损害自身奖励，审计 (audit) 可使报告成为最优但不保证训练学会报告。理论上给出使精确策略梯度收敛到普遍报告的审计条件，并证明完全共享策略的审计成本恰为按角色分策略的 k 倍；PPO 在 24 个见证图上训练显示，分离共同见证者使不安全完成率相对同规模乱序分组下降 33.59 个百分点。
Motivation: 共享奖励下报告不安全工作会降低报告者自身收益，沉默成为均衡；审计能让报告变优，却未必让一个沉默团队在后续训练中学会报告，需要判定审计何时足以驱动策略梯度到达普遍报告。
Method: 在任意策略分组的博弈中推导期望奖励对共享沉默概率的导数（普遍沉默处每任务收益被计 k 次），给出使精确策略梯度更新到达普遍报告的充分审计条件、并在普遍沉默附近（除边界情形外）必要；再用 PPO 从沉默状态训练 24 个见证图。
Result: 分离共同见证者使不安全完成率比同规模乱序分组在相同审计下低 33.59 个百分点（95% graph-bootstrap 区间 21.03–45.13）；48 次见证组运行中仅 9 次同时达到不安全完成率低于 1% 且正当完成率不低于 90%；同一审计预算下，完全共享网络在独立动作抽样时 48 次全不达标、在共同抽样时 48 次全部达标；平衡族中满足给定正裕度的最便宜审计对完全共享的成本恰为每角色一策略的 k 倍。
Conclusion: 审计条件能把策略梯度推向普遍报告，但共享策略的审计成本随见证者数 k 线性放大，且共享网络能否同时守住安全与正当完成阈值取决于动作抽样方式。

papers.title: How Fragile Is On-Device Language Model Safety? Localizing Safety-Critical Parameters for Sparse Fault Analysis
papers.abstract_en: As small language models (SLMs) are increasingly deployed on resource-constrained and on-device platforms, including as components of agentic systems, the integrity of locally stored model parameters becomes an important safety concern. We investigate whether safety-sensitive behavior in LLaMA-2-7B-Chat is concentrated within a sparse subset of parameters, creating a reduced fault surface for targeted analysis. We study two complementary localization methods: low-rank safety-associated subspace analysis and parameter-level safety--utility importance filtering. Both approaches reveal highly non-uniform safety sensitivity across the network, with the MLP down_proj consistently emerging as a prominent safety-sensitive component and o_proj providing a smaller contribution. Using parameter-level localization, modifying only 0.19% of model weights in down_proj yields 53% Basic ASR and 56% GCG ASR, while tinyBenchmarks accuracy remains at 51.6% compared with a 52.2% unmodified baseline. These results motivate targeted fault analysis and selective integrity protection for language models deployed in resource-constrained, on-device, and agentic settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 LLaMA-2-7B-Chat 上定位安全敏感参数，发现安全敏感性在网络中高度非均匀，MLP down_proj 是主要敏感模块、o_proj 贡献较小。仅改动 down_proj 中 0.19% 的权重即可得到 53% Basic ASR 与 56% GCG ASR，而 tinyBenchmarks 精度仅从 52.2% 降到 51.6%，说明安全故障面可被压缩到极小的稀疏参数子集。
Motivation: SLM 部署到本地与端侧平台后，本地存储的模型参数完整性成为安全问题，但安全敏感行为是否集中于稀疏参数子集、能否据此缩小故障分析面尚不清楚。
Method: 在 LLaMA-2-7B-Chat 上比较两种互补定位方法：低秩安全关联子空间分析 (low-rank safety-associated subspace analysis)，以及参数级安全-效用重要性过滤 (parameter-level safety–utility importance filtering)，据此定位安全敏感权重。
Result: 两种方法都显示安全敏感性高度非均匀，down_proj 为主要敏感模块、o_proj 贡献较小；仅修改 down_proj 中 0.19% 权重得到 53% Basic ASR 与 56% GCG ASR，tinyBenchmarks 精度 51.6%，对比未修改基线 52.2%。
Conclusion: 安全敏感性集中在稀疏参数子集，因此可对端侧与 agentic 部署的语言模型做定向故障分析与选择性完整性保护。

summary_sections.method: 在 LLaMA-2-7B-Chat 上比较两种互补定位方法：低秩安全关联子空间分析 (low-rank safety-associated subspace analysis)，以及参数级安全-效用重要性过滤 (parameter-level safety–utility importance filtering)，据此定位安全敏感权重。
summary_sections.result: 两种方法都显示安全敏感性高度非均匀，down_proj 为主要敏感模块、o_proj 贡献较小；仅修改 down_proj 中 0.19% 权重得到 53% Basic ASR 与 56% GCG ASR，tinyBenchmarks 精度 51.6%，对比未修改基线 52.2%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 安全敏感性集中在稀疏参数子集，因此可对端侧与 agentic 部署的语言模型做定向故障分析与选择性完整性保护。

papers.title: PhysEvo: Astra Can Act, Let It
papers.abstract_en: Astra can act, yet reliable manipulation depends on the system through which it observes and controls the world. We introduce PhysEvo, a framework for physical recursive self-improvement (RSI) around a single frozen model. A task agent executes robot tasks; a meta-agent uses the resulting trajectories to diagnose failures, revise tools and skills, and test corrections. The meta-agent can also improve its own diagnostic tools, so retained revisions support both later action and later self-improvement. This process develops joint-level control, evidence-seeking observation, and reusable manipulation skills without model-weight updates or a separately trained action policy. Across 42 RoboDojo tasks, held-out-layout evaluation of retained task-specific deployment versions yields a five-dimension average score of 68.14/100 and 62.00% success, compared with 47.17% for RoboDawn's one-shot Astra agent, the strongest published reference in our comparison. On eight manipulation tasks challenging direct Astra, PhysEvo achieves 55.00% success, compared with 1.25% for the direct-Astra reference. Deploying the simulation-evolved harness on AgileX PiPER and continuing skill revision yields 90.60/100 average score and 84.00% success across 25 trials on five real-world tasks. PhysEvo turns the consequences of action into persistent, testable changes to how a frozen model acts and improves.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhysEvo 围绕单个冻结模型做物理递归自我改进 (RSI)：任务 agent 执行机器人任务，meta-agent 用轨迹诊断失败、改写工具与技能并测试修正，且能改进自己的诊断工具。在 RoboDojo 42 个任务上留出布局评测得 68.14/100、成功率 62.00%，对比 RoboDawn 一次性 Astra agent 的 47.17%；八个直连 Astra 难任务上 55.00% 对 1.25%；仿真演化的 harness 部署到 AgileX PiPER 后，五个真实任务 25 次试验得 90.60/100、成功率 84.00%。
Motivation: 冻结模型的机器人操作可靠性取决于其观察与控制的外围系统，而权重更新或单独训练动作策略成本高；失败发生后工具与技能的修正往往不留存、无法被后续行动与后续自我改进复用。
Method: 任务 agent 执行机器人任务产生轨迹，meta-agent 据此诊断失败、修订工具与技能并测试修正；meta-agent 同样可改进自身的诊断工具，使留存的修订同时支撑后续行动与后续自我改进。全程不更新模型权重、不单独训练动作策略，发展出关节级控制、寻证式观察 (evidence-seeking observation) 与可复用操作技能。
Result: RoboDojo 42 个任务的留出布局评测中，留存的任务特定部署版本五维平均分 68.14/100、成功率 62.00%，对比 RoboDawn 一次性 Astra agent 的 47.17%；八个对直连 Astra 有挑战的操作任务上成功率 55.00%，对比直连 Astra 参照的 1.25%；把仿真演化的 harness 部署到 AgileX PiPER 并继续修订技能后，五个真实任务 25 次试验平均分 90.60/100、成功率 84.00%。
Conclusion: 把行动后果转成对冻结模型行动与自我改进方式的持久、可测试修改，可以在不更新权重的前提下同时提升仿真与真实机器人的操作成功率。

papers.title: Verify Less, Evolve More: Training Idea-Level Critics for Verification-Efficient ML Evolving Agents
papers.abstract_en: As large language models become more powerful, self-evolving agents are able to tackle challenging tasks including AI for machine learning (AI4ML). In AI4ML, while empirical verification is available, it often requires computationally costly model training and evaluation, limiting the speed and scale of agent evolution. Yet verification efficiency remains under-explored, and frontier models provide only limited gains when used directly as idea selectors. We address this gap with specialized idea-level critic models that predict whether a proposed ML modification will improve upon the current solution, allowing agents to screen ideas and concentrate verification resources on the most promising candidates. We train the critic models through supervised fine-tuning on high-quality critiques synthesized by Gemini-3.1-Pro, followed by GRPO to further improve their predictive accuracy. Empirically, our critic models outperform Gemini-3.1-Pro in static idea evaluation, and these gains extend to agent inference, continual learning, and policy training. During inference-time evolution, they improve final solution quality under the same verification budget by selecting more promising ideas, with further gains from continual learning. During policy training, they serve as learned reward models, reserving empirical verification for uncertain cases and enabling substantially more policy updates with the same verification resources. Together, these results show that idea-level critic models help ML agents discover better solutions and learn stronger proposal policies under limited verification budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 AI4ML 自演化智能体中训练 idea-level critic 模型，先用 Gemini-3.1-Pro 合成高质量批评做 SFT，再用 GRPO 提升预测准确率，用于在昂贵的经验验证前筛掉低价值 ML 修改想法。critic 在静态想法评估上超过 Gemini-3.1-Pro，并把增益带到 agent 推理、持续学习与策略训练：同等验证预算下选出更有希望的想法、得到更优最终解，作为 reward model 时把经验验证留给不确定样本，从而在相同验证资源下完成多得多的策略更新。
Motivation: AI4ML 中每次想法验证都要跑完整模型训练与评估，计算昂贵，拖慢并限制智能体演化规模；而直接把 frontier 模型当 idea selector 收益有限，验证效率这一环节基本未被研究。
Method: 训练专门的 idea-level critic 模型来预测某个 ML 修改能否改进当前解：先在由 Gemini-3.1-Pro 合成的高质量批评语料上做监督微调 (SFT)，再用 GRPO 进一步提高预测准确率；推理时用 critic 筛选候选想法，把验证资源集中到最有希望的候选上，策略训练阶段则把 critic 当作 learned reward model。
Result: critor 模型在静态 idea 评估上超过 Gemini-3.1-Pro，且增益延伸到 agent 推理、continual learning 与 policy training；推理期演化在相同验证预算下提升最终解质量，持续学习带来进一步增益；策略训练中作为 reward model，把经验验证留给不确定情形，使同等验证资源下能进行 substantially 更多的策略更新。
Conclusion: 在验证预算受限时，用 idea-level critic 代替直接调用大模型做想法选择，可以让 ML agent 找到更好的解并学出更强的提议策略，把昂贵的经验验证集中到不确定候选上。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: REFIT: Recognize, Fix, and Test Wearable Sensor Placement Shifts without Labels
papers.abstract_en: We present REFIT, an input calibration for frozen activity-recognition models whose inertial sensors are worn differently at deployment than in training. When users move a watch to the other wrist or put a strap sensor back on turned, the model sees the same motion on changed axes. REFIT undoes such shifts without labels or retraining. It describes them by families of axis transforms, such as reflections and rotations, and fits each family to the user's data so that simple statistics match those of the training data. The family that removes most of the mismatch names the shift. REFIT fixes the shift by applying the best member of that family before the frozen model and re-estimating its normalization statistics. It tests the fixed model with a label-free accuracy estimate and asks the user to re-wear the sensor when it is low. Experiments on real left/right sensor pairs and on real and simulated re-attachment show that REFIT outperforms label-free test-time adaptation methods on every dataset and restores most of the accuracy lost to re-attachment. It names injected shifts far more reliably than a confidence-based selector. After a correction over all signed permutations of the axes, the estimate separates successful from failed corrections.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: REFIT 是面向可穿戴惯性传感器活动识别模型的无标签输入标定方法：把换手佩戴、表带装反这类部署偏移描述为轴反射与旋转的变换族，拟合使简单统计量与训练数据一致，取消除失配最多的族成员在冻结模型前校正并重估归一化统计量，再用无标签精度估计决定是否要求用户重新佩戴。在真实左右手传感器对与真实/模拟重贴实验中，它在每个数据集上都优于无标签测试时自适应方法，恢复了重贴造成的大部分精度损失，且命名注入偏移远比基于置信度的选择器可靠。
Motivation: 活动识别模型在训练与部署时的传感器佩戴方式不一致（换手、表带装反），同一动作落到不同轴上，冻结模型精度下降；现有无标签测试时自适应方法难以识别具体偏移类型。
Method: REFIT 把偏移建模为轴变换族（反射、旋转等），对每个族拟合用户数据使简单统计量匹配训练数据，选失配消除最多的族并取其最优成员在冻结模型前施加，同时重估归一化统计量；随后用无标签精度估计检验修正效果，估计偏低时提示用户重新佩戴。
Result: 在真实左右手传感器对以及真实与模拟重贴数据上，REFIT 在每个数据集上都优于无标签测试时自适应 (test-time adaptation) 方法，恢复了重贴造成的大部分精度损失；命名注入偏移的可靠性远高于基于置信度的选择器；对所有带符号轴置换做修正后，无标签精度估计能把成功修正与失败修正区分开。
Conclusion: 把佩戴偏移显式参数化为轴变换族并配合无标签检验，可以在不重训、不用标签的前提下修复冻结活动识别模型的部署偏移，并判断修正是否成功。

papers.title: LASER: Latent Space Adjoint Matching for Support-Constrained Entropy-Regularized Offline RL
papers.abstract_en: While offline reinforcement learning (RL) enables policy optimization from static datasets without costly online interaction, it remains bottlenecked by the risk of executing out-of-distribution (OOD) actions. Recent approaches mitigate this by learning a behavior-cloning policy through flow matching and then performing RL within its constrained latent space. However, naively optimizing the latent policy can easily cause the policy to collapse into a brittle mode or exploit sharp artifacts of the learned critic. In this work, we find that entropy regularization is essential in latent-space RL for addressing these challenges. We introduce LASER, a novel offline RL algorithm that applies latent-space adjoint matching to achieve entropy-regularized latent-space RL with expressive flow policies while avoiding backpropagation through time. Through comprehensive experiments on 40 challenging OGBench tasks with varying dataset qualities, we show that LASER achieves state-of-the-art performance. Notably, LASER uses fixed method-specific hyperparameters across all tasks and outperforms the evaluated baselines, including those with task- and dataset-specific tuning, which highlights the robust applicability of LASER. Project website: https://mit-realm.github.io/laser/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LASER 在流匹配 (flow matching) 学到的潜空间策略上做熵正则强化学习，用潜空间伴随匹配 (latent-space adjoint matching) 计算梯度以避免反向传播穿过时间 (BPTT)，从而防止策略塌缩到脆弱模式或利用 critic 的尖锐伪影。在 40 个不同数据质量的 OGBench 任务上达到 state-of-the-art，且全部任务共用一组固定超参数，胜过含任务/数据集专门调参的被评基线。
Motivation: 离线 RL 受限于执行分布外 (OOD) 动作的风险；在流匹配行为克隆策略的潜空间内做 RL 虽能约束动作，但直接优化潜空间策略容易塌缩到脆弱模式或钻 learned critic 的尖锐伪影。
Method: 先用 flow matching 学行为克隆策略并把策略优化限制在其潜空间；再以潜空间伴随匹配实现熵正则的潜空间 RL 梯度，绕开 BPTT，同时保留表达力强的流策略。
Result: 在 40 个 OGBench 挑战性任务（覆盖不同数据质量）上取得 state-of-the-art；全部任务使用同一组固定的方法专属超参数，仍胜过被评基线，包括做了任务级与数据集级调参的基线。
Conclusion: 熵正则对潜空间 RL 是关键，使 LASER 在无需逐任务调参的情况下稳健适用；作者以固定超参数胜过专门调参基线来支撑这一主张。

papers.title: A method for multimodal analysis of TAIGA experiment data using essential features
papers.abstract_en: The aim of processing and analyzing experimental data from physical experiments is to obtain physically significant information about the phenomenon under study. This goal is achieved by multi-stage processing of experimental data, during which noise associated with measurements is suppressed and the dimensionality of the input data is reduced. In this paper, we propose a new method based on the use of neural networks such as autoencoders to extract essential features. The special value of the proposed approach lies in the possibility of its application to the analysis of multimodal data received simultaneously from several installations. We will apply this approach to a multimodal data (MMD) of the experiment TAIGA. Currently, the analysis of the MMD is carried out independently for each installation separately. Therefore, the development of methods for the joint analysis of MMD from TAIGA-type installations is an urgent task in cosmic ray physics and gamma-ray astronomy. Based on Monte Carlo simulation, it is shown that the proposed method allows for effective MMD analysis. It can also be used for MMD analysis at other experimental complexes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用自编码器从 TAIGA 多模态实验数据 (MMD) 中提取 essential features 的联合分析方法，替代目前各探测装置各自独立分析的做法。基于 Monte Carlo 仿真表明该方法能有效分析 MMD，并可推广到其他实验综合体。
Motivation: TAIGA 类装置的多模态数据目前按装置逐个独立分析，无法联合利用；而物理实验数据需要先抑制测量噪声、再降维才能提取物理上有意义的信息，联合分析方法在宇宙线物理与伽马射线天文学中是紧迫任务。
Method: 基于神经网络（自编码器 autoencoder）提取 essential features，实现多阶段降噪与降维；关键在于同一方法可同时处理来自多个装置的多模态数据，验证基于 Monte Carlo 仿真。
Result: Monte Carlo 仿真显示该方法可对 TAIGA 多模态数据进行有效分析，并适用于其他实验综合体的 MMD 分析。
Conclusion: 自编码器提取 essential features 的框架可把 TAIGA 各装置的独立 MMD 分析统一为联合分析，且可迁移到其他实验综合体。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Zero-Shot Brain MRI Inpainting with 2.5D Unconditional Flow Priors
papers.abstract_en: Generative inpainting of brain MRI volumes is essential for synthesizing healthy tissue in pathological regions, improving the accuracy and reliability of automated downstream brain analysis applications such as image registration, brain extraction, and segmentation. However, standard 3D approaches are computationally prohibitive, while efficient 2D slice-wise methods suffer from severe inter-slice discontinuities. Furthermore, traditional models rely on conditional training, requiring task-specific learning of masked inputs. We propose a zero-shot brain MRI inpainting framework utilizing 2.5D unconditional flow priors to capture spatial context along the superior-inferior axis without the overhead of full 3D convolutions. During training, our flow matching model learns the joint distribution of adjacent axial slice triplets, modeling the manifold of healthy brain anatomy while explicitly excluding pathological regions from the loss function. At inference, the model processes the input triplets autoregressively along the depth axis. We employ the Restora-Flow solver to constrain the unconditional prior using the input mask, achieving accurate zero-shot inpainting. Evaluations show our 2.5D strategy resolves the structural discontinuities of 2D baselines, synthesizing plausible healthy tissue while maintaining volumetric consistency across the axial, sagittal, and coronal planes. As a final step, we generate and average an ensemble of multiple stochastic reconstructions to form the final prediction. Quantitative results benchmarked on the official BraTS 2026 Inpainting Challenge validation set demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed approach, yielding an SSIM of 0.816 $\pm$ 0.112, MSE of 0.007 $\pm$ 0.005, and PSNR of 22.923 $\pm$ 4.343. Code is available at https://github.com/imigraz/brats2026-inpainting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出零样本脑 MRI 修补框架：用 2.5D 无条件 flow matching 先验学习相邻轴位三层切片的联合分布，训练时把病理区域从损失中剔除，推理时沿深度轴自回归处理三元组，并用 Restora-Flow 求解器把无条件先验约束到输入掩码上。在 BraTS 2026 Inpainting Challenge 官方验证集上 SSIM 0.816±0.112、MSE 0.007±0.005、PSNR 22.923±4.343，缓解了 2D 逐层方法的层间结构断裂。
Motivation: 3D 修补计算代价过高，2D 逐层方法又产生严重层间不连续；传统模型依赖条件训练，需要针对任务学习带掩码输入。
Method: 训练 flow matching 模型学习相邻轴位切片三元组的联合分布，建模健康脑解剖流形并在损失中显式排除病理区域；推理时沿深度轴自回归处理输入三元组，用 Restora-Flow 求解器以输入掩码约束无条件先验，最后生成并平均多次随机重建的 ensemble 作为最终预测。
Result: 在 BraTS 2026 Inpainting Challenge 官方验证集上：SSIM 0.816±0.112，MSE 0.007±0.005，PSNR 22.923±4.343；2.5D 策略解决了 2D 基线的结构断裂，合成合理健康组织并在轴位、矢状位、冠状位三个平面上保持体积一致性。
Conclusion: 2.5D 无条件 flow 先验加掩码约束求解器可以在零样本设定下做脑 MRI 修补，兼顾 2D 的效率与 3D 的层间一致性。

papers.title: S2Tok: Streaming 3D Gaussian Reconstruction with Persistent Spatial Tokens
papers.abstract_en: Streaming 3D reconstruction requires more than a sequence of geometric predictions: it requires a persistent scene state that can incorporate new evidence and remain renderable as observations arrive. Latent spatial tokens offer a promising representation for this purpose, but constructing them from an image collection leaves open how to maintain them online, where each observation may both revisit known regions and reveal new content. We introduce S2Tok, a feed-forward framework that maintains a size-adaptive, persistent scene state from uncalibrated image streams. Its central idea is to distinguish updates to the existing representation from selective expansion. A spatially informed transformer integrates each incoming observation with the persistent scene tokens, while a learned admission module selectively expands the representation to limit redundant storage. A hierarchical decoder and Gaussian head convert the evolving state into non-pixel-aligned 3D Gaussians, enabling novel-view rendering without caching previous frames. Experiments across four benchmarks demonstrate competitive streaming rendering quality with compact Gaussian representations. These results support latent spatial tokens as a persistent computational state for online 3D reconstruction, combining learned scene updates with explicit Gaussian rendering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: S2Tok 把流式 3D 重建做成一个持久场景状态问题：用空间信息 transformer 把每帧未标定图像与持久 spatial token 融合，再由学习到的准入模块选择性扩张表示，最后经分层解码器与 Gaussian head 输出非像素对齐的 3D Gaussians，实现无需缓存历史帧的新视角渲染。在四个 benchmark 上取得有竞争力的流式渲染质量且 Gaussian 表示紧凑。
Motivation: 从图像集合离线构建 latent spatial token 已有方案，但在线场景中每帧既重访已知区域又揭示新内容，如何持续维护 token 状态并保持可渲染性是缺口。
Method: 前馈框架维护尺寸自适应的持久场景状态：空间信息 transformer 将新观测与持久 scene token 融合，学习的 admission module 决定是否扩张表示以限制冗余存储，分层解码器加 Gaussian head 把状态转成 3D Gaussians，渲染时不缓存前帧。
Result: 在四个 benchmark 上展示出有竞争力的流式渲染质量，并保持紧凑的 Gaussian 表示；输入为未标定图像流 (uncalibrated image streams)。
Conclusion: latent spatial tokens 可以充当在线 3D 重建的持久计算状态，把学习的场景更新与显式 Gaussian 渲染结合起来。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SNR-Gated LSTM-Conditioned Diffusion Model for MIMO Channel Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate and low latency channel estimation is critical for modern MIMO systems, particularly under mobility, where channels exhibit structured sparsity and strong temporal correlation. This paper proposes a time-series conditioned diffusion framework for channel estimation that performs denoising in the angular domain. Starting from least squares (LS) observations, we train a diffusion denoiser whose conditioning information is encoded by a long short-term memory (LSTM) network over a short observation sequence, enabling the model to exploit temporal dynamics beyond per-snapshot estimation. To robustly balance observation fidelity and learned generative priors across a wide signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) range, we introduce a learnable SNR-gated late-fusion shortcut that injects the network input into the final decoding stage through a sigmoid gate with trainable center and scale. To reduce inference latency, we adopt deterministic denoising diffusion implicit model (DDIM) style reverse updates with SNR-adaptive truncation and step allocation, which significantly reduces the number of reverse diffusion steps at high SNR while maintaining strong performance in low SNR regimes. Simulations on time-evolving standardized channel models demonstrate that the proposed method achieves consistent performance gains over existing diffusion-based channel estimation baselines, while retaining low latency through SNR-adaptive inference.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 5 figures. Accepted by and presented at the 2026 IEEE 104th Vehicular Technology Conference (VTC2026-Fall)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向移动 MIMO 信道估计提出时间序列条件扩散框架：在角度域去噪，用 LSTM 编码短观测序列作条件，并以可学习的 SNR 门控晚期融合捷径（sigmoid 门，含可训练中心与尺度）平衡观测保真与生成先验。仿真在时变标准化信道模型上相对已有扩散类信道估计基线取得一致增益，同时靠 SNR 自适应 DDIM 截断与步数分配在高 SNR 下大幅减少反向步数、保持低时延。
Motivation: 移动场景下 MIMO 信道具有结构化稀疏与强时间相关性，需要准确且低时延的信道估计；逐快照 (per-snapshot) 估计无法利用时间动态，且扩散类方法在宽 SNR 范围内难以兼顾观测保真与先验、推理步数多导致时延高。
Method: 从最小二乘 (LS) 观测出发，在角度域训练扩散去噪器；条件由 LSTM 在短观测序列上编码，以利用时间动态。引入可学习 SNR 门控晚期融合捷径，把网络输入经 sigmoid 门（可训练中心与尺度）注入最终解码阶段；推理采用确定性 DDIM 式反向更新，配合 SNR 自适应截断与步数分配。
Result: 在时变标准化信道模型 (time-evolving standardized channel models) 上的仿真中，相对已有扩散类信道估计基线取得一致的性能增益；高 SNR 下反向扩散步数显著减少，低 SNR 区间仍保持强性能，并通过 SNR 自适应推理维持低时延。
Conclusion: 把时间序列条件、SNR 门控融合与 SNR 自适应扩散推理结合起来，可以在宽 SNR 范围内同时改善 MIMO 信道估计精度与推理时延。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: The Best Optimizer Depends on Batch Size
papers.abstract_en: A plethora of new adaptive optimizers are designed to efficiently estimate and use minibatch gradient statistics to shape parameter updates, but they are typically benchmarked at a single batch size. Hyperparameter scaling rules promise to preserve performance as batch size and gradient noise change, suggesting that the best optimizer at one batch size should remain the best at another. We challenge this approach to developing and evaluating optimizers by showing: (1) no principled scaling rule for Muon works consistently across training settings, and (2) the best optimizer for language model pretraining changes with batch size even after extensive hyperparameter tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文挑战「超参缩放规则能保住优化器排序」这一前提：对 Muon 找不到在各种训练设置下都成立的 principled 缩放规则，且在充分调参之后，语言模型预训练的最优优化器仍随 batch size 改变。结论是优化器评测必须在多个 batch size 上做，不能只报单一批大小的排名。
Motivation: 新自适应优化器通常只在单一 batch size 上评测，而缩放规则声称能随 batch size 与梯度噪声变化保持性能，这使「一个 batch size 上最优的优化器在别处也最优」被默认成立，排序可能因此被系统性误判。
Method: 针对 Muon 检验其超参缩放规则在不同训练设置下的一致性，并在语言模型预训练上对多个优化器做广泛的超参调优，比较不同 batch size 下的最优优化器归属。
Result: 两项发现：一是没有 principled 的 Muon 缩放规则能在所有训练设置下一致成立；二是在 extensive hyperparameter tuning 之后，语言模型预训练的最优优化器仍随 batch size 变化。
Conclusion: 以单一批大小加缩放规则来开发和评测优化器的做法不成立：优化器排名本身依赖 batch size，评测应在多个 batch size 上进行。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: HULK: Learning Whole-Body Forceful Loco-Manipulation for Humanoids
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid loco-manipulation of large, heavy objects demands forceful interaction across the entire body. However, such payloads shift a humanoid's center of mass and impose sustained loads across the upper body, challenging balance and command tracking. We present HULK, a whole-body control framework for forceful loco-manipulation. Using model predictive control (MPC) to guide reinforcement learning with predictions of the loaded dynamics, we train two teachers: one tracks arm motions under wrist forces, and the other locomotes while holding large objects against the body. A capture-point control barrier function augments the wrist-force teacher during training to improve balance under load. We distill both teachers into a single policy. Evaluation spans simulation and the Unitree G1. In simulation, the teacher with the barrier function achieves the lowest forward and lateral velocity tracking errors at 10 kg per arm among evaluated controllers and reduces aggregate divergent component of motion (DCM) excursion magnitude by 35.7% relative to MPC-guided reinforcement learning alone. Our wrist-force teacher withstands torso push disturbances of up to 130 N.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 7 figures, IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HULK 用 MPC 引导强化学习训练两个教师策略（腕力下跟踪手臂动作、抱大物体行走），再蒸馏成单一全身控制策略，使类人机器人在负载下保持平衡与指令跟踪。仿真中带 capture-point 控制障碍函数 (CBF) 的教师在每臂 10 kg 时前后与侧向速度跟踪误差最低，DCM 偏移总量比仅 MPC 引导 RL 降低 35.7%，腕力教师可承受高达 130 N 的躯干推扰。
Motivation: 搬运大重物会移动类人机器人质心并在上半身施加持续载荷，破坏平衡与指令跟踪，需要全身用力的 loco-manipulation 控制。

papers.title: Work While They Sleep: Exploiting Evaluation Latency for Fully Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Black-box optimization problems are ubiquitous across science and engineering, often dealing with expensive objective functions. This objective latency has two consequences during optimization: (i) the objective evaluation dominates execution time, and (ii) sample-efficient algorithms are crucial to accelerate development and avoid wasting resources. Bayesian optimization (BO) methods are the \textit{de facto} choice of planners for suggesting the next point to try. Standard BO fits the surrogate model's hyperparameters with a point estimate. Alternatively, a fully Bayesian approach uses model averaging to account for uncertainty over the hyperparameters, leading to better uncertainty estimates---useful in the low-data regime that is pervasive in BO. However, it is often prohibitively expensive and thus rarely used. In this work, we propose ELF-BO, an algorithm that uses the objective evaluation latency to headstart the computation of the next suggestion, allowing for fully Bayesian optimization without incurring substantial decision-time costs. This is done by sampling from the hyperparameter posterior \emph{while} the objective is being evaluated, only requiring reweighting of the samples once the objective value is observed. Across synthetic functions and real-world applications, we show that ELF-BO matches the performance of fully Bayesian methods while only incurring decision latency on par with or better than standard BO. Thus, ELF-BO makes fully Bayesian optimization practical in real-world use cases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ELF-BO 利用目标函数评估本身的耗时，在评估进行的同时从超参数后验采样，观测值返回后仅需对样本重加权，从而在不增加决策延迟的前提下跑通 fully Bayesian 优化。在合成函数与真实应用上，它达到 fully Bayesian 方法的性能，而决策延迟与标准 BO 持平或更好。
Motivation: 目标函数评估昂贵时，标准 BO 用点估计拟合超参数，不确定性刻画不足；fully Bayesian 的模型平均虽在低数据 regime 更准，但计算开销大到几乎不可用。
Method: ELF-BO 在目标评估的空闲时间里并行采样超参数后验，等目标值观测到后对已有样本做一次重加权，把 fully Bayesian 的计算藏进 objective latency，避免额外决策开销。
Result: 在合成函数与真实应用场景中，ELF-BO 的性能与 fully Bayesian 方法相当，同时决策延迟与标准 BO 持平或更低。
Conclusion: 把超参数后验采样挪到目标评估期间，可让 fully Bayesian 优化在真实场景中实用化，不必在样本效率与决策时间之间取舍。

papers.title: Socio-Foundation: A Model for Generalizable Individual Behavior Simulation via Hierarchical Capability Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Simulating individual behavior requires large language models (LLMs) to preserve persona traits while adapting to dynamic social contexts. However, general-purpose LLMs often flatten distinct personas, while task-specific tuning suffers from fragmentation and generalization. To overcome these challenges, we organize individual simulation into the \textbf{FONTS Taxonomy}, comprising five complementary capability dimensions: \emph{persona fidelity} (\textbf{F}), \emph{outcome realization} (\textbf{O}), \emph{behavioral naturalness} (\textbf{N}), \emph{trajectory coherence} (\textbf{T}), and \emph{social grounding} (\textbf{S}). Grounded in this taxonomy, we curate a standardized training corpus library of approximately 10 million instances across 14 representative datasets and present \textbf{Socio-Foundation}. Socio-Foundation decouples specialization from integration via a three-stage pipeline: learning task experts via DAPO, consolidating them into capability experts via off-policy distillation, and unifying them via multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). We also establish \textbf{IndiEval}, consolidating 29 metrics across the FONTS dimensions. Experiments show that Socio-Foundation outperforms its \textit{Qwen3-8B} base by 11.0 points and approaches frontier models such as \textit{GLM-5.2}, with ablations and out-of-distribution evaluations further demonstrating the effectiveness and generalization of our model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Socio-Foundation 用 FONTS 五维能力分类（persona fidelity、outcome realization、behavioral naturalness、trajectory coherence、social grounding）组织个体行为模拟，经 DAPO 学任务专家、off-policy 蒸馏成能力专家、多教师 on-policy 蒸馏 (MOPD) 统一，构建约 1000 万实例、14 个数据集的训练语料与 29 指标的 IndiEval。在其评测上比 Qwen3-8B 基座高 11.0 分，接近 GLM-5.2 等前沿模型。
Motivation: 通用 LLM 做个体模拟会把不同 persona 拉平，而任务专用微调又碎片化、泛化差，需要把个性化保持与跨情境适应解耦。
Method: 先定义 FONTS 五维能力分类，据此整理约 1000 万条、覆盖 14 个代表性数据集的标准化训练语料库；三阶段流水线为 DAPO 学习任务专家、off-policy 蒸馏整合为能力专家、多教师 on-policy 蒸馏 (MOPD) 统一，评测用汇总 FONTS 五维 29 个指标的 IndiEval。
Result: 实验中 Socio-Foundation 比其 Qwen3-8B 基座高 11.0 分，并接近 GLM-5.2 等前沿模型；消融与 out-of-distribution 评测进一步支持其有效性与泛化性。
Conclusion: 把个体模拟拆成互补能力维度再分层蒸馏，能在保持 persona 的同时获得跨任务泛化，逼近前沿闭源模型水平。

papers.title: Humanity's Sixth Sense: Benchmarking Intuitive Visual Reasoning in Multimodal Models
papers.abstract_en: Humans perceive far more in a scene than what is explicitly depicted: a single glance captures past causes and future trajectories; a quick peek determines if a vehicle can fit between two parked cars; a few seconds of video reveals who holds authority in a room; and a fleeting clip highlights subtle abstract patterns like unwritten rules or hidden labels. This capacity reflects a form of humanity's sixth sense: an intuitive reasoning mechanism that recovers implicit information beyond raw sensory perception. Crucially, this rapid, zero-shot visual intuition underpins everyday navigation and social interaction, making it a vital capability for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) deployed alongside people. Existing visual benchmarks, however, target either deliberate expert-level analysis in academic and mathematical domains or low-level perception, leaving the intuitive reasoning that people perform largely untested. To bridge this gap, we introduce Humanity's Sixth Sense (HSS), a benchmark for intuitive visual reasoning. HSS spans diverse image and video inputs, organizes items under a structured taxonomy, and pairs each with human-written prompts probing the implicit temporal, spatial, social, and abstract structure that people infer at a glance. Frontier MLLMs fall short of human performance: participants reach 93.1% accuracy, while the strongest model, GPT-6-astra, reaches only 53.6% even at maximum reasoning effort. Despite excelling in many complex tasks that require advanced perception and knowledge, current models still struggle significantly on these visual tasks that are intuitive for humans. We further explore agentic setup that apply dynamic visual manipulation to HSS, which narrows but does not close the gap. HSS establishes intuitive visual reasoning as a measurable axis and directs attention to a capability that scaling on current benchmarks has so far left behind.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出直觉视觉推理基准 HSS：用图像与视频输入配人写的提示，探测人一眼就能推断的隐含时间、空间、社会与抽象结构。人类受试者准确率 93.1%，最强模型 GPT-6-astra 即使开最大推理努力也只有 53.6%；加入动态视觉操作的 agentic 设置能缩小但不能消除差距。
Motivation: 现有视觉基准要么考学术与数学领域的专家级深思分析，要么只测低层感知，人日常一瞥完成的直觉推理基本没有被测过，而这是 MLLM 与人共处时导航和社会互动的基础能力。
Method: 构建 HSS 基准，覆盖多样的图像与视频输入，按结构化分类组织条目，每条配人写的提示，专门探测隐含的时间、空间、社会与抽象结构；另探索对 HSS 施加动态视觉操作的 agentic 设置。
Result: 人类参与者准确率 93.1%，最强模型 GPT-6-astra 在最大推理努力下仅 53.6%；agentic 动态视觉操作缩小但未闭合这一差距。
Conclusion: 直觉视觉推理是可度量的独立能力轴，靠在现有基准上做规模扩展并未被覆盖，前沿 MLLM 在这类对人而言直觉的任务上仍显著落后。

papers.title: On KL-Regularized Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) for large language model (LLM) agents trains one policy on trajectories generated by another: rollouts come from stale checkpoints, and the inference engine's probabilities differ from the trainer's even at identical parameters. Standard remedies either clip importance ratios, which biases the update, or, as in GRPO, sample a group of responses per prompt, which is costly when episodes are long. We propose KL-Regularized Policy Optimization (KLPO), a framework that anchors the KL regularizer at the sampler. The regularized improvement step then has a closed-form Gibbs solution, and KLPO fits its log-ratio optimality condition by least squares on the sampler's own trajectories, so the sampler probability enters through a log-ratio and no importance weights are needed. Profiling out the regression intercept replaces the intractable log-partition function with the signal's sampler mean plus a sampler-to-trainer KL divergence. For token-level policy mirror descent targets, we show that the resulting gradient can be computed from terminal returns without a critic, via sampler-centered scores or a single trajectory residual, even under stochastic tool outputs. We further prove that independent Monte Carlo estimates of the KL term keep these gradients unbiased, derive the exact KL gap of cheaper top-$K$ and binary approximations, and show that SPPO, GPO, REBEL, and BPO arise as special cases of KLPO. The result is a critic-free update that uses one rollout per prompt and requires neither a learned normalizer nor a group of responses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 KL 正则策略优化 (KLPO)，把 KL 正则项锚定在采样器一侧，使正则化改进步有闭式 Gibbs 解，并用最小二乘在采样器自身轨迹上拟合 log-ratio 最优性条件，从而无需重要性权重。梯度可由终端回报在无 critic 下算出，且 SPPO、GPO、REBEL、BPO 都是其特例。
Motivation: 异步 RL 训练 LLM agent 时策略与轨迹来自不同来源：rollout 出自过期 checkpoint，推理引擎概率与训练器在同参数下也不一致。裁剪重要性比率会引入偏差，GRPO 的按 prompt 采样一组响应在长 episode 下代价高昂。
Method: KLPO 将 KL 正则锚定在采样器，正则化改进步得到闭式 Gibbs 解；用最小二乘在采样器轨迹上拟合 log-ratio 最优性条件，采样器概率以 log-ratio 进入，不需要重要性权重。通过把回归截距 profile 掉，用信号的采样器均值加采样器到训练器的 KL 散度替代难算的 log-partition 函数；token 级 policy mirror descent 目标下，梯度可由终端回报经采样器中心 score 或单条轨迹残差计算，无需 critic。
Result: 证明 KL 项的独立 Monte Carlo 估计仍使梯度无偏；推导出更廉价的 top-K 与 binary 近似的精确 KL gap；证明 SPPO、GPO、REBEL、BPO 均为 KLPO 特例。最终更新只需每 prompt 一条 rollout，不需要学习归一化器或一组响应。
Conclusion: 把 KL 正则锚在采样器一侧，可以在无 critic、单 rollout 的条件下得到无偏且免重要性权重的异步 LLM RL 更新，并把现有多个算法统一进同一框架。

papers.title: Directed Temporal Representations for Offline Visual Control
papers.abstract_en: Predictive world models provide compact visual representations for control. Control requires a latent geometry aligned with temporal reachability rather than predictive similarity alone. We introduce Directed Temporal Representations for Control (DTRC), which learns such a geometry from offline visual trajectories on top of frozen LeWorldModel (LeWM) features. DTRC constructs a directed temporal quasimetric over the learned control representation. Short-range temporal offsets calibrate the distance scale. Bootstrapped targets extend temporal reachability across longer horizons. Action-conditioned consistency aligns the representation with local transition dynamics. The resulting distance estimates temporal reaching cost, and its change across a transition defines goal-relative temporal progress. We use this progress signal as a temporal critic for direct goal-conditioned policy learning. Model-assisted targets provide an additional training-time refinement under behavior-support and dynamics-agreement constraints. Across ten visual control tasks, DTRC achieves strong goal-conditioned control performance relative to planning and direct-policy baselines. Held-out diagnostics on the four LeWM tasks show consistent short-range temporal calibration, task-dependent long-range and directional structure, and positive transition-level progress. Temporal supervision improves the same flow-policy parameterization across all four LeWM tasks, while the resulting policy acts directly without iterative trajectory search at test time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DTRC 在冻结的 LeWorldModel 特征之上学习有向时间拟度量 (directed temporal quasimetric)，把距离解释为到达代价、其跨转移的变化定义为目标相对时间进度，并用该进度信号作为 temporal critic 直接训练目标条件策略。在十个视觉控制任务上相对规划式与直接策略基线取得较强的目标条件控制性能，测试时无需迭代轨迹搜索。
Motivation: 预测式世界模型给出的潜空间几何对齐的是预测相似度，而控制需要对齐时间可达性 (temporal reachability) 的几何，两者不等价。
Method: 在冻结 LeWM 特征上学有向时间拟度量：短程时间偏移标定距离尺度，bootstrapped targets 把可达性延伸到更长时程，action-conditioned consistency 使表征与局部转移动力学对齐；进度信号作 temporal critic 做直接目标条件策略学习，另有 model-assisted targets 在 behavior-support 与 dynamics-agreement 约束下做训练期精修。
Result: 十个视觉控制任务上相对 planning 与 direct-policy 基线取得较强目标条件控制性能；四个 LeWM 任务的 held-out 诊断显示短程时间标定一致、长程与方向性结构依任务而异、转移级 progress 为正；同一 flow-policy 参数化在全部四个 LeWM 任务上都因时间监督而改善。
Conclusion: 把时间可达性几何显式注入潜表征，可让目标条件策略直接执行而不做迭代轨迹搜索，且时间监督对同一策略参数化普遍有效。

papers.title: GraphOPD: Graph-Augmented On-Policy Distillation for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation post-trains large language model agents by supplying dense, step-level guidance from a teacher policy when the reinforcement-learning reward is sparse and arrives only once per trajectory. Existing instantiations allocate this guidance by the size of the teacher-student divergence at each step, on the single-turn intuition that a large disagreement marks a mistake worth correcting. Once decisions chain over many turns, that rule misfires, since an early drift enters every later context both policies condition on, leaving the teacher consistent with the drifted trajectory instead of flagging its cause, while interchangeable steps register large but outcome-irrelevant divergences. We demonstrate this on an agentic benchmark, where distilling the highest-divergence steps brings no consistent benefit over random selection. To this end, we introduce GraphOPD, the first method to bring graph-based structural augmentation into on-policy distillation for agent capabilities. It reads which steps enabled which later ones from the environment's own record of state changes, immune to the drift that corrupts the teacher-student gap, organizes them into a dependency graph, scores each step by a random-walk stationary distribution over it, and fuses that structural credit with the divergence signal into a trajectory-relative mask concentrating supervision on each rollout's highest-aptitude steps. Across three model scales and eleven baselines on ALFWorld, WebShop, and SearchQA, GraphOPD shows competitive performance throughout, improving over the strongest baseline by up to +5.8 pp. An executed-replay audit further shows that this structural credit score tracks true causal impact far above chance, that both fused signals are independently necessary, and that the same signal transfers to out-of-domain tool-integrated reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GraphOPD 把环境状态变更记录构建成步骤依赖图，用随机游走平稳分布给每步打结构信用分，再与教师-学生分歧信号融合成轨迹相对掩码，把蒸馏监督集中在每条 rollout 中最该学的步骤上。在 ALFWorld、WebShop、SearchQA 三个模型规模、十一个基线上，相对最强基线最高提升 +5.8 pp；执行回放审计显示该结构信用分远高于随机水平地追踪真实因果影响，且两个融合信号各自不可替代。
Motivation: 多轮 agent 轨迹中，按教师-学生分歧大小选蒸馏步骤会失灵：早期漂移进入后续所有上下文，教师反而与漂移后的轨迹一致，而可互换步骤又产生大却与结果无关的分歧。
Method: GraphOPD 从环境自身的状态变更记录读出哪些步骤促成了后续步骤，避开被漂移污染的教师-学生分歧；据此构建依赖图，用图上随机游走平稳分布 (random-walk stationary distribution) 为每步打分，再把该结构信用与分歧信号融合成轨迹相对掩码，集中监督每条 rollout 中 aptitude 最高的步骤。
Result: 在 agentic benchmark 上，蒸馏分歧最大的步骤相对随机选择没有一致收益；GraphOPD 在 ALFWorld、WebShop、SearchQA、三个模型规模、十一个基线上整体表现有竞争力，相对最强基线最高提升 +5.8 pp。执行回放审计 (executed-replay audit) 显示结构信用分追踪真实因果影响远高于随机水平，两个融合信号各自独立必要，同一信号可迁移到域外工具集成推理 (tool-integrated reasoning)。
Conclusion: 多轮 agent 的 on-policy 蒸馏应按环境记录的因果依赖而非教师-学生分歧分配监督，结构信用与分歧信号融合后两者都不可省。

papers.title: RACER: Reflective Agent Coupling Query Interpretation and Tool-Based Retrieval for Frame Selection in Long Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Video large language models (Vid-LLMs) excel at diverse video-language tasks by reasoning over selected frames. However, frame selection for long videos remains challenging, as it requires retrieving relevant frames distributed across segments from a large candidate pool given complex queries. This paper investigates dominant approaches to long-video frame selection from a task-decomposition perspective, identifying two key challenges: the Query Comprehension Gap in similarity-based methods and the Interpretation--Selection Gap in judgment-based methods. To address them, we propose RACER, a training-free reflective agentic framework that decomposes long-video frame selection into query interpretation driven by a lightweight Vid-LLM and evidence localization supported by an embedding model serving as a retrieval tool. Specifically, the Vid-LLM is responsible solely for reformulating the complex query into sub-queries that make implicit information requirements explicit, mitigating the Query Comprehension Gap. Meanwhile, the retrieval tool leverages these sub-queries to localize relevant evidence, relieving the Vid-LLM of direct frame selection and thus addressing the Interpretation--Selection Gap. Finally, the retrieved frames are fed back to the Vid-LLM for sub-query refinement, forming a reflection loop that iteratively improves query interpretation and frame selection. Experiments across multiple benchmarks show that RACER consistently improves long video understanding. Notably, RACER achieves effective frame selection even with limited-capability components, demonstrating that agentic integration enables these components to enhance more capable Vid-LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RACER 是一个免训练的反思式智能体框架，把长视频帧选择拆成轻量 Vid-LLM 负责的查询解释与 embedding 模型作为检索工具负责的证据定位，检索帧回喂 Vid-LLM 迭代精化子查询形成反思循环。在多个长视频理解基准上一致提升表现，且用能力有限的组件也能完成有效帧选择。
Motivation: 长视频帧选择需从大量候选池中跨片段检索与复杂查询相关的帧：相似度方法存在 Query Comprehension Gap，判断式方法存在 Interpretation–Selection Gap。
Method: RACER（training-free reflective agentic framework）：轻量 Vid-LLM 把复杂查询改写为显式子查询；embedding 模型作为检索工具按子查询定位证据，免除 Vid-LLM 直接选帧；检索帧回喂 Vid-LLM 精化子查询，构成反思循环。
Result: 在多个长视频理解基准上一致提升长视频理解；即使组件能力有限也能实现有效帧选择，表明智能体式集成可让这些组件增强更强的 Vid-LLM。
Conclusion: 把查询解释与证据定位解耦并用反思循环耦合，可在免训练前提下缓解两个任务分解缺口，并让弱组件协同增强强 Vid-LLM。

papers.title: One-Slide Calibration of Pathology Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Scanner variation changes how pathology foundation models represent the same tissue. We introduce SlideRuler, which uses regions within a slide as internal controls to estimate and correct acquisition-induced shifts in other regions. A transfer map learned from paired rescans enables calibration from a single scan at inference while keeping the foundation model fixed. Across two encoders and five SCORPION scanners, learned transfer reduces mean target-to-source embedding distance by 16.3-38.5% relative to raw embeddings. Comparisons with unrelated same-scanner controls reveal a positive same-slide contribution across all four evaluation settings, including scanner holdout. A source-anchored variant reduces source-feature displacement by 47.7-83.6% relative to learned transfer while retaining most of its alignment gain. By drawing calibration information from the slide itself, SlideRuler offers a path toward more consistent use of frozen pathology models across imaging systems.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop AI at Scale for Clinical Impact (ASCI): Cancer Pathology Foundation Models
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SlideRuler 用同一张病理切片内部的区域作为内部对照，估计并校正扫描仪引起的表征偏移，从单次扫描即可校准冻结的病理基础模型。在两个编码器与五台 SCORPION 扫描仪上，学到的 transfer map 使平均 target-to-source embedding 距离相对原始 embedding 下降 16.3–38.5%，source-anchored 变体再把 source-feature 位移压低 47.7–83.6%。
Motivation: 扫描仪差异会改变病理基础模型对同一组织的表征，跨成像系统使用冻结模型时一致性不足；推理时通常只有单次扫描，缺少配对重扫来估计偏移。
Method: 以切片内区域作内部对照，估计并校正其他区域的采集诱导偏移；用配对重扫 (paired rescans) 学一个 transfer map，推理时仅需单次扫描且基础模型保持冻结；另设 source-anchored 变体约束 source 特征位移。
Result: 在两个编码器、五台 SCORPION 扫描仪上，学到的 transfer 使平均 target-to-source embedding 距离相对原始 embedding 降低 16.3–38.5%；与无关的同扫描仪对照比较显示四个评估设置（含 scanner holdout）均存在正的 same-slide 贡献；source-anchored 变体相对 learned transfer 把 source-feature 位移降低 47.7–83.6%，同时保留大部分对齐增益。
Conclusion: 校准信息可以只从切片自身取，无需改动冻结模型即可跨成像系统更一致地使用病理基础模型；source-anchored 变体在位移与对齐增益之间给出更稳的折中。

papers.title: SPW-Nav: A Streaming Panoramic World Model for Language-Guided Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Language-guided panoramic video generation benefits various downstream applications, such as interactive 3D scene exploration, virtual reality experiences, and embodied agent training. Existing panoramic generators follow predefined trajectories, and interactive world models act through low-level actions in perspective views. We propose SPW-Nav, a streaming panoramic world model that understands movement instructions and streams one minute of 2K 360-degree video in real time from a single panorama. SPW-Nav interprets each instruction in the previously generated panorama as camera motion. Spherical rotation decoupling applies rotation exactly on the sphere, pose-aligned conditioning keeps translation inputs bounded over long streams, and a multi-term memory with a few-step generator continues the scene as instructions change. We also build SPW-NavSet, panoramic videos with camera trajectories and verified instructions. Driven by language, SPW-Nav outperforms prior panoramic generators in camera-following accuracy and video quality, and supports on-the-fly instruction switching.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPW-Nav 是一个流式全景世界模型：从单张全景图出发，把语言指令解码为相机运动，实时流式生成 1 分钟 2K 360 度视频。球面旋转解耦 (spherical rotation decoupling) 在球面上精确施加旋转，位姿对齐条件化 (pose-aligned conditioning) 让长流中的平移输入保持有界，多项记忆加少步生成器在指令切换时延续场景。在自建 SPW-NavSet 上，其相机跟随精度与视频质量超过已有全景生成器，并支持即时指令切换。
Motivation: 现有全景生成器只能沿预定义轨迹运动，交互式世界模型又局限于透视视角下的低层动作，语言指令驱动的全景视频生成缺少能长时间流式、且可随时改换指令的方案。
Method: SPW-Nav 将每条指令在已生成全景中解释为相机运动；用球面旋转解耦在球面上精确施加旋转，用 pose-aligned conditioning 约束长序列中的平移输入，用 multi-term memory 配合 few-step generator 在指令变化时延续场景。同时构建 SPW-NavSet：带相机轨迹与经校验指令的全景视频数据集。
Result: 在 SPW-NavSet 上，SPW-Nav 在 camera-following accuracy 与 video quality 两方面超过已有全景生成器，并支持 on-the-fly instruction switching；可从单张全景实时流式生成 1 分钟 2K 360 度视频。
Conclusion: 把语言指令当作相机运动、并用球面解耦与有界条件化来约束长流，可以让全景世界模型在保持画质与跟随精度的同时随时改换指令。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: A Shortcut to Structure in AlphaFold 3
papers.abstract_en: AlphaFold 3 predicts protein structures with remarkable accuracy, yet how structural information emerges within the model remains poorly understood. Here, through causal interventions on internal representations and direct probing of every Pairformer block, we trace the formation of global protein geometry and identify the multiple sequence alignment (MSA) as a structural shortcut to the fold. Removing the MSA largely preserves local secondary structure while disrupting the long-range relationships that define global topology. Restoring the MSA-enriched pair representation at only forty residues recovers most of this lost organization, including at pairs never directly modified. This contribution depends on the detailed direction of the MSA module's output rather than its magnitude. The Pairformer rapidly converts this signal into global geometry: the final fold becomes recoverable by approximately block 9 of 48 for a majority of proteins, roughly twenty-seven blocks before the model's decoder can render it, whereas without the MSA it remains inaccessible for most proteins throughout the pass. Which homologs are supplied shapes this trajectory more strongly than which query is supplied; it persists for a designed query that never evolved but collapses for a shuffled sequence. Most importantly, an alignment built for a different protein that shares the fold, supplied only at the structurally corresponding columns, raises the median TM-score against experiment from 0.44 to 0.72, while the same alignment shifted a few residues along the chain performs worse than supplying no alignment at all. What AlphaFold 3 reads from an alignment is therefore a description of the fold itself, transferable between proteins that share one, rather than the query's own evolutionary history. This explains both its accuracy and the limits of what it has solved.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 AlphaFold 3 做因果干预与逐 Pairformer 块探针，把 MSA 定位为通往折叠结构的捷径：去掉 MSA 只破坏长程拓扑而保留二级结构，在仅 40 个残基上恢复 MSA 富集的 pair 表示即可找回大部分丢失的组织。最终折叠约在 48 个 block 中的第 9 个就可恢复，比 decoder 早约 27 个 block；把共享同一折叠的另一条蛋白的比对按对应列喂入，中位 TM-score 从 0.44 升到 0.72，而错位几残基的同一比对比不给比对还差。
Motivation: AlphaFold 3 精度很高但其内部如何形成全局结构不清楚，需要判定 MSA 在结构生成中到底承担什么角色，以及模型读取的是比对中的何种信息。
Method: 对内部表征做因果干预，并直接探针 (probe) 每一个 Pairformer block；移除 MSA、在仅 40 个残基上恢复 MSA 富集的 pair 表示、替换为其他蛋白的比对及其错位版本，并测试设计序列与打乱序列。
Result: 移除 MSA 后局部二级结构大体保留而长程关系被破坏；仅 40 个残基的 pair 表示恢复即可找回大部分组织，包括未被直接修改的残基对；贡献取决于 MSA 模块输出的方向而非幅度。多数蛋白的最终折叠约在 48 个 block 中的第 9 个即可恢复，比 decoder 早约 27 个 block，而无 MSA 时整个前向过程对多数蛋白都不可及。共享折叠的另一蛋白比对按结构对应列输入时，对实验结构的中位 TM-score 从 0.44 升至 0.72，同一比对沿链错位几残基则比不提供比对更差。
Conclusion: AlphaFold 3 从比对中读取的是折叠本身的描述，可在共享折叠的蛋白间迁移，而非查询序列自身的进化历史；这同时解释了它的精度与尚未解决的边界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VCR-Bench: A Modular Open-Source Benchmark for Video Classification Robustness
papers.abstract_en: Robustness of image classification has several benchmarks, but their video counterparts are absent. In video classification temporal dimension introduces additional degrees of freedom for adversarial attacks, defenses, and preprocessing. Temporal sampling, perturbation budgets, and metric aggregation also interact in ways with no direct analogue in the image setting. Therefore, robustness for video classifiers is studied across scattered, incompatible implementations, making reported numbers hard to reproduce and analyze. We introduce VCR-Bench, a modular open-source benchmark framework that standardizes video loading, wrappers for classifiers, adversarial attacks and defenses, perceptual metrics, configuration presets, and result logging. VCR-Bench currently integrates 30 video classification models, 14 adversarial attacks, and 10 defense wrappers under a common evaluation protocol. We evaluate representative video classifiers, attacks, and defenses on Kinetics-400 subset, reporting clean accuracy, attack success rate, perceptual quality, runtime, and memory usage. VCR-Bench is released with documented installation, reproducible run presets, component-extension interfaces, and scripts for reproducing the reported results at https://github.com/msu-video-group/vcr-bench.
papers.comment: 6 pages,1 figure, accepted at ACM MM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VCR-Bench 把视频分类鲁棒性评测标准化：统一视频加载、分类器包装、对抗攻击与防御、感知指标与结果日志，目前集成 30 个视频分类模型、14 种对抗攻击和 10 个防御包装。在 Kinetics-400 子集上按统一协议评测代表性模型、攻击与防御，报告干净准确率、攻击成功率、感知质量、运行时与内存占用，并附可复现预设与脚本。
Motivation: 视频分类的鲁棒性评测散落在互不兼容的实现中，时间维度带来的额外自由度（时序采样、扰动预算、指标聚合）没有图像设定的直接对应物，导致报告数字难以复现和比较。
Method: 模块化开源框架：标准化视频加载、分类器 wrapper、对抗攻击与防御 wrapper、感知指标、配置预设与结果日志；提供组件扩展接口与复现脚本，统一评测协议下集成 30 个模型、14 种攻击、10 个防御。
Result: 在 Kinetics-400 子集上评测代表性视频分类器、攻击与防御，报告 clean accuracy、attack success rate、感知质量、runtime 与 memory usage 五类指标；集成规模为 30 个模型、14 种攻击、10 个防御 wrapper。
Conclusion: 视频分类鲁棒性需要独立于图像基准的标准化评测协议，VCR-Bench 以可扩展、可复现的开源框架提供该协议并已发布代码。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Toward Evidence-Driven Human-Agent-Robot Teaming for Earth-Independent Anomaly Triage
papers.abstract_en: Deep-space crews cannot rely on real-time ground support for urgent off-nominal events. Initial alerts may underdetermine cause, while discriminating evidence may reside in crew observations or at locations that are unsafe, costly, or unavailable for crew inspection. We present an evidence-driven architecture for human-agent-robot teaming in Earth-independent anomaly triage. Agentic AI is treated as a stateful coordinator over bounded, inspectable services rather than as a fully autonomous vehicle controller. A triage state manager maintains hypotheses, evidence provenance, uncertainty, operational context, and tool status; a crew-facing embodied agent elicits observations and explains assessment changes; and a mobile robot acquires targeted, localized evidence. Typed interfaces separate dialogue and orchestration from monitoring, robot command, context retrieval, and safety-critical control. Two scenarios illustrate the architecture: a crewed deep-space mission based on an actual ISS ammonia false alarm, where suspected contamination restricts crew access, and a power-interface anomaly at a crewed lunar base, where robotic inspection distinguishes a local connector fault from other causes ambiguous in remote telemetry. Our main contribution is an authority-bounded closed evidence-loop architecture, exercised in a hardware-in-the-loop integration prototype using Reachy Mini and an Innate MARS mobile robot.
papers.comment: Accepted to the Space Robotics Workshop at 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向深空自主异常分诊 (anomaly triage) 的权限受限人-智能体-机器人闭环证据架构：智能体只做有状态协调器，三元组状态管理器维护假设、证据溯源与不确定性，具身智能体向乘员采集并解释，移动机器人去危险处取局部证据。架构在 Reachy Mini 与 Innate MARS 硬件在环原型上跑通两个场景（ISS 氨气误报、月球基地电源接口异常）。
Motivation: 深空乘员在紧急异常事件上拿不到实时地面支持，初始告警欠定原因，而能区分原因的证据可能在乘员观察里或在对人不安全、昂贵、无法到达的位置。
Method: 把 Agentic AI 定位为在有界、可检查服务之上的有状态协调器，而非全自主车辆控制器；三元组 Triage state manager 维护假设、证据 provenance、不确定性、运行上下文与工具状态，乘员侧具身智能体负责采集观察并解释评估变化，移动机器人执行定点局部取证；用类型化接口把对话/编排与监控、机器人指令、上下文检索、安全关键控制分开。
Result: 用两个场景演示架构：基于真实 ISS 氨气误报、污染嫌疑限制乘员进入的载人深空任务，以及月球基地电源接口异常（机器人检查把本地连接器故障与遥测上模糊的其他原因区分开）；硬件在环集成原型使用 Reachy Mini 与 Innate MARS 移动机器人。
Conclusion: 主要贡献是权限受限的闭环证据架构 (authority-bounded closed evidence-loop)，即把自主性约束在可检查服务内、由机器人补上乘员无法安全获取的证据。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Multi-Aspect Runtime Verification for Simulation-Based V&V of LLM-Enabled Autonomous Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents are entering decision-support roles in defence staff work, where the obligations they must respect are already written down and binding, and where retraining is not available as a control because models arrive as procured components. What can be placed under engineering control is the interface between the agent and the systems it acts on. Those obligations are at once spatial, temporal and text-semantic, and a violation typically lives in the composition of a multi-step interaction, which is why per-event guardrails miss sequential tool-attack chains. We present a multi-aspect runtime-verification framework that decomposes a natural-language policy clause into a typed spatial/temporal/semantic triple over one canonical event stream, checks each aspect with its own monitoring specification, and fuses the verdicts through a four-valued algebra that carries provenance. The spatial aspect is interpreted over a weighted two-sorted location graph in which mission geometry and information-release topology are one object; we show that these spatial obligations are not in general subsumed by a first-order temporal specification. The past-time aspect runs on the unmodified MonPoly engine, which agrees with our reference monitor at every time point. Across two mission domains, casualty evacuation and contested sustainment, and one civil domain, composition under the precautionary blocking policy drives attack success to zero with no observed false positives and microsecond-scale per-event cost, while every single aspect and every pair leaves a substantial share of attacks succeeding. In a closed-loop experiment a policy-naive planner reaches a violating state in most unshielded missions and in none when shielded, and four refused episodes in five still recover to a compliant outcome.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at Modelling and Simulation for Autonomous Systems (MESAS 2026), to appear in Springer LNCS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向国防决策支持中的 LLM 智能体，提出多视角运行时验证框架：把自然语言策略条款分解为带类型的空间/时间/语义三元组，在统一事件流上分别监测，再用带溯源的四值代数融合裁决。在伤亡后送与 contested sustainment 两个任务域加一个民事域上，precautionary blocking 策略下组合验证把攻击成功率压到 0、无观测假阳性、每事件微秒级开销，而单独任一视角或任两视角组合仍留有大量成功攻击。
Motivation: LLM 智能体进入国防决策支持岗位，义务条款本身已具约束力，而模型作为采购件无法靠再训练约束；逐事件 guardrail 抓不住跨多步交互的 tool-attack 链，且空间、时间、文本语义三类义务常同时存在。
Method: 把自然语言策略条款分解为带类型的 spatial/temporal/semantic 三元组，落在同一条规范化事件流上；空间视角用加权二部位置图（任务几何与信息释放拓扑合一）解释，时间过去式视角跑在未改动的 MonPoly 引擎上，各视角独立监测后由带 provenance 的四值代数融合裁决。
Result: 在 casualty evacuation、contested sustainment 两个任务域与一个民事域上，precautionary blocking 策略下组合验证使攻击成功率为 0、无观测假阳性、每事件微秒级开销；单独任一视角或任两视角组合仍留下可观比例的成功攻击。闭环实验中，policy-naive planner 在多数无盾任务里到达违规状态、加盾后为 0 次，五次被拒回合中有四次仍恢复到合规结果。MonPoly 与参考监测器在每个时间点裁决一致。
Conclusion: 空间义务一般不能被一阶时序规范涵盖，只有三视角组合验证才能把顺序性攻击链封死；单视角或两视角防护不足以消除违规。
Relevance: 1
