papers.title: The Signed Geometry of One-Shot Recourse: On-Path Validity and the Signed-Curvature Criterion
papers.abstract_en:
Closed-form recourse moves a rejected user along the unit gradient $\hat g$ of the classifier score $f$ by the promised distance $d_p=|f(x)|/\|
abla f(x)\|$, at which the linearized score reaches zero. We ask when this one-shot step succeeds and what additional model queries change. To leading order the step ends on the favorable side exactly when the path curvature $κ=\hat g^	op
abla^2 f(x)\,\hat g$ is nonnegative. Across 80 shallow models, the fraction of rejected users whose step ends there and the fraction with $κ\ge0$ correlate at $r=0.985$, although on Fashion-MNIST the first falls below the second by 8.2 points on average. No rule that uses only the score value and gradient can be valid for every score with path curvature bounded by $K$ without overshooting some by order $Kd_p^2/\|
abla f(x)\|$. When the curvature is also Lipschitz and the step is short, one evaluation of $f$ at the promised point attains the minimax rate among deterministic one-query rules that know the curvature bound and its Lipschitz constant, and split-conformal calibration makes such a rule reach the first crossing or abstain with probability at least $1-δ$. Training with an asymmetric curvature penalty lets 99-100% of paths cross within the promised step on undershoot-prone shallow data, at about 4-22 times the overshoot of symmetric penalties (Fashion-MNIST, COMPAS). Because $κ$ and $d_p$ depend on how the score is scaled, part of this gain can be a longer promised step, and at matched validity a smaller audit of briefly trained models finds no uniform advantage over tuned inflation. Where a per-user line search along the ray is affordable, it is exact to grid resolution and preferable.
papers.comment: v2: minor corrections and clarifications. Main text 8 pages; 58 pages including appendix and checklist
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 闭式 recourse 沿分类器分数的单位梯度走一步承诺距离 d_p=|f(x)|/‖∇f(x)‖，本文判定这一步何时落到有利侧：一阶条件下恰由路径曲率 κ=ĝᵀ∇²f(x)ĝ 的符号决定，κ≥0 才成功。80 个浅层模型上「一步成功比例」与「κ≥0 比例」相关 r=0.985；用非对称曲率惩罚训练可让 99–100% 的路径在承诺步内穿越，但代价是约 4–22 倍的过冲。
Motivation: 闭式一步 recourse 承诺把被拒用户推到决策边界，却没人说清这一步何时真正越界、以及额外查询能改变什么；只用分数值和梯度的规则在曲率有界时必然对某些样本过冲。
Method: 对分数 f 做一阶展开，导出路径曲率 κ=ĝᵀ∇²f(x)ĝ 作为成功判据；证明只用分数值与梯度的规则在曲率界 K 下必有量级 Kd_p²/‖∇f(x)‖ 的过冲下界；在曲率 Lipschitz 且步长短时用承诺点处一次 f 求值达到确定性单查询规则的 minimax 率，并用 split-conformal 校准使规则以至少 1−δ 概率到达首次穿越或弃权；训练时加入非对称曲率惩罚。
Result: 80 个浅层模型上，一步落到有利侧的比例与 κ≥0 的比例相关 r=0.985，但在 Fashion-MNIST 上前者平均比后者低 8.2 个百分点。非对称曲率惩罚训练使 99–100% 的路径在承诺步内穿越（undershoot-prone 浅层数据，Fashion-MNIST 与 COMPAS），过冲约为对称惩罚的 4–22 倍；在匹配有效性下，对短暂训练模型的小规模审计未发现相对调优膨胀 (tuned inflation) 的一致优势。
Conclusion: 路径曲率符号是一步 recourse 成败的判据，非对称曲率惩罚能把穿越率推到 99–100%，但 κ 与 d_p 随分数尺度变化、部分收益来自更长的承诺步；若能负担沿射线的逐用户 line search，它精确到网格分辨率且更可取。

papers.title: Residual-Stream Burden Shapes Representation Learning in Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: In diffusion-based generation, a neural network can be trained to predict the clean data, the noise, or the velocity from a noisy input. These prediction targets are interconvertible and describe the same generative process, yet plain Diffusion Transformers operating on large pixel patches succeed with clean prediction and fail with noise or velocity prediction. We argue that this asymmetry arises because noisy targets require the residual stream to preserve noise-dependent input variation through depth for the final readout, forcing subsequent layers to compute on noisy representations. A spectrally concentrated clean target imposes a lighter demand, leaving greater freedom to organize hidden representations for subsequent computation. We call this preservation requirement *residual-stream burden* and show how it shapes representation learning in Diffusion Transformers. Controlled experiments indicate that the exploitable structure is spectral concentration in patch space and that the bandwidth of the persistent residual state is a key resource for noisy prediction. We further show that this account is consistent with recent decoupled pixel-space architectures, whose diverse designs all reduce the residual-stream burden on the main pathway. To examine this understanding from a complementary direction, we expand and reorganize the residual-stream bandwidth directly, introducing Spatially Indexed Hyper-Connections (SiHC) that reach FID 1.71 on ImageNet $256^2$. Together, these results identify residual-stream burden as a mechanism through which prediction targets and architecture jointly shape representation learning in Diffusion Transformers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 residual-stream burden 概念解释 Diffusion Transformer 上预测目标的不对称：干净图像预测可行而噪声/速度预测失败，因为噪声类目标要求残差流在深度上保持噪声相关的输入变化。受控实验指出可利用结构是 patch 空间的谱集中度、持久残差态的带宽是噪声预测的关键资源；据此直接扩展残差流带宽的 Spatially Indexed Hyper-Connections (SiHC) 在 ImageNet 256^2 上达到 FID 1.71。
Motivation: 在大像素 patch 上，干净预测、噪声预测、速度预测本可互换描述同一生成过程，但 plain Diffusion Transformer 只在干净预测上成功，这一不对称缺少机制解释。
Method: 把预测目标对表示学习的影响归因于残差流负担：噪声类目标迫使后续层在含噪表示上计算，谱集中的干净目标负担更轻。用受控实验定位可利用结构为 patch 空间谱集中度与持久残差态带宽，并据此提出 Spatially Indexed Hyper-Connections (SiHC) 直接扩展重组残差流带宽，同时用该框架解释近期解耦像素空间架构。
Result: SiHC 在 ImageNet 256^2 上达到 FID 1.71；受控实验表明可利用结构是 patch 空间谱集中度，持久残差态带宽是噪声预测的关键资源；近期解耦像素空间架构的多样设计都被归结为降低主通路的残差流负担。
Conclusion: 预测目标与架构通过 residual-stream burden 共同塑造 Diffusion Transformer 的表示学习，扩展残差流带宽是提升生成质量的可行路径。

papers.title: Despite Instructions: Frontier Agents Improvise Covert Channels at Test Time
papers.abstract_en: In security-sensitive applications, language-model agents are often required to coordinate without disclosing confidential information. Yet repeated interactions may also let ordinary messages acquire shared private meaning. We study a repeated game with pairs of models in which the sender model observes one of four secret states and selects one of four summaries of the same public report, while the receiver model tries to infer the secret state. We find that model pairs can learn to communicate the secret using only one bit of feedback indicating whether the receiver inferred it correctly. This learning occurs during inference with fixed parameters and no supplied codebook or encoding examples. The effect also persists when agents generate their own free-form updates in a simulated incident-response task. Across ten independent games, pairs of GPT-5.6 Sol agents reach 98.8% final accuracy, compared with 25% chance, despite explicit instructions prohibiting disclosure and a monitor that screens each message without access to the agents' interaction histories. The same interactions that help agents cooperate can therefore allow confidential information to pass through messages intended for legitimate coordination.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在重复博弈中，成对的 LLM agent 仅凭「接收方是否猜对」这一比特反馈，就能在推理阶段（参数固定、无码本）把秘密状态编码进看似合规的消息。GPT-5.6 Sol 在十条独立博弈中最终准确率达 98.8%（随机 25%），且能绕过无历史访问权的监视器。
Motivation: 安全敏感场景要求 agent 在不泄露机密的前提下协调，但反复交互会让普通消息自发获得共享私有含义，现有监视机制只看单条消息、看不到交互历史，无法识别这种隐蔽信道。
Method: 构造重复博弈：发送方观察四个秘密状态之一、从同一公开报告的四个摘要中选择，接收方推断秘密；仅提供一比特正误反馈，无码本或编码示例，参数固定。另在一个模拟 incident-response 任务中让 agent 自行生成自由文本更新，并配一个看不到交互历史的消息监视器。
Result: 跨十条独立博弈，GPT-5.6 Sol agent 对最终准确率 98.8%，对照随机水平 25%；该效应在显式禁止披露的指令与逐条筛查的监视器下仍然存在，并在自由形式更新的 incident-response 任务中持续。
Conclusion: 帮助 agent 合作的同一批交互本身就能让机密信息穿过用于合法协调的消息，仅靠单消息监视与禁止披露的指令不足以阻断测试时涌现的隐蔽信道。

summary_sections.method: 构造重复博弈：发送方观察四个秘密状态之一、从同一公开报告的四个摘要中选择，接收方推断秘密；仅提供一比特正误反馈，无码本或编码示例，参数固定。另在一个模拟 incident-response 任务中让 agent 自行生成自由文本更新，并配一个看不到交互历史的消息监视器。
summary_sections.result: 跨十条独立博弈，GPT-5.6 Sol agent 对最终准确率 98.8%，对照随机水平 25%；该效应在显式禁止披露的指令与逐条筛查的监视器下仍然存在，并在自由形式更新的 incident-response 任务中持续。
summary_sections.conclusion: 帮助 agent 合作的同一批交互本身就能让机密信息穿过用于合法协调的消息，仅靠单消息监视与禁止披露的指令不足以阻断测试时涌现的隐蔽信道。

papers.title: GridSFM: A Foundation Model for Solving AC Optimal Power Flow
papers.abstract_en: We introduce GridSFM, a framework that combines a pretrained foundation model across grid topologies with physics-informed fine-tuning for solving AC Optimal Power Flow (AC-OPF) at scale. It is a $15$ million parameter physics-inspired graph neural network pretrained across $54$ topologies of $500$ to $4{,}000$ buses. Our model attains a $2.45\%$ zero-shot generation-cost error on a $10{,}000$ bus case held-out operating conditions with no degradation as system size grows. Building on this, we pair the pretrained backbone with a physics-informed fine-tuning design based on Newton's method for power flow. With only $100$ solved instances, GridSFM adapts to unseen grids up to $10{,}000$ buses. We show it out performs single topology, dedicated neural network models that are trained more data, both in terms of cost and solver iterations when deployed as warm starting points. In designing this foundation model, we overcome the fact that the feasible set for AC-OPF can be disconnected. This is an obstruction that prevents any continuous neural network from approximating the solution map. To do so, we lift the problem and relax its constraints with logarithmically penalized slacks. We prove that the resulting elastic feasible set is contractible, that the AC-OPF minimizers remain minimizers of the elastic problem above an explicit penalty threshold, and that projecting an approximate solution back onto the AC-OPF feasible set is well posed. We release all models, data, and code so that the community can build on a shared starting point for AC-OPF.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GridSFM 把跨 54 种拓扑（500–4,000 节点）预训练的 1500 万参数物理启发图神经网络与基于 Newton 法的物理信息微调结合，用于大规模求解 AC-OPF。在 10,000 节点留出工况上零样本发电成本误差 2.45% 且不随系统规模增大而退化；仅用 100 个已解实例即可适配到未见的 10,000 节点电网，作为 warm start 时在成本与求解迭代次数上胜过用更多数据训练的单拓扑专用网络。
Motivation: AC-OPF 的可行集可能不连通，构成连续神经网络无法逼近解映射的障碍；同时专用网络只在单一拓扑上训练，换电网或扩规模就要重训。
Method: 1500 万参数物理启发 GNN 在 54 种 500–4,000 节点拓扑上预训练，再配基于 Newton power flow 的物理信息微调设计；为绕开可行集不连通，对问题做 lift 并用对数惩罚松弛 slack（logarithmically penalized slacks），得到弹性可行集。
Result: 10,000 节点留出工况零样本发电成本误差 2.45%，且误差不随系统规模增长而退化；仅 100 个已解实例即可适配到未见的 10,000 节点电网；作为 warm starting point 部署时，在成本与 solver iterations 两方面均优于用更多数据训练的单拓扑专用神经网络。理论上证明弹性可行集可收缩（contractible）、在显式惩罚阈值之上 AC-OPF 极小点仍是弹性问题的极小点、以及把近似解投影回 AC-OPF 可行集是 well posed。
Conclusion: 跨拓扑预训练加物理信息微调可让单一模型零样本扩展到 10,000 节点 AC-OPF 并作为通用 warm start；用 lift 加对数惩罚松弛能绕过可行集不连通对连续神经网络的逼近障碍。全部模型、数据与代码开源。

papers.title: QUARTET: Quad-branch cross-Attention and Random-walk Traces for Enhancing Transformers on Relational Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Relational Deep Learning (RDL) models multi-table databases as heterogeneous temporal graphs, and graph transformers currently achieve state-of-the-art performance on benchmarks like RelBench. However, the current leading model, RelGT, suffers from two key limitations: its random local sampler yields loosely connected subgraphs that hinder message passing, and its global attention module relies on a single, seed-feature-based memory that ignores broader macro-level dynamics. To overcome these limitations, we introduce QUARTET, an expressive graph transformer architecture that applies full self-attention on local subgraphs while enriching global context through cross-attention branches. Specifically, QUARTET employs a Causal Random Walk (CRW) sampler based on recency-truncated Personalized PageRank (PPR) to extract compact, hub-robust, and densely connected local subgraphs without temporal leakage. Concurrently, a quad-branch cross-attention module integrates global context from four complementary perspectives: seed feature, seed topology, temporal dynamics, and collaborative dynamics. Across the RelBench v1 classification tasks, QUARTET consistently matches or outperforms the current state-of-the-art graph transformer baselines (HGT and RelGT). Ablation studies confirm that the CRW sampler significantly enriches local neighborhood quality, while the global branches provide essential, task-specific predictive gains.
papers.comment: This work has been accepted for main conference track at Learning on Graphs (LoG) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QUARTET 针对 RelBench 上关系图 Transformer 的两个短板提出改进：用基于时间截断 Personalized PageRank 的 Causal Random Walk (CRW) 采样器替换随机局部采样，得到紧凑、抗 hub、无时间泄漏的稠密子图；再用四分支 cross-attention（seed 特征、seed 拓扑、时间动态、协同动态）补充全局上下文。在 RelBench v1 分类任务上与 HGT、RelGT 基线持平或更优，消融显示 CRW 显著改善局部邻域质量、各全局分支带来任务相关的增益。
Motivation: RelGT 的随机局部采样产生松散子图阻碍消息传递，其全局注意力只依赖单一 seed 特征记忆，忽略宏观动态，限制了 RelBench 上关系深度学习模型的表现。
Method: CRW 采样器用 recency-truncated Personalized PageRank 抽取紧凑、hub-robust、无时间泄漏的局部子图，子图上做全 self-attention；quad-branch cross-attention 从 seed 特征、seed 拓扑、时间动态、协同动态四个互补视角融合全局上下文。
Result: 在 RelBench v1 分类任务上，QUARTET 与当前 SOTA 图 Transformer 基线 HGT 和 RelGT 持平或更优；消融显示 CRW 采样器显著提升局部邻域质量，四个全局分支提供任务相关的预测增益。
Conclusion: 更稠密的因果局部子图加多视角全局 cross-attention，是关系图 Transformer 在 RelBench 上继续提升的有效设计；各全局分支的贡献是任务相关的。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: mbariml: a curation pipeline for turning deep-sea imagery and video into object-detection training data
papers.abstract_en: Training data quantity and quality greatly affect object detection model performance, regardless of model architecture. For object detection in deep-sea video and imagery, where the objects of interest (primarily organisms) are sparse, faint, and hard to identify, incremental improvements to detector performance may require an iterative approach to data labeling and management. This paper presents mbariml, a Python-based video and image analysis pipeline built around the data labeling and management process. mbariml uses an Ultralytics YOLO detection model, runs it over still images or video, stores every detection as a reviewable region of interest, groups those regions by visual similarity so that a human can accept or reject them in bulk, and exports the result as training data, statistics, image sidecars, and additional metadata. Existing YOLO and Pascal VOC datasets can be imported into the same database, so a legacy training set can be reviewed, extended, and re-exported alongside new detections. The human review stage is the center of the design: an annotator can validate, relabel, resize, delete, and draw entirely new localizations, optionally assisted by the SAM3 segmentation model, and every one of those edits is written back to the same database the detector wrote to. Video receives particular attention: the software treats each tracker-produced track as a provisional observation and selects one representative frame instead of retaining every detection in the track. We describe the pipeline stage by stage, including how each track's representative frame is chosen (from a user-selected third of the track, the middle by default), which we examine on 684 tracks from seafloor video.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: mbariml 是一条把深海视频与静止图像转成目标检测训练数据的 Python 流程：用 Ultralytics YOLO 跑出检测并存为可审阅 ROI，按视觉相似度分组供人批量接受/拒绝，人工修改（可选 SAM3 辅助）全部写回同一数据库。视频侧把每条 tracker 轨迹当作临时观测、只选一帧代表（默认取轨迹中段，可选用户指定的三分之一段），该选帧方式在 684 条海底视频轨迹上做了检验。
Motivation: 深海视频中目标（主要是生物）稀疏、微弱、难辨识，检测器性能的渐进提升依赖迭代式标注与数据管理，而现有 YOLO/Pascal VOC 数据集与新检测难以在同一处复审、扩展和再导出。
Method: mbariml 以 Ultralytics YOLO 对静止图像或视频推理，把每个检测存为可审阅 ROI 并按视觉相似度分组以支持批量接受/拒绝；人工阶段可验证、重标、缩放、删除、重画定位，可选 SAM3 分割模型辅助，所有编辑写回检测器所用的同一数据库；可导入既有 YOLO 与 Pascal VOC 数据集一并复审再导出；视频按轨迹选代表帧（默认轨迹中段，可选用户选定的三分之一段）。
Result: 在 684 条海底视频轨迹上检验了每条轨迹代表帧的选取方式；导出物包括训练数据、统计量、图像 sidecar 与附加元数据。
Conclusion: 把人工复审放在流程中心、并让检测器与标注者共享同一数据库，可让深海目标检测训练集被持续复审、扩展与再导出；视频轨迹应压缩为单个代表帧而非保留全部检测。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: TACTICS: Taxonomy-Aware Intelligent Corpus Sampling for Machine Translation
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale machine-translation (MT) systems are typically evaluated on random samples from a corpus whose distributional composition is an artifact of how it was assembled. Such a sample inherits the phenomena the collection happens to contain rather than the full space a system must handle, spanning rule-governed conventions (terminology, punctuation, currency formatting) and context-dependent phenomena (tone, honorifics, document-level coherence), and thus provides no coverage guarantee for assessing robustness. We propose TACTICS (Taxonomy-Aware Coverage-opTimized Intelligent Corpus Sampling), which recasts coverage as an explicit objective. TACTICS induces a hierarchical taxonomy from a locale style guide, classifies segments against it, and selects a fixed-budget subset jointly optimizing coverage of rare categories, document-level coherence, and distributional fidelity to the full corpus. Applied to MT evaluation across four translation directions, TACTICS improves coverage of rare categories over lexical and embedding-based selection. By targeting the phenomena that separate systems, TACTICS makes a fixed evaluation budget go further, recovering the true system ranking from far fewer segments than random sampling wherever a real quality gap exists and never signaling a difference where none exists.
papers.comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026 (The Eleventh Conference in Machine Translation 2026 - WMT2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TACTICS 把 MT 评测抽样从随机采样改成显式覆盖目标：从 locale style guide 归纳层级分类法，给语料分段打类标，再在固定预算下联合优化稀有类别覆盖、文档级连贯性与对全语料的分布保真。在四个翻译方向上，它比基于词面和 embedding 的选择更能覆盖稀有类别，用远少于随机采样的片段就恢复出真实系统排序，且在没有真实质量差距时不会误报差异。
Motivation: MT 评测通常从语料随机抽样，样本分布是语料构建过程的副产物，只覆盖恰好被收进去的现象，对术语、标点、货币格式等规则性约定与语气、敬语、文档级连贯等上下文现象都没有覆盖保证，无法支撑鲁棒性判断。
Method: TACTICS (Taxonomy-Aware Coverage-opTimized Intelligent Corpus Sampling) 三步：从 locale style guide 归纳层级分类法；按该分类法对语料分段分类；在固定评测预算下联合优化稀有类别覆盖、文档级连贯性与对完整语料的分布保真来选子集。
Result: 在四个翻译方向的 MT 评测上，TACTICS 对稀有类别的覆盖优于基于词面 (lexical) 与基于 embedding 的选择；在存在真实质量差距处，它用远少于随机采样的片段恢复出真实系统排序，在不存在差距处从不误报差异。
Conclusion: 把评测覆盖当成显式优化目标，固定预算就能更有效地分辨 MT 系统：优先覆盖能区分系统的现象，既省片段又不制造虚假差距。

papers.title: Large Distant Gradients Need Not Be Reliable: reliability-weighted credit assignment for long-horizon autoregressive forecasting
papers.abstract_en: In autoregressive forecasting, long prediction rollouts provide distant supervision, but backpropagation through time (BPTT) carries gradients from those losses through many autoregressive steps. Repeated Jacobian products can make distant gradients dominate the update while amplifying predictable signal and unpredictable innovation together; a large distant gradient therefore need not carry reliable learning signal. Motivated by this, we introduce Internal Dual-Wiener routing (Internal-DW), a backward-only intervention that preserves the full forward rollout and all step losses while reliability-weighting internal gradient routes. At each residual block, we derive bounded Wiener gains for the identity and nonlinear routes that balance preserving predictable learning signal against suppressing unpredictable variation, and estimate them from route-level gradient statistics and an explicit noise model. In a controlled system with known gradient signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), we show that distant gradients can grow even as their SNR falls, and that Internal-DW reduces error in recovering predictable gradient signals and improves forecasting. On four history-dominated, weak-drive testbeds, Internal-DW reduces forecast error by 5.2%-13.8% relative to full BPTT, outperforms gradient clipping and Jacobian regularization on three testbeds, with similar performance on shear flow, and outperforms validation-selected truncated BPTT (TBPTT) on three. It also extends or preserves the fitted optimal training-horizon range across these four testbeds. Across benchmarks, the current Internal-DW estimator has a clear applicability boundary: its benefit diminishes or reverses when usable history is limited or when the selected sampler fails to represent dominant drive-dependent variation. The results show that retaining long-horizon supervision does not require trusting every backward contribution equally.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 长程自回归预报中，BPTT 把远端损失的梯度经多步 Jacobian 乘积回传，远端梯度变大时其信噪比 (SNR) 反而下降，携带的可靠学习信号未必更多。作者提出 backward-only 的 Internal Dual-Wiener routing (Internal-DW)：保留完整前向 rollout 与各步损失，在每个残差块用有界 Wiener 增益对恒等路与非线路做可靠性加权。在四个 history-dominated、弱驱动 testbed 上，Internal-DW 相对全量 BPTT 降低预报误差 5.2%–13.8%。
Motivation: 长 rollout 提供远距离监督，但重复 Jacobian 乘积会让远端梯度主导更新，并把可预测信号与不可预测 innovation 一起放大，大梯度不等于可靠的学习信号。
Method: Internal-DW 是只改反向的干预：前向 rollout 与各步损失完全不动。在每个残差块上推导恒等路与非线路的有界 Wiener 增益，用路线级梯度统计加显式噪声模型估计，在保留可预测学习信号与抑制不可预测变化之间做权衡；另在一个已知梯度 SNR 的受控系统上做验证。
Result: 在已知梯度 SNR 的受控系统中，远端梯度可在 SNR 下降的同时增大，Internal-DW 降低可预测梯度信号的恢复误差并改善预报。在四个 history-dominated 弱驱动 testbed 上，Internal-DW 相对全量 BPTT 降低预报误差 5.2%–13.8%；在三个 testbed 上优于 gradient clipping 与 Jacobian regularization，在 shear flow 上与之相当；在三个 testbed 上优于按验证集选择的 TBPTT，并在四个 testbed 上扩展或保持了拟合出的最优训练时程范围。
Conclusion: 保留长时程监督不等于要同等信任每一条反向贡献，按梯度可靠性加权即可；但当可用历史有限、或所选 sampler 无法代表主导的 drive-dependent 变化时，Internal-DW 的收益会减弱甚至反转。
Relevance: 47

papers.title: Robust PAC Learning of Concurrent Stochastic Games
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the first Probably Approximately Correct (PAC) learning framework for general-sum concurrent stochastic games (CSGs) with transition uncertainty, while addressing the challenge of Nash equilibrium (NE) existence. Our algorithm maintains data-driven $L^1$ confidence sets over transition kernels and solves a robust CSG to compute a social-welfare optimal $\varepsilon$-NE, using a robust MDP-based exploration mechanism to drive joint state-action coverage. Crucially, we introduce a Nash margin characterisation that enables principled reasoning about equilibrium existence: the framework either returns an $\varepsilon$-approximate NE whose social-welfare value is $\varepsilon$-close to optimal, or provides a sound certificate that no exact NE exists. Under a minimum reachability condition $p_{\mathrm{reach}}>0$ over relevant state-action pairs, the algorithm terminates after a polynomial number of trajectory samples, with sample complexity $\widetilde{O}\left( {R_{\max}^2 H^4 |S|^2 |A| / (p_{\mathrm{reach}} \varepsilon^2)} \right)$. Empirical results on benchmark CSGs demonstrate near-optimal performance, correct handling of equilibrium (non-)existence, and sample complexity consistent with theory.
papers.comment: Camera-ready version of a paper accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Main text: 10 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables; Appendix: 22 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Minor revisions to the experiment compute resources
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 首次为带转移不确定性的通用和并发随机博弈 (CSG) 给出 PAC 学习框架：维护转移核的 L1 置信集、求解鲁棒 CSG 得到社会福利最优的 ε-NE，并用鲁棒 MDP 探索机制驱动状态-动作覆盖。在最小可达性条件 p_reach>0 下多项式样本终止，样本复杂度为 Õ(R²_max H⁴ |S|² |A| / (p_reach ε²))；基准 CSG 上表现近最优，且能正确判定均衡存在与否。
Motivation: 并发随机博弈的转移核未知时，既要在有限样本下学到近似 Nash 均衡，又要处理均衡可能根本不存在的情况，此前缺少统一的 PAC 学习框架。
Method: 对转移核维护数据驱动的 L1 置信集，求解鲁棒 CSG 以计算社会福利最优的 ε-NE；用基于鲁棒 MDP 的探索机制保证联合状态-动作覆盖；引入 Nash margin 刻画，使框架能区分返回 ε-NE 与给出“不存在精确 NE”的可靠证书。
Result: 样本复杂度为 Õ(R²_max H⁴ |S|² |A| / (p_reach ε²))，在 p_reach>0 下多项式轨迹样本内终止；基准 CSG 实验显示近最优表现、正确处理均衡（不）存在情形，且实测样本复杂度与理论一致。
Conclusion: Nash margin 刻画加鲁棒 MDP 探索，可让 CSG 的 PAC 学习在有限样本内同时给出近似均衡或“无精确 NE”的可靠证书。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Implications of Linguistic Illegibility for LLM Security
papers.abstract_en: LLMs are trained to generate natural language. However, various strands of evidence indicate that an LLM's externalized linguistic outputs and mechanistically-extracted linguistic features can be an unreliable lens for understanding internal model computation. We introduce the term ``linguistic illegibility'' to broadly refer to scenarios in which an LLM's externalized or mechanistically-probed language artifacts fail to represent how the model actually thinks. We argue that the specter of linguistic illegibility is unavoidable for LLMs whose internal computations are not directly expressed via language, but rather math over activation spaces (with lossy translations between activation spaces and natural language happening at the bookends). If linguistic illegibility is always possible, then security mechanisms that rely on a model's linguistic self-reporting (e.g., chain-of-thought monitoring, constitutional self-critique, activation probing for linguistically-defined feature vectors) can never be completely sound; the model sandbox will always need isolation techniques whose guarantees do not depend on reading a model's linguistic state at all. We argue that observing a model's outputs using taint tracking is a promising approach for an effective sandbox: regardless of how a model linguistically self-reports, a taint tracking policy can define, a priori, various pieces of system state that should never be influenced by model-produced data. We also discuss several additional sandboxing mechanisms (e.g., robust virtualization, third-party auditing of sandboxing configurations) which collectively provide a critical floor beneath linguistic monitoring, and would have mitigated recent sandbox exploits by frontier models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出“语言不可读性 (linguistic illegibility)”概念：LLM 的外部语言输出与机制提取的语言特征无法可靠反映其内部以激活空间上的数学运算进行的计算，因此依赖语言自报告的安全机制（chain-of-thought 监控、constitutional self-critique、针对语言定义特征向量的 activation probing）不可能完全可靠。作者主张沙箱必须依赖不读取语言状态的隔离技术，其中对模型输出做 taint tracking 是有前景的方案：先验规定哪些系统状态绝不能被模型产生的数据影响。
Motivation: LLM 安全机制普遍假设模型的语言自报告可信，但内部计算与自然语言之间存在有损翻译，使这类监控在原理上无法完全可靠，沙箱因此缺少不依赖语言的保证底线。
Method: 论证路线：把语言不可读性刻画为内部激活运算与两端有损语言翻译的必然产物，据此论证语言自报告类安全机制不可完全 sound；提出以 taint tracking 策略定义不可被模型数据污染的系统状态，并列举 robust virtualization、第三方沙箱配置审计等补充机制。
Result: 本文为论证性工作，给出的结论是语言监控类安全机制不可能完全 sound，taint tracking 策略可先验定义禁止被模型数据影响的系统状态，所述沙箱机制组合足以缓解近期前沿模型的沙箱逃逸利用。
Conclusion: 只要内部计算不直接以语言表达，语言不可读性就不可避免，沙箱必须以不依赖读取模型语言状态的隔离保证为底线，语言监控只能是其上的补充层。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: End-to-End Quantum Semantic Communication with Variational Quantum Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Quantum-enabled learning is increasingly being explored for future communication and networking applications, including distributed sensing, Internet of Things (IoT), and distributed quantum computing. However, existing approaches often face challenges in scalable inference and efficient information processing. To address these limitations, this paper integrates quantum machine learning (QML) with quantum semantic communication (QSemCom) in an end-to-end learning framework. A classical dataset is first mapped to a low-dimensional feature representation and encoded by a variational quantum transmitter that learns task-relevant semantic features. The resulting features are transmitted through a quantum channel and processed by a receiver to perform a downstream classification task. The proposed framework is evaluated using the MNIST dataset and variational quantum neural networks (QNNs) under ideal and noisy quantum-channel conditions. First, a baseline model is trained over an ideal channel and evaluated under increasing depolarizing noise without retraining. A second set of experiments introduces a trainable receiver QNN and jointly optimizes the transmitter and receiver through end-to-end (E2E) training. The results demonstrate that jointly trained quantum semantic transceivers can adapt the transmitted representation to channel impairments and preserve task-relevant information, highlighting the potential of receiver-aware QML for robust inference in quantum semantic communication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把量子语义通信 (QSemCom) 做成端到端可训练框架：变分量子发射机先学任务相关语义特征，经量子信道传输后由接收机做下游分类。在 MNIST 上，理想信道训练的基线在去极化噪声增大且不重训时性能退化，而联合优化发射机与接收机的 E2E 训练能让表示适应信道损伤、保住任务相关信息。
Motivation: 现有量子使能学习方案在可扩展推理与高效信息处理上受限，且发射端不感知信道时，语义表示在含噪量子信道下难以保持下游任务所需信息。
Method: 经典数据集先映射为低维特征表示，由变分量子发射机编码出任务相关语义特征，经量子信道传输后由接收端执行分类；对比两条路线——理想信道训练后在递增去极化噪声下直接评测（不重训），以及引入可训练接收机 QNN 后对收发两端做端到端联合优化。
Result: 在 MNIST 数据集、变分量子神经网络 (QNN) 上，于理想与含噪量子信道两种条件下评测：基线在理想信道训练后面对递增去极化噪声不重训即退化；联合训练的量子语义收发机可调整所传表示以适应信道损伤并保留任务相关信息。
Conclusion: 接收机感知的 QML（收发端 E2E 联合训练）是量子语义通信中抗信道损伤、保持下游推理鲁棒性的有效路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hidden in the Request: Explaining Unethical LLM Compliance through Token Relevance
papers.abstract_en: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) are aligned to optimize for both helpfulness and harmlessness, these dual objectives may conflict, inevitably leading to alignment failures. This work systematically investigates instances where LLMs fail to exhibit ethical behavior. To understand the underlying mechanics of these vulnerabilities, we introduce a probing methodology that presents unethical scenarios to LLMs in three distinct structural modalities: objective classification tasks, subjective first-person statements, and direct requests for assistance. We find that model performance degrades in the request-for-assistance-based form. Using Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP), we trace this discrepancy to an attribution bias: the model places greater emphasis on benign task-framing tokens (e.g., "Can you help me...") than on tokens signaling the underlying unethical behavior (e.g., "without getting caught"), which we term cue-tokens. We hypothesize that this under-attribution contributes to harmful compliance. To test this, we introduce two LRP-guided decoding methods that steer generation toward trajectories more relevant to cue tokens. Empirical evaluations show that these interventions promote safer responses, supporting cue-token attribution's role in compliance failures.
papers.journal_ref: NeurIPS 2026, SocialAgent Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 在「请求协助」形式的不道德提示下更容易违规服从，LRP 归因显示模型把更多权重放在「Can you help me...」这类良性任务框架 token 上，而低估了标示不道德行为的 cue-tokens（如「without getting caught」）。两种 LRP 引导的解码干预把生成拉向与 cue-token 更相关的轨迹，实证评估显示回应更安全。
Motivation: helpfulness 与 harmlessless 两个对齐目标冲突会造成对齐失败，但同一不道德内容在不同句式结构下服从度差异的内部机制尚不清楚。
Method: 用三种结构模态呈现不道德场景：客观分类任务、主观第一人称陈述、直接请求协助；再用 Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP) 做 token 级归因，定位 cue-tokens 与良性框架 token 的权重差异，并据此设计两种 LRP 引导的解码方法干预生成。
Result: 请求协助形式下模型表现下降；LRP 归因显示良性任务框架 token 的相关性高于 cue-tokens；两种 LRP 引导解码干预的实证评估显示生成更安全的回应。
Conclusion: 对 cue-token 的归因不足是 LLM 不道德服从的成因之一，按 LRP 归因做解码引导可缓解该类合规失败。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.tldr: LLM 在「请求协助」形式的不道德提示下更容易违规服从，LRP 归因显示模型把更多权重放在「Can you help me...」这类良性任务框架 token 上，而低估了标示不道德行为的 cue-tokens（如「without getting caught」）。两种 LRP 引导的解码干预把生成拉向与 cue-token 更相关的轨迹，实证评估显示回应更安全。
summary_sections.motivation: helpfulness 与 harmlessless 两个对齐目标冲突会造成对齐失败，但同一不道德内容在不同句式结构下服从度差异的内部机制尚不清楚。
summary_sections.method: 用三种结构模态呈现不道德场景：客观分类任务、主观第一人称陈述、直接请求协助；再用 Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP) 做 token 级归因，定位 cue-tokens 与良性框架 token 的权重差异，并据此设计两种 LRP 引导的解码方法干预生成。
summary_sections.result: 请求协助形式下模型表现下降；LRP 归因显示良性任务框架 token 的相关性高于 cue-tokens；两种 LRP 引导解码干预的实证评估显示生成更安全的回应。
summary_sections.conclusion: 对 cue-token 的归因不足是 LLM 不道德服从的成因之一，按 LRP 归因做解码引导可缓解该类合规失败。

papers.title: Dual-Primal Graph VAEs for Noisy Label Aggregation
papers.abstract_en: Inferring the ground-truth from noisy crowdsourced labels is an important theoretical and practical problem. Neural network-based methods offer an alternative to classical Bayesian models which require specifying a family of generative models used for inference. However, current models either still rely on fairly simple generative models for inference or require pseudo-labels or synthetic data to train the aggregate classifier. We propose a graph VAE architecture in which the decoder and encoder use GAT-based message passing on the adjacency graph of a crowdsourced dataset and its dual, respectively. The ground-truth labels are treated as latent variables, enabling unsupervised representation learning without needing to train a separate classifier. We show our model achieves state of the art performance on crowdsourcing benchmarks. We then demonstrate the generality of our approach by showing how the original crowdsourcing graph can be augmented to incorporate side information such as representations from neural network classifiers trained on the noisy labels to substantially boost their classification performance at test time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Dual-Primal Graph VAE：解码器与编码器分别在众包数据集的邻接图及其对偶图上做 GAT 消息传递，把真实标签当作隐变量，从而无需单独训练聚合分类器即可无监督学习表示。在众包基准上达到 state of the art，并可通过并入神经网络分类器表示等侧信息来增强原图，显著提升测试时分类性能。
Motivation: 从含噪众包标签推断真实标签是经典问题：现有神经方法要么生成模型过于简单，要么依赖伪标签或合成数据来训练聚合分类器。
Method: 提出 graph VAE 架构，解码器在众包数据集的邻接图上用 GAT 消息传递，编码器在其对偶图上做 GAT 消息传递；真实标签作为隐变量，实现无需单独分类器的无监督表示学习。进一步把原众包图与侧信息（如在含噪标签上训练的神经网络分类器表示）拼接增强。
Result: 在众包基准 (crowdsourcing benchmarks) 上达到 state of the art 性能；加入侧信息增强后可显著提升分类器在测试时的分类性能。
Conclusion: 对偶图上的 graph VAE 能在不依赖伪标签或合成数据的条件下完成标签聚合，且图增强机制可把外部分类器表示接入同一框架。

papers.title: Faster-WAM: Do World Action Models Need Deep Action Modules?
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) build on pretrained video models, whose representations are grounded in physical dynamics and provide a natural basis for action prediction. Despite this natural foundation, many WAMs still rely on deep, parameter-heavy action-prediction modules that incur high inference latency and may overfit to limited robot demonstrations, restricting their real-world applicability. In this paper, we advocate a world-model-centric principle that concentrates capacity and computation in the video world model, while a lightweight action expert translates the backbone's representations into executable robot actions. We realize this principle through three key choices: Dock of Transformers (DoT) with Lite KV-Fusion to give the shallow, lightweight action expert access to representations from all video layers; world-model-only conditioning of the action expert; and retracted 1D-RoPE for positional alignment between video keys and action queries. We test this principle using Faster-WAM, a world-model-centric WAM with only a single-layer action expert. Despite this restriction on action-specific computation, Faster-WAM achieves competitive control performance on LIBERO and RoboTwin~2.0 without additional embodied pretraining. It provides approximately $3.7\times$ and $1.3\times$ inference speedups over Fast-WAM and $π_{0.5}$, respectively. Consistent with its world-model-centric design, Faster-WAM demonstrates stronger generalizability under distribution shifts: the same LIBERO-trained policy achieves $78.3\%$ success on LIBERO-Plus, exceeding Fast-WAM and LingBot-VA by $26.8$ and $8.8$ percentage points, respectively. Finally, real-robot experiments demonstrate success rates comparable to Fast-WAM, with substantially lower inference latency and shorter task-completion times.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Faster-WAM 主张把容量和算力集中在预训练视频世界模型上，动作预测只用单层轻量 action expert：通过 Dock of Transformers (DoT) 配合 Lite KV-Fusion 让浅层专家访问全部视频层表征，动作专家只以世界模型为条件，并用 retracted 1D-RoPE 对齐视频 key 与 action query。在不加具身预训练的前提下，LIBERO 与 RoboTwin 2.0 上控制性能有竞争力，推理比 Fast-WAM 快约 3.7 倍、比 π0.5 快约 1.3 倍；分布偏移下同一 LIBERO 训练策略在 LIBERO-Plus 达 78.3% 成功率，高出 Fast-WAM 与 LingBot-VA 分别 26.8 和 8.8 个百分点。
Motivation: 许多 World Action Model 仍依赖参数量大、延迟高的深层动作预测模块，在有限机器人演示上易过拟合，限制了真实部署。
Method: 三个设计选择：Dock of Transformers (DoT) 加 Lite KV-Fusion，让单层浅动作专家读取全部视频层表征；动作专家只以世界模型为条件（world-model-only conditioning）；用 retracted 1D-RoPE 做视频 key 与 action query 的位置对齐。整体即 Faster-WAM，动作专家仅一层，无需额外具身预训练。
Result: 在 LIBERO 与 RoboTwin 2.0 上取得有竞争力的控制性能；推理加速约 3.7 倍（对 Fast-WAM）与 1.3 倍（对 π0.5）。分布偏移下，同一 LIBERO 训练策略在 LIBERO-Plus 上成功率 78.3%，比 Fast-WAM 与 LingBot-VA 分别高 26.8 与 8.8 个百分点。真机实验成功率与 Fast-WAM 相当，但推理延迟更低、任务完成时间更短。
Conclusion: 把容量集中到视频世界模型、动作侧只留单层专家，可以在不牺牲控制性能的前提下大幅降延迟，并在分布偏移下获得更强泛化。

papers.title: ReToken: Improving Long-Context VLMs with Visual Retrieval Token
papers.abstract_en: Long visual contexts challenge vision-language models: performance degrades as the number of distractors grows, and processing all tokens at once can exceed GPU memory limits. We present RETOKEN, a single learnable embedding that extracts retrieval signals from the VLM's internal representations to select query-relevant visual tokens from the pre-filled KV cache. This enables retrieval within the answering VLM, without a separate retriever or re-encoding. Despite being trained on only a small image-QA dataset, RETOKEN generalizes across image and video benchmarks. On Visual Haystacks, it improves Qwen3VL-8B by 13.4 points and InternVL3.5 by 12.4 points (>20% relative). On LVBench, it transfers zero-shot to long video and improves Qwen3VL-8B by 8.0 points. Thanks to its lightweight design, both training and long-video inference fit on a single H100. Code is available at: https://github.com/avaxiao/ReToken
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReToken 用一个可学习的 embedding 从 VLM 内部表征中提取检索信号，在已预填充的 KV cache 里挑选与问题相关的视觉 token，从而在答题模型内部完成检索，无需独立检索器或重编码。在 Visual Haystacks 上把 Qwen3VL-8B 提升 13.4 点、InternVL3.5 提升 12.4 点（相对提升 >20%），在 LVBench 上零样本迁移提升 Qwen3VL-8B 8.0 点。
Motivation: 长视觉上下文里干扰项增多会导致 VLM 性能下降，而一次性处理全部 token 会超出 GPU 显存；现有做法需要独立检索器或重编码。
Method: ReToken 是单个可学习 embedding，从 VLM 内部表征抽取检索信号，在预填充的 KV cache 上选择与 query 相关的视觉 token，实现答题模型内部的检索；仅用一个小型 image-QA 数据集训练，训练与长视频推理均可放在单张 H100 上。
Result: Visual Haystacks 上 Qwen3VL-8B 提升 13.4 点、InternVL3.5 提升 12.4 点（相对 >20%）；LVBench 上零样本迁移到长视频，Qwen3VL-8B 提升 8.0 点；训练与长视频推理均在单张 H100 上完成。
Conclusion: 在答题 VLM 内部用一个轻量可学习 token 做 KV cache 检索，即可跨图像与视频基准泛化，且无需独立检索器或重编码。

papers.title: SWE-NFI: Studying and Benchmarking Coding Agents for Non-Functional Improvements
papers.abstract_en: Although coding agents have achieved impressive performance on correctness-oriented benchmarks, their ability to make behavior-preserving non-functional improvements (NFIs) remains underexplored. In real-world software development, developers continuously improve software quality without changing observable behavior, yet existing benchmarks primarily evaluate functional correctness and provide limited support for assessing these non-functional improvements. In this paper, we present SWE-NFI, a benchmark for evaluating coding agents on NFIs beyond functional correctness. SWE-NFI contains 188 tasks constructed from real merged pull requests in open-source Python projects. We operationalize five developer-oriented NFI aspects into 92 executable rules and develop an evaluation suite that first applies task-specific functional preservation checks to assess whether key properties of the original code are preserved and then performs rule-based NFI evaluation. For outputs that pass these checks, we measure NFI improvement as the change in the normalized rule score for the task's target aspect relative to the original code. We evaluate eight commercial and open-source agent configurations and run each configuration five times on every task. At most 70.0% of valid agent outputs satisfy all task-specific functional preservation checks. Among outputs that pass these checks, NFI performance varies substantially across aspects. In particular, all evaluated configurations achieve mean Logic Patterns improvements between 0.0 and 1.3, below the Human Reference mean of 1.5. Our benchmark and findings provide a reproducible foundation for evaluating coding agents on non-functional improvements and identifying the NFI aspects where further advances are needed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SWE-NFI 是一个评测 coding agent 能否在不改变可观察行为的前提下做非功能改进 (NFI) 的基准，含 188 个来自开源 Python 项目真实合并 PR 的任务，把 5 个面向开发者的 NFI 维度拆成 92 条可执行规则。评测先做任务特定的功能保持检查，再按规则打分并算归一化规则分相对原代码的变化；8 个商业与开源 agent 配置各跑 5 次，最多只有 70.0% 的有效输出通过全部功能保持检查，Logic Patterns 维度所有配置的平均提升仅 0.0–1.3，低于 Human Reference 的 1.5。
Motivation: 现有 coding agent 基准主要测功能正确性，对“行为不变、质量提升”这类真实开发中持续进行的非功能改进缺少可评测的支撑。
Method: 从真实 merged PR 构造 188 个任务，把 5 个开发者导向的 NFI 维度操作化为 92 条可执行规则；评测套件先跑任务特定的功能保持检查，通过后再做基于规则的 NFI 评测，用目标维度归一化规则分相对原代码的变化度量提升；评测 8 个商业与开源 agent 配置，每个任务每配置跑 5 次。
Result: 最多 70.0% 的有效 agent 输出通过全部任务特定功能保持检查；通过检查的输出中各 NFI 维度表现差异很大，Logic Patterns 上所有配置的平均提升在 0.0 到 1.3 之间，均低于 Human Reference 的 1.5。
Conclusion: coding agent 在功能保持约束下做非功能改进的能力明显不足，Logic Patterns 是当前各配置普遍落后于人类参考的短板维度。

papers.title: When to Plan: Learning to Select Between Reactive Control and Deliberative Planning
papers.abstract_en: It has long been recognized that humans have the ability to switch between fast, reactive decision-making and slower, deliberative planning. In this paper, we study the question of how to learn this ability, known as meta-reasoning, in artificial agents. We model reactive decision-making as a policy that directly maps state observations to actions. Such policies can be trained with reinforcement learning (RL) or imitation learning, but may generalize poorly outside of their training distribution. Alternatively, model-based decision-time planning is more likely to produce good actions across a broader set of states but requires additional computation time, which delays acting. In this work, we introduce an RL method for training a meta-reasoning policy that allocates computation by conditioning on a reactive-policy uncertainty score. This score enables it to predict when the reactive policy is likely to perform poorly and when planning is needed. We conduct an empirical study on motion planning and navigation environments, showing that this design enables the meta-reasoning policy to learn when the reactive policy provides a good-enough action versus when decision-time planning is needed. Additionally, we show that our design enables the meta-agent to shift toward fully reactive control as the reactive policy improves.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种元推理 (meta-reasoning) 策略的 RL 训练方法，以反应式策略的不确定性分数为条件来分配计算：预测反应式策略何时会表现差、何时需要决策时规划。在运动规划与导航环境的实证研究中，该设计使元策略学会判断反应式动作何时够用、何时需启动规划，并随反应式策略变好而转向完全反应式控制。
Motivation: 反应式策略训练快但训练分布外泛化差，基于模型的决策时规划覆盖状态更广却要额外计算时间、延迟行动；缺少在两者之间按需切换的学习机制。
Method: 把反应式决策建模为状态到动作的策略（RL 或模仿学习训练），训练一个元推理策略按反应式策略的不确定性分数条件化地分配计算，决定直接行动还是触发决策时规划。
Result: 在运动规划与导航环境上的实证研究表明：元推理策略能学会判断反应式策略给出的动作何时够好、何时需要决策时规划；且随反应式策略改进，元智能体转向完全反应式控制。
Conclusion: 以反应式策略不确定性为条件的元推理策略可以在反应式控制与审慎规划之间按需切换，并随底层策略质量提升自动减少规划开销。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 提出一种元推理 (meta-reasoning) 策略的 RL 训练方法，以反应式策略的不确定性分数为条件来分配计算：预测反应式策略何时会表现差、何时需要决策时规划。在运动规划与导航环境的实证研究中，该设计使元策略学会判断反应式动作何时够用、何时需启动规划，并随反应式策略变好而转向完全反应式控制。

papers.title: Curvature-Guided Module Localization for Low-Rank Detoxification of Backdoored Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Backdoor attacks pose a serious threat to large language models (LLMs) by causing otherwise benign systems to produce attacker-specified malicious behavior when a hidden trigger is present. In this work, we study post hoc detoxification of backdoored LLMs in a practical setting where the defender has access to the poisoned model but does not wish to retrain the full network from scratch. We propose a mechanistically guided weight-space repair framework that first localizes modules involved in propagating trigger-induced behavior using activation patching and Fisher/K-FAC curvature analysis, and then applies targeted low-rank repair to only the most influential modules. We evaluate the method on poisoned variants of \texttt{Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct} with triggers inserted at the beginning, middle, and end of otherwise benign prompts. Results show that the proposed approach substantially suppresses trigger-conditioned malicious responses while preserving benign model behavior. These findings suggest that backdoor removal in LLMs can be formulated as a localized structural repair problem rather than only a broad behavioral alignment problem.
papers.comment: Accepted for presentation at the 2026 IEEE Military Communications Conference (MILCOM 2026), Washington, D.C., USA, October 12-16, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对已投毒 LLM 的事后净化，提出机制引导的权重空间修复框架：先用 activation patching 与 Fisher/K-FAC 曲率分析定位传播触发行为的模块，再只对最有影响力的模块做低秩修复 (low-rank repair)。在 Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct 的投毒变体上，触发词位于提示开头、中间、结尾三种位置时，均显著压低触发条件下的恶意输出并保持良性行为。
Motivation: 防御方只有被投毒的模型、不愿从头重训全网，而现有后门移除多当作宽泛的行为对齐问题，缺少对触发传播模块的定位。
Method: 机制引导的权重空间修复：activation patching 结合 Fisher/K-FAC 曲率分析定位对触发诱导行为影响最大的模块，再对这些模块施加定向低秩修复，不重训整个网络。
Result: 在 Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct 的投毒变体上，触发词分别插入良性提示的开头、中间、结尾时，触发条件下的恶意响应被大幅抑制，同时良性行为得以保留；摘要给出的是定性结论，无具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 作者主张 LLM 后门移除可表述为局部结构性修复问题，而非单纯的广义行为对齐问题。

papers.title: Geological text descriptions in ill-posed inverse problems: insights from learned hydraulic-conductivity inversion
papers.abstract_en: Hydraulic-conductivity inversion is ill posed: even complete head observations can leave structural ambiguity. Geological text descriptions can supply additional information about subsurface structure to constrain reconstruction. However, it remains unclear when descriptions improve reconstruction and how solvers use their stated content. We examine these questions in learned inversion using a synthetic Darcy-flow benchmark with idealised descriptions, varying observation density and flow direction. After sparse-observation training, descriptions can improve reconstruction over models trained without them when observations leave structural ambiguity, though gains vary across conditions and runs. Instance-specific content can improve reconstruction beyond field-type information. Editing this content shifts reconstructions toward the stated geometry of selected features, less strongly as observations become more informative about those features. We do not establish a reconstruction advantage of text over numerical inputs encoding the same geological information. Finally, we discuss how this complementarity could guide the joint design of measurements and geological knowledge acquisition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在合成 Darcy-flow 水力传导率反演中加入理想化地质文本描述，稀疏观测训练后，当观测本身留下结构歧义时描述能改善重建；实例级内容比单纯场类型信息带来额外提升，编辑该内容会把重建推向所描述的目标几何，且观测越能约束该特征时编辑效应越弱。作者明确未确立文本相对编码同等地质信息的数值输入的重建优势。
Motivation: 水力传导率反演是不适定问题，即使完整水头观测也可能留下结构歧义；地质文本可补充地下结构信息，但尚不清楚描述何时改善重建、求解器如何使用其陈述内容。
Method: 在合成 Darcy-flow 基准上做 learned inversion，使用理想化地质描述，系统改变观测密度与流向；先做稀疏观测训练，再比较有/无描述的模型，并对描述中的实例级内容做编辑以观察重建响应。
Result: 当观测留下结构歧义时，带描述的模型优于无描述训练的模型，但增益随条件与运行而变；实例级内容比场类型信息带来额外改善；编辑内容使重建向所选特征的既定几何移动，观测对该特征约束越强则移动越弱；未确立文本相对编码相同地质信息的数值输入的重建优势。
Conclusion: 文本描述与观测信息互补，其价值取决于观测留下的结构歧义程度；这种互补性可用于联合设计测量与地质知识获取。

papers.title: GRADE: Graph Representation of LLM Agent Dependency and Execution
papers.abstract_en: Traces record what LLM agents did, leaving implicit what each step relied on. GRADE holds both in one graph; six published graph views are its projections. Execution edges come free; each costly dependency edge is graded as observed in the trace, declared by added logging, or inferred under an assumption, a schema we test one grade at a time. We recover the dependency layer from six tool-use, coding, and web corpora and measure its failure-prediction gain over run size. First, over a linear run-size baseline, it improves prediction on three corpora, but the gain depends on the learner and task sampling. On held-out corpora the layer stays above chance where run size does not, under one learner, with the same task-sampling caveat. Second, structure can pass for signal it does not carry: a layer inferred under full history restates run size. Within a corpus, a preregistered test does not separate the recovered layer from a degree-matched counterfeit that rewires each step's dependencies but keeps their number. The recovered layer's largest transfer lead over it reverses when the held-out corpus's task family is withheld. Before crediting structure, grade each edge, keep a run-size baseline, and score degree-matched attachment controls.
papers.comment: 35 pages. Expanded analyses and revised figures. Code: https://github.com/yzhao062/grade
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GRADE 把 LLM agent 的执行轨迹与隐式依赖压进同一张图，依赖边按 observed / declared / inferred 三档分级，并在六个 tool-use、coding、web 语料上测其对失败预测的增益。结果是结构信号常被 run size 冒充：语料内预注册检验无法区分恢复的依赖层与保持度数的 degree-matched counterfeit，跨语料领先在扣住任务族后反转。作者主张给每条边分级、保留 run size 基线、并跑度数匹配对照，再谈结构是否有用。
Motivation: LLM agent 轨迹只记录做了什么，不记录每步依赖了什么；直接把恢复出的依赖结构当作失败预测信号，可能只是在复述 run size 这类平凡量。
Method: GRADE 将执行边与依赖边放进同一张图，依赖边按证据分为 trace 中 observed、额外日志 declared、假设下 inferred 三档，并逐档检验；在六个 tool-use、coding、web 语料上恢复依赖层，用不同 learner 与任务采样方式对比 run size 线性基线，并构造保持每步依赖数的 degree-matched counterfeit 作为预注册对照。
Result: 相对 run size 线性基线，依赖层在三个语料上提升失败预测，但增益依赖 learner 与任务采样；在 held-out 语料上仅在一种 learner 下保持高于 chance 而 run size 不行，且仍有任务采样这一条件。全历史下 inferred 的层只是复述 run size；语料内预注册检验无法把恢复层与 degree-matched counterfeit 分开，最大跨语料领先在扣住 held-out 语料任务族后反转。
Conclusion: 依赖结构的预测价值在当前检验下不稳固，可能由度数与任务族分布冒充；给边分级、保留 run size 基线并跑度数匹配对照，是把结构与平凡量区分开的最低要求。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning-Based Traffic Signal Control for IoT-Enabled Intersections
papers.abstract_en: Urban traffic congestion remains a persistent challenge in car-dependent cities, imposing significant economic and societal costs. Traffic signal systems are increasingly deployed as networked cyber-physical components within smart-city infrastructures, where distributed sensing and edge intelligence enable adaptive traffic management. This paper investigates reinforcement learning (RL) as an edge-intelligent approach for adaptive traffic signal operation at a signalized urban intersection in Kuwait. A Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)-based controller is developed to dynamically allocate green-phase durations using locally observed traffic states, without relying on future demand information or centralized coordination. The controller is evaluated in a realistic simulation environment informed by real-world hourly traffic volume data from Kuwait, and is compared against both conventional fixed-time control and a vehicle-actuated controller representing the current state of practice, using average vehicle delay, queue length, and emissions as performance metrics. Under nominal conditions, the proposed controller reduces average vehicle delay by 46% relative to fixed-time control and 34% relative to actuated control, while also lowering per-vehicle CO2 emissions by approximately 23%. These performance gains persist under demand perturbations of +/-15%, generalize from weekday to weekend traffic patterns, and are corroborated by a reward function ablation; low variance across five random seeds confirms their statistical reliability. These findings demonstrate the practicality of learning-based edge traffic signal control as a building block for IoT-enabled smart-city transportation systems, and as a deployable precursor toward fully connected, Internet of Vehicles (IoV)-based urban mobility.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, Published in IEEE Open Journal of Intelligent Transportation Systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在科威特信号交叉口上用 PPO 按本地观测动态分配绿灯时长，不依赖未来需求或中心协调。相对固定配时平均车辆延误降 46%、相对感应式控制降 34%，单车 CO2 排放降约 23%；±15% 需求扰动下收益保持，五个随机种子方差低。
Motivation: 依赖小汽车的城市里交通拥堵成本高，现有信号控制要么固定配时、要么本地感应，缺少不依赖未来需求与中心协调的自适应方案。
Method: 基于 PPO 的控制器用本地观测的交通状态动态调整绿灯相位时长，在由科威特真实小时交通量数据驱动的仿真环境中训练与评估；对照固定配时与车辆感应式控制，指标为平均车辆延误、排队长度与排放，并做奖励函数消融。
Result: 标称条件下平均车辆延误较固定配时降 46%、较感应式控制降 34%，单车 CO2 排放降约 23%；±15% 需求扰动下收益保持，且从工作日泛化到周末模式，五个随机种子间方差低。
Conclusion: 学习型边缘信号控制在真实交通量驱动的仿真中可作为 IoT 智慧城市交通的可部署基础单元，并作为面向 IoV 全联网出行的前置步骤。

papers.title: ArapaiSecure: An Autonomous AI Security Agent for Banking: Multi-Vector Fraud and AML Detection Across Retail and Corporate Accounts
papers.abstract_en: Banks face two threat families with fundamentally different detection requirements: signature-based fraud (card- not-present attacks, account takeover, ATM cloning) and behavioural financial crime (structuring, layering, mule networks, business email compromise). Static rule engines catch high-velocity events but remain blind to BEC payment redirection, session hijacking, and laundering layering, which are engineered to resemble legitimate activity at the individual level. This paper presents ArapaiSecure, an autonomous AI security agent for retail and corporate banking using a three-component fusion architecture across two parallel event streams: transactions (card fraud, ACH/wire fraud, AML) and sessions (account takeover, hijacking, SIM-swap, insider abuse). Each stream combines an LSTM sequence model of per-account behaviour, a statistical ve- locity/threshold monitor, and a graph module capturing account-counterparty patterns (fan-in, fan-out, pass-through ratio) for laundering detection. Experiments on a synthetic log of 237,669 transactions and 113,508 sessions across 13 threat categories and 3,470 accounts show that ArapaiSecure achieves an overall F1 of 0.787 (transaction) and 0.867 (session), versus 0.562/0.733 for a rule-based baseline and 0.655/0.713 for an LSTM-only baseline. ArapaiSecure also incorporates a customer-facing verification chatbot (96.6% identity accuracy, 86.8% mass-reset detection) and an analyst case-summary assistant (99.3% action recommendation F1), with Critical-tier response latency under 0.43 ms at the 95th percentile.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ArapaiSecure 把交易流与会话流并行建模，每条流用 LSTM 序列模型、统计速度/阈值监测器和图模块三路融合，覆盖 13 类威胁。在 237,669 笔交易、113,508 条会话、3,470 个账户的合成日志上，交易/会话 F1 达 0.787/0.867，明显高于规则基线 0.562/0.733 与纯 LSTM 基线 0.655/0.713。
Motivation: 静态规则引擎能抓高频签名型欺诈，却对 BEC 支付重定向、会话劫持、分层洗钱这类在个体层面伪装成正常行为的金融犯罪失明；零售与账户接管、企业与洗钱网络的检测需求又截然不同。
Method: 三组件融合架构并行处理交易流（卡欺诈、ACH/电汇欺诈、AML）与会话流（账户接管、劫持、SIM-swap、内部滥用）；每条流由 LSTM 行为序列模型、统计速度/阈值监测器、以及刻画账户-对手方 fan-in、fan-out、pass-through ratio 的图模块组成。另配面向客户的验证聊天bot与分析师案情摘要助手。
Result: 在 237,669 笔交易、113,508 条会话、13 类威胁、3,470 个账户的合成日志上，整体 F1 为交易 0.787、会话 0.867；规则基线为 0.562/0.733，纯 LSTM 基线为 0.655/0.713。验证聊天bot 身份识别准确率 96.6%、批量重置检测 86.8%；分析师助手动作推荐 F1 99.3%；Critical 级响应延迟 95 分位低于 0.43 ms。
Conclusion: 把序列、速度规则与图模式三条线索在双事件流上融合，可在合成银行日志上同时覆盖签名型欺诈与行为型金融犯罪，并把 F1 相对规则引擎抬高约 0.225（交易）与 0.134（会话）。

papers.title: Hidden in Plain Sight: Benchmarking Agent Safety Against Decomposition Attacks with DECOMPBENCH
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based Agents are becoming increasingly capable and widely deployed, creating growing incentives for adversarial misuse in the real-world. A key emerging threat is Decomposition Attacks \cite{glukhov2024breach, jones2024adversaries} in which a harmful task is broken into simpler, benign subtasks that evade safety mechanisms when executed separately but cumulatively fulfill the malicious intent. Although recent benchmarks assess agent safety in multi-turn and multi-tool-use settings, they do not explicitly capture this form of decompositional misuse and may not represent realistic adversarial execution flows. To this end, we introduce DeCompBench, a benchmark designed specifically to evaluate agentic safety under decomposition attacks. DeCompBench is created with a decomposition-by-design principle using a graphical framework and enables harmful task decomposition into individually benign and executable subtasks with realistic workflows. Our experiments using a custom decomposer show that state-of-the-art agents exhibit high refusal rates on monolithic harmful tasks, but significantly lower refusal rates on their decomposed variants, while often inadvertently fulfilling the adversarial objectives. These findings underscore the need for safety evaluations against decomposition attacks and corresponding defenses. Our dataset is publicly available and can be found at https://huggingface.co/datasets/decompositionbench/DeCompBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DeCompBench：按 decomposition-by-design 原则用图框架把有害任务拆成单独看良性、可执行且工作流真实的子任务序列，专门评测智能体在分解攻击下的安全性。用自研 decomposer 实验发现，SOTA 智能体对整块有害任务拒绝率高，对其分解版本拒绝率显著更低，并常常无意间完成了对抗目标。
Motivation: 现有智能体安全基准覆盖多轮与多工具场景，但不显式捕捉把有害任务拆成良性子任务、逐段执行却累积达成恶意意图的分解攻击 (Decomposition Attacks)，也未必反映真实对抗执行流。
Method: DeCompBench 采用 decomposition-by-design 原则，基于图 (graphical) 框架生成有害任务的分解，得到单独良性、可执行且带真实工作流的子任务序列；评测时用一个自研 decomposer (custom decomposer) 构造分解变体，对照整块有害任务测智能体的拒绝行为。
Result: 实验显示：state-of-the-art 智能体对整块 (monolithic) 有害任务拒绝率高，对其分解变体拒绝率显著降低，并且常常无意中满足了对抗目标。数据集已公开于 huggingface.co/datasets/decompositionbench/DeCompBench。
Conclusion: 整块任务上的高拒绝率不能代表智能体对分解攻击的安全性，安全评测与相应防御必须显式覆盖分解式滥用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Resilience-as-a-Service assessment framework for coordinated disruption response in interdependent urban transit systems
papers.abstract_en: Urban public transport disruptions require rapid response strategies, yet existing studies rarely provide a decision support framework to compare alternative disruption response solutions using a common set of dynamic, passenger, operator, and environment oriented indicators. This paper proposes a KPI-driven, time-indexed framework to assess the resilience of disruption response solutions in urban transit systems. The framework combines an optimization model with a behavioral evaluation in agent-based simulation. It also underlays the secondary service degradation induced on helper lines when in-service vehicles are withdrawn to support the disrupted corridor. Rather than treating resilience as a single score, it evaluates complementary dimensions including vulnerability, adaptability, robustness, resilience loss, responsiveness, cost-based performance, emissions, and equity. The framework is implemented for the RER B transit line in the Ile-de-France (Paris) network. Results show that the coordinated strategy provides the most balanced resilience profile, combining high service continuity with lower total disruption cost than single mode alternatives, while also improving equity and maintaining competitive environmental performance. Sensitivity analysis further identifies the disruption conditions under which coordinated multimodal response is most valuable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 KPI 驱动、时间索引的城市公交中断响应韧性评估框架，把优化模型与基于智能体的行为仿真结合，并显式刻画抽调在役车辆支援中断走廊时对辅助线路造成的二次服务退化。在巴黎 RER B 线案例中，协调式多模式响应给出最均衡的韧性画像：服务连续性高、总中断成本低于单一模式方案，同时改善公平性并保持有竞争力的环境表现。
Motivation: 城市公交中断需要快速响应，但既有研究很少提供统一动态、乘客、运营者与环境指标的决策支持框架，无法横向比较不同响应方案。
Method: 框架由优化模型与智能体仿真中的行为评估组合而成，按时间索引计算 KPI，并把辅助线路的二次服务退化纳入评估；韧性不压成单一分数，而是分解为脆弱性、适应性、鲁棒性、韧性损失、响应性、成本绩效、排放与公平性等互补维度。
Result: 在 Île-de-France（巴黎）RER B 线实施：协调式策略在服务连续性与总中断成本之间最均衡，优于单一模式方案，同时改善公平性并保持有竞争力的环境绩效；敏感性分析识别出协调多模式响应最有价值的中断条件。
Conclusion: 多维度 KPI 评估下，协调式多模式中断响应比单一模式更能兼顾服务、成本、公平与排放，其优势取决于具体中断条件。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: A prism hierarchy of learning regimes in large linear autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Theoretical studies of machine learning models commonly consider different limiting regimes in which the learning dynamics of gradient descent becomes theoretically tractable. It is, however, desirable to have a systematically obtained picture of qualitatively different extreme learning regimes for a particular type of models. In this paper we propose such a picture for large weight-tied linear autoencoders characterized by input and latent dimensions, initialization magnitude, and training set size. This model is nonlinear in the weights and its gradient flow does not have a general theoretical solution. We show that at the level of the formal loss-expansion hierarchy, its extreme regimes are naturally associated with faces of a triangular prism. In particular, there are five basic extreme regimes associated with the 2-faces of the prism: (1) large-data, (2) small-data, (3) mean-field, (4) narrow-latent, and (5) free. For regimes (1,2,3,4), we derive and rigorously characterize the limiting train and population dynamics under gradient flow, rigorously prove convergence to these limits, and get good agreement with experimental results. The resulting limits reveal spectral critical slowing, initialization-driven trapping away from the PCA optimum, and regimes in which population loss converges exponentially while training loss relaxes only algebraically.
papers.comment: 95 pages; polished and slightly extended version of a paper under review for ICLR'2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把权重绑定大型线性自编码器的极端学习体制系统化为一个三棱柱几何：以输入/隐层维度、初始化幅度、训练集大小为坐标，形式化损失展开层级中的极端体制对应棱柱的面，其中五个基本极端体制对应 2-面——大数据、小数据、mean-field、窄隐层与 free。对前四类体制推导并严格刻画梯度流下的训练与总体动力学极限、证明收敛到该极限且与实验吻合，极限揭示谱临界慢化、初始化导致的偏离 PCA 最优解的捕获，以及总体损失指数收敛而训练损失仅代数松弛的体制。
Motivation: 机器学习理论通常各自研究若干可解的极限体制，缺少针对某一类模型系统得到的、定性不同的极端学习体制全景；而权重绑定线性自编码器对权重非线性，其梯度流没有一般理论解。
Method: 以输入维度、隐层维度、初始化幅度和训练集大小为参数刻画大型权重绑定线性自编码器，在形式化损失展开 (loss-expansion) 层级下把极端体制对应到三棱柱的面；对五个 2-面对应的大数据、小数据、mean-field、窄隐层、free 体制中的前四类推导梯度流下训练与总体动力学的极限并证明收敛。
Result: 五个基本极端体制对应三棱柱的 2-面；对体制 (1,2,3,4) 严格证明训练与总体动力学收敛到所推导的极限，且与实验结果吻合良好；极限行为显示谱临界慢化 (spectral critical slowing)、初始化驱动的偏离 PCA 最优的捕获，以及总体损失指数收敛而训练损失仅代数松弛的体制。
Conclusion: 大型权重绑定线性自编码器的极端学习体制可由三棱柱的面系统组织，且这些极限在严格意义下可实现并被实验验证；总体损失与训练损失的收敛速率可以在同一模型中分离为指数与代数两种行为。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: MAdam: Metric-Aware Multi-Objective Adam
papers.abstract_en: Multi-objective optimization (MOO) underlies many machine learning problems, yet MOO solvers across the loss-balancing, gradient-balancing, and Pareto-based families almost universally hand their reconciled directions to Adam~\citep{kingma2015adam}. We show this coupling introduces two systematic gaps between the solver's intent and the optimizer's execution. The first is a weighting mismatch: Adam's second-moment denominator entangles the time-varying preference vector with gradient statistics, marginalizing the preference into a history average and collapsing distinct Pareto trade-offs toward a near-uniform mixture. The second is a geometric mismatch: Adam's adaptive metric distorts the Euclidean geometry MOO solvers assume, turning aligned objectives into apparent conflicts. To resolve both jointly, we introduce MAdam (Metric-Aware Multi-Objective Adam), a drop-in wrapper that leaves both solver and optimizer unchanged. MAdam preconditions the reconciled direction by the preference-conditioned curvature of the scalarized objective; on this whitened input, Adam's second moment collapses to identity, so the realized update is governed by the preference-conditioned metric. Across multi-task learning, Pareto-front recovery, physics-informed neural networks, and medical imaging, MAdam improves over Adam in aggregate for every solver family. Our code is available at https://github.com/lfb-1/MAdam.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MAdam 指出多目标优化 (MOO) 求解器把协调后的方向交给 Adam 时存在两处系统性错位：二阶矩分母把时变偏好向量与梯度统计纠缠、把不同 Pareto 权衡压向近均匀混合，且 Adam 的自适应度量扭曲 MOO 假设的欧氏几何。MAdam 用标量化目标的偏好条件曲率对协调方向做预条件，使白化输入上 Adam 二阶矩退化为单位阵、实际更新由偏好条件度量支配；在多任务学习、Pareto 前沿恢复、物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 与医学影像四类任务上，对每个求解器家族相对 Adam 均有整体改进。
Motivation: loss-balancing、gradient-balancing 与 Pareto 三类 MOO 求解器几乎都把协调方向交给 Adam，导致求解器意图与优化器执行之间出现偏好被历史平均边缘化、以及几何被扭曲成伪冲突两处错位。
Method: MAdam 是不改动求解器与优化器的 drop-in wrapper：以标量化目标的偏好条件曲率对协调方向做预条件，使 Adam 二阶矩在白化输入上塌缩为单位阵，从而更新由偏好条件度量决定。
Result: 在多任务学习、Pareto-front recovery、physics-informed neural networks 与医学影像四类设置上，MAdam 对每一个求解器家族（loss-balancing、gradient-balancing、Pareto-based）相对 Adam 均取得整体改进；代码发布于 github.com/lfb-1/MAdam。
Conclusion: MOO 与 Adam 的耦合错位可由偏好条件曲率预条件联合消解，且该 wrapper 无需改动求解器或优化器即可跨求解器家族与跨任务域生效。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.tldr: MAdam 指出多目标优化 (MOO) 求解器把协调后的方向交给 Adam 时存在两处系统性错位：二阶矩分母把时变偏好向量与梯度统计纠缠、把不同 Pareto 权衡压向近均匀混合，且 Adam 的自适应度量扭曲 MOO 假设的欧氏几何。MAdam 用标量化目标的偏好条件曲率对协调方向做预条件，使白化输入上 Adam 二阶矩退化为单位阵、实际更新由偏好条件度量支配；在多任务学习、Pareto 前沿恢复、物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 与医学影像四类任务上，对每个求解器家族相对 Adam 均有整体改进。

papers.title: StressDream: Steering Video World Models for Robust Policy Evaluation and Improvement
papers.abstract_en: Video world models (WMs) have shown promise for policy evaluation and improvement by imagining realistic future observations conditioned on ego-robot actions. While WMs can model distributions over futures, policy evaluation and improvement typically rely on nominal imaginations, which can miss high-impact outcomes of robot actions unless prohibitively many samples are drawn. To enable robust policy evaluation and improvement over WM imaginations, we propose StressDream, which steers imaginations toward high-impact yet plausible outcomes specified at inference time by optimizing the initial noise of diffusion-based WMs. However, optimizing high-dimensional noise is challenging: the optimization must reason about nuanced, scene-dependent target events in generated videos while avoiding out-of-distribution (OOD) noise that yields implausible imaginations. We address this with two complementary objectives: a semantic objective with a Vision-Language Model that provides informative gradients by reasoning about the generated video, and a plausibility objective that prevents the optimized noise from drifting OOD. With state-of-the-art video world models for autonomous driving and robotic manipulation, we show that StressDream effectively steers imaginations toward high-impact yet plausible outcomes specified by text at inference time, such as task failures, enabling robust policy evaluation and improvement by identifying actions whose plausible futures include undesirable outcomes. Video results are available at https://stressdream.github.io/.
papers.comment: Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL) 2026. Project page: https://stressdream.github.io/

TL;DR: StressDream 在推理时优化扩散式视频世界模型的初始噪声，把想象轨迹推向文本指定的高影响但合理的结果（如任务失败），从而在不大量采样的情况下做稳健的策略评估与改进。语义目标由 Vision-Language Model 对生成视频打分提供梯度，合理性目标约束噪声不漂移到 OOD。在自动驾驶与机器人操作的前沿视频世界模型上，该方法能有效把想象导向这类高影响结果，进而识别出「合理未来中含不良后果」的动作。

papers.title: Open-Weight LLM Fine-Tuning Defenses are Susceptible to Simple Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Recent defenses for safeguarding open-weight large language models (LLMs) are intended to prevent adversarial usage. Underlying these defenses is an assumption that new harmful behavior is learned through fine-tuning rather than elicited by jailbreaking the model. Yet, pretrained LLMs already encode substantial harmful knowledge across many domains, which raises an important question: can an adversary jailbreak safeguarded models, to achieve harmful usage without fine-tuning at all? In this paper, we show that open-weight safeguards are susceptible to simpler strategies that, despite being well known, have not been systematically evaluated against these safeguards. Specifically, we evaluate two low-cost attacks--abliteration and prefilling--that do not rely on gradient-based optimization. Across three harmfulness evaluation benchmarks (BeaverTails, HarmBench, and AdvBench), these attacks increase attack success rates against safeguarded open-weight models from below 10\% to a range of 16%-96%. To mitigate this vulnerability, we introduce abliteration-resistant tuning (ART), which incorporates an abliteration-based objective into training. ART can be layered onto existing defenses and reduces the success rates of abliteration, prefilling, and their combination by 10%-20%. These findings indicate that the attack surface for open-weight models is broader than previously characterized, and that evaluations of safeguarding defenses should incorporate a more diverse set of attack strategies beyond adversarial fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 开源权重 LLM 的安全防护建立在「有害行为需通过微调获得」这一假设上，但 abliteration 与 prefilling 两种无需梯度的低成本攻击即可绕过防护，使三个有害性基准上的攻击成功率从低于 10% 升到 16%–96%。作者据此提出 abliteration-resistant tuning (ART)，把 abliteration 目标并入训练，可叠加在现有防护之上，把 abliteration、prefill 及其组合的成功率再降 10%–20%。
Motivation: 现有开源权重模型防护默认对抗方必须靠微调注入有害行为，因而评估集中在对抗微调；但预训练模型本身已编码大量有害知识，越狱即可触发，这一攻击面此前未被系统评估。
Method: 在 BeaverTails、HarmBench、AdvBench 三个有害性基准上评估两种不依赖梯度优化的攻击：abliteration 与 prefilling；并提出 ART，把 abliteration 目标写入训练过程，作为可叠加到既有防护之上的缓解手段。
Result: 两种攻击把受防护开源模型的攻击成功率从低于 10% 提升到 16%–96%（三个基准）；ART 将 abliteration、prefilling 及两者组合的成功率降低 10%–20%。
Conclusion: 开源权重模型的攻击面比此前刻画的更宽，防护评估必须纳入对抗微调之外的多样化攻击策略；ART 可叠加但只是部分缓解。

papers.title: Fourier Feature Pyramids for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: We present an improved neural field architecture for solving partial differential equations (PDEs). Current physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) provide a flexible framework for solving PDEs, but they struggle to achieve highly accurate solutions and require computation that scales poorly with parameter count. Our model, which we call beignet (Bandlimited Embedding with Interpolated Grid Network), replaces the random Fourier feature embedding used by existing PINN models with a trainable multi-resolution Fourier feature pyramid. To query beignet at a continuous coordinate, we use Fourier interpolation at each level of the pyramid to return features at the input coordinate, and then decode this vector with a fully-connected neural network trunk. Our model provides multiple benefits: 1) Spatial derivatives can be computed efficiently by using the chain rule to compose derivatives of the neural network computed with automatic differentiation with derivatives of the feature grid computed spectrally by the Fast Fourier transform (FFT). 2) beignet can achieve higher accuracy in a compute-efficient manner by scaling the parameter count of this Fourier feature pyramid, instead of the less-efficient strategy of scaling the neural network architecture. 3) beignet can directly control the representation bandlimit, resulting in more stable optimization for difficult PDEs. We demonstrate that beignet finds significantly more accurate solutions on PDE benchmarks using fewer parameters than state-of-the-art PINN methods. We further evaluate beignet on the self-similar inviscid Burgers blowup problem and show that it can minimize residuals to near machine precision using Adam, an accuracy regime previously attained only by using computationally expensive higher-order optimizers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: beignet 用可训练的多分辨率 Fourier feature pyramid 替换 PINN 的随机 Fourier 特征，配合 FFT 谱求导与可调表示带宽限制，在更少参数下显著提高 PDE 求解精度。在自相似无粘 Burgers blowup 问题上，仅用 Adam 就把残差压到接近机器精度，此前该精度只能靠计算昂贵的高阶优化器达到。
Motivation: 现有 PINN 难以取得高精度解，且计算量随参数量增长很差；扩大网络结构来换精度的策略效率低，困难 PDE 上优化也不稳定。
Method: beignet (Bandlimited Embedding with Interpolated Grid Network) 用可训练的多分辨率 Fourier feature pyramid 取代随机 Fourier 特征；查询连续坐标时在金字塔每层做 Fourier 插值得到该点特征，再由全连接网络 trunk 解码。空间导数由自动微分的网络导数与 FFT 谱计算的特征网格导数按链式法则合成；表示带宽限制可直接控制。
Result: 在 PDE benchmarks 上，beignet 用少于 SOTA PINN 方法的参数量找到显著更精确的解；在自相似无粘 Burgers blowup 问题上，用 Adam 就把残差最小化到接近机器精度，而这一精度此前只能由计算昂贵的高阶优化器达到。
Conclusion: 扩 Fourier feature pyramid 的参数量比扩网络结构更划算，可调带宽限制让困难 PDE 的优化更稳，并使一阶优化器也能达到高阶优化器的精度。

papers.title: Towards Direct Evaluation of Harness Optimizers via Priority Ranking
papers.abstract_en: Harness optimization enables automated agent creation by having an optimizer agent iteratively update the harness of target agents. Despite its success, current studies evaluate optimizers solely by observing target agents' performance gains. This indirect end-improvement evaluation neglects optimizers' actions at intermediate steps, which are often erroneous and hinder agent performance in deployment. Therefore, it is unclear whether harness optimization is driven by optimizers' informed update actions or simply trial-and-error. This necessitates direct evaluation of harness optimizers. However, evaluating harness optimizers directly is non-trivial and costly due to the lack of oracle harnesses. To address this, we present a simple, low-cost design to directly evaluate them, namely priority ranking. By asking harness optimizers to rank components (e.g., tools) in a given harness by their potential to improve/hinder agent performance when updated, our design quantifies optimizer ability at the step level without expensive rollouts or manual examination. More importantly, optimizers' ranking performance correlates with their ability to improve agents in actual multi-step harness optimization, establishing priority ranking as a reliable indicator of optimization ability. Priority ranking is enabled by SHOR, a collection of 182 human-verified optimization scenarios spanning across domains, designs, and time stages. Code and data: https://github.com/k59118/Harness_Optimizer_Evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 priority ranking：让 harness optimizer 对给定 harness 中各组件（如工具）按更新后提升或损害 agent 性能的潜力排序，从而在步骤级直接度量 optimizer 能力，无需昂贵 rollout 或人工检查。该排序表现与 optimizer 在真实多步 harness optimization 中提升 agent 的能力相关，因此可作为优化能力的可靠指标；支撑数据是含 182 个人工核验优化场景的 SHOR。
Motivation: 现有研究只看目标 agent 最终性能增益来评价 optimizer，忽略中间步骤中常出错、拖累部署表现的更新动作，无法区分 harness optimization 是靠有信息的更新还是纯试错；直接评价又因缺少 oracle harness 而昂贵。
Method: priority ranking 设计：要求 harness optimizer 对给定 harness 的组件（如工具）按其更新时提升/损害 agent 性能的潜力排序，在步骤级量化能力，不需昂贵 rollout 或人工检查；由 SHOR 支撑，含 182 个跨领域、跨设计、跨时间阶段的人工核验优化场景。
Result: SHOR 收录 182 个经人工核验的优化场景；optimizer 的排序表现与其在真实多步 harness optimization 中提升 agent 的能力相关。
Conclusion: priority ranking 是 harness optimizer 步骤级能力的可靠、低成本直接指标，可替代只看最终性能增益的间接评价。

papers.title: Insights Generator: Systematic Corpus-Level Trace Diagnostics for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Diagnosing failures in LLM agents remains largely manual. Practitioners inspect a small subset of execution traces, form ad-hoc hypotheses, and iterate. This process misses patterns that only emerge across trace populations and does not scale to production corpora where individual traces span tens of thousands of tokens. We formalize the problem of corpus-level trace diagnostics. Given a corpus of execution traces, the goal is to produce grounded natural-language insights that characterize systematic behavioral patterns across trace groups, each linked to supporting evidence. We present the Insights Generator (IG), a multi-agent system that answers diagnostic questions by proposing and testing hypotheses across the trace corpus to produce an evidence-backed insights report. We evaluate IG across qualitative and objective dimensions, spanning rubric-based report assessment and downstream performance improvements achieved by implementing IG insights. Human experts using IG reports improve scaffold performance by 30.4 pp over the unmodified baseline scaffold, and coding agents leveraging IG-derived insights show consistent and stable gains. Across benchmarks, IG's scout-investigator architecture produces findings comparable in detection coverage to competing approaches, while domain experts rated IG reports as leading depth and evidence quality.
papers.comment: v4: expanded evaluation with the APEX-Agents benchmark and a GPT-5.4 cross-family judge. Revised analysis and appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Insights Generator (IG)，一个面向 LLM agent 执行轨迹的多智能体诊断系统，用 scout-investigator 架构在整批轨迹上提出并检验假设，产出带证据支撑的自然语言洞察报告。使用 IG 报告的人类专家使 scaffold 性能相对未修改基线提升 30.4 个百分点，检测覆盖度与竞争方法相当，报告深度与证据质量被领域专家评为领先。
Motivation: LLM agent 故障诊断依赖人工抽查少量轨迹、凭经验猜假设，无法发现只在轨迹群体层面显现的模式，也难以扩展到单条轨迹上万 token 的生产级轨迹库。
Method: 将问题形式化为 corpus-level trace diagnostics：给定执行轨迹库，生成跨轨迹组的、每条都链接到支撑证据的自然语言洞察。IG 采用 scout-investigator 多智能体架构，围绕诊断问题在轨迹库上提出并检验假设，输出证据支撑的报告；评测含基于 rubric 的报告评估与落地 IG 洞察后的下游性能提升，v4 扩展了 APEX-Agents benchmark 与 GPT-5.4 跨家族 judge。
Result: 使用 IG 报告的人类专家使 scaffold 性能相对未修改基线提升 30.4 个百分点；借助 IG 洞察的 coding agent 收益一致且稳定。跨 benchmark 上 IG 的 scout-investigator 架构检测覆盖度与竞争方法相当，领域专家评定其报告在深度与证据质量上领先。

papers.title: Steering Without Breaking: Mechanistically Informed Interventions for Discrete Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Discrete diffusion language models (DLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising all positions in parallel, offering an alternative to autoregressive models. Controlled generation methods for DLMs, imported from autoregressive models, apply uniform intervention at every denoising step. We show this uniform schedule is inefficient and degrades quality, and the damage compounds when multiple attributes are steered jointly. To diagnose the failure, we train sparse autoencoders on four DLMs (124M-8B parameters) and find that different attributes commit on distinct schedules, varying in timing, sharpness, and magnitude. For instance, topic commits within the first 2% of denoising on MDLM, whereas sentiment emerges gradually over 20% of the process. Motivated by these profiles, we propose an adaptive scheduling mechanism that concentrates intervention where each attribute is actively forming. An idealized allocation analysis predicts that attributes with more sharply concentrated emergence benefit more from adaptive scheduling, a prediction we confirm empirically. Across seven single- and multi-attribute steering tasks on four DLMs, adaptive steering consistently improves the control-quality balance over uniform and interval-restricted baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 离散扩散语言模型 (DLM) 的受控生成沿用自回归模型的均匀干预调度，效率低且损害生成质量，多属性联合时损伤叠加。用 sparse autoencoder 在四个 DLM（124M–8B）上诊断发现各属性的 commit 时点不同：MDLM 上 topic 在前 2% 去噪内定型，sentiment 则在 20% 过程中渐显；据此把干预集中到各属性正在形成的时段，在 7 项单/多属性 steering 任务上一致改善控制与质量的平衡。
Motivation: 从自回归模型搬来的均匀干预调度在 DLM 的每一步去噪上都施加控制，既低效又降低质量，多属性联合 steering 时损伤还会累积，而各属性何时定型此前无从知晓。
Method: 先在四个 DLM（124M–8B 参数）上训练 sparse autoencoders，刻画各属性 commit 的 timing、sharpness、magnitude 三类剖面；再据此提出自适应调度机制，把干预集中到每个属性活跃形成的去噪阶段，并给出理想化分配分析，预测 emergence 越尖锐集中的属性从自适应调度中获益越大。
Result: MDLM 上 topic 在前 2% 去噪内 commit，sentiment 在 20% 的过程中渐显；理想化分配分析的预测（emergence 越尖锐获益越大）经实证确认；在四个 DLM 上的 7 项单属性与多属性 steering 任务中，自适应调度相对均匀调度与 interval-restricted 基线一致改善控制-质量平衡。
Conclusion: 均匀干预之所以失败，是因为属性定型时点各异；按各属性的 commit 剖面分配干预强度，能在不牺牲生成质量的前提下拿到更强的控制，且 emergence 越尖锐的属性收益越大。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: TAVIS: A Benchmark for Egocentric Active Vision and Anticipatory Gaze in Imitation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Active vision -- where a policy controls its own gaze during manipulation -- has emerged as a key capability for imitation learning, with multiple independent systems demonstrating its benefits in the past year. Yet there is no shared benchmark to compare approaches or quantify what active vision contributes, on which task types, and under what conditions. We introduce TAVIS, evaluation infrastructure for active-vision imitation learning, with two complementary task suites -- TAVIS-Head (5 tasks, global search via pan/tilt necks) and TAVIS-Hands (3 tasks, local occlusion via wrist cameras) -- on two humanoid torso embodiments (GR1T2, Reachy2), built on IsaacLab. TAVIS provides three evaluation primitives: a paired headcam-vs-fixedcam protocol on identical demonstrations; GALT (Gaze-Action Lead Time), a novel metric grounded in cognitive science and HRI that quantifies anticipatory gaze in learned policies; and procedural ID/OOD splits. Baseline experiments with Diffusion Policy and $π_0$ reveal that (i) active vision generally helps, consistently across training runs, but benefits are task-conditional rather than uniform; (ii) multi-task policies degrade sharply under controlled distribution shifts on both suites; and (iii) imitation alone yields anticipatory gaze that lands on the task-relevant object, with lead times comparable to those of the human demonstrations, although head motion is less smooth than in the demonstrations, an effect of action chunking that success rate does not reveal. Code and evaluation scripts are released at https://github.com/spiglerg/tavis; demonstrations (LeRobot v3.0; ~2200 episodes) and trained baselines at https://huggingface.co/tavis-benchmark.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 6 figures, 14 tables. v2: revised and extended (inter-seed variability, wrist-camera ablation, GALT validation and sensitivity analyses, gaze behaviour statistics). Project page: https://tavis-bench.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TAVIS 是面向主动视觉模仿学习的评测基准，含 TAVIS-Head（5 任务、pan/tilt 颈部全局搜索）与 TAVIS-Hands（3 任务、腕部相机局部遮挡）两套任务，跑在 GR1T2、Reachy2 两个人形躯干上、基于 IsaacLab。用 Diffusion Policy 与 π0 的基线实验显示：主动视觉总体有益但收益随任务而变；受控分布偏移下多任务策略性能急剧下降；仅靠模仿就能学到落在任务相关物体上的预期性凝视，lead time 与人类示范相当，但头部运动不如人类平滑，且成功率掩盖了这一点。
Motivation: 主动视觉（策略在操作中自行控制视线）近一年多个独立系统证明了价值，但缺少共享基准来比较方法、量化主动视觉在哪些任务类型和条件下带来收益。
Method: TAVIS 提供三个评测原语：在完全相同示范上配对比较 headcam 与 fixedcam 的协议；新指标 GALT（Gaze-Action Lead Time，源自认知科学与 HRI）量化策略的预期性凝视；以及程序化 ID/OOD 划分。基线用 Diffusion Policy 与 π0 训练，代码与评测脚本开源，示范以 LeRobot v3.0 格式发布（约 2200 episodes）。
Result: 基线实验三条发现：主动视觉总体有帮助且跨训练随机种子一致，但收益是任务条件性的而非均匀；在两套任务上，多任务策略在受控分布偏移下急剧退化；仅模仿训练得到的预期性凝视落在任务相关物体上，lead time 与人类示范可比，但头部运动平滑度低于人类示范，这一效应源于 action chunking，而成功率无法揭示。
Conclusion: 主动视觉的收益必须按任务类型和分布偏移条件分别量化，且成功率不足以刻画凝视质量，需要 GALT 这类独立指标与配对 headcam/fixedcam 协议。
Relevance: 4
