papers.title: The Metagame of Interpretability and Meta-Attributions
papers.abstract_en: How can an arbitrary attribution method be generalized from first principles to capture interactions? We answer this with the metagame, a conceptual framework for quantifying second-order interaction effects of model explanations. We cast the attribution value $φ_i$ of feature $i$ as a cooperative game among the other features and compute its Shapley value, which measures how much feature $j$ influences the attribution of $i$, yielding the directional meta-attribution $\varphi_{j \to i}$. By decomposing attribution itself rather than the model directly, meta-attributions extend any gradient- or attention-based method to interactions, uniting removal-based perturbations with model internals. Theoretically, we prove that meta-attributions sum to the first-order attribution they explain, a hierarchical decomposition that Shapley interactions and integrated Hessians turn out to perform implicitly. Empirically, we demonstrate that meta-attributions deliver insights across diverse interpretability applications: (i) quantifying token interactions in instruction-tuned language models, (ii) explaining cross-modal similarity in vision-language encoders, and (iii) interpreting text-to-image concepts in multimodal diffusion transformers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 metagame 框架，把特征 i 的归因值 φ_i 视为其余特征间的合作博弈并求其 Shapley 值，得到方向性元归因 (meta-attribution) φ_{j→i}，量化特征 j 对特征 i 归因的影响。理论上证明元归因求和等于其解释的一阶归因，且 Shapley interactions 与 integrated Hessians 实际上隐式执行了这一分层分解。
Motivation: 现有归因方法多只给出一阶重要性，难以从第一性原理推广到刻画特征间二阶交互；扰动法与基于模型内部（梯度、注意力）的方法彼此割裂。
Method: 将任意归因方法的输出 φ_i 建模为其余特征上的合作博弈，对其计算 Shapley 值，得到方向性元归因 φ_{j→i}；分解对象是归因本身而非模型，从而把任意梯度或注意力类方法扩展到交互，并统一 removal-based 扰动与模型内部信号。
Result: 理论上证明元归因之和等于其解释的一阶归因，构成层级分解，并指出 Shapley interactions 与 integrated Hessians 隐式执行该分解；在三类可解释性应用上给出实证：指令微调语言模型中的 token 交互量化、视觉-语言编码器的跨模态相似性解释、多模态 diffusion transformer 的文生图概念解释。
Conclusion: 对归因值本身做博弈论分解，即可把任意一阶归因方法系统性地推广到二阶交互，同时把扰动式与内部信号式方法统一到同一框架下。

papers.title: From Packets to Patterns: Interpreting Encrypted Network Traffic as Longitudinal Behavioral Signals
papers.abstract_en: Human behavior is difficult to observe continuously at scale, yet it leaves measurable traces in everyday device use. We test whether encrypted smartphone network traffic---a ubiquitous, always-on, passive sensing modality---can passively capture behavioral patterns related to sleep, stress, and loneliness. We model shared behavioral structure using a transformer backbone with per-user adapters, allowing the model to represent both typical individual behavior and deviations from it. To make these representations interpretable, we apply a sparse autoencoder to extract behavioral features corresponding to distinct patterns of activity. We relate these features to sleep disturbance, stress, and loneliness using generalized estimating equations with Mundlak decomposition, separating between-person differences from within-person changes over time. We find that the three outcomes reflect distinct temporal structures: stress is primarily associated with stable between-person differences, loneliness with within-person variation, and sleep disturbance with a combination of both. Notably, these within-person dynamics are not captured by predefined network-traffic features, demonstrating the value of learned representations for longitudinal behavioral sensing. These results establish encrypted network traffic as a viable passive sensing modality, revealing interpretable behavioral dynamics---particularly deviations from an individual's baseline---that are not visible in raw traffic features.
papers.comment: 38 pages, 8 figures. Accepted to Proceedings of the ACM on Interactive, Mobile, Wearable and Ubiquitous Technologies (IMWUT), Vol. 10, No. 4
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把加密手机网络流量当作纵向行为传感信号：用带 per-user adapter 的 transformer 学共享行为表征，再用稀疏自编码器 (sparse autoencoder) 解释成活动模式特征，最后以 Mundlak 分解的广义估计方程区分个体内与个体间效应。发现压力主要对应稳定的个体间差异、孤独对应个体内波动、睡眠障碍兼有两者，且这些个体内动态是预定义网络流量特征捕捉不到的。
Motivation: 人类行为难以在大规模上连续观察，而日常设备使用会留下可测痕迹；预定义的网络流量特征无法刻画个体相对自身基线的纵向偏移。
Method: 以 transformer 主干加 per-user adapter 建模共享与个体行为结构，接稀疏自编码器提取可解释行为特征，再用带 Mundlak 分解的广义估计方程 (GEE) 把个体间差异与个体内随时间的变化分开，关联睡眠障碍、压力与孤独三个结局。
Result: 三个结局呈不同时间结构：压力主要与稳定的个体间差异相关，孤独与个体内变化相关，睡眠障碍两者兼有；个体内动态未被预定义网络流量特征捕捉，学到的表征才可见。
Conclusion: 加密网络流量可作为可行的被动传感模态，其学习表征能揭示原始流量特征中不可见的可解释行为动态，尤其是个体相对自身基线的偏移。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.result: 三个结局呈不同时间结构：压力主要与稳定的个体间差异相关，孤独与个体内变化相关，睡眠障碍两者兼有；个体内动态未被预定义网络流量特征捕捉，学到的表征才可见。
summary_sections.conclusion: 加密网络流量可作为可行的被动传感模态，其学习表征能揭示原始流量特征中不可见的可解释行为动态，尤其是个体相对自身基线的偏移。

papers.title: EduGage: A Multimodal Dataset and Benchmark for Sensor-Based Momentary Assessment of Engagement in Self-Guided Video Learning
papers.abstract_en: Engagement, which links to attentional, emotional, and cognitive dimensions, plays an important role in learning. In online and video-based learning environments, learners often need to regulate their own interactions with instructional materials. Measuring and reflecting on engagement can therefore support both learners and adaptive learning systems. In this study, we use wearable and camera-based sensing devices to collect physiological and motion signals, including PPG, ECG, EDA, EEG, IMU, heart rate, temperature, and eye-tracking data, to estimate learner engagement. We conducted a user study with 16 participants in a video-based learning scenario, where participants completed learning tasks and provided repeated in-situ engagement-probe ratings on a 1-5 scale, reporting how difficult it was to pay attention during the preceding minute. We establish a benchmark for engagement estimation, compare different sensing modalities, and further analyze the feasibility and effectiveness of multimodal modeling for characterizing learner engagement. Across participant-based cross-validation, the modality-aware reference model achieves an MAE of 0.80, 83.18% within-1 accuracy, 70.96% binary accuracy, and 62.90% binary Macro-F1, outperforming sensor-free, statistical, deep temporal, foundation-model, and LLM-based baselines. Our results suggest that fine-grained engagement estimation is feasible but inherently noisy, and that the preferred sensing configuration depends on the target metric and practical sensing burden. We release the EduGage dataset as the primary contribution of this work, including synchronized multimodal sensor signals, probe-aligned engagement-probe ratings, video metadata, quizzes, and study materials, to support reproducible research on fine-grained sensor-based engagement modeling in self-guided learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EduGage 发布一个基于可穿戴与摄像头传感的自主视频学习投入度 (engagement) 多模态数据集与基准，用 16 人用户研究中 1–5 分的逐分钟情境探针评分做估计。参与者交叉验证下 modality-aware 参考模型 MAE 0.80、within-1 准确率 83.18%、二分类准确率 70.96%、Macro-F1 62.90%，超过无传感、统计、深度时序、foundation model 与 LLM 基线。
Motivation: 在线与视频学习中学习者需自我调节，细粒度投入度测量可支撑学习者反思与自适应系统，但缺少公开的同步多模态传感与探针对齐数据来支撑可复现研究。
Method: 用可穿戴与摄像头设备采集 PPG、ECG、EDA、EEG、IMU、心率、温度与眼动信号；16 名参与者在视频学习场景中完成任务并给出前一分钟注意力难度的 1–5 分重复探针评分；建立基准，比较不同传感模态并做多模态建模分析，采用参与者交叉验证。
Result: modality-aware 参考模型在参与者交叉验证下 MAE 0.80、within-1 准确率 83.18%、二分类准确率 70.96%、二分类 Macro-F1 62.90%，优于 sensor-free、统计、deep temporal、foundation-model 与 LLM-based 基线；首选传感配置取决于目标指标与实际传感负担。
Conclusion: 细粒度投入度估计可行但本质上含噪，传感模态选择应按目标指标与负担权衡；EduGage 数据集（同步传感信号、探针对齐评分、视频元数据、测验与材料）作为主要贡献发布以支持可复现研究。

papers.title: Continuous Semantic Caching for Low-Cost LLM Serving
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become increasingly popular, caching responses so that they can be reused by users with semantically similar queries has become a vital strategy for reducing inference costs and latency. Existing caching frameworks have proposed to decide which query responses to cache by assuming a finite, known universe of discrete queries and learning their serving costs and arrival probabilities. As LLMs' pool of users and queries expands, however, such an assumption becomes increasingly untenable: real-world LLM queries reside in an infinite, continuous embedding space. In this paper, we establish the first rigorous theoretical framework for semantic LLM response caching in continuous query space under uncertainty. To bridge the gap between discrete optimization and continuous representation spaces, we introduce dynamic $ε$-net discretization coupled with Kernel Ridge Regression. This design enables the system to formally quantify estimation uncertainty and generalize partial feedback on LLM query costs across continuous semantic query neighborhoods. We develop both offline learning and online adaptive algorithms optimized to reduce switching costs incurred by changing the cached responses. We prove that our online algorithm achieves a sublinear regret bound against an optimal oracle, which reduces to existing bounds for discrete query models. Extensive empirical evaluations demonstrate that our framework approximates the continuous optimal cache well while also reducing computational and switching overhead compared to existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 LLM 语义缓存中查询被假设为有限离散集合的问题，提出首个在连续嵌入空间与不确定代价下的理论框架：动态 ε-net 离散化结合 Kernel Ridge Regression 量化估计不确定性并在语义邻域泛化部分反馈，在线算法对最优 oracle 达到次线性 regret，且退化为已有离散模型的界。
Motivation: 现有语义缓存框架假设查询来自有限、已知的离散集合并已知到达概率与服务代价，但真实 LLM 查询位于无限连续嵌入空间，该假设不再成立。
Method: 用动态 ε-net 离散化连续查询空间，并以 Kernel Ridge Regression 估计 LLM 查询代价，形式化量化估计不确定性、在连续语义邻域间泛化部分反馈；分别设计离线学习与在线自适应算法，优化改变缓存响应带来的切换代价 (switching cost)。
Result: 证明在线算法相对最优 oracle 达到次线性 regret 界，且该界退化为已有离散查询模型的界；实证评估显示框架良好逼近连续最优缓存，并相较已有方法降低计算与切换开销。
Conclusion: 连续查询空间下的语义 LLM 响应缓存可以被严格理论化，动态离散化加核回归既能给出可证明的次线性 regret，也能在实践中压低计算与切换开销。

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation Must Move Beyond Factual Grounding to Represent Diverse Opinions
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems are built on an unexamined assumption - that queries have correct answers and retrieval should converge toward them. This position paper argues that this creates a factual bias where RAG systems optimize for reducing epistemic uncertainty while ignoring the aleatoric uncertainty, inherent in opinion-rich content. The consequences go beyond technical limitations- due to risk of minority voice erasure and risk of opinion manipulation. To address this, we formalize opinion-aware retrieval through uncertainty quantification and derive a unified objective using the Wasserstein distance. As an existence proof, we present Opinion-Aware RAG (O-RAG), which enriches documents with LLM-extracted, entity-linked opinion metadata before indexing. Across e-commerce seller forums and public hotel reviews, O-RAG reduces Wasserstein distance to corpus-level sentiment distributions by 18-48%, and human evaluators preferred its responses 79.2% of the time. We close with a research agenda for opinion-aware RAG.
papers.comment: 17 pages, Accepted at 19th International Conference on Natural Language Generation 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 立场论文指出 RAG 默认「查询有正确答案、检索应收敛到它」，因而只压低认知不确定性、忽略观点内容固有的偶然不确定性 (aleatoric uncertainty)，导致少数声音被抹除与观点操纵风险。提出 O-RAG：用 LLM 抽取并实体链接观点元数据来富化文档再索引，以 Wasserstein 距离统一目标；在电商卖家论坛与公开酒店评论上，到语料级情感分布的 Wasserstein 距离下降 18–48%，人工评估者 79.2% 的时候更偏好其回答。
Motivation: RAG 的事实性假设把观点型查询当成有唯一正确答案的问题，优化方向系统性偏向主流观点，少数意见在检索与生成中被边缘化。
Method: 先把 opinion-aware retrieval 形式化为不确定性量化问题，用 Wasserstein 距离推导统一目标；再以 O-RAG 作为存在性证明，用 LLM 抽取观点元数据并做实体链接，富化文档后建立索引。
Result: 在电商卖家论坛与公开酒店评论两个语料上，O-RAG 到语料级情感分布的 Wasserstein 距离降低 18–48%；人工评估者在 79.2% 的情况下更偏好 O-RAG 的回答。
Conclusion: RAG 应从事实性接地扩展到观点感知检索，把分布层面的观点覆盖纳入优化目标，而不只是收敛到单一答案。

papers.title: Handle with CARE: Can LLMs Reproduce How Online Communities React?
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as proxies for computational social analysis, yet faithfully representing the "thick descriptions" (Geertz, 1973) of human communities remains a critical challenge. Current evaluations often reduce social identity to static labels, sidelining how real-world groups navigate social shifts. To bridge this gap, we introduce CARE (Community-Aware Reaction Evaluation), a reaction-centered framework that benchmarks LLM-simulated discourse against the authentic, event-contingent responses of distinct communities to real-world news. Spanning 207 Reddit communities and covering 9,947 authentic reactions towards 2,166 news articles, CARE evaluates leading LLMs using a hierarchical taxonomy covering coarse attitudes and fine-grained communicative tones. Our empirical findings expose two critical failure modes in prevailing community-conditioning paradigms. First, while community context and targeted reasoning significantly enhance macro-level attitudinal and tonal profiling, these gains largely collapse at the instance level when predicting reactions to specific events. Second, the benefits of community conditioning are remarkably uneven: prompting strategies yield non-uniform shifts, where fidelity gains in some communities are offset by performance drops in others. This micro-macro divergence and community-level instability demonstrate that standard conditioning enables models to approximate static baseline profiles without capturing dynamic or equitable event reactions, establishing CARE as an essential diagnostic tool for community-aware social simulation. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/nuankw/Handle_with_CARE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CARE 用 207 个 Reddit 社区、9,947 条真实反应对 2,166 篇新闻的事件触发回应，评测 LLM 能否复现在线社区反应。社区上下文与定向推理只在宏观态度/语气画像上显著提升，到具体事件的实例级预测时增益基本崩塌；且不同社区的提示策略收益极不均匀，一些社区的保真度提升被另一些社区的性能下降抵消。
Motivation: 现有评测把社会身份压成静态标签，无法刻画真实群体如何随事件迁移，导致 LLM 作为计算社会分析代理的可靠性无从检验。
Method: 提出 CARE（Community-Aware Reaction Evaluation），以反应为中心，将 LLM 模拟话语与社区对真实新闻的事件触发回应对比；采用分层分类体系，覆盖粗粒度态度与细粒度交际语气，并考察社区条件化与提示策略。
Result: 基准覆盖 207 个 Reddit 社区、9,947 条真实反应、2,166 篇新闻；实证发现两类失败模式：宏观态度与语气画像显著提升但在实例级事件反应预测上增益基本消失，且提示策略带来的保真度变化在社区间不均匀，部分社区提升、部分社区下降。
Conclusion: 标准社区条件化只能让模型逼近静态基线画像，未捕捉动态且均衡的事件反应；CARE 被定位为社区感知社会模拟的诊断工具。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Bridging Natural Language and Interactive What-If Interfaces via LLM-Generated Declarative Specifications
papers.abstract_en: What-if analysis (WIA) lets users explore hypothetical scenarios by adjusting parameters, applying constraints, and scoping data through interactive interfaces. Current tools fall short: spreadsheet and BI tools require laborious setup, while LLM-generated interfaces frequently misinterpret analytical intent. It remains unclear whether an explicit intermediate representation is needed, or whether LLMs can generate WIA interfaces directly. We build a benchmark of 405 WIA questions across 11 types and 5 datasets with human-authored ground-truth intent, and find that direct one-shot generation across three LLMs fails to produce a working interface in 17-45% of cases and, when interfaces render, often misrepresents the question's objective (up to 77.5%) and constraints (up to 58.2%). We therefore present a two-stage workflow that translates NL questions into Praxa Specification Language (PSL) specifications, then compiles them into interfaces. Because errors localize to named properties, taxonomy-guided repair raises correctness from 52.42% to 80.42%, unlike errors in directly generated code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 what-if 分析 (WIA) 界面生成中 LLM 直接产出常歪曲分析意图的问题，构建含 405 个问题、11 类型、5 个数据集的基准，发现一次性直接生成在三个 LLM 上有 17–45% 完全无法产出可运行界面，且渲染成功时目标错误率最高 77.5%、约束错误率最高 58.2%。改用两阶段流程——先译为 Praxa Specification Language (PSL) 声明式规格再编译成界面——配合 taxonomy-guided repair，正确率从 52.42% 升到 80.42%。
Motivation: 表格与 BI 工具做 what-if 分析需繁琐手工搭建，而 LLM 直接生成的界面常误读分析意图；尚不清楚是否需要显式中间表示，还是 LLM 可直接生成 WIA 界面。
Method: 构建 405 个 WIA 问题、11 种问题类型、5 个数据集并带人工撰写的真实意图标注的基准；先比较三个 LLM 的一次性直接生成，再提出两阶段工作流：把自然语言问题翻译为 Praxa Specification Language (PSL) 声明式规格，随后编译为界面；错误可定位到命名属性，据此做 taxonomy-guided repair。
Result: 直接一次性生成在三个 LLM 上有 17–45% 的案例无法产出可运行界面；界面能渲染时，目标 (objective) 被歪曲的比例最高 77.5%，约束 (constraints) 最高 58.2%。taxonomy-guided repair 把正确率从 52.42% 提升到 80.42%，而直接生成代码的错误不具备这种可定位性。
Conclusion: 显式中间表示（PSL 规格）是必要的：它让错误落到命名属性上，从而可被分类引导的修复流程系统性纠正，而直接生成的代码错误做不到这一点。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 针对 what-if 分析 (WIA) 界面生成中 LLM 直接产出常歪曲分析意图的问题，构建含 405 个问题、11 类型、5 个数据集的基准，发现一次性直接生成在三个 LLM 上有 17–45% 完全无法产出可运行界面，且渲染成功时目标错误率最高 77.5%、约束错误率最高 58.2%。改用两阶段流程——先译为 Praxa Specification Language (PSL) 声明式规格再编译成界面——配合 taxonomy-guided repair，正确率从 52.42% 升到 80.42%。
summary_sections.motivation: 表格与 BI 工具做 what-if 分析需繁琐手工搭建，而 LLM 直接生成的界面常误读分析意图；尚不清楚是否需要显式中间表示，还是 LLM 可直接生成 WIA 界面。
summary_sections.method: 构建 405 个 WIA 问题、11 种问题类型、5 个数据集并带人工撰写的真实意图标注的基准；先比较三个 LLM 的一次性直接生成，再提出两阶段工作流：把自然语言问题翻译为 Praxa Specification Language (PSL) 声明式规格，随后编译为界面；错误可定位到命名属性，据此做 taxonomy-guided repair。
summary_sections.result: 直接一次性生成在三个 LLM 上有 17–45% 的案例无法产出可运行界面；界面能渲染时，目标 (objective) 被歪曲的比例最高 77.5%，约束 (constraints) 最高 58.2%。taxonomy-guided repair 把正确率从 52.42% 提升到 80.42%，而直接生成代码的错误不具备这种可定位性。

papers.title: A Variational Latent-Space Framework for Uncertainty-Aware Spectral Image Emulation
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic spectral image generation is essential for remote sensing simulation and mission design, yet physically based radiative transfer models (RTMs) remain computationally expensive. Existing learning-based emulators reduce this cost, but are mostly deterministic parameter-to-spectrum regressors with limited spatial modeling and uncertainty information. We formulate spectral image emulation as a parameter-conditioned latent-variable problem and propose a variational autoencoder (VAE)-based framework combining nonlinear spectral-image representations, fast inference, and per-pixel uncertainty estimates. The framework is instantiated at spectrum and spatial--spectral levels through two-step VAE pretraining and latent mapping. We evaluate it on PROSAIL-simulated hyperspectral vegetation cubes (211 bands) and real Sentinel-3 OLCI multispectral ocean-colour imagery (21 bands) against classical regression emulators and a deep CNN baseline. Results show that no single architecture is optimal: pixel-to-pixel models perform best on controlled hyperspectral simulations, whereas a fully convolutional VAE is more robust on noisy real observations with missing or contaminated pixels. VAE-based emulators also achieve high throughput for large-scale generation. On Sentinel-3, the spatial--spectral VAE provides predictive intervals closer to empirical errors than pixel-wise neural and classical emulators, although absolute calibration remains incomplete. A look-up-table-based retrieval experiment further shows that reconstruction fidelity alone does not ensure reliable leaf area index and chlorophyll retrieval. Emulators should therefore be evaluated in representative remote-sensing end-use scenarios, not by reconstruction metrics alone.

TL;DR: 把光谱图像仿真写成参数条件化的隐变量问题，用两步 VAE 预训练加隐空间映射，在 PROSAIL 模拟高光谱立方体（211 波段）与 Sentinel-3 OLCI 真实海洋水色影像（21 波段）上做逐像元不确定性估计。逐像元模型在受控仿真上最好，全卷积 VAE 在含缺失与污染像元的噪声真实数据上更稳；空间-光谱 VAE 的预测区间更贴近经验误差，但绝对校准仍不完整，且重建保真度高不等于 LAI 与叶绿素反演可靠。
Motivation: 基于物理的辐射传输模型 (RTM) 计算昂贵，现有学习型仿真器多为确定性的参数到光谱回归，空间建模与不确定性信息都有限。
Method: 将光谱图像仿真表述为参数条件化的隐变量问题，提出基于 VAE 的框架：非线性光谱-图像表示、快速推理与逐像元不确定性估计，在 spectrum 与 spatial-spectral 两个层级通过两步 VAE 预训练加隐空间映射实例化；与经典回归仿真器和深度 CNN 基线对比，并追加基于查找表 (LUT) 的反演实验。
Result: 在 PROSAIL 模拟的 211 波段高光谱植被立方体与 21 波段 Sentinel-3 OLCI 真实影像上，无单一架构最优：pixel-to-pixel 模型在受控仿真上表现最好，全卷积 VAE 在含缺失或污染像元的噪声真实观测上更鲁棒；VAE 仿真器在大规模生成上吞吐量高。Sentinel-3 上空间-光谱 VAE 的预测区间比逐像元神经与经典仿真器更接近经验误差，但绝对校准仍不完整；LUT 反演实验显示重建保真度本身不能保证可靠的叶面积指数 (LAI) 与叶绿素反演。
Conclusion: 仿真器应在有代表性的遥感终端使用场景中评估，而不能只看重建指标；且不存在对受控仿真与含噪真实观测都最优的单一架构。

papers.title: Tri-Prompting: Video Diffusion with Unified Control over Scene, Subject, and Motion
papers.abstract_en: Recent video diffusion models achieve strong visual quality and temporal coherence, but still lack coordinated control over scene layout, customized subject identity, and camera/subject motion. We study controllable video generation from three prompts: a first-frame scene image, 3D-aware multi-view subject references, and a motion-driving signal. This setting is challenging because background regions are often trackable under camera motion, while foreground subjects can rotate, self-occlude, and reveal new regions that require identity-consistent appearance. We introduce Tri-Prompting, a video diffusion framework that combines multi-view subject conditioning with dual-conditioned motion control. Tri-Prompting uses XYZ tracking points for visible background motion and low-resolution RGB proxies for foreground subject pose, allowing the model to recover fine appearance from multi-view references while retaining flexibility for plausible subject-scene interactions. An inference-time ControlNet scale schedule further balances motion controllability and visual realism. We evaluate Tri-Prompting against specialized baselines: DaS for motion reconstruction and Phantom for subject-driven generation. Tri-Prompting achieves competitive or improved reconstruction quality, stronger multi-view identity preservation, and better 3D consistency, while enabling 3D-aware subject insertion and in-scene manipulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Tri-Prompting 把首帧场景图、3D 感知多视角主体参考与运动驱动信号三种提示统一进视频扩散框架：用 XYZ 跟踪点表示可见背景运动、低分辨率 RGB 代理表示前景主体姿态，并在推理时用 ControlNet scale 调度平衡运动可控性与视觉真实感。对比 DaS（运动重建）与 Phantom（主体驱动生成），该方法取得有竞争力或更优的重建质量、更强的多视角身份保持与更好的 3D 一致性。
Motivation: 现有视频扩散模型画质与时序连贯性已强，但无法同时协调场景布局、定制主体身份与相机/主体运动三类控制；背景在相机运动下可跟踪，前景主体会旋转、自遮挡并露出新区域，身份一致性难以保证。
Method: Tri-Prompting 视频扩散框架：多视角主体条件 + 双条件运动控制，XYZ 跟踪点驱动可见背景运动，低分辨率 RGB 代理驱动前景主体姿态，模型从多视角参考恢复精细外观；推理阶段用 ControlNet scale 调度调节运动可控性与真实感。
Result: 在与专用基线 DaS（运动重建）和 Phantom（主体驱动生成）的对比中，取得有竞争力或更优的重建质量、更强的多视角身份保持和更好的 3D 一致性，并支持 3D 感知主体插入与场景内操作。
Conclusion: 把背景跟踪点与前景姿态代理分路条件化，可在同一视频扩散模型里同时拿到运动可控性、主体身份保持与 3D 一致性，无需在三类控制之间取舍。

papers.title: Bi-CamoDiffusion: A Boundary-informed Diffusion Approach for Camouflaged Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Bi-CamoDiffusion is introduced, an evolution of the CamoDiffusion framework for camouflaged object detection. It integrates edge priors into early-stage embeddings via a parameter-free injection process, enhancing boundary sharpness and preventing structural ambiguity. An optimization objective that unifies spatial accuracy, structural constraints, and uncertainty supervision is also proposed, allowing the model to capture of both the object's global context and its intricate boundary transitions. Evaluations across the CAMO, COD10K, and NC4K datasets show that Bi-CamoDiffusion surpasses the baseline, delivering sharper delineation of thin structures and protrusions while also minimizing false positives. The model consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods across all evaluated metrics, including $S_m$, $F_β^{w}$, $E_m$, and $MAE$, demonstrating a more precise object-background separation and sharper boundary recovery. Code available at: https://github.com/plsuarez/Bi-CamoDiffusion
papers.journal_ref: In Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition, pp. 1401-1410, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Bi-CamoDiffusion 在 CamoDiffusion 基础上把边缘先验以免参数注入方式送进早期嵌入，配合统一空间精度、结构约束与不确定性监督的优化目标，提升伪装目标检测的边界锐度。在 CAMO、COD10K、NC4K 上于 S_m、F_β^w、E_m、MAE 全部指标超过基线与现有 SOTA，减少假阳性并更好保留细长结构与突起。
Motivation: 伪装目标与背景纹理高度相似，边界与细结构易产生结构歧义，导致目标-背景分离不准与假阳性。
Method: 在 CamoDiffusion 框架上以免参数注入过程把边缘先验并入早期阶段嵌入；提出统一空间精度、结构约束与不确定性监督的优化目标，同时建模全局上下文与精细边界过渡。
Result: 在 CAMO、COD10K、NC4K 三个数据集上，于 S_m、F_β^w、E_m、MAE 全部评估指标一致超过基线 CamoDiffusion 与现有 SOTA 方法，细长结构与突起的轮廓更锐利，假阳性更少。
Conclusion: 把边缘先验注入早期嵌入并用结构与不确定性约束联合优化，可改善伪装目标检测的目标-背景分离与边界恢复质量。

papers.title: A Parameter-efficient Convolutional Approach for Camouflaged Weed Detection in Multispectral Aerial Imagery
papers.abstract_en: We introduce FCBNet, an efficient model designed for camouflaged weed detection. The architecture is based on a fully frozen ConvNeXt backbone, the proposed Feature Correction Block (FCB), which leverages efficient convolutions for feature refinement, and a lightweight decoder. FCBNet is evaluated on the WeedBananaCOD and WeedMap datasets under both RGB and multispectral modalities, showing that FCBNet outperforms models such as U-Net, DeepLabV3+, SK-U-Net, SegFormer, and WeedSense in terms of mIoU, exceeding 85%, while also achieving superior computational efficiency, requiring only 0.06 to 0.2 hours for training. Furthermore, the frozen backbone strategy reduces the number of trainable parameters by more than 90%, significantly lowering memory requirements. Code available at: https://github.com/Leo-Thomas/fcbnet
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition, pp. 1349-1358, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FCBNet 用全冻结 ConvNeXt 主干加 Feature Correction Block (FCB) 与轻量解码器做多光谱航拍伪装杂草检测，在 WeedBananaCOD 与 WeedMap 的 RGB 和多光谱两种模态上 mIoU 超过 85%，高于 U-Net、DeepLabV3+、SK-U-Net、SegFormer、WeedSense，同时可训练参数减少 90% 以上、训练仅需 0.06–0.2 小时。
Motivation: 伪装杂草与作物背景光谱和纹理高度相似，分割模型精度与算力开销难以兼顾；航拍多光谱数据上训练成本与显存占用是实际部署的瓶颈。
Method: 以完全冻结的 ConvNeXt 为主干，接提出的 Feature Correction Block (FCB)（用高效卷积做特征修正）和轻量解码器；冻结策略使可训练参数量下降 90% 以上，在 WeedBananaCOD 与 WeedMap 上分别以 RGB 和多光谱模态训练评估。
Result: 在 WeedBananaCOD 与 WeedMap 的 RGB 与多光谱模态下，mIoU 超过 85%，高于 U-Net、DeepLabV3+、SK-U-Net、SegFormer 与 WeedSense；训练耗时仅 0.06 至 0.2 小时，可训练参数减少 90% 以上，显存需求显著降低。
Conclusion: 冻结主干加特征修正块的参数高效设计能在伪装杂草分割上同时保住精度并大幅压缩训练成本与显存，代码已开源。

papers.title: CADReasoner: Iterative Program Editing for CAD Reverse Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Computer-Aided Design (CAD) powers modern engineering, yet producing high-quality parts still demands substantial expert effort. Many AI systems tackle CAD reverse engineering, but most are single-pass and miss fine geometric details. In contrast, human engineers compare the input shape with the reconstruction and iteratively modify the design based on remaining discrepancies. Agent-based methods mimic this loop with frozen VLMs, but weak 3D grounding of current foundation models limits reliability and efficiency. We introduce CADReasoner, a model trained to iteratively refine its prediction using geometric discrepancy between the input and the predicted shape. The model outputs a runnable CadQuery Python program whose rendered mesh is fed back at the next step. CADReasoner fuses multi-view renders and point clouds as complementary modalities. To bridge the realism gap, we propose a scan-simulation protocol applied during both training and evaluation. Across DeepCAD, Fusion 360, and MCB benchmarks, CADReasoner attains state-of-the-art results on clean and scan-sim tracks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CADReasoner 用几何差异反馈驱动迭代式 CAD 逆向工程：模型输出可运行的 CadQuery Python 程序，渲染网格在下一步回喂，并融合多视角渲染与点云两种模态。在 DeepCAD、Fusion 360 与 MCB 三个基准的 clean 与 scan-sim 赛道上均取得 state-of-the-art 结果。
Motivation: 现有 CAD 逆向工程方法多为单次生成，漏掉细几何细节；基于 agent 的迭代方案依赖冻结 VLM，其 3D grounding 弱，可靠性和效率受限。
Method: 训练模型按输入形状与预测形状之间的几何差异迭代修正预测，每步输出可运行 CadQuery Python 程序并渲染成网格回喂下一步；融合多视角渲染与点云作为互补模态，并提出在训练与评估阶段都使用的 scan-simulation 协议以弥合真实扫描与仿真的差距。
Result: 在 DeepCAD、Fusion 360 与 MCB 三个基准上，clean 与 scan-sim 两条赛道均达到 state-of-the-art。
Conclusion: 把几何差异作为迭代修正信号、并用 scan-simulation 协议对齐真实扫描，可让 CAD 逆向工程在干净与扫描两类输入上同时达到最优。

papers.title: ANCRe: Adaptive Neural Connection Reassignment for Efficient Depth Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Scaling network depth has been a central driver behind the success of modern foundation models, yet recent investigations suggest that deep layers are often underutilized. This paper revisits the default mechanism for deepening neural networks, namely residual connections, from an optimization perspective. Rigorous analysis proves that the layout of residual connections can fundamentally shape convergence behavior, and even induces an exponential gap in convergence rates. Prompted by this insight, we introduce adaptive neural connection reassignment (ANCRe), a principled and lightweight framework that parameterizes and learns residual connectivities from the data. ANCRe adaptively reassigns residual connections with negligible computational and memory overhead ($<1\%$), while enabling more effective utilization of network depth. Extensive numerical tests across pre-training of large language models, diffusion models, and deep ResNets demonstrate consistently accelerated convergence, boosted performance, and enhanced depth efficiency over conventional residual connections.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ANCRe 把残差连接的拓扑本身参数化并从数据中学习，按优化视角自适应重连，证明残差连接布局会带来收敛速率的指数级差距。重连的计算与内存开销低于 1%，在 LLM 预训练、扩散模型与深层 ResNet 上均加速收敛并提升深度利用效率。
Motivation: 加深网络是基础模型的主要扩展路径，但深层常被闲置；默认的残差连接布局在优化上并非中性，会实质决定收敛行为。
Method: 从优化视角严格分析残差连接布局对收敛的影响，据此提出 ANCRe：参数化并从数据中学习残差连接拓扑，自适应重连，开销可忽略（<1% 计算与内存）。
Result: 证明残差连接布局会造成收敛速率的指数级差距；重连开销 <1%；在 LLM 预训练、扩散模型与深层 ResNet 上一致表现出收敛加速、性能提升与更高的深度效率。
Conclusion: 残差连接不应是固定默认结构，从数据中学习连接拓扑能以极小开销换来更快收敛和更有效的深度利用。

papers.title: Multi-encoder ConvNeXt Network with Smooth Attentional Feature Fusion for Multispectral Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: This work proposes MeCSAFNet, a multi-branch encoder-decoder architecture for land cover segmentation in multispectral imagery. The model separately processes visible and non-visible channels through dual ConvNeXt encoders, followed by individual decoders that reconstruct spatial information. A dedicated fusion decoder integrates intermediate features at multiple scales, combining fine spatial cues with high-level spectral representations. The feature fusion is further enhanced with CBAM attention, and the ASAU activation function contributes to stable and efficient optimization. The model is designed to process different spectral configurations, including a 4-channel (4c) input combining RGB and NIR bands, as well as a 6-channel (6c) input incorporating NDVI and NDWI indices. Experiments on the Five-Billion-Pixels (FBP) and Potsdam datasets demonstrate significant performance gains. On FBP, MeCSAFNet-base (6c) surpasses U-Net (4c) by +19.21%, U-Net (6c) by +14.72%, SegFormer (4c) by +19.62%, and SegFormer (6c) by +14.74% in mIoU. On Potsdam, MeCSAFNet-large (4c) improves over DeepLabV3+ (4c) by +6.48%, DeepLabV3+ (6c) by +5.85%, SegFormer (4c) by +9.11%, and SegFormer (6c) by +4.80% in mIoU. The model also achieves consistent gains over several recent state-of-the-art approaches. Moreover, compact variants of MeCSAFNet deliver notable performance with lower training time and reduced inference cost, supporting their deployment in resource-constrained environments. Model code is available at: https://github.com/Leo-Thomas/mecsafnet
papers.journal_ref: Neurocomputing, vol. 685, pages 133533, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MeCSAFNet 用双 ConvNeXt 编码器分别处理可见光与非可见光波段，经独立解码器重建空间信息后由专用融合解码器在多尺度上整合，并加 CBAM 注意力与 ASAU 激活。在 FBP 上 MeCSAFNet-base (6c) 的 mIoU 比 U-Net (4c) 高 19.21%、比 SegFormer (6c) 高 14.74%；Potsdam 上 large (4c) 比 DeepLabV3+ (4c) 高 6.48%、比 SegFormer (4c) 高 9.11%。
Motivation: 多光谱语义分割需要同时利用可见光的空间细节与 NIR、NDVI、NDWI 等光谱信息，而直接把各波段堆进单一编码器难以兼顾两者。
Method: 双 ConvNeXt 编码器分别处理可见与非可见通道，各自解码器重建空间信息，再由专用融合解码器在多个尺度上整合中间特征；融合过程加 CBAM 注意力，ASAU 激活函数用于稳定高效优化。支持 4 通道 (RGB+NIR) 与 6 通道 (加 NDVI、NDWI) 两种输入配置，并提供 base/large 与紧凑变体。

papers.title: A Positive Case for Faithfulness: LLM Self-Explanations Help Predict Model Behavior
papers.abstract_en: LLM self-explanations are often presented as a promising tool for AI oversight, yet their faithfulness to the model's true reasoning process is poorly understood. Existing faithfulness metrics have critical limitations, typically relying on identifying unfaithfulness via adversarial prompting or detecting reasoning errors. These methods overlook the predictive value of explanations. We introduce Normalized Simulatability Gain (NSG), a general and scalable metric based on the idea that a faithful explanation should allow an observer to learn a model's decision-making criteria, and thus better predict its behavior on related inputs. We evaluate 18 frontier proprietary and open-weight models, e.g., Gemini 3, GPT-5.2, and Claude 4.5, on 7,000 counterfactuals from popular datasets covering health, business, and ethics. We find self-explanations substantially improve prediction of model behavior (11-37% NSG). Self-explanations also provide more predictive information than explanations generated by external models, even when those models are stronger. This implies an advantage from self-knowledge that external explanation methods cannot replicate. Our approach also reveals that, across models, 5-15% of self-explanations are highly misleading. Despite their imperfections, we show a positive case for self-explanations: they encode information that helps predict model behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出归一化可模拟性增益 (Normalized Simulatability Gain, NSG)，用「解释能否让观察者学会模型的判据并预测其在相关输入上的行为」来度量忠实度。在 18 个前沿模型、7,000 条反事实上，自解释把行为预测提升 11–37%，且优于更强外部模型生成的解释；同时 5–15% 的自解释高度误导。
Motivation: 现有忠实度指标靠对抗性提示或检测推理错误来找不忠实，忽略了解释本身对预测模型行为的价值，无法刻画自解释是否携带可复用的判据信息。
Method: 定义可扩展指标 NSG：让观察者读解释后预测模型在相关输入上的行为，按归一化增益计分；在覆盖健康、商业、伦理的流行数据集上构造 7,000 条反事实，评测 Gemini 3、GPT-5.2、Claude 4.5 等 18 个专有与开放权重模型，并与外部模型生成的解释对比。
Result: 自解释使模型行为预测提升 11–37% NSG；自解释提供的预测信息多于外部模型生成的解释，即使后者更强；跨模型有 5–15% 的自解释高度误导。
Conclusion: 自解释虽不完美，却编码了外部解释方法无法复制的自我知识，可用于 AI 监督中的行为预测；同时需警惕其中 5–15% 的高度误导解释。

papers.title: Continuous-Utility Direct Preference Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Large language model reasoning is often treated as a monolithic capability, relying on binary preference supervision that fails to capture partial progress or fine-grained reasoning quality. We introduce continuous utility direct preference optimization (CU-DPO), a framework that aligns models to a portfolio of prompt-based cognitive strategies by replacing binary labels with continuous scores that capture fine-grained reasoning quality. We prove that learning with K strategies yields a Theta(K log K) improvement in sample complexity over binary preferences and that DPO converges to the entropy-regularized utility-maximizing policy. To exploit this signal, we propose a two-stage pipeline: (i) strategy selection, which optimizes the model to choose the best strategy via best-vs-all comparisons, and (ii) execution refinement, which trains correct execution using margin-stratified pairs. The framework is domain-agnostic: any task admitting cognitively distinct solution strategies and a decomposable continuous utility signal can be incorporated into the portfolio. On mathematical reasoning benchmarks, CU-DPO improves strategy selection accuracy from 35-46% to 68-78% across seven base models, yielding downstream reasoning gains of up to +6.6 points on in-distribution datasets with effective out-of-distribution transfer. CU-DPO demonstrates consistent gains on code generation and causal reasoning benchmarks, confirming generalization beyond the mathematical domain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CU-DPO 用连续效用分数替代二元偏好标签，把 LLM 对齐到一组提示式认知策略上，并证明 K 个策略相对二元偏好带来 Θ(K log K) 的样本复杂度改进、DPO 收敛到熵正则效用最大化策略。在七个基座模型的数学推理基准上，策略选择准确率从 35–46% 提到 68–78%，分布内下游推理最多 +6.6 分且可有效迁移到分布外。
Motivation: LLM 推理被当作单一能力，用二元偏好监督训练，既捕捉不到部分进展，也刻画不了细粒度的推理质量。
Method: CU-DPO 两阶段流水线：策略选择阶段用 best-vs-all 比较优化模型挑出最佳策略，执行修正阶段用 margin-stratified 配对训练正确执行；连续效用信号需可分解，框架对领域通用，可纳入任何存在认知上不同解法的任务。
Result: 数学推理基准上，七个基座模型的策略选择准确率由 35–46% 升至 68–78%，分布内数据集下游推理最多 +6.6 分，分布外迁移有效；代码生成与因果推理基准上也有一致增益。理论上 K 策略相对二元偏好带来 Θ(K log K) 样本复杂度改进，DPO 收敛到熵正则效用最大化策略。
Conclusion: 把二元偏好换成连续效用并拆成策略选择与执行修正两步，能在数学、代码、因果推理上同时提升策略选择与下游推理，且增益可跨领域泛化。

papers.title: Order-Optimal Sample Complexity of Rectified Flows
papers.abstract_en: Recently, flow-based generative models have shown superior efficiency compared to diffusion models. In this paper, we study rectified flow models, which constrain transport trajectories to be linear from the base distribution to the data distribution. This structural restriction greatly accelerates sampling, often enabling high-quality generation with a single Euler step. Under standard assumptions on the neural network classes used to parameterize the velocity field and data distribution, we prove that rectified flows achieve sample complexity $\tilde{O}(\varepsilon^{-2})$. This improves on the best known $O(\varepsilon^{-4})$ bounds for flow matching model and matches the optimal rate for mean estimation. Our analysis exploits the particular structure of rectified flows: because the model is trained with a squared loss along linear paths, the associated hypothesis class admits a sharply controlled localized Rademacher complexity. This yields the improved, order-optimal sample complexity and provides a theoretical explanation for the strong empirical performance of rectified flow models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明 rectified flow（把输运轨迹约束为基分布到数据分布的直线）在标准神经网络与数据分布假设下样本复杂度为 Õ(ε⁻²)，优于 flow matching 已知最优的 O(ε⁻⁴) 上界，并与均值估计的最优速率一致。关键机制是线性路径上的平方损失训练使假设类的局部 Rademacher 复杂度可被锐利控制。
Motivation: flow-based 生成模型虽在采样效率上超过 diffusion，但其样本复杂度已知上界为 O(ε⁻⁴)，与均值估计的最优速率存在差距，rectified flow 的直线轨迹结构能否带来理论上的阶改进尚不清楚。
Method: 在参数化速度场的神经网络类与数据分布的标准假设下做理论分析：利用 rectified flow 沿线性路径以平方损失训练这一结构，对相应假设类推导锐利控制的局部 Rademacher 复杂度，进而得到样本复杂度界。
Result: 证明 rectified flow 样本复杂度为 Õ(ε⁻²)，改进 flow matching 模型已知最优的 O(ε⁻⁴) 界，并匹配均值估计的最优速率；摘要未给出实验数值。
Conclusion: rectified flow 的直线轨迹加平方损失结构在理论上足以把生成模型样本复杂度降到阶最优，为其实证上的强表现提供理论解释。

papers.title: Epistemic Constitutionalism Or: how to avoid coherence bias
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly function as artificial reasoners: they evaluate arguments, assign credibility, and express confidence. Yet their responses can leave the epistemic policies governing these evaluations implicit. This paper argues for an epistemic constitution for AI: explicit, contestable meta-norms regulating how systems form and express beliefs. Source attribution provides the motivating case. An exploratory audit suggested that expectations about a source's position intrude on argument evaluation. A preregistered study (arXiv:2609.35286) then found content-dependent effects of source attribution, with selected written evaluations supporting source-position fit as an explanation. The audit also revealed conflicting justifications for attending to sources. Source independence, however, is not a neutral default: in testimonial contexts, a source's position and the costs of speaking against interest can provide relevant evidence. I distinguish two approaches to epistemic constitution design: the Platonic, which mandates formal correctness and default source-independence from a privileged standpoint, and the Liberal, which rejects such privilege and protects conditions for collective inquiry while allowing principled source-attending grounded in epistemic vigilance. I defend the Liberal approach, sketch a constitutional core of eight principles and four orientations, and argue that AI epistemic governance requires explicit, contestable norms for evaluating testimony, responding to evidence, and revising judgements.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 1 table. Substantial revision: empirical discussion updated in light of arXiv:2609.35286; exploratory-audit claims corrected against public logs. Appendix A: full per-log register. Appendix B: corrections to v4 and AI-assisted writing documentation. Philosophical argument clarified
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文主张为 AI 系统建立显式、可争议的「认识论宪法」：用可辩论的元规范约束系统如何形成与表达信念，而非让认识策略隐含在模型行为中。作者区分 Platonic（从特权立场强制形式正确与默认来源独立）与 Liberal（保护集体探究条件、允许基于认识警惕的有原则来源关注）两种设计路径，并为后者勾勒八条原则与四个取向的宪法核心。
Motivation: LLM 越来越多地充当推理者，评判论证、分配可信度、表达置信，但支配这些评价的认识策略是隐含的，无法被审查或争议。
Method: 以来源归因 (source attribution) 为动机案例：先做探索性审计，再依据预注册研究 (arXiv:2609.35286) 检验来源立场是否侵入论证评价；随后做规范性区分（Platonic vs Liberal）并给出 Liberal 路径的宪法核心设计。
Result: 预注册研究发现来源归因存在内容依赖效应，部分书面评价支持「来源立场契合 (source-position fit)」作为解释；审计还揭示对关注来源的相互冲突的论证。作者论证来源独立并非中立默认：在证言情境中，来源立场与「逆利益发言」的成本可构成相关证据。
Conclusion: AI 认识治理需要显式、可争议的规范来处理证言、回应证据与修正判断；Liberal 路径优于从特权立场强制来源独立的 Platonic 路径。

papers.title: Activation-Informed Pareto-Guided Low-Rank Compression for Efficient LLM/VLM
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLM) and vision-language models (VLM) have achieved state-of-the-art performance, but they impose significant memory and computing challenges in deployment. We present a novel low-rank compression framework to address this challenge. First, we upper bound the change of network loss via layer-wise activation-based compression errors, filling a theoretical gap in the literature. We then formulate low-rank model compression as a bi-objective optimization and prove that a single uniform tolerance yields surrogate Pareto-optimal heterogeneous ranks. Based on our theoretical insights, we propose Pareto-Guided Singular Value Decomposition (PGSVD), a zero-shot pipeline that improves activation-aware compression via Pareto-guided rank selection and alternating least-squares implementation. We apply PGSVD to both LLM and VLM, showing better accuracy at the same compression levels and inference speedup.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出零样本低秩压缩框架 PGSVD：先用逐层激活误差给网络损失变化做上界，再把压缩写成双目标优化并证明统一容差即可得到 Pareto 最优的异构秩，据此做 Pareto 引导的秩选择与交替最小二乘实现。在 LLM 与 VLM 上，同等压缩比下精度更高且推理加速。
Motivation: LLM/VLM 部署面临内存与算力压力，而现有低秩压缩缺少损失变化的理论上界，秩选择也缺少统一的优化准则。
Method: PGSVD（Pareto-Guided Singular Value Decomposition）零样本流水线：以逐层激活为基础的压缩误差上界网络损失变化，将低秩压缩建模为双目标优化并证明单一统一容差给出代理 Pareto 最优的异构秩，再用 Pareto 引导秩选择加交替最小二乘 (alternating least-squares) 求解。
Result: 在 LLM 与 VLM 上，PGSVD 在相同压缩水平下取得更高精度并带来推理加速；理论部分给出损失变化的逐层激活上界，以及统一容差下异构秩的代理 Pareto 最优性证明。
Conclusion: 激活感知的 Pareto 引导秩选择加交替最小二乘，可以在不微调的前提下同时换取更高压缩比与更快推理，且有损失上界与 Pareto 最优性作为理论支撑。

papers.title: Persistence Paradox in Dynamic Science: Evidence from the Deep Learning Revolution
papers.abstract_en: Persistence is often regarded as a virtue in science. In this paper, however, we challenge this conventional view by highlighting its contextual nature, particularly how persistence can become a liability during paradigm shifts. We focus on the deep learning revolution catalyzed by AlexNet in 2012. Analyzing the 20-year career trajectories of more than 5,000 scientists active in top machine learning venues during the preceding decade, we examine how their research focus and output evolved. We first uncover a dynamic period in which leading venues increasingly prioritized cutting-edge deep learning developments, displacing traditional statistical learning methods. Scientists responded to these changes in markedly different ways: those who were previously successful or affiliated with established teams adapted more slowly. Such persistence is positively associated with productivity but, after 2012, negatively associated with scientific impact. Most researchers, and the largest share of the field's output, cluster in a band of moderate persistence, pointing to a trade-off between output and impact, as well as to institutional frictions that make larger departures costly. These conclusions are robust to alternative identification strategies and to competing explanations such as topic popularity premiums and survivorship bias. Taken together, our macro- and micro-level findings suggest that, in this case, a paradigm shift creates an opportunity structure by devaluing the very expertise that conferred incumbents' advantage in the first place.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 以 AlexNet(2012) 引发的深度学习革命为范式转换案例，追踪 5,000 多名顶级机器学习会议活跃科学家 20 年的职业轨迹：坚持 (persistence) 与产出正相关，但 2012 年之后与学术影响力负相关，此前越成功或隶属成熟团队的人适应越慢。多数研究者聚在中等坚持度区间，体现产出与影响力之间的权衡。
Motivation: 科学社会学常把坚持当作美德，但范式转换期坚持可能变成负担；此前缺少在个体职业轨迹层面、跨越一次真实范式转换的宏观与微观证据。
Method: 样本为前十年顶级机器学习会议中活跃的 5,000 余名科学家，构建其 20 年职业轨迹，测量研究方向的坚持度、产出与影响力，并以替代识别策略以及主题热度溢价、幸存者偏差等竞争性解释做稳健性检验。
Result: 坚持度与产出正相关，2012 年后与影响力负相关；此前成功或隶属成熟团队者适应更慢；多数研究者与最大份额产出集中在中等坚持度带；结论对替代识别策略与竞争性解释稳健。
Conclusion: 范式转换通过贬低造就在位者优势的那套专长来创造机会结构，坚持的收益在转换前后发生符号反转。

papers.title: "Is This Really a Human Peer Supporter?": Misalignments Between Peer Supporters and Experts in LLM-Supported Interactions
papers.abstract_en: Mental health is a growing global concern, prompting interest in AI-driven solutions to expand access to psychosocial support. Peer support, grounded in lived experience, offers a valuable complement to professional care. However, variability in training, effectiveness, and definitions raises concerns about quality, consistency, and safety. Large Language Models (LLMs) present new opportunities to enhance peer support interactions, particularly in real-time, text-based interactions. We present and evaluate an AI-supported system with an LLM-simulated distressed client (SimClient), context-sensitive LLM-generated suggestions (Suggestions), and real-time emotion visualisations. 2 mixed-methods studies with 12 peer supporters and 6 mental health professionals (i.e., experts) examined the system's effectiveness and implications for practice. Both groups recognised its potential to enhance training and improve interaction quality. However, we found a key tension emerged: while peer supporters engaged meaningfully, experts consistently flagged critical issues in peer supporter responses, such as missed distress cues and premature advice-giving. This misalignment highlights potential limitations in current peer support training, especially in emotionally charged contexts where safety and fidelity to best practices are essential. Our findings underscore the need for standardised, psychologically grounded training, especially as peer support scales globally. They also demonstrate how LLM-supported systems can scaffold this development--if designed with care and guided by expert oversight. This work contributes to emerging conversations on responsible AI integration in mental health and the evolving role of LLMs in augmenting peer-delivered care.
papers.comment: Accepted at CSCW 2026. 52 pages, 12 figures, 17 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 构建并评估一套 LLM 支持的同伴支持训练系统：LLM 模拟的困境来访者 (SimClient)、情境敏感的 LLM 建议 (Suggestions) 与实时情绪可视化。对 12 名同伴支持者和 6 名心理健康专家的两项混合方法研究发现，同伴支持者参与有意义，但专家持续指出其回应中的关键问题（漏掉 distress 线索、过早给建议），暴露出现有同伴支持训练在情绪激动场景下的失准。
Motivation: 同伴支持在培训、有效性和定义上差异大，质量、一致性与安全性存疑；随着同伴支持全球扩展，需要可扩展且有专家把关的训练方式。
Method: 提出并评估一个 AI 支持系统，含三个组件：LLM 模拟的困境来访者 SimClient、情境敏感的 LLM 生成建议 Suggestions、实时情绪可视化；通过两项混合方法研究，参与者为 12 名同伴支持者与 6 名心理健康专家，考察系统对训练与互动质量的作用。
Result: 两项混合方法研究（12 名同伴支持者、6 名专家）中，两组都认可系统有提升培训与互动质量的潜力；但专家持续标记同伴支持者回应中的关键问题，典型为漏掉 distress 线索与过早给建议，与同伴支持者自身的有意义参与形成张力。
Conclusion: 同伴支持者与专家对同一回应质量的判断存在系统性失准，说明需要标准化、心理学有依据的同伴支持培训；LLM 支持系统可以 scaffold 这一发展，前提是设计审慎并有专家监督。

papers.title: APE: Selective Fine-tuning with Acceptance Criteria for Language Model Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: We present Adjacent Possible Exploration (APE), a selective fine-tuning method for adapting large language models that systematically explores parameter modifications while maintaining model stability. Inspired by evolutionary optimization principles, APE evaluates multiple candidate parameter updates through fine-tuning on small data subsets and accepts only those exceeding a performance threshold. Unlike standard fine-tuning that follows single gradient directions, APE implements a filtered selection process that prevents destabilizing parameter changes while enabling systematic improvement. Our method achieves 33.9\% BLEU improvement and 36.2\% perplexity reduction on news summarization tasks while using minimal computational resources. The approach provides a practical framework for controlled model adaptation that balances performance gains with representational stability.

TL;DR: APE（Adjacent Possible Exploration）用进化式选择性微调替代单步梯度更新：在小数据子集上生成多个候选参数更新，只接受性能超过阈值的那些，以抑制破坏稳定性的改动。摘要报告新闻摘要任务上 BLEU 提升 33.9%、困惑度下降 36.2%；作者已撤回该文，声明第 3 节实验未实现第 2 节的接受准则、3.2 节人工评估无效，结果与结论应作废。
Motivation: 大语言模型微调沿单一梯度方向走，容易产生破坏表示稳定性的参数改动；需要一种在小数据、低算力下可控的适配方式。
Method: APE 借鉴进化优化：在小数据子集上微调出多个候选参数更新，按性能阈值做过滤式选择，只接受超过阈值的更新，其余丢弃，从而在提升性能的同时维持模型稳定性。
Result: 摘要报告新闻摘要任务 BLEU 提升 33.9%、困惑度降低 36.2%，并称计算资源开销极小；作者撤回说明指出第 3 节（Table 3、Figure 2）的实验并未实现第 2 节描述的接受准则，3.2 节人工评估无效，所报结果与结论应被忽略。
Conclusion: 作者的主张是选择性接受候选更新能在性能增益与表示稳定之间取得平衡，但该主张已因实验实现与方法描述不符而被作者本人撤回作废。

papers.title: Generative AI for Autonomous Driving: Frontiers and Opportunities
papers.abstract_en: Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) constitutes a transformative technological wave that reconfigures industries through its unparalleled capabilities for content creation, reasoning, planning, and multimodal understanding. This revolutionary force offers the most promising path yet toward solving one of engineering's grandest challenges: achieving reliable, fully autonomous driving, particularly the pursuit of Level 5 autonomy. This survey delivers a comprehensive and critical synthesis of the emerging role of GenAI across the autonomous driving stack. We begin by distilling the principles and trade-offs of modern generative modeling, encompassing VAEs, GANs, Diffusion Models, and Large Language Models (LLMs). We then map their frontier applications in image, LiDAR, trajectory, occupancy, video generation as well as LLM-guided reasoning and decision making. We categorize practical applications, such as synthetic data workflows, end-to-end driving strategies, high-fidelity digital twin systems, smart transportation networks, and cross-domain transfer to embodied AI. We identify key obstacles and possibilities such as comprehensive generalization across rare cases, evaluation and safety checks, budget-limited implementation, regulatory compliance, ethical concerns, and environmental effects, while proposing research plans across theoretical assurances, trust metrics, transport integration, and socio-technical influence. By unifying these threads, the survey provides a forward-looking reference for researchers, engineers, and policymakers navigating the convergence of generative AI and advanced autonomous mobility. An actively maintained repository of cited works is available at https://github.com/taco-group/GenAI4AD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于生成式 AI 与自动驾驶的综述，覆盖 VAE、GAN、Diffusion、LLM 等生成建模范式及其在图像、LiDAR、轨迹、占据、视频生成与 LLM 推理决策中的应用，并归纳合成数据、端到端驾驶、数字孪生、智慧交通与具身 AI 迁移等落地形态。核心论断是 GenAI 是通往 Level 5 自动驾驶最有希望的路径，但需先解决长尾泛化、评估与安全检查、预算受限部署、合规与伦理等障碍。
Motivation: 自动驾驶要达到 Level 5 仍是最困难的工程挑战之一，长尾场景、评估与安全验证、成本与合规共同卡住现有方案；综述旨在系统梳理 GenAI 能在自动驾驶栈的哪些环节补位。
Method: 综述先梳理 VAE、GAN、Diffusion Models、LLM 的原理与权衡，再把它们映射到图像/LiDAR/轨迹/占据/视频生成与 LLM 引导的推理决策，并按合成数据流程、端到端驾驶策略、高保真数字孪生、智慧交通网络、跨域迁移到具身 AI 分类实际应用。
Result: 综述识别出的关键障碍包括跨罕见场景的全面泛化、评估与安全检查、预算受限实现、监管合规、伦理问题与环境影响，并给出理论保证、信任度量、交通集成与社会技术影响四条研究计划；配套维护被引文献仓库 GenAI4AD（github.com/taco-group/GenAI4AD）。
Conclusion: 生成式 AI 与先进自动驾驶的融合需要同时推进理论保证、信任度量、交通系统集成与社会技术影响研究，才可能支撑 Level 5 自动驾驶落地。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: The Utility and Complexity of in- and out-of-Distribution Machine Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning, the process of selectively removing data from trained models, is increasingly crucial for addressing privacy concerns and knowledge gaps post-deployment. Despite this importance, existing approaches are often heuristic and lack formal guarantees. In this paper, we analyze the fundamental utility, time, and space complexity trade-offs of approximate unlearning, providing rigorous certification analogous to differential privacy. For in-distribution forget data -- data similar to the retain set -- we show that a surprisingly simple and general procedure, empirical risk minimization with output perturbation, achieves tight unlearning-utility-complexity trade-offs, addressing a previous theoretical gap on the separation from unlearning "for free" via differential privacy, which inherently facilitates the removal of such data. However, such techniques fail with out-of-distribution forget data -- data significantly different from the retain set -- where unlearning time complexity can exceed that of retraining, even for a single sample. To address this, we propose a new robust and noisy gradient descent variant that provably amortizes unlearning time complexity without compromising utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在机器遗忘 (machine unlearning) 的效用-时间-空间复杂度权衡中，对与保留集相似的 in-distribution 遗忘数据，带输出扰动的经验风险最小化 (ERM + output perturbation) 即可达到紧的权衡，填补了与差分隐私「免费遗忘」分离的理论缺口；但对 out-of-distribution 遗忘数据该类方法失效，遗忘时间复杂度甚至超过重训练（哪怕单个样本），作者提出带噪声的梯度下降变体以可证明地摊销时间复杂度且不牺牲效用。
Motivation: 现有遗忘方法多为启发式、缺少形式化保证，而近似遗忘的效用、时间与空间复杂度权衡此前存在理论缺口，尤其 OOD 遗忘数据下遗忘代价可能高于重训练。
Method: 给出类差分隐私的严格遗忘认证，分析近似遗忘的基本效用/时间/空间复杂度权衡；对 in-distribution 遗忘数据用经验风险最小化加输出扰动 (ERM with output perturbation)，对 out-of-distribution 情形提出鲁棒带噪梯度下降变体以摊销遗忘时间。
Result: 对 in-distribution 遗忘数据，ERM 加输出扰动达到紧的遗忘-效用-复杂度权衡；对 out-of-distribution 遗忘数据，此类技术失效，遗忘时间复杂度可超过重训练，即使只遗忘单个样本；新梯度下降变体可证明地摊销遗忘时间复杂度且不损害效用。
Conclusion: 遗忘的复杂度代价取决于遗忘数据与保留集的分布距离：相似时简单扰动法已最优，显著不同时必须改用可摊销时间的算法而非直接复用原方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Allocation Stability and Wald Inference under Variance-Aware UCB
papers.abstract_en: Allocation stability is often used to justify Gaussian inference from bandit data, but when is it necessary? In this paper, we address this question for a two-armed, fixed-horizon variance-aware UCB policy with bounded reward distributions that may vary with the horizon. We find a sharp criterion in terms of the reward gap and variances that determines whether the optimal-arm count admits a deterministic approximation with vanishing relative error, while the suboptimal-arm count is always stable. Despite the possible instability of the optimal-arm count, we show that the ordinary Wald statistic for a linear combination of the arm means has a standard normal limit for every fixed nonzero coefficient vector, provided the product of the pull count and reward variance diverges in probability for each arm. Under the same condition, however, this Gaussian approximation holds uniformly over deterministic nonzero coefficient vectors if and only if the optimal-arm count is stable. The analysis relies on two main ingredients: (i) a pathwise comparison with an auxiliary policy whose final optimal-arm count is asymptotically equivalent to the original count and independent of the optimal-arm reward sequence; and (ii) joint limits for the rescaled optimal-arm count and the two studentized sample-mean errors under the original policy, which yield nonstandard Wald limits for certain linear combinations of the arm means with coefficients that vary with the horizon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在两臂、固定轮次的 variance-aware UCB bandit 下，给出最优臂抽取次数何时具有相对误差消失的确定性近似的尖锐判据（由奖励间隙与方差决定），并证明即使最优臂次数不稳定，普通 Wald 统计量对每个固定非零系数向量仍服从标准正态极限；但一致 Gaussian 逼近对确定性非零系数向量成立当且仅当最优臂次数稳定。
Motivation: bandit 数据上用 Gaussian/Wald 推断常以 allocation stability 为前提，但该条件何时真正必要并不清楚，尤其当奖励分布可随轮次变化时。
Method: 研究两臂固定轮次 variance-aware UCB 策略、有界奖励分布；核心工具是 (i) 与末次最优臂次数渐近等价且独立于最优臂奖励序列的辅助策略做逐路径比较，(ii) 原策略下重标度最优臂次数与两个学生化样本均值误差的联合极限。
Result: 得到由奖励间隙与方差刻画的尖锐判据：最优臂次数存在相对误差消失的确定性近似，而次优臂次数总是稳定的；在每臂拉取次数与奖励方差之积依概率发散的条件下，Wald 统计量对每个固定非零系数向量有标准正态极限，但对确定性非零系数向量的一致 Gaussian 逼近当且仅当最优臂次数稳定；系数随轮次变化的某些线性组合给出非标准 Wald 极限。
Conclusion: allocation stability 对逐点 Wald 推断并非必要，但对一致 Gaussian 逼近是本质条件；稳定性判据取决于奖励间隙与方差的相对大小。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Auto-Regressive Models Need Structural Registers: Semantic Foresight Improves Coherent Driving Video Continuation
papers.abstract_en: Front-view driving video continuation is a critical component for constructing sophisticated world models. However, maintaining long-term coherence faces the fundamental challenge of mitigating ''generative degeneration'' during the auto-regressive process. This phenomenon arises when the limited attention capacity of world models becomes saturated with high-entropy pixel details over extended sequences, leading to a collapse of global scene structure and motion intensity. To address this, we introduce STRIDE (STructural RegIsters for Decoupled Extrapolation), a large vision model architecture with an enforced semantic foresight mechanism. STRIDE decouples video continuation into two sub-tasks via interleaved generation of semantic and RGB tokens: forecasting low-entropy semantic maps, and subsequently generating high-frequency visual appearance conditioned on this structure. The semantic tokens explicitly function as ''structural registers'' -- dedicated memory slots that robustly retain the scene's long-term context and world dynamics. Furthermore, we employ an architecturally decoupled flow matching-based super-resolution module to enhance the final visual fidelity. Extensive experiments in autonomous driving scenarios demonstrate that STRIDE effectively mitigates generative degeneration, achieving minute-level, temporally consistent driving video continuation with strong generalization ability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STRIDE 把前视驾驶视频的自回归续写拆成语义与 RGB 交替生成两步：先预测低熵语义图作为承载长期场景上下文的 structural registers，再在其条件下生成高频外观，并接一个架构解耦的 flow matching 超分模块。作者称该机制抑制了注意力被高熵像素细节饱和导致的 generative degeneration，实现分钟级、时间一致的驾驶视频续写。
Motivation: 世界模型自回归续写长序列时，有限注意力被高熵像素细节占满，全局场景结构与运动强度随之崩塌（generative degeneration），长期连贯性无法维持。
Method: STRIDE 以 interleaved 方式交替生成语义 token 与 RGB token，把续写解耦为先预测低熵语义图、再按该结构生成高频外观；语义 token 作为专用记忆槽保留长期上下文与世界动态，末端接架构解耦的 flow matching 超分模块提升视觉保真度。
Result: 在自动驾驶场景的大量实验中，STRIDE 被展示可抑制 generative degeneration，达成分钟级、时间一致的驾驶视频续写，并具备较强泛化能力。
Conclusion: 把长期结构信息从像素细节中解耦到专用语义记忆槽，是自回归驾驶视频续写维持分钟级连贯的可行架构路径。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Speech Emotion Recognition Using CNN and Its Use Case in Digital Healthcare
papers.abstract_en: The process of identifying human emotion and affective states from speech is known as speech emotion recognition (SER). This is based on the observation that tone and pitch in the voice frequently convey underlying emotion. Speech recognition includes the ability to recognize emotions, which is becoming increasingly popular and in high demand. With the help of appropriate factors (such modalities, emotions, intensities, repetitions, etc.) found in the data, my research seeks to use the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to distinguish emotions from audio recordings and label them in accordance with the range of different emotions. I have developed a machine learning model to identify emotions from supplied audio files with the aid of machine learning methods. The evaluation is mostly focused on precision, recall, and F1 score, which are common machine learning metrics. To properly set up and train the machine learning framework, the main objective is to investigate the influence and cross-relation of all input and output parameters. To improve the ability to recognize intentions, a key condition for communication, I have evaluated emotions using my specialized machine learning algorithm via voice that would address the emotional state from voice with the help of digital healthcare, bridging the gap between human and artificial intelligence (AI).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 CNN 从音频录音中识别语音情感 (speech emotion recognition)，按情感、强度、重复等数据因子标注情绪标签，并把该模型接到数字医疗场景中从语音推断情绪状态。评价指标选 precision、recall 与 F1 score，摘要未给出任何具体数值。
Motivation: 语音中的音调与音色常承载潜在情绪，但把情感识别做成可用的意图理解能力、并落到数字医疗这类人机交互场景，仍需要系统化的模型搭建与参数交叉关系研究。
Method: 以 Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) 为核心构建机器学习框架，输入为音频录音，利用数据中的模态、情感、强度、重复等因子区分并标注情绪；训练目标是考察全部输入与输出参数的影响及其交叉关系，评价用 precision、recall、F1 score。
Result: 摘要给出的是方法与评价设置：以 CNN 区分音频中的情绪并按情感范围标注，评价集中在 precision、recall、F1 score 三项指标，未给出任何具体数值、数据集名称或基线对比。
Conclusion: 作者主张 CNN 驱动的语音情感识别可经由语音补足情绪状态识别，从而在数字医疗中缩小人类与 AI 的沟通差距；arXiv comment 标注该稿存在技术不一致、需要修订。

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Diffusion Approximate Posterior Sampling for Sparse-View and Limited-Angle CT
papers.abstract_en: Sparse-view computed tomography (CT) reduces radiation dose and acquisition time and may mitigate motion artifacts. However, angular undersampling provides insufficient information to determine the image uniquely and stably. Limited-angle CT, arising from restricted angular coverage, produces strongly directional information loss associated with the missing angular range. In both settings, image directions may be strongly observed, weakly constrained, or unobservable, leading to severe ill-posedness and reconstruction ambiguity. Existing diffusion-based approaches incorporate measurement information through likelihood guidance, data-consistency operations, or range-null-space corrections. However, they do not generally use the continuously varying measurement sensitivity of the acquisition to jointly shape both reconstruction updates and stochastic exploration. We propose a geometry-aware diffusion-guided stochastic reconstruction framework for sparse-view and limited-angle CT. Its central component is a regularized noise-weighted pullback metric constructed from the CT forward operator and measurement-noise covariance. This metric continuously adapts both the measurement-aware update and stochastic exploration according to directional measurement sensitivity, suppressing changes along strongly constrained directions while permitting greater exploration along weakly constrained and unobservable directions. We complement this geometry-aware update with a regularized data-consistency correction and approximately null-space-restricted stochastic perturbations, implemented matrix-free using forward and backprojection operations together with conjugate-gradient solves. Experiments on sparse-view, noisy, and limited-angle CT demonstrate competitive reconstruction quality, strong measurement consistency, and spatially resolved empirical uncertainty estimates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向稀疏视角与有限角 CT 的几何感知扩散近似后验采样框架，核心是由 CT 前向算子与测量噪声协方差构造的正则化噪声加权 pullback 度量，按方向性测量灵敏度同时调制更新与随机探索：强约束方向抑制变化，弱约束与不可观测方向放开探索。在稀疏、含噪与有限角 CT 实验中给出有竞争力的重建质量、强测量一致性与空间分辨的经验不确定性估计。
Motivation: 稀疏视角与有限角 CT 的角度欠采样使图像方向有的强观测、有的弱约束、有的完全不可观测，病态性严重；已有扩散方法靠似然引导、数据一致性或 range-null-space 修正注入测量信息，却未利用采集过程中连续变化的测量灵敏度来同时塑造更新与随机探索。
Method: 以 CT 前向算子和测量噪声协方差构造正则化噪声加权 pullback 度量，据此调制测量感知更新与随机探索；辅以正则化数据一致性修正和近似限制在零空间内的随机扰动，全部 matrix-free 实现，只用前向/反投影加共轭梯度 (conjugate-gradient) 求解。
Result: 在稀疏视角、含噪与有限角 CT 三类实验中展示有竞争力的重建质量、强测量一致性，以及空间分辨的经验不确定性估计。
Conclusion: 把采集几何的方向性测量灵敏度直接写进扩散后验采样的度量，可以同时改善重建与不确定性刻画，且无需显式矩阵求逆。

papers.title: Adversarial RL for Port-Scan Evasion: Attacker Feature Visibility in Edge-Deployed IDS
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning-based intrusion detection systems (IDS) are increasingly used in resource-constrained Internet of Things (IoT) environments, yet their robustness is often evaluated against static attacks rather than adversaries that adapt to detection feedback. This paper investigates adaptive port-scan evasion against ML-based IDS models deployed on a Raspberry Pi 3B+. We implement a live Zeek-based IDS pipeline with XGBoost, a multi-layer perceptron, and a 1D convolutional neural network trained on TON_IoT telemetry, and use a Deep Q-Network (DQN) adversary to learn evasive combinations of probe timing, TCP flags, and payload size under black-box, gray-box, and white-box feature-visibility settings. Although the deployed IDS models detect conventional port scans at 91.1--99.8%, DQN final-50-episode evasion rates range from 61.9% to 98.3% across feature-visibility settings. Greater feature visibility does not monotonically improve evasion, and its effect is model-dependent: against XGBoost, the black-box agent achieves 92.9% evasion, compared with 61.9% and 76.9% for gray-box and white-box agents, respectively, whereas 1D-CNN is most vulnerable under white-box access at 98.1%. Because standard DQN can overestimate action values, we additionally spot-check representative conditions using Double DQN. The gray-box condition remains unstable in this check, providing no evidence that overestimation bias alone explains the observed instability. These results show that limited feature knowledge can still enable effective adaptive evasion against static edge-deployed IDS models, motivating more robust defenses for IoT edge environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Raspberry Pi 3B+ 上部署基于 Zeek 的 ML 入侵检测流水线（XGBoost、MLP、1D-CNN，训练于 TON_IoT 遥测），用 Deep Q-Network 对手自适应组合探测时序、TCP 标志与载荷大小做端口扫描规避。常规扫描检出率 91.1–99.8%，但 DQN 最后 50 回合规避率达 61.9%–98.3%；特征可见性越高并不单调更易规避，XGBoost 在黑箱下规避 92.9%（灰箱 61.9%、白箱 76.9%），1D-CNN 则在白箱最脆弱达 98.1%。
Motivation: 面向 IoT 的 ML-IDS 鲁棒性多在静态攻击下评估，缺少对能利用检测反馈自适应调整的对手的检验；边缘部署资源受限使这一缺口更突出。
Method: 在 Raspberry Pi 3B+ 上搭建实时 Zeek IDS 流水线，训练 XGBoost、多层感知机 (MLP) 与 1D 卷积网络于 TON_IoT 遥测；以 Deep Q-Network (DQN) 对手在黑箱、灰箱、白箱三种特征可见性下学习探测时序、TCP 标志与载荷大小的规避组合，并用 Double DQN 对代表性条件做抽查。
Result: 部署模型对常规端口扫描检出率 91.1–99.8%；DQN 最后 50 回合规避率在各可见性设置下为 61.9%–98.3%。XGBoost 上黑箱 92.9%、灰箱 61.9%、白箱 76.9%；1D-CNN 在白箱下 98.1%。Double DQN 抽查中灰箱条件仍不稳定，未显示过估偏差可单独解释该不稳定。
Conclusion: 有限的特征知识即可对静态边缘 IDS 实现有效自适应规避，且可见性与规避效果的关系依模型而异，IoT 边界环境需要更鲁棒的防御。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CIRRA: Dual-Level Continual Instruction Reconciliation with Ongoing Execution for Embodied Robot Agents in Interactive Household Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Household robots must accommodate new user instructions while executing ongoing tasks. Existing agents often regenerate or extensively revise the remaining task sequence, introducing plan ambiguity, logical inconsistency, and redundant execution. We formulate continual instruction reconciliation and propose CIRRA (Continual Instruction Reconciliation for Robot Agents), a dual-level framework combining LLM-based semantic reasoning with rule-constrained structural integration. CIRRA first grounds incoming instructions to unique executable skills and resolves underspecified actions and execution locations. It then preserves the ongoing subtask sequence as an execution backbone and generates integration candidates by inserting incoming subtasks into location-matched segments. The semantic reasoner evaluates only modified segments to identify dependencies and conflicts and select the most logically coherent local integration. This structure-preserving process maintains alignment with ongoing execution, mitigates ambiguity and inconsistency, and reuses shared subtasks to reduce redundant execution. We also introduce CHIRP (Continual Household Instruction Reconciliation and Planning), a text-based benchmark of 120 episodes across eight household environments and six categories of everyday activities. On CHIRP, CIRRA achieves 74.2% decision agreement, exceeding the strongest replanning baseline by 30 percentage points; every correct fusion decision yields a correctly placed, conflict-free schedule. On a Unitree G1 humanoid, CIRRA interrupts ongoing skills at the correct moment in every trial and significantly outperforms all baselines on every metric.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CIRRA 把新指令以插入方式并入正在执行的家务任务序列：先将指令落到唯一可执行技能并补全欠定动作与位置，再保留在执行的子任务骨架、只让语义推理器审查被改动的片段以选出逻辑最连贯的局部融合。在自建 CHIRP 基准（120 个 episode、8 个家庭环境、6 类日常活动）上决策一致率 74.2%，比最强重规划基线高 30 个百分点；Unitree G1 实机每次试验都在正确时刻打断当前技能。
Motivation: 家用机器人执行任务途中接收新指令时，现有 agent 常整体重生成或大改剩余任务序列，带来计划歧义、逻辑不一致与重复执行。
Method: CIRRA 双层框架：LLM 语义推理加规则约束的结构化融合。先把新指令 grounding 到唯一可执行技能并解决欠定动作与执行位置，再把在执行的子任务序列当作 execution backbone，只在位置匹配的片段插入新子任务生成融合候选；语义推理器仅评估被修改片段，识别依赖与冲突后选出逻辑最连贯的局部整合，并复用共享子任务。同时提出文本基准 CHIRP。
Result: 在 CHIRP（120 episodes、8 个家庭环境、6 类日常活动）上 CIRRA 决策一致率 74.2%，超出最强重规划基线 30 个百分点；每个正确的融合决策都产出放置正确、无冲突的调度。在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上，每次试验都在正确时刻打断当前技能，并在每一项指标上显著优于全部基线。
Conclusion: 保留执行骨架、只对被改动片段做局部融合，可以在不打断正在进行的任务的前提下吸收新指令，避免整体重规划造成的歧义与冗余执行。

papers.title: LRCC: Generalizing Low-Rank Compression with Conditional Computation
papers.abstract_en: Low-rank compression reduces the cost of pretrained language models by replacing linear transformations with low-rank factorizations. However, conventional methods use a fixed rank allocation during inference, assigning the same amount of compute regardless of the input token. We introduce Low-Rank Conditional Computation (LRCC), which adds token-dependent computation to pretrained models by training one lightweight router per Transformer block to select among a small set of nested low-rank paths. During training, the low-rank factors remain frozen, and only the routers are optimized. We evaluate LRCC on Llama and Qwen models for language modeling and zero-shot downstream tasks. Within the same average active-parameter budget, LRCC improves the predictive performance over static low-rank compression, including a 7.6 percentage-point gain in average downstream accuracy on Llama-2-7B over static methods. At matched batch-size-1 decoding latency, LRCC improves both perplexity and downstream accuracy on Llama-3.2-1B and remains competitive on Llama-2-7B, without specialized kernels. Finally, we assess the usefulness of assigning a token-wise path by analyzing the routers' path choices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LRCC 为预训练语言模型的低秩压缩引入 token 级条件计算：每个 Transformer 块配一个轻量 router，在一组嵌套低秩路径间按输入 token 选择，训练时低秩因子冻结、只优化 router。在相同平均活跃参数预算下，Llama-2-7B 下游平均准确率比静态低秩压缩高 7.6 个百分点；在 batch-size-1 解码延迟对齐时，Llama-3.2-1B 的困惑度与下游准确率同时改善，且无需专用 kernel。
Motivation: 常规低秩压缩在推理时使用固定秩分配，无论输入 token 难易都消耗相同计算量，导致算力浪费。
Method: 在每个 Transformer 块训练一个轻量 router，从少量嵌套低秩路径中做 token 级选择；训练时低秩因子保持冻结，仅优化 router。在 Llama 与 Qwen 系列上做语言建模与 zero-shot 下游任务评测，并分析 router 的路径选择行为。
Result: 相同平均活跃参数预算下，LRCC 优于静态低秩压缩：Llama-2-7B 下游平均准确率提升 7.6 个百分点。在匹配 batch-size-1 解码延迟下，Llama-3.2-1B 的 perplexity 与下游准确率均改善，Llama-2-7B 上保持竞争力，全程无需专用 kernel。
Conclusion: 把固定秩分配换成 token 级的嵌套低秩路径选择，可以在同等算力或同等延迟下同时改善语言模型的困惑度与下游准确率，说明逐 token 差异化计算量是有价值的。

papers.title: Autonomous Droplet Navigation via Model-Based Reinforcement Learning: Zero-Shot Transfer and Emergent Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Self-driving laboratories (SDLs) are transforming chemical and materials discovery through closed-loop automation, yet automated infrastructure for physical manipulation of soft, deformable matter remains beyond current robotic platforms. A critical instance is autonomous droplet transport on an open surface, where contact-angle hysteresis, capillary pinning, and surface heterogeneity produce partially observable dynamics that pose significant challenges for classical model-based controllers. We introduce the first robotic platform for closed-loop autonomous liquid droplet navigation on an open, unconfined surface using model-based reinforcement learning. A two-axis tilting board coated with a thin silicone oil film drives the droplet, while an overhead camera provides real-time feedback. A learned policy was trained on just 50 to 150 physical episodes depending on geometric complexity, without simulation or analytical models. Beyond performance alone, the platform demonstrates three capabilities of interest to the SDL community: it robustly transfers zero-shot to unseen geometries; it autonomously discovers an oscillatory depinning strategy to free the droplet when it sticks; and it completes its full training pipeline in under 90 minutes. These results extend reinforcement-learning manipulation from rigid microrobots to deformable soft-matter systems for next-generation SDLs.
papers.comment: Accepted for presentation at the Robotics & Automation in Self-Driving Laboratories 2026 Workshop, IROS 2026. https://sites.tufts.edu/selfdrivinglabs-iros2026/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用基于模型的强化学习 (model-based RL) 在两轴倾斜板加硅油薄膜的开放面上做液滴自主导航，策略只用 50–150 次真实 episode 训练，不用仿真或解析模型。策略零样本迁移到未见几何形状，卡住时自主发现振荡脱钉 (oscillatory depinning) 策略，整条训练管线在 90 分钟内完成。
Motivation: 自驱动实验室 (SDL) 已能闭环做化学与材料发现，但软、可变形物质的物理操作缺乏自动化基础设施；开放面上的液滴输运受接触角迟滞、毛细钉扎和表面非均匀性影响，动力学部分可观测，经典基于模型的控制器难以应对。
Method: 平台为两轴倾斜板，表面覆薄硅油膜驱动液滴，顶部相机提供实时反馈；用 model-based reinforcement learning 直接在物理系统上训练策略，不借助仿真或解析模型，训练样本量按几何复杂度取 50 至 150 个真实 episode。
Result: 策略零样本 (zero-shot) 迁移到未见几何形状；在液滴卡住时自主发现振荡脱钉策略将其释放；完整训练管线耗时低于 90 分钟；训练仅需 50–150 个物理 episode，随几何复杂度变化。
Conclusion: 基于模型的强化学习可以把刚性微机器人上的操作能力扩展到可变形软物质系统，使开放面上的液滴导航在无需仿真与解析模型、且训练时间不到 90 分钟的条件下可行。

papers.title: QuanLing: Cross-Branch Validation of Language Distance Quantification on Western Romance
papers.abstract_en: Quantifying language distance among closely related languages remains a core challenge in quantitative linguistics. Our previous work [1] introduced QuanLing (Quantitative Linguistics via Pretrained Language Models), a quantitative framework combining language distance metrics (sentence embedding distance, tokenization fragmentation rate) with language property analysis (MLM prediction probability), validated on North Germanic (Danish, Norwegian Bokmål, Swedish). This paper extends QuanLing to Western Romance--French, Portuguese, Spanish, Italian--testing cross-branch applicability with the same metric family and aggregation protocol as our North Germanic study, adapted for four languages (English anchor, quadruplet construction). Using 150 four-language parallel sentences, we compute LaBSE sentence embedding distances, tokenization fragmentation rates from four monolingual BERT tokenizers, and mBERT masked language model mutual intelligibility. Results show that Portuguese--Spanish are closest (LaBSE distance 0.0229), French--Italian most distant (0.0338); LaBSE and mBERT rankings agree on 4 of 6 pairs, confirming cross-model robustness. Western Romance shows a wider absolute distance span than North Germanic (0.011 vs. 0.008) but comparable relative ratios (1.48 vs. 1.67), consistent with longer divergence time. French exhibits notably higher MLM predictability (36.12% top-1 accuracy vs. 29.28% for Italian), reflecting its orthography--phonology decoupling. This cross-branch validation provides further evidence for QuanLing's generalizability beyond a single language branch.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QuanLing 跨分支扩展到西罗曼语（法、葡、西、意），用 LaBSE 句向量距离、四个单语 BERT 分词碎片率与 mBERT 互可懂度在 150 条四语平行句上量化语言距离。葡-西最近（LaBSE 0.0229），法-意最远（0.0338），LaBSE 与 mBERT 排序在 6 对中对上 4 对；西罗曼绝对跨度 0.011 宽于北日耳曼的 0.008，相对比值 1.48 对 1.67 相当。
Motivation: 语言距离量化在近缘语言上仍困难，此前 QuanLing 只在北日耳曼语支验证过，跨语支普适性未检验。
Method: 沿用北日耳曼研究的同一指标族与聚合协议，改为四语言设置（英语锚点、quadruplet 构造）：150 条四语平行句上计算 LaBSE 句向量距离、四个单语 BERT 分词器的 tokenization fragmentation rate，以及 mBERT MLM 的互可懂度（top-1 预测概率）。
Result: 葡萄牙-西班牙最近，LaBSE 距离 0.0229；法国-意大利最远，0.0338。LaBSE 与 mBERT 排序在 6 对语言中一致 4 对。西罗曼绝对距离跨度 0.011，宽于北日耳曼的 0.008，相对比值 1.48 对 1.67。法语 MLM top-1 准确率 36.12%，高于意大利语的 29.28%。
Conclusion: 同一指标族与聚合协议可跨语支复用，为 QuanLing 超出单一语支的普适性提供证据；西罗曼更宽的绝对跨度与更长分化时间一致，法语更高的 MLM 可预测性反映其正字法-音系解耦。

papers.title: Abdominal Ultrasound Simulation from Semantic Labels using Paired Label-to-Physics-Based Image Translation
papers.abstract_en: Purpose: Current abdominal ultrasound (US) simulation methods often require CT-based anatomical references for ray-casting, limiting deformation and pathology variability. We propose a learning-based pipeline trained to predict physics-based images derived from CT scans from semantic labels, enabling controlled simulations without patient-specific CT volumes at inference time. Methods: We introduce a two-stage pipeline that maps anatomical segmentations to realistic US images through a simplified US image. Stage~I synthesizes this image from semantic labels using models trained on CT-based ray-casting outputs. Stage~II refines it into a realistic US scan using anatomically guided unpaired translation. Deformations and pathologies are generated by editing anatomical maps. Results: We evaluated Pix2Pix and the Semantic Diffusion Model (SDM) in Stage~I, followed by segmentation-guided CycleGAN (SG-CycleGAN) refinement in Stage~II. SDM significantly outperformed Pix2Pix in morphological metrics, including MAE (19.85 vs. 21.65), SSIM (0.28 vs. 0.24), and mIoU (0.43 vs. 0.29), whereas Pix2Pix yielded better perceptual point estimates (LPIPS: 0.17 vs. 0.19; FID: 0.32 vs. 0.37; KID: 0.25 vs. 0.48). Conclusion: Training paired generative models with physics-based supervision enables approximation of CT-derived ray-casting outputs at inference time directly from semantic labels. Although the pipeline does not require patient-specific CT volumes at inference time, CT-derived segmentations and ray-casting simulations remain necessary to train Stage~I. Once trained, the framework enables controllable healthy and pathological simulations through semantic-map modification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出两阶段学习式腹部超声仿真流程：Stage I 用语义分割标签直接回归 CT 射线投射得到的简化超声图，Stage II 用分割引导的非配对翻译把它细化成逼真超声。形态学指标上 SDM 显著优于 Pix2Pix（MAE 19.85 vs 21.65，SSIM 0.28 vs 0.24，mIoU 0.43 vs 0.29），但感知指标的点估计 Pix2Pix 更好（LPIPS 0.17 vs 0.19，FID 0.32 vs 0.37，KID 0.25 vs 0.48）。
Motivation: 现有腹部超声仿真依赖 CT 解剖做射线投射，形变与病理变化难以控制，推理时也需要逐病人的 CT 体积。
Method: 两阶段管线：Stage I 用 Pix2Pix 与 Semantic Diffusion Model (SDM) 从语义标签合成 CT 射线投射输出的简化超声图；Stage II 用分割引导的 CycleGAN (SG-CycleGAN) 做解剖引导的非配对翻译细化。形变与病理通过编辑解剖图生成。
Result: Stage I 中 SDM 在形态学指标上显著优于 Pix2Pix：MAE 19.85 vs 21.65，SSIM 0.28 vs 0.24，mIoU 0.43 vs 0.29；Pix2Pix 感知点估计更优：LPIPS 0.17 vs 0.19，FID 0.32 vs 0.37，KID 0.25 vs 0.48。
Conclusion: 用物理仿真监督训练配对生成模型，可在推理时仅凭语义标签逼近 CT 射线投射结果，实现可控的健康与病理超声仿真；但 Stage I 训练仍需 CT 派生的分割与射线投射仿真。

papers.title: STRIDE: Spatial-Temporal Representation for Interval-conditioned Disease Evolution in Longitudinal Glioblastoma MRI
papers.abstract_en: Glioblastoma (GBM), an aggressive primary brain tumor, is routinely monitored with longitudinal MRI after treatment. Distinguishing stable disease (SD), pseudoprogression (PsP), and true progression (TP) remains challenging because these states can show overlapping MRI appearances despite different temporal trajectories. Existing longitudinal methods still face challenges in modeling scan-specific spatial variability, variable follow-up intervals, and complementary information from the observed follow-up state and its longitudinal change. We propose STRIDE, a framework for spatial-temporal representation of interval-conditioned disease evolution that takes paired post-treatment MRI scans and their inter-scan interval as input and predicts SD, PsP, or TP. The lesion-prior-guided spatial representation combines SoftGate and an Adaptive-window Hierarchical Transformer (AWHT) to emphasize lesion-related regions while preserving surrounding context. The time-conditioned latent transition uses pair-level context and the actual inter-scan interval to estimate interval-dependent representation changes between visits. The observed--transition fusion integrates the transition-estimated follow-up representation with the directly observed follow-up representation to jointly characterize the follow-up state and its longitudinal change. BraTS2024 is used to develop and evaluate the lesion-prior generator, while longitudinal pretraining on LUMIERE supports transfer before downstream adaptation to Burdenko. On the Burdenko three-class task, STRIDE achieves a macro ROC--AUC of 0.816 and a macro F1-score of 0.796. These results support its potential for more reliable longitudinal post-treatment GBM state assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STRIDE 把配对的治疗后 MRI 与其真实随访间隔一起编码，用 SoftGate 加 Adaptive-window Hierarchical Transformer (AWHT) 突出病灶区域并保留周边上下文，再以时间条件化的隐状态转移与直接观测的随访表征融合，三分类判读 SD、PsP、TP。在 Burdenko 三分类任务上 macro ROC-AUC 0.816、macro F1 0.796。
Motivation: 治疗后 GBM 的稳定、假性进展与真进展在 MRI 上外观重叠但时间轨迹不同，现有纵向方法难以同时刻画逐次扫描的空间差异、不等长随访间隔，以及随访状态本身与其纵向变化的互补信息。
Method: 输入为配对治疗后 MRI 及其 inter-scan interval；病灶先验引导的空间表示用 SoftGate 与 Adaptive-window Hierarchical Transformer (AWHT) 加权病灶相关区域；time-conditioned latent transition 用 pair-level 上下文和实际间隔估计两次就诊间的表征变化，再由 observed–transition fusion 把转移估计的随访表征与直接观测的随访表征融合。BraTS2024 用于开发与评估病灶先验生成器，LUMIERE 上做纵向预训练后迁移，最后在 Burdenko 上做下游适配。
Result: 在 Burdenko 三分类（SD/PsP/TP）任务上，STRIDE macro ROC-AUC 0.816、macro F1 0.796；病灶先验生成器在 BraTS2024 上开发与评估，迁移链路为 LUMIERE 纵向预训练 → Burdenko 下游适配。
Conclusion: 把随访间隔显式条件化并融合观测状态与纵向变化，可支持更可靠的治疗后 GBM 纵向状态判读。
Relevance: 4
