summary_sections.method: 输入为配对治疗后 MRI 及其 inter-scan interval；病灶先验引导的空间表示用 SoftGate 与 Adaptive-window Hierarchical Transformer (AWHT) 加权病灶相关区域；time-conditioned latent transition 用 pair-level 上下文和实际间隔估计两次就诊间的表征变化，再由 observed–transition fusion 把转移估计的随访表征与直接观测的随访表征融合。BraTS2024 用于开发与评估病灶先验生成器，LUMIERE 上做纵向预训练后迁移，最后在 Burdenko 上做下游适配。
summary_sections.result: 在 Burdenko 三分类（SD/PsP/TP）任务上，STRIDE macro ROC-AUC 0.816、macro F1 0.796；病灶先验生成器在 BraTS2024 上开发与评估，迁移链路为 LUMIERE 纵向预训练 → Burdenko 下游适配。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把随访间隔显式条件化并融合观测状态与纵向变化，可支持更可靠的治疗后 GBM 纵向状态判读。

papers.title: Beyond Risk Prediction: Evidence Grounding and Psychosocial Factor Verification for Explainable Suicide Risk Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Identifying suicide risk from social networking services (SNS) posts is important for detecting suicide-related signals in online environments. However, risk classification alone provides limited insight into the textual evidence and psychosocial factors behind a prediction. Based on the IEEE BigData 2026 Explainable Suicide Risk Detection Challenge, this study presents a framework consisting of Risk Assessment, Evidence Grounding, and Factor Identification. Risk Assessment uses length-based routing to accommodate posts of different lengths. Evidence Grounding identifies supporting phrases and uses a Risk-Evidence constraint to maintain consistency with the Risk prediction. For Factor Identification, two verifiers are used. The Taxonomy Verifier focuses on factor semantics, whereas the Evidence-Aware Verifier uses factor-specific lexical-semantic cues to select informative positive training units. Their prediction probabilities are combined to produce the final factor predictions. The three tasks are evaluated using task-specific F1 score measures. Risk Assessment achieved a Weighted F1 of 0.8088, Evidence Grounding achieved a test Macro row F1 of 0.7605, and Factor Identification achieved a Macro F1 of 0.5562. The results show that the framework can provide risk predictions, along with supporting textual evidence and fine-grained information on psychosocial factors. Overall, the proposed framework extends suicide-risk assessment beyond risk-level prediction and provides a more interpretable analysis of SNS posts.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Mental Health Disorder Detection on Social Media (MHSM 2026), held in conjunction with IEEE ICDM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 IEEE BigData 2026 Explainable Suicide Risk Detection Challenge，提出三段式框架：按帖子长度路由的风险评估、带 Risk-Evidence 一致性约束的证据定位、以及双验证器（Taxonomy Verifier 与 Evidence-Aware Verifier）融合的心理社会因子识别。三项任务加权 F1 0.8088、Macro row F1 0.7605、Macro F1 0.5562，输出同时含风险等级、支撑短语与细粒度因子。

Method: 框架分三段：Risk Assessment 用 length-based routing 处理不同长度帖子；Evidence Grounding 抽取支撑短语并施加 Risk-Evidence 约束使其与风险预测一致；Factor Identification 用 Taxonomy Verifier（关注因子语义）与 Evidence-Aware Verifier（用因子专属词义线索筛选有信息量的正训练单元）两路概率加权得到最终因子预测。
Result: 在该挑战测试集上，Risk Assessment 加权 F1 0.8088，Evidence Grounding 测试 Macro row F1 0.7605，Factor Identification Macro F1 0.5562，三项各用任务专属 F1 度量。
Conclusion: 把风险预测、证据定位与因子识别串成一条管线，可让 SNS 自杀风险评估从单一风险等级扩展到带文本证据与细粒度心理社会因子的可解释分析。

papers.title: Beyond the Sycophancy Score: How Task, Model, and Pressure Shape LLM Yielding
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) often abandon a correct answer, or endorse a user's position, once the user pushes back. This behavior, called sycophancy, is usually reported as a single rate per model, which says little about when it happens or how a user can avoid it. We study the conditions that produce it with 103,939 graded replies from ten configurations: eight LLMs with reasoning disabled, and two of them again with maximum reasoning, all facing the same 200 items, 13 pressure conditions, and four-turn conversations, with every reply labeled by two independent LLM judges. We find that the dominant factors are how costly it is for the model to verify the user's claim, and whether a trained guardrail covers it. Removing this task factor from a logistic model costs 0.485 of McFadden $R^2$, against 0.139 for model family and 0.009 for pressure tactic. Anchored facts are almost never conceded (1.3%), while adoption on logic puzzles rises with the number of clues needed to refute the pushed answer. Personal choices are endorsed in 77.0% of conversations. Most concessions on hard items come from models that cannot reliably solve them; models that can solve them rarely give the answer up. For both models tested, maximum reasoning removes these concessions completely: adoption on deep puzzles falls from 19.2% and 12.5% to 0%. Fallacious or emotional framing adds nothing beyond plain repetition. Three human annotators agree with the judges' consensus on 118/120 calibration items. These results give practical rules for reliable use: simplify hard-to-verify problems and reason deeply, state the question rather than one's preferred answer, ask for evidence on open questions, and choose models by their measured guardrail profile.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 103,939 条分级回复、10 种配置（8 个 LLM 关闭推理 + 其中 2 个开最大推理）在同一批 200 题、13 种施压条件、四轮对话上量化谄媚 (sycophancy)：主导因素是核验用户主张的成本与训练 guardrail 是否覆盖，而非施压话术。逻辑谜题上开最大推理使采纳率从 19.2% 和 12.5% 降到 0%，作者据此给出简化难核验问题、深推理、只陈述问题不陈述偏好答案等使用规则。
Motivation: 谄媚通常只按模型报一个总比率，无法说明它何时发生、用户如何规避；本文要拆出任务、模型、施压三类因素各自的贡献。
Method: 在 200 道题、13 种压力条件、四轮对话上收集 103,939 条分级回复，覆盖 8 个关闭推理的 LLM 与其中 2 个开最大推理共 10 种配置，每条回复由两个独立 LLM judge 标注；用 logistic 模型做因素归因，并以 3 名人类标注者在 120 条校准样本上核对 judge 共识。
Result: 去掉任务因素使 McFadden R² 损失 0.485，模型家族为 0.139，施压话术仅 0.009；锚定事实几乎不让步（1.3%），个人选择类问题在 77.0% 的对话中被附和，逻辑谜题上的采纳率随反驳所需线索数上升；两个模型开最大推理后深层谜题采纳率从 19.2% 与 12.5% 降到 0%；谬误或情绪化框架相对单纯重复无额外作用；3 名人类标注者在 120 条校准样本中 118 条与 judge 共识一致。
Conclusion: 谄媚主要由任务可核验性与 guardrail 覆盖决定，施压话术本身几乎不起作用；可靠用法是简化难核验问题并深推理、只陈述问题不陈述偏好答案、对开放问题索要证据、按实测 guardrail 画像选模型。

papers.title: Deep Learning-Based Tri-Hybrid Multi-User MIMO Precoding: The Blessing of EM-Reconfigurable Antennas
papers.abstract_en: Electromagnetic (EM)-reconfigurable antennas provide multiple candidate radiation patterns per element, thereby introducing an additional EM-domain degree of freedom. Integrating radiation-pattern reconfigurability, realized as EM-domain precoding, with conventional hybrid analog-digital precoding yields tri-hybrid multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) precoding, which can substantially improve the spectral efficiency of wideband multi-user MIMO orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) systems. However, the joint design of EM, analog, and digital precoding remains challenging. To address this challenge, we propose a tri-hybrid precoding network (Tri-PNet) based on Conformer, an emerging neural architecture that combines the local modeling strength of convolutional neural networks with the global dependency modeling of Transformers. Furthermore, two representative radiation-pattern modes, i.e., the non-regular mode and the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Report (TR) 38.901 mode, are investigated. Tri-PNet is trained in an unsupervised manner to jointly learn EM, analog, and digital precoding by maximizing the average sum spectral efficiency. Its radiation-pattern selection network (RPSNet) employs a Conformer encoder to capture both local and global frequency-domain correlations, whereas its hybrid analog-digital precoding network (HPNet) combines cross-attention and dual-path processing with singular-value-decomposition (SVD) and zero-forcing (ZF) priors. Simulation results under both radiation-pattern modes demonstrate that Tri-PNet outperforms random EM precoding and conventional hybrid MIMO without EM precoding, approaches the greedy EM precoding search scheme with substantially lower online complexity, and remains robust to imperfect channel state information (CSI).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于 Conformer 的三混合预编码网络 Tri-PNet，把 EM 可重构天线的辐射图选择与模拟-数字混合预编码联合起来，用无监督方式最大化平均和频谱效率。仿真中在 non-regular 与 3GPP TR 38.901 两种辐射图模式下均优于随机 EM 预编码和无 EM 的传统混合 MIMO，逼近贪心 EM 搜索方案而在线复杂度大幅降低，且对不完美 CSI 鲁棒。
Motivation: EM 可重构天线为每个阵元提供多个候选辐射图，把 EM 域自由度引入预编码后，EM、模拟、数字三级的联合设计成为宽带多用户 MIMO OFDM 频谱效率提升的主要瓶颈。
Method: Tri-PNet 由两部分组成：RPSNet 用 Conformer 编码器捕捉频域的局部与全局相关性以选辐射图；HPNet 结合 cross-attention 与双路径处理，并注入 SVD 与 ZF 先验做模拟-数字预编码。整体以最大化平均和频谱效率为目标做无监督训练，考察 non-regular 与 3GPP TR 38.901 两种辐射图模式。
Result: 仿真结果显示，两种辐射图模式下 Tri-PNet 均超过随机 EM 预编码与无 EM 预编码的传统混合 MIMO，接近贪心 EM 频繁搜索方案但在线复杂度显著更低，并在不完美 CSI 下保持鲁棒。
Conclusion: 把 EM 域辐射图选择与混合模拟-数字预编码放进同一个无监督网络联合学习，可以在远低于贪心搜索复杂度的条件下拿到接近的频谱效率，且对 CSI 误差不敏感。

papers.title: Deep Learning for Longitudinal Medical Imaging: A Scoping Review
papers.abstract_en: Longitudinal medical imaging analysis is a cornerstone of modern medical practice and patient care. Deep learning applied to longitudinal imaging offers wide potential to enhance diagnosis and track disease progression by capturing spatial changes over time. With major advances in single-timepoint deep learning for imaging, there has been growing interest in longitudinal image analysis, given its increased clinical relevance, though technical challenges remain. Several recent innovations may lead to a new era of multi-timepoint image evaluation, yet the scientific landscape, recent progress, and areas of need remain under-characterized. To address this gap, we conducted a scoping review of deep learning methodologies applied to longitudinal medical imaging, yielding 102 studies published between 2018 and 2025. Neurological disorders (48%) and ophthalmic conditions (12%) were the most common clinical applications, with MRI serving as the predominant imaging modality (67%). Sequential feature modeling approaches combining convolutional neural networks (CNNs) with temporal models (LSTM/RNN) were the most frequent methodology (40%), followed by direct feature aggregation across timepoints (23%). Most studies targeted classification tasks (56%), while external validation was performed in only 24% of studies. Our findings highlight that deep learning-based longitudinal imaging analysis remains a promising field, though newer temporal architectures and larger datasets may improve success and clinical adoption of these tools.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 2018–2025 年深度学习用于纵向医学影像的 102 项研究做范围综述 (scoping review)，发现该领域以 CNN+LSTM/RNN 时序建模为主（40%），但外部验证仅 24%，临床落地仍受限于验证不足与数据规模。
Motivation: 单时点影像深度学习已成熟，但纵向多时点分析的科学图景、近期进展与不足尚未被系统刻画，缺少可指导研究与临床采纳的全景梳理。
Method: 采用范围综述 (scoping review) 方法，检索并纳入 2018 至 2025 年间深度学习应用于纵向医学影像的 102 项研究，按临床应用、成像模态、方法学与任务类型分类统计。
Result: 共 102 项研究（2018–2025）；神经系统疾病占 48%、眼科疾病 12%；MRI 为主要模态（67%）；CNN 结合 LSTM/RNN 的时序特征建模占 40%，跨时点直接特征聚合占 23%；分类任务占 56%，仅 24% 的研究做了外部验证。
Conclusion: 纵向影像深度学习仍是有前景的方向，但要提升成功率与临床采纳，需要更新的时序架构和更大数据集。

papers.title: Leveraging LLM-Generated Explanations for Detecting Emotionally Rewritten Fake News
papers.abstract_en: The spread of fake news may cause severe social consequences. Existing fake news detection methods mainly focus on stylistic variations or incorporate external information such as explanations. However, news articles are often rewritten under different emotional backgrounds while preserving their underlying factual claims, which may affect the robustness of detection models. In this work, we investigate fake news detec- tion under fact-preserving emotional variations. To study this problem, we construct emotion-rewritten test sets and generate explanations from the original news articles as stable background knowledge. We then propose a Gated Cross Attention (GCA) framework that adaptively integrates emotionally rewritten news with the corresponding explanations, enabling the model to focus on informative explanation content while reducing potential mismatches caused by emotional reframing. Experiments on PolitiFact, GossipCop, and LUN demonstrate that the proposed method achieves notable improvements under multiple emotional conditions on PolitiFact and LUN, while maintaining competitive performance on GossipCop. We further analyze the effects of explanation guidance and gating mechanisms under different emotional conditions. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/Flulike/fakenews gca .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Gated Cross Attention (GCA) 框架，用 LLM 生成的原文解释作为稳定背景知识，自适应融合被情感改写但事实不变的新闻，以提升假新闻检测在情感重写下的稳健性。在 PolitiFact、GossipCop、LUN 上的实验显示，该方法在 PolitiFact 与 LUN 的多种情感条件下取得明显提升，在 GossipCop 上保持竞争力表现。
Motivation: 新闻常在不同情感背景下被改写而事实主张不变，现有检测方法针对文体变化或依赖外部解释，难以应对这种事实保持的情感重写，检测稳健性受影响。
Method: 构建情感改写测试集 (emotion-rewritten test sets)，并从原始新闻生成解释作为稳定背景知识；提出 Gated Cross Attention (GCA) 框架，自适应整合情感改写后的新闻与对应解释，让模型聚焦解释中有信息量的内容，同时抑制情感重构造成的不匹配。
Result: 在 PolitiFact、GossipCop、LUN 三个数据集上实验：GCA 在 PolitiFact 与 LUN 的多种情感条件下取得明显提升 (notable improvements)，在 GossipCop 上保持竞争力表现；并分析了不同情感条件下解释引导与门控机制的作用。
Conclusion: 把 LLM 生成的解释作为稳定背景知识并用门控交叉注意力融合，可在事实保持的情感改写下提升假新闻检测的稳健性，且在不同数据集上表现有差异（GossipCop 仅保持竞争力）。

papers.title: JoyAI-Voice 2.0: A Full-Continuous Autoregressive Speech Generation Model with Semantic-Acoustic Joint Representation
papers.abstract_en: We present JoyAI-Voice~2.0, an end-to-end anthropomorphic speech generation model built upon a fully continuous, dual-encoder architecture. Raw speech is encoded into continuous latents and partitioned into patches. Each patch is decomposed by a semantic-acoustic dual encoder into a semantically purified representation and an acoustic representation, which are fused and jointly fed to a causal autoregressive Transformer for planning. The Transformer predicts the conditioning for the next patch, and a local diffusion Transformer renders its full latents for 48\,kHz synthesis. The model is trained with a joint flow-matching and stop-prediction objective, followed by supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with DiffusionNFT to improve model performance. It achieves the lowest average word error rate of 2.51\% on Seed-TTS, a 14.9\% relative reduction over the strongest baseline, and state-of-the-art attribute fidelity on InstructTTSEval in both Chinese and English, leading on 5 of 10 perceptual dimensions with the highest overall score of 0.893 on MDVD-Eval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JoyAI-Voice 2.0 是端到端类人语音生成模型：语义-声学双编码器把每个语音 patch 拆成语义净化表征与声学表征，融合后由因果自回归 Transformer 规划下一 patch 条件，再由局部 diffusion Transformer 渲染全 latent 做 48 kHz 合成。Seed-TTS 上平均字错率 (WER) 2.51%，相对最强基线降低 14.9%；InstructTTSEval 中英双语属性保真度达 SOTA，MDVD-Eval 10 个感知维度中领先 5 个、总分 0.893。
Motivation: 全连续自回归语音生成需要同时保住语义正确性与声学自然度，把两者混在一个表征里容易互相干扰，且 TTS 的 WER 与属性保真度常需分别优化。
Method: 原始语音编码为连续 latent 并切 patch，语义-声学双编码器对每个 patch 分别产出语义净化表征与声学表征，融合后送入因果自回归 Transformer 预测下一 patch 的条件；局部 diffusion Transformer 渲染该 patch 的完整 latent 以合成 48 kHz 语音。训练采用 flow-matching 与 stop-prediction 联合目标，随后做监督微调和基于 DiffusionNFT 的强化学习。
Result: Seed-TTS 平均 WER 2.51%，相对最强基线下降 14.9%；InstructTTSEval 中英文属性保真度均为 SOTA，在 10 个感知维度中 5 个领先，MDVD-Eval 总分 0.893。
Conclusion: 语义与声学解耦后再联合规划、由 diffusion 渲染 latent 的双阶段自回归架构，可在中英双语上同时拿到低 WER 与高属性保真度。

papers.title: CoDR: Training-Free Confidence-Drift Remasking for Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) decode by repeatedly committing tokens to masked positions, but these commitments are usually irreversible. A token chosen under sparse, partial context is kept fixed, even when later context no longer supports it. Existing samplers mainly decide when to commit a token, but rarely check whether an already committed token should still be kept, allowing early mistakes to propagate. We trace this issue to confidence drift, where the model's confidence in a committed token drops from its sparse commit-time context to the denser context available later. Based on this signal, we propose CoDR (Confidence Drift Remasking), a training-free and sampler-agnostic refinement pass. CoDR estimates drift for all committed positions in only k forward passes via k-partition probing, then remasks and regenerates only the tokens the model no longer endorses. Across two backbones, four reasoning and coding tasks, and three base samplers, CoDR improves average accuracy across all evaluated model-sampler configurations and improves most individual task settings with modest overhead. Controlled experiments show that the gains come from targeted confidence-drift remasking rather than extra compute alone, and that CoDR uses far fewer forward passes than prior remasking methods. Code is available at https://github.com/YueWu0301/CoDR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoDR 针对掩码扩散语言模型 (MDLM) 中已提交 token 不可逆的问题，提出训练自由、与采样器无关的置信度漂移重掩码 (confidence-drift remasking)：用 k-partition probing 在 k 次前向内估计所有已提交位置的置信度漂移，只对模型不再认可的 token 重掩码并重新生成。在两个 backbone、四个推理与编码任务、三种基础采样器上，CoDR 提升所有 model-sampler 配置的平均准确率，且前向次数远少于既有重掩码方法。
Motivation: MDLM 的 token 在稀疏部分上下文下被提交后即固定，后续上下文不再支持也不回退；现有采样器只决定何时提交，不检查已提交 token 是否仍应保留，使早期错误传播。
Method: CoDR 是训练自由、采样器无关的精化 pass：通过 k-partition probing 用 k 次前向估计全部已提交位置的置信度漂移（从提交时稀疏上下文到后期稠密上下文），再只对漂移大、模型不再认可的 token 执行 remasking 与重新生成。
Result: 在两个 backbone、四个推理与 coding 任务、三种 base sampler 的全部 model-sampler 配置上平均准确率均提升，多数单项任务设置也改善，开销 modest；受控实验表明增益来自定向的 confidence-drift remasking 而非额外计算，且前向次数远少于先前 remasking 方法。
Conclusion: 已提交 token 的置信度漂移可作为训练自由的重掩码信号，用极少前向次数纠正扩散解码的早期错误，且与采样器和 backbone 解耦。

papers.title: MoR-MLLM: Mixture of Recursions for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable reasoning capabilities across vision and language tasks. However, their massive computational and memory demands hinder real-world deployment. While recent efforts reduce costs by employing lightweight language backbones, existing paradigms remain computation-dense due to their static sparsity and depth allocation, which cannot adapt to the semantic complexity of each token. To this end, we propose MoR-MLLM, a computation-sparse MLLM based on the recent Mixture-of-Recursions (MoR) framework. MoR-MLLM introduces adaptive per-token recursion, allowing the model to dynamically adjust its recursive depth and allocate more computation to visually or linguistically challenging tokens while skipping redundant operations for simpler ones. To stabilize the training of recursive sparsity in multimodal settings, we further design a three-stage MoR-Tuning strategy and an entropy-regularized loss to encourage diverse routing distributions. Extensive experiments show that compared with recent advanced tiny MLLMs, our proposed MoR-MLLM can greatly reduce the training memory and computation complexity while retaining high performance on various vision-language tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MoR-MLLM 把 Mixture-of-Recursions 引入多模态大模型，按 token 语义难度自适应分配递归深度：难 token 多算、简单 token 跳过冗余操作，并用三阶段 MoR-Tuning 与熵正则损失稳定递归稀疏训练。相比近期先进的 tiny MLLM，训练显存与计算复杂度大幅下降，同时在多种视觉-语言任务上保持高性能。
Motivation: MLLM 推理与显存开销大阻碍部署；现有轻量语言骨干方案的稀疏性与深度分配是静态的，无法按每个 token 的语义复杂度调整，仍属计算密集。
Method: 基于 Mixture-of-Recursions (MoR) 框架构建计算稀疏 MLLM：自适应逐 token 递归 (adaptive per-token recursion) 动态调整递归深度；训练上设计三阶段 MoR-Tuning 策略，并加熵正则损失 (entropy-regularized loss) 鼓励多样化路由分布以稳定多模态下的递归稀疏训练。
Result: 与近期先进的 tiny MLLM 相比，MoR-MLLM 大幅降低训练显存与计算复杂度，同时在多种视觉-语言任务上保持高性能。
Conclusion: 按 token 语义难度动态分配计算的递归稀疏设计，可在多模态任务上以更低训练开销维持性能，替代静态稀疏的轻量 MLLM 范式。

papers.title: Child ASR Adaptation with Adult Retention: An Empirical Study
papers.abstract_en: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems often underperform for children and non-native speakers, while adapting adult ASR models to child speech can cause adult-speech forgetting. We study child ASR adaptation with adult retention across Arabic and English. We compare full fine-tuning, LoRA, and post-hoc weight-space merging across encoder--decoder, encoder--CTC, and AudioLLM-based ASR systems. Experiments use Arabic native and non-native child speech, English MyST child speech, and adult benchmarks from MGB-2 and LibriSpeech test-clean. We evaluate recognition quality with WER and quantify the adaptation--retention trade-off using Retention Index, Child Adaptation Gain, and Adaptation Recovery. Results show that child adaptation is necessary, especially for non-native Arabic and English child speech, but direct adaptation often reduces adult ASR performance. Bilingual adaptation is more stable than language-specific adaptation. Weight-space merging often improves the trade-off, especially for encoder--CTC, Whisper, and AudioLLM-based ASR, with LERP favoring adult retention and TIES recovering stronger child gains. For the encoder--decoder model, direct bilingual fine-tuning remains strongest in raw WER.\footnote{Code, and models are available at https://github.com/qcri/Child-ASR-Adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 儿童 ASR 适配会牺牲成人性能，本文在阿拉伯语与英语上系统比较全量微调、LoRA 与事后权重空间合并（LERP、TIES）在 encoder-decoder、encoder-CTC 与 AudioLLM 三类架构上的适配-保留权衡。结论是双语适配比单语更稳定，权重空间合并普遍改善权衡（LERP 偏向成人保留、TIES 恢复更强的儿童增益），而 encoder-decoder 上直接双语微调在原始 WER 上仍最强。
Motivation: 儿童与非母语说话人上 ASR 表现本就偏弱，把成人模型直接适配到儿童语音又会引发成人语音遗忘，需要量化这一权衡并寻找缓解方式。
Method: 在阿拉伯语（本族与非本族儿童语音）与英语 MyST 儿童语音上，对比全量微调、LoRA 与事后权重空间合并，覆盖 encoder-decoder、encoder-CTC 与 AudioLLM 三类 ASR；成人侧用 MGB-2 与 LibriSpeech test-clean 作基准，以 WER 衡量识别质量，并用 Retention Index、Child Adaptation Gain、Adaptation Recovery 三个指标刻画适配-保留权衡。
Result: 结果显示儿童适配是必要的，对非本族阿拉伯语与英语儿童语音尤其如此，但直接适配常降低成人 ASR 性能；双语适配比语言特定适配更稳定；权重空间合并普遍改善权衡，在 encoder-CTC、Whisper 与 AudioLLM 上尤其明显，其中 LERP 偏向成人保留、TIES 恢复更强的儿童增益；encoder-decoder 上直接双语微调在原始 WER 上仍最强。
Conclusion: 适配-保留权衡可用权重空间合并按架构调节：LERP 与 TIES 分别偏向成人保留与儿童增益，而 encoder-decoder 场景直接双语微调仍是原始 WER 的最优选择。

papers.title: PanoPed: Beyond Bounding Boxes for Sim-to-Real Panoramic Pedestrian Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Full-sphere panoramic cameras let fixed monitoring systems and mobile robots track people in every direction, but a planar bounding box does not fully describe where a person is on the sphere. We introduce PanoPed, a sim-to-real benchmark for pedestrian tracking on the full sphere. PanoPed-S contains 108,000 frames from fixed, quadruped-mounted, and drone-mounted cameras, with synchronized masks, depth, camera poses, and 3D pedestrian states. PanoPed-R adds 28,002 real frames from fixed cameras, 16,247 of them densely annotated. We find that an ERP rectangle cannot uniquely determine the spherical center and angular extent of the visible person, while the detector's visual query still carries information about them. Inspired by the sextant's use of angular measurements to locate objects, we propose Sextant, a plug-and-play angular localization head with only about 0.035M parameters. It reuses a frozen detector, keeps track identities unchanged, and needs no extra image encoder. Sextant gives the best result in our PanoPed-S test comparison, raising the strongest baseline, MOTIP, from 47.30 to 49.49 HOTA, with gains on all eight test sequences. Without fine-tuning on real data, the same synthetic-trained heads improve MOTIP and HAT by 0.96-1.14 HOTA on real video, and both seeds improve every real sequence. HAT+Sextant scores best among the compared systems that add no localization image encoder.

papers.title: Autonomous Driving Research Requires a Community-Driven Data Paradigm
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous driving has made remarkable progress, with recent AI advances enabling commercial deployments that are reshaping urban mobility. Yet the field remains far from its universal social promise: autonomous systems that can operate robustly anywhere, anytime, for anyone. We posit that this gap is not merely a modeling problem, but a problem of the prevailing data paradigm. Current research relies heavily on a few benchmark datasets with limited spatial and scenario coverage, even though the community has collectively produced over 600 autonomous driving datasets across nearly 50 countries. However, this abundance has not translated into broad research impact: most datasets remain significantly underused due to fragmentation, limited visibility, incompatible protocols, and benchmark incentives that concentrate attention on a few dominant datasets. We therefore argue that autonomous driving research requires a collaborative, community-driven data paradigm. Such a paradigm would improve the discovery, reuse, integration, and evaluation of diverse datasets; make underexplored data easier and more rewarding to study; and lower the barrier for new contributors. We outline its key principles, illustrate an early realization, and call for collaboration across academia and industry to transform fragmented datasets into shared community infrastructure for anytime-anywhere autonomy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 自动驾驶研究的瓶颈不在模型而在数据范式：社区已产出 600 多个数据集、覆盖近 50 个国家，却因碎片化、可见性低、协议不兼容和基准激励而大量闲置，研究仍集中在少数几个基准上。作者主张转向社区驱动的协作数据范式，以提升数据的发现、复用、整合与评测，让冷门数据更易被研究，并降低新贡献者门槛。
Motivation: 现有研究高度依赖少数几个空间与场景覆盖有限的基准数据集，而社区自产的 600 多个数据集大多因碎片化、可见性、协议不兼容与基准激励问题被严重低估使用，导致系统难以做到随时随地对任何人鲁棒运行。
Method: 作为 NeurIPS 2026 立场论文，提出社区驱动数据范式的原则框架，说明其如何改善多样化数据集的发现、复用、整合与评测，并给出一个早期实现作为示例，号召学界与产业界协作。
Result: 论文点名的量化事实：社区累计产出超过 600 个自动驾驶数据集、覆盖近 50 个国家，但多数数据集因碎片化、可见性有限、协议不兼容与基准激励而显著低度使用；该文为立场论文，未给出实验指标对比。
Conclusion: 自动驾驶的差距本质是数据范式问题而非建模问题，需要把碎片化数据集转化为共享的社区基础设施，才能支撑随时随地对任何人的自动驾驶。

papers.title: HCPN-GCN: Scaling Hierarchical Prototype Networks with Cone Geometry for Continual Graph Learning
papers.abstract_en: Continual Graph Learning (CGL) aims to incrementally learn from graph-structured data while preserving knowledge acquired from previous tasks. A major challenge in this setting is catastrophic forgetting, where learning new tasks degrades performance on previously learned ones. Hierarchical Prototype Networks (HPNs) address this problem through a prototype-based memory mechanism that avoids storing historical data, but their reliance on linear feature extractors limits their ability to exploit graph topology, while point-based prototypes often lead to inefficient prototype growth on structurally diverse graphs. In this work, we propose HCPN-GCN, a graph-aware extension of HPN that replaces the original linear feature extractors with Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) and introduces cone-based prototypes with a diversity regularization objective. The proposed design produces richer graph-aware representations while compactly modeling the embedding space, reducing prototype proliferation without sacrificing discriminability. Experimental results on six continual graph learning benchmarks demonstrate that HCPN-GCN consistently improves average classification accuracy over the original HPN and representative continual learning baselines while maintaining near-zero forgetting. Furthermore, our analysis shows that the proposed model learns substantially richer class-level prototype hierarchies using approximately $30\times$ fewer atomic prototypes than the original HPN, providing a more compact and effective memory representation for continual graph learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HCPN-GCN 把 Hierarchical Prototype Networks 的线性特征提取器换成 GCN，并用带多样性正则的锥形 (cone-based) 原型替代点原型，在六个 continual graph learning 基准上平均分类精度一致高于原 HPN 与代表性持续学习基线，同时遗忘接近零；类层级原型更丰富但原子原型数量减少约 30 倍。
Motivation: 持续图学习 (CGL) 中新任务会灾难性遗忘旧任务；原 HPN 依赖线性特征提取器无法利用图拓扑，点原型在结构多样的图上原型数量膨胀、记忆低效。
Method: HCPN-GCN 用 Graph Convolutional Networks 替换 HPN 的线性特征提取器，引入 cone-based 原型与 diversity regularization 目标，紧凑建模嵌入空间以抑制原型增殖，同时保留不存历史数据的原型记忆机制。
Result: 在六个 continual graph learning 基准上，平均分类精度一致超过原 HPN 与代表性持续学习基线，遗忘接近零；类级原型层级显著更丰富，原子原型数量约为原 HPN 的 1/30（约 30× 更少）。
Conclusion: 图感知的锥形原型层级能在不牺牲判别力的前提下压缩持续图学习的记忆表示，同时维持近零遗忘。

papers.title: A Vehicle-Integrated Approach to Digital Twin Deployment for Bridges Through Drive-By Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Ageing bridge infrastructure is a growing global concern, yet conventional Structural Health Monitoring (SHM) systems are costly and difficult to scale, and routine visual inspections remain subjective. Drive-by, or indirect, bridge inspection, in which a sensorised vehicle recovers structural information from vehicle-bridge interaction (VBI) and vehicle-road interaction (VRI) responses, offers a scalable alternative. However, key challenges remain unresolved, including separating bridge responses from road roughness, detecting damage under normal traffic, and generalising across diverse bridge types. This paper presents a vehicle-integrated digital twin framework that unifies physics-based modelling and machine learning for continuous monitoring of bridge and road conditions. The framework comprises three pillars. First, surrogate models of VBI and VRI are constructed using a Fourier Neural Operator that learns function-to-function mappings from operating conditions to vehicle responses. Trained on both simulated and field data, these surrogates deliver millisecond-scale inference, replacing computationally intensive full-order analyses. Second, the design of a custom electric inspection vehicle, its sensor layout, and signal processing chain are optimised through Bayesian optimisation to maximise bridge information yield while suppressing road and vehicle noise. Unsupervised damage-assessment pipelines based on adversarial autoencoders, matrix profiles, and transformer architectures have been developed and validated to process the resulting vehicle data. Third, the complete workflow is validated through coordinated multi-site field trials in Australia and Japan, covering a range of bridge types, traffic conditions, and environmental settings.
papers.comment: Extended abstract for 2nd International Conference on Engineering Structures (ICES2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向桥梁的车载数字孪生框架，用 Fourier Neural Operator 学习工况到车辆响应的函数映射，替代全阶 VBI/VRI 分析，推理达毫秒级；再用 Bayesian 优化定制电动检测车的传感器布局与信号链，最大化桥梁信息、压制路面与车辆噪声。无监督损伤评估由 adversarial autoencoder、matrix profile 与 transformer 组成，并在澳大利亚与日本多站点实桥试验中完成验证。
Motivation: 桥梁老化是全球性问题，传统 SHM 系统成本高、难以规模化，例行目视检查又带主观性；drive-by 间接检测仍卡在从路面粗糙度中分离桥响应、在正常交通下检出损伤、跨桥型泛化这三个未解难题上。
Method: 三支柱：其一，用 Fourier Neural Operator 构造 VBI 与 VRI 代理模型，学习工况到车辆响应的函数映射，训练数据同时来自仿真与现场；其二，用 Bayesian 优化设计定制电动检测车、传感器布局与信号处理链；其三，用 adversarial autoencoder、matrix profile 与 transformer 搭建无监督损伤评估流程处理车载数据。
Result: 代理模型推理为毫秒级，用以替代计算量大的全阶分析；无监督损伤评估流程已开发并在产生的车载数据上得到验证；整套流程经澳大利亚与日本多站点现场试验检验，覆盖多种桥型、交通条件与环境。
Conclusion: 把物理建模与机器学习统一进车载数字孪生，可让桥梁与路面状况的连续监测走低成本、可规模化的 drive-by 路线，前提是代理模型、传感布局与无监督损伤检测三者协同设计。

papers.title: Task-Oriented Key-Layer KV Communication for Efficient Latent Multi-Agent Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: Large language model-based multi-agent systems improve complex problem solving through collaboration, while latent communication directly transmits model internal states to avoid the high inference costs of natural language. However, existing KV-based latent communication methods prioritize sender-side state fidelity, leading to substantial communication and computation overhead and potentially introducing redundant information. To address these limitations, we revisit latent communication from a task-oriented perspective, shifting its objective from sender-side state fidelity to receiver-side task sufficiency. Under this formulation, we propose KITE, a training-free framework for task-oriented key-layer KV communication. KITE identifies a task-effective key layer using a receiver trajectory distortion criterion, transmits only the latent working memory associated with the key layer, and further uses the same layer as the entry point for autoregressive latent reasoning. Experiments on seven benchmarks across two model families and three model scales show that, compared with full-layer KV communication, KITE reduces communication volume by 28-36$\times$, achieves up to 3$\times$ end-to-end inference speedup, and improves accuracy by up to 23.3 percentage points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KITE 把 LLM 多-agent 潜在通信的目标从发送端状态保真改为接收端任务充分性，用接收端轨迹失真准则选出一个 task-effective key layer，只传该层的 latent working memory，并以同一层作为自回归潜在推理入口。在两个模型家族、三种规模的七个基准上，相比全层 KV 通信通信量降 28–36×，端到端推理加速最高 3×，准确率最高提升 23.3 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有基于 KV 的潜在通信方法一味追求发送端状态保真，导致通信与计算开销大，并可能传入冗余信息。
Method: KITE 是 training-free 框架：以接收端轨迹失真准则 (receiver trajectory distortion criterion) 定位 task-effective key layer，只传输该层对应的 latent working memory，并复用该层作为 autoregressive latent reasoning 的入口。
Result: 在两个模型家族、三种模型规模的七个基准上，与全层 KV 通信相比通信量减少 28–36×，端到端推理加速最高 3×，准确率最高提升 23.3 个百分点。
Conclusion: 潜在通信应以接收端任务充分性而非发送端状态保真为目标，只保留关键层即可同时压缩通信、提速并抬高准确率。

papers.title: HydroSphere: A Framework for Governed, Self-Healing Wastewater Infrastructure
papers.abstract_en: Rapid industrialization and urban growth are increasing pressure on water quality and wastewater treatment systems, while conventional treatment plants often rely on static monitoring and control strategies that cannot easily adapt to changing pollutant conditions. This paper presents HydroSphere, a governed, data-driven framework for real-time water quality monitoring, forecasting, treatment optimization, and fault recovery. HydroSphere is evaluated using 2.82 million water-quality measurements collected between 1940 and 2023. The framework integrates three main components. First, a hybrid TCN-LSTM model performs multi-step forecasting across seven water-quality parameters, achieving an RMSE of 0.1417, MAE of 0.1047, and R2 of 0.3596. Second, the Adaptive Dosage Optimization Module uses PPO reinforcement learning to adjust chemical dosing, achieving a mean step reward of 1.059 compared with 1.017 for a fixed-dose baseline. The results also show that unconstrained reward optimization can lead to excessive dosing, demonstrating the need for explicit operational safeguards. Third, the SHADE anomaly detection module uses a deep autoencoder to identify sensor and process anomalies, achieving an F1 score of 0.651 under controlled fault injection. HydroSphere combines these capabilities with tiered governance, deterministic safety bounds, and human oversight to support safer and more adaptive water infrastructure. The framework provides a scalable foundation for intelligent wastewater management and supports the objectives of UN Sustainable Development Goals 6 and 13.

papers.title: Just for FUNS: LLM-Guided Spatio-Temporal Graph Node Generation for Forecasting Unobserved Node States
papers.abstract_en: Spatio-temporal forecasting is a cornerstone of logistics, urban planning, and intelligent transportation systems. However, constrained by deployment costs and maintenance resources, sensor networks often lack comprehensive spatial coverage, rendering Forecast Unobserved Node States (FUNS) a critical yet formidable challenge. Conventional models rely on historical observations and typically falter when encountering nodes without prior records. To address this, we redefine the problem as a conditional generation task on spatio-temporal graphs and propose GenST, a framework that introduces Large Language Models (LLMs) as a semantic bridge, leveraging a pre-trained LLM fine-tuned to extract rich semantic features from node descriptions, such as functional zones and road network structures, to compensate for missing spatio-temporal signals. Specifically, we design a two-stage generative architecture: a Spatio-Temporal VAE first compresses spatio-temporal dynamics into a latent space, followed by a Generative Transformer (GenT) that reconstructs the future states of unobserved nodes from noise, guided by multi-modal conditions including semantics, geographic coordinates, and neighborhood contexts. Experiments on six traffic and two non-traffic datasets show GenST significantly outperforms existing baselines in zero-shot prediction tasks, demonstrating the practical potential of semantic-guided generation for mitigating spatio-temporal data sparsity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GenST 把无历史记录节点的状态预报重定义为时空图上的条件生成任务：用微调后的 LLM 从节点描述（功能区、路网结构）提取语义特征补足缺失信号，再由 Spatio-Temporal VAE 压入隐空间、Generative Transformer (GenT) 在语义、地理坐标与邻域上下文的多模态条件下从噪声重建未来状态。在六个交通与两个非交通数据集上，零样本预测显著优于现有基线。
Motivation: 传感器网络受部署与维护成本限制导致空间覆盖不全，而常规时空模型依赖历史观测，遇到没有历史记录的节点就失效，形成 FUNS（Forecast Unobserved Node States）难题。
Method: 两阶段生成架构：Spatio-Temporal VAE 先把时空动态压缩到隐空间，随后 Generative Transformer (GenT) 从噪声重建未观测节点的未来状态；条件包括微调 LLM 从节点描述抽取的语义特征、地理坐标与邻域上下文，任务被重构为时空图上的条件生成。
Result: 在六个交通数据集与两个非交通数据集上，GenST 在零样本预测任务中显著优于现有基线。
Conclusion: 语义引导的生成模型可以弥补时空数据稀疏，让无历史记录节点的零样本预报成为可行路径。

papers.title: DenoFlow: Flow Matching for SSVEP Denoising under Real Physiological Artifacts
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG)-based brain-computer interfaces (BCIs), particularly steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) systems, are highly vulnerable to noise and artifacts, which severely degrade decoding accuracy. Although recent denoising approaches have shown promise, they are fitted without paired ground truth, can settle on reproducing their input, and are optimized on waveform distance alone, which says nothing about whether the output stays decodable. To address these issues, we propose DenoFlow, which casts SSVEP denoising as transport: instead of learning a direct map from a contaminated trial to a clean one, a field network regresses the velocity of the straight path between them, following the rectified-flow formulation, and denoising integrates that field forward from the observation. The field network is an encoder-decoder that sees the contaminated trial at every layer and the path position at its bottleneck, and a classifier trained alongside it supervises the integrated output. Because the observation itself is both the conditioning input and the starting point of the integration, the model never generates a trial from noise, and training reduces to regression, removing the adversarial min-max game. To obtain paired data on datasets with no ground truth, we injected physiological artifacts of the recorded electromyography (EMG) and electrooculography (EOG) signals under a controlled signal-to-noise target. Experiments on two public SSVEP datasets with five popular SSVEP decoders showed that DenoFlow outperformed seven baseline denoising models on both signal fidelity and downstream decoding accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/wzwvv/DenoFlow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DenoFlow 把 SSVEP 去噪写成传输问题：场网络回归受污染试次到干净试次直线路径的速度场 (rectified flow)，从观测本身出发积分前向，同时由并行训练的分类器监督积分输出，使去噪结果保持可解码。在两个公开 SSVEP 数据集上，用记录到的 EMG/EOG 生理伪迹按受控信噪比注入构造配对数据，配合五种常用 SSVEP 解码器，DenoFlow 在信号保真度与下游解码准确率上均超过七个去噪基线。
Motivation: 现有 SSVEP 去噪方法没有配对真值训练，容易退化成复现输入，且只按波形距离优化，完全不保证输出仍可被解码。
Method: 按 rectified-flow 公式把去噪建模为传输：编码器-解码器场网络在每一层看到受污染试次、瓶颈处看到路径位置，回归直路径速度场；观测既是条件输入又是积分起点，因此不从噪声生成试次，训练退化为回归，去掉对抗 min-max。并行训练的分类器监督积分输出。配对数据通过在无真值数据集上按受控 SNR 注入记录的 EMG 与 EOG 伪迹获得。
Result: 在两个公开 SSVEP 数据集上，用五种常用 SSVEP 解码器评测，DenoFlow 在信号保真度和下游解码准确率两方面均优于七个去噪基线模型。
Conclusion: 把去噪当作从观测出发的传输并用解码器监督积分输出，可以在没有配对真值的 SSVEP 数据上同时保住波形保真与可解码性，且无需对抗训练。

papers.title: The Cost of Long Memory: State, Context, and Stability Complexity in Sequence Models
papers.abstract_en: Long-range temporal dependence poses a resource question for sequence models: for a specified predictive-memory law, how much state, context, or dynamical criticality is required in order to forecast accurately? We study this question directly in forecasting risk. For algebraically decaying predictive memory, we prove matching upper and lower approximation bounds for exponential and finite-state modes. The best $r$-mode forecast error decays as $e^{-Θ(\sqrt r)}$, so reaching forecast error $τ$ needs $r=Θ(\log^2(1/τ))$ states or modes. Earlier curse-of-memory results establish broad limitations of stable recurrent models under different approximation notions; here both sides match for one canonical predictive target in forecast risk, which fixes the optimal resource exponent for that target. We then show that genuine fractional long memory changes the geometry itself. In particular, forecast error is measured after fractional integration, prediction from a finite context of length $L$ has an exact $1/L$ leading order, and a fixed fractional strength $d$ keeps the square-log state-complexity law. Near the short-memory boundary, we identify the relevant $d^2$ and $d^4$ scales and give a uniform constructive law in the intermediate regime. For nonlinear contextual recurrences with uniformly contractive state dynamics, we derive an exponential first-chaos envelope and an explicit necessary condition that relates forecast accuracy to the contraction margin. Vanishing forecasting error on an algebraic target forces the recurrence quantitatively toward criticality, a condition that is necessary and not by itself sufficient. Finite-sample Kullback--Leibler calculations further connect the predictive geometry to statistical information. Theorem-matched experiments with contractive state-space, gated recurrent, and attention models reproduce the state and stability predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在预测风险 (forecast risk) 下证明长记忆序列模型的资源-精度匹配界：代数衰减预测记忆下，最优 r 模误差按 e^{-Θ(√r)} 衰减，达到误差 τ 需 r=Θ(log²(1/τ)) 个状态或模态。分数阶长记忆把误差几何改为分数积分后度量，有限上下文长度 L 的预测有精确 1/L 首阶，固定强度 d 仍保持平方对数状态复杂度律；代数目标上误差趋零迫使递归定量逼近临界点，该条件必要但不充分。
Motivation: 长程时间依赖给序列模型提出资源问题：在给定预测记忆律下，要达到指定预报精度究竟需要多少状态、上下文或动力学临界性。既有 curse-of-memory 结果用不同逼近概念给出宽泛限制，但上下界未在同一预测目标与预测风险下匹配。
Method: 对代数衰减预测记忆，证明指数模态与有限状态模式的匹配上下逼近界；引入分数阶积分后的预测误差度量，导出有限上下文 1/L 首阶与短记忆边界附近的 d²、d⁴ 尺度及中间区统一构造律；对一致收缩的非线性上下文递归推导指数 first-chaos 包络与收缩裕度的必要条件，并做有限样本 Kullback–Leibler 计算；用与定理匹配的实验检验收缩状态空间、门控递归与 attention 模型。
Result: 最优 r 模预报误差 e^{-Θ(√r)}，达误差 τ 需 r=Θ(log²(1/τ)) 个状态或模态；分数阶情形有限上下文长度 L 的预报误差首阶精确为 1/L，固定 d 保持平方对数状态复杂度律，短记忆边界附近识别出 d² 与 d⁴ 尺度；收缩递归给出指数 first-chaos 包络及预报精度与收缩裕度的显式必要条件；定理匹配实验在 contractive state-space、gated recurrent 与 attention 模型上复现状态与稳定性预测。
Conclusion: 对一个规范预测目标，资源指数在预测风险下可被两侧匹配地固定为平方对数律；分数阶长记忆改变误差几何但不改变该指数，而逼近零误差会把递归定量推向临界性——必要而不自足。

papers.title: Bounded Autonomy and Verifiable Safety for Agentic AI Enabled Automation
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI-enabled automation cannot be safely deployed in high-stakes environments on probabilistic reasoning alone. A recurring risk is epistemic drift: as reasoning deepens, system behavior may move away from subject-matter-expert constraints for safe operation. This paper presents BRaVeS, a bounded reasoning and safety-governance framework termed the Defensible Next-Gen Reasoning System (DNRS). BRaVeS encodes SME-defined constraints as invariant anchors, proposes MoDA-Style (Mixture of Depths Attention) depth-aware access as a candidate mechanism for keeping these anchors visible during inference, and uses a state hierarchy (SMARtAutonomy) to reduce autonomy as epistemic risk increases. To formalize bounded recovery, we introduce the Lyapunov-Bounded Consensus Framework (LBCF), which maps continuous epistemic-risk signals into a finite K-bag abstraction and applies shielded state transitions that enforce Lyapunov-style energy descent or route the system to a human-mediated terminal state. The formal convergence result applies to the finite LBCF abstraction under fixed thresholds and feasible-shield assumptions; it does not prove safety of the full continuous neural activation space. We evaluate the framework through a discrete event Monte Carlo simulation using HAI 22.04 industrial-control-system time-series data with synthetic noise and sensor-degradation regimes. Across the tested parameter-grouping strategies and thresholds, the LBCF process achieved finite-step convergence and no safety-guard violations. These results provide simulation-based evidence that bounded governance behavior can be enforced under the stated abstraction, while motivating future work on deployed transformer implementations, live human-in-the-loop validation, and broader adversarial settings.

TL;DR: 提出 BRaVeS/DNRS 治理框架：把 SME 安全约束编码为不变锚点，用 MoDA-Style (Mixture of Depths Attention) 在推理中保持锚点可见，并以 SMARtAutonomy 状态层级随认知风险升高而降级自主权；LBCF 把连续认知风险信号映射到有限 K-bag 抽象并施加 shielded 状态转移。在 HAI 22.04 工控时序数据加合成噪声与传感器退化的离散事件 Monte Carlo 仿真中，LBCF 在所测参数分组与阈值下实现有限步收敛且零安全护栏违规。
Motivation: 高风险环境中的 agentic AI 仅靠概率推理无法安全部署，推理加深时系统行为会漂移出 SME 安全约束（epistemic drift），需要可验证的有界恢复机制。
Method: BRaVeS 框架包含三部分：SME 约束编码为 invariant anchors、MoDA-Style 深度感知注意力作为推理期保持锚点可见的候选机制、SMARtAutonomy 状态层级按认知风险降级自主权；LBCF 将连续认知-risk 信号压到有限 K-bag 抽象，用 shielded 状态转移强制 Lyapunov 式能量下降或转入人工中介终态。评估用离散事件 Monte Carlo 仿真，数据为 HAI 22.04 工业控制系统时序，叠加合成噪声与传感器退化 regime。
Result: 在所测参数分组策略与阈值下，LBCF 过程达到有限步收敛且无安全护栏违规；形式化收敛结果限于固定阈值与可行 shield 假设下的有限 LBCF 抽象，不证明完整连续神经激活空间的安全。
Conclusion: 在给定有限抽象下，有界治理行为可以被强制执行并给出仿真级证据；结论不外推到完整连续激活空间，作者把部署版 transformer 实现、真实 human-in-the-loop 验证与更广对抗场景列为后续工作。

papers.title: Route-Verify-Vote: Procedure-Conditioned Self-Consistency for Mixed-Domain Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Compositional generalization remains challenging when language models must combine familiar reasoning operations in unfamiliar ways. The Scenario-Based Commonsense Reasoning Evaluation (SCoRE) 2026 tests this ability on three mixed domains absent from training and requires models to identify the complete set of correct options for each question. We introduce Route-Verify-Vote (RVV), a framework for procedure-conditioned self-consistency that uses language models without parameter updates. Route uses the provided domain label to select a reasoning procedure that guides the model in representing and applying the relevant constraints. Verify prompts the model to assess each option against those constraints. Vote aggregates complete answer sets and allocates additional samples to questions with a small vote-count margin between the two most frequent sets. Samples for each question follow the same domain-specific procedure. On the official test set, voting over 16 sampled answer sets per question achieves an exact-set accuracy of 74.6%. Adaptive RVV reaches 77.3%, and combining models on selected domain routes raises accuracy to 79.4%. The final system ranked second among participating systems. These results support domain-specific reasoning procedures and answer-set disagreement as useful tools for allocating inference-time computation in mixed-domain reasoning.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 8 figures, and 8 tables. Accepted for oral presentation at CCL26-Eval
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Route-Verify-Vote (RVV) 用不改参数的程序条件化自一致性做混合域组合推理：按域标签选推理程序，逐选项核验约束，再对完整答案集投票并把额外采样分给前两名票差小的题。在 SCoRE 2026 官方测试集上，每题 16 个采样答案集投票得 74.6% exact-set accuracy，自适应 RVV 到 77.3%，按域路由组合模型到 79.4%，最终排名第二。
Motivation: 语言模型把熟悉的推理操作以陌生方式组合时仍然吃力，SCoRE 2026 用三个训练中未见的混合域并要求给出完整正确选项集，直接暴露这一缺口。
Method: Route 用给定域标签挑选推理程序来表示并应用相关约束；Verify 让模型按这些约束逐选项评估；Vote 聚合完整答案集，且对前两个最频繁集合票差小的题追加采样，同题采样共用同一域程序，全程不更新参数。
Result: SCoRE 2026 官方测试集上，每题 16 个采样答案集投票 exact-set accuracy 74.6%，自适应 RVV 77.3%，按选定域路由组合模型 79.4%，系统在参赛系统中排名第二。
Conclusion: 域特定推理程序与答案集分歧可以作为在混合域推理中分配推理时算力的有效依据。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Pre-training, Reasoning, Benchmarking: X-ray Report Generation on CheXpert Plus Dataset
papers.abstract_en: X-ray image-based Radiology Report Generation (RRG) constitutes a critical research direction within medical artificial intelligence, with great potential to alleviate clinicians' diagnostic workload and shorten patient waiting periods. Despite substantial advances over recent years, the field faces evident bottlenecks stemming from insufficient standardized benchmarks and inadequate domain adaptation of generic large models. Notably, the newly released CheXpert Plus dataset is provided without accompanying baseline implementations and evaluation results, which impedes standardized training, quantitative evaluation and fair comparison among follow-up algorithms. To mitigate this limitation, we establish a comprehensive benchmark encompassing prevailing X-ray report generation models and Large Language Models on CheXpert Plus. This benchmark delivers a reliable comparative foundation for upcoming methods and enables researchers to rapidly identify state-of-the-art approaches within this domain. Beyond benchmark construction, we rethink X-ray RRG under the paradigm of large models and propose a novel framework termed MambaXray-PRB. Our framework improves report generation performance and enhances model interpretability via multi-stage large-model pre-training and multi-modal Chain-of-Thought reasoning. The pipeline consists of three successive phases: self-supervised auto-regressive modeling, X-ray-report contrastive learning, and post-training optimization for reasoning and report generation. Extensive experiments on IU X-ray, MIMIC-CXR, and CheXpert Plus datasets validate the effectiveness of MambaXray-PRB for radiology report generation. The source code of this paper is available on https://github.com/Event-AHU/Medical_Image_Analysis
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CheXpert Plus 数据集发布时没有配套基线与评测结果，作者先在该数据集上建立覆盖主流 X-ray 报告生成模型与 LLM 的基准，再提出 MambaXray-PRB 框架：经自回归建模、X-ray-报告对比学习、面向推理与报告生成的后训练三阶段大模型预训练，配合多模态 Chain-of-Thought 推理提升报告生成性能与可解释性，并在 IU X-ray、MIMIC-CXR、CheXpert Plus 上验证有效。
Motivation: X-ray 放射报告生成 (RRG) 缺乏标准化基准，通用大模型在该领域适配不足；新发布的 CheXpert Plus 没有基线实现和评测结果，阻碍标准化训练、定量评估与后续算法的公平比较。
Method: 两部分：一是在 CheXpert Plus 上建立涵盖主流 RRG 模型与 Large Language Models 的综合基准；二是提出 MambaXray-PRB 框架，管线含三个连续阶段——自监督自回归建模 (self-supervised auto-regressive modeling)、X-ray-报告对比学习 (contrastive learning)、面向推理与报告生成的后训练优化 (post-training optimization)，并以多模态 Chain-of-Thought 推理增强可解释性。
Result: 在 IU X-ray、MIMIC-CXR 与 CheXpert Plus 三个数据集上的大量实验验证了 MambaXray-PRB 对放射报告生成的有效性；基准给出 CheXpert Plus 上各主流 RRG 模型与 LLM 的比较结果。
Conclusion: 多阶段大模型预训练加多模态 Chain-of-Thought 推理能提升 X-ray 报告生成性能与模型可解释性，而 CheXpert Plus 上的标准化基准为后续方法提供了可比较的参照与快速定位 SOTA 的途径。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Taming an End-to-End Autonomous Driving Policy for Urban Navigation of Quadruped Robots
papers.abstract_en: We present Go2-DrivoR, a goal-conditioned adaptation of the end-to-end autonomous driving trajectory planning framework DrivoR for urban navigation with quadrupedal robots. By conditioning trajectory generation on a local-frame subgoal through a goal token and adapting the vehicle-centric scoring formulation, the method extends DrivoR to short-horizon goal-conditioned local planning without redesigning its core decoders. Specifically, we redefine drivable-area compliance for sidewalk-oriented navigation and reformulate the original ego progress term as goal-conditioned ego progress. Trained exclusively on TartanGround simulation data, Go2-DrivoR improves waypoint-conditioned planning performance on unseen simulation environments and transfers zero-shot to open-loop real-world trajectory prediction.
papers.comment: Accepted to IROS 2026 Workshop on AI Meets Autonomy
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Go2-DrivoR 把端到端自动驾驶轨迹规划框架 DrivoR 改造成四足机器人城市导航的目标条件局部规划器：用 goal token 把局部坐标系子目标喂给轨迹生成，并把可行驶区域合规改为面向人行道的定义、把 ego progress 项重写为目标条件 ego progress。仅用 TartanGround 仿真数据训练后，在未见仿真环境中提升 waypoint 条件规划表现，并零样本迁移到真实世界的开环轨迹预测。
Motivation: DrivoR 面向车辆中心的驾驶场景，直接用于四足机器人的人行道导航时缺少子目标条件，且其可行驶区域与进度项的定义与步行环境不匹配。
Method: 以 goal token 将局部坐标系子目标条件化到轨迹生成，不改动核心解码器；重定义 drivable-area compliance 以适配 sidewalk 导航，并把原始 ego progress 项改写为 goal-conditioned ego progress；训练数据全部来自 TartanGround 仿真。
Result: 在未见仿真环境中 waypoint 条件规划性能提升，并零样本 (zero-shot) 迁移到真实世界的开环 (open-loop) 轨迹预测。
Conclusion: 在不重设计核心解码器的前提下，通过子目标条件化与评分项改造，即可把车辆端到端规划框架复用为四足机器人城市局部导航策略，并具备仿真到真实的零样本迁移能力。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: KVFetch: Temporal Prefetching for the Missing Half of KV Cache Compression
papers.abstract_en: As context windows scale to tens or hundreds of thousands of tokens, KV cache compression has become essential for efficient LLM inference. Existing methods fall into three families: score-based eviction, summary compensation, and offload-and-recall. Yet all three decide what to keep or recall by content relevance to the current query. We show this shared design is structurally incomplete. A cache supports two access modes: associative lookup by content and sequential traversal by position; current compressors implement only the first. The gap matters in practice: retrieval-augmented generation, code completion, and structured-data extraction all require the model to reproduce identifiers, field values, or code tokens verbatim from the context. Under compression, content-based eviction retains the head of such a sequence but discards its continuation, causing verbatim copying to break irreversibly midway, a failure we call sequential forgetting. This failure resists better scoring, larger budgets, summary compensation, and dynamic re-scoring; it is the dominant source of remaining quality loss under compression. We propose KVFetch, a training-free, drop-in framework that opens a temporal recall channel for any score-based compressor. It demotes evicted candidates to a quantized cold tier, detects active copying through a monotone read pointer, and prefetches positional successors into fixed-size hot-tier slots without increasing attention cost. On RULER-16K under an iso-budget control, KVFetch recovers verbatim copying from 0.8 to 78.4 and raises the 13-task average by +8.4, with gains concentrating on tasks that require sequential access. On LongBench, where no task requires sequential access, the channel remains dormant and imposes no cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KVFetch 指出 KV cache 压缩只实现了按内容的联想查找，缺失按位置的顺序遍历，导致逐字复制在序列中途不可逆地断裂（sequential forgetting）。它为任意基于打分的压缩器加一条时序召回通道：被淘汰项降级到量化冷层，用单调读指针检测正在发生的复制，把位置后继预取进固定大小的热层槽位，且不增加 attention 开销。在 RULER-16K 等预算对照下，逐字复制从 0.8 恢复到 78.4，13 任务平均提升 +8.4；LongBench 上通道保持休眠、无额外开销。
Motivation: 长上下文 LLM 推理中 KV cache 压缩是必需的，但现有三类方法（打分淘汰、摘要补偿、卸载-召回）都只按与当前查询的内容相关性决定保留什么，无法支持 RAG、代码补全、结构化数据抽取中按位置逐字复现标识符与字段值的需求。
Method: KVFetch 是一个免训练、可直接嵌入任意基于打分压缩器的框架：把被淘汰候选项降级到量化冷层，用单调读指针 (monotone read pointer) 检测模型是否正在逐字复制，再把位置后继预取进固定大小的热层槽位，预取不增加 attention 成本。
Result: 在 RULER-16K 的等预算 (iso-budget) 对照下，逐字复制得分从 0.8 恢复到 78.4，13 任务平均提升 +8.4，增益集中在需要顺序访问的任务上；在 LongBench（无任务需要顺序访问）上该通道保持休眠且不带来开销。摘要还指出该失败对更好的打分、更大预算、摘要补偿和动态重打分均不敏感，是压缩下剩余质量损失的主因。
Conclusion: KV cache 压缩必须同时支持内容联想查找与位置顺序遍历；补上时序召回通道即可在不增加 attention 成本的前提下恢复逐字复制能力，而在不需要顺序访问的任务上自动休眠。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: KVFetch 是一个免训练、可直接嵌入任意基于打分压缩器的框架：把被淘汰候选项降级到量化冷层，用单调读指针 (monotone read pointer) 检测模型是否正在逐字复制，再把位置后继预取进固定大小的热层槽位，预取不增加 attention 成本。
summary_sections.result: 在 RULER-16K 的等预算 (iso-budget) 对照下，逐字复制得分从 0.8 恢复到 78.4，13 任务平均提升 +8.4，增益集中在需要顺序访问的任务上；在 LongBench（无任务需要顺序访问）上该通道保持休眠且不带来开销。摘要还指出该失败对更好的打分、更大预算、摘要补偿和动态重打分均不敏感，是压缩下剩余质量损失的主因。
summary_sections.conclusion: KV cache 压缩必须同时支持内容联想查找与位置顺序遍历；补上时序召回通道即可在不增加 attention 成本的前提下恢复逐字复制能力，而在不需要顺序访问的任务上自动休眠。

papers.title: Transferability and operational reliability of a Prithvi crop classification foundation model under phenological and geographic shift across three continents
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuned geospatial foundation models (GeoFMs) pretrained on large satellite archives have been shown to improve crop classification accuracy and geographic transferability. However, their operational performance beyond the training distribution remains poorly characterized. We evaluated the out-of-distribution performance of a widely adopted GeoFM [Prithvi-EO-2.0] across 37 events in 12 countries on three continents and validated against regional reference products. Results indicated that the mean overall accuracy (OA) declined from 0.65 in the United States to 0.40 in Europe. Beyond accuracy metrics, we assessed five key aspects of model performance: whether model confidence indicates signal failure, sensitivity to observation windows, the effect of coarsening class schemes, and robustness to both band loss and cloud- and shadow-contamination. Accuracy collapsed when the observation window misaligned with local crop phenology, while deterministic confidence remained high. Expected calibration error increased for seven of eight paired events, and 12-51% of each affected scene was confidently mislabeled at near-zero precision. Monte Carlo dropout entropy registered the shift in all eight, indicating that much of the apparent cross-continent decline reflected phenological misalignment rather than spatial transfer. Two adjustments recovered accuracy without retraining. Consolidating 13 classes into 10, based on the model's dominant confusions, raised the mean OA by 8.4 percentage points. Compressing the window toward near-real-time use preserved accuracy across a 45- to 90-day plateau, peaking near 75 days, though arms tighter than 30 days fell about 0.11 below that plateau. Fine-tuned crop GeoFMs therefore transfer usefully only where observation windows match local growing seasons. We translate these findings into operational guidance for the reliable deployment of the released model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Prithvi-EO-2.0 作物分类基础模型上评估跨物候与跨地域分布外表现：观测窗口与当地作物物候错位时精度崩塌但确定性置信度仍高，而 Monte Carlo dropout 熵在全部 8 组配对事件中都识别出该偏移，说明跨洲精度下降主要反映物候错位而非空间迁移失败。不重训的两项调整可恢复精度：按模型主导混淆把 13 类合并为 10 类使平均 OA 提升 8.4 个百分点；把观测窗口压缩向近实时使用时，45–90 天区间精度保持平台、约 75 天达峰，窗口紧于 30 天则比平台低约 0.11。
Motivation: 微调后的地理空间基础模型 (GeoFM) 在训练分布之外的运行表现缺乏刻画，跨洲部署时精度下降的成因（空间迁移失败还是物候错位）与可恢复手段都不清楚。
Method: 在 3 大洲 12 个国家的 37 个事件上评估 Prithvi-EO-2.0 的分布外表现，并用区域参考产品验证；除总体精度外检验 5 个方面：置信度能否指示信号失效、对观测窗口的敏感性、类别方案粗化的影响、波段丢失鲁棒性、云与阴影污染鲁棒性；用期望校准误差 (ECE) 与 Monte Carlo dropout 熵对比确定性置信度。
Result: 平均总体精度 (OA) 从美国的 0.65 降到欧洲的 0.40；观测窗口与当地物候错位时精度崩塌而确定性置信度仍高，8 组配对事件中 7 组 ECE 上升，每个受影响场景有 12–51% 像元被高置信度错标、近零精度；MC dropout 熵在全部 8 组中都记录到偏移。13 类合并为 10 类使平均 OA 提升 8.4 个百分点；观测窗口 45–90 天为精度平台、约 75 天达峰，紧于 30 天的窗口比平台低约 0.11。
Conclusion: 微调作物 GeoFM 只有在观测窗口与当地生长季匹配时才有效迁移；跨洲精度下降很大程度是物候错位而非空间迁移问题，且不重训的类别合并与窗口调整即可恢复精度，作者据此给出已发布模型的运行部署指南。

papers.title: Beyond Baseline Severity: Temporal and Disease-Specific Predictors of Depression Outcomes Following Mindfulness Interventions
papers.abstract_en: Depression severity among patients with chronic or acute medical conditions is influenced by a complex interaction of baseline psychological state, demographic characteristics, clinical context, and engagement with behavioral interventions. This paper presents an interpretable machine-learning analysis of a multi-center longitudinal clinical cohort to predict Beck Depression Inventory-II (BDI-II) scores at 12 and 24 weeks following mindfulness-based intervention participation. The study uses demographic variables, clinical condition information, hospital-center identifiers, baseline BDI-II scores, and therapy engagement measures to model short-term and long-term depression outcomes. Missing follow-up outcomes were addressed using a model-based stochastic imputation procedure to preserve the modest sample size while maintaining outcome variability. Five regression models were evaluated, spanning regularized linear regression and tree-based ensemble methods. Ridge Regression achieved the best 12-week performance with an RMSE of 5.186 and R^2 of 0.474, while LightGBM achieved the best 24-week performance with an RMSE of 5.038 and R^2 of 0.525. Beyond prediction accuracy, the analysis reveals three clinically relevant patterns: baseline severity remains the strongest overall predictor, short-term outcomes are more strongly associated with clinical and hospital context, and long-term outcomes show greater dependence on behavioral adherence and demographic factors. Disease-specific and hierarchical subgroup analyses further indicate that predictors differ substantially across and within clinical categories. These findings support the use of interpretable, context-aware modeling to inform personalized mental-health support following mindfulness-based interventions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用可解释机器学习预测正念干预后 12 与 24 周的 BDI-II 抑郁评分：Ridge 在 12 周最优（RMSE 5.186，R² 0.474），LightGBM 在 24 周最优（RMSE 5.038，R² 0.525）。基线严重度仍是最强预测因子，但短期结局更依赖临床与医院情境，长期结局更依赖行为依从性与人口学因素，且疾病亚组间预测因子差异显著。
Motivation: 正念干预后的抑郁结局预测通常只看基线严重度，忽略临床情境、医院中心与依从性在不同时间尺度上的差异化作用，难以支撑个体化心理支持。
Method: 在多中心纵向临床队列上做可解释回归建模，特征含人口学变量、临床疾病信息、医院中心标识、基线 BDI-II 与治疗投入度；缺失随访结局用基于模型的随机插补 (model-based stochastic imputation) 处理以保留样本量与结局方差；比较五种回归模型（正则线性回归与树集成），并做疾病特异与层级亚组分析。
Result: Ridge Regression 12 周 RMSE 5.186、R² 0.474（五模型中最佳）；LightGBM 24 周 RMSE 5.038、R² 0.525（最佳）。三类模式：基线严重度为最强总体预测因子；短期结局与临床及医院情境关联更强；长期结局更依赖行为依从性与人口学因素。疾病特异与层级亚组分析显示预测因子在临床类别间与类别内差异显著。
Conclusion: 预测正念干预后的抑郁结局需按时间尺度区分情境与依从性的作用，支持用可解释、情境感知的模型为个体化心理健康支持提供依据。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Accelerating Floating-Point Satisfiability Solving via Gradient Normalization
papers.abstract_en: Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) solvers are foundational to software verification, program analysis, and compiler testing, particularly over the theory of Quantifier-Free Floating-Point (QF_FP). While recent optimization-based SMT solvers have successfully applied gradient descent to continuous relaxations of logical formulas, they are fundamentally bottlenecked by gradient domination, a phenomenon where a small subset of difficult clauses hijacks the optimization trajectory, preventing the solver from satisfying the broader formula and trapping it in local minima. To overcome this, we present GradSAT, a novel framework that bridges optimization-based SMT solving with Multi-Task Learning (MTL). GradSAT reformulates the constraint satisfaction process by treating each SMT clause as an independent MTL task. By applying dynamic gradient normalization (GradNorm), GradSAT actively balances the gradient magnitudes across all clauses at runtime, systematically penalizing dominant gradients and accelerating lagging clauses to ensure uniform convergence. GradSAT implements this through a highly optimized, two-stage hybrid pipeline. First, a GPU-accelerated PyTorch backend leveraging symbolic compilation and operator fusion navigates the continuous relaxation to a high-quality basin. Second, the candidate assignment is handed off to a bit-precise local search engine to rapidly resolve the exact, rigorous assignment. By stabilizing the continuous search dynamics, GradSAT mitigates the brittleness of prior gradient-based solvers and provides a robust, highly parallelizable architecture for complex constraint solving.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GradSAT 把 QF_FP 上的 SMT 求解改写成多任务学习：每条子句作为一个 MTL 任务，用 GradNorm 在运行时动态归一化各子句梯度幅度，压制主导梯度、加速落后子句，缓解梯度支配 (gradient domination) 导致的局部极小。随后由 GPU 加速的 PyTorch 连续松弛搜索加位精确局部搜索的两阶段混合流水线给出最终赋值。
Motivation: 基于梯度下降的连续松弛 SMT 求解器被梯度支配卡住：少数难子句劫持优化轨迹，使公式其余部分无法满足并陷入局部极小，QF_FP 上尤其明显。
Method: 将每条 SMT 子句视为独立 MTL 任务，用动态梯度归一化 (GradNorm) 在运行时平衡各子句梯度幅度，惩罚主导梯度并加速落后子句；两阶段混合流水线先用带符号编译与算子融合 (operator fusion) 的 GPU PyTorch 后端在连续松弛中导航到高质量盆地，再交给位精确 (bit-precise) 局部搜索引擎求精确赋值。
Result: 摘要给出的是机制层面的定性结论：GradNorm 稳定连续搜索动态，缓解此前基于梯度的求解器的脆弱性，并给出可高度并行的约束求解架构；未列出基准、求解数量或加速比等数值。
Conclusion: 把子句级梯度平衡与连续松弛、位精确局部搜索串成两阶段流水线，是让基于梯度的 QF_FP SMT 求解摆脱局部极小并保持稳健的一条路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Review Of Robotic World Models For Dynamic Environments Based On Factor And Scene Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Models based on graphs have emerged in robotics as a powerful foundation for internal world representations, where factor and scene graphs are among the most prominent model types found in the related literature and in successful robotic solutions. Initially, many of these models were assuming static environments as a simplification. Herein, factor graphs mainly provide uncertainty-aware geometric estimations while scene graphs enable a structured semantic abstraction. However, real-world robotic environments are often dynamic, posing severe challenges for purely static world representations. Therefore, this review presents a comprehensive view on how dynamic aspects of real-world environments can be addressed in such graph-based world models. We organize our assessments around three main aspects: (I) suitable representations, (II) pipelines to construct and update the representations, and (III) their exploitation for downstream tasks. We review approaches that are either based on factor or scene graphs, but put special emphasis on novel approaches that combine both types to form hybrid models. We mainly analyze how different types of dynamics can be modeled herein, and categorize common architectural patterns. Finally, emerging trends and open challenges are identified, including uncertainty propagation from learned perception through the representation layers, the observability of dynamic-entity motion and scale under minimal sensing, scalable lifelong maintenance, and the lack of datasets and evaluation protocols that ground world-model quality in downstream task performance under dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 综述机器人动态环境下的图基世界模型，指出 factor graph 提供带不确定性的几何估计、scene graph 提供结构化语义抽象，纯静态表示无法应对真实动态场景。文章按表示、构建与更新管线、下游任务利用三方面组织文献，重点归纳把两类图结合的混合模型如何建模不同类型的动态并分类常见架构模式。
Motivation: 既有图基世界模型多把环境当静态以简化问题，而真实机器人环境常是动态的，纯静态表示在动态实体上失效。
Method: 综述性工作：按 (I) 表示、(II) 构建与更新管线、(III) 下游任务利用三个维度组织文献，分别梳理 factor graph 与 scene graph 方法，重点分析二者结合的混合模型如何建模动态，并归纳架构模式。
Result: 全文为文献综述（34 页、7 张表、8 张图），给出动态类型建模方式的分类与架构模式归纳，并指出开放挑战：从学习感知经表示各层的不确定性传播、最小传感下动态实体运动与尺度的可观测性、可扩展的终身维护，以及缺少在动态下以下游任务表现衡量世界模型质量的数据集与评测协议。
Conclusion: 作者认为混合 factor-scene graph 是处理动态环境的主要路径，但该领域仍受不确定性传播、可观测性、终身维护与评测协议缺失制约。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 综述性工作：按 (I) 表示、(II) 构建与更新管线、(III) 下游任务利用三个维度组织文献，分别梳理 factor graph 与 scene graph 方法，重点分析二者结合的混合模型如何建模动态，并归纳架构模式。
summary_sections.result: 全文为文献综述（34 页、7 张表、8 张图），给出动态类型建模方式的分类与架构模式归纳，并指出开放挑战：从学习感知经表示各层的不确定性传播、最小传感下动态实体运动与尺度的可观测性、可扩展的终身维护，以及缺少在动态下以下游任务表现衡量世界模型质量的数据集与评测协议。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为混合 factor-scene graph 是处理动态环境的主要路径，但该领域仍受不确定性传播、可观测性、终身维护与评测协议缺失制约。

papers.title: Tokka-Bench: Evaluating Tokenizers Across 100 Natural and 20 Programming Languages
papers.abstract_en: Large language models rely on subword tokenizers whose quality varies across languages, yet no standardized multi-metric framework exists for broad comparative evaluation. We introduce Tokka-Bench, an open-source framework that evaluates tokenizers on five complementary metrics -- bytes per token, unique token coverage, subword fertility, word-split rate, and vocabulary composition -- across 100 natural languages (30+ scripts) and 20 programming languages, using language-aware segmentation adapted to each writing system. Comparing seven BPE tokenizers (GPT-2, GPT-4, gpt-oss, Llama 3.1, Gemma 3, Qwen3, and Kimi K2) within individual languages, we find that vocabulary allocation strategy matters more than raw vocabulary size, and that programming-language efficiency has converged among recent tokenizers despite divergent natural-language profiles. The framework, data, and interactive dashboard are publicly available.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 5 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/bgub/tokka-bench. Interactive dashboard: https://tokka-bench.streamlit.app/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Tokka-Bench 提出开源多指标 tokenizer 评测框架，用 bytes per token、unique token coverage、subword fertility、word-split rate、vocabulary composition 五项指标，在 100 种自然语言（30+ 文字系统）和 20 种编程语言上按各文字系统的语言感知切分比较七个 BPE tokenizer。结论是词表分配策略比词表规模本身更重要，且近期 tokenizer 的编程语言效率已趋同，而自然语言表现仍分化。
Motivation: LLM 的 subword tokenizer 质量随语言差异很大，但缺少覆盖多语言、多指标的标准化比较框架。
Method: 开源框架 Tokka-Bench，五项互补指标（bytes per token、unique token coverage、subword fertility、word-split rate、vocabulary composition），针对每种文字系统做语言感知切分；在单语言内部比较七个 BPE tokenizer：GPT-2、GPT-4、gpt-oss、Llama 3.1、Gemma 3、Qwen3、Kimi K2，覆盖 100 种自然语言（30+ 文字系统）与 20 种编程语言。
Result: 在单语言比较中发现词表分配策略比原始词表大小更关键；近期 tokenizer 的编程语言效率已趋同，而自然语言表现仍呈分化。框架、数据与交互 dashboard 公开发布。
Conclusion: 评估 tokenizer 应按多指标、跨 100 自然语言与 20 编程语言的统一框架进行，且优化重点应放在词表分配策略而非单纯扩大词表。

papers.title: Adaptive Workflow Intelligence: A Cognitive Architecture for Context-Driven Enterprise Automation
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise systems increasingly rely on automated workflows, yet many AI-driven solutions remain brittle under non-stationary conditions, evolving policies, and delayed operational feedback. While reinforcement learning and large language model (LLM) agents offer partial adaptability, they do not by themselves provide persistent reflection mechanisms or straightforward integration with policy-constrained enterprise operations. This paper introduces Adaptive Workflow Intelligence (AWI), a cognitive architecture for context-driven enterprise agents organized around a four-layer Perception-Cognition-Action-Reflection (PCAR) loop. AWI treats reflection as a mechanism for continuous policy refinement and combines hybrid reasoning with reflective memory and feedback-driven adaptation to support decision making under environmental drift and operational constraints. We evaluate AWI in a simulated enterprise decision workflow characterized by delayed outcomes and a controlled regime shift. In a drift-and-delay stress test, guardrail-constrained adaptive approaches recover more rapidly than static automation while maintaining policy compliance. Within this setting, AWI's reflective components modestly reduce behavioral oscillation and feedback variance, illustrating the stability-agility trade-off introduced by reflective policy adaptation.
papers.comment: 12 pages, simulation-based evaluation of adaptive workflow agents
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AWI 提出面向企业工作流的认知架构，用四层 Perception-Cognition-Action-Reflection (PCAR) 循环把反思作为持续策略精化的机制，结合混合推理、反思记忆与反馈驱动适应来应对环境漂移和运营约束。在含延迟结果与受控 regime shift 的仿真企业决策工作流中，带护栏的自适应方案比静态自动化恢复更快且保持策略合规，反思组件小幅降低行为振荡与反馈方差。
Motivation: 企业自动化在非平稳条件、策略演化和延迟运营反馈下容易失效；RL 与 LLM agent 本身缺少持续反思机制，也难以直接嵌入受策略约束的企业运营。
Method: 提出 Adaptive Workflow Intelligence (AWI)：四层 PCAR 循环，反思层用于持续策略精化，配合混合推理 (hybrid reasoning)、反思记忆 (reflective memory) 与反馈驱动适应；在含延迟结果和受控 regime shift 的仿真企业决策工作流上做压力测试。
Result: 在 drift-and-delay 压力测试中，护栏约束的自适应方案比静态自动化恢复更快并保持策略合规；AWI 的反思组件小幅降低行为振荡与反馈方差，体现反思式策略适应带来的 stability-agility 权衡。
Conclusion: 在延迟反馈加 regime shift 的企业工作流里，带护栏的反思式策略适应比静态自动化更稳也更敏捷，但收益是小幅的，且以稳定性-敏捷性权衡为代价。

papers.title: Efficient Dense Crowd Trajectory Prediction Via Dynamic Clustering
papers.abstract_en: Crowd trajectory prediction plays a crucial role in public safety and management, where it can help prevent disasters such as stampedes. Recent works address the problem by predicting individual trajectories and considering surrounding objects based on manually annotated data. However, these approaches tend to overlook dense crowd scenarios, where the challenges of automation become more pronounced due to the massiveness, noisiness, and inaccuracy of the tracking outputs, resulting in high computational costs. To address these challenges, we propose and extensively evaluate a novel cluster-based approach that groups individuals based on similar attributes over time, enabling faster execution through accurate group summarisation. Our plug-and-play method can be combined with existing trajectory predictors by using our output centroid in place of their pedestrian input. We evaluate our proposed method on several challenging dense crowd scenes. papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对密集人群轨迹预测中跟踪输出量大、噪声多、计算成本高的问题，提出基于随时间相似属性的动态聚类方法，用准确的群体摘要（质心）替代逐个行人输入，可即插即用地接入现有轨迹预测器。在多个高难度密集人群场景上，相比最先进方法处理更快、内存占用更低，同时保持精度。
Motivation: 现有方法逐个预测个体轨迹并依赖人工标注，在密集人群场景下跟踪结果规模巨大、含噪且不准，导致自动化困难与高计算成本。
Method: 基于动态聚类 (dynamic clustering) 的方法：按随时间相似的属性对个体分组，输出群体质心 (centroid) 代替逐个行人输入，作为即插即用模块接入已有轨迹预测器。
Result: 在多个挑战性密集人群场景上评估：相比最先进方法处理速度更快、内存使用更低，同时维持精度（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 在密集人群场景下，用群体摘要代替逐人轨迹输入可在保持精度的同时显著降低计算与内存开销。

papers.title: A Bayesian Mirror Architecture for Emergent Consciousness: Circular Hierarchies, Self-Manifolds, and Hybrid Event-Self Binding
papers.abstract_en: We present a foundational formulation of the Bayesian Mirror Architecture (BMA), a self-referential generative framework in which sensory abstractions, meta-abstractions, and a self-latent interact through circular recursion. The defining constraint is a closed update S_t <- H_{t-1}, where a hybrid event-self latent H_t binds self-representations to abstract world models and reinjects this coupling into the self-state. Consciousness, in a restricted sense, is not an optimization objective nor a semantic label, but an architectural property of systems possessing this circular structure. Because inference operates over posterior beliefs, BMA's intrinsic state space is a space of probability measures equipped with optimal-transport geometry. Stability and coherence are formulated in the 2-Wasserstein metric on P_2, yielding coordinate-free notions of self-stability and hybrid coherence along belief trajectories. We define a Causal Learning Regime (CLR) via bounds on Wasserstein belief drift together with an integration index capturing sustained coupling between self and world latents. CLR diagnoses whether the environment contains learnable causal structure; it is not a marker of consciousness. Global strict contractivity is not required: BMA may exhibit multiple coherent basins. We define self-manifolds basin-wise as supports of invariant measures under local Wasserstein contractivity. We identify Wasserstein epsilon-necks, transport bottlenecks where basins decouple, yielding a unique realized continuation in a vanishing-conductance limit. We interpret this selection as choice: internally determined yet externally unpredictable at finite resolution. Learning proceeds via variational free-energy minimization, with stability and agency emerging from what the environment affords to learn.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Bayesian Mirror Architecture (BMA)：一个以闭合更新 S_t ← H_{t-1} 为约束的自指生成框架，把感觉抽象、元抽象与自潜变量通过循环递归耦合，意识被定义为这种循环结构的架构属性而非优化目标。推断在 P_2 概率测度空间上以 2-Wasserstein 度量刻画自稳定性与混合一致性，学习由变分自由能最小化驱动；CLR 仅诊断环境是否含可学习因果结构，不标记意识。
Motivation: 自指生成模型中自我表征与世界模型的耦合缺少坐标无关的稳定性刻画，且“意识”常被当作优化目标或语义标签，无法区分因果可学习性与意识本身。
Method: BMA 用混合 event-self 潜变量 H_t 绑定自表征与抽象世界模型并回灌自状态，形成闭合更新 S_t ← H_{t-1}；在 P_2 上以 2-Wasserstein 度量定义自稳定性与混合一致性，提出带 Wasserstein belief drift 界与 self-world 耦合积分指数的 Causal Learning Regime (CLR)；按局部 Wasserstein 收缩性逐 basin 定义 self-manifold（不变测度支撑），并以 Wasserstein ε-neck 输运瓶颈刻画 basin 解耦；学习用变分自由能最小化。
Result: 给出理论构造而非实验数字：CLR 由 Wasserstein belief drift 界与耦合积分指数界定；全局严格收缩非必需，BMA 可有多个一致 basin；在 vanishing-conductance 极限下 ε-neck 瓶颈给出唯一实现的延续，被解释为“选择”——内部决定但在有限分辨率下外部不可预测。
Conclusion: 意识在受限意义上是循环递归架构的属性，而非优化目标；因果可学习性由 CLR 独立诊断，稳定与能动来自环境提供的可学习结构。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Fourier neural operator for real-time simulation of 3D dynamic urban microclimate
papers.abstract_en: Global urbanization has underscored the significance of urban microclimates for human comfort, health, and building/urban energy efficiency. They profoundly influence building design and urban planning as major environmental impacts. Understanding local microclimates is essential for cities to prepare for climate change and effectively implement resilience measures. However, analyzing urban microclimates requires considering a complex array of outdoor parameters within computational domains at the city scale over a longer period than indoors. As a result, numerical methods like Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) become computationally expensive when evaluating the impact of urban microclimates. The rise of deep learning techniques has opened new opportunities for accelerating the modeling of complex non-linear interactions and system dynamics. Recently, the Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) has been shown to be very promising in accelerating solving the Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) and modeling fluid dynamic systems. In this work, we apply the FNO network for real-time three-dimensional (3D) urban wind field simulation. The training and testing data are generated from CFD simulation of the urban area, based on the semi-Lagrangian approach and fractional stepping method to simulate urban microclimate features for modeling large-scale urban problems. Numerical experiments show that the FNO model can accurately reconstruct the instantaneous spatial velocity field. We further evaluate the trained FNO model on unseen data with different wind directions, and the results show that the FNO model can generalize well on different wind directions. More importantly, the FNO approach can make predictions within milliseconds on the graphics processing unit, making real-time simulation of 3D dynamic urban microclimate possible.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) 用于城市尺度三维风场的实时模拟，训练与测试数据来自基于 semi-Lagrangian 方法与 fractional stepping 的 CFD 仿真。数值实验显示 FNO 能准确重建瞬时空间速度场，并在未见过的风向上泛化良好，GPU 上毫秒级出结果，使 3D 动态城市微气候实时模拟成为可能。
Motivation: 城市微气候涉及城市场域、长时段的大量室外参数，CFD 数值求解计算代价过高，难以支撑建筑与城市规划中反复的风环境评估。
Method: 将 FNO 网络直接用于求解城市风场：训练/测试数据由城市场域 CFD 仿真生成，仿真采用 semi-Lagrangian approach 与 fractional stepping method；训练后在含不同风向的 unseen data 上测试泛化，并在 GPU 上计时推理。
Result: 数值实验表明 FNO 能准确重建瞬时空间速度场；在风向不同的未见数据上泛化良好；推理在 GPU 上于毫秒内完成，实现 3D 动态城市微气候的实时模拟。
Conclusion: FNO 可替代昂贵的 CFD 做城市三维风场的实时模拟，且对训练中未出现的风向具备泛化能力。
Relevance: 41

summary_sections.tldr: 把 Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) 用于城市尺度三维风场的实时模拟，训练与测试数据来自基于 semi-Lagrangian 方法与 fractional stepping 的 CFD 仿真。数值实验显示 FNO 能准确重建瞬时空间速度场，并在未见过的风向上泛化良好，GPU 上毫秒级出结果，使 3D 动态城市微气候实时模拟成为可能。
summary_sections.motivation: 城市微气候涉及城市场域、长时段的大量室外参数，CFD 数值求解计算代价过高，难以支撑建筑与城市规划中反复的风环境评估。
summary_sections.method: 将 FNO 网络直接用于求解城市风场：训练/测试数据由城市场域 CFD 仿真生成，仿真采用 semi-Lagrangian approach 与 fractional stepping method；训练后在含不同风向的 unseen data 上测试泛化，并在 GPU 上计时推理。
summary_sections.result: 数值实验表明 FNO 能准确重建瞬时空间速度场；在风向不同的未见数据上泛化良好；推理在 GPU 上于毫秒内完成，实现 3D 动态城市微气候的实时模拟。
summary_sections.conclusion: FNO 可替代昂贵的 CFD 做城市三维风场的实时模拟，且对训练中未出现的风向具备泛化能力。
